verses.name: Genesis 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1"/><title type="x-s">The Creation</title> <div sID="gen3" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1"/>In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth—

verses.name: Genesis 1:2
verses.text: Now<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the earth was formless and empty, and darkness <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God <transChange type="added">was</transChange> hovering over the surface of the waters.

verses.name: Genesis 1:3
verses.text: And God said, “Let there be light!” And there was light.

verses.name: Genesis 1:4
verses.text: And God saw the light, that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> good, and God caused <transChange type="added">there to be</transChange> a separation between the light and between the darkness.

verses.name: Genesis 1:5
verses.text: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first day.  <div eID="gen3" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2"/><div sID="gen4" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2"/>And God said, “Let there be a vaulted dome<note placement="foot">Or “expanse”</note> in the midst of the waters, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞let it cause a separation between the waters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “Let there be a separation made between waters to waters”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:7
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> God made the vaulted dome,<note placement="foot">Or “expanse”</note> and he caused a separation between the waters which were under the vaulted dome<note placement="foot">Or “expanse”</note> and between the waters which were over the vaulted dome.<note placement="foot">Or “expanse”</note> And it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:8
verses.text: And God called the vaulted dome<note placement="foot">Or “expanse”</note> “heaven.”<note placement="foot">Or “sky”</note> And there was evening, and there was morning, a second day.  <div eID="gen4" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3"/><div sID="gen5" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3"/>And God said, “Let the waters under heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> be gathered to one place, and let the dry ground appear.” And it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:10
verses.text: And God called the dry ground “earth,” and he called the collection of the waters “seas.” And God saw that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> good.

verses.name: Genesis 1:11
verses.text: And God said, “Let the earth produce green plants <transChange type="added">that will</transChange> bear seed—fruit trees bearing fruit <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in which there is seed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which its seed is in it”</note>—according to its<note placement="foot">Or “their”</note> kind, on the earth.” And it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:12
verses.text: And the earth brought forth green plants bearing seed according to its<note placement="foot">Or “their”</note> kind, and trees bearing fruit <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in which there was seed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which its seed is in it”</note> according to its<note placement="foot">Or “their”</note> kind. And God saw that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> good.

verses.name: Genesis 1:13
verses.text: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.  <div eID="gen5" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4"/><div sID="gen6" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4"/>And God said, “Let there be lights<note placement="foot">Or “light sources”</note> in the vaulted dome<note placement="foot">Or “expanse”</note> of heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to separate day from night⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to make a separation between the day and between the night”</note> and let them be as signs and for appointed times, and for days and years,

verses.name: Genesis 1:15
verses.text: and they shall be as lights<note placement="foot">Or “light sources”</note> in the vaulted dome<note placement="foot">Or “expanse”</note> of heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> to give light on the earth.” And it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:16
verses.text: And God made two lights,<note placement="foot">Or “light sources”</note> the greater light<note placement="foot">Or “light source”</note> to rule<note placement="foot">Literally “as the authority of”</note> the day and the smaller light<note placement="foot">Or “light source”</note> to rule<note placement="foot">Literally “as the authority of”</note> the night, and the stars.

verses.name: Genesis 1:17
verses.text: And God placed them in the vaulted dome<note placement="foot">Or “expanse”</note> of heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> to give light on the earth

verses.name: Genesis 1:18
verses.text: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞separate light from darkness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “make a separation between the light and between the darkness”</note> And God saw that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> good.

verses.name: Genesis 1:19
verses.text: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.  <div eID="gen6" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5"/><div sID="gen7" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5"/>And God said, “Let the waters swarm <transChange type="added">with</transChange> swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly over the earth across the face of the vaulted dome<note placement="foot">Or “expanse”</note> of heaven.<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:21
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> God created the great sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarm, according to their kind, and every bird with wings according to its<note placement="foot">Or “their”</note> kind. And God saw that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> good.

verses.name: Genesis 1:22
verses.text: And God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth.”

verses.name: Genesis 1:23
verses.text: And there was evening, and there was morning, a fifth day.  <div eID="gen7" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6"/><div sID="gen8" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6"/>And God said, “Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kind: cattle and moving things, and wild animals<note placement="foot">Literally “animals of the earth/land”</note> according to their kind.” And it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:25
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> God made wild animals<note placement="foot">Literally “animals of the earth/land”</note> according to their kind and the cattle according to their kind, and every creeping thing of the earth according to its<note placement="foot">Or “their”</note> kind. And God saw that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> good.  <div eID="gen8" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7"/><div sID="gen9" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7"/>And God said, “Let us make humankind in<note placement="foot">Or “as”</note> our image and according to<note placement="foot">Or “as”</note> our likeness, and let them rule over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of heaven,<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every moving thing that moves upon the earth.”

verses.name: Genesis 1:27
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> God created humankind in<note placement="foot">Or “as”</note> his image, in<note placement="foot">Or “as”</note> the likeness of God he created him,<note placement="foot">Or “it” collective: humankind</note> male and female he created them.

verses.name: Genesis 1:28
verses.text: And God blessed them, and God said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it, and rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of heaven,<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> and over every animal that moves upon the earth.”  <div eID="gen9" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8"/><div sID="gen10" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8"/>And God said, “Look—I am giving to you every plant <transChange type="added">that</transChange> bears seed which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the face of the whole earth, and every kind of tree <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that bears fruit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “which in it fruit of a tree bears seed”</note> They shall be yours as food.”

verses.name: Genesis 1:30
verses.text: And to every kind of animal of the earth and to every bird of heaven,<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> and to everything that moves upon the earth in which <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> life <transChange type="added">I am giving</transChange> every green plant as food.” And it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:31
verses.text: And God saw everything that he had made and, behold, <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> very good. And there was evening, and there was morning, a sixth day.  <chapter eID="Gen.1"/> <div eID="gen10" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:1
verses.text: And heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> and earth<note placement="foot">Or “the earth”</note> and all their array<note placement="foot">Or “host”</note> were finished.

verses.name: Genesis 2:2
verses.text: And on the seventh day God finished his work that he had done, and he rested on the seventh day from all his work that he had done.

verses.name: Genesis 2:3
verses.text: And God blessed the seventh day, and he sanctified<note placement="foot">Or “hallowed”</note> it, because on it he rested from all his work <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of creating that there was to do⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “which God created to do”</note>  <div eID="gen11" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9"/><title type="x-s">The Generations of Heaven and Earth</title> <div sID="gen12" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9"/>These are the generations<note placement="foot">Or “family records”</note> of heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> and earth<note placement="foot">Or “the earth”</note> when they were created, in the day that Yahweh God made earth and heaven<note placement="foot">Or “sky”</note>—

verses.name: Genesis 2:5
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before any plant of the field was⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and every plant of the field not yet was”</note> on earth, and before <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any plant of the field⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and every plant of the field not yet”</note> had sprung up, because Yahweh God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was no human being to cultivate the ground,

verses.name: Genesis 2:6
verses.text: but a stream <transChange type="added">would</transChange> rise from the earth and water the whole face of the ground—

verses.name: Genesis 2:7
verses.text: when<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> Yahweh God formed the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> dust from the ground, and he blew into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living creature.  <div eID="gen12" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10"/><div sID="gen13" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10"/>And Yahweh God planted a garden in Eden in the east, and there he put the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> whom he had formed.

verses.name: Genesis 2:9
verses.text: And Yahweh God caused to grow every tree <transChange type="added">that</transChange> was pleasing to the sight and good for food. And the tree of life <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in the midst of the garden, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞along with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.  <div eID="gen13" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11"/><div sID="gen14" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11"/>Now<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a river flowed out from Eden that watered the garden, and from there it diverged and became four branches.

verses.name: Genesis 2:11
verses.text: The name of the first <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the Pishon. It went around all the land of Havilah, where <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> gold.

verses.name: Genesis 2:12
verses.text: (The gold of that land <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good; bdellium and onyx stones <transChange type="added">are</transChange> there.)

verses.name: Genesis 2:13
verses.text: And the name of the second <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Gihon. It went around all the land of Cush.

verses.name: Genesis 2:14
verses.text: And the name of the third <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Tigris. It flows east of Assyria. And the fourth river <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the Euphrates.  <div eID="gen14" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12"/><div sID="gen15" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12"/>And Yahweh God took the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> and set him in the garden of Eden to cultivate it and to keep it.

verses.name: Genesis 2:16
verses.text: And Yahweh God commanded the man,<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> saying, “From every tree of the garden <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you may freely eat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “eating you may eat”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:17
verses.text: but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that you eat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of your eating”</note> from it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall surely die⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “dying you shall die”</note>  <div eID="gen15" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv13"/><div sID="gen16" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv13"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh God said, “it is not good that the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> is alone. I will make for him a helper <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as his counterpart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “as his opposite”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:19
verses.text: And out of the ground Yahweh God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the sky,<note placement="foot">Or “the heavens”</note> and he brought each to the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> to see what he would call it. And whatever the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> called that living creature <transChange type="added">was</transChange> its name.

verses.name: Genesis 2:20
verses.text: And the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞gave names⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “called names”</note> to every domesticated animal and to the birds of heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> and to all the wild animals.<note placement="foot">Literally “animals of the earth/land”</note> But for the man there was not found a helper <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as his counterpart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as his opposite”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:21
verses.text: And Yahweh God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man.<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> While<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the flesh where it had been⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the flesh in the place of it”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:22
verses.text: And Yahweh God fashioned the rib which he had taken from the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> into a woman and brought her to the man.<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:23
verses.text: And the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> said, <div eID="gen16" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞She is now⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “this one the time”</note> bone from my bones<l eID="gen18" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19"/>and flesh from my flesh;<l eID="gen19" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “this one”</note> shall be called ‘Woman,’<l eID="gen20" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she was taken⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “this one was taken”</note> from man.” <l eID="gen21" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv14"/><div sID="gen22" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv14"/>Therefore a man shall leave his father and his mother and shall cling to his wife, and they shall be as one flesh.

verses.name: Genesis 2:25
verses.text: And the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> and his wife, both of them, were naked, and they were not ashamed.  <chapter eID="Gen.2"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv15"/><title type="x-s">The Fall</title> <div sID="gen23" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv15"/>Now the serpent was more crafty than any other <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wild animal⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “animal of the field”</note> which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Did God indeed say, ‘You shall not eat from any tree in the garden’?”

verses.name: Genesis 3:2
verses.text: The woman said to the serpent, “From the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat,

verses.name: Genesis 3:3
verses.text: but from the tree that is in the midst of the garden, God said, ‘You shall not eat from it, nor shall you touch it, lest you die’.”

verses.name: Genesis 3:4
verses.text: But the serpent said to the woman, “You shall not surely die.

verses.name: Genesis 3:5
verses.text: For God knows that on the day you <transChange type="added">both</transChange> eat from it, then your eyes will be opened and you <transChange type="added">both</transChange> shall be like gods,<note placement="foot">The plural is in the context of v. <reference osisRef="Gen.3.22">22</reference> “one of us” and the plural suffix pronouns 〚“you all”〛 throughout the verse</note> knowing good and evil.”

verses.name: Genesis 3:6
verses.text: When<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the woman saw that the tree was good for food and that it was a delight to the eyes, and the tree was desirable to make one wise, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> she took from its fruit and she ate. And she gave <transChange type="added">it</transChange> also to her husband with her, and he ate.

verses.name: Genesis 3:7
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> naked. And they sewed together fig leaves and they made for themselves coverings.  <div eID="gen23" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv16"/><div sID="gen24" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv16"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> they heard the sound of Yahweh God walking in the garden <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the windy time of day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “at the wind of the day”</note> And the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh God among the trees of the garden.

verses.name: Genesis 3:9
verses.text: And Yahweh God called to the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> and said to him, “Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you?”

verses.name: Genesis 3:10
verses.text: And he replied,<note placement="foot">Literally “And he said”; “replied” distinguishes Adam as the speaker</note> “I heard the sound of you in the garden, and I was afraid because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> naked, so I hid myself.”

verses.name: Genesis 3:11
verses.text: Then he<note placement="foot">That is, Yahweh God</note> asked,<note placement="foot">Or “said”</note> “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the tree from which I forbade you to eat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “the tree which I commanded to not eat from it”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 3:12
verses.text: And the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> replied,<note placement="foot">Or “said”</note> “The woman whom you gave <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> with me—she gave to me from the tree and I ate.”

verses.name: Genesis 3:13
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh God said to the woman, “What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this you have done?” And the woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

verses.name: Genesis 3:14
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh God said to the serpent, <div eID="gen24" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26"/>“Because you have done this,<l eID="gen26" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27"/>you <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> cursed<l eID="gen27" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28"/>more than any domesticated animal<l eID="gen28" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen29"/>and more than any wild animal.<note placement="foot">Literally “animal of the earth/land”</note><l eID="gen29" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30"/>On your belly you shall go<l eID="gen30" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen31"/>and dust you shall eat<l eID="gen31" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen32"/>all the days of your life. <l eID="gen32" level="2"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv17"/><l level="1" sID="gen33"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv17"/>And I will put hostility<l eID="gen33" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen34"/>between you and between the woman,<l eID="gen34" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen35"/>and between your offspring<note placement="foot">Literally “seed”</note> and between her offspring;<note placement="foot">Literally “seed”</note><l eID="gen35" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen36"/>he will strike you <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> head,<l eID="gen36" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen37"/>and you will strike him <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> heel.” <l eID="gen37" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen25"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv18"/><div sID="gen38" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv18"/>To the woman he said, <div eID="gen38" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen39"/> <l level="1" sID="gen40"/>“I will greatly increase<l eID="gen40" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen41"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your pain in childbearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “your pain and your childbearing”</note><l eID="gen41" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen42"/>in pain you shall bear children.<l eID="gen42" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen43"/>And to your husband <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> your desire.<l eID="gen43" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen44"/>And he shall rule over you.” <l eID="gen44" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen39"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv19"/><div sID="gen45" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv19"/>And to Adam<note placement="foot">The noun lacks the definite article and is taken as a proper noun in this context</note> he said, “Because you listened to the voice of your wife and you ate from the tree <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from which I forbade you to eat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the tree which I commanded saying not to eat from it”</note> <div eID="gen45" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen46"/> <l level="1" sID="gen47"/>the ground <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> cursed on your account.<l eID="gen47" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen48"/>In pain you shall eat <transChange type="added">from</transChange> it<l eID="gen48" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen49"/>all the days of your life. <l eID="gen49" level="2"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv20"/><l level="1" sID="gen50"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv20"/>And thorns and thistles shall sprout for you,<l eID="gen50" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen51"/>and you shall eat the plants of the field. <l eID="gen51" level="2"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv21"/><l level="1" sID="gen52"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv21"/>By the sweat of your brow<note placement="foot">Literally “your face”</note><l eID="gen52" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen53"/>you shall eat bread,<l eID="gen53" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen54"/>until your return to the ground.<l eID="gen54" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen55"/>For from it you were taken;<l eID="gen55" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen56"/>for you are dust,<l eID="gen56" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen57"/>and to dust you shall return.” <l eID="gen57" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen46"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv22"/><div sID="gen58" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv22"/>And the man<note placement="foot">“The man” indicates the noun is singular and occurs with the definite article</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞named⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “called the name”</note> his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all life.

verses.name: Genesis 3:21
verses.text: And Yahweh God made for Adam<note placement="foot">The noun lacks the definite article and is taken as a proper noun in this context</note> and for his wife garments of skin, and he clothed them.  <div eID="gen58" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv23"/><div sID="gen59" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv23"/>And Yahweh God said, “Look—the man has become as one of us, to know good and evil. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What if⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And now lest”</note> he stretches out his hand and takes also from the tree of life and eats, and lives forever?”

verses.name: Genesis 3:23
verses.text: And Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

verses.name: Genesis 3:24
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he drove the man out, and placed cherubim east of the garden of Eden, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a flaming, turning sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a flame of the sword which was turning”</note> to guard the way to the tree of life.  <chapter eID="Gen.3"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv24"/><title type="x-s">Cain and Abel</title> <div sID="gen60" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv24"/>Now Adam knew<note placement="foot">Or “had intercourse with”</note> Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain. And she said, “I have given birth to a man with <transChange type="added">the help of</transChange> Yahweh.”

verses.name: Genesis 4:2
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Then she bore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And she added to bear”</note> his brother Abel. And Abel became a keeper of sheep, and Cain became a tiller of the ground.

verses.name: Genesis 4:3
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the course of time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it came to pass at the end of days”</note> Cain brought an offering from the fruit of the ground to Yahweh,

verses.name: Genesis 4:4
verses.text: and Abel also brought <transChange type="added">an offering</transChange> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the choicest firstlings of his flock⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from the firstlings of his flock and from their fat”</note> And Yahweh looked with favor to Abel and to his offering,

verses.name: Genesis 4:5
verses.text: but to Cain and to his offering he did not look with favor. And Cain became very angry, and his face fell.

verses.name: Genesis 4:6
verses.text: And Yahweh said to Cain, “Why are you angry, and why is your face fallen?

verses.name: Genesis 4:7
verses.text: If you do well <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will I not accept you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “a lifting up”; this is an abbreviation of the Hebrew idiom “to lift up the face,” which means “to accept or regard with favor”</note> But if you do not do well, sin is crouching at the door. And its desire <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for you, but you must rule over it.”  <div eID="gen60" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv25"/><div sID="gen61" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv25"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let us go out into the field.”<note placement="foot">This phrase is not present in the Hebrew; it is supplied in other versions Samaritan, Septuagint, Syriac, Vulgate</note> And when they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.

verses.name: Genesis 4:9
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh said to Cain, “Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Abel your brother?” And he said, “I do not know; am I my brother’s keeper?”

verses.name: Genesis 4:10
verses.text: And he said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood is crying out to me from the ground.

verses.name: Genesis 4:11
verses.text: So now you are cursed from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive the blood of your brother from your hand.

verses.name: Genesis 4:12
verses.text: When you till the ground <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it shall no longer yield its strength to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it shall not add to give its strength to you”</note> You shall be a wanderer and a fugitive on the earth.”

verses.name: Genesis 4:13
verses.text: And Cain said to Yahweh, “My punishment <transChange type="added">is</transChange> greater than <transChange type="added">I can</transChange> bear.

verses.name: Genesis 4:14
verses.text: Look, you have driven me out today from the face of the ground, and from your face I must hide. I will be a wanderer and a fugitive on the earth, and it will happen that whoever finds me will kill me.”

verses.name: Genesis 4:15
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh said to him, “Therefore, whoever kills Cain will be avenged sevenfold.” Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh put a sign on Cain so that whoever found him would not kill him.

verses.name: Genesis 4:16
verses.text: And Cain went out from the presence of Yahweh, and he settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.  <div eID="gen61" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv26"/><div sID="gen62" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv26"/>And Cain knew<note placement="foot">Or “had intercourse with”</note> his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Enoch. And when he built a city <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he named the city after his son, Enoch⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he called the name of the city as the name of his son, Enoch”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:18
verses.text: And to Enoch was born Irad, and Irad fathered Mehujael, and Mehujael fathered Methushael, and Methushael fathered Lamech.

verses.name: Genesis 4:19
verses.text: And Lamech took to himself two wives.<note placement="foot">Or “women”</note> The name of the first <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Adah, and the name of the second <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Zillah.

verses.name: Genesis 4:20
verses.text: And Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and <transChange type="added">those who have</transChange> livestock.

verses.name: Genesis 4:21
verses.text: And the name of his brother <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Jubal; he was the father of all who play stringed instruments and wind instruments.

verses.name: Genesis 4:22
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Zillah also gave birth to Tubal-Cain who forged all <transChange type="added">kinds of</transChange> tools of bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal-Cain <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Naamah.  <div eID="gen62" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv27"/><div sID="gen63" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv27"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Lamech said to his wives, <div eID="gen63" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen64"/> <l level="1" sID="gen65"/>“Adah and Zillah, listen to my voice;<l eID="gen65" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen66"/>O wives of Lamech, hear my words.<l eID="gen66" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen67"/>I have killed a man for wounding me,<l eID="gen67" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen68"/>Even a young man for injuring me. <l eID="gen68" level="2"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv28"/><l level="1" sID="gen69"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv28"/>If Cain is avenged sevenfold,<l eID="gen69" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen70"/>Then Lamech <transChange type="added">will be avenged</transChange> seventy and seven <transChange type="added">times</transChange>. <l eID="gen70" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen64"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv29"/><div sID="gen71" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv29"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Adam knew<note placement="foot">Or “had intercourse with”</note> his wife again, and she gave birth to a son. And she called his name Seth, for <transChange type="added">she said</transChange> “God has appointed to me another child in the place of Abel, because Cain killed him.”

verses.name: Genesis 4:26
verses.text: And as for Seth, he also fathered a son, and he called his name Enosh. At that time he<note placement="foot">Or “humankind,” if the 3ms form is considered collective</note> began to call on the name of Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Gen.4"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv30"/><title type="x-s">Adam’s Descendants to Noah</title> <div sID="gen72" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv30"/>This is the record of the generations<note placement="foot">Or “family records”</note> of Adam. When<note placement="foot">Literally “On the day”</note> God created Adam,<note placement="foot">Or “humankind”</note> he made him in the likeness of God.

verses.name: Genesis 5:2
verses.text: Male and female he created them. And he blessed them. And he called their name “Humankind” when<note placement="foot">Literally “on the day”</note> they were created.

verses.name: Genesis 5:3
verses.text: And when Adam had lived one hundred and thirty years, he fathered a child in his likeness, according to his image. And he called his name Seth.

verses.name: Genesis 5:4
verses.text: And the days of Adam after he fathered Seth were eight hundred years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 5:5
verses.text: And all the days of Adam which he lived were nine hundred and thirty years, and he died.  <div eID="gen72" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv31"/><div sID="gen73" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv31"/>When<note placement="foot">Literally “On the day”</note> Seth had lived one hundred and five years, he fathered Enosh.

verses.name: Genesis 5:7
verses.text: And after Seth had fathered Enosh he lived eight hundred and seven years, and fathered sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 5:8
verses.text: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.  <div eID="gen73" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv32"/><div sID="gen74" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv32"/>When<note placement="foot">Literally “On the day”</note> Enosh lived ninety years, he fathered Kenan.

verses.name: Genesis 5:10
verses.text: And after Enosh fathered Kenan he lived eight hundred and fifteen years, and fathered sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 5:11
verses.text: And all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years, and he died.  <div eID="gen74" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv33"/><div sID="gen75" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv33"/>When<note placement="foot">Literally “On the day”</note> Kenan had lived seventy years, he fathered Mahalalel.

verses.name: Genesis 5:13
verses.text: And after Kenan had fathered Mahalalel, he lived eight hundred and forty years, and fathered sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 5:14
verses.text: And all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.  <div eID="gen75" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv34"/><div sID="gen76" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv34"/>When<note placement="foot">Literally “On the day”</note> Mahalalel had lived sixty-five years, he fathered Jared.

verses.name: Genesis 5:16
verses.text: And after Mahalalel had fathered Jared, he lived eight hundred and thirty years, and fathered sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 5:17
verses.text: And all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he died.  <div eID="gen76" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv35"/><div sID="gen77" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv35"/>When<note placement="foot">Literally “On the day”</note> Jared had lived one hundred and sixty-two years, he fathered Enoch.

verses.name: Genesis 5:19
verses.text: And after Jared had fathered Enoch, he lived eight hundred years, and fathered sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 5:20
verses.text: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he died.  <div eID="gen77" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv36"/><div sID="gen78" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv36"/>When<note placement="foot">Literally “On the day”</note> Enoch had lived sixty-five years, he fathered Methuselah.

verses.name: Genesis 5:22
verses.text: And Enoch walked with God after he fathered Methuselah three hundred years, and fathered sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 5:23
verses.text: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.

verses.name: Genesis 5:24
verses.text: And Enoch walked with God, and he was no more, for God took him.  <div eID="gen78" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv37"/><div sID="gen79" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv37"/>When<note placement="foot">Literally “On the day”</note> Methuselah had lived one hundred and eighty-seven years, he fathered Lamech.

verses.name: Genesis 5:26
verses.text: And after Methuselah had fathered Lamech, he lived seven hundred and eighty-two years, and fathered sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 5:27
verses.text: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred and sixty-nine years, and he died.  <div eID="gen79" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv38"/><div sID="gen80" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv38"/>When<note placement="foot">Literally “On the day”</note> Lamech had lived one hundred and eighty-two years, he fathered a son.

verses.name: Genesis 5:29
verses.text: And he called his name Noah, saying, “This one <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall relieve us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shall comfort us”</note> from our work, and from the hard labor of our hands, from the ground which Yahweh had cursed.

verses.name: Genesis 5:30
verses.text: And after Lamech had fathered Noah he lived five hundred and ninety-five years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 5:31
verses.text: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy-seven years, and he died.  <div eID="gen80" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv39"/><div sID="gen81" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv39"/>When<note placement="foot">Literally “On the day”</note> Noah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was five hundred years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “was a son of five hundred years”</note> Noah fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth.  <chapter eID="Gen.5"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv40"/><title type="x-s">Prelude to the Flood</title> <div sID="gen82" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv40"/>And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, when humankind began to multiply on the face of the ground, daughters were born to them.

verses.name: Genesis 6:2
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the sons of God saw the daughters of humankind, that they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> beautiful. And they took for themselves wives from all that they chose.

verses.name: Genesis 6:3
verses.text: And Yahweh said, “My Spirit shall not abide with humankind forever in that he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> also flesh. And his days <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> one hundred and twenty years.”

verses.name: Genesis 6:4
verses.text: The Nephilim <transChange type="added">were</transChange> upon the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God went into the daughters of humankind, and they bore children to them.  <div eID="gen82" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv41"/><div sID="gen83" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv41"/>And Yahweh saw that the evil of humankind <transChange type="added">was</transChange> great upon the earth, and every inclination of the thoughts of his heart <transChange type="added">was</transChange> always<note placement="foot">Literally “every day”</note> only evil.

verses.name: Genesis 6:6
verses.text: And Yahweh regretted that he had made humankind on the earth, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he was grieved in his heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he was grieved to his heart”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 6:7
verses.text: And Yahweh said, “I will destroy humankind whom I created from upon the face of the earth, from humankind, to animals, to creeping things, and to the birds of heaven,<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> for I regret that I have made them.”

verses.name: Genesis 6:8
verses.text: But Noah found favor in the eyes of Yahweh.  <div eID="gen83" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv42"/><div sID="gen84" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv42"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the generations<note placement="foot">Or “family records”</note> of Noah. Noah <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a righteous man, without defect in his generations. Noah walked with God.

verses.name: Genesis 6:10
verses.text: And Noah fathered three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.name: Genesis 6:11
verses.text: And the earth <transChange type="added">was</transChange> corrupted before God, and the earth was filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> violence.

verses.name: Genesis 6:12
verses.text: And God saw the earth, and behold, it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 6:13
verses.text: And God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh <transChange type="added">has</transChange> come before me, for the earth was filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> violence because of them. Now, look, I <transChange type="added">am going</transChange> to destroy them <transChange type="added">along</transChange> with the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 6:14
verses.text: Make for yourself an ark of cypress wood; you must make the ark <transChange type="added">with</transChange> rooms, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you must cover it with pitch, inside and outside.

verses.name: Genesis 6:15
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> how you must make it: the length of the ark, three hundred cubits; its width fifty cubits; its height, thirty cubits.

verses.name: Genesis 6:16
verses.text: You must make a roof for the ark, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞finish it to a cubit above⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to one cubit you must finish it from above”</note> And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> the door of the ark, you must put <transChange type="added">it</transChange> in its side. You must make it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a lower, second, and a third <transChange type="added">deck</transChange>.  <div eID="gen84" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv43"/><div sID="gen85" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv43"/>And I, behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to bring the flood waters over the earth to destroy all flesh in which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the breath of life from under the heaven;<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> everything that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the earth shall perish.

verses.name: Genesis 6:18
verses.text: And I will establish my covenant with you, and you must go into the ark—you, and your sons, and your wife, and the wives of your sons with you.

verses.name: Genesis 6:19
verses.text: And of every living thing, from all flesh, you must bring two from every <transChange type="added">kind</transChange> into the ark to keep <transChange type="added">them</transChange> alive with you; they shall be male and female.

verses.name: Genesis 6:20
verses.text: From the birds according to their<note placement="foot">Or “its”</note> kind, and from the animals according to their<note placement="foot">Or “its”</note> kind, from every creeping thing on the ground according to its<note placement="foot">Or “their”</note> kind—two from every kind shall come to you to keep <transChange type="added">them</transChange> alive.

verses.name: Genesis 6:21
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> you, take for yourself from every kind of food that is eaten. And you must gather <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to yourself. And it shall be for you and for them for food.”

verses.name: Genesis 6:22
verses.text: And Noah did according to all that God commanded him; thus he did.  <chapter eID="Gen.6"/> <div eID="gen85" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 7:1
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh said to Noah, “Go—you and all your household—into the ark, for I have seen you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> righteous before me in this generation.

verses.name: Genesis 7:2
verses.text: From all the clean animals you must take for yourself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞seven pairs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “seven, seven”</note> a male and its mate. And from the animals that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not clean <transChange type="added">you must take</transChange> two, a male and its mate,

verses.name: Genesis 7:3
verses.text: as well as from the birds of heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞seven pairs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “seven, seven”</note> male and female, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to keep their kind alive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to keep seed alive”</note> on the face of the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 7:4
verses.text: For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within seven days⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to seven days still”</note> I will send rain upon the earth <transChange type="added">for</transChange> forty days and forty nights. And I will blot out all the living creatures that I have made from upon the face of the ground.”

verses.name: Genesis 7:5
verses.text: And Noah did according to all that Yahweh commanded him.  <div eID="gen86" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv44"/><title type="x-s">The Flood</title> <div sID="gen87" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv44"/>Noah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was six hundred years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was a son of six hundred years”</note> when<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the flood waters came upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 7:7
verses.text: And Noah and his sons and his wife, and the wives of his sons with him, went into the ark because of the waters of the flood.

verses.name: Genesis 7:8
verses.text: Of clean animals, and of animals which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not clean, and of the birds, and everything that creeps upon the ground,

verses.name: Genesis 7:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞two of each⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “two, two”</note> went to Noah, into the ark, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.

verses.name: Genesis 7:10
verses.text: And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> after seven days the waters of the flood came over the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 7:11
verses.text: In the six hundredth year of the life of Noah, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month—on that day all the springs of the great deep were split open, and the windows of heaven were opened.

verses.name: Genesis 7:12
verses.text: And the rain came upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

verses.name: Genesis 7:13
verses.text: On this same day, Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and the wife of Noah and the three wives of his sons with them, went into the ark,

verses.name: Genesis 7:14
verses.text: they and all the living creatures according to their<note placement="foot">Or “its”</note> kind, and all the domesticated animals according to their<note placement="foot">Or “its”</note> kind, and all the creatures that creep upon the earth according to their<note placement="foot">Or “its”</note> kind, all the birds according to their<note placement="foot">Or “its”</note> kind, every winged creature.

verses.name: Genesis 7:15
verses.text: And they came to Noah to the ark, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞two of each⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “two, two”</note> from every living thing in which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the breath of life.

verses.name: Genesis 7:16
verses.text: And those that came, male and female, of every living thing, came as God had commanded him. And Yahweh shut the door behind him.

verses.name: Genesis 7:17
verses.text: And the flood came forty days and forty nights upon the earth. And the waters increased, and lifted the ark, and it rose up from the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 7:18
verses.text: And the waters prevailed and increased greatly upon the earth. And the ark went upon the surface<note placement="foot">Hebrew “face”</note> of the waters.

verses.name: Genesis 7:19
verses.text: And the waters prevailed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞overwhelmingly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “very very”</note> upon the earth, and they covered all the high mountains which were under the entire heaven.<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 7:20
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The waters swelled fifteen cubits above the mountains, covering them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Fifteen cubits above the waters swelled, and they covered the mountains”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 7:21
verses.text: And every living thing that moved on the earth perished—the birds, and the domesticated animals, and the wild animals, and everything that swarmed on the earth, and all humankind.

verses.name: Genesis 7:22
verses.text: Everything in whose nostrils <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the breath of life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a breath of spirit of life”</note> among all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on dry land, died.

verses.name: Genesis 7:23
verses.text: And he<note placement="foot">In context, God</note> blotted out every living thing upon the surface of the ground, from humankind, to animals, to creeping things, and to the birds of heaven;<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> they were blotted out from the earth. Only Noah and those who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him in the ark remained.

verses.name: Genesis 7:24
verses.text: And the waters prevailed over the earth one hundred and fifty days.  <chapter eID="Gen.7"/>

verses.name: Genesis 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv45"/><title type="x-s">The Flood Subsides</title> <div sID="gen88" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv45"/>And God remembered Noah and all the wild animals, and all the domesticated animals that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him in the ark. And God caused a wind to blow<note placement="foot">Or “go”</note> over the earth, and the waters subsided.

verses.name: Genesis 8:2
verses.text: And the fountains of the deep and the windows of the heavens<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> were closed, and the rain from the heavens<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> was restrained.

verses.name: Genesis 8:3
verses.text: And the waters receded from the earth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞gradually⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “going and returning”</note> and the waters abated at the end of one hundred and fifty days.

verses.name: Genesis 8:4
verses.text: And the ark came to rest in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the mountains of Ararat.

verses.name: Genesis 8:5
verses.text: And the waters <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continued to recede⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “going and receding”</note> to the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first of the month, the tops of the mountains appeared.

verses.name: Genesis 8:6
verses.text: And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> at the end of forty days Noah opened the window of the ark that he had made.

verses.name: Genesis 8:7
verses.text: And he sent out a<note placement="foot">Or “the”</note> raven;<note placement="foot">Or “crow”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it went to and fro⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it went out, going out and returning”</note> until the waters were dried up from upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 8:8
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he sent out a<note placement="foot">Or “the”</note> dove⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and he sent out a dove from him”</note> to see <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> the waters had subsided from upon the ground.

verses.name: Genesis 8:9
verses.text: But the dove did not find a resting place for the sole of her foot, and she returned to him into the ark, for the waters <transChange type="added">were still</transChange> on the face of the earth. And he stretched out his hand and took her, and brought her to himself into the ark.

verses.name: Genesis 8:10
verses.text: And he waited another seven days, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞again he sent out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he added to send”</note> the dove from the ark.

verses.name: Genesis 8:11
verses.text: And the dove came to him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the evening⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at the time of the evening”</note> and behold, a freshly-picked olive tree leaf <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in her mouth. And Noah knew that the waters had subsided from upon the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 8:12
verses.text: And he waited <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞seven more days⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “again another seven days”</note> and he sent out the dove. But it did not return again to him.

verses.name: Genesis 8:13
verses.text: And it happened that, in the six hundred and first year, in the first <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, on the first <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the month, the waters dried up from upon the earth. And Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked. And behold, the face of the ground was dried up.

verses.name: Genesis 8:14
verses.text: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

verses.name: Genesis 8:15
verses.text: And God spoke to Noah, saying:

verses.name: Genesis 8:16
verses.text: “Go out from the ark, you and your wife, and your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

verses.name: Genesis 8:17
verses.text: Bring out with you all the living things which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with you, from all the living creatures—birds, and animals, and everything that creeps on the earth, and let them swarm on the earth and be fruitful and multiply on the earth.”

verses.name: Genesis 8:18
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Noah went out, with<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> his sons and his wife, and the wives of his sons with him.

verses.name: Genesis 8:19
verses.text: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> everything <transChange type="added">that</transChange> moves upon the earth, according to its families, went out from the ark.

verses.name: Genesis 8:20
verses.text: And Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and he took from all the clean animals and from all the clean birds, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

verses.name: Genesis 8:21
verses.text: And Yahweh smelled the soothing fragrance, and Yahweh said <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to his heart”</note> “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Never again will I curse⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will not add to curse again”</note> the ground for the sake of humankind, because the inclination of the heart of humankind is evil from his youth. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Nor will I ever again destroy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And I will not add again to destroy”</note> all life as I have done.

verses.name: Genesis 8:22
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As long as the earth endures⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “While all the days of the earth”</note> seed and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will not cease.  <chapter eID="Gen.8"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv46"/><title type="x-s">God’s Covenant with Noah and Humankind</title> <div sID="gen89" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv46"/>And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 9:2
verses.text: And fear of you and dread of you shall be upon every animal of the earth, and on every bird of heaven,<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> on everything that moves upon the ground, and on all the fish of the sea. Into your hand they shall be given.

verses.name: Genesis 9:3
verses.text: Every moving thing that lives shall be for you as food. As <transChange type="added">I gave</transChange> the green plants to you, I have <transChange type="added">now</transChange> given you everything.

verses.name: Genesis 9:4
verses.text: Only you shall not eat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞raw flesh with blood in it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “flesh with its life, its blood”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 9:5
verses.text: And<note placement="foot">Or “only”; the same word that occurs at the beginning of v. <reference osisRef="Gen.9.4">4</reference></note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your lifeblood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your blood belonging to your life”</note> I will require; from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every animal⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the hand of every animal”</note> I will require it. And from the hand of humankind, from the hand of <transChange type="added">each</transChange> man to his brother I will require the life of humankind.  <div eID="gen89" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv47"/><lg sID="gen90"/> <l level="1" sID="gen91"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv47"/>“<transChange type="added">As for</transChange> the one shedding the blood of humankind,<l eID="gen91" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen92"/>by humankind his blood shall be shed,<l eID="gen92" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen93"/>for God made humankind in his own image. <l eID="gen93" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen90"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv48"/><div sID="gen94" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv48"/>“And you, be fruitful and multiply, swarm on the earth and multiply in it.”

verses.name: Genesis 9:8
verses.text: And God said to Noah and to his sons with him,

verses.name: Genesis 9:9
verses.text: “As for me, behold, I am establishing my covenant with you and with your seed after you,

verses.name: Genesis 9:10
verses.text: and with every living creature that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with you—the birds, the animals, and every animal of the earth with you, from all <transChange type="added">that</transChange> came out of the ark to all the animals of the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 9:11
verses.text: I am establishing my covenant with you, that never again will all flesh be cut off by the waters of a flood, nor will there ever be a flood that destroys the earth.”

verses.name: Genesis 9:12
verses.text: And God said, “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the sign of the covenant that I am making between me and you, and between every living creature that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with you for future generations.

verses.name: Genesis 9:13
verses.text: My bow I have set in the clouds, and it shall be for a sign of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> covenant between me and between the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 9:14
verses.text: And when I make clouds appear over the earth the bow shall be seen in the clouds.

verses.name: Genesis 9:15
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> I will remember my covenant that is between me and you, and between every living creature, with all flesh. And the waters of a flood will never again <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cause the destruction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “be to destroy”</note> of all flesh.

verses.name: Genesis 9:16
verses.text: The bow shall be in the clouds, and I will see it, so as to remember <transChange type="added">the</transChange> everlasting covenant between God and between every living creature, with all flesh that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon the earth.”

verses.name: Genesis 9:17
verses.text: And God said to Noah, “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the sign of the covenant which I am establishing between me and all flesh that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon the earth.  <div eID="gen94" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv49"/><title type="x-s">Noah’s Descendants</title> <div sID="gen95" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv49"/>Now<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the sons of Noah who came out of the ark <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Shem, Ham, and Japheth. (Ham <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the father of Canaan.)

verses.name: Genesis 9:19
verses.text: These three <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Noah, and from these <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the whole earth was populated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all the earth branched out”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 9:20
verses.text: And Noah began <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> a man of the ground, and he planted a vineyard.

verses.name: Genesis 9:21
verses.text: And he drank some of the wine and became drunk, and he exposed himself in the midst of his tent.

verses.name: Genesis 9:22
verses.text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and he told his two brothers outside.

verses.name: Genesis 9:23
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Shem and Japheth took a garment, and the two of them put it on their shoulders and, walking backward, they covered the nakedness of their father. And their faces were turned backward, so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they did not see the nakedness of their father.

verses.name: Genesis 9:24
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Noah awoke from his drunkenness,<note placement="foot">Or “his wine”</note> and he knew what his youngest son had done to him.

verses.name: Genesis 9:25
verses.text: And he said, <div eID="gen95" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen96"/> <l level="1" sID="gen97"/>“Cursed <transChange type="added">be</transChange> Canaan,<l eID="gen97" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen98"/>a slave of slaves he shall be to his brothers.” <l eID="gen98" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen96"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv50"/><div sID="gen99" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv50"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he said, <div eID="gen99" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen100"/> <l level="1" sID="gen101"/>“Blessed <transChange type="added">be</transChange> Yahweh, the God of Shem,<l eID="gen101" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen102"/>and let Canaan be a slave to them. <l eID="gen102" level="2"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv51"/><l level="1" sID="gen103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv51"/>May God make space for Japheth,<l eID="gen103" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen104"/>and let him dwell in the tents of Shem,<l eID="gen104" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen105"/>and let Canaan be a slave for him.” <l eID="gen105" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen100"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv52"/><div sID="gen106" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv52"/>And Noah lived three hundred and fifty years after the flood.

verses.name: Genesis 9:29
verses.text: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years, and he died.  <chapter eID="Gen.9"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv53"/><title type="x-s">The Descendants of the Sons of Noah</title> <div sID="gen107" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv53"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the generations<note placement="foot">Or “family records”</note> of the sons of Noah—Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> were born to them after the flood.

verses.name: Genesis 10:2
verses.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.name: Genesis 10:3
verses.text: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.name: Genesis 10:4
verses.text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.name: Genesis 10:5
verses.text: From these the coastland peoples spread out through their lands, each according to his own language by their own families, in their nations.  <div eID="gen107" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv54"/><div sID="gen108" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv54"/>And the sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put, and Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 10:7
verses.text: And the sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.name: Genesis 10:8
verses.text: And Cush fathered Nimrod. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He was the first on earth to be a mighty warrior⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “He began to be a mighty warrior on the earth”</note>

verses.name: Genesis 10:9
verses.text: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it was said, “Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before Yahweh.”

verses.name: Genesis 10:10
verses.text: Now,<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the beginning of his kingdom <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Babel, Erech, Akkad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

verses.name: Genesis 10:11
verses.text: From that land he went out <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Assyria, and he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,

verses.name: Genesis 10:12
verses.text: Resen between Nineveh and Calah; that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the great city.

verses.name: Genesis 10:13
verses.text: And Egypt fathered Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

verses.name: Genesis 10:14
verses.text: Pathrusim, and Casluhim (from whom the Philistines came), and Caphtorim.  <div eID="gen108" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv55"/><div sID="gen109" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv55"/>Canaan fathered Sidon, his firstborn, and Heth,

verses.name: Genesis 10:16
verses.text: and the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

verses.name: Genesis 10:17
verses.text: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

verses.name: Genesis 10:18
verses.text: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

verses.name: Genesis 10:19
verses.text: And the territory of the Canaanites <transChange type="added">was</transChange> from Sidon <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the direction of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in your going”</note> Gerar as far as Gaza, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the direction of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in your going”</note> Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.

verses.name: Genesis 10:20
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons” (“descendants” was chosen since the proper names in this section are gentilic in form—that is, they indicate one’s place of origin—and have the definite article)</note> of Ham, according to their families and their languages, in their lands, and in their nations.  <div eID="gen109" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv56"/><div sID="gen110" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv56"/>And to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the older brother of Japheth, <transChange type="added">children</transChange> were also born.

verses.name: Genesis 10:22
verses.text: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.

verses.name: Genesis 10:23
verses.text: And the sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

verses.name: Genesis 10:24
verses.text: And Arphaxad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.

verses.name: Genesis 10:25
verses.text: And to Eber two sons were born. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided, and the name of his brother <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Joktan.

verses.name: Genesis 10:26
verses.text: And Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

verses.name: Genesis 10:27
verses.text: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

verses.name: Genesis 10:28
verses.text: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

verses.name: Genesis 10:29
verses.text: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Joktan.

verses.name: Genesis 10:30
verses.text: And their dwelling <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞extended from⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was from”</note> Mesha <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the direction of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in your going”</note> Sephar <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the hill country of the east.

verses.name: Genesis 10:31
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the sons of Shem, according to their families, according to their languages, in their lands, and according to their nations.  <div eID="gen110" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv57"/><div sID="gen111" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv57"/>These are the families of the sons of Noah, according to their generations<note placement="foot">Or “family records”</note> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> in their nations. And from these the nations spread abroad on the earth after the flood.  <chapter eID="Gen.10"/>

verses.name: Genesis 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv58"/><title type="x-s">The Tower of Babel</title> <div sID="gen112" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv58"/>Now<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the whole earth <transChange type="added">had</transChange> one language and the same words.

verses.name: Genesis 11:2
verses.text: And as people migrated<note placement="foot">Or “set out”</note> from the east they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.

verses.name: Genesis 11:3
