verses.text: And a cubit <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from one side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from this”</note> and a cubit <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from the other side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from this”</note> in the surplus in the length of the curtains of the tent will be hung over the sides of the tabernacle <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞equally⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from this and from this”</note> to cover it.  <div eID="gen576" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv403"/><div sID="gen577" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv403"/>“And you will make a covering for the tent of red-dyed ram skins and a covering of fine leather <transChange type="added">to go</transChange> above.  <div eID="gen577" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv404"/><div sID="gen578" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv404"/>“And you will make the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> for the tabernacle of acacia wood as uprights.<note placement="foot">Literally “standing”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:16
verses.text: The length of the frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> will be ten cubits, and the width of the one frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> one and a half cubits.

verses.name: Exodus 26:17
verses.text: You will make two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> for the one frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> for joining <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each to another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a woman to her sister”</note> and likewise for all the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 26:18
verses.text: And you will make the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> for the tabernacle with twenty frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞south⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “south southward”</note> side.

verses.name: Exodus 26:19
verses.text: And you will make forty silver bases under the twenty frames,<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> with two bases under the one frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> for its two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> and two bases under the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞next⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one”</note> frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> for its two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:20
verses.text: And for the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> twenty frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:21
verses.text: and their forty silver bases, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> two bases under the one frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> and two bases under the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞next⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one”</note> frame.<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note>  <div eID="gen578" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv405"/><div sID="gen579" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv405"/>“And for the rear of the tabernacle <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “westward,” literally “seaward,” toward the Mediterranean Sea</note> you will make six frames.<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:23
verses.text: And you will make two frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> for the tabernacle corners at the rear.

verses.name: Exodus 26:24
verses.text: They will be double at the bottom, and they will be completely together on its top to the one ring; it will be likewise for the two of them; they will be for the two corners.

verses.name: Exodus 26:25
verses.text: And there will be eight frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> and their silver bases, sixteen bases, with two bases under the one frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> and two bases under the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞next⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one”</note> frame.<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note>  <div eID="gen579" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv406"/><div sID="gen580" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv406"/>“You will make five bars of acacia wood for the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> on the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.name: Exodus 26:27
verses.text: and five bars for the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> on the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> on the side of the tabernacle at the rear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Or “westward,” literally “seaward,” toward the Mediterranean Sea</note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:28
verses.text: And the bar in the middle, in the midst of the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> <transChange type="added">will</transChange> run from end to end.

verses.name: Exodus 26:29
verses.text: And you will overlay the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> with gold, and you will make their rings of gold as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “houses”</note> for the bars, and you will overlay the bars with gold.

verses.name: Exodus 26:30
verses.text: And you will erect the tabernacle according to its plan, which you have been shown on the mountain.  <div eID="gen580" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv407"/><div sID="gen581" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv407"/>“And you will make a curtain of blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and finely twisted linen, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of a skilled craftsman; he will make it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> cherubim.

verses.name: Exodus 26:32
verses.text: And you will put it on four acacia pillars overlaid with gold <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their gold hooks on four silver bases.

verses.name: Exodus 26:33
verses.text: And you will put the curtain under the clasps, and you will bring the ark of the testimony there inside the curtain, and the curtain will separate for you between the holy and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞most holy place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “holy place of the holiness”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:34
verses.text: And you will put the atonement cover on the ark of the testimony in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞most holy place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “holy place of the holiness”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:35
verses.text: And you will place the table outside the curtain and the lampstand opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle, and you will put the table on the north side.  <div eID="gen581" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv408"/><div sID="gen582" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv408"/>“And you will make for the entrance of the tent a screen of blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and finely twisted linen, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of an embroiderer.

verses.name: Exodus 26:37
verses.text: And you will make for the screen five acacia pillars, and you will overlay them with gold <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their gold hooks, and you will cast for them five bronze bases.  <chapter eID="Exod.26"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv409"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Making the Bronze Altar</title> <div sID="gen583" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv409"/>“And you will make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide; the altar will be square, and its height <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> three cubits.

verses.name: Exodus 27:2
verses.text: And you will make its horns on its four corners; its horns will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of one piece with it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from it”</note> and you will overlay it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 27:3
verses.text: And you will make its pots for removing its fat-soaked ashes and its shovels and its sprinkling bowls and its forks<note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="1Sam.2.13">1 Samuel 2:13 </reference>mentions a fork with “three teeth” used by priests</note> and its fire pans; you will make all its equipment <transChange type="added">with</transChange> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 27:4
verses.text: And you will make for it a grating, a work of bronze network, and you will make on the network four bronze rings on its four ends.

verses.name: Exodus 27:5
verses.text: And you will put it under the ledge of the altar, below, and the network will be up to the middle of the altar.

verses.name: Exodus 27:6
verses.text: And you will make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and you will overlay them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 27:7
verses.text: And the poles will be put into the rings, and the poles will be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

verses.name: Exodus 27:8
verses.text: You will make it hollow with boards. As it was shown you on the mountain, so they will do.  <div eID="gen583" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv410"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Making the Courtyard</title> <div sID="gen584" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv410"/>“You will make the courtyard of the tabernacle; for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞south⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “south southward”</note> side <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> hangings for the courtyard of finely twisted linen, one hundred cubits long for the one side.

verses.name: Exodus 27:10
verses.text: And its twenty pillars and their twenty bases <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> silver.

verses.name: Exodus 27:11
verses.text: And likewise for the north side along the length <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> hangings one hundred cubits long; and its twenty pillars and their bases <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> silver.

verses.name: Exodus 27:12
verses.text: And the width of the courtyard for the west<note placement="foot">Or “sea”</note> side <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> hangings of fifty cubits, their ten pillars and their ten bases.

verses.name: Exodus 27:13
verses.text: And the width of the courtyard for the east side, toward sunrise, <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> fifty cubits.

verses.name: Exodus 27:14
verses.text: And hangings for the shoulder<note placement="foot">Or “side,” referring to the span on one side of the courtyard’s entry</note> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> fifteen cubits <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their three pillars and their three bases.

verses.name: Exodus 27:15
verses.text: And fifteen cubits of hangings <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> for the second shoulder<note placement="foot">Or “side,” referring to the span on one side of the courtyard’s entry</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their three pillars and their three bases.

verses.name: Exodus 27:16
verses.text: And for the gate of the courtyard <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> a screen of twenty cubits of blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and finely twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer; <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their four pillars and their four bases.  <div eID="gen584" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv411"/><div sID="gen585" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv411"/>“All the pillars of the courtyard all around will be banded <transChange type="added">with</transChange> silver, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> their hooks <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> silver, and their bases <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 27:18
verses.text: The length of the courtyard will be one hundred cubits and the width fifty <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “fifty with fifty.” Some suggest that the word for cubits has been accidentally omitted and the number fifty repeated in the Hebrew text. Others suggest that repetition of the number is original and indicates that the two ends of the courtyard are the same size</note> and the height five cubits, of finely twisted linen, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their bronze bases.

verses.name: Exodus 27:19
verses.text: Bronze <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> for all the equipment of the tabernacle in all its service and all its <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> and all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> of the courtyard.  <div eID="gen585" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv412"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Making Oil for the Lampstand</title> <div sID="gen586" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv412"/>“And you will command the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and they will bring to you pure, beaten olive oil for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

verses.name: Exodus 27:21
verses.text: In the tent of assembly outside the curtain that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> before the testimony, Aaron and his sons will arrange it, from evening until morning, before Yahweh <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a lasting statute throughout their generations from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <chapter eID="Exod.27"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv413"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Making Garments for Priests</title> <div sID="gen587" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv413"/>“And bring near to you Aaron, your brother, and his sons with him from the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> to serve as priests for me—Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron.

verses.name: Exodus 28:2
verses.text: And you will make holy garments<note placement="foot">Or “garments of holiness”</note> for Aaron, your brother, for glory and for splendor.<note placement="foot">Or “beauty”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:3
verses.text: And you will speak to all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> skilled of heart, whom I have given <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a gift of skill⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a spirit of wisdom”</note> and they will make the garments of Aaron to consecrate him for his serving as my priest.

verses.name: Exodus 28:4
verses.text: And these are the garments that they will make: A breast piece and an ephod and a robe and a tunic of specially woven fabric,<note placement="foot">Precisely what kind of fabric this was is debated</note> a turban and a sash. And they will make holy garments<note placement="foot">Or “garments of holiness”</note> for Aaron your brother, and for his sons to serve as priests for me.  <div eID="gen587" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv414"/><div sID="gen588" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv414"/>“And they will take the gold and the blue and the purple and the crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and the fine linen,

verses.name: Exodus 28:6
verses.text: and they will make the ephod of gold, blue and purple, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange>, and finely twisted linen, the work of a skilled craftsman.

verses.name: Exodus 28:7
verses.text: It will have two joining shoulder pieces at its two edges, so that it can be fastened.

verses.name: Exodus 28:8
verses.text: And the waistband of his ephod, which is on it, will be of like work to it—gold, blue, and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and finely twisted linen.  <div eID="gen588" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv415"/><div sID="gen589" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv415"/>“And you will take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">with</transChange> six of their names on the one stone and the remaining six on the second, according to their genealogies.<note placement="foot">In other words, “according to their birth order”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As the</transChange> work of a skilled stone craftsman, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> seal engravings you will engrave on the two stones the names of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> you will make them mounted <transChange type="added">in</transChange> gold filigree settings.

verses.name: Exodus 28:12
verses.text: And you will set the two stones on the ephod’s shoulder pieces <transChange type="added">as</transChange> stones of remembrance for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and Aaron will bear their names before Yahweh on his two shoulder pieces for remembrance.  <div eID="gen589" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv416"/><div sID="gen590" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv416"/>“And you will make gold filigree settings.

verses.name: Exodus 28:14
verses.text: And you will make two braided chains of pure gold ornamental cord work, and you will put the chains of the ornamental cords on the filigree settings.

verses.name: Exodus 28:15
verses.text: And you will make a breast piece of judgment, a work of a skilled craftsman; you will make it like the work of the ephod; you will make it of gold, blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange>, and finely twisted linen.

verses.name: Exodus 28:16
verses.text: It will be squared, doubled, a span its length and a span its width.

verses.name: Exodus 28:17
verses.text: And you will fill it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> stone mounting, four rows <transChange type="added">of</transChange> stone, a row of carnelian, topaz, and emerald <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the first row;

verses.name: Exodus 28:18
verses.text: and the second row <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a malachite, a sapphire, and a moonstone;

verses.name: Exodus 28:19
verses.text: and the third row <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

verses.name: Exodus 28:20
verses.text: and the fourth row <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a turquoise and an onyx and a jasper. Their settings will be woven <transChange type="added">with</transChange> gold.

verses.name: Exodus 28:21
verses.text: The stones will be according to the names of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> twelve according to their names, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> seal engravings, each according to its name they will be for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twelve tribes.  <div eID="gen590" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv417"/><div sID="gen591" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv417"/>“And you will make on the breast piece braided chains, a work of pure gold ornamental cord.

verses.name: Exodus 28:23
verses.text: And you will make on the breast piece two gold rings, and you will put the two rings on the two edges of the breast piece.

verses.name: Exodus 28:24
verses.text: And you will put the two gold ornamental cords on the two rings on the edges of the breast piece.

verses.name: Exodus 28:25
verses.text: And you will put the two ends of the two ornamental cords on the two filigree settings, and you will put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> on the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front of it.

verses.name: Exodus 28:26
verses.text: And you will make two gold rings, and you will place them on the two ends of the breast piece, on its edge that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the other side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “beyond”</note> of the ephod, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the inside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “houseward,” “to house,” meaning “inward”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:27
verses.text: And you will make two rings and put them on the two shoulder pieces of the ephod below at its front near its seam above the waistband of the ephod.

verses.name: Exodus 28:28
verses.text: And they will tie the breast piece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord to be on the waistband of the ephod, and the breast piece will not come loose from the ephod.

verses.name: Exodus 28:29
verses.text: And Aaron will bear the names of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> in the breast piece of judgment on his heart, when he comes to the sanctuary, for a remembrance before Yahweh continually.

verses.name: Exodus 28:30
verses.text: And you will put the Urim and the Thummim on the breast piece of judgment, and they will be on the heart of Aaron when he comes before Yahweh, and Aaron will bear the judgment of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> on his heart before Yahweh continually.  <div eID="gen591" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv418"/><div sID="gen592" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv418"/>“And you will make the robe of the ephod totally of blue <transChange type="added">yarn</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:32
verses.text: And the opening for his head will be in the middle of it; its opening will have an edge all around, the work of a weaver; it will be like the opening of a sturdy garment for it, <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> it will not be torn.

verses.name: Exodus 28:33
verses.text: And you will make on its hem pomegranates of blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> on its hem all around and bells of gold in the midst of them all around,

verses.name: Exodus 28:34
verses.text: a gold bell and a pomegranate, a gold bell and a pomegranate, on the hem of the robe all around.

verses.name: Exodus 28:35
verses.text: And it will be on Aaron for serving, and its sound will be heard at his coming into the sanctuary before Yahweh and at his going out, so that he will not die.  <div eID="gen592" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv419"/><div sID="gen593" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv419"/>“And you will make a pure gold rosette,<note placement="foot">Or “medallion”</note> and you will engrave on it with seal engravings: “A holy object for Yahweh.”

verses.name: Exodus 28:37
verses.text: And you will place it on a blue cord, and it will be on the turban, at the front of the turban it will be.

verses.name: Exodus 28:38
verses.text: And it will be on the forehead of Aaron, and Aaron will bear the guilt of the holy objects that the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> will consecrate for all their holy gifts, and it will be on his forehead continually for acceptance for them before Yahweh.  <div eID="gen593" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv420"/><div sID="gen594" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv420"/>“And you will weave the tunic of fine linen, and you will make a turban of fine linen, and you will make a sash, the work of an embroiderer.

verses.name: Exodus 28:40
verses.text: And for the sons of Aaron you will make tunics, and you will make for them sashes and headdresses; you will make them for glory and for splendor.<note placement="foot">Or “beauty”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:41
verses.text: And you will clothe them—Aaron, your brother, and his sons with him—and you will anoint them and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ordain them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fill their hand”</note> and consecrate them, and they will serve as priests for me.

verses.name: Exodus 28:42
verses.text: And make for them undergarments of linen to cover naked flesh; they will be from loins to thigh.

verses.name: Exodus 28:43
verses.text: And they will be on Aaron and on his sons when they come to the tent of assembly or when they approach the altar to serve in the sanctuary, so that they will not bear guilt and die. <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> a lasting statute for him and for his offspring after him.  <chapter eID="Exod.28"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv421"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Consecrating Aaron and His Sons</title> <div sID="gen595" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv421"/>“And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the thing that you will do for them to consecrate them to serve as a priest for me: Take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one young bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of cattle”</note> and two rams without defect

verses.name: Exodus 29:2
verses.text: and unleavened bread and unleavened, ring-shaped bread cakes mixed with oil, and wafers of unleavened breads smeared with oil. You will make them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> finely milled wheat flour,

verses.name: Exodus 29:3
verses.text: and you will put them on one basket, and you will bring them on the basket and <transChange type="added">bring</transChange> the bull and the two rams.

verses.name: Exodus 29:4
verses.text: And you will bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of assembly, and you will wash them with water.

verses.name: Exodus 29:5
verses.text: And you will take the garments and clothe Aaron with the tunic and the robe of the ephod, and you will fasten to him the ephod and the breast piece with the waistband of the ephod.

verses.name: Exodus 29:6
verses.text: And you will set the turban on his head, and you will put the holy diadem on the turban.

verses.name: Exodus 29:7
verses.text: And you will take the anointing oil and pour it on his head and anoint him.

verses.name: Exodus 29:8
verses.text: And you will bring his sons and clothe them with tunics.

verses.name: Exodus 29:9
verses.text: And you will gird Aaron and his sons <transChange type="added">with</transChange> sashes and wrap headdresses on them. And priesthood will be theirs as a lasting rule, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will ordain Aaron and his sons.⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you will fill the hand of Aaron and the hands of his sons”</note>  <div eID="gen595" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv422"/><div sID="gen596" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv422"/>“And you will bring the bull before the tent of assembly, and Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on the head of the bull.

verses.name: Exodus 29:11
verses.text: And you will slaughter the bull before Yahweh <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the entrance of the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Exodus 29:12
verses.text: And you will take <transChange type="added">some</transChange> of the blood of the bull and with your finger put it on the horns of the altar, and you will pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

verses.name: Exodus 29:13
verses.text: And you will take and turn into smoke <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the altar all the fat covering the inner parts and the lobe on the liver and the two kidneys and the fat that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them.

verses.name: Exodus 29:14
verses.text: And the flesh of the bull and its skin and its offal you will burn with fire outside the camp; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sin offering.  <div eID="gen596" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv423"/><div sID="gen597" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv423"/>“And you will take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on the head of the ram.

verses.name: Exodus 29:16
verses.text: And you will slaughter the ram and take its blood and sprinkle <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on the altar all around.

verses.name: Exodus 29:17
verses.text: And you will cut the ram into pieces and wash its inner parts, and you will put its legs with its pieces and with its head.

verses.name: Exodus 29:18
verses.text: And you will turn into smoke <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the altar all of the ram; it is a burnt offering for Yahweh; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a smell of appeasement, an offering by fire for Yahweh.  <div eID="gen597" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv424"/><div sID="gen598" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv424"/>“And you will take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on the head of the ram.

verses.name: Exodus 29:20
verses.text: And you will slaughter the ram and take <transChange type="added">some</transChange> of its blood and put <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on Aaron’s <transChange type="added">right</transChange> earlobe and on the right earlobe of his sons and on the thumb of their right hand and on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the big toe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the thumb of”</note> of their right foot, and you will sprinkle the blood at the base of the altar all around.

verses.name: Exodus 29:21
verses.text: And you will take <transChange type="added">some</transChange> of the blood that is on the altar and <transChange type="added">some</transChange> of the anointing oil, and you will spatter <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on Aaron and on his garments and on his sons and on his sons’ garments with him, and he will be sacred, and his garments and his sons and his sons’ garments with him.

verses.name: Exodus 29:22
verses.text: And you will take from the ram the fat and the fat tail and the fat covering the inner parts and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them and the right thigh, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the ram of ordination.  <div eID="gen598" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv425"/><div sID="gen599" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv425"/>“And one loaf of bread and one ring-shaped bread cake of oiled bread and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> before Yahweh—

verses.name: Exodus 29:24
verses.text: you will put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> all on the palms of Aaron and on the palms of his sons, and you will wave them as a wave offering before Yahweh.

verses.name: Exodus 29:25
verses.text: And you will take them from their hand and turn <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to smoke on the altar beside the burnt offering as a fragrance of appeasement before Yahweh; it is an offering made by fire before Yahweh.  <div eID="gen599" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv426"/><div sID="gen600" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv426"/>“And you will take the breast section from the ram of ordination that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for Aaron, and you will wave it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a wave offering before Yahweh. It will be your portion.

verses.name: Exodus 29:27
verses.text: And you will consecrate the wave offering breast section and the thigh of the contribution that was waved and that was presented<note placement="foot">Literally “lifted up”</note> from the ram of the ordination that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for Aaron and for his sons.

verses.name: Exodus 29:28
verses.text: And it will be for<note placement="foot">Or “belong to”</note> Aaron and for his sons as a lasting rule from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> because it is a contribution, and it will be a contribution from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> from their sacrifices of fellowship, their contribution to Yahweh.  <div eID="gen600" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv427"/><div sID="gen601" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv427"/>“And the holy garments that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> for Aaron will be for his sons after him in which to anoint them and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to ordain them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to fill in them their hands”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 29:30
verses.text: Seven days the priest who replaces him from among his sons will wear them, who comes to the tent of assembly to serve in the sanctuary.

verses.name: Exodus 29:31
verses.text: And you will take the ram of ordination and boil its meat in a holy place.

verses.name: Exodus 29:32
verses.text: And Aaron and his sons will eat the meat of the ram and the bread that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the basket at the entrance of the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Exodus 29:33
verses.text: And they will eat them—<transChange type="added">the things</transChange> by which atonement was made for them to ordain them to consecrate them—and a stranger will not eat <transChange type="added">them</transChange> because they are holy objects.

verses.name: Exodus 29:34
verses.text: If any remains until morning from the ordination meat or from the bread, you will burn the remainder in fire; it will not be eaten, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a holy object.

verses.name: Exodus 29:35
verses.text: And you will do so for Aaron and for his sons, according to all that I have commanded you; seven days you will ordain them.  <div eID="gen601" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv428"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Regular Offerings at the Tabernacle</title> <div sID="gen602" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv428"/>“And you will offer a bull for a sin offering every day for the atonement; and you will offer a sin offering on the altar<note placement="foot">Or “you will purify the altar”</note> when you make atonement for it, and you will anoint it to consecrate it.

verses.name: Exodus 29:37
verses.text: Seven days you will make atonement for the altar, and you will consecrate it, and the altar will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a holiness of holinesses” or “a holy thing among holy things,” a thing of utmost holiness</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Anyone who⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “anything that”; literally “all touching”</note> touches the altar will be holy.  <div eID="gen602" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv429"/><div sID="gen603" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv429"/>“And this is what you shall offer on the altar: Two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one-year-old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> male lambs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the day,” or per day</note> continually.

verses.name: Exodus 29:39
verses.text: The first lamb you will offer in the morning, and the second lamb you will offer <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at twilight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “between the evenings”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 29:40
verses.text: And a tenth of finely milled flour mixed with a fourth of a hin of beaten oil, and a fourth of a hin of wine as a libation with the first lamb.

verses.name: Exodus 29:41
verses.text: And the second lamb you will offer <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at twilight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “between the evenings”</note> you will offer a grain offering and its libation like that of the morning for a fragrance of appeasement, an offering made by fire for Yahweh.

verses.name: Exodus 29:42
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It will be</transChange> a burnt offering of continuity throughout your generations <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the entrance of the tent of assembly before Yahweh, where I will meet with you to speak to you there.  <div eID="gen603" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv430"/><div sID="gen604" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv430"/>“And I will meet with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> there, and it will be consecrated by my glory.

verses.name: Exodus 29:44
verses.text: And I will consecrate the tent of assembly and the altar, and Aaron and his sons I will consecrate to serve as priests for me.

verses.name: Exodus 29:45
verses.text: And I will dwell in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and I will be their God.

verses.name: Exodus 29:46
verses.text: And they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, their God, who brought them out from the land of Egypt in order to dwell in their midst. I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh their God.  <chapter eID="Exod.29"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv431"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Making the Incense Altar</title> <div sID="gen605" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv431"/>“And you will make an altar <transChange type="added">for</transChange> burning incense; you will make it of acacia wood,

verses.name: Exodus 30:2
verses.text: a cubit its length and a cubit its width—it will be square—and two cubits its height, its horns <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of one piece with it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from it”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 30:3
verses.text: And you will overlay it with pure gold, its top and its sides all around and its horns, and you will make for it a gold molding all around.

verses.name: Exodus 30:4
verses.text: And you will make two gold rings for it; under its molding <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on two opposite sides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on two of its sides you will make on two of its sides”</note> you will make them as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “houses”</note> for poles to carry it with them.

verses.name: Exodus 30:5
verses.text: You will make the poles of acacia wood, and you will overlay them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> gold.

verses.name: Exodus 30:6
verses.text: And you will put it before the curtain that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon the ark of the testimony, before the atonement cover, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the testimony, there where I will meet with you.  <div eID="gen605" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv432"/><div sID="gen606" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv432"/>“And on it Aaron will turn fragrant incense into smoke; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the morning in the morning”</note> when he tends the lamps, he will turn it into smoke.

verses.name: Exodus 30:8
verses.text: And when Aaron sets up the lamps <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at twilight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “between the two evenings”</note> he will turn it into smoke—incense of continuity—before Yahweh throughout your generations.

verses.name: Exodus 30:9
verses.text: You will not offer on it strange incense or a burnt offering or a grain offering, and you will not pour a libation on it.

verses.name: Exodus 30:10
verses.text: And Aaron will make atonement on its horns one time in the year from the blood of the sin offering of the atonement; one time in the year he will make atonement on it throughout your generations; it is a most holy thing for Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen606" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv433"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Numbering the People</title> <div sID="gen607" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv433"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 30:12
verses.text: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When you take a census of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “when you lift up the heads of”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> to count them, they will each give the ransom of his life for Yahweh when counting them, and a plague will not be among them when counting them.

verses.name: Exodus 30:13
verses.text: This they will give, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone who is counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all of the going over to the being counted”</note> the half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> twenty gerahs per shekel. The half shekel <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a contribution for Yahweh.

verses.name: Exodus 30:14
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Everyone who is counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of the going over to the being counted”</note> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above will give the contribution of Yahweh.

verses.name: Exodus 30:15
verses.text: The rich will not give more, and the poor will not give less than the half shekel to give the contribution of Yahweh to make atonement for their lives.

verses.name: Exodus 30:16
verses.text: And you will take the atonement money from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and give it to the service of the tent of assembly, and it will be as a memorial for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> before Yahweh to make atonement for your lives.”  <div eID="gen607" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv434"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Making the Basin</title> <div sID="gen608" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv434"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 30:18
verses.text: “And you will make a basin of bronze and its bronze stand for washing, and you will put it between the tent of assembly and the altar, and you will put water there.

verses.name: Exodus 30:19
verses.text: And Aaron and his sons will wash their hands and their feet with it.

verses.name: Exodus 30:20
verses.text: When they come to the tent of assembly, they will wash with water so that they do not die, or when they approach the altar to serve by turning to smoke an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

verses.name: Exodus 30:21
verses.text: And they will wash their hands and their feet so that they do not die, and it will be a lasting rule for them—to him and to his offspring throughout their generations.  <div eID="gen608" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv435"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Making Anointing Oil and Incense</title> <div sID="gen609" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv435"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 30:23
verses.text: “And take for yourself top quality balsam oils, five hundred <transChange type="added">shekels of</transChange> flowing myrrh, half <transChange type="added">as much</transChange>—two hundred and fifty <transChange type="added">shekels of</transChange> fragrant cinnamon, and two hundred and fifty <transChange type="added">shekels of</transChange> fragrant reed,

verses.name: Exodus 30:24
verses.text: and five hundred <transChange type="added">shekels of</transChange> cassia, according to the sanctuary shekel, and a hin of olive oil.

verses.name: Exodus 30:25
verses.text: And you will make it <transChange type="added">into</transChange> holy anointing oil, a spice blend of a fragrant ointment <transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of a perfumer; it will be holy anointing oil.

verses.name: Exodus 30:26
verses.text: And you will anoint with it the tent of assembly and the ark of the testimony,

verses.name: Exodus 30:27
verses.text: and the table and all its equipment and the lampstand and its equipment and the incense altar,

verses.name: Exodus 30:28
verses.text: and the altar of burnt offering and all its equipment and the basin and its stand.

verses.name: Exodus 30:29
verses.text: And you will consecrate them, and they will be most holy things; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone who⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “anything that”; literally “all touching”</note> touches them will be holy.

verses.name: Exodus 30:30
verses.text: And you will anoint Aaron and his sons, and you will consecrate them to serve as priests for me.  <div eID="gen609" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv436"/><div sID="gen610" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv436"/>“And you will speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘This will be my holy anointing oil throughout your generations.

verses.name: Exodus 30:32
verses.text: It will not be poured on human flesh, and with its measurements<note placement="foot">Or “recipe” or “formula”</note> you will not make <transChange type="added">any</transChange> like it; it is holy; it will be holy to you.

verses.name: Exodus 30:33
verses.text: Anyone who compounds perfume like it and who puts it on a stranger will be cut off from his people.’ ”  <div eID="gen610" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv437"/><div sID="gen611" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv437"/>And Yahweh said to Moses, “Take for yourself fragrant perfumes—stacte resin and onycha and galbanum—fragrant perfumes and pure frankincense, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an equal part of each⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “part by part it will be”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 30:35
verses.text: and make it into a compound of incense, the work of a perfumer, salted, pure, holy.

verses.name: Exodus 30:36
verses.text: And you will grind part of it to powder, and you will put part of it before the testimony in the tent of assembly where I will meet with you; it will be a most holy thing to you.

verses.name: Exodus 30:37
verses.text: And the incense that you will make with its measurements<note placement="foot">Or “recipe” or “formula”</note> you will not make for yourselves; it will be holy to you for Yahweh.

verses.name: Exodus 30:38
verses.text: Anyone who makes <transChange type="added">any</transChange> like it to smell it will be cut off from his people.”  <chapter eID="Exod.30"/>

verses.name: Exodus 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv438"/><title type="x-s">Provision of Skilled People</title> <div sID="gen612" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv438"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 31:2
verses.text: “See, I have called by name<note placement="foot">In other words, “specifically chosen”</note> Bezalel the son of Uri the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah.

verses.name: Exodus 31:3
verses.text: And I have filled him <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the Spirit of God, with wisdom and with skill<note placement="foot">Or “understanding,” “discernment,” “cleverness”</note> and with knowledge and with every <transChange type="added">kind of</transChange> craftsmanship,

verses.name: Exodus 31:4
verses.text: to devise designs, to work with gold and with silver and with bronze,

verses.name: Exodus 31:5
verses.text: and in stonecutting for setting and in cutting wood, for doing every <transChange type="added">kind of</transChange> craftsmanship.

verses.name: Exodus 31:6
verses.text: And, look, I have given with him Oholiab the son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, and I have put skill in the heart of all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> skilled of heart, and they will make all that I have commanded you—

verses.name: Exodus 31:7
verses.text: the tent of assembly and the ark of the testimony and the atonement cover that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on it and all the equipment of the tent,

verses.name: Exodus 31:8
verses.text: and the table and all its equipment, and the pure <transChange type="added">gold</transChange> lampstand and all its equipment, and the incense altar,

verses.name: Exodus 31:9
verses.text: and the altar of burnt offering and all its equipment, and the basin and its stand,

verses.name: Exodus 31:10
verses.text: and the garments of woven material, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the garments of the sanctuary⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the garments of the holiness” or “the holy garments”</note> for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons to serve as priests,

verses.name: Exodus 31:11
verses.text: and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense for the sanctuary. According to all that I have commanded you, they will make <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.  <div eID="gen612" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv439"/><title type="x-s">Provision of Rest from Work</title> <div sID="gen613" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv439"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses <transChange type="added">and</transChange> said,

verses.name: Exodus 31:13
verses.text: “And you, speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘Surely you must keep my Sabbaths, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sign between me and you throughout your generations, <transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, who consecrates you.

verses.name: Exodus 31:14
verses.text: And you must keep the Sabbath, because it is holy for you; defilers<note placement="foot">Or “profaners,” those who treat it as common</note> of it will surely be put to death, because anyone who does work on it—that person will be cut off from among his people.

verses.name: Exodus 31:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">On</transChange> six days work can be done, and on the seventh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is a Sabbath of complete rest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a Sabbath of ‘Sabbathation.’ ” “Sabbathation” is not a real word, but devised as an attempt to convey the sounds of the related nouns in the Hebrew phrase</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a holy day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “holiness”</note> for Yahweh; anyone doing work on the Sabbath day will surely be put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 31:16
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> will pay attention to the Sabbath in order to fulfill the Sabbath<note placement="foot">Or “keep the Sabbath to do/observe the Sabbath”</note> throughout their generations <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a lasting covenant.

verses.name: Exodus 31:17
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sign between me and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> forever, because in six days Yahweh made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh he ceased<note placement="foot">Or “rested”</note> and recovered.”<note placement="foot">Or “breathed freely,” “got his breath”</note>  <div eID="gen613" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv440"/><div sID="gen614" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv440"/>And when he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave to Moses the two tablets of the testimony, stone tablets, written with the finger of God.  <chapter eID="Exod.31"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv441"/><title type="x-s">The Golden Calf</title> <div sID="gen615" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv441"/>And the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, and the people gathered opposite Aaron, and they said to him, “Come,<note placement="foot">Or “arise” or “get up”</note> make for us gods who will go before us, because this Moses, the man who brought us up from the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.”  <div eID="gen615" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv442"/><div sID="gen616" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv442"/>And Aaron said to them, “Take off the rings of gold that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to me.”

verses.name: Exodus 32:3
verses.text: And all the people took off the rings of gold that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on their ears and brought <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to Aaron.

verses.name: Exodus 32:4
verses.text: And he took from their hand, and he shaped it with a tool, and he made it a cast-image bull calf, and they said, “These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.”  <div eID="gen616" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv443"/><div sID="gen617" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv443"/>And Aaron saw, and he built an altar before it, and Aaron called, and he said, “A feast for Yahweh tomorrow.”

verses.name: Exodus 32:6
verses.text: And they started early the next day, and they offered burnt offerings, and they presented fellowship offerings, and the people sat to eat and drink, and they rose up to revel.  <div eID="gen617" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv444"/><div sID="gen618" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv444"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, go down because your people behave corruptly, whom you brought up from the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 32:8
verses.text: They have turned aside quickly from the way that I commanded them; they have made for themselves a cast-image bull calf, and they bowed to it, and they sacrificed to it, and they said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.’ ”  <div eID="gen618" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv445"/><div sID="gen619" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv445"/>And Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen this people, and, indeed, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a stiff-necked people.

verses.name: Exodus 32:10
verses.text: And now leave me <transChange type="added">alone</transChange> so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my anger may blaze⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my nose may become hot”</note> against them, and let me destroy them, and I will make you into a great nation.”  <div eID="gen619" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv446"/><div sID="gen620" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv446"/>And Moses <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞implored Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “implored the face of Yahweh”</note> his God, and he said, “Why, Yahweh, should <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your anger blaze⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your nose become hot”</note> against your people whom you brought up from the land of Egypt with great power and with a strong hand?

verses.name: Exodus 32:12
verses.text: Why should <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Egyptians <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “say, saying”</note>, ‘With evil intent he brought them out to kill them in the mountains and wipe them from the face of the earth’?<note placement="foot">Or “ground”</note> Turn from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your fierce anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the heat of your nose”</note> and relent concerning the disaster for your people.

verses.name: Exodus 32:13
verses.text: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by yourself, and you told them, ‘I will multiply your offspring like the stars of the heavens, and all this land that I promised I will give to your offspring, and they will inherit <transChange type="added">it</transChange> forever.’ ”  <div eID="gen620" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv447"/><div sID="gen621" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv447"/>And Yahweh relented concerning the disaster that he had <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞threatened⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoken”</note> to do to his people.

verses.name: Exodus 32:15
verses.text: And Moses turned and went down from the mountain, and the two tablets of the testimony <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in his hand, tablets written on their two sides; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the front and on the back⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from this and from this”</note> they were written.

verses.name: Exodus 32:16
verses.text: And the tablets, they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the work of God; and the writing, it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the writing of God engraved on the tablets.  <div eID="gen621" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv448"/><div sID="gen622" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv448"/>And Joshua heard the sound of the people in their shouting, and he said to Moses, “A sound of war <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the camp.”  <div eID="gen622" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv449"/><div sID="gen623" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv449"/>But he said, “There is not a sound of shouting of victory, and there is not a sound of shouting of defeat. I hear a sound of singing.”  <div eID="gen623" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv450"/><div sID="gen624" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv450"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it was”</note> as he came near to the camp, he saw the bull calf and dancing, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Moses became angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the nose of Moses became hot”</note> and he threw the tablets from his hand, and he broke them under the mountain.

verses.name: Exodus 32:20
verses.text: And he took the bull calf that they had made, and he burned <transChange type="added">it</transChange> with the fire, and he crushed <transChange type="added">it</transChange> until it became fine, and he scattered <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on the surface of the water, and he made the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> drink.  <div eID="gen624" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv451"/><div sID="gen625" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv451"/>And Moses said to Aaron, “What did this people do to you that you brought on them <transChange type="added">such</transChange> a great sin?”

verses.name: Exodus 32:22
verses.text: And Aaron said, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Let not my lord become angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “let not the nose of my lord become hot”</note> You yourself know the people, that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they are intent on evil⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they in evil”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 32:23
verses.text: And they said to me, ‘Make for us gods who will go before us, because this Moses, the man who brought us up from the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.’

verses.name: Exodus 32:24
verses.text: And I said to them, ‘Whoever <transChange type="added">has</transChange> gold, take <transChange type="added">it</transChange> off.’ And they gave <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to me, and I threw it in the fire, and out came this bull calf.”  <div eID="gen625" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv452"/><div sID="gen626" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv452"/>And Moses saw the people, that they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> running wild<note placement="foot">Or “out of control,” “running loose”</note> because Aaron had allowed them to run wild,<note placement="foot">Or “to be out of control,” “to run loose”</note> for a laughingstock among <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their enemies⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “those arising against them”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 32:26
verses.text: And Moses stood at the entrance of the camp, and he said, “Whoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for Yahweh, to me.” And all the sons of Levi were gathered to him.

verses.name: Exodus 32:27
verses.text: And he said to them, “Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, ‘Put each his sword on his side. Go <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞back and forth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “through and come back”</note> from gate to gate in the camp, and kill, each his brother and each his friend and each his close relative.’ ”

verses.name: Exodus 32:28
verses.text: And the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses, and from the people on that day about three thousand persons fell.<note placement="foot">Literally “three thousands of man”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 32:29
verses.text: And Moses said, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You are ordained⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your hands are filled”</note> today for Yahweh, because each <transChange type="added">has been</transChange> against his son and against his brother and so bringing on you today a blessing.”  <div eID="gen626" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv453"/><div sID="gen627" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv453"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it was”</note> the next day Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. And now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I can make atonement for your sin.”  <div eID="gen627" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv454"/><div sID="gen628" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv454"/>And Moses returned to Yahweh, and he said, “Alas, this people has sinned a great sin and made for themselves gods of gold.

verses.name: Exodus 32:32
verses.text: And now if you will forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me from your scroll that you have written.”

verses.name: Exodus 32:33
verses.text: And Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me I will blot him from my scroll.

verses.name: Exodus 32:34
verses.text: And now go, lead the people to where I spoke to you. Look, my angel will go before you, and on the day <transChange type="added">when</transChange> I punish I will punish them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> their sin.”

verses.name: Exodus 32:35
verses.text: And Yahweh afflicted the people because they had made the bull calf that Aaron had made.  <chapter eID="Exod.32"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv455"/><title type="x-s">Command to Resume Travel</title> <div sID="gen629" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv455"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, go up from here, you and the people whom you have brought up from the land of Egypt, to the land that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’

verses.name: Exodus 33:2
verses.text: And I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> the Amorites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> and the Hittites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hittite”</note> and the Perizzites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Perizzite”</note> the Hivites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hivite”</note> and the Jebusites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jebusite”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 33:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Go</transChange> to a land flowing with milk and honey, but I will not go up among you, because you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a stiff-necked people, lest I destroy you on the way.”

verses.name: Exodus 33:4
verses.text: And the people heard this troubling<note placement="foot">Or “bad,” “disastrous,” “calamitous”</note> word, and they mourned, and they each did not put their ornaments on themselves.  <div eID="gen629" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv456"/><div sID="gen630" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv456"/>And Yahweh said to Moses, “Say to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> ‘You are a stiff-necked people; if one moment I were to go up among you, I would destroy you. And now take down your ornaments from on you, and I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞decide⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “know”</note> what I will do to you.”

verses.name: Exodus 33:6
verses.text: And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> stripped themselves of their ornaments from Mount Horeb <transChange type="added">onward</transChange>.  <div eID="gen630" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv457"/><title type="x-s">The Tent outside the Camp</title> <div sID="gen631" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv457"/>And Moses took the tent and pitched it outside the camp far from the camp, and he called it the tent of assembly, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it would be”</note> all seeking Yahweh would go out to the tent of assembly, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> outside the camp.

verses.name: Exodus 33:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it would be”</note> at the going out of Moses to the tent, all the people would rise and stand, each at the opening of his tent, and gaze after Moses until his entering the tent.

verses.name: Exodus 33:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it would be”</note> at the entering of Moses <transChange type="added">into</transChange> the tent the column of cloud would descend and stand <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the opening of the tent, and he would speak with Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 33:10
verses.text: And all the people would see the column of cloud standing <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the opening of the tent, and all the people would rise and bow in worship, each <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the opening of his tent.

verses.name: Exodus 33:11
verses.text: And Yahweh would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his neighbor. And he would return to the camp, and his assistant Joshua the son of Nun, a young man, did not leave the middle of the tent.  <div eID="gen631" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv458"/><title type="x-s">Presence and Glory</title> <div sID="gen632" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv458"/>And Moses said to Yahweh, “See, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> saying to me, ‘Take this people up.’ But you have not let me know whom you will send with me, and you yourself have said, ‘I know you by name, and you also have found favor in my eyes.’

verses.name: Exodus 33:13
verses.text: And now if I have found favor in your eyes, make known <transChange type="added">to</transChange> me, please, your way, and so I may know you so that I can find favor in your eyes. And see that this nation is your people.”

verses.name: Exodus 33:14
verses.text: And he said, “My presence will go, and I will give you rest.”

verses.name: Exodus 33:15
verses.text: And he said to him, “If your presence <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not going, do not bring us up from here.

verses.name: Exodus 33:16
verses.text: And by what will it be known then that I have found favor in your eyes, I and your people? Is it not by your going with us? And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> we will be distinguished, I and your people, from all the people who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on the face of the ground.”  <div eID="gen632" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv459"/><div sID="gen633" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv459"/>And Yahweh said to Moses, “Also I will do this thing that you have spoken, because you have found favor in my eyes and I have known you by name.”  <div eID="gen633" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv460"/><div sID="gen634" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv460"/>And he said, “Please show me your glory.”  <div eID="gen634" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv461"/><div sID="gen635" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv461"/>And he said, “I myself will cause all my goodness to pass over before you, and I will proclaim the name of Yahweh before you, and I will be gracious <transChange type="added">to</transChange> whom I will be gracious, and I will show compassion <transChange type="added">to</transChange> whom I will show compassion.”

verses.name: Exodus 33:20
verses.text: But he said, “You are not able to see my face, because <transChange type="added">a</transChange> human will not see me and live.”

verses.name: Exodus 33:21
verses.text: And Yahweh said, “There is a place with me, and you will stand on the rock.

verses.name: Exodus 33:22
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it will be”</note> when my glory passes over, I will put you in the rock’s crevice, and I will cover you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> my hand until I pass over.

verses.name: Exodus 33:23
verses.text: And I will remove my hand, and you will see my back, but my face will not be visible.”  <chapter eID="Exod.33"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv462"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Description of Himself</title> <div sID="gen636" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv462"/>And Yahweh said to Moses, “Cut for yourself two stone tablets like the first ones, and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

verses.name: Exodus 34:2
verses.text: And be ready for the morning, and go up in the morning to Mount Sinai and present yourself to me there on the top of the mountain.

verses.name: Exodus 34:3
verses.text: And no one will go up with you, and neither let anyone be seen on all the mountain, nor let the sheep and goats and the cattle graze <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞opposite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the front of”</note> that mountain.”  <div eID="gen636" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv463"/><div sID="gen637" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv463"/>And Moses cut two stone tablets like the first ones, and he started early in the morning, and he went up to Mount Sinai, as Yahweh had commanded him, and he took in his hand the two stone tablets.

verses.name: Exodus 34:5
verses.text: And Yahweh descended in the cloud, and he stood with him there, and he proclaimed the name of Yahweh.

verses.name: Exodus 34:6
