verses.text: And Yahweh passed over before him, and he proclaimed, “Yahweh, Yahweh, God, <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> compassionate and gracious, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞slow to anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “long of nose”</note> and abounding with<note placement="foot">Or “rich in” or “great of”</note> loyal love and faithfulness,

verses.name: Exodus 34:7
verses.text: keeping loyal love to the thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and he does not leave utterly unpunished, punishing <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guilt of fathers on sons and on sons of sons on third and fourth <transChange type="added">generations</transChange>.”  <div eID="gen637" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv464"/><div sID="gen638" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv464"/>And Moses hurried and knelt down to the earth and worshiped.

verses.name: Exodus 34:9
verses.text: And he said, “Please, if I have found favor in your eyes, Lord, let my Lord, please, go among us—indeed it is a stiff-necked people—and forgive our iniquity and our sin and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞take us as your possession⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Or “take possession of us,” “make us your inheritance”</note>  <div eID="gen638" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv465"/><title type="x-s">Covenant Stipulations</title> <div sID="gen639" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv465"/>And he said, “Look, I <transChange type="added">am about to</transChange> make a covenant. In front of all your people I will do wonders that have not been created on all the earth and among all the nations, and all the people among whom you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> will see Yahweh’s work, because what I <transChange type="added">am about to</transChange> do with you <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> awesome.  <div eID="gen639" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv466"/><div sID="gen640" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv466"/>“Keep for yourself what I myself have commanded you today. Look, I <transChange type="added">am about to</transChange> drive from before you the Amorites and the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> and the Hittites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hittite”</note> and the Perizzites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Perizzite”</note> and the Hivites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hivite”</note> and the Jebusites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jebusite”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 34:12
verses.text: Be careful for yourself, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which you are going, lest it be a snare among you.

verses.name: Exodus 34:13
verses.text: Rather, you will tear down their altars, and you will break their stone pillars, and you will cut off their Asherah poles.

verses.name: Exodus 34:14
verses.text: For you will not bow in worship to another god, for ‘Yahweh <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> Jealous’ is his name, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a jealous God,

verses.name: Exodus 34:15
verses.text: lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they prostitute <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> after their gods, and they sacrifice to their gods, and they invite you, and you eat their sacrifice,

verses.name: Exodus 34:16
verses.text: and you take from their daughters for your sons, and their daughters prostitute <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> after their gods, and they cause your sons to prostitute <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> after their gods.

verses.name: Exodus 34:17
verses.text: You will not make gods of cast metal for yourself.  <div eID="gen640" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv467"/><div sID="gen641" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv467"/>“You will keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. Seven days you will eat unleavened bread, which I commanded you, at the appointed time of the month of Abib, for in the month of Abib you came out from Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 34:19
verses.text: Every first offspring of a womb <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for me—all of your male livestock, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first offspring of cattle and small livestock.

verses.name: Exodus 34:20
verses.text: But the first offspring of a donkey you will redeem with small livestock, and if you will not redeem <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, you will break its neck. Every firstborn of your sons you will redeem, and you will not appear before me empty-handed.

verses.name: Exodus 34:21
verses.text: Six days you will work, and on the seventh day you will rest; in the <transChange type="added">time of</transChange> plowing and in the <transChange type="added">time of</transChange> harvest you will rest.

verses.name: Exodus 34:22
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for yourself” or “as for you, you will observe”</note> will observe the Feast of Weeks—the firstfruits of the wheat harvest—and the Feast of Harvest Gathering at the turn of the year.

verses.name: Exodus 34:23
verses.text: Three times in the year all your males will appear before the Lord, Yahweh, the God of Israel,

verses.name: Exodus 34:24
verses.text: because I will evict nations before you, and I will enlarge your territory, and no one will covet your land when you go up to appear before Yahweh your God three times in the year.  <div eID="gen641" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv468"/><div sID="gen642" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv468"/>“You will not slaughter the blood of my sacrifice on <transChange type="added">food with</transChange> yeast, and the sacrifice of the Feast of the Passover will not stay overnight to the morning.

verses.name: Exodus 34:26
verses.text: The beginning of the firstfruits of your land you will bring <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of Yahweh your God. You will not boil a young goat<note placement="foot">Or “kid”</note> in its mother’s milk.”  <div eID="gen642" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv469"/><div sID="gen643" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv469"/>And Yahweh said to Moses, “Write for yourself these words, because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the mouth of”</note> these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”  <div eID="gen643" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv470"/><title type="x-s">The Shining Face of Moses</title> <div sID="gen644" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv470"/>And he was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights. He ate no food and drank no water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten words.

verses.name: Exodus 34:29
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it was”</note> when Moses came down from Mount Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the hand of Moses at his coming down from the mountain; and Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because of his speaking with him.

verses.name: Exodus 34:30
verses.text: And Aaron and all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saw Moses, and, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to their amazement⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “look” or “behold”</note> the skin of his face shone, and they were afraid of coming near to him.

verses.name: Exodus 34:31
verses.text: And Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the leaders of the community returned to him, and Moses spoke to them.

verses.name: Exodus 34:32
verses.text: And afterward all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> came near, and he commanded them all that Yahweh had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

verses.name: Exodus 34:33
verses.text: And Moses finished speaking with them, and he put a veil on his face.

verses.name: Exodus 34:34
verses.text: And when Moses came before Yahweh to speak with him, he would remove the veil until he went out, and he would go out and would speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> what he had been commanded.

verses.name: Exodus 34:35
verses.text: And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> would see the face of Moses, that the skin of the face of Moses shone, and Moses would put back the veil on his face until his coming to speak with him.  <chapter eID="Exod.34"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv471"/><title type="x-s">Preparation of Materials and People for Building</title> <div sID="gen645" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv471"/>And Moses assembled all the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and he said to them, “These are the words that Yahweh has commanded <transChange type="added">for us</transChange> to do them.

verses.name: Exodus 35:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">On</transChange> six days work can be done, and on the seventh there will be for you a holy <transChange type="added">day</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Literally “holiness”</note> a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Sabbath of complete rest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a Sabbath of ‘Sabbathation.’ ” “Sabbathation” is not a real word, but it is devised as an attempt to convey the sounds of the related nouns in the Hebrew phrase</note> for Yahweh; anyone doing work on it will be put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 35:3
verses.text: You will not kindle a fire in any of your dwellings on the day of the Sabbath.”  <div eID="gen645" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv472"/><div sID="gen646" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv472"/>And Moses said to all the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, “This is the word that Yahweh has commanded, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 35:5
verses.text: ‘Take from among you a contribution for Yahweh, anyone willing of heart, let him bring Yahweh’s contribution—gold and silver and bronze,

verses.name: Exodus 35:6
verses.text: and blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange>, and fine linen and goat hair,

verses.name: Exodus 35:7
verses.text: and red-dyed ram skins, and fine leather,<note placement="foot">The particular kind of leather is uncertain</note> and acacia wood,

verses.name: Exodus 35:8
verses.text: and oil for the lamp, balsam oils for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,

verses.name: Exodus 35:9
verses.text: onyx stones and stones for mountings on the ephod and the breast piece.  <div eID="gen646" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv473"/><div sID="gen647" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv473"/>“And let all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> skilled of heart among you come and make all that Yahweh has commanded:

verses.name: Exodus 35:11
verses.text: The tabernacle, its tent, and its covering; its clasps and its frames;<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> its bars, its pillars, and its bases;

verses.name: Exodus 35:12
verses.text: the ark and its poles; the atonement cover and the curtain of the screen;

verses.name: Exodus 35:13
verses.text: the table and its poles and all its equipment; and the bread of the presence;

verses.name: Exodus 35:14
verses.text: and lampstand of the light and its equipment and its lamps and the oil for the light;

verses.name: Exodus 35:15
verses.text: and the altar of incense and its poles; and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense and the entrance curtain for the entrance of the tabernacle;

verses.name: Exodus 35:16
verses.text: the altar of the burnt offering and the bronze grating that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for it, its poles and all its equipment; the basin and its stand;

verses.name: Exodus 35:17
verses.text: the hangings of the courtyard, its pillars, and its bases, and the screen for the courtyard gate;

verses.name: Exodus 35:18
verses.text: the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> of the tabernacle and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> of the courtyard and their cords;

verses.name: Exodus 35:19
verses.text: the woven garments for serving in the sanctuary—the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons to serve as priests.”  <div eID="gen647" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv474"/><div sID="gen648" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv474"/>And all the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> went out from before Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 35:21
verses.text: And they came—every man whose heart lifted him and every man whose spirit impelled him—they brought Yahweh’s contribution for the work of the tent of assembly and for all its service and for the holy garments.

verses.name: Exodus 35:22
verses.text: And they came, the men in addition to the women, all <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> willing of heart; they brought brooches and jewelry rings and signet rings and ornaments—every <transChange type="added">variety</transChange> of gold object—every man who waved a wave offering of gold for Yahweh,

verses.name: Exodus 35:23
verses.text: and every man with whom was found blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and fine linen and goat hair and red-dyed ram skins and fine leather brought <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:24
verses.text: All <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> presenting a contribution of silver and bronze brought Yahweh’s contribution, and all with whom was found acacia wood for all the work of service brought <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:25
verses.text: And every woman <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> skilled of heart with her hands they spun, and they brought yarn—the blue and the purple, the crimson and the fine linen.

verses.name: Exodus 35:26
verses.text: And all the women whose heart lifted them with skill spun the goat hair.

verses.name: Exodus 35:27
verses.text: And the leaders brought the onyx stones and stones for mountings for the ephod and for the breast piece

verses.name: Exodus 35:28
verses.text: and the balsam oils and the oil for light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.

verses.name: Exodus 35:29
verses.text: Every man and woman whose heart impelled them to bring for all the work to be done that Yahweh had commanded <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by the agency of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by the hand of”</note> Moses—the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> brought freely to Yahweh.  <div eID="gen648" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv475"/><div sID="gen649" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv475"/>And Moses said to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> “See, Yahweh has called by name<note placement="foot">In other words, “specifically chosen”</note> Bezalel the son of Uri the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah.

verses.name: Exodus 35:31
verses.text: And he has filled him <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the Spirit of God, with wisdom and with skill<note placement="foot">Or “understanding,” “discernment,” “cleverness”</note> and with knowledge and with every <transChange type="added">kind of</transChange> craftsmanship,

verses.name: Exodus 35:32
verses.text: and to devise designs, to work with the gold and with the silver and with the bronze,

verses.name: Exodus 35:33
verses.text: and in stonecutting for setting and in cutting wood, for doing every <transChange type="added">kind of</transChange> design craftsmanship.

verses.name: Exodus 35:34
verses.text: And he has put <transChange type="added">it</transChange> in his heart to teach—he and Oholiab the son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan.

verses.name: Exodus 35:35
verses.text: He has filled them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> skill of heart to do every work of a craftsman and a designer and an embroiderer with the blue and with the purple, with the crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and with the fine linen and a weaver; <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> doers of every <transChange type="added">kind of</transChange> craftsmanship and devisers of designs.  <chapter eID="Exod.35"/> <div eID="gen649" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:1
verses.text: And Bezalel and Oholiab and everyone <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> skilled of heart in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and skill to know and to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary—<transChange type="added">they</transChange> will do <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, according to all that Yahweh has commanded.”  <div eID="gen650" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv476"/><title type="x-s">Making the Tabernacle</title> <div sID="gen651" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv476"/>And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab and everyone skilled of heart, in whose heart Yahweh had put skill, all whose heart lifted him to come near to the work in order to do it.

verses.name: Exodus 36:3
verses.text: And they took from Moses all the contributions<note placement="foot">Hebrew “contribution”</note> that the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> had brought for the work of the service for the sanctuary in order to do it, and they still brought to him voluntary offerings <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the morning in the morning”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:4
verses.text: And all the skilled <transChange type="added">workers who were</transChange> doing all the work for the sanctuary came, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “man man”</note> from his work that they were doing.

verses.name: Exodus 36:5
verses.text: And they said to Moses, saying, “The people are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bringing more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “making much to bring”</note> than enough for the service of the work that Yahweh has commanded <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to be done⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “to do it”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:6
verses.text: And Moses commanded, and they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞proclaimed the message⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “caused a voice to cross through”</note> in the camp, saying, “Let no man or woman again make anything for the sanctuary contribution.” And so the people were restrained from bringing.

verses.name: Exodus 36:7
verses.text: And the material was enough for doing all the work, and it was left over.  <div eID="gen651" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv477"/><div sID="gen652" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv477"/>And all who were skilled of heart among the doers of the work made the tabernacle <transChange type="added">with</transChange> ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> cherubim; he made them, the work of a skilled craftsman.

verses.name: Exodus 36:9
verses.text: The length of the one curtain <transChange type="added">was</transChange> twenty-eight cubits, and the width <transChange type="added">was</transChange> four cubits <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the one curtain; one measurement <transChange type="added">was</transChange> for all the curtains.

verses.name: Exodus 36:10
verses.text: And he joined five of the curtains <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one to another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “one to one”</note> and five curtains he joined <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one to another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “one to one”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:11
verses.text: And he made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain, at the end in the set; so he did on the edge of the end curtain in the second set.

verses.name: Exodus 36:12
verses.text: He made fifty loops on the one curtain, and he made fifty loops on the end of the curtain that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in the second set; the loops were opposite<note placement="foot">Or “interlinked” or “matching”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one to another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “one to one”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:13
verses.text: And he made fifty gold clasps and joined the curtains <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one to another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one to one”</note> with the clasps, so that the tabernacle was one.  <div eID="gen652" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv478"/><div sID="gen653" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv478"/>And he made curtains of goat hair for a tent over the tabernacle; he made them eleven curtains.

verses.name: Exodus 36:15
verses.text: The length of the one curtain <transChange type="added">was</transChange> thirty cubits, and the width <transChange type="added">was</transChange> four cubits <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the one curtain; one measure <transChange type="added">was</transChange> for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eleven curtains.

verses.name: Exodus 36:16
verses.text: And he joined five curtains together and six curtains together.

verses.name: Exodus 36:17
verses.text: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the end curtain in the set, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the second set.

verses.name: Exodus 36:18
verses.text: And he made fifty bronze clasps for joining the tent to become one.  <div eID="gen653" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv479"/><div sID="gen654" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv479"/>And he made a covering for the tent of red-dyed ram skin and a covering of fine leather <transChange type="added">to go</transChange> above.  <div eID="gen654" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv480"/><div sID="gen655" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv480"/>And he made the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> for the tabernacle of acacia wood as uprights.<note placement="foot">Literally “standing”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:21
verses.text: The length of the frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> was ten cubits, and the width of the one frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> one and a half cubits.

verses.name: Exodus 36:22
verses.text: He made two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> for the one frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> for joining <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one to another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one to one”</note> and likewise for all the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 36:23
verses.text: And he made the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> for the tabernacle with twenty frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> for the south<note placement="foot">Or “southward southward”</note> side.

verses.name: Exodus 36:24
verses.text: And he made forty silver bases under the twenty frames,<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> with two bases under the one frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> for its two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> and two bases under the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞next⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one”</note> frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> for its two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:25
verses.text: And for the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, he made twenty frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:26
verses.text: and their forty silver bases, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> two bases under the one frame<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note> and two bases under the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞next⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one”</note> frame.<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note>  <div eID="gen655" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv481"/><div sID="gen656" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv481"/>And for the rear of the tabernacle <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “westward,” literally “seaward,” toward the Mediterranean Sea</note> he made six frames.<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:28
verses.text: And he made two frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> for the tabernacle corners at the rear.

verses.name: Exodus 36:29
verses.text: And they were double at the bottom, and they were completely together on its top to the one ring; he did likewise for the two of them, for the two corners.

verses.name: Exodus 36:30
verses.text: And there were eight frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> and their sixteen silver bases, two bases, two bases under the one frame.<note placement="foot">Or “board” or “plank”</note>  <div eID="gen656" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv482"/><div sID="gen657" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv482"/>And he made five bars of acacia wood for the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> on the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.name: Exodus 36:32
verses.text: and five bars for the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> on the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> at the rear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Or “westward,” literally “seaward,” toward the Mediterranean Sea</note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:33
verses.text: And he made the middle bar to run in the midst of the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> from end to end.

verses.name: Exodus 36:34
verses.text: And he overlaid the frames<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> with gold, and he made their rings of gold as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “houses”</note> for the bars, and he overlaid the bars with gold.

verses.name: Exodus 36:35
verses.text: And he made the curtain of blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and finely twisted linen, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of a craftsman; he made it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> cherubim.

verses.name: Exodus 36:36
verses.text: And he made for it four acacia pillars, and he overlaid them with gold, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their gold hooks, and he cast for them four silver bases.  <div eID="gen657" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv483"/><div sID="gen658" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv483"/>And he made for the entrance of the tent a screen of blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and finely twisted linen, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of an embroiderer,

verses.name: Exodus 36:38
verses.text: and the five pillars and their hooks, and he overlaid their tops and their connections <transChange type="added">with</transChange> gold, and their five bases <transChange type="added">were</transChange> bronze.  <chapter eID="Exod.36"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv484"/><title type="x-s">Making the Ark of the Covenant</title> <div sID="gen659" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv484"/>And Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits its length and a cubit and a half its width and a cubit and a half its height.

verses.name: Exodus 37:2
verses.text: And he overlaid it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> pure gold inside and outside, and he made for it a gold molding all around.

verses.name: Exodus 37:3
verses.text: And he cast for it four gold rings on its four feet; and two rings were on its one side, and two rings were on its second side.

verses.name: Exodus 37:4
verses.text: And he made poles of acacia wood, and he overlaid them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> gold.

verses.name: Exodus 37:5
verses.text: And he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.  <div eID="gen659" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv485"/><div sID="gen660" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv485"/>And he made an atonement cover of pure gold, two and a half cubits its length and a cubit and a half its width.

verses.name: Exodus 37:7
verses.text: And he made two cherubim of gold; he made them of hammered work at the two ends of the atonement cover.

verses.name: Exodus 37:8
verses.text: One cherub <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at one end⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from end from this”</note> and one cherub was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the other end⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from end from this”</note> of the atonement cover; he made the cherubim at its two ends.

verses.name: Exodus 37:9
verses.text: And the cherubim were <transChange type="added">with</transChange> outspread wings above, covering with their wings over the atonement cover <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and facing each other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “and their faces a man to his brother”</note> the faces of the cherubim were toward the atonement cover.  <div eID="gen660" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv486"/><title type="x-s">Making the Table and the Lampstand</title> <div sID="gen661" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv486"/>And he made the table of acacia wood, two cubits its length and a cubit its width and a cubit and a half its height.

verses.name: Exodus 37:11
verses.text: And he overlaid it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> pure gold, and he made for it a gold molding all around.

verses.name: Exodus 37:12
verses.text: And he made for it a handbreadth rim all around, and he made a gold molding for its rim all around.

verses.name: Exodus 37:13
verses.text: And he cast for it four gold rings, and he put the rings on the four corners where its four <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞legs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “feet”</note> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:14
verses.text: The rings were near the rim as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “houses”</note> for the poles to carry the table.

verses.name: Exodus 37:15
verses.text: And he made the poles of acacia wood, and he overlaid them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> gold to carry the table.

verses.name: Exodus 37:16
verses.text: And he made the vessels that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on the table—its plates and its ladles,<note placement="foot">Or “bowls”</note> and its bowls and its pitchers with which <transChange type="added">libations</transChange> were poured—<transChange type="added">of</transChange> pure gold.  <div eID="gen661" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv487"/><div sID="gen662" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv487"/>And he made the lampstand of pure gold; he made the lampstand of hammered work—its base and its branch, its cups, its buds, and its blossoms were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all part of it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from it”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 37:18
verses.text: And six branches <transChange type="added">were</transChange> going out from its sides, three branches of the lampstand from its one side and three branches of the lampstand from its second side.

verses.name: Exodus 37:19
verses.text: Three almond-flower cups <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on the one branch <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a bud and a blossom, and three almond-flower cups <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on the one branch <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a bud and a blossom—likewise for the six branches going out from the lampstand.

verses.name: Exodus 37:20
verses.text: And on the lampstand <transChange type="added">were</transChange> four almond-flower cups, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> its<note placement="foot">Refers to the lampstand</note> buds and its blossoms.

verses.name: Exodus 37:21
verses.text: And a bud <transChange type="added">was</transChange> under the two branches <transChange type="added">that came</transChange> from it, and a bud under the two branches from it, and a bud under the two branches from it, <transChange type="added">likewise</transChange> for the six branches coming out from the lampstand.

verses.name: Exodus 37:22
verses.text: Their buds and their branches were from it, all of it one <transChange type="added">piece</transChange> of pure gold, hammered work.

verses.name: Exodus 37:23
verses.text: And he made its seven lamps and its snuffers and its fire pans of pure gold.

verses.name: Exodus 37:24
verses.text: He made it <transChange type="added">from</transChange> a talent of pure gold and all its <transChange type="added">pieces of</transChange> equipment.  <div eID="gen662" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv488"/><title type="x-s">Making the Incense Altar and Anointing Oil</title> <div sID="gen663" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv488"/>And he made the incense altar of acacia wood, a cubit its length and a cubit its width—a square—and two cubits its height; its horns were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of one piece with it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from it”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 37:26
verses.text: And he overlaid it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> pure gold—its top and its sides all around and its horns—and he made for it a gold molding all around.

verses.name: Exodus 37:27
verses.text: And he made for it two gold rings under its molding <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on two opposite sides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on two of its sides on two of its sides”</note> as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “houses”</note> for poles to carry it with them.

verses.name: Exodus 37:28
verses.text: And he made the poles of acacia wood, and he overlaid them with gold.

verses.name: Exodus 37:29
verses.text: And he made the holy anointing oil and the pure fragrant incense—work of a perfumer.  <chapter eID="Exod.37"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv489"/><title type="x-s">Making the Bronze Altar and the Basin</title> <div sID="gen664" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv489"/>And he made the burnt-offering altar of acacia wood; its length <transChange type="added">was</transChange> five cubits, and its width <transChange type="added">was</transChange> five cubits—<transChange type="added">it was</transChange> square—and its height <transChange type="added">was</transChange> three cubits.

verses.name: Exodus 38:2
verses.text: And he made its horns on its four corners; its horns were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of one piece with it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “from it”</note> and he overlaid it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 38:3
verses.text: And he made all the equipment of the altar—the pots and the shovels and the sprinkling bowls and the forks<note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="1Sam.2.13">1 Samuel 2:13 </reference>mentions a fork with “three teeth” used by priests</note> and the fire pans—all its equipment he made <transChange type="added">with</transChange> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 38:4
verses.text: And he made for the altar a grating, a work of bronze network under its ledge, below, up to its middle.

verses.name: Exodus 38:5
verses.text: And he cast four rings on the four ends of the bronze grating <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “houses”</note> for the poles.

verses.name: Exodus 38:6
verses.text: And he made the poles of acacia wood, and he overlaid them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 38:7
verses.text: And he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar to carry it with them. He made it hollow with boards.  <div eID="gen664" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv490"/><div sID="gen665" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv490"/>And he made the basin of bronze and its stand of bronze from the mirrors of the serving women who served <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the entrance of the tent of assembly.  <div eID="gen665" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv491"/><title type="x-s">Making the Courtyard</title> <div sID="gen666" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv491"/>And he made the courtyard; for the south<note placement="foot">Or “southward southward”</note> side <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the hangings of the court of finely twisted linen, one hundred cubits,

verses.name: Exodus 38:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their twenty pillars and their twenty bases of bronze <transChange type="added">and with</transChange> the hooks of the pillars and their bands of silver.

verses.name: Exodus 38:11
verses.text: And for the north side <transChange type="added">the hangings were</transChange> one hundred cubits <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their twenty pillars and their twenty bases of bronze <transChange type="added">and with</transChange> the hooks of the pillars and their bands of silver.

verses.name: Exodus 38:12
verses.text: And for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sea”</note> side fifty cubits <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hangings <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their ten pillars and their ten bases <transChange type="added">and with</transChange> the hooks of the pillars and their bands of silver.

verses.name: Exodus 38:13
verses.text: And for the eastward side, toward sunrise, fifty cubits;

verses.name: Exodus 38:14
verses.text: fifteen cubits of hangings <transChange type="added">were</transChange> to the shoulder,<note placement="foot">Or “side,” referring to the span on one side of the courtyard’s entry</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their three pillars and their three bases,

verses.name: Exodus 38:15
verses.text: and for the second shoulder<note placement="foot">Or “side,” referring to the span on one side of the courtyard’s entry</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from this and from this”</note> of the gate of the courtyard <transChange type="added">were</transChange> fifteen cubits of hangings, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their three pillars and their three bases.

verses.name: Exodus 38:16
verses.text: All the hangings of the courtyard all around <transChange type="added">were</transChange> finely twisted linen,

verses.name: Exodus 38:17
verses.text: and the bases for the pillars <transChange type="added">were</transChange> bronze, the hooks of the pillars and their bands <transChange type="added">were</transChange> silver, and the overlay of their tops <transChange type="added">was</transChange> silver, and all the pillars of the courtyard <transChange type="added">were</transChange> banded <transChange type="added">with</transChange> silver.  <div eID="gen666" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv492"/><div sID="gen667" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv492"/>And the screen of the gate of the courtyard <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the work of an embroiderer, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and finely twisted linen; <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> twenty cubits long and five cubits <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞high⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “height in width”</note> like the hangings of the courtyard,

verses.name: Exodus 38:19
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their four pillars and their four bases of bronze, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their silver hooks and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their tops and their bands of silver.

verses.name: Exodus 38:20
verses.text: And all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> for the tabernacle and for the courtyard all around <transChange type="added">were</transChange> bronze.  <div eID="gen667" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv493"/><title type="x-s">Amounts of Gold, Silver, and Bronze Used</title> <div sID="gen668" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv493"/>These are the records of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the testimony, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> recorded at the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of”</note> Moses, the work of the Levites, in the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.name: Exodus 38:22
verses.text: And Bezalel the son of Uri the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, did all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 38:23
verses.text: And with him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Oholiab the son of Ahisamach of the tribe of Dan, a skilled craftsman and a designer and an embroiderer with the blue and with the purple and with the crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> and with the linen.  <div eID="gen668" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv494"/><div sID="gen669" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv494"/>And all the gold used for the work, in the work of the sanctuary, it was the gold of the wave offering—twenty-nine talents and seven hundred and thirty shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.  <div eID="gen669" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv495"/><div sID="gen670" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv495"/>And the silver recorded from the community <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a hundred talents and a thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

verses.name: Exodus 38:26
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It was</transChange> a bekah for the individual, the half shekel according to the sanctuary shekel, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone who was counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all of the going over to the being counted”</note> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, for six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

verses.name: Exodus 38:27
verses.text: And it was one hundred talents of the silver to cast the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the curtain—one hundred bases for one hundred talents of silver, a talent for <transChange type="added">each</transChange> base.

verses.name: Exodus 38:28
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">from</transChange> the thousand seven hundred and seventy-five <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> he made hooks for the pillars, and he overlaid their tops, and he made bands <transChange type="added">for</transChange> them.  <div eID="gen670" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv496"/><div sID="gen671" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv496"/>And the bronze of the wave offering <transChange type="added">was</transChange> seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

verses.name: Exodus 38:30
verses.text: And he made with it the bases of the entrance of the tent of assembly and the bronze altar and the bronze grating that belonged to it and all the equipment of the altar

verses.name: Exodus 38:31
verses.text: and the bases of the courtyard all around and the bases of the gate of the courtyard and all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> of the tabernacle and all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> of the courtyard all around.  <chapter eID="Exod.38"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv497"/><title type="x-s">Making Garments for Priests</title> <div sID="gen672" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv497"/>And from the blue and the purple and the crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange> they made woven garments for serving in the sanctuary, and they made the holy garments that were for Aaron, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 39:2
verses.text: And he made the ephod <transChange type="added">of</transChange> gold, blue, and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange>, and finely twisted linen.

verses.name: Exodus 39:3
verses.text: And he hammered out the leaves of gold, and he cut off cords to weave in the midst of the blue and in the midst of the purple and in the midst of the crimson and in the midst of the linen—<transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of a skilled craftsman.

verses.name: Exodus 39:4
verses.text: They made joined shoulder pieces for it; it was joined on its two edges.

verses.name: Exodus 39:5
verses.text: And the waistband of his ephod, which <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was of one piece with it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “on it from it”</note> <transChange type="added">was of</transChange> like work, gold, blue, and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange>, and finely twisted linen, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 39:6
verses.text: And they made onyx stones mounted <transChange type="added">in</transChange> gold filigree settings, engraved <transChange type="added">with</transChange> seal engravings according to the names of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 39:7
verses.text: And he set them on the ephod’s shoulder pieces <transChange type="added">as</transChange> stones of remembrance for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen672" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv498"/><div sID="gen673" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv498"/>And he made the breast piece, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of a skilled craftsman, like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ephod, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> gold, blue, and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange>, and finely twisted linen.

verses.name: Exodus 39:9
verses.text: It was squared; they made the breast piece doubled; its length <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a span, and its width <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a span <transChange type="added">when</transChange> doubled.

verses.name: Exodus 39:10
verses.text: And they filled it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> four rows of stone; a row of carnelian, topaz, and emerald <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the first row;

verses.name: Exodus 39:11
verses.text: and the second row <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a malachite, a sapphire, and a moonstone;

verses.name: Exodus 39:12
verses.text: and the third row <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

verses.name: Exodus 39:13
verses.text: and the fourth row <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a turquoise, an onyx, and a jasper. <transChange type="added">They were</transChange> set <transChange type="added">with</transChange> gold filigree settings in their mountings.

verses.name: Exodus 39:14
verses.text: And the stones <transChange type="added">were</transChange> according to the names of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> twelve according to their names, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> seal engravings, each according to its name for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twelve tribes.  <div eID="gen673" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv499"/><div sID="gen674" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv499"/>And they made on the breast piece braided chains, a work of pure gold ornamental cord.

verses.name: Exodus 39:16
verses.text: And they made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and they put the two rings on the two edges of the breast piece.

verses.name: Exodus 39:17
verses.text: And they put the two gold ornamental cords on the two rings on the edges of the breast piece.

verses.name: Exodus 39:18
verses.text: And they put the two ends of the two ornamental cords on the two filigree settings, and they put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front of it.

verses.name: Exodus 39:19
verses.text: And they made two gold rings, and they placed <transChange type="added">them</transChange> on the two edges of the breast piece, on its lip that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the other side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “beyond”</note> of the ephod, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the inside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “houseward,” “to house,” meaning “inward”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 39:20
verses.text: And they made two gold rings and put them on the ephod’s two shoulder pieces below, at its front near its seam above the waistband of the ephod.

verses.name: Exodus 39:21
verses.text: And they tied the breast piece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> the breast piece <transChange type="added">would</transChange> be on the waistband of the ephod and not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen674" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv500"/><div sID="gen675" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv500"/>And he made the robe of the ephod, weaver’s work, totally of blue <transChange type="added">yarn</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:23
verses.text: And the opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a sturdy garment, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> an edge for its opening all around so that it would not be torn.

verses.name: Exodus 39:24
verses.text: And they made on the hem of the robe pomegranates of finely twisted blue and purple and crimson.

verses.name: Exodus 39:25
verses.text: And they made pure gold bells and put the bells in the midst of the pomegranates on the hem of the robe all around in the midst of the pomegranates,

verses.name: Exodus 39:26
verses.text: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate on the hem of the robe all around for serving, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen675" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv501"/><div sID="gen676" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv501"/>And they made the tunics of fine linen, a weaver’s work, for Aaron and for his sons,

verses.name: Exodus 39:28
verses.text: and the turban of fine linen and the headdresses of the headbands of fine linen and undergarments of the linen cloth, finely twisted,

verses.name: Exodus 39:29
verses.text: and the sash of finely twisted linen and blue and purple and crimson <transChange type="added">yarns</transChange>, the work of an embroiderer, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen676" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv502"/><div sID="gen677" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv502"/>And they made the rosette<note placement="foot">Or “medallion”</note> of the holy diadem <transChange type="added">of</transChange> pure gold, and they wrote on it <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> writing of seal engravings: “A holy object for Yahweh.”

verses.name: Exodus 39:31
verses.text: And they put a blue cord on it to put it above on the turban, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen677" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv503"/><title type="x-s">Preparations Complete</title> <div sID="gen678" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv503"/>And all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of assembly was finished, and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> had done according to all that Yahweh had commanded Moses; so they did.

verses.name: Exodus 39:33
verses.text: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its equipment, its hooks, its frames,<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> its bars, and its pillars and its bases;

verses.name: Exodus 39:34
verses.text: and the covering of the red-dyed ram skins and the covering of fine leather and the curtain of the screen;

verses.name: Exodus 39:35
verses.text: the ark of the testimony and its poles and the atonement cover;

verses.name: Exodus 39:36
verses.text: the table, all its equipment, and the bread of the presence;

verses.name: Exodus 39:37
verses.text: the pure <transChange type="added">gold</transChange> lampstand, its lamps—the lamps of the row—and all its equipment and the oil of the light;

verses.name: Exodus 39:38
verses.text: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the screen of the entrance of the tent;

verses.name: Exodus 39:39
verses.text: the bronze altar, and the bronze grating that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for it, its poles, and all its equipment, the basin and its stand,

verses.name: Exodus 39:40
verses.text: the hangings of the courtyard, its pillars, and its bases; and the screen for the courtyard gate, its tent cords and its <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pegs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> and all the equipment of the service of the tabernacle for the tent of assembly,

verses.name: Exodus 39:41
verses.text: the woven garments for serving in the sanctuary—the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests.

verses.name: Exodus 39:42
verses.text: According to all that Yahweh had commanded Moses, so the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did all the work.

verses.name: Exodus 39:43
verses.text: And Moses saw all the work, and, indeed, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded; so they did, and Moses blessed them.  <chapter eID="Exod.39"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv504"/><title type="x-s">Completion of the Tabernacle</title> <div sID="gen679" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv504"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 40:2
verses.text: “On the first day of the month, you will set up the tabernacle of the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Exodus 40:3
verses.text: And you will put there the ark of the testimony, and you will cover over the ark <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the curtain.<note placement="foot">Or “veil the ark with the curtain”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 40:4
verses.text: And you will bring the table, and you will arrange its setting, and you will bring the lampstand, and you will set up its lamps.

verses.name: Exodus 40:5
verses.text: And you will put the gold altar for incense before the ark of the testimony, and you will set up the entrance screen for the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 40:6
verses.text: And you will put the altar of the burnt offering before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Exodus 40:7
verses.text: And you will put the basin between the tent of assembly and the altar, and you will put water <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “there”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 40:8
verses.text: And you will set up the courtyard all around, and you will put up the screen of the gate of the courtyard.  <div eID="gen679" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv505"/><div sID="gen680" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv505"/>“And you will take the anointing oil, and you will anoint the tabernacle and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in it, and you will consecrate all of its equipment,<note placement="foot">Or “vessels” or “utensils” or “contents”</note> and it will be holy.

verses.name: Exodus 40:10
verses.text: And you will anoint the altar of the burnt offering and all of its equipment,<note placement="foot">Or “vessels” or “utensils” or “contents”</note> and you will consecrate the altar, and the altar will be a most holy thing.<note placement="foot">Literally “holiness of holinesses,” that is, “a holy thing among holy things”</note>

verses.name: Exodus 40:11
verses.text: And you will anoint the basin and its stand, and you will consecrate it.

verses.name: Exodus 40:12
verses.text: And you will bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of assembly, and you will wash them with the water.

verses.name: Exodus 40:13
verses.text: And you will clothe Aaron with the holy garments, and you will anoint him, and you will consecrate him, and he will serve as a priest for me.

verses.name: Exodus 40:14
verses.text: And you will bring his sons, and you will clothe them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> tunics.

verses.name: Exodus 40:15
verses.text: And you will anoint them as you anointed their father, and they will serve as priests for me. And their anointing will be for them to be a lasting priesthood<note placement="foot">Or “a priesthood of eternity”</note> throughout their generations.”

verses.name: Exodus 40:16
verses.text: And Moses did according to all that Yahweh had commanded him; so he did.  <div eID="gen680" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv506"/><div sID="gen681" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv506"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it was in”</note> the first month of the second year, on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first of the month, the tabernacle was set up.

verses.name: Exodus 40:18
verses.text: And Moses raised the tabernacle, and he placed its bases, and he set up its frames,<note placement="foot">Or “boards” or “planks”</note> and he placed its bars, and he raised its pillars.

verses.name: Exodus 40:19
verses.text: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle; he placed the covering of the tent over it, above <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 40:20
verses.text: And he took and he put the testimony into the ark, and he placed the poles on the ark, and he put the atonement cover on the ark, above <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:21
verses.text: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and he set up the curtain of the screening, and he shielded the ark of the testimony, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen681" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv507"/><div sID="gen682" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv507"/>And he put the table in the tent of assembly on the north side of the tabernacle outside the curtain.

verses.name: Exodus 40:23
verses.text: And he arranged on it an arrangement of bread before Yahweh, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 40:24
verses.text: And he placed the lampstand in the tent of assembly opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 40:25
verses.text: And he set up the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 40:26
verses.text: And he placed the gold altar in the tent of assembly before the curtain.

verses.name: Exodus 40:27
verses.text: And he turned fragrant incense into smoke on it, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen682" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv508"/><div sID="gen683" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv508"/>And he set up the entrance screen for the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 40:29
verses.text: And the altar of burnt offering he placed <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of assembly, and he offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 40:30
verses.text: And he placed the basin between the tent of assembly and the altar, and he put there water for washing.

verses.name: Exodus 40:31
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet from it.

verses.name: Exodus 40:32
verses.text: At their going into the tent of assembly and at their approaching the altar, they washed, as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen683" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv509"/><div sID="gen684" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv509"/>And he set up the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and he put up the screen of the gate of the courtyard, and Moses completed the work.

verses.name: Exodus 40:34
verses.text: And the cloud covered the tent of assembly, and the glory of Yahweh filled the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 40:35
verses.text: And Moses was unable to go into the tent of assembly because the cloud settled on it and the glory of Yahweh filled the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 40:36
verses.text: And when the cloud was lifted from the tabernacle, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> set out on all their journeys.

verses.name: Exodus 40:37
verses.text: But if the cloud was not lifted, they did not set out until the day of its being lifted.

verses.name: Exodus 40:38
verses.text: For the cloud of Yahweh <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it <transChange type="added">by</transChange> night before the eyes of all the house of Israel throughout all their journeys.  <chapter eID="Exod.40"/> <div eID="gen684" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen333" osisID="Exod" type="book"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv510"/><title type="x-s">Laws for Burnt Offerings</title> <div sID="gen686" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv510"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of assembly, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 1:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘When a person<note placement="foot">Or “man”—the singular noun is generic, thus the “you” and “your” in the remainder of the verse are all plural</note> from you presents an offering to Yahweh, you shall present your offering from domestic animals, from the cattle<note placement="foot">Or “herd”</note> or from the flock.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 1:3
verses.text: If his offering <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a burnt offering from the cattle,<note placement="foot">Or “herd”</note> then he must present<note placement="foot">Hebrew “present it”</note> an unblemished male; he must present it at the door of the tent of assembly for his acceptance <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen686" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv511"/><div sID="gen687" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv511"/>“ ‘He<note placement="foot">Or “And he”</note> must lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering and it will be accepted<note placement="foot">Same root word as “acceptance” in v. <reference osisRef="Lev.1.3">3</reference></note> for him <transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to make atonement for him.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:5
verses.text: He<note placement="foot">Or “And he”</note> must slaughter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the young bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of the herd” or “the son of the cattle”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> Aaron’s sons, the priests, will present the blood and sprinkle the blood all around the altar that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the door of the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:6
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he must remove <transChange type="added">the</transChange> skin <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the burnt offering and cut it into its pieces.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:7
verses.text: The sons of<note placement="foot">Or “And the sons of”</note> Aaron the priest will put fire on the altar and arrange the wood on the fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:8
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Aaron’s sons, the priests, will arrange the pieces of meat,<note placement="foot">Verse <reference osisRef="Lev.1.6">6</reference> in the context uses the same word with reference to the meat</note> the head, and the suet on the wood that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the fire that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:9
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he must wash its inner parts<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note> and its lower leg bones with water, and the priest will turn into smoke the whole <transChange type="added">animal</transChange> on the altar <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a burnt offering <transChange type="added">by</transChange> fire, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an appeasing fragrance for Yahweh.  <div eID="gen687" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv512"/><div sID="gen688" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv512"/>“ ‘But if his offering <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from the flock,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> from the sheep or from the goats for a burnt offering, he must present<note placement="foot">Hebrew “present it”</note> an unblemished<note placement="foot">Same word as in v. <reference osisRef="Lev.1.3">3</reference></note> male.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:11
verses.text: He<note placement="foot">Or “And he”</note> must slaughter it on the north side of the altar <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh; then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> Aaron’s sons, the priests, will sprinkle its blood all around the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:12
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he must cut it into pieces <transChange type="added">along</transChange> with its head and its suet; and the priest will arrange them on the wood that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the fire that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:13
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he must wash the inner parts<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note> and the lower leg bones with water and the priest shall present the whole animal and will turn it<note placement="foot">Understood direct object</note> into smoke on the altar; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a burnt offering <transChange type="added">by</transChange> fire <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an appeasing fragrance for Yahweh.  <div eID="gen688" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv513"/><div sID="gen689" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv513"/>“ ‘But if his offering for Yahweh is a burnt offering from the birds, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> he must present his offering from the turtledoves or from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the young doves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the sons of the dove”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 1:15
verses.text: The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> will present it at the altar and must wring off its head and turn it into smoke on the altar, and its blood will be drained out on the wall<note placement="foot">Or “side”</note> of the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:16
verses.text: He<note placement="foot">Or “And he”</note> must remove its crop with its plumage and throw it to the east beside the altar on the place of the fatty ashes.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:17
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he must tear it apart by its wings but must not sever it; then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the priest will turn it into smoke on the altar. It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a burnt offering <transChange type="added">by</transChange> fire <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an appeasing fragrance for Yahweh.’ ”  <chapter eID="Lev.1"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv514"/><title type="x-s">Laws for Grain Offerings</title> <div sID="gen690" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv514"/>“ ‘When a person<note placement="foot">Or “a soul”</note> brings a grain offering to Yahweh, his offering must be finely milled flour, and he must pour out oil on it and place frankincense on it.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:2
verses.text: And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests, and he<note placement="foot">That is, the priest—see v. <reference osisRef="Lev.2.9">9</reference></note> shall take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his handful from its finely milled flour⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there his handful from its finely milled flour”</note> and from its oil in addition to all its frankincense. The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> shall turn its token portion into smoke on the altar <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an offering made <transChange type="added">by</transChange> fire, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an appeasing fragrance for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:3
verses.text: The remainder<note placement="foot">Or “And the remainder”</note> of the grain offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belongs to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for”</note> Aaron and to his sons—<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a holiness of holinesses”</note> from the offerings made by fire for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen690" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv515"/><div sID="gen691" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv515"/>“ ‘But if you bring a grain offering of something oven-baked, <transChange type="added">it must be of</transChange> finely milled flour <transChange type="added">as</transChange> ring-shaped unleavened bread <transChange type="added">mixed</transChange> with oil or wafers of unleavened bread smeared with oil.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:5
verses.text: If your offering <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a <transChange type="added">grain</transChange> offering <transChange type="added">baked</transChange> on a<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> flat baking pan, it must be finely milled flour, unleavened bread mixed with oil;

verses.name: Leviticus 2:6
verses.text: break it into pieces and pour out oil on it; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a grain <transChange type="added">offering</transChange>.  <div eID="gen691" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv516"/><div sID="gen692" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv516"/>“ ‘If<note placement="foot">Or “And if”</note> your offering <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a grain <transChange type="added">offering</transChange> <transChange type="added">prepared in</transChange> a cooking pan, it must be <transChange type="added">with</transChange> finely milled flour in oil.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:8
