verses.text: And you shall bring the grain <transChange type="added">offering</transChange> that is made from these things to Yahweh, and <transChange type="added">the offerer</transChange><note placement="foot">Changing from 2ms in the first verb to 3ms in the second verb apparently moves from general to specific; NET takes the second verb as an imperative (“Present it”), and NJPS translates it as an indefinite 3ms, making it passive (“it shall be brought”)</note> shall bring it to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:9
verses.text: And the priest shall take away from the grain <transChange type="added">offering</transChange> its token portion, and he shall turn <transChange type="added">it</transChange> into smoke on the altar <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an offering made <transChange type="added">by</transChange> fire, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an appeasing fragrance for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:10
verses.text: And the remainder of the grain <transChange type="added">offering</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belongs to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for”</note> Aaron and to his sons—<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a holiness of holinesses”</note> from the offerings made by fire for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen692" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv517"/><div sID="gen693" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv517"/>“ ‘Every grain <transChange type="added">offering</transChange> you<note placement="foot">The first time a plural 2m verb has been employed since 1:2</note> bring to Yahweh must not be made of yeasted food, because you must not turn into smoke any yeast or any honey from<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from it”</note> an offering made by fire for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> an offering of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> choicest portion, you<note placement="foot">Another occurrence of the 2mp</note> may bring them to Yahweh, but they must not be offered on the altar <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an appeasing fragrance.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:13
verses.text: Also all<note placement="foot">Or “And all”</note> of your grain offerings you must season with salt; you<note placement="foot">Or “and you”</note> must not omit the salt of your God’s covenant from your offering.  <div eID="gen693" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv518"/><div sID="gen694" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv518"/>“ ‘And if you bring to Yahweh a grain <transChange type="added">offering</transChange> of firstfruits, you must bring an ear of new grain roasted by fire, coarsely crushed ripe grain, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> the grain <transChange type="added">offering</transChange> of your firstfruits.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:15
verses.text: And you shall put oil on it and place frankincense on it; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a grain <transChange type="added">offering</transChange>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:16
verses.text: The<note placement="foot">Or “And the”</note> priest shall turn into smoke its token portion from its coarsely crushed grain together with all of its frankincense—<transChange type="added">it is</transChange> an offering made by fire for Yahweh.’ ”  <chapter eID="Lev.2"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv519"/><title type="x-s">Laws for Fellowship Offerings</title> <div sID="gen695" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv519"/>“ ‘Now if<note placement="foot">Or “And if”</note> his offering is a sacrifice of fellowship offering, if he brings it from the cattle,<note placement="foot">Or “the herd”</note> whether male or female, he must bring it without defect before Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:2
verses.text: He<note placement="foot">Or “And he”</note> must lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance of the tent of assembly, and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood on the altar all around.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:3
verses.text: He shall present<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall present”</note> from the sacrifice of the fellowship offering an offering made by fire for Yahweh consisting of<note placement="foot">The Hebrew accusative implies this transition</note> the fat covering the inner parts<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note> and all the fat that is on the inner parts,<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 3:4
verses.text: the two kidneys,<note placement="foot">Or “and the two kidneys”</note> and the fat that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the loins, and he must remove the lobe on the liver in addition to the kidneys.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:5
verses.text: Aaron’s sons shall turn it to smoke on the altar in addition to the burnt offering that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the wood, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the fire; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an offering made by fire <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an appeasing fragrance for Yahweh.  <div eID="gen695" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv520"/><div sID="gen696" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv520"/>“ ‘But if his offering for a sacrifice of fellowship offering for Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from the flock,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> he must bring a male or a female without defect.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:7
verses.text: If he brings a sheep <transChange type="added">as</transChange> his offering, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall present it before Yahweh,

verses.name: Leviticus 3:8
verses.text: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and he shall slaughter it before the tent of assembly, and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood on the altar all around.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:9
verses.text: He shall present<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall present”</note> from the sacrifice of the fellowship offering an offering made by fire for Yahweh: he must remove its fat, the entire fat tail near the tailbone, and the fat covering the inner parts<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note> and all the fat that is on the inner parts,<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 3:10
verses.text: the two kidneys,<note placement="foot">Or “and the two kidneys”</note> and the fat that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the loins, and he must remove the lobe on the liver in addition to the kidneys.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:11
verses.text: The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> shall turn it into smoke on the altar <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a food offering made by fire for Yahweh.  <div eID="gen696" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv521"/><div sID="gen697" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv521"/>“ ‘And<note placement="foot">Or “But”</note> if his offering is a goat, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall bring it before Yahweh,

verses.name: Leviticus 3:13
verses.text: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and he shall slaughter it before the tent of assembly, and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood on the altar all around.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:14
verses.text: He shall present<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall present”</note> his offering from it as an offering made by fire for Yahweh: the fat covering the inner parts<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note> and all the fat that is on the inner parts,<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 3:15
verses.text: the two kidneys,<note placement="foot">Or “and the two kidneys”</note> and the fat that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the loins, and he must remove the lobe on the liver in addition to the kidneys.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:16
verses.text: The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> shall turn them into smoke on the altar as a food offering;<note placement="foot">Compare v. <reference osisRef="Lev.3.11">11</reference></note> all the fat <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an offering made by fire <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an appeasing fragrance for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This is</transChange><note placement="foot">Understood by context</note> a lasting statute for your generations in all your dwellings: you must not eat any fat or any blood.’ ”  <chapter eID="Lev.3"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv522"/><title type="x-s">Laws for Sin Offerings</title> <div sID="gen698" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv522"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 4:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘If a person<note placement="foot">Or “a soul”</note> sins by an unintentional wrong from any of Yahweh’s commands that should not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞violated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “done”</note> and he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞violates⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “does”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from one from them”; see NET</note>—

verses.name: Leviticus 4:3
verses.text: if the anointed priest sins, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bringing guilt on the people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the guilt of the people”</note> then,<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> concerning the sin that he has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note> he shall bring <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a young bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a bull, a son of cattle”</note> without defect for Yahweh as a sin offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:4
verses.text: He shall bring<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall bring”</note> the bull to the tent of assembly’s entrance before Yahweh, place<note placement="foot">Or “And place”</note> his hand on the bull’s head, and slaughter the bull before Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:5
verses.text: The anointed priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the anointed priest”</note> shall take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the bull’s blood and shall bring it to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly,

verses.name: Leviticus 4:6
verses.text: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and shall spatter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the blood seven times before Yahweh in front of the sanctuary’s curtain.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:7
verses.text: The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> shall put <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense before Yahweh, which is in the tent of assembly, and all the rest<note placement="foot">Implied by the context</note> of the bull’s blood he must pour out on the base of the altar of the burnt offering, which <transChange type="added">is at the</transChange> entrance of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly.  <div eID="gen698" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv523"/><div sID="gen699" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv523"/>“ ‘He must remove<note placement="foot">Or “And he must remove”</note> all the fat from the bull of the sin offering: the fat that covers the inner parts<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note> and all of the fat that is on the inner parts,<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:9
verses.text: the two<note placement="foot">Or “and the two”</note> kidneys and the fat that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them, and the liver’s lobe <transChange type="added">that</transChange> he must remove in addition to the kidneys—

verses.name: Leviticus 4:10
verses.text: just as it is removed from the ox of the fellowship offerings’ sacrifice—and the priest shall turn them into smoke on the altar of the burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:11
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the bull’s skin and its meat, in addition to its head, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its lower leg bones⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and in addition to its lower leg bones”</note> its<note placement="foot">Or “and its”</note> inner parts,<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note> and its offal—

verses.name: Leviticus 4:12
verses.text: he shall carry<note placement="foot">Or “and he shall carry out”</note> all of the bull <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to from an outside place of the camp”</note> to a ceremonially clean place, to the fatty ashes’ dump, and he shall burn it on wood in the fire; it must be burned up on the fatty ashes’ dump.  <div eID="gen699" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv524"/><div sID="gen700" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv524"/>“ ‘If<note placement="foot">Or “And if”</note> Israel’s whole assembly did wrong unintentionally and the matter<note placement="foot">Or “thing”</note> was concealed from the assembly’s eyes, and they acted<note placement="foot">Or “did”</note> against <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one from all of”</note> Yahweh’s commands that should not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞violated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “done”</note> so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they incur guilt,

verses.name: Leviticus 4:14
verses.text: when<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the sin that they have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note> against that command<note placement="foot">The 3fs pronominal suffix may refer to “one of Yahweh’s commands”—“one” is also fs</note> becomes known, the assembly<note placement="foot">Or “and the assembly”</note> shall present <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a young bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a bull, a son of cattle”</note> as a sin offering, and they shall bring it before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:15
verses.text: And the elders of the community shall place their hands on the bull’s head before Yahweh, and he<note placement="foot">Or “someone”; see NET—the 3ms refers to either one of the elders or the priest</note> shall slaughter the bull before Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:16
verses.text: Then the anointed priest shall bring <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the bull’s blood to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly,

verses.name: Leviticus 4:17
verses.text: and the priest shall dip his finger in<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> the blood and shall spatter it seven times before Yahweh in front of the curtain.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:18
verses.text: He must put<note placement="foot">Or “And he must put”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the blood on the altar’s horns before Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the tent of assembly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “which is in the tent of assembly”—the reference is to the altar</note> and all the rest<note placement="foot">Indicated by the context</note> of the blood he must pour out on the base of the altar of the burnt offering, which <transChange type="added">is at the</transChange> tent of assembly’s entrance.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:19
verses.text: He must remove<note placement="foot">Or “And he must remove”</note> all its fat from it, and he shall turn <transChange type="added">it</transChange> into smoke on the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:20
verses.text: He shall do<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall do”</note> to the bull <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> he did to the sin offering’s bull, so he must do to it. The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> shall make atonement for them, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will be forgiven⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it shall be forgiven to them”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:21
verses.text: He shall bring<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall bring out”</note> the rest of<note placement="foot">Indicated by the context</note> the bull <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to from an outside place of the camp”</note> and he shall burn it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> he burned the first bull; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the sin offering for the assembly.  <div eID="gen700" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv525"/><div sID="gen701" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv525"/>“ ‘When a leader sins and commits<note placement="foot">Or “does”</note> an unintentional wrong against <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one from all of”</note> the commands of Yahweh his God that should not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞violated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “done”</note> so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he incurs guilt,

verses.name: Leviticus 4:23
verses.text: or his sin he has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note> is made known to him, he shall bring<note placement="foot">Or “and he shall bring” or “then he shall bring”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a male goat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a he-goat of goats a male”</note> without defect <transChange type="added">as</transChange> his offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:24
verses.text: He shall place<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall place”</note> his hand on the he-goat’s head and slaughter it in the place where he slaughtered the burnt offering before Yahweh; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sin offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:25
verses.text: The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> shall take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the sin offering’s blood with his finger, and he shall put it on the horns of the altar of the burnt offering, and he must pour out the rest of<note placement="foot">Indicated by context</note> its blood on the base of the altar of the burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:26
verses.text: He<note placement="foot">Or “And he”; the antecedent is the priest (cp. vv. <reference osisRef="Lev.4.10">10</reference>, 31)</note> must turn all of its fat into smoke on the altar like the fat of the fellowship offerings’ sacrifice, and the priest shall make atonement for him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> his sin, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will be forgiven⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it shall be forgiven to him”</note>  <div eID="gen701" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv526"/><div sID="gen702" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv526"/>“ ‘If<note placement="foot">Or “And if”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a soul one”</note> of the people of the land sins by an unintentional wrong by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞violating⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “doing”</note> one of Yahweh’s commands that should not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞violated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “done”</note> so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he incurs guilt,

verses.name: Leviticus 4:28
verses.text: or his sin he has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note> is made known to him, he shall bring<note placement="foot">Or “and he shall bring” or “then he shall bring”</note> as his offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a female goat without defect⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a she-goat of goats without defect a female”</note> as his offering for his sin that he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:29
verses.text: He shall place<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall place”</note> his hand on the sin offering’s head and slaughter the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:30
verses.text: The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> shall take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> its blood with his finger, and he shall put it on the horns of the altar of the burnt offering, and he must pour out all the rest of<note placement="foot">Indicated by context</note> its blood on the altar’s base.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:31
verses.text: He<note placement="foot">Or “And he”</note> must remove all of its fat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> the fat was removed from<note placement="foot">Or “from on” or “from upon”</note> the fellowship offerings’ sacrifice, and the priest shall turn it into smoke on the altar as an appeasing fragrance for Yahweh. The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> shall make atonement for him, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will be forgiven⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it shall be forgiven to him”</note>  <div eID="gen702" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv527"/><div sID="gen703" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv527"/>“ ‘But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if he brings a lamb <transChange type="added">as</transChange> his offering for a sin offering, he must bring a female without defect.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:33
verses.text: He shall place<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall place”</note> his hand on the sin offering’s head, and he shall slaughter it as a sin offering in the place where he slaughtered the burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:34
verses.text: The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> shall take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the sin offering’s blood with his finger, and he shall put it on the horns of the altar of the burnt offering, and he must pour out all the rest<note placement="foot">Indicated by context</note> of its blood on the altar’s base.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:35
verses.text: He must remove<note placement="foot">Or “And he must remove”</note> all of its fat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> the lamb’s fat from the fellowship offerings’ sacrifice was removed, and the priest shall turn them into smoke on the altar upon Yahweh’s offerings made by fire; and the priest shall make atonement for him because of<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> his sin that he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will be forgiven⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “it will be forgiven to him”</note>  <chapter eID="Lev.4"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv528"/><title type="x-s">More Laws Regarding Sin Offerings</title> <div sID="gen704" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv528"/>“ ‘When a person<note placement="foot">Or “a soul”</note> sins in that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he hears the utterance of a curse and he is a witness or he sees or he knows, if he does not make it known, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall bear his guilt.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:2
verses.text: Or if a person<note placement="foot">Or “a soul”</note> touches anything unclean, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whether⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “or”</note> an unclean wild<note placement="foot">Implied by the following phrase specifying domestic animals</note> animal’s dead body or an unclean domestic animal’s dead body or an unclean swarmer’s dead body, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he is unaware of it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “it is concealed from him”</note> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> unclean and he is guilty.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:3
verses.text: Or when he touches human uncleanness, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞namely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for” or “to” (see HALOT 510)</note> any uncleanness of his by which he might become unclean, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he is unaware of it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “it is concealed from him”</note> and he himself finds out, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he will be guilty.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:4
verses.text: Or when a person<note placement="foot">Or “a soul”</note> swears, speaking thoughtlessly with his lips, to do evil or to do good <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with regard to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for” or “to” (see HALOT 510)</note> anything that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the man”</note> in a sworn oath speaks thoughtlessly, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he is unaware of it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “it is concealed from him”</note> he will be guilty <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in any of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for one of”</note> these.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:5
verses.text: When he becomes guilty <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in any of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for one of”</note> these, he shall confess<note placement="foot">Or “and he shall confess”</note> what he has sinned <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞regarding⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “upon” or “against”</note> it,

verses.name: Leviticus 5:6
verses.text: and he shall bring his guilt offering to<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> Yahweh for his sin that he has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note> a female from the flock,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> a ewe-lamb or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a she-goat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a she-goat of goats”</note> as a sin offering, and the priest shall make atonement for him for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> his sin.  <div eID="gen704" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv529"/><div sID="gen705" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv529"/>“ ‘If<note placement="foot">Or “And if”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he cannot afford a sheep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his hand does not touch enough of small livestock”</note> he shall bring as his guilt offering for what he sinned two turtledoves or two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young doves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of dove” or “children of dove”</note> for Yahweh, one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:8
verses.text: He shall bring<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall bring”</note> them to the priest, and he shall present that which is for the sin offering first, and the priest<note placement="foot">Required by the previous action (see NET)</note> shall wring its head off <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the back of its neck⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from opposite its neck”</note> but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he must not sever <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,

verses.name: Leviticus 5:9
verses.text: and he shall spatter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the sin offering’s blood on the altar’s side, and the leftover blood must be drained out on the altar’s base; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sin offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:10
verses.text: The second<note placement="foot">Or “And the second”</note> bird he must prepare as a burnt offering according to the regulation, and the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin that he has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note> and he shall be forgiven.  <div eID="gen705" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv530"/><div sID="gen706" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv530"/>“ ‘But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he cannot afford⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his hand cannot produce for”</note> two turtledoves or two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young doves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of dove” or “children of dove”</note> then,<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> because he has sinned, he shall bring as his offering a tenth of an<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> ephah of finely milled flour as a sin offering. He must not put<note placement="foot">Or “And he must not put”</note> oil on it, nor should he put frankincense on it, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sin offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:12
verses.text: He shall bring<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall bring”</note> it to the priest, and the priest <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall take a handful of it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shall scoop up from it the fullness of his handful”</note> for its token portion, and he shall turn it to smoke on the altar <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in addition to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on” or “upon”</note> the offerings made by fire <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Yahweh; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sin offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:13
verses.text: Thus<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the priest shall make atonement for him because of the sin that he has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in any of these⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from one from these”</note> and he shall be forgiven. It shall be<note placement="foot">Or “And it shall be”</note> for the priest, like the grain offering.’ ”  <div eID="gen706" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv531"/><title type="x-s">Laws for Guilt Offerings</title> <div sID="gen707" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv531"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 5:15
verses.text: “When a person<note placement="foot">Or “a soul”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞displays infidelity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “acts unfaithfully infidelity” or “is unfaithful in unfaithfulness”</note> and he sins in an unintentional wrong <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in any of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> Yahweh’s holy things, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall bring his guilt offering to<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> as a guilt offering by your valuation in silver shekels<note placement="foot">Or “convertible into silver shekels” (NET, NRSV, TNK), “of the proper value in silver” (NIV; cp. ESV “valued in silver shekels,” CSB), or “or you may buy one of equal value with silver” (NLT)</note> according to the sanctuary shekel.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:16
verses.text: And he shall make restitution <transChange type="added">for</transChange> what he sinned <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from” (see HALOT 598)</note> a holy thing and shall add one-fifth of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its value⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it”</note> onto it and shall give it to the priest. The priest<note placement="foot">Or “And the priest”</note> shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering, and he will be forgiven.  <div eID="gen707" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv532"/><div sID="gen708" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv532"/>“If<note placement="foot">Or “And if”</note> a person<note placement="foot">Or “a soul”</note> when he sins <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞violates⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and she/it does”</note> one from all of Yahweh’s commands that should not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞be violated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they are to be done”</note> but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he did not know, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he is guilty and he shall bear his guilt.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:18
verses.text: He shall bring<note placement="foot">Or “And he shall bring”</note> to the priest a ram without defect from the flock<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> as a guilt offering by your valuation, and the priest shall make atonement for him because of his unintentional wrong (although<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he himself did not know), and he will be forgiven.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:19
verses.text: It is a guilt offering; he certainly was guilty before Yahweh.”  <chapter eID="Lev.5"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv533"/><title type="x-s">Additional Laws for Burnt Offerings</title> <div sID="gen709" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv533"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Lev.6.1-Lev.6.30">Leviticus 6:1–30 </reference>in the English Bible is 5:20–6:23 in the Hebrew Bible</note> Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:2
verses.text: “When a person<note placement="foot">Or “a soul”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞displays infidelity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “acts unfaithfully infidelity” or “is unfaithful in unfaithfulness”</note> against Yahweh and he deceives his fellow citizen regarding<note placement="foot">Literally “in”</note> something entrusted or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a pledge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a pledge of a hand”</note> or stealing or he exploits his fellow citizen,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:3
verses.text: or he finds lost property and lies about it and swears <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in accordance with deception”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in regard to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on” or “upon”</note> any one of these things by which <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the man”</note> might commit sin,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:4
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it will be when”</note> he sins and is guilty, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall bring back <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the things he had stolen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the robbed things that he had stolen”</note> or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what he had extorted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the extortion that he had extorted”</note> or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞something with which he had been entrusted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “something entrusted that had been entrusted to him”</note> or the lost property that he had found,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:5
verses.text: or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞regarding⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> anything about which he has sworn <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in accordance with deception”</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall repay it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in”</note> its value and shall add one-fifth of its value to it—he must give it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to whom it belongs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to whom it is to him”</note> on the day of his guilt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:6
verses.text: And he must bring as his guilt offering to Yahweh a ram without defect from the flock<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> by your valuation<note placement="foot">See 5:15 and 18</note> as a guilt offering to the priest,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:7
verses.text: and the priest shall make atonement for him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh, and he shall be forgiven <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one”</note> from all that he might do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by which he might incur guilt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “which he might do for incurring guilt by it”</note>  <div eID="gen709" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv534"/><div sID="gen710" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv534"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:9
verses.text: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the regulation of the burnt offering: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The burnt offering must remain on the hearth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “It shall be the burnt offering on a hearth”</note> on the altar all night until the morning, and the altar’s fire must be kept burning on it.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:10
verses.text: And the priest shall put on his linen robe, and he must put his linen undergarments on his body, and he shall take away the fatty ashes <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the burnt offering that the fire has consumed on the altar, and he shall place them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him/it”—plural required by the English “fatty ashes”</note> beside the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:11
verses.text: And he shall take off his garments and put on other garments, and he shall bring out the fatty ashes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to from an outside place of the camp”</note> to a ceremonially clean place,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:12
verses.text: but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the fire on the altar must be kept burning on it; it must not be quenched. And the priest must burn wood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the morning in the morning”</note> on it,<note placement="foot">Antecedent for this 3fs suffix is “fire” (“altar” is ms)</note> and he shall arrange the burnt offering on it,<note placement="foot">Antecedent for this 3fs suffix is “fire” (“altar” is ms)</note> and he shall turn into smoke the fat portions of the fellowship offerings on it.<note placement="foot">Antecedent for this 3fs suffix is “fire” (“altar” is ms)</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:13
verses.text: A perpetual fire must be kept burning on the altar; it must not be quenched.  <div eID="gen710" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv535"/><title type="x-s">Additional Laws for Grain Offerings</title> <div sID="gen711" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv535"/>“ ‘And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the regulation of the grain offering. Aaron’s sons shall present it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in front of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> the altar,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:15
verses.text: and he<note placement="foot">That is, the priest; understood by context and 3ms verb</note> in his fist shall take away from it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the grain offering’s finely milled flour, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> its oil and all of the frankincense that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the grain offering, and he shall turn into smoke its token portion on the altar <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an appeasing fragrance to Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:16
verses.text: And Aaron and his sons must eat the remainder of it; they must eat it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> unleavened bread in a holy place—in the tent of assembly’s courtyard they must eat it.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:17
verses.text: It must not be baked <transChange type="added">with</transChange> yeast. I have given it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> their share from my offerings made by fire. It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a holiness of holinesses”</note> like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:18
verses.text: Every male among Aaron’s sons may eat it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a lasting rule among your generations from the offerings made by fire <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belonging to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> Yahweh. Anything that<note placement="foot">Or “Everyone who”</note> touches them will become holy.’ ”  <div eID="gen711" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv536"/><div sID="gen712" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv536"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:20
verses.text: “This is the offering of Aaron and his sons that they shall present to Yahweh on the day of his being anointed: a tenth of an<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> ephah of finely milled flour <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a perpetual grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:21
verses.text: It must be made<note placement="foot">Or “prepared”</note> in<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> oil on a flat baking pan; you<note placement="foot">Singular masculine</note> must bring it well-mixed; you must present pieces of a grain offering’s baked goods<note placement="foot">Or “broken bits” (JPS, NET, NIV)</note> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an appeasing fragrance to Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:22
verses.text: And the anointed priest <transChange type="added">taking</transChange> his place from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> his sons must do it. <transChange type="added">As</transChange> a lasting rule, it must be turned into smoke totally for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:23
verses.text: And every grain offering of a priest must be a whole burnt offering; it must not be eaten.”  <div eID="gen712" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv537"/><title type="x-s">Additional Laws for Sin Offerings</title> <div sID="gen713" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv537"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:25
verses.text: “Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the regulation of the sin offering: In <transChange type="added">the</transChange> place where the sin offering is slaughtered, the sin offering must be slaughtered <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh; it is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a holiness of holinesses”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:26
verses.text: The priest <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who offers the sin offering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one who offers it a sin offering”</note> must eat it in a holy place—in the tent of assembly’s courtyard.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:27
verses.text: Anything that<note placement="foot">Or “Everyone who”</note> touches its flesh will become holy, and when <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> its blood spatters on a<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> garment, what was spattered on it you<note placement="foot">Singular masculine</note> shall wash in a holy place.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:28
verses.text: And a clay vessel in which it was boiled must be broken, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> if it was boiled in a bronze vessel, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> it shall be thoroughly scoured and rinsed with water.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:29
verses.text: Any male among the priests may eat it; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a holiness of holinesses”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:30
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> any sin offering from which <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> its blood is brought to the tent of assembly to make atonement in the sanctuary must not be eaten; it must be burned in the fire.’ ”  <chapter eID="Lev.6"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv538"/><title type="x-s">Additional Laws for Guilt Offerings</title> <div sID="gen714" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv538"/>“ ‘And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the regulation of the guilt offering; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a holiness of holinesses”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:2
verses.text: In the place where they slaughter the burnt offering,<note placement="foot">Or, taking the verb as an indefinite (thus passive) imperfect 3mp, “the sin offering is slaughtered”</note> they must slaughter the guilt offering,<note placement="foot">Or, taking the verb as an indefinite (thus passive) imperfect 3mp, “the guilt offering must be slaughtered”</note> and he<note placement="foot">That is, the priest; understood by context and 3ms verb</note> must sprinkle its blood upon the altar all around.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:3
verses.text: And he must present all of its fat:<note placement="foot">Hebrew “all of its fat from it”</note> the fat tail and the fat that covers the inner parts,<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:4
verses.text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the loins, and he must remove the lobe on the liver in addition to the kidneys.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:5
verses.text: And the priest shall turn it into smoke it on the altar <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a food offering made by fire for Yahweh; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a guilt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:6
verses.text: Every male among the priests may eat it; it must be eaten in a holy place; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a holiness of holinesses”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> instruction <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the same for the guilt offering as for the sin offering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “as the sin offering as the guilt offering one for them”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it belongs to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for him it shall be” or “it will become his”</note> the priest, who makes atonement with it.  <div eID="gen714" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv539"/><title type="x-s">Portions for the Priests</title> <div sID="gen715" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv539"/>“ ‘And<note placement="foot">Or “As for”</note> the priest who presents <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a person’s⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of a man”</note> burnt offering, to that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> priest <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belongs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to/for him it shall be”</note> the skin of the burnt offering that he presented.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:9
verses.text: And every grain offering that is baked in the oven and all that is prepared in a<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> cooking pan or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> on a flat baking pan <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belongs to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for him it shall be” or “it will become his”</note> the priest who presented it.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:10
verses.text: And every grain offering, <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> mixed with oil or dry, shall be for all of Aaron’s sons <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞equally⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “each as his brother”</note>  <div eID="gen715" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv540"/><title type="x-s">Additional Laws for Fellowship Offerings</title> <div sID="gen716" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv540"/>“ ‘And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the regulation of the fellowship offerings that he must present to Yahweh:

verses.name: Leviticus 7:12
verses.text: If he presents it for thanksgiving, in addition to the thanksgiving sacrifice he shall present ring-shaped unleavened bread mixed with oil and unleavened bread wafers smeared with oil and well-mixed ring-shaped bread cakes of finely milled flour mixed with oil.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:13
verses.text: In addition to ring-shaped cakes of bread <transChange type="added">with</transChange> yeast, he must present his <transChange type="added">grain</transChange><note placement="foot">Implied by v. <reference osisRef="Lev.7.12">12</reference></note> offering together with<note placement="foot">Or “in addition to”</note> his sacrifice of thanksgiving peace offerings.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:14
verses.text: And he shall present one of each kind of <transChange type="added">grain</transChange><note placement="foot">Implied by v. <reference osisRef="Lev.7.12">12</reference></note> offering as a contribution for Yahweh; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it belongs to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for him it shall be” or “it will become his”</note> the priest who sprinkles the fellowship offerings’ blood.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:15
verses.text: And the meat of the sacrifice of his thanksgiving fellowship offerings must be eaten on the day of his offering; he must not leave it until morning.  <div eID="gen716" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv541"/><div sID="gen717" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv541"/>“ ‘But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if his sacrifice is for a vow or as a freewill offering, it must be eaten on the day of his presenting his sacrifice, and on the next day the remainder<note placement="foot">Or “and the remainder”</note> from it may be eaten,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:17
verses.text: but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the remainder from the sacrifice’s meat must be burned up in the fire on the third day.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:18
verses.text: And if indeed some of the meat of his fellowship offerings’ sacrifice is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted; it will not be considered <transChange type="added">of benefit</transChange> for the one who presented it—it shall be unclean <transChange type="added">meat</transChange>, and the person<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> who eats it shall bear his guilt.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:19
verses.text: And the meat that touches anything unclean must not be eaten; it must be burned with fire, and as for the <transChange type="added">clean</transChange><note placement="foot">Understood by context</note> meat, anyone who is clean may eat the meat.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:20
verses.text: And the person<note placement="foot">Or “the soul”</note> who eats meat from the fellowship offerings’ sacrifice, which is for Yahweh, and whose uncleanness is upon him—that person<note placement="foot">Or “the soul”</note> shall be cut off from his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:21
verses.text: And when a person<note placement="foot">Or “a soul”</note> touches anything unclean, whether human uncleanness or an unclean animal or any unclean detestable thing, and he eats from the meat of the fellowship offerings’ sacrifice, which is for Yahweh, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> that person<note placement="foot">Or “the soul”</note> shall be cut off from his people.’ ”  <div eID="gen717" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv542"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for the People</title> <div sID="gen718" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv542"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:23
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must not eat any fat of ox, or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> sheep, or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> goat;

verses.name: Leviticus 7:24
verses.text: and a dead body’s fat or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> mangled carcass’s fat may be used for any <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞purpose⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “work”</note> but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> certainly must not eat it.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:25
verses.text: When anyone eats fat from the domestic animal from which he presented an offering made by fire for Yahweh, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> that person<note placement="foot">Or “the soul”</note> who ate shall be cut off from his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:26
verses.text: And in any of your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> dwellings, you must not eat any blood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belonging to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to/of”</note> birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the bird”; generic article with a collective noun</note> or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> domestic animals.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the domestic animal”; generic article with a collective noun</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:27
verses.text: Any person<note placement="foot">Or “any soul” or “all soul(s)”</note> who eats any blood, that person<note placement="foot">Or “and that soul”</note> shall be cut off from his people.’ ”  <div eID="gen718" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv543"/><title type="x-s">Portions of Fellowship Offerings for Priests</title> <div sID="gen719" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv543"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:29
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘The one who presents his fellowship offerings’ sacrifice for Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh from his fellowship offerings’ sacrifice.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:30
verses.text: His <transChange type="added">own</transChange> hands must bring Yahweh’s offerings made by fire. He must bring the fat in addition to the breast section to wave the breast section <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a wave offering before Yahweh,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:31
verses.text: and the priest shall turn the fat into smoke on the altar, and the breast section shall be for Aaron and his<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for his”</note> sons.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:32
verses.text: And the right upper thigh you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must give as a contribution for the priest from your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> fellowship offerings’ sacrifice.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:33
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> the one from Aaron’s sons who presents the blood of the fellowship offerings and the fat, the right upper thigh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall belong to him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for him it shall be”</note> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> his share,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:34
verses.text: because I have taken the wave offering’s breast section and the contribution <transChange type="added">offering’s</transChange> upper thigh from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> out of their fellowship offerings’ sacrifices, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and his<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to his”</note> sons from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a lasting rule.’ ”  <div eID="gen719" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv544"/><div sID="gen720" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv544"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Aaron’s allotted portion and his sons’ allotted portion from Yahweh’s offerings made by fire <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in a day”</note> he brought them forward to serve as priests for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:36
verses.text: This is what Yahweh commanded to give them from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> on the day of his anointing them; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> a lasting statute for their generations.  <div eID="gen720" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv545"/><title type="x-s">Concluding Summary Concerning the Offerings</title> <div sID="gen721" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv545"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the regulation for the burnt offering, for the grain offering and for the sin offering and for the guilt offering and for the consecration <transChange type="added">offering</transChange> and for the fellowship offerings’ sacrifice,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:38
verses.text: which Yahweh commanded Moses on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Sinai⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Sinai”</note> on the day of his commanding the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> to present their offerings to Yahweh in the desert of Sinai.  <chapter eID="Lev.7"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv546"/><title type="x-s">Installing the Priests</title> <div sID="gen722" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv546"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 8:2
verses.text: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments and the anointing oil and the bull of the sin offering and the two rams and the basket of the unleavened bread,

verses.name: Leviticus 8:3
verses.text: and summon all of the community to the entrance to<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> the tent of assembly.”

verses.name: Leviticus 8:4
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses did just as Yahweh commanded him, and the community gathered by the entrance to<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> the tent of assembly.  <div eID="gen722" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv547"/><div sID="gen723" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv547"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses said to the community, “This is the word that Yahweh has commanded to be done.”<note placement="foot">Or “to do” or “me to do”</note>  <div eID="gen723" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv548"/><div sID="gen724" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv548"/>So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses brought Aaron and his sons near, and he washed them with water.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:7
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he put the tunic on him and tied<note placement="foot">Or “he tied”</note> the sash around him; then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he clothed him with the robe and put<note placement="foot">Or “he put”</note> the ephod on him; then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he tied the ephod’s waistband around him and fastened<note placement="foot">Or “he fastened”</note> the ephod<note placement="foot">Understood by context</note> to him with it.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:8
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he placed the breastpiece on him and put<note placement="foot">Or “he put”</note> the Urim and the Thummim into the breastpiece;

verses.name: Leviticus 8:9
verses.text: and he placed the turban on his head, and on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the front of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the front of his faces”</note> the turban he placed the gold rosette, the holy diadem, <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen724" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv549"/><div sID="gen725" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv549"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses took the anointing oil and anointed<note placement="foot">Or “he anointed”</note> the tabernacle and all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in it, and he consecrated them.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:11
verses.text: And he spattered <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞part of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> it on the altar seven times—thus<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he anointed the altar and all of its utensils, and the basin and its stand, to consecrate them.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:12
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he poured out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞part of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the anointing oil on Aaron’s head—thus<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he anointed him <transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to consecrate him.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:13
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses brought Aaron’s sons near and clothed<note placement="foot">Or “he clothed”</note> them with tunics and tied<note placement="foot">Or “he tied”</note> a sash around <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “them”</note> and he bound headbands on<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> them, <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen725" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv550"/><title type="x-s">The Offerings for Consecration</title> <div sID="gen726" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv550"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he brought forth the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons placed their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering,

verses.name: Leviticus 8:15
verses.text: and he slaughtered <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and Moses took the blood and put<note placement="foot">Or “he put”</note> it with his finger on the altar’s horns all around and purified the altar; then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he poured the blood out on the altar’s base—thus<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he consecrated it in order to make atonement for it.<note placement="foot">Or “to make atonement upon it” (see NET, Tanakh)</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:16
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he took all the fat that was on the inner parts<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note> and the lobe on the liver and the two kidneys and their fat, and Moses turned <transChange type="added">them</transChange> into smoke on the altar,

verses.name: Leviticus 8:17
verses.text: but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he burned the bull and its skin and its meat and its offal in the fire <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from an outside place of the camp”</note> <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen726" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv551"/><div sID="gen727" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv551"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he brought the ram of the burnt offering near, and Aaron and his sons placed their hands on the ram’s head,

verses.name: Leviticus 8:19
verses.text: and he slaughtered <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses sprinkled the blood on the altar all around.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:20
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he cut the ram into pieces, and Moses turned into smoke the head and the pieces and the suet,

verses.name: Leviticus 8:21
verses.text: but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he washed the inner parts<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note> and the lower leg bones with water, and Moses turned into smoke all of the ram on the altar; it was a burnt offering as an appeasing fragrance, an offering made by fire for<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> Yahweh, <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen727" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv552"/><div sID="gen728" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv552"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he brought the second ram near, the ram of the consecration, and Aaron and his sons placed their hands on the ram’s head,

verses.name: Leviticus 8:23
verses.text: and he slaughtered <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses took <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> its blood and put<note placement="foot">Or “he put”</note> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on Aaron’s right ear lobe and on his right hand’s thumb and on his right foot’s big toe.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:24
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he brought Aaron’s sons near, and Moses put <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the blood on their right ear lobe and on their right hand’s thumb and on their right foot’s big toe, and Moses sprinkled the blood on the altar all around.  <div eID="gen728" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv553"/><div sID="gen729" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv553"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he took the fat and the fat tail and all of the fat that was on the inner parts<note placement="foot">Or “entrails”</note> and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat and the right upper thigh;

verses.name: Leviticus 8:26
verses.text: and from the basket of the unleavened bread that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> before Yahweh he took one ring-shaped unleavened bread and one ring-shaped bread with<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> oil and one wafer, and he placed them on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fat parts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fats”</note> and on the right upper thigh.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:27
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he put <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all of these⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the all”</note> on Aaron’s palms and on his sons’ palms, and he waved them as a wave offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:28
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses took them from upon their palms, and he turned them into smoke upon the burnt offering on the altar; they were a consecration offering as an appeasing fragrance—it was an offering made by fire for<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:29
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses took the breast section, and he waved it as a wave offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh from the ram of the consecration offering; it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Moses’ share, <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen729" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv554"/><title type="x-s">Anointing the Priests and Their Garments</title> <div sID="gen730" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv554"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses took <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the anointing oil and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the blood that was on the altar, and he spattered them on Aaron, on his garments, and on Aaron’s sons and on his sons’ garments with him—thus<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he consecrated Aaron, his garments, and his sons and his sons’ garments with him.  <div eID="gen730" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv555"/><div sID="gen731" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv555"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat in the entrance to<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly, and there you must eat it and the bread that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the basket of the consecration offering, <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as I have commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons must eat it,’

verses.name: Leviticus 8:32
verses.text: but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the remainder of the meat and the bread you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must burn in the fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:33
verses.text: And you must not go out from the entrance to<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> the tent of assembly for seven days, until the day of fulfilling the days of your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> consecration, because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it will take seven days to ordain you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “seven of days it will fill your (plural) hand”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:34
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Just</transChange> as was done<note placement="foot">Or “he did”</note> on this day, Yahweh commanded to be done<note placement="foot">Or “to do”</note> in order to make atonement for you.<note placement="foot">Plural</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:35
verses.text: And you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must stay at the entrance to<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> the tent of assembly day and night for seven days, and you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall keep the obligation from<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> Yahweh, so you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> might not die, for thus I have been commanded.”

verses.name: Leviticus 8:36
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Aaron and his sons did all the things that Yahweh had commanded <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by the hand of”</note> Moses.  <chapter eID="Lev.8"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv556"/><title type="x-s">Worship at the Tent of Assembly</title> <div sID="gen732" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv556"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And it happened”</note> on the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and Israel’s elders,

verses.name: Leviticus 9:2
