verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the one who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞owns the house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the house is for him”</note> shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘It appears to me <transChange type="added">that</transChange> an infection <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the house.’

verses.name: Leviticus 14:36
verses.text: And the priest shall <transChange type="added">issue a</transChange> command, and they shall clear out the house before the priest comes to examine the infection, so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> all that is in the house might not become unclean; and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞afterward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “after thus”</note> the priest shall go to examine the house.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:37
verses.text: And he shall examine the infection, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞if⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “look” or “behold”</note> the infection on the house’s wall has yellowish-green or reddish spots and its appearance is deeper than the surface of<note placement="foot">Implied by the context</note> the wall,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:38
verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the priest shall go out from the house to the house’s entrance, and he shall confine<note placement="foot">Or “close up”</note> the house <transChange type="added">for</transChange> seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:39
verses.text: And the priest shall return on the seventh day, and he shall examine <transChange type="added">the infection</transChange>,<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞if⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “look” or “behold”</note> the infection has spread on the house’s wall,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:40
verses.text: the priest shall <transChange type="added">issue a</transChange> command and they shall remove the stones on which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the infection, and they shall throw them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to from an outside place of the city”</note> on an unclean place.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:41
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> shall scrape off the plaster<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> from all around the house, and they shall pour out the plaster,<note placement="foot">See HALOT 862 s.v. <reference osisRef="Lev.14.3">3</reference>.b</note> which they scraped off, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to from an outside place of the city”</note> on an unclean place.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:42
verses.text: And they shall take other stones, and they shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞put⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “bring”</note> them in place of those stones, and they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> shall take other plaster,<note placement="foot">See HALOT 862 s.v. <reference osisRef="Lev.14.3">3</reference>.b</note> and they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> shall replaster<note placement="foot">Implied by the context; Hebrew “plaster”</note> the house.  <div eID="gen769" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv594"/><div sID="gen770" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv594"/>“But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if the infection should return and it breaks out in the house after they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> have removed the stones and after scraping off the plaster<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> of the house and after it has been replastered,<note placement="foot">Implied by the context; or “plaster”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:44
verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the priest shall come, and he shall examine the infection,<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞if⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “look” or “behold”</note> the infection has spread in the house, it is a destructive <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mildew⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “infectious disease”</note> in the house—it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:45
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he shall break down the house, its stones and its wood and all of the house’s plaster,<note placement="foot">See HALOT 862 s.v. <reference osisRef="Lev.14.3">3</reference>.b</note> and he shall bring it all<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to from an outside place of the city”</note> to an unclean place.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:46
verses.text: And the person who enters into the house <transChange type="added">during</transChange> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days <transChange type="added">that</transChange> he<note placement="foot">That is, the priest</note> confined<note placement="foot">Or “closed up”</note> it shall become unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:47
verses.text: And the person who sleeps in the house must wash his garments, and the person who eats in the house shall wash his garments.  <div eID="gen770" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv595"/><div sID="gen771" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv595"/>“And if the priest comes again and examines <transChange type="added">the house</transChange><note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞if⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “look” or “behold”</note> the infection has not spread in the house after being replastered,<note placement="foot">Implied by the context; or “plaster”</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the infection is healed.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:49
verses.text: And he shall take two birds and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cedar wood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wood of cedar”</note> and a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞crimson thread⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “crimson thread of the worm”</note> and hyssop to cleanse the house;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:50
verses.text: and he shall slaughter the first bird over fresh water on a clay vessel.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:51
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he shall take the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cedar wood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wood of cedar”</note> and the hyssop and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the crimson thread⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the crimson thread of the worm”</note> and the living bird, and he shall dip them in the slaughtered bird’s blood and in the fresh water, and he shall spatter them<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> on the house seven times.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:52
verses.text: Thus<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he shall purify the house with the bird’s blood and with the fresh water and with the living bird and with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cedar wood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wood of cedar”</note> and with the hyssop and with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the crimson thread⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the crimson thread of the worm”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:53
verses.text: And he shall send the living bird <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to from an outside place of the city”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞into the open field⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of the field”</note> and so he shall make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.  <div eID="gen771" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv596"/><div sID="gen772" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv596"/>“This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the instruction for any infectious skin disease and for the diseased area of skin,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:55
verses.text: and for a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mildew⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “infectious skin disease”</note> of the garment and for the house,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:56
verses.text: and for the swelling and for the epidermal eruption and for the spot,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:57
verses.text: to teach <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when something is unclean and when something is clean⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on the day of the unclean and on the day of the clean”</note> This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the regulation of the infectious skin disease.”  <chapter eID="Lev.14"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv597"/><title type="x-s">Instructions About Bodily Discharges</title> <div sID="gen773" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv597"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 15:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and you shall say to them, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Any man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man a man”</note> when a fluid discharge occurs<note placement="foot">Or “becomes” or “shall be”</note> from his body, his fluid discharge <transChange type="added">is</transChange> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:3
verses.text: And this becomes his uncleanness in his fluid discharge: <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> his body secretes his fluid discharge or his body blocks his fluid discharge, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his uncleanness.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:4
verses.text: Any bed upon which the person who discharges lies down becomes unclean, and any object upon which he sits becomes unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:5
verses.text: And anyone who touches his bed must wash his garments and shall wash<note placement="foot">Or “bathe”</note> himself<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and he shall be unclean until evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:6
verses.text: And the person who sits on the object upon which the person who discharges has sat must wash his garments, and he shall wash<note placement="foot">Or “bathe”</note> himself<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:7
verses.text: And the person who touches the body of the person who discharges must wash his garments, and he shall wash<note placement="foot">Or “bathe”</note> himself<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:8
verses.text: And if the person who discharges spits on <transChange type="added">one who is</transChange><note placement="foot">The generic article designating a class of persons or things</note> clean, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> that one<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> shall wash is garments, and he shall wash himself<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:9
verses.text: And any saddle upon which the person who discharges rides becomes unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:10
verses.text: And any person who touches anything that happened to be under him becomes unclean until the evening, and the person who carries them must wash his garments, and he shall wash <transChange type="added">himself</transChange><note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:11
verses.text: And anyone whom the person who discharges might touch <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not”</note> rinsing off his hands with water shall wash his garments, and he shall wash himself<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:12
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a clay vessel that the person who discharges touches must be broken, and any <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wood object⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “object of wood”</note> must be rinsed with water.  <div eID="gen773" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv598"/><div sID="gen774" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv598"/>“ ‘And when the person who discharges becomes clean from his body fluid discharge, he shall count<note placement="foot">Literally “and he shall count”</note> for himself seven days for his cleansing; then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall wash his garments, and he shall wash his body with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fresh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “running”; literally “living”</note> water, and he shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:14
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> on the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young doves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of dove”</note> and he shall come <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly’s entrance, and he shall give them to the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:15
verses.text: And the priest shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sacrifice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do” or “make”</note> one as a sin offering and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the one”</note> as a burnt offering, and so the priest shall make atonement for him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh from his body fluid discharge.  <div eID="gen774" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv599"/><div sID="gen775" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv599"/>“ ‘And if an emission of semen goes out from anyone, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall wash all of his body with water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:17
verses.text: And any garment and anything leather on which is an emission of semen shall be washed with water, and it shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:18
verses.text: If<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> there is a woman with whom a man lies down and there is an emission of semen, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they shall wash themselves<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and they shall be unclean until the evening.  <div eID="gen775" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv600"/><div sID="gen776" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv600"/>“ ‘And when a woman <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is menstruating⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “is discharging blood”</note> her body fluid discharge occurs in<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> her body; for seven days she shall be in her menstruation, and any person who touches her shall become unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:20
verses.text: And anything upon which she lies down during her menstruation shall become unclean, and anything upon which she sits shall become unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:21
verses.text: And any person who touches her bed must wash his garments, and he shall wash <transChange type="added">himself</transChange><note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:22
verses.text: And any person who touches any object on which she sat must wash his garments, and he shall wash <transChange type="added">himself</transChange><note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:23
verses.text: And if it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the bed or on the object on which she sits, at his touching it he becomes unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:24
verses.text: And if a man indeed lies with her and her menstruation occurs on him, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall be unclean <transChange type="added">for</transChange> seven days, and any bed on which he lies down becomes unclean.  <div eID="gen776" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv601"/><div sID="gen777" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv601"/>“ ‘And when a woman discharges a body fluid <transChange type="added">consisting</transChange> of her blood <transChange type="added">for</transChange> many days, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> not <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the time of her menstruation, or when she discharges in addition to<note placement="foot">Or “beyond”</note> her menstruation, all the days of her unclean body fluid discharge she shall become unclean as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the days of her menstruation.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:26
verses.text: Any bed on which she lies <transChange type="added">during</transChange> all the days of her body fluid discharge shall become for her as her bed of menstruation, and any object on which she sits becomes unclean as her menstruation’s uncleanness.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:27
verses.text: And any person who touches them becomes unclean, and he shall wash his garments, and he shall wash <transChange type="added">himself</transChange><note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.  <div eID="gen777" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv602"/><div sID="gen778" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv602"/>“ ‘And if she is clean from her body fluid discharge, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> she shall count for herself seven days, and afterward she becomes clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:29
verses.text: And on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young doves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of dove”</note> and she shall bring them to the priest at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly’s entrance.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:30
verses.text: And the priest shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sacrifice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do” or “make”</note> the one as a sin offering and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one”</note> as a burnt offering, and so the priest shall make atonement for her <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the the faces of”</note> Yahweh from her unclean body fluid discharge.’  <div eID="gen778" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv603"/><div sID="gen779" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv603"/>“And you shall keep the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> separate from their uncleanness so that they might not die because of<note placement="foot">Or “by” or “in”</note> their uncleanness by their making my tabernacle, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in their midst, unclean.  <div eID="gen779" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv604"/><div sID="gen780" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv604"/>“This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the regulation of <transChange type="added">the one with</transChange> the body fluid discharge and <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> from whom an emission of semen goes out so that he becomes unclean by it

verses.name: Leviticus 15:33
verses.text: and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concerning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> the menstruating woman in her bleeding<note placement="foot">See similar idiom at 12:2</note> and the person who discharges his body fluid, for the male and for the female and for a man who lies with an unclean woman.”  <chapter eID="Lev.15"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv605"/><title type="x-s">The Day of Atonement</title> <div sID="gen781" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv605"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron’s two sons, when they had come near <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before faces of”</note> Yahweh and they died.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:2
verses.text: And Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell<note placement="foot">Or “Speak to”</note> your brother Aaron that he should not enter at any time into the sanctuary <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞behind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the interior/inside to”</note> the curtain <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in front of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> the atonement cover that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the ark, so that he might not die, because I appear in the cloud over the atonement cover.  <div eID="gen781" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv606"/><div sID="gen782" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv606"/>“Aaron must enter the sanctuary with this: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a young bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a bull a son of cattle”</note> as a sin offering and a ram as a burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:4
verses.text: He must put on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a holy linen tunic⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a tunic of linen of holiness”</note> and linen undergarments must be on his body, and he must fasten himself<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with a linen sash, and he must wrap a linen turban around his head<note placement="foot">Supplied from context in the English translation</note>—they are holy garments, and he shall wash his body with water, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall put them on.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:5
verses.text: And he must take from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>’<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> community two he-goats as a sin offering and one ram as a burnt offering.  <div eID="gen782" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv607"/><div sID="gen783" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv607"/>“And Aaron shall present the sin offering’s bull, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for himself, and so he shall make atonement for himself and for his family.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:7
verses.text: And he shall take the two goats, and he shall present them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh <transChange type="added">at the</transChange> tent of assembly’s entrance.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:8
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for Yahweh and one for Azazel.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:9
verses.text: And Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot for Yahweh fell, and he shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sacrifice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do” or “make”</note> it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a sin offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:10
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he must present alive <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh the goat on which the lot for Azazel fell to make atonement for himself, to send it away into the desert to Azazel.  <div eID="gen783" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv608"/><div sID="gen784" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv608"/>“And Aaron shall present the sin offering’s bull, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for himself, and so he shall make atonement for himself and for his family; then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall slaughter the sin offering’s bull, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for himself.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:12
verses.text: And he shall take a<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> censer full of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞burning charcoal⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “burning charcoal of fire”</note> from upon the altar from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞two handfuls⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the fullness of the hollow of his hands”</note> of incense of powdered fragrant perfumes, and he shall bring it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from behind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the interior/inside of”</note> the curtain,

verses.name: Leviticus 16:13
verses.text: and he shall put the incense on the fire <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh so that the cloud of incense might cover the atonement cover, which is on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞covenant text⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “testimony”</note> so that he might not die.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:14
verses.text: And he shall take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the bull’s blood, and he shall spatter it<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with his finger on the atonement cover’s surface on the eastern side, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> the atonement cover he shall spatter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the blood with his finger seven times.  <div eID="gen784" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv609"/><div sID="gen785" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv609"/>“And he shall slaughter the sin offering’s goat, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the people, and he shall bring its blood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from behind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the interior/inside of”</note> the curtain, and he shall do with its blood as that which he did with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> the bull’s blood, and he shall spatter it on the atonement cover and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> the atonement cover.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:16
verses.text: Thus<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he shall make atonement for the sanctuary from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>’<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> impurities and from their transgressions for all their sins; and so he must do for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly, which dwells with them in the midst of their impurities.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:17
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “any man not”</note> shall be in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly when he enters to make atonement in the sanctuary until he comes out, and so he shall make atonement for himself and for his family and for all of Israel’s assembly.  <div eID="gen785" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv610"/><div sID="gen786" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv610"/>“Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he shall go out to the altar that is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh, and he shall make atonement for it; and he shall take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the bull’s blood and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the goat’s blood, and he shall put it<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> all around on the altar’s horns.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:19
verses.text: And he shall spatter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the blood on it seven times with his finger, and he shall cleanse it and consecrate<note placement="foot">Literally “he shall consecrate”</note> it from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>’<note placement="foot">Literally “of the sons/children of Israel”</note> impurities.  <div eID="gen786" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv611"/><div sID="gen787" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv611"/>“And he shall finish making atonement <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the sanctuary and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly and the altar; then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall present the living goat.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:21
verses.text: And Aaron shall place his two hands on the living goat’s head, and he shall confess over it all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>’<note placement="foot">Literally “of the sons/of the children of Israel”</note> iniquities and all their transgressions for all their sins, and he shall put them on the goat’s head, and he shall send it<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> away into the desert <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by the hand of”</note> a man standing ready.<note placement="foot">Or “at hand”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:22
verses.text: Thus<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the goat shall bear on it to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a barren region⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a land of separation” or “a land of infertility”</note> all their guilt, and he shall send the goat away into the desert.  <div eID="gen787" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv612"/><div sID="gen788" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv612"/>“And Aaron shall enter <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly, and he shall take off the linen garments that he put on at his coming to the sanctuary, and he shall leave them there.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:24
verses.text: And he shall wash his body with water in a holy place, and he shall put on his garments and go out and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sacrifice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he shall do” or “he shall make”</note> his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering, and so he shall make atonement for himself and for people.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:25
verses.text: And he must turn into smoke the sin offering’s fat on the altar.  <div eID="gen788" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv613"/><div sID="gen789" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv613"/>“And the person who sends out the goat for Azazel shall wash his garments, and he shall wash his body with water, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞afterward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “after thus”</note> he shall come to the camp.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:27
verses.text: And the sin offering’s bull and the sin offering’s goat, whose blood was brought to make atonement in the sanctuary, shall be brought <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to from an outside place of the camp”</note> and they shall burn their hide and their flesh and their offal in the fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:28
verses.text: And the person who burns them shall wash his garments, and he shall wash his body with water, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞afterward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “after thus”</note> he must come to the camp.  <div eID="gen789" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv614"/><div sID="gen790" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv614"/>“And this shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a lasting statute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a statute of eternity” or “a statute of long duration”</note> for you: in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month, you must deny yourselves and you must not do any work, whether the native or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the alien who is dwelling in your midst,

verses.name: Leviticus 16:30
verses.text: because on this day he shall make atonement for you to cleanse you; you must be clean from all your sins <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:31
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a Sabbath of complete rest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a Sabbath of ‘Sabbathation.’ ” “Sabbathation” is not a real word, but it is devised as an attempt to convey the sounds of the related nouns in the Hebrew phrase</note> for you, and you shall deny yourselves—it is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a lasting statute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a statute of eternity” or “a statute of long duration”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:32
verses.text: And the priest who is anointed and who is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ordained⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “filled his hand”</note> to serve as a priest in place of his father shall make atonement; thus<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall put on the linen garments, the holy garments,

verses.name: Leviticus 16:33
verses.text: and he shall make atonement for the sanctuary’s holy place, and he shall make atonement for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly and the altar, and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all of the assembly’s people.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:34
verses.text: And this shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a lasting statute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a statute of eternity” or “a statute of long duration”</note> for you to make atonement for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> one time in a year from all their sins.”  <chapter eID="Lev.16"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv615"/><title type="x-s">The Place of Sacrifice</title> <div sID="gen791" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv615"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:2
verses.text: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and you shall say to them, ‘This is the word that Yahweh has commanded, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:3
verses.text: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Any man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “A man a man”</note> from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox or a sheep or a goat in the camp or who slaughters it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from an outside place of the camp”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:4
verses.text: and he does not bring it to the tent of assembly’s entrance to present an offering to Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh’s tabernacle, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> that man shall be accounted bloodguilty—he has poured out blood, and that man shall be cut off from the midst of his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This is</transChange> so that the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> may bring their sacrifices that they are sacrificing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the open field⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the faces of the field”</note> and bring<note placement="foot">Or “they shall bring”</note> them for Yahweh to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly’s entrance to the priest, and they shall sacrifice fellowship offerings for Yahweh with them.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:6
verses.text: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood on Yahweh’s altar <transChange type="added">at the</transChange> tent of assembly’s entrance, and he shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞burn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “turn into smoke”</note> the fat as an appeasing fragrance for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:7
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they may no longer sacrifice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not they may sacrifice again”</note> their sacrifices to the goat-idols after which they were prostituting. This is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a lasting statute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a statute of eternity” or “a statute of long duration”</note> for them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> their generations.” ’  <div eID="gen791" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv616"/><title type="x-s">Instructions Against Eating Blood</title> <div sID="gen792" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv616"/>“And you shall say to them, ‘<transChange type="added">if there is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “A man a man”</note> from the house of Israel or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> from the alien who dwells in their midst who offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice

verses.name: Leviticus 17:9
verses.text: and he does not bring it to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent of assembly’s entrance to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sacrifice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do” or “make”</note> it for Yahweh, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> that man shall be cut off from his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:10
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">if there is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man a man”</note> from the house of Israel or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> from the alien who is dwelling in their midst who eats any blood, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will set my face against the person who eats the blood, and I will cut him off from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:11
verses.text: Indeed<note placement="foot">Or “Because”</note> the flesh’s life <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the blood, and I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your lives, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the blood with the life that makes atonement.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:12
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> I said to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞None of you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of individual self from you not”</note> may eat blood, nor<note placement="foot">Or “and not”</note> may the alien who is dwelling in your midst eat blood.’  <div eID="gen792" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv617"/><div sID="gen793" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv617"/>“And <transChange type="added">if there is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man a man”</note> from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> from the alien who is dwelling in their midst who hunts a wild game animal or a bird that may be eaten, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall pour out its blood, and he shall cover it with the soil.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:14
verses.text: Indeed,<note placement="foot">Or “Because”</note> the life of all flesh, its blood, is in its life, so<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I said to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> ‘You may not eat <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blood of any flesh, because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> life of all flesh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> its blood; anyone who eats it must be cut off.’  <div eID="gen793" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv618"/><div sID="gen794" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv618"/>“And <transChange type="added">if there is</transChange> any person who eats a dead body or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> a mangled carcass, whether among the native or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> among the alien, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall wash his garments, and he shall wash himself<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with water, and he shall be unclean until the evening, and he shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:16
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if he does not wash his garments<note placement="foot">The direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> and he does not wash his body, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall bear his guilt.”  <chapter eID="Lev.17"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv619"/><title type="x-s">Unlawful Sexual Relations</title> <div sID="gen795" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv619"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 18:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:3
verses.text: You must not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞carry out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do”</note> the practices of the land of Egypt, in which you lived, and you must not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞carry out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do”</note> the practices of the land of Canaan, to which I am bringing you; and you must not follow their statutes.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:4
verses.text: You must <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞carry out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do”</note> my regulations, and you must observe<note placement="foot">Or “keep”</note> my statutes by following them; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:5
verses.text: And you shall observe<note placement="foot">Or “keep”</note> my statutes and my regulations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by which the person doing them shall live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “which the man does them and he shall live in them”</note> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen795" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv620"/><div sID="gen796" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv620"/>“ ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞None⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man a man … not”</note> of you shall approach anyone who is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his close relative⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the flesh of his body”</note> to expose nakedness; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:7
verses.text: You must not expose your father’s nakedness or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your mother’s nakedness—she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your mother; you must not expose her nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:8
verses.text: You must not expose the nakedness of your father’s wife—it is your father’s nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> your sister’s nakedness, <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞born at home⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a relative of house”</note> or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞born abroad⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a relative of an outside place”</note> you must not expose their nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> the nakedness of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, you must not expose their nakedness, because they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> the nakedness of the daughter of your father’s wife, she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your sister, a relative of your father; you must not expose her nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:12
verses.text: You must not expose the nakedness of your father’s sister; she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your father’s close relative⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the flesh of your father”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:13
verses.text: You must not expose the nakedness of your mother’s sister, because she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your mother’s close relative⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the flesh of your mother”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:14
verses.text: You must not expose the nakedness of your father’s brother; you must not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have sex with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “approach”</note> his wife—she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your aunt.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:15
verses.text: You must not expose your daughter-in-law’s nakedness; she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your son’s wife; you must not expose her nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:16
verses.text: You must not expose the nakedness of your brother’s wife; she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your brother’s nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:17
verses.text: You must not expose the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, or her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter; you must not take <transChange type="added">her as wife</transChange><note placement="foot">The verb לקח is used to speak of marrying (“taking a wife”)</note> to expose her nakedness; they are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞close relatives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “flesh”; see vv. <reference osisRef="Lev.18.6">6</reference>, 12, 13</note>—that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wickedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:18
verses.text: And you must not take <transChange type="added">as wife</transChange><note placement="foot">The verb לקח is used to speak of marrying (“taking a wife”)</note> a woman with her sister, to be a rival-wife, to expose her nakedness before her <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞during⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in”</note> her life.  <div eID="gen796" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv621"/><div sID="gen797" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv621"/>“ ‘And you must not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have sex with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “approach”</note> a woman to expose her nakedness <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞during⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in”</note> her menstrual uncleanness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:20
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you must not have sex⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you shall not give your lying down for semen”</note> with your fellow citizen’s<note placement="foot">Or “neighbor’s”</note> wife, becoming unclean with her.  <div eID="gen797" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv622"/><div sID="gen798" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv622"/>“ ‘And you shall not give <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> your offspring<note placement="foot">Or “descendants”</note> in order to sacrifice them to Molech, nor<note placement="foot">Or “and not”</note> shall you profane the name of your God; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:22
verses.text: And you shall not lie with a male as lying <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> a woman; that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a detestable thing.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:23
verses.text: And you shall not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have sexual relations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “give your lying down”</note> with any animal, becoming unclean with it; and a woman shall not stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> an animal to copulate with it—that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a perversion.  <div eID="gen798" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv623"/><div sID="gen799" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv623"/>“ ‘You must not make yourself unclean in any of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, because the nations whom I am driving out from your presence were made unclean by all of these.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:25
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the land became unclean, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have brought the punishment of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I have visited”</note> its guilt upon it, and the land has vomited out its inhabitants.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:26
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you (neither the native nor<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the alien who is dwelling in your midst) shall keep my statutes and my regulations, and you shall not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞practice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do”</note> any of these detestable things

verses.name: Leviticus 18:27
verses.text: (because the people of the land, who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of you”</note> did all these detestable things, so the land became unclean),

verses.name: Leviticus 18:28
verses.text: so that the land will not vomit you out when you make it unclean <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as it vomited out the nation that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of you”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:29
verses.text: Indeed, anyone who does any of these detestable things, even<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> those persons who do so shall be cut off from the midst of their people.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:30
verses.text: Thus<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you shall keep my obligation to not do any of the statutes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞regarding⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> the detestable things that they did <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of you”</note> so that you will not make yourselves unclean by them; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.’ ”  <chapter eID="Lev.18"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv624"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Is Holy</title> <div sID="gen800" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv624"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 19:2
verses.text: “Speak to all the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must be holy, because I, Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:3
verses.text: Each <transChange type="added">of you</transChange> must revere your mother<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his mother”</note> and your father,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his father”</note> and you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must keep my Sabbaths; I am Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:4
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must not turn to idols, and you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must not make for yourselves gods of cast metal; I am Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God.  <div eID="gen800" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv625"/><div sID="gen801" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv625"/>“ ‘And when you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> sacrifice a sacrifice of fellowship offerings to Yahweh, you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must sacrifice it for your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> acceptance.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:6
verses.text: It must be eaten on the day of your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> sacrifice and the next day; but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the remainder must be burned up in the fire by the third day.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:7
verses.text: And if it is indeed eaten on the third day, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> unclean meat; it shall not be regarded as accepted.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:8
verses.text: And the one who eats it shall bear his guilt, because he has profaned Yahweh’s holiness, and that person shall be cut off from his people.  <div eID="gen801" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv626"/><title type="x-s">Love Your Neighbor as Yourself</title> <div sID="gen802" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv626"/>“ ‘And at your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> reaping the harvest of your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> land you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> must not finish reaping the edge of your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> field, and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> must not glean the remnants of your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> harvest.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:10
verses.text: And you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> must not glean your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> vineyard, and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> must not gather your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> vineyard’s fallen grapes; you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> must leave them behind for the needy and for the alien; I am Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God.  <div eID="gen802" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv627"/><div sID="gen803" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv627"/>“ ‘You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not steal, and you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not deceive, and you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not lie <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a man to his fellow citizen”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:12
verses.text: and you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not swear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the deception”</note> in my name, and so one of you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> profane<note placement="foot">Or “you shall profane”</note> the name of your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> God; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen803" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv628"/><div sID="gen804" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv628"/>“ ‘You<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not exploit your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> neighbor, and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not rob him; a hired worker’s wage you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞withhold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “leave with you”</note> overnight until morning.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:14
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not curse the deaf, and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not put a stumbling block <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> a blind person, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall revere your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> God; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen804" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv629"/><div sID="gen805" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv629"/>“ ‘You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not do injustice in judgment; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not show partiality to the powerless⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “you shall not lift up the faces of the poor/powerless”</note> you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not give preference <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the powerful⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “faces of the great”</note> you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall judge your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> fellow citizen with justice.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:16
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not go about with slander among your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> people; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not endanger your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> neighbor’s life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “you shall not stand on the blood of your neighbor”</note> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen805" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv630"/><div sID="gen806" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv630"/>“ ‘You<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not hate your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> brother in your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> heart; you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall surely rebuke your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> fellow citizen, so that you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> do not incur sin <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞along with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “in addition to him”; literally “upon him”</note> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:18
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not seek vengeance, and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not harbor a grudge against <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> fellow citizens⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the sons of your people”</note> and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall love your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> neighbor like yourself;<note placement="foot">Singular</note> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen806" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv631"/><title type="x-s">You Shall Keep My Statutes</title> <div sID="gen807" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv631"/>“ ‘You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must keep my statutes: as for your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> domestic animals, you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not cause two differing kinds to breed; as for your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> field, you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not sow two differing kinds of seed; and, a garment of two differing kinds of woven material should not be worn on you.<note placement="foot">Singular</note>  <div eID="gen807" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv632"/><div sID="gen808" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv632"/>“ ‘And when a man lies with a woman <transChange type="added">and there is</transChange> an emission of semen and she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a female slave promised to a man, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> she indeed has not been ransomed or freedom has not be given to her, <transChange type="added">there</transChange> shall be an obligation to compensate; they shall not be put to death, because she has not been freed.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:21
verses.text: And he shall bring his guilt offering to Yahweh at the tent of assembly’s entrance: a ram <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a guilt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:22
verses.text: And the priest shall make atonement for him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh with the ram of the guilt offering for his sin that he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note> and so his sin that he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sinned”</note> shall be forgiven him.  <div eID="gen808" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv633"/><div sID="gen809" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv633"/>“ ‘And when you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> have come into the land and you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> plant any tree for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> food, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall regard its fruit as unharvestable⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “and you shall regard its foreskin as uncircumcised its fruit”</note> for three years it shall be forbidden for you;<note placement="foot">Plural</note> it shall not be eaten.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:24
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, offerings of praise for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:25
verses.text: And in the fifth year you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall eat its fruit to increase its yield for you;<note placement="foot">Plural</note> I am Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God.  <div eID="gen809" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv634"/><div sID="gen810" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv634"/>“ ‘You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must not eat anything with the blood; you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not practice divination, nor shall you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> interpret signs.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:27
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not round off the corner hair of your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> head, and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not trim the corner of your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> beard.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:28
verses.text: And you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not make a slash in your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> body for a dead person, nor shall you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> make on yourselves a tattoo’s mark; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen810" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv635"/><div sID="gen811" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv635"/>“ ‘You<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not profane your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> daughter by making her a prostitute, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lest the land be prostituted and the land fill up with depravity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and the land does not prostitute and the land fills up depravity” or “so that the land does not prostitute and the land fills up depravity”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:30
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall keep my Sabbaths, and you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall revere my sanctuary; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen811" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv636"/><div sID="gen812" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv636"/>“ ‘You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not turn to the mediums and to the soothsayers; you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not seek them to become unclean with them; I am Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God.  <div eID="gen812" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv637"/><div sID="gen813" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv637"/>“ ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the faces of”</note> old age you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall get up, and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall show respect for an old person; and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall revere your God; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen813" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv638"/><div sID="gen814" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv638"/>“ ‘And when an alien dwells with you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> in your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> land, you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not oppress him.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:34
verses.text: The alien who is dwelling with you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall be like a native among you,<note placement="foot">Plural</note> and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall love him like yourself,<note placement="foot">Singular</note> because you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> were aliens in the land of Egypt; I am Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God.  <div eID="gen814" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv639"/><div sID="gen815" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv639"/>“ ‘You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall not commit injustice in regulation, in measurement, in weight, or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> volume.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:36
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must have honest balances, honest weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin; I am Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God who brought you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> out from the land of Egypt.  <div eID="gen815" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv640"/><div sID="gen816" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv640"/>“ ‘<transChange type="added">Thus</transChange> you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall keep all my statutes and all my regulations, and you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall do them; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.’ ”  <chapter eID="Lev.19"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv641"/><title type="x-s">Molech Worship and Spiritism</title> <div sID="gen817" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv641"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 20:2
verses.text: “And to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> you shall say, ‘If there is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man a man”</note> from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> from the alien who is dwelling in Israel, who gives <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> his offspring to Molech, he must surely be put to death; the people of the land must stone him with stones.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the stone”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:3
verses.text: And I myself will set my face against that man, and I will cut him off from the midst of his people, because he has given <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> his offspring to Molech, so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he makes my sanctuary unclean⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to make unclean my sanctuary”</note> and profanes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to profane”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the name of my holiness”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:4
verses.text: And if the people of the land ever shut their eyes from<note placement="foot">Or “disregard”</note> that man at his giving <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> his offspring to Molech, not putting him to death,

verses.name: Leviticus 20:5
verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I myself will set my face against that man and against his clan, and I will cut him off and all those from the midst of their people who prostitute after Molech.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:6
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the person who turns to the mediums and the soothsayers to prostitute after them, I will set<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and I will set”</note> my face against that person, and I will cut him off from the midst of his people.  <div eID="gen817" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv642"/><div sID="gen818" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv642"/>“ ‘And you shall consecrate yourselves, and you shall be holy, because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:8
verses.text: And you shall keep my statutes, and you shall do them; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh who consecrates you.  <div eID="gen818" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv643"/><title type="x-s">Family and Sexual Offenses</title> <div sID="gen819" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv643"/>“ ‘If <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man a man”</note> who curses his father or his mother, he shall surely be put to death; he has cursed his father and his mother—his blood <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon him.  <div eID="gen819" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv644"/><div sID="gen820" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv644"/>“ ‘As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a man who commits adultery with a man’s wife, who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> the man who commits adultery and the woman who commits adultery shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:11
