verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a man who lies with his father’s wife, he has exposed his father’s nakedness; both of them shall be put to death—their blood <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:12
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a man who lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall be put to death; they have committed a perversion—their blood <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them.  <div eID="gen820" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv645"/><div sID="gen821" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv645"/>“ ‘As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the man who lies with a male <transChange type="added">as</transChange> lying <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a woman, they have committed a detestable thing; they shall surely be put to death—their blood <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them.  <div eID="gen821" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv646"/><div sID="gen822" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv646"/>“ ‘As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a man who marries a woman and her mother, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> depravity; they shall burn him and them, so that it shall not become depravity in the midst of you <transChange type="added">all</transChange>.  <div eID="gen822" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv647"/><div sID="gen823" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv647"/>“ ‘As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a man who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞has sexual relations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he gives his lying down”</note> with an animal, he shall surely be put to death, and you must kill the animal.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:16
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a woman who approaches any animal to copulate with it, you shall kill<note placement="foot">Or “and you shall kill”</note> the woman and the animal; they shall surely be put to death—their blood <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them.  <div eID="gen823" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv648"/><div sID="gen824" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv648"/>“ ‘As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a man who takes his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter, and he sees her nakedness and she herself sees his nakedness, it is a disgrace, and they shall be cut off <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in”</note> the eyes of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the sons/children of their people”</note> he has exposed his sister’s nakedness—he must bear his guilt.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:18
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a man who lies with a menstruating woman, he exposes<note placement="foot">Or “and he exposes”</note> her nakedness—her source he exposes and she herself reveals her blood’s source—both of them shall be cut off from the midst of their people.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:19
verses.text: And you shall not expose the nakedness of your mother’s sister, and you shall not expose your father’s sister, because such a person<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> has dishonored his close relative—they must bear their guilt.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:20
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a man who lies with his aunt, he has exposed his uncle’s nakedness—they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:21
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a man who marries his brother’s wife, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an abomination; he has exposed his brother’s nakedness—they shall be childless.  <div eID="gen824" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv649"/><title type="x-s">You Shall Be Holy</title> <div sID="gen825" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv649"/>“ ‘And you shall keep all my statutes and all my regulations, and you shall do them, so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the land, to which I am bringing you to inhabit it, shall not vomit you out.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:23
verses.text: And you shall not follow the statutes of the nation that I am driving out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from your faces”</note> because they did all these things, and I detested them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:24
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> I said to you, “You yourselves shall take possession of their land, and I myself shall give it to you to possess it—a land flowing with milk and honey”; I am Yahweh your God, who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞has set you apart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I have set you apart”</note> from the nations.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:25
verses.text: And you shall distinguish between the clean and the unclean animal and between the unclean and the clean bird; and you shall not defile yourselves with the animal or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> with the bird or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> with anything that moves along the ground that I have set apart for you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as unclean⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to make unclean”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:26
verses.text: And you shall be holy for me, because I, Yahweh, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> holy, and I have singled you out from the nations to be mine.  <div eID="gen825" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv650"/><div sID="gen826" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv650"/>“ ‘And a man or a woman, if a spirit of the dead or a spirit of divination is in them, they shall surely be put to death; they shall stone them with stones<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the stone”</note>—their blood <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them.’ ”  <chapter eID="Lev.20"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv651"/><title type="x-s">Regulations Concerning Priests</title> <div sID="gen827" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv651"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, Aaron’s sons, and say to them, ‘One must not make himself unclean for a dead person among his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> people,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:2
verses.text: except for his direct relative closest to him: his mother and his father, and his son and his daughter, and his brother,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:3
verses.text: and for his sister, a virgin, <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> closest to him, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who has not had a husband⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who is not for a man/husband”</note>—for her he may defile himself.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:4
verses.text: He must not make himself unclean <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a kinsman by marriage⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a husband among his people”</note> defiling himself.  <div eID="gen827" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv652"/><div sID="gen828" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv652"/>“ ‘And they shall not shave bald patches on their head, and they shall not shave off the corner of their beard, and they shall not make a cut in their body.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:6
verses.text: They shall be holy to their God, and they shall not profane the name of their God, because they are bringing near the offerings made by fire to<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> Yahweh—their God’s food—and they shall be holy.  <div eID="gen828" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv653"/><div sID="gen829" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv653"/>“ ‘They shall not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞marry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “take”</note> a woman who is a prostitute and defiled, nor shall they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞marry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “take”</note> a woman divorced from her husband, because each priest<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”; singular antecedent specified from the context</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> holy for his God.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:8
verses.text: And you shall consecrate him, because he is bringing near your God’s food; he shall be holy to you, since I, Yahweh, who consecrates you, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> holy.  <div eID="gen829" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv654"/><div sID="gen830" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv654"/>“ ‘As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the daughter of any priest, if she is defiled by prostituting, she is disgracing her father—she shall be burned in the fire.  <div eID="gen830" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv655"/><div sID="gen831" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv655"/>“ ‘As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the priest who is higher than his brothers, on whose head the oil of anointment is poured and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he was ordained⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he has filled up his hand”</note> to wear the garments, he shall not dishevel his head, and he shall not tear his garments.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:11
verses.text: And he shall not go near any dead person, nor shall he make himself unclean for his father or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> for his mother.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:12
verses.text: And he shall not go out from the sanctuary, and he shall not profane his God’s sanctuary, because the dedication of his God’s oil of anointment <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on him; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen831" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv656"/><div sID="gen832" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv656"/>“ ‘And he himself must take a wife in her virginity.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:14
verses.text: A widow or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> a divorced woman or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> a defiled woman, a prostitute—these he must not take; he shall take only<note placement="foot">Or “instead”</note> a virgin from his people <transChange type="added">as</transChange> wife.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:15
verses.text: And he shall not profane his offspring among his people, because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, who consecrates him.’ ”  <div eID="gen832" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv657"/><div sID="gen833" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv657"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:17
verses.text: “Speak to Aaron, saying, ‘A man from your offspring throughout their generations, in whom is a physical defect, shall not come near to present your God’s food.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:18
verses.text: Indeed,<note placement="foot">Or “For”</note> any man in whom is a physical defect shall not come near: a blind man or lame or disfigured or deformed,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:19
verses.text: or a man in whom is a broken foot or a broken hand,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:20
verses.text: or a hunchback or a dwarf, or a spot in his eye or a skin disorder or a skin eruption or a crushed testicle.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:21
verses.text: Any man from Aaron the priest’s offspring in whom is a physical defect shall not come near to present offerings made by fire to<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> Yahweh; a physical defect <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in him; he shall not come near to present his God’s food.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:22
verses.text: He may eat his God’s food, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the most holy things⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the holy things of the holy things”</note> and from the holy things.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:23
verses.text: But he must not enter the curtain, and he must not come near to the altar, because a physical defect <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in him, and he must not profane my sanctuary, because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, who consecrates them.’ ”  <div eID="gen833" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv658"/><div sID="gen834" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv658"/>Thus<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <chapter eID="Lev.21"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv659"/><title type="x-s">Priests and Their Food</title> <div sID="gen835" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv659"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:2
verses.text: “Tell<note placement="foot">Or “Speak to”</note> Aaron and his sons<note placement="foot">Literally “to Aaron and to his sons”</note> that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they must deal respectfully with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>’<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> votive offerings, and they must not profane my holy name, which they are consecrating to me; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen835" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv660"/><div sID="gen836" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv660"/>“Say to them, ‘Throughout your generations, any man from any of your offspring who comes near the votive offerings that the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> consecrate to Yahweh with<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> his uncleanness on him, that person shall be cut off<note placement="foot">Or “and that person shall be cut off”</note> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of me”</note> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen836" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv661"/><div sID="gen837" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv661"/>“ ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Anyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “A man a man”</note> from Aaron’s offspring, if<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he is afflicted with a skin disease or a fluid discharge, shall not eat in the sanctuary <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until which”</note> he is clean; and the one who touches any unclean person or a man from whom an emission of semen goes out,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:5
verses.text: or a man who touches any swarmer that is unclean for him or <transChange type="added">who touches</transChange> a person who is unclean for him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞due to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for”</note> whatever his uncleanness,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:6
verses.text: a person who touches such a thing<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him” or “it”</note> shall be unclean until the evening, and he shall not eat from the votive offerings, except<note placement="foot">Or “but if” or “but rather”</note> when he washes<note placement="foot">Or “bathes”</note> his body with water

verses.name: Leviticus 22:7
verses.text: and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the sun sets⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the sun goes” or “the sun enters”</note> and he shall be clean; then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> afterward he may eat from the votive offerings, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his food.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:8
verses.text: He shall not eat a <transChange type="added">naturally</transChange> dead body or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> a mangled carcass, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that he becomes unclean⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to become unclean”</note> by it; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen837" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv662"/><div sID="gen838" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv662"/>“ ‘And they shall keep my obligation, and they shall not incur guilt because of it, so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they die through it, because they have profaned it; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh who consecrates them.  <div eID="gen838" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv663"/><div sID="gen839" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv663"/>“ ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞No stranger shall eat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And any stranger shall not eat”</note> the votive offering; nor shall a temporary resident with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> a priest or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> a hired worker eat <transChange type="added">the</transChange> votive offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:11
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a priest, if with his money he buys a person as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his possession⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “property of”</note> that one may eat it, and the descendants of his house themselves may eat his food.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:12
verses.text: And a priest’s daughter, when <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she marries a layman⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “she becomes for a strange man”</note> she herself may not eat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the votive offering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the offering/lifting of the votive offering”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:13
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a priest’s daughter, when she becomes a widow or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> divorced or there is no offspring for her, and she returns to her father’s house as in her childhood, she may eat from her father’s food, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no layman may eat it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “any stranger shall not eat it”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:14
verses.text: And if a man eats <transChange type="added">the</transChange> votive offering unintentionally, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall add to it a fifth of it, and he shall give the votive offering to the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:15
verses.text: And they shall not profane the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>’<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> votive offerings that they present to Yahweh,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:16
verses.text: and so cause them, by their eating their votive offerings, to bear guilt requiring a guilt offering, because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, who consecrates them.’ ”  <div eID="gen839" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv664"/><title type="x-s">Acceptable Offerings</title> <div sID="gen840" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv664"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:18
verses.text: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘Anyone from the house of Israel or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> from the alien in Israel who presents his offering for any of their vows or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> for any of their freewill offerings that they present to Yahweh as a burnt offering,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">it must be</transChange> without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to be acceptable for you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “for your acceptance”</note> a male among the cattle, among the sheep, or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> among the goats.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:20
verses.text: You shall not present any <transChange type="added">animal</transChange> in which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a physical defect, because it shall not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞acceptable⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for acceptance”</note> for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:21
verses.text: And if anyone brings a sacrifice of fellowship offerings for Yahweh to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering from<note placement="foot">Or “among”</note> the cattle or from<note placement="foot">Or “among”</note> the flock,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> it must be without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to be acceptable⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “for acceptance”</note> there must not be any physical defect in it.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> blind or <transChange type="added">the</transChange> injured or <transChange type="added">the</transChange> maimed or <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seeping or <transChange type="added">one with a</transChange> skin disorder or <transChange type="added">one with a</transChange> skin eruption—these you shall not present to Yahweh, nor shall you give from them an offering made by fire on the altar for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:23
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> an ox or sheep that is deformed or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> that is stunted, you may present it as a freewill offering, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> for a vow it will not be accepted.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:24
verses.text: And you shall not present <transChange type="added">anything</transChange> for Yahweh <transChange type="added">with</transChange> bruised or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> shattered or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> torn or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> cut-off testicles, and you shall not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sacrifice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do” or “make”</note> <transChange type="added">such</transChange> in your land.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:25
verses.text: And you shall not present your God’s food from any of these by the hand of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a foreigner⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of a foreign land”</note> because their deformity <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in them; a physical defect <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in them; they shall not be accepted for you.’ ”  <div eID="gen840" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv665"/><div sID="gen841" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv665"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:27
verses.text: “When an ox or a sheep or a goat is born, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> it shall be under its mother <transChange type="added">for</transChange> seven days, and from the eighth day and beyond it is acceptable as an offering made by fire for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:28
verses.text: And you shall not slaughter an ox or a sheep and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its young⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his son” or “his child”</note> on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the same day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on day one” or “in one day”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:29
verses.text: And when you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you must sacrifice <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to be acceptable for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:30
verses.text: It must be eaten on that day; you must not leave over <transChange type="added">anything</transChange> from it until morning; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen841" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv666"/><div sID="gen842" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv666"/>“Thus<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you shall keep my commands, and you shall do them; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen842" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv667"/><div sID="gen843" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv667"/>“And you shall not profane my holy name, so that I may be consecrated in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, who consecrates you,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:33
verses.text: the one who brought you out from the land of Egypt to be as God for you; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.”  <chapter eID="Lev.22"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv668"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Feasts</title> <div sID="gen844" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv668"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘The festivals of Yahweh that you shall proclaim <transChange type="added">are</transChange> holy assemblies; these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my appointed times.  <div eID="gen844" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv669"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Sabbath</title> <div sID="gen845" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv669"/>“ ‘<transChange type="added">For</transChange> six days work is to be done, and on the seventh day <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a Sabbath of complete rest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a Sabbath of ‘Sabbathation.’ ” “Sabbathation” is not a real word, but it is devised as an attempt to convey the sounds of the related nouns in the Hebrew phrase</note> a holy assembly; you shall not do any work; it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> a Sabbath for Yahweh in all your dwellings.  <div eID="gen845" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv670"/><title type="x-s">The Passover</title> <div sID="gen846" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv670"/>“ ‘These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> Yahweh’s appointed times, holy assemblies, which you shall proclaim at<note placement="foot">Or “on”</note> their appointed time.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:5
verses.text: In the first month, on the fourteenth of the month at the evening <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh’s Passover.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:6
verses.text: And on the fifteenth day of this month <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh’s Feast of Unleavened Bread; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:7
verses.text: On the first day <transChange type="added">there</transChange> shall be a holy assembly for you; you shall not do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all work of labor”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:8
verses.text: And you shall present an offering for Yahweh made by fire <transChange type="added">for</transChange> seven days; on the seventh day <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> a holy assembly; you shall not do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “all work of labor”</note>  <div eID="gen846" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv671"/><title type="x-s">The Feast of Firstfruits</title> <div sID="gen847" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv671"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:10
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘When you come to the land that I am about to give to you and you reap its harvest, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruit of your harvest to the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:11
verses.text: And he shall wave the sheaf <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh for your acceptance; the priest shall wave it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the day after⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the next day of”</note> the Sabbath.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:12
verses.text: And on the day of your waving the sheaf you shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞offer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “sacrifice”; literally “do” or “make”</note> a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yearling⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of its year”</note> male lamb without defect as a burnt offering to Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:13
verses.text: And its grain offering <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> two-tenths <transChange type="added">of an ephah</transChange><note placement="foot">Supplied by context</note> of finely milled flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire for Yahweh, an appeasing fragrance; and its libation shall be a fourth of a hin<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the hin”</note> of wine.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:14
verses.text: And you shall not eat bread or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> roasted grain or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> ripe grain until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this very same day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the exactly of this day”</note> until you present your God’s offering. This must be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a lasting statute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a statute of eternity” or “a statute of long duration”</note> for your generations in all your dwellings.  <div eID="gen847" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv672"/><title type="x-s">The Feast of Weeks</title> <div sID="gen848" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv672"/>“ ‘And you shall count for yourselves <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from the day after⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the next day of”</note> the Sabbath, from the day of your bringing the wave offering’s sheaf—<transChange type="added">there</transChange> shall be seven full weeks.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:16
verses.text: Until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the day after⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the next day of”</note> the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you shall present a new grain offering for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:17
verses.text: You shall bring from your dwellings for a wave offering two <transChange type="added">loaves of</transChange> bread <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they shall be”</note> two-tenths of an ephah<note placement="foot">Supplied by context</note> of finely milled flour; they must be baked with leaven—the firstfruits <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belonging to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:18
verses.text: And, in addition to the bread, you shall present seven <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yearling⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of its year”</note> male lambs without defects and one <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a bull a son of cattle”</note> and two rams—they shall be a burnt offering for Yahweh with<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> their grain offering and their libations, an offering made by fire, an appeasing fragrance for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:19
verses.text: And you shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞offer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “sacrifice”; literally “do” or “make”</note> one he-goat as a sin offering and two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yearling⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of its year”</note> male lambs as a sacrifice of fellowship offerings.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:20
verses.text: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a wave offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh; in addition to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> two male lambs, they shall be holy for Yahweh for the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:21
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall make a proclamation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you shall proclaim”</note> on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this very same day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the exactly of this day”</note> it shall be a holy assembly for you; you shall not do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “all work of labor”</note> this is a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lasting statute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a statute of eternity” or “a statute of long duration”</note> in all your dwellings throughout<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> your generations.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:22
verses.text: And when you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> reap the harvest of your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> land, you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> must not finish the edge of your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> field at your reaping, and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> must not glean the remnants of your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> harvest—you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall leave them behind for the needy and for the alien; I am Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God.’ ”  <div eID="gen848" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv673"/><title type="x-s">The Feast of Trumpets</title> <div sID="gen849" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv673"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:24
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you must have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it must be for yourselves”</note> a rest period, a remembrance of <transChange type="added">the trumpet</transChange> blast, a holy assembly.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:25
verses.text: You must not do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all work of labor”</note> and you shall present an offering made by fire to Yahweh.’ ”  <div eID="gen849" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv674"/><title type="x-s">The Day of Atonement</title> <div sID="gen850" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv674"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:27
verses.text: “Surely the Day of Atonement <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the tenth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the seventh month; it shall be a holy assembly for you, and you shall deny yourselves, and you shall present an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:28
verses.text: And you must not do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all work of labor”</note> on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this very same day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the exactly of this day”</note> because it is the Day of Atonement to make atonement for you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:29
verses.text: If <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> any person who does not deny <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this very same day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the exactly of this day”</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall be cut off from his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:30
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> any person who does any work on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this very same day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the exactly of this day”</note> I will exterminate that person from the midst of his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:31
verses.text: You must not do any work; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lasting statute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a statute of eternity” or “a statute of long duration”</note> throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:32
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a Sabbath of complete rest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a Sabbath of ‘Sabbathation.’ ” “Sabbathation” is not a real word, but it is devised as an attempt to convey the sounds of the related nouns in the Hebrew phrase</note> for you, and you shall deny yourselves on the ninth day of the month in the evening—from evening to evening you must observe your extraordinary<note placement="foot">Supplied from the immediate context within this verse</note> Sabbath.”  <div eID="gen850" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv675"/><title type="x-s">The Feast of Booths</title> <div sID="gen851" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv675"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:34
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> the Feast of Booths <transChange type="added">for</transChange> seven days for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:35
verses.text: On the first day <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> a holy assembly; you must not do any <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “work of labor”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:36
verses.text: <transChange type="added">For</transChange> seven days you must present an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day it shall be a holy assembly for you, and you shall present an offering made by fire to Yahweh; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a celebration; you must not do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all work of labor”</note>  <div eID="gen851" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv676"/><title type="x-s">Summary</title> <div sID="gen852" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv676"/>“ ‘These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> Yahweh’s festivals, which you must proclaim, holy assemblies to present an offering made by fire to Yahweh—burnt offering and grain offering, sacrifice and libations, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each on its proper day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a thing of a day on its day”</note>—

verses.name: Leviticus 23:38
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞besides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from to alone”</note> Yahweh’s Sabbaths and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞besides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from to alone”</note> your gifts and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞besides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from to alone”</note> your vows and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞besides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from to alone”</note> all your freewill offerings that you give to Yahweh.  <div eID="gen852" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv677"/><div sID="gen853" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv677"/>“ ‘Surely on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, at your gathering the land’s produce, you shall hold Yahweh’s festival for seven days; on the first day <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> a rest period and on the eighth day a rest period.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:40
verses.text: And on the first day you shall take for yourselves the first fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees and branches<note placement="foot">Collective singular</note> of a leafy tree and of a brook’s poplar trees, and you shall rejoice <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">for</transChange> seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:41
verses.text: And you must hold it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a festival for Yahweh <transChange type="added">for</transChange> seven days in the year; <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lasting statute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a statute of eternity” or “a statute of long duration”</note> throughout your generations; in the seventh month you must hold it.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:42
verses.text: You must live in the booths <transChange type="added">for</transChange> seven days; all the natives in Israel must live in the booths,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:43
verses.text: so that your generations shall know that I made the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> live in booths when I brought them from the land of Egypt; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.’ ”  <div eID="gen853" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv678"/><div sID="gen854" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv678"/>Thus<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses announced to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> Yahweh’s appointed times.  <chapter eID="Lev.23"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv679"/><title type="x-s">The Sanctuary’s Lamp and Bread</title> <div sID="gen855" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv679"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 24:2
verses.text: “Command the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they should bring pure olive oil from beaten olives for the light to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞present⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to cause raising up”; or “set up” (HALOT 830 s.v. <reference osisRef="Lev.24.4">4</reference>.d)</note> a lamp continually.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:3
verses.text: Aaron shall arrange for it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the outside of to”</note> the curtain of the testimony in the tent of assembly from evening until morning <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh continually; it shall be a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lasting statute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a statute of eternity” or “a statute of long duration”</note> throughout your generations.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:4
verses.text: On the pure <transChange type="added">golden</transChange><note placement="foot">Supplied by context and the description of the lampstand in <reference osisRef="Exod.25.31">Exod 25:31</reference></note> lampstand he shall arrange for the lamps <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh continually.  <div eID="gen855" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv680"/><div sID="gen856" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv680"/>“And you shall take finely milled flour, and you shall bake <transChange type="added">with</transChange> it twelve ring-shaped bread cakes: each one <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> two-tenths <transChange type="added">of an ephah</transChange>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:6
verses.text: And you shall place them <transChange type="added">in</transChange> two rows, six <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> row, on the pure <transChange type="added">gold</transChange><note placement="foot">Supplied by context and the description of the table in <reference osisRef="Exod.25.24">Exod 25:24</reference></note> table <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:7
verses.text: And you shall put pure frankincense on each<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> row so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> it shall be for the bread as a memorial offering, an offering made by fire for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞On every Sabbath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “On the day of the Sabbath on the day of the Sabbath”</note> he shall arrange it in rows <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> Yahweh continually; they are from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> as an everlasting<note placement="foot">Or “eternal” or “enduring” or “perpetual”</note> covenant.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:9
verses.text: And it shall be for Aaron and for his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a holy thing of holy things”</note> for him from Yahweh’s offerings made by fire—a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lasting rule⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “rule of eternity” or “rule of long duration”</note>  <div eID="gen856" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv681"/><title type="x-s">Punishment for Blasphemy</title> <div sID="gen857" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv681"/>And an Israelite woman’s son, and he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> an Egyptian man’s son, went out in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and the Israelite woman’s son and an<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> Israelite man fought in the camp.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:11
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the Israelite woman’s son blasphemed the name, and he cursed, so<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they brought him to Moses—and the name of his mother <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Shelomith the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:12
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> they put him in custody <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> <transChange type="added">the matter</transChange> might be made clear to them in accordance with the mouth of Yahweh.  <div eID="gen857" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv682"/><div sID="gen858" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv682"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 24:14
verses.text: “Bring the curser <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to from an outside place of the camp”</note> and all the hearers shall place their hands on his head, and the whole community shall stone him.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:15
verses.text: And you shall speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Any man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “A man a man”</note> when he curses his God shall bear<note placement="foot">Or “and he shall bear”</note> his sin.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:16
verses.text: And he who blasphemes Yahweh’s name certainly shall be put to death; the whole community certainly shall stone him. As the alien, so the native shall be put to death at blaspheming his name.  <div eID="gen858" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv683"/><div sID="gen859" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv683"/>“ ‘And when a man kills any human being, he certainly shall be put to death.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:18
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he who kills⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he who kills the soul of” or “he who kills the life of”</note> a domestic animal must repay <transChange type="added">for</transChange> it life in place of life.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:19
verses.text: And when a man <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞causes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gives”</note> a physical defect in his fellow citizen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> what he has done, so it shall be done to him:

verses.name: Leviticus 24:20
verses.text: fracture in place of fracture, eye in place of eye, tooth in place of tooth—<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> the physical defect he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞causes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gives”</note> to the person, likewise it shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞caused⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “given”</note> to him.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:21
verses.text: And a killer of a domestic animal must repay <transChange type="added">for</transChange> it, and a killer of a human shall be put to death.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:22
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You must have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it shall be for you”</note> one norm; as for the alien, so<note placement="foot">Hebrew “as”</note> it must be <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the native, because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.’ ”  <div eID="gen859" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv684"/><div sID="gen860" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv684"/>Thus<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Moses spoke to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and they brought the curser <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to from an outside place of the camp”</note> and they stoned him with stones, and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <chapter eID="Lev.24"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv685"/><title type="x-s">The Sabbath Year</title> <div sID="gen861" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv685"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Sinai⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Sinai”</note> saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 25:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘When you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> come into the land that I am about to give to you,<note placement="foot">Plural</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the land shall observe a Sabbath for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:3
verses.text: Six years you<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and you shall gather its yield.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:4
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> in the seventh year it shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a Sabbath of complete rest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a Sabbath of ‘Sabbathation.’ ” “Sabbathation” is not a real word, but it is devised as an attempt to convey the sounds of the related nouns in the Hebrew phrase</note> for the land—a Sabbath for Yahweh; you<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> must not sow your field, and you must not prune your vineyard.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:5
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> must not reap your harvest’s aftergrowth, and you must not harvest the grapes of your unpruned vines—it shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a year of complete rest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a year of a rest period”</note> for the land.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:6
verses.text: And a Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you:<note placement="foot">Plural</note> for you<note placement="foot">Singular here and through the rest of this verse</note> and for your slave and for your slave woman and for your hired worker and for your temporary residents<note placement="foot">Collective singular; Hebrew “temporary resident”</note> who are dwelling as aliens with you;

verses.name: Leviticus 25:7
verses.text: and all its yield shall be for your<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> domestic animal and for the wild animal, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in your land to eat.  <div eID="gen861" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv686"/><title type="x-s">The Year of Jubilee</title> <div sID="gen862" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv686"/>“ ‘And you<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> shall count for yourself seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years, and they shall be for you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞time periods of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “days of”</note> years: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forty-nine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “nine and forty”</note> years.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:9
verses.text: And you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall cause <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a loud horn blast⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a ram’s horn of a blast”</note> to be heard on the seventh month on the tenth of the month; on the Day of Atonement you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall cause a ram’s horn to be heard in all your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> land.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:10
verses.text: And you<note placement="foot">Plural throughout this verse</note> shall consecrate the fiftieth year, and you shall proclaim a release in the land for all its inhabitants. It is a Jubilee; it shall be for you, and you shall return. You must return—everyone to his property and everyone to his clan.<note placement="foot">Or “each of you must return to his property and to his clan”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:11
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You<note placement="foot">Plural throughout this verse</note> shall have the fiftieth year as a Jubilee⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a Jubilee it the year of the fiftieth year it shall be for you”</note> you must not reap its aftergrowth, and you must not harvest its unpruned vines.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:12
verses.text: Because it is a Jubilee, it shall be holy to you. You must eat its<note placement="foot">That is, the field’s</note> produce from the field.  <div eID="gen862" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv687"/><div sID="gen863" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv687"/>“ ‘In this Year of Jubilee <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each of you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> shall return⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you shall return a man” or “you shall return everyone”</note> to his property.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:14
verses.text: And when you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> sell something to your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> fellow citizen or you buy from your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> neighbor’s hand, you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must not oppress <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a man his brother”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:15
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> must buy from your fellow citizen according to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> number of years after the Jubilee; he must sell to you according to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> number of years of yield.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:16
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> must increase its price <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to a greater number of years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the mouth of many of the years”</note> but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you must decrease its price <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to a lesser number of years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the mouth of few of the years”</note> because he is selling <transChange type="added">its</transChange> yields to you.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:17
verses.text: And you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must not oppress <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a man his citizen”</note> but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall revere your God, because I am Yahweh, your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God.  <div eID="gen863" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv688"/><div sID="gen864" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv688"/>“ ‘And you<note placement="foot">Plural throughout this verse</note> shall do my statutes, and you must keep my regulations, and you shall do them, so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you shall live <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞securely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence”</note> on the land.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:19
verses.text: And the land shall give its fruit, and you<note placement="foot">Plural throughout this verse</note> shall eat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your fill⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to contentment”</note> and you shall live <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞securely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence”</note> on it.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:20
verses.text: And if you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> should say, “What shall we eat in the seventh year, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞if⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “look”</note> we do not sow and we do not gather its yield?”

verses.name: Leviticus 25:21
verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will command my blessing for you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> in the sixth year, so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> it will make<note placement="foot">Or “produce”</note> the yield for three years.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:22
verses.text: And you<note placement="foot">Plural throughout this verse</note> will sow in the eighth year, and you shall eat from the old yield;<note placement="foot">The verse divides here</note> until the ninth year, until the coming of its yield, you shall eat <transChange type="added">the</transChange> old <transChange type="added">yield</transChange>.  <div eID="gen864" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv689"/><div sID="gen865" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv689"/>“ ‘But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the land must not be sold in<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> perpetuity, because the land is mine, because you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> aliens and temporary residents with me.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:24
verses.text: And in all your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> property’s land you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must provide redemption for the land.  <div eID="gen865" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv690"/><div sID="gen866" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv690"/>“ ‘When your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> brother becomes poor and he sells part of his property, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his nearest redeemer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his redeemer the nearest to him”</note> shall come, and he shall redeem the thing sold by his brother.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:26
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if<note placement="foot">Or “when”</note> a man <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞does not have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it is not for him”</note> a redeemer, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he prospers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his hand produces”</note> and he finds enough for his redemption,

verses.name: Leviticus 25:27
verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall calculate the years of its selling, and he shall refund the balance to the man to whom he sold <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and he shall return to his property.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:28
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if his hand does not find enough to refund to him, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what he has sold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his thing sold”</note> shall be in the buyer’s hand until the Year of Jubilee; and it shall go out of the buyer’s hand<note placement="foot">Meaning derived from context; an alternative translation could be “shall not be released” (cf. NKJV, NRSV, ESV, NJPS) or “shall not revert” (NASB, NET)</note> in the Jubilee, and he shall return to his property.  <div eID="gen866" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv691"/><div sID="gen867" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv691"/>“ ‘And if a man sells <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a residential house in a walled city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a house of a dwelling of a city wall”</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> it shall be his redemption until completing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a year after his selling⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a year of his selling”</note> its redemption <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall last⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shall be”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “days”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:30
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if it is not redeemed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before a full year has passed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until the fulfilling of for him/it an entire year”</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the house that is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the walled city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the city that for it a wall”</note> shall belong to the buyer in<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for”</note> perpetuity throughout his generations; it shall not go out of the buyer’s hand<note placement="foot">Meaning derived from context; an alternative translation could be “shall not be released” (cf. NKJV, NRSV, ESV, NJPS) or “shall not revert” (NASB, NET)</note> in the Jubilee.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:31
verses.text: However,<note placement="foot">Or “And” or “But”</note> village houses that have no surrounding wall shall be considered <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞open country⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the field of the land”</note> there is redemption for it, and in the Jubilee it shall go out of the buyer’s hand.<note placement="foot">Meaning derived from context; an alternative translation could be “shall not be released” (cf. NKJV, NRSV, ESV, NJPS) or “shall not revert” (NASB, NET)</note>  <div eID="gen867" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv692"/><div sID="gen868" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv692"/>“ ‘As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the cities of the Levites, that is, the houses in<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> their property’s cities, it shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a lasting redemption⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “a permanent redemption”; literally “redemption of eternity” or “redemption of long duration”</note> for the Levites.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:33
verses.text: And whatever <transChange type="added">anyone</transChange> redeems from the Levites then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> must go out of the buyer’s hand<note placement="foot">Meaning derived from context; an alternative translation could be “shall not be released” (cf. NKJV, NRSV, ESV, NJPS) or “shall not revert” (NASB, NET)</note> in the Jubilee, including a house’s selling <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in his city’s property⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the city of his property”</note> because the houses in<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> the cities of the Levites are their property in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:34
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> a<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> field of their cities’ pastureland must not be sold, because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is their property for all time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a property of eternity it is for them” or “a property of long duration it is for them”</note>  <div eID="gen868" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv693"/><div sID="gen869" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv693"/>“ ‘And if your<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> countryman<note placement="foot">Or “brother”</note> becomes poor and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞if he becomes dependent on you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and his hand is shaky with you”</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you shall support him <transChange type="added">like</transChange> an alien and <transChange type="added">like</transChange> a temporary resident, and he shall live with you.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:36
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> must not take interest or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> usury from him, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you shall revere your God, and your countryman<note placement="foot">Or “brother”</note> shall live with you.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:37
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> must not give your money to him with interest or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> give your food for<note placement="foot">Or “in” or “with”</note> profit.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:38
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural throughout this verse</note> God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt to give <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to you”</note> the land of Canaan, to be as God for you.  <div eID="gen869" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv694"/><div sID="gen870" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv694"/>“ ‘And if your<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> countryman<note placement="foot">Or “brother”</note> who is with you becomes poor, and he is sold to you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall not treat him as a slave⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you shall not let him work the work of a slave” or “you shall not enslave him the work of a slave”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:40
verses.text: He shall be with you like a hired worker, like a temporary resident; he shall work with you until the Year of Jubilee.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:41
verses.text: And he and his sons with him shall go out from you, and he shall return to his clan, and to the property of his ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> he shall return.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:42
verses.text: Because they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my servants whom I brought out from the land of Egypt, they shall not be sold <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as a slave⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a selling of a slave”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:43
verses.text: You<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> shall not rule over him with ruthlessness, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you shall revere your God.  <div eID="gen870" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv695"/><div sID="gen871" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv695"/>“ ‘As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> slave and your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> slave woman who are<note placement="foot">Or “may be” (permission; cf. NASU, ESV, NRSV) or “can be” (ability)</note> yours,<note placement="foot">Singular</note> from the nations that are all around you,<note placement="foot">Plural</note> from them you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> may buy a slave or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> a slave woman.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:45
verses.text: And you<note placement="foot">Plural throughout this verse</note> may buy also from the children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of the temporary residents who are dwelling with you as aliens and from their clan who are with you, who have children in your land; indeed,<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they may be as property for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:46
verses.text: And you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> may pass them on as an inheritance to your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> sons<note placement="foot">Or “children”</note> after you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> to take possession of as property <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for all time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity” or “forever” or “for a long duration”</note>—you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> may let them work. But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> as for your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> countrymen,<note placement="foot">Or “brothers”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> shall not rule with ruthlessness over <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a man over his brother”</note>  <div eID="gen871" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv696"/><div sID="gen872" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv696"/>“ ‘And if <transChange type="added">the</transChange> alien or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the temporary resident who are with you<note placement="foot">Singular throughout this verse</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞prosper⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the hand produces”</note> but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your countryman<note placement="foot">Or “brother”</note> <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> with him becomes poor and he is sold to an alien, a temporary resident <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> with you, or to a descendant of an alien’s clan,

verses.name: Leviticus 25:48
