verses.text: after he is sold redemption shall be for him; one of his brothers may redeem him,

verses.name: Leviticus 25:49
verses.text: or his uncle or his uncle’s son may redeem him, or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his close relatives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the direct relative of his flesh”</note> from his clan may redeem him; or if <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he prospers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his hand produces”</note> he may redeem himself.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:50
verses.text: And he shall calculate with his buyer from the year of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his selling himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his being sold for him”</note> until the Jubilee; and the value of his selling shall be according to the number of years—it shall be with him like<note placement="foot">Or “as”</note> a hired worker’s days.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:51
verses.text: If <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> still many years, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in keeping with them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the mouth of them”</note> he shall restore his redemption <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in proportion to his purchase price⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from the price of his acquisition”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:52
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> a few years left until the Year of Jubilee, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall calculate for himself; he shall restore his redemption <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to the number of his years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “according to the mouth of his years”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:53
verses.text: He shall be with him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as a yearly hired worker⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “as a hired worker of a year in a year”</note> he shall not rule over him with ruthlessness <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to your eyes” or “for your eyes”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:54
verses.text: And if he is not redeemed by<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> any of these ways,<note placement="foot">Bracketed words provided from the sense of the context</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he and his sons with him shall go out in the Year of Jubilee.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:55
verses.text: Indeed,<note placement="foot">Emphatic use of כִּי, since there is no indication of direct causation to only what precedes in vv. <reference osisRef="Lev.25.47-Lev.25.54">47–54</reference>; or “Because”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> are servants for me; they are my servants whom I brought out from the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> God.’ ”  <chapter eID="Lev.25"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv697"/><title type="x-s">Blessings for Obedience</title> <div sID="gen873" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv697"/>“ ‘You<note placement="foot">Plural throughout the entire chapter</note> shall not make for yourselves idols and divine images, and you shall not raise up stone pillars for yourselves, and you shall not put a sculptured stone in your land in order to<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> worship before it, because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.  <div eID="gen873" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv698"/><div sID="gen874" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv698"/>“ ‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and you shall revere my sanctuary; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen874" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv699"/><div sID="gen875" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv699"/>“ ‘If you walk in my statutes and you keep my commands and you do them,

verses.name: Leviticus 26:4
verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will give you rains in their time, and the land shall give its produce, and the trees of the field shall give their fruit.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:5
verses.text: And for you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> threshing season shall overtake <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grape harvest, and the grape harvest shall overtake <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sowing, and you shall eat your food <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to your fill⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to contentment”</note> and you shall live <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞securely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence”</note> in your land.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:6
verses.text: And I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and there shall not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anybody who makes you afraid⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “who makes afraid” or “making afraid”</note> and I will remove harmful animals from the land, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no sword shall pass through your land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a sword shall not pass through in your land”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:7
verses.text: And you shall pursue your enemies, and they shall fall by the sword <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to your faces”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:8
verses.text: And five of<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> you shall pursue a hundred, and a hundred of<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> you shall pursue a myriad;<note placement="foot">Or “ten thousand”</note> and your enemies shall fall by the sword <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to your faces”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:9
verses.text: And I will turn to you, and I will make you fruitful, and I will make you numerous; and I will keep my covenant with you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:10
verses.text: And you shall eat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞old grain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “old what is stale”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall clear away the old before the new⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “old from the faces of new you shall bring out”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:11
verses.text: And I will put my dwelling place in your midst, and my inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> shall not abhor you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:12
verses.text: And I will walk about in your midst, and I shall be your God,<note placement="foot">Or “as a God for you”</note> and you shall be my people.<note placement="foot">Or “as a people for me”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:13
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from being their slaves; and I broke the bars of your yoke, and I caused you to walk erectly.  <div eID="gen875" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv700"/><title type="x-s">Punishment for Disobedience</title> <div sID="gen876" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv700"/>“ ‘But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if you do not listen to me and you do not carry out<note placement="foot">Or “you do not do” or “you do not observe” or “you do not perform”</note> all these commands,

verses.name: Leviticus 26:15
verses.text: and if you reject my statutes and if your inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> abhors my regulations, to not carry out<note placement="foot">Or “do” or “observe” or “perform”</note> all my commands <transChange type="added">by</transChange> your breaking my covenant,

verses.name: Leviticus 26:16
verses.text: I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in turn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “also” or “indeed”</note> will do this to you: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will summon onto you horror, the wasting disease, and the fever that wastes eyes and that drains away life; and you shall sow your seed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in vain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for the emptiness”</note> and your enemies shall eat it.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:17
verses.text: And I will set my face against you, and you shall be defeated <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> your enemies; and your haters shall rule over you, and you shall flee away, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> there shall not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anybody who is pursuing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who pursues” or “pursuing”</note> you.  <div eID="gen876" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv701"/><div sID="gen877" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv701"/>“ ‘And if in spite of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> you do not listen to me, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will continue to discipline you seven times for your sins.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:19
verses.text: And I will break the pride of your strength; and I will make your heaven like iron<note placement="foot">Or “iron ore”</note> and your land like copper.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:20
verses.text: And your strength shall be consumed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in vain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to the emptiness”</note> and your land shall not give its produce, and the land’s trees shall not give their fruit.  <div eID="gen877" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv702"/><div sID="gen878" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv702"/>“ ‘And if you go against me <transChange type="added">in</transChange> hostility and you are not willing to listen to me, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will add a plague onto you seven times according to your sins.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:22
verses.text: And I will send <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wild animals⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the animals of the field”</note> out among you, and they shall make you childless, and they shall cut down your domestic animals, and they shall make you fewer; and your roads shall be desolate.  <div eID="gen878" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv703"/><div sID="gen879" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv703"/>“ ‘And if you do not accept correction from<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for” or “to”</note> me through these things, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you go against me <transChange type="added">in</transChange> hostility,

verses.name: Leviticus 26:24
verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> will also go against you in hostility, and I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> also will strike you seven times for your sins.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:25
verses.text: And I will bring upon you a sword that seeks vengeance <transChange type="added">for the</transChange> covenant, and you shall be gathered to your cities; and I will send a plague in your midst, and you shall be given into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of an enemy.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:26
verses.text: At my breaking <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞supply⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “staff”</note> of bread<note placement="foot">Or “food”</note> for you, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall return your bread by weight; and you shall eat <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and you shall not be satisfied.  <div eID="gen879" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv704"/><div sID="gen880" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv704"/>“ ‘And if through this you do not listen to me and you go against me in hostility,

verses.name: Leviticus 26:28
verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will go against you in hostile anger, and also<note placement="foot">Or “surely”</note> I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> will discipline you seven times for your sins.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:29
verses.text: And you shall eat the flesh of your sons; and the flesh of your daughters you shall eat.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:30
verses.text: And I will destroy your high places, and I will cut down your incense altars, and I will place your corpses on your idols’ corpses; and my inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> shall abhor you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:31
verses.text: And I will lay your cities <transChange type="added">in</transChange> ruins, and I will lay waste your sanctuaries; and I shall not smell your <transChange type="added">sacrifices’</transChange><note placement="foot">Implied by the use of the same phraseology in regard to the sacrifices in the early chapters of the book</note> appeasing fragrance.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:32
verses.text: And I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> will lay waste the land, and your enemies who are living in it shall be appalled over it.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:33
verses.text: And I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw a sword behind you; and your land shall be a desolation, and your cities shall be a ruin.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:34
verses.text: Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all the days of its lying desolate, and you <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> in the land of your enemies; then the land shall rest, and it shall enjoy its Sabbaths.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:35
verses.text: All the days of its lying desolate it shall rest <transChange type="added">for the time</transChange><note placement="foot">Implied by context</note> that it had not rested during your Sabbaths while you were living on it.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:36
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the ones who remain among you, I will bring<note placement="foot">Or “and I will bring”</note> fearfulness in their hearts in the land of their enemies; and a sound of a windblown leaf shall pursue them, and they shall flee like flight <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> a sword, and they shall fall, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> there shall not be a pursuer.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:37
verses.text: And they shall stumble over <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man on his brother”</note> as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the faces of”</note> a sword, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> there shall not be a pursuer; and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall have no resistance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it shall not be for you resistance”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> your enemies.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:38
verses.text: And you shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:39
verses.text: And because of their guilt, the ones among you who remain shall decay in the land of their enemies; and also because of the iniquities of their ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> they shall decay with them.  <div eID="gen880" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv705"/><div sID="gen881" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv705"/>“ ‘But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> when they confess their guilt and the guilt of their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> in their infidelity that they displayed against me, and moreover that they went against me in hostility—

verses.name: Leviticus 26:41
verses.text: I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> also<note placement="foot">Or “surely”</note> went against them in hostility, and I brought them into the land of their enemies—or <transChange type="added">if</transChange> then their uncircumcised heart is humbled and then they pay for their guilt,

verses.name: Leviticus 26:42
verses.text: I will remember<note placement="foot">Or “and I will remember”</note> my covenant <transChange type="added">with</transChange> Jacob; and I will remember also my covenant <transChange type="added">with</transChange> Isaac and also my covenant <transChange type="added">with</transChange> Abraham, and I will remember the land.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:43
verses.text: And the land shall be deserted by them, and it shall enjoy its Sabbaths in its being desolate from them, and they themselves<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> must pay for their guilt, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞simply because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because and in because”</note> they rejected my regulations, and their inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> abhorred my statutes.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:44
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in spite of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “also even” or “moreover also” or “moreover even”</note> this, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they are⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in their being”</note> in the land of their enemies I will not reject them, and I will not abhor them to destroy them, to break my covenant with them, because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh their God.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:45
verses.text: And I will remember <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first covenant for them<note placement="foot">Or “on behalf of them” or “on their behalf”</note>—whom I brought out from the land of Egypt <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the sight of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the eyes of” or “for the eyes of”</note> the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to be their God⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to be for them for God” or “to be for them as a God”</note> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.’ ”  <div eID="gen881" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv706"/><div sID="gen882" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv706"/>These are the rules and the regulations and the laws that Yahweh gave between himself and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Sinai⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Sinai”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in/by the hand of”</note> Moses.  <chapter eID="Lev.26"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv707"/><title type="x-s">Instructions About Vows</title> <div sID="gen883" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv707"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 27:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say<note placement="foot">Or “and you shall say”</note> to them, ‘When a man makes a vow according to your<note placement="foot">Singular when modifying “proper value” throughout the entire chapter</note> proper value <transChange type="added">of</transChange> persons to Yahweh,

verses.name: Leviticus 27:3
verses.text: if<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your proper value is for a male<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the male”</note> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twenty years of age⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> up to<note placement="foot">Or “and up to”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sixty years of age⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of sixty years”</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your proper value shall be fifty shekels <transChange type="added">of</transChange> money according to the sanctuary’s shekel.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:4
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if it is for a female, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your proper value shall be thirty shekels.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:5
verses.text: And if from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞five years of age⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of five years”</note> up to<note placement="foot">Or “and up to”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twenty years of age⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your proper value shall be twenty shekels <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the male and ten shekels for the female.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:6
verses.text: And if from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a month of age⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of a month”</note> up to<note placement="foot">Or “and up to”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞five years of age⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of five years”</note> then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your proper value shall be five shekels <transChange type="added">of</transChange> money <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the male, and your proper value for the female <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> three shekels <transChange type="added">of</transChange> money.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:7
verses.text: And if from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sixty years of age⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of sixty years”</note> and above: if a male, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your proper value shall be fifteen shekels; and for the female, ten shekels.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:8
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if he is poorer than your proper value, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall present himself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> the priest, and the priest shall set a value on him; the priest shall value him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on a mouth of”</note> what the person who made a vow <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞can afford⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his hand produces”</note>  <div eID="gen883" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv708"/><div sID="gen884" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv708"/>“ ‘And if <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> a domestic animal from which they present an offering for Yahweh, all that he gives from it for Yahweh shall be a holy object.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:10
verses.text: He shall not replace it, nor shall he exchange it, <transChange type="added">either</transChange> good with bad or bad with good; and if he indeed exchanges a domestic animal with a domestic animal, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it and its substitution shall be a holy object⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it shall be and its substitution shall be holy”</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:11
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if it is any unclean animal from which they may not present an offering for Yahweh, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall present the animal <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:12
verses.text: And the priest shall set a value on it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞either good or bad⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “between good and between bad”</note> as the priest <transChange type="added">sets</transChange> your proper value, so it shall be.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:13
verses.text: And if he indeed wants to redeem it, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall add a fifth of it onto your proper value.  <div eID="gen884" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv709"/><div sID="gen885" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv709"/>“ ‘And if a man consecrates his house <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a holy object for Yahweh, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the priest shall set a value on it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞either good or bad⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “between good and between bad”</note> <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as the priest sets a value on it, so it shall remain.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:15
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if the one who consecrates it wants to redeem his house, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall add a fifth of your proper value’s money onto it, and it shall be his.  <div eID="gen885" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv710"/><div sID="gen886" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv710"/>“ ‘And if a man consecrates <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> his property’s fields<note placement="foot">Collective singular; Hebrew “field”</note> for Yahweh, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your proper value shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in accordance with its seed requirements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “to the number of its seed”</note> a homer of barley seed for fifty shekels of money.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:17
verses.text: If he consecrates his field from the Year of Jubilee, it shall stand as your proper value.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:18
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> if he consecrates his field after the Jubilee, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the priest shall calculate the money for him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to the number of years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the mouth of the years”</note> that are left over until the Year of Jubilee; and it shall be deducted from your proper value.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:19
verses.text: And if he indeed redeems the field that is consecrated, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall add a fifth of your proper value’s money onto it, and it shall stand for<note placement="foot">Or “remain for” or “belong to”</note> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:20
verses.text: And if he does not redeem the field and if he sells the field to another man, it may not be redeemed again,

verses.name: Leviticus 27:21
verses.text: and the field shall be a holy object for Yahweh when it goes out<note placement="foot">Or “is released” or “reverts”</note> in the Jubilee, like a devoted<note placement="foot">Or “permanently set apart”; a different Hebrew word than previously translated “consecrated” in this chapter</note> field; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it shall be the priest’s property⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to/for the priest it shall be his property”</note>  <div eID="gen886" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv711"/><div sID="gen887" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv711"/>“ ‘And if he consecrates for Yahweh his acquired<note placement="foot">Or “purchased”</note> field that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not the field of his <transChange type="added">inherited</transChange> possession,

verses.name: Leviticus 27:23
verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the priest shall calculate for him the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞amount⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “number”</note> of your proper value until the year of the Jubilee, and he shall give your proper value on that day <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a holy object for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:24
verses.text: In the Year of the Jubilee the field shall return to the one who bought it from him, to the one whose property the land <transChange type="added">is</transChange>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:25
verses.text: And every proper value of yours shall be in the sanctuary’s shekel—the shekel shall be twenty gerahs.  <div eID="gen887" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv712"/><div sID="gen888" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv712"/>“ ‘However, a man shall not consecrate a firstborn among livestock, which belongs as firstborn to Yahweh; whether an ox <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞or⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “whether” or “if”</note> small livestock, it is for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:27
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> among the unclean animals, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall ransom it according to your proper value, and he shall add a fifth of its value onto it; and if it is not redeemed, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> it shall be sold according to your proper value.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:28
verses.text: However, anything devoted<note placement="foot">Or “permanently set apart”; a different Hebrew word than previously translated “consecrated” in this chapter</note> that a man has devoted to Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from all that he has⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from all that is for him”</note> from human or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> animal, or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> from the field of his property, may not be sold, and it may not be redeemed; anything devoted is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a holy thing of holy things”</note> for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:29
verses.text: Anyone devoted who is devoted from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞human beings⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the human”</note> cannot be ransomed—he shall surely be put to death.  <div eID="gen888" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv713"/><div sID="gen889" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv713"/>“ ‘And any tithe of the land from the land’s seed <transChange type="added">or</transChange> from the fruit of the trees <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for Yahweh; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a holy object for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:31
verses.text: And if a man indeed redeems from his tithe, he shall add a fifth of its <transChange type="added">value</transChange> onto it.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:32
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> every tithe of cattle or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> of the flock,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> all which crosses under the rod, the tenth shall be a holy object for Yahweh.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:33
verses.text: He shall not inspect between <transChange type="added">the</transChange> good and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bad, and he shall not exchange it; but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> if he indeed exchanges it, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it and its substitution shall be⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it shall be and its substitution shall be”</note> a holy object—it shall not be redeemed.’ ”  <div eID="gen889" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv714"/><div sID="gen890" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv714"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the commands that Yahweh commanded Moses for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Sinai⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Sinai”</note>  <chapter eID="Lev.27"/> <div eID="gen890" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen685" osisID="Lev" type="book"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv715"/><title type="x-s">God Commands Moses to Take a Census</title> <div sID="gen892" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv715"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses in the desert of Sinai, in the tent of assembly, on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first of the month, in the second year <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞after they came out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of their coming out”</note> of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 1:2
verses.text: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Take a census of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Lift up the head of”</note> the entire community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> according to their clans and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> number of names, every male individually

verses.name: Numbers 1:3
verses.text: from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone in Israel who is able to go to war. You and Aaron must muster them<note placement="foot">Or “count them,” or “summon them,” or “enroll them”</note> for their wars.

verses.name: Numbers 1:4
verses.text: A man from each tribe will be with you, each man the head of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of his father”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 1:5
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the names of the men who will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞assist you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “stand with you”</note> from Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;

verses.name: Numbers 1:6
verses.text: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;

verses.name: Numbers 1:7
verses.text: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;

verses.name: Numbers 1:8
verses.text: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;

verses.name: Numbers 1:9
verses.text: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon.

verses.name: Numbers 1:10
verses.text: From the descendants of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.

verses.name: Numbers 1:11
verses.text: From Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;

verses.name: Numbers 1:12
verses.text: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;

verses.name: Numbers 1:13
verses.text: from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;

verses.name: Numbers 1:14
verses.text: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;

verses.name: Numbers 1:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”

verses.name: Numbers 1:16
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the ones summoned from the community, the leaders of their ancestors’<note placement="foot">Or “fathers’ ”</note> tribes; they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the heads of Israel’s clans.  <div eID="gen892" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv716"/><div sID="gen893" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv716"/>So Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name,

verses.name: Numbers 1:18
verses.text: and they summoned the entire community on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first day of the second month. And they registered themselves among their clans according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above individually,

verses.name: Numbers 1:19
verses.text: just as Yahweh commanded Moses. And he counted them in the desert of Sinai.  <div eID="gen893" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv717"/><div sID="gen894" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv717"/>The descendants of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, every male individually from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:21
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Reuben were forty-six thousand five hundred.  <div eID="gen894" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv718"/><div sID="gen895" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv718"/>From the descendants of Simeon, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> those who were counted according to the number of their names, every individual male from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:23
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Simeon were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.  <div eID="gen895" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv719"/><div sID="gen896" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv719"/>From the descendants of Gad, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:25
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Gad were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.  <div eID="gen896" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv720"/><div sID="gen897" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv720"/>From the descendants of Judah, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:27
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Judah were seventy-four thousand six hundred.  <div eID="gen897" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv721"/><div sID="gen898" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv721"/>From the descendants of Issachar, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:29
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Issachar were fifty-four thousand four hundred.  <div eID="gen898" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv722"/><div sID="gen899" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv722"/>From the descendants of Zebulun, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:31
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Zebulun were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.  <div eID="gen899" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv723"/><div sID="gen900" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv723"/>From the descendants of Joseph: from the descendants of Ephraim, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:33
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Ephraim were forty thousand five hundred.  <div eID="gen900" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv724"/><div sID="gen901" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv724"/>From the descendants of Manasseh, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:35
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Manasseh were thirty-two thousand two hundred.  <div eID="gen901" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv725"/><div sID="gen902" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv725"/>From the descendants of Benjamin, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:37
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Benjamin were thirty-five thousand four hundred.  <div eID="gen902" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv726"/><div sID="gen903" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv726"/>From the descendants of Dan, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:39
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Dan were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.  <div eID="gen903" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv727"/><div sID="gen904" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv727"/>From the descendants of Asher, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:41
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Asher were forty-one thousand five hundred.  <div eID="gen904" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv728"/><div sID="gen905" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv728"/>From the descendants of Naphtali, their genealogies according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “their fathers”</note> according to the number of names, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war:

verses.name: Numbers 1:43
verses.text: those who were counted from the tribe of Naphtali were fifty-three thousand four hundred.  <div eID="gen905" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv729"/><div sID="gen906" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv729"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the ones counted whom Moses and Aaron mustered,<note placement="foot">Or “counted,” or “summoned,” or “enrolled”</note> with the twelve leaders of Israel, each one from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of his fathers”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 1:45
verses.text: So all those who were counted from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, everyone in Israel who <transChange type="added">is able</transChange> to go to war.

verses.name: Numbers 1:46
verses.text: All of the ones counted were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.

verses.name: Numbers 1:47
verses.text: The Levites from their ancestors’<note placement="foot">Or “fathers’ ”</note> tribe were not mustered<note placement="foot">Or “counted,” or “summoned,” or “enrolled”</note> in their midst.  <div eID="gen906" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 1:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv730"/><div sID="gen907" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv730"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 1:49
verses.text: “You will not muster<note placement="foot">Or “count,” or “summon,” or “enroll”</note> the tribe of Levi, and you will not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞take a census of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Lift up the head of”</note> them in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 1:50
verses.text: You will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞appoint⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “count,” or “summon,” or “enroll”</note> them over the tabernacle of the testimony,<note placement="foot">Other modern translations read “tabernacle of the covenant”</note> over all its vessels, and over all that belongs to it. They will carry the tabernacle and all its vessels, and they will care for it; and they will camp around the tabernacle.

verses.name: Numbers 1:51
verses.text: And when the tabernacle is set out, the Levites will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞take it down⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “lower it”</note> and when encamping the tabernacle the Levites will set it up; the stranger<note placement="foot">Or “outsider”</note> that approaches <transChange type="added">it</transChange> will be put to death.

verses.name: Numbers 1:52
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> will encamp, each in their own camp, and each by their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his” or “its”</note> own banner according to their divisions.

verses.name: Numbers 1:53
verses.text: But the Levites will encamp around the tabernacle of the testimony,<note placement="foot">Other modern translations read “tabernacle of the covenant”</note> and there will not be wrath on the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and the Levites will keep the requirements of the tabernacle of the testimony.”<note placement="foot">Other modern translations read “tabernacle of the covenant”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 1:54
verses.text: And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did thus; they did everything that Yahweh commanded Moses.  <chapter eID="Num.1"/>

verses.name: Numbers 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv731"/><title type="x-s">The Arrangement of the Camps</title> <div sID="gen908" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv731"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 2:2
verses.text: “The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> will encamp each with his standard, with a banner according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> they will encamp around the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Numbers 2:3
verses.text: The ones who encamp on the eastern side, toward the sunrise, <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> of the standard of the camp of Judah according to their divisions; and the leader of the descendants of Judah <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Nahshon son of Amminadab,

verses.name: Numbers 2:4
verses.text: and his division and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> seventy-four thousand six hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:5
verses.text: And the ones who encamp next to him <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> the tribe of Issachar. And the leader of the descendants of Issachar <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Nethanel son of Zuar,

verses.name: Numbers 2:6
verses.text: and his division <transChange type="added">are</transChange> fifty-four thousand four hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:7
verses.text: For the tribe of Zebulun: the leader of the descendants of Zebulun <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Eliab son of Helon,

verses.name: Numbers 2:8
verses.text: and his division and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of him,” or “the ones mustered of him”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:9
verses.text: All those counted from the camp of Judah <transChange type="added">are</transChange> one hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred. They will set out first according to their divisions.  <div eID="gen908" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv732"/><div sID="gen909" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv732"/>“The standard of the camp of Reuben <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> to the south according to their divisions. The leader of the descendants <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Elizur son of Shedeur.

verses.name: Numbers 2:11
verses.text: And his division and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of him,” or “the ones mustered of him”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> forty-six thousand five hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:12
verses.text: Those encamped next to him <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> the tribe of Simeon. The leader of the descendants of Simeon <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.

verses.name: Numbers 2:13
verses.text: And his division and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:14
verses.text: For the tribe of Gad: the leader of the descendants of Gad <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Eliasaph son of Reuel.

verses.name: Numbers 2:15
verses.text: And his division and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

verses.name: Numbers 2:16
verses.text: All <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “those mustered”</note> from the camp of Reuben <transChange type="added">are</transChange> one hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty. They will set out second according to their divisions.  <div eID="gen909" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv733"/><div sID="gen910" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv733"/>“The tent of assembly the camp of the Levites will set out in the midst of the camps; they will set out just as they encamped, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each according to their standards⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “each man on his hand according to their standards”</note>  <div eID="gen910" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv734"/><div sID="gen911" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv734"/>“The standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> to the west. The leader of the descendants of Ephraim <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Elishama son of Ammihud.

verses.name: Numbers 2:19
verses.text: And his division and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> forty thousand five hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:20
verses.text: The tribe of Manasseh <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> next to him. The leader of the descendants of the tribe of Manasseh <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Camaliel son of Pedahzur.

verses.name: Numbers 2:21
verses.text: And his division and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> thirty-two thousand two hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:22
verses.text: For the tribe of Benjamin: the leader of the descendants of Benjamin <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Abidan son of Gideoni.

verses.name: Numbers 2:23
verses.text: And his division and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> thirty-five thousand four hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:24
verses.text: All <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “those mustered”</note> from the camp of Ephraim <transChange type="added">are</transChange> one hundred and eighty thousand one hundred. They will set out third according to their divisions.  <div eID="gen911" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv735"/><div sID="gen912" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv735"/>“The standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> to the west. The leader of the descendants of Dan <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

verses.name: Numbers 2:26
verses.text: And his division and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:27
verses.text: Those encamped next to him <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> the tribe of Asher. The leader of the descendants of Asher <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Pagiel son of Ocran.

verses.name: Numbers 2:28
verses.text: And his division and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> forty-one thousand five hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:29
verses.text: For the tribe of Naphtali: the leader of the descendants of Naphtali <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> Ahira son of Enan.

verses.name: Numbers 2:30
verses.text: And his division and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> fifty-three thousand four hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:31
verses.text: All the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> from the camp of Dan are one hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They will set out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞last⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from behind”</note> according to their divisions.”  <div eID="gen912" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 2:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv736"/><div sID="gen913" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv736"/>These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the ones counted of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> all those counted from the camps according to their divisions <transChange type="added">were</transChange> six hundred and three thousand five hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 2:33
verses.text: The Levites were not counted in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> just as Yahweh commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen913" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 2:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv737"/><div sID="gen914" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv737"/>And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did everything that Yahweh commanded Moses. They encamped according to their standards, and they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “each one,” or “each man”</note> set out each one according to their clans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his clans”</note> among <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of his fathers”</note>  <chapter eID="Num.2"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv738"/><title type="x-s">Aaron’s Sons</title> <div sID="gen915" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv738"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the genealogies of Aaron and Moses <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on a day”</note> when Yahweh spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.

verses.name: Numbers 3:2
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the names of the descendants of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.name: Numbers 3:3
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the names of the descendants of Aaron, the priests, the anointed ones whom <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he consecrated as priests⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he filled their hands to serve as a priest”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 3:4
verses.text: Nadab and Abihu died <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of Yahweh”</note> when they presented a strange fire <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of Yahweh”</note> in the desert of Sinai, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they had no children⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons were not for them”</note> Eleazar and Ithamar served as priest during the presence of Aaron their father.  <div eID="gen915" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv739"/><div sID="gen916" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv739"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 3:6
verses.text: “Bring near the tribe of Levi, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞set the tribe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause it to stand”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Aaron⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of Aaron”</note> the priest, and they will minister to him.

verses.name: Numbers 3:7
verses.text: They shall observe his duties and the duties of the entire community before the tent of assembly, to do the work of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Numbers 3:8
verses.text: And they will keep all the vessels of the tent of assembly and the responsibilities of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> to do the work<note placement="foot">Or “service”</note> of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Numbers 3:9
verses.text: You will give the Levites to Aaron and to his descendants; they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> surely assigned to him from among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 3:10
verses.text: But you will count Aaron and his descendants; they will keep their priesthood, and the stranger<note placement="foot">Or “outsider”</note> who approaches will be put to death.”  <div eID="gen916" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv740"/><div sID="gen917" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv740"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 3:12
verses.text: “I <transChange type="added">myself</transChange> receive the Levites from the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> in the place of all the firstborn of the offspring of the womb from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> The Levites will be mine

verses.name: Numbers 3:13
verses.text: because all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstborn <transChange type="added">are</transChange> mine; on the day of my killing all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated for myself all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstborn in Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞both humankind and animal⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “from humankind to animal”</note> they will be mine. I am Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen917" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv741"/><div sID="gen918" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv741"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses in the desert of Sinai, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 3:15
verses.text: “Muster<note placement="foot">Or “count,” or “summon,” or “enroll”</note> the descendants of Levi according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> according to their clans. You will count every male from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one month⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of a month”</note> and above.”

verses.name: Numbers 3:16
verses.text: So Moses mustered<note placement="foot">Or “counted,” or “summoned,” or “enrolled”</note> them according to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of Yahweh”</note> just as he commanded.

verses.name: Numbers 3:17
verses.text: These were the sons of Levi according to their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.name: Numbers 3:18
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the names of the sons of Gershon according to their clans: Libni and Shimei.

verses.name: Numbers 3:19
verses.text: And the sons of Kohath according to their clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.name: Numbers 3:20
verses.text: The sons of Merari according to their tribes: Mahli and Mushi. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the clans of the Levites according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note>  <div eID="gen918" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv742"/><div sID="gen919" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv742"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞To Gershon belonged⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To Gershon was”</note> the clan of the Libnites and the clan of the Shimeites; these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the clans of the Gershonites.

verses.name: Numbers 3:22
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> according to the number of every male from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one month⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of a month and above”</note> and above <transChange type="added">were</transChange> seven thousand five hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 3:23
verses.text: The clans of the Gershonites will camp behind the tabernacle to the west,

verses.name: Numbers 3:24
verses.text: and the leader of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the house of his father”</note> of the Gershonites is Eliasaph son of Lael.

verses.name: Numbers 3:25
verses.text: And the responsibility of the descendants of Gershon in the tent of assembly <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the tabernacle, and the tent covering it and the curtain of the doorway of the tent of the assembly,

verses.name: Numbers 3:26
verses.text: and the hangings of the courtyard and the curtain of the doorway of the courtyard that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> around the tabernacle and the altar, and its ten cords, all of its use.  <div eID="gen919" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv743"/><div sID="gen920" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv743"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞To Kohath belonged⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “For Kohath was”</note> the clan of Amramites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amramite”</note> the clan of the Izharites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Izharite”</note> the clan of the Hebronites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hebronite”</note> and the clan of the Uzzielites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Uzzielite”</note> these were the clans of the Kohathites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Kohathite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 3:28
verses.text: According to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> number of every male from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one month⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of a month”</note> and above <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> eight thousand six hundred keeping the responsibility of the sanctuary.

verses.name: Numbers 3:29
verses.text: The clan of the descendants of Kohath will encamp on the side of the tabernacle to the south.

verses.name: Numbers 3:30
verses.text: The leader of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the house of his father”</note> according to the clans of the Kohathites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Kohathite”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

verses.name: Numbers 3:31
verses.text: Their responsibility <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altar, and the vessels of the sanctuary, with which they ministered, and the curtain, and all of its use.

verses.name: Numbers 3:32
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞chief of the leaders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the leader of leaders”</note> of the Levites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Levite”</note> was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest <transChange type="added">who had</transChange> oversight of those keeping the responsibility of the sanctuary.  <div eID="gen920" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv744"/><div sID="gen921" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv744"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞To Merari belonged⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for Merari was”</note> the clan of Mahlites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Mahlite”</note> and the clan of the Mushites:<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Mushite”</note> these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the clans of Merari.

verses.name: Numbers 3:34
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> according to the number of every male from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one month⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of a month”</note> and above <transChange type="added">were</transChange> six thousand two hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 3:35
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> leader of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the house of his father”</note> according to the clans of Merari <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Zuriel son of Abihail; they will encamp of the side of the tabernacle to the north.

verses.name: Numbers 3:36
verses.text: The responsibility of the sons of Merari <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the supervision of the frames of the tabernacle, its bars, pillars, bases, and all its vessels and all its service,

verses.name: Numbers 3:37
verses.text: and the pillars around the courtyard, and their bases, pegs, and cords.  <div eID="gen921" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv745"/><div sID="gen922" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv745"/>Those encamped before the tabernacle to the east—before the tent of assembly to the east—<transChange type="added">were</transChange> Moses and Aaron and his sons; they will keep the responsibility of the sanctuary <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “for the responsibility of the children of Israel”</note> and the stranger<note placement="foot">Or “outsider”</note> who approaches will be put to death.

verses.name: Numbers 3:39
verses.text: All those counted from the Levites whom Moses and Aaron mustered<note placement="foot">Or “counted,” or “summoned,” or “enrolled”</note> according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the word of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of Yahweh”</note> according to their clans, every male from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one month⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of a month”</note> and above <transChange type="added">were</transChange> twenty-two thousand.  <div eID="gen922" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:40
