verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv746"/><div sID="gen923" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv746"/>And Yahweh said to Moses, “Muster every firstborn male from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one month⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of a month”</note> and above and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞count⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and lift up the number of”</note> their names.

verses.name: Numbers 3:41
verses.text: And you will receive the Levites for me—I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh—in the place of all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstborn among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the Levites in the place of all the firstborn among the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 3:42
verses.text: So Moses mustered<note placement="foot">Or “counted” or “summoned” or “enrolled”</note> all the firstborn among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> just as Yahweh commanded him.

verses.name: Numbers 3:43
verses.text: And all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstborn males<note placement="foot">Hebrew “male”</note> among the number of names from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one month⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of a month”</note> and above, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.  <div eID="gen923" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv747"/><div sID="gen924" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv747"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 3:45
verses.text: “Receive the Levites in the place of all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstborn among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and the animals of the Levites in the place of their animals; the Levites will be mine. I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 3:46
verses.text: And the ransom of the two hundred and seventy-three of the firstborn of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> who are excessive over the Levites,

verses.name: Numbers 3:47
verses.text: you will receive five shekels a person, in the sanctuary shekel; you will collect twenty gerahs<note placement="foot">Hebrew “gerah”</note> <transChange type="added">per</transChange> shekel.

verses.name: Numbers 3:48
verses.text: You will give the money to Aaron, and to his sons the ransom of the ones who are excessive among them.”

verses.name: Numbers 3:49
verses.text: And Moses received the money of the redemption from the ones who were excessive from those redeemed of the Levites.

verses.name: Numbers 3:50
verses.text: From the firstborn of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> he took the money, one thousand three hundred and sixty-five shekels, in the sanctuary shekel.

verses.name: Numbers 3:51
verses.text: And Moses gave the money of the ransom to Aaron and to his sons according to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞word⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth”</note> of Yahweh just as Yahweh commanded Moses.  <chapter eID="Num.3"/>

verses.name: Numbers 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv748"/><title type="x-s">The Census of the Kohathites</title> <div sID="gen925" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv748"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 4:2
verses.text: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Take a census⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and lift up the number of”</note> of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Kohath from the midst of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Levi, according to their clans and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 4:3
verses.text: from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞thirty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of thirty years”</note> and above, up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fifty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of fifty years”</note> everyone who comes to the service to do the work in the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Numbers 4:4
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the work of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Kohath in the tent of assembly, concerning the holiness of the sanctuary:

verses.name: Numbers 4:5
verses.text: When setting out the camp, Aaron and his sons will go and lower the curtain of the covering and cover with it the ark of the testimony.<note placement="foot">Or “the ark of the covenant”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 4:6
verses.text: They will put on it a covering of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fine leather⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the hide of a sea cow”</note> and they will spread a cloth of perfect blue over it, and they will place its poles.

verses.name: Numbers 4:7
verses.text: And over the table of the presence they will spread <transChange type="added">out</transChange> a blue cloth and put on it the plates, dishes, and libation bowls, and the pitchers of the libation; and the bread of continuity will be on it.

verses.name: Numbers 4:8
verses.text: They will spread over it a scarlet cloth, and they will cover it with a covering of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fine leather⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the hide of a sea cow”</note> and they will place its poles.

verses.name: Numbers 4:9
verses.text: They will take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand for the light source, its lamps, a pair of its tongs, its small pans, and all the vessels of its oil with which they attend to it.

verses.name: Numbers 4:10
verses.text: They will put it and all its vessels inside a covering of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fine leather⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the hide of a sea cow”</note> and put it on the carrying frame.

verses.name: Numbers 4:11
verses.text: Over the altar of gold they will spread a blue cloth, and they will cover it with a covering of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fine leather⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the hide of a sea cow”</note> and place its poles.

verses.name: Numbers 4:12
verses.text: They will take all the vessels of the cultic service with which they serve in the sanctuary and put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> on a blue cloth, and they will cover them with a covering of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fine leather⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the hide of a sea cow”</note> and they will put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> on the carrying frame.

verses.name: Numbers 4:13
verses.text: They will remove the fat-soaked ashes from the altar and spread a purple cloth over it;

verses.name: Numbers 4:14
verses.text: they will put on it all the vessels with which they serve, the fire pans, forks, shovels, and bowls—all the vessels of the altar. They will spread on it a covering of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fine leather⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the hide of a sea cow”</note> and they will place its poles.

verses.name: Numbers 4:15
verses.text: And when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the vessels of the sanctuary when the camp sets out, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Kohath will come after to carry these, but they must not touch the sanctuary, or they will die. These are the load of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Kohath in the tent of assembly.  <div eID="gen925" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv749"/><div sID="gen926" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv749"/>“Eleazar son of Aaron the priest is to supervise the oil of the light source, the incense, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the regular grain offering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the grain offering of continuity”</note> the oil of anointment, the supervision of all the tabernacle and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in it, in the sanctuary and in its vessels.”  <div eID="gen926" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv750"/><div sID="gen927" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv750"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 4:18
verses.text: “You must not cut off the tribe of the clan of the Kohathites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Kohathite”</note> from the midst of the Levites.

verses.name: Numbers 4:19
verses.text: Do this to them and they will live and not die when they come near the most holy things. Aaron and his sons will go and appoint them, each one to his task and burden.

verses.name: Numbers 4:20
verses.text: But they must not go and look <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for a moment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as devouring”</note> at the holy objects.”  <div eID="gen927" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv751"/><div sID="gen928" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv751"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 4:22
verses.text: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Take a census⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And lift up the number of”</note> of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gershon also, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> and clans,

verses.name: Numbers 4:23
verses.text: from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fifty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of fifty years”</note> you will muster<note placement="foot">Or “count,” or “summon,” or “enroll”</note> them, all who come to help to do the work of the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Numbers 4:24
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the work of the clans of the Gershonites:<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gershonite”</note> to serve and to carry.

verses.name: Numbers 4:25
verses.text: They will carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tent of assembly <transChange type="added">and</transChange> its covering and the covering of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fine leather⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the hide of a sea cow”</note> which <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is on top of it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “is above upon it”</note> and the curtain of the doorway of the tent of assembly,

verses.name: Numbers 4:26
verses.text: and the curtains of the courtyard, and the covering for the doorway of the gate of the courtyard, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> all around on the tabernacle and altar, and their cords and all the vessels of their work; and all that is done to them they will do.

verses.name: Numbers 4:27
verses.text: And all the work of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of the Gershonites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gershonite”</note> will be at <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the command⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth”</note> of Aaron and his sons, for all they <transChange type="added">are to</transChange> carry and for all their work, and you will appoint to them responsibility for all they <transChange type="added">are to</transChange> carry.

verses.name: Numbers 4:28
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the work of the clan of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of the Gershonites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gershonite”</note> in the tent of assembly, and their responsibility lies <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞under the direction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the hand”</note> of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.  <div eID="gen928" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 4:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv752"/><div sID="gen929" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv752"/>“<transChange type="added">For</transChange> the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Merari according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> you will muster<note placement="foot">Or “count,” or “summon,” or “enroll”</note> them;

verses.name: Numbers 4:30
verses.text: from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those thirty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of thirty years”</note> and above until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fifty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of fifty years”</note> you will muster<note placement="foot">Or “count,” or “summon,” or “enroll”</note> them, all who come to do the work of the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Numbers 4:31
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the responsibility of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who are to carry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “them carrying”</note> all their work in the tent of assembly: the frames of the tabernacle and its bars, pillars, and bases,

verses.name: Numbers 4:32
verses.text: and the pillars of the courtyard all around, and their bases, pegs, and cords, with all their vessels and for all their work. You will appoint by name the vessels that they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> responsible to carry.

verses.name: Numbers 4:33
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the work of the clan of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Merari, for all their work in the tent of assembly <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞under the direction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the hand”</note> of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.”  <div eID="gen929" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 4:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv753"/><div sID="gen930" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv753"/>And Moses and Aaron mustered the leaders of the community according to the house of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 4:35
verses.text: from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those thirty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of thirty years”</note> and above until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fifty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of fifty years”</note> everyone who comes to the service to work in the tent of assembly,

verses.name: Numbers 4:36
verses.text: the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

verses.name: Numbers 4:37
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> those counted of the clans of the Kohathites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Kohathite”</note> everyone who served in the tent of assembly whom Moses and Aaron mustered<note placement="foot">Or “counted,” or “summoned,” or “enrolled”</note> according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the command⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth”</note> of Yahweh by the hand of Moses.<note placement="foot">Or “through Moses”</note>  <div eID="gen930" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 4:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv754"/><div sID="gen931" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv754"/>And the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gershon counted according to their clans and according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 4:39
verses.text: from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those thirty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of thirty years”</note> and above until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fifty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of fifty years”</note> everyone who comes to the service to work in the tent of assembly;

verses.name: Numbers 4:40
verses.text: the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> were two thousand six hundred and thirty.

verses.name: Numbers 4:41
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> those counted of the clans of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gershon, everyone who serves in the tent of assembly whom Moses and Aaron mustered<note placement="foot">Or “counted,” or “summoned,” or “enrolled”</note> according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the command⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth”</note> of Yahweh.  <div eID="gen931" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 4:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv755"/><div sID="gen932" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv755"/>Those counted of the clans of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Merari according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 4:43
verses.text: from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those thirty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “thirty years and above”</note> and above until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fifty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of fifty years”</note> everyone who comes to the service to work in the tent of assembly,

verses.name: Numbers 4:44
verses.text: the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> according to their clans, were three thousand two hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 4:45
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> those counted of the clans of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron mustered<note placement="foot">Or “counted,” or “summoned,” or “enrolled”</note> according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the command⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth”</note> of Yahweh by the hand of Moses.<note placement="foot">Or “through Moses”</note>  <div eID="gen932" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 4:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv756"/><div sID="gen933" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv756"/>All those counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and all the leaders of Israel mustered<note placement="foot">Or “counted,” or “summoned,” or “enrolled”</note> according to their clans, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 4:47
verses.text: from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those thirty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of thirty years”</note> and above until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fifty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of fifty years”</note> everyone who comes to the service to do <transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of the service carrying in the tent of assembly,

verses.name: Numbers 4:48
verses.text: the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones counted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones counted of them,” or “the ones mustered of them”</note> were eighty thousand five hundred and eighty.

verses.name: Numbers 4:49
verses.text: According to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the command⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth”</note> of Yahweh by the hand of Moses<note placement="foot">Or “through Moses”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they were mustered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he mustered”</note> each man according to his service and according to their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> service and according to their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> burden; and so they were counted by him just as Yahweh commanded Moses.  <chapter eID="Num.4"/>

verses.name: Numbers 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv757"/><title type="x-s">Rules Concerning Those Unclean</title> <div sID="gen934" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv757"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 5:2
verses.text: “Command the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> they must send everyone from the camp who is afflicted with a rash,<note placement="foot">The precise meaning is uncertain; many modern translations suggest “leprosy”</note> everyone with a fluid discharge, and everyone unclean through <transChange type="added">contact with</transChange> a corpse.

verses.name: Numbers 5:3
verses.text: You will send away <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞both male and female⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “from male until female”</note> you will send them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to an outside place of the camp”</note> They must not make unclean their camps where I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> dwelling in their midst.”

verses.name: Numbers 5:4
verses.text: So the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did so. They sent them away <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to an outside place of the camp”</note> just as Yahweh spoke to Moses, so did the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <div eID="gen934" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv758"/><title type="x-s">Rules of Restitution</title> <div sID="gen935" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv758"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 5:6
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> ‘When a man or woman <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞commits⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “does”</note> any of the sins of humankind by acting unfaithfully, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> a sin against Yahweh, and that person will be guilty;

verses.name: Numbers 5:7
verses.text: they will confess their sin that they did and will make restitution <transChange type="added">for</transChange> their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> guilt by adding a fifth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on top of it”</note> and giving it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to whomever was wronged⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to whomever he was guilty”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 5:8
verses.text: But if the man does not have a redeemer to make restitution to him for the reparation, the reparation is to be given to Yahweh for the priest, in addition to the ram of atonement by which atonement is made for him.

verses.name: Numbers 5:9
verses.text: And every contribution of all the holy objects of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> that they bring to the priest for him will be his.

verses.name: Numbers 5:10
verses.text: The holy objects of a man will be for him;<note placement="foot">That is, the priest</note> whatever he gives to the priest will be for him.’ ”  <div eID="gen935" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv759"/><title type="x-s">Rules Concerning an Unfaithful Wife</title> <div sID="gen936" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv759"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 5:12
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and acts unfaithfully to him,

verses.name: Numbers 5:13
verses.text: and a man sleeps with her and ejaculates and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and she is concealed, although she is defiled, and there is no witness against her and she was not caught,

verses.name: Numbers 5:14
verses.text: if a spirit of jealousy comes over him, and he is jealous <transChange type="added">of</transChange> his wife and she is defiled; or if a spirit of jealousy comes over him and he is jealous <transChange type="added">of</transChange> his wife but she is not defiled,

verses.name: Numbers 5:15
verses.text: he will bring his wife to the priest. And he will bring her offering for her, one-tenth of an ephah of flour. He will not pour oil on it, and he will not put frankincense on it because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> a grain offering of jealousy, a grain offering of remembering,<note placement="foot">Or “memorial”</note> a reminding of guilt.  <div eID="gen936" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv760"/><div sID="gen937" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv760"/>“ ‘Then the priest will bring her near and present her <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of”</note> Yahweh;

verses.name: Numbers 5:17
verses.text: the priest will take holy waters in a clay vessel, and from the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle, and the priest will put <transChange type="added">it</transChange> into the waters.

verses.name: Numbers 5:18
verses.text: And the priest will present the woman <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of”</note> Yahweh, and he will uncover the head of the woman; he will then put in her hands the grain offering of the remembering—<transChange type="added">which is</transChange> the grain offering of jealousy—and in the hand of the priest will be the waters of bitterness that brings a curse.

verses.name: Numbers 5:19
verses.text: Then the priest will make her swear an oath, and he will say to the woman, “If a man has not slept with you, and if you have not had an impurity affair under your husband, go unpunished from the waters of bitterness that brings this curse.

verses.name: Numbers 5:20
verses.text: But if you have had an affair under your husband, and if you are defiled and a man other than your husband had intercourse with you,”

verses.name: Numbers 5:21
verses.text: the priest will make the woman swear an oath of the sworn oath of the curse, the priest will say to the woman, “May Yahweh give you a curse and a sworn oath in the midst of your people with Yahweh making<note placement="foot">Hebrew “giving”</note> your hip fall away<note placement="foot">Or “waste away”</note> and your stomach swollen;

verses.name: Numbers 5:22
verses.text: and these waters that bring a curse will go into your intestines to cause <transChange type="added">your</transChange> womb to swell and to make <transChange type="added">your</transChange> hip fall away.”<note placement="foot">Or “waste away”</note> And the women will say, “Amen. Amen.”  <div eID="gen937" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv761"/><div sID="gen938" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv761"/>“ ‘And the priests will write these curses on the scroll, and he will wipe <transChange type="added">them</transChange> off into the waters of the bitterness.

verses.name: Numbers 5:24
verses.text: He will make the woman drink the waters of the bitterness that brings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bring”</note> a curse, and the waters of bitterness that bring a curse will go into her.

verses.name: Numbers 5:25
verses.text: The priest will take the grain offering of jealousy from the hand of the woman, and he will wave the grain offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of Yahweh”</note> and he will present it to the altar;

verses.name: Numbers 5:26
verses.text: the priest will grasp her memorial offering from the grain offering, and he will turn <transChange type="added">it</transChange> into smoke <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the altar, and afterward he will make the woman drink the waters.

verses.name: Numbers 5:27
verses.text: When he has made her drink the waters, it will come about, if she has defiled herself and acted unfaithfully to her husband and the waters of bitterness that bring a curse go into her and her stomach swells and her hip falls away,<note placement="foot">Or “wastes away”</note> the woman will be as a curse in the midst of her people.

verses.name: Numbers 5:28
verses.text: And if the woman is not defiled, and she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> pure, she will go unpunished and be able to conceive children.  <div eID="gen938" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 5:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv762"/><div sID="gen939" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv762"/>“ ‘This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the regulation of jealousy, when a woman has an affair under her husband and she is defiled,

verses.name: Numbers 5:30
verses.text: or when a spirit of jealousy comes over a man and he is jealous <transChange type="added">of</transChange> his wife, he will present the woman <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of”</note>and the priest will do to her all of this law.

verses.name: Numbers 5:31
verses.text: The man will go unpunished from guilt, and the woman, she will bear her guilt.’ ”  <chapter eID="Num.5"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv763"/><title type="x-s">Rules Concerning Nazirites</title> <div sID="gen940" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv763"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 6:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘When a man or a woman takes a special vow, a vow of a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Nazirite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “one separated”</note> to keep separate for Yahweh,

verses.name: Numbers 6:3
verses.text: he will abstain from wine and fermented drink; he will not drink wine vinegar or vinegar of fermented drink; he will not drink the fruit juice of grapes or eat fresh or dry grapes.

verses.name: Numbers 6:4
verses.text: All the days of his separation<note placement="foot">That is, “the Nazirite”</note> you will not eat from anything that is made from the grapevine, from sour grapes to the skin <transChange type="added">of grapes</transChange>.  <div eID="gen940" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv764"/><div sID="gen941" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv764"/>“ ‘All the days of the vow of his separation a razor will not pass over his head. Until fulfilling the days that he separated himself to Yahweh he will be holy and grow long the locks of the hair of his head.  <div eID="gen941" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv765"/><div sID="gen942" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv765"/>“ ‘All the days of keeping himself separated for Yahweh he will not go to a person who is dead;

verses.name: Numbers 6:7
verses.text: for even his father, mother, brother, or sister he will not make himself unclean <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by their death⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with their dying”</note> because the separation to his God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on his head.

verses.name: Numbers 6:8
verses.text: He will be holy for Yahweh all the days of his separation.<note placement="foot">That is, “the Nazirite”</note>  <div eID="gen942" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv766"/><div sID="gen943" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv766"/>“ ‘If someone dies suddenly and makes the head of his separation<note placement="foot">That is, “the Nazirite”</note> unclean, he will shave off <transChange type="added">the hair of</transChange> his head on the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day he will shave it off.

verses.name: Numbers 6:10
verses.text: On the eighth day he will bring two turtledoves or two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young pigeons⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the sons of doves”</note> to the priest by the doorway of the tent of assembly,

verses.name: Numbers 6:11
verses.text: and the priest will offer one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering, and he will make atonement for him because he sinned concerning the corpse. He will consecrate his head on that day.

verses.name: Numbers 6:12
verses.text: He will rededicate to Yahweh the days of his separation<note placement="foot">That is, “the Nazirite”</note> and bring a ram-lamb <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in its first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of his year”</note> as a guilt offering. The former days <transChange type="added">of his vow</transChange> will fall away because his separation was defiled.  <div eID="gen943" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv767"/><div sID="gen944" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv767"/>“ ‘This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the regulation of the Nazirite for the day of the fulfilling of the days of his separation: one will bring him to the doorway of the tent of the assembly.

verses.name: Numbers 6:14
verses.text: He will present his offering to Yahweh, one ram-lamb <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in its first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of his year”</note> without defect as a burnt offering, and one ewe-lamb <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in its first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a daughter of his year”</note> without defect as a sin offering, and one ram without defect as a fellowship offering;

verses.name: Numbers 6:15
verses.text: and a basket of unleavened bread, finely milled flour of ring-shaped bread cakes mixed with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread smeared with oil, and their grain offering and their libations.

verses.name: Numbers 6:16
verses.text: The priest will present <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “before the face of Yahweh”</note> and offer his sin offering, his burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 6:17
verses.text: he will offer a ram as a sacrifice of a fellowship offering to Yahweh, in addition to the basket of the unleavened bread; the priest will offer his grain offering and his libation.

verses.name: Numbers 6:18
verses.text: The Nazirite will shave off <transChange type="added">the hair of</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his consecrated head⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the head of his separation”</note> at the doorway of the tent of assembly, and he will take the hair of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his consecrated head⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the head of his separation”</note> and he will put <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on the fire that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> beneath the sacrifice of the fellowship offering.

verses.name: Numbers 6:19
verses.text: The priest will take the shoulder from the ram that is boiled, and one ring-shaped bread cake of unleavened bread from the basket, and one wafer of unleavened bread, and he will put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his consecrated head⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his separation”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 6:20
verses.text: The priest will wave them <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a wave offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before the presence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of”</note> Yahweh; they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> are a holy object to the priest, in addition to the breast section of the wave offering, and in addition to the upper thigh of the contribution; and afterward the Nazirite may drink wine.  <div eID="gen944" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv768"/><div sID="gen945" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv768"/>“ ‘This is the regulation of the Nazirite who has made a vow of his offering to Yahweh according to his separation, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in addition to what he can afford⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “except from that which overtakes his hand”</note> In accordance to the word of his vow that he vowed, he will do, concerning the instruction of his separation.’ ”  <div eID="gen945" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv769"/><title type="x-s">The Priestly Blessing</title> <div sID="gen946" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv769"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 6:23
verses.text: “Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘You will bless the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> You will say to them:  <div eID="gen946" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv770"/><lg sID="gen947"/> <l level="1" sID="gen948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv770"/>Yahweh will bless you<l eID="gen948" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen949"/>and keep you; <l eID="gen949" level="2"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv771"/><l level="1" sID="gen950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv771"/>Yahweh will make shine his face on you<l eID="gen950" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen951"/>and be gracious to you; <l eID="gen951" level="2"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv772"/><l level="1" sID="gen952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv772"/>Yahweh will lift up his face upon you,<l eID="gen952" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen953"/>and he will give you peace.’ <l eID="gen953" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen947"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv773"/><div sID="gen954" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv773"/>And they will put my name on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and I will bless them.”  <chapter eID="Num.6"/>

verses.name: Numbers 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv774"/><title type="x-s">The Leaders Make Offerings</title> <div sID="gen955" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv774"/>On the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle and appointed and consecrated it and all its vessels, and the altar and its vessels, and he appointed them and consecrated them,

verses.name: Numbers 7:2
verses.text: the leaders of Israel, the heads of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note> presented an offering; they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the leaders of the tribes and <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the ones in charge of the counting.

verses.name: Numbers 7:3
verses.text: They brought their offering before the presence of<note placement="foot">Or “before the face of”</note> Yahweh, six covered utility carts and twelve cattle, a utility cart for two of the leaders, and a bull for each; and they presented them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of”</note> the tabernacle.

verses.name: Numbers 7:4
verses.text: Yahweh said to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 7:5
verses.text: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Take them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Take from them”</note> and they will be used to do the work of the tent of the assembly; and you will give them to the Levites, each <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to his required service⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “according to the mouth of his work”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 7:6
verses.text: So Moses took the utility carts and the cattle, and he gave them to the Levites.

verses.name: Numbers 7:7
verses.text: Two utility carts and four cattle he gave to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gershon <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to their required service⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “according to the mouth of their work”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 7:8
verses.text: and four utility carts and eight cattle he gave to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Merari <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to their required service⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “according to the mouth of their work”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞under the authority of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the hand of”</note> Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

verses.name: Numbers 7:9
verses.text: But to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Kohath he did not give anything because the work of the sanctuary they carried upon them on their shoulders.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the shoulder”</note>  <div eID="gen955" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv775"/><div sID="gen956" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv775"/>The leaders presented offerings for the dedication of the altar on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of its anointing, and the leaders presented their offerings <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> the altar.

verses.name: Numbers 7:11
verses.text: Yahweh said to Moses, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞One leader for each day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “One leader for the day one leader for the day”</note> will present their offering for the dedication of the altar.”  <div eID="gen956" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv776"/><div sID="gen957" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv776"/>And it happened, the one who presented his offering on the first day <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Nahshon son of Amminadab from the tribe of Judah.

verses.name: Numbers 7:13
verses.text: His offering <transChange type="added">was</transChange> one plate of silver—its weight was one hundred and thirty shekels—<transChange type="added">and</transChange> one silver bowl <transChange type="added">weighing</transChange> seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞both of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the two of them”</note> filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> finely milled flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:14
verses.text: one golden dish weighing ten shekels filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> incense;

verses.name: Numbers 7:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one young bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “one bull, a son of a cattle”</note> one ram, one male lamb <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in its first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of its year”</note> as a burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:16
verses.text: one he-goat as a sin offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:17
verses.text: and as a sacrifice of the fellowship offering, two cattle, five rams, five he-goats, and five male lambs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a year old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> This <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the offering of Nahshon son of Amminadab.  <div eID="gen957" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv777"/><div sID="gen958" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv777"/>On the second day Nethanel son of Zuar, leader of Issachar, presented an offering.

verses.name: Numbers 7:19
verses.text: He presented <transChange type="added">as</transChange> his offering one silver plate—its weight one hundred and thirty <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange>—<transChange type="added">and</transChange> one silver bowl for drinking wine <transChange type="added">weighing</transChange> seventy shekels<note placement="foot">Hebrew “shekel”</note> according to the sanctuary shekel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞both of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the two of them”</note> filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> finely milled flour mixed with oil as a grain offering.

verses.name: Numbers 7:20
verses.text: One dish weighing ten shekels filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> incense;

verses.name: Numbers 7:21
verses.text: one <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young ⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of cattle”</note> bull, one ram, a male lamb <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in its first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of its year”</note> as a burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:22
verses.text: one he-goat as a sin offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:23
verses.text: and for the sacrifice of the fellowship offering, two cattle, five rams, five he-goats, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> five male lambs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> This <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the offering of Nethanel son of Zuar.  <div eID="gen958" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv778"/><div sID="gen959" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv778"/>On the third day Eliab son of Helon, leader of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zebulun:

verses.name: Numbers 7:25
verses.text: his offering <transChange type="added">was</transChange> one silver plate—its weight one hundred and thirty <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange>—<transChange type="added">and</transChange> one silver bowl for drinking wine <transChange type="added">weighing</transChange> seventy shekels<note placement="foot">Hebrew “shekel”</note> according to the sanctuary shekel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞both of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the two of them”</note> filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> finely milled flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:26
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one golden dish weighing ten shekels⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one dish of ten gold”</note> filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> incense;

verses.name: Numbers 7:27
verses.text: one <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of cattle”</note> bull, one ram, a male lamb <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in its first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of its year”</note> as a burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:28
verses.text: one he-goat as a sin offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:29

verses.name: Numbers 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv790"/><title type="x-s">The Seven Lamps</title> <div sID="gen971" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv790"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 8:2
verses.text: “Speak to Aaron, and say to him: ‘When you are setting up the lamps, the seven lamps will give light in front of the face of the lampstand.’ ”

verses.name: Numbers 8:3
verses.text: And Aaron did so; he set up the lampstand in front of the face of its lamps, just as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.name: Numbers 8:4
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how the lampstand was made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the work of the lampstand”</note> a hammered-work of gold; from its base up to its blossom,<note placement="foot">Or “flower”</note> it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> hammered-work according to the pattern that Yahweh showed Moses; so he made the lampstand.  <div eID="gen971" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv791"/><title type="x-s">Moses Consecrates the Levites</title> <div sID="gen972" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv791"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 8:6
verses.text: “Take the Levites from the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and purify them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:7
verses.text: So you will do to them, to purify them: sprinkle on them waters of purification, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will shave their whole body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they will send a razor on all their body”</note> and wash their garments.

verses.name: Numbers 8:8
verses.text: And they will take a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a bull, a son of cattle”</note> and its grain offering of finely milled flour mixed with oil, and you will take a second <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a bull, a son of cattle”</note> as a sin offering.

verses.name: Numbers 8:9
verses.text: You will bring the Levites <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> the tent of assembly, and you will summon the entire community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 8:10
verses.text: And you will bring the Levites <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of Yahweh”</note> and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> will lay their hands on the Levites,

verses.name: Numbers 8:11
verses.text: and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Aaron will offer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Aaron will wave”</note> the Levites as a wave offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of Yahweh”</note> from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and they will do the work of Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 8:12
verses.text: And the Levites will lay their hands on the head of the one bull and offer <transChange type="added">it</transChange> as a sin offering and the other one as a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.

verses.name: Numbers 8:13
verses.text: And you will present the Levites <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Aaron and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> his sons, and he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will offer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Aaron will wave”</note> them <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a wave offering to Yahweh.  <div eID="gen972" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv792"/><div sID="gen973" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv792"/>“And you will separate the Levites from the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and the Levites will be for me.

verses.name: Numbers 8:15
verses.text: And after this the Levites will come to serve <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the tent of assembly, and you will purify them, and you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will offer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Aaron will wave”</note> them <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a wave offering.

verses.name: Numbers 8:16
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> given to me exclusively from the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> I have taken them for myself in place of the firstborn of every womb, every firstborn from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 8:17
verses.text: For every firstborn among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine, both humankind and animal. On the day I destroyed every firstborn in the land of Egypt I consecrated them to me,

verses.name: Numbers 8:18
verses.text: and I have taken the Levites in the place of every firstborn among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 8:19
verses.text: And I have given the Levites; they are given to Aaron and his sons from the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> to do the work of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> in the tent of the assembly and to make atonement for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> so a plague will not be among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> when the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> come near the sanctuary.”  <div eID="gen973" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv793"/><div sID="gen974" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv793"/>And Moses and Aaron and the entire community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did to the Levites; everything that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did to them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:21
verses.text: And the Levites purified themselves, and they washed their garments, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Aaron offered them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Aaron waved them”</note> as a wave offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of Yahweh”</note> and Aaron made atonement for them to purify them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:22
verses.text: After this the Levites came to do their work in the tent of assembly before Aaron and his sons. Just as Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levities, so they did to them.  <div eID="gen974" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 8:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv794"/><div sID="gen975" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv794"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 8:24
verses.text: “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> what is for the Levites: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty-five years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from a son of twenty-five years”</note> and above will<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and he will”</note> come to help <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> service in the work of the tent of assembly;

verses.name: Numbers 8:25
verses.text: and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those fifty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from a son of fifty years”</note> will<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he will”</note> return from the service of the work and will serve no longer.

verses.name: Numbers 8:26
verses.text: They<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> can attend<note placement="foot">Or “assist”</note> their brothers in the tent of assembly to keep their responsibilities, but they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> will not do work. This is what you will do concerning the Levities and their responsibilities.”  <chapter eID="Num.8"/>

verses.name: Numbers 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv795"/><title type="x-s">The Passover</title> <div sID="gen976" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv795"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses in the desert of Sinai, in the second year after they came out from the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 9:2
verses.text: “Let the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> observe the Passover at its appointed time.

verses.name: Numbers 9:3
verses.text: On the fourteenth day of this month <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at twilight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “between the two evenings”</note> you will perform it at its appointed time according to all its decrees; and according to all its stipulations you will observe it.”

verses.name: Numbers 9:4
verses.text: So Moses spoke to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> to observe the Passover.

verses.name: Numbers 9:5
verses.text: And they observed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at twilight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “between the two evenings”</note> in the desert of Sinai. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, thus the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did.  <div eID="gen976" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv796"/><div sID="gen977" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv796"/>And it happened, men who were unclean <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by a dead person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by a life of a person”</note> were not able to perform the Passover on that day. And they came <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Moses and Aaron on that day.

verses.name: Numbers 9:7
verses.text: And those men said to him, “<transChange type="added">Although</transChange> we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> unclean <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by a dead person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “by a life of a person”</note> why are we hindered from presenting the offering of Yahweh at its appointed time in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 9:8
verses.text: Moses said to them, “Stay. I will hear what Yahweh commands to you.”  <div eID="gen977" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv797"/><div sID="gen978" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv797"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 9:10
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘Each man that is unclean <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by a dead person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by a life of a person”</note> or is on a far journey, you or your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞descendants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “generations”</note> he will observe the Passover of Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 9:11
verses.text: On the second month on the fourteenth day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at twilight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “between the two evenings”</note> they will observe it; they will eat it with unleavened bread and bitter plants.

verses.name: Numbers 9:12
verses.text: They will leave none of it until morning, and they will not break a bone in it; they will observe it according to every decree of the Passover.

verses.name: Numbers 9:13
verses.text: But the man who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> clean and not on a journey, and he fails to observe the Passover, that person will be cut off from the people because he did not present the offering of Yahweh on its appointed time. That man will bear his guilt.

verses.name: Numbers 9:14
verses.text: If an alien dwells with you he will observe the Passover of Yahweh according <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the decree of the Passover and according <transChange type="added">to</transChange> its stipulation; thus you will have one decree for you, for the alien and for the native of the land.’ ”  <div eID="gen978" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv798"/><title type="x-s">The Cloud and the Fire</title> <div sID="gen979" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv798"/>And on a day setting up the tabernacle, the cloud covered the tent of the tabernacle, the tent of the testimony; in the evening it was on the tabernacle as an appearance of fire until morning.

verses.name: Numbers 9:16
verses.text: So it was<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it will be”</note> continually; the cloud would cover it and the appearance of fire <transChange type="added">by</transChange> night.

verses.name: Numbers 9:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Whenever</transChange> the cloud lifted up from on the tent, after that the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> would set out, and in the place where the cloud dwelled, there the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> camped.

verses.name: Numbers 9:18
verses.text: On the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of Yahweh”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> would set out, and on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of Yahweh”</note> they encamped; all the days that the cloud dwelled on the tabernacle they encamped.

verses.name: Numbers 9:19
verses.text: And when the cloud prolonged on the tabernacle many days the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> kept the kept requirement of Yahweh and did not set out.

verses.name: Numbers 9:20
verses.text: When the cloud <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞remained⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it was there”</note> a number of days on the tabernacle, on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of Yahweh”</note> they encamped; and on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of Yahweh”</note> they set out.

verses.name: Numbers 9:21
verses.text: When the cloud <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞remained⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it was there”</note> from evening until morning, and the cloud lifted up in the morning, they would set out, or <transChange type="added">if it remained</transChange> in the daytime and <transChange type="added">at</transChange> night, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> the cloud lifted up they set out.

verses.name: Numbers 9:22
verses.text: When <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> two days, a month, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞or a year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “or days”</note> that the cloud prolonged to dwell on the tabernacle, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> encamped, and they did not set out; when it lifted up they set out.

verses.name: Numbers 9:23
verses.text: On the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of Yahweh”</note> they encamped, and on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of Yahweh”</note> they set out. They kept the requirement of Yahweh, on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of Yahweh”</note> in the hand of Moses.<note placement="foot">Or “through Moses”</note>  <chapter eID="Num.9"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv799"/><title type="x-s">The Silver Trumpets</title> <div sID="gen980" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv799"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 10:2
verses.text: “Make yourself two silver trumpets; make them <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hammered-work. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You will use them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “They will be for you”</note> for calling the community and for breaking the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 10:3
verses.text: You will blow them, and all the community will assemble to the doorway of the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Numbers 10:4
verses.text: But if they blow only one, the leaders, the heads of the thousands of Israel, will assemble to you.

verses.name: Numbers 10:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">When</transChange> you will blow a blast, the camps that are camping on the east will set out;

verses.name: Numbers 10:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">when</transChange> you blow a second blast, the camps that are camping on the south will set out; they will blow a blast for their journeys.

verses.name: Numbers 10:7
verses.text: But when summoning the assembly, you will blow, but you will not signal with a loud noise.

verses.name: Numbers 10:8
verses.text: The sons of Aaron, the priests, will blow on the trumpets; this will be an eternal decree for your generations.

verses.name: Numbers 10:9
verses.text: If you go <transChange type="added">to</transChange> war in your land against the enemy who attacks you, you will signal with a loud noise on the trumpets. You will be remembered <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh your God, and you will be rescued from your enemies.  <div eID="gen980" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv800"/><div sID="gen981" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv800"/>“And on the day of your joy and in your appointed times, at the beginning of your months, you will blow on the trumpets in addition to your burnt offerings and in addition to the sacrifices of your fellowship offerings. And they will be as a memorial for you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> your God; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.”  <div eID="gen981" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv801"/><title type="x-s">The Israelites Depart from Sinai</title> <div sID="gen982" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv801"/>And it happened, in the second year, in the second month, on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twentieth of the month the cloud was lifted from upon the tabernacle of the testimony.<note placement="foot">Some modern translations (e.g., the NRSV) have “tabernacle of the covenant”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 10:12
verses.text: And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> set out for their journey<note placement="foot">Hebrew “journeys”</note> from the desert of Sinai, and the cloud dwelled in the desert of Paran.

verses.name: Numbers 10:13
verses.text: They set out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the first time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the beginning”</note> on the command of Yahweh in the hand of Moses.<note placement="foot">Or “through Moses”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 10:14
verses.text: The standard of the camp of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah set out for the first time according to their divisions, with Nahshon son of Amminadab over its division.

verses.name: Numbers 10:15
verses.text: And Nathanel son of Zuar <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the division of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Issachar;

verses.name: Numbers 10:16
verses.text: Eliab son of Helon <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the division of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zebulun.  <div eID="gen982" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv802"/><div sID="gen983" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv802"/>The tabernacle was taken down, and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, the bearers of the tabernacle, set out.

verses.name: Numbers 10:18
verses.text: And the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions; Elizur son of Shedeur <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over their division.

verses.name: Numbers 10:19
verses.text: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the division of the sons of the tribe of Simeon.

verses.name: Numbers 10:20
verses.text: Eliasaph son of Deuel <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the division of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad.  <div eID="gen983" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv803"/><div sID="gen984" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv803"/>The Kohathites, the bearers of the sanctuary, set out, and they set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

verses.name: Numbers 10:22
verses.text: And the stand of the camp of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Ephraim set out according to their divisions; Elishama son of Ammihud <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over its division.

verses.name: Numbers 10:23
verses.text: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the division of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Manasseh.

verses.name: Numbers 10:24
verses.text: Abidan son of Gideoni <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the division of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Benjamin.  <div eID="gen984" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv804"/><div sID="gen985" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv804"/>Then the standard of the camp of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Dan, who formed a rear guard for all the camps, set out according to their divisions; Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over its division.

verses.name: Numbers 10:26
verses.text: Pagiel son of Ocran <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the division of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Asher.

verses.name: Numbers 10:27
verses.text: Ahira son of Enan <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the division of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Naphtali.

verses.name: Numbers 10:28
