verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the departures of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> according to their divisions; and so they set out.  <div eID="gen985" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv805"/><div sID="gen986" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv805"/>Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, “We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> setting out to the place that Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you’; go with us, and we will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞treat you well⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do good to you”</note> because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Yahweh spoke”</note> good concerning Israel.”

verses.name: Numbers 10:30
verses.text: But he said to him, “I will not go. I will only go to my land and to my family.”

verses.name: Numbers 10:31
verses.text: He<note placement="foot">That is, Moses</note> said, “Please, do not abandon us because you know our encampment in the desert, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you should be our guide⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you should be our eyes”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 10:32
verses.text: Moreover, if you go with us, the good that Yahweh will do to us we will do to you.”  <div eID="gen986" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv806"/><div sID="gen987" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv806"/>And so they set out from the mountain of Yahweh a journey of three days, with the ark of the covenant of Yahweh setting out ahead of them<note placement="foot">Or “before them”</note> three days’ journey to search out a resting place for them;

verses.name: Numbers 10:34
verses.text: and the cloud of Yahweh <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over them by day when they set out from the camp.  <div eID="gen987" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv807"/><div sID="gen988" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv807"/>And whenever the ark was setting out Moses would say, <div eID="gen988" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen989"/> <l level="1" sID="gen990"/>“Rise up, Yahweh!<l eID="gen990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen991"/>May your enemies be scattered;<l eID="gen991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen992"/>may the ones that hate you flee from your presence.” <l eID="gen992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv808"/><l level="1" sID="gen993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv808"/>And when it rested he would say,<l eID="gen993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen994"/>“Return, Yahweh,<l eID="gen994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen995"/>to the countless thousands of Israel.” <l eID="gen995" level="1"/><lg eID="gen989"/> <chapter eID="Num.10"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv809"/><title type="x-s">The Israelites Complain</title> <div sID="gen996" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv809"/>And it happened, the people were like those who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞complain of hardship⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “complain of bad”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the hearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the ears”</note> of Yahweh, and Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞became angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his nose became hot”</note> and the fire of Yahweh burned among them, and it consumed the edge of the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 11:2
verses.text: Then the people cried out to Moses, and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire died down.

verses.name: Numbers 11:3
verses.text: And he called the name of that place Taberah<note placement="foot">This word is difficult, but some modern translations suggest the word in Hebrew means “burning” (see NRSV, NASB)</note> because the fire of Yahweh burned among them.  <div eID="gen996" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv810"/><div sID="gen997" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv810"/>The riff-raff that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in their midst <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had a strong desire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “desired a desire”</note> and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> turned back and also wept, and they said, “Who will feed us meat?

verses.name: Numbers 11:5
verses.text: We remember the fish that we ate in Egypt for nothing, the cucumber, melon, leek, the onions, and the garlic.

verses.name: Numbers 11:6
verses.text: But now <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞our strength is dried up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “our life is dry”</note> there is nothing whatsoever except <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the manna before us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “for the manna of our eyes”</note>  <div eID="gen997" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv811"/><div sID="gen998" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv811"/>Now the manna <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like coriander seed, and its outward appearance was like that of bdellium-gum.

verses.name: Numbers 11:8
verses.text: The people went about and gathered <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and they ground <transChange type="added">it</transChange> with mills or crushed <transChange type="added">it</transChange> with mortar. Then they boiled <transChange type="added">it</transChange> in a pot and made it <transChange type="added">into</transChange> bread-cakes; and it tasted like olive oil cakes.

verses.name: Numbers 11:9
verses.text: When the dew came down on the camp <transChange type="added">at</transChange> night, the manna came down <transChange type="added">with</transChange> it.  <div eID="gen998" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv812"/><div sID="gen999" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv812"/>Moses heard the people weeping according to their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “its”</note> clans, each at the doorway of their tents. Then <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh became very angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the nose of Yahweh became very hot”</note> and in the eyes of Moses it was bad.

verses.name: Numbers 11:11
verses.text: And Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you brought trouble to your servant? Why have I not found favor in your eyes, that the burdens of all these people have been placed on me?

verses.name: Numbers 11:12
verses.text: Did I conceive all these people? If I have fathered them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him/it”</note> that you could say to me, ‘Carry them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him/it”</note> in your lap, just as a foster-father carries the suckling on the land that you swore an oath to their ancestors?’<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:13
verses.text: From where do I have meat to give all these people? They weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat and let us eat!’

verses.name: Numbers 11:14
verses.text: I am not able to carry all these people along alone; they are too heavy for me.

verses.name: Numbers 11:15
verses.text: If this is how you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> going to treat me, please kill me immediately if I find favor in your eyes, and do not let me see my misery.”  <div eID="gen999" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv813"/><div sID="gen1000" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv813"/>And Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather for me seventy men from the elders of Israel whom you know <transChange type="added">are</transChange> elders of the people and their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his/its”</note> officials; take them to the tent of assembly, and they will stand there with you.

verses.name: Numbers 11:17
verses.text: I will come down and speak with you there; I will take away from the spirit that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on you, and I will place <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on them; and they will bear the burdens of the people with you; you will not bear it alone.

verses.name: Numbers 11:18
verses.text: And you will say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves tomorrow, for you will eat meat because you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will feed us good meat? <transChange type="added">It was</transChange> good for us in Egypt.” Yahweh will give to you meat, and you will eat.

verses.name: Numbers 11:19
verses.text: You will eat, not one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

verses.name: Numbers 11:20
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but for a whole month⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until a period of one month”</note> until it comes out from your nose and becomes as nausea to you; because you have rejected Yahweh, who is in your midst, and you wept before <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “before his face”</note> saying, “Why did we ever leave Egypt?” ’ ”

verses.name: Numbers 11:21
verses.text: But Moses said, “<transChange type="added">There are</transChange> six hundred thousand on foot, among whom I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> in the midst, and you yourself said, ‘I will give meat to them, and they will eat for a whole month.’

verses.name: Numbers 11:22
verses.text: Should flocks and cattle be slaughtered for them? Should all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be enough for them?”

verses.name: Numbers 11:23
verses.text: And Yahweh said to Moses, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Is Yahweh’s power limited⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “Is Yahweh’s hand short?”</note> Now you will see if my word will happen or not.”  <div eID="gen1000" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv814"/><div sID="gen1001" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv814"/>So Moses went out, and he spoke the words of Yahweh to the people, and he gathered <transChange type="added">together</transChange> seventy men from the elders of the people, and he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made them stand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “caused them to stand”</note> all around the tent.

verses.name: Numbers 11:25
verses.text: Then Yahweh went down in the cloud and spoke to him, and he took away the spirit that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on him, and he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞put it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “gave it”</note> on the seventy elders. And as soon as the spirit was resting on them they prophesied, but they did not do it again.  <div eID="gen1001" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv815"/><div sID="gen1002" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv815"/>But two men were left in the camp; the name of one <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Eldad, and the name of the second <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Medad, and the spirit rested on them; they were among those who were written <transChange type="added">down</transChange>, but they did not go out to the tent, so they prophesied in the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 11:27
verses.text: So a boy<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the boy”</note> ran and told Moses and said, “Eldad and Medad <transChange type="added">are</transChange> prophesying in the camp.”

verses.name: Numbers 11:28
verses.text: And Joshua son of Nun, the assistant of Moses from time of his youth, answered, “Moses, my lord, stop them.”

verses.name: Numbers 11:29
verses.text: But Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? Would that he<note placement="foot">That is, Yahweh</note> give all Yahweh’s people prophets, that Yahweh put his spirit on them!”

verses.name: Numbers 11:30
verses.text: Then Moses and the elders of Israel were gathered to the camp.  <div eID="gen1002" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv816"/><title type="x-s">The Quail</title> <div sID="gen1003" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv816"/>Then a wind set out from Yahweh, and it drove quails from the west, and he spread <transChange type="added">them</transChange> out on the camp about a day’s journey on one side and about a day’s journey on the other, all around the camp, about two cubits on the surface of the land.

verses.name: Numbers 11:32
verses.text: And so the people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞worked⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “arose”</note> all day and all night and all the next day, and they gathered the quail (the least of the ones collecting gathered ten homers).<note placement="foot">HALOT 330, “a dry measure”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:33
verses.text: While the meat <transChange type="added">was</transChange> still between their teeth, before it was consumed, Yahweh was angry with the people, and Yahweh struck a very great plague among the people.

verses.name: Numbers 11:34
verses.text: And he called the name of that place Kibroth Hattaavah<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the graves of greediness”</note> because they buried the people that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were greedy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “craved”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:35
verses.text: From Kibroth Hattaavah<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the graves of greediness”</note> the people set out to Hazeroth; and they stayed<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they were”</note> in Hazeroth.  <chapter eID="Num.11"/>

verses.name: Numbers 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv817"/><title type="x-s">Aaron and Miriam Murmur Against Moses</title> <div sID="gen1004" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv817"/>And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he took (because he took a Cushite wife);

verses.name: Numbers 12:2
verses.text: and they said, “Has Yahweh spoken only through Moses? Has not Yahweh also spoken through us?” And Yahweh heard it.

verses.name: Numbers 12:3
verses.text: Now the man, Moses, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> more humble than any other person on the face of the earth,

verses.name: Numbers 12:4
verses.text: and Yahweh said suddenly to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, “Go out, you three, to the tent of assembly.” So the three of them when out.

verses.name: Numbers 12:5
verses.text: And Yahweh went down in a column of cloud and stood <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the doorway of the tent, and he called Aaron and Miriam, and the two of them went,

verses.name: Numbers 12:6
verses.text: and he said, <div eID="gen1004" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen1005"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1006"/>“Please hear my words:<l eID="gen1006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1007"/>If there is a prophet among you, I, Yahweh,<l eID="gen1007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1008"/>will make myself known to him in a vision.<l eID="gen1008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1009"/>I will speak to him in a dream.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the dream”</note> <l eID="gen1009" level="2"/>

verses.name: Numbers 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv818"/><l level="1" sID="gen1010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv818"/>Not so with my servant Moses;<l eID="gen1010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1011"/>in all my house he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> faithful. <l eID="gen1011" level="2"/>

verses.name: Numbers 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv819"/><l level="1" sID="gen1012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv819"/>I will speak to him mouth to mouth,<l eID="gen1012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1013"/><transChange type="added">in</transChange> clearness, not in riddles;<l eID="gen1013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1014"/>and he will look at the form of Yahweh.<l eID="gen1014" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen1005"/> <div sID="gen1015" type="x-p"/> Why were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”  <div eID="gen1015" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv820"/><div sID="gen1016" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv820"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And Yahweh became very angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And the nose of Yahweh became hot”</note> with them, and he went <transChange type="added">away</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:10
verses.text: And the cloud departed from on the tent, and behold, Miriam <transChange type="added">was</transChange> infected with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a skin disease⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">The precise meaning is uncertain; many modern translations suggest “leprosy”</note> white like snow; when Aaron turned toward Miriam, behold, <transChange type="added">she was</transChange> afflicted with a skin disease.

verses.name: Numbers 12:11
verses.text: So Aaron said to Moses, “Please, my lord, please do not put on us <transChange type="added">this</transChange> sin <transChange type="added">in</transChange> which we were foolish and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> which we have sinned.

verses.name: Numbers 12:12
verses.text: Please do not let her be like the dead, whose flesh is half consumed when coming out from the womb of its mother.”

verses.name: Numbers 12:13
verses.text: And Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞please heal her⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!”<note placement="foot">Literally “Please heal please her”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 12:14
verses.text: But Yahweh said to Moses, “<transChange type="added">If</transChange> her father had surely spit in her face, would she not bear her shame for seven days? Let her be confined for seven days to an outside place of the camp, and afterward she may be gathered.”

verses.name: Numbers 12:15
verses.text: So Miriam was confined to the outside place of the camp seven days, and the people did not set out until Miriam was gathered.

verses.name: Numbers 12:16
verses.text: And afterward the people set out from Hazeroth, and they encamped in the desert of Paran.  <chapter eID="Num.12"/>

verses.name: Numbers 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv821"/><title type="x-s">Spies Sent to Spy Out the Land of Canaan</title> <div sID="gen1017" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv821"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 13:2
verses.text: “Send for yourself men, and let them explore the land of Canaan, which I <transChange type="added">am about</transChange> to give to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from each tribe of his father send one man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “one man one man from the tribe of his father”</note> everyone a leader among them.”

verses.name: Numbers 13:3
verses.text: So Moses sent them from the desert of Paran on the command of Yahweh; all of the men <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞leaders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heads”</note> of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 13:4
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur;

verses.name: Numbers 13:5
verses.text: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;

verses.name: Numbers 13:6
verses.text: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;

verses.name: Numbers 13:7
verses.text: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;

verses.name: Numbers 13:8
verses.text: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;

verses.name: Numbers 13:9
verses.text: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;

verses.name: Numbers 13:10
verses.text: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;

verses.name: Numbers 13:11
verses.text: from the tribe of Joseph, from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi son of Susi;

verses.name: Numbers 13:12
verses.text: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;

verses.name: Numbers 13:13
verses.text: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;

verses.name: Numbers 13:14
verses.text: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;

verses.name: Numbers 13:15
verses.text: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Maki.

verses.name: Numbers 13:16
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the names of the men whom Moses sent to explore the land. And Moses called Hoshea son of Nun Joshua.  <div eID="gen1017" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv822"/><div sID="gen1018" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv822"/>Moses sent them to explore the land of Canaan, and he said to them, “Go up <transChange type="added">like</transChange> this to the Negev,<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judean hills</note> and go up into the hill country,

verses.name: Numbers 13:18
verses.text: and you will see what the land is <transChange type="added">like</transChange> and if the people who inhabit it <transChange type="added">are</transChange> strong or weak, or whether they are few or many,

verses.name: Numbers 13:19
verses.text: and whether the land that they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> inhabiting <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good or bad, and whether the cities they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> inhabiting are camps or fortifications,

verses.name: Numbers 13:20
verses.text: and whether the land <transChange type="added">is</transChange> fertile or lean, and whether there are trees on it or not. You will show yourself courageous, and you will take some of the fruit of the land.” It <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the time of first ripe grapes.  <div eID="gen1018" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv823"/><div sID="gen1019" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv823"/>So they went up and explored the land from the desert of Zin until Rehob, at Lebo Hamath.<note placement="foot">Or “near Hamath”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 13:22
verses.text: They went up through the Negev<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judean hills</note> and came to Hebron, where<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and there”</note> Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai the descendants of the Anakites <transChange type="added">were</transChange>. (Hebron was built seven years before Zoan <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Egypt.)

verses.name: Numbers 13:23
verses.text: And they came up to the valley<note placement="foot">Or “wadi”</note> of Eshcol, and they cut off a vine branch and one cluster of grapes from there; they carried it on <transChange type="added">a</transChange> pole between two <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> pomegranates and figs.

verses.name: Numbers 13:24
verses.text: That place he called the valley<note placement="foot">Or “wadi”</note> of Eshcol on account of the cluster of grapes that the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> cut off from there.  <div eID="gen1019" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 13:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv824"/><title type="x-s">The Spies Return</title> <div sID="gen1020" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv824"/>They returned from exploring the land at the end of forty days.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “day”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 13:26
verses.text: And they came<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they went and came”</note> to Moses and Aaron and to the entire community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> in the desert of Paran at Kadesh; they brought back word to them and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> all the community, and they showed them the fruit of the land.

verses.name: Numbers 13:27
verses.text: And they told him,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they told him and said”</note> “We came to the land that you sent us, and it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> flowing of milk and honey; this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> its fruit.

verses.name: Numbers 13:28
verses.text: Yet the people who are inhabiting <transChange type="added">it are</transChange> strong and the cities <transChange type="added">are</transChange> fortified and very large; moreover, we saw the descendants of the Anakites there.

verses.name: Numbers 13:29
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> Amalekites <transChange type="added">are</transChange> living in the land of the Negev;<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judean hills</note> the Hittites, Jebusites, and the Amorites <transChange type="added">are</transChange> living in the hill country; and the Canaanites <transChange type="added">are</transChange> living at the sea and on the banks of the Jordan.”  <div eID="gen1020" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 13:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv825"/><div sID="gen1021" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv825"/>And Caleb silenced the people before Moses and said, “Surely, let us go up and let us take possession of it because surely we will be able to prevail over it.”

verses.name: Numbers 13:31
verses.text: And the men who went up with him said, “We are not able to go up to the people because they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> stronger than us.”

verses.name: Numbers 13:32
verses.text: And they presented the report of the land that they explored to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, “The land that we went through to explore is a land that eats its inhabitants, and all the people whom we saw in its midst are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞men of great size⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “men of measurements”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 13:33
verses.text: There we saw the Nephilim (the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Anak <transChange type="added">came</transChange> from the Nephilim), and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their eyes.”  <chapter eID="Num.13"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv826"/><title type="x-s">The People Complain</title> <div sID="gen1022" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv826"/>Then all the community <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lifted up their voices⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they lifted up and gave their voice”</note> and the people wept during that night.

verses.name: Numbers 14:2
verses.text: And all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and all the community said to them, “If only we had died in the land of Egypt or in this desert!

verses.name: Numbers 14:3
verses.text: Why did Yahweh bring us into this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little children will become plunder; would it not be better for us to return <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt?”

verses.name: Numbers 14:4
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They said to each other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “A man said to his brother”</note> “Let us appoint a leader, and we will return <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt.”  <div eID="gen1022" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv827"/><div sID="gen1023" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv827"/>Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> the assembly of the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 14:6
verses.text: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, from the explorers <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the land, tore their garments.

verses.name: Numbers 14:7
verses.text: And they said to all the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> “The land that we went through to explore is an <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞exceptionally good land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the land is very very good”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 14:8
verses.text: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and he will give it to us, a land that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> flowing <transChange type="added">with</transChange> milk and honey.

verses.name: Numbers 14:9
verses.text: Only do not rebel against Yahweh, and you will not fear the people of the land, because they will be our food. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Their protection⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Their shadow”</note> has been turned from them; Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with us. You should not fear them.”

verses.name: Numbers 14:10
verses.text: And all the community said to stone them with stones, but the glory of Yahweh appeared in the tent of assembly among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <div eID="gen1023" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv828"/><div sID="gen1024" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv828"/>And Yahweh said to Moses, “How long until this people will despise me, and how long until they will not believe in me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> in all the signs that I have done in their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> midst?

verses.name: Numbers 14:12
verses.text: I will strike them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> with disease, and I will dispossess them;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> I will make you into a greater and stronger nation than them.”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note>  <div eID="gen1024" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv829"/><div sID="gen1025" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv829"/>And Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear that you brought up this people from their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> midst in your power,

verses.name: Numbers 14:14
verses.text: and they will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞tell it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “say”</note> to the inhabitants of this land. They heard that you, Yahweh, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the midst of this people, that you are seen eye to eye, and your cloud <transChange type="added">is</transChange> standing over them, and in a column of cloud you go before them by day and in a column of fire <transChange type="added">at</transChange> night.

verses.name: Numbers 14:15
verses.text: But if you destroy this people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all at once⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as one man”</note> the nations that will have heard your message will say,

verses.name: Numbers 14:16
verses.text: ‘Yahweh was unable to bring this people in the land that he swore by an oath, and he slaughtered them in the desert.’

verses.name: Numbers 14:17
verses.text: But now, please, let the power of my Lord be great, just has you spoke,  <div eID="gen1025" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv830"/><lg sID="gen1026"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv830"/>‘Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞slow to anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “slow of noses”</note><l eID="gen1027" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1028"/>and great of loyal love,<l eID="gen1028" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1029"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forgiving⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lifting up”</note> sin and rebellion;<l eID="gen1029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1030"/>but surely he leaves nothing unpunished,<l eID="gen1030" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1031"/>visiting the sin of the fathers on the sons<l eID="gen1031" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1032"/>to the third and fourth generations.’ <l eID="gen1032" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1026"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv831"/><div sID="gen1033" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv831"/>Please forgive the sin of this people according to the greatness of your loyal love, just as you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forgave⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lifted up”</note> this people, from Egypt until now.”  <div eID="gen1033" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv832"/><div sID="gen1034" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv832"/>Yahweh said, “I have forgiven <transChange type="added">them</transChange> according to your word;

verses.name: Numbers 14:21
verses.text: but as I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> alive, the glory of Yahweh will fill all the earth.

verses.name: Numbers 14:22
verses.text: But because all the men who have seen my glory and my signs that I did in Egypt and in the desert yet tested me these ten times and did not listen to my voice,

verses.name: Numbers 14:23
verses.text: they will not see the land that I swore by oath to their ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and all those who despised me will not see it.

verses.name: Numbers 14:24
verses.text: But my servant Caleb, because another spirit was with him, he remained true after me, and I will bring him into the land that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he entered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “he went to”</note> and his offspring will take possession of it.

verses.name: Numbers 14:25
verses.text: And the Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys; tomorrow turn and set out <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the desert <transChange type="added">by</transChange> way of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reed”</note>  <div eID="gen1034" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv833"/><div sID="gen1035" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv833"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 14:27
verses.text: “How long <transChange type="added">will I bear</transChange> this evil community who are grumbling against me? I have heard the grumbling of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> which <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they are making⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they are grumbling”</note> against me.

verses.name: Numbers 14:28
verses.text: Say to them, ‘Surely as I live,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘just as you spoke <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in my hearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in my ears”</note> so I will do to you;

verses.name: Numbers 14:29
verses.text: in this desert your corpses will fall, and all your counted ones, according to all your number, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above who grumbled against me.

verses.name: Numbers 14:30
verses.text: You <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange> will not come into the land that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I swore by oath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I lifted up my hand”</note> to make you to dwell in it, but Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

verses.name: Numbers 14:31
verses.text: But your little children, whom you said would be plunder, I will bring them, and they will know the land that you rejected.

verses.name: Numbers 14:32
verses.text: But for you, all your corpses will fall in this desert.

verses.name: Numbers 14:33
verses.text: And your children will be shepherds in the desert forty years,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> and you will bear your unfaithfulness until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all your corpses have fallen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until to complete your corpses”</note> in the desert.

verses.name: Numbers 14:34
verses.text: According to the number of the days<note placement="foot">Hebrew “day”</note> that you explored the land, forty days,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “day”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a day for each year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a day for a year a day for a year”</note> you will bear your sins forty years,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> and you will know my opposition.’

verses.name: Numbers 14:35
verses.text: I, Yahweh, have spoken; I will surely do this to all this evil community who has banded together against me. In this desert they will come to an end, and there they will die.”  <div eID="gen1035" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv834"/><div sID="gen1036" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv834"/>As for the men whom Moses sent to explore the land, who returned and made the community grumble against him by spreading a report over the land,

verses.name: Numbers 14:37
verses.text: the men who spread the evil report of the land died by the plague <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of Yahweh”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 14:38
verses.text: But Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh lived from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> the men who went to explore the land.  <div eID="gen1036" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv835"/><div sID="gen1037" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv835"/>And Moses spoke words to all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and the people mourned greatly.

verses.name: Numbers 14:40
verses.text: They rose early in the morning and went to the top of the mount, saying, “Here we are. We will go up to the place that Yahweh said, because we have sinned.”

verses.name: Numbers 14:41
verses.text: But Moses said, “Why <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you going against the command of Yahweh? It will not succeed.

verses.name: Numbers 14:42
verses.text: You should not go up because Yahweh is not in your midst; do not let yourselves be defeated in the presence of your enemies,

verses.name: Numbers 14:43
verses.text: because the Amalekites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amalekite”</note> and the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> are there <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in your presence”</note> and you will fall by the sword; because you have turned <transChange type="added">back</transChange> from Yahweh, and Yahweh will not be with you.”

verses.name: Numbers 14:44
verses.text: But they dared to go to the top of the mountain, and the ark of the covenant of Yahweh and Moses did not depart from the midst of the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 14:45
verses.text: So the Amalekites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amalekite”</note> and the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> who were living on the mountain descended, and they beat them down, up to Hormah.  <chapter eID="Num.14"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv836"/><title type="x-s">Various Sacrifices and Offerings</title> <div sID="gen1038" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv836"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 15:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘When you come into the land of your dwellings that I <transChange type="added">am about</transChange> to give to you,

verses.name: Numbers 15:3
verses.text: you will make an offering by fire for Yahweh from the cattle or from the flock, a burnt offering or a sacrifice to fulfill a vow, or as a freewill offering or at your feasts, to make a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 15:4
verses.text: And the one who presents an offering<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his offering”</note> for Yahweh, he will present a grain offering <transChange type="added">of</transChange> finely milled flour; a tenth will be mixed with a fourth of the liquid measure <transChange type="added">of</transChange> oil;

verses.name: Numbers 15:5
verses.text: and you will add a fourth of wine for the libation upon the burnt offering, or to the sacrifice for each ram-lamb.

verses.name: Numbers 15:6
verses.text: Or for the ram you will make a grain offering <transChange type="added">of</transChange> two-tenths of finely milled flour mixed into a third of a liquid measure of oil.

verses.name: Numbers 15:7
verses.text: You will present a third of the liquid measure of wine for the libation, a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 15:8
verses.text: When you prepare <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of cattle”</note> as a burnt offering or a sacrifice to fulfill a vow or <transChange type="added">a</transChange> fellowship offering for Yahweh,

verses.name: Numbers 15:9
verses.text: you will present with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of the cattle”</note> a grain offering of three-tenths <transChange type="added">of</transChange> finely milled flour mixed with half a liquid measure of oil,

verses.name: Numbers 15:10
verses.text: and you will present half a liquid measure of wine as a libation, as an offering made by fire, a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh.  <div eID="gen1038" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv837"/><div sID="gen1039" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv837"/>“ ‘This is how it should be done for each bull, or for the each ram, or for the small four-footed mammal, or ram-lambs, or goats.

verses.name: Numbers 15:12
verses.text: According to the number that you prepare, so should you do to each according to their number.

verses.name: Numbers 15:13
verses.text: Every native must do these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to present an offering made by fire, a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 15:14
verses.text: If an alien dwells among you, or whoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your midst throughout your generations,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for your generations”</note> and prepares an offering made by fire, a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh, he should do as you do.

verses.name: Numbers 15:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">For</transChange> the assembly, there will be one decree for you and for the alien who dwells <transChange type="added">among you</transChange>; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> an eternal decree for <transChange type="added">all</transChange> your generations. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You as well as the alien⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “like you like the alien”</note> will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of Yahweh”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 15:16
verses.text: There will be one law and one stipulation for you and for the alien dwelling among you.’ ”  <div eID="gen1039" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv838"/><div sID="gen1040" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv838"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 15:18
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘When you come into the land to which I <transChange type="added">am about</transChange> to bring you,

verses.name: Numbers 15:19
verses.text: whenever you eat from the food of the land, you will lift up a contribution to Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 15:20
verses.text: You must lift up a contribution of the first <transChange type="added">batch</transChange> of your ring-shaped dough bread; you must lift it up as a contribution of the threshing floor.

verses.name: Numbers 15:21
verses.text: You will give to Yahweh a contribution from the first of your dough throughout your generations.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for your generations”</note>  <div eID="gen1040" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv839"/><div sID="gen1041" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv839"/>“ ‘But if you go astray and you do not follow<note placement="foot">Or “do”</note> all these commandments that Yahweh commanded to Moses,

verses.name: Numbers 15:23
verses.text: all that Yahweh commanded you by the hand of Moses<note placement="foot">Or “through Moses”</note> from the day that Yahweh commanded and beyond, throughout your generations,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for your generations”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 15:24
verses.text: and if it was done unintentionally <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without the knowledge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the eyes”</note> of the community, then the entire community must prepare one <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young bull⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a bull a son of cattle”</note> as a burnt offering, as a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh, and its grain offering and its libation, according to the stipulation, and one male goat as a sin offering.

verses.name: Numbers 15:25
verses.text: The priest will make atonement for all of the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will be forgiven⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it will be forgiven to them”</note> because it was unintentional; they will bring their offering, an offering made by fire for Yahweh, their sin offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of Yahweh”</note> for their unintentional sin.

verses.name: Numbers 15:26
verses.text: All of the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> will be forgiven, as well as the alien that dwells in their midst, because the whole community <transChange type="added">was involved</transChange> in the unintentional wrong.  <div eID="gen1041" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv840"/><div sID="gen1042" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv840"/>“ ‘If one person sins unintentionally, that person will present a female goat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in its first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a daughter of a year”</note> as a sin offering.

verses.name: Numbers 15:28
verses.text: And the priest will make atonement for the person who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sinned unintentionally⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sinned unintentionally when sinning an unintentional wrong”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of Yahweh”</note> to make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

verses.name: Numbers 15:29
verses.text: <transChange type="added">For</transChange> the native among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and the alien that dwells in their midst, there will be one law for anyone who commits an unintentional wrong.

verses.name: Numbers 15:30
verses.text: But the one <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who acts presumptuously⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who acts with a high hand”</note> from among the native or alien blasphemes against Yahweh, and that person must be cut off from the midst of the people.

verses.name: Numbers 15:31
verses.text: Because he despised the word of Yahweh and broke his command, that person will be surely cut off and bear the guilt.’ ”  <div eID="gen1042" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv841"/><title type="x-s">Violation of the Sabbath</title> <div sID="gen1043" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv841"/>When the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> were in the desert, they found a man who was gathering wood on the day of the Sabbath.

verses.name: Numbers 15:33
verses.text: The ones who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses, Aaron, and to all the community.

verses.name: Numbers 15:34
verses.text: And they put him under watch because it was not made clear what should be done to him.

verses.name: Numbers 15:35
verses.text: And Yahweh said to Moses, “Surely the man must be put to death by stoning him; all the community <transChange type="added">must stone him</transChange> with stones from outside the camp.”

verses.name: Numbers 15:36
verses.text: So the entire community brought him out to a place outside the camp, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they stoned him to death⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they stoned him with stones and he died”</note> just as Yahweh commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen1043" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv842"/><title type="x-s">Garment Fringes</title> <div sID="gen1044" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv842"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 15:38
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and tell them to make for themselves tassels<note placement="foot">Hebrew “tassel”</note> on the hems of their garments throughout their generations<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for their generations”</note> and to put a blue cord on the tassel of the hem.

verses.name: Numbers 15:39
verses.text: You will have a tassel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for you to look at⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and you will look at it”</note> and remember all the commands of Yahweh and do them, and not follow <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞after the unfaithfulness of your own heart and eyes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “after your heart and after your eyes, which you are unfaithful after them”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 15:40
verses.text: so that you will remember and do all my commandments, and you will be holy for your God.

verses.name: Numbers 15:41
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.”  <chapter eID="Num.15"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv843"/><title type="x-s">Korah, Dathan, and Abiram Rebel</title> <div sID="gen1045" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv843"/>Now Korah son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben,

verses.name: Numbers 16:2
verses.text: took two hundred and fifty men from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> leaders of the community summoned from the assembly, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞renowned men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “men of name”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they confronted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they rose up before”</note> Moses.

verses.name: Numbers 16:3
verses.text: They were assembled in front of Moses and Aaron, and they said to them, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You take too much upon yourselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “It is much for you”</note> All of the community is holy, every one of them, and Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in their midst, so why do you raise yourselves over the assembly of Yahweh?”  <div eID="gen1045" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv844"/><div sID="gen1046" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv844"/>When Moses heard <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, he fell on his face.

verses.name: Numbers 16:5
verses.text: And he said to Korah and to his entire company, saying, “<transChange type="added">Tomorrow</transChange> morning Yahweh will make known who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his and <transChange type="added">who</transChange> is holy, and he will bring him near to him, whomever he chooses he will bring near to him.

verses.name: Numbers 16:6
verses.text: Do this: take for yourselves censers, Korah and all of your company;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his company”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 16:7
verses.text: tomorrow put fire in them and place incense on them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh; the man whom Yahweh chooses <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> the holy <transChange type="added">one</transChange>. You take too much upon yourselves, sons of Levi!”  <div eID="gen1046" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv845"/><div sID="gen1047" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv845"/>And Moses said to Korah, “Please listen, sons of Levi!

verses.name: Numbers 16:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> too little for you that the God of Israel set you apart from the community of Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to allow you to approach him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to bring you near to him”</note> to do the work of the tabernacle of Yahweh, to stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> the community to serve them?

verses.name: Numbers 16:10
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He has allowed you to approach him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “He has brought you near”</note> you with all your brothers, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Levi, but yet you also seek the priesthood.

verses.name: Numbers 16:11
verses.text: Therefore you and your company that has banded together against Yahweh. What is Aaron that you grumble against him?”  <div eID="gen1047" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv846"/><div sID="gen1048" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv846"/>Moses sent to call <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Dathan and Abiram son of Eliab, but they said, “We will not come!<note placement="foot">Hebrew “We will not come up!”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 16:13
verses.text: Is it too little that you have brought us from a land that flows with milk and honey to kill us in the desert, and that you also appoint yourself as a ruler over us?

verses.name: Numbers 16:14
verses.text: Surely, you have not brought us to a land that flows with milk and honey, and you have not given us the inheritance of fields and a vineyard. Will you gouge out the eyes of these men? We will not come!”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “We will not come up!”</note>  <div eID="gen1048" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv847"/><div sID="gen1049" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv847"/>Then Moses became angry, and he said to Yahweh, “Do not notice their grain offering. I have not offered one donkey from them, and I have not mistreated one of them.”

verses.name: Numbers 16:16
verses.text: And Moses said to Korah, “You and your entire company will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh tomorrow, you and they and Aaron.

verses.name: Numbers 16:17
verses.text: Each one take his censer, and put incense on it<note placement="foot">Hebrew “on them”</note> and you will present it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh, and each of you bring his censer, two hundred and fifty censers, you and Aaron, each his censer.”

verses.name: Numbers 16:18
verses.text: So each of them took his censer, and they put fire on them, and they placed incense on them; they stood <transChange type="added">at the</transChange> doorway of the tent of the assembly of Moses and Aaron.

verses.name: Numbers 16:19
verses.text: And Korah summoned them, the entire community, by the doorway of the tent of assembly, and the glory of Yahweh appeared to all the community.  <div eID="gen1049" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv848"/><div sID="gen1050" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv848"/>And Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 16:21
verses.text: “Separate yourselves from the midst of this community, that I can destroy them in a moment.”

verses.name: Numbers 16:22
verses.text: And they fell on their faces, and they said, “God, God of the spirits of all flesh, will one man sin and you become angry toward the entire community?”  <div eID="gen1050" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv849"/><div sID="gen1051" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv849"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 16:24
verses.text: “Speak to the community, saying, ‘Move away from the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.’ ”

verses.name: Numbers 16:25
verses.text: So Moses stood up and went to Dathan and Abiram; the elders of Israel followed after him.

verses.name: Numbers 16:26
verses.text: He said to the community, saying, “Please turn away from the tents of these wicked men, and do not touch anything <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that belongs to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “that is to them”</note> or you will be destroyed with all their sins.”

verses.name: Numbers 16:27
verses.text: And so they moved away from around the dwellings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dwelling”</note> of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram; and Dathan and Abiram came out standing <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the doorway of their tents, with their wives, sons, and little children.

verses.name: Numbers 16:28
verses.text: And Moses said, “In this you will know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not from my heart.

verses.name: Numbers 16:29
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞If they die a natural death⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If they die like the death of every human”</note> or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞if a natural fate is visited upon them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “If the fate of every human is visited upon them”</note> Yahweh has not sent me.

verses.name: Numbers 16:30
verses.text: But if Yahweh creates something new, and the ground opens its mouth and swallows them up and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all that belongs to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “All that is for them”</note> and they go down alive <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Sheol, and you will know that these men have despised Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen1051" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv850"/><div sID="gen1052" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv850"/>And it happened, as soon as he finished <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞speaking⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to speak”</note> all these words, the ground that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> under them split open.

verses.name: Numbers 16:32
verses.text: The land opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their houses and every person <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that belonged to Korah⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that was to Korah”</note> and all the property.

verses.name: Numbers 16:33
verses.text: They went down alive <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Sheol, they and all that belonged to them, and the land covered over them, and they perished from the midst of the assembly.

verses.name: Numbers 16:34
verses.text: All Israel who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> around them fled at their cry, because they said, “Lest the land swallow us up!”

verses.name: Numbers 16:35
verses.text: And fire went out from Yahweh, and it consumed the two hundred and fifty men presenting the incense.  <div eID="gen1052" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv851"/><div sID="gen1053" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv851"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Num.16.36-Num.17.13">Numbers 16:36–17:13 </reference>in the English Bible is 17:1–28 in the Hebrew Bible</note> And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 16:37
verses.text: “Say to Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Take out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “raise up”</note> the censers from among the place of burning because they are sacred, and scatter the fire outside.

verses.name: Numbers 16:38
verses.text: The censers of these <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who have sinned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sinners”</note> at the cost of their lives, let them be made into gilded leafing plating for the altar; because they presented them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of Yahweh”</note> they are holy; and they will be a sign for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 16:39
verses.text: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers that the ones who were burned presented, and they hammered them out thinly <transChange type="added">as</transChange> plating for the altar;

verses.name: Numbers 16:40
verses.text: <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> a memorial for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no strange man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">NASB translates “no layman”</note> who is not from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the offspring⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the seed”</note> of Aaron should approach the presence of Yahweh to burn a smoke offering;<note placement="foot">That is, an incense offering</note> he will not be like Korah and his company, just as Yahweh had spoken to him by the hand of Moses.<note placement="foot">Or “through Moses”</note>  <div eID="gen1053" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv852"/><title type="x-s">The Israelites Grumble</title> <div sID="gen1054" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv852"/>The next day all the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> grumbled against Moses and Aaron, saying, “You have killed the people of Yahweh!”

verses.name: Numbers 16:42
verses.text: Then, when the community had gathered against Moses and Aaron, they turned to the tent of assembly, and behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Yahweh appeared.

verses.name: Numbers 16:43
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron came to the front of the tent of assembly,

verses.name: Numbers 16:44
verses.text: and Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 16:45
verses.text: “Get away from the midst of this community, and I will finish them in an instant,”<note placement="foot">Or “in a moment”</note> but they fell on their faces.

verses.name: Numbers 16:46
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron said, “Take the censer, and put fire on it from the altar. Place incense <transChange type="added">on it</transChange>, and bring it quickly to the community, and make atonement for them, because wrath went out from the presence of Yahweh, and a plague has begun.”

verses.name: Numbers 16:47
verses.text: And so Aaron took <transChange type="added">it</transChange> just as Moses had spoken, and he ran into the midst of the assembly, for behold, the plague had begun among the people; so he gave the incense and made atonement for the people.

verses.name: Numbers 16:48
verses.text: He stood between the dead and between the living, and the plague was stopped.

verses.name: Numbers 16:49
verses.text: Those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died on account of Korah.

verses.name: Numbers 16:50
verses.text: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the doorway of the tent of assembly, and the plague was stopped.  <chapter eID="Num.16"/>

verses.name: Numbers 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv853"/><title type="x-s">Aaron’s Staff Is Chosen</title> <div sID="gen1055" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv853"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 17:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and take from among them twelve staffs, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a staff from each family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a staff from a house of a father”</note> from among all their leaders according to their families’ households. Write the name of each man on his staff,

verses.name: Numbers 17:3
verses.text: and the name of Aaron on the staff of Levi, because one staff <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the head of <transChange type="added">each of</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of their fathers”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 17:4
verses.text: You must then put them in the tent of assembly <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> the testimony<note placement="foot">Or “the statute”</note> where I meet with you.

verses.name: Numbers 17:5
verses.text: And it will happen, the man whom I will choose, his staff will blossom, and so I will rid from upon myself the grumblings of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> grumbling against you.”

verses.name: Numbers 17:6
verses.text: Moses spoke to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and all their leaders gave him a staff for each leader, one from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each of their families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “each from the house of their fathers”</note> twelve staffs, and the staff of Aaron <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in the midst of their tribes.

verses.name: Numbers 17:7
verses.text: And Moses put the staffs before Yahweh in the tent of testimony.  <div eID="gen1055" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv854"/><div sID="gen1056" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv854"/>Then the next day, Moses went into the tent of the testimony, and behold the staff of Aaron for the house of Levi blossomed and put forth a flower and produced blossoms, and it produced almonds.

verses.name: Numbers 17:9
verses.text: Then Moses brought out to all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> all the staffs before the presence of Yahweh, and they saw, and each man took his staff.

verses.name: Numbers 17:10
verses.text: And Yahweh said to Moses, “Bring back the staff of Aaron before the testimony<note placement="foot">Or “the statute”</note> as a guard and sign for the children of rebellion, and let them finish their grumblings before me and not die.”

verses.name: Numbers 17:11
verses.text: So Moses did; just as Yahweh commanded him, so he did.  <div eID="gen1056" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv855"/><div sID="gen1057" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv855"/>And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> said to Moses, saying, “Look! We will die! We will be destroyed! All of us will perish!

verses.name: Numbers 17:13
verses.text: Anyone who approaches the tabernacle of Yahweh will die. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Will we all die⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “Will we all die to perish?”</note>  <chapter eID="Num.17"/>

verses.name: Numbers 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv856"/><title type="x-s">The Duties of the Priests and Levities</title> <div sID="gen1058" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv856"/>Yahweh said to Aaron, “You, your sons, and your family with you will bear the guilt of the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you will bear the guilt of your priesthood.

verses.name: Numbers 18:2
verses.text: Moreover, bring your brothers with you, the tribe of Levi the tribe of your father, that they may be joined to you and minister <transChange type="added">to</transChange> you, you and your sons with you before the tent of testimony.

verses.name: Numbers 18:3
verses.text: They will keep your responsibility and the responsibility of all the tent, only they may not come near the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, so both you and they will not die.

verses.name: Numbers 18:4
verses.text: They will be joined to you, and they will keep the responsibility of the tent of assembly for the entire service of the tent; a stranger may not come near you.

verses.name: Numbers 18:5
verses.text: You will keep the responsibility of the sanctuary and the responsibility of the altar, and there will no longer be wrath on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 18:6
verses.text: Look, I myself have chosen your brothers the Levites from the midst of the children. They are a gift to you given from Yahweh to perform the work of the tent of assembly.

verses.name: Numbers 18:7
verses.text: But you with your sons will keep your priesthood to perform your priestly duties for everything at the altar<note placement="foot">Or “for all the things of the altar”</note> and for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the area behind the curtain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of the curtain”</note> I give you the priesthood as a gift, but the stranger who approaches will be put to death.”  <div eID="gen1058" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv857"/><title type="x-s">Portions for the Priests</title> <div sID="gen1059" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv857"/>Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given to you the responsibility of my contributions for all the holy objects of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> I have given them as a portion to you and your sons as an eternal decree.

verses.name: Numbers 18:9
verses.text: This will be for you from the sanctuary of the holy things from the fire; all of their offerings, from every grain offering, from every sin offering, and from every guilt offering which they will bring to me <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a most holy thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a holy object of holiness”</note> for you and your sons.

verses.name: Numbers 18:10
verses.text: You will eat it in the most holy place;<note placement="foot">Alternatively “as a holy object of holiness”</note> every male will eat it. It will be a holy object to you.

verses.name: Numbers 18:11
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is also</transChange> for you: the contribution of their gift of the wave offerings of the children Israel. I have given them to you and your sons and your daughters with you as an eternal decree; whoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> clean in your house may eat it.

verses.name: Numbers 18:12
verses.text: All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> finest olive oil and all the finest new wine and their best grain that they have given to Yahweh, I have given them to you.

verses.name: Numbers 18:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> firstfruits of all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in their land that they present to Yahweh will be for you; whoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> clean in your house may eat it.

verses.name: Numbers 18:14
verses.text: All consecrated possessions<note placement="foot">Hebrew “possession”</note> in Israel will be for you.

verses.name: Numbers 18:15
verses.text: All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first offspring of a womb of any creature that they offer to Yahweh, whether human or animal, will be yours; you will surely redeem the firstborn of the human and the unclean firstborn of the animal.

verses.name: Numbers 18:16
