verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv929"/><div sID="gen1223" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv929"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Simeon, according to their clans: of Nemuel, the clan of the Nemuelites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Nemuelite”</note> of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jaminite”</note> of Jakin, the clan of the Jakinites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jakinite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:13
verses.text: of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Zerahite”</note> of Shaul, the clan of the Shaulites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shaulite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:14
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the clans of the Simeonites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Simeonite”</note> twenty-two thousand two hundred.  <div eID="gen1223" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv930"/><div sID="gen1224" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv930"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad according to their clans: of Zephon, the clan of the Zephonites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Zephonite”</note> of Haggi, the clan of the Haggites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Haggite”</note> of Shuni, the clan of the Shunites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shunite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:16
verses.text: of Ozni, the clan of the Oznites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Oznite”</note> of Eri, the clan of the Erites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Erite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:17
verses.text: of Arod, the clan of the Arodites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Arodite”</note> of Areli, the clan of the Arelites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Arelite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:18
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the clans of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad according to the ones counted of them, forty thousand five hundred.  <div eID="gen1224" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv931"/><div sID="gen1225" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv931"/>The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Numbers 26:20
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah according to their clans were: of Shelah, the clan of the Shelanites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shelanite”</note> of Perez, the clan of the Perezites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Perezite”</note> of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Zerahite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:21
verses.text: The children of Perez were: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hezronite”</note> of Hamul, the clan of the Hamulites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hamulite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:22
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the clans of Judah according to the ones counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.  <div eID="gen1225" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv932"/><div sID="gen1226" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv932"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Issachar according to their clans: of Tola, the clan of the Tolaites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Tolaite”</note> of Puvah, the clan of the Punites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Punite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:24
verses.text: of Jashub, the clans of the Jashubites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jashubite”</note> of Shimron, the clan of the Shimronites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shimronite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:25
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the clans of Issachar according to the ones counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.  <div eID="gen1226" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv933"/><div sID="gen1227" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv933"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zebulun according to their clans: of Sered, the clan of the Seredites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Seredite”</note> of Elon, the clan of the Elonites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Elonite”</note> of Jahleel, the clan of the Jahleelites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jahleelite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:27
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the clans of the Zebulunites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Zebulunite”</note> according to the ones counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.  <div eID="gen1227" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv934"/><div sID="gen1228" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv934"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Joseph according to their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.name: Numbers 26:29
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Manasseh: of Makir, the clan of the Makirites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Makirite”</note> And Makir fathered Gilead; of Gilead, the clan of the Gileadites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gileadite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:30
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gilead: of Iezer, the clan of the Iezerites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Iezerite”</note> of Helek, the clan of the Helekites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Helekite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:31
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Asriel, the clan of the Asrielites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Asrielite”</note> and of Shechem, the clan of the Shechemites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shechemite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:32
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Shemida, the clan of the Shemidaites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shemidaite”</note> and of Hepher, the clan of the Hepherites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hepherite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:33
verses.text: Zelophehad son of Hepher did not have sons, but only daughters; and the names<note placement="foot">Hebrew “name”</note> of the daughters of Zelophehad <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.name: Numbers 26:34
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the clans of Manasseh, and the ones counted of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> fifty-two thousand seven hundred.  <div eID="gen1228" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv935"/><div sID="gen1229" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv935"/>These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Ephraim according to their clans: of Shuthelah, the clan of the Shuthelahites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shuthelahite”</note> of Beker, the clan of the Bekerites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Bekerite”</note> of Tahan, the clan of the Tahanites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Tahanite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:36
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Eranite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:37
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the clans of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Ephraim according to the ones counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These were the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Joseph according to their clans.  <div eID="gen1229" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv936"/><div sID="gen1230" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv936"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Benjamin according to their clans: of Bela, the clan of the Belaites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Belaite”</note> of Ashbel, the clan of the Ashbelites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Ashbelite”</note> of Ahiram, the clan of the Ahiramites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Ahiramite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:39
verses.text: of Shephupham, the clan of the Shuphamites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shuphamite”</note> of Hupham, the clan of the Huphamites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Huphamite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:40
verses.text: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: <transChange type="added">of Ard</transChange>, the clan of the Ardites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Ardite”</note> of Naaman, the clan of the Naamites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Naamite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:41
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Benjamin according to their clans. And the ones counted of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> forty-five thousand six hundred.  <div eID="gen1230" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv937"/><div sID="gen1231" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv937"/>These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Dan according to their clans: of Shuham, the clan of the Shuhamites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shuhamite”</note> These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the clans of Dan according to their clans.

verses.name: Numbers 26:43
verses.text: All the clans of the Shuhamites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shumhamite”</note> according to the ones counted of them, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> sixty-four thousand four hundred.  <div eID="gen1231" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv938"/><div sID="gen1232" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv938"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Asher according to their clans: of Imnah, the clan of the Imnahites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Imnahite”</note> of Ishvi, the clan of the Ishvites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Ishvite”</note> of Beriah, the clan of the Beriahites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Beriahite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:45
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Beriah: of Heber, the clan of the Heberites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Heberite”</note> of Malkiel, the clan of the Malkielites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Malkielite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:46
verses.text: The name of the daughter of Asher <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Serah.

verses.name: Numbers 26:47
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the clans of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Asher according to the ones counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.  <div eID="gen1232" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv939"/><div sID="gen1233" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv939"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Naphtali according to their clans: of Jahzeel, the clan of the Jahzeelites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jahzeelite”</note> of Guni, the clan of the Gunites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gunite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:49
verses.text: of Jezer, the clan of the Jezerites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jezerite”</note> of Shillem, the clan of the Shillemites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shillemite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:50
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the clans of Naphtali according to their clans, the ones counted of them, forty-five thousand four hundred.  <div eID="gen1233" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv940"/><div sID="gen1234" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv940"/>These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the ones counted of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.  <div eID="gen1234" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv941"/><div sID="gen1235" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv941"/>Then Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 26:53
verses.text: “For these the land must be divided as an inheritance according to the number of names.

verses.name: Numbers 26:54
verses.text: For the larger group you must increase their inheritance, and for the smaller group you must make smaller their inheritance; each must be given <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> inheritance according to the number of the ones counted of them.

verses.name: Numbers 26:55
verses.text: Surely the land will be divided by lot. They will inherit according to the names of the tribes of their ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:56
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Their⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “His”</note> inheritance must be divided according to the lot between the larger and smaller <transChange type="added">groups</transChange>.”  <div eID="gen1235" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv942"/><div sID="gen1236" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv942"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the ones counted of the Levites according to their clans: of Gershon, the clan of the Gershonites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gershonite”</note> of Kohath, the clan of the Kohathites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Kohathite”</note> of Merari, the clan of the Merarites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Merarite”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:58
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the clans of Levi: the clan of the Libnites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Libnite”</note> the clan of the Hebronites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hebronite”</note> the clan of the Mahlites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Mahlite”</note> the clan of the Mushites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Mushite”</note> the clan of the Korahites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Korahite”</note> Kohath fathered Amram.

verses.name: Numbers 26:59
verses.text: The name of the wife of Amram <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whose <transChange type="added">mother</transChange> bore her for Levi in Egypt; she bore to Amram: Aaron and Moses and their sister Miriam.

verses.name: Numbers 26:60
verses.text: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.name: Numbers 26:61
verses.text: But Nadab and Abihu died when they presented strange fire <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 26:62
verses.text: The ones counted were twenty-three thousand, every male from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a month old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of one month”</note> and above, because they were not counted in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> since no inheritance was given to them in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <div eID="gen1236" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv943"/><div sID="gen1237" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv943"/>These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the ones counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> on the desert-plateau of Moab on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Jordan <transChange type="added">across</transChange> Jericho.

verses.name: Numbers 26:64
verses.text: And among these there was not a man of those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> in the desert of Sinai.

verses.name: Numbers 26:65
verses.text: For Yahweh said to them, “They will surely die in the desert.” And not a man was left over from them, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.  <chapter eID="Num.26"/>

verses.name: Numbers 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv944"/><title type="x-s">Laws of Inheritance</title> <div sID="gen1238" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv944"/>Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, of the clan of Manasseh the son of Joseph, came near; and these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, and Tirzah.

verses.name: Numbers 27:2
verses.text: They stood before Moses and before Eleazar the priest and before the leaders of the entire community <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the doorway of the tent of assembly,<note placement="foot">Or “meeting”</note> saying,

verses.name: Numbers 27:3
verses.text: “Our father died in the desert; he was not in the midst of the company of those who banded together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin, and he had no sons.

verses.name: Numbers 27:4
verses.text: Why should the name of our father disappear from the midst of his clan because he does not have a son? Give us property in the midst of the brothers of our father.”

verses.name: Numbers 27:5
verses.text: So Moses brought their case before Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 27:6
verses.text: And Yahweh said to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 27:7
verses.text: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The statements of the daughters of Zelophehad are right⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Such as the daughters of Zelophehad are speaking”</note> You must surely give them <transChange type="added">the</transChange> property of an inheritance in the midst of their father’s brothers, and you must transfer the inheritance of their father to them.

verses.name: Numbers 27:8
verses.text: And you must speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘If a man dies and has no son, you must transfer his inheritance to his daughter.

verses.name: Numbers 27:9
verses.text: And if he has no daughter, you must give his inheritance to his brothers.

verses.name: Numbers 27:10
verses.text: If he has no brothers, then you must give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

verses.name: Numbers 27:11
verses.text: If his father has no brothers, then you must give his inheritance to his nearest relative from his own clan, and he will take possession of it. It will be as a decree of stipulation for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> just as Yahweh commanded Moses.’ ”  <div eID="gen1238" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv945"/><div sID="gen1239" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv945"/>Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up to this mountain of Abarim, and see the land that I have given to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 27:13
verses.text: When you see it, you will be gathered to your people, just as Aaron your brother was gathered,

verses.name: Numbers 27:14
verses.text: because you rebelled against my word in the desert of Zin when the community quarreled regarding my holiness at the waters.” (These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the waters of Meribah-Kadesh <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the desert of Zin.)  <div eID="gen1239" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 27:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv946"/><title type="x-s">Joshua Succeeds Moses</title> <div sID="gen1240" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv946"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 27:16
verses.text: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the community

verses.name: Numbers 27:17
verses.text: who will go out before them and will come in before them, and who will lead them out and bring them in, so the community of Yahweh will not be like a flock that does not have a shepherd.”

verses.name: Numbers 27:18
verses.text: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spirit, and place your hand on him.

verses.name: Numbers 27:19
verses.text: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and before the entire community, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞commission him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “command him”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “before their eyes”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 27:20
verses.text: You will give to him from your authority so that the entire community of Israel will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞obey him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “hear him”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 27:21
verses.text: He will stand before Eleazar the priest, who will ask for him by the decision<note placement="foot">Or “judgment”</note> of the Urim before Yahweh. On <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his command⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his word”</note> they will go out, and at <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his command⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his word”</note> they will come in, both he and all of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> with him, the entire community.”

verses.name: Numbers 27:22
verses.text: Moses did just as Yahweh commanded him, and he took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest and before the entire community.

verses.name: Numbers 27:23
verses.text: And he placed his hands on him and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞commissioned him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “commanded him”</note> just as Yahweh spoke by the hand of Moses.<note placement="foot">Or “through Moses”</note>  <chapter eID="Num.27"/>

verses.name: Numbers 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv947"/><title type="x-s">Daily Sacrifice</title> <div sID="gen1241" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv947"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 28:2
verses.text: “Command the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and say to them, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You will be careful to present⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you will observe to present”</note> my offering, my food of my offerings made by fire, of a fragrance of appeasement to me, at its appointed time.’

verses.name: Numbers 28:3
verses.text: You will say to them, ‘This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the offering made by fire that you will offer to Yahweh: two male lambs without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> as a continual burnt offering each day.

verses.name: Numbers 28:4
verses.text: You will offer one male lamb in the morning, and the second male lamb you will offer <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at twilight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “between the two evenings”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 28:5
verses.text: and a tenth of an ephah of finely milled flour as a grain offering, mixed with a fourth of a measure of beaten oil.

verses.name: Numbers 28:6
verses.text: It is a continual burnt offering that was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ordained⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “done”</note> on Mount Sinai as a fragrance of appeasement, an offering made by fire for Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 28:7
verses.text: The libation with it <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> a fourth of a liquid measure for each male lamb; in the sanctuary you will pour out the libation of fermented drink for Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 28:8
verses.text: And the second male lamb you will offer <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at twilight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “between the two evenings”</note> as the grain offering of the morning and as its libation you will offer it, an offering made by fire, a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh.  <div eID="gen1241" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv948"/><div sID="gen1242" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv948"/>“ ‘On the day of the Sabbath, two male lambs without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> and two-tenths of finely milled flour mixed with oil <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a grain offering and its libation.

verses.name: Numbers 28:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This is</transChange> the burnt offering every Sabbath <transChange type="added">in addition to</transChange> the continual burnt offering and its libation.  <div eID="gen1242" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv949"/><div sID="gen1243" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv949"/>“ ‘And at the beginning of each of your months, you will present a burnt offering for Yahweh: two bulls and one ram, seven male lambs without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 28:12
verses.text: and three-tenths of finely milled flour mixed with oil <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a grain offering, for each bull; and two-tenths of finely milled flour mixed with oil <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a grain offering for the one ram;

verses.name: Numbers 28:13
verses.text: and a tenth of finely milled flour mixed with oil <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a grain offering for each male lamb, for a burnt offering of a fragrance of appeasement, an offering of fire for Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 28:14
verses.text: Their libations will be half a liquid measure of wine for the bull and a third of a liquid measure of wine for the ram and a fourth of a liquid measure of wine for the male lamb; this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the burnt offering for every month for the months of the year.

verses.name: Numbers 28:15
verses.text: And one male goat as a sin offering for Yahweh; it will be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its libation.  <div eID="gen1243" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv950"/><div sID="gen1244" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv950"/>“ ‘On the fourteenth day of the first month <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the Passover for Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 28:17
verses.text: On the fifteenth day of this month <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a religious feast, unleavened bread must be eaten for seven days.

verses.name: Numbers 28:18
verses.text: On the first day <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> a holy convocation; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not do any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you will not do work of labor”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 28:19
verses.text: You will present an offering by fire, a burnt offering for Yahweh: two bulls and one ram and seven male lambs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> they will be for you without defect.

verses.name: Numbers 28:20
verses.text: For their grain offering, you will offer finely milled flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for the bull and two-tenths for the ram.

verses.name: Numbers 28:21
verses.text: You will offer a tenth for each of the seven male lambs;

verses.name: Numbers 28:22
verses.text: and a goat for one sin offering to make atonement for you.

verses.name: Numbers 28:23
verses.text: You will offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the continual burnt offering.

verses.name: Numbers 28:24
verses.text: Like this you will offer daily, for seven days, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> food of the offering made by fire, a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh; it will be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its libation.

verses.name: Numbers 28:25
verses.text: On the seventh day you will have a holy convocation; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not do any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you will not do work of labor”</note>  <div eID="gen1244" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 28:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv951"/><title type="x-s">Offerings for the Festival of Weeks</title> <div sID="gen1245" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv951"/>“ ‘And on the day of firstfruits, when you are presenting a new offering for Yahweh during your Festival of Weeks, you will have a holy convocation; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not do any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you will not do work of labor”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 28:27
verses.text: You will present a burnt offering for a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh: two bulls, one ram, seven male lambs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 28:28
verses.text: and their grain offering will be finely milled flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for one ram,

verses.name: Numbers 28:29
verses.text: a tenth for each of the male lambs;

verses.name: Numbers 28:30
verses.text: and one male goat to make atonement for you.

verses.name: Numbers 28:31
verses.text: In addition to the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, you will offer <transChange type="added">them</transChange> without defect with their libation.  <chapter eID="Num.28"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv952"/><title type="x-s">Offers for the Seventh Month</title> <div sID="gen1246" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv952"/>“ ‘On the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you will have a holy convocation; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not do any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you will not do work of labor”</note> It will be a day for you of blowing trumpets.

verses.name: Numbers 29:2
verses.text: You will offer a burnt offering as a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh: one bull, one ram, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> seven male lambs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> they will be without defect.

verses.name: Numbers 29:3
verses.text: Their grain offering will be finely milled flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for the bull, two-tenths for the ram;

verses.name: Numbers 29:4
verses.text: and one-tenth for each of the seven male lambs;

verses.name: Numbers 29:5
verses.text: with one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you,

verses.name: Numbers 29:6
verses.text: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon and its grain offering, the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their libations, according to their stipulations, as a fragrance of appeasement by fire for Yahweh.  <div eID="gen1246" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv953"/><title type="x-s">Offerings for the Day of Atonement</title> <div sID="gen1247" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv953"/>“ ‘And on the tenth of this seventh month you will have a holy convocation, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will afflict yourselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “you will afflict your lives” or “you will afflict your souls”</note> you will not do any work.

verses.name: Numbers 29:8
verses.text: You will present a burnt offering for Yahweh, a fragrance of appeasement: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> they will be without defect.

verses.name: Numbers 29:9
verses.text: And their grain offering <transChange type="added">will be of</transChange> finely milled flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,

verses.name: Numbers 29:10
verses.text: one-tenth for each of the seven male lambs;

verses.name: Numbers 29:11
verses.text: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement and the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their libations.  <div eID="gen1247" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv954"/><div sID="gen1248" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv954"/>“ ‘Then on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you will have a holy convocation; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not do any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you will not do work of labor”</note> and you will hold a religious feast for Yahweh for seven days.

verses.name: Numbers 29:13
verses.text: You will present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire as a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh: thirteen bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> they will be without defect.

verses.name: Numbers 29:14
verses.text: And their grain offering <transChange type="added">will be of</transChange> finely milled flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,

verses.name: Numbers 29:15
verses.text: one-tenth for each of the seven male lambs;

verses.name: Numbers 29:16
verses.text: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its libation.  <div eID="gen1248" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv955"/><div sID="gen1249" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv955"/>“ ‘On the second day: twelve bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> they will be without defect;

verses.name: Numbers 29:18
verses.text: and their grain offering and their libations for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs, by their number according to the stipulation;

verses.name: Numbers 29:19
verses.text: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their libations.  <div eID="gen1249" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv956"/><div sID="gen1250" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv956"/>“ ‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 29:21
verses.text: and their grain offering and their libations for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs, by their number according to the stipulation;

verses.name: Numbers 29:22
verses.text: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its libation.  <div eID="gen1250" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv957"/><div sID="gen1251" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv957"/>“ ‘On the fourth day: ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 29:24
verses.text: and their grain offering and their libations for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the stipulation;

verses.name: Numbers 29:25
verses.text: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its libation.  <div eID="gen1251" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv958"/><div sID="gen1252" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv958"/>“ ‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 29:27
verses.text: and their grain offering and their libations for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the stipulation;

verses.name: Numbers 29:28
verses.text: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its libation.  <div eID="gen1252" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv959"/><div sID="gen1253" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv959"/>“ ‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note> and their grain offering and their libations for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the stipulation;

verses.name: Numbers 29:30
verses.text: and their grain offering and their libations for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the stipulation;

verses.name: Numbers 29:31
verses.text: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its libation.  <div eID="gen1253" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv960"/><div sID="gen1254" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv960"/>“ ‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 29:33
verses.text: and their grain offering and their libations for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the stipulation;

verses.name: Numbers 29:34
verses.text: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its libation.  <div eID="gen1254" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv961"/><div sID="gen1255" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv961"/>“ ‘On the eighth day you will have an assembly; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not do any regular work⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you will not do work of labor”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 29:36
verses.text: You will present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire as a fragrance of appeasement for Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs without defect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their first year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a year”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 29:37
verses.text: and their grain offering and their libations for the bulls, for the rams, and for the male lambs by their number according to the stipulation;

verses.name: Numbers 29:38
verses.text: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its libation.  <div eID="gen1255" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv962"/><div sID="gen1256" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv962"/>“ ‘You will present these to Yahweh at your appointed time, in addition to your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings and for you grain offerings and for your libations and for your fellowship offerings.’ ”  <div eID="gen1256" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv963"/><div sID="gen1257" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv963"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Num.29.40-Num.30.16">Numbers 29:40–30:16 </reference>in the English Bible is 30:1–17 in the English Bible</note> So Moses said to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> in accordance with all that Yahweh commanded Moses.  <chapter eID="Num.29"/>

verses.name: Numbers 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv964"/><title type="x-s">Laws for Vows</title> <div sID="gen1258" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv964"/>Then Moses spoke to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the leaders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the heads”</note> of the tribes concerning the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the word that Yahweh commanded:

verses.name: Numbers 30:2
verses.text: if a man makes a vow for Yahweh or swears an oath with a binding pledge on himself, he must not render his word invalid; he must do all that went out from his mouth.  <div eID="gen1258" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv965"/><div sID="gen1259" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv965"/>“If a woman makes a vow to Yahweh, and she binds a pledge <transChange type="added">on herself</transChange> in her father’s house in your childhood,

verses.name: Numbers 30:4
verses.text: but if her father hears her vow or her pledge that she bound on herself and says nothing to her, then all her vows will stand, and every pledge that she binds on her life will stand.

verses.name: Numbers 30:5
verses.text: If her father forbids her on the day he hears <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, all her vows or her pledges that she bound on herself will not stand, and Yahweh will forgive her because her father has forgiven her.  <div eID="gen1259" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv966"/><div sID="gen1260" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv966"/>“If <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she has a husband⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “she is to a man”</note> while bound by her vows or a rash promise of her lips,

verses.name: Numbers 30:7
verses.text: and her husband hears <transChange type="added">of it</transChange> and is silent on the day he hears <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, her vows will stand, and her pledge that she bound upon herself will stand.

verses.name: Numbers 30:8
verses.text: But if on the day her husband hears <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, he forbids her, then he will nullify her vow that she is under, and the rash promise of her lips that she bound on herself; and Yahweh will forgive her.  <div eID="gen1260" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv967"/><div sID="gen1261" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv967"/>“But the vow of a widow or a woman who is divorced, all that she binds on herself will stand on her.

verses.name: Numbers 30:10
verses.text: But if she made a vow <transChange type="added">in</transChange> her husband’s house, or bound herself on a pledge with a sworn oath,

verses.name: Numbers 30:11
verses.text: and her husband heard <transChange type="added">it</transChange> but was silent to her, and he did not forbid her, all her vows will stand and every pledge that she bound on herself will stand.

verses.name: Numbers 30:12
verses.text: But if her husband nullified them on the day he hears <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, all her vows going out of her lips concerning her vows or the pledge on herself will not stand; her husband has nullified them, and Yahweh will forgive her.  <div eID="gen1261" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv968"/><div sID="gen1262" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv968"/>“Any vow and any sworn oath of a pledge to inflict on herself, her husband can confirm it or her husband can nullify it.

verses.name: Numbers 30:14
verses.text: But if her husband is completely silent from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or all her pledges that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on her; he confirms them because he was silent to her on the day he heard <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 30:15
verses.text: But if he indeed nullifies them after he hears them, then he will bear her guilt.”  <div eID="gen1262" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv969"/><div sID="gen1263" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv969"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the decrees that Yahweh commanded Moses, as between a husband and his wife, and between a father and his daughter, <transChange type="added">while</transChange> her childhood <transChange type="added">is in</transChange> her father’s house.  <chapter eID="Num.30"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv970"/><title type="x-s">War Against the Midianites</title> <div sID="gen1264" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv970"/>Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 31:2
verses.text: “Seek vengeance for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> on the Midianites; afterward you will be gathered to your people.”

verses.name: Numbers 31:3
verses.text: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm yourself from among your men for the battle, so that they will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞go⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “be”</note> against Midian to mete out the vengeance of Yahweh on Midian.

verses.name: Numbers 31:4
verses.text: A thousand from each tribe of every tribe of Israel you will send to battle.”

verses.name: Numbers 31:5
verses.text: So theywere assigned from the thousands of Israel, a thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand equipped for battle.

verses.name: Numbers 31:6
verses.text: Moses sent them, a thousand from each tribe, to the battle, and Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest to the battle with them, and the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets of the blast <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in his hand.

verses.name: Numbers 31:7
verses.text: And they fought against Midian just as Yahweh commanded Moses, and they killed every male.

verses.name: Numbers 31:8
verses.text: They killed the kings of Midian in addition to the ones they had slain: Evi and Rekem and Zur and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian; they also killed Balaam son of Beor by the sword.

verses.name: Numbers 31:9
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> took captive the women of Midian and their children, and they plundered all their domestic animals and all their livestock and all their wealth.

verses.name: Numbers 31:10
verses.text: They burned all their cities where they dwelled and all their camps with fire.

verses.name: Numbers 31:11
verses.text: They took all the plunder and all the war-booty with the humans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note> and domestic animals.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:12
verses.text: They brought the captives, the war-booty, and the plunder to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the community of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> to the camp to the desert-plateau of Moab, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Jordan <transChange type="added">across</transChange> Jericho.  <div eID="gen1264" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv971"/><div sID="gen1265" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv971"/>And Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the community went out to meet them outside the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 31:14
verses.text: But Moses was angry toward the leaders of the troops, the commanders of the thousands and the commanders of the hundreds, who came from the battle of the war.

verses.name: Numbers 31:15
verses.text: And Moses said to them, “You have kept alive every female?

verses.name: Numbers 31:16
verses.text: Behold, these women <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞caused⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “were to”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> by the word of Balaam, to be in apostasy against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, so that the plague was among the community of Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 31:17
verses.text: Now kill every male among the little children, and kill every woman who has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had sexual intercourse with a man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “who has known the bed of a male”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:18
verses.text: But all the females who have not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had sexual intercourse with a man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “who has known the bed of a male”</note> keep alive for yourselves.

verses.name: Numbers 31:19
verses.text: And you, camp outside the camp seven days; all who killed a person and all who touched the slain purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

verses.name: Numbers 31:20
verses.text: You will purify yourselves and every garment and every object of hide and all the work of goats’ hair, and every object of wood.”  <div eID="gen1265" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv972"/><div sID="gen1266" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv972"/>Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of the battle who came from the war, “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the decree of the law that Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.name: Numbers 31:22
verses.text: Only the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead—

verses.name: Numbers 31:23
verses.text: everything that will go through the fire—you will pass through the fire, and it will be clean, and only in waters of impurity will it be purified. Whatever does not go into the fire you will pass through the waters.

verses.name: Numbers 31:24
verses.text: And you will wash your garments on the seventh day and be clean, and afterward you will come into the camp.”  <div eID="gen1266" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv973"/><title type="x-s">Division of the War-Booty</title> <div sID="gen1267" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv973"/>Yahweh said to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 31:26
verses.text: “You and Eleazar the priest and the leaders of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> of the community, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞take count⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lift up the head”</note> of the war-booty that was captured, both humans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note> and the domestic animals;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:27
verses.text: divide the war-booty between those who engaged in the war, who went out to the battle, and all the community.

verses.name: Numbers 31:28
verses.text: Exact a tribute for Yahweh from the men of the war, those who went out to the battle, one from five hundred persons, and from the cattle and from the male donkeys and from the flock;

verses.name: Numbers 31:29
verses.text: take from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a contribution to Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 31:30
verses.text: From half of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> take one share drawn by lot from the fifty from the humans,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note> from the cattle, from the male donkeys, from the flock, from all the domestic animals,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> and give them to the Levities who keep the responsibilities of the tabernacle of Yahweh.”

verses.name: Numbers 31:31
verses.text: Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as Yahweh commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen1267" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv974"/><div sID="gen1268" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv974"/>Thus the war-booty that remained of the plunder that the people of the battle plundered was six hundred and seventy-five thousand flocks <transChange type="added">of sheep</transChange>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:33
verses.text: seventy-two thousand cattle,

verses.name: Numbers 31:34
verses.text: sixty-one thousand male donkeys,

verses.name: Numbers 31:35
verses.text: and the life of humankind, from the women who did not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have sexual intercourse with a man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “who has known the bed of a male”</note> all the persons<note placement="foot">Hebrew “person”</note> were thirty-two thousand.  <div eID="gen1268" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv975"/><div sID="gen1269" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv975"/>The half of the share that was going out to the battle: the number of the flock <transChange type="added">of sheep</transChange> was thee hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred;

verses.name: Numbers 31:37
verses.text: the tribute to Yahweh from the flock was six hundred and seventy-five;

verses.name: Numbers 31:38
verses.text: and the cattle were thirty-six thousand; and the tribute to Yahweh <transChange type="added">was</transChange> seventy-two.

verses.name: Numbers 31:39
verses.text: Of the male donkeys there were thirty thousand five hundred, and the tribute to Yahweh was sixty-one;

verses.name: Numbers 31:40
verses.text: the humans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note> were sixteen thousand, and the tribute to Yahweh <transChange type="added">was</transChange> thirty-two persons.

verses.name: Numbers 31:41
verses.text: And Moses gave away the tribute of the contribution of Yahweh to Eleazar the priest, just as Yahweh commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen1269" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv976"/><div sID="gen1270" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv976"/>From the half of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> which Moses divided from the men who were fighting,

verses.name: Numbers 31:43
verses.text: the half that belonged to the community was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred from the flock,

verses.name: Numbers 31:44
verses.text: and thirty-six thousand cattle,

verses.name: Numbers 31:45
verses.text: and thirty thousand five hundred male donkeys,

verses.name: Numbers 31:46
verses.text: and sixteen thousand humans.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:47
verses.text: From the half that belonged to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> Moses took one share drawn by lot out of every fifty humans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note> and domestic animals, and he gave them to the Levites, who keep the responsibility of the tabernacle of Yahweh, just as Yahweh commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen1270" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv977"/><div sID="gen1271" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv977"/>Then the leaders of the thousands of the army, the commanders of the thousands and the commanders of the hundreds, approached Moses,

verses.name: Numbers 31:49
verses.text: and they said to Moses, “Your servants have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞taken count⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lifted up the head”</note> of the men of war who were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in our charge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in our hand”</note> and no man is missing from us.

verses.name: Numbers 31:50
verses.text: So we brought the offering of Yahweh, what each man found, objects of gold, bangles,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bangle”</note> bracelets,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bracelet”</note> rings,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ring”</note> earrings,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “earring”</note> and female ornaments,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ornament”</note> to make atonement for ourselves <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh.”

verses.name: Numbers 31:51
verses.text: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, all objects of work.

verses.name: Numbers 31:52
verses.text: All the gold of the contribution that they raised up to Yahweh, from the commanders of the thousands and the commanders of the hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

verses.name: Numbers 31:53
verses.text: The men of battle plundered each for himself.

verses.name: Numbers 31:54
verses.text: So Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the commanders of the thousands and hundreds, and they brought it to the tent of the assembly as a memorial for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> before Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Num.31"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv978"/><title type="x-s">Gad and Reuben Inherit Gilead</title> <div sID="gen1272" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv978"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben and the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad had a very large number of livestock. And they saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and behold it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a place for livestock.

verses.name: Numbers 32:2
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad and the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben came, and they said to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the leaders of the community, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 32:3
verses.text: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

verses.name: Numbers 32:4
verses.text: the land that Yahweh struck before the community of Israel, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a land of livestock, and your servants have livestock.”

verses.name: Numbers 32:5
verses.text: They said, “If we have found favor in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “your eyes”</note> let this land be given to your servants as property; do not lead us <transChange type="added">across</transChange> the Jordan.”  <div eID="gen1272" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv979"/><div sID="gen1273" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv979"/>But Moses said to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad and to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, “Will your brothers go to war while you yourselves live here?

verses.name: Numbers 32:7
verses.text: Why are you discouraging the hearts of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> from crossing into the land that Yahweh gave to them?

verses.name: Numbers 32:8
verses.text: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

verses.name: Numbers 32:9
verses.text: When they went up to the valley<note placement="foot">Or “the wadi”</note> of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> so that they did not come to the land that Yahweh gave to them.

verses.name: Numbers 32:10
verses.text: So <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh’s anger burned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Yahweh’s nose became hot”</note> on that day, and he swore an oath, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 32:11
verses.text: ‘The men who went up from Egypt, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty years”</note> and above, will not see the land that I swore with an oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob because they have not wholly followed me,

verses.name: Numbers 32:12
verses.text: except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, because they followed Yahweh wholly.’

verses.name: Numbers 32:13
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh became angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Yahweh’s nose became hot”</note> and he made them wander in the desert forty years until the entire generation who did evil in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sight of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “eyes of Yahweh”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had died⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “had completed”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 32:14
verses.text: Behold, you stand in the place of your fathers, a brood of sinful men, to increase still more <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh’s fierce anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the fierce anger of Yahweh’s nose”</note> against Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 32:15
verses.text: If you turn from following him, he will again abandon them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> in the wilderness, and you would have destroyed all these people.”  <div eID="gen1273" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv980"/><div sID="gen1274" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv980"/>They came near to him and said, “We will build sheep pens here for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flock of our livestock and cities for our little children;

verses.name: Numbers 32:17
verses.text: but we ourselves will become armed <transChange type="added">and</transChange> ready before the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> until we have brought them to their place, and our little children will live in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

verses.name: Numbers 32:18
verses.text: We will not return to our houses until the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> each obtain their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> inheritance for themselves.

verses.name: Numbers 32:19
verses.text: For we will not take possession with them from across the Jordan and beyond because our inheritance has come to us from across the Jordan to the east.”  <div eID="gen1274" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv981"/><div sID="gen1275" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv981"/>So Moses said to them, “If you do this thing, if you arm yourselves <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh for the war,

verses.name: Numbers 32:21
verses.text: and everyone of you armed cross the Jordan <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

verses.name: Numbers 32:22
verses.text: and the land is subdued <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh, then afterward you will return and be free of obligation from Yahweh and from Israel, and this land will be your property <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Numbers 32:23
verses.text: But if you do not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh, and know that your sin will find you.

verses.name: Numbers 32:24
verses.text: Build for yourselves cities for your little children and sheep pens for your flocks; what has gone out from your mouth you will do.”  <div eID="gen1275" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv982"/><div sID="gen1276" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv982"/>So the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad and the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben said to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do just as my lord commands.

verses.name: Numbers 32:26
verses.text: Our little children, our wives, our livestock, and all of our animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will remain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will be there”</note> in the cities of Gilead,

verses.name: Numbers 32:27
verses.text: but your servants, everyone who is armed for battle, will cross over <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh to the war, just as my lord says.”  <div eID="gen1276" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv983"/><div sID="gen1277" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv983"/>So Moses commanded them, Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> of the tribes of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 32:29
verses.text: Moses said to them, “If the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad and the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, everyone who is armed for the war, cross over the Jordan <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, you will give them the land of Gilead as property.

verses.name: Numbers 32:30
verses.text: But if they will not cross over with you armed, they will acquire land in your midst in Canaan.”

verses.name: Numbers 32:31
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad and the descendants of Reuben answered and said, “What Yahweh has commanded your servants, we will do.

verses.name: Numbers 32:32
verses.text: We ourselves will cross over armed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh to the land of Canaan, and the property of our inheritance <transChange type="added">will remain</transChange> with us beyond the Jordan.”  <div eID="gen1277" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv984"/><div sID="gen1278" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv984"/>So Moses gave to them, to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad and the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, and to half of the tribe of Joseph’s son Manasseh, the kingdom of Sihon the king of Amorites and the kingdom of Og the king of the Bashan, the land with its cities <transChange type="added">and their</transChange> territories, the cities of the surrounding land.

verses.name: Numbers 32:34
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad rebuilt Dibon, Ataroth, and Aroer,

verses.name: Numbers 32:35
verses.text: and Atroth Shophan, Jazer, and Jogbehah,

verses.name: Numbers 32:36
verses.text: and Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran, the cities of Mibzar, and the sheep pens for flocks.

verses.name: Numbers 32:37
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, and Kiriathaim,

verses.name: Numbers 32:38
verses.text: and Nebo, Baal Meon (their names<note placement="foot">Hebrew “name”</note> were changed), and Sibmah, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they renamed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they called to names the names”</note> the cities that they rebuilt.

verses.name: Numbers 32:39
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Makir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and they captured it and drove out the Amorites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in it.

verses.name: Numbers 32:40
verses.text: So Moses gave Gilead to Makir son of Manasseh, and he lived in it.

verses.name: Numbers 32:41
verses.text: And Jair son of Manasseh went and captured their unwalled villages, and he called them Havvoth Jair.

verses.name: Numbers 32:42
verses.text: Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages, and he called it Nobah after his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> name.  <chapter eID="Num.32"/>

verses.name: Numbers 33:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv985"/><title type="x-s">The Travels Are Recounted</title> <div sID="gen1279" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv985"/>These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the journeys of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> who went out from the land of Egypt according to their divisions, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.name: Numbers 33:2
verses.text: Moses wrote down their movements according to their journeys on the command of Yahweh, and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> their journeys according to their movements.

verses.name: Numbers 33:3
verses.text: They set out from Rameses on the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> went out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞boldly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with a hand that was raised”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the eyes”</note> of all the Egyptians

verses.name: Numbers 33:4
verses.text: while the Egyptians <transChange type="added">were</transChange> burying all the firstborn among them whom Yahweh struck. Yahweh <transChange type="added">also</transChange> executed punishments among their gods.  <div eID="gen1279" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv986"/><div sID="gen1280" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv986"/>Then the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> set out from Rameses, and they camped in Succoth.

verses.name: Numbers 33:6
verses.text: They journeyed from Succoth and camped in Etham, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the edge of the desert.

verses.name: Numbers 33:7
verses.text: Then they set out from Etham and returned to Pi-Hahiroth, which faces Baal Zephon, and they camped before Migdol.

verses.name: Numbers 33:8
verses.text: They set out from Pi-Hahiroth and went through the midst of the sea into the desert; and they went a journey of three days into the desert of Etham and camped at Marah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:9
verses.text: They set out from Marah and came to Elim, and in Elim <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.

verses.name: Numbers 33:10
verses.text: They set out from Elim, and they camped at the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reed”</note>

verses.name: Numbers 33:11
verses.text: They set out from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reed”</note> and camped at the desert of Sin.

verses.name: Numbers 33:12
verses.text: They set out from the desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:13
verses.text: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.

verses.name: Numbers 33:14
verses.text: They set out from Alush and encamped at Rephidim; and it was there <transChange type="added">that</transChange> the people had no water to drink.

verses.name: Numbers 33:15
verses.text: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the desert of Sinai.

verses.name: Numbers 33:16
verses.text: The set out from the desert of Sinai and camped at Kibroth Hattaavah.  <div eID="gen1280" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Numbers 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv987"/><div sID="gen1281" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv987"/>They set out from Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

verses.name: Numbers 33:18
verses.text: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:19
verses.text: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perez.

verses.name: Numbers 33:20
verses.text: They set out from Rimmon Perez and camped at Libnah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:21
verses.text: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:22
verses.text: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:23
verses.text: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shapher.

verses.name: Numbers 33:24
verses.text: They set out from Mount Shapher and camped at Haradah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:25
verses.text: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.

verses.name: Numbers 33:26
verses.text: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

verses.name: Numbers 33:27
verses.text: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:28
verses.text: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithcah.
