verses.text: <transChange type="added">Remember</transChange> the day that you stood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh your God at Horeb <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when Yahweh said to me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “when to say Yahweh”</note> ‘Summon for me the people so that I can tell them my words, that they may learn to fear me all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the days they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> alive on the earth and so <transChange type="added">that</transChange> they may teach their children.’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:11
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you came near, and you stood under the mountain, and the mountain <transChange type="added">was</transChange> burning with fire up to the heart of the heaven, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞dark with a very thick cloud⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “darkness, cloud, and very thick darkness”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:12
verses.text: And Yahweh spoke to you from the midst of the fire; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you heard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you were hearing”</note> a sound of words, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you did not see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you were not seeing”</note> a form—only a voice.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:13
verses.text: And he declared to you his covenant, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Ten Commandments⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the ten words”</note> which he charged you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to do”</note> and he wrote them on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> two tablets of stone.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:14
verses.text: And Yahweh charged me at that time to teach you rules and regulations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for your observation of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for your doing them”</note> in the land that you are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞about to cross into⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “about to cross into there”</note> to take possession of it.  <div eID="gen1324" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1028"/><div sID="gen1325" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1028"/>“So <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you must be very careful for yourselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “watch yourselves diligently with respect to your souls”</note> because you did not see<note placement="foot">Or “have not seen”</note> any form on the day Yahweh spoke to you at Horeb from the midst of the fire,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:16
verses.text: so that you <transChange type="added">do</transChange> not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ruin yourselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “corrupt yourselves”</note> and make for yourselves a divine image <transChange type="added">in</transChange> a form of any image, a replica of male or female,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:17
verses.text: a replica of any animal that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon the earth, a replica of any winged bird that flies in the air,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:18
verses.text: a replica of any creeping thing on the ground, a replica of any fish that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the water <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞below⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “under”</note> the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And do this so that you do not lift⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And lest you lift up”</note> your eyes toward heaven and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “see”</note> the sun and the moon and the stars, all the host of the heaven, and be led astray and bow down to them and serve them, things that Yahweh your God has allotted to all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the peoples under all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the heaven.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:20
verses.text: But Yahweh has taken you and brought you out from the furnace of iron, from Egypt, to be a people of inheritance to<note placement="foot">Or “for”; a people of inheritance = a people who is his very own possession</note> him, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as it is this day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as the day the this” = as you are now</note>  <div eID="gen1325" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1029"/><div sID="gen1326" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1029"/>“And Yahweh was angry with me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “because of your matter”</note> and he swore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that I would not cross the Jordan⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not I to cross the Jordan”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that I would not go to the good land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not I going to the land”</note> that Yahweh your God is giving you as an inheritance.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:22
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to die in this land; I am not going to cross the Jordan, but you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> going to cross, and you are going to take possession of this good land.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:23
verses.text: Watch <transChange type="added">out</transChange> for yourselves so that you do not forget the covenant of Yahweh your God that he had <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> with you and make for yourselves a divine image of the form of anything that Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞has forbidden⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “has commanded you about”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:24
verses.text: for Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a devouring fire, a jealous<note placement="foot">Or “zealous” or “impassioned”</note> God.  <div eID="gen1326" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1030"/><div sID="gen1327" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1030"/>“When you have had children and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞grandchildren⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “children of children”</note> and you have grown old in the land and you act corruptly and you make a divine image <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the form of anything and you do evil in the eyes of Yahweh your God, <transChange type="added">thus</transChange> provoking him to anger,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:26
verses.text: I call<note placement="foot">Or “I shall call to witness”</note> to witness against you today the heaven and the earth, that you will perish soon and completely from the land that you are crossing the Jordan into it to take possession of it; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not live long on it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you will not extend days”</note> but you will be completely destroyed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:27
verses.text: And Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞few in number⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “people of number,” as opposed to people without number</note> among the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to where Yahweh will lead you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he will lead Yahweh you there”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:28
verses.text: And you will there serve gods <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made by human hands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the work of the hands of human”</note> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> wood and stone, <transChange type="added">gods</transChange> that cannot see and cannot hear and cannot eat and cannot smell.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:29
verses.text: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God and will find him, if you seek him with all your heart and with all your soul.<note placement="foot">Or “inner self”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:30
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In your distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In the distress for you”</note> when<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> all these things have found you in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞latter days⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the last of the days”</note> then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you will return to Yahweh your God, and you will listen to his voice.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:31
verses.text: For Yahweh your God is a compassionate God; he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will not abandon you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “will not leave you alone”</note> and he will not destroy you, and he will not forget the covenant of your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> that he swore to them.  <div eID="gen1327" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1031"/><div sID="gen1328" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1031"/>“Yes, ask, please, about former days that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞preceded you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that they were to the face of you”</note> from the day that God created humankind on the earth; ask even from one end of the heaven up to the other end of heaven <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whether anything ever happened⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was it ever”</note> like this great thing or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whether anything like it was ever heard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “was it ever heard as it”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:33
verses.text: Has a people <transChange type="added">ever</transChange> heard the voice of God speaking from the midst of the fire, <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as you heard <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and lived?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:34
verses.text: Or has a god <transChange type="added">ever</transChange> attempted to go to take for himself<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for him”</note> a nation from the midst of a nation, <transChange type="added">using</transChange> trials and signs and wonders and war, with an outstretched arm and with great and awesome deeds, like all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:35
verses.text: You <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange><note placement="foot">Emphatic use of pronoun; plural meaning implied</note> were shown this wonder in order for you to acknowledge that Yahweh is the God;<note placement="foot">The definite article indicates that Israel’s God is alone the true God and the one who revealed himself to them</note> there is no other God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞besides him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “except him” or “to him alone”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:36
verses.text: From heaven he made you hear his voice to teach you, and on the earth he showed you his great fire, and you heard his words from the midst of the fire.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:37
verses.text: And because he loved your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> he chose their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞descendants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “seed”</note> after them. And he brought you forth from Egypt <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with his own presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with his faces”</note> by his great strength,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:38
verses.text: to drive out nations greater and more numerous than you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from your face”</note> to bring you <transChange type="added">and</transChange> to give to you their land <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an inheritance, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:39
verses.text: So you shall acknowledge <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you must call to mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you shall bring back to your heart”</note> that Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no other <transChange type="added">God</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:40
verses.text: And you shall keep his rules and his commandments that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it may go well⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he/it is good”</note> for you and for your children<note placement="foot">Or “descendants”</note> after you, and so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you may remain a long time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you may make long/prolong days”</note> on the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you <transChange type="added">during</transChange> all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> those days.”  <div eID="gen1328" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1032"/><div sID="gen1329" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1032"/>Then Moses set apart three cities <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the other side of the Jordan⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the beyond of the Jordan”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞toward the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “toward rising of the sun”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:42
verses.text: <transChange type="added">in order for</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a manslayer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a killer of a man”</note> to flee there who has killed his neighbor <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without intent⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “without previous knowledge”</note> and was not hating him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞previously⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day before yesterday”</note> and so he could flee to one of these cities <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and be safe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and live”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:43
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He set apart</transChange> Bezer in the wilderness<note placement="foot">Or “desert”</note> in the land of the plateau of the Reubenites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Reubenite”</note> Ramoth in Gilead of the Gadites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gadite”</note> and Golan in Bashan of the Manassites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Manassite”</note>  <div eID="gen1329" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1033"/><div sID="gen1330" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1033"/>Now this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the <hi type="italic">torah</hi>” = teaching, instruction, law</note> that Moses set <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the faces of”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:45
verses.text: these are the legal provisions and the rules and the regulations that Moses spoke to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they left Egypt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at their going out from Egypt”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:46
verses.text: beyond the Jordan in the valley opposite Beth Peor in the land of Sihon the king of the Amorites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> who was reigning in Heshbon and whom Moses and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> defeated <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they came out of Egypt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “at their going out from Egypt”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:47
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> they took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> who were beyond the Jordan, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞eastward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “toward the rising of the sun”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:48
verses.text: from Aroer, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the bank of the wadi<note placement="foot">A valley that is dry most of the year, but contains a stream during the rainy season</note> of Arnon and as far as Mount Sirion; that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Hermon,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:49
verses.text: and all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the Arabah<note placement="foot">Or “valley” in this instance</note> beyond the Jordan, eastward, and as far as the Sea of the Arabah<note placement="foot">Commonly known today as the Dead Sea</note> under the slopes of Pisgah.  <chapter eID="Deut.4"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1034"/><title type="x-s">Basic Stipulations</title> <div sID="gen1331" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1034"/>And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> Moses summoned all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Israel and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the rules and the regulations that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> speaking in your ears <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> and you shall learn them, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you must observe them diligently⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you shall observe them carefully to do them”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:2
verses.text: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It was</transChange> not with our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> Yahweh made this covenant, <transChange type="added">but with</transChange> these <transChange type="added">of</transChange> us <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> here alive today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:4
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Face to face⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Faces to faces”</note> Yahweh spoke with you at the mountain from the midst of the fire.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:5
verses.text: I was standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞between Yahweh and you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “between Yahweh and between you”</note> at that time to report<note placement="foot">Or “declare”</note> to you the word of Yahweh, for you were afraid because of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the presence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the faces of”</note> the fire, and so you did not go up the mountain. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “To say”</note>  <div eID="gen1331" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1035"/><div sID="gen1332" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1035"/>‘I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There</transChange> shall not be for you other gods <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞besides me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “before my face”</note>  <div eID="gen1332" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1036"/><div sID="gen1333" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1036"/>‘You shall not make for yourself a divine image of any <transChange type="added">type</transChange> of form that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the heaven above or that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the earth beneath or that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the water under the earth.  <div eID="gen1333" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1037"/><div sID="gen1334" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1037"/>‘You shall not bow down to them, and you shall not serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a jealous God, punishing the guilt of fathers upon <transChange type="added">their</transChange> children and upon <transChange type="added">the</transChange> third and upon <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fourth generation of <transChange type="added">those</transChange> hating me,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:10
verses.text: but showing loyal love to thousands of <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> love me and of <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> keep my commandments.  <div eID="gen1334" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1038"/><div sID="gen1335" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1038"/>‘You shall not take up the name of Yahweh your God for <transChange type="added">a</transChange> worthless purpose, for Yahweh will not leave unpunished <transChange type="added">anyone</transChange> who uses his name for <transChange type="added">a</transChange> worthless purpose.  <div eID="gen1335" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1039"/><div sID="gen1336" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1039"/>‘Observe the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Sabbath day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day of the Sabbath”</note> to make it holy,<note placement="foot">Or “to sanctify it”</note> <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as Yahweh your God has commanded you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:13
verses.text: Six days you shall work, and you shall do all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your work,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:14
verses.text: but the seventh day <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <transChange type="added">a</transChange> Sabbath unto Yahweh your God; you shall not do any work, or your son, or your daughter, or your slave, or your slave woman, or your ox, or your donkey, or any of your domestic animals, or your <transChange type="added">resident</transChange> alien who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> so that your slave and your slave woman may rest as you <transChange type="added">rest</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:15
verses.text: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm; therefore, Yahweh your God commanded you to keep <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Sabbath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the day of the Sabbath”</note>  <div eID="gen1336" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1040"/><div sID="gen1337" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1040"/>‘Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you, so that it will be good for you<note placement="foot">Or “it may go well for you”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the ground”</note> that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you.  <div eID="gen1337" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1041"/><div sID="gen1338" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1041"/>‘You shall not murder.  <div eID="gen1338" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1042"/><div sID="gen1339" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1042"/>‘And you shall not commit adultery.  <div eID="gen1339" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1043"/><div sID="gen1340" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1043"/>‘And you shall not steal.  <div eID="gen1340" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1044"/><div sID="gen1341" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1044"/>‘And you shall not falsely bear evidence against your neighbor.  <div eID="gen1341" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1045"/><div sID="gen1342" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1045"/>‘And you shall not covet the wife of your neighbor, and you shall not crave the house of your neighbor, his field or his slave or his slave woman or his ox and his donkey or anything <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that belongs to your neighbor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “that is for your neighbor”</note>  <div eID="gen1342" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1046"/><div sID="gen1343" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1046"/>“These words Yahweh spoke to your whole assembly at the mountain from the midst of the fire and the very thick cloud <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a loud voice, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he did not add anything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and not he added”</note> and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> he wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:23
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it happened”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you heard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and as/when you heard” or “at the moment of your hearing”</note> the voice from the midst of the darkness, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> the mountain <transChange type="added">was</transChange> burning with fire, and <transChange type="added">and</transChange> all the heads of your tribes and your elders approached me,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:24
verses.text: you said, ‘Look, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice from the midst of the fire; this day we have seen<note placement="foot">Or “saw”</note> that God can speak with a human being, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yet he remains alive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and he lives”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:25
verses.text: And so then why shall we die, for this great fire will consume us if <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞we continue⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “we do again to hear”; or “we are doing again to hear”</note> to hear the voice of Yahweh our God <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> we shall die?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:26
verses.text: For who <transChange type="added">is there of</transChange> all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire as we <transChange type="added">have heard it</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and remained alive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “and lives”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:27
verses.text: <transChange type="added">You</transChange> go near and hear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of that which”</note> that Yahweh our God will say; and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> you tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you, and we will listen, and we will do <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.’  <div eID="gen1343" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1047"/><div sID="gen1344" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1047"/>“And Yahweh heard the sound of your words <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you spoke to me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in/at you to speak to me”</note> and Yahweh said to me, ‘I have heard the sound of the words of this people that they have spoken to you; <transChange type="added">they</transChange> are right <transChange type="added">with respect to</transChange> all that they have spoken.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:29
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞If only⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who gives/will give”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they had such a mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>’;<note placement="foot">Literally “it would be their heart this to them”</note> that is, to fear me and to keep all my commandments <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at all times⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all the days”</note> so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it will go well⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he/it is good”</note> for them and for their children <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:30
verses.text: Go! Say to them, “Return to your tents.”

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:31
verses.text: But you stand here with me, and let me tell you all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the commandments and the rules and the regulations that you shall teach them, so that they may do <transChange type="added">them</transChange> in the land that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> giving to them to take possession of it.’  <div eID="gen1344" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1048"/><div sID="gen1345" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1048"/>“<transChange type="added">So</transChange> you must be careful to do <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as Yahweh your God commanded you; you shall not turn <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> right or <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> left.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:33
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In exactly the path⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In all the way/path”</note> that Yahweh your God has commanded, you must go, so that you may live and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it will go well⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and good it is”</note> for you and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you may live long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you may make long”</note> in the land that you will take possession of.”  <chapter eID="Deut.5"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1049"/><title type="x-s">Detailed Stipulations</title> <div sID="gen1346" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1049"/>“Now this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the commandment, the rules and the regulations, that Yahweh your God charged to teach <transChange type="added">to</transChange> you <transChange type="added">for you</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to do”</note> in the land that you are about to cross over into<note placement="foot">Or “there”</note> to take possession of it,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:2
verses.text: so that you may revere Yahweh your God by keeping all his statutes and his commandments that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you, you and your children and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞grandchildren⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the children of your children”</note> all the days of your life and so you may live long<note placement="foot">Literally “they may be long your days”</note> <transChange type="added">lives</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:3
verses.text: And you shall hear, Israel, and be careful to observe <transChange type="added">these instructions</transChange>, so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it may go well for you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it/he may be good”</note> and that you may multiply greatly, just as Yahweh, the God of your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note> you, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> a land with milk and honey.  <div eID="gen1346" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1050"/><div sID="gen1347" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1050"/>“Hear, Israel, Yahweh our God, Yahweh is unique.<note placement="foot">Or “one”; or possibly “one Lord”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:5
verses.text: And you shall love Yahweh your God with all of your heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> and with all of your soul<note placement="foot">Or “inner self”</note> and with all of your might.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:6
verses.text: And these words that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> shall be on<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> your heart.<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:7
verses.text: And you shall recite them to your children, and you shall talk about them at <transChange type="added">the time of</transChange> your living in your house and at <transChange type="added">the time of</transChange> your going on the road and at <transChange type="added">the time of</transChange> your lying down and at <transChange type="added">the time of</transChange> your rising <transChange type="added">up</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:8
verses.text: And you shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as an emblem between your eyes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:9
verses.text: And you shall write them on the doorframe of your house and on your gates.  <div eID="gen1347" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1051"/><div sID="gen1348" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1051"/>“And then it will happen <transChange type="added">that</transChange> when Yahweh your God will bring you to the land that he swore to your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to you large and fine cities that you did not build,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:11
verses.text: and houses full of all <transChange type="added">sorts</transChange> of good things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing”</note> that you did not fill, and hewn cisterns that you did not hew, vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you have eaten your fill⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you have eaten and you are satisfied”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:12
verses.text: then take care for yourself, so that you <transChange type="added">do</transChange> not forget Yahweh, who brought you out from the land of Egypt from the house of slavery.  <div eID="gen1348" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1052"/><div sID="gen1349" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1052"/>“You shall fear Yahweh your God, and you shall serve him, and by his name you shall swear.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:14
verses.text: You shall not go after other gods from the gods of the peoples who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all around you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:15
verses.text: for Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a jealous god in your midst, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that the anger of Yahweh your God would be kindled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “so that not/lest the nose of Yahweh your God would become hot”</note> and he would destroy you from the face of the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:16
verses.text: You shall not put Yahweh your God to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> test, as you tested <transChange type="added">him</transChange> at Massah.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:17
verses.text: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God and his legal provisions and his rules that he has commanded you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:18
verses.text: And you shall do <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> right and good in the eyes of Yahweh, so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it shall go well⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he/it shall be good”</note> for you and so that you may go and you may take possession of the good land that Yahweh swore for your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “your fathers”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:19
verses.text: by driving out all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your enemies <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the face of you”</note> just as Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞has promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “had spoken”</note>  <div eID="gen1349" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1053"/><div sID="gen1350" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1053"/>“When your child<note placement="foot">Or “son”</note> asks you in the future, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘What <transChange type="added">is the meaning of</transChange> the legal provisions and the rules and the regulations that Yahweh our God commanded for you?’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:21
verses.text: Then you shall say to your child,<note placement="foot">Or “son”</note> ‘We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, and Yahweh brought us out from Egypt with a strong hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:22
verses.text: And Yahweh gave great and awesome signs and wonders in Egypt against Pharaoh and against his entire household <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in our presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “before our eyes”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:23
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">he</transChange> brought us out from there in order to bring us <transChange type="added">here</transChange> to give us the land that he swore to our ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:24
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> Yahweh commanded us to observe all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> these rules <transChange type="added">and</transChange> to revere Yahweh our God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for our benefit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for good for us”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the days that we live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all the days for our living”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as it is today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as the day the this”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:25
verses.text: And it shall be righteousness for us if we diligently observe <transChange type="added">and</transChange> do all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> this commandment <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the faces of”</note> Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.’  <chapter eID="Deut.6"/> <div eID="gen1350" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:1
verses.text: “When Yahweh your God brings you into the land that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to enter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞into it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there”</note> to take possession of it, and he drives<note placement="foot">Or “he will drive out”</note> out many nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from your faces”</note> the Hittites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hittite”</note> and the Girgashites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Girgashite”</note> and the Amorites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> and the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> and the Hivites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hivite”</note> and the Jebusites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jebusite”</note> seven nations mightier and more numerous than you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:2
verses.text: and Yahweh your God will give them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞over to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to your faces” or “before you”</note> and you defeat them, you must <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞utterly destroy them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “set them aside for destruction”</note> you shall not make a covenant with them, and you shall not show mercy <transChange type="added">to them</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:3
verses.text: And you shall not intermarry with them; you shall not give your daughter to their son; and you shall not take his daughter for your son.<note placement="foot">Grammatically singular pronominal suffixes here can also be rendered “their”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:4
verses.text: For their<note placement="foot">Or “his”</note> sons and daughters will cause your son<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> to turn away <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from following me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally from “behind/after me”</note> and so they will serve other gods, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the anger of Yahweh would be kindled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it would become hot the nose of Yahweh”</note> against you, and he would quickly destroy you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:5
verses.text: But this is what you must do to them: you shall break down their altars, and their stone pillars you shall smash, and their Asherah poles you shall hew down, and you shall burn their idols with fire.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:6
verses.text: For you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a holy people for Yahweh your God; Yahweh your God has chosen you to be for him a people, a treasured possession from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> all the peoples that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on the face<note placement="foot">Or “surface”</note> of the earth.  <div eID="gen1351" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1054"/><div sID="gen1352" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1054"/>“Yahweh loved you and chose you not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of your great number⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from your multitude/abundance”</note> exceeding all <transChange type="added">other</transChange> peoples, for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> fewer than all of the peoples,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:8
verses.text: but<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the love of Yahweh for you and because of his keeping of the sworn oath that he swore to your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> Yahweh brought you <transChange type="added">out</transChange> with a strong hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">So</transChange> know that Yahweh your God, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> God, the trustworthy God, maintaining his<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> covenant and his<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> loyal love with those who love him and with those who keep his commandments to a thousand generations,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “generation”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:10
verses.text: but repaying those<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the one”</note> who hate him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their own person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to their faces”</note> to destroy them;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”; “them” in sense</note> he is not slow with those who hate him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their own person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to their faces”</note> he repays them.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:11
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you shall keep the commandment and the rules and the regulations that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> to observe them.  <div eID="gen1352" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1055"/><div sID="gen1353" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1055"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> because you listen to these regulations and you diligently keep and you do them, then Yahweh your God will maintain his<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> covenant and his<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> loyal love that he swore to your ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:13
verses.text: And he will love you, and he will bless you, and he will multiply you, and he will bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your soil, your grain, your wine, and your olive oil, and <transChange type="added">newborn</transChange> calves of your cattle, and the <transChange type="added">newborn</transChange> lambs<note placement="foot">Or “increase of”</note> of your flocks in the land that he swore to your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to give you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:14
verses.text: You shall be blessed more than all of the peoples; among you there shall not be sterility and bareness, even<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> among domestic animals.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:15
verses.text: And Yahweh will turn away from you all the illness and all the harmful diseases of Egypt that you experienced; he will not lay them on you, but he will lay them on all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> those who hate you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:16
verses.text: And you shall devour all of the peoples <transChange type="added">that</transChange> Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall not pity them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “your eye shall not take pity on them”</note> and you shall not serve their gods, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> will be a snare for you.  <div eID="gen1353" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1056"/><div sID="gen1354" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1056"/>“If you think in your heart, ‘These nations <transChange type="added">are</transChange> more numerous than I, so how can I dispossess them?’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">then remember</transChange> you must not be afraid of them; you must well remember what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and to all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Egypt:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:19
verses.text: the great trials that your eyes saw and the signs and the wonders and the <transChange type="added">workings of</transChange> the strong hand and the outstretched arm <transChange type="added">by</transChange> which Yahweh your God brought you out; so Yahweh your God will do to all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the peoples <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of whom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from them”</note> you are in fear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from their presence”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:20
verses.text: And, moreover, Yahweh your God will send the hornets<note placement="foot">Hebrew “hornet”</note> among them until both the survivors and the fugitives <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are destroyed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the destroying of”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from your faces”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:21
verses.text: You must not <transChange type="added">be in dread</transChange> from the presence of them, because Yahweh your God, <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> in your midst, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a great and awesome God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:22
verses.text: And Yahweh your God will clear away these nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from your faces”</note> little by little; you will not be able to finish them off quickly, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “so that not”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wild animals⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “animals of the field”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞multiply⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will become numerous”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:23
verses.text: But Yahweh your God will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞give them to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “give them to your face”</note> and he will throw them into great panic <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until they are destroyed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until their destroying”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:24
verses.text: And he will give their kings into your hand, and you shall blot out their names<note placement="foot">Hebrew “name”</note> from under the heaven; anyone will not be able to stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in your faces”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until you destroy them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until your destroying them”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:25
verses.text: You shall burn the images of their gods with fire; you shall not covet <transChange type="added">the</transChange> silver or gold <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> on them, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you take <transChange type="added">it</transChange> for yourself, so that you are not ensnared by it, for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a detestable thing to Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:26
verses.text: And you must not bring a detestable thing into your house, or you will become a thing devoted to destruction like it; you must utterly detest it, and you must utterly abhor it, for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <transChange type="added">an</transChange> object devoted to destruction.  <chapter eID="Deut.7"/> <div eID="gen1354" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:1
verses.text: “All of the commandments<note placement="foot">Or “every commandment”</note> that I am commanding you today you must diligently observe, so that you may live and multiply, and you may go and take possession of the land that Yahweh swore to your ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “your fathers”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:2
verses.text: And you shall remember all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the way that Yahweh your God led you <transChange type="added">during</transChange> these forty years in the desert in order to humble you and to test you to know what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your heart, whether you would <transChange type="added">diligently</transChange> keep his commandments or not.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:3
verses.text: And he humbled you and let you go hungry, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> he fed you with that which you did not know nor did your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> know, in order to make you know that not by bread alone but by all that goes out<note placement="foot">Or “by all of the going out of”</note> of the mouth of Yahweh humankind shall live.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:4
verses.text: Your clothing did not wear out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from on you”</note> and your feet did not swell <transChange type="added">during</transChange> these forty years.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:5
verses.text: And you should know with your heart that as a man disciplines his son, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> disciplining you.<note placement="foot">Or “has disciplined you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:6
verses.text: So you must keep the commandments of Yahweh your God by walking in his ways and by fearing him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:7
verses.text: For Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> bringing you to a good land <transChange type="added">with</transChange> streams of water, springs and underground water, welling up in the valleys<note placement="foot">Hebrew “valley”</note> and in the hills,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “hill”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">to</transChange> a land of wheat and barley and vines<note placement="foot">Hebrew “vine”</note> and fig trees<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fig tree”</note> and pomegranate trees,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “pomegranate tree”</note> a land of olive trees,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “olive tree”</note> olive oil and honey;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">to</transChange> a land where you may eat food in it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without scarcity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “not in scarcity”</note> you will not find anything lacking in it, a land where its stones <transChange type="added">are</transChange> iron and from its mountains you can mine copper.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:10
verses.text: And you will eat, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will be satisfied⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you will eat your fill”</note> and you will bless Yahweh your God because <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the good land that he has given to you.  <div eID="gen1355" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1057"/><div sID="gen1356" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1057"/>“Take care for yourself so that you not forget Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">by</transChange> not keeping his commandments and his regulations and his statutes that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:12
verses.text: lest <transChange type="added">when</transChange> you have eaten and you are satisfied and you have built good houses and you live <transChange type="added">in them</transChange>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:13
verses.text: and your herds and your flocks have multiplied, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you have accumulated silver and gold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and silver and gold has multiplied for you”</note> and all that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “is for you”</note> has multiplied,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:14
verses.text: then your heart <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞becomes proud⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “raises up”</note> and you forget Yahweh your God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the one who brought you out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the one bringing you out”</note> from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:15
verses.text: the one leading you in the great and terrible desert <transChange type="added">infested</transChange> with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞dangerous⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “burning”</note> snakes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “snake”</note> and scorpions<note placement="foot">Hebrew “scorpion”</note> and parched ground, where there is<note placement="foot">Or “was”</note> no water, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the one bringing out water for you from flint rock,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:16
verses.text: the one <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞feeding you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “causing you to eat”</note> manna in the desert, food that your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> did not know, in order to humble you and in order to test you so that he could do good to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the future⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the end/later”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:17
verses.text: And you may think<note placement="foot">Or “say”</note> in your heart, ‘My strength and the might of my hand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞acquired this wealth for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gave this wealth to”</note> me.’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:18
verses.text: But you must remember Yahweh your God, for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> giving you strength to acquire wealth in order to confirm his covenant that he swore to your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as it is today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as the day the this”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:19
verses.text: And it will happen <transChange type="added">that</transChange> if you indeed forget Yahweh your God and you go after other gods and you serve them and you bow down before them, I warn you today that you will surely perish.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:20
verses.text: As <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the nations that Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> destroying <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from your faces”</note> so you shall perish because you would not obey the voice of Yahweh your God.  <chapter eID="Deut.8"/> <div eID="gen1356" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:1
verses.text: “Hear, Israel, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to cross the Jordan today to go to dispossess nations larger and more numerous than you, great cities fortified <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with high walls⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in heaven/the sky”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:2
verses.text: a great and tall people, the sons of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Anakites, whom you know and <transChange type="added">of whom you</transChange> have heard <transChange type="added">it said</transChange>, ‘Who could stand before the sons of Anak?’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:3
verses.text: You should know <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> that Yahweh your God is the one crossing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ahead of you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to your faces”</note> as a devouring fire; he will destroy them, and he will subdue them before you; so you will dispossess them, and you will destroy them quickly, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note> you.  <div eID="gen1357" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1058"/><div sID="gen1358" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1058"/>“You shall not say <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in your heart”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when Yahweh your God is driving them out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at the driving out of Yahweh, your God, them”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from before your faces”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Because of my righteousness Yahweh brought me to take possession of this land’; but because of the wickedness of these nations Yahweh is driving them out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from your faces”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> not because of your righteousness and because of the uprightness of your heart <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming to take possession of their land, but because of the wickedness of these nations Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> driving them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from your faces”</note> and in order to confirm the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “word”</note> that Yahweh swore to your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.  <div eID="gen1358" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1059"/><div sID="gen1359" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1059"/>“So you should understand that <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not because of your righteousness <transChange type="added">that</transChange> Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving you this good land to take possession of it, because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you are a stubborn people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a people stiff of neck you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:7
verses.text: Remember, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞do not forget⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “not you shall forget”</note> that you provoked Yahweh your God in the desert, and from the day that you went out from the land of Egypt until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you came to this place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your coming up to this place the this” = until arrived at this location</note> you were rebelling against Yahweh.  <div eID="gen1359" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1060"/><div sID="gen1360" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1060"/>“And <transChange type="added">remember</transChange> at Horeb you provoked Yahweh, and Yahweh became angry <transChange type="added">enough</transChange> to destroy you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When I went up the mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In/At my going up the mountain”</note> to receive <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the stone tablets⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the tablets of stones”</note> the tablets of the covenant that Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> with you, and remained on the mountain forty days<note placement="foot">Hebrew “day”</note> and forty nights,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “night”</note> I did not eat food and I did not drink water.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:10
verses.text: And Yahweh gave me the two tablets of stone written with the finger of God, and on them <transChange type="added">was writing</transChange> according to all the words that Yahweh spoke with you at the mountain, from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:11
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it happened”</note> at the end of forty days<note placement="foot">Hebrew “day”</note> and forty nights,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “night”</note> Yahweh gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:12
verses.text: And Yahweh said to me, ‘Come <transChange type="added">now</transChange>, go down quickly from this mountain because your people behave corruptly whom you brought out from Egypt, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> they turned quickly from the way that I commanded them <transChange type="added">to follow</transChange>; they have made for themselves a cast image.’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:13
verses.text: And Yahweh spoke to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘I have seen this people, and look! <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They are a stubborn people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “It is a people stiff of neck”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:14
verses.text: Leave me alone, and let me destroy them, and let me blot out their name from under heaven, and let me make you into a nation mightier and more numerous than they!’  <div eID="gen1360" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1061"/><div sID="gen1361" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1061"/>“And I turned, and I went down the mountain, as the mountain was burning with fire, and the two tablets of the covenant <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in my two hands.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:16
verses.text: And I looked,<note placement="foot">Or “saw”</note> and indeed you had sinned against Yahweh your God; you had made for yourselves an image of a calf of cast metal;<note placement="foot">Or “molten calf”</note> you <transChange type="added">had</transChange> turned quickly from the way that Yahweh had commanded <transChange type="added">for</transChange> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:17
verses.text: And I took hold of the two tablets, and I threw them out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> my two hands and smashed them before your eyes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:18
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> I lay prostrate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh, as earlier, forty days<note placement="foot">Hebrew “day”</note> and forty nights;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “night”</note> I did not eat food and I did not drink water because of all your sins that you committed, by doing evil in the eyes of Yahweh <transChange type="added">and so</transChange> provoking him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:19
verses.text: For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I was in dread⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I dreaded”</note> from being in the presence of the anger and the wrath with which Yahweh was angry with you so as to destroy you, but Yahweh listened to me also <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at that time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the occurrence the that”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:20
verses.text: And with Aaron Yahweh was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞angry enough⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “very angry”</note> to destroy him, and I prayed also for Aaron at that time.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:21
verses.text: And your sinful thing that you had made, the molten calf, I took and I burned it with fire, and I crushed it, grinding it thoroughly until it was crushed to dust, and I threw its dust into <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the stream that flowed down the mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the stream the one going down from the mountain”</note>  <div eID="gen1361" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1062"/><div sID="gen1362" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1062"/>“And <transChange type="added">also</transChange> at Taberah and at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked Yahweh to anger.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:23
verses.text: And when Yahweh sent you <transChange type="added">out</transChange> from Kadesh Barnea, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Go up and take possession of the land that I have given you,’ you rebelled against the command of Yahweh your God, and you did not believe him, and you did not listen to his voice.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:24
verses.text: You have been rebellious toward Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from the day I have known you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from the day of my knowing you”</note>  <div eID="gen1362" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1063"/><div sID="gen1363" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1063"/>“And I lay prostrate before Yahweh through forty days,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “day”</note> and through forty nights<note placement="foot">Hebrew “night”</note> I prostrated myself, because Yahweh intended to kill you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:26
verses.text: And I prayed to Yahweh, and I said, ‘Lord Yahweh, you must not destroy your people and your inheritance whom you redeemed in your greatness,<note placement="foot">Or “your great act”</note> whom you brought out from Egypt with a strong hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:27
verses.text: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; you must not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pay attention to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “turn toward”</note> the stubbornness of this people, to their wickedness and to their sin,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:28
verses.text: lest <transChange type="added">the people of</transChange> the land from which you brought us out from there say, “Because Yahweh was not able to bring them to the land that he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoken”</note> to them and because of his hatred <transChange type="added">toward</transChange> them, he has brought them out to kill them in the desert.”

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:29
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your people and your inheritance whom you brought with your great power and with your outstretched arm.’  <chapter eID="Deut.9"/> <div eID="gen1363" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:1
verses.text: “At that time Yahweh said to me, ‘Carve for yourself two tablets of stone <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as the former <transChange type="added">ones</transChange>, and come up the mountain to me, and you shall make for yourself an ark of wood.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:2
verses.text: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the former <transChange type="added">tablets</transChange>, which you smashed, and you must put them in the ark.’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:3
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I made an ark <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of acacia wood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “of wood of acacia trees”</note> and I carved two tablets of stone like the former <transChange type="added">ones</transChange>, and I went up the mountain <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the two tablets in my hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:4
verses.text: And he wrote upon the tablets <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to the first writing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as the writing the first”</note> the ten words that Yahweh spoke to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly, and Yahweh gave them to me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:5
verses.text: And I turned, and I came down from the mountain, and I put the tablets in the ark that I had made, and they are there, <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as Yahweh commanded me.  <div eID="gen1364" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1064"/><div sID="gen1365" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1064"/>“And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> journeyed from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wells of Bene-Yaqan <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Moserah; there Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar, his son, served as a priest in place of him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:7
verses.text: From there they journeyed to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land <transChange type="added">flowing with</transChange> streams of water.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:8
verses.text: At that time Yahweh set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of Yahweh to stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the faces of”</note> Yahweh, to serve him and to bless <transChange type="added">the people</transChange> in his name until this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:9
verses.text: Therefore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there was not⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it/he was not”</note> for Levi an allotment or an inheritance along with his brothers; rather Yahweh is his inheritance just as Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note> to him.  <div eID="gen1365" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:10
