verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1065"/><div sID="gen1366" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1065"/>And I stayed on the mountain <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as <transChange type="added">during</transChange> the former forty days<note placement="foot">Hebrew “day”</note> and forty nights,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “night”</note> and Yahweh listened to me also on that occasion;<note placement="foot">Or “occurrence” or “that time”</note> Yahweh was not willing to destroy you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:11
verses.text: And Yahweh said to me, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Come, continue⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Arise, go”</note> your journey <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before the people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the faces of the people”</note> so that you may go and take possession of the land that I swore to their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to give to them.’  <div eID="gen1366" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1066"/><div sID="gen1367" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1066"/>And now, Israel, what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh your God asking<note placement="foot">Or “requiring”</note> from you, except<note placement="foot">Or “but only”</note> to revere Yahweh your God, to go<note placement="foot">Or “to walk”</note> in all his ways and to love him and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,<note placement="foot">Or “inner self”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:13
verses.text: to keep the commandments of Yahweh and his statutes that I am commanding you today <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for your own good⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for good to you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:14
verses.text: Look! For to Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belong⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “is”</note> heaven and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞highest heavens⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heavens of the heavens”</note> the earth and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yet⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Only”</note> to your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> Yahweh was very attached, so as to love them, and so he chose their offspring after them, namely you, from all the peoples, as it is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the day the this”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:16
verses.text: So you shall circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞do not be stubborn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “your neck you shall not make stiff any longer”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:17
verses.text: For Yahweh your God, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> God of the gods and Lord of the lords, the great and mighty God, the awesome <transChange type="added">one</transChange> who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is not partial⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “does not lift up faces”</note> and he does not take bribes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And he</transChange> executes justice for the orphan and widow, and <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> one who loves <transChange type="added">the</transChange> alien, to give to them food and clothing.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:19
verses.text: And you shall love the alien, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:20
verses.text: Yahweh your God, you shall revere him, you shall serve him, and to him you shall cling, and by his name you shall swear.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:21
verses.text: He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your praise, and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your God, who has done with you these great and awesome <transChange type="added">things</transChange> that your eyes have seen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:22
verses.text: With <transChange type="added">only</transChange> seventy persons your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> went down to Egypt, but now Yahweh your God has made you as the stars of the heaven <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with respect to multitude⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as far as number”</note>  <chapter eID="Deut.10"/> <div eID="gen1367" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:1
verses.text: “And you shall love Yahweh your God, and you shall keep his obligations and his statutes and his regulations and his commandments <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞always⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all of the days”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:2
verses.text: And you shall realize <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> that <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your children who have not known and who have not seen the discipline of Yahweh your God—his greatness, his strong hand, and his outstretched arm,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:3
verses.text: and his signs and his deeds that he did in the midst of Egypt to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and to all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> his land,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:4
verses.text: and what he did to the army of Egypt and to their horses and to their chariots, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> how he made the water of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reed”</note> flow over them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they pursued after them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in/at their pursuing after them”</note> and so Yahweh has destroyed them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as is the case today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until the day the this”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:5
verses.text: and what he did to you in the desert until you came up to this place,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:6
verses.text: and what he did to Dathan and to Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben, how the earth opened its mouth wide and swallowed them, their households and their tents, and all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the living creatures<note placement="foot">Hebrew “creature”</note> that were in their possession and that were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞following along with them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in their feet” = “living things traveling along with them”</note> in the midst of all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:7
verses.text: The fact of the matter is, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your own eyes have seen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your eyes that are seeing”</note> all of the great deeds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “deed”</note> of Yahweh that he did.  <div eID="gen1368" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1067"/><div sID="gen1369" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1067"/>“And you must keep all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the commandments<note placement="foot">Hebrew “commandment”</note> that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> so that you may have strength and you may go and you may take possession of that land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to which you are crossing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you are crossing there”</note> to take possession of it,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:9
verses.text: so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you may live long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you may make long days”</note> on the land that Yahweh swore to your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to give <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:10
verses.text: For the fact is <transChange type="added">that</transChange> the land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that you are about to go into⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you are about to go there”</note> to take possession of it is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞come out of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “come out from there”</note> where you sow your seed and you give water by your foot, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as in a vegetable garden⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as the garden of the vegetables”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:11
verses.text: But the land that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to cross into to take possession of it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a land of hills and valleys, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> by the rain of the heaven it drinks water,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:12
verses.text: a land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> caring for it; continually the eyes of Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on it, from the beginning of the year up to the end of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> year.  <div eID="gen1369" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1068"/><div sID="gen1370" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1068"/>“And it will happen <transChange type="added">that</transChange> if you listen carefully to my commandments that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> to love Yahweh your God, and to serve him with all of your heart and with all of your soul,<note placement="foot">Or “inner self”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:14
verses.text: then ‘I will send the rain for your land in its season, early rain and later rain, and you will gather your grain and your wine and your olive oil.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:15
verses.text: And I will give vegetation in your field for your livestock, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will eat your fill⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “you will eat and you will be satisfied”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:16
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Take care⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Watch for yourself”</note> so that your heart is not easily deceived, and you turn away, and you serve other gods, and you bow down to them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:17
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the anger of Yahweh will be kindled against you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the nose of Yahweh become hot against you”</note> and he will shut up the heavens,<note placement="foot">Or “sky”</note> and there shall not be rain, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> the ground will not give its produce, and you will perish quickly from the good land that Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you.  <div eID="gen1370" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1069"/><div sID="gen1371" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1069"/>“And you shall put these, my words, on your heart and on your inner self,<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> and you shall bind them as a sign on your hand and let them be as an emblem between your eyes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:19
verses.text: And you shall teach them to your children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> by talking about them when you sit in your house and when you travel on the road and when you lie down and when you get up.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:20
verses.text: And you shall write them on the doorframes of your house and on your gates,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:21
verses.text: so that <transChange type="added">they</transChange> may multiply your days and the days of your children on the land that Yahweh swore to your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to give it to them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as long as heaven endures over the earth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “like the days of heaven above the earth”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:22
verses.text: Yes, if you diligently keep all<note placement="foot">Or “every one of”</note> this commandment that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to observe it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to do it”</note> by loving Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by walking in⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to walk in”</note> all his ways and by holding fast to him,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:23
verses.text: then Yahweh will drive out all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> these nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> and you will dispossess nations larger and more numerous than you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:24
verses.text: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads, it shall be yours; your boundary shall be from the desert and Lebanon from the river, the river Euphrates, on up to the western sea.<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean Sea</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:25
verses.text: No one can take a stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to your faces”</note> your dread and your fear Yahweh your God will put on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surface⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “faces”</note> of all the land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where you tread⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “which you tread in it”</note> just as he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note> to you.  <div eID="gen1371" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1070"/><div sID="gen1372" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1070"/>“See, I am setting <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> a blessing and a curse:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:27
verses.text: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:28
verses.text: and the curse, if you <transChange type="added">do</transChange> not listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, but <transChange type="added">rather</transChange> you turn from the way that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> to go after other gods that you have not known.  <div eID="gen1372" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1071"/><div sID="gen1373" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1071"/>“And it will happen <transChange type="added">that</transChange> when Yahweh your God has brought you to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the land that you are going to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the land that you are going there”</note> to take possession of it, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you shall pronounce the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:30
verses.text: (Are they not beyond the Jordan, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞toward the west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “after the way of the descent of the sun”</note> in the land of the Canaanites living in the Jordan Valley,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in the Arabah”</note> opposite Gilgal beside the terebinth<note placement="foot">Or “oaks”</note> of Moreh?)

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:31
verses.text: For you are <transChange type="added">now</transChange> about to cross the Jordan to go to take possession of the land that Yahweh, your God, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you, and you will take possession of it and live in it,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:32
verses.text: and you must diligently <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “observe to do”</note> all the rules and the regulations that I am setting <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before your face”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>  <chapter eID="Deut.11"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1072"/><title type="x-s">Detailed Stipulations: Purity and Unity</title> <div sID="gen1374" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1072"/>“These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the rules and the regulations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that you must diligently observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that you must observe to do”</note> in the land that Yahweh, the God of your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> has given to you to take possession of it, <transChange type="added">during</transChange> all the days that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> living on the land.  <div eID="gen1374" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1073"/><div sID="gen1375" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1073"/>You must completely demolish all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the places there where <transChange type="added">they</transChange> served their gods, <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, the nations whom you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to dispossess, on the high mountains, and on the hills and under each leafy green tree.<note placement="foot">Or “spreading tree”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:3
verses.text: And you shall break down their altars, and you shall smash their stone pillars, and their Asherah poles you must burn with fire, and the images of their gods you shall hew down, and you shall blot out their names from that place.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:4
verses.text: You shall not worship Yahweh your God like this.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:5
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞But only⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “But if”</note> to the place that Yahweh your God will choose from all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your tribes to place his name there as his dwelling shall you seek, and there you shall go.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:6
verses.text: And you shall bring there your burnt offerings and your sacrifices and your tithes and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your donations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the contributions of your hand”</note> and your votive gifts and your freewill offerings and the firstling of your herd and your flock.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:7
verses.text: And you shall eat there <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the faces of”</note> Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in all your endeavors⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in all of the sending of your hand”</note> you and your family <transChange type="added">in</transChange> which Yahweh your God has blessed you.  <div eID="gen1375" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1074"/><div sID="gen1376" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1074"/>“You must not do <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> doing here <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each according to all that is right in his eyes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “each man all of the right in his eyes”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:9
verses.text: For you have not come up to now to the resting place and to the inheritance that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:10
verses.text: But you will cross the Jordan, and you will settle in the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving you as an inheritance, and he will give rest to you from all your enemies from all around, and you will live securely,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:11
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it will happen”</note> at the place that Yahweh your God will choose, to let his name dwell there, there you shall bring all the things I am commanding you, your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your donations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the contribution of your hand”</note> and all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the choice <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, your votive gifts that you vow to Yahweh.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:12
verses.text: And you shall rejoice <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the face of”</note> Yahweh your God, you and your sons and your daughters and your slaves and your slave women and the Levite who is in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> because there is not for him a plot of ground and an inheritance with you.  <div eID="gen1376" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1075"/><div sID="gen1377" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1075"/>“Take care for yourself so that you do not offer your burnt offerings at <transChange type="added">just</transChange> any place that you happen to see,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:14
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but only⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “but only if”</note> at the place that Yahweh will choose among one of your tribes; there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you.  <div eID="gen1377" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1076"/><div sID="gen1378" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1076"/>“But <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whenever you desire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in all the wanting of your soul/inner self”</note> you may slaughter, and you may eat meat according to the blessing of Yahweh your God that he has given to you in all of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> the unclean and the clean may eat it <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as <transChange type="added">they would</transChange> the gazelle and as the deer.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:16
verses.text: Only the blood you must not eat, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> on the ground you must pour it like water.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:17
verses.text: You are not allowed to eat in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> the tithe of your grain and your wine and your olive oil and the firstborn of your herd and your flock and all of your votive gifts that you vowed and your freewill offering and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your donations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the contribution of your hand”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:18
verses.text: But only <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of”</note> Yahweh your God you shall eat it, at the place that Yahweh your God will choose,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “choose it”</note> you and your son and your daughter and your slave and your slave woman and the Levite who is in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “gate”</note> and you must rejoice <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of”</note> your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in all your undertakings⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in all of the sending of your hand”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Take care⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Watch for yourself”</note> so that you do not neglect the Levite all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your days on your land.  <div eID="gen1378" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1077"/><div sID="gen1379" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1077"/>“When Yahweh your God enlarges your territory <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as he has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoken”</note> to you, and you say ‘I want to eat some meat,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because you want it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “because your soul/inner self desires it”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whenever you desire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at/in all the wanting of your soul/inner self”</note> you may eat meat.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:21
verses.text: If the place that<note placement="foot">Or “where”</note> Yahweh your God will choose to put his name there is too far from you, and you slaughter any of your herd and any of your flock that Yahweh has given to you just as I have commanded you, then you may eat whenever you desire in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:22
verses.text: Surely <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as the gazelle and the deer is eaten, so <transChange type="added">both</transChange> the unclean and the clean together may eat it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:23
verses.text: Only, be sure not to eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you shall not eat the life with the meat.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:24
verses.text: You shall not eat it, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> on the ground you shall pour it out like water.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:25
verses.text: You shall not eat it, so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it will go well⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it/he is good”</note> for you and your children after you, because then you will be doing what is<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> right in the eyes of Yahweh.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:26
verses.text: Only your holy objects <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that are yours⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that are for you”</note> and your votive gifts you must carry and you must bring to the place that Yahweh will choose.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:27
verses.text: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood on the altar of Yahweh your God, and the blood of your sacrifices you shall pour out on the altar of Yahweh your God, but the meat you may eat.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:28
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Be careful to obey⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Watch carefully and listen”</note> all these things that I am commanding you, so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it will go well⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he/it is good”</note> for you and for your children after you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until ever”</note> because then you will be doing what is<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> good and right<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the right”</note> in the eyes of Yahweh your God.  <div eID="gen1379" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1078"/><div sID="gen1380" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1078"/>“When Yahweh your God has cut off the nations whom you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞about to go to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “about to go to there”</note> to dispossess them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of you”</note> and you have dispossessed them, and you live in their land,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:30
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞take care⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Watch for yourself”</note> so that you are not ensnared <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞into imitating them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “after them”</note> after their being destroyed from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of you”</note> and so that you not enquire concerning their gods, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘How did these nations serve their gods, and thus <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Emphatic use of the pronoun</note> want to do also.’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:31
verses.text: You must not do so toward Yahweh your God, because of every detestable thing they have done for their gods Yahweh hates, for even their sons and their daughters they would burn in the fire to their gods.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:32
verses.text: <note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Deut.12.32-Deut.13.18">Deuteronomy 12:32–13:18 </reference>in the English Bible is 13:1–19 in the Hebrew Bible</note> All of the things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing”</note> that I am commanding you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you must diligently observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “you must observe to do it”</note> you shall not add to it, and you shall not take away from it.”  <chapter eID="Deut.12"/> <div eID="gen1380" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:1
verses.text: “If a prophet stands up in your midst or a dreamer of dreams<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dream”</note> and he gives to you a sign or wonder,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:2
verses.text: and the sign or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> the wonder comes about that he spoke<note placement="foot">Or “promised/declared”</note> to you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Let us go after other gods (those whom you have not known), and let us serve them,’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:3
verses.text: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or to that dreamer, for Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is testing you to know whether you love⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a testing of Yahweh your God concerning you in order to know whether there is you loving”</note> Yahweh your God with all of your heart and with all of your inner self.<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:4
verses.text: You shall go after Yahweh your God, and him you shall revere, and his commandment you shall keep, and to his voice you shall listen, and him you shall serve, and to him you shall hold fast.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:5
verses.text: But that prophet or the dreamer of that dream shall be executed, for he spoke falsely about Yahweh your God, the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> bringing you out from the land of Egypt and the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> redeeming you from the house of slavery, in order to seduce you from the way that Yahweh your God commanded you to go in it; so <transChange type="added">in this way</transChange> you shall purge the evil from your midst.  <div eID="gen1381" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1079"/><div sID="gen1382" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1079"/>“If your brother, the son of your mother or your son or your daughter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞or your wife whom you embrace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “or the wife of your embrace”</note> or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your intimate friend⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your friend who is like your soul/inner self”</note> in secrecy <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞says⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Let us go and let us serve other gods!’ gods that you and your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> have not known,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:7
verses.text: from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> the gods of the people who are around you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those near you or those far from you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the near ones to you or the distant ones from you”</note> from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> end of the earth and up to the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> end of the earth,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:8
verses.text: you must not give in to him, and you shall not listen to him, and your eye shall not take pity on him, and you shall not have compassion, and you shall not cover <transChange type="added">up</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “conceal” him</note> for him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:9
verses.text: But you shall certainly kill him; your hand shall be first against him to kill him and next the hand of all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the people.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:10
verses.text: And you shall stone him with stones and let him die, for he tried to seduce you from Yahweh your God, the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> bringing you from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:11
verses.text: And all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Israel shall hear, and they shall fear, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they shall not continue to act⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they shall not add to do”</note> according to this evil thing in your midst.  <div eID="gen1382" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1080"/><div sID="gen1383" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1080"/>“If you hear in one of your towns which Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you to live in, <transChange type="added">someone</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:13
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞worthless men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Belial”</note> have gone out from your midst and have seduced the inhabitants of their town, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Let us go and serve other gods!’ whom you have not known,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:14
verses.text: then you shall inquire and examine and interrogate thoroughly, and, look! <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> true; the thing has actually been done, this detestable thing in your midst,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">then</transChange> you shall certainly strike down the inhabitants of that town with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞edge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth”</note> of the sword; you shall destroy it and everything in it, its domestic animals with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞edge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:16
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> you shall gather all of its booty into the middle of its public square, and you shall burn the town and all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> its war-booty totally for Yahweh your God, and it shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a pile of rubble forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a tell/ruin forever”</note> it shall not be built again.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:17
verses.text: And let not something cling to your hand from the things devoted to destruction, so that Yahweh may turn back <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from his burning anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the burning of his nose”</note> and he may show compassion to you and he may continue to show compassion and so multiply you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as he swore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that he swore”</note> to your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:18
verses.text: if you listen to the voice of Yahweh your God, to keep all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> his commandments that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding <transChange type="added">to</transChange> you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> <transChange type="added">so as</transChange> to do the right <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> in the eyes of Yahweh your God.”  <chapter eID="Deut.13"/> <div eID="gen1383" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:1
verses.text: “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Yahweh your God; therefore you must not gash<note placement="foot">Or “cut”</note> yourself, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you must not make your forehead bald⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you shall not make/place baldness between your eyes”</note> for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dead.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:2
verses.text: For you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a people holy to Yahweh your God, and you Yahweh has chosen to be a treasured possession from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the peoples that are on the surface<note placement="foot">Or “face”</note> of the earth.  <div eID="gen1384" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1081"/><div sID="gen1385" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1081"/>You shall not eat any detestable thing.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:4
verses.text: These are the animals you may eat: ox, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sheep, goats⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “small livestock of the sheep and a small livestock of the goats”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:5
verses.text: deer, gazelle, roebuck, wild goat, ibex, antelope, and mountain sheep.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:6
verses.text: And any animal having a split hoof<note placement="foot">Or “divides the hoof”</note> and so <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a dividing of the hoof into two parts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a dividing cleft creating two hoofs”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and that chews the cud⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and that brings up the cud”</note> among the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note>—that <transChange type="added">animal</transChange> you may eat.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:7
verses.text: Only these you may not eat from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those chewing the cud⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “bringing up the cud”</note> and from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those having a division of the hoof⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “those having a division of the hoof divided”</note> the camel and the hare and the coney, because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they chew the cud⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they bringing up of the cud”</note> but they <transChange type="added">do</transChange> not divide the hoof; they are <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> unclean for you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:8
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">also</transChange> the pig <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because it has a division of the hoof⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because a division of the hoof”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but does not chew the cud⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “but not a chewing cud”</note> it is unclean for you; from their meat you shall not eat, and you shall not touch their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞carcasses⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “dead body”</note>  <div eID="gen1385" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1082"/><div sID="gen1386" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1082"/>“This <transChange type="added">is what</transChange> you shall eat from all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the water: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of that”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that has fins and scales⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for it is fins and scales,” showing possession of these features</note> you may eat.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:10
verses.text: But <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anything that does not have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of that there is not for it,” showing lack of possession of these features</note> fins and scales, you may not eat, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> unclean for you.  <div eID="gen1386" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1083"/><div sID="gen1387" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1083"/>“All <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> birds <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> clean you may eat.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:12
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the ones you shall not eat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “from them”</note> the eagle and the vulture and the short-toed eagle,<note placement="foot">This list of birds is difficult to translate since the terms are not definitely known: e.g., some translations render the last bird as a “buzzard” (NASV); other translations give different names for all three: griffon vulture, black vulture, bearded vulture (NEB)</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:13
verses.text: and the red kite<note placement="foot">Various options are available: large bird, kite, red kite, glede, buzzard</note> and the black kite or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any kind of falcon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “or the falcon according to its kind”; other options for falcon: bird, falcon, kite (others as carrion-bird), vulture, crow or raven, buzzard</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:14
verses.text: and any <transChange type="added">kind</transChange> of crow<note placement="foot">Or others translate as “raven”</note> according to its kind,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:15
verses.text: and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ostrich⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “daughter of the ostrich”; others “desert owl”</note> and the short-eared owl and the seagull<note placement="foot">Or “long-eared owl”</note> and the hawk according to its kind,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:16
verses.text: the little owl and the great owl and the barn owl,<note placement="foot">Or “white owl”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:17
verses.text: and the desert owl<note placement="foot">Or “large bird” or “horned-owl”</note> and the carrion vulture<note placement="foot">Or “large bird”</note> and the cormorant,<note placement="foot">Or “large bird,” or “fisher-owl”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:18
verses.text: and the stork and the heron according to its kind and the hoopoe and the bat.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:19
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">also</transChange> all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the winged insects⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the swarmers of the flyers” or “all the swarms of things that fly”</note> they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> unclean for you; you shall not eat <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:20
verses.text: You may eat any clean bird.  <div eID="gen1387" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1084"/><div sID="gen1388" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1084"/>“You shall not eat any carcass;<note placement="foot">Or “corpse”</note> you may give it to the alien who is in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> and he may eat it, or you may sell <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to a foreigner, for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a holy people for Yahweh your God; you may not boil a kid in its mother’s milk.  <div eID="gen1388" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1085"/><div sID="gen1389" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1085"/>“Certainly you must give a tithe <transChange type="added">of</transChange> all the yield of your seed, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞which comes forth from your field year after year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the going forth of the field year by year”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:23
verses.text: And you shall eat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the faces of”</note> Yahweh your God in the place that he will choose to make to dwell his name there the tithe of your grain, your wine and your olive oil and the firstling of your herd and your flock, so that you may learn to revere Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞always⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all of the days”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:24
verses.text: But if <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the distance is too great for you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “it is great from you the journey that”</note> so that you are not able to transport<note placement="foot">Or “carry”</note> it, because the place that Yahweh your God will choose to set his name there, it is <transChange type="added">too</transChange> far from you, when Yahweh your God will bless you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:25
verses.text: then <transChange type="added">in that case</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you may exchange for money⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you may give it in for the money/silver”</note> and you shall take<note placement="foot">Or “bind”</note> the money to your hand and go to the place that Yahweh your God will choose.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:26
verses.text: You may spend the money for anything <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that you desire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “that your soul/inner self desires”</note> for oxen or for sheep or for wine or for strong drink or for anything <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that you desire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “that your soul/inner self desires”</note> and you shall eat it there <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:27
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as to</transChange> the Levite who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> you shall not neglect him, because there is not a plot of ground for him and an inheritance <transChange type="added">along</transChange> with you.  <div eID="gen1389" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1086"/><div sID="gen1390" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1086"/>“At the end of three years you shall bring out all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the tithe of your yield for that year, and you shall store <transChange type="added">it</transChange> in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:29
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> the Levite may come, because there is no plot of ground for him or an inheritance with you, and the alien <transChange type="added">also may come</transChange> and the orphan and the widow that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they may eat their fill⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they may eat and they may be satisfied”</note> so that Yahweh your God may bless you in all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the work of your hand that you undertake.”  <chapter eID="Deut.14"/> <div eID="gen1390" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:1
verses.text: “At the end of seven years you shall grant <transChange type="added">a</transChange> remission of debt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:2
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the manner of the remission of debt: every <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞creditor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “owner of the loan of his hand”</note> shall remit his claim that he holds against his neighbor, and he shall not exact payment from his brother because there<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> a remission of debt has been proclaimed unto<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">With respect to</transChange> the foreigner you may exact payment, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you must remit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your hand shall remit”</note> what shall be <transChange type="added">owed</transChange> to you <transChange type="added">with respect to</transChange> your brother.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:4
verses.text: Nevertheless, there<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> shall not be among you a poor <transChange type="added">person</transChange>, because Yahweh will certainly bless you in the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an inheritance, to take possession of it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:5
verses.text: If only you listen well to the voice of Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by observing diligently⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to observe so as to do”</note> all of these commandments<note placement="foot">Hebrew “commandment”</note> that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:6
verses.text: When Yahweh your God has blessed you, <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note> to you, then you will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow <transChange type="added">from them</transChange>, and you will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:7
verses.text: If <transChange type="added">there</transChange> is a poor <transChange type="added">person</transChange> among you from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> one of your brothers in one of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> that Yahweh your God is giving to you, you shall not harden your heart, and you shall not shut your hand toward <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your brother who is poor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from among your brothers, the poor one”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:8
verses.text: But you shall certainly open your hand for him, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall willingly lend⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lending you shall lend”</note> to him enough to meet his need, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whatever it is⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “whatever is lacking for him”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Take care⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Watch for yourself”</note> so that there<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> will not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a thought of wickedness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a thing in your heart wickedness”</note> in your heart, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘The seventh year, the year of the remission of debt is near,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and you view your needy neighbor with hostility⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “is bad your eye against your brother who is needy”</note> and so you do not give to him, and he might cry out against you to Yahweh, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you would incur guilt against yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it will be against you a sin”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:10
verses.text: By all means you must give to him, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you must not be discontented⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not shall be bad/evil your heart at/when”</note> at your giving to him, because on account of this very thing, Yahweh your God will bless you in all your work and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in all that you undertake⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in all of the sending/putting forth of your hand”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:11
verses.text: For the poor<note placement="foot">Or “the needy person”</note> will not cease to be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the midst of “</note> in the land; therefore I am commanding you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘You shall willingly open your hand to your brother, to your needy and to your poor <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> in your land.’  <div eID="gen1391" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1087"/><div sID="gen1392" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1087"/>If your relative<note placement="foot">Or “brother”</note> who is a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman is sold to you, and he or she has served you six years, then in the seventh year you shall send that person out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞free⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “free from with you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:13
verses.text: And when you send him <transChange type="added">out</transChange> free from you, you shall not send him <transChange type="added">away</transChange> empty-handed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:14
verses.text: You shall generously supply him from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> your flocks and from your threshing floor and from your press; <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> that <transChange type="added">with which</transChange> Yahweh your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:15
verses.text: And remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you; therefore I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you thus <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:16
verses.text: And then <transChange type="added">if</transChange> it will happen <transChange type="added">that</transChange> he says to you, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I do not want to go out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will not go out”</note> from you,’ because he loves you and your family, because it is good for him <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> with you;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:17
verses.text: then you shall take an awl, and you shall thrust <transChange type="added">it</transChange> through his earlobe and into the door, and he shall be to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a slave forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a slave of eternity”</note> and you shall also do likewise for your slave woman.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:18
verses.text: It shall not be hard in your eyes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you send him forth free⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in/at you to send him forth free from being with you”</note> because for six years he has served you worth twice the wage of a hired worker; and Yahweh your God will bless you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in whatever you will do⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in all of that you will do”</note>  <div eID="gen1392" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1088"/><div sID="gen1393" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1088"/>“Every firstling male that is born of your herd and of your flock you shall consecrate to Yahweh your God; you shall not do work with the firstling of your ox, and you shall not shear the firstling of your flock.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Rather</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the face of Yahweh”</note> your God you shall eat it year by year at the place Yahweh will choose, you and your household.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:21
verses.text: But if there is a physical defect in it, <transChange type="added">such as</transChange> lameness or blindness, any serious defect, you shall not sacrifice it to Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:22
verses.text: In your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> you shall eat it, the unclean and the clean together <transChange type="added">may eat it</transChange>, <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as <transChange type="added">they eat</transChange> the gazelle and as <transChange type="added">they eat</transChange> the deer.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:23
verses.text: But you shall not eat its blood; you shall pour it on the ground like water.”  <chapter eID="Deut.15"/> <div eID="gen1393" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:1
verses.text: “Observe the month of Abib, and you shall keep <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Passover to Yahweh your God, for in the month of Abib Yahweh your God brought you out from Egypt <transChange type="added">by</transChange> night.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:2
verses.text: And you shall offer the Passover sacrifice to Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">from among</transChange> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> flock and herd at the place that Yahweh will choose, to let his name dwell there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:3
verses.text: You shall not eat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in addition to” or “upon it”</note> anything leavened; seven days you shall eat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in addition to” or “upon it”</note> unleavened bread of affliction, because in haste you went out from the land of Egypt, so that you will remember the day of your going out from the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:4
verses.text: And leaven shall not be seen with<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> you in any of your territory<note placement="foot">Or “all of” your territory</note> for seven days, and none of the meat that you will slaughter on the evening on the first day shall remain overnight until morning.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:5
verses.text: You are not allowed to offer the Passover sacrifice in one of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> that Yahweh your God is giving to you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:6
verses.text: but only at the place that Yahweh your God will choose, to let his name dwell there; you shall offer the Passover sacrifice <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the evening at sunset⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the evening as the sun goes/sets”</note> at the designated time<note placement="foot">The Hebrew word here indicates the specific time that God had chosen to bring Israel out of Egypt</note> of your going out from Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:7
verses.text: And you shall cook, and you shall eat <transChange type="added">it</transChange> at the place that Yahweh your God will choose; and you may turn in the morning and go to your tents.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:8
verses.text: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> an assembly for Yahweh your God; you shall not do work.  <div eID="gen1394" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1089"/><div sID="gen1395" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1089"/>“You shall count <transChange type="added">off</transChange> seven weeks for you; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from the time you begin to harvest the standing grain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the beginning of the sickle against the standing grain”</note> you shall begin to count seven weeks.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:10
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks for Yahweh your God with the measure of the freewill offering of your hand that you shall give <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as Yahweh your God has blessed you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:11
verses.text: And you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God, you and your son and your daughter and your slave and your slave woman and the Levite that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> and the alien and the orphan and the widow who are in your midst in the place that Yahweh your God will choose to let his name dwell there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:12
verses.text: And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall diligently observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you shall observe and do”</note> these rules.  <div eID="gen1395" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1090"/><div sID="gen1396" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1090"/>“You shall celebrate the Feast of Booths for yourselves<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for you”</note> seven days <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the gathering in of the produce⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at your gathering of the produce”</note> from your threshing floor and from your press;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:14
verses.text: and you shall rejoice at your feast, you and your son and your daughter and your slave and your slave woman and the Levite and the orphan and the widow that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:15
verses.text: Seven days you shall celebrate <transChange type="added">your</transChange> feast to Yahweh your God at the place Yahweh will choose, for Yahweh your God shall bless you in all of your produce<note placement="foot">Or “increase”</note> and in all of the work of your hand, and you shall surely be rejoicing.<note placement="foot">Or “joyful”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:16
verses.text: Three times in the year all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your males shall appear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before ⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with the face of”</note> Yahweh your God at the place that he will choose, at the Feast of Unleavened Bread and at the Feast of Weeks and at the Feast of Booths, and they shall not appear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with the face of Yahweh”</note> empty-handed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:17
verses.text: Each <transChange type="added">person</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall give as he is able⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “according to the gift of his hand”</note> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, according to the blessing of Yahweh your God that he has given to you.  <div eID="gen1396" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1091"/><div sID="gen1397" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1091"/>“You shall appoint judges and officials for you in all your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> that Yahweh your God is giving to you throughout your tribes, and you shall render for the people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞righteous judgments⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a judgment based on righteousness”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:19
verses.text: You shall not subvert<note placement="foot">Or “distort/pervert”</note> justice; you shall not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞show partiality⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “recognize faces”</note> and you shall not take a bribe, for the bribe makes blind <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise and misrepresents <transChange type="added">the</transChange> words of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:20
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Justice, only justice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “justice justice”</note> you shall pursue, so that you may live, and you shall take possession of the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:21
verses.text: You shall not plant for yourselves<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for/to you” but with collective meaning</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an Asherah pole⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “an Asherah of any wood/tree”</note> beside the altar of Yahweh your God that you make for yourselves.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for/to you” but with collective meaning</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:22
verses.text: And you shall not set up for yourselves a stone pillar, <transChange type="added">a thing</transChange> that Yahweh your God hates.  <chapter eID="Deut.16"/> <div eID="gen1397" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:1
verses.text: “You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or sheep <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that has a physical defect⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that is on it a physical defect”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of anything seriously wrong⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “of any thing bad/evil”</note> for that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a detestable thing to Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:2
verses.text: If <transChange type="added">there</transChange> is found in one of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you a man or a woman that does evil in the eyes of Yahweh your God to transgress his covenant

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:3
verses.text: and by going and serving other gods and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> he bows down to them and to the sun or to the moon or to any <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the host of heaven <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞which I have forbidden⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “which not I have commanded”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:4
verses.text: and it is reported to you or you hear <transChange type="added">about it</transChange> and you enquire <transChange type="added">about it</transChange> thoroughly and, indeed,<note placement="foot">Or “look!”</note> the trustworthiness of the deed<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the thing”</note> has been established, it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞has occurred⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “has been done”</note> this detestable thing, in Israel,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:5
verses.text: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has<note placement="foot">Hebrew “have”</note> done this evil thing to your gates; that is, the man or the woman, and you shall stone them with stones <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to death⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and so they die”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:6
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞On the evidence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “By the mouth of”</note> two or three witnesses <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the person shall be put to death⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he/she shall be put to death, the dead person”</note> The person<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he/she”</note> shall not be put to death by the mouth of one witness.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:7
verses.text: The hand of the witnesses shall be first against the person<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> to kill the person,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> and afterward the hands<note placement="foot">Hebrew “hand”</note> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> all the people, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you shall purge the evil from your midst.  <div eID="gen1398" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1092"/><div sID="gen1399" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1092"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞If a matter is too difficult for you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “If is difficult/wonderful from you a thing for judgment”</note> for example disputes between blood and blood,<note placement="foot">Or “between one homicide and another”</note> between legal claim and legal claim<note placement="foot">Or “one kind of lawsuit and another”</note> and between assault and assault<note placement="foot">Or “one kind of abuse and another”</note> and between matters of discernment in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> then you shall get up and you shall go to the place that Yahweh your God will choose;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:9
verses.text: then you shall go to the priests and the Levites and to the judge who will be <transChange type="added">in office</transChange> in those days, and you shall enquire, and they shall announce to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the verdict⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the word of the decision”</note>  <div eID="gen1399" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1093"/><div sID="gen1400" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1093"/>“And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall carry out exactly the decision⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and you shall do according to the mouth of the word”</note> that they announced to you from that place that Yahweh will choose, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall diligently observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and you shall observe and do”</note> according to all that they instruct you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And so</transChange> according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the instruction of the law⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of the law”</note> that they teach you and according to the decisions that they say to you, you shall do; you shall not turn from the word that they tell you to the right or <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> left.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:12
verses.text: And the man who treats with contempt<note placement="foot">Or “acts presumptuously”</note> <transChange type="added">so as</transChange> not to listen to the priest <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> standing to minister on behalf of Yahweh your God or to the judge, that man shall die; so you shall purge the evil from Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:13
verses.text: And all the people will hear and will be afraid, and they will not behave presumptuously again.  <div eID="gen1400" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1094"/><div sID="gen1401" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1094"/>“When you have come to that land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you and you have taken possession of it and you have settled in it, and you say, ‘I will set over me a king like all the nations that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> around me,’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:15
