verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1142"/><div sID="gen1456" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1142"/>“Fathers shall not be put to death because of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> children, and children shall not be put to death because of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> fathers; each one shall be put to death for his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> sin.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:17
verses.text: You shall not subvert the rights of an alien <transChange type="added">or</transChange> an orphan, and you shall not take as pledge <transChange type="added">the</transChange> garment of a widow.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:18
verses.text: And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> Yahweh your God redeemed you from there; therefore I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you to do this commandment.  <div eID="gen1456" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1143"/><div sID="gen1457" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1143"/>“When<note placement="foot">Or “If”</note> you reap your harvest in your field and you forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not return to get it, for it shall be for the alien, for the orphan, and for the widow, so that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:20
verses.text: When you beat off the fruit of your olive trees you shall not search through the branches afterward, for it<note placement="foot">That is, what is left</note> shall be for the alien, for the orphan, and for the widow.  <div eID="gen1457" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1144"/><div sID="gen1458" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1144"/>When you harvest <transChange type="added">grapes</transChange>, you shall not glean your vineyards <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “behind/after you”</note> it<note placement="foot">That is, what is left</note> shall be for the alien, for the orphan, and for the widow.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:22
verses.text: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, therefore I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you to do this thing.”  <chapter eID="Deut.24"/> <div eID="gen1458" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:1
verses.text: “When a legal dispute <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞takes place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shall be”</note> between men and they come near to the court, and <transChange type="added">the judges</transChange> judge <transChange type="added">with respect to</transChange> them, then they shall declare the righteous <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> in the right and they shall condemn the wicked,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:2
verses.text: then it will happen if the guilty <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deserves beating⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “is a son of beating”</note> then the judge shall make him lie, and he shall beat him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of him”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the prescribed number of lashes proportionate to the offense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as is sufficient/necessary, with respect to number, for his wickedness/wicked behavior”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:3
verses.text: He may beat him <transChange type="added">with</transChange> forty lashes, and he shall not do more <transChange type="added">than these</transChange>, so that he <transChange type="added">will</transChange> not beat more in addition to these many blows,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “blow”</note> and your countryman<note placement="foot">Or “brother”</note> would be<note placement="foot">Hebrew “is”</note> degraded before your eyes.  <div eID="gen1459" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1145"/><div sID="gen1460" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1145"/>“You shall not muzzle an ox <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he is threshing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “at his threshing”</note>  <div eID="gen1460" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1146"/><div sID="gen1461" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1146"/>“When brothers dwell together and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the deceased shall not become the wife of a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞man of another family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Others: “strange man,” “man outside the family” (NEB)</note> her brother-in-law <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall have sex with her⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “shall go to her”</note> and he shall take her <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to/for him”</note> as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> wife, and he shall perform his duty as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> brother-in-law <transChange type="added">with respect to</transChange> her.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:6
verses.text: And then the firstborn that she bears <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall represent his dead brother⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he shall stand upon the name of his brother the deceased”</note> so that his name is not blotted out from Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:7
verses.text: But if the man <transChange type="added">does</transChange> not want to take his sister-in-law, then his sister-in-law shall go up to the gate, to the elders, and she shall say, ‘My brother-in-law refused <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to perpetuate his brother’s name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to cause a name to stand for his brother”</note> in Israel, for he is not willing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to marry me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “to consummate the marriage with the widow of a his brother”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:8
verses.text: Then the elders of his town shall summon him and speak to him, and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> he persists and says, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I do not desire to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I do not delight in”</note> marry her’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">then</transChange> his sister-in-law shall go near him before the eyes of the elders, and she shall pull off his sandal from his foot, and she shall spit in his face, and she shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declare⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “respond/answer”</note> and she shall say, ‘This is how it is done to the man who does not build the house of his brother.’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:10
verses.text: And his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “name”</note> shall be called in Israel, ‘The house where the sandal was pulled off.’<note placement="foot">Or “the house of the man whose sandal was pulled off”</note>  <div eID="gen1461" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1147"/><div sID="gen1462" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1147"/>“If a man and his brother fight each other and the wife of the one <transChange type="added">man</transChange> comes near to rescue her husband from the hand of his attacker and she stretches <transChange type="added">out</transChange> her hand and she seizes his genitals,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:12
verses.text: then you shall cut off her hand; your eye shall not take pity.  <div eID="gen1462" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1148"/><div sID="gen1463" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1148"/>“There shall not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for your use⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to you”</note> in your bag <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞two kinds of stone weights, a large one and a small one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “stone and stone large and small”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:14
verses.text: There shall not be in your house <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for your use⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for you”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞two kinds of measures⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “ephah and ephah large and small”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Rather</transChange> a full and honest weight shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for your use⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “for you”</note> there shall be for you a full and honest <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞measure⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “an ephah”</note> so that your days on the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you may be long.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:16
verses.text: For detestable to<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> Yahweh your God is everyone who is doing such things,<note placement="foot">Or “are all whoare doing”</note> everyone who is acting<note placement="foot">Or “all whoare acting”</note> dishonestly.  <div eID="gen1463" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1149"/><div sID="gen1464" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1149"/>“Remember what Amalek did to you on the journey when<note placement="foot">Or “at/in”</note> you went out from Egypt,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:18
verses.text: that he met you on the journey and attacked you, all those lagging behind you and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> you were weary and worn out, and he did not fear God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen when”</note> Yahweh your God gives rest to you from all your enemies from around <transChange type="added">about you</transChange> in the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you <transChange type="added">as an</transChange> inheritance to take possession of it, you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under the heavens; you shall not forget!”  <chapter eID="Deut.25"/> <div eID="gen1464" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:1
verses.text: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it shall happen”</note> when you come to the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you <transChange type="added">as an</transChange> inheritance, and you take possession of it and you settle in it,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:2
verses.text: then you shall take from the firstfruit of all the fruit of the ground that you harvest from your land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you, and you shall put <transChange type="added">it</transChange> in a basket, and you shall go to the place that Yahweh your God will choose to make his name to dwell there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:3
verses.text: And you shall go to the priest who is <transChange type="added">in office</transChange> in those days, and you shall say, ‘I declare <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> to Yahweh your God that I have come into the land that Yahweh swore to our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to give to us.’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:4
verses.text: Then the priest takes the basket from your hand and places it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the altar of Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:5
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall declare⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answer”</note> and you shall say <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> your God, ‘My ancestor<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> was a wandering Aramean, and he went down to Egypt, and there he dwelt as an alien <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞few in number⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in people only a few”</note> and there he became a great nation, mighty and numerous.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:6
verses.text: And the Egyptians treated us badly, and they oppressed us and imposed on us hard labor.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:7
verses.text: And we cried to Yahweh, the God of our ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and Yahweh heard our voice and saw our affliction and our toil and our oppression.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:8
verses.text: And Yahweh brought us <transChange type="added">out</transChange> from Egypt with a strong hand and an outstretched arm and with great terror and with signs and with wonders.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:9
verses.text: And he brought us to this place and gave to us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:10
verses.text: And now, look, I am bringing<note placement="foot">Hebrew “I bring”</note> the firstfruit of the fruit of the ground that you gave to me, Yahweh,’ and you shall place it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh your God, and you shall bow down <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:11
verses.text: And you shall celebrate with all of the bounty that Yahweh your God gave to you and to your family, you and the Levite and the alien who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your midst.  <div eID="gen1465" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1150"/><div sID="gen1466" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1150"/>“When you are finished <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞giving a tithe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to give a tenth”</note> all of the tithe of your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, then you shall give to the Levite, to the alien, to the orphan, and to the widow, so that they may eat in your towns and they may be satisfied.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:13
verses.text: And you shall say <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh your God, ‘I have removed the sacred portion from the<note placement="foot">Or “my” house since the definite article can show possession here</note> house and, moreover, I have given it to the Levite and to the alien and to the orphan and to the widow according to all your commandment that you commanded me; I have not transgressed any of your commandments, and I have not forgotten <transChange type="added">any of them</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:14
verses.text: I have not eaten during my <transChange type="added">time of</transChange> mourning, and I have not removed <transChange type="added">anything</transChange> from it while <transChange type="added">being</transChange> unclean, and I have not offered <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any of it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from it”</note> to someone who <transChange type="added">has</transChange> died. I have listened to the voice of Yahweh my God; I have done all that you commanded me <transChange type="added">to do</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:15
verses.text: Look down from the dwelling place of your holiness, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the land that you have given to us, as you swore to our ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “our fathers”</note> a land flowing with milk and honey.’  <div eID="gen1466" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1151"/><div sID="gen1467" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1151"/>“This day Yahweh your God is commanding you to do these rules and regulations, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and you must observe them diligently⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and you shall observe and you shall do them”</note> with all your heart and with all your soul.<note placement="foot">Or “inner self”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:17
verses.text: Yahweh you <transChange type="added">have</transChange> declared <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> to be for you as your God, and to go<note placement="foot">Or “to walk”</note> in his ways and to observe his rules and his commandments and his regulations and to listen to his voice.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:18
verses.text: And Yahweh <transChange type="added">has</transChange> declared you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> to be for him as a people, a treasured possession, as he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note> to you, and <transChange type="added">that you are</transChange> to observe all his commandments,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and that he then will set you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and to set you”</note> high above all the nations that he has made for his praise and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for fame⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for a name”</note> and for honor and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for you to be a holy people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for you to be/your being a people holy”</note> to Yahweh your God, as he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note>  <chapter eID="Deut.26"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1152"/><title type="x-s">Ceremonies</title> <div sID="gen1468" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1152"/>Then Moses and the elders of Israel charged the people, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Keep all of the commandment that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:2
verses.text: And then on the day that you cross the Jordan to the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you, then you shall set up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for yourselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for you”</note> large stones, and you shall paint<note placement="foot">Or “coat/cover them”</note> them with lime,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:3
verses.text: and you shall write on them all the words of this law at your crossing, so that you may come into the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note> to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:4
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you cross the Jordan⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at/in your crossing the Jordan”</note> you shall set up these stones that I am commanding you about <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> on Mount Ebal, and you shall paint<note placement="foot">Or “coat/cover”</note> them with lime.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:5
verses.text: And you shall build an altar there for Yahweh your God, an altar of stone, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall not use an iron tool to shape the stones⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and you shall not wave to and fro over them an iron tool”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:6
verses.text: You must build the altar of your God <transChange type="added">with</transChange> unhewn stones, and you shall sacrifice on it burnt offerings to Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:7
verses.text: And you shall sacrifice fellowship offerings, and you shall eat <transChange type="added">them</transChange> there, and you shall rejoice <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:8
verses.text: You shall write on the stone all of the words of this law very clearly.”  <div eID="gen1468" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1153"/><div sID="gen1469" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1153"/>Then Moses and the priests, the Levites, spoke to all Israel, saying,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Be silent and hear, Israel, for this day you have become <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for a people”</note> for Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:10
verses.text: And listen to the voice of Yahweh your God, and observe his commandments and his rules that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>  <div eID="gen1469" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1154"/><title type="x-s">Blessings and Curses</title> <div sID="gen1470" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1154"/>And Moses charged the people on that day, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:12
verses.text: “These <transChange type="added">tribes</transChange> shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you cross⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at/in crossing your”</note> the Jordan: Simeon and Levi and Judah and Issachar and Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:13
verses.text: And these shall stand on Mount Ebal for <transChange type="added">delivering</transChange> the curse: Reuben, Gad and Asher and Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:14
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Levites shall declare⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they shall answer the Levites”</note> and they shall say to each man of Israel <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a loud voice,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:15
verses.text: ‘Cursed be the man that makes a divine image or a cast image, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> a detestable thing for Yahweh, the work of the hand of a skilled craftsman, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> sets <transChange type="added">it</transChange> in a hiding place.’<note placement="foot">Or “a secret place”</note> And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the people shall respond⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and they shall answer all of the people”</note> ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1470" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1155"/><div sID="gen1471" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1155"/>‘Cursed be the one who dishonors his father or his mother.’ And all of the people shall say, ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1471" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1156"/><div sID="gen1472" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1156"/>‘Cursed be the one who moves the boundary <transChange type="added">marker</transChange> of his neighbor.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1472" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1157"/><div sID="gen1473" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1157"/>‘Cursed be the one who misleads a blind person on the road.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1473" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1158"/><div sID="gen1474" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1158"/>‘Cursed be the one who deprives <transChange type="added">the</transChange> alien, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow of justice.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1474" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1159"/><div sID="gen1475" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1159"/>‘Cursed be the one who lies with the wife of his father, because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he has dishonored his father’s bed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “because he uncovered the hem of his father”</note> And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1475" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1160"/><div sID="gen1476" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1160"/>‘Cursed be the one who lies with any <transChange type="added">kind</transChange> of animal.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1476" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1161"/><div sID="gen1477" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1161"/>‘Cursed be the one who lies with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1477" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1162"/><div sID="gen1478" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1162"/>‘Cursed be the one who lies with his mother-in-law.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1478" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1163"/><div sID="gen1479" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1163"/>‘Cursed be the one who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1479" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1164"/><div sID="gen1480" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1164"/>‘Cursed be the one who takes a bribe <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to murder an innocent person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “to strike down an individual person in blood”</note> And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’  <div eID="gen1480" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1165"/><div sID="gen1481" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1165"/>‘Cursed be <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who does not keep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who not keeps”</note> the words of this law, to observe them.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’ ”  <chapter eID="Deut.27"/> <div eID="gen1481" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:1
verses.text: “And it will happen <transChange type="added">that</transChange> if you indeed listen to the voice of Yahweh your God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to diligently observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to observe to do”</note> all his commandments that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> then Yahweh your God will set you above all the nations of the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:2
verses.text: And all of these blessings shall come upon you, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they shall have an effect on you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they shall overtake you”</note> if you listen to the voice of Yahweh your God:  <div eID="gen1482" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1166"/><div sID="gen1483" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1166"/>“You will be blessed in the city, and you will be blessed in the field.  <div eID="gen1483" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1167"/><div sID="gen1484" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1167"/>“Blessed will be the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground and the fruit of your livestock, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the calf of your cattle and the lambs of your flock⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “what is dropped of your cattle and the offspring of your flocks”</note>  <div eID="gen1484" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1168"/><div sID="gen1485" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1168"/>“Blessed will be your basket and your kneading trough.  <div eID="gen1485" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1169"/><div sID="gen1486" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1169"/>“Blessed will you be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you come in and blessed will you be when you go out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in/at your coming and you will be blessed in/at your going out”</note>  <div eID="gen1486" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1170"/><div sID="gen1487" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1170"/>“Yahweh will cause your enemies <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who rise up against you to be defeated before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones rising against you being defeated to the face of you”</note> on one road<note placement="foot">Or “way”</note> they shall come out against you, but on seven roads<note placement="foot">Or “ways”</note> they shall flee <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:8
verses.text: Yahweh will command <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concerning you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with you”</note> the blessing to be in your barns and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in all your endeavors⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “in all of the sending forth of your hand”</note> and he will bless you in the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:9
verses.text: Yahweh will establish you for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to/for him”</note> as a holy people as he has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of Yahweh your God and you walk in his ways.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:10
verses.text: And all of the peoples of the earth shall see that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by the name of Yahweh you are called⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “that the name of Yahweh is called/assigned upon you”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they shall fear you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they shall be afraid/fearful from you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:11
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh will make you successful and prosperous⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Yahweh will cause for you goodness”</note> in the fruit of your womb and on the land that Yahweh swore to your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to give to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:12
verses.text: Yahweh shall open for you his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rich⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “good”</note> storehouse, even the heavens, to give the rain for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> your land in its time and to bless all of the work of your hand, and you will lend to many nations; you will not borrow <transChange type="added">from them</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:13
verses.text: And Yahweh shall make you<note placement="foot">Literally “place/set you up”</note> as head and not the tail, and you shall be only at the top of the nations, and you shall not be at the bottom, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and diligently observe them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to observe them and to do them”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:14
verses.text: And you <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> not turn aside from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of”</note> the words that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> right or left by going after other gods to serve them.  <div eID="gen1487" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1171"/><div sID="gen1488" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1171"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it will happen”</note> if you do not listen to the voice of Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by diligently observing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to observe and to do”</note> all of his commandments and his statutes that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> then all of these curses shall come upon you, and they shall overtake you:  <div eID="gen1488" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1172"/><div sID="gen1489" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1172"/>“You <transChange type="added">shall</transChange><note placement="foot">All of these curses have a future orientation that points to Israel in the land of Canaan</note> be cursed in the city, and <transChange type="added">you shall</transChange> be cursed in the field.  <div eID="gen1489" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1173"/><div sID="gen1490" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1173"/>“Your basket <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> be cursed and your kneading trough.  <div eID="gen1490" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1174"/><div sID="gen1491" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1174"/>“The fruit of your womb <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> be cursed and the fruit of you ground, the calves of your cattle and the lambs of your flock.  <div eID="gen1491" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1175"/><div sID="gen1492" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1175"/>“You shall be cursed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you come in⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at/in your coming”</note> and you shall be cursed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you go out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “at/in your going out”</note>  <div eID="gen1492" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1176"/><div sID="gen1493" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1176"/>“Yahweh will send upon you<note placement="foot">Others translate as a wish: “may Yahweh send upon you …”</note> the curse,<note placement="foot">These words are translated variously, e.g., “starvation,” “thirst,” “rebuke/dysentery” (NEB) or “curses,” “confusion,” “frustration” (NLT)</note> the panic,<note placement="foot">Or “confusion”</note> and the threat<note placement="foot">Or “rebuke”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in everything that you undertake⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in all the sending out of your hand that you do”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until your to be destroyed and until your to perish quickly”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of the evil of your deeds”</note> the evil of your deeds in that<note placement="foot">Literally “which”</note> you have forsaken me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:21
verses.text: Yahweh will cause the plague to cling to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until it consumes you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it to consume to”</note> from the land that you are going to,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to there”</note> to take possession of it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:22
verses.text: Yahweh will afflict you with the wasting diseases and with the fever and with the inflammation and with the scorching heat and with the sword<note placement="foot">Others translate “drought” (NLT, NEB)</note> and with the blight and with the mildew, and they shall pursue you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until you perish⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until your/you to perish”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:23
verses.text: And your heavens that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> over your heads shall be <transChange type="added">like</transChange> bronze, and the earth that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> under you <transChange type="added">shall be like</transChange> iron.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:24
verses.text: Yahweh will change the rain of your land <transChange type="added">to</transChange> fine dust and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> sand; from the heaven it shall come down upon you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until you are destroyed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until your being destroyed”</note>  <div eID="gen1493" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1177"/><div sID="gen1494" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1177"/>“Yahweh shall cause you to be defeated <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> your enemies; on one road you shall go <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to/toward”</note> them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> but you will flee on seven roads <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> and you shall become a thing of horror to all of the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:26
verses.text: And your dead bodies shall be as food for all of the birds of the heaven and to the animals of the earth, and there shall not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone to frighten them away⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “one causing fright to them”</note>  <div eID="gen1494" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1178"/><div sID="gen1495" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1178"/>“Yahweh shall afflict you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors and with the scurvy and with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the skin rash that cannot be healed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the skin rash that not it is able it to be healed”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:28
verses.text: Yahweh shall afflict you with madness and with blindness and with confusion of heart.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:29
verses.text: And you shall be groping at noon just as the blind person gropes in the dark, and you shall not succeed <transChange type="added">in finding</transChange> your way, and you shall only be abused and robbed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all the days”</note> and there will not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone who will rescue you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “one who delivers/rescues you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:30
verses.text: You shall become engaged to a woman, but another man shall sleep<note placement="foot">Or “ravish/violate”</note> with her; you shall build a house, but you shall not live in it; a vineyard you shall plant, but you shall not enjoy it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:31
verses.text: Your ox <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> slaughtered before your eyes, and you shall not eat it; your donkey <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> stolen <transChange type="added">right</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> and it shall not be returned to you; your sheep and your goats shall be given to your enemies, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there shall not be anyone who rescues you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “there shall not be for you one who rescues”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:32
verses.text: Your sons and your daughters <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> given to other people, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will be looking on⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your eyes will see/look”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞longingly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wearing out”</note> for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> them all day, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but you will be powerless to do anything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “but there will not be for power of your hand”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:33
verses.text: A people that you do not know shall consume the harvest of your land and all your labor, and you will be only oppressed and crushed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the rest of your lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all of the days”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:34
verses.text: You shall become mad <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of what your eyes shall see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from/by the sight of your eyes”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:35
verses.text: Yahweh shall strike you with grievous boils on the knees and on the upper thighs <transChange type="added">from which</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not be able to be healed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “which not you are able to heal”</note> from the sole of your foot and up to your crown.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:36
verses.text: Yahweh will bring you and your king whom you set up over you to a nation that you or your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> have not known, and there you will serve other gods <transChange type="added">of</transChange> wood and stone.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:37
verses.text: And you will become a horror and a proverb and ridicule among all the peoples where Yahweh drives you there.  <div eID="gen1495" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1179"/><div sID="gen1496" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1179"/>“You shall carry out much seed to the field, but you shall gather little <transChange type="added">produce</transChange>, for the locust shall devour it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:39
verses.text: You shall plant vineyards and you shall dress<note placement="foot">Or “cultivate”</note> them, but you shall not drink wine and you shall not gather grapes, for the worm shall eat it.<note placement="foot">That is, the produce</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:40
verses.text: There shall be olive trees for you in all of your territory, but you shall not anoint <transChange type="added">yourself</transChange>, for your olives<note placement="foot">Hebrew “olive”</note> shall drop off.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:41
verses.text: You shall bear sons and daughters, but they shall not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yours⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for you”</note> for they shall go into captivity.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:42
verses.text: The cricket shall take possession of all your trees and the fruit of your ground.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:43
verses.text: The alien that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your midst shall ascend over you, higher <transChange type="added">and</transChange> higher, but you shall go down lower <transChange type="added">and</transChange> lower.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:44
verses.text: He shall lend to you, but you shall not lend to him; he shall be <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head, but you shall be <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tail.  <div eID="gen1496" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1180"/><div sID="gen1497" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1180"/>“And all of these curses shall come over you, and they shall pursue you, and they shall overtake you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until you are destroyed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until you to be destroyed”</note> because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you did not listen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not you listened”</note> to the voice of Yahweh your God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by observing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to observe”</note> his commandments and his statutes that he commanded you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:46
verses.text: And they shall be among you as a sign and as a wonder and among your offspring <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until eternity,” but not in a timeless, philosophic sense</note>  <div eID="gen1497" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1181"/><div sID="gen1498" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1181"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Under”</note> <transChange type="added">of the fact</transChange> that you did not serve Yahweh your God with joy and with gladness of heart for the abundance of everything,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:48
verses.text: then you shall serve your enemies, whom Yahweh will send against you <transChange type="added">under conditions of</transChange> famine, in thirst, in nakedness, and in <transChange type="added">a</transChange> lack of everything; and he shall place<note placement="foot">Literally “give”</note> a yoke of iron on your neck <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until he has destroyed you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until his destroying of you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:49
verses.text: Yahweh will raise <transChange type="added">up</transChange> against you a nation from far <transChange type="added">off</transChange>, from the end of the earth, <transChange type="added">attacking</transChange> as the eagle swoops <transChange type="added">down</transChange>, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a nation whose language you will not understand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a nation who not you will understand its language”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:50
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a grim-faced nation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a nation fierce/determined of face”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who does not show respect⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who not lifts up faces”</note> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> old and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young <transChange type="added">and</transChange> does not show pity.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:51
verses.text: And it<note placement="foot">That is, the invading nation</note> shall consume the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until you are destroyed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until your destroying”</note> and who will not leave for you any grain, wine, and olive oil, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞calves of your herds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “what is dropped of your herds”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lambs of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the offspring of small animals”</note> your flock <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until it has destroyed you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until his to destroy you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:52
verses.text: And it shall besiege you in all your towns <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until your high and fortified walls fall⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until the coming down of your walls, high and fortified”</note> which you are trusting in<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in them,” which is redundant</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout your land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “in all of your land”</note> and it shall besiege you in all of your towns in all of your land that Yahweh your God has given to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:53
verses.text: And you shall eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of your sons and your daughters, whom Yahweh your God gave to you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞during the siege and during the distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in siege and in distress”</note> your enemy inflicts upon you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:54
verses.text: The most refined and the very sensitive<note placement="foot">Or “kindly disposed”</note> man among you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall be mean with his brother⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shall be bad/evil his eye against his brother”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against his beloved wife⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “against the wife of his lap”</note> and against the rest<note placement="foot">Or “remainder”</note> of his children that he has left over,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:55
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by refraining from giving⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from giving”</note> to even one of them any of the meat of his children that he eats, because there is not anything that is left over for him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞during the siege and distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the siege and distress”</note> that your enemy inflicts upon you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:56
verses.text: The most refined and the <transChange type="added">most</transChange> delicate <transChange type="added">woman</transChange> among you, who shall<note placement="foot">Or “would”</note> not venture to put the sole of her foot on the ground from being so delicate and from such gentleness, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall be mean to her beloved husband⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shall be bad her eye against the husband of her lap”</note> and against her son and against her daughter,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:57
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">even</transChange> concerning her afterbirth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that goes out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the going out”</note> from between her feet and also concerning her children that she bears, because she eats them for lack of anything in secret <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞during the siege and during the distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the siege and in the distress”</note> that your enemy inflicts upon her in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note>  <div eID="gen1498" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1182"/><div sID="gen1499" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1182"/>“If <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you do not diligently observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you observe to do”</note> all the words of this law written in this scroll by revering this glorious and awesome name, Yahweh your God,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:59
verses.text: then Yahweh shall overwhelm <transChange type="added">you</transChange> with your plagues and the plagues of your offspring, severe plagues and lasting illnesses, grievous and enduring.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:60
verses.text: And he shall bring back upon you all the diseases of Egypt <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> which <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you were in dread⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you dreaded”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from their presence”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:61
verses.text: Also any illness and any plague<note placement="foot">Or “each illness and each plague”</note> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not written in the scroll of this law, he shall bring them, Yahweh, upon you until you are destroyed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:62
verses.text: And you shall remain <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞only a few people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with people of few”</note> in place of <transChange type="added">the fact</transChange> you were <transChange type="added">formerly</transChange> as the stars of heaven as far as number <transChange type="added">is concerned</transChange>, because you did not listen to the voice of Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:63
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> as Yahweh delighted over you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to make you prosperous⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to do good with you”</note> to make you numerous, so Yahweh shall delight over you to exterminate you<note placement="foot">Or “to cause you to perish”</note> and to destroy you, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you shall be plucked from the land that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> going there to take possession of it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:64
verses.text: And Yahweh shall scatter you among all the nations from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> end of the earth up to the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> end of the earth, and there you shall serve other gods that you have not known nor<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “your fathers”</note> <transChange type="added">gods of</transChange> wood and stone.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:65
verses.text: And among these nations you shall not find rest, and <transChange type="added">there</transChange> shall not be a resting place for the sole of your foot, and Yahweh shall give you there an anxious heart and a weakening of eyes<note placement="foot">Or “a failure of eyes”</note> and a languishing of your inner self.<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:66
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your life shall hang in doubt before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they shall be your life hanging for you in front”</note> and you shall be startled<note placement="foot">Or “in fear”</note> night and day, and you shall not be confident of your life.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:67
verses.text: In the morning you shall say, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞If only it was evening⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!’<note placement="foot">Literally “Who shall give evening?”</note> and in the evening you shall say ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞If only it was morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!’<note placement="foot">Literally “Who shall give morning?”</note> because of the dread of your heart that you shall feel, and because of the sight of your eyes that you shall see.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:68
verses.text: And Yahweh shall bring you back <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt in ships by the route that I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note> to you that ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You shall not see it again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!’<note placement="foot">Literally “you shall not do again further to see it/her”</note> And you shall sell yourself there to your enemies as slaves and as female slaves, but there will not be a buyer.”  <chapter eID="Deut.28"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1183"/><title type="x-s">Covenant Renewal, Oaths, Restoration, Charges to the Nation</title> <div sID="gen1500" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1183"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Deut.29.1-Deut.29.29">Deuteronomy 29:1–29 </reference>in the English Bible is 28.69–29:28 in the Hebrew Bible</note> These are the words of the covenant that Yahweh commanded Moses to make with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> in the land of Moab <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞besides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from to alone”</note> the covenant that he made with them at Horeb.  <div eID="gen1500" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1184"/><div sID="gen1501" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1184"/>And Moses summoned all of Israel and said to them, “You saw all that Yahweh did before your eyes in the land of Egypt and to Pharaoh and to all his servants and to all his land;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, the great trials that your eyes saw, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> those great signs and wonders.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:4
verses.text: But Yahweh has not given to you a heart to understand, or eyes to see, or ears to hear, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to this day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until the day the this”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:5
verses.text: And I have led you forty years<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> in the desert; your clothes have not worn out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from on you”</note> and your sandal has not worn out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on your foot⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from on your foot”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:6
verses.text: You have not eaten bread, and you have not drunk wine and strong drink, so that you may know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:7
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> you came to this place <transChange type="added">then</transChange> Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out to meet you for battle, and we defeated them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:8
verses.text: And we took their land and gave it as <transChange type="added">an</transChange> inheritance to the Reubenites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Reubenite”</note> and to the Gadites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gadite”</note> and to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:9
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you must diligently observe the words of this covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you must keep the words of the covenant the this and you must do them”</note> so that you may succeed in all that you do.  <div eID="gen1501" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1185"/><div sID="gen1502" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1185"/>“You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> all of you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh your God, your leaders, your tribes, your elders, and your officials, all the men of Israel,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:11
verses.text: your little children, your women and your aliens<note placement="foot">Hebrew “alien”</note> who are in the midst of your camp, from the choppers<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chopper”</note> of your wood to the drawers<note placement="foot">Hebrew “drawer”</note> of your water,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:12
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in order for you to enter into the covenant of Yahweh your God⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for you to go over into the covenant of Yahweh your God”</note> and into<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> his oath that Yahweh your God is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞making with you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cutting with you”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:13
verses.text: in order to establish you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for him”</note> as a people and so that he may be for you as God, just as he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note> to you and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “according to that which”</note> he swore to your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “your fathers”</note> to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.  <div eID="gen1502" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1186"/><div sID="gen1503" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1186"/>“Now I am not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞making this covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cutting this covenant”</note> and this oath <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with you alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with you to alone you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:15
verses.text: But with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whoever is standing here⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with who he is here with us standing”</note> with us <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh our God, and with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whoever is not standing here⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with who he is not standing here with us”</note> with us <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:16
verses.text: For you know how we lived in the land of Egypt and how we traveled through the midst of the nations that you traveled<note placement="foot">Or “journeyed”</note> through.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:17
verses.text: And you have seen their detestable things and their idols of wood and stone, silver, and gold that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> among them,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:18
verses.text: so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there is not⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lest there be/develop”</note> among you a man or a woman or a clan or a tribe <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his heart”</note> turns <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> with Yahweh our God to go to serve the gods of these nations, so that there is not among you a root sprouting poison and wormwood.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:19
verses.text: And then when he hears the words of this oath, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will assure himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he will bless himself”; HALOT 160 suggests “to consider oneself fortunate”</note> in his heart, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Safety shall be mine even though I go in the stubbornness of my heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,’<note placement="foot">Literally “Peace shall happen/be for me, although/even if in the stubbornness of my heart I go”</note> thereby destroying the well-watered land along with the parched.<note placement="foot">Some translators prefer to include the last clause as a part of the words of the wicked man (NASV vs. NEB)</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:20
verses.text: Yahweh will not be willing to forgive him, for <transChange type="added">by then</transChange> the anger of Yahweh will smoke, and his passion against that man and all the curses written in this scroll will descend on him, and Yahweh will blot out his name from under heaven.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:21
verses.text: And Yahweh will single him out for calamity out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in the scroll of this law.  <div eID="gen1503" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1187"/><div sID="gen1504" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1187"/>“And the next generation, <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, your children who will rise <transChange type="added">up</transChange> after you, and the foreigner who will come from a distant land, when<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> they will see the plagues of that land and its diseases that Yahweh has inflicted upon it, will say,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:23
verses.text: ‘All its land is brimstone and salt left by fire, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞none of its land will be sown⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all of its land will not be sown”</note> and it will not make plants sprout out and it will not grow any vegetation; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> as the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Adman and Zeboiim, which Yahweh overturned in his anger and in his wrath.’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:24
verses.text: And all the nations will say, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Why⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “On what basis”</note> has Yahweh done <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞such a thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “so”</note> to this land? What <transChange type="added">caused</transChange> the fierceness of this great anger?’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:25
verses.text: And they will say,<note placement="foot">Or “answer/respond”</note> ‘It is because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> which he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> with them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he brought them out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at/in his to bring them out from the land of Egypt”</note> from the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:26
verses.text: And they went and served other gods and bowed down to them, gods whom they did not know them and he<note placement="foot">That is, Yahweh</note> had not allotted to them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:27
verses.text: So <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the anger of Yahweh was kindled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “became hot the nose of Yahweh”</note> against that land to bring upon it all the curses written in this scroll,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:28
verses.text: and Yahweh uprooted them from their land in anger and in wrath and in great fury, and he cast them into another land, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as it is today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “as the day the this”</note>  <div eID="gen1504" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1188"/><div sID="gen1505" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1188"/>“The hidden <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belong to Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “are for Yahweh”</note> our God, but the revealed things <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belong to us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “are for us”</note> to know and to our children <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until eternity”</note> <transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to do all the words of this law.”  <chapter eID="Deut.29"/> <div eID="gen1505" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:1
verses.text: “And then when all of these things come upon you, the blessing and the curse that I have set <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and you call them to mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and you bring them back to your heart”</note> among the nations there where Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">has</transChange> scattered you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:2
verses.text: and you return to Yahweh and you listen to his voice according to all that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> both you and your children,<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> with all your heart and with all your inner self,<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:3
verses.text: and Yahweh your God will restore your fortunes, and he will have compassion <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> you, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will again gather you together⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he will do again and he will gather you together”</note> from all the peoples where Yahweh your God scattered you there.  <div eID="gen1506" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1189"/><div sID="gen1507" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1189"/>“<transChange type="added">Even</transChange> if <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you are outcasts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he/it shall be outcasting your”</note> at the end of the heavens, even from there Yahweh your God shall gather you, and from there <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he shall bring you back⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he shall take/fetch you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:5
verses.text: And Yahweh your God will bring you to the land that your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> had taken possession of,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of it”</note> and he will make you successful, and he will make you more numerous than your ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>  <div eID="gen1507" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1190"/><div sID="gen1508" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1190"/>“And Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart and the heart of your offspring to love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that you may live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for the sake of your life”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:7
verses.text: And Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on those who hate you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the haters of you”</note> on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who harassed you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “who pursued after/persecuted you”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:8
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will again listen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you will return and you will listen”</note> to the voice of Yahweh, and you will do all his commandments that I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:9
verses.text: And Yahweh your God will make you prosperous <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in all your undertakings⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in all of the work of your hand”</note> and in the fruit of your livestock and in the fruit of your ground <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞abundantly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to/for good”</note> for Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will again rejoice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he will return ... to rejoice”</note> over you, just as he rejoiced over your ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:10
