verses.text: <transChange type="added">He will do this</transChange> if you listen to<note placement="foot">Or “if you obey/hearken to”</note> the voice of Yahweh your God by keeping his commandment and his statutes written in the scroll of this law and if you return to Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your inner self.<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note>  <div eID="gen1508" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1191"/><div sID="gen1509" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1191"/>“For this commandment that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞not too wonderful for you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “not is wonderful it from you”</note> and it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">too</transChange> far <transChange type="added">from you</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:12
verses.text: It is not in the heavens <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that you might say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Who will go up for us to the heavens and get it for us and cause us to hear it, so that we may do it?’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:13
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞not beyond the sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “is not from beyond the sea”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that you might say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Who will cross for us to the other side of the sea and take it for us and cause us to hear it, so that we may do it?’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:14
verses.text: But the word is very near you, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> in your mouth and in your heart, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that you may do it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to do it”</note>  <div eID="gen1509" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1192"/><div sID="gen1510" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1192"/>“See, I am setting <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> life and prosperity and death and disaster;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:16
verses.text: what I am commanding you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> is to love Yahweh your God by going<note placement="foot">Or “walking”</note> in his ways and by keeping his commandments and his statutes and his regulations, and then you will live, and you will become numerous, and Yahweh your God will bless you in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞land where you are going⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the land where you are going there”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:17
verses.text: However, if your heart turns aside and you <transChange type="added">do</transChange> not listen and you are lured away and you bow down to other gods and you serve them,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:18
verses.text: I declare to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> that you will certainly perish; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not extend your time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you will not make long days”</note> on the land that you are crossing the Jordan to go there to take possession of it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:19
verses.text: I invoke as a witness against you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> the heaven and the earth: life and death I have set <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> blessing and curse. So choose life, so that you may live, you and your offspring,<note placement="foot">Or “seed”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:20
verses.text: by loving Yahweh your God by listening to his voice and by clinging to him, for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your life and the length of your days <transChange type="added">in order for you</transChange> to live on the land that Yahweh swore to your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them.”  <chapter eID="Deut.30"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1193"/><title type="x-s">Succession, Deposition, and Recitation of Text</title> <div sID="gen1511" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1193"/>And Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:2
verses.text: And he said to them, “I am <transChange type="added">a</transChange> hundred and twenty years old <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> I am not able to go out and to come <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer, and Yahweh said to me, ‘You may not cross this Jordan.’

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:3
verses.text: Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is about to</transChange> cross <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> he will destroy these nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will be crossing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> just as Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “spoke”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:4
verses.text: And Yahweh will do to them <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and to their land, which he destroyed with them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:5
verses.text: And Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will deliver them to you before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “will give them Yahweh to the face of you”</note> and you shall do to them according to every commandment that I have commanded you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:6
verses.text: Be strong and be courageous; you should not be afraid, and you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞should not be in dread from their presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “not you should dread from their face”</note> for Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> going with you; he will not leave you alone and he will not forsake you.”  <div eID="gen1511" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1194"/><div sID="gen1512" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1194"/>Then Moses summoned Joshua, and he said to him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the presence of all Israel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “before the eyes of all Israel”</note> “Be strong and be courageous, for you will go with this people into the land that Yahweh swore to their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “their fathers”</note> to give to them, and you will give it to them as an inheritance.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:8
verses.text: Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> going <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> he will be with you, and he will not leave you alone, and he will not forsake you; you shall not be afraid, and you shall not be discouraged.”

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:9
verses.text: So Moses wrote this law, and he gave it to the priests, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Levi, the <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> carrying the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, and to all the elders of Israel.  <div eID="gen1512" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1195"/><div sID="gen1513" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1195"/>Then Moses commanded them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “At the end of seven years, in the time of the year for canceling debts during the Feast of Booths,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:11
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when all Israel comes to appear before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at/in the coming of all of Israel to see”</note> Yahweh their God at the place that he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their hearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in their ears”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:12
verses.text: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little children and your aliens that are in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “gates”</note> so that they may hear and so that they may learn and they may revere Yahweh your God, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they shall diligently observe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they shall keep to do”</note> all the words of this law.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:13
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> their children,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “child”</note> who have not known, they too may hear, and they may learn to revere Yahweh their God all the days <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that you live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that you are alive”</note> on the land that you are crossing the Jordan <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to get there⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there”</note> to take possession of it.”  <div eID="gen1513" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1196"/><div sID="gen1514" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1196"/>Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Look, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you are about to die⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “are near your days to die”</note> call Joshua and present yourselves in the tent of assembly,<note placement="foot">Or “meeting”</note> so that I may instruct him.” So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves in<note placement="foot">Or “at”</note> the tent of assembly.<note placement="foot">Or “meeting”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:15
verses.text: And Yahweh appeared in the tent in a column of cloud, and the column of the cloud stood at the entrance of the tent.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:16
verses.text: And Yahweh said to Moses, “Look, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to lie <transChange type="added">down</transChange> with your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and this people will arise and they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> will play the prostitute after <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the foreign gods⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the gods of the foreigner/foreign person of the land”</note> of the land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to which they are going⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “which he is going to”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:17
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my anger shall flare up against them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shall become my nose against it/him”</note> on that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> shall become as prey, and disasters and troubles shall find<note placement="foot">Or “encounter”</note> them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> and they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> shall say on that day, ‘Is it not because our<note placement="foot">Hebrew “my” but represents all the people</note> God is not in our<note placement="foot">Hebrew “my”</note> midst that these disasters have found<note placement="foot">Or “encountered”</note> us?’<note placement="foot">Hebrew “me”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:18
verses.text: But I will certainly hide my face on that day, because <transChange type="added">of</transChange> all of the evil that they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> did because they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> turned to other gods.  <div eID="gen1514" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1197"/><div sID="gen1515" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1197"/>“And so then write this song for yourselves and teach it to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> put it in their mouth, so that this song may be for me as a witness against the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:20
verses.text: For when I bring them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him,” referring to the people</note> into the land that I swore to their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> a land flowing with milk and honey, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will eat their fill⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he will eat and he will be satisfied”</note> and they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> will become fat, and then they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> will turn to other gods, and they will serve them, and they will spurn me, and they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> will break my covenant.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:21
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it shall happen”</note> many disasters and troubles will come upon them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> and this song will give evidence before them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> as a witness, because it will not be forgotten from out of the mouth of their descendants,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his offspring/descendant”</note> for I know their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> inclination that they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> are having <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> before I have brought them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> into the land that I swore.”

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:22
verses.text: And Moses wrote this song on that day and taught it <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <div eID="gen1515" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1198"/><div sID="gen1516" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1198"/>Then he<note placement="foot">That is, Yahweh</note> told Joshua the son of Nun, and said to him, “Be strong and be courageous, for you shall bring the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> into the land that I swore to them, and I will be with you.”  <div eID="gen1516" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1199"/><div sID="gen1517" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1199"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then when Moses finished writing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it happened as/when to finish Moses to write”</note> the words of this law on the scroll <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until they were complete⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until their to be complete/”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:25
verses.text: then Moses commanded the Levites carrying the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:26
verses.text: “Take the scroll of this law and put it at the side of the ark of the covenant of Yahweh your God, and it will be there as a witness against you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:27
verses.text: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck <transChange type="added">even now</transChange> while I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> still alive with you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> rebelling against Yahweh, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how much more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and also for/indeed”</note> after my death.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:28
verses.text: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officials, so that I may speak in their ears these words, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I may call as witness against them heaven and earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:29
verses.text: For I know that after my death you will certainly act corruptly, and you will turn aside from the way that I have commanded you, and the disaster in the future days will befall you, because you will do evil<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the evil”; the definite article indicates the general concept of evil</note> in the eyes of Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞provoking him with the work of your hands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “to provoke him with/by the work of your hands”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:30
verses.text: So Moses spoke into the ears of the assembly of Israel the words of this song <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until they were complete⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until their to be complete”</note>  <chapter eID="Deut.31"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1200"/><title type="x-s">The Song of Moses</title> <div sID="gen1518" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen1518" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen1519"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1200"/>“Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak,<l eID="gen1520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1521"/>and let the earth hear the words of my mouth. <l eID="gen1521" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1201"/><l level="1" sID="gen1522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1201"/>May my teaching trickle like the dew,<l eID="gen1522" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1523"/>my words like rain showers on tender grass,<l eID="gen1523" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1524"/>and like spring showers on new growth. <l eID="gen1524" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1202"/><l level="1" sID="gen1525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1202"/>For I will proclaim the name of Yahweh;<l eID="gen1525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1526"/>ascribe greatness to our God! <l eID="gen1526" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1203"/><l level="1" sID="gen1527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1203"/>The Rock, his work <transChange type="added">is</transChange> perfect,<l eID="gen1527" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1528"/>for all his ways <transChange type="added">are</transChange> just;<l eID="gen1528" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1529"/><transChange type="added">he is</transChange> a faithful God, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without injustice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not injustice”</note><l eID="gen1529" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1530"/>righteous and upright <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he. <l eID="gen1530" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1204"/><l level="1" sID="gen1531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1204"/>They <transChange type="added">have</transChange> behaved corruptly toward<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> him;<l eID="gen1531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1532"/><transChange type="added">they are</transChange> not his children; <transChange type="added">this is</transChange> their flaw,<l eID="gen1532" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1533"/>a generation crooked and perverse. <l eID="gen1533" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1205"/><l level="1" sID="gen1534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1205"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> this do you treat Yahweh,<l eID="gen1534" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1535"/>foolish and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞unwise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not wise”</note> people?<l eID="gen1535" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1536"/><transChange type="added">Has</transChange> he not, your father, created you?<l eID="gen1536" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1537"/>He made you, and he established you. <l eID="gen1537" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1206"/><l level="1" sID="gen1538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1206"/>Remember <transChange type="added">the</transChange> old days, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the years long past⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the years of from generation to generation”</note><l eID="gen1538" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1539"/>ask your father, and he will inform you,<l eID="gen1539" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1540"/>your elders and they will tell you.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to you”</note> <l eID="gen1540" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1207"/><l level="1" sID="gen1541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1207"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When the Most High apportioned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In/at the apportioning of the Most High”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations,<l eID="gen1541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1542"/>at his dividing <transChange type="added">up</transChange> of the sons of humankind,<l eID="gen1542" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1543"/>he fixed the boundaries of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen1543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1544"/>according to the number of the children of Israel.<note placement="foot">LXX reads “the number of the angels of God”; Dead Sea Scrolls reads “the number of the sons of God”</note> <l eID="gen1544" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1208"/><l level="1" sID="gen1545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1208"/>For Yahweh’s portion <transChange type="added">was</transChange> his people,<l eID="gen1545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1546"/>Jacob the share of his inheritance. <l eID="gen1546" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1209"/><l level="1" sID="gen1547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1209"/>He found him in a desert land,<l eID="gen1547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1548"/>and in a howling, desert wasteland;<l eID="gen1548" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1549"/>he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞encircled him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “moved around him”</note> he cared for him,<l eID="gen1549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1550"/>he protected him like the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞apple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “pupil”</note> of his eye. <l eID="gen1550" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1210"/><l level="1" sID="gen1551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1210"/>As an eagle stirs up its nest,<l eID="gen1551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1552"/>hovers over its young,<l eID="gen1552" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1553"/>spreads out its wings, takes them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it” but used poetically and with plural sense in context</note><l eID="gen1553" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1554"/>carries them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it” but used poetically and with plural sense in context</note> on its pinions,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “pinion”</note> <l eID="gen1554" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1211"/><l level="1" sID="gen1555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1211"/><transChange type="added">so</transChange> Yahweh alone guided him,<note placement="foot">That is, Jacob, standing for Israel</note><l eID="gen1555" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1556"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there was no foreign god accompanying him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and there was not with him a god foreign/strange”</note> <l eID="gen1556" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1212"/><l level="1" sID="gen1557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1212"/>And he set him on the high places of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen1557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1558"/>and he fed <transChange type="added">him</transChange> the crops<note placement="foot">Hebrew “crop”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> field,<l eID="gen1558" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1559"/>and he nursed him with honey from crags,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “crag”</note><l eID="gen1559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1560"/>and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> oil from flinty rock, <l eID="gen1560" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1213"/><l level="1" sID="gen1561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1213"/><transChange type="added">With</transChange> curds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “curd”</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> herd,<l eID="gen1561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1562"/>and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> milk from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flock,<l eID="gen1562" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1563"/>with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fat of young rams,<l eID="gen1563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1564"/>and rams, the offspring of Bashan,<l eID="gen1564" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1565"/>and with goats <transChange type="added">along</transChange> with the finest kernels of wheat,<l eID="gen1565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1566"/>and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> the blood of grapes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “grape”</note> you drank fermented wine.<note placement="foot">Or “partially fermented wine”; others translate simply as wine (NASB, NEB); HALOT 330, “still fermenting wine”</note> <l eID="gen1566" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1214"/><l level="1" sID="gen1567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1214"/>And Jeshurun grew fat, and he kicked;<l eID="gen1567" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1568"/>you grew fat, you bloated, and you became obstinate;<l eID="gen1568" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1569"/>and he abandoned God, his maker,<l eID="gen1569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1570"/>and he scoffed <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the rock of his salvation. <l eID="gen1570" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1215"/><l level="1" sID="gen1571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1215"/>They made him jealous with strange <transChange type="added">gods</transChange>;<l eID="gen1571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1572"/>with detestable things they provoked him. <l eID="gen1572" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1216"/><l level="1" sID="gen1573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1216"/>They sacrificed to the demons, not God,<l eID="gen1573" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1574"/><transChange type="added">to</transChange> gods whom<note placement="foot">Hebrew “them”</note> they had not known,<l eID="gen1574" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1575"/>new <transChange type="added">gods</transChange> <transChange type="added">who</transChange><note placement="foot">Hebrew “they,” understood in the verb form</note> came from recent times;<l eID="gen1575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1576"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their ancestors had not known them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “their fathers not knew them”</note> <l eID="gen1576" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1217"/><l level="1" sID="gen1577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1217"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> rock who<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he,” understood in verb form</note> bore you, you neglected,<l eID="gen1577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1578"/>and you forgot God, <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> giving you birth. <l eID="gen1578" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1218"/><l level="1" sID="gen1579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1218"/>Then Yahweh saw, and he spurned <transChange type="added">them</transChange>,<l eID="gen1579" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1580"/>because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters. <l eID="gen1580" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1219"/><l level="1" sID="gen1581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1219"/>So he said, ‘I will hide my face from them;<l eID="gen1581" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1582"/>I will see what <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> their end,<l eID="gen1582" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1583"/>for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a generation of perversity,<l eID="gen1583" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1584"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞children in whom there is no faithfulness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons not faithfulness is in them”</note> <l eID="gen1584" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1220"/><l level="1" sID="gen1585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1220"/>They annoyed me with <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> not a god;<l eID="gen1585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1586"/>they provoked me with their idols.<l eID="gen1586" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1587"/>So I will make them jealous with <transChange type="added">those</transChange> not a people,<l eID="gen1587" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1588"/>with a foolish nation I will provoke them. <l eID="gen1588" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1221"/><l level="1" sID="gen1589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1221"/>For a fire was kindled<note placement="foot">Or “ignited”</note> by my anger,<l eID="gen1589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1590"/>and it burned <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞up to the depths of Sheol⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “up to Sheol depths”</note><l eID="gen1590" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1591"/>and it devoured <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth and its produce,<l eID="gen1591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1592"/>and it set afire the foundation of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains. <l eID="gen1592" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1222"/><l level="1" sID="gen1593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1222"/>I will heap disasters upon them;<l eID="gen1593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1594"/>my arrows I will spend on them. <l eID="gen1594" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1223"/><l level="1" sID="gen1595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1223"/><transChange type="added">They will become</transChange> weakened by famine,<l eID="gen1595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1596"/>and consumed by plague and bitter pestilence;<l eID="gen1596" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1597"/>and the teeth of wild animals I will send against them,<l eID="gen1597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1598"/>with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poison of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> creeping <transChange type="added">things</transChange> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust; <l eID="gen1598" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1224"/><l level="1" sID="gen1599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1224"/>From outside <transChange type="added">her boundaries</transChange> the sword will make <transChange type="added">her</transChange> childless,<l eID="gen1599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1600"/>and from inside, terror;<l eID="gen1600" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1601"/>both <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young man <transChange type="added">and</transChange> also the young woman,<l eID="gen1601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1602"/>the infant <transChange type="added">along with</transChange> the gray-headed man. <l eID="gen1602" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1225"/><l level="1" sID="gen1603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1225"/>I thought, “I will wipe them out;<l eID="gen1603" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1604"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will make people forget they ever existed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “I will blot out from among human being their remembrance”</note> <l eID="gen1604" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1226"/><l level="1" sID="gen1605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1226"/>If I had not feared a provocation of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy,<l eID="gen1605" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1606"/>lest their foes might misunderstand,<note placement="foot">Or “so that they not make a false construal” of what has happened</note><l eID="gen1606" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1607"/>lest they should say,<note placement="foot">Or “so that they might not”</note> “Our hand is<l eID="gen1607" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1608"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞triumphant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “raised/held high”</note> and Yahweh <transChange type="added">did</transChange> not do all this.” ’ <l eID="gen1608" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1227"/><l level="1" sID="gen1609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1227"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they are a nation void of sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they a nation perishing of counsel”</note><l eID="gen1609" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1610"/>and there is not <transChange type="added">any</transChange> understanding in them. <l eID="gen1610" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1228"/><l level="1" sID="gen1611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1228"/>If only they were wise, they would understand this;<l eID="gen1611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1612"/>they would discern <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for themselves their end⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they would discern for end their”</note> <l eID="gen1612" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1229"/><l level="1" sID="gen1613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1229"/>How could one chase a thousand<l eID="gen1613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1614"/>and two could cause a myriad to flee,<l eID="gen1614" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1615"/>if their Rock had not sold them,<l eID="gen1615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1616"/>and Yahweh had <transChange type="added">not</transChange> given them up? <l eID="gen1616" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1230"/><l level="1" sID="gen1617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1230"/>For the fact of the matter is,<l eID="gen1617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1618"/>their rock <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not like our Rock,<l eID="gen1618" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1619"/>and our enemies recognize<note placement="foot">The meaning of this expression is uncertain, but “discerns” or “judges” seem good choices; see HALOT 932, which allows for “judges” or “in the estimation of our enemies”</note> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>. <l eID="gen1619" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1231"/><l level="1" sID="gen1620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1231"/>For their vine <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from the vine of Sodom,<l eID="gen1620" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1621"/>and from the terraces of Gomorrah;<l eID="gen1621" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1622"/>their grapes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> grapes of poison;<l eID="gen1622" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1623"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their clusters are bitter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “clusters of bitter are for them”</note> <l eID="gen1623" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1232"/><l level="1" sID="gen1624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1232"/>Their wine <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the poison of snakes,<l eID="gen1624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1625"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deadly poison of horned vipers. <l eID="gen1625" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1233"/><l level="1" sID="gen1626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1233"/>‘<transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not this stored up with me,<l eID="gen1626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1627"/>sealed in my treasuries?’<note placement="foot">Or “storehouses</note> <l eID="gen1627" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1234"/><l level="1" sID="gen1628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1234"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Vengeance belongs to me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To me is vengeance”</note> and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> recompense,<l eID="gen1628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1629"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for at the time their foot slips⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at the time when it shall slip foot their”</note><l eID="gen1629" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1630"/>because the day of their disaster <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near,<l eID="gen1630" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1631"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and fate comes quickly for them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “and comes quickly/hurries events to come to them”</note> <l eID="gen1631" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1235"/><l level="1" sID="gen1632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1235"/>For Yahweh will judge <transChange type="added">on behalf of</transChange> his people,<l eID="gen1632" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1633"/>and concerning his servants;<l eID="gen1633" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1634"/>he will change his mind when he sees that <transChange type="added">their</transChange> power has disappeared,<l eID="gen1634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1635"/>and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no one left, confined<note placement="foot">Or “bond/bound”</note> or free.<note placement="foot">Or “freed”</note> <l eID="gen1635" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1236"/><l level="1" sID="gen1636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1236"/>And he will say, ‘Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> their gods,<l eID="gen1636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1637"/><transChange type="added">their</transChange> rock in whom<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in him”</note> they took refuge? <l eID="gen1637" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1237"/><l level="1" sID="gen1638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1237"/>Who ate the fat of their sacrifices<l eID="gen1638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1639"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> drank the wine of their libations?<l eID="gen1639" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1640"/>Let them rise <transChange type="added">up</transChange>, and let them help you;<l eID="gen1640" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1641"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Let them be to you a refuge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “let there be/him/them unto you as a shelter”</note> <l eID="gen1641" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1238"/><l level="1" sID="gen1642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1238"/>See, now, that I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he,<l eID="gen1642" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1643"/>and there is not a god besides me;<l eID="gen1643" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1644"/>I put to death and I give life;<l eID="gen1644" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1645"/>I wound and I heal;<l eID="gen1645" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1646"/>there is not <transChange type="added">one</transChange> who delivers from my hand! <l eID="gen1646" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1239"/><l level="1" sID="gen1647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1239"/>For <transChange type="added">indeed</transChange> I lift up my hand to heaven,<l eID="gen1647" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1648"/>And I promise <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as I live forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “live I to eternity”</note> <l eID="gen1648" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1240"/><l level="1" sID="gen1649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1240"/>When I sharpen<note placement="foot">Or “have sharpened”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my flashing sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the flashing of my sword”</note><l eID="gen1649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1650"/>and my hand takes hold<note placement="foot">Or “seizes”</note> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange> in judgment,<l eID="gen1650" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1651"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will take reprisals against my foes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I will let return vengeance to foes my”</note><l eID="gen1651" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1652"/>and my haters I will repay. <l eID="gen1652" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1241"/><l level="1" sID="gen1653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1241"/>I will make my arrows drunk with blood,<l eID="gen1653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1654"/>and my sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain,<l eID="gen1654" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1655"/>and captives<note placement="foot">Hebrew “captive”</note> from the heads<note placement="foot">Hebrew “head”</note> of the leaders of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy.’ <l eID="gen1655" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1242"/><l level="1" sID="gen1656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1242"/>Call for songs of joy, O nations, <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> his people,<note placement="foot">Dead Sea Scrolls reads: “Rejoice, O heavenly ones, with him! Bow down, all you gods, before him!”</note><l eID="gen1656" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1657"/>for the blood of his servants he will avenge,<l eID="gen1657" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1658"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and he will take reprisals against his foes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “vengeance he will let return to his foes”</note><l eID="gen1658" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1659"/>and he will make atonement <transChange type="added">for</transChange> his land, his people.” <l eID="gen1659" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1519"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1243"/><div sID="gen1660" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1243"/>And Moses came, and he spoke<note placement="foot">Or “recited”</note> all the words of this song in the ears of the people; <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:45
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And when Moses finished speaking⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And he finished Moses to speak”</note> all these words to all Israel,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:46
verses.text: then he said to them, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Take to heart all the words⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Put heart your to all the words”</note> that I am admonishing against you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> concerning which you should instruct them with respect to your children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that they will observe diligently⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to keep to do”</note> all the words of this law,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:47
verses.text: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not a trifling matter among you, but it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your life, and through this word <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will live long in the land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you will make long days on the land”</note> that you <transChange type="added">are about</transChange> to cross the Jordan <transChange type="added">to get</transChange> there to take possession of it.”  <div eID="gen1660" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1244"/><title type="x-s">Instructions Concerning Moses’ Death</title> <div sID="gen1661" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1244"/>And Yahweh said to Moses on exactly this day, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:49
verses.text: “Go up to this mountain of the Abarim <transChange type="added">range</transChange>, Mount Nebo, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞opposite Jericho⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “on the face of Jericho”</note> and see the land of Canaan that I am giving to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> possession.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:50
verses.text: You shall die on that mountain that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to go up there, and <transChange type="added">you will</transChange> be gathered to your people, <transChange type="added">just</transChange> as your brother Aaron died on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Hor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on Hor the mountain”</note> and he was gathered to his people,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:51
verses.text: because <transChange type="added">of the fact</transChange> that you broke faith with me in the midst of Israel at the waters of Meribah Kadesh, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the desert of Zin, because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you did not treat me as holy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that not you treated me as holy”</note> in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:52
verses.text: Yes, from afar you may view the land, but there you shall not enter there, <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, into the land that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> giving to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <chapter eID="Deut.32"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1245"/><title type="x-s">Blessings of Moses on Israel</title> <div sID="gen1662" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1245"/>Now<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> this is the blessing with which Moses, the man of God, blessed the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> his death.  <div eID="gen1662" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1246"/><div sID="gen1663" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1246"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he said, <div eID="gen1663" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen1664"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1665"/>“Yahweh came from Sinai,<l eID="gen1665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1666"/>and he dawned upon them from Seir;<l eID="gen1666" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1667"/>he shone forth from Mount Paran,<l eID="gen1667" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1668"/>and he came with myriads of holy ones,<l eID="gen1668" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1669"/>at his right hand a fiery law for them.<note placement="foot">This pointing of the MT is very difficult; here HALOT 93 suggests “fire a law for them” as a translation of the compound Hebrew word made up of “fire” + “law,” which I render as “a fiery law”</note> <l eID="gen1669" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1247"/><l level="1" sID="gen1670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1247"/>Moreover,<note placement="foot">Or “Indeed”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he loves his people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a lover of peoples”</note><l eID="gen1670" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1671"/>all the holy ones <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in your hand,<l eID="gen1671" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1672"/>and they bowed down to<note placement="foot">Or “at”</note> your feet,<l eID="gen1672" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1673"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each one accepted directions from you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he takes up from your words”</note> <l eID="gen1673" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1248"/><l level="1" sID="gen1674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1248"/>A law Moses instructed for us,<l eID="gen1674" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1675"/><transChange type="added">as a</transChange> possession <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the assembly of Jacob. <l eID="gen1675" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1249"/><l level="1" sID="gen1676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1249"/>And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> a king arose in Jeshurun,<l eID="gen1676" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1677"/>at the gathering of the leaders of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people,<l eID="gen1677" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1678"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞united were the tribes of Israel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “together the tribes of Israel”</note> <l eID="gen1678" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1250"/><l level="1" sID="gen1679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1250"/>“May Reuben live, and may he not die,<l eID="gen1679" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1680"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and let his number not be few⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “let he be his people of number”</note> <l eID="gen1680" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1251"/><l level="1" sID="gen1681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1251"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And he said this of Judah⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and this concerning/to Judah, and he said”</note><l eID="gen1681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1682"/>“Hear, O Yahweh, the voice of Judah,<l eID="gen1682" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1683"/>and bring him to his people;<l eID="gen1683" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1684"/>his own hands strive<note placement="foot">Or “is/are great” on his behalf</note> for him,<l eID="gen1684" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1685"/>and may you be a help <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> his foes.” <l eID="gen1685" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1252"/><l level="1" sID="gen1686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1252"/>And of Levi he said,<l eID="gen1686" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1687"/>“Your Thummim and your Urim<l eID="gen1687" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1688"/><transChange type="added">are</transChange> for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your faithful one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “man, your faithful one”</note><l eID="gen1688" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1689"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whom you tested at Massah⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “whom you tested him at Massah”</note><l eID="gen1689" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1690"/>you contended <transChange type="added">with</transChange> him<l eID="gen1690" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1691"/>at the waters of Meribah. <l eID="gen1691" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1253"/><l level="1" sID="gen1692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1253"/>The <transChange type="added">one</transChange> saying of his father and of his mother,<l eID="gen1692" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1693"/>‘I have not regarded them,’<l eID="gen1693" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1694"/>and his brothers he <transChange type="added">did</transChange> not acknowledge,<l eID="gen1694" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1695"/>and his children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> <transChange type="added">he did</transChange> not know,<l eID="gen1695" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1696"/>but <transChange type="added">rather</transChange> they observed your word,<l eID="gen1696" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1697"/>and your covenant they kept. <l eID="gen1697" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1254"/><l level="1" sID="gen1698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1254"/>They taught<note placement="foot">Or “teach/will teach”</note> your regulations to Jacob,<l eID="gen1698" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1699"/>and your law to Israel;<l eID="gen1699" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1700"/>they placed incense smoke <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in your nose”</note><l eID="gen1700" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1701"/>and whole burnt offerings on your altar. <l eID="gen1701" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1255"/><l level="1" sID="gen1702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1255"/>Bless, O Yahweh, his substance,<l eID="gen1702" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1703"/>and with the work of his hands you must be pleased;<l eID="gen1703" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1704"/>smite the loins of those who attack him,<l eID="gen1704" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1705"/>and those hating him, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that they cannot arise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “so that not they stand up”</note> <l eID="gen1705" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1256"/><l level="1" sID="gen1706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1256"/>Of Benjamin he said,<l eID="gen1706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1707"/>“The beloved of Yahweh dwells <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞securely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in confidence”</note><l eID="gen1707" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1708"/>the Most High<note placement="foot">This is the most likely reading in context (Most High God). Literally the Hebrew text reads “upon him,” so the NASV translates the first line as: dwell in security “by him”</note> shields <transChange type="added">all</transChange> around him,<l eID="gen1708" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1709"/>all the day,<l eID="gen1709" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1710"/>and between his shoulders he dwells.” <l eID="gen1710" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1257"/><l level="1" sID="gen1711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1257"/>And of Joseph he said,<l eID="gen1711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1712"/>“Blessed by Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his land,<l eID="gen1712" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1713"/>with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> the choice things of heaven,<l eID="gen1713" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1714"/>with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> dew, and with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> the deep lying down beneath, <l eID="gen1714" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1258"/><l level="1" sID="gen1715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1258"/>and with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> the choice things of the fruits<note placement="foot">Or “produce of”</note> of the <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun,<l eID="gen1715" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1716"/>and with the choice things of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> yield of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞seasons⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “months”</note> <l eID="gen1716" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1259"/><l level="1" sID="gen1717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1259"/>and with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> the finest things of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ancient mountains,<l eID="gen1717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1718"/>and with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> the choice things of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞eternal hills⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the hills of eternity never ending ages”</note> <l eID="gen1718" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1260"/><l level="1" sID="gen1719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1260"/>and with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> the choice things of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth and its fullness,<l eID="gen1719" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1720"/>and the favor of <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who dwelt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “dwells” but context puts the event into the past; literally “dweller of the bush”</note> in the bush.<note placement="foot">Some scholars suggest that this expression must be read as: on Sinai</note><l eID="gen1720" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1721"/>Let them come to the head of Joseph,<l eID="gen1721" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1722"/>and to the crown of the prince among his brothers. <l eID="gen1722" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1261"/><l level="1" sID="gen1723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1261"/><transChange type="added">As</transChange> the firstborn of his ox, majesty <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belongs to him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “is for him”</note><l eID="gen1723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1724"/>and his horns <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> horns of a wild ox;<l eID="gen1724" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1725"/>with them he drives people together,<note placement="foot">Or “all at once” (NASB)</note><l eID="gen1725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1726"/>and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the myriads of Ephraim,<l eID="gen1726" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1727"/>and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the thousands of Manasseh.” <l eID="gen1727" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1262"/><l level="1" sID="gen1728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1262"/>And of Zebulun he said,<l eID="gen1728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1729"/>“Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out,<l eID="gen1729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1730"/>and <transChange type="added">rejoice</transChange>, Issachar, in your tents; <l eID="gen1730" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1263"/><l level="1" sID="gen1731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1263"/>They summon people <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> mountains;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mountain”</note><l eID="gen1731" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1732"/>there they sacrifice the sacrifices of righteousness,<l eID="gen1732" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1733"/>because the affluence of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas they suck <transChange type="added">out</transChange>,<l eID="gen1733" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1734"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the most hidden treasures of the sand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “the covered of the hidden of the sand”</note> <l eID="gen1734" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1264"/><l level="1" sID="gen1735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1264"/>And of Gad he said,<l eID="gen1735" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1736"/>“Blessed <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the one who enlarges Gad⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the enlarger of Gad”</note><l eID="gen1736" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1737"/>like a lion he dwells,<l eID="gen1737" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1738"/>and he tears an arm as well as a scalp. <l eID="gen1738" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1265"/><l level="1" sID="gen1739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1265"/>And he selected<note placement="foot">Or “provided”</note> the best part for himself,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for him”</note><l eID="gen1739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1740"/>for there <transChange type="added">the</transChange> portion of a ruler <transChange type="added">is</transChange> included,<l eID="gen1740" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1741"/>and he came <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> heads of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people;<note placement="foot">Or possibly, “the heads of the people came/assembled” (compare NEB)</note><l eID="gen1741" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1742"/>he did<note placement="foot">Or “worked”</note> the righteousness of Yahweh,<l eID="gen1742" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1743"/>and his regulations for Israel.” <l eID="gen1743" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1266"/><l level="1" sID="gen1744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1266"/>And of Dan he said,<l eID="gen1744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1745"/>“Dan <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a cub of <transChange type="added">a</transChange> lion;<l eID="gen1745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1746"/>he leaps from Bashan.”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the Bashan,” referring to a well-known geographical and agricultural area</note> <l eID="gen1746" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1267"/><l level="1" sID="gen1747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1267"/>And of Naphtali, he said,<l eID="gen1747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1748"/>“Oh, Naphtali, sated of favor,<l eID="gen1748" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1749"/>and full of the blessing of Yahweh;<l eID="gen1749" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1750"/>take possession of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lake,<l eID="gen1750" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1751"/>and <transChange type="added">the land to the</transChange> south.” <l eID="gen1751" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1268"/><l level="1" sID="gen1752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1268"/>And of Asher he said,<l eID="gen1752" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1753"/>“Blessed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞more than sons⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “blessed from/of sons is” features the comparative use the Hebrew preposition <hi type="italic">min</hi>, “than”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Asher;<l eID="gen1753" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1754"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞may he be the favorite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “may he be favored”</note> of his brothers,<l eID="gen1754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1755"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞dipping his feet in the oil⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and dipping in the oil his feet”</note> <l eID="gen1755" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1269"/><l level="1" sID="gen1756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1269"/>Your bars <transChange type="added">are</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “will be”</note> iron and bronze,<l eID="gen1756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1757"/>and as your days, <transChange type="added">so is</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “so will be/may be”</note> your strength.” <l eID="gen1757" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1270"/><l level="1" sID="gen1758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1270"/>“There is no <transChange type="added">one</transChange> like God, O, Jeshurun,<l eID="gen1758" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1759"/>who rides <transChange type="added">through</transChange> the heavens to your help,<l eID="gen1759" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1760"/>and with his majesty <transChange type="added">through the</transChange> skies. <l eID="gen1760" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1271"/><l level="1" sID="gen1761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1271"/>The God of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ancient time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before/earlier times”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a hiding place,<l eID="gen1761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1762"/>and underneath <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> arms of eternity,<note placement="foot">Or “everlasting ages” or “everlasting arms”</note><l eID="gen1762" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1763"/>and he drove out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from your face”</note> you your enemy,<l eID="gen1763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1764"/>and he said, ‘Destroy <transChange type="added">them</transChange>!’ <l eID="gen1764" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1272"/><l level="1" sID="gen1765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1272"/>So Israel dwells alone <transChange type="added">and</transChange> carefree,<l eID="gen1765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1766"/>the spring of Jacob in a land of grain and wine;<l eID="gen1766" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1767"/>his heavens even drip dew. <l eID="gen1767" level="2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1273"/><l level="1" sID="gen1768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1273"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you, O Israel.<l eID="gen1768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1769"/>Who is like you, a people who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> saved by Yahweh,<l eID="gen1769" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1770"/>the shield of your help,<l eID="gen1770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1771"/>and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the sword of your triumph,<l eID="gen1771" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1772"/>and your enemies, they shall fawn before you,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to you”</note><l eID="gen1772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1773"/>and you shall tread on their backs.” <l eID="gen1773" level="2"/><lg eID="gen1664"/> <chapter eID="Deut.33"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1274"/><title type="x-s">The Death of Moses and the Commissioning of Joshua</title> <div sID="gen1774" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1274"/>Then Moses went up from the desert plateau<note placement="foot">Or “plains/lowlands”</note> of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞which is opposite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which is on the face of”</note> Jericho, and Yahweh showed him all of the land, Gilead <transChange type="added">all the way</transChange> up to Dan,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:2
verses.text: and all of Naphtali and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh and all of the land of Judah, up to the western sea,<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean Sea</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:3
verses.text: and the Negev and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palms, <transChange type="added">on</transChange> up to Zoar.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:4
verses.text: And Yahweh said to him, “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the land that I swore to Abraham to Isaac and to Jacob, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘To your offspring I will give it.’ I have let you see it with your eyes, but you shall not cross <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞into it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “to there”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:5
verses.text: Then Moses, the servant of Yahweh, died there in the land of Moab <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to the command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “at the mouth of Yahweh”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:6
verses.text: And he<note placement="foot">That is, Yahweh</note> buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor. But until this day no one knows his burial site.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:7
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Now Moses was a hundred and twenty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and Moses was a son of a hundred and twenty year”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he died⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “at/in his dying”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his sight was not impaired and his vigor had not abated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not faded his eyes and not had fled away his vitality”</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:8
verses.text: And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> wept <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> Moses thirty days; <transChange type="added">finally</transChange> the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were completed.  <div eID="gen1774" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1275"/><div sID="gen1775" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1275"/>Now<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom because Moses had placed his hands on him, and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> listened to him, and they did as Yahweh had commanded Moses.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:10
verses.text: And not again<note placement="foot">Or “since then”</note> has a prophet arisen in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew<note placement="foot">Hebrew “knew him”</note> face to face,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:11
verses.text: as far as all the signs and the wonders Yahweh sent him to do in the land of Egypt, against<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> Pharaoh and all of his servants and against<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> all of his land,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:12
verses.text: and as far as all of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the mighty deeds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the hand the strong”</note> and as far as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the great awesome wonders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the terrifying the great actions”</note> Moses did before the eyes of all Israel.  <chapter eID="Deut.34"/> <div eID="gen1775" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen1302" osisID="Deut" type="book"/>

verses.name: Joshua 1:1
