verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1276"/><title type="x-s">Joshua Addresses the Israelites</title> <div sID="gen1777" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1276"/>After the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh said to Joshua son of Nun, the assistant<note placement="foot">Or “servant”</note> of Moses, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 1:2
verses.text: “My servant Moses <transChange type="added">is</transChange> dead. Get up and cross the Jordan, you and all this people, into the land that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> giving to them, to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 1:3
verses.text: Every place that the soles of your feet will tread, I have given it to you, as I promised<note placement="foot">Or “spoke”</note> to Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 1:4
verses.text: From the wilderness <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and the Lebanon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “this Lebanon”; “Lebanon” in Hebrew means “white mountain”</note> up to the great river, the river Euphrates, all of the land of the Hittites, and up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the great sea in the west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the great sea of the setting sun”</note> will be your territory.

verses.name: Joshua 1:5
verses.text: No one will stand before you<note placement="foot">Or “in your presence”</note> all the days of your life. <transChange type="added">Just</transChange> as I was with Moses, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> will I be with you; I will not fail you, and I will not forsake you.

verses.name: Joshua 1:6
verses.text: Be strong and courageous, for you will give the people this land as an inheritance that I swore to their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to give them.

verses.name: Joshua 1:7
verses.text: Only be strong and very courageous <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to observe diligently the whole law⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to keep and to act according to the whole law”</note> that Moses my servant commanded you. Do not turn aside from it, to the right or left, so that you may succeed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wherever you go⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in all that you go”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 1:8
verses.text: The scroll of this law will not depart from your mouth; you will meditate on it day and night so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you may observe diligently all that is written⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to keep and to act according to all that is written”</note> in it. For then you will succeed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> your ways and prosper.

verses.name: Joshua 1:9
verses.text: Did I not command you? Be strong and courageous! Do not fear or be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wherever you go⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “in all that you go”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 1:10
verses.text: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 1:11
verses.text: “Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people: ‘Prepare your provisions;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “provision”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for in still”</note> three days you <transChange type="added">are to</transChange> cross the Jordan to go possess the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving you to possess.’ ”  <div eID="gen1777" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1277"/><div sID="gen1778" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1277"/>To the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh Joshua said,

verses.name: Joshua 1:13
verses.text: “Remember the word that Moses Yahweh’s servant commanded you, saying, ‘Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving rest to you, and he is giving<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he gave”</note> you this land.’

verses.name: Joshua 1:14
verses.text: Your wives, your little children, and your livestock, they will remain in the land that Moses gave to you beyond the Jordan. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞All of the best fighting men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All the mighty warriors of the troop”</note> will cross armed in front of your families; they will help you

verses.name: Joshua 1:15
verses.text: until Yahweh gives rest to your families as well as to you. They will take possession of the land that Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving to them. Then you will return to your own land and take possession of it, <transChange type="added">the land</transChange> that Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “to the sunrise”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 1:16
verses.text: And they answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you will send us we will go.

verses.name: Joshua 1:17
verses.text: Just as we obeyed Moses, so will we obey you. Only may Yahweh your God be with you, as he was with Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 1:18
verses.text: Whoever <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rebels against your orders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “defiles against your mouth”</note> and does not obey your words according to what you commanded us will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”  <chapter eID="Josh.1"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1278"/><title type="x-s">Spies View the Land</title> <div sID="gen1779" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1278"/>Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two men from Acacia Grove<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shittim”</note> as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, especially Jericho.” So they went, and entered the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spent the night⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lay down”</note> there.

verses.name: Joshua 2:2
verses.text: The king of Jericho was told, “Look, <transChange type="added">some</transChange> men from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> have come here tonight to search out the land.”

verses.name: Joshua 2:3
verses.text: And the king of Jericho sent <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who came to you, the ones who have entered your house, for they have come to search out the whole land.”

verses.name: Joshua 2:4
verses.text: But the woman took the two men and hid them. And she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> from.

verses.name: Joshua 2:5
verses.text: And when <transChange type="added">it was time</transChange> to shut the gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the night⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the darkness” or “at dark”</note> the men left, and I do not know where they went. Chase after them quickly, for you may catch up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> them.”

verses.name: Joshua 2:6
verses.text: (But she had taken them to the roof and had hidden them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the stalks of flax⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the flaxes of the plant stalk”</note> that she <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had spread out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “had been arranged”</note> on the roof.)

verses.name: Joshua 2:7
verses.text: So the men chased after them on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the way to the Jordan⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the road of the Jordan”</note> at the fords; and they shut the gate behind the pursuers that had gone out after them.  <div eID="gen1779" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1279"/><div sID="gen1780" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1279"/>Before <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they went to sleep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they lay down”</note> she came up to them on the roof

verses.name: Joshua 2:9
verses.text: and said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that dread of you has fallen on us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away <transChange type="added">in fear</transChange> because of your presence.

verses.name: Joshua 2:10
verses.text: For we have heard how Yahweh dried up the waters of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reeds”</note> before you when you went out from Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> beyond the Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.

verses.name: Joshua 2:11
verses.text: We heard <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, and our hearts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> melted, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no courage was left in anyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a spirit no longer stood in anyone”</note> because of your presence. For Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> God in the heavens above and on the earth below.

verses.name: Joshua 2:12
verses.text: So then please swear to me by Yahweh, because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have shown loyalty to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I have done with you a loyal love”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will also show loyalty⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you will do … loyal love”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to my family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with the house of my father”</note> You must give me a sign of good faith,<note placement="foot">Or “faithfulness”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 2:13
verses.text: and you will spare my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all that belongs to them; you will deliver our lives from death.”

verses.name: Joshua 2:14
verses.text: And the men said to her, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Our lives for yours⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Our lives in place of yours to die”</note> If you do not report this business of ours, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞we will show you loyalty and faithfulness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “we will do with you loyal love and faithfulness”</note> when Yahweh gives us the land.”  <div eID="gen1780" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1280"/><div sID="gen1781" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1280"/>Then she lowered them with a rope through the window, as her house <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on the outer side of the wall, and she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> residing in the wall.

verses.name: Joshua 2:16
verses.text: And she said to them, “Go to the mountain, so that the pursuers will not find you, and hide yourselves there three days until the pursuers return, and afterward you may go <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on your way⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “to your way”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 2:17
verses.text: The men said to her, “We <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> released from this oath of yours that you made us swear.

verses.name: Joshua 2:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">When</transChange> we come to the land, you must tie this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and you must gather your father and mother, and your brothers, and your whole family to your house.

verses.name: Joshua 2:19
verses.text: If anyone goes outside the doors of your house, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will be responsible for their own death⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his blood will be on his head”</note> and we will be innocent. Anyone who will be with you in the house, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞we will be responsible for their death⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his blood will be on our head”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞if a hand is laid on them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “if a hand will be against him”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 2:20
verses.text: But if you report this business of ours, we will be released from your oath that you made us swear.”

verses.name: Joshua 2:21
verses.text: And she said, “According to your word it <transChange type="added">will be</transChange>.” Then she sent them away, and they went, and she tied the scarlet cord in the window.  <div eID="gen1781" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1281"/><div sID="gen1782" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1281"/>They departed and came to the mountain, and they stayed there three days until the pursuers returned. The pursuers searched <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all along the way⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on all of the road”</note> but did not find <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:23
verses.text: The two men returned and went down from the mountain, and they crossed <transChange type="added">over</transChange> and came to Joshua son of Nun, and they told him everything that happened to them.

verses.name: Joshua 2:24
verses.text: They said to Joshua, “Surely Yahweh has given all the land into our hand; also, all the inhabitants of the land melt away <transChange type="added">in fear</transChange> because of our presence.”  <chapter eID="Josh.2"/>

verses.name: Joshua 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1282"/><title type="x-s">The Israelites Cross the Jordan</title> <div sID="gen1783" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1282"/>Joshua rose early in the morning, and they set out from Acacia Grove.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shittim”</note> And they came up to the Jordan, he and all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and they spent the night there before they crossed <transChange type="added">over</transChange>.

verses.name: Joshua 3:2
verses.text: At the end of the three days the officers passed through the midst of the camp,

verses.name: Joshua 3:3
verses.text: and they commanded the people: “When you see the Levitical priests carrying the ark of the covenant of Yahweh your God you must set out from your place and go after it.

verses.name: Joshua 3:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> there will be a distance between you and it of about two thousand cubits in measurement.<note placement="foot">That is, about 1 km</note> Do not come near it, so that you may know the way that you must go, for you have not passed on this way <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “from yesterday three days before”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 3:5
verses.text: And Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves, because tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders in your midst.”

verses.name: Joshua 3:6
verses.text: And Joshua said to the priests, “Take up the ark of the covenant and cross <transChange type="added">over</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ahead of the people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “before the presence of the people”</note> And they took up the ark of the covenant and went <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ahead of the people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “before the presence of the people”</note>  <div eID="gen1783" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1283"/><div sID="gen1784" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1283"/>Then Yahweh said to Joshua, “This day I will begin exalting you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the eyes”</note> of all Israel, that they may know that I was with Moses, and I will be with you.

verses.name: Joshua 3:8
verses.text: You will command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘At the moment that you come to the edge of the waters of the Jordan, you will stand <transChange type="added">still</transChange> in the Jordan.’ ”

verses.name: Joshua 3:9
verses.text: And Joshua said to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> “Come here, and hear the words of Yahweh your God.”

verses.name: Joshua 3:10
verses.text: Joshua said, “By this you will know that <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your midst, and he will certainly drive out the Canaanites <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “from your presence”</note> and the Hittites, Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

verses.name: Joshua 3:11
verses.text: Look! The ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth<note placement="foot">Or “world”</note> <transChange type="added">is about to</transChange> cross <transChange type="added">over</transChange> ahead of you into the Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 3:12
verses.text: So then, take twelve men from the tribes of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one from each tribe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “one man for the tribe”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 3:13
verses.text: When the soles of the feet of the priests carrying the ark of Yahweh, Lord of all the earth,<note placement="foot">Or “world”</note> rest in the waters of the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan will be cut off <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upstream⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “going down from above”</note> and they will stand <transChange type="added">still in</transChange> one heap.  <div eID="gen1784" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1284"/><div sID="gen1785" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1284"/>And it happened, when the people set out from their tents to cross <transChange type="added">over</transChange> the Jordan, the priests carrying the ark of the covenant were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ahead of the people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “before the presence of the people”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 3:15
verses.text: When those carrying the ark came up to the Jordan, and the priests carrying the ark dipped their feet in the edge of the water (the Jordan was flowing over its banks during all the days of harvest),

verses.name: Joshua 3:16
verses.text: the waters flowing down from above stood <transChange type="added">still</transChange>; they stood up <transChange type="added">in</transChange> one heap very far from Adam, the city that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> beside Zarethan, while <transChange type="added">the waters</transChange> flowing down to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea,<note placement="foot">That is, the Dead Sea</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were completely cut off⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “they were completed they were cut off”</note> and the people crossed <transChange type="added">over</transChange> opposite Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 3:17
verses.text: And the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of Yahweh stood firmly on the dry land in the middle of the Jordan while all Israel crossed on dry ground, until all the nation finished crossing the Jordan.  <chapter eID="Josh.3"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1285"/><title type="x-s">The Israelites Make a Memorial</title> <div sID="gen1786" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1285"/>After all the nation finished crossing the Jordan, Yahweh said to Joshua,

verses.name: Joshua 4:2
verses.text: “Take twelve men from the people, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one man from each tribe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “man one man one from tribe”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 4:3
verses.text: and command them, saying, ‘Take for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan where the priests’ feet stood firmly, and bring them over with you, and set them up in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the place where you will camp tonight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “the lodging place where you will lodge tonight”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 4:4
verses.text: So Joshua summoned the twelve men whom he had appointed from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> one from each tribe.

verses.name: Joshua 4:5
verses.text: And Joshua said to them, “Cross <transChange type="added">over</transChange> before<note placement="foot">Or “the presence”</note> the ark of Yahweh your God to the middle of the Jordan, and each one of you lift up a stone on your<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 4:6
verses.text: so that this may be a reminder<note placement="foot">Or “sign”</note> among you. When your children ask in the future, saying, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What do these stones mean to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?’<note placement="foot">Literally “What are these stones for you?”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 4:7
verses.text: you will say to them that the waters of the Jordan were cut off <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “the presence of”</note> the ark of the covenant of Yahweh. When it crossed the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones will be as a memorial for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> for eternity.”  <div eID="gen1786" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1286"/><div sID="gen1787" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1286"/>Thus the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did as Joshua commanded. They took twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan as Yahweh told Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and they carried them over with them to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the camp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the place of overnight lodging”</note> and they put them there.

verses.name: Joshua 4:9
verses.text: Then Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the covenant <transChange type="added">stood</transChange>, and they are there to this day.

verses.name: Joshua 4:10
verses.text: The priests carrying the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything that Yahweh commanded Joshua to tell the people was finished, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua. And the people hastily crossed <transChange type="added">over</transChange>.  <div eID="gen1787" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1287"/><div sID="gen1788" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1287"/>And it happened, when all the people had finished crossing, the ark of Yahweh and the priests crossed <transChange type="added">over</transChange> in front of<note placement="foot">Or “before the presence”</note> the people.

verses.name: Joshua 4:12
verses.text: The children of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed <transChange type="added">over</transChange> armed before the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> as Moses told them.

verses.name: Joshua 4:13
verses.text: About forty thousand armed for fighting crossed <transChange type="added">over</transChange> before the presence of Yahweh to the plains of Jericho for battle.

verses.name: Joshua 4:14
verses.text: On that day Yahweh exalted Joshua <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the eyes”</note> of all Israel, and they respected him<note placement="foot">Or “feared him”</note> as they respected<note placement="foot">Or “feared”</note> Moses all the days of his life.  <div eID="gen1788" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1288"/><div sID="gen1789" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1288"/>Then Yahweh said to Joshua, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 4:16
verses.text: “Command the priests carrying the ark of the testimony<note placement="foot">That is, the ark of the covenant</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to come up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and let them come up”</note> from the Jordan.”

verses.name: Joshua 4:17
verses.text: So Joshua commanded the priests, saying, “Come up from the Jordan.”

verses.name: Joshua 4:18
verses.text: And it happened that when the priests carrying the ark came up from the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞touched dry land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “were raised from the ground to dry land”</note> the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and flowed over all its banks as before.  <div eID="gen1789" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1289"/><div sID="gen1790" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1289"/>And the people came up from the Jordan on the tenth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the first month, and they camped in Gilgal on the eastern edge<note placement="foot">That is, border</note> of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 4:20
verses.text: And those twelve stones that they took from the Jordan, Joshua set up in Gilgal.

verses.name: Joshua 4:21
verses.text: And he said to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> “When your children ask in the future <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their parents⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “their fathers”</note> ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What is the meaning of these stones⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?’<note placement="foot">Literally “What are these stones?”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 4:22
verses.text: you will let your children know <transChange type="added">by</transChange> saying, ‘Israel crossed this Jordan on dry ground.’

verses.name: Joshua 4:23
verses.text: For Yahweh your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you, until you had crossed, just as Yahweh your God did to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reeds”</note> which he dried up before us until we had crossed over,

verses.name: Joshua 4:24
verses.text: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> strong, so that you may fear Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “all the days”</note>  <chapter eID="Josh.4"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1290"/><title type="x-s">The Israelites Are Circumcised</title> <div sID="gen1791" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1290"/>And it happened, when all the kings of the Amorites who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> beyond the Jordan to the west, and all the kings of the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> who were by the sea heard that Yahweh dried up the waters of the Jordan in front of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> until they crossed over, their hearts melted, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there was no courage left in them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a spirit was no longer in them”</note> because of the presence of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <div eID="gen1791" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1291"/><div sID="gen1792" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1291"/>At that time Yahweh said to Joshua, “Make for yourself knives of flint, and circumcise the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> a second time.”

verses.name: Joshua 5:3
verses.text: So Joshua made knives of flint, and he circumcised the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> at the hill of the foreskins.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gibeath-haaraloth”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 5:4
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the reason why Joshua circumcised all the people: all the males who went out from Egypt, all the warriors, died in the wilderness as they went out from Egypt <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the journey⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on the road”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 5:5
verses.text: For all the people who left were circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the journey⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the road”</note> <transChange type="added">after</transChange> they left from Egypt were not circumcised.

verses.name: Joshua 5:6
verses.text: For forty years the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> traveled in the wilderness until all the nation, the warriors that left Egypt, perished, because they did not listen to the voice of Yahweh. To them Yahweh swore that they would not see the land that he<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Yahweh”</note> swore to their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to give to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.name: Joshua 5:7
verses.text: And it was their children <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> he raised in their place that Joshua circumcised, for they were uncircumcised, because they had not been circumcised <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the journey⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on the road”</note>  <div eID="gen1792" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1292"/><title type="x-s">The Israelites Celebrate Passover in Canaan</title> <div sID="gen1793" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1292"/>And it happened, when all the nation had finished circumcising, they remained where they were in the camp until they recovered.

verses.name: Joshua 5:9
verses.text: And Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the disgrace of Egypt from you.” Therefore, the name of that place is called Gilgal<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rolling”</note> to this day.

verses.name: Joshua 5:10
verses.text: And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> camped at Gilgal, and they kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month, in the evening, on the plains of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 5:11
verses.text: On the next day after the Passover, on that<note placement="foot">Literally “this”</note> very day, they ate from the produce of the land, unleavened cakes and roasted corn.

verses.name: Joshua 5:12
verses.text: And the manna ceased the day after, when they <transChange type="added">started</transChange> eating the produce of the land, and there was no longer manna for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> They ate from the crop of the land of Canaan in that year.  <div eID="gen1793" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1293"/><title type="x-s">The Commander of Yahweh’s Army Appears Before Joshua</title> <div sID="gen1794" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1293"/>And it happened, when Joshua was by Jericho, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he looked up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he lifted up his eyes”</note> and he saw a man standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞opposite him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “against him”</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> his sword drawn in his hand. And Joshua went to him and said, “Are you with us, or with our adversaries?”

verses.name: Joshua 5:14
verses.text: And he said, “Neither. I have come now <transChange type="added">as</transChange> the commander of Yahweh’s army.” And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he bowed down⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “he worshiped”</note> and said to him, “What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my lord commanding his servant?”

verses.name: Joshua 5:15
verses.text: The commander of Yahweh’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sandal”</note> from your feet,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “foot”</note> for the place where you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> standing <transChange type="added">is</transChange> holy.” And Joshua did so.  <chapter eID="Josh.5"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1294"/><title type="x-s">The Battle of Jericho</title> <div sID="gen1795" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1294"/>Now Jericho <transChange type="added">was</transChange> shut up inside and out because of the presence of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> no one was going out or coming in.

verses.name: Joshua 6:2
verses.text: And Yahweh said to Joshua, “Look, I am giving Jericho into your hand, its king and the soldiers of the army.

verses.name: Joshua 6:3
verses.text: You will march around the city, all the warriors circling the city once; you will do so for six days.

verses.name: Joshua 6:4
verses.text: And seven priests will bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day you will march around the city seven times, and the priests will blow on the trumpets.

verses.name: Joshua 6:5
verses.text: And when they blow long on the horn of the ram, when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people will shout <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a great war cry, and the wall of the city will fall flat,<note placement="foot">Or “in its place”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the people will charge, each one straight ahead⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “the people will go up, each before him”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 6:6
verses.text: So Joshua son of Nun summoned the priests and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests carry the trumpets of the rams’ horns before the ark of Yahweh.”

verses.name: Joshua 6:7
verses.text: And he said<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they said”</note> to the people, “Go forward and march around the city, and let the armed <transChange type="added">men</transChange> pass before the ark of Yahweh.  <div eID="gen1795" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1295"/><div sID="gen1796" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1295"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And when Joshua spoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it happened the moment of the saying of Joshua”</note> to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the presence of Yahweh went forward and they blew the trumpets; and the ark of the covenant of Yahweh followed behind them.

verses.name: Joshua 6:9
verses.text: And the armed <transChange type="added">men</transChange> went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard came after the ark, while they were blowing the trumpets.

verses.name: Joshua 6:10
verses.text: But Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You will not shout, and you will not let your voice be heard; a word will not go out from your mouth until the day I say to you ‘Shout!’ Then you will shout.”

verses.name: Joshua 6:11
verses.text: And the ark of Yahweh went around the city, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞circling once⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “circling one occurrence”</note> and they came <transChange type="added">into</transChange> the camp and spent the night in the camp.

verses.name: Joshua 6:12
verses.text: Then Joshua got up early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of Yahweh.

verses.name: Joshua 6:13
verses.text: The seven priests carrying the seven trumpets of the rams’ horns before the ark of Yahweh went on continually, and they blew on the trumpets. And the armed <transChange type="added">men</transChange> went before them, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rear guard came after the ark of Yahweh, while the trumpets blew continually.

verses.name: Joshua 6:14
verses.text: And they marched around the city once on the second day, and they returned <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the camp. They did <transChange type="added">this</transChange> for six days.  <div eID="gen1796" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1296"/><div sID="gen1797" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1296"/>Then on the seventh day they rose early at dawn, and they marched around the city in this manner seven times. <transChange type="added">It was</transChange> only on that day that they marched around the city seven times.

verses.name: Joshua 6:16
verses.text: And at the seventh time the priests blew on the trumpets, and Joshua said to the people, “Shout! For Yahweh has given you the city.

verses.name: Joshua 6:17
verses.text: The city and all that is in it will be devoted to Yahweh; only Rahab the prostitute and all who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with her in the house will live, because she hid the messengers whom we sent.

verses.name: Joshua 6:18
verses.text: As for you, keep <transChange type="added">away</transChange> from the things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing”</note> devoted to destruction so that you do not take them and bring about your own destruction, making the camp of Israel an object for destruction, bringing trouble upon it.

verses.name: Joshua 6:19
verses.text: But all of the silver and gold, and the items of bronze and iron, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> holy to Yahweh, and they must go to Yahweh’s treasury.”

verses.name: Joshua 6:20
verses.text: So the people shouted, and they<note placement="foot">That is, the priests</note> blew on the trumpets. And when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, they raised a great shout, and the wall fell flat. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The people charged, each one straight ahead into the city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “The people went up, each before him”</note> and they captured it.

verses.name: Joshua 6:21
verses.text: And they utterly destroyed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by the mouth of the sword”</note> all who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the city, both men and women, young and old, ox, sheep, and donkey.  <div eID="gen1797" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1297"/><div sID="gen1798" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1297"/>Then Joshua said to the two men who spied on the land, “Go <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the prostitute’s house and bring out from there the woman and all who belong to her, just as you swore to her.”

verses.name: Joshua 6:23
verses.text: So the young men who were spies went and brought Rahab and her father and mother, her brothers, and all who were with her. And they brought all her family out and set them outside the camp of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 6:24
verses.text: And they burned the city and all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in it with fire; they put only the silver and gold, and the items of copper and iron, <transChange type="added">into</transChange> the treasury of the house of Yahweh.

verses.name: Joshua 6:25
verses.text: But Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and her family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and the house of her father”</note> and all who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with her, and she has lived in the midst of Israel until this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.  <div eID="gen1798" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1298"/><div sID="gen1799" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1298"/>And Joshua swore at that time, saying, “Cursed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> anyone before Yahweh who gets up and builds Jericho, this city. At the cost of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates.”

verses.name: Joshua 6:27
verses.text: So Yahweh was with Joshua, and his fame was in all the land.  <chapter eID="Josh.6"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1299"/><title type="x-s">The Sin of Achan</title> <div sID="gen1800" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1299"/>But the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> broke faith concerning the devoted things.<note placement="foot">Or “consecrated possessions”</note> Achan son of Carmi son of Zabdi son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took from the devoted things;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing” or “consecrated possession”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh’s anger was kindled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the nose of Yahweh became hot”</note> against the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <div eID="gen1800" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1300"/><div sID="gen1801" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1300"/>Now Joshua sent men from Jericho <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Ai, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near Beth Aven, east of Bethel, and he said to them, “Go up and spy out Ai.” And the men went up and spied out Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 7:3
verses.text: And they returned to Joshua and said to him, “Do not let all the people go up and attack Ai; <transChange type="added">only</transChange> two or three thousand men should go up because they<note placement="foot">That is, the people of Ai</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> few. Do not make all the people weary <transChange type="added">up</transChange> there.”

verses.name: Joshua 7:4
verses.text: So about three thousand from the people went up there, and they fled before the men of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 7:5
verses.text: The men of Ai killed about thirty-six of them, and they chased them from the gate up to Shebarim and killed them on the slope. And the hearts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> of the people melted and became like water.  <div eID="gen1801" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1301"/><div sID="gen1802" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1301"/>And Joshua tore his clothes and fell to the ground on his face before the ark of Yahweh until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “head”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:7
verses.text: And Joshua said, “Ah, my Lord! Why did you bring this people across the Jordan to give us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us? If only we had been content and stayed beyond the Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 7:8
verses.text: Please, my Lord! What can I say after <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israel has fled from its enemies⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “Israel has turned its neck before its enemies”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:9
verses.text: The Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear <transChange type="added">of this</transChange>, and they will surround us and cut off our name from the land. What will you do, for your great name?”  <div eID="gen1802" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1302"/><div sID="gen1803" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1302"/>And Yahweh said to Joshua, “Stand up! <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Why⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “For what this”</note> <transChange type="added">have</transChange> you fallen on your face?

verses.name: Joshua 7:11
verses.text: Israel has sinned and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞transgressed my covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “crossed my covenant”</note> that I commanded them. They have taken from the devoted things;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing” or “from the consecrated possession”</note> they have stolen and acted deceitfully, and they have put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> among their belongings.

verses.name: Joshua 7:12
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> were unable to stand before their enemies; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they fled from their enemies⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they turned their neck before their enemies”</note> because they have become a thing devoted<note placement="foot">Or “consecrated”</note> for destruction. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will be with you no more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will not do again to be with you”</note> unless you destroy the devoted things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing” or “consecrated possession”</note> from among you.

verses.name: Joshua 7:13
verses.text: Get up, sanctify the people, and say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow. Thus says Yahweh the God of Israel: “<transChange type="added">There are</transChange> devoted things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing” or “consecrated possession”</note> in your midst, O Israel. You will be unable to stand before you enemies until you remove the devoted things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing” or “consecrated possession”</note> from your midst.”

verses.name: Joshua 7:14
verses.text: In the morning you will come forward, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞tribe by tribe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “according to your tribes”</note> and the tribe that Yahweh will select by lot will come forward by clans, and the clan that Yahweh selects by lot will come forward by families, and the family that Yahweh selects by lot will come forward one by one.

verses.name: Joshua 7:15
verses.text: The one caught with the devoted things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing” or “consecrated possession”</note> will be burned with fire, he and all that belongs to him, because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he transgressed the covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he crossed the covenant”</note> of Yahweh, and because he did a disgraceful thing in Israel.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen1803" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1303"/><div sID="gen1804" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1303"/>So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Joshua rose early in the morning and brought forward Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞tribe by tribe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “according to its tribes”</note> and the tribe of Judah was selected by lot.

verses.name: Joshua 7:17
verses.text: And he brought forward the clans of Judah and selected the clan of the Zerahites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Zerahite”</note> by lot. Then he brought forward the clan of the Zerahites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Zerahite”</note> one by one, and Zabdi was selected by lot.

verses.name: Joshua 7:18
verses.text: He brought forward his family, one by one, and Achan son of Carmi son of Zabdi son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected by lot.

verses.name: Joshua 7:19
verses.text: And Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please, give glory to Yahweh the God of Israel, and give him a doxology in court.<note placement="foot">Some interpret “make a confession”</note> Tell me, please, what you have done; do not hide <transChange type="added">it</transChange> from me.”

verses.name: Joshua 7:20
verses.text: And Achan answered Joshua and said, “It is true. I have sinned against Yahweh the God of Israel, and this is what I did:

verses.name: Joshua 7:21
verses.text: I saw among the spoil a beautiful robe from Shinar,<note placement="foot">“Shinar” refers to Babylonia</note> two hundred shekels of silver, and one bar of gold <transChange type="added">that</transChange> weighed fifty shekels; I coveted them and took them. They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> hidden in the ground inside my tent, and the silver <transChange type="added">is</transChange> under it.”  <div eID="gen1804" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1304"/><div sID="gen1805" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1304"/>Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and there <transChange type="added">they were</transChange>, hidden in his tent, and the silver <transChange type="added">was</transChange> under it.

verses.name: Joshua 7:23
verses.text: And they took them from the tent and brought them to Joshua and all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> And they spread them out before the presence of Yahweh.

verses.name: Joshua 7:24
verses.text: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the bar of gold, his sons and daughters, his cattle and donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and everything that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> his, and they brought them <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the valley of Achor.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “trouble”; a valley in the Jericho region</note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:25
verses.text: And Joshua said, “Why did you bring us trouble? Yahweh will bring you trouble on this day.” And all Israel stoned them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> with stones;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “stone”</note> and they burned them with fire <transChange type="added">after</transChange> they stoned them with stones.

verses.name: Joshua 7:26
verses.text: Then <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they placed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they raised up”</note> on top of him a great pile of stones that remains to this day. And Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞turned from his burning anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “turned from his burning nose”</note> and thus the name of that place to this day is called the valley of Achor.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “trouble”; a valley in the Jericho region</note>  <chapter eID="Josh.7"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1305"/><title type="x-s">Ai Is Destroyed</title> <div sID="gen1806" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1305"/>Then Yahweh said to Joshua, “Do not fear or be dismayed. Take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the fighting men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all the people of war”</note> with you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and go up immediately to Ai⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “get up and go up to Ai”</note> Look, I am giving into your hand the king of Ai, his city, and his land.

verses.name: Joshua 8:2
verses.text: You will do to Ai and its king that which you did to Jericho and its king; you may take only its spoils<note placement="foot">Hebrew “spoil”</note> and livestock as booty for yourself. Set for yourself an ambush against the city <transChange type="added">from</transChange> behind <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.”  <div eID="gen1806" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1306"/><div sID="gen1807" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1306"/>So Joshua and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the fighting men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all the people of war”</note> went up immediately to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand of the best fighting men and sent them <transChange type="added">by</transChange> night.

verses.name: Joshua 8:4
verses.text: And he commanded them, saying, “Look, you are to lay an ambush against the city from behind. Do not go very far from the city and be ready.

verses.name: Joshua 8:5
verses.text: Then I and all of the people who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with me will approach the city. And when they go out to meet us <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as that at the first occasion”</note> we will flee from them.<note placement="foot">Or “before their presence”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:6
verses.text: They will come out after us until we draw them away from the city, because they will think, ‘<transChange type="added">They are</transChange> fleeing from us<note placement="foot">Or “before our presence”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “as that at the first occasion”</note> So we will flee from them.<note placement="foot">Or “before their presence”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:7
verses.text: Then you will rise up from the ambush and take possession of the city, for Yahweh your God will give it into your hand.

verses.name: Joshua 8:8
verses.text: And when you capture the city you will set it on fire as Yahweh commanded. Look, I have commanded you.”

verses.name: Joshua 8:9
verses.text: So Joshua sent them out, and they went to the <transChange type="added">place of the</transChange> ambush, and they sat between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai; but Joshua spent the night <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with the people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the middle of the people”</note>  <div eID="gen1807" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1307"/><div sID="gen1808" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1307"/>Joshua rose early in the morning and mustered the people, and he went up <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the elders of Israel before the people of Ai.<note placement="foot">Or “before the presence of the people of Ai”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:11
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞All the fighting men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All the people of war”</note> who were with him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞went up and drew near before the city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “went up, drew near, and came before the city”</note> and camped north of Ai; <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> a valley between him and Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:12
verses.text: And he took about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:13
verses.text: So they stationed the forces; all the army <transChange type="added">was</transChange> north of the city while <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the rear guard was west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “while its rear guard was west of the city”</note> But Joshua went that night to the middle of the valley.

verses.name: Joshua 8:14
verses.text: When the king of Ai saw <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, the men of the city hurried and rose early and went out to meet Israel for battle—he<note placement="foot">That is, the king</note> and all his army—to the meeting place before the Arabah.<note placement="foot">A dry region that runs south of the Sea of Galilee along the Jordan Valley</note> He did not know that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> an ambush for him behind the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:15
verses.text: Then Joshua and all Israel acted like they were beaten before them, and they fled <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the direction of the wilderness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the way of the wilderness”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:16
verses.text: All of the people who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the city were called to pursue after them. As they pursued after Joshua, they were drawn away from the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:17
verses.text: Not a man remained in Ai or Bethel who had not gone out after Israel; they left the city open and pursued after Israel.  <div eID="gen1808" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1308"/><div sID="gen1809" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1308"/>And Yahweh said to Joshua, “Stretch out the sword<note placement="foot">Or “spear”</note> that is in your hand to Ai, because I will give it into your hand.” And Joshua stretched out the sword that was in his hand to the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:19
verses.text: The moment he stretched out his hand, those in the ambush stood up quickly from their place and ran. And they went <transChange type="added">into</transChange> the city and captured it, quickly setting the city ablaze with fire.

verses.name: Joshua 8:20
verses.text: Then the men of Ai looked behind them, and they saw smoke from the city rising to the sky; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they had no power to flee this way or that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “it was not in their hands to flee here and here”</note> and the people fleeing the wilderness turned around to the pursuers.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “pursuer”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:21
verses.text: And Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had captured the city and that the smoke of the city was rising; they returned and struck down the men of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:22
verses.text: Then the others from the city came out to meet them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and they found themselves surrounded by Israel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they were in the middle of Israel”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some on one side, and others on the other side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “these from these, and these from this”</note> And they<note placement="foot">That is, Israel</note> struck them down until no survivor or fugitive <transChange type="added">was</transChange> left.

verses.name: Joshua 8:23
verses.text: But they captured the king of Ai alive, and they brought him to Joshua.  <div eID="gen1809" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1309"/><div sID="gen1810" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1309"/>When Israel finished slaughtering all the inhabitants of Ai in the open field, in the wilderness where they pursued them, and when all of them had fallen by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> until they all had perished, all Israel returned to Ai and attacked it with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:25
verses.text: All the people that fell on that day, both men and women, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> twelve thousand—all the inhabitants of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:26
verses.text: For Joshua did not draw back his hand that was stretched out with the sword until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:27
verses.text: Only the livestock and the spoil of that city Israel took as booty for themselves, according to the word of Yahweh that Joshua commanded.

verses.name: Joshua 8:28
verses.text: So Joshua burned Ai and made it an everlasting heap of rubbish, a desolate place until this day.

verses.name: Joshua 8:29
verses.text: The king of Ai he hanged on a tree until the time of evening, and as the sun went down Joshua commanded <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, and they brought down his dead body from the tree. Then they threw it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and they raised over it a great heap of stones <transChange type="added">that remains</transChange> to this day.  <div eID="gen1810" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1310"/><title type="x-s">Israel Renews the Covenant</title> <div sID="gen1811" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1310"/>Then Joshua built an altar on Mount Ebal for Yahweh the God of Israel,

verses.name: Joshua 8:31
verses.text: as Moses Yahweh’s servant commanded the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> as it is written in the scroll of the law of Moses: “an altar of unhewn<note placement="foot">Or “whole”</note> stones on which no one has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wielded⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “waved over them”</note> an iron implement.”<note placement="foot">See <reference osisRef="Exod.20.25">Exod 20:25</reference></note> And they offered burnt offerings on it and sacrificed fellowship offerings.

verses.name: Joshua 8:32
verses.text: And there Joshua wrote on the stones <transChange type="added">a</transChange> copy of the law of Moses, which he<note placement="foot">That is, Moses</note> had written, in the presence of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:33
verses.text: Then all Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foreigner as well as native⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as the alien as the native”</note> with the elders, officials, and judges stood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on either side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from this and from this”</note> of the ark before the priests and the Levites, who carried the ark of the covenant of Yahweh. Half of them <transChange type="added">stood</transChange> in front of Mount Gerizim, and the other half in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses Yahweh’s servant had commanded before to bless the people of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 8:34
verses.text: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “blessing”</note> and the curses,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “curse”</note> according to all that was written in the scroll of the law.

verses.name: Joshua 8:35
verses.text: There was not a word from all that Moses commanded that Joshua did not read before the assembly of all Israel, and the women, the little children, and the traveling foreigners<note placement="foot">Hebrew “foreigner”</note> among them.  <chapter eID="Josh.8"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1311"/><title type="x-s">The Gibeonites Act with Cunning</title> <div sID="gen1812" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1311"/>Now<note placement="foot">Or “And it happened”</note> when all the kings who were beyond the Jordan in the hill country and in the Shephelah,<note placement="foot">Or “lowlands”; a geographical region on the western edge of the hills of Judea</note> and on all the coast of the great sea toward Lebanon<note placement="foot">Literally “white mountain”</note>—the Hittites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hittite”</note> the Amorites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> the Canaanites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> the Perizzites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Perizzite”</note> the Hivites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hivite”</note> and the Jebusites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jebusite”</note>—heard of <transChange type="added">this</transChange>,

verses.name: Joshua 9:2
verses.text: they gathered themselves together to fight with one accord against<note placement="foot">Hebrew “with”</note> Joshua and Israel.  <div eID="gen1812" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1312"/><div sID="gen1813" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1312"/>But the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua did to Jericho and Ai,

verses.name: Joshua 9:4
verses.text: and they acted on their part with cunning: they went and prepared provisions,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is difficult here. Some ancient manuscripts read, “they sent out a delegation/an envoy”</note> and took worn-out sacks<note placement="foot">Or “sackcloths”</note> for their donkeys and old wineskins <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> torn and mended.

verses.name: Joshua 9:5
verses.text: The sandals on their feet <transChange type="added">were</transChange> patched and old, their clothes <transChange type="added">were</transChange> old, and their food was dry and crumbled.

verses.name: Joshua 9:6
verses.text: And they went to Joshua at the camp <transChange type="added">at</transChange> Gilgal and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far land; so then <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make a covenant with us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “cut for us a covenant”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 9:7
verses.text: And the men of Israel said to the Hivites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hivite”</note> “Perhaps you are living among us; how can we <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make a covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut a covenant”</note> with you?”

verses.name: Joshua 9:8
verses.text: They said to Joshua, “We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your servants.” And Joshua said to them, “Who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you, and from where do you come?”

verses.name: Joshua 9:9
verses.text: And they said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far land because of the name of Yahweh your God; we have heard of his reputation, of all that he did in Egypt,

verses.name: Joshua 9:10
verses.text: and of all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> beyond the Jordan—to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in Ashtaroth.

verses.name: Joshua 9:11
verses.text: So our elders said to us and all the inhabitants of our land, ‘Take in your hand provisions for the journey, and go to meet them, and say to them, “We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your servants; so then <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make a covenant with us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.” ’<note placement="foot">Literally “cut for us a covenant”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 9:12
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our bread; <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> hot <transChange type="added">when</transChange> we took it from our houses as provisions on the day we set out to come to you. But now, look, it is dry and crumbled.

verses.name: Joshua 9:13
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the wineskins that we filled new, but look, they have burst; and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> our clothes and sandals that have worn out from the very long journey.”

verses.name: Joshua 9:14
verses.text: So the leaders<note placement="foot">Or “men”</note> took from their provisions, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they did not ask direction from Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of Yahweh they did not ask”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 9:15
verses.text: And Joshua made peace with them, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he made a covenant with them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he cut a covenant with them”</note> to allow them to live happily, and the leaders of the congregation swore <transChange type="added">an oath</transChange> to them.  <div eID="gen1813" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1313"/><div sID="gen1814" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1313"/>And it happened that at the end of three days, after they made a covenant with them, they heard that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they were their neighbors⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they were near them”</note> and living among them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:17
verses.text: And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> set out and went to their cities on the third day (their cities <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim).

verses.name: Joshua 9:18
verses.text: But the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did not attack them, because the leaders of the congregation had sworn to them by Yahweh the God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against their leaders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “against the leaders of the congregation”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 9:19
verses.text: But all the leaders of the congregation said, “We have sworn to them by Yahweh the God of Israel, and so we cannot touch them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:20
verses.text: This we will do to them: <transChange type="added">we will</transChange> let them live so that wrath will not be on us because of the oath we swore to them.”

verses.name: Joshua 9:21
verses.text: And the leaders<note placement="foot">Or “men”</note> said to them, “Let them live.” So they became woodcutters and water carriers for all the congregation, just as the leaders had said to them.  <div eID="gen1814" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1314"/><div sID="gen1815" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1314"/>And Joshua summoned them and said, “Why have you deceived us saying, ‘We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> very far from you’ when you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> living among us?

verses.name: Joshua 9:23
verses.text: Therefore you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> cursed; some of you will always be slaves as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God.”

verses.name: Joshua 9:24
verses.text: And they answered Joshua and said, “Because it was told with certainty to your servants that Yahweh your God commanded Moses his servant to give to you all the land and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land before you, so we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and so we did this thing.

verses.name: Joshua 9:25
verses.text: So then, look, we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in your hand; do with us whatever seems good and right in your eyes.”

verses.name: Joshua 9:26
verses.text: So he did this to them: he saved them from the hand of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and they did not kill them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:27
verses.text: And that day Joshua made them woodcutters and water carriers for the congregation and for the altar of Yahweh, to this day, in the place that he should choose.  <chapter eID="Josh.9"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1315"/><title type="x-s">The Sun Stands Still at Gibeon</title> <div sID="gen1816" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1315"/>And it happened that when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua captured Ai and had utterly destroyed it (just as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he did to Ai and its king) and that the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,

verses.name: Joshua 10:2
verses.text: he<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they”</note> became very afraid because Gibeon was a very large city, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞like one of the royal cities⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “like one of the cities of the kingship”</note> and because it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> larger than Ai, and all its men <transChange type="added">were</transChange> mighty warriors.

verses.name: Joshua 10:3
verses.text: So Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent <transChange type="added">word</transChange> to Hohman king of Hebron, to Piram king of Jarmuth, to Japhia king of Lachish, and to Debir king of Eglon, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 10:4
verses.text: “Come up and help me, and let us attack Gibeon, because it has made peace with Joshua and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 10:5
verses.text: And the five kings of the Amorites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered together and went up, they and all their forces, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they laid siege to Gibeon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they camped against Gibeon”; see <reference osisRef="Josh.10.31">Josh 10:31</reference></note> and made war against it.  <div eID="gen1816" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1316"/><div sID="gen1817" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1316"/>And the men of Gibeon sent <transChange type="added">word</transChange> to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Do not abandon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do not release your hands from”</note> your servant. Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us, for all the kings of the Amorites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> who dwell in the hill country have gathered against us.”

verses.name: Joshua 10:7
verses.text: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the fighting men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all the people of the war”</note> with him, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the best warriors⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all the mighty warriors of the army”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 10:8
