verses.text: And Yahweh said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for I have given them into your hand; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no one will withstand you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not a man of them will stand in your presence”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 10:9
verses.text: Joshua came upon them suddenly <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by marching up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he went up”</note> all night from Gilgal.

verses.name: Joshua 10:10
verses.text: And Yahweh threw them into panic before Israel, who<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> struck them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a great blow at Gibeon and pursued them by the way of the ascent of Beth-horon and struck them as far as Azekah and Makkedah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:11
verses.text: And as they were fleeing from Israel, <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> on the slope of Beth-horon, and Yahweh threw huge stones from the heavens on them as far as Azekah; and more died by the hail stones than those whom the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> killed by the sword.  <div eID="gen1817" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1317"/><div sID="gen1818" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1317"/>Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh, on the day Yahweh gave the Amorites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> over to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and he said in the sight of Israel, <div eID="gen1818" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen1819"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1820"/>“Sun in Gibeon, stand still,<l eID="gen1820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1821"/>and moon, in the valley of Aijalon.” <l eID="gen1821" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1318"/><l level="1" sID="gen1822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1318"/>And the sun stood still, and the moon stopped,<l eID="gen1822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1823"/>until <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nation took vengeance <transChange type="added">on</transChange> its enemies.<l eID="gen1823" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1819"/> <div sID="gen1824" type="x-p"/> Is it not written in the scroll of Jashar? The sun stood still in the middle of the heaven and was not in haste to set for about a full day.

verses.name: Joshua 10:14
verses.text: There has not been a day like this before it or after, that Yahweh listened to the voice of <transChange type="added">a</transChange> man; for Yahweh fought for Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 10:15
verses.text: And Joshua returned and all Israel with him to the camp at Gilgal.  <div eID="gen1824" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1319"/><title type="x-s">The Kings of the Amorites Are Killed</title> <div sID="gen1825" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1319"/>But these five kings fled and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:17
verses.text: And it was told to Joshua, saying, “The five kings were found hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”

verses.name: Joshua 10:18
verses.text: And Joshua said, “Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and set men in front of it to guard them.

verses.name: Joshua 10:19
verses.text: But do not stay <transChange type="added">there</transChange>; pursue after your enemies and attack them from the rear. Do not allow them to go into their cities, for Yahweh your God has given them into your hand.”

verses.name: Joshua 10:20
verses.text: When Joshua and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> had finished striking them with a very great blow, until they perished, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those of them who survived⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the survivors who survived”</note> went into the fortified cities,

verses.name: Joshua 10:21
verses.text: and all the people returned to the camp safely<note placement="foot">Or “in peace”</note> to Joshua at Makkedah. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞No one spoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “No one moved his tongue”</note> against the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <div eID="gen1825" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1320"/><div sID="gen1826" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1320"/>And Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave, and bring to me those five kings from the cave.”

verses.name: Joshua 10:23
verses.text: And they did so, and brought him these five kings from the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

verses.name: Joshua 10:24
verses.text: And when they brought these kings to Joshua, Joshua called all the men of Israel and said to the commanders of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the fighting men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the men of war”</note> who had gone with him, “Come near, put your feet on the necks of these kings.” So they came near and put their feet on their necks.

verses.name: Joshua 10:25
verses.text: And Joshua said to them, “Do not be afraid or dismayed! Be strong and bold, for thus Yahweh will do to all your enemies whom you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to fight.

verses.name: Joshua 10:26
verses.text: And after this Joshua struck them down and killed them, and he hanged them on five trees. And they were hanging on the trees until the evening.

verses.name: Joshua 10:27
verses.text: And it happened <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the time of sunset⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at the time of the going of the sun”</note> Joshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave where they had hidden themselves, and they put large stones against the mouth of the cave, <transChange type="added">which are there</transChange> to this very day.  <div eID="gen1826" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1321"/><div sID="gen1827" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1321"/>Joshua captured Makkedah on that day, and he struck it and its king with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> he utterly destroyed it and everyone that was in it. He did not leave behind a survivor. So he did to the king of Makkedah just as he did to the king of Jericho.  <div eID="gen1827" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1322"/><title type="x-s">Joshua’s Conquest of the South</title> <div sID="gen1828" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1322"/>And Joshua passed on, and all of Israel with him, from Makkedah <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Libnah, and he fought against Libnah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:30
verses.text: And Yahweh also gave it into the hand of Israel, and its king and all the people in it he struck with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> He left in it no survivor. He did to its king just as he did to the king of Jericho.  <div eID="gen1828" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1323"/><div sID="gen1829" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1323"/>And Joshua passed on, and all of Israel with him, from Libnah to Lachish, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he laid siege to it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he camped opposite it”</note> and fought against it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:32
verses.text: And Yahweh gave Lachish into the hand of Israel, and he captured it on the second day. He struck it with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> and everyone in it, just as he did to Libnah.  <div eID="gen1829" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1324"/><div sID="gen1830" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1324"/>Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish, and Joshua struck him and his people until he left no survivor behind.  <div eID="gen1830" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1325"/><div sID="gen1831" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1325"/>And Joshua passed on, and all of Israel with him, from Lachish to Eglon, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they laid siege to it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they camped opposite it”</note> and fought against it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:35
verses.text: And they captured it on that day, and he struck it with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> and all the people that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in it on that day he utterly destroyed as he had done to Lachish.  <div eID="gen1831" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1326"/><div sID="gen1832" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1326"/>And Joshua went up, and all Israel with him, from Eglon to Hebron, and they fought against it

verses.name: Joshua 10:37
verses.text: and captured it, and they struck it with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> its king and all its cities, and all the people that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in it; he left behind no survivor, as he had done to Eglon, and he utterly destroyed it and all the people that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:38
verses.text: Then Joshua returned to Debir, and all of Israel with him, and they fought against it,

verses.name: Joshua 10:39
verses.text: and he captured it and its king and all its cities, and they struck them with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> and they utterly destroyed all the people that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in it; he left behind no survivor, just as he had done to Hebron. Thus he did to Debir and its king what he had done to Libnah and its king.  <div eID="gen1832" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1327"/><div sID="gen1833" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1327"/>So Joshua struck all the land—the hill country, the Negev,<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judaean hills</note> the Shephelah,<note placement="foot">Or “lowlands”; a geographical region on the western edge of the hills of Judea</note> and the slopes<note placement="foot">The slopes of the hills of the western Jordan to the Dead Sea region</note>—and all their kings; he left behind no survivor, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all that breathed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of the breath”</note> he utterly destroyed as Yahweh the God of Israel commanded.

verses.name: Joshua 10:41
verses.text: Joshua struck them from Kadesh Barnea to Gaza, and all the land of Goshen up to Gibeon;

verses.name: Joshua 10:42
verses.text: all of these kings and their land Joshua captured at one time, because Yahweh the God of Israel fought for Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 10:43
verses.text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.  <chapter eID="Josh.10"/>

verses.name: Joshua 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1328"/><title type="x-s">Joshua’s Conquest of the North</title> <div sID="gen1834" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1328"/>And it happened, when Jabin king of Hazor heard <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Acshaph,

verses.name: Joshua 11:2
verses.text: and to the kings who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the north in the hill country, in the Arabah<note placement="foot">A dry region that runs south of the Sea of Galilee along the Jordan valley</note> south of Kinnereth,<note placement="foot">That is, the Sea of Galilee</note> in the Shephelah,<note placement="foot">Or “lowlands”; a geographical region on the western edge of the hills of Judea</note> and in Naphoth Dor<note placement="foot">Or “the heights of Dor”</note> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> west,

verses.name: Joshua 11:3
verses.text: to the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> in the east and west, the Amorites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> the Hittites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hittite”</note> the Perizzites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Perizzite”</note> and the Jebusites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jebusite”</note> in the hill country, and the Hivites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hivite”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the foot of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “under”</note> Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

verses.name: Joshua 11:4
verses.text: They came out, they and all their armies with them, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a great army like the sand on the seashore, with very many horses and chariots.

verses.name: Joshua 11:5
verses.text: And all these kings joined forces, and they came and camped together by the waters of Merom to fight with Israel.  <div eID="gen1834" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1329"/><div sID="gen1835" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1329"/>And Yahweh said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid because of their presence, for tomorrow at this time I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> hand them over slain to Israel; you will hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”

verses.name: Joshua 11:7
verses.text: So Joshua, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the fighting men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all the people of war”</note> with him, came against them suddenly at the waters of Merom, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they attacked them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they fell upon them”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 11:8
verses.text: And Yahweh gave them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them and pursued them up to Great Sidon and Misrephoth Maim, and eastward up to the valley of Mizpeh. And they struck them until they left behind no survivor.

verses.name: Joshua 11:9
verses.text: And Joshua did to them as Yahweh commanded him; he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.  <div eID="gen1835" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1330"/><div sID="gen1836" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1330"/>Then Joshua turned back at that time, and he captured Hazor and struck its king with the sword, because Hazor formerly <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the head of all these kingdoms.

verses.name: Joshua 11:11
verses.text: He struck all the people that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in it with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> utterly destroying them. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞There was no one left who breathed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “No one was left over of any breath”</note> and he burned Hazor with fire.

verses.name: Joshua 11:12
verses.text: And Joshua captured all the cities of these kings, and all their kings, and he utterly destroyed them with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded.

verses.name: Joshua 11:13
verses.text: Israel did not burn the cities standing on their mounds,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mound”</note> except Hazor alone, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> Joshua burned.

verses.name: Joshua 11:14
verses.text: And all the spoil and livestock of these cities the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/> took as booty; they struck the people with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> until they had destroyed them—they left behind no one who breathed.

verses.name: Joshua 11:15
verses.text: Just as Yahweh commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua did; he left nothing undone that Yahweh had commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen1836" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1331"/><title type="x-s">A Review of Joshua’s Conquests</title> <div sID="gen1837" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1331"/>So Joshua took all this land: the hill country, all the Negev,<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judaean hills</note> all the land of Goshen,<note placement="foot">A southern region; the name means “on the mountains”</note> the Shephelah,<note placement="foot">Or “lowlands”; a geographical region on the western edge of the hills of Judea</note> the Arabah,<note placement="foot">A dry region that runs south of the Sea of Galilee along the Jordan valley</note> and the hill country of Israel and its Shephelah,<note placement="foot">Or “lowlands”; a geographical region on the western edge of the hills of Judea</note>

verses.name: Joshua 11:17
verses.text: from Mount Halak <transChange type="added">that</transChange> rises to Seir and to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon<note placement="foot">Or “white mountain”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the foot of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “under”</note> Mount Hermon; he captured all their kings, struck them, and killed them.

verses.name: Joshua 11:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">For</transChange> many days Joshua made war with all these kings.

verses.name: Joshua 11:19
verses.text: There was not a city that made peace with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> besides the Hivites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hivite”</note> and the inhabitants of Gibeon—<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all were taken in battle⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the all they took in the battle”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 11:20
verses.text: For it was Yahweh that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hardened their hearts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “made their hearts strong”</note> to meet Israel in war in order to utterly destroy them without mercy, that they would destroy them just as Yahweh commanded Moses.  <div eID="gen1837" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 11:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1332"/><div sID="gen1838" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1332"/>At that time Joshua came and exterminated the Anakites from the hill country, from Hebron, Debir, Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel; Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

verses.name: Joshua 11:22
verses.text: None of the Anakites were left in the land of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> some remained only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.

verses.name: Joshua 11:23
verses.text: Joshua took all the land according to all that Yahweh had spoken to Moses; and Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel, according to their tribal divisions, and the land rested from war.  <chapter eID="Josh.11"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1333"/><title type="x-s">The Kings Conquered by Joshua</title> <div sID="gen1839" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1333"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the kings of the land whom the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> defeated, and of whose land they took possession beyond the Jordon <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the rising of the sun”</note> from the wadi<note placement="foot">A valley that is dry most of the year, but contains a stream during the rainy season</note> of Arnon up to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah<note placement="foot">A dry region that runs south of the Sea of Galilee along the Jordan Valley</note> to the east:

verses.name: Joshua 12:2
verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the edge of the wadi<note placement="foot">A valley that is dry most of the year, but contains a stream during the rainy season</note> of Arnon, from the middle of the valley and half of Gilead, up to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Jabbok River⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Jabbok the wadi”</note> which marks the border of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon” or “children of Ammon”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 12:3
verses.text: and the Arabah<note placement="foot">A dry region that runs south of the Sea of Galilee along the Jordan Valley</note> up to the Kinnereth Sea<note placement="foot">That is, the Sea of Galilee</note> to the east, and as far as the sea of Arabah, the Salt Sea<note placement="foot">That is, the Dead Sea</note> to the east, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the direction of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the way of”</note> Beth Jeshimoth, and to the area southward, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the foot of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “under”</note> the slopes of Pisgah;<note placement="foot">Or Ashdoth Pisgah</note>

verses.name: Joshua 12:4
verses.text: the territory of Og king of Bashan, one of the last of the Rephaites, who lived at Ashtaroth and Edrei

verses.name: Joshua 12:5
verses.text: and ruled over Mount Hermon and Salecah and over all Bashan up to the border of the Geshurites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Geshurite”</note> and the Maacathites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Maacathite”</note> and half of Gilead, as far as the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

verses.name: Joshua 12:6
verses.text: Moses Yahweh’s servant and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> defeated them; and Moses Yahweh’s servant gave it as a possession to the Reubenites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Reubenite”</note> the Gadites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gadite”</note> and the half-tribe of Manasseh.  <div eID="gen1839" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1334"/><title type="x-s">The Kings Conquered by Moses</title> <div sID="gen1840" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1334"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the kings of the land whom Joshua and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> defeated beyond to the Jordan to the west, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon,<note placement="foot">Or “white mountain”</note> and up to Mount Halak, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> rises to Seir. And Joshua gave it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a possession to the tribes of Israel according to their allotments,

verses.name: Joshua 12:8
verses.text: in the hill country, the Shephelah,<note placement="foot">Or “lowlands”; a geographical region on the western edge of the hills of Judea</note> the Arabah,<note placement="foot">A dry region that runs south of the Sea of Galilee along the Jordan Valley</note> on the slopes, in the wilderness, and in the Negev;<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judaean hills</note> the Hittites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hittite”</note> the Amorites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> the Canaanites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> the Perizzites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Perizzite”</note> the Hivites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hivite”</note> and the Jebusites:<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jebusite”</note>  <div eID="gen1840" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1335"/><div sID="gen1841" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1335"/>the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> beside Bethel, one;  <div eID="gen1841" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1336"/><div sID="gen1842" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1336"/>the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;  <div eID="gen1842" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1337"/><div sID="gen1843" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1337"/>the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;  <div eID="gen1843" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1338"/><div sID="gen1844" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1338"/>the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;  <div eID="gen1844" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1339"/><div sID="gen1845" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1339"/>the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;  <div eID="gen1845" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1340"/><div sID="gen1846" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1340"/>the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;  <div eID="gen1846" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1341"/><div sID="gen1847" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1341"/>the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;  <div eID="gen1847" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1342"/><div sID="gen1848" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1342"/>the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;  <div eID="gen1848" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1343"/><div sID="gen1849" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1343"/>the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;  <div eID="gen1849" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1344"/><div sID="gen1850" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1344"/>the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;  <div eID="gen1850" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1345"/><div sID="gen1851" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1345"/>the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;  <div eID="gen1851" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1346"/><div sID="gen1852" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1346"/>the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Acshaph, one;  <div eID="gen1852" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1347"/><div sID="gen1853" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1347"/>the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;  <div eID="gen1853" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1348"/><div sID="gen1854" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1348"/>the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;  <div eID="gen1854" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1349"/><div sID="gen1855" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1349"/>the king of Dor in Naphath Dor, one; the king of Goiim for Gilgal, one;  <div eID="gen1855" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1350"/><div sID="gen1856" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1350"/>the king of Tirzah, one; all the kings, thirty-one.  <chapter eID="Josh.12"/>

verses.name: Joshua 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1351"/><title type="x-s">Land Still Remains to be Conquered</title> <div sID="gen1857" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1351"/>Now Joshua was old <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞advanced in years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he went in the days”</note> and Yahweh said to him, “You are old and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞advanced in years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you went in the days”</note> and very much of the land remains to be possessed.

verses.name: Joshua 13:2
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the remaining land: all the regions of the Philistines, and all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the Geshurites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Geshurite”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 13:3
verses.text: from the Shihor, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞east of Egypt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “on the face of Egypt”</note> up to the border of Ekron to the north, which is reckoned as Canaanite; there are five Philistine rulers: the Gazites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gazite”</note> Ashdodites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Ashdodite”</note> Ashkelonites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Ashkelonite”</note> Gittites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gittite”</note> Ekronites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Ekronite”</note> and the Avvim.

verses.name: Joshua 13:4
verses.text: In <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south; all the land of the Canaanites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> and Mearah, which belongs to the Sidonians up to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 13:5
verses.text: and the land of the Gebalites, and all the Lebanon,<note placement="foot">Or “white mountain”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞toward the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the rise of the sun”</note> from Baal Gad <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the foot of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “below” or “under”</note> Mount Hermon up to Lebo-Hamath;

verses.name: Joshua 13:6
verses.text: all the inhabitants of the hill country, from the Lebanon<note placement="foot">Or “white mountain”</note> up to Misrephoth Maim, and all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> only allocate it to Israel as an inheritance just as I have commanded you.

verses.name: Joshua 13:7
verses.text: Therefore, divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”  <div eID="gen1857" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1352"/><div sID="gen1858" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1352"/>With it<note placement="foot">That is, the other half-tribe of Manasseh</note> the Reubenites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Reubenite”</note> and the Gadites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gadite”</note> received their inheritance, which Moses gave them beyond the Jordan to the east, just as Moses Yahweh’s servant gave to them:

verses.name: Joshua 13:9
verses.text: from Aroer, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the edge of the wadi<note placement="foot">A valley that is dry most of the year, but contains a stream during the rainy season</note> of Arnon, and the city which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the middle of the wadi, and all the plateau <transChange type="added">from</transChange> Medeba up to Dibon;

verses.name: Joshua 13:10
verses.text: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> who reigned in Heshbon up to the border of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Ammon”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 13:11
verses.text: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurite<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Geshurite”</note> and the Maacathites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Maacathite”</note> all of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Hermon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “the hill country of Hermon”</note> and Bashan up to Salecah;

verses.name: Joshua 13:12
verses.text: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei—he was left over from the survivors<note placement="foot">Hebrew “survivor”</note> of the Rephaim; these Moses had defeated and driven out.

verses.name: Joshua 13:13
verses.text: But the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did not drive out the Geshurites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Geshurite”</note> or the Maacathites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Maacathite”</note> Geshur and Maacah live among Israel to this day.

verses.name: Joshua 13:14
verses.text: Only the tribe of Levites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Levite”</note> Moses did not give an inheritance; the offerings made by fire to Yahweh the God of Israel are their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> inheritance, just as he promised to them.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he said to him”</note>  <div eID="gen1858" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1353"/><title type="x-s">Reuben’s Inheritance</title> <div sID="gen1859" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1353"/>Moses gave <transChange type="added">an inheritance</transChange> to the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:16
verses.text: Their territory was from Aroer, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on the edge of the wadi<note placement="foot">A valley that is dry most of the year, but contains a stream during the rainy season</note> of Arnon, and the city that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the middle of the valley, and all the plateau by Medeba;

verses.name: Joshua 13:17
verses.text: Heshbon and its cities that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on the plateau; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

verses.name: Joshua 13:18
verses.text: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

verses.name: Joshua 13:19
verses.text: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, and Zereth Shahar on the hill of the valley;

verses.name: Joshua 13:20
verses.text: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth;

verses.name: Joshua 13:21
verses.text: all of the cities of the plateau, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> who reigned in Heshbon and whom Moses defeated with the leaders of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon who dwelled in the land.

verses.name: Joshua 13:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">In addition</transChange> to their slain, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> killed with the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practiced divination.

verses.name: Joshua 13:23
verses.text: And the border of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben was the Jordan and its banks.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bank”</note> This was the inheritance of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben according to their families, the cities, and their villages.  <div eID="gen1859" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1354"/><title type="x-s">Gad’s Inheritance</title> <div sID="gen1860" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1354"/>Moses gave <transChange type="added">an inheritance</transChange> to the tribe of Gad, to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gad, according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:25
verses.text: Their territory was Jazer and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Ammon”</note> up to Aroer, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞which is east of Rabbah⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “which is before Rabbah”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 13:26
verses.text: and from Heshbon up to Ramah-Mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim up to the territory to Debir;

verses.name: Joshua 13:27
verses.text: in the valley of Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, Zaphon, and the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan and <transChange type="added">its</transChange> banks,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bank”</note> up to the lower end of the Kinnereth Sea<note placement="foot">That is, the Sea of Galilee</note> beyond the Jordan to the east.

verses.name: Joshua 13:28
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the inheritance of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Gadites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Gad”</note> according to their families, the cities, and their villages.  <div eID="gen1860" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 13:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1355"/><title type="x-s">The Half-Tribe of Manasseh’s Inheritance</title> <div sID="gen1861" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1355"/>Moses gave <transChange type="added">an inheritance</transChange> to the half-tribe of Manasseh; it was for the half-tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Manasseh according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:30
verses.text: Their territory was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the settlements<note placement="foot">Or “tent villages”</note> of Jair, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in Bashan, sixty cities,

verses.name: Joshua 13:31
verses.text: and half of Gilead, with Ashtaroth, Edrei, and the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan; <transChange type="added">these were allotted</transChange> to the children of Makir son of Manasseh, for half of the children of Makir according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:32
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are the territories</transChange> that Moses gave as an inheritance on the desert-plateau of Moab, beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 13:33
verses.text: But to the tribe of Levi Moses did not give an inheritance; Yahweh the God of Israel, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their inheritance, just as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he promised them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he said to them”</note>  <chapter eID="Josh.13"/>

verses.name: Joshua 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1356"/><title type="x-s">The Land Allotted West of the Jordan</title> <div sID="gen1862" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1356"/>These <transChange type="added">are the territories</transChange> that the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families of the tribes of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> gave as an inheritance to them.

verses.name: Joshua 14:2
verses.text: Their inheritance <transChange type="added">was</transChange> by lot, just as Yahweh commanded through the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe.

verses.name: Joshua 14:3
verses.text: For Moses had given <transChange type="added">an</transChange> inheritance of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan, but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

verses.name: Joshua 14:4
verses.text: For the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, and they did not give a plot of ground to the Levites in the land, only cities to live <transChange type="added">in</transChange>, with their pastureland for their flocks and for their goods.

verses.name: Joshua 14:5
verses.text: Just as Yahweh commanded Moses, so the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did; and they allotted the land.  <div eID="gen1862" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1357"/><title type="x-s">Caleb Receives Hebron</title> <div sID="gen1863" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1357"/>Then the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah came to Joshua at Gilgal; and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the word that Yahweh said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh Barnea concerning you and me.

verses.name: Joshua 14:7
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I was forty years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I was a son of forty years”</note> when Moses Yahweh’s servant sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land, and I returned <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with an honest report⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with a word just as was with my heart”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 14:8
verses.text: My companions who went up with me made the hearts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> of the people melt, but I remained true to Yahweh my God.

verses.name: Joshua 14:9
verses.text: And Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land that your foot has trodden on will be an inheritance to you and your sons forever, because you remained true to Yahweh my God.’

verses.name: Joshua 14:10
verses.text: So then, look, Yahweh has kept me alive just as he promised these forty-five years,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> from the time that Yahweh spoke this word to Moses while Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wandered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “went”</note> in the wilderness. Now look, today <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am eighty-five years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “I am a son of eighty-five years”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 14:11
verses.text: Today I am still strong, just as on the day that Moses sent me; as my strength <transChange type="added">was</transChange> then, so now also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my strength for war <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and for daily activities⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for going out and for coming in”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 14:12
verses.text: So now give me this hill country that Yahweh spoke <transChange type="added">of</transChange> on that day, for you heard on that day that the Anakites <transChange type="added">were</transChange> there, with great and fortified cities. Perhaps Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with me, and I will drive them out just as Yahweh promised.”<note placement="foot">Or “said”</note>  <div eID="gen1863" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1358"/><div sID="gen1864" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1358"/>And Joshua blessed him and gave Hebron to Caleb son of Jephunneh as an inheritance.

verses.name: Joshua 14:14
verses.text: Thus Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he remained true to Yahweh the God of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 14:15
verses.text: And the name of Hebron formerly <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Kiriath Arba;<note placement="foot">Or “the city of Arba”</note> <transChange type="added">Arba was</transChange> the greatest person among the Anakites. And the land rested from war.  <chapter eID="Josh.14"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1359"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of Judah</title> <div sID="gen1865" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1359"/>The allotment for the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah according to their families reached to the border of Edom, to the wilderness of Zin, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the far south⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the south at the end of south”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 15:2
verses.text: Their southern border was from the end of the Salt Sea,<note placement="foot">That is, the Dead Sea</note> from the bay facing southward;

verses.name: Joshua 15:3
verses.text: it continues<note placement="foot">Hebrew “goes out”</note> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south to the ascent of Akrabbim, passes <transChange type="added">along</transChange> to Zin, it goes up south of Kadesh Barnea, passes <transChange type="added">along</transChange> Hezron, goes up to Addar, and makes a turn to Karka;

verses.name: Joshua 15:4
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it passes on⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it was to”</note> to Azmon, continues<note placement="foot">Hebrew “goes out”</note> by the wadi of Egypt, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of the border were”</note> at the sea. This will be your southern border.

verses.name: Joshua 15:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> eastern border <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the Salt Sea<note placement="foot">That is, the Dead Sea</note> up to the mouth<note placement="foot">Or “end”</note> of the Jordan. The border on the northern side runs from the bay of the sea at the mouth<note placement="foot">Or “end”</note> of the Jordan;

verses.name: Joshua 15:6
verses.text: the border goes up to Beth-hoglah and passes <transChange type="added">along</transChange> north of Beth Arabah; and the border goes up the stone of Bohan son of Reuben;

verses.name: Joshua 15:7
verses.text: and the border goes up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and to the north, turning to Gilgal, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> opposite the ascent of Adummim, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> south of the wadi;<note placement="foot">A valley that is dry most of the year, but contains a stream during the rainy season</note> and the border passes on to the waters of En Shemesh, and it ends at En Rogel.

verses.name: Joshua 15:8
verses.text: Then the border goes up <transChange type="added">by</transChange> the Valley of Ben Hinnom<note placement="foot">Or “valley of the son of Hinnom”</note> to the slope of the Jebusites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jebusite”</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Jerusalem); and the border goes up to the top of the mountain that <transChange type="added">lies</transChange> opposite the valley of Hinnom to the west, which is at the end of the valley of Rephaim to the north;

verses.name: Joshua 15:9
verses.text: then the border turns from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and continues<note placement="foot">Hebrew “goes out”</note> from there to the cities of Mount Ephron; the border <transChange type="added">then</transChange> turns <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Baalah (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Kiriath Jearim);

verses.name: Joshua 15:10
verses.text: and the border goes around from Baalah to the west, to Mount Seir, and passes on to the slope of Mount Jearim from the north (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Kesalon), and goes down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Beth Shemesh, and passes <transChange type="added">along by</transChange> Timnah.

verses.name: Joshua 15:11
verses.text: The border continues<note placement="foot">“Hebrew “goes out”</note> to the slope of Ekron to the north, then bends around to Shikkeron, it passes on to Mount Baalah and continues to Jabneel; and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the border ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of the border were”</note> at the sea.

verses.name: Joshua 15:12
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> western border <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to the Great Sea<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean</note> and its coast. This is the border surrounding the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah according to their families.  <div eID="gen1865" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1360"/><div sID="gen1866" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1360"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞According to the commandment of Yahweh to Joshua⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “according to the mouth of Yahweh to Joshua”</note> he gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh a plot of ground among the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah, Kiriath Arba,<note placement="foot">Or “the city of Arba”</note> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Hebron (<transChange type="added">Arba</transChange> was Anak’s father).

verses.name: Joshua 15:14
verses.text: Caleb drove out from there three of Anak’s sons, Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “children”</note> of Anak.

verses.name: Joshua 15:15
verses.text: And from there he went up against the inhabitants of Debir (the former name of Debir <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Kiriath Sepher).

verses.name: Joshua 15:16
verses.text: And Caleb said, “Whoever attacks Kiriath Sepher and captures it, I will give to him my daughter Acsah as a wife.”

verses.name: Joshua 15:17
verses.text: Othniel son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, captured it, and he gave to him Acsah his daughter as a wife.

verses.name: Joshua 15:18
verses.text: When she came <transChange type="added">to him</transChange> she urged him to ask her father for a field. So she dismounted from the donkey, and Caleb said to her, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What do you want⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “What is for you?”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 15:19
verses.text: And she said to him, “Give to me a gift;<note placement="foot">Or “blessing”</note> you have given me the land of the Negev,<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judaean hills</note> and you must give to me a spring of water.” And he gave to her the upper and lower spring.<note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Josh.15.13-Josh.15.19">Joshua 15:13–19 </reference>is almost identical to <reference osisRef="Judeg.1.11-Judeg.1.15">Judges 1:11–15</reference></note>  <div eID="gen1866" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1361"/><title type="x-s">The Cities of Judah</title> <div sID="gen1867" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1361"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the inheritance of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah according to their families:

verses.name: Joshua 15:21
verses.text: the cities belonging to the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah to the far south, to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> border of Edom to the south, were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

verses.name: Joshua 15:22
verses.text: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:23
verses.text: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

verses.name: Joshua 15:24
verses.text: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

verses.name: Joshua 15:25
verses.text: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Hazor),

verses.name: Joshua 15:26
verses.text: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:27
verses.text: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

verses.name: Joshua 15:28
verses.text: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:29
verses.text: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

verses.name: Joshua 15:30
verses.text: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:31
verses.text: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:32
verses.text: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon; <transChange type="added">in</transChange> all, twenty-nine cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1867" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1362"/><div sID="gen1868" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1362"/>In the Shephelah:<note placement="foot">Or “lowlands”; a geographical region on the western edge of the hills of Judea</note> Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:34
verses.text: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

verses.name: Joshua 15:35
verses.text: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:36
verses.text: Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1868" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1363"/><div sID="gen1869" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1363"/>Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

verses.name: Joshua 15:38
verses.text: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

verses.name: Joshua 15:39
verses.text: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

verses.name: Joshua 15:40
verses.text: Cabbon, Lahma, Kitlish,

verses.name: Joshua 15:41
verses.text: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1869" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1364"/><div sID="gen1870" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1364"/>Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

verses.name: Joshua 15:43
verses.text: Jephthah, Ashnah, Nezib,

verses.name: Joshua 15:44
verses.text: Keilah, Aczib, and Mareshah; nine cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1870" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1365"/><div sID="gen1871" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1365"/>Ekron, its towns and villages;

verses.name: Joshua 15:46
verses.text: from Ekron to the sea, and all that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were near⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “were on the hand of”</note> Ashdod and their villages.  <div eID="gen1871" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1366"/><div sID="gen1872" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1366"/>Ashdod, its towns and villages; Gaza, its towns and villages, up to the wadi<note placement="foot">A valley that is dry most of the year, but contains a stream during the rainy season</note> of Egypt and the Great Sea<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean</note> and its coast.<note placement="foot">Literally “border”</note>  <div eID="gen1872" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1367"/><div sID="gen1873" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1367"/>And in the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

verses.name: Joshua 15:49
verses.text: Dannah, Kiriath Sanna (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Debir),

verses.name: Joshua 15:50
verses.text: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

verses.name: Joshua 15:51
verses.text: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1873" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1368"/><div sID="gen1874" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1368"/>Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

verses.name: Joshua 15:53
verses.text: Janim, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:54
verses.text: Humtah, Kiriath Arba<note placement="foot">Or “the city of Arba”</note> (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Hebron), and Zior; nine cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1874" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1369"/><div sID="gen1875" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1369"/>Moan, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:56
verses.text: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:57
verses.text: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1875" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1370"/><div sID="gen1876" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1370"/>Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

verses.name: Joshua 15:59
verses.text: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1876" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1371"/><div sID="gen1877" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1371"/>Kiriath Baal (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Kiriath Jearim) and Rabbah; two cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1877" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1372"/><div sID="gen1878" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1372"/>In the wilderness: Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:62
verses.text: Nibshan, the city of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1878" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1373"/><div sID="gen1879" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1373"/>But the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah were unable to drive out the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so the Jebusites live with the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah in Jerusalem to this day.  <chapter eID="Josh.15"/>

verses.name: Joshua 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1374"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of Ephraim and Manasseh</title> <div sID="gen1880" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1374"/>The allotment of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Joseph went from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Jordan by Jericho, at the waters of Jericho to the east, <transChange type="added">into</transChange> the wilderness, going up from Jericho into the hill country <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Bethel;

verses.name: Joshua 16:2
verses.text: it continues from Bethel to Luz, and it passes <transChange type="added">along</transChange> to the territory of the Arkites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Arkite”</note> at Ataroth.

verses.name: Joshua 16:3
verses.text: Then it goes down, to the west, to the territory of the Japhletites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Japhletite”</note> up to the territory of Lower Beth-horon, then to Gezer, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of it were”</note> at the sea.  <div eID="gen1880" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1375"/><div sID="gen1881" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1375"/>And the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance.

verses.name: Joshua 16:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This</transChange> was the border of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Ephraim according to their families: the border of their inheritance to the east <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Ataroth Addar, up to Upper Beth-horon.

verses.name: Joshua 16:6
verses.text: The border continues to the sea; from Micmethath to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north, the border turns to the east to Taanath Shiloh, and it passes <transChange type="added">along</transChange> it from the east to Janoah.

verses.name: Joshua 16:7
verses.text: Then it goes down from Janoah to Ataroth and to Naarah; it touches Jericho and ends <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the Jordan;

verses.name: Joshua 16:8
verses.text: from Tappuah the border goes to the west, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the wadi<note placement="foot">A valley that is dry most of the year, but contains a stream during the rainy season</note> of Kanah, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of it were”</note> at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Ephraim according to their families,

verses.name: Joshua 16:9
verses.text: with the cities that were set apart for the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Ephraim in the midst of the inheritance of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Manasseh, all the cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 16:10
verses.text: But they did not drive out the Canananites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> who were dwelling in Gezer, and so the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> live in the midst of Ephraim to this day, but they became forced laborers.  <chapter eID="Josh.16"/>

verses.name: Joshua 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1376"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of the Other Half-Tribe of Manasseh</title> <div sID="gen1882" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1376"/>Then the allotment was made for the tribe of Manasseh, because he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the firstborn of Joseph. To Makir, the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were allotted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and there was to him”</note> Gilead and Bashan, because he was a warrior.<note placement="foot">Literally “a man of war”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 17:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">An allotment</transChange> was <transChange type="added">made</transChange> for the remaining descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Manasseh, according to their families: For the children of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida—these were the male descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Manasseh son of Joseph according to their families.  <div eID="gen1882" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1377"/><div sID="gen1883" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1377"/>But Zelophehad son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Makir, son of Manasseh, had no sons, only daughters. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.name: Joshua 17:4
verses.text: They came before Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders, saying, “Yahweh commanded Moses to give an inheritance to us among our kinsmen.”<note placement="foot">Or “among our brothers”</note> Therefore, according to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth of Yahweh”</note> he gave them an inheritance among the kinsmen<note placement="foot">Or “brothers”</note> of their father.

verses.name: Joshua 17:5
verses.text: Thus ten shares fell to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> beyond the Jordan,

verses.name: Joshua 17:6
verses.text: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons. And the land of Gilead was <transChange type="added">allotted</transChange> to the remaining descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Manasseh.

verses.name: Joshua 17:7
verses.text: The border of Manasseh was from Asher <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Micmethath, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> opposite Shechem;<note placement="foot">Or “which faces Shechem”</note> then the border goes to the south, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

verses.name: Joshua 17:8
verses.text: The land of Tappuah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belonged to Manasseh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “was to Manasseh”</note> but Tuppuah on the border of Manasseh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belonged to the descendants of Ephraim⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “was to the children of Ephraim”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 17:9
verses.text: Then the border goes down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the wadi<note placement="foot">A valley that is dry most of the year, but contains a stream during the rainy season</note> of Kanah to the south of the wadi. These cities belong to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh is north of the wadi, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of it were”</note> at the sea.

verses.name: Joshua 17:10
verses.text: The south <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Ephraim’s, and the north <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Manasseh’s; the sea is their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “its”</note> border; Asher touches <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north and on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east Issachar.

verses.name: Joshua 17:11
verses.text: In Issachar and Asher, Manasseh had Beth-shean and its villages, Ibleam and its villages, the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, the inhabitants of En-dor and its villages, the inhabitants of Taanach and its villages, the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages; the third is Napheth.

verses.name: Joshua 17:12
verses.text: But the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Manasseh were not able to take possession of these towns; the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> were determined to live in this land.

verses.name: Joshua 17:13
verses.text: And it happened, when the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> grew strong, they put the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> to forced labor but never drove them out completely.  <div eID="gen1883" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1378"/><title type="x-s">The Tribes of Joseph Object</title> <div sID="gen1884" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1378"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Joseph spoke with Joshua, saying, “Why have you given us<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to me”</note> one allotment and one share <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an inheritance? We are many people, which Yahweh has blessed.”

verses.name: Joshua 17:15
verses.text: And Joshua said to them, “If you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> many people, go up to the forest and clear <transChange type="added">a place</transChange> there for yourselves in the land of the Perizzites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Perizzite”</note> and Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is <transChange type="added">too</transChange> narrow for you.”

verses.name: Joshua 17:16
verses.text: And the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us, and all of the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> living in the land of the valley have chariots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note> of iron, those in Beth-shean and its villages, and those in the Jezreel Valley.”

verses.name: Joshua 17:17
verses.text: And Joshua said to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and Manasseh, “You are many people and have great power; you will not have one allotment <transChange type="added">only</transChange>;

verses.name: Joshua 17:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hill country will be yours. Even though it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a forest, you will clear it, and it will be yours <transChange type="added">to</transChange> its farthest borders. You will drive out the Canaanites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> even though they have iron chariots and <transChange type="added">are</transChange> strong.”  <chapter eID="Josh.17"/>

verses.name: Joshua 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1379"/><title type="x-s">The Last of the Land Is Divided</title> <div sID="gen1885" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1379"/>The entire congregation of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> assembled at Shiloh, and they set up there the tent of meeting, and the land was subdued before them.<note placement="foot">Or “in their presence”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 18:2
verses.text: And seven tribes remained among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> who had not been apportioned their inheritance.

verses.name: Joshua 18:3
verses.text: And Joshua said to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Until when”</note> will you be slack about going to take possession of the land that Yahweh, the God of your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> has given you?

verses.name: Joshua 18:4
verses.text: Provide three men <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from each tribe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “according to each tribe”</note> and I will send them so that they may begin to go through the land and write a description of it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to their inheritance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “according to the mouth of their inheritance”</note> and let them come to me.

verses.name: Joshua 18:5
verses.text: They will divide it among themselves into seven portions; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Judah will maintain its border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Judah will stand on its border”</note> from the south, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the house of Joseph will maintain its border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the house of Joseph will stand on its border”</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north.

verses.name: Joshua 18:6
verses.text: Describe the land <transChange type="added">in</transChange> seven divisions, and bring <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to me here; I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.

verses.name: Joshua 18:7
verses.text: The Levites among you have no portion, for their inheritance <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the priesthood of Yahweh; Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh received their inheritance beyond the Jordan to the east, which Moses Yahweh’s servant gave to them.”  <div eID="gen1885" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1380"/><div sID="gen1886" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1380"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the men went immediately⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the men got up and went”</note> and Joshua commanded the ones going to describe the land, saying, “Go and walk about through the land, write a description, and return to me, and here I will cast a lot for you before<note placement="foot">Or “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh at Shiloh.”

verses.name: Joshua 18:9
verses.text: And the men went and passed through the land, and they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞described⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wrote it”</note> the cities in seven divisions in a book; and they came to Joshua to the camp <transChange type="added">at</transChange> Shiloh,

verses.name: Joshua 18:10
verses.text: and Joshua cast a lot for them at Shiloh before<note placement="foot">Or “in the presence of”</note> Yahweh, and there he divided the land for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to each a portion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “according to their allotment”</note>  <div eID="gen1886" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1381"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of Benjamin</title> <div sID="gen1887" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1381"/>And the allotment of the tribe of Benjamin came up according to their families, and the border of their allotment fell<note placement="foot">Literally “went out”</note> between the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah and the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Joseph.

verses.name: Joshua 18:12
verses.text: Their northern border began at the Jordan and went up to the slope of Jericho on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north and continued into the hill country to the west; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of it were”</note> at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

verses.name: Joshua 18:13
verses.text: The border passes <transChange type="added">on</transChange> from there to Luz, to the slope of Luz to the south (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Bethel); then the border goes down to Ataroth Addar to the mountain that is south of Lower Beth-Horon.

verses.name: Joshua 18:14
verses.text: Then the border changes direction and turns to the western side southward, from the mountain that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is opposite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “against the face of”</note> Beth-Horon to the south. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞It ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of it were”</note> at Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim), a town belonging to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah. This <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> western side.

verses.name: Joshua 18:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> southern side <transChange type="added">begins</transChange> on the outskirts of Kiriath Jearim, and the border continues to the west to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah;

verses.name: Joshua 18:16
verses.text: the border goes down to the foot<note placement="foot">Or “to the edge”</note> of the mountain, which is opposite the Valley of Ben Hinnom,<note placement="foot">Or “valley of the son of-Hinnom”</note> which is in the valley of Rephaim to the north; then it does down the valley of Hinnom to the slope of the Jebusites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jebusite”</note> to the south, and then it goes down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> En Rogel.

verses.name: Joshua 18:17
