verses.text: It changes direction from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north, and it continues <transChange type="added">to</transChange> En Shemesh; it goes out to Geliloth, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> opposite the ascent of Adummim, and it goes down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the stone of Bohan, son of Reuben.

verses.name: Joshua 18:18
verses.text: It passes <transChange type="added">on</transChange> to the slope opposite the Arabah<note placement="foot">A dry region that runs south of the Sea of Galilee along the Jordan Valley</note> to the north, and it goes down to the Arabah.<note placement="foot">A dry region that runs south of the Sea of Galilee along the Jordan Valley</note>

verses.name: Joshua 18:19
verses.text: The border passes <transChange type="added">on</transChange> to the slope of Beth-hoglah to the north and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of it were”</note> at the north bay of the Salt Sea<note placement="foot">That is, the Dead Sea</note> at the south end of the Jordan. This is the southern border.

verses.name: Joshua 18:20
verses.text: The Jordan forms its border on the eastern side. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the inheritance of the tribe of Benjamin, its borders that surrounds <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, according to their families.  <div eID="gen1887" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1382"/><div sID="gen1888" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1382"/>Now the towns of the tribes of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Benjamin, according to their families, were Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek Keziz,

verses.name: Joshua 18:22
verses.text: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

verses.name: Joshua 18:23
verses.text: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

verses.name: Joshua 18:24
verses.text: Kephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1888" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 18:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1383"/><div sID="gen1889" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1383"/>Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

verses.name: Joshua 18:26
verses.text: Mizpeh, Kephirah, Mozah,

verses.name: Joshua 18:27
verses.text: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

verses.name: Joshua 18:28
verses.text: Zela, Haeleph, Jebus (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath; fourteen cities and their villages. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the inheritance of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Benjamin according to their families.  <chapter eID="Josh.18"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1384"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of Simeon</title> <div sID="gen1890" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1384"/>The second allotment <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “went out”</note> for Simeon, for the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Simeon, according to their families. And their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah.

verses.name: Joshua 19:2
verses.text: And they had as their inheritance Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:3
verses.text: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

verses.name: Joshua 19:4
verses.text: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:5
verses.text: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:6
verses.text: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:7
verses.text: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages,

verses.name: Joshua 19:8
verses.text: and all the villages that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> around these towns up to Baalat-Beor, Ramath of the Negev.<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judaean hills</note> This was the inheritance of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Simeon according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:9
verses.text: Part of the portion <transChange type="added">allotted to</transChange> the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah became the inheritance of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Simeon because the portion for the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞too large for them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “large from them”</note> so the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Simeon inherited <transChange type="added">from</transChange> their inheritance.  <div eID="gen1890" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1385"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of Zebulun</title> <div sID="gen1891" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1385"/>The third allotment came up for the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance went up to Sarid.

verses.name: Joshua 19:11
verses.text: Their border goes up to the west, to Maralah; it touches<note placement="foot">Or “reaches to”</note> Dabbesheth, then the wadi<note placement="foot">A valley that is dry most of the year, but contains a stream during the rainy season</note> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> opposite Jokneam.

verses.name: Joshua 19:12
verses.text: It turns from Sarid to the east to the sunrise, to the border of Kislot-Tabor; it continues to Daberath and goes up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Japhia.

verses.name: Joshua 19:13
verses.text: From there it passes <transChange type="added">along</transChange> to the east toward the sunrise, to Gath Hepher and to Eth Kazin, and continuing <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Rimmon, it turns <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Neah;

verses.name: Joshua 19:14
verses.text: it changes direction from the north of Hannathon, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of it were” </note> at the valley of Yiptah-El;

verses.name: Joshua 19:15
verses.text: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem; twelve cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:16
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the inheritance of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zebulun according to their families, these cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1891" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1386"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of Issachar</title> <div sID="gen1892" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1386"/>The fourth allotment <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “came out”</note> for Issachar, for the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Issachar, according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:18
verses.text: Their border went to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

verses.name: Joshua 19:19
verses.text: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

verses.name: Joshua 19:20
verses.text: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

verses.name: Joshua 19:21
verses.text: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez;

verses.name: Joshua 19:22
verses.text: and the border touches Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Its border ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of their border were”</note> at the Jordan; sixteen cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:23
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the inheritance of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1892" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1387"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of Asher</title> <div sID="gen1893" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1387"/>The fifth allotment <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “came out” </note> for the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Asher according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:25
verses.text: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Acshaph,

verses.name: Joshua 19:26
verses.text: Allamelech, Amad, and Mishal; it touches Carmel to the west, and Shihor-Libnat.

verses.name: Joshua 19:27
verses.text: Then it turns <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞eastward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the rising of the sun”</note> to Beth-dagon and touches Zebulun and the valley of Yiptah-El to the north<note placement="foot">Literally “left hand/side” </note> to Beth Emeck and Neiel; it continues to Cabul from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,

verses.name: Joshua 19:28
verses.text: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah up to Great Sidon;

verses.name: Joshua 19:29
verses.text: then the border turns <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Ramah, and up to the fortified city of Tyre, <transChange type="added">where</transChange> the border turns <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Hosah; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of it were”</note> at the sea, from Hebel to Aczib.

verses.name: Joshua 19:30
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Included were</transChange> Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob; twenty-two cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:31
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the inheritance of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Asher according to their families, these cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1893" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1388"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of Naphtali</title> <div sID="gen1894" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1388"/>The sixth allotment <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “came out”</note> for the children of Naphtali, for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:33
verses.text: Their border was from Heleph, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oak in Zaanannim, Adami Nekeb, Jabneel, up to Lakkum; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it ends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the goings out of it were”</note> at the Jordan;

verses.name: Joshua 19:34
verses.text: then the border turns to the west, to Aznoth Tabor, and continues from there to Hukok, and it touches<note placement="foot">Or “reaches to”</note> Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west, and Judah on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the rising of the sun”</note> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 19:35
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The fortified cities⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the cities of fortification”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Kinnereth,

verses.name: Joshua 19:36
verses.text: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

verses.name: Joshua 19:37
verses.text: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

verses.name: Joshua 19:38
verses.text: Yiron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth-anath, Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:39
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1894" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1389"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of Dan</title> <div sID="gen1895" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1389"/>The seventh lot <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “came out”</note> for the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Dan according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:41
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,

verses.name: Joshua 19:42
verses.text: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:43
verses.text: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

verses.name: Joshua 19:44
verses.text: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

verses.name: Joshua 19:45
verses.text: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

verses.name: Joshua 19:46
verses.text: Me Jarkon, Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

verses.name: Joshua 19:47
verses.text: The border of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Dan continued <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beyond them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from them”</note> because the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Dan went up and fought with Lesham, and they captured and struck it with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> and they took possession of it and settled in it; and they called Leshem Dan, after the name of Dan their ancestor.<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 19:48
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the inheritance of the tribe of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Dan according to their families, these cities and their villages.  <div eID="gen1895" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1390"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment Is Completed</title> <div sID="gen1896" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1390"/>They finished assigning the land according to its borders, and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> gave an inheritance <transChange type="added">from</transChange> among them to Joshua son of Nun.

verses.name: Joshua 19:50
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞According to the commandment of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “On the mouth of Yahweh”</note> they gave him the city that he requested, Timnath Serah, in the hill country of Ephraim, and he rebuilt the city and settled<note placement="foot">Or “dwelt”</note> in it.

verses.name: Joshua 19:51
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the inheritances that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families of the tribes, distributed by allotment <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> at Shiloh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “in the presence of Yahweh”</note> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the entrance of the tent of meeting. And they finished dividing the land.  <chapter eID="Josh.19"/>

verses.name: Joshua 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1391"/><title type="x-s">Cities of Refuge Are Established</title> <div sID="gen1897" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1391"/>And Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 20:2
verses.text: “Speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> saying, ‘Appoint for yourselves cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you through the hand of Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 20:3
verses.text: Anyone who kills a person by accident or unintentionally<note placement="foot">Or “by not knowing”</note> may flee there; they will be for yourselves a refuge from the avenger of blood.

verses.name: Joshua 20:4
verses.text: The killer will flee to one of these cities, stand <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the entrance of the gate of the city, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞state his case to the elders of that city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “he will speak his words in the ears of the elders of that city”</note> and they will take him<note placement="foot">Or “they will gather him”</note> into the city and give him a place, and he will dwell among them.

verses.name: Joshua 20:5
verses.text: And if the avenger of blood pursues after him, they will not hand over the killer into his hand, because he killed his neighbor unintentionally, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he did not hate him previously⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he did not hate him since yesterday and the day before that”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 20:6
verses.text: The killer will stay in that city until he stands before the congregation for the trial, until the death of the one who is the high priest in those days. Then <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the killer will return⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the killer will return and go”</note> to his city and to his house, to the city from which he fled.’ ”  <div eID="gen1897" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1392"/><div sID="gen1898" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1392"/>So <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they set apart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “consecrated”</note> Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba<note placement="foot">Or “the city of Arba”</note> (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

verses.name: Joshua 20:8
verses.text: Beyond the Jordan east of Jericho, they appointed Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau, from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead, from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in the Bashan, from the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.name: Joshua 20:9
verses.text: These were the cities designated for all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and for the foreigners<note placement="foot">Hebrew “foreigner”</note> dwelling among them, for anyone that kills a person unintentionally to flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until there is a trial⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until he stands”</note> before the congregation.  <chapter eID="Josh.20"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1393"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of the Levites</title> <div sID="gen1899" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1393"/>Then the heads of the families of the Levites came to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the heads of the families of the tribes of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 21:2
verses.text: And they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “Yahweh commanded through the hand of Moses to give us cities to live <transChange type="added">in</transChange>, with their pasturelands for our livestock.”

verses.name: Joshua 21:3
verses.text: So, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “by the mouth of Yahweh”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> gave the Levites these cities and their pasturelands from their inheritance.  <div eID="gen1899" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1394"/><div sID="gen1900" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1394"/>The allotment <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “came out”</note> for the families of the Kohathites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Kohathite”</note> The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞received⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they had”</note> by lot thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.  <div eID="gen1900" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1395"/><div sID="gen1901" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1395"/>The remaining descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Kohath <transChange type="added">received</transChange> by lot ten cities from the families of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.  <div eID="gen1901" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1396"/><div sID="gen1902" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1396"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gershon <transChange type="added">received</transChange> by lot thirteen cities from the families of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, and Naphtali and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.  <div eID="gen1902" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1397"/><div sID="gen1903" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1397"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of the Merarites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Merarite”</note> according to their families <transChange type="added">received</transChange> twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.  <div eID="gen1903" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1398"/><div sID="gen1904" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1398"/>The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> gave to the Levites these cities and their pastureland by lot, just as Yahweh commanded through the hand of Moses.  <div eID="gen1904" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1399"/><div sID="gen1905" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1399"/>They gave these cities, which are <transChange type="added">here</transChange> mentioned by name, from the tribe of the families of Judah and from the tribe of the families of Simeon;

verses.name: Joshua 21:10
verses.text: and they were for the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Aaron, from the families of the Kohathites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Kohathite”</note> from the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Levi, because the first lot was theirs.

verses.name: Joshua 21:11
verses.text: And they gave to them Kiriath Arba,<note placement="foot">Or “the city of Arba”</note> <transChange type="added">Arba being</transChange> the father of Anak (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, Hebron), in the hill country of Judah and the pasturelands surrounding it.

verses.name: Joshua 21:12
verses.text: But the field of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his property.  <div eID="gen1905" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1400"/><div sID="gen1906" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1400"/>To the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron, the city of refuge <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the killer, and its pasturelands, Libnah and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:14
verses.text: Jattir and its pasturelands, Eshtemoa and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:15
verses.text: Holon and its pasturelands, Debir and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:16
verses.text: Ain and its pasturelands, Juttah and its pasturelands, and Beth Shemesh and its pasturelands; nine cities from these two tribes.

verses.name: Joshua 21:17
verses.text: From the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon and its pasturelands, Geba and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:18
verses.text: Anathoth and its pasturelands, Almon and its pasturelands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:19
verses.text: All the cities of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Aaron the priests, thirteen cities and their pasturelands.  <div eID="gen1906" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1401"/><div sID="gen1907" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1401"/>For the families of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Kohath, the remaining Levites of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Kohath, they <transChange type="added">received</transChange> the cities of their lot from the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.name: Joshua 21:21
verses.text: They gave them Shechem, the city of refuge <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the killer, and its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, Gezer and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:22
verses.text: Kibzaim and its pasturelands, and Beth-horon and its pasturelands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:23
verses.text: From the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh and its pasturelands, Gibbethon and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:24
verses.text: Aijalon and its pasturelands, and Gath Rimmon and its pasturelands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:25
verses.text: From the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach and its pasturelands and Gath Rimmon with its pasturelands; two cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:26
verses.text: All the cities and their pasturelands for the remaining families of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Kohath <transChange type="added">were</transChange> ten.  <div eID="gen1907" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1402"/><div sID="gen1908" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1402"/>To the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gershon, one of the families of the Levites, from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan, a city of refuge for the killer, and its pasturelands, and Eshtarah and its pasturelands; two cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:28
verses.text: From the tribe of Issachar, Kishion and its pasturelands, Daberath and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:29
verses.text: Jarmuth and its pasturelands, En Gannim and its pasturelands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:30
verses.text: From the tribe of Asher, Mishal and its pasturelands, Abdon and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:31
verses.text: Helkath and its pasturelands, Rehob and its pasturelands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:32
verses.text: From the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee, the city of refuge for the killer, and its pasturelands, Hammoth Dor and its pasturelands, and Kartan and its pasturelands; three cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:33
verses.text: All the cities of the Gershonites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Gershonite”</note> according to their families <transChange type="added">were</transChange> thirteen cities and their pasturelands.  <div eID="gen1908" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1403"/><div sID="gen1909" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1403"/>To the families of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Merarite, the remaining Levites, from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam and its pasturelands, Kartah and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:35
verses.text: Dimnah and its pasturelands, and Nahalal and its pasturelands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:36
verses.text: From the tribe of Reuben, Bezer and its pasturelands, Jahaz and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:37
verses.text: Kedemoth and its pasturelands, and Mephaath and its pasturelands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:38
verses.text: From the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead, the city of refuge for the killer, and its pasturelands, Mahanaim and its pasturelands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:39
verses.text: Heshbon and its pasturelands, and Jazer and its pasturelands; four cities <transChange type="added">in</transChange> all.

verses.name: Joshua 21:40
verses.text: All <transChange type="added">these were</transChange> the cities of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Merarite according to their families, the remaining families of the Levites; their allotment was twelve cities.  <div eID="gen1909" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1404"/><div sID="gen1910" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1404"/>All the cities of the Levites among the property of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> forty-eight cities and their pasturelands.

verses.name: Joshua 21:42
verses.text: Each of these cities had pasturelands surrounding them; so <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> for all of these cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:43
verses.text: And Yahweh gave to Israel all the land that he swore to give to their ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and they took possession of it and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞settled in it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Or “dwelled in it”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 21:44
verses.text: Yahweh gave them rest on every side, according to all that he had sworn to their ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and nobody from all their enemies withstood them, for Yahweh had given all their enemies into their hand.

verses.name: Joshua 21:45
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞nothing failed from⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Not a thing fell”</note> all the good things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing”</note> that Yahweh promised to the house of Israel; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everything came to pass⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “everything it came”</note>  <chapter eID="Josh.21"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1405"/><title type="x-s">The Eastern Tribes Return</title> <div sID="gen1911" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1405"/>Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

verses.name: Joshua 22:2
verses.text: and he said to them, “You have observed all that Moses Yahweh’s servant commanded you, and you have listened<note placement="foot">Or “you have obeyed”</note> to my voice in all that I have commanded you;

verses.name: Joshua 22:3
verses.text: you have not forsaken your kinsmen<note placement="foot">Or “brothers”</note> these many days, up to this day, and you have observed the obligation of the command of Yahweh your God.

verses.name: Joshua 22:4
verses.text: So then, Yahweh your God has given rest to your kinsmen,<note placement="foot">Or “brothers”</note> just as he promised them; so then, turn and go to your tents to the land of your possession, which Moses Yahweh’s servant gave to you beyond the Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 22:5
verses.text: Only be very careful to observe the commandment and law that Moses Yahweh’s servant commanded you, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”<note placement="foot">Or “inner self”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:6
verses.text: And Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their tents.

verses.name: Joshua 22:7
verses.text: And to the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given <transChange type="added">a possession</transChange> in Bashan, but to the other half Joshua had given <transChange type="added">a possession</transChange> with their kinsmen<note placement="foot">Or “brothers”</note> beyond the Jordan to the west; and when Joshua sent them to their tents and blessed them,

verses.name: Joshua 22:8
verses.text: he said to them, “Return to your tents with much wealth, and with very much livestock, with silver, gold, copper, iron, and with very much clothing; divide the war-booty of your enemies with your kinsmen.”<note placement="foot">Or “brothers”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:9
verses.text: So the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned home and departed with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead to the land of their possession, which they had acquired <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to the command of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the mouth of Yahweh”</note> through the hand of Moses.  <div eID="gen1911" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1406"/><div sID="gen1912" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1406"/>And they came to the region of the Jordan that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the land of Canaan, and the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh built there an altar on the Jordan, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a large and imposing altar⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a large altar to appearance”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:11
verses.text: And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> heard it said that the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had built an altar next to the land of Canaan, in the region of the Jordan, on the side belonging to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:12
verses.text: When the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> heard of it, the whole congregation of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> gathered <transChange type="added">at</transChange> Shiloh to go up against them for battle.

verses.name: Joshua 22:13
verses.text: And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> sent to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, Phinehas the priest son of Eleazar,

verses.name: Joshua 22:14
verses.text: and ten leaders with him, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one leader for each⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one leader, one leader”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of the house of father”</note> from each of the tribes of Israel; and each one was the head of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house of their fathers”</note> among the clans of Israel.<note placement="foot">Or “thousands of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:15
verses.text: They came to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 22:16
verses.text: “Thus says all the congregation of Yahweh: ‘What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this treachery that you have committed against the God of Israel by turning away today from following Yahweh, by building for yourselves an altar to rebel today against Yahweh?

verses.name: Joshua 22:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not the sin of Peor <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞enough for us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “too little for us”</note> from which we have not cleansed ourselves today, and for which a plague came to the congregation of Yahweh,

verses.name: Joshua 22:18
verses.text: that you must turn today from following Yahweh? <transChange type="added">If</transChange> you rebel today against Yahweh, tomorrow he will be angry with all of the congregation of Israel;

verses.name: Joshua 22:19
verses.text: if, however, the land of your property <transChange type="added">is</transChange> unclean, cross <transChange type="added">over</transChange> to the land of Yahweh’s property, where Yahweh’s tabernacle resides,<note placement="foot">Or “stands”</note> and take possession among us. But you must not rebel against Yahweh or against us by building for yourselves an altar other than the altar of Yahweh our God.

verses.name: Joshua 22:20
verses.text: Did not Achan son of Zerah commit treachery with devoted things,<note placement="foot">Or “consecrated possession”</note> and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And he alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And he is one man that”</note> did not perish because of his iniquity.’ ”  <div eID="gen1912" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1407"/><div sID="gen1913" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1407"/>And the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh spoke with the heads of the clans<note placement="foot">Or “thousands”</note> of Israel,

verses.name: Joshua 22:22
verses.text: “Yahweh, God of gods! Yahweh, God of gods knows. And let Israel itself know, if <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> in rebellion or treachery against Yahweh, do not spare us this day

verses.name: Joshua 22:23
verses.text: for building for ourselves an altar to turn away from Yahweh, or if <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> to offer burnt offerings,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “offering”</note> grain offerings,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “offering”</note> or fellowship offerings on it, may Yahweh himself take vengeance.

verses.name: Joshua 22:24
verses.text: But in fact, we have done this because of anxiety, because of a reason, saying, ‘In the future your children may say to our children, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What is the relationship between you and Yahweh the God of Israel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “What is to you and to Yahweh the God of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:25
verses.text: Yahweh has made the Jordan a border between us and you, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben and Gad; you have no portion in Yahweh.’ So your children may put an end to our children worshiping<note placement="foot">Or “seeing”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Joshua 22:26
verses.text: So we said, ‘Let us build immediately for ourselves an altar, not for burnt offerings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “offering”</note> or for sacrifices;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sacrifice”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:27
verses.text: instead, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us for performing the serving of Yahweh in his presence with our burnt offerings, sacrifices, and fellowship offerings; so that your children may not say in the future to our children, “You have no portion in Yahweh.” ’

verses.name: Joshua 22:28
verses.text: And we thought, if they say to us and to our children in the future, we can say, ‘Look at this replica of the altar of Yahweh, which our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> made, not for burnt offerings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “offering”</note> or sacrifices;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sacrifice”</note> rather, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a witness between us and you.’

verses.name: Joshua 22:29
verses.text: Far be it from us to rebel against Yahweh, to turn today from following Yahweh, to build an altar for burnt offerings,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “offering”</note> grain offerings,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “offering”</note> or sacrifices,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sacrifice”</note> instead of the altar of Yahweh our God that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> before his tabernacle.”  <div eID="gen1913" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1408"/><div sID="gen1914" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1408"/>Phinehas the priest, the leaders of the congregation, and the heads of the clans<note placement="foot">Or “thousands”</note> of Israel who were with him heard the words that the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh spoke, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they were satisfied⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it was good in their eyes”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:31
verses.text: Phinehas the priest, son of Eleazar, said to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh, “Today we know that Yahweh is among us, because you have not committed this treachery against Yahweh. Therefore you have rescued the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> from the hand of Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen1914" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1409"/><div sID="gen1915" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1409"/>And Phinehas the priest, son of Eleazar, and the leaders returned from the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben and Gad, from the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they gave them their report⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they brought back a word to them”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:33
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The report satisfied the Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “The report was good in the eyes of the children of Israel”</note> they blessed God, and they did not speak of going up for battle against them to destroy the land in which the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben and Gad were living.<note placement="foot">Or “dwelling”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:34
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reuben and Gad called the altar Witness, “Because,” <transChange type="added">they said</transChange>, “it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a witness between us that Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> God.”  <chapter eID="Josh.22"/>

verses.name: Joshua 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1410"/><title type="x-s">Joshua’s Farewell Address</title> <div sID="gen1916" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1410"/>And it happened, after <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a long time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “many days”</note> after Yahweh had given rest to Israel from all their surrounding enemies, and after Joshua was old and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞well-advanced in years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he went into the days”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:2
verses.text: Joshua summoned all Israel, their elders, heads, judges, and officials, and he said to them, “I am old and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞well-advanced in years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I went into the days”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:3
verses.text: and you have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to all these nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for your sake⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “because of your presence”</note> for Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> fighting for you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:4
verses.text: Look! I have allotted to you these remaining nations as an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> all the nations that I have cut off, to the Great Sea<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the setting of the sun”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:5
verses.text: And Yahweh your God will push them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞back before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from your presence”</note> and drive them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞out of your sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from your face”</note> and you will possess their land, just as Yahweh your God promised to you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:6
verses.text: Be very strong to observe carefully all that is written in the scroll of the law of Moses so as not to turn aside from it, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the right or left,

verses.name: Joshua 23:7
verses.text: so as not to go among these remaining nations with you; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞do not profess⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do not mention”</note> the name of their gods, and do not swear by them, serve them, or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bow down to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “bow yourselves down to them”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:8
verses.text: But hold fast to Yahweh your God, just as you have done up to this day.

verses.name: Joshua 23:9
verses.text: Yahweh has driven out before you great and strong nations; and as for you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞nobody has withstood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man has not stood in your presence”</note> you to this day.

verses.name: Joshua 23:10
verses.text: One of your men put to flight a thousand, for Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> fighting for you, just as he promised you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:11
verses.text: Take utmost care for <transChange type="added">the sake of</transChange> your life to love Yahweh your God,

verses.name: Joshua 23:12
verses.text: for if indeed you turn back and join these remaining nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with you”</note> and you intermarry with them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞marrying their women and they yours⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you go into them and they into you”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:13
verses.text: know for certain that Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will not continue to drive out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will not drive out again”</note> these nations from before you; they will be for you a snare and a trap, a whip on your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land that Yahweh your God has given to you.  <div eID="gen1916" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1411"/><div sID="gen1917" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1411"/>Look! <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am about to die⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I am going today on the way of all the earth”</note> and you know in all your hearts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> and souls<note placement="foot">Hebrew “soul”; or “inner self”</note> that not one thing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞failed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fell”</note> from all the good things that Yahweh your God promised concerning you; everything <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞has been fulfilled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “has come out”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞not one thing failed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not one thing fell from it”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:15
verses.text: But just as all the good things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing”</note> came to you that Yahweh your God promised, so will Yahweh bring to you all the bad things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “things”</note> until he has destroyed you from this good land that Yahweh your God has given to you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:16
verses.text: If you transgress the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he commanded <transChange type="added">to</transChange> you, and you go and serve other gods and bow down to them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh’s anger will be kindled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Yahweh’s nose will become hot”</note> against you, and you will perish quickly from the good land that he has given to you.”  <chapter eID="Josh.23"/>

verses.name: Joshua 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1412"/><title type="x-s">Joshua Recounts Their History</title> <div sID="gen1918" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1412"/>And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem; he summoned the elders of Israel, their heads, their judges, and their officials, and they presented themselves before God.

verses.name: Joshua 24:2
verses.text: And Joshua said to all the people, “Thus says Yahweh the God of Israel: ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Long ago⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from ancient”</note> your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>—Terah the father of Abraham and the father of Nahor—lived beyond the river,<note placement="foot">That is, the Euphrates</note> and they served other gods.

verses.name: Joshua 24:3
verses.text: I took your ancestor<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> Abraham from beyond the river<note placement="foot">That is, the Euphrates</note> and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I increased his offspring; I gave him Isaac,

verses.name: Joshua 24:4
verses.text: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. To Esau I gave the hill country of Seir to possess, but Jacob and his children went down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt.

verses.name: Joshua 24:5
verses.text: And I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt with what I did in its midst; and afterward I brought you out.

verses.name: Joshua 24:6
verses.text: When I brought out your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> from Egypt, you came to the sea, and the Egyptians pursued after your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> with chariots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note> and horsemen to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reed”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 24:7
verses.text: They cried out to Yahweh, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and he brought the sea over them<note placement="foot">That is, the Egyptians</note> and covered them; your own eyes saw what I did in Egypt. Then you lived in the wilderness for many days.

verses.name: Joshua 24:8
verses.text: And I brought you to the land of the Amorites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> who lived beyond the Jordan; they fought you, and I gave them into your hand; you took possession of their land, and I destroyed them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in your presence”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 24:9
verses.text: Then Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, set out and fought against Israel, and he sent and summoned Balaam son of Beor to curse you,

verses.name: Joshua 24:10
verses.text: but I was not willing to listen to Balaam, and he richly blessed you. So I rescued you from his hand,

verses.name: Joshua 24:11
verses.text: and you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. And the citizens of Jericho, the Amorites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> the Perizzites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Perizzite”</note> the Canaanites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> the Hittites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hittite”</note> the Girgashites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Girgashite”</note> the Hivites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Hivite”</note> and the Jebusites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jebusite”</note> fought against you, and I gave them into your hand.

verses.name: Joshua 24:12
verses.text: I sent before you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hornet and they drove out before you two kings of the Amorites;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> not by your sword or bow.

verses.name: Joshua 24:13
verses.text: I gave to you a land that you have not labored on, and cities that you have not built, and you live<note placement="foot">Or “dwell”</note> in them; you eat <transChange type="added">from</transChange> vineyards and olive groves that you have not planted.’  <div eID="gen1918" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 24:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1413"/><title type="x-s">The Israelites Promise to Serve Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen1919" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1413"/>“So now, revere Yahweh and serve him in sincerity and faithfulness; remove the gods that your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> served beyond the river<note placement="foot">That is, the Euphrates</note> and in Egypt, and serve Yahweh.

verses.name: Joshua 24:15
verses.text: But if it is bad in your eyes to serve Yahweh, choose for yourselves today whom you want to serve, whether it is the gods that your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> served beyond the river,<note placement="foot">That is, the Euphrates</note> or the gods of the Amorites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> in whose land you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> living; but as for me and my household, we will serve Yahweh.”

verses.name: Joshua 24:16
verses.text: And the people answered and said, “Far be it from us that we would forsake Yahweh to serve other gods,

verses.name: Joshua 24:17
verses.text: for Yahweh our God brought us and our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery, and did these great signs before our eyes. He protected us along the entire way that we went, and among all the peoples through whose midst we passed.

verses.name: Joshua 24:18
verses.text: And Yahweh drove out all the people before us, the Amorites<note placement="foot">“Hebrew “Amorite”</note> who live<note placement="foot">Or “dwell”</note> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the land. We will serve Yahweh, for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our God.”  <div eID="gen1919" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1414"/><div sID="gen1920" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1414"/>But Joshua said to the people, “You cannot serve Yahweh, for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a holy and jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions or your sins.

verses.name: Joshua 24:20
verses.text: If you forsake Yahweh and serve foreign gods, he will turn and bring disaster to you; he will destroy you after he has done good to you.”

verses.name: Joshua 24:21
verses.text: And the people said to Joshua, “No, we will serve Yahweh.”

verses.name: Joshua 24:22
verses.text: And Joshua said to the people, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen for yourselves to serve Yahweh.” And they said, “<transChange type="added">We are</transChange> witnesses.”

verses.name: Joshua 24:23
verses.text: He said, “Remove the foreign gods that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in your midst, and incline your hearts to Yahweh the God of Israel.”

verses.name: Joshua 24:24
verses.text: And the people said to Joshua, “We will serve Yahweh our God, and we will listen to his voice.”

verses.name: Joshua 24:25
verses.text: So Joshua <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made a covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut a covenant”</note> with the people on that day, and he established for them a statute and a judgment at Shechem.

verses.name: Joshua 24:26
verses.text: Then Joshua wrote these words in a scroll of the law of God, and he took a large stone and set it up there under a large tree, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> at the shrine of Yahweh.

verses.name: Joshua 24:27
verses.text: And Joshua said to all the people, “Look, this stone will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words of Yahweh that he spoke with us. It will be as a witness against you, so that you do not deny your God.”

verses.name: Joshua 24:28
verses.text: Then Joshua sent the people away to their inheritance.  <div eID="gen1920" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 24:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1415"/><div sID="gen1921" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1415"/>After these things Joshua son of Nun servant of Yahweh died; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he was one hundred and ten years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of one hundred and ten years”</note>

verses.name: Joshua 24:30
verses.text: They buried him in the territory of his inheritance, at Timnath-Serah, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

verses.name: Joshua 24:31
verses.text: Israel served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who lived long after Joshua, and who had known all the work that Yahweh did for Israel.<note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Josh.24.28-Josh.24.31">Joshua 24:28–31 </reference>is repeated in <reference osisRef="Judeg.2.6-Judeg.2.10">Judges 2:6–10</reference></note>

verses.name: Joshua 24:32
verses.text: The bones of Jacob, which the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> had brought out from Egypt, they buried at Shechem, in a piece of land that Jacob had bought from the children of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for one hundred pieces of money;<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">kesitah</hi></note> it became an inheritance for the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Joseph.

verses.name: Joshua 24:33
verses.text: And Eleazar son of Aaron died; and they buried him in Gibeah in the hill country of Ephraim, which had been given to his son Phinehas.  <chapter eID="Josh.24"/> <div eID="gen1921" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen1776" osisID="Josh" type="book"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1416"/><title type="x-s">Israel Continues Its Conquest</title> <div sID="gen1923" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1416"/>After the death of Joshua, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Who will go up first for us against the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> to fight against them?”

verses.name: Judges 1:2
verses.text: And Yahweh said, “Judah will go up. I hereby give the land into his hand.”

verses.name: Judges 1:3
verses.text: And Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Go up with me into my allotment, and let us fight against the Canaanites; then I too will go with you into your allotment.” And Simeon went with him.

verses.name: Judges 1:4
verses.text: And Judah went up, and Yahweh gave the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> and the Perizzites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Perizzite”</note> into their hand, and they defeated ten thousand men at Bezek.

verses.name: Judges 1:5
verses.text: At Bezek they came upon Adoni-bezek, and they fought against him and defeated the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> and the Perizzites.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Perizzite”</note>

verses.name: Judges 1:6
verses.text: And Adoni-bezek fled, but they pursued after him; they caught him and cut off <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his thumbs and big toes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the thumbs of his hands and feet”</note>

verses.name: Judges 1:7
verses.text: Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their thumbs and big toes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the thumbs of their hands and feet”</note> cut off used to pick up <transChange type="added">scraps</transChange> under my table; just as I have done, so God has repaid to me. And they brought him <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Jerusalem, and he died there.  <div eID="gen1923" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1417"/><div sID="gen1924" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1417"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Judah fought against Jerusalem, and they captured it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞put it to the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they struck it with the mouth of the sword”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞set the city on fire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the city they sent away with fire”</note>

verses.name: Judges 1:9
verses.text: Afterward the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Judah pursued to fight against the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> who were living in the hill country, the Negev,<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judean hills</note> and the Shephelah.<note placement="foot">A geographical region associated with an area of low country on the western edge of the Judaean hills.</note>

verses.name: Judges 1:10
verses.text: And Judah went against the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> living in Hebron (the former name of Hebron <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Kiriath Arba). And they defeated Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.  <div eID="gen1924" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1418"/><div sID="gen1925" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1418"/>And from there they went to the inhabitants of Debir (the former name of Debir <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Kiriath Sepher).

verses.name: Judges 1:12
verses.text: And Caleb said, “Whoever attacks Kiriath Sepher and captures it, I will give to him Acsah my daughter as a wife.”

verses.name: Judges 1:13
verses.text: Othniel son of Kenaz, the younger brother of Caleb, captured it, and he gave to him Acsah his daughter as a wife.

verses.name: Judges 1:14
verses.text: When she came <transChange type="added">to him</transChange>, she urged him to ask her father for a field. As she dismounted from the donkey, Caleb said to her, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What do you want⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “What is for you?”</note>

verses.name: Judges 1:15
verses.text: And she said to him, “Give me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a gift⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “blessing”</note> you have given me the land of the Negev,<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judaean hills</note> and give me also a spring of water.” And Caleb gave to her the upper and lower spring.<note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Judeg.1.11-Judeg.1.15">Judges 1:11–15 </reference>is almost identical to <reference osisRef="Josh.15.13-Josh.15.19">Joshua 15:13–19</reference></note>  <div eID="gen1925" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1419"/><div sID="gen1926" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1419"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Hobab the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, went up with the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Judah from the city of palms into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the Negev<note placement="foot">An arid region south of the Judaean hills</note> near Arad. And they went<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he went”</note> and settled with the people.

verses.name: Judges 1:17
verses.text: And Judah went with his brother Simeon, and they defeated the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> inhabiting Zephath; they utterly destroyed it, so he called the name of the city Hormah.

verses.name: Judges 1:18
verses.text: Judah captured Gaza and its territory, Ashkelon and its territory, and Ekron and its territory.

verses.name: Judges 1:19
verses.text: And Yahweh was with Judah, and he took possession of the hill country, but they could not drive out the inhabitants of the plain because they <transChange type="added">had</transChange> chariots of iron.

verses.name: Judges 1:20
verses.text: They gave Hebron to Caleb just as Moses said, and he drove out the three sons of Anak from there.

verses.name: Judges 1:21
verses.text: But the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Jebusite”</note> who lived in Jerusalem, so the Jebusites have lived among the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.  <div eID="gen1926" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1420"/><div sID="gen1927" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1420"/>Likewise, the house of Joseph went up <transChange type="added">against</transChange> Bethel, and Yahweh <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with them.

verses.name: Judges 1:23
verses.text: And the house of Joseph spied out Bethel (the former name of the city was Luz).

verses.name: Judges 1:24
verses.text: And when the spies saw a man leaving the city,<note placement="foot">Or “going out from the city”</note> they said to him, “Please show us the entrance of the city, and we will deal kindly<note placement="foot">Or “do a loyal love”</note> with you.”

verses.name: Judges 1:25
verses.text: So he showed them the entrance of the city, and they struck the city with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the edge of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mouth of the sword”</note> but they let go the man and all his family.

verses.name: Judges 1:26
verses.text: And the man went <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the land of the Hittites, and he built a city and named it Luz; this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> its name to this day.  <div eID="gen1927" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1421"/><div sID="gen1928" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1421"/>Manasseh did not drive out Beth-Sean and its towns, or Taanach and its towns, or the inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of Dor and its towns, or the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> determined to live in this land.

verses.name: Judges 1:28
verses.text: And it happened, when Israel grew strong, they put the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> to forced labor, but they never totally drove them out.

verses.name: Judges 1:29
verses.text: Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> living in Gezer, so the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> lived in their midst in Gezer.

verses.name: Judges 1:30
verses.text: Zebulun did not drive out the inhabitants of Kitron or Nahalol, so the Canaanites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> lived in their midst and became <transChange type="added">subjected</transChange> to forced labor.

verses.name: Judges 1:31
verses.text: Asher did not drive out the inhabitants of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Aczib, Helbah, Aphik, or Rehob,

verses.name: Judges 1:32
verses.text: so the Asherites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Asherite”</note> lived in the midst of the Canaanites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> the inhabitants of the land, for they did not drive them out.  <div eID="gen1928" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1422"/><div sID="gen1929" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1422"/>Naphtali did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh or Beth-anath, but lived in the midst of the Canaanites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> the inhabitants of the land; the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and Beth-anath became forced labor for them.  <div eID="gen1929" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1423"/><div sID="gen1930" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1423"/>The Amorites pressed<note placement="foot">Or “forced”</note> the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Dan to the hill country, and they did not allow them to come down to the plain;

verses.name: Judges 1:35
verses.text: the Amorites <transChange type="added">were</transChange> determined to live in Har-heres,<note placement="foot">Or “Mount Heres”</note> in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim, but the hand of the house of Joseph was heavy <transChange type="added">on them</transChange>, and they became <transChange type="added">subjected</transChange> to forced labor.

verses.name: Judges 1:36
verses.text: The border of the Amorites<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Amorite”</note> <transChange type="added">ran</transChange> from the ascent of Akrabbim from Sela and upward.  <chapter eID="Judg.1"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1424"/><title type="x-s">Israel Disobeys Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen1931" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1424"/>And the angel of Yahweh went up from Gilgal to Bokim and said, “I brought you up from Egypt, and I brought you to the land that I had promised to your ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.

verses.name: Judges 2:2
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> you, do not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make a covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut a covenant”</note> with the inhabitants of this land; break down their altars.’ But you did not listen to my voice. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Why would you do such a thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “What is this thing you have done?”</note>

verses.name: Judges 2:3
verses.text: Now I say, I will not drive them out from before you; they will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞become as thorns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “become snares;” some ancient manuscripts read “be adversaries”</note> for you, and their gods will be a trap for you.”

verses.name: Judges 2:4
verses.text: And as the angel of Yahweh spoke these words to all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> the people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wept bitterly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “lifted up their voices and they wept”</note>

verses.name: Judges 2:5
verses.text: And they called the name of this place Bokim,<note placement="foot">“Bokim” means “weepers”</note> and there they sacrificed to Yahweh.  <div eID="gen1931" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1425"/><title type="x-s">Joshua Dies</title> <div sID="gen1932" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1425"/>And Joshua sent the people away, and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> went each to their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> own inheritance to take possession of the land.

verses.name: Judges 2:7
verses.text: And the people served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who saw all the great work Yahweh had done for Israel.

verses.name: Judges 2:8
verses.text: And Joshua son of Nun, servant of Yahweh, died <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the age of one hundred and ten years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of one hundred and ten years”</note>

verses.name: Judges 2:9
verses.text: They buried him within the border of his inheritance in Timnah-heres, in the hill country of Ephraim north of Mount Gaash.

verses.name: Judges 2:10
verses.text: Moreover, that entire generation was gathered to their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and another generation grew up after them who did not know Yahweh or the work he had done for Israel.<note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Judeg.2.6-Judeg.2.10">Judges 2:6–10 </reference>is repeated in <reference osisRef="Josh.24.28-Josh.24.31">Joshua 24:28–31</reference></note>  <div eID="gen1932" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1426"/><title type="x-s">Israel Worships the Baals</title> <div sID="gen1933" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1426"/>The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> did evil in the eyes of Yahweh, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they served⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “they worshiped”</note> the Baals.

verses.name: Judges 2:12
verses.text: They abandoned Yahweh the God of their ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> who brought them out from the land of Egypt. They <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞followed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “went after”</note> other gods from the gods of the people who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> around them; and they bowed down to them, and they provoked the anger of Yahweh.

verses.name: Judges 2:13
verses.text: They abandoned Yahweh, and they served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

verses.name: Judges 2:14
verses.text: So <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the anger of Yahweh was kindled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The nose of Yahweh became hot”</note> against Israel, and he gave them into the hand of plunderers; and they plundered them, and he sold them into the hand of their enemies from all sides. They were unable to withstand their enemies any longer.

verses.name: Judges 2:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Whenever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At all that”</note> they went out, the hand of Yahweh was against them to harm them, just as Yahweh warned, and just as Yahweh had sworn to them. And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they were very distressed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it was very cramped for them”</note>  <div eID="gen1933" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1427"/><div sID="gen1934" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1427"/>Then Yahweh raised up leaders,<note placement="foot">Or “judges”</note> and they delivered them from the hand of their plunderers.

verses.name: Judges 2:17
verses.text: But they did not listen to their leaders,<note placement="foot">Or “judges”</note> but lusted after other gods and bowed down to them. They turned away quickly from the way that their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> went, who had obeyed the commandment of Yahweh; they did not do <transChange type="added">as their ancestors</transChange>.

verses.name: Judges 2:18
