verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2229"/><div sID="gen3008" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2229"/>The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞valiant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of strength”</note> men <transChange type="added">who</transChange> carried a shield and a sword, and archers, and <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> expert in war, forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty <transChange type="added">for</transChange> going out <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an army.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:19
verses.text: And they made war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:20
verses.text: And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites and all who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with them were given into their hand, for they cried out to God in the battle, and he responded to their prayer because they trusted in him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:21
verses.text: And they captured their livestock: fifty thousand of their camels; two hundred and fifty thousand sheep; two thousand donkeys; and one hundred thousand men alive.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:22
verses.text: For many <transChange type="added">were</transChange> slain because the war was of God. And they lived under them until the exile.  <div eID="gen3008" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2230"/><title type="x-s">The Half-Tribe of Manasseh</title> <div sID="gen3009" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2230"/>And the sons of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land from Bashan to Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon. They <transChange type="added">were</transChange> numerous.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:24
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the heads of their fathers’ households: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of strength, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞famous men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “men of the name”</note> heads of their fathers’ households.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:25
verses.text: But they transgressed against the God of their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and prostituted themselves after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:26
verses.text: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul, king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tiglath-Pilneser, king of Assyria, and he took them <transChange type="added">into exile</transChange>, namely, the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh. And he brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river Gozan, until this day.  <chapter eID="1Chr.5"/> <div eID="gen3009" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:1
verses.text: <note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="1Chr.6.1-1Chr.6.81">1 Chronicles 6:1–81 </reference>in the English Bible is 5:27–6:66 in the Hebrew Bible</note> The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:2
verses.text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:3
verses.text: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:4
verses.text: Eleazar fathered Phinehas; Phinehas fathered Abishua;

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:5
verses.text: Abishua fathered Bukki; Bukki fathered Uzzi;

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:6
verses.text: Uzzi fathered Zerahiah; Zerahiah fathered Meraioth;

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:7
verses.text: Meraioth fathered Amariah; Amariah fathered Ahitub;

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:8
verses.text: Ahitub fathered Zadok; Zadok fathered Ahimaaz;

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:9
verses.text: Ahimaaz fathered Azariah; Azariah fathered Johanan;

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:10
verses.text: and Johanan fathered Azariah. <transChange type="added">It was</transChange> he who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:11
verses.text: And Azariah fathered Amariah; Amariah fathered Ahitub;

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:12
verses.text: Ahitub fathered Zadok; Zadok fathered Shallum;

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:13
verses.text: Shallum fathered Hilkiah; Hilkiah fathered Azariah;

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:14
verses.text: Azariah fathered Seraiah; Seraiah fathered Jehozadak.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:15
verses.text: And Jehozadak went into exile <transChange type="added">when</transChange> Yahweh <transChange type="added">sent</transChange> Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.  <div eID="gen3010" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2231"/><title type="x-s">The Descendants of Levi</title> <div sID="gen3011" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2231"/>The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:17
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:18
verses.text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:19
verses.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the families of the Levites according to their ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:20
verses.text: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:21
verses.text: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:22
verses.text: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:23
verses.text: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:24
verses.text: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:25
verses.text: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:26
verses.text: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:27
verses.text: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:28
verses.text: The sons of Samuel: <transChange type="added">Joel</transChange><note placement="foot">“Joel” is from 1 Samuel 8:2, the parallel to this genealogy. The name has dropped out of the text here</note> his firstborn and Abijah the second.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:29
verses.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:30
verses.text: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.  <div eID="gen3011" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2232"/><title type="x-s">David’s Appointees for Music in the Temple</title> <div sID="gen3012" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2232"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are the men</transChange> whom David appointed for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞control of singing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the hands of song”</note> in the house of Yahweh where the ark rested.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:32
verses.text: They were ministering with song before the tabernacle of the tent of assembly<note placement="foot">Or “meeting”</note> until Solomon built the temple of Yahweh in Jerusalem. And they stood according to their order with respect to their duty.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:33
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> those who served and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, son of Samuel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:34
verses.text: son of Elkanah, son of Jeroham, son of Eliel, son of Toah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:35
verses.text: son of Zuph, son of Elkanah, son of Mahath, son of Amasai,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:36
verses.text: son of Elkanah, son of Joel, son of Azariah, son of Zephaniah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:37
verses.text: son of Tahath, son of Assir, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:38
verses.text: son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, son of Israel;

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:39
verses.text: and his brother Asaph, who stood on his right <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, Asaph the son of Berechiah, son of Shimea,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:40
verses.text: son of Michael, son of Baaseiah, son of Malkijah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:41
verses.text: son of Ethni, son of Zerah, son of Adaiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:42
verses.text: son of Ethan, son of Zimmah, son of Shimei,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:43
verses.text: son of Jahath, son of Gershom, son of Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:44
verses.text: On the left <transChange type="added">were</transChange> their brothers, the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, son of Abdi, son of Malluch,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:45
verses.text: son of Hashabiah, son of Amaziah, son of Hilkiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:46
verses.text: son of Amzi, son of Bani, son of Shemer,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:47
verses.text: son of Mahli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:48
verses.text: And their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:49
verses.text: But Aaron and his sons made offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.  <div eID="gen3012" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2233"/><title type="x-s">The Descendants of Aaron</title> <div sID="gen3013" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2233"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:51
verses.text: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:52
verses.text: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:53
verses.text: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:54
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> their dwellings according to their settlements within their borders: to the sons of Aaron of the clans of Kohathites, for the <transChange type="added">first</transChange> lot <transChange type="added">was</transChange> theirs,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:55
verses.text: and they gave to them Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:56
verses.text: but the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:57
verses.text: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, Libnah with its pasturelands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasturelands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:58
verses.text: Hilen with its pasturelands, Debir with its pasturelands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:59
verses.text: Ashan with its pasturelands, and Beth-Shemesh with its pasturelands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:60
verses.text: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasturelands, Alemeth with its pasturelands, and Anathoth with its pasturelands. All their cities <transChange type="added">were</transChange> thirteen cities throughout their clans.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:61
verses.text: To the Kohathites who remained from the family of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, <transChange type="added">were given</transChange> by lot ten cities.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:62
verses.text: To the Gershomites according to their clans thirteen cities <transChange type="added">were allotted</transChange> out of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:63
verses.text: To the Merarites twelve cities <transChange type="added">were</transChange> allotted according to their clans out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:64
verses.text: So the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> gave the Levites the cities with their pasturelands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:65
verses.text: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin these cities that are mentioned by name.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:66
verses.text: And of the clans of the sons of Kohath were cities of their territory out of the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:67
verses.text: And they gave them the cities of refuge: Shechem with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, Gezer with its pasturelands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:68
verses.text: Jokmeam with its pasturelands, Beth-Horon with its pasturelands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:69
verses.text: Aijalon with its pasturelands, and Gath-Rimmon with its pasturelands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:70
verses.text: And out of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner with its pasturelands, and Bileam with its pasturelands for the remaining the clans of the Kohathites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:71
verses.text: To the Gershomites <transChange type="added">were given</transChange> out of the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan with its pasturelands and Ashtaroth with its pasturelands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:72
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with its pasturelands, Daberath with its pasturelands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:73
verses.text: Ramoth with its pasturelands, and Anem with its pasturelands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:74
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its pasturelands, Abdon with its pasturelands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:75
verses.text: Hukok with its pasturelands, and Rehob with its pasturelands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:76
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its pasturelands, Hammon with its pasturelands, and Kiriathaim with its pasturelands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:77
verses.text: To the remainder of the Merarites <transChange type="added">were allotted</transChange> out of the tribe of Zebulun: Rimmono with its pasturelands, Tabor with its pasturelands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:78
verses.text: And beyond the Jordan <transChange type="added">at</transChange> Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasturelands, Jahzah with its pasturelands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:79
verses.text: Kedemoth with its pasturelands, and Mephaath with its pasturelands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:80
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its pasturelands, Mahanaim with its pasturelands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:81
verses.text: Heshbon with its pasturelands, and Jazer with its pasturelands.  <chapter eID="1Chr.6"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2234"/><title type="x-s">The Descendants of Issachar</title> <div sID="gen3014" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2234"/>The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:2
verses.text: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses; for Tola, mighty warriors of their generations, their number in the days of David <transChange type="added">were</transChange> twenty-two thousand six hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:3
verses.text: The sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah; all five of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> chiefs.<note placement="foot">Or “heads”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:4
verses.text: And in addition to them, according to their generations, according to the house of their fathers, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> troops of the army for war: thirty-six thousand. For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they had⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there were”</note> many wives and sons.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:5
verses.text: Now their kinsmen belonging to all the clans of Issachar <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in all eighty-seven thousand mighty warriors, enrolled according to their genealogy.  <div eID="gen3014" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2235"/><title type="x-s">The Descendants of Benjamin</title> <div sID="gen3015" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2235"/><transChange type="added">The sons of</transChange> Benjamin: Bela, Beker, and Jediael, three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:7
verses.text: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heads of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> house of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fathers, mighty warriors. And their enrollment by genealogy <transChange type="added">was</transChange> twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:8
verses.text: The sons of Beker: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Beker.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:9
verses.text: And their enrollment by genealogy according to their generations, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> heads of the house of their fathers, mighty warriors, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> twenty thousand two hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:10
verses.text: The sons of Jediael: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:11
verses.text: All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Jediael according to the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> mighty warriors, seventeen thousand two hundred, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞able to go to war⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “going out to the army to the war”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:12
verses.text: And Shuppim and Huppim <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Ir; Hushim, the son of Aher.  <div eID="gen3015" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2236"/><title type="x-s">The Descendants of Naphtali</title> <div sID="gen3016" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2236"/>The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞descendants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons”</note> of Bilhah.  <div eID="gen3016" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2237"/><title type="x-s">The Descendants of Manasseh</title> <div sID="gen3017" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2237"/>The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his Aramean concubine bore; she gave birth to Makir the father of Gilead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:15
verses.text: And Machir took a wife for Huppim and for Shuppim. And the name of his sister <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Maacah. And the name of the second, Zelophehad. And Zelophehad had daughters.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:16
verses.text: And Maacah the wife of Machir gave birth to a son, and she called his name Peresh. And the name of his brother <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Sheresh, and his sons <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Ulam and Rekem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:17
verses.text: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Gilead the son of Makir, son of Manasseh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:18
verses.text: And his sister, Hammolecheth, gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:19
verses.text: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.  <div eID="gen3017" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2238"/><title type="x-s">The Descendants of Ephraim</title> <div sID="gen3018" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2238"/>The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah and Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:21
verses.text: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead. And the men of Gath who were born in the land killed them because they came down to take their livestock.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:22
verses.text: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:23
verses.text: And Ephraim went in to his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. And he called his name Beriah because disaster <transChange type="added">had been</transChange> upon his house.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:24
verses.text: And his daughter <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Sheerah, and she built Lower and Upper Beth-Horon and Uzzen-Sheerah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:25
verses.text: And Rephah <transChange type="added">was</transChange> his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, Tahan his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:26
verses.text: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:27
verses.text: Nun his son, Joshua his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:28
verses.text: And their property and their dwellings <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Bethel and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “her daughters,” here and below</note> And to the east, Naaran. And to the west, Gezer and its towns, and Shechem and its towns, up to Aija and its towns.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:29
verses.text: And along the borders of the sons of Manasseh: Beth-Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. In these lived the sons of Joseph the son of Israel.  <div eID="gen3018" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2239"/><title type="x-s">The Descendants of Asher</title> <div sID="gen3019" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2239"/>The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:31
verses.text: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the father of Birzayith.<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:32
verses.text: And Heber fathered Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and their sister Shua.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:33
verses.text: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Japhlet.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:34
verses.text: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:35
verses.text: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:36
verses.text: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:37
verses.text: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:38
verses.text: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:39
verses.text: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:40
verses.text: All of these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Asher, heads of the house of the fathers, chosen mighty warriors, heads of the princes. And their number enrolled by genealogy, in the army for the war, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> twenty-six thousand men.  <chapter eID="1Chr.7"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2240"/><title type="x-s">The Genealogy of Saul</title> <div sID="gen3020" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2240"/>Now Benjamin fathered Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:2
verses.text: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:3
verses.text: And Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:4
verses.text: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:5
verses.text: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:6
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the sons of Ehud (these were heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> for the inhabitants of Geba, and they took them away to Manahath):

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:7
verses.text: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who took them away. And he fathered Uzza and Ahihud.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:8
verses.text: And Shaharaim fathered <transChange type="added">children</transChange> in the fields of Moab after he had sent them away—Hushim and Baara, his wives.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:9
verses.text: And he fathered by Hodesh his wife Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:10
verses.text: Jeuz, Sakia, and Mirmah. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> his sons, heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:11
verses.text: And by Husham he fathered Abitub and Elpaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:12
verses.text: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, Shemed (he built Ono and Lod with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>),<note placement="foot">Literally “her daughters”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:13
verses.text: and Beriah and Shema who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> of the inhabitants of Aijalon (they themselves chased away the inhabitants of Gath).

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:14
verses.text: Now Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:15
verses.text: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:16
verses.text: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha <transChange type="added">were</transChange> sons of Beriah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:17
verses.text: And Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:18
verses.text: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Elpaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:19
verses.text: And Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:20
verses.text: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:21
verses.text: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Shimei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:22
verses.text: And Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:23
verses.text: Abdon, Zikri, Hanan,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:24
verses.text: Hananiah, Elam, Antothijah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:25
verses.text: Iphdeiah, and Peniel <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Shashak.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:26
verses.text: And Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:27
verses.text: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zikri <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Jeroham.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:28
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> according to their generations, chiefs. These lived in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:29
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">Jeiel</transChange><note placement="foot">The name Jeiel comes from <reference osisRef="1Chr.9.35">1 Chronicles 9:35; </reference>it has dropped out of the text here</note> the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. And the name of his wife <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Maacah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:30
verses.text: And his firstborn son <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:31
verses.text: Gedor, Ahio, Zeker,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:32
verses.text: and Mikloth (he fathered Shimeah). Now these also lived nearby their brothers in Jerusalem with their kinsmen.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:33
verses.text: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-Shua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:34
verses.text: And the son of Jonathan <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Merib-baal, and Merib-baal fathered Micah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:35
verses.text: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:36
verses.text: And Ahaz fathered Jehoaddah, and Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. And Zimri fathered Moza.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:37
verses.text: And Moza fathered Binea; Raphah <transChange type="added">was</transChange> his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:38
verses.text: And Azel had six sons, and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Azel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:39
verses.text: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:40
verses.text: And the sons of Ulam were men <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> mighty warriors, bowmen, and <transChange type="added">they had</transChange> many sons and grandsons, one hundred and fifty. All these were Benjaminites.  <chapter eID="1Chr.8"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2241"/><title type="x-s">The Genealogy of Returned Exiles</title> <div sID="gen3021" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2241"/>So all Israel was enrolled in genealogy. And behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel. And Judah was taken away to Babylon on account of their sin.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:2
verses.text: Now the first inhabitants who <transChange type="added">were settled</transChange> on their property in their cities <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Israel <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:3
verses.text: And some of the people of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh lived in Jerusalem:

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:4
verses.text: Uthai the son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani,<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> from the sons of Perez,<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> the son of Judah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:5
verses.text: And from the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:6
verses.text: And from the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:7
verses.text: And from the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:8
verses.text: Ibneah the son of Jeroham; Elah the son of Uzzi, son of Michri; Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:9
verses.text: and their brethren according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> in the house of their fathers.  <div eID="gen3021" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2242"/><div sID="gen3022" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2242"/>And from the priests: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jakin;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:11
verses.text: Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, the commander of the house of God;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:12
verses.text: Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malkijah; Maasai the son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:13
verses.text: and their kinsmen, heads of the house of their fathers, one thousand seven hundred and sixty mighty men <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the work of the service of the house of God.  <div eID="gen3022" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2243"/><div sID="gen3023" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2243"/>And from the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, from the sons of Merari;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:15
verses.text: Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah the son of Mica, son of Zicri, son of Asaph;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:16
verses.text: Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of Netophathite.  <div eID="gen3023" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2244"/><div sID="gen3024" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2244"/>And the gatekeepers <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brethren (Shallum <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the chief);

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:18
verses.text: until then they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> gatekeepers at the gate of the king on the east <transChange type="added">side</transChange> toward the camps of the Levites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:19
verses.text: And Shallum the son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, and his kinsmen of the house of his fathers, the Korahites, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> over the work of the service, the guardians of the entrances to the tent, and their fathers <transChange type="added">were</transChange> over the camp of Yahweh, guardians of the entrance.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:20
verses.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the leader over them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in time past⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Or “before”</note> Yahweh <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:21
verses.text: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah <transChange type="added">was</transChange> gatekeeper at the doorway to the tent of assembly.<note placement="foot">Or “meeting”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:22
verses.text: All of them were chosen as gatekeepers at the entrances, two hundred and twelve. They were enrolled by genealogies in their villages. They <transChange type="added">were</transChange> established <transChange type="added">by</transChange> David and Samuel the seer on account of their faithfulness.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:23
verses.text: So they and their sons <transChange type="added">were</transChange> over the gates of the house of Yahweh at the house of the tent as guards.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:24
verses.text: The gatekeepers <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on four sides: east, west, north, and south.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:25
verses.text: And their brethren in their villages <transChange type="added">were</transChange> to come <transChange type="added">every</transChange> seven days <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by turn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from time to time”</note> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> with these.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:26
verses.text: For the four mighty gatekeepers, they who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Levites, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were entrusted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they in their faithfulness”</note> and <transChange type="added">were</transChange> over the chambers and over the storerooms of the house of God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:27
verses.text: And they lodged all around the house of God, for upon them <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a responsibility. And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they had charge of opening <transChange type="added">the house of God</transChange> every morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they were over the key and to morning to morning”</note>  <div eID="gen3024" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2245"/><div sID="gen3025" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2245"/>And some of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> over the utensils of the service, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they count them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in number”</note> when they are brought in and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they count them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in number”</note> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> they are brought out.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:29
verses.text: And some of them were appointed over the objects, over the objects of the sanctuary, and over the wheat flour and the wine, the olive oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:30
verses.text: And some of the sons of the priests mixed the fragrant ointment for the spices.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:31
verses.text: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was entrusted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in faithfulness”</note> with the work of the pan breads.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:32
verses.text: And from the sons of the Kohathites, some of their kinsmen <transChange type="added">were</transChange> over the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞showbread⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “bread of the rows”</note> to prepare it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every Sabbath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Sabbath Sabbath”</note>  <div eID="gen3025" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2246"/><div sID="gen3026" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2246"/>Now these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the singers; the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> of the Levites <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the chambers free from other service, for day and night <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> over them on the service.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:34
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> of the Levites according to their genealogies, leaders. These lived in Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen3026" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2247"/><title type="x-s">Saul’s Genealogy Repeated</title> <div sID="gen3027" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2247"/>And <transChange type="added">these</transChange> lived in Gibeon: Jeiel the father of Gibeon. And the name of his wife <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Maacah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:36
verses.text: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:37
verses.text: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:38
verses.text: And Mikloth fathered Shimeam. And they also lived nearby their brothers in Jerusalem with their brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:39
verses.text: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-Shua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:40
verses.text: And the son of Jonathan <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Meribaal. And Meribaal fathered Micah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:41
verses.text: And the sons of Micah <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, <transChange type="added">and Ahaz.</transChange><note placement="foot">The name is drawn from <reference osisRef="1Chr.8.35">1 Chronicles 8:35; </reference>it has dropped out of the text here</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:42
verses.text: And Ahaz fathered Jarah, and Jarah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. And Zimri fathered Moza,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:43
verses.text: and Moza fathered Binea; and Rephaiah <transChange type="added">was</transChange> his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:44
verses.text: And Azel had six sons, and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Azel.  <chapter eID="1Chr.9"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2248"/><title type="x-s">The Death of Saul and His Sons</title> <div sID="gen3028" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2248"/>Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and every Israelite fled away from before the Philistines. And they fell slain upon Mount Gilboa.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:2
verses.text: And the Philistines <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞overtook⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “caught up behind”</note> Saul and his sons. And the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malki-Shua, the sons of Saul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:3
verses.text: And the battle was heavy against Saul, and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞archers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shooters with the bow”</note> found him, and he was wounded by the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞archers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “shooters”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:4
verses.text: And Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and deal harshly with me.” But he was very afraid. Then Saul took the sword and fell upon it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:5
verses.text: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul <transChange type="added">was</transChange> dead, he also fell upon the sword, and he died.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:6
verses.text: So Saul died. And his three sons and all his house died together.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:7
verses.text: And when all the men of Israel who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the valley saw that they<note placement="foot">That is, the army</note> had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities and fled. Then the Philistines came and dwelled in them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:8
verses.text: And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> on the next day when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:9
verses.text: And they stripped him and took his head and his weapons, and they sent <transChange type="added">them</transChange> throughout the land of the Philistines to bring news to their idols and the nation.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:10
verses.text: And they put his weapons in the temple of their gods, and they fastened his skull to the temple of Dagon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:11
verses.text: When all Jabesh-Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:12
verses.text: every strong man arose and took the dead body of Saul and the dead bodies of his sons and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh and fasted seven days.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:13
verses.text: So Saul died on account of his sin which he had sinned against Yahweh concerning the command of Yahweh that he did not keep. He also consulted a medium to seek <transChange type="added">guidance</transChange>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:14
verses.text: But he did not seek Yahweh. So Yahweh put him to death and turned over the kingship to David, the son of Jesse.  <chapter eID="1Chr.10"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2249"/><title type="x-s">The Anointing of David as King</title> <div sID="gen3029" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2249"/>Then all Israel gathered to David in Hebron, saying, “Look—we are your flesh and bones.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:2
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞For some time now⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “also yesterday also in the past”</note> even when Saul was king, you were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the one who led the army of Israel in battle⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the one who went out and brought in Israel”</note> And Yahweh your God said to you, ‘You will shepherd my people Israel and will be leader over my people Israel.’ ”

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:3
verses.text: Then all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them at Hebron in the presence of Yahweh. And they anointed David as king over Israel according to the word of Yahweh by the hand of Samuel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:4
verses.text: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Jebus). And the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> there.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:5
verses.text: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not enter here.” But David captured the stronghold of Zion; that <transChange type="added">is,</transChange> the city of David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:6
verses.text: Then David said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first will be chief and commander.” And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first and became chief.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:7
verses.text: And David lived in the fortress. Therefore they called it the city of David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:8
verses.text: And he built the city all around from the Millo and up to the circuit. And Joab restored the remainder of the city.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:9
verses.text: And David <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞became greater and greater⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “increased certainly and in greatness”</note> And Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with him.  <div eID="gen3029" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2250"/><title type="x-s">David’s Mighty Men</title> <div sID="gen3030" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2250"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the chiefs of the mighty men who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> for David, who gave him strong support in his kingdom, together with all Israel to make him king according to the word of Yahweh concerning Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:11
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the numbering of the mighty warriors who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> for David: Jashobeam son of Hachmoni <transChange type="added">was</transChange> chief of the three. He himself raised his spear against three hundred <transChange type="added">whom he</transChange> killed on one occasion.  <div eID="gen3030" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2251"/><div sID="gen3031" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2251"/>And after him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite. He <transChange type="added">was</transChange> among the three mighty warriors.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:13
verses.text: He himself <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with David at Pas-Dammim when the Philistines were gathered there for the battle. And there was a plot of the field filled with barley, and the people fled before the Philistines.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:14
verses.text: But they took their stand in the middle of the plot and defended it. And they killed the Philistines. And Yahweh saved <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a great victory.  <div eID="gen3031" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2252"/><div sID="gen3032" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2252"/>And three of the thirty chiefs went down toward the rock to David at the cave of Adullam when the army of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:16
verses.text: And David <transChange type="added">was</transChange> then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines <transChange type="added">was</transChange> then in Bethlehem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:17
verses.text: And David had a craving, and he said, “Who could give me a drink of water from the well of Bethlehem that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> by the gate!”

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:18
verses.text: Then the three broke through into the camp of the Philistines and drew water from the well of Bethlehem that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> by the gate and brought <transChange type="added">it</transChange> and came to David. But David would not drink it and poured it out before Yahweh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:19
verses.text: And he said, “Far be it from me <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I would do this before my God. Shall I drink the lifeblood of these men? For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the risk of their lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “against their lives”</note> they brought it.” And he was not willing to drink it. These things the three mighty men did.  <div eID="gen3032" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2253"/><div sID="gen3033" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2253"/>Now Abishai the brother of Joab was himself the head of the three.<note placement="foot">Other manuscripts have “thirty” which makes better sense in the context</note> And he roused himself with his spear against three hundred whom he killed and made a name for himself<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> among the three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:21
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He was twice as renowned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he was glorified double”</note> among the three<note placement="foot">Other manuscripts have “thirty,” which makes better sense in the context</note> and was their commander. But he did not attain to the three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> Benaiah the son of Jehoiada <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a strong man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of a strong man”</note> from Kabzeel, <transChange type="added">one who did</transChange> great deeds. He himself struck down two <transChange type="added">sons of</transChange> Ariel of Moab. And he himself went down and struck down a lion within a pit on a snowy day.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:23
verses.text: And he himself struck down an Egyptian man, a large man five cubits <transChange type="added">tall</transChange>. And in the hand of the Egyptian <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a spear like a weaver’s beam. But he went down to him with a club and seized the spear from the hand of the Egyptian and killed him with his own spear.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:24
verses.text: These things Benaiah son of Jehoiada did and had a name among the three mighty warriors.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:25
verses.text: He himself was certainly distinguished among the thirty, but he did not attain to the three. And David appointed him over his bodyguard.  <div eID="gen3033" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2254"/><div sID="gen3034" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2254"/>Now the mighty warriors of the troops <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo from Bethlehem,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:27
verses.text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:28
verses.text: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:29
verses.text: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:30
verses.text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:31
verses.text: Ittai the son of Ribai from Gibeah of the people of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:32
verses.text: Hurai of the valleys of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:33
verses.text: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:34
verses.text: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jehonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:35
verses.text: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:36
verses.text: Hepher the Mekerathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:37
verses.text: Hezro the Carmelite, Naari the son of Ezbai,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:38
verses.text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:39
verses.text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the bearer of the weapons of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:40
verses.text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:41
verses.text: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:42
verses.text: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a leader of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:43
verses.text: Hanan the son of Maacah, Jehoshaphat the Mithnite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:44
verses.text: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:45
verses.text: Jediael the son of Shimri and Joha his brother the Tizite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:46
verses.text: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:47
verses.text: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.  <chapter eID="1Chr.11"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2255"/><title type="x-s">David and His Mighty Men at Ziklag</title> <div sID="gen3035" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2255"/>Now these are the ones who came to David at Ziklag while he was still shut up because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of Saul⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “of the face of Saul”</note> the son of Kish. And they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the mighty warriors helping <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the war.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">They were</transChange> armed with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bow, <transChange type="added">able to shoot</transChange> right-handed or left-handed, <transChange type="added">slinging</transChange> stones or <transChange type="added">shooting</transChange> arrows with the bow; <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> kinsmen of Saul from Benjamin.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:3
verses.text: The leader <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Ahiezer, then Jehoash, sons of Shemaah the Gibeonite; Jeiel and Pelet, sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:4
verses.text: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty warrior among the thirty <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> over the thirty;<note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="1Chr.12.5">1 Chronicles 12:5 </reference>begins here in the Hebrew Bible</note> Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:5
verses.text: <note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="1Chr.12.5-1Chr.12.40">1 Chronicles 12:5–40 </reference>in the English Bible is 12:6–41 in the Hebrew Bible</note> Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Hariphite;

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:6
verses.text: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam the Korahites;

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:7
verses.text: Joelah and Zebadiah, sons of Jeroham from the Gedor.  <div eID="gen3035" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2256"/><div sID="gen3036" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2256"/>And from the Gadites, valiant mighty warriors, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞soldiers fit for war⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “men of battle for the war”</note> expert with shield and spear, defected to David at the fortress toward the wilderness. And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they had faces like lions⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “faces of a lion were their faces”</note> <transChange type="added">and were</transChange> swift as gazelles upon the mountains.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:9
verses.text: Ezer the chief, Obadiah second, Eliab third,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:10
verses.text: Mishmannah fourth, Jeremiah fifth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:11
verses.text: Attai sixth, Eliel seventh,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:12
verses.text: Jehonan eighth, Elzabad ninth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:13
verses.text: Jeremiah tenth, Macbannai eleventh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:14
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Gad, leaders of the army. The smallest one <transChange type="added">was</transChange> as a hundred, and the greatest as a thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:15
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> they who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it was filled over its banks. And they put to flight all <transChange type="added">who were in</transChange> the valley to the east and to the west.  <div eID="gen3036" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2257"/><div sID="gen3037" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2257"/>And some of the sons of Benjamin and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> Judah came to the fortress, to David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:17
verses.text: And David went out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to meet them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before them”</note> and answered and said to them, “If you come in peace to me, to help me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my heart will be joined with you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the heart will be to me to you together”</note> but if <transChange type="added">you come</transChange> to betray me to my adversaries, although <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no wrong on my hands, may the God of our fathers see and pass judgment.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:18
verses.text: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, chief of the thirty <transChange type="added">who said</transChange>: <div eID="gen3037" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen3038"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3039"/>“<transChange type="added">We are</transChange> yours, O David!<l eID="gen3039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3040"/>And <transChange type="added">we are</transChange> with you, O son of Jesse!<l eID="gen3040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3041"/>Peace! Peace to you, and peace to those who help you,<l eID="gen3041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3042"/>for your God helps you.”<l eID="gen3042" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen3038"/> <div sID="gen3043" type="x-p"/> So David appointed them as heads of the troops.  <div eID="gen3043" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2258"/><div sID="gen3044" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2258"/>And some Manassites deserted to David when he came with the Philistines to the battle against Saul, but he did not help them, for the rulers of the Philistines sent him away upon counsel, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul at <transChange type="added">the cost of</transChange> our heads.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:20
verses.text: When he went to Ziklag some Manassites deserted to him: Adnah, Jehozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, heads of the thousands that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> for Manasseh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:21
verses.text: And they themselves helped David against the troops, for all of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> mighty men of strength and were commanders in the army.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:22
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Day in and day out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for to the time of day to the day”</note> they came to David to help him until <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> a great army, like the army of God.  <div eID="gen3044" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2259"/><div sID="gen3045" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2259"/>And these are the numbers of the chiefs of those prepared for the army who came to David at Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul over to him according to the word of Yahweh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:24
verses.text: The sons of Judah bearing shield and spear: six thousand eight hundred armed troops.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:25
verses.text: From the men of Simeon, mighty warriors of strength for war: seven thousand one hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:26
verses.text: From the Levites: four thousand six hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:27
verses.text: Jehoiada the chief officer of <transChange type="added">the house of</transChange> Aaron, and with him, three thousand seven hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:28
verses.text: And Zadok, a young man, a mighty warrior of strength, and the house of his father: twenty-two commanders.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:29
verses.text: From the men of Benjamin, kinsmen of Saul, three thousand, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞even still⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and even they”</note> the majority of them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞remained loyal⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “keeping the responsibility”</note> to the house of Saul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:30
verses.text: And from the men of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred mighty warriors of strength, famous men in the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:31
verses.text: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand who were designated by name to come to make David king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:32
verses.text: And from the men of Issachar: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞men who were skilled in understanding the times⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “men who knew the understanding of the times”</note> to know what Israel should do. Their chiefs <transChange type="added">were</transChange> two hundred, and all their kinsmen <transChange type="added">were</transChange> under their command.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:33
verses.text: From Zebulun, those who went out armed, equipped for battle with all the weapons of war: fifty thousand to help David <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with singleness of purpose⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with not heart and heart”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:34
verses.text: From Naphtali: one thousand commanders; and <transChange type="added">those</transChange> with them with shield and spear: thirty-seven thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:35
verses.text: From the Danites, <transChange type="added">those</transChange> equipped for battle: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:36
verses.text: And from Asher, those who went out armed <transChange type="added">and</transChange> prepared for battle: forty thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:37
verses.text: And from beyond the Jordan, from the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> weapons of war for battle: one hundred and twenty thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:38
verses.text: All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> men of war arrayed in battle line <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with a whole heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with heart well”</note> They came to Hebron to make David king over all Israel. Likewise, all the rest of Israel <transChange type="added">had</transChange> one heart to make David king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:39
verses.text: And they were there with David three days, eating and drinking, for their kinsmen were prepared for them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:40
verses.text: And also their relatives, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought food on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen—provisions of flour, cakes of figs, raisin cakes, wine and oil, cattle and sheep in abundance, for <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> great joy in Israel.  <chapter eID="1Chr.12"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2260"/><title type="x-s">The Ark of the Covenant Brought from Kiriath-Jearim</title> <div sID="gen3046" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2260"/>And David consulted with the commanders of thousands and hundreds, with every leader.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:2
verses.text: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞If it seems good to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If to you good”</note> and before Yahweh our God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞let us send word abroad⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “let us spread out, let us send”</note> to our brothers who remain in all the land of Israel and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the priests and Levites with them in the cities with their pasturelands that they might be gathered to us.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:3
verses.text: Then let us bring around the ark of our God to us, for we did not seek it in the days of Saul.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:4
verses.text: And all the assembly agreed to do so, for the word was pleasing in the eyes of all the people.  <div eID="gen3046" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2261"/><div sID="gen3047" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2261"/>And David summoned all Israel from Shihor of Egypt up to Lebo-Hamath to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-Jearim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:6
verses.text: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, Kiriath-Jearim of Judah, to bring up from there the ark of Yahweh God <transChange type="added">who</transChange> is enthroned <transChange type="added">between</transChange> the cherubim, which is called the name.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:7
verses.text: And they carried the ark of God upon a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio were driving the cart.  <div eID="gen3047" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2262"/><div sID="gen3048" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2262"/>Now David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> strength, and with songs, lyres, harps, tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:9
verses.text: And when they came to the threshing floor of Kidon, Uzza reached out his hand to hold the ark because the cattle had stumbled.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:10
verses.text: And Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “nostrils became hot”</note> with Uzza, and he struck him down because he reached his hand upon the ark. And he died there before God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:11
verses.text: And David <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it was hot”</note> because Yahweh had broken out in wrath against Uzza. And that place is called Perez Uzza unto this day.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:12
verses.text: And David feared God on that day, saying, “How can I bring the ark of God <transChange type="added">home</transChange> to me?”

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:13
verses.text: So David did not move the ark to himself into the city of David but diverted it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:14
verses.text: And the ark of God remained with the household of Obed-Edom in his house three months. And Yahweh blessed the household of Obed-Edom and all that he had.  <chapter eID="1Chr.13"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2263"/><title type="x-s">David’s Wives and Children</title> <div sID="gen3049" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2263"/>And Hiram, king of Tyre, sent messengers to David and cedar trees, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞masons⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “craftsmen of the wall”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞carpenters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “craftsmen of wood”</note> to build a house for him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:2
verses.text: And David knew that Yahweh had established him as king over Israel <transChange type="added">and</transChange> that his kingdom was highly exalted for the sake of his people Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:3
verses.text: And David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David fathered more sons and daughters.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:4
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the names of the children who were <transChange type="added">born</transChange> to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:5
verses.text: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:6
verses.text: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:7
verses.text: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.  <div eID="gen3049" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2264"/><title type="x-s">David Defeats the Philistines</title> <div sID="gen3050" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2264"/>When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed as king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to search for David. But David heard and went out from before them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:9
verses.text: Now the Philistines came and carried out a raid in the Valley of Rephaim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:10
verses.text: Then David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you put them into my hand?” And Yahweh said to him, “Go up. I will put them into your hand.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:11
verses.text: And he went up to Baal-Perazim, and David struck them there. And David said, “God has burst out against my enemies by my hand like waters burst out.” Therefore they will call the name of this place Baal-Perazim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:12
verses.text: And they abandoned their gods there. And David commanded, and they were burnt with fire.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:13
verses.text: Then the Philistines <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞carried out another raid⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they added again and made a raid”</note> in the valley.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:14
verses.text: Then David inquired again of God. And God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Go around from before them and come against them the opposite <transChange type="added">way</transChange> of the balsam trees.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:15
verses.text: And it shall be <transChange type="added">that</transChange> when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then go out into battle, for God goes out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:16
verses.text: And David did as God commanded him, and they struck the camp of the Philistines from Gibeon to Gezer.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:17
verses.text: And the fame of David went out through all the lands. And Yahweh put the fear of him upon all the nations.  <chapter eID="1Chr.14"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2265"/><title type="x-s">David’s Wives and Children</title> <div sID="gen3051" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2265"/>And David built houses for himself in the city of David, and he established a place for the ark of God. And he pitched a tent for it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:2
verses.text: Then David ordered <transChange type="added">that</transChange> none except the Levites should carry the ark of God, for Yahweh had chosen them to carry the ark of Yahweh and to serve him forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:3
verses.text: And David gathered all Israel to Jerusalem to bring up the ark of Yahweh to its place that he had established for it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:4
verses.text: And David gathered the sons of Aaron and the Levites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:5
verses.text: Of the sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief and one hundred and twenty of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:6
verses.text: Of the sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief and two hundred and twenty of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:7
verses.text: Of the sons of Gershom: Joel the chief and one hundred and thirty of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:8
verses.text: Of the sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the chief and two hundred of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:9
verses.text: Of the sons of Hebron: Eliel the chief and eighty of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:10
verses.text: Of the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief and one hundred and twelve of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:11
verses.text: Then David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:12
verses.text: And he said to them, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> for the Levites. Sanctify yourselves and your brothers and bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel, to <transChange type="added">the place</transChange> I have established for it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:13
verses.text: Because the first time you did not, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> Yahweh our God burst out against us, for we did not care for it according to the law.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:14
verses.text: Then the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:15
verses.text: And the sons of the Levites carried the ark of God according to what Moses commanded, according to the word of Yahweh, on their shoulders with the carrying poles upon them.  <div eID="gen3051" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2266"/><div sID="gen3052" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2266"/>Then David ordered the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their brothers <transChange type="added">as</transChange> singers with instruments of song, musical instruments, stringed instruments, and cymbals, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞raising their voices for joy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “causing to hear to the mountains with a sound of rejoicing”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:17
verses.text: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel, and from his brothers, Asaph the son of Berekiah, and from the sons of Merari, their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:18
verses.text: and with them their brothers <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the second <transChange type="added">rank</transChange>, Zechariah the son, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-Edom and Jeiel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:19
