verses.text: Now the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> to sound bronze cymbals;

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:20
verses.text: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah <transChange type="added">were to play</transChange> on harps according to Alamoth;

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:21
verses.text: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah <transChange type="added">were to play</transChange> lyres, directing according to the Sheminith.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:22
verses.text: And Kenaniah, chief of the Levites in singing, <transChange type="added">was to be</transChange> an instructor in singing because he understood.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:23
verses.text: And Berekiah and Elkanah <transChange type="added">were</transChange> gatekeepers for the ark.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:24
verses.text: And Shebaniah, Jehoshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Elizezer the priests <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sounded the trumpets⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “trumpet blowers with trumpets”</note> before the ark of God. And Obed-Edom and Jehiah <transChange type="added">were</transChange> gatekeepers for the ark.  <div eID="gen3052" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2267"/><div sID="gen3053" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2267"/>And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of thousands went to bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahweh from the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:26
verses.text: And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> when God helped the Levites carrying the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:27
verses.text: Now David was clothed with a robe of fine linen; so also all the Levites who were carrying the ark, the singers, and Kenaniah the chief of the singing. And David wore a linen ephod.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:28
verses.text: And all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of Yahweh with shouting, with the sound of a shofar,<note placement="foot">Or “horn, trumpet”</note> and with trumpets and cymbals, making loud music with musical instruments and stringed instruments.  <div eID="gen3053" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2268"/><div sID="gen3054" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2268"/>And when the ark of the covenant of Yahweh came into the city of David, then Michal the daughter of Saul looked down from the window and saw the king, David, leaping and dancing. And she despised him in her heart.  <chapter eID="1Chr.15"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2269"/><title type="x-s">The Ark of the Covenant Placed in Its Tent</title> <div sID="gen3055" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2269"/>And they brought the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it. And they offered burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:2
verses.text: And when David had finished offering the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahweh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:3
verses.text: And he distributed to every man of Israel, both men and women, to each <transChange type="added">person</transChange> a loaf of bread, a cake of dates, and a cake of raisins.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:4
verses.text: Then he appointed some of the Levites as ministers before the ark of Yahweh, to invoke, thank, and praise Yahweh the God of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:5
verses.text: Asaph <transChange type="added">was</transChange> chief, and his second <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Zechariah; Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on harps and lyres. And Asaph played on the cymbals.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:6
verses.text: And Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests <transChange type="added">blew</transChange> on the trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:7
verses.text: Then on that day David first appointed to give thanks to Yahweh by the hand of Asaph and his brothers. <div eID="gen3055" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">David’s Song of Thanks</title> <div sID="gen3056" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen3056" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2270"/><lg sID="gen3057"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2270"/>Give thanks to Yahweh; call upon his name;<l eID="gen3058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3059"/>make known his deeds among the nations! <l eID="gen3059" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2271"/><l level="1" sID="gen3060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2271"/>Sing to him; sing praises to him;<l eID="gen3060" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3061"/>tell of his wondrous works! <l eID="gen3061" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2272"/><l level="1" sID="gen3062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2272"/>Glory in his holy name;<l eID="gen3062" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3063"/>let the hearts of those seeking Yahweh rejoice! <l eID="gen3063" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2273"/><l level="1" sID="gen3064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2273"/>Seek Yahweh and his strength;<l eID="gen3064" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3065"/>seek his face continually! <l eID="gen3065" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2274"/><l level="1" sID="gen3066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2274"/>Remember his wonderful works that he has done,<l eID="gen3066" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3067"/>his wonders and the judgments of his mouth, <l eID="gen3067" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2275"/><l level="1" sID="gen3068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2275"/>O offspring of Israel, his servant,<l eID="gen3068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3069"/>O sons of Jacob, his chosen ones! <l eID="gen3069" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2276"/><l level="1" sID="gen3070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2276"/>He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh our God;<l eID="gen3070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3071"/>his judgments <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in all the earth. <l eID="gen3071" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2277"/><l level="1" sID="gen3072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2277"/>Remember his covenant forever,<l eID="gen3072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3073"/>the word he commanded for a thousand generations, <l eID="gen3073" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2278"/><l level="1" sID="gen3074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2278"/>that he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> with Abraham,<l eID="gen3074" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3075"/>his sworn oath to Isaac. <l eID="gen3075" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2279"/><l level="1" sID="gen3076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2279"/>And he confirmed it to Jacob as a statute,<l eID="gen3076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3077"/>an everlasting covenant to Israel, <l eID="gen3077" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2280"/><l level="1" sID="gen3078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2280"/>saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan,<l eID="gen3078" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3079"/>the portion of your inheritance.” <l eID="gen3079" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2281"/><l level="1" sID="gen3080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2281"/>When you were few in number, little,<l eID="gen3080" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3081"/>and sojourners <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in it, <l eID="gen3081" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2282"/><l level="1" sID="gen3082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2282"/>when they wandered from nation to nation,<l eID="gen3082" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3083"/>and from one kingdom to another people, <l eID="gen3083" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2283"/><l level="1" sID="gen3084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2283"/>he did not allow anyone to oppress them,<l eID="gen3084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3085"/>and he rebuked kings on their account, <l eID="gen3085" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2284"/><l level="1" sID="gen3086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2284"/><transChange type="added">saying,</transChange> “You must not touch my anointed<l eID="gen3086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3087"/>nor do harm to my prophets!” <l eID="gen3087" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2285"/><l level="1" sID="gen3088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2285"/>Sing to Yahweh, all the earth!<l eID="gen3088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3089"/>Proclaim his salvation from day to day! <l eID="gen3089" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2286"/><l level="1" sID="gen3090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2286"/>Proclaim his glory among the nations,<l eID="gen3090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3091"/>his wondrous works among the peoples! <l eID="gen3091" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2287"/><l level="1" sID="gen3092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2287"/>For Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great and greatly praised,<l eID="gen3092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3093"/>and he is feared among all gods. <l eID="gen3093" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2288"/><l level="1" sID="gen3094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2288"/>For all the gods of the nations <transChange type="added">are</transChange> idols,<l eID="gen3094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3095"/>but Yahweh made the heavens. <l eID="gen3095" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2289"/><l level="1" sID="gen3096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2289"/>Splendor and majesty <transChange type="added">are</transChange> before him;<l eID="gen3096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3097"/>strength and joy <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in his place. <l eID="gen3097" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2290"/><l level="1" sID="gen3098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2290"/>Ascribe to Yahweh, O clans of the nations,<l eID="gen3098" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3099"/>ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength! <l eID="gen3099" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2291"/><l level="1" sID="gen3100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2291"/>Ascribe to Yahweh the glory of his name!<l eID="gen3100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3101"/>Lift up an offering and come before him!<l eID="gen3101" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3102"/>Bow down to Yahweh in the splendor of holiness! <l eID="gen3102" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2292"/><l level="1" sID="gen3103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2292"/>Tremble before him, all the earth;<l eID="gen3103" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3104"/>surely the world shall not be shaken. <l eID="gen3104" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2293"/><l level="1" sID="gen3105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2293"/>Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad,<l eID="gen3105" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3106"/>and let them tell the peoples, “Yahweh reigns!” <l eID="gen3106" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2294"/><l level="1" sID="gen3107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2294"/>Let the sea roar and its fullness;<l eID="gen3107" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3108"/>let the field rejoice and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in it. <l eID="gen3108" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2295"/><l level="1" sID="gen3109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2295"/>Then the trees of the forest shall sing for joy before Yahweh,<l eID="gen3109" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3110"/>for he comes to judge the earth. <l eID="gen3110" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2296"/><l level="1" sID="gen3111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2296"/>Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good;<l eID="gen3111" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3112"/>his loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> everlasting. <l eID="gen3112" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2297"/><l level="1" sID="gen3113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2297"/>Then say, “Save us, O God of our salvation;<l eID="gen3113" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3114"/>gather us and rescue us from the nations<l eID="gen3114" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3115"/>that <transChange type="added">we may</transChange> give thanks to your holy name<l eID="gen3115" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3116"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> glory in your praise. <l eID="gen3116" level="2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2298"/><l level="1" sID="gen3117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2298"/>Blessed be Yahweh the God of Israel,<l eID="gen3117" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3118"/>from everlasting to everlasting!”<l eID="gen3118" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3057"/> <div sID="gen3119" type="x-p"/> Then all the people said, “Amen!” and praised Yahweh.  <div eID="gen3119" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2299"/><title type="x-s">Worship and the Ark</title> <div sID="gen3120" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2299"/>So he<note placement="foot">That is, David</note> left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of Yahweh to minister before the ark regularly <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as each day required⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “according to the word of a day with respect to its day”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:38
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">he left</transChange> Obed-Edom with his sixty-eight brothers. And Obed-Edom, the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah <transChange type="added">were</transChange> gatekeepers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:39
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">he left</transChange> Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tabernacle of Yahweh at the high place which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> at Gibeon

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:40
verses.text: to offer burnt offerings regularly to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering, morning and evening, according to all that was written in the law of Yahweh that he commanded concerning Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:41
verses.text: And with them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Heman and Jeduthun and the remainder of those chosen, who were designated by name to give thanks to Yahweh, for his loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> everlasting.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:42
verses.text: And Heman and Jeduthun with them <transChange type="added">had</transChange> trumpets and cymbals for making music, along with instruments for the song of God. And the sons of Jeduthun <transChange type="added">were</transChange> at the gate.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:43
verses.text: Then all the people went each to his house, and David turned to bless his household.  <chapter eID="1Chr.16"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2300"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Covenant with David</title> <div sID="gen3121" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2300"/>And as David lived in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Look, I live in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> under tent curtains.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:2
verses.text: And Nathan said to David, “Whatever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your heart, do, for God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with you.”  <div eID="gen3121" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2301"/><div sID="gen3122" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2301"/>And it happened that same night the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:4
verses.text: “Go and say to David my servant, ‘Thus says Yahweh, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not to build a house for me to live <transChange type="added">in</transChange>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:5
verses.text: for I have not lived in a house from the day that I brought out Israel unto this day. I have been from tent to tent and from tabernacle <transChange type="added">to tabernacle</transChange>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:6
verses.text: In every <transChange type="added">place</transChange> I have moved about, did I say one word <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the judges of Israel I commanded to shepherd my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built for me a house of cedar?’ ” ’

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:7
verses.text: So now, thus you shall say to my servant David, ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts, “I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be leader over my people Israel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:8
verses.text: and I have been with you wherever you went and have cut down your enemies from before you and will make a name for you, like the name of the great ones on the earth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:9
verses.text: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and I will plant them,<note placement="foot">Or “him” (i.e., the nation)</note> and they<note placement="foot">Or “he”</note> shall dwell in their<note placement="foot">Or “his”</note> place and be in anguish no longer. And wicked men will no longer wear them down as before,

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:10
verses.text: from the day that I commanded judges over my people Israel. And I will subdue your enemies, and I declare to you <transChange type="added">that</transChange> Yahweh will build for you a house.<note placement="foot">Or “household” (that is, a dynasty)</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:11
verses.text: And it shall be that when your days are fulfilled to go <transChange type="added">and sleep</transChange> with your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> then I will raise up your seed after you, who will be one of your sons, and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:12
verses.text: He himself will build for me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:13
verses.text: I myself will be a father to him, and he himself will be a son to me. And I will not remove my steadfast love from him as I took it away from whoever was before you.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:14
verses.text: And I will establish him in my house and in my kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.” ’ ”

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:15
verses.text: According to all these words and according to all this revelation, thus did Nathan speak to David.  <div eID="gen3122" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2302"/><title type="x-s">David’s Prayer</title> <div sID="gen3123" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2302"/>Then King David went and sat before Yahweh and said, “Who <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I, O Yahweh God, and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my house that you have brought me thus far?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:17
verses.text: And this was a small <transChange type="added">matter</transChange> in your eyes, O God. And you have spoken concerning the house of your servant for a long <transChange type="added">time</transChange> and have shown me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞future generations to come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with a turn of humankind ascending”</note> O Yahweh God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:18
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “What to add again”</note> can David <transChange type="added">do</transChange> to you for honoring your servant? Now you know your servant.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:19
verses.text: O Yahweh, for the sake of your servant and according to your heart you have done all this greatness, to make known all <transChange type="added">these</transChange> great things.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:20
verses.text: O Yahweh, there is none like you, and there is no God except you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:21
verses.text: And who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like your people Israel, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one nation upon earth whom God went to redeem for himself, to establish for you a reputation<note placement="foot">Or “name”</note> for great and awesome things, to drive out nations from before your people whom you redeemed from Egypt?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:22
verses.text: And you made your people Israel an everlasting nation for yourself. And you, O Yahweh, became their God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:23
verses.text: So now, O Yahweh, let the word that you spoke to your servant and to his house be established forever, that you might do what you have spoken.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:24
verses.text: And let your name be established and be magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, is Israel’s God, and may the house of David your servant be established before you.’

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:25
verses.text: For you, my God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have informed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “have opened the ear of”</note> your servant <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you will build a house for him. Therefore, your servant has found <transChange type="added">courage</transChange> to pray before you.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:26
verses.text: So now, O Yahweh, you yourself <transChange type="added">are</transChange> God, and you have spoken to your servant this good thing.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:27
verses.text: And now may you begin to bless the house of your servant <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to continue forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to be forever”</note> before you, for you, O Yahweh, have blessed. And it will be blessed forever.”  <chapter eID="1Chr.17"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2303"/><title type="x-s">David’s Victory over His Enemies</title> <div sID="gen3124" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2303"/>And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> after David struck the Philistines and subdued them, he captured Gath and its villages out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:2
verses.text: And he struck Moab, and the Moabites became servants to David, bearing tribute.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:3
verses.text: And David struck Hadadezer, king of Zobah-Hamath, as he set up his monument at the Euphrates River.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:4
verses.text: And David captured from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. And David hamstrung all the chariot horses but left one hundred of them <transChange type="added">to</transChange> remain <transChange type="added">for</transChange> chariots.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:5
verses.text: And when the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah-Hamath, David struck down twenty-two thousand men of Aram.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:6
verses.text: Then David set up <transChange type="added">garrisons</transChange> in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became servants to David, bearing tribute. And Yahweh delivered David wherever he went.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:7
verses.text: And David took small round shields of gold that were upon the servants of Hadadezer and brought them <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:8
verses.text: And from Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David captured very much bronze. Solomon made the bronze sea with it along with the columns and objects of bronze.  <div eID="gen3124" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2304"/><div sID="gen3125" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2304"/>And when Tou the king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the whole army of Hadadezer the king of Zobah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:10
verses.text: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to ask him for peace and to bless him because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him, for Tou <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had been at war⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man of battles”</note> with Hadadezer. And <transChange type="added">he brought with him</transChange> all the objects of gold, silver, and bronze.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:11
verses.text: King David dedicated these also to Yahweh, along with the silver and gold that he had taken from all the nations, from Edom, Moab, the sons of Ammon, the Philistines, and Amalek.  <div eID="gen3125" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2305"/><div sID="gen3126" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2305"/>And Abishai son of Zeruiah defeated eighteen thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:13
verses.text: And he put garrisons in Edom, and all Edom became servants to David. And Yahweh delivered David wherever he went.  <div eID="gen3126" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2306"/><title type="x-s">David’s Administration</title> <div sID="gen3127" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2306"/>So David reigned over all Israel, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he administered justice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he was a doer of justice”</note> and righteousness to all his people.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:15
verses.text: And Joab son of Zeruiah <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the army, and Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud <transChange type="added">was</transChange> recorder.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:16
verses.text: And Zadok son of Ahitub and Abimelech son of Abiathar <transChange type="added">were</transChange> priests, and Shavsha <transChange type="added">was</transChange> secretary.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:17
verses.text: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the Kerethites and the Pelethites. And the sons of David <transChange type="added">were</transChange> chief officials under the hand of the king.  <chapter eID="1Chr.18"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2307"/><title type="x-s">The Ammonites Humiliate David’s Messengers</title> <div sID="gen3128" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2307"/>And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> after this Nahash the king of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> died, and his son reigned in his place.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:2
verses.text: And David said, “I will deal kindly with Hanun the son of Nahash because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And the servants of David came to the land of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> to Hanun, to comfort him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:3
verses.text: But the princes of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> said to Hanun, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Do you think⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In your eyes”</note> because David sent comforters to you <transChange type="added">that</transChange> David honors your father? Is it not for the purpose of exploring <transChange type="added">so as</transChange> to overthrow and spy out the land that his servants have come to you?”

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:4
verses.text: So Hanun took the servants of David and shaved them and cut off their garments at the middle, up to the buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:5
verses.text: And they went and told David concerning the men, and he inquired of them, for the men were very disgraced. And the king said, “Dwell in Jericho until your beards grow out; then return.”  <div eID="gen3128" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2308"/><div sID="gen3129" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2308"/>And when the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> saw that they made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> sent one thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves horses and chariots from Aram-Naharaim, Aram-Maacah, and Zobah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:7
verses.text: And they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots and the king of Maacah and his people, and they came and encamped before Medeba. And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> were gathered from their cities and came to the battle.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:8
verses.text: And when David heard, he sent Joab and the entire army of mighty warriors.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:9
verses.text: And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> went out and took up positions for battle at the entrance of the city. And the kings who had come <transChange type="added">were</transChange> alone in the field.  <div eID="gen3129" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2309"/><div sID="gen3130" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2309"/>When Joab saw that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a battle line⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the face of the battle”</note> against him at the front and the back, he chose from among the chosen <transChange type="added">men</transChange> in Israel and arranged <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to meet Aram.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:11
verses.text: And the remainder of the people he put in the hand of Abishai his brother, and they were arranged to meet the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:12
verses.text: And he said, “If Aram is too strong for me, then you must be a help to me, but if the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> are too strong for you, then I will help you.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:13
verses.text: Be strong! Let us strengthen ourselves on behalf of our people and on behalf of the cities of our God. And may Yahweh do <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> good in his eyes.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:14
verses.text: And Joab and the people who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him drew near before Aram for battle, and they fled before him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:15
verses.text: And when the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> saw that Aram had fled, they also fled before Abishai his brother, and they came to the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen3130" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2310"/><div sID="gen3131" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2310"/>And when Aram saw that they were defeated before Israel, they sent messengers and brought out Aram, who <transChange type="added">was from</transChange> beyond the Euphrates,<note placement="foot">Or “the river”</note> with Shophach the commander of the army of Hadadezer before them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:17
verses.text: And when it was told to David, he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan. And he came to them and was arrayed against them. Then David was arrayed to meet Aram in battle, and they fought with him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:18
verses.text: And Aram fled before Israel. And David killed from Aram <transChange type="added">the men of</transChange> seven thousand chariots and forty thousand foot soldiers, and he put to death Shophach the commander of the army.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:19
verses.text: And when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with David and became servants to him. So Aram was no longer willing to help the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note>  <chapter eID="1Chr.19"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2311"/><title type="x-s">The Capture of Rabbah</title> <div sID="gen3132" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2311"/>And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the spring time of year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at the time of the returning of the year”</note> the time when kings go out to battle, Joab led the troops of the army and destroyed the land of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> And he came and besieged Rabbah, but David remained in Jerusalem. And Joab struck Rabbah and destroyed it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:2
verses.text: And David took the crown of their king from his head and found it to weigh a talent of gold. And in it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a precious stone. Then it was <transChange type="added">placed</transChange> upon the head of David. And he brought out the booty of the city, a large amount.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:3
verses.text: And the people who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in it he brought out, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he set them to work with saws and iron implements and axes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">The translation comes from <reference osisRef="2Sam.12.31">2 Samuel 12:31 </reference>since the Hebrew text here is uncertain</note> Thus David did to all the cities of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> Then David returned, and all the nation <transChange type="added">went</transChange> with him.  <div eID="gen3132" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2312"/><title type="x-s">The Philistine Giants Slain</title> <div sID="gen3133" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2312"/>And after this there arose a war in Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite struck down Sippai, one of the descendants of the Rephaim. And they were subdued.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:5
verses.text: And again there was war with the Philistines. And Elhanan son of Jair struck down Lahmi, the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like a weaver’s beam.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:6
verses.text: And again there was war in Gath. And there was a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞very tall⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “measured”</note> man there, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in all⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and his fingers, six and six, twenty-four”</note> He himself <transChange type="added">was</transChange> also a descendant of the Rephaim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:7
verses.text: And he taunted Israel, but Jehonathan son of Shimea, brother of David, struck him down.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:8
verses.text: These were born to the giants in Gath, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.  <chapter eID="1Chr.20"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2313"/><title type="x-s">The Census of David</title> <div sID="gen3134" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2313"/>Then Satan<note placement="foot">Or “an accuser,” or “an adversary”</note> stood against Israel and urged David to count Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:2
verses.text: So David said to Joab and to the commanders of the nation, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba to Dan and bring a report to me that I might know their number.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:3
verses.text: But Joab said, “May Yahweh add to the people a hundred times what they are! Are they not, O my lord the king, all of them the king’s servants? Why does my lord seek this? Why would he bring guilt to Israel?”

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:4
verses.text: But the word of the king prevailed over Joab. Then he went about through all Israel and came to Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:5
verses.text: And Joab gave the number of the enrollment of the people to David. And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> all Israel <transChange type="added">was</transChange> one million one hundred thousand men drawing a sword, and in Judah <transChange type="added">were</transChange> four hundred and seventy thousand men drawing a sword.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:6
verses.text: But he did not count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the word of the king was repulsive to Joab.  <div eID="gen3134" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2314"/><div sID="gen3135" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2314"/>But this word was displeasing in the eyes of God, and he struck Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:8
verses.text: Then David said to God, “I have sinned severely <transChange type="added">in</transChange> that I have done this thing. But now, please forgive the sin of your servant, for I have been very foolish.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:9
verses.text: Then Yahweh spoke to Gad the seer of David, saying,

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:10
verses.text: “Go, you must speak to David, saying, ‘Thus says Yahweh: “Three <transChange type="added">choices</transChange> I offer to you. Choose one of them for yourself that I will do to you.” ’ ”

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:11
verses.text: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Thus says Yahweh: ‘Choose for yourself:

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:12
verses.text: whether three years of famine or three months of devastation by your enemies while the sword of your enemies overtakes you, or three days of the sword of Yahweh, with disease in the land and the angel of Yahweh destroying throughout all the territory in Israel.’ So now, see what word I should return to my sender.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:13
verses.text: Then David said to Gad, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am very troubled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Great trouble to me”</note> Let me into the hand of Yahweh, for his compassion is very great, but do not let me fall into the hand of a man.”  <div eID="gen3135" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2315"/><div sID="gen3136" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2315"/>So Yahweh sent a pestilence through Israel, and seventy thousand men from Israel fell.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:15
verses.text: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it, and as <transChange type="added">he was about</transChange> to destroy <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, Yahweh saw and was grieved on account of the calamity. Then he said to the angel, the destroyer, “<transChange type="added">It is</transChange> enough; slacken your hand.” And the angel of Yahweh was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:16
verses.text: And David lifted his eyes and saw the angel of Yahweh standing between earth and heaven, with his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:17
verses.text: Then David said to God, “Was it not I <transChange type="added">who</transChange> gave a command to count the people? Now I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he who has sinned, and I have certainly done wickedness, but these sheep, what have they done? O Yahweh, my God, please let your hand be against me and against the house of my father, but against your people, <transChange type="added">let there be</transChange> no plague.”  <div eID="gen3136" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2316"/><title type="x-s">David Builds an Altar</title> <div sID="gen3137" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2316"/>Now the angel of Yahweh had spoken to Gad to say to David that David should go up <transChange type="added">and</transChange> erect an altar for Yahweh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:19
verses.text: So David went up at the word of Gad that he had spoken in the name of Yahweh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:20
verses.text: Now Ornan was threshing wheat, and Ornan turned and saw the angel, and his four sons with him hid themselves.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:21
verses.text: Then David came to Ornan, and Ornan looked and saw David. And he went out from the threshing floor, and they bowed down to David, faces to the ground.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:22
verses.text: Then David said to Ornan, “Please give me the place, the threshing floor, that I might build an altar on it to Yahweh; at full price please give it to me, that the plague against the people might be stopped.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:23
verses.text: And Ornan said to David, “Take <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to yourself; let my lord the king do what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good in his eyes. See, I give the cattle for the burnt offerings and threshing sledges for the wood and wheat for the grain offering—I give <transChange type="added">it</transChange> all.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:24
verses.text: But King David said to Ornan, “No, for I will certainly buy <transChange type="added">it</transChange> at full value; indeed, I will not take what is yours for Yahweh and offer burnt offerings for nothing.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:25
verses.text: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:26
verses.text: Then David built an altar there to Yahweh, and he offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and he called to Yahweh. And he answered him with fire from heaven upon the altar of burnt offering.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:27
verses.text: Then Yahweh commanded the angel, and he returned his sword to its sheath.  <div eID="gen3137" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2317"/><div sID="gen3138" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2317"/>At that time, when David saw that Yahweh answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he sacrificed there.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:29
verses.text: Now the tabernacle of Yahweh that Moses had made in the desert and the altar of burnt offering <transChange type="added">were</transChange> at that time at the high place of Gibeon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:30
verses.text: But David was not able to go before it to seek God, for he was afraid on account of the sword of the angel of Yahweh.  <chapter eID="1Chr.21"/> <div eID="gen3138" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:1
verses.text: Then David said, “This will be the house of Yahweh God, and this altar of burnt offering for Israel.”  <div eID="gen3139" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2318"/><title type="x-s">David’s Preparations for Building the Temple</title> <div sID="gen3140" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2318"/>And David commanded to assemble the resident aliens who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the land of Israel and appointed stone craftsmen to cut dressed stones to build the house of God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:3
verses.text: And David provided much iron for nails for the doors of the gates and for the seams, and abundant copper <transChange type="added">that</transChange> could not be weighed,

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:4
verses.text: and cedar timbers without number, for the Sidonians and Tyrians brought abundant cedars to David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:5
verses.text: Then David said, “Solomon my son <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a boy and inexperienced, and the house built for Yahweh <transChange type="added">must be</transChange> exceedingly great in fame and splendor throughout every land. I will make preparations for him.” So David provided abundant <transChange type="added">materials</transChange> before he died.  <div eID="gen3140" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2319"/><title type="x-s">Solomon Charged with Building the Temple of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen3141" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2319"/>Then he called to Solomon his son and commanded him to build a house for Yahweh, the God of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:7
verses.text: And David said to Solomon his son, “I myself had in my heart to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God,

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:8
verses.text: but it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> the word of Yahweh <transChange type="added">came</transChange> over me, saying, ‘You have shed much blood and have made much war; you shall not build a house for my name because you have shed much blood upon the ground before me.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:9
verses.text: Behold, a son shall be born to you; he himself will be a man of rest, and I will give rest to him from all his enemies all around, for his name will be Solomon, and peace and quietness I will give to Israel in his days.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:10
verses.text: He himself will build a house for my name, and he himself will be to me a son, and I <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> to him as a father, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:11
verses.text: Now, my son, Yahweh will be with you, that you may succeed and build the house of Yahweh your God as he has spoken concerning you.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:12
verses.text: Only may Yahweh give to you understanding and insight that he might give you charge over Israel and the keeping of the law of Yahweh your God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:13
verses.text: Then you will prosper if you take care to do the statutes and judgments which Yahweh commanded Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and be courageous; fear not and do not be dismayed.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:14
verses.text: Now see, with great effort I have made provision for the house of Yahweh: 100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, and bronze and iron <transChange type="added">that</transChange> cannot be weighed, for there is an abundance. Also timber and stone I have provided, but to these you should add.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:15
verses.text: And with you <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> an abundance of craftsmen: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and everyone skilled in every <transChange type="added">kind of</transChange> craftsmanship

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:16
verses.text: with gold, silver, bronze, and iron without number. Arise and work! Yahweh will be with you!”  <div eID="gen3141" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2320"/><div sID="gen3142" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2320"/>And David commanded all the commanders of Israel to help Solomon his son, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:18
verses.text: “Is not Yahweh your God with you? And has he <transChange type="added">not</transChange> given you rest all around? For he has put in my hand the inhabitants of the land, and the land is subdued before Yahweh and before his people.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:19
verses.text: Now set your heart and mind to seek Yahweh your Go, and arise and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God, that the ark of the covenant of Yahweh and the holy vessels of God might be brought into the house built for the name of Yahweh.  <chapter eID="1Chr.22"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2321"/><title type="x-s">David Organizes the Levites</title> <div sID="gen3143" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2321"/>Now David <transChange type="added">was</transChange> old and full of days. And he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:2
verses.text: And he assembled all the commanders of Israel and the priests and the Levites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:3
verses.text: And the Levites thirty years old and above were counted, and their number according to their head count for the men <transChange type="added">was</transChange> thirty-eight thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:4
verses.text: Of these, <transChange type="added">David said,</transChange> “Twenty-four thousand <transChange type="added">are</transChange> to direct the work of the house of Yahweh, along with six thousand judges and officials,

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:5
verses.text: four thousand gatekeepers, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> four thousand offering praise with the instruments that I have made for praise.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:6
verses.text: And David organized them <transChange type="added">in</transChange> divisions according to the sons of Levi: to Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.  <div eID="gen3143" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2322"/><div sID="gen3144" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2322"/>For the Gershonites <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Ladan and Shimei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:8
verses.text: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief and Zetham and Joel, three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:9
verses.text: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> of Ladan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:10
verses.text: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah; these four <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Shimei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:11
verses.text: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second, but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons. They were enrolled as one for the house of a father.  <div eID="gen3144" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2323"/><div sID="gen3145" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2323"/>The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:13
verses.text: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was set apart to consecrate the most holy things. He and his sons <transChange type="added">were</transChange> to burn offerings forever before Yahweh to serve him and to bless in his name forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:14
verses.text: But Moses the man of God <transChange type="added">and</transChange> his sons were reckoned among the tribe of Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:15
verses.text: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:16
verses.text: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:17
verses.text: And the sons of Eliezer were Rehabiah, the head. And Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:18
verses.text: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:19
verses.text: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:20
verses.text: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief and Isshiah the second.  <div eID="gen3145" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2324"/><div sID="gen3146" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2324"/>The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:22
verses.text: And Eleazar died, and he did not have sons, but only daughters. And the sons of Kish, their relatives, married them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:23
verses.text: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.  <div eID="gen3146" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2325"/><div sID="gen3147" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2325"/>These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of Levi according to the house of their fathers, the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> according to their enrollment, by the number of the names, according to their head count, <transChange type="added">who were to</transChange> do the work of the service of the house of Yahweh, from twenty years old and above.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:25
verses.text: For David said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people, and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:26
verses.text: And also, the Levites do not <transChange type="added">need</transChange> to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:27
verses.text: For by the last words of David, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the number of the sons of Levi, from twenty years old and above.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:28
verses.text: For their station <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to assist⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the hand of”</note> the sons of Aaron with the service of the house of Yahweh, over the courtyards, over the chambers, and over the cleansing of all the sanctified objects, and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the work of the service of the house of God,

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:29
verses.text: and with the rows of bread, the flour, the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baked offering, the offering mixed with oil, and for all the amounts and measurements.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:30
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> to stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the morning, in the morning”</note> thanking and praising Yahweh, and likewise in the evening,

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:31
verses.text: and for every burnt offering offered to Yahweh, on Sabbaths, on new moon festivals, and at the appointed feasts, according to the customary number <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞required of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “over them”</note> regularly before Yahweh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:32
verses.text: And they shall keep the responsibility of the tent of assembly,<note placement="foot">Or “meeting”</note> the responsibility of the sanctified objects, and the responsibility of the sons of Aaron, their brothers, to serve the house of Yahweh.  <chapter eID="1Chr.23"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2326"/><title type="x-s">David Organizes the Priests</title> <div sID="gen3148" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2326"/>And as for the sons of Aaron, <transChange type="added">these were</transChange> their divisions. The sons of Aaron <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:2
verses.text: And Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they had no sons⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons were not to them”</note> so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:3
verses.text: And David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their appointments for their service.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:4
verses.text: And more sons of Eleazar were found as heads of the men than the sons of Ithamar, so they divided them to the sons of Eleazar <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> sixteen heads over the house of the fathers, and to the sons of Ithamar over the house of the fathers <transChange type="added">were</transChange> eight <transChange type="added">heads</transChange>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:5
verses.text: They divided them by lot <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all alike⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “these with those”</note> for they were commanders of the sanctuary and commanders of God from among the sons of Eleazar and the sons of Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:6
verses.text: And Shemaiah the son of Nethanel, the scribe, from the Levites, recorded them before the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> of the priests and Levites, one father’s house drawn by Lot for Eleazar and one drawn by lot for Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:7
verses.text: And the first lot went out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:8
verses.text: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:9
verses.text: the fifth to Malkijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:10
verses.text: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:11
verses.text: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shekaniah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:12
verses.text: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:13
verses.text: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:14
verses.text: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:15
verses.text: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Ha-Pizzez,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:16
verses.text: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Ezekiel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:17
verses.text: the twenty-first to Jakin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:18
verses.text: the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:19
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> their appointments for their service to come into the house of Yahweh according to their custom by the hand of Aaron their father, as Yahweh the God of Israel had commanded him.  <div eID="gen3148" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2327"/><div sID="gen3149" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2327"/>And as for the remainder of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:21
verses.text: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:22
verses.text: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons Shelomoth, Jahath.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:23
verses.text: Of the sons of Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:24
verses.text: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; the sons of Micah, Shamur.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:25
verses.text: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:26
verses.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, his son.<note placement="foot">Or “Beno”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:27
verses.text: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, his son,<note placement="foot">Or “Beno”</note> Shoham, Zakkur, and Ibri.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:28
verses.text: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:29
verses.text: Of Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:30
verses.text: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the sons of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:31
verses.text: And lots were also cast <transChange type="added">for</transChange> these, just as their brothers, the sons of Aaron, before David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> for the priests and for the Levites the fathers, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the principle of the chief and younger brother alike⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the head like his brother the younger”</note>  <chapter eID="1Chr.24"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2328"/><title type="x-s">David Organizes the Musicians</title> <div sID="gen3150" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2328"/>And David and the commanders of the army set apart for the service the sons of Asaph, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Heman, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Jeduthun, who prophesied with stringed instruments, with harps, and with cymbals. And their inventory of the men of the work <transChange type="added">and</transChange> for their duty was:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:2
verses.text: for the sons of Asaph: Zakkur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, sons of Asaph, under the hand<note placement="foot">That is, under the direction</note> of Asaph, who prophesied under the hands<note placement="foot">That is, under the direction</note> of the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:3
verses.text: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah,<note placement="foot">One Hebrew manuscript and the LXX add “Shimei” between Jeshaiah and Heshabiah (see verse <reference osisRef="1Chr.25.17">17</reference>)</note> Heshabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands<note placement="foot">That is, under the direction</note> of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the stringed instrument with thanksgiving and praise to Yahweh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:4
verses.text: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:5
verses.text: All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> sons to Heman, the seer of the king, according to the words of God to raise a horn.<note placement="foot">That is, to exalt Heman</note> And God had given to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:6
verses.text: All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> under the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞direction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> of their father in the music of the house of Yahweh, with cymbals, harps, and stringed instruments for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞direction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands”</note> of the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:7
verses.text: And their number, along with their brothers, trained singers, all the skilled people for Yahweh, were two hundred and eighty-eight.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:8
verses.text: And they cast lots <transChange type="added">for</transChange> responsibilities <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the principle of small and great alike⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for like the small, like the great”</note> teacher with student.  <div eID="gen3150" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2329"/><div sID="gen3151" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2329"/>And the first lot for Asaph went out to Joseph; the second to Gedaliahu; he and his brothers and his twelve sons.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:10
verses.text: The third, Zakkur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:11
verses.text: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:12
verses.text: the fifth, Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:13
verses.text: the sixth, Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:14
verses.text: the seventh, Jesarelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:15
verses.text: the eighth, Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:16
verses.text: the ninth, Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:17
verses.text: the tenth, Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:18
verses.text: eleventh, Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:19
verses.text: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:20
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:21
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:22
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fifteenth, to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:23
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sixteenth, to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:24
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seventeenth, to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:25
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eighteenth, to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:26
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nineteenth, to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:27
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twentieth, to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:28
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twenty-first, to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:29
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twenty-second, to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:30
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twenty-third, to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:31
verses.text: to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twenty-fourth, to Romamti-ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.  <chapter eID="1Chr.25"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2330"/><title type="x-s">The Divisions of the Gatekeepers</title> <div sID="gen3152" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2330"/>As for the working groups of the gatekeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, from the sons of Asaph.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:2
verses.text: And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:3
verses.text: Elam the fifth, Jehohana the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:4
verses.text: And Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:5
verses.text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:6
verses.text: And to Shemaiah his son were sons born who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> rulers in the house of their father, for they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> mighty warriors of ability.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:7
verses.text: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose brothers <transChange type="added">were</transChange> sons of ability, Elihu and Semakiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:8
verses.text: All these from the sons of Obed-Edom, they and their sons, and their brothers <transChange type="added">were</transChange> men of ability with strength for service; sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:9
verses.text: And Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, sons of ability, eighteen.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:10
verses.text: And Hosah, from the sons of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (though he was not firstborn, his father appointed him as chief),

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:11
verses.text: Hilkiah the second, Tabaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brothers of Hosah <transChange type="added">were</transChange> thirteen.  <div eID="gen3152" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2331"/><div sID="gen3153" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2331"/>These working groups of gatekeepers, corresponding to the chief men, had responsibilities like their brothers to serve in the house of Yahweh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:13
verses.text: And they cast lots, small and great alike, by their fathers’ houses, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for their gates⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for gate and gate”</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:14
verses.text: And the lot fell to the east to Shelemiah. As for Zechariah his son, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a wise counselor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “giving counsel with understanding”</note> they cast lots. And his lot came out for the north.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:15
verses.text: To Obed-Edom <transChange type="added">went out</transChange> the south, and to his sons, the storehouses.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:16
verses.text: For Shuppim and Hosah <transChange type="added">it went out</transChange> for the west, at the gate of Shalleketh, on the road that goes up, guard for guard.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:17
verses.text: To the east, six Levites; to the north, four daily; to the south, four daily; and at the storerooms, two <transChange type="added">by</transChange> two.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:18
verses.text: For the court to the west, four at the road, two at the court.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:19
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the working groups of the gatekeepers among the sons of the Korahites and among the sons of Merari.  <div eID="gen3153" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2332"/><title type="x-s">Treasurers and Other Officials</title> <div sID="gen3154" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2332"/>And of the Levites: Ahijah <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over the treasuries of the house of God and over the treasuries of the sanctified objects.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:21
verses.text: The sons of Ladan: the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:22
verses.text: The sons of Jehieli, Zetham and Joel his brother, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> over the treasuries of the house of Yahweh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:23
verses.text: Of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the Ozzielites:

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:24
verses.text: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> commander over the treasuries.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:25
verses.text: And his brothers: from Eliezer <transChange type="added">were</transChange> Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zikri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:26
verses.text: That Shelomoth and his brothers <transChange type="added">were</transChange> over all the treasuries of the sanctified objects that King David and the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> to the commanders of thousands and hundreds and the commanders of the army had dedicated.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:27
verses.text: From the battles and from the spoil they had dedicated <transChange type="added">these things</transChange> to strengthen the house of Yahweh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:28
verses.text: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated—all the dedicated gifts <transChange type="added">were</transChange> under the hand of Shelomith and his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:29
verses.text: For the Izharites: Kenaniah and his sons <transChange type="added">were appointed</transChange> to the duties outside of Israel as officials and as judges.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:30
verses.text: For the Hebronites: Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of ability, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> over the administration of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the work of Yahweh and for the service of the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:31
verses.text: For the Hebronites: Jeriah the chief of the Hebronites for the genealogy for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> (In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were examined, and there was found among them mighty warriors of strength at Jazer in Gilead.)

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:32
