verses.name: Ezra 5:7
verses.text: They sent to him the report <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in which was written as follows⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “and like this was written in its middle”</note> “To Darius the king, all peace.

verses.name: Ezra 5:8
verses.text: May it be known to the king that we went to the province of Judah, the house of the great God. It is being built with stone blocks and timber is being put in the walls. This work is being done with diligence and is making progress in their hands.

verses.name: Ezra 5:9
verses.text: Then we asked those elders and said this to them, ‘Who issued forth to you a decree to build this house and to finish this structure?’

verses.name: Ezra 5:10
verses.text: We also asked them their names to make them known to you, that we might write down the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞name of their leaders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “name of the men at their head”</note>

verses.name: Ezra 5:11
verses.text: And this is the answer they returned to us: ‘We are servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are building the house that was built formerly many years ago, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> a great king of Israel had built and finished.

verses.name: Ezra 5:12
verses.text: But because our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> angered the God of heaven, he gave them into the hand of the Chaldean King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. He destroyed this house and carried away the people to Babylonia.

verses.name: Ezra 5:13
verses.text: But in the first year of King Cyrus of Babylon’s reign he issued forth a decree to build this house of God.

verses.name: Ezra 5:14
verses.text: Also, the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took away from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to the temple in Babylonia, King Cyrus removed them from the temple in Babylonia and they were given to Sheshbazzar, whom he appointed governor.

verses.name: Ezra 5:15
verses.text: He said to him, ‘Take these vessels. Go put them in the temple in Jerusalem and let the house of God be built on its site.’

verses.name: Ezra 5:16
verses.text: Then this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundation of the house of God in Jerusalem. And from that <transChange type="added">time</transChange> until now it is being built, but not yet finished.’

verses.name: Ezra 5:17
verses.text: And now, if it seems good for the king, let it be investigated in the house of the treasury of the king in Babylonia <transChange type="added">to see</transChange> if a decree was issued forth from King Cyrus to build this house of God in Jerusalem. And let the king send to us his desire on this matter.”  <chapter eID="Ezra.5"/>

verses.name: Ezra 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2548"/><title type="x-s">Darius’ Search for the Decree</title> <div sID="gen3376" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2548"/>Then King Darius issued forth a decree, and they searched the house of the treasury of scrolls being stored in Babylonia.

verses.name: Ezra 6:2
verses.text: But it was in Ecbatana in the province of Media, in the citadel, that a certain scroll had written on it, “A record.

verses.name: Ezra 6:3
verses.text: In the first year of King Cyrus, he issued forth a decree concerning the house of God in Jerusalem. Let the house be built, the place where sacrifices are offered and let its foundations be raised. Its height <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits,

verses.name: Ezra 6:4
verses.text: with three layers of great stones and a layer of timber. Let the new expenses be paid from the house of the king.

verses.name: Ezra 6:5
verses.text: Also, let the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylonia, be returned and brought to the temple in Jerusalem to its place. Put them in the house of God.”  <div eID="gen3376" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2549"/><title type="x-s">The Decree of Darius</title> <div sID="gen3377" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2549"/>“Now then, Tattenai governor of <transChange type="added">the province</transChange> Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and your associates, the envoys who are in <transChange type="added">the province</transChange> Beyond the River—keep far away from there.

verses.name: Ezra 6:7
verses.text: Leave this work of the house of God alone. Let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God on its site.

verses.name: Ezra 6:8
verses.text: And I issue forth a decree for what you should do for these elders of the Jews to build this house of God. The full expense will be paid to these men from the riches of the king from the taxes of <transChange type="added">the province</transChange> Beyond the River, without delay.

verses.name: Ezra 6:9
verses.text: Whatever may be needed—<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young bulls⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the sons of young bulls”</note> young rams, sheep for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil for the priests in Jerusalem—let it be given to them day by day with no negligence,

verses.name: Ezra 6:10
verses.text: that they may offer incense offerings to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king and his children.

verses.name: Ezra 6:11
verses.text: Furthermore, I issue forth a decree that if any person violates this decree, let a beam be pulled out from his house and let him be impaled on it. And let his house be made a pile of rubble on <transChange type="added">account of</transChange> this.

verses.name: Ezra 6:12
verses.text: May the God who has set his name there overthrow any king or people who sets his hand to alter <transChange type="added">or</transChange> to destroy this house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, issue forth a decree. Let it be done with diligence.”  <div eID="gen3377" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2550"/><title type="x-s">Temple is Dedicated and Completed</title> <div sID="gen3378" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2550"/>Then Tattenai the governor of the <transChange type="added">province</transChange> Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates consequently did with diligence what Darius the king ordered.

verses.name: Ezra 6:14
verses.text: So the elders of the Jews were building and prospering, through the prophecy of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo. They finished building by the command of the God of Israel and by the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and King Artaxerxes of Persia.

verses.name: Ezra 6:15
verses.text: This house was completed on the third day of the month of Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.  <div eID="gen3378" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2551"/><div sID="gen3379" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2551"/>And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞returned exiles⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of the exile”</note> celebrated the dedication of this house of God with joy.

verses.name: Ezra 6:17
verses.text: And they offered during the dedication of this house of God one hundred young bulls, two hundred young rams, four hundred lambs, and twelve male goats as a sin offering for Israel <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> the number of the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Ezra 6:18
verses.text: Then they set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their sections for the work of God in Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.  <div eID="gen3379" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2552"/><title type="x-s">The Celebration of Passover</title> <div sID="gen3380" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2552"/>On the fourteenth day of the first month the returned exiles observed the Passover feast.

verses.name: Ezra 6:20
verses.text: For the priests and Levites together had consecrated themselves; all of them were clean. And they slaughtered the Passover sacrifice for all of the returned exiles, for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.

verses.name: Ezra 6:21
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> who returned from the exile and all those who separated themselves from the uncleanness of the nations of the earth to seek Yahweh the God of Israel, ate.

verses.name: Ezra 6:22
verses.text: With joy they celebrated the festival of unleavened bread <transChange type="added">for</transChange> seven days, because Yahweh had made them joyful and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them in order to help them with the work of their hands on the house of the God of Israel.  <chapter eID="Ezra.6"/>

verses.name: Ezra 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2553"/><title type="x-s">Ezra’s Arrival and Work</title> <div sID="gen3381" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2553"/>After these things <transChange type="added">during</transChange> the reign of King Artaxerxes of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, son of Azariah, son of Hilkiah,

verses.name: Ezra 7:2
verses.text: son of Shallum, son of Zadok, son of Ahitub,

verses.name: Ezra 7:3
verses.text: son of Amariah, son of Azariah, son of Meraioth,

verses.name: Ezra 7:4
verses.text: , son of Zerahiah, son of Uzzi, son of Bukki,

verses.name: Ezra 7:5
verses.text: son of Abishua, son of Phinehas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the chief priest—

verses.name: Ezra 7:6
verses.text: this Ezra went up from Babylonia. He was a scribe skilled in the law of Moses, which Yahweh the God of Israel gave. The king granted him all his requests, for the hand of Yahweh was upon him.  <div eID="gen3381" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2554"/><div sID="gen3382" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2554"/>Some of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> some priests and Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.

verses.name: Ezra 7:8
verses.text: He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

verses.name: Ezra 7:9
verses.text: For on the first day of the first month he began the journey from Babylonia; and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, for the good hand of his God <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on him.

verses.name: Ezra 7:10
verses.text: For Ezra had set his heart to seek the law of Yahweh, to do <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and to teach the regulations and judgments in Israel.  <div eID="gen3382" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2555"/><title type="x-s">Artaxerxes’ Letter to Ezra</title> <div sID="gen3383" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2555"/>This is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe of the scroll of the words of the commands of Yahweh and his statutes for Israel:

verses.name: Ezra 7:12
verses.text: “Artaxerxes, the king of kings, to Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of the heavens. Peace. And now

verses.name: Ezra 7:13
verses.text: I issue forth a decree that any of the people of Israel, their priests, or their Levites in my kingdom who are willing to go to Jerusalem may go with you.

verses.name: Ezra 7:14
verses.text: For you are sent from the king and his seven counselors to enquire about Judah and Jerusalem concerning the law of your God, which is in your hand.

verses.name: Ezra 7:15
verses.text: Also, bring the silver and gold that the king and his advisors have freely offered to the God of Israel whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,

verses.name: Ezra 7:16
verses.text: and all of the silver and gold that you will find in the whole province of Babylonia, with the freewill offerings of the people and the priests giving willingly for the house of their God in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezra 7:17
verses.text: With this money, then, with diligence you must buy young bulls, young rams, lambs, and their offerings and libations. You must offer them on the altar that is in the house of your God in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezra 7:18
verses.text: You may do whatever seems best to you and your brothers to do with the remainder of the silver and gold according to the desire of your God.

verses.name: Ezra 7:19
verses.text: And the vessels that were given to you for the service of the house of your God you shall deliver before the God of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezra 7:20
verses.text: And the remainder of the needs for the house of your God that falls to you to provide, you may provide from the house of the king’s treasury.”  <div eID="gen3383" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2556"/><div sID="gen3384" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2556"/>“I, even I, King Artaxerxes, issue forth a decree to all the treasurers who are in <transChange type="added">the province</transChange> Beyond the River. Whatever the priest Ezra, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, may ask of you, let it be done with diligence,

verses.name: Ezra 7:22
verses.text: up to one hundred talents of silver, one hundred measures of wheat, one hundred baths of wine, one hundred baths of oil, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞unlimited salt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally, “salt that is not specified”</note>

verses.name: Ezra 7:23
verses.text: All that is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done with diligence for the house of the God of heaven, otherwise wrath will come on the kingdom of the king and his sons.

verses.name: Ezra 7:24
verses.text: You also should be aware that it is not permitted to place tax, tribute, or duty upon all of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the doorkeepers, the temple servants, and other servants of the house of God.  <div eID="gen3384" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2557"/><div sID="gen3385" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2557"/>“You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that you possess, appoint magistrates and judges who can judge all of the people <transChange type="added">in the province</transChange> Beyond the River who know the laws of your God. And you will teach those who do not know.

verses.name: Ezra 7:26
verses.text: All who do not obey the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with diligence, whether for death or for banishment or for confiscation of goods and for imprisonment.”  <div eID="gen3385" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 7:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2558"/><div sID="gen3386" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2558"/>Blessed be Yahweh the God of our ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> who put this in the heart of the king to glorify the house of Yahweh in Jerusalem

verses.name: Ezra 7:28
verses.text: and who extended to me loyal love before the king and his counselors, and before all of the mighty officials of the king. I took courage, for the hand of Yahweh my God was upon me, and I gathered leaders from Israel to go up with me.  <chapter eID="Ezra.7"/>

verses.name: Ezra 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2559"/><title type="x-s">Family Heads Who Returned With Ezra</title> <div sID="gen3387" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2559"/>These were the heads of their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> and the register of those returnees from Babylonia who <transChange type="added">came up</transChange> with me in the reign of King Artaxerxes:

verses.name: Ezra 8:2
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Phinehas: Gershom. From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Ithamar: Daniel. From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of David: Hattush.

verses.name: Ezra 8:3
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Shecaniah, from the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Parosh: Zechariah and with him one hundred and fifty registered males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:4
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Pahath-Moab: Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah and with him two hundred males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:5
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zattu:<note placement="foot">Commentators and translators agree that there is a name missing from the Masoretic text. Zattu has been restored from the LXX</note> Shecaniah son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:6
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Adin: Ebed son of Jehonathan, and with him fifty males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:7
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Elam: Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:8
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Shephatiah: Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him eighty males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:9
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Joab: Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:10
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Bani:<note placement="foot">Commentators and translators agree that there is a name missing from the Masoretic text. Bani has been restored from the LXX</note> Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and with him one hundred and sixty males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:11
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Bebai: Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him twenty-eight males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:12
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Azgad: Jehohanan son of Haqqatan, and with him one hundred and ten males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:13
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Adonikam, those who came last, these were their names: Eliphelet, Jeiel, Shemaiah, and with them sixty males.

verses.name: Ezra 8:14
verses.text: From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Bigvai: Uthai son of Zabud,<note placement="foot">Or “and Zabud”</note> and with him seventy males.  <div eID="gen3387" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2560"/><title type="x-s">Servants for the Temple are Gathered</title> <div sID="gen3388" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2560"/>I gathered them by the river that goes to Ahava and we camped there for three days. And I looked at the people and the priests, I found no one there from the sons of Levi.

verses.name: Ezra 8:16
verses.text: And I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, who were family heads, and for Jehoiarib and Elnathan who were wise.

verses.name: Ezra 8:17
verses.text: I sent them to Iddo, the head of the place called Casiphia, and I placed in their mouths what words to say to Iddo and his brothers the temple servants in Casiphia, to send to us ministers for the house of our God.

verses.name: Ezra 8:18
verses.text: With the good hand of our God before us, they brought us a man of understanding from the sons of Mahli, son of Levi, son of Israel—Sherebiah and his sons and brothers, eighteen <transChange type="added">in total</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:19
verses.text: Also Hashabiah and with him Jeshaiah, the sons of Merari, with his brothers and their sons, twenty <transChange type="added">in total</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:20
verses.text: And from the temple servants, whom David and <transChange type="added">his</transChange> officials had set up to serve the Levites, two hundred and twenty <transChange type="added">in total</transChange>. All of them were registered by name.  <div eID="gen3388" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2561"/><title type="x-s">Ezra Proclaims a Fast</title> <div sID="gen3389" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2561"/>I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava to humble ourselves before our God in order to seek from him a safe journey for us, our children, and our possessions.

verses.name: Ezra 8:22
verses.text: For I was ashamed to ask the king for troops and horses to protect us from enemies on the way because we said to the king, “the hand of our God is favorable to all who seek him, but his strength and anger are against all who forsake them.”

verses.name: Ezra 8:23
verses.text: So we fasted and sought our God for this and he responded to our prayer.  <div eID="gen3389" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 8:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2562"/><title type="x-s">The Priests’ Gift for the Temple</title> <div sID="gen3390" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2562"/>I set apart twelve of the official priests: Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them.

verses.name: Ezra 8:25
verses.text: Then I weighed out to them silver and gold and the vessels, the offering of the house of our God that the king, his counselors, his commanders, and all of Israel who was present offered.

verses.name: Ezra 8:26
verses.text: I weighed out into their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, one hundred vessels of silver, one hundred talents of gold,

verses.name: Ezra 8:27
verses.text: twenty gold bowls worth one thousand darics, and two vessels of good polished bronze as precious as gold.

verses.name: Ezra 8:28
verses.text: And I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh and the vessels are holy. The silver and gold are a freewill offering to Yahweh, God of your ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Ezra 8:29
verses.text: Guard and look after <transChange type="added">them</transChange> until you weigh <transChange type="added">them</transChange> before the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> of Israel in Jerusalem, in the chamber of the house of Yahweh.”

verses.name: Ezra 8:30
verses.text: So the priests and Levites took over the weighed silver, gold, and the vessels to bring to Jerusalem for the house of our God.  <div eID="gen3390" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 8:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2563"/><title type="x-s">Return to Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen3391" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2563"/>On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the river of Ahava to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and from ambushing on the way.

verses.name: Ezra 8:32
verses.text: We came to Jerusalem and remained there three days.

verses.name: Ezra 8:33
verses.text: On the fourth day, the silver, gold, and vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of priest Meremoth, the son of Uriah, and with him Eleazar son of Phinehas. With them were the Levites, Jehozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.

verses.name: Ezra 8:34
verses.text: The amount and weight of all the weighed <transChange type="added">items</transChange> was recorded at that time.  <div eID="gen3391" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 8:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2564"/><div sID="gen3392" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2564"/>The exiles that returned from captivity offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel; twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve goats as a sin offering. All was a burnt offering to Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezra 8:36
verses.text: They delivered the customs of the king to the king’s satraps and to the governor of <transChange type="added">the province</transChange> Beyond the River. And they supported the people of the house of God.  <chapter eID="Ezra.8"/>

verses.name: Ezra 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2565"/><title type="x-s">Disdain Over Mixed Marriages</title> <div sID="gen3393" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2565"/>After finishing these things the officials approached me saying, “The people of Israel, the priests, and the Levites have not separated from the people of the lands with their detestable things, and from the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.

verses.name: Ezra 9:2
verses.text: For they have taken from their daughters for themselves and their sons. So the holy seed has mixed itself with the peoples of the lands, and the hand of the officials and prefects were foremost in this sin.

verses.name: Ezra 9:3
verses.text: When I heard this I tore my garment and my robe, and I pulled the hair out from my head and beard, and I sat appalled.

verses.name: Ezra 9:4
verses.text: Then all who trembled at the words of the God of Israel because of the sin of the returned exiles were gathered around me and I sat appalled until the evening offering.  <div eID="gen3393" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2566"/><title type="x-s">Ezra Prays</title> <div sID="gen3394" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2566"/>At the evening offering I got up from my mourning posture and, with my garment and robe torn, I fell down on my knees and I spread out my palms to Yahweh my God

verses.name: Ezra 9:6
verses.text: and said, “My God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to lift my face to you, my God. For our sins have risen above our heads and our guilt has grown up to the heavens.

verses.name: Ezra 9:7
verses.text: From the days of our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> until this day we have been in great guilt, and because of our sins we ourselves, our kings, and our priests have been handed into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to utter shame, as it is this day.

verses.name: Ezra 9:8
verses.text: But now for a brief moment mercy has been shown by Yahweh our God, who left behind for us a remnant, and given us security in his holy place—for our God to brighten our eyes and to give us brief relief in our bondage.

verses.name: Ezra 9:9
verses.text: For we are slaves and in our bondage our God did not forsake us, and he has extended to us loyal love in the presence of the kings of Persia, to give to us deliverance<note placement="foot">Or “preservation”</note> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> to set up the house of our God, to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judea and Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen3394" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2567"/><div sID="gen3395" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2567"/>“And now our God what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,

verses.name: Ezra 9:11
verses.text: which you commanded by the hand of your servants the prophets saying, ‘The land that you are entering to possess is a land of impurity with the impurity of the peoples of the lands, with their detestable things which they have filled from end to end with their uncleanness.

verses.name: Ezra 9:12
verses.text: Therefore, do not give your daughters to their sons, and do not take their daughters for your sons. Do not seek their peace and prosperity so that forever you may be strong and eat the good of the land and may give it as an inheritance to your sons.’

verses.name: Ezra 9:13
verses.text: After all that has come upon us for our evil practices and for our great guilt—you, our God, have held back less than our guilt <transChange type="added">deserved</transChange> and you have given us a remainder such as this.

verses.name: Ezra 9:14
verses.text: Shall we again break your commandments and intermarry with the peoples who practice these detestable things? Would you not be angry with us until you destroy us with no remnant or remainder?

verses.name: Ezra 9:15
verses.text: Yahweh, God of Israel, you are righteous, for we have been left this day as a remnant. Here we are before you in our guilt, for none can stand before you because of this.”  <chapter eID="Ezra.9"/>

verses.name: Ezra 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2568"/><title type="x-s">The People Respond</title> <div sID="gen3396" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2568"/>While Ezra was praying and confessing, weeping and throwing himself down before the house of God, a very great assembly of men, women, and children from Israel gathered to him. And the people wept bitterly.

verses.name: Ezra 10:2
verses.text: Shecaniah son of Jehiel, of the sons of Elam, answered and said to Ezra, “We ourselves have broken faith with our God and have married foreign women from the peoples of the land, and even now there is hope for Israel in spite of this.

verses.name: Ezra 10:3
verses.text: So now let us make a covenant with our God to send away all of these women and their offspring, according to the advice of my lord and those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.

verses.name: Ezra 10:4
verses.text: Arise, for it is your task and we are with you. Be strong and do it.”

verses.name: Ezra 10:5
verses.text: Then Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, Levites, and all of Israel swear to do according to what was said. So they swore this oath.  <div eID="gen3396" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2569"/><title type="x-s">Foreign Wives and Children are Sent Away</title> <div sID="gen3397" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2569"/>Ezra rose from before the house of God and went to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He did not eat food nor drink water because he was mourning over the sin of the exiles.

verses.name: Ezra 10:7
verses.text: And they sent a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem to all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞returned exiles⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the sons of the exile”</note> to assemble in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezra 10:8
verses.text: Anyone who did not come within three days, by decision of the officials and elders, all of his possessions would be devoted to God, and he himself would be excluded from the assembly of exiles.  <div eID="gen3397" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2570"/><div sID="gen3398" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2570"/>Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled in Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month on the twentieth day of the month. All the people sat in the public square of the house of God trembling because of this matter and from the rains.

verses.name: Ezra 10:10
verses.text: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have broke faith and married foreign women, increasing the guilt of Israel.

verses.name: Ezra 10:11
verses.text: Now make a confession to Yahweh the God of your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and do his will. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”  <div eID="gen3398" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2571"/><div sID="gen3399" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2571"/>Then all the assembly answered with a great voice and said, “It is so. We must do according to your words.

verses.name: Ezra 10:13
verses.text: But the people are many, and it is the time of rain; we are unable to stand outside. The task is not for one day or two, for we greatly rebelled in this matter.

verses.name: Ezra 10:14
verses.text: Please let our leaders stand for the whole assembly, and let all that are in our cities who have married foreign women come at set times, and with them the elders of and judges of each city, until the fierce wrath of our God because of this matter is averted from us.”

verses.name: Ezra 10:15
verses.text: Only Jehonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah stood against this, and the Levites Meshullam and Shabbethai supported them.  <div eID="gen3399" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2572"/><div sID="gen3400" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2572"/>The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞returned exiles⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the sons of the exile”</note> did so. Ezra the priest selected men, the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> according to the house of their fathers, all of them by name. They sat down to examine the matter on the first day of the tenth month.

verses.name: Ezra 10:17
verses.text: They finished <transChange type="added">investigating</transChange> all the men who married foreign women by the first day of the first month.  <div eID="gen3400" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2573"/><div sID="gen3401" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2573"/>There was found from the sons of the priests those who had married foreign women, from the sons of Jeshua son of Jehozadak and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

verses.name: Ezra 10:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They pledged themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they gave their hand”</note> to put away their wives, and their guilt offering was a ram of the flock for their guilt.

verses.name: Ezra 10:20
verses.text: From the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

verses.name: Ezra 10:21
verses.text: From the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

verses.name: Ezra 10:22
verses.text: From the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Eleasah.  <div eID="gen3401" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2574"/><div sID="gen3402" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2574"/>From the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

verses.name: Ezra 10:24
verses.text: From the singers: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.  <div eID="gen3402" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezra 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2575"/><div sID="gen3403" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2575"/>And from Israel, the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkijah, and Benaiah.

verses.name: Ezra 10:26
verses.text: From the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

verses.name: Ezra 10:27
verses.text: From the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

verses.name: Ezra 10:28
verses.text: From the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

verses.name: Ezra 10:29
verses.text: From the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

verses.name: Ezra 10:30
verses.text: From the sons of Pahath-Moab: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

verses.name: Ezra 10:31
verses.text: From the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshiah, Malkijah, Shemaiah, Simeon,

verses.name: Ezra 10:32
verses.text: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

verses.name: Ezra 10:33
verses.text: From the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

verses.name: Ezra 10:34
verses.text: From the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

verses.name: Ezra 10:35
verses.text: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Keluhi,

verses.name: Ezra 10:36
verses.text: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

verses.name: Ezra 10:37
verses.text: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,

verses.name: Ezra 10:38
verses.text: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

verses.name: Ezra 10:39
verses.text: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

verses.name: Ezra 10:40
verses.text: Macnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

verses.name: Ezra 10:41
verses.text: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

verses.name: Ezra 10:42
verses.text: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

verses.name: Ezra 10:43
verses.text: From the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.

verses.name: Ezra 10:44
verses.text: All of these had married foreign wives, and some from among the wives bore children.  <chapter eID="Ezra.10"/> <div eID="gen3403" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen3346" osisID="Ezra" type="book"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2576"/><title type="x-s">Nehemiah’s Prayer for the People</title> <div sID="gen3405" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2576"/>The words of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah. <div eID="gen3405" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen3406" type="x-p"/> It happened in the month of Kislev, in the twentieth year, that I myself was in the citadel in Susa,

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:2
verses.text: and one of my brothers, Hanani, came with some men from Judah. I asked them about the Jews who had escaped the captivity and about Jerusalem.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:3
verses.text: They replied to me, “The survivors in the province who have survived the captivity are in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been burned in the fire.”  <div eID="gen3406" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2577"/><div sID="gen3407" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2577"/>When I heard these words, I sat and wept and mourned for days, and I was fasting and praying before the God of the heavens.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:5
verses.text: I said, “O Yahweh God of the heavens, the great and awesome one who keeps the covenant and loyal love for the ones who love him and for those who keep his commands.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:6
verses.text: Please, let your ear be attentive and your eyes open to hear the prayer of your servant that I am praying before you by day and by night for your servants, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and confessing the sins of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> that we have sinned against you. I and my father’s house have sinned.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:7
verses.text: We have certainly offended you and have not kept the commands, regulations, and judgments that you have commanded your servant Moses.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:8
verses.text: Please, remember the word that you have commanded to your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you act unfaithfully I will scatter you all among the nations.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:9
verses.text: But if you return to me and keep my commandments and do them, even though all of your outcasts are at the furthest parts of heaven, I will gather them and bring them to the place which I have chosen to make my name dwell.’

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:10
verses.text: They are your servants and your people whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:11
verses.text: O Lord, please let your ear be attentive to the prayer of your servant and to the prayer of your servants who delight to revere in your name. Please, let your servant be successful this day and give him compassion before this man.” <div eID="gen3407" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen3408" type="x-p"/> I was cupbearer for the king.  <chapter eID="Neh.1"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2578"/><title type="x-s">Nehemiah Sent</title> <div sID="gen3409" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2578"/>It happened in the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when wine was before him, I carried the wine and gave it to the king. And I had never been sad before the king.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:2
verses.text: So the king said to me, “Why is your face sad since you are not sick? This is nothing but sadness of the heart.” And I was very much afraid.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:3
verses.text: I said to the king, “May the king live forever! Why should my face not be sad when the city of my ancestors’<note placement="foot">Or “fathers’ ”</note> burial site<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sites”</note> is ruined and her gates are consumed by fire?”

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:4
verses.text: Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of the heavens.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:5
verses.text: Then I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has <transChange type="added">found</transChange> favor in your presence, <transChange type="added">I ask</transChange> that you send me to Judah, to the city of my ancestors’<note placement="foot">Or “fathers’ ”</note> burial sites, so that I may rebuild it.”  <div eID="gen3409" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2579"/><div sID="gen3410" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2579"/>With the queen sitting beside him, the king said to me, “How long will your journey be and when will you return?” So it pleased the king and he sent me, and I set for him an appointed time.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:7
verses.text: Then I said to the king, “If it is good for the king, let letters be given to me for the governors <transChange type="added">in the province</transChange> Beyond the River, that they may let me pass until I come to Judah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:8
verses.text: Also, a letter to Asaph, keeper of the king’s land reserve, that he should give me timber for laying the beams for the gates of the citadel of the house and for the walls of the city, and for the house which I will enter.” And the king gave <transChange type="added">permission</transChange> to me, according to the good hand of God on me.  <div eID="gen3410" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2580"/><div sID="gen3411" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2580"/>I came to the governors of <transChange type="added">the province</transChange> Beyond the River, and I gave them the letters of the king. Then the king sent troop commanders and horses with me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:10
verses.text: But when Sanballat the Horonite and the Ammonite servant Tobiah heard <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they were greatly displeased⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it was a great disaster for them”</note> that a person had come to seek the welfare of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>  <div eID="gen3411" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2581"/><title type="x-s">Nehemiah Inspects the Walls and Decides to Restore Them</title> <div sID="gen3412" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2581"/>I came to Jerusalem and was there for three days.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:12
verses.text: I got up during the night, I and a few men with me. I did not tell anybody what my God put in my heart to do for Jerusalem. No animal <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with me except the animal that I was riding on.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:13
verses.text: I went out during the night at the gate of the valley by the Dragon spring and to the Dung Gate. And I examined the walls in Jerusalem and its gates that had been destroyed by the fire.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:14
verses.text: I crossed over to the Fountain Gate and to the King’s Pool, but there was no place for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my mount⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the animal under me”</note> to cross over.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:15
verses.text: So I went up by the valley during the night and was examining the wall. Then I returned and came to the Valley Gate and returned.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:16
verses.text: The prefects did not know where I had gone and what I was doing. I had not yet told the Jews, the priests, the nobles, the prefects, and the rest of the workers.  <div eID="gen3412" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2582"/><div sID="gen3413" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2582"/>Then I said to them, “You see the misery that we are in, that Jerusalem is ruined and its gates burned by the fire. Come, build the walls of Jerusalem and we shall no longer be a disgrace.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:18
verses.text: I told them of the good hand of my God that was upon me and surely the words of the king that were spoken to me. And they said, “Let us arise and build!” And they strengthened their hands for <transChange type="added">this</transChange> good work.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:19
verses.text: But Sanballat the Horonite, the Ammonite servant Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard it, and they mocked and despised us, saying, “What is this thing that you are doing? Are you rebelling against the king?”

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:20
verses.text: Then I answered and said to them, “The God of the heavens himself will let us succeed, and we his servants shall arise and build. But for you there is no share, right, or memorial in Jerusalem.”  <chapter eID="Neh.2"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2583"/><title type="x-s">Organization of the Work</title> <div sID="gen3414" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2583"/>Then Eliashib the high priest and his brothers the priests arose and rebuilt the Sheep Gate. They consecrated it and erected its doors. They consecrated it up to the Tower of the Hundred and up to the Tower of Hananel.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:2
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞next to him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at his hand”</note> the men of Jericho built, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞next to him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at his hand”</note> Zaccur son of Imri built.  <div eID="gen3414" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2584"/><div sID="gen3415" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2584"/>The sons of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate. They laid its beams and erected its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:4
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At their hand”</note> Meremoth son of Uriah, son of Hakkoz, repaired. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At their hand”</note> Meshullam son of Berekiah, son of Meshezabel, repaired. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At their hand”</note> Zadok son of Baana repaired.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:5
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At their hand”</note> the Tekoites repaired, but their nobles did not put their neck to the work of their lord.  <div eID="gen3415" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2585"/><div sID="gen3416" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2585"/>Jehoiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam repaired the old Yeshanah Gate. They laid its beams and erected its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:7
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At their hand”</note> Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and Mizpah who were under the rule of the governor of <transChange type="added">the province</transChange> Beyond the River, repaired.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At his hand”</note> Uzziel son of Harhaiah (goldsmiths) repaired. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At his hand”</note> Hananiah son of the perfume-makers repaired. They restored Jerusalem up to the Broad Wall.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At their hand”</note> Rephaiah son of Hur, commander of half the district of Jerusalem, repaired.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:10
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At their hand”</note> Jedaiah son of Harumaph repaired opposite his house. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At his hand”</note> Hattush son of Hashabneiah repaired.  <div eID="gen3416" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2586"/><div sID="gen3417" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2586"/>Malkijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-Moab repaired another section and the Tower of the Ovens.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:12
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Next to him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At his hand”</note> Shallum son of Hallohesh, commander of half of the district of Jerusalem, repaired with his daughters.  <div eID="gen3417" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2587"/><div sID="gen3418" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2587"/>Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the Valley Gate. They rebuilt it and erected its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and a thousand cubits of the wall up to the Dung Gate.  <div eID="gen3418" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2588"/><div sID="gen3419" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2588"/>Malkijah son of Recab, commander of the district of Beth-haccherem, repaired the Dung Gate. He rebuilt it and erected its doors, its bolts, and its bars.  <div eID="gen3419" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2589"/><div sID="gen3420" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2589"/>Shallun son of Col-Hozeh, the commander of the district of Mizpah, repaired the Fountain Gate. He rebuilt it and covered it and erected its doors, its bolts, its bars, and <transChange type="added">he built</transChange> the wall of the Pool of Shelah of the king’s garden, right up to the steps going down from the city of David.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:16
verses.text: After him Nehemiah son of Azbuk, commander of half of the district of Beth Zur, repaired up to <transChange type="added">a point</transChange> opposite the burial sites of David, and up to the artificial pool and to the house of the mighty warriors.  <div eID="gen3420" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2590"/><div sID="gen3421" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2590"/>After him the Levites repaired; Rehum son of Bani, and next to him Hashabiah, commander of half of the district of Keilah, repaired his district.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:18
verses.text: After him their brothers repaired: Bavvai son of Henadad, commander of half of the district of Keilah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞next to him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at his hand”</note> Ezer son of Jeshua, commander of Mizpah, repaired a second section of a wall opposite of the ascent of the armory at the angle.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:20
verses.text: After him Baruch son of Zabbai zealously repaired a second section of a wall from the angle up to the doorway of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:21
verses.text: After him Meremoth son of Uriah, son of Hakkoz, repaired a second section of a wall from the doorway of the house of Eliashib up to the end of the house of Eliashib.  <div eID="gen3421" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2591"/><div sID="gen3422" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2591"/>After him the priests, men from the vicinity, repaired.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:23
verses.text: After them Benjamin and Hasshub repaired opposite their house. After them Azariah son of Maaseiah, son of Ananiah, repaired beside his house.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:24
verses.text: After him Binnui son of Henadad repaired a second section of a wall from the house of Azariah up to the angle up to the corner.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:25
verses.text: Palal son of Uzai <transChange type="added">repaired</transChange> opposite the Angle at the tower that juts out from the upper house of the king, at the courtyard of the guard. After him Pedaiah son of Parosh

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:26
verses.text: and the temple servants who were living on Ophel <transChange type="added">repaired</transChange> up to opposite the Water Gate on the east and the projecting tower.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:27
verses.text: After him the Tekoites repaired a second section of a wall opposite the projecting tower that goes out as far as the wall of Ophel.  <div eID="gen3422" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2592"/><div sID="gen3423" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2592"/>Above the Horse Gate the priests repaired, each one opposite his house.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:29
verses.text: After them Zadok son of Immer repaired opposite his house. After him Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, keeper of the East Gate, repaired.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:30
verses.text: After him Hananiah son of Shelemiah and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph repaired another section. After him Meshullam son of Berekiah repaired <transChange type="added">the wall</transChange> opposite his room.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:31
verses.text: After him Malkijah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one of the goldsmiths⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the son of the goldsmith”</note> repaired up to the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Enrollment Gate and up to the upper room of the corner.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:32
verses.text: Between the upper room of the corner to the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and merchants repaired.  <chapter eID="Neh.3"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2593"/><title type="x-s">Opposition Begins</title> <div sID="gen3424" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2593"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Neh.4.1-Neh.4.23">Nehemiah 4:1–23 </reference>in the English Bible is 3:33–4:17 in the Hebrew Bible</note> Now it happened when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, <transChange type="added">he</transChange> became angry and greatly provoked, and he mocked the Jews.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:2
verses.text: Then he said before his brothers and the army of Samaria, “What are the feeble Jews doing? Will they restore <transChange type="added">these things</transChange> for themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish it in a day? Will they revive the stones from the piles of rubble—even those burned up?”  <div eID="gen3424" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2594"/><div sID="gen3425" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2594"/>Tobiah the Ammonite was beside him and said, “Their wall of stone that they are building would break down if a fox went on it!”  <div eID="gen3425" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2595"/><div sID="gen3426" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2595"/>Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn their scorn on their head and give them over to plunder in the land of captivity.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:5
verses.text: Do not cover their guilt, and do not let their sin be blotted out from before you. They have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞provoked the builders to anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “provoked anger before the builders”</note>  <div eID="gen3426" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2596"/><div sID="gen3427" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2596"/>So we rebuilt the wall, and all of the wall was joined up to half <transChange type="added">its height</transChange>. For the people had a heart to do <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.  <div eID="gen3427" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2597"/><title type="x-s">Opposition Stopped</title> <div sID="gen3428" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2597"/>Now when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the restoration of the walls of Jerusalem were going forward and the gaps were being closed, they were very angry.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:8
verses.text: So all of them plotted together to come fight against Jerusalem and to make trouble for it.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:9
verses.text: So we prayed to our God and set up a guard against them day and night.  <div eID="gen3428" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2598"/><div sID="gen3429" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2598"/>But Judah said, “The strength of the carriers is failing, and there is too much dirt, and we are not able to build at the wall.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:11
verses.text: Then our enemies said, “They will not know nor see until we come upon them and will kill them and stop the work.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:12
verses.text: When the Jews who lived beside them came, they said to us ten times, “From all of the places where they live, <transChange type="added">they will come up</transChange> against us.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:13
verses.text: I stationed the people behind the deepest part of the wall in the open places according to their families, with their swords, spears, and bows.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:14
verses.text: And I looked, got up, and said to the nobles, prefects, and the rest of the people, “Do not be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”  <div eID="gen3429" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2599"/><div sID="gen3430" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2599"/>It happened when our enemies heard that their plan was known to us, that God had frustrated <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and we all returned to the wall—each to his work.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:16
verses.text: From that day, half of my servants were working on craftsmanship, half were holding spears, small shields, bows, and breastplates. The commanders were behind the whole house of Judah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:17
verses.text: The ones who were building the wall and the ones <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who carried the materials⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who carried the burden”</note> were carrying in one hand while doing the task, and with the other hand were grasping a weapon.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:18
verses.text: Each of the builders had his sword tied to his side while building. And the man who sounded the trumpet was beside me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:19
verses.text: I said to the nobles, to the prefects, and to the rest of the people, “The work is great and widespread, and we are spread out over the wall far from each other.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:20
verses.text: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, come together to us there. Our God will fight for us.”  <div eID="gen3430" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2600"/><div sID="gen3431" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2600"/>So we labored at the work, and half of them were holding the spears from dawn until the stars came out.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:22
verses.text: At the time I also said to the people, “Let each man and his servant spend the night inside Jerusalem, so that they will be a guard for us in the night and work in the day.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:23
verses.text: So neither I nor my brothers nor my young men nor the men of the guard who were behind me took off our clothes. Each one <transChange type="added">kept</transChange> his weapon <transChange type="added">even</transChange> in the water.  <chapter eID="Neh.4"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2601"/><title type="x-s">Nehemiah Deals with Strife</title> <div sID="gen3432" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2601"/>Now there was a great cry of distress of the people and of their wives <transChange type="added">against</transChange> their Jewish brothers.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:2
verses.text: There were those who were saying, “Our sons and daughters, we are many. We must get grain so that we may eat and live.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:3
verses.text: There were also those saying, “We have pledged our fields and our vineyards and our houses so that we can get grain in the famine.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:4
verses.text: And there were those who were saying, “We have borrowed money on our fields and our vineyards for the tax of the king.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:5
verses.text: Now our flesh is like the flesh of our brothers, our sons are like their sons. Look, we are subduing our sons and our daughters to be slaves, and there are some from our daughters being molested. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞We are powerless⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “There is no power in our hand”</note> and our fields and vineyards <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> to others.”  <div eID="gen3432" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2602"/><div sID="gen3433" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2602"/>I was very angry when I heard their shouts and these words.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:7
verses.text: I thought over this in my heart, and then I quarreled with the nobles and the prefects. I said to them, “You yourselves are taking interest from your own brother!” So I called the great assembly against them,

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:8
verses.text: and I said to them: “We ourselves have bought back our brothers the Jews who were sold to the nations as we were able. But now you yourselves have sold your brothers so they may be sold to us!” They were silent and could not find a word <transChange type="added">to say</transChange>.  <div eID="gen3433" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2603"/><div sID="gen3434" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2603"/>So I said, “The thing that you are doing is not good. Should you not walk in the fear of our God <transChange type="added">to prevent</transChange> the disgrace from the nations, our enemies?

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:10
verses.text: Also, I and my brothers and my servants are lending them money and grain. Please stop <transChange type="added">taking</transChange> this interest.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:11
verses.text: Please restore to them this day their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, their houses, and the interest on the money, the grain, the grape juice, and the olive oil that you have been taking from them.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:12
verses.text: So they said, “We will restore it and will not request <transChange type="added">anything more</transChange>. So we will do as you say.” Then I called the priests and made them take an oath to do this promise.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:13
verses.text: I also shook out my garment and said, “This is how God will shake out everyone from his house who will not keep this promise. So this is how his possessions will be shaken out and emptied.” And all the assembly said, “Amen!” And they praised Yahweh, and the people kept this promise.  <div eID="gen3434" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2604"/><title type="x-s">Nehemiah Denies His Allotment</title> <div sID="gen3435" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2604"/>Moreover, from the appointed day I was made their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year until the thirty-second year of King Artaxerxes—twelve years. My brothers and I did not eat the food <transChange type="added">allowance</transChange> of the governor.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:15
verses.text: The former governors who were before me laid burdens on the people, and they took food and wine from them, besides forty shekels. Also, their servants controlled the people, but I did not do so because of the fear of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:16
verses.text: I also devoted myself to the work of this wall, and we did not buy land. All of my servants were gathered for the work.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:17
verses.text: One hundred and fifty men, prefects and Jews, and those who came to us from the nations around us, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> at my table.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:18
verses.text: Now what was prepared each day for me was one ox, six choice sheep, and birds. And every ten days all <transChange type="added">kinds of</transChange> wine were made. But for this I did not demand the food <transChange type="added">allowance</transChange> of the governor because the slavery was too heavy on this people.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:19
verses.text: Remember me for good, my God, all that I have done for this people.  <chapter eID="Neh.5"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2605"/><title type="x-s">Enemies Foiled</title> <div sID="gen3436" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2605"/>Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall and that no gap was left in it—though up to that time I had not erected doors in the gates—

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:2
verses.text: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come and let us meet together in <transChange type="added">one of</transChange> the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they planned to do evil to me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:3
verses.text: So I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work and I am not able to come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it and come down to you all?”

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:4
verses.text: And they sent a message to me four times like this, and I returned an answer like this to them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:5
verses.text: And Sanballat sent his servant with an open letter, <transChange type="added">another</transChange> word like this to me a fifth time, in his hand.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:6
verses.text: In it was written, “It has been reported among the nations, and Gashmu also is saying it, that you and the Jews are considering rebellion. Therefore, truly you are building the wall and you are becoming their king, according to these words.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:7
verses.text: You have also set up prophets to proclaim in Jerusalem concerning you, saying, ‘<transChange type="added">There is</transChange> a king in Judah.’ And now it will be proclaimed to the king according to these words. Now, come and we will plan together.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:8
verses.text: So I sent to him saying, “None of these words you have spoken has happened. You are indeed saying <transChange type="added">things</transChange> created in your own mind”—

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:9
verses.text: for all of them <transChange type="added">sought</transChange> to frighten us, saying, “their hands will not do the work.” And now, <transChange type="added">God</transChange>, strengthen my hands.  <div eID="gen3436" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2606"/><div sID="gen3437" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2606"/>Now I went into the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, son of Mehetabel, who was confined <transChange type="added">at home</transChange>, and he said, “Let us meet in the house of God, inside the temple, and let us close the doors of the temple; for they are coming to kill you—during the night they are coming to kill you.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:11
verses.text: But I said, “Should a man like me run away? And would a man like me go into the temple so that he can save his life? I will not go in!”

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:12
verses.text: Then I look and realized God had not sent him; rather, he had spoken the prophecy against me <transChange type="added">because</transChange> Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:13
verses.text: For this reason he was hired: to frighten <transChange type="added">me</transChange> so that I would act and sin, so that they would have a bad report so they could taunt me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:14
verses.text: Remember, O my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to their works, and also Noadiah the prophetess, and the remainder of the prophets who were frightening me.  <div eID="gen3437" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2607"/><title type="x-s">The Wall is Completed</title> <div sID="gen3438" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2607"/>So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:16
verses.text: When our enemies heard of this, all of the nations surrounding us were afraid and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lost their confidence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “fell much in their eyes”</note> They knew that this work had been done with <transChange type="added">the help of</transChange> our God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:17
verses.text: Also, in those days the nobles of Judah increasingly sent their letters to Tobiah, and <transChange type="added">letters</transChange> from Tobiah returned to them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:18
verses.text: For many in Judah were bound by oath to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah son of Arah. His son Jehohanan took as a wife the daughter of Meshullam son of Berekiah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:19
verses.text: They also were speaking of his good deeds in my presence, and they were sending my words out to him. Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.  <chapter eID="Neh.6"/> <div eID="gen3438" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:1
verses.text: Now when the wall had been built and I had erected the doors and appointed the gatekeepers, singers, and the Levites,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:2
verses.text: I gave command over Jerusalem to my brother Hanani and Hananiah the commander of the citadel. For he was a faithful man and feared God more than many.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:3
verses.text: I said to them, “Do not open the gates of Jerusalem until the sun is hot. While they are standing guard let them shut and fasten the doors. And appoint guards from the inhabitants of Jerusalem, one at his post and another opposite his house.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:4
verses.text: The city <transChange type="added">was</transChange> widespread and large, but the people in it were few and no houses were rebuilt.  <div eID="gen3439" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2608"/><title type="x-s">Lists of the Exiles Who Returned</title> <div sID="gen3440" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2608"/>Then my God put into my heart to assemble the nobles, the prefects, and the people to be enrolled. I found the book of the genealogy of those who first came back, and I found <transChange type="added">this</transChange> written upon it:  <div eID="gen3440" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2609"/><div sID="gen3441" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2609"/>These are the people of the province who came up from captivity of the exiles whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried into exile. They returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, each one to his city.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:7
verses.text: These came with Zerubbabel, Joshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. <div eID="gen3441" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen3442" type="x-p"/> The number of the men of the people of Israel:

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:8
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Parosh, two thousand one hundred and seventy-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:9
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:10
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Arah, six hundred and fifty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:11
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Pahath-Moab, of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and eighteen.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:12
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Elam, one thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:13
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zattu, eight hundred and forty-five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:14
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:15
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Binnui, six hundred and forty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:16
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Bebai, six hundred and twenty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:17
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Azgad, two thousand three hundred and twenty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:18
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty-seven.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:19
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Bigvai, two thousand and sixty-seven.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:20
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Adin, six hundred and fifty-five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:21
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Ater, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange> of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:22
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hashum, three hundred and twenty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:23
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Bezai, three hundred and twenty-four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:24
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hariph, one hundred and twelve.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:25
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gibeon, ninety-five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:26
verses.text: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, one hundred and eighty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:27
verses.text: The men of Anathoth, one hundred and twenty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:28
verses.text: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:29
verses.text: The men of Kiriath-Jearim, Kephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty-three.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:30
verses.text: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty-one.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:31
verses.text: The men of Micmash, one hundred and twenty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:32
verses.text: The men of Bethel and Ai, one hundred and twenty-three.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:33
verses.text: The men of the other Nebo, fifty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:34
