verses.text: The people<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:35
verses.text: The people<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:36
verses.text: The people<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:37
verses.text: The people<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-one.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:38
verses.text: The people<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.  <div eID="gen3442" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2610"/><div sID="gen3443" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2610"/>The priests: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy-three.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:40
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Immer, one thousand and fifty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:41
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred and forty-seven.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:42
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Harim, one thousand and seventeen.  <div eID="gen3443" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2611"/><div sID="gen3444" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2611"/>The Levites: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Jeshua, namely of Kadmiel of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:44
verses.text: The singers: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Asaph, one hundred and forty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:45
verses.text: The gatekeepers: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Shallum, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Ater, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Talmon, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Akkub, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hatita, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Shobai, one hundred and thirty-eight.  <div eID="gen3444" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2612"/><div sID="gen3445" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2612"/>The temple servants: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Ziha, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hasupha, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Tabbaoth,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:47
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Keros, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Siaha, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Padon,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:48
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Lebanah, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hagaba, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Shalmai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:49
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hanan, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Giddel, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gahar,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:50
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Reaiah, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Rezin, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Nekoda,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:51
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Gazzam, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Uzza, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Paseah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:52
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Besai, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Meunim, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Nephushesim,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:53
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Bakbuk, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hakupha, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Harhur,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:54
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Bazlith, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Mehida, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Harsha,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:55
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Barkos, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Sisera, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Temah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:56
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Neziah, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hatipha.  <div eID="gen3445" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2613"/><div sID="gen3446" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2613"/>The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Solomon’s servants: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Sotai, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Sophereth, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Perida,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:58
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Jaala, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Darkon, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Giddel,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:59
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Shephatiah, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hattil, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Pochereth-Hazzebaim, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Amon.  <div eID="gen3446" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2614"/><div sID="gen3447" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2614"/>All the temple servants and the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Solomon’s servants were three hundred and ninety-two.  <div eID="gen3447" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2615"/><div sID="gen3448" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2615"/>These were the ones who came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer, but they were not able to prove their ancestral houses or their descent, whether they were from Israel:

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:62
verses.text: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Delaiah, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Tobiah, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Nekoda, six hundred and forty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:63
verses.text: And from the priests: the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hobaiah, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Hakkoz, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Barzillai (who had taken as a wife from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name).

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:64
verses.text: These sought their record among those enrolled in the genealogy, but it was not found there, so they were excluded as unclean from the priesthood.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:65
verses.text: So the governor said to them that they could not eat the most holy food until a priest could come with Urim and Thummim.  <div eID="gen3448" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2616"/><div sID="gen3449" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2616"/>All of the assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:67
verses.text: besides their servants and female slaves—these were seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven. And the male and female singers were two hundred and forty-five,<note placement="foot">After this verse, some versions add verse <reference osisRef="Neh.7.68">68</reference>: “Their horses were seven hundred and thirty-six; their mules two hundred and forty-five”; compare <reference osisRef="Ezra.2.66">Ezra 2:66</reference></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:69
verses.text: <note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Neh.7.69-Neh.7.73">Nehemiah 7:69–73 </reference>in the English Bible is 7:68–72 in the Hebrew Bible</note> <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> four hundred and thirty-five camels and six thousand seven hundred and twenty male donkeys.  <div eID="gen3449" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:70
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2617"/><div sID="gen3450" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2617"/>Now some from the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> gave to the work. The governor gave to the storehouse one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred and thirty priestly tunics.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:71
verses.text: Now some of the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> gave to the storehouse of the work twenty thousand gold darics and two thousand two hundred silver minas.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:72
verses.text: And what the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand silver minas, and sixty-seven priestly tunics.  <div eID="gen3450" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:73
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2618"/><div sID="gen3451" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2618"/>So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel settled in their cities. When the seventh month came, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in their cities.  <chapter eID="Neh.7"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2619"/><title type="x-s">Ezra Reads the Law to the People</title> <div sID="gen3452" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2619"/>All of the people gathered as one to the public square before the Water Gate. They asked Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> of Moses that Yahweh had commanded Israel.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:2
verses.text: So Ezra the priest brought the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> before the assembly for <transChange type="added">each</transChange> man and woman to hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:3
verses.text: He read from it facing the public square before the Water Gate from dawn until noon that day, opposite the men, women, and those with understanding. The ears of all the people <transChange type="added">were attentive</transChange> to the book of the law.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:4
verses.text: Then Ezra the scribe stood on a wooden podium that had been made for the occasion. And beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah on his right. On his left <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:5
verses.text: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people, because he was above all of the people. When he opened it all the people stood up.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:6
verses.text: Then Ezra blessed Yahweh the great God, and all of the people answered, “Amen! Amen!” while lifting their hands. Then they bowed down and worshiped Yahweh <transChange type="added">with their</transChange> noses to the ground.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:7
verses.text: And Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites were teaching the people from the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> while the people were in their places.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:8
verses.text: So they read the book from the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> of God, making it clear and giving the meaning so that they could understand the reading.  <div eID="gen3452" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2620"/><div sID="gen3453" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2620"/>Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all of the people, “This day is holy to Yahweh your God. Do not mourn nor weep.” For all of the people wept when they heard the words of the law.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:10
verses.text: Then he said to them, “Go, eat festive food and drink sweet drinks, and send a share to those for whom nothing is prepared; for this day is holy to our lord. Do not be grieved because the joy of Yahweh is your refuge.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:11
verses.text: So the Levites silenced all of the people, saying, “Silence, for this day is holy. Do not be grieved.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:12
verses.text: All of the people went to eat, to drink, to send a share, and to have great joy because they understood the words that they had made known to them.  <div eID="gen3453" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2621"/><title type="x-s">Festival of Booths</title> <div sID="gen3454" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2621"/>On the second day the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> of all the people, the priests, and the Levites gathered together to Ezra the scribe to study the words of the law.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:14
verses.text: They found written in the law,<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> which Yahweh had commanded by the hand of Moses, that the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> should live in booths during the festival of the seventh month,

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:15
verses.text: and that they should proclaim and give voice in all of their cities in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the hill and bring olive tree branches, olive oil wood branches, myrtle shrub branches, palm tree branches, and other leafy tree branches to make booths, as it is written.”

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:16
verses.text: So the people went out and brought them and made booths for themselves, each on his roof, in their courtyards, in the courtyards of the house of God, in the public square of the Water Gate, and in the public square of the Gate of Ephraim.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:17
verses.text: And all of the assembly of those who returned from captivity made booths and lived in the booths because the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> had not done it from the days of Jeshua son of Nun until that day. And there was very great joy.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:18
verses.text: And he read from the scroll of the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> of God day by day from the first day up to the last day. They celebrated the festival for seven days, and on the eighth day there was an assembly according to the rule.  <chapter eID="Neh.8"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2622"/><title type="x-s">The Nation Confesses</title> <div sID="gen3455" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2622"/>On the twenty-fourth day of this month the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> gathered in fasting, in sackcloths, and with soil on them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:2
verses.text: Those of the seed of Israel separated themselves from all of the foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:3
verses.text: They stood up in their place and read from the book of the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> of Yahweh their God for a fourth part of the day, and for a fourth they were confessing and worshiping Yahweh their God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:4
verses.text: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Kenani stood on the platform of the Levites and cried out with a loud voice to Yahweh their God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:5
verses.text: Then the Levites, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said, “Stand up, bless Yahweh your God from everlasting until everlasting. Blessed be your glorious name that is being exalted above all blessing and praise!  <div eID="gen3455" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2623"/><div sID="gen3456" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2623"/>“You alone are Yahweh. You alone have made the heavens, the heavens of the heavens, and all of their army, the earth and all that is in it, the waters and all that is in them. You give life to all of them, and the army of the heavens worship you.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:7
verses.text: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram and brought him from Ur of the Chaldeans and named him Abraham.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:8
verses.text: You found his heart faithful before you and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite and the Girgashite—to give <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to his seed. And you have kept your word because you are righteous.  <div eID="gen3456" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2624"/><div sID="gen3457" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2624"/>“You saw the misery of our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> in Egypt, and you heard their shout at the Red Sea.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:10
verses.text: You gave signs and wonders against Pharaoh, all of his servants, and all of the people of his land because you knew that they acted arrogantly against them. You made a name for yourself, as it is this day.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:11
verses.text: And you divided the sea before them, and they passed through the sea on dry ground, but their pursuers you threw into the depths like a stone into mighty waters.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:12
verses.text: You led them by day with a column of cloud and with a column of fire by night, to give them light on the way that they were to go.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:13
verses.text: Then you came down on Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven and gave them right judgments and true teachings, good regulations and commandments.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:14
verses.text: You made known your holy Sabbath to them and gave them commandments, regulations, and law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> by the hand of your servant Moses.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:15
verses.text: You gave them bread from heaven for their starvation, and you caused water to go out from a rock for their thirst. You told them to go in order to take into possession the land that you have sworn by your hand to give to them.  <div eID="gen3457" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2625"/><div sID="gen3458" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2625"/>“But they and our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> acted arrogantly and stiffened their neck and did not listen to your commandments.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:17
verses.text: They refused to listen and did not remember your wonders that you did among them. They stiffened their neck and in their rebellion <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞determined⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they gave head to”</note> to return to their slavery. But you are a God of forgiveness, gracious and compassionate, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞slow to anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “long of nose”</note> abundant in loyal love, so you did not abandon them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:18
verses.text: Even when they made for themselves a molten idol of a calf and said, ‘This is your God who brought you out from Egypt,’ and committed great blasphemies.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:19
verses.text: But you in your many mercies did not abandon them in the desert. The column of cloud <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> over them in the day did not cease to leave them on the way, and the column of fire by night <transChange type="added">that</transChange> gave light to them on the way that they went.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:20
verses.text: And you gave your good Spirit to instruct them and did not withhold your manna from their mouth and gave them water for their thirst.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:21
verses.text: Forty years you sustained them in the desert—they were not in need. Their clothing did not wear out and their feet did not swell.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:22
verses.text: And you gave them kingdoms and nations and allotted them a portion. They took into possession the land of Sihon king of Heshbon and the land of Og king of Bashan.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:23
verses.text: You made their children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> numerous like the stars of the heavens and brought them to the land that you told their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to enter in order to take possession.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:24
verses.text: So the children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> went in and took possession of the land. You subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites; you gave them into their hand, and their kings and the nations of the land to do with them according to their pleasure.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:25
verses.text: And they captured fortified cities and a fertile land and took possession of houses filled with every good thing: hewn cisterns, vineyards, olive groves, and many <transChange type="added">fruit</transChange> trees. They ate and became full, and they became fat and took delight in your great goodness.  <div eID="gen3458" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2626"/><div sID="gen3459" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2626"/>“But they rebelled and were rebellious against you and cast your law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> behind their back and killed your prophets, who had warned them to turn back to you, and they did great blasphemies.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:27
verses.text: Therefore you gave them into the hand of their enemy, and they brought trouble to them. Then in the time of their trouble they cried out to you, and you heard from the heavens, and according to your great compassions, you gave them saviors, and you saved them from the hand of their enemies.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:28
verses.text: But when they had rest they returned to doing evil before you, and you abandoned them in the hand of their enemies, and they ruled over them. Then they returned and cried out to you, and from the heavens you heard and many times rescued them according to your compassions.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:29
verses.text: You warned them so that they would return to your law.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> Yet they acted arrogantly and did not listen to your commandments but sinned against your judgments that a person must do so that they may live. They turned a stubborn shoulder and stiffened their neck and would not listen.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:30
verses.text: You were patient toward them for many years, and you have warned them by your spirit through the hand of your prophets, but they did not listen. So you gave them into the hand of the nations of the lands.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:31
verses.text: But in your great compassions you did not put an end to them, and you did not abandon them. For you are a gracious and compassionate God.  <div eID="gen3459" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2627"/><div sID="gen3460" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2627"/>“And now our God, the great, mighty, and awesome God who keeps <transChange type="added">his</transChange> covenant and loyal love, do not belittle in your presence all of the hardship that is found in us, our kings, our officials, our priests, our prophets, our ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and all of our people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until this day.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:33
verses.text: You are righteous in everything that has come on us, for you dealt faithfully, and we have acted wickedly.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:34
verses.text: Our kings, our officials, our priests, and our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> did not keep your law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> and did not listen to your commandments and statutes that you declared to them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:35
verses.text: And in their kingdom and in the greatness you gave to them, and in the wide and fertile land that you gave before them, they did not serve you and did not turn from their evil deeds.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:36
verses.text: Behold, we are slaves to this day, and the land that you have given to our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to eat its fruits and <transChange type="added">enjoy</transChange> its goodness—behold, we are slaves in it!

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:37
verses.text: Its rich yield goes to the kings whom you have given over us because of our sins, and <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> ruling over our dead bodies and our livestock at their pleasure. We are in great trouble.  <div eID="gen3460" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2628"/><div sID="gen3461" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2628"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Neh.9.38-Neh.10.39">Nehemiah 9:38–10:39 </reference>in the English Bible is 10:1–40 in the Hebrew Bible</note> “Now because of all of this we make a binding written agreement and are writing on the sealed documents <transChange type="added">the names of</transChange> our commanders, our Levites, and our priests.”  <chapter eID="Neh.9"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2629"/><title type="x-s">The Names of Those Who Signed the Covenant</title> <div sID="gen3462" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2629"/>Upon the sealed documents: Nehemiah the governor, son of Hacaliah and Zedekiah;

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:2
verses.text: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:3
verses.text: Pashhur, Amariah, Malkijah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:4
verses.text: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:5
verses.text: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:6
verses.text: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:7
verses.text: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:8
verses.text: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah—these are the priests.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:9
verses.text: And the Levites: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:10
verses.text: their brothers Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:11
verses.text: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:12
verses.text: Zaccur, Shereiah, Shebanaih,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:13
verses.text: Hodiah, Bani, Beninu.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:14
verses.text: The heads of the people: Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:15
verses.text: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:16
verses.text: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:17
verses.text: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:18
verses.text: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:19
verses.text: Hariph, Anathoth, Nobai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:20
verses.text: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:21
verses.text: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:22
verses.text: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:23
verses.text: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:24
verses.text: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:25
verses.text: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:26
verses.text: Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:27
verses.text: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.  <div eID="gen3462" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2630"/><title type="x-s">A Summary of the Covenant</title> <div sID="gen3463" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2630"/>“The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all who separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to <transChange type="added">observe</transChange> the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> of God—their wives, their sons, their daughters, and all who know and understand—

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:29
verses.text: <transChange type="added">are</transChange> helping their brothers, their nobles, and entering into a solemn oath to walk in the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> of God which was given by the hand of Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all of the commandments of Yahweh our Lord and his judgments and regulations.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:30
verses.text: We will not give our daughters to the peoples of the land nor take their daughters for our sons.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:31
verses.text: And the peoples of the land who bring merchandise and any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, we will not accept it from them on the Sabbath or on a holy day. We will forego <transChange type="added">the crops of</transChange> the seventh year and <transChange type="added">cancel</transChange> every debt.  <div eID="gen3463" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2631"/><div sID="gen3464" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2631"/>“We put on ourselves the commandment upon us to yearly give a third of a shekel for the service of the house of our God:

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:33
verses.text: for the rows of bread, the offering of the daily sacrifice, the continual <transChange type="added">burnt</transChange> sacrifice, the Sabbaths, the new moon festivals, the appointed <transChange type="added">festival</transChange> times, the holy objects, the sin offerings that make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:34
verses.text: And we have cast lots for the contributions of the wood offering of the priests, the Levites, and the people to bring <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to the house of our God, by our fathers’ houses, at designated times, year by year, to burn on the altar of Yahweh our God—as it is written in the law.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:35
verses.text: We <transChange type="added">also</transChange> bring the first fruits of our soil and the first fruits of all the fruit trees, year by year, for the house of Yahweh.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:36
verses.text: And the firstborn of our sons and beasts—as it is written in the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note>—and the firstborn of our cattle and sheep, to bring to the house of our God <transChange type="added">and</transChange> to the priests serving in the house of our God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:37
verses.text: And we bring the best of our dough, our offerings, the fruit of every tree, new wine, and olive oil to the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and <transChange type="added">to bring</transChange> the tithe of our soil to the Levites, for the Levites <transChange type="added">receive</transChange> the tithes in all of our rural towns.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:38
verses.text: And the priest, the descendant<note placement="foot">Or “son”</note> of Aaron, will be with the Levites during the tithe the Levites receive. The Levites will bring up a tithe of the tithes for the house of our God to the chambers of the storehouse.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:39
verses.text: For the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Levites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Levi”</note> will bring to the storerooms the offering of grain, new wine, and olive oil. These are the objects of the sanctuary and the priests who minister and the gatekeepers and singers. We will not neglect the house of our God.”  <chapter eID="Neh.10"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2632"/><title type="x-s">The Leaders and Servants in Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen3465" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2632"/>Now the commanders of the people lived in Jerusalem, but the remainder of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to live in the holy city of Jerusalem, the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> nine’s place <transChange type="added">was in</transChange> the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> cities.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:2
verses.text: And the people blessed all the men who willingly offered to live in Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen3465" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2633"/><div sID="gen3466" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2633"/>These are the heads of the province who lived in Jerusalem, but in the cities of Judah each one lived on his property in their cities: Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Solomon’s servants.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">some</transChange> from the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah and Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. From the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, son of Zechariah, son of Amariah, son of Shephatiah, son of Mahalalel, from the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Perez;

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:5
verses.text: and Maaseiah son of Baruch, son of Col-Hozeh, son of Hazaiah, son of Adaiah, son of Jehoiarib, son of Zechariah, son<note placement="foot">Or “descendant”</note> of the Shilonite.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:6
verses.text: All of the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Perez who were living in Jerusalem <transChange type="added">were</transChange> four hundred and sixty-eight able-bodied men.  <div eID="gen3466" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2634"/><div sID="gen3467" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2634"/>These are the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Joed, son of Pedaiah, son of Kolaiah, son of Maaseiah, son of Ithiel, son of Jeshaiah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:8
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">following</transChange> after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred and twenty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:9
verses.text: And Joel son of Zicri, their chief officer; and Judah son of Hassenuah, second <transChange type="added">in command</transChange> over the city.  <div eID="gen3467" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2635"/><div sID="gen3468" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2635"/>From the priests: Jedaiah son of Jehoiarib, Jakin,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:11
verses.text: Seraiah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub—the leader of the house of God—

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:12
verses.text: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred and twenty-two. And Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pelaliah, son of Amzi, son of Zechariah, son of Pashhur, son of Malkijah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:13
verses.text: and his brothers, heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> two hundred and forty-two. And Amashai son of Azarel, son of Ahzai, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:14
verses.text: and their brothers; mighty warriors of strength, one hundred and twenty-eight. The chief officer over them <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Zabdiel son of Hagedolim.  <div eID="gen3468" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2636"/><div sID="gen3469" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2636"/>Now from the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, son of Bunni;

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:16
verses.text: and Shabbethai and Jehozabad, leaders over the work of the Levites outside of the house of God;

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:17
verses.text: Mattaniah son of Micah, son of Zabdi, son<note placement="foot">Or “descendant”</note> of Asaph, <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> the leader to begin the thanksgiving prayer, and Bakbukiah the second of his brothers; Abda son of Shammua, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:18
verses.text: All of the Levites in the holy city <transChange type="added">were</transChange> two hundred and eighty-four.  <div eID="gen3469" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2637"/><div sID="gen3470" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2637"/>The gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, the keepers of the gates, one hundred and seventy-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:20
verses.text: And the remainder of Israel, the priests and the Levites, in all of the cities of Judah, each in his inheritance.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:21
verses.text: But the temple servants were living on the Ophel; Ziha and Gishpa <transChange type="added">were</transChange> over the temple servants.  <div eID="gen3470" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2638"/><div sID="gen3471" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2638"/>The chief officer of the Levites in Jerusalem <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Uzzi son of Bani, son of Hashabiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Mica, from the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Asaph, the singers over the work of the house of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:23
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> a command of the king concerning them and a regulation concerning the singers, required <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞day by day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a word for a day on his day”</note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:24
verses.text: And Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, from the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zerah the son of Judah, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> at the hand of the king in all matters concerning the people.  <div eID="gen3471" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2639"/><title type="x-s">Villages Outside of Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen3472" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2639"/>As for the villages in their territories, <transChange type="added">some</transChange> from the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah lived in Kiriath-Arba and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its settlements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “its daughters”</note> Dibon and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its settlements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “its daughters”</note> Jekabzeel and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its settlements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “its daughters”</note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:26
verses.text: Jeshua, Moladah, Beth Pelet,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:27
verses.text: Hazar Shual, Beersheba and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its settlements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “its daughters”</note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:28
verses.text: Ziklad, Meconah and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its settlements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “its daughters”</note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:29
verses.text: En-Rimmon, Zorah, Jarmuch,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:30
verses.text: Zanoah, Adullam and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their settlements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “their daughters”</note> Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its settlements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “its daughters”</note> So they camped from Beersheba up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Valley <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Hinnom.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:31
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Benjamin from Geba, Micmash, Aija, Bethel and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their settlements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “their daughters”</note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:32
verses.text: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:33
verses.text: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:34
verses.text: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:35
verses.text: Lod, and Ono the valley of the artisans.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:36
verses.text: And from the Levites the working groups of Judah <transChange type="added">were assigned</transChange> to Benjamin.  <chapter eID="Neh.11"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2640"/><title type="x-s">The Leaders and Servants in Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen3473" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2640"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the priests and the Levites who came up with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:2
verses.text: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:3
verses.text: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:4
verses.text: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:5
verses.text: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:6
verses.text: Shemaiah, Jehoiarib, Jedaiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:7
verses.text: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the heads of the priests and their brothers in the days of Jeshua.  <div eID="gen3473" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2641"/><div sID="gen3474" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2641"/>And the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah and his brothers <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:9
verses.text: And Bakbukiah, Unno, their brothers <transChange type="added">stood</transChange> opposite them during service.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:10
verses.text: Jeshua fathered Jehoiakim; Jehoiakim fathered Eliashib; Eliashib <transChange type="added">fathered</transChange> Jehoiada;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:11
verses.text: Jehoiada fathered Jehonathan; Jehonathan fathered Jaddua.  <div eID="gen3474" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2642"/><div sID="gen3475" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2642"/>Now in the days of Jehoiakim the priests and the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> were: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:13
verses.text: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:14
verses.text: of Melichu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:15
verses.text: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:16
verses.text: of Adaia, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:17
verses.text: of Abijah, Zicri; of Miniamin; of Moadiah, Piltai;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:18
verses.text: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:19
verses.text: of Jehoiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:20
verses.text: of Sallu, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:21
verses.text: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> of Jedaiah, Nethanel.  <div eID="gen3475" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2643"/><div sID="gen3476" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2643"/>In the days of Eliashib, Jehoiada, Jehohanan, and Jaddua the Levites were recorded as heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> So <transChange type="added">these were</transChange> the priests <transChange type="added">during</transChange> the reign of Darius the Persian.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:23
verses.text: The descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Levi and the heads of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> were recorded in the scroll of the Annals until the days of Jehohanan son of Eliashib.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:24
verses.text: And the heads of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their brothers opposite them, to praise and to give thanks by the command of David the man of God, section alongside section.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:25
verses.text: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers standing guard at the storerooms of the gates.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:26
verses.text: These were in the days of Jehoiakim son of Jeshua, son of Jehozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and Ezra the priest and scribe.  <div eID="gen3476" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2644"/><title type="x-s">Dedication of the Wall of Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen3477" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2644"/>At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites from all of their places in order to bring them to Jerusalem to do the dedication with joy, thanksgivings, song and cymbals, stringed instruments and lyres.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:28
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞singers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of the singers”</note> were gathered from the circuit all around Jerusalem and from the villages of Netophathite,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:29
verses.text: from Beth Gilgal, from the field of Geba and Azmaveth; for the singers built for themselves villages all around Jerusalem.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:30
verses.text: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves and purified the people, the gates, and the wall.  <div eID="gen3477" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2645"/><div sID="gen3478" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2645"/>Then I brought the commanders of Judah up on to the wall. I appointed two great choirs; <transChange type="added">one went in</transChange> a procession to the right on the wall to the Dung Gate.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:32
verses.text: After them went Hoshaiah, half of the commanders of Judah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:33
verses.text: Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:34
verses.text: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:35
verses.text: and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞priests⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of the priests”</note> with trumpets; Zechariah son of Jehonathan, son of Shemaiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Micaiah, son of Zaccur, son of Asaph;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:36
verses.text: and his brothers Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani with the instruments of the songs of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe <transChange type="added">went</transChange> before them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:37
verses.text: At the Fountain Gate opposite them they went up the steps of the city of David, at the assent to the wall, over the house of David, and up to the Water Gate to the east.  <div eID="gen3478" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2646"/><div sID="gen3479" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2646"/>Then the second choir went the opposite <transChange type="added">way</transChange>. I <transChange type="added">followed</transChange> after them with half of the people on the wall, from over the Tower of the Ovens up to the Wide Wall

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:39
verses.text: and over the Gate of Ephraim, at the Old Gate, at the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the Sheep Gate. And they <transChange type="added">stopped and</transChange> stood at the Gate of the Guard.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:40
verses.text: So the two choirs stood in the house of God, and I and half of the prefects with me;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:41
verses.text: and the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah with the trumpets;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:42
verses.text: Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang with Jizrahiah the chief officer.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:43
verses.text: They offered on that day great sacrifices and rejoiced because God brought great joy to them. And the women and children also rejoiced. The joy of Jerusalem was heard from afar.  <div eID="gen3479" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2647"/><title type="x-s">Celebration at the Temple</title> <div sID="gen3480" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2647"/>On that day men were appointed for the storehouse rooms, the offerings, the first fruits, and the tithes, in order to gather in them from the fields of the cities the requirements of the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> for the priests and Levites; for the joy of Judah <transChange type="added">was</transChange> upon the priests and Levites standing there.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:45
verses.text: They kept the responsibility of their God and the responsibility of cleansing, and the singers and gatekeepers, according to the command of David and his son Solomon.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:46
verses.text: For in the days of David and Asaph from ancient times there was the head of the singers and a song of praise and thanksgiving to God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:47
verses.text: So all of Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the daily food portions of the singers and gatekeepers. And they set apart <transChange type="added">that which was for</transChange> the Levites, and the Levites set apart <transChange type="added">that which was for</transChange> the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Aaron.  <chapter eID="Neh.12"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2648"/><title type="x-s">Israel Separates Itself</title> <div sID="gen3481" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2648"/>On that day the book of Moses was read in the hearing of the people and it was found written in it that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever come into the assembly of God

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:2
verses.text: because they did not come to meet the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> with bread and water, but hired Balaam against them in order to curse them—but our God changed the curse into a blessing.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:3
verses.text: So it happened when they heard the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> that they separated all of the foreign people from Israel.  <div eID="gen3481" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2649"/><title type="x-s">Nehemiah Brings Reform</title> <div sID="gen3482" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2649"/>Before this, Eliashib the priest who was appointed over the chambers of the house of our God—the one related to Tobiah—

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:5
verses.text: prepared for <transChange type="added">Tobiah</transChange> a large chamber where they had formerly put the grain offering, the frankincense, the <transChange type="added">temple</transChange> objects, tithes of grain, wine, and oil commanded for the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the offerings of the priests.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:6
verses.text: During all of this, I was not in Jerusalem because in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king. At the end of <transChange type="added">some</transChange> days I asked permission from the king <transChange type="added">to leave</transChange>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:7
verses.text: So I came to Jerusalem. And I came to learn of the wrong that Eliashib had done for Tobiah by making him a room in the courtyard of the house of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:8
verses.text: It was very displeasing for me, and I threw all of the objects from the house of Tobiah outside of the chamber.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:9
verses.text: And I spoke <transChange type="added">in order</transChange>, and they cleansed the chambers. Then I returned the objects of the house of God—the grain offering and the frankincense.  <div eID="gen3482" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2650"/><div sID="gen3483" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2650"/>And then I came to learn that the food of the Levites had not been given to them, so that the Levites and the singers, the doers of the work, had gone back each to his field.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:11
verses.text: So I quarreled with the prefects, and I said, “Why is the house of God forsaken?” And I gathered them and set them at their station.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:12
verses.text: So all of Judah brought the tithe of grain, new wine, and olive oil into the storehouses.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:13
verses.text: I appointed as treasurer over the storehouses Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, Pedaiah from the Levites, and as their hand Hanan son of Zaccur, son of Mattaniah, for they were considered faithful. <transChange type="added">The responsibility given</transChange> to them was to distribute to their brothers.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:14
verses.text: Remember me, my God, concerning this, and do not wipe out my loyal acts which I have done in the house of my God and in his service.  <div eID="gen3483" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2651"/><title type="x-s">Nehemiah Begins Sabbath Reforms</title> <div sID="gen3484" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2651"/>In those days I saw in Judah <transChange type="added">people</transChange> treading the wine press on the Sabbath, bringing in heaps <transChange type="added">of grain</transChange> and loading them on donkeys along with wine, grapes and figs, and every kind of burden and bringing <transChange type="added">it all</transChange> to Jerusalem on the day of the Sabbath. And I warned them at that time against selling food.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:16
verses.text: Tyrian men who lived in <transChange type="added">Jerusalem</transChange> brought fish and every kind of merchandise and sold <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on the Sabbath to the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Judah and in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:17
verses.text: So I quarreled with the nobles of Judah and said to them, “What is this evil thing that you are doing, profaning the day of the Sabbath?

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:18
verses.text: Did not your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> do this also, and our God brought on us all of this disaster and on this city <transChange type="added">too</transChange>? Now you are adding fierce wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath!”  <div eID="gen3484" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2652"/><div sID="gen3485" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2652"/>So when it became dark at the gates of Jerusalem before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors be shut and said that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. And I appointed some of my young men over the gates <transChange type="added">to prevent</transChange> any <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞goods⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “burden”</note> being brought in on the day of the Sabbath.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:20
verses.text: So the merchants and the sellers of merchandise spent the night outside of Jerusalem once or twice.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:21
verses.text: But I warned them and said to them, “Why are you spending the night opposite the wall? If you do <transChange type="added">it again</transChange>, I will lay hands against you.” From that time on they did not come on the Sabbath.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:22
verses.text: And then I told two Levites that they must purify themselves and come to guard the gates in order to consecrate the day of the Sabbath. Remember this also, my God, and take pity on me according to the greatness of your loyal love.  <div eID="gen3485" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2653"/><title type="x-s">Mixed Marriages are Condemned</title> <div sID="gen3486" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2653"/>Also in those days I saw Jews who had married women of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:24
verses.text: Half of their children spoke Ashdodite and could not speak Judean, but <transChange type="added">only</transChange> the tongues of other nations.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:25
verses.text: So I quarreled with them and cursed them and beat some of their men and pulled out their hair. I made them take an oath by God: “Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons or for yourselves.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:26
verses.text: Did not King Solomon of Israel sin in this way? And among the many nations there was no king like him, and he was beloved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Yet the foreign women made even him sin.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:27
verses.text: Should we listen to you all and do this great evil, acting unfaithfully against our God by marrying foreign women?”  <div eID="gen3486" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2654"/><div sID="gen3487" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2654"/>One from the sons of Jehoiada, son of the high priest Eliashib, <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> the son-in-law of Sanballat the Horonote <transChange type="added">was there</transChange>. I chased him away from me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:29
verses.text: Remember them, my God, because of their defilements of the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and the Levites.  <div eID="gen3487" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2655"/><div sID="gen3488" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2655"/>So I cleansed them from everything foreign, and I established responsibilities for the priests and Levites, each in his own work,

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:31
verses.text: a contribution of the wood offering at appointed times, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.  <chapter eID="Neh.13"/> <div eID="gen3488" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen3404" osisID="Neh" type="book"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2656"/><title type="x-s">The King’s Banquets</title> <div sID="gen3490" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2656"/>And it happened in the days of Ahasuerus, the Ahasuerus who reigned from India to Cush<note placement="foot">That is, “Ethiopia”</note>—over one hundred and twenty-seven provinces.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “province”</note>

verses.name: Esther 1:2
verses.text: In those days as King Ahasuerus was sitting on the throne of his kingdom, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in the citadel of Susa,

verses.name: Esther 1:3
verses.text: he gave a banquet in the third year of his reign for all his officials and servants. The army of Persia and Media and the nobles and officials of the provinces were in his presence

verses.name: Esther 1:4
verses.text: as he displayed the wealth of the glory of his kingdom and the glorious splendor of his greatness <transChange type="added">for</transChange> many days, one hundred and eighty days<note placement="foot">Hebrew “day”</note>.  <div eID="gen3490" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2657"/><div sID="gen3491" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2657"/>And when those days were completed, the king gave for all the people that were present at the citadel of Susa, both great and small, a banquet in the courtyard of the king’s palace garden that lasted seven days.

verses.name: Esther 1:6
verses.text: There were curtains of finely woven linen and blue cloth tied with cords of fine white linen and purple cloth to silver curtain rings and pillars of alabaster, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> couches of gold and silver on a paved floor of alabaster, precious stone, mother-of-pearl, and costly stones.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “stone”</note>

verses.name: Esther 1:7
verses.text: Drinks were served in goblets of gold and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞goblets of different kinds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “goblets from changing goblets”</note> and there was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞plentiful royal wine according to the bounty of the king⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “much wine of the kingdom according to the hand of the king”</note>

verses.name: Esther 1:8
verses.text: There were no restrictions on the drinking, for the king had instructed every official of his palace to do as each one pleased.

verses.name: Esther 1:9
verses.text: Furthermore, Queen Vashti gave a banquet for the women <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the palace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the house of the reign” or “in the house of the kingdom”</note> that belonged to King Ahasuerus.  <div eID="gen3491" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2658"/><title type="x-s">Queen Vashti Refuses the King’s Request</title> <div sID="gen3492" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2658"/>On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he said to Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, seven of the eunuchs attending King Ahasuerus,

verses.name: Esther 1:11
verses.text: to bring Queen Vashti before the king <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with her royal crown⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with her headdress of the kingdom”</note> to show the people and the officials her beauty, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for she was very attractive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for she was of good appearance”</note>

verses.name: Esther 1:12
verses.text: But Queen Vashti refused to come at the word of the king that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞conveyed by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by the hand of”</note> the eunuchs. And the king became very angry, and his anger burned in him.  <div eID="gen3492" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2659"/><div sID="gen3493" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2659"/>And the king said to the wise men, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the ones who know the times⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the knowers of the times”</note>—for it was the procedure of the king before all those who knew law and rights;<note placement="foot">Or “custom and legalities”</note>

verses.name: Esther 1:14
verses.text: and those next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, Memucan, the seven officials of Persia and Media who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had access to the king⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “saw the face of the king”</note> and sat first in the kingdom—

verses.name: Esther 1:15
verses.text: “According to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> law, what is to be done with Queen Vashti, because she has not done the command of King Ahasuerus <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞conveyed by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by the hand of”</note> the eunuchs?

verses.name: Esther 1:16
verses.text: And Memucan said before the king and the officials, “Not only has Queen Vashti done wrong to the king, but to all the officials and all of the people who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus.

verses.name: Esther 1:17
verses.text: For this deed of the queen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will be known⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will go out”</note> to all the women, causing them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to look with contempt on their husbands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to despise their husbands in their eyes”</note> as they will say, ‘King Ahasuerus commanded Queen Vashti to be brought before him but she did not come!’

verses.name: Esther 1:18
verses.text: This day the women of nobility from Persia and Media will respond to all the officials of the king and there will be no end to contempt and anger.

verses.name: Esther 1:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞If it pleases⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If it is good to”</note> the king, let <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a royal edict⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a word of the kingdom”</note> go out from him, and let it be written among the laws of Persia and Media so that it will not be altered, that Vashti cannot come before King Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal position to her neighbor who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> better than she.

verses.name: Esther 1:20
verses.text: And let the king’s decree that he will make be proclaimed in all his kingdom, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> vast and all the women will honor their husbands, great and small.”<note placement="foot">Or “high and low”</note>  <div eID="gen3493" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2660"/><div sID="gen3494" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2660"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞This advice pleased the king⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The word was good in the eyes of the king</note> and the officials, and the king acted according to the word of Memucan.

verses.name: Esther 1:22
verses.text: And he sent letters to all the provinces of the king, to each province according to its own script, and to every people in their own <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞language⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “tongue”</note> that every man should be the master of his house and who speaks in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞language⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “tongue”</note> of his people.  <chapter eID="Esth.1"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2661"/><title type="x-s">Esther is Chosen Queen</title> <div sID="gen3495" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2661"/>After these things, when the anger of King Ahasuerus subsided, he remembered Vashti and what she had done and what had been decreed against her.

verses.name: Esther 2:2
verses.text: And the king’s servants attending him said, “Let them seek attractive young virgins for the king.

verses.name: Esther 2:3
verses.text: Let the king appoint chief officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, and let them gather every attractive young virgin to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞harem⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house of the women”</note> in the citadel of Susa <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞under the care of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the hand of”</note> Hegai, the king’s eunuch, who is in charge of the women; and let him give <transChange type="added">them</transChange> their beauty treatment.

verses.name: Esther 2:4
verses.text: And let the young woman <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who is pleasing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who is good”</note> in the king’s eyes become queen in place of Vashti. The thing was good in the king’s eyes, and he acted accordingly.  <div eID="gen3495" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2662"/><div sID="gen3496" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2662"/>There was a Jew in the citadel of Susa whose name <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Mordecai son of Jair, son of Shimei, son of Kish, a Benjaminite,

verses.name: Esther 2:6
verses.text: who was deported<note placement="foot">Or “exiled”</note> from Jerusalem with the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> who were deported<note placement="foot">Or “exiled”</note> with Jeconiah<note placement="foot">A variant spelling of “Jehoiachin”</note> the king of Judah, whom King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon had deported.<note placement="foot">Or “exiled”</note>

verses.name: Esther 2:7
verses.text: He<note placement="foot">That is, Mordecai</note> was raising Hadassah, that is Esther, his uncle’s daughter,<note placement="foot">That is, his cousin</note> for she did not have a father or a mother; the young woman <transChange type="added">had</transChange> a beautiful figure and <transChange type="added">was</transChange> very attractive. When her father and mother died, Mordecai had taken her as his daughter.

verses.name: Esther 2:8
verses.text: And it happened, at the proclaiming of the edict of the king and his law, when many young women were being gathered to the citadel of Susa <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞under Hegai’s care⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the hand of Hegai”</note> Esther was taken to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞king’s palace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house of the king”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞under the care of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the hand of”</note> Hegai who was in charge of the women.

verses.name: Esther 2:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The young woman pleased him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the young woman was good in his eyes”</note> and she won favor in his presence, and he quickly provided for her beauty treatment and her portion of food, with seven chosen maids to give to her from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞king’s palace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “house of the king”</note> and he advanced her and her maids to the best part of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞harem⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “house of the women”</note>

verses.name: Esther 2:10
verses.text: Esther did not disclose her people and her family because Modecai had charged her that she must not tell.

verses.name: Esther 2:11
verses.text: And every day Modecai would walk up and down in front of the courtyard of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞harem⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house of the women”</note> to learn <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how Esther was doing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the peace of Esther and how it does/does with her”</note>  <div eID="gen3496" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2663"/><div sID="gen3497" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2663"/>When the turn came for each girl to go to King Ahasuerus, after the end of twelve months of being under the regulations of the women—for the days of their beauty treatments had to be filled, six months with the oil of myrrh and six months with perfumes and women’s cosmetics—

verses.name: Esther 2:13
verses.text: in this way, the girl goes to the king and all that she asks is given to her <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to take⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to go”</note> with her from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞harem⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house of the women”</note> to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞king’s palace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “house of the king”</note>

verses.name: Esther 2:14
verses.text: In the evening she would go and in the morning she would return to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞second harem⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “second house of the women”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞under the care of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the hand of”</note> Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch in charge of the concubines. She would not go back to the king unless the king delighted in her and she was called by name.  <div eID="gen3497" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2664"/><div sID="gen3498" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2664"/>When the turn came near for Esther daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken <transChange type="added">her</transChange> as a daughter, to go to the king, she did not ask anything except what Hegai the eunuch of the king who was in charge of the women, advised. And Esther carried favor in the eyes of everyone that saw her.

verses.name: Esther 2:16
verses.text: Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus, to his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞palace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “house of the reign” or “house of the kingdom”</note> in the tenth month that is Tebeth in the seventh year of his reign.

verses.name: Esther 2:17
verses.text: And the king loved Esther more than all the women, and she won his favor and loyalty more than all the virgins, so he put a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞royal crown⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “crown of the kingdom”</note> on her head and made her queen instead of Vashti.

verses.name: Esther 2:18
verses.text: And the king gave a great banquet, Esther’s banquet, for all his officials and servants. And he granted a tax amnesty<note placement="foot">See HALOT 252–253 s.v.</note> to the provinces and he gave gifts with royal liberality.  <div eID="gen3498" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:19
