verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2739"/><l level="1" sID="gen3615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2739"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Think⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Remember”</note> now, who has perished <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> innocent?<l eID="gen3615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3616"/>Or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the upright destroyed? <l eID="gen3616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2740"/><l level="1" sID="gen3617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2740"/><transChange type="added">Just</transChange> as I have seen, plowers of mischief<l eID="gen3617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3618"/>and sowers of trouble will reap it. <l eID="gen3618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2741"/><l level="1" sID="gen3619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2741"/>By<note placement="foot">Or “From”</note> the breath of God they perish,<l eID="gen3619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3620"/>and by<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> the blast of his anger they come to an end. <l eID="gen3620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2742"/><l level="1" sID="gen3621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2742"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> roar of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lion and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of a lion in its prime,<l eID="gen3621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3622"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> teeth of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young lions are broken. <l eID="gen3622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2743"/><l level="1" sID="gen3623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2743"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> lion is perishing without<note placement="foot">Or “from lack of”</note> prey,<l eID="gen3623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3624"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lion’s whelps are scattered. <l eID="gen3624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2744"/><l level="1" sID="gen3625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2744"/>“And a word came stealing to me,<l eID="gen3625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3626"/>and my ear received <transChange type="added">the</transChange> whisper from it. <l eID="gen3626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2745"/><l level="1" sID="gen3627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2745"/>Amid troubling thoughts from night visions,<l eID="gen3627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3628"/>at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> falling of deep sleep on men, <l eID="gen3628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2746"/><l level="1" sID="gen3629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2746"/>dread met me, and trembling,<l eID="gen3629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3630"/>and it made many of my bones shake. <l eID="gen3630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2747"/><l level="1" sID="gen3631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2747"/>And a spirit glided before my face;<l eID="gen3631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3632"/>the hair of my flesh<note placement="foot">Or “body”</note> bristled. <l eID="gen3632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2748"/><l level="1" sID="gen3633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2748"/>It stood still, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I could not recognize its appearance;<l eID="gen3633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3634"/>a form <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to before”</note> my eyes;<l eID="gen3634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3635"/><transChange type="added">there was</transChange> a hush, and I heard a voice: <l eID="gen3635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2749"/><l level="1" sID="gen3636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2749"/>‘Can a human being be more righteous than God,<l eID="gen3636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3637"/>or can a man be more pure than his Maker? <l eID="gen3637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2750"/><l level="1" sID="gen3638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2750"/>Look, he does not trust in his servants<l eID="gen3638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3639"/>and he charges his angels with error. <l eID="gen3639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2751"/><l level="1" sID="gen3640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2751"/>How much more dwellers in clay houses,<l eID="gen3640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3641"/>whose foundation <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the dust?<l eID="gen3641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3642"/>They are crushed like a moth. <l eID="gen3642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2752"/><l level="1" sID="gen3643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2752"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Between morning and evening⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from morning to the evening”</note> they are destroyed;<l eID="gen3643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3644"/>without <transChange type="added">anyone</transChange> regarding <transChange type="added">it</transChange> they perish forever. <l eID="gen3644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2753"/><l level="1" sID="gen3645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2753"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not their tent cord pulled up within them?<l eID="gen3645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3646"/>They die, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> not in<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> wisdom.’ <l eID="gen3646" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3604"/> <chapter eID="Job.4"/>

verses.name: Job 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2754"/><title type="x-s">Eliphaz’s Response Continues</title> <div sID="gen3647" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen3647" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen3648"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2754"/>“Call now, is there <transChange type="added">anyone</transChange> answering you?<l eID="gen3649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3650"/>And to which of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy ones will you turn? <l eID="gen3650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2755"/><l level="1" sID="gen3651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2755"/>For vexation will slay the fool,<l eID="gen3651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3652"/>and jealousy will kill <transChange type="added">the</transChange> simple. <l eID="gen3652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2756"/><l level="1" sID="gen3653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2756"/>I have seen a fool taking root,<l eID="gen3653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3654"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> suddenly I cursed his dwelling. <l eID="gen3654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2757"/><l level="1" sID="gen3655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2757"/>His children are far from deliverance,<l eID="gen3655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3656"/>and they are crushed in the gate,<l eID="gen3656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3657"/>and there is no deliverer— <l eID="gen3657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2758"/><l level="1" sID="gen3658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2758"/>whose harvest <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hungry eats,<l eID="gen3658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3659"/>and he takes it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from behind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to from”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thorns;<l eID="gen3659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3660"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thirsty pants after their wealth. <l eID="gen3660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2759"/><l level="1" sID="gen3661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2759"/>Indeed,<note placement="foot">Or “For”</note> mischief does not come from the dust,<l eID="gen3661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3662"/>and trouble does not sprout from the earth. <l eID="gen3662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2760"/><l level="1" sID="gen3663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2760"/>But a human being is born to trouble,<l eID="gen3663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3664"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they soar aloft⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they make high to fly”</note> like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sparks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “children of flame”</note> <l eID="gen3664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2761"/><l level="1" sID="gen3665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2761"/>“But I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> will seek God,<l eID="gen3665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3666"/>and to God I would commit my cause. <l eID="gen3666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2762"/><l level="1" sID="gen3667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2762"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> is doing great and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞unsearchable⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there is no searching”</note> things,<l eID="gen3667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3668"/>marvelous things <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without number⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until there is no number”</note>— <l eID="gen3668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2763"/><l level="1" sID="gen3669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2763"/>the one who is giving rain on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surface of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “faces of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth<l eID="gen3669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3670"/>and is sending water on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surface of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “faces of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fields, <l eID="gen3670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2764"/><l level="1" sID="gen3671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2764"/>to set <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lowly on high,<l eID="gen3671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3672"/>and <transChange type="added">those</transChange> mourning are lifted to safety. <l eID="gen3672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2765"/><l level="1" sID="gen3673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2765"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> is frustrating <transChange type="added">the</transChange> devices of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> crafty,<l eID="gen3673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3674"/>and their hands do not achieve success. <l eID="gen3674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2766"/><l level="1" sID="gen3675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2766"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> is capturing <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise in their craftiness,<l eID="gen3675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3676"/>and the schemes of the wily are rushed. <l eID="gen3676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2767"/><l level="1" sID="gen3677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2767"/>In the daytime they meet <transChange type="added">with</transChange> darkness,<l eID="gen3677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3678"/>and they grope at noon<note placement="foot">Or “the noon”</note> as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the night. <l eID="gen3678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2768"/><l level="1" sID="gen3679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2768"/>And<note placement="foot">Or “Thus,” or “So”</note> he saves from the sword of<note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> their mouth,<l eID="gen3679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3680"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞even⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and”; the entire verse could be translated “So he saves the poor from the sword of their mouth and from the hand of the strong”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor from the hand of the strong. <l eID="gen3680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2769"/><l level="1" sID="gen3681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2769"/>So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> there is hope<note placement="foot">Or “hope exists”</note> for the powerless,<l eID="gen3681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3682"/>and wickedness shuts its mouth. <l eID="gen3682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2770"/><l level="1" sID="gen3683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2770"/>“Look, happy <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> human being whom God reproves;<l eID="gen3683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3684"/>and you must not despise the discipline of Shaddai, <l eID="gen3684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2771"/><l level="1" sID="gen3685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2771"/>for he himself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> wounds, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he binds up;<l eID="gen3685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3686"/>he strikes, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> his hands heal. <l eID="gen3686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2772"/><l level="1" sID="gen3687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2772"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞From⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In,” or “By”</note> six troubles he will deliver you,<l eID="gen3687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3688"/>and in seven evil shall not touch you. <l eID="gen3688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2773"/><l level="1" sID="gen3689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2773"/>In famine he will redeem you from death,<l eID="gen3689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3690"/>and in war from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword. <l eID="gen3690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2774"/><l level="1" sID="gen3691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2774"/>From <transChange type="added">the</transChange> scourge of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tongue you shall be hidden,<l eID="gen3691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3692"/>and you shall not be afraid of<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> destruction when it comes. <l eID="gen3692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2775"/><l level="1" sID="gen3693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2775"/>At destruction and famine<note placement="foot">Hebrew “at famine”</note> you shall laugh,<l eID="gen3693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3694"/>and you shall not fear the wild animals of the earth. <l eID="gen3694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2776"/><l level="1" sID="gen3695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2776"/>For your covenant <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> with the stones of the field,<l eID="gen3695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3696"/>and the wild animals<note placement="foot">Collective singular</note> of the field will be at peace with you. <l eID="gen3696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2777"/><l level="1" sID="gen3697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2777"/>And you shall know that your tent <transChange type="added">is</transChange> safe,<l eID="gen3697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3698"/>and you will inspect your fold, and you shall not be missing <transChange type="added">anything</transChange>. <l eID="gen3698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2778"/><l level="1" sID="gen3699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2778"/>And you shall know that your offspring <transChange type="added">are</transChange> many,<l eID="gen3699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3700"/>and your descendants like the vegetation of the earth. <l eID="gen3700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2779"/><l level="1" sID="gen3701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2779"/>You shall come in maturity to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grave,<l eID="gen3701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3702"/>as the raising up of a stack of sheaves in its season. <l eID="gen3702" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2780"/><l level="1" sID="gen3703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2780"/>“Look, we have searched this out—it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> true;<l eID="gen3703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3704"/>hear it and know <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “you for yourself”</note> <l eID="gen3704" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3648"/> <chapter eID="Job.5"/>

verses.name: Job 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2781"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Second Speech: A Response to Eliphaz</title> <div sID="gen3705" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2781"/> Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job answered and said,  <div eID="gen3705" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2782"/><lg sID="gen3706"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2782"/>“If only my vexation could be well weighed,<l eID="gen3707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3708"/>and my calamity could be lifted up together <transChange type="added">with it</transChange> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> balances, <l eID="gen3708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2783"/><l level="1" sID="gen3709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2783"/>for then it would be heavier than the sand of the seas;<l eID="gen3709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3710"/>therefore my words have been rash, <l eID="gen3710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2784"/><l level="1" sID="gen3711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2784"/>for the arrows of Shaddai <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in me;<l eID="gen3711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3712"/>my spirit drinks their poison;<l eID="gen3712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3713"/>the terrors of God are arrayed against me. <l eID="gen3713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2785"/><l level="1" sID="gen3714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2785"/>Does <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wild ass bray over grass,<l eID="gen3714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3715"/>or <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ox bellow over its fodder? <l eID="gen3715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2786"/><l level="1" sID="gen3716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2786"/>Can tasteless <transChange type="added">food</transChange> be eaten without<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from without”</note> salt,<l eID="gen3716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3717"/>or is there taste in the white of a marshmallow plant? <l eID="gen3717" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2787"/><l level="1" sID="gen3718"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2787"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I refused⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “My soul/throat refuses”</note> to touch <transChange type="added">them</transChange>;<l eID="gen3718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3719"/>they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞food that will make me ill⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the illness of my bread/food”</note> <l eID="gen3719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2788"/><l level="1" sID="gen3720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2788"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who would give”</note> my request may come,<l eID="gen3720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3721"/>and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> God may grant my hope, <l eID="gen3721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2789"/><l level="1" sID="gen3722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2789"/>that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> God would decide that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he would crush me,<l eID="gen3722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3723"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> he would let loose his hand and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞kill me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he would cut me off”</note> <l eID="gen3723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2790"/><l level="1" sID="gen3724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2790"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> it will still be my consolation,<l eID="gen3724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3725"/>and I would recoil in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞unrelenting⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he/it does not have compassion,” or “he/it does not have pity,” or “he/it does not spare”</note> pain,<l eID="gen3725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3726"/>for I have not denied <transChange type="added">the</transChange> words of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Holy One. <l eID="gen3726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2791"/><l level="1" sID="gen3727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2791"/>What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my strength, that I should wait?<l eID="gen3727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3728"/>And what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my end, that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I should hold out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “I should make my self long,” or “I should lengthen my self”</note> <l eID="gen3728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2792"/><l level="1" sID="gen3729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2792"/>Or <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my strength <transChange type="added">like</transChange> the strength of stones?<l eID="gen3729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3730"/>Or <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my flesh bronze? <l eID="gen3730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2793"/><l level="1" sID="gen3731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2793"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Indeed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">An interrogative marker plus “if”</note> my help is not in me,<l eID="gen3731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3732"/>and <transChange type="added">any</transChange> success is driven from me. <l eID="gen3732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2794"/><l level="1" sID="gen3733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2794"/>“Loyal love<note placement="foot">Or “Kindness”</note> <transChange type="added">should come</transChange> for the afflicted <transChange type="added">from</transChange> his friend,<l eID="gen3733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3734"/>even if<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he forsakes the fear of Shaddai. <l eID="gen3734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2795"/><l level="1" sID="gen3735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2795"/>My companions are treacherous like a torrent-bed;<l eID="gen3735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3736"/>like a streambed of wadis<note placement="foot">A seasonal stream that is often dry</note> they flow away, <l eID="gen3736" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2796"/><l level="1" sID="gen3737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2796"/>which are growing dark because of ice upon them,<l eID="gen3737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3738"/>it will pile up snow. <l eID="gen3738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2797"/><l level="1" sID="gen3739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2797"/>In time they dry up, they disappear;<l eID="gen3739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3740"/>when it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> hot, they vanish from their place. <l eID="gen3740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2798"/><l level="1" sID="gen3741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2798"/>The paths of their way wind <transChange type="added">around</transChange>;<l eID="gen3741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3742"/>they go up into the wasteland, and they perish. <l eID="gen3742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2799"/><l level="1" sID="gen3743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2799"/>The caravans of Tema looked;<l eID="gen3743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3744"/>the traveling merchants of Sheba hope for them. <l eID="gen3744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2800"/><l level="1" sID="gen3745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2800"/>They are disappointed, because they trusted;<l eID="gen3745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3746"/>they came <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞here⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “up to it”</note> and they are confounded. <l eID="gen3746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2801"/><l level="1" sID="gen3747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2801"/>“For now you<note placement="foot">Plural throughout the rest of this chapter</note> have become <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞such⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to it,” or “for it”</note><l eID="gen3747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3748"/>you see terrors, and you fear. <l eID="gen3748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2802"/><l level="1" sID="gen3749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2802"/>Is it because I have said, ‘Give to me,’<l eID="gen3749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3750"/>or,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> ‘Offer a bribe for me from your wealth’? <l eID="gen3750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2803"/><l level="1" sID="gen3751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2803"/>or,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> ‘Save me from the foe’s hand,’<l eID="gen3751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3752"/>or,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> ‘Ransom me from the tyrants’ hand’? <l eID="gen3752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2804"/><l level="1" sID="gen3753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2804"/>Teach me, and I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> will be silent;<l eID="gen3753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3754"/>and make me understand how I have gone astray. <l eID="gen3754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2805"/><l level="1" sID="gen3755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2805"/>How painful are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upright words⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “words of uprightness”</note><l eID="gen3755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3756"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> what does <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your reproof⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “reproving from you”</note> reprove? <l eID="gen3756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2806"/><l level="1" sID="gen3757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2806"/>Do you intend to reprove <transChange type="added">my</transChange> words<note placement="foot">Or “Do you intend to reprove with words”</note><l eID="gen3757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3758"/>and <transChange type="added">consider the</transChange> words of a desperate <transChange type="added">man</transChange> as wind? <l eID="gen3758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2807"/><l level="1" sID="gen3759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2807"/>Even over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan you would cast the lot,<l eID="gen3759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3760"/>and you would bargain over your friend. <l eID="gen3760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2808"/><l level="1" sID="gen3761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2808"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And now,” or “And so then”</note> be prepared, turn to me,<l eID="gen3761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3762"/>and I surely will not lie to your face.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “faces”</note> <l eID="gen3762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2809"/><l level="1" sID="gen3763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2809"/>Please turn, let no injustice happen;<l eID="gen3763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3764"/>indeed,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> turn, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my righteousness is still intact⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “still my righteousness is in it”</note> <l eID="gen3764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2810"/><l level="1" sID="gen3765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2810"/>Is there injustice on my tongue?<l eID="gen3765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3766"/>Or can my palate not discern calamity?<note placement="foot">Or “calamities”</note> <l eID="gen3766" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3706"/> <chapter eID="Job.6"/>

verses.name: Job 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2811"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Second Speech: A Response to Eliphaz</title> <div sID="gen3767" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen3767" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen3768"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2811"/>“Does not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a human being<note placement="foot">Or a collective singular, “human beings”</note> have hard service⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hard service for a human being”</note> on earth?<l eID="gen3769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3770"/>And <transChange type="added">are not</transChange> his<note placement="foot">Or a collective singular, “their”</note> days like the days of a laborer? <l eID="gen3770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2812"/><l level="1" sID="gen3771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2812"/>Like a slave he longs for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shadow,<l eID="gen3771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3772"/>and like a laborer he waits for his wages. <l eID="gen3772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2813"/><l level="1" sID="gen3773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2813"/>So <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I had to inherit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I am allotted to me”</note> months of worthlessness,<l eID="gen3773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3774"/>and nights of misery are apportioned to me. <l eID="gen3774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2814"/><l level="1" sID="gen3775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2814"/>When I lie down, I say,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and I say”</note> ‘When shall I rise?’<l eID="gen3775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3776"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night is long,<l eID="gen3776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3777"/>and I have my fill of tossing until dawn. <l eID="gen3777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2815"/><l level="1" sID="gen3778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2815"/>My body is clothed <transChange type="added">with</transChange> maggots and clods of dust;<l eID="gen3778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3779"/>my skin hardens, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it gives way <transChange type="added">again</transChange>. <l eID="gen3779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2816"/><l level="1" sID="gen3780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2816"/>“My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle,<l eID="gen3780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3781"/>and they come to an end <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without hope⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with nothing hope”</note> <l eID="gen3781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2817"/><l level="1" sID="gen3782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2817"/>Remember that my life <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a breath;<l eID="gen3782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3783"/>my eye will not return to see good. <l eID="gen3783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2818"/><l level="1" sID="gen3784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2818"/>The eye of <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> seeing me will not see me;<l eID="gen3784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3785"/>your eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> upon me, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will be gone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not me,” or “I am not”</note> <l eID="gen3785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2819"/><l level="1" sID="gen3786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2819"/>A cloud vanishes, and it goes away,<l eID="gen3786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3787"/>so <transChange type="added">he who</transChange> goes down to Sheol will not come up. <l eID="gen3787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2820"/><l level="1" sID="gen3788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2820"/>He does not return again to his house,<l eID="gen3788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3789"/>and his place does not recognize him again. <l eID="gen3789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2821"/><l level="1" sID="gen3790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2821"/>“Even<note placement="foot">Or “I on my part”</note> I will not restrain my mouth;<l eID="gen3790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3791"/>I will speak in my spirit’s anguish;<l eID="gen3791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3792"/>I will complain in my inner self’s<note placement="foot">Or “soul’s”</note> bitterness. <l eID="gen3792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2822"/><l level="1" sID="gen3793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2822"/>Am I <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea, or a sea monster,<l eID="gen3793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3794"/>that you set a guard over me? <l eID="gen3794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2823"/><l level="1" sID="gen3795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2823"/>When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me,<l eID="gen3795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3796"/>and my couch<note placement="foot">Or “bed”</note> will ease my complaint,’ <l eID="gen3796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2824"/><l level="1" sID="gen3797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2824"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you terrify me with dreams,<note placement="foot">Or “the dreams”</note><l eID="gen3797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3798"/>and with visions you terrify<note placement="foot">Or “dishearten,” or “frighten”</note> me. <l eID="gen3798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2825"/><l level="1" sID="gen3799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2825"/>So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> my inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> will choose<note placement="foot">Or “I will choose”</note> strangling—<l eID="gen3799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3800"/>death more than my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞existence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “bones”</note> <l eID="gen3800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2826"/><l level="1" sID="gen3801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2826"/>I loathe <transChange type="added">my life</transChange>; I would not live forever;<l eID="gen3801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3802"/>depart from me, for my days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a breath. <l eID="gen3802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2827"/><l level="1" sID="gen3803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2827"/>“What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a human being that you make him great<l eID="gen3803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3804"/>and that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you fix your mind on him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you set on him your heart”</note> <l eID="gen3804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2828"/><l level="1" sID="gen3805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2828"/>so that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you visit him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for mornings,” or “at mornings”</note><l eID="gen3805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3806"/>you test him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every moment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “for moments,” or “at moments”</note> <l eID="gen3806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2829"/><l level="1" sID="gen3807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2829"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Like what”</note> will you not turn away from me?<l eID="gen3807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3808"/><transChange type="added">Or</transChange> not leave me alone until I swallow<note placement="foot">Or “my swallowing”</note> my spit? <l eID="gen3808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2830"/><l level="1" sID="gen3809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2830"/><transChange type="added">If</transChange> I have sinned, what have I done to you, watcher of humanity?<l eID="gen3809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3810"/>Why have you made me as a target for yourself,<l eID="gen3810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3811"/>so that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I have become a burden to myself?<note placement="foot">Some translations translate as “you” (e.g., ESV, NRSV, NIV, NET)</note> <l eID="gen3811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2831"/><l level="1" sID="gen3812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2831"/>And why do you not pardon my transgression<l eID="gen3812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3813"/>and take away my guilt?<l eID="gen3813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3814"/>For now I shall lie in the dust,<l eID="gen3814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3815"/>and you will seek me, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will be no more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not me,” or “I am not”</note> <l eID="gen3815" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3768"/> <chapter eID="Job.7"/>

verses.name: Job 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2832"/><title type="x-s">Bildad’s First Response to Job</title> <div sID="gen3816" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2832"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he said”</note>  <div eID="gen3816" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2833"/><lg sID="gen3817"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2833"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Until when”</note> will you say these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>,<l eID="gen3818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3819"/>and the words of your mouth <transChange type="added">be</transChange> a mighty wind? <l eID="gen3819" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2834"/><l level="1" sID="gen3820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2834"/>Does God pervert justice,<l eID="gen3820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3821"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞or⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and if”</note> Shaddai pervert righteousness? <l eID="gen3821" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2835"/><l level="1" sID="gen3822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2835"/>If your children sinned against him,<l eID="gen3822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3823"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he sent them into the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> of their transgression. <l eID="gen3823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2836"/><l level="1" sID="gen3824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2836"/>If you yourself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> would seek God,<l eID="gen3824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3825"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you would plead to Shaddai for grace. <l eID="gen3825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2837"/><l level="1" sID="gen3826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2837"/>If you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> pure and upright,<l eID="gen3826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3827"/>indeed,<note placement="foot">Or “even,” or “yes”</note> now he will rouse himself for you,<l eID="gen3827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3828"/>and he will restore your righteous abode. <l eID="gen3828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2838"/><l level="1" sID="gen3829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2838"/>Though<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> your beginning was small,<l eID="gen3829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3830"/>your end<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and your end”</note> will be very great. <l eID="gen3830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2839"/><l level="1" sID="gen3831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2839"/>“Indeed,<note placement="foot">Or “For”</note> please inquire of former generations,<l eID="gen3831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3832"/>and consider <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what their ancestors have found⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as to the finding of their fathers”</note> <l eID="gen3832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2840"/><l level="1" sID="gen3833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2840"/>for we <transChange type="added">are of</transChange> yesterday, and we do not know,<l eID="gen3833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3834"/>for our days on earth <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a shadow. <l eID="gen3834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2841"/><l level="1" sID="gen3835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2841"/>Will they themselves<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> not teach you and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞tell you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they will say to you”</note><l eID="gen3835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3836"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞utter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they will bring out”</note> words from their heart? <l eID="gen3836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2842"/><l level="1" sID="gen3837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2842"/>Can papyrus grow tall where <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> not a marsh?<l eID="gen3837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3838"/>Will reeds flourish without water?<note placement="foot">Or “where there is no water”</note> <l eID="gen3838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2843"/><l level="1" sID="gen3839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2843"/>While it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in its flower <transChange type="added">and</transChange> is not plucked,<l eID="gen3839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3840"/>yet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it withers <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> all grass. <l eID="gen3840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2844"/><l level="1" sID="gen3841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2844"/>So <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the paths of all who forget God;<l eID="gen3841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3842"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hope of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> godless will perish, <l eID="gen3842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2845"/><l level="1" sID="gen3843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2845"/>whose confidence is cut off<l eID="gen3843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3844"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose trust⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his trust”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a spider’s house. <l eID="gen3844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2846"/><l level="1" sID="gen3845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2846"/>He will lean himself against his house, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it will not stand;<l eID="gen3845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3846"/>he will take hold of it, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it will not endure. <l eID="gen3846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2847"/><l level="1" sID="gen3847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2847"/>He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞thriving⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “soaked,” or “well-watered”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> the sun,<l eID="gen3847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3848"/>and his plant shoots spread over his garden. <l eID="gen3848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2848"/><l level="1" sID="gen3849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2848"/>His roots twine over a stone heap;<l eID="gen3849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3850"/>he sees a house of stone. <l eID="gen3850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2849"/><l level="1" sID="gen3851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2849"/>If he destroys him from his place,<l eID="gen3851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3852"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it deceives him, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, ‘I have never seen you.’ <l eID="gen3852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2850"/><l level="1" sID="gen3853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2850"/>Look, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the joy of his way,<l eID="gen3853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3854"/>and from dust others will spring up. <l eID="gen3854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2851"/><l level="1" sID="gen3855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2851"/>“Look, God will not reject <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blameless,<l eID="gen3855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3856"/>and he will not uphold the hand of evildoers. <l eID="gen3856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2852"/><l level="1" sID="gen3857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2852"/>Yet he will fill your mouth <transChange type="added">with</transChange> laughter<l eID="gen3857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3858"/>and your lips <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a shout of joy. <l eID="gen3858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2853"/><l level="1" sID="gen3859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2853"/><transChange type="added">Those</transChange> who hate you will be clothed with shame,<l eID="gen3859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3860"/>and the tent of the wicked <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will be no more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not it,” or “it is not”</note> <l eID="gen3860" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3817"/> <chapter eID="Job.8"/>

verses.name: Job 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2854"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Third Speech: A Response to Bildad</title> <div sID="gen3861" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2854"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job answered and said,  <div eID="gen3861" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2855"/><lg sID="gen3862"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2855"/>“Truly I know that <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> so,<l eID="gen3863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3864"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> how can a human being be just before God? <l eID="gen3864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2856"/><l level="1" sID="gen3865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2856"/>If he wants to contend with him,<l eID="gen3865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3866"/>he cannot answer him one <transChange type="added">time</transChange> in a thousand. <l eID="gen3866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2857"/><l level="1" sID="gen3867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2857"/><transChange type="added">He is</transChange> wise in<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> heart and mighty in<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> strength;<l eID="gen3867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3868"/>who has resisted him and succeeded?<note placement="foot">Literally “he succeeded”</note> <l eID="gen3868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2858"/><l level="1" sID="gen3869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2858"/>“<transChange type="added">He is the one</transChange> who moves mountains, and they do not know <transChange type="added">how</transChange>,<l eID="gen3869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3870"/>who overturns them in his anger. <l eID="gen3870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2859"/><l level="1" sID="gen3871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2859"/><transChange type="added">He is the one</transChange> who shakes <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth from its place,<l eID="gen3871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3872"/>and its pillars tremble. <l eID="gen3872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2860"/><l level="1" sID="gen3873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2860"/><transChange type="added">He is the one</transChange> who commands the sun, and it does not rise,<l eID="gen3873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3874"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and he seals up the stars⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and behind the stars he seals up”</note> <l eID="gen3874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2861"/><l level="1" sID="gen3875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2861"/><transChange type="added">He is the one</transChange> who alone stretches out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens<l eID="gen3875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3876"/>and <transChange type="added">who</transChange> tramples on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> waves of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea. <l eID="gen3876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2862"/><l level="1" sID="gen3877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2862"/><transChange type="added">He is the one</transChange> who made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Bear <transChange type="added">and</transChange> Orion,<l eID="gen3877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3878"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> Pleiades and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> constellations of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south. <l eID="gen3878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2863"/><l level="1" sID="gen3879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2863"/><transChange type="added">He is the one</transChange> who does great things <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beyond understanding⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until there is not understanding”</note><l eID="gen3879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3880"/>and marvelous things <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beyond number⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until there is not number”</note> <l eID="gen3880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2864"/><l level="1" sID="gen3881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2864"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞If⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Look”</note> he passes by me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I would not see him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “and I would not see”</note><l eID="gen3881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3882"/>and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> he should move on, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I would not recognize him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and I would not recognize him”</note> <l eID="gen3882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2865"/><l level="1" sID="gen3883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2865"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞If⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Look”</note> he would snatch away, who could turn him?<l eID="gen3883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3884"/>Who could say to him, ‘What are you doing?’ <l eID="gen3884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2866"/><l level="1" sID="gen3885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2866"/>God will not turn back his anger;<l eID="gen3885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3886"/>beneath him the helpers of Rahab bow. <l eID="gen3886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2867"/><l level="1" sID="gen3887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2867"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How much less⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Also for”</note> can I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> answer him?<l eID="gen3887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3888"/><transChange type="added">How</transChange> can I choose my words with him, <l eID="gen3888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2868"/><l level="1" sID="gen3889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2868"/>whom I cannot answer, even though I am righteous?<l eID="gen3889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3890"/>From<note placement="foot">Hebrew “To”</note> my judge I must implore grace. <l eID="gen3890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2869"/><l level="1" sID="gen3891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2869"/>If I summon <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, and he should answer me,<l eID="gen3891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3892"/>I do not believe that he will listen to my voice— <l eID="gen3892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2870"/><l level="1" sID="gen3893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2870"/>who crushes me with a tempest<l eID="gen3893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3894"/>and multiplies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he multiplies”</note> my wounds without cause. <l eID="gen3894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2871"/><l level="1" sID="gen3895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2871"/>He will not allow me to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞catch⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “return,” or “regain”</note> my breath;<l eID="gen3895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3896"/>rather, he will fill me with bitterness. <l eID="gen3896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2872"/><l level="1" sID="gen3897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2872"/>If <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is a matter of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for”; see NASB, NIV, NET</note> strength, look, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> mighty.<l eID="gen3897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3898"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> if <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is a matter of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for”; NASB, NIV, NET, NRSV</note> justice, who can summon me?<note placement="foot">Or “arraign me”</note> <l eID="gen3898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2873"/><l level="1" sID="gen3899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2873"/>Even though I am righteous, my mouth will condemn me;<l eID="gen3899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3900"/><transChange type="added">even though</transChange> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> blameless, yet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it would pronounce me guilty. <l eID="gen3900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2874"/><l level="1" sID="gen3901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2874"/>“I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> blameless; I do not care about myself;<note placement="foot">Perhaps the meaning is “but it makes no difference to me” (NLT)</note><l eID="gen3901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3902"/>I loathe my life. <l eID="gen3902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2875"/><l level="1" sID="gen3903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2875"/>It <transChange type="added">is all</transChange> one; therefore I say,<l eID="gen3903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3904"/>‘He destroys <transChange type="added">both the</transChange> blameless and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked.’ <l eID="gen3904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2876"/><l level="1" sID="gen3905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2876"/>When the whip<note placement="foot">Or “scourge”</note> kills suddenly,<l eID="gen3905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3906"/>he mocks at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> despair of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> innocent. <l eID="gen3906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2877"/><l level="1" sID="gen3907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2877"/>The earth is given into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked;<l eID="gen3907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3908"/>he covers the face of its judge—<l eID="gen3908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3909"/>if <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">he</transChange>, then who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> it? <l eID="gen3909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2878"/><l level="1" sID="gen3910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2878"/>“And my days are swifter than a runner;<l eID="gen3910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3911"/>they flee away; they do not see good. <l eID="gen3911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2879"/><l level="1" sID="gen3912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2879"/>They go by like papyrus skiffs,<l eID="gen3912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3913"/>like an eagle swoops down on <transChange type="added">its</transChange> prey. <l eID="gen3913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2880"/><l level="1" sID="gen3914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2880"/>Though<note placement="foot">Or “If”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “my saying”</note> ‘I will forget my complaint;<l eID="gen3914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3915"/>I will change my expression, and I will rejoice,’ <l eID="gen3915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2881"/><l level="1" sID="gen3916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2881"/>I become afraid of all my sufferings;<l eID="gen3916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3917"/>I know that you do not consider me innocent. <l eID="gen3917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2882"/><l level="1" sID="gen3918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2882"/><transChange type="added">If</transChange> I shall be <transChange type="added">declared</transChange> guilty,<l eID="gen3918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3919"/>why then should I labor in vain? <l eID="gen3919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2883"/><l level="1" sID="gen3920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2883"/>If I wash myself with soap,<note placement="foot">Or “with snow,” or “in snow”</note><l eID="gen3920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3921"/>and I cleanse my hands with lye, <l eID="gen3921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2884"/><l level="1" sID="gen3922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2884"/>then you plunge me into the <transChange type="added">slime</transChange> pit,<l eID="gen3922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3923"/>and my clothes abhor me. <l eID="gen3923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2885"/><l level="1" sID="gen3924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2885"/>“For<note placement="foot">Or the emphatic “Indeed”</note> <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> not a mortal like me <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I can answer him,<l eID="gen3924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3925"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞we can come to trial together⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “we come together in the justice,” or “we come together in the judgment”</note> <l eID="gen3925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2886"/><l level="1" sID="gen3926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2886"/>There is no arbiter between us<l eID="gen3926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3927"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> he might lay his hand on both of us. <l eID="gen3927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2887"/><l level="1" sID="gen3928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2887"/>May he remove his rod from me,<l eID="gen3928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3929"/>and let his dread not terrify me; <l eID="gen3929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2888"/><l level="1" sID="gen3930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2888"/><transChange type="added">then</transChange> I would speak and not fear him,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and I will not fear him”</note><l eID="gen3930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3931"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in myself I am not fearful⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not so I with me”</note> <l eID="gen3931" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3862"/> <chapter eID="Job.9"/>

verses.name: Job 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2889"/><title type="x-s">Job Continues His Response to Bildad</title> <div sID="gen3932" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen3932" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen3933"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2889"/>“My inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> loathes my life;<l eID="gen3934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3935"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I want to give vent to my complaint⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “I want to let go upon me my complaint”</note><l eID="gen3935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3936"/>I want to speak out of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bitterness of my inner self.<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> <l eID="gen3936" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2890"/><l level="1" sID="gen3937"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2890"/>I will say to God, ‘You should not condemn me;<l eID="gen3937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3938"/>let me know why you contend <transChange type="added">against</transChange> me. <l eID="gen3938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2891"/><l level="1" sID="gen3939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2891"/>Is it good for you that you oppress,<l eID="gen3939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3940"/>that you despise the labor of your hands,<l eID="gen3940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3941"/>and you smile over the schemes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked? <l eID="gen3941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2892"/><l level="1" sID="gen3942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2892"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Do you have eyes of flesh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “Are eyes of flesh for you”</note><l eID="gen3942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3943"/>Or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞do you see as human beings see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “as seeing of human beings you see”</note> <l eID="gen3943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2893"/><l level="1" sID="gen3944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2893"/><transChange type="added">Are</transChange> your days as the days of human beings,<l eID="gen3944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3945"/>or your years as the days of man, <l eID="gen3945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2894"/><l level="1" sID="gen3946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2894"/>that you seek out my iniquity,<l eID="gen3946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3947"/>and you search for my sin <l eID="gen3947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2895"/><l level="1" sID="gen3948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2895"/>because of your knowledge that I am not guilty,<l eID="gen3948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3949"/>and there is no escaping from your hand? <l eID="gen3949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2896"/><l level="1" sID="gen3950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2896"/>Your hands fashioned me and made me<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they made me”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞altogether⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “together all around”</note><l eID="gen3950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3951"/>then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you destroyed me. <l eID="gen3951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2897"/><l level="1" sID="gen3952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2897"/>Please<note placement="foot">Or an untranslatable particle expressing urgency</note> remember that you made me like clay,<l eID="gen3952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3953"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you turn me into dust <transChange type="added">again</transChange>? <l eID="gen3953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2898"/><l level="1" sID="gen3954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2898"/>Did you not pour me out like milk<l eID="gen3954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3955"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞curdle me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you did curdle me”</note> like cheese? <l eID="gen3955" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2899"/><l level="1" sID="gen3956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2899"/>You clothed me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> skin and flesh,<l eID="gen3956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3957"/>and you knit me together with bones and sinews. <l eID="gen3957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2900"/><l level="1" sID="gen3958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2900"/>You have granted me life and loyal love,<l eID="gen3958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3959"/>and your care has preserved my spirit. <l eID="gen3959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2901"/><l level="1" sID="gen3960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2901"/>“ ‘Yet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> you hid these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> in your heart;<l eID="gen3960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3961"/>I know that this <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was your purpose⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “was with you”</note> <l eID="gen3961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2902"/><l level="1" sID="gen3962"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2902"/>If I had sinned, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you would be watching me,<l eID="gen3962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3963"/>and you would not acquit me of my guilt. <l eID="gen3963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:15
