verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2903"/><l level="1" sID="gen3964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2903"/>If I am guilty, woe to me!<l eID="gen3964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3965"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> if I am righteous, I dare not lift my head;<l eID="gen3965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3966"/><transChange type="added">I am</transChange> filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> shame, and <transChange type="added">just</transChange> look <transChange type="added">at</transChange> my misery! <l eID="gen3966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2904"/><l level="1" sID="gen3967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2904"/>And <transChange type="added">if my head</transChange> grows bold, you would hunt me as the lion in its prime;<l eID="gen3967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3968"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and you repeat your exploits against me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and you do again you display marvelous powers against me”</note> <l eID="gen3968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2905"/><l level="1" sID="gen3969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2905"/>You renew your witnesses against me,<l eID="gen3969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3970"/>and you increase your vexation against me;<l eID="gen3970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3971"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞relief forces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “substitute and forces”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> against me. <l eID="gen3971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2906"/><l level="1" sID="gen3972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2906"/>So<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> why did you bring me forth from the womb?<l eID="gen3972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3973"/>I should have passed away, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and no eye should have seen me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and an eye should not have seen me”</note> <l eID="gen3973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2907"/><l level="1" sID="gen3974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2907"/>I should have been as though I had not been;<l eID="gen3974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3975"/>I should have been brought from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb to the grave. <l eID="gen3975" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2908"/><l level="1" sID="gen3976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2908"/><transChange type="added">Are</transChange> not my days few? Let him leave <transChange type="added">me</transChange> alone;<l eID="gen3976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3977"/>let him turn from me, and let me rejoice a little. <l eID="gen3977" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2909"/><l level="1" sID="gen3978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2909"/>Before I go—and I will not return—<l eID="gen3978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3979"/>to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of darkness and deep shadow, <l eID="gen3979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2910"/><l level="1" sID="gen3980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2910"/>to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of darkness,<l eID="gen3980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3981"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> darkness of a deep shadow and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞chaos⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and not order”</note><l eID="gen3981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3982"/>so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> it shines forth like darkness.’ ” <l eID="gen3982" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3933"/> <chapter eID="Job.10"/>

verses.name: Job 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2911"/><title type="x-s">Zophar’s First Response to Job</title> <div sID="gen3983" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2911"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,  <div eID="gen3983" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2912"/><lg sID="gen3984"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2912"/>“Should an abundance of words go unanswered,<l eID="gen3985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3986"/>or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a man full of talk⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man of lips”</note> be vindicated?<note placement="foot">Hebrew “should he be vindicated”</note> <l eID="gen3986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2913"/><l level="1" sID="gen3987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2913"/>Should your loose talk put people to silence?<l eID="gen3987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3988"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And when you mock, shall no one put you to shame⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “And you will mock there is not putting to shame”</note> <l eID="gen3988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2914"/><l level="1" sID="gen3989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2914"/>For you say, ‘My teaching <transChange type="added">is</transChange> pure,<l eID="gen3989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3990"/>and I am clean in your sight.’ <l eID="gen3990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2915"/><l level="1" sID="gen3991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2915"/>But,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And but”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who shall give”</note> God might speak,<l eID="gen3991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3992"/>and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> he would open his lips to you, <l eID="gen3992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2916"/><l level="1" sID="gen3993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2916"/>and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> he would tell you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> secrets of wisdom,<l eID="gen3993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3994"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞insight has many sides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “double to sound wisdom”</note><l eID="gen3994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3995"/>And know that God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on your behalf⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for you”</note> has forgotten <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> your guilt. <l eID="gen3995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2917"/><l level="1" sID="gen3996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2917"/>“Can you find <transChange type="added">out</transChange> the essence of God,<l eID="gen3996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3997"/>or can you find <transChange type="added">out</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the ultimate limits⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “up to the limit”</note> of Shaddai? <l eID="gen3997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2918"/><l level="1" sID="gen3998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2918"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞It is higher than the heaven⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “heights of heaven”</note> what can you do?<l eID="gen3998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3999"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> deeper than Sheol; what can you know? <l eID="gen3999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2919"/><l level="1" sID="gen4000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2919"/>Its measure <transChange type="added">is</transChange> longer than <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth<l eID="gen4000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4001"/>and broader than <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea. <l eID="gen4001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2920"/><l level="1" sID="gen4002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2920"/>“If he passes through and imprisons someone<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and he imprisons”</note><l eID="gen4002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4003"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and summons the assembly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and he summons”</note> then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> who can hinder him? <l eID="gen4003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2921"/><l level="1" sID="gen4004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2921"/>For he knows <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who are worthless⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “men of worthlessness”</note><l eID="gen4004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4005"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he sees⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And he will see”</note> iniquity, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will not consider it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and he will not consider”</note> <l eID="gen4005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2922"/><l level="1" sID="gen4006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2922"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an empty-headed person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man hollowed out”</note> will get understanding<l eID="gen4006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4007"/>when<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> a wild donkey’s colt is born <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a human being. <l eID="gen4007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2923"/><l level="1" sID="gen4008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2923"/>“If you yourself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> direct your heart<l eID="gen4008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4009"/>and stretch out your hands to him— <l eID="gen4009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2924"/><l level="1" sID="gen4010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2924"/>if iniquity<note placement="foot">See v. <reference osisRef="Job.11.11">11</reference>, where the same word is used</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your hand, put it far away,<l eID="gen4010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4011"/>and you must not let wickedness reside in your tents— <l eID="gen4011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2925"/><l level="1" sID="gen4012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2925"/>surely then you will lift up your face without<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> blemish,<l eID="gen4012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4013"/>and you will be firmly established and will not fear.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and not will you fear”</note> <l eID="gen4013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2926"/><l level="1" sID="gen4014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2926"/>For you yourself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> will forget your misery;<l eID="gen4014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4015"/>you will remember <transChange type="added">it</transChange> as water <transChange type="added">that</transChange> has flowed past. <l eID="gen4015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2927"/><l level="1" sID="gen4016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2927"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And your life will be brighter than noon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “And from noon lifespan will arise”</note><l eID="gen4016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4017"/><transChange type="added">its</transChange> darkness will be like the morning. <l eID="gen4017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2928"/><l level="1" sID="gen4018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2928"/>And you will have confidence because there is hope;<l eID="gen4018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4019"/>and you will be well protected—<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will sleep in safety⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you will lie down securely”</note> <l eID="gen4019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2929"/><l level="1" sID="gen4020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2929"/>And you will lie down, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no one will make you afraid⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not making afraid”</note><l eID="gen4020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4021"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and many will entreat your favor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and they will appease/implore your faces many”</note> <l eID="gen4021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2930"/><l level="1" sID="gen4022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2930"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked will fail;<l eID="gen4022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4023"/>and refuge will be lost to them,<l eID="gen4023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4024"/>and their hope <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to breathe their last breath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “the expiring of soul”</note> <l eID="gen4024" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3984"/> <chapter eID="Job.11"/>

verses.name: Job 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2931"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Fourth Speech</title> <div sID="gen4025" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2931"/> Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job answered and said,  <div eID="gen4025" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2932"/><lg sID="gen4026"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2932"/>“Truly indeed you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> <transChange type="added">are the</transChange> people,<l eID="gen4027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4028"/>and wisdom will die with you.<note placement="foot">Plural</note> <l eID="gen4028" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2933"/><l level="1" sID="gen4029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2933"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I also have insight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Also for me heart”</note> like you;<note placement="foot">Plural</note><l eID="gen4029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4030"/>I am not more inferior than you.<note placement="foot">Plural</note><l eID="gen4030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4031"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who does not know things like these⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “and who there is not like these”</note> <l eID="gen4031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2934"/><l level="1" sID="gen4032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2934"/>I am a laughingstock to my friends:<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to his friends”</note><l eID="gen4032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4033"/>‘<transChange type="added">He</transChange> calls on God, and he answers him.’<l eID="gen4033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4034"/>A righteous, blameless man <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a laughingstock. <l eID="gen4034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2935"/><l level="1" sID="gen4035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2935"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Those at ease have contempt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Contempt is according to the thought of the complacent”</note> for the thought of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞disaster⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a torch”</note><l eID="gen4035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4036"/><transChange type="added">but it is</transChange> ready for those unstable of foot. <l eID="gen4036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2936"/><l level="1" sID="gen4037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2936"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> tents of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> destroyers are at peace,<l eID="gen4037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4038"/>and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> security for those who provoke God,<l eID="gen4038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4039"/><transChange type="added">for those</transChange> whom God brings into his hand.<note placement="foot">Or “power”</note> <l eID="gen4039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2937"/><l level="1" sID="gen4040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2937"/>“But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> ask<note placement="foot">Or “ask now,” or “please ask”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> animals, and they will teach you,<l eID="gen4040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4041"/>and the birds of the heaven, and they will tell you; <l eID="gen4041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2938"/><l level="1" sID="gen4042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2938"/>or ask the earth, and it will teach you,<l eID="gen4042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4043"/>and the fishes of the sea will declare to you. <l eID="gen4043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2939"/><l level="1" sID="gen4044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2939"/>Who among all of these does not know<l eID="gen4044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4045"/>that Yahweh’s hand has done this? <l eID="gen4045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2940"/><l level="1" sID="gen4046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2940"/>In whose hand <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the life of all living things<l eID="gen4046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4047"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the breath of every human being⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “the breath of all the flesh of man”</note> <l eID="gen4047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2941"/><l level="1" sID="gen4048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2941"/>Does not <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ear test words<l eID="gen4048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4049"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> palate taste food for itself? <l eID="gen4049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2942"/><l level="1" sID="gen4050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2942"/>Wisdom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> aged,<l eID="gen4050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4051"/>and understanding <transChange type="added">is in</transChange> length of days. <l eID="gen4051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2943"/><l level="1" sID="gen4052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2943"/>“With him <transChange type="added">are</transChange> wisdom and powerful deeds,<l eID="gen4052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4053"/>and to him <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> counsel and understanding. <l eID="gen4053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2944"/><l level="1" sID="gen4054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2944"/>If he tears down, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it will not be rebuilt;<l eID="gen4054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4055"/>if he shuts a man in, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he cannot be freed. <l eID="gen4055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2945"/><l level="1" sID="gen4056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2945"/>Look, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> he withholds the water,<note placement="foot">Or “waters”</note> then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> they dry up;<l eID="gen4056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4057"/>and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> he sends them out, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> they overwhelm <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land. <l eID="gen4057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2946"/><l level="1" sID="gen4058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2946"/>“Strength and sound wisdom <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with him;<l eID="gen4058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4059"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> deceived and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deceiver <transChange type="added">are</transChange> his.<note placement="foot">Or “for him”</note> <l eID="gen4059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2947"/><l level="1" sID="gen4060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2947"/>He leads counselors away stripped,<l eID="gen4060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4061"/>and he makes fools of judges. <l eID="gen4061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2948"/><l level="1" sID="gen4062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2948"/>He loosens <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fetters of kings,<l eID="gen4062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4063"/>and he binds a loincloth on their loins. <l eID="gen4063" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2949"/><l level="1" sID="gen4064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2949"/>He leads priests away stripped,<l eID="gen4064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4065"/>and he overthrows <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the members of ancient families⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the constant”</note> <l eID="gen4065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2950"/><l level="1" sID="gen4066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2950"/>He deprives <transChange type="added">the</transChange> trustworthy of speech,<l eID="gen4066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4067"/>and he takes away <transChange type="added">the</transChange> discretion of elders. <l eID="gen4067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2951"/><l level="1" sID="gen4068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2951"/>He pours contempt on noblemen,<l eID="gen4068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4069"/>and he loosens <transChange type="added">the</transChange> girdle of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty. <l eID="gen4069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2952"/><l level="1" sID="gen4070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2952"/>“He uncovers mysteries out of darkness,<l eID="gen4070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4071"/>and he brings deep shadow to the light. <l eID="gen4071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2953"/><l level="1" sID="gen4072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2953"/>He makes the nations great, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he destroys them;<l eID="gen4072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4073"/>he expands the nations, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he guides them. <l eID="gen4073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2954"/><l level="1" sID="gen4074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2954"/>He strips <transChange type="added">away</transChange> the insight of the heads of the earth’s people,<l eID="gen4074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4075"/>and he makes them wander in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a pathless wasteland⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in a wasteland not a way”</note> <l eID="gen4075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2955"/><l level="1" sID="gen4076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2955"/>They grope <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the dark <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not”</note> light,<l eID="gen4076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4077"/>and he makes them stagger like a<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> drunkard. <l eID="gen4077" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4026"/> <chapter eID="Job.12"/>

verses.name: Job 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2956"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Fourth Speech Continues</title> <div sID="gen4078" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen4078" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4079"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2956"/>“Look, my eye has seen everything;<l eID="gen4080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4081"/>my ear has heard and has understood it. <l eID="gen4081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2957"/><l level="1" sID="gen4082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2957"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> know⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Like your knowledge”</note> I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> also know—<l eID="gen4082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4083"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> not more inferior than you.<note placement="foot">Plural</note> <l eID="gen4083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2958"/><l level="1" sID="gen4084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2958"/>But I would speak to Shaddai,<l eID="gen4084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4085"/>and I desire to argue with God. <l eID="gen4085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2959"/><l level="1" sID="gen4086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2959"/>“But<note placement="foot">Or “And but”</note> you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whitewash with lies⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “coverers of lies”</note><l eID="gen4086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4087"/>all of you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞worthless healers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “healers of worthlessness”</note> <l eID="gen4087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2960"/><l level="1" sID="gen4088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2960"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who shall give”</note> you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> would keep completely silent,<l eID="gen4088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4089"/>and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> it would become wisdom for you.<note placement="foot">Plural</note> <l eID="gen4089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2961"/><l level="1" sID="gen4090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2961"/>Please hear my argument,<l eID="gen4090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4091"/>and listen attentively <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> pleadings of my lips. <l eID="gen4091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2962"/><l level="1" sID="gen4092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2962"/>“Will you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> speak falsely for God?<l eID="gen4092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4093"/>And will you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> speak deceitfully for him? <l eID="gen4093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2963"/><l level="1" sID="gen4094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2963"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Will you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> show partiality for him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “his faces will you raise”</note><l eID="gen4094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4095"/>Or do you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> want to plead God’s case? <l eID="gen4095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2964"/><l level="1" sID="gen4096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2964"/><transChange type="added">Will it be</transChange> well, if he examines you?<note placement="foot">Plural</note><l eID="gen4096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4097"/>Or can you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> deceive him like deceiving a human being? <l eID="gen4097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2965"/><l level="1" sID="gen4098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2965"/>“Surely he will rebuke you<note placement="foot">Plural</note><l eID="gen4098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4099"/>if <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> show partiality⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “faces you lift up”</note> in secret. <l eID="gen4099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2966"/><l level="1" sID="gen4100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2966"/>Will not his majesty terrify you,<note placement="foot">Plural</note><l eID="gen4100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4101"/>and his dread fall upon you?<note placement="foot">Plural</note> <l eID="gen4101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2967"/><l level="1" sID="gen4102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2967"/>Your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> maxims <transChange type="added">are</transChange> proverbs of ashes;<l eID="gen4102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4103"/>your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> defenses <transChange type="added">are</transChange> defenses of clay. <l eID="gen4103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2968"/><l level="1" sID="gen4104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2968"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Let me have silence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Be silent away from me”</note> and I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> will speak,<l eID="gen4104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4105"/>and let come over me whatever <transChange type="added">may</transChange>. <l eID="gen4105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2969"/><l level="1" sID="gen4106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2969"/>Why should I take my flesh in my teeth<l eID="gen4106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4107"/>and<note placement="foot">Hebrew “now”</note> put<note placement="foot">Or “should I put,” or “will I put”</note> my life in my hand? <l eID="gen4107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2970"/><l level="1" sID="gen4108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2970"/>Look,<note placement="foot">Or “Though”</note> though he kill me, I will hope in<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> him;<l eID="gen4108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4109"/>however, I will defend my ways <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to his faces”</note> <l eID="gen4109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2971"/><l level="1" sID="gen4110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2971"/>Moreover, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> salvation to me,<l eID="gen4110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4111"/>that <transChange type="added">the</transChange> godless would not come <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to his faces”</note> <l eID="gen4111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2972"/><l level="1" sID="gen4112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2972"/>“Listen carefully <transChange type="added">to</transChange> my words,<l eID="gen4112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4113"/>and <transChange type="added">let</transChange> my exposition <transChange type="added">be</transChange> in your ears. <l eID="gen4113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2973"/><l level="1" sID="gen4114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2973"/>Please look,<note placement="foot">Or “Look here”</note> I have prepared <transChange type="added">my</transChange> case;<l eID="gen4114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4115"/>I know that I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> will be vindicated. <l eID="gen4115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2974"/><l level="1" sID="gen4116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2974"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he who will contend with me?<l eID="gen4116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4117"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/> I would be silent, and I would pass away.<l eID="gen4117" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4079"/> <title type="x-s">Job Argues His Case with God</title> <div sID="gen4118" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen4118" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2975"/><lg sID="gen4119"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2975"/>“Only you<note placement="foot">Singular; the antecedent is God</note> must not do <transChange type="added">these</transChange> two <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to me;<l eID="gen4120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4121"/>then I will not hide from your face: <l eID="gen4121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2976"/><l level="1" sID="gen4122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2976"/>withdraw your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> hand from me,<l eID="gen4122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4123"/>and let not your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> dread terrify me. <l eID="gen4123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2977"/><l level="1" sID="gen4124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2977"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> call, and I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> will answer;<l eID="gen4124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4125"/>or let me speak, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> reply to me. <l eID="gen4125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2978"/><l level="1" sID="gen4126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2978"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How many⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Like what”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my iniquities and sins?<l eID="gen4126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4127"/>Make known to me my transgression and my sin. <l eID="gen4127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2979"/><l level="1" sID="gen4128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2979"/>Why do you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> hide your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> face<l eID="gen4128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4129"/>and count me as your<note placement="foot">Singular</note> enemy? <l eID="gen4129" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2980"/><l level="1" sID="gen4130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2980"/>Will you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> terrify a blown leaf?<l eID="gen4130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4131"/>And will you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> pursue dry stubble? <l eID="gen4131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2981"/><l level="1" sID="gen4132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2981"/>“Indeed, you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> write bitter things against me,<l eID="gen4132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4133"/>and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> make me reap the iniquities of my childhood. <l eID="gen4133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2982"/><l level="1" sID="gen4134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2982"/>And you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> put my feet in the block,<l eID="gen4134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4135"/>and you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> watch all my paths;<l eID="gen4135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4136"/>you carve <transChange type="added">a mark</transChange> on the soles of my feet.<note placement="foot">Or “You mark/note my footprints”</note> <l eID="gen4136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2983"/><l level="1" sID="gen4137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2983"/>And he himself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note>wastes away like something rotten,<l eID="gen4137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4138"/>like a garment that <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moth has eaten. <l eID="gen4138" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4119"/> <chapter eID="Job.13"/>

verses.name: Job 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2984"/><title type="x-s">Job Continues to Argue His Case with God</title> <div sID="gen4139" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen4139" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4140"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2984"/>“A human being born of a woman<l eID="gen4141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4142"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> short of days and full of troubles.<note placement="foot">Literally “trouble”</note> <l eID="gen4142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2985"/><l level="1" sID="gen4143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2985"/>Like a flower he comes up, and he withers away;<l eID="gen4143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4144"/>and he flees like a<note placement="foot">Or “the”</note> shadow, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he does not last. <l eID="gen4144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2986"/><l level="1" sID="gen4145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2986"/>Even on such a one you fix your eyes,<l eID="gen4145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4146"/>and you bring me into judgment with you. <l eID="gen4146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2987"/><l level="1" sID="gen4147"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2987"/>“Who can bring a clean <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> from an unclean <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>?<l eID="gen4147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4148"/>No one!<note placement="foot">Or “Not one”</note> <l eID="gen4148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2988"/><l level="1" sID="gen4149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2988"/>If his days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> determined, the number of his months <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with you;<l eID="gen4149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4150"/>you have appointed his boundaries, and he cannot cross <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <l eID="gen4150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2989"/><l level="1" sID="gen4151"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2989"/>Look away from him, and let him desist<l eID="gen4151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4152"/>until he enjoys his days like a laborer. <l eID="gen4152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2990"/><l level="1" sID="gen4153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2990"/>“Indeed, there is hope for a tree:<l eID="gen4153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4154"/>if it is cut down, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it will sprout again,<l eID="gen4154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4155"/>and its new shoots will not cease; <l eID="gen4155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2991"/><l level="1" sID="gen4156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2991"/>though its root grows old in the earth,<l eID="gen4156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4157"/>and its stump dies in the dust, <l eID="gen4157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2992"/><l level="1" sID="gen4158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2992"/>at<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from”</note> the scent of water it will bud,<l eID="gen4158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4159"/>and it will put forth branches like a young plant. <l eID="gen4159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2993"/><l level="1" sID="gen4160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2993"/>“But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> a man dies, and he dwindles away;<l eID="gen4160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4161"/>thus<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> a human being passes away, and where is he?<note placement="foot">Or “where is he then?”</note> <l eID="gen4161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2994"/><l level="1" sID="gen4162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2994"/><transChange type="added">As</transChange> water disappears from a lake,<l eID="gen4162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4163"/>and a river withers away and dries up,<note placement="foot">Or “it dries up”</note> <l eID="gen4163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2995"/><l level="1" sID="gen4164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2995"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> a man lies down, and he does not arise.<l eID="gen4164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4165"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Until the heavens are no more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Until not heavens”</note> they will not awaken,<l eID="gen4165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4166"/>and they will not be roused out of their sleep. <l eID="gen4166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2996"/><l level="1" sID="gen4167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2996"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who shall give”</note> you would conceal me in Sheol,<l eID="gen4167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4168"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> you would hide me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until your wrath is past⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until the return of your nose”</note><l eID="gen4168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4169"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> you would appoint a set time for me and remember me. <l eID="gen4169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2997"/><l level="1" sID="gen4170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2997"/>If a man dies, will he live <transChange type="added">again</transChange>?<l eID="gen4170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4171"/>All the days of my compulsory service I will wait,<l eID="gen4171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4172"/>until the coming of my relief. <l eID="gen4172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2998"/><l level="1" sID="gen4173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2998"/>You would call, and I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> would answer you;<l eID="gen4173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4174"/>you would long for the work of your hand. <l eID="gen4174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2999"/><l level="1" sID="gen4175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2999"/>For then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “now”</note> you would count my steps,<l eID="gen4175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4176"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> you would not keep watch over my sin. <l eID="gen4176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3000"/><l level="1" sID="gen4177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3000"/>My transgression would be sealed in a bag,<l eID="gen4177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4178"/>and you would cover over my guilt. <l eID="gen4178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3001"/><l level="1" sID="gen4179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3001"/>“But<note placement="foot">Or “And but”</note> a mountain falls; it crumbles away,<l eID="gen4179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4180"/>and a rock moves away from its place. <l eID="gen4180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3002"/><l level="1" sID="gen4181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3002"/>Water wears away stones;<l eID="gen4181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4182"/>its torrents wash away <transChange type="added">the</transChange> soil of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth;<l eID="gen4182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4183"/>so<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you destroy the hope of human beings. <l eID="gen4183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3003"/><l level="1" sID="gen4184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3003"/>You overpower him forever, and he passes away;<l eID="gen4184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4185"/><transChange type="added">you</transChange> change <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his countenance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his faces”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you send him away. <l eID="gen4185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3004"/><l level="1" sID="gen4186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3004"/>His children may <transChange type="added">come to</transChange> honor, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he does not know <transChange type="added">it</transChange>;<l eID="gen4186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4187"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> they may become lowly, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he does not realize it.<note placement="foot">Or “them”</note> <l eID="gen4187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3005"/><l level="1" sID="gen4188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3005"/>He feels only the pain of his own body,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his body on him”</note><l eID="gen4188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4189"/>and his inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> mourns for him.”<note placement="foot">Or “for himself”</note> <l eID="gen4189" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4140"/> <chapter eID="Job.14"/>

verses.name: Job 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3006"/><title type="x-s">Eliphaz’s Second Response to Job</title> <div sID="gen4190" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3006"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,  <div eID="gen4190" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3007"/><lg sID="gen4191"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3007"/>“Should <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise answer <transChange type="added">with</transChange> windy knowledge,<l eID="gen4192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4193"/>and should he fill his stomach <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> east wind? <l eID="gen4193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3008"/><l level="1" sID="gen4194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3008"/>Should he argue in talk <transChange type="added">that</transChange> is not profitable<l eID="gen4194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4195"/>or <transChange type="added">in</transChange> words with which he cannot do good? <l eID="gen4195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3009"/><l level="1" sID="gen4196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3009"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What is worse⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Also,” or “Even”</note> you yourself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> are doing away with fear,<l eID="gen4196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4197"/>and you are lessening meditation <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> God. <l eID="gen4197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3010"/><l level="1" sID="gen4198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3010"/>For your iniquity teaches your mouth,<l eID="gen4198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4199"/>and you choose <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tongue of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> crafty. <l eID="gen4199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3011"/><l level="1" sID="gen4200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3011"/>Your mouth condemns you, and not I;<l eID="gen4200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4201"/>and your lips testify against you. <l eID="gen4201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3012"/><l level="1" sID="gen4202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3012"/>“Were you born the firstborn of the human race?<l eID="gen4202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4203"/>And were you brought forth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hills? <l eID="gen4203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3013"/><l level="1" sID="gen4204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3013"/>Have you listened in God’s confidential discussion?<l eID="gen4204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4205"/>And do you limit wisdom to yourself? <l eID="gen4205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3014"/><l level="1" sID="gen4206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3014"/>What do you know that we do not know?<l eID="gen4206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4207"/><transChange type="added">What</transChange> do you understand that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not clear to us? <l eID="gen4207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3015"/><l level="1" sID="gen4208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3015"/>Both <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gray-haired and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> old <transChange type="added">are</transChange> among us—<l eID="gen4208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4209"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those older than your father⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “more aged than your father in days”</note> <l eID="gen4209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3016"/><l level="1" sID="gen4210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3016"/>“Are the consolations of God too small for you,<l eID="gen4210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4211"/>a word <transChange type="added">spoken</transChange> gently with you? <l eID="gen4211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3017"/><l level="1" sID="gen4212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3017"/>Why does your heart carry you away?<l eID="gen4212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4213"/>And why do your eyes flash, <l eID="gen4213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3018"/><l level="1" sID="gen4214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3018"/>that you turn your spirit against God,<l eID="gen4214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4215"/>and you let <transChange type="added">such</transChange> words go out of your mouth? <l eID="gen4215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3019"/><l level="1" sID="gen4216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3019"/>“What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a human being, that he can be clean,<l eID="gen4216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4217"/>or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> that <transChange type="added">one</transChange> born of a woman can be righteous? <l eID="gen4217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3020"/><l level="1" sID="gen4218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3020"/>Look, he does not trust his holy ones,<l eID="gen4218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4219"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens are not clean in his eyes. <l eID="gen4219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3021"/><l level="1" sID="gen4220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3021"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How much less⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Also for,” or “Indeed for,” or “Indeed that”</note> he who is abominable and corrupt,<note placement="foot">Or “he who is corrupt”</note><l eID="gen4220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4221"/>a man drinking wickedness like water. <l eID="gen4221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3022"/><l level="1" sID="gen4222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3022"/>“I will show you, listen to me;<l eID="gen4222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4223"/>and what I have seen, I will tell<note placement="foot">Literally “and I will tell”</note>— <l eID="gen4223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3023"/><l level="1" sID="gen4224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3023"/>what wise men have told,<l eID="gen4224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4225"/>and they have not hidden <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> from their ancestors, <l eID="gen4225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3024"/><l level="1" sID="gen4226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3024"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to whom alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to them to alone them”</note> the land was given,<l eID="gen4226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4227"/>and no stranger passed through their midst. <l eID="gen4227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3025"/><l level="1" sID="gen4228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3025"/>“All of the wicked <transChange type="added">one’s</transChange> days he is writhing,<l eID="gen4228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4229"/>even<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">through</transChange> the number of years that are laid up for the tyrant. <l eID="gen4229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3026"/><l level="1" sID="gen4230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3026"/>Sounds of terror <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in his ears;<l eID="gen4230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4231"/>in prosperity <transChange type="added">the</transChange> destroyer will come <transChange type="added">against</transChange> him. <l eID="gen4231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3027"/><l level="1" sID="gen4232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3027"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He cannot trust that he will return⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “He cannot trust to return,” or “He is not certain to return,” or “He cannot be sure to return” (compare NJPS)</note> from darkness,<l eID="gen4232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4233"/>and he himself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> is destined for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword. <l eID="gen4233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3028"/><l level="1" sID="gen4234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3028"/>“He is wandering for bread, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, ‘Where <transChange type="added">is it</transChange>?’<l eID="gen4234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4235"/>He knows that a day of darkness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> ready <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at hand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “at his hand”; the meaning seems to be, “his ruin is certain”</note> <l eID="gen4235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3029"/><l level="1" sID="gen4236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3029"/>Anguish and distress terrify him;<l eID="gen4236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4237"/>they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> overpower him like a king ready for the battle. <l eID="gen4237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3030"/><l level="1" sID="gen4238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3030"/>Because he stretched out his hand against God,<l eID="gen4238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4239"/>and he was arrogant to Shaddai; <l eID="gen4239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3031"/><l level="1" sID="gen4240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3031"/>he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞stubbornly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with neck”</note> runs against him<l eID="gen4240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4241"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with his thick-bossed shield⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with the thickness of the boss of his shield”</note> <l eID="gen4241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3032"/><l level="1" sID="gen4242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3032"/>“Because he has covered his face with his fat<l eID="gen4242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4243"/>and has gathered fat upon <transChange type="added">his</transChange> loins, <l eID="gen4243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3033"/><l level="1" sID="gen4244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3033"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will dwell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “and he will dwell”</note> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> desolate cities,<l eID="gen4244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4245"/>in houses that they should not inhabit,<l eID="gen4245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4246"/>which are destined for rubble. <l eID="gen4246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3034"/><l level="1" sID="gen4247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3034"/>He will not become rich, and his wealth will not endure,<l eID="gen4247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4248"/>and their possessions will not stretch across the earth.<note placement="foot">See HCSB, ESV; or “will not reach to the earth”; perhaps “his possessions will not go to the underworld”</note> <l eID="gen4248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3035"/><l level="1" sID="gen4249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3035"/>“He will not escape from darkness;<l eID="gen4249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4250"/>a flame will dry up his new shoot,<l eID="gen4250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4251"/>and by the wind of his mouth he shall be removed. <l eID="gen4251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3036"/><l level="1" sID="gen4252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3036"/>Let him not trust in emptiness—he will be deceiving himself—<l eID="gen4252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4253"/>for worthlessness will be his recompense. <l eID="gen4253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3037"/><l level="1" sID="gen4254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3037"/>It will be paid in full <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before his time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in not his day,” or “without his day”</note><l eID="gen4254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4255"/>and his branch will not flourish. <l eID="gen4255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3038"/><l level="1" sID="gen4256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3038"/>“He will shake off his unripe fruit like the vine,<l eID="gen4256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4257"/>and he will cast off his blossom like the olive tree; <l eID="gen4257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3039"/><l level="1" sID="gen4258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3039"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> company of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> godless <transChange type="added">is</transChange> barren,<l eID="gen4258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4259"/>and fire consumes the tents of those who accept bribes. <l eID="gen4259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3040"/><l level="1" sID="gen4260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3040"/><transChange type="added">They</transChange> conceive trouble and bring forth mischief,<l eID="gen4260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4261"/>and their womb prepares deceit.” <l eID="gen4261" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4191"/> <chapter eID="Job.15"/>

verses.name: Job 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3041"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Fifth Speech</title> <div sID="gen4262" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3041"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job answered and said,  <div eID="gen4262" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3042"/><lg sID="gen4263"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3042"/>“I have heard many <transChange type="added">things</transChange> like these;<l eID="gen4264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4265"/>all of you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞miserable comforters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “comforters of trouble”</note> <l eID="gen4265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3043"/><l level="1" sID="gen4266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3043"/><transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> a limit to windy words?<l eID="gen4266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4267"/>What provokes you that you answer? <l eID="gen4267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3044"/><l level="1" sID="gen4268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3044"/>I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun;</note> also could talk as you,<l eID="gen4268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4269"/>if <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you were in my place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “there is your soul in place of my soul”</note><l eID="gen4269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4270"/>I could join against you with words,<l eID="gen4270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4271"/>and I could shake at you with my head. <l eID="gen4271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3045"/><l level="1" sID="gen4272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3045"/>I could<note placement="foot">Or “would”</note> encourage you with my mouth,<l eID="gen4272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4273"/>and the solace of my lips would<note placement="foot">Or “should”</note> ease the pain. <l eID="gen4273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3046"/><l level="1" sID="gen4274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3046"/>If I speak, my pain is not relieved;<l eID="gen4274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4275"/>and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> I cease, how much will leave me? <l eID="gen4275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3047"/><l level="1" sID="gen4276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3047"/>“Surely now he has worn me out;<l eID="gen4276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4277"/>you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> have devastated all my company. <l eID="gen4277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3048"/><l level="1" sID="gen4278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3048"/>Thus<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> you shriveled me up;<note placement="foot">Or “you have seized me”</note><l eID="gen4278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4279"/>it became a witness.<l eID="gen4279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4280"/>And my leanness has risen up against me;<l eID="gen4280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4281"/>it testifies to my face. <l eID="gen4281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3049"/><l level="1" sID="gen4282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3049"/>His wrath has torn, and he has been hostile toward me;<l eID="gen4282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4283"/>he gnashed at me with his teeth.<l eID="gen4283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4284"/>My foe sharpens his eyes against me. <l eID="gen4284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3050"/><l level="1" sID="gen4285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3050"/>They gaped at me with their mouth;<l eID="gen4285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4286"/>they struck my cheeks with disgrace;<l eID="gen4286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4287"/>they have massed themselves together against me. <l eID="gen4287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3051"/><l level="1" sID="gen4288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3051"/>God delivers me to an evil one,<l eID="gen4288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4289"/>and he casts me into the hands of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked. <l eID="gen4289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3052"/><l level="1" sID="gen4290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3052"/>“I was at ease, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he broke me in two,<l eID="gen4290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4291"/>and he seized <transChange type="added">me</transChange> by my neck;<l eID="gen4291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4292"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he shattered me<l eID="gen4292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4293"/>and set me up as a target for him. <l eID="gen4293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3053"/><l level="1" sID="gen4294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3053"/>His archers surround me;<l eID="gen4294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4295"/>he slashes open my kidneys, and he does not have compassion;<l eID="gen4295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4296"/>he pours out my gall on the ground. <l eID="gen4296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3054"/><l level="1" sID="gen4297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3054"/>He breached me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞breach upon breach⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “breach upon the faces of breach”</note><l eID="gen4297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4298"/>he rushes at me like a warrior. <l eID="gen4298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3055"/><l level="1" sID="gen4299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3055"/>“I have sewed sackcloth on my skin,<l eID="gen4299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4300"/>and I have inserted <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my pride⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my horn”</note> in the dust. <l eID="gen4300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3056"/><l level="1" sID="gen4301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3056"/>My face is red because of weeping,<l eID="gen4301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4302"/>and deep shadows <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on my eyelids, <l eID="gen4302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3057"/><l level="1" sID="gen4303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3057"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞although⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “upon,” or “because”</note> violence <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not on my hands,<l eID="gen4303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4304"/>and my prayer <transChange type="added">is</transChange> pure. <l eID="gen4304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3058"/><l level="1" sID="gen4305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3058"/>“O earth, you should not cover my blood,<l eID="gen4305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4306"/>and let there be no place<note placement="foot">Or “do not let it become a place”</note> for my cry for help. <l eID="gen4306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3059"/><l level="1" sID="gen4307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3059"/>So now look, my witness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the heavens,<l eID="gen4307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4308"/>and he <transChange type="added">who</transChange> vouches for me <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the heights. <l eID="gen4308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3060"/><l level="1" sID="gen4309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3060"/>My friends scorn me;<l eID="gen4309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4310"/>my eye pours out tears to God, <l eID="gen4310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3061"/><l level="1" sID="gen4311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3061"/>and it argues<note placement="foot">Or “but may someone argue”</note> for a mortal with God,<l eID="gen4311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4312"/>and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a human⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of man”</note> for his friend. <l eID="gen4312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3062"/><l level="1" sID="gen4313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3062"/>Indeed, <transChange type="added">after</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a few years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “years of number”</note> have come,<l eID="gen4313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4314"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I will go <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way <transChange type="added">from which</transChange> I will not return. <l eID="gen4314" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4263"/> <chapter eID="Job.16"/>

verses.name: Job 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3063"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Fifth Speech, Continued</title> <div sID="gen4315" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen4315" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4316"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3063"/>“My spirit is pulled down; my days are extinguished;<l eID="gen4317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4318"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> graveyard <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for me. <l eID="gen4318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:2
