verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3064"/><l level="1" sID="gen4319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3064"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If not”</note> mockery <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with me,<l eID="gen4319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4320"/>and my eye <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rests⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spends the night”</note> on their provocation. <l eID="gen4320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3065"/><l level="1" sID="gen4321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3065"/>Please lay down a pledge for me with yourself;<l eID="gen4321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4322"/>who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he <transChange type="added">who</transChange> will give security for my hand?<note placement="foot">Or “who will give security for me?”</note> <l eID="gen4322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3066"/><l level="1" sID="gen4323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3066"/>Indeed,<note placement="foot">Or “For”</note> you have closed their mind from understanding;<l eID="gen4323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4324"/>therefore, you will not let <transChange type="added">them</transChange> triumph. <l eID="gen4324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3067"/><l level="1" sID="gen4325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3067"/>He denounces friends for reward,<l eID="gen4325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4326"/>so<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> his children’s eyes will fail. <l eID="gen4326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3068"/><l level="1" sID="gen4327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3068"/>“And he has made me a proverb for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen4327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4328"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and I am one before whom people spit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and spitting to the faces I am”</note> <l eID="gen4328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3069"/><l level="1" sID="gen4329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3069"/>And my eye has grown dim from grief,<l eID="gen4329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4330"/>and the limbs of my body <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all<note placement="foot">Hebrew “all of them”</note> like a shadow. <l eID="gen4330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3070"/><l level="1" sID="gen4331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3070"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> upright are appalled at this,<l eID="gen4331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4332"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> innocent excites himself over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> godless. <l eID="gen4332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3071"/><l level="1" sID="gen4333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3071"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous holds on to his way,<l eID="gen4333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4334"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he who has clean hands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the clean of hands”</note> increases in strength. <l eID="gen4334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3072"/><l level="1" sID="gen4335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3072"/>But<note placement="foot">Literally “And but”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all of you must return⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of them you must return”</note>—<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞please come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “and please come,” or “come on!”</note><l eID="gen4335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4336"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> I shall not find a wise <transChange type="added">person</transChange> among you. <l eID="gen4336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3073"/><l level="1" sID="gen4337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3073"/>“My days are past; my plans are broken down—<l eID="gen4337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4338"/><transChange type="added">even</transChange> the desires of my heart. <l eID="gen4338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3074"/><l level="1" sID="gen4339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3074"/>They make night into day,<l eID="gen4339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4340"/><transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, ‘Light <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞near to darkness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “near from the faces of darkness”</note> <l eID="gen4340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3075"/><l level="1" sID="gen4341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3075"/>If I hope <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Sheol <transChange type="added">as</transChange> my house,<l eID="gen4341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4342"/><transChange type="added">if</transChange> I spread my couch in the darkness, <l eID="gen4342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3076"/><l level="1" sID="gen4343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3076"/><transChange type="added">if</transChange> I call to the pit, ‘You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my father,’<l eID="gen4343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4344"/>to the maggot, ‘<transChange type="added">You are</transChange> my mother or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> my sister,’ <l eID="gen4344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3077"/><l level="1" sID="gen4345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3077"/>where<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and where”</note> then <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my hope?<l eID="gen4345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4346"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who will see my hope⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “my hope who will see it”</note> <l eID="gen4346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3078"/><l level="1" sID="gen4347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3078"/>Will they go down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the bars of Sheol?<l eID="gen4347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4348"/>Or shall we descend together into the dust?” <l eID="gen4348" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4316"/> <chapter eID="Job.17"/>

verses.name: Job 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3079"/><title type="x-s">Bildad’s Second Speech</title> <div sID="gen4349" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3079"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,  <div eID="gen4349" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3080"/><lg sID="gen4350"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3080"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Until when”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> hunt for words⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “will you set a snare for words”</note><l eID="gen4351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4352"/>Consider,<note placement="foot">Or “you should consider”; plural second person</note> and afterward we shall speak. <l eID="gen4352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3081"/><l level="1" sID="gen4353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3081"/>Why are we considered as animals?<l eID="gen4353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4354"/><transChange type="added">Why</transChange> are we taken as<note placement="foot">Or “considered”</note> stupid in your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> eyes? <l eID="gen4354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3082"/><l level="1" sID="gen4355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3082"/>“<transChange type="added">You who</transChange> are tearing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his soul,” or “his individual self”</note> in your<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> anger,<l eID="gen4355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4356"/>will <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth be forsaken because of you?<note placement="foot">Singular</note><l eID="gen4356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4357"/>Or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> will <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rock be removed from its place? <l eID="gen4357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3083"/><l level="1" sID="gen4358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3083"/>Furthermore,<note placement="foot">Or “Also”</note> the light of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked is put out,<l eID="gen4358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4359"/>and the flame of his fire will not shine. <l eID="gen4359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3084"/><l level="1" sID="gen4360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3084"/>The light becomes dark in his tent,<l eID="gen4360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4361"/>and his lamp above him is put out. <l eID="gen4361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3085"/><l level="1" sID="gen4362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3085"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞His strong steps⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The steps of his power”</note> are shortened,<l eID="gen4362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4363"/>and his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> schemes<note placement="foot">Collective singular</note> throw him down, <l eID="gen4363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3086"/><l level="1" sID="gen4364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3086"/>for he is thrust into a net by his feet,<l eID="gen4364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4365"/>and he walks into a pitfall. <l eID="gen4365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3087"/><l level="1" sID="gen4366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3087"/>A trap seizes <transChange type="added">him</transChange> by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heel;<l eID="gen4366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4367"/>a snare takes hold of him. <l eID="gen4367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3088"/><l level="1" sID="gen4368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3088"/>His rope is hidden in the ground,<l eID="gen4368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4369"/>and his trap on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> path. <l eID="gen4369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3089"/><l level="1" sID="gen4370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3089"/>“Sudden terrors terrify him all around,<l eID="gen4370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4371"/>and they chase him at his heels. <l eID="gen4371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3090"/><l level="1" sID="gen4372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3090"/>His wealth will become hunger,<l eID="gen4372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4373"/>and disaster is ready for his stumbling. <l eID="gen4373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3091"/><l level="1" sID="gen4374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3091"/>It consumes parts of his skin;<l eID="gen4374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4375"/>the firstborn of death consumes his limbs. <l eID="gen4375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3092"/><l level="1" sID="gen4376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3092"/>He is torn from his tent <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in which he trusted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his trust”</note><l eID="gen4376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4377"/>and it brought him to the king of terrors. <l eID="gen4377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3093"/><l level="1" sID="gen4378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3093"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Nothing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “From not”</note> remains for him in his tent;<l eID="gen4378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4379"/>sulfur is scattered upon his dwelling place. <l eID="gen4379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3094"/><l level="1" sID="gen4380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3094"/>His roots dry up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞below⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from under”</note><l eID="gen4380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4381"/>and its branches<note placement="foot">Singular collective</note> wither away above.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from above”</note> <l eID="gen4381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3095"/><l level="1" sID="gen4382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3095"/>His remembrance perishes from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen4382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4383"/>and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> not a name for him on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> street. <l eID="gen4383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3096"/><l level="1" sID="gen4384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3096"/>“They thrust him from light into darkness,<l eID="gen4384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4385"/>and they drive him out from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world. <l eID="gen4385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3097"/><l level="1" sID="gen4386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3097"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> no offspring for him nor<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and not”</note> a descendant among his people,<l eID="gen4386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4387"/>and there is not a survivor in his abode. <l eID="gen4387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3098"/><l level="1" sID="gen4388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3098"/><transChange type="added">Those of the</transChange> west are appalled over <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his fate⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his day”</note><l eID="gen4388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4389"/>and <transChange type="added">those of the</transChange> east <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are seized with horror⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they seize horror”</note> <l eID="gen4389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3099"/><l level="1" sID="gen4390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3099"/>Surely these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the dwellings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> godless,<l eID="gen4390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4391"/>and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the dwelling place of him <transChange type="added">who</transChange> knows not God.” <l eID="gen4391" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4350"/> <chapter eID="Job.18"/>

verses.name: Job 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3100"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Sixth Speech: A Response to Bildad</title> <div sID="gen4392" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3100"/> Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job answered and said,  <div eID="gen4392" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3101"/><lg sID="gen4393"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3101"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Until when”</note> will you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> torment me<note placement="foot">Hebrew “my soul,” or “my self”</note><l eID="gen4394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4395"/>and crush me with words? <l eID="gen4395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3102"/><l level="1" sID="gen4396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3102"/>These ten times you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> have disgraced me;<l eID="gen4396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4397"/>you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> are not ashamed that you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> have attacked<note placement="foot">Or “astonished”</note> me. <l eID="gen4397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3103"/><l level="1" sID="gen4398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3103"/>And what is more, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> I have truly erred,<l eID="gen4398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4399"/>my error remains with me. <l eID="gen4399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3104"/><l level="1" sID="gen4400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3104"/>If indeed you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must magnify yourselves against me,<l eID="gen4400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4401"/>and you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> must let my disgrace argue against me, <l eID="gen4401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3105"/><l level="1" sID="gen4402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3105"/>know then that God has wronged me<l eID="gen4402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4403"/>and has surrounded me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> his net. <l eID="gen4403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3106"/><l level="1" sID="gen4404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3106"/>“Look, I cry out, ‘Violence!’ but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I am not answered;<l eID="gen4404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4405"/>I cry out, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> there is no justice. <l eID="gen4405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3107"/><l level="1" sID="gen4406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3107"/>He has walled up my way so that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I cannot pass;<l eID="gen4406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4407"/>and he has set darkness upon my paths. <l eID="gen4407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3108"/><l level="1" sID="gen4408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3108"/>He has taken my glory from me,<l eID="gen4408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4409"/>and he has removed the crown of<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> my head. <l eID="gen4409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3109"/><l level="1" sID="gen4410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3109"/>He has broken me down all around, and I am gone.<l eID="gen4410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4411"/>And he has uprooted my hope like a tree, <l eID="gen4411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3110"/><l level="1" sID="gen4412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3110"/>and he has kindled his wrath against me,<l eID="gen4412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4413"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he has counted me as one of his foes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he has counted me for him as his foes”</note> <l eID="gen4413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3111"/><l level="1" sID="gen4414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3111"/>His troops have come together<l eID="gen4414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4415"/>and have thrown up their rampart<note placement="foot">Or “siege works”; compare NRSV</note> against me<l eID="gen4415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4416"/>and have encamped around my tent. <l eID="gen4416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3112"/><l level="1" sID="gen4417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3112"/>“He has removed my kinsfolk from me,<l eID="gen4417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4418"/>and my acquaintances have only<note placement="foot">Or “completely”</note> turned aside from me. <l eID="gen4418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3113"/><l level="1" sID="gen4419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3113"/>My relatives have failed,<l eID="gen4419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4420"/>and my close friends have forgotten me. <l eID="gen4420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3114"/><l level="1" sID="gen4421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3114"/>The sojourners in<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> my house and my slave women count me as a stranger;<l eID="gen4421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4422"/>I have become a foreigner in their eyes. <l eID="gen4422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3115"/><l level="1" sID="gen4423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3115"/>I call to my servant, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he does not answer;<l eID="gen4423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4424"/>I must <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞personally⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with my mouth”</note> plead with him. <l eID="gen4424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3116"/><l level="1" sID="gen4425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3116"/>My breath is repulsive to my wife,<l eID="gen4425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4426"/>and I am loathsome to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my own family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the children of my womb”</note> <l eID="gen4426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3117"/><l level="1" sID="gen4427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3117"/>Little boys also despise me;<l eID="gen4427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4428"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> I rise, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> they talk against me. <l eID="gen4428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3118"/><l level="1" sID="gen4429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3118"/>All <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my intimate friends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the men of the circle of my confidants”</note> abhor me,<l eID="gen4429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4430"/>and these <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> I have loved have turned against me. <l eID="gen4430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3119"/><l level="1" sID="gen4431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3119"/>My bones<note placement="foot">Collective singular</note> cling to my skin and to my flesh,<l eID="gen4431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4432"/>and I have escaped by the skin of my teeth. <l eID="gen4432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3120"/><l level="1" sID="gen4433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3120"/>“Pity me, pity me, you my friends,<l eID="gen4433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4434"/>for God’s hand has touched me. <l eID="gen4434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3121"/><l level="1" sID="gen4435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3121"/>Why do you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> pursue me like God?<l eID="gen4435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4436"/>And are not satisfied with my flesh? <l eID="gen4436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3122"/><l level="1" sID="gen4437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3122"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who then shall give and”</note> my words could be written down!<l eID="gen4437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4438"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O that they could be inscribed in a scroll⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “Who shall give in the scroll and they could be inscribed”</note> <l eID="gen4438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3123"/><l level="1" sID="gen4439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3123"/><transChange type="added">That</transChange> with a pen of iron and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> lead<l eID="gen4439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4440"/>they might be engraved on a rock forever! <l eID="gen4440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3124"/><l level="1" sID="gen4441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3124"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> know <transChange type="added">that</transChange> my redeemer <transChange type="added">is</transChange> alive,<l eID="gen4441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4442"/>and <transChange type="added">at the</transChange> last he will stand up upon <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the earth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “dust”</note> <l eID="gen4442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3125"/><l level="1" sID="gen4443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3125"/>And after my skin has been thus destroyed,<l eID="gen4443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4444"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> from<note placement="foot">Or “without”</note> my flesh I will see God, <l eID="gen4444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3126"/><l level="1" sID="gen4445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3126"/>whom <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will see for myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I myself will see for myself”; emphatic personal pronoun as subject to the singular verb</note><l eID="gen4445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4446"/>and <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> my eyes will see and not a stranger.<note placement="foot">Or “another”</note><l eID="gen4446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4447"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞My heart faints within me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “My kidneys fail in my lap”; see NRSV</note> <l eID="gen4447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3127"/><l level="1" sID="gen4448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3127"/>“If you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> say, ‘How will we persecute him?’<l eID="gen4448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4449"/>And ‘The root of the trouble is found’ in me,<note placement="foot">Or “ ‘The root of the trouble is found’ in him”</note> <l eID="gen4449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3128"/><l level="1" sID="gen4450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3128"/>be afraid for yourselves <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the faces of the sword”</note><l eID="gen4450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4451"/>for wrath <transChange type="added">brings</transChange> punishment by<note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword,<l eID="gen4451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4452"/>so that you may know that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> judgment.” <l eID="gen4452" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4393"/> <chapter eID="Job.19"/>

verses.name: Job 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3129"/><title type="x-s">Zophar’s Second Speech</title> <div sID="gen4453" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3129"/> Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,  <div eID="gen4453" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 20:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3130"/><lg sID="gen4454"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3130"/>“Therefore my disquieting thoughts bring me back<l eID="gen4455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4456"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the sake of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and in because of”</note> my inward excitement.<note placement="foot">Or “my inward haste”</note> <l eID="gen4456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3131"/><l level="1" sID="gen4457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3131"/>I hear discipline that insults me,<l eID="gen4457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4458"/>and a spirit beyond my understanding answers me. <l eID="gen4458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3132"/><l level="1" sID="gen4459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3132"/>“Did you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> know this from of old,<l eID="gen4459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4460"/>since the setting of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> human being on earth, <l eID="gen4460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3133"/><l level="1" sID="gen4461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3133"/>that <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rejoicing of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞short⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from near”</note><l eID="gen4461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4462"/>and the joy of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> godless <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lasts only a moment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “is until a moment”</note> <l eID="gen4462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3134"/><l level="1" sID="gen4463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3134"/>Even though his stature mounts up to the heaven,<l eID="gen4463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4464"/>and his head reaches to the clouds, <l eID="gen4464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3135"/><l level="1" sID="gen4465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3135"/>he will perish forever like his dung;<l eID="gen4465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4466"/><transChange type="added">those who</transChange> have seen him will say, ‘Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he?’ <l eID="gen4466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3136"/><l level="1" sID="gen4467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3136"/>He will fly away like a dream, and they will not find him,<l eID="gen4467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4468"/>and he will be chased away like a vision of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night. <l eID="gen4468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3137"/><l level="1" sID="gen4469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3137"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> eye <transChange type="added">that</transChange> saw him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will not see him again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and it will not do again”</note><l eID="gen4469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4470"/>and his place will no longer behold him. <l eID="gen4470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3138"/><l level="1" sID="gen4471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3138"/>His children will seek favors from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor,<l eID="gen4471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4472"/>and his hands will return his wealth. <l eID="gen4472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3139"/><l level="1" sID="gen4473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3139"/>His bones were full of his vigor,<l eID="gen4473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4474"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it will lie down with him on<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust. <l eID="gen4474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3140"/><l level="1" sID="gen4475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3140"/>“Though wickedness tastes sweet in his mouth,<l eID="gen4475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4476"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> he hides it under his tongue, <l eID="gen4476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3141"/><l level="1" sID="gen4477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3141"/><transChange type="added">though</transChange> he spares it and does not let it go<l eID="gen4477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4478"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> holds it back in the midst of his palate, <l eID="gen4478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3142"/><l level="1" sID="gen4479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3142"/>in his bowels his food is turned,<l eID="gen4479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4480"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> venom of horned vipers <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in his entrails”</note> <l eID="gen4480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3143"/><l level="1" sID="gen4481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3143"/>He swallows riches, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he vomits them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> <transChange type="added">up</transChange>;<l eID="gen4481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4482"/>God drives them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> out from his stomach. <l eID="gen4482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3144"/><l level="1" sID="gen4483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3144"/>He will suck <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poison of horned vipers;<l eID="gen4483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4484"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> viper’s tongue will kill him. <l eID="gen4484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3145"/><l level="1" sID="gen4485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3145"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He will not enjoy the streams⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “He will not look on streams”</note><l eID="gen4485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4486"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> torrents of honey and curds. <l eID="gen4486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3146"/><l level="1" sID="gen4487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3146"/>Returning <transChange type="added">the</transChange> products of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> toil, he will not swallow;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and he will not swallow”</note><l eID="gen4487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4488"/>according to the profit of his trade, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will not enjoy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and he will not taste”</note> <l eID="gen4488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3147"/><l level="1" sID="gen4489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3147"/>for he has oppressed; he has abandoned <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor;<l eID="gen4489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4490"/>he has seized a house but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> did not build it. <l eID="gen4490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3148"/><l level="1" sID="gen4491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3148"/>Because he has not known satisfaction in his stomach,<l eID="gen4491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4492"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he lets nothing escape that he desires⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in his desire he does not let be saved”</note> <l eID="gen4492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3149"/><l level="1" sID="gen4493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3149"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞There is nothing left after he has eaten⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “There is not a remnant at his eating”</note><l eID="gen4493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4494"/>therefore his prosperity will not endure. <l eID="gen4494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3150"/><l level="1" sID="gen4495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3150"/>In the fullness of his excess <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will be in distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “it will be in distress for him”</note><l eID="gen4495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4496"/>all of misery’s power will come <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> him. <l eID="gen4496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3151"/><l level="1" sID="gen4497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3151"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When his stomach fills up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “It will be to fill up his stomach”</note> God will send <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his burning anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the blaze of his nose/anger”</note> upon him,<l eID="gen4497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4498"/>and he will let <transChange type="added">it</transChange> rain down upon him<note placement="foot">Or “them”</note> as his food. <l eID="gen4498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3152"/><l level="1" sID="gen4499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3152"/>“He will flee from an iron weapon,<l eID="gen4499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4500"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> an arrow of bronze will pierce him. <l eID="gen4500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3153"/><l level="1" sID="gen4501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3153"/>He draws <transChange type="added">it</transChange> forth, and it comes out from <transChange type="added">his</transChange> body,<l eID="gen4501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4502"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> glittering point comes from his gall-bladder;<l eID="gen4502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4503"/>terrors come upon him. <l eID="gen4503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3154"/><l level="1" sID="gen4504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3154"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Total darkness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All darkness”</note> is hidden for his treasures;<note placement="foot">Or “His treasures are hidden by total darkness”</note><l eID="gen4504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4505"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an unfanned fire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a fire not fanned”</note> will devour him;<l eID="gen4505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4506"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> remnant<note placement="foot">Of his treasures</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will be consumed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will be evil,” or “will be bad”</note> in his tent. <l eID="gen4506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3155"/><l level="1" sID="gen4507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3155"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> heavens will reveal his guilt,<l eID="gen4507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4508"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth will rise up against him. <l eID="gen4508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3156"/><l level="1" sID="gen4509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3156"/>The products of his house will be carried away<note placement="foot">Or “the produce of his house will go away into exile”</note><l eID="gen4509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4510"/><transChange type="added">like</transChange> gushing waters<note placement="foot">Or “by gushing waters”</note> on the day of his wrath. <l eID="gen4510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3157"/><l level="1" sID="gen4511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3157"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a wicked human being’s portion from God<l eID="gen4511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4512"/>and the inheritance of his decree from God.”<note placement="foot">Or “and the inheritance decreed for him by God” (compare ESV, NJPS)</note> <l eID="gen4512" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4454"/> <chapter eID="Job.20"/>

verses.name: Job 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3158"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Seventh Speech: A Response to Zophar</title> <div sID="gen4513" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3158"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job answered and said,  <div eID="gen4513" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3159"/><lg sID="gen4514"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3159"/>“Listen carefully to my words,<l eID="gen4515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4516"/>and let this be your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> consolation. <l eID="gen4516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3160"/><l level="1" sID="gen4517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3160"/>Bear <transChange type="added">with</transChange> me, and I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> will speak;<l eID="gen4517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4518"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> after my speaking you can mock. <l eID="gen4518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3161"/><l level="1" sID="gen4519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3161"/><transChange type="added">As for</transChange> me, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my complaint for human beings?<l eID="gen4519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4520"/>And if <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, why cannot I be impatient? <l eID="gen4520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3162"/><l level="1" sID="gen4521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3162"/>Turn to me and be appalled,<l eID="gen4521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4522"/>and place <transChange type="added">your</transChange> hand on <transChange type="added">your</transChange> mouth. <l eID="gen4522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3163"/><l level="1" sID="gen4523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3163"/>And when I think of <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, I am horrified,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and I am horrified”</note><l eID="gen4523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4524"/>and shuddering seizes my flesh. <l eID="gen4524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3164"/><l level="1" sID="gen4525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3164"/>“Why do <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked live,<l eID="gen4525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4526"/>grow old, even grow mighty <transChange type="added">in</transChange> power? <l eID="gen4526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3165"/><l level="1" sID="gen4527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3165"/>With them their offspring <transChange type="added">are</transChange> established <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to their faces”</note><l eID="gen4527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4528"/>and their descendants before their eyes. <l eID="gen4528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3166"/><l level="1" sID="gen4529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3166"/>Their houses <transChange type="added">are</transChange> safe without fear,<l eID="gen4529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4530"/>and the rod of God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not upon them. <l eID="gen4530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3167"/><l level="1" sID="gen4531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3167"/>His bull breeds and does not fail;<l eID="gen4531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4532"/>his cow calves and does not miscarry. <l eID="gen4532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3168"/><l level="1" sID="gen4533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3168"/>They send out their little ones like the flock,<l eID="gen4533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4534"/>and their children dance around. <l eID="gen4534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3169"/><l level="1" sID="gen4535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3169"/>They <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they lift up their voices”</note> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tambourine and lyre,<l eID="gen4535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4536"/>and they rejoice to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> long flute. <l eID="gen4536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3170"/><l level="1" sID="gen4537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3170"/>They spend their days in prosperity,<l eID="gen4537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4538"/>and in peace they go down to Sheol. <l eID="gen4538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3171"/><l level="1" sID="gen4539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3171"/>And they say to God, ‘Turn away from us,<l eID="gen4539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4540"/>for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> we do not desire to know your ways. <l eID="gen4540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3172"/><l level="1" sID="gen4541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3172"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Shaddai that we should serve him,<l eID="gen4541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4542"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> what would we benefit when we plead with him?’ <l eID="gen4542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3173"/><l level="1" sID="gen4543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3173"/>Look, their prosperity <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not in their hands;<l eID="gen4543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4544"/>the schemes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked are repugnant<note placement="foot">Or “the plan of the wicked is repugnant”</note> to me. <l eID="gen4544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3174"/><l level="1" sID="gen4545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3174"/>“How often is <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lamp of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked put out,<l eID="gen4545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4546"/>and their disaster comes upon them?<l eID="gen4546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4547"/>He<note placement="foot">The antecedent is “God,” or possibly “the Almighty”</note> distributes pains in his anger. <l eID="gen4547" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3175"/><l level="1" sID="gen4548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3175"/><transChange type="added">How often</transChange> are they like straw <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> the wind,<l eID="gen4548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4549"/>and like chaff that <transChange type="added">the</transChange> storm carries away? <l eID="gen4549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3176"/><l level="1" sID="gen4550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3176"/>‘God stores up his iniquity for his children’?<note placement="foot">Or “You say, ‘God stores up his iniquity for his children.’ ”</note><l eID="gen4550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4551"/><transChange type="added">Then</transChange> let him repay <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to him that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he may know. <l eID="gen4551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3177"/><l level="1" sID="gen4552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3177"/>Let his eyes see his decay,<l eID="gen4552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4553"/>and let him drink from the wrath of Shaddai, <l eID="gen4553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3178"/><l level="1" sID="gen4554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3178"/>for what <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞does he care for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his joy in”</note> his house after him,<l eID="gen4554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4555"/>when the number of his months is<note placement="foot">Hebrew “are”</note> cut off? <l eID="gen4555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3179"/><l level="1" sID="gen4556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3179"/>Can anyone teach knowledge to God,<l eID="gen4556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4557"/>since<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he himself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> judges high ones? <l eID="gen4557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3180"/><l level="1" sID="gen4558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3180"/>This <transChange type="added">one</transChange> dies <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in full prosperity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the vigor of his prosperity”</note><l eID="gen4558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4559"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞completely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of him”</note> at ease and secure. <l eID="gen4559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3181"/><l level="1" sID="gen4560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3181"/>His vats are full <transChange type="added">with</transChange> milk<l eID="gen4560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4561"/>and the marrow of his bones is moist. <l eID="gen4561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3182"/><l level="1" sID="gen4562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3182"/>Yet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> another dies with a bitter inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note><l eID="gen4562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4563"/>and has not tasted prosperity. <l eID="gen4563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3183"/><l level="1" sID="gen4564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3183"/>They lie down together in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust,<l eID="gen4564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4565"/>and maggots cover them. <l eID="gen4565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3184"/><l level="1" sID="gen4566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3184"/>“Look, I know your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> thoughts<l eID="gen4566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4567"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> schemes you devise against me. <l eID="gen4567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3185"/><l level="1" sID="gen4568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3185"/>For you say, ‘Where is the nobleman’s house,<l eID="gen4568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4569"/>and where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the tents in which the wicked dwell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?’<note placement="foot">Literally “tent of dwelling places of wicked”</note> <l eID="gen4569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3186"/><l level="1" sID="gen4570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3186"/>Do you not ask <transChange type="added">those</transChange> traveling <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roads,<l eID="gen4570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4571"/>and do you not take notice of their accounts? <l eID="gen4571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3187"/><l level="1" sID="gen4572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3187"/>Indeed, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked is spared from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of disaster;<l eID="gen4572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4573"/>he is delivered from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of wrath. <l eID="gen4573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3188"/><l level="1" sID="gen4574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3188"/>Who denounces his way to his face?<l eID="gen4574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4575"/>And who repays him <transChange type="added">for what</transChange> he has done? <l eID="gen4575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3189"/><l level="1" sID="gen4576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3189"/>When<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> he is brought to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grave,<l eID="gen4576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4577"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> someone stands guard over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tomb. <l eID="gen4577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3190"/><l level="1" sID="gen4578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3190"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> clods of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> valley are sweet to him;<l eID="gen4578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4579"/>everyone will follow after him,<l eID="gen4579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4580"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they are innumerable⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not number”</note> <l eID="gen4580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3191"/><l level="1" sID="gen4581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3191"/>So<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> how will you comfort me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> emptiness,<l eID="gen4581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4582"/>when<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> fraud is left <transChange type="added">in</transChange> your answers?” <l eID="gen4582" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4514"/> <chapter eID="Job.21"/>

verses.name: Job 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3192"/><title type="x-s">Eliphaz’s Third Speech</title> <div sID="gen4583" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3192"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,  <div eID="gen4583" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3193"/><lg sID="gen4584"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3193"/>“Can a man be of use to God?<l eID="gen4585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4586"/>Yes, can <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise be of use to him? <l eID="gen4586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3194"/><l level="1" sID="gen4587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3194"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> it a pleasure to Shaddai if you are righteous,<l eID="gen4587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4588"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> a gain if you make your ways blameless? <l eID="gen4588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3195"/><l level="1" sID="gen4589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3195"/>Does he reprove you because of your reverence<l eID="gen4589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4590"/><transChange type="added">or</transChange> enter into judgment with you? <l eID="gen4590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3196"/><l level="1" sID="gen4591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3196"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not your wickedness great,<l eID="gen4591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4592"/>and there is no end to your iniquities? <l eID="gen4592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3197"/><l level="1" sID="gen4593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3197"/>“Indeed, you have required a pledge from your family for nothing,<l eID="gen4593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4594"/>and you have stripped off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clothes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> naked. <l eID="gen4594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3198"/><l level="1" sID="gen4595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3198"/>You have given no water <transChange type="added">for the</transChange> weary to drink,<l eID="gen4595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4596"/>and you withheld food from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hungry. <l eID="gen4596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3199"/><l level="1" sID="gen4597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3199"/>And the land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞belongs to the man of power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “man of power for him”</note><l eID="gen4597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4598"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the favored⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lifted up of face”</note> lives in it. <l eID="gen4598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3200"/><l level="1" sID="gen4599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3200"/>You have sent widows away empty-handed,<l eID="gen4599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4600"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> arms of orphans were crushed. <l eID="gen4600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3201"/><l level="1" sID="gen4601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3201"/>Therefore trapping nets <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all around you,<l eID="gen4601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4602"/>and panic suddenly terrifies you, <l eID="gen4602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3202"/><l level="1" sID="gen4603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3202"/>or <transChange type="added">it is so</transChange> dark you cannot see,<l eID="gen4603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4604"/>and a flood of water covers you. <l eID="gen4604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3203"/><l level="1" sID="gen4605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3203"/>“<transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not God <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> height of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens?<l eID="gen4605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4606"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> see how lofty are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the highest stars⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “top of stars,” or “head of stars”</note> <l eID="gen4606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3204"/><l level="1" sID="gen4607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3204"/>And you ask, ‘What does God know?<l eID="gen4607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4608"/>Can he judge through deep gloom? <l eID="gen4608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3205"/><l level="1" sID="gen4609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3205"/>Thick clouds <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a covering for him, so that he does not see;<l eID="gen4609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4610"/>and he walks about on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dome of heaven.’ <l eID="gen4610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3206"/><l level="1" sID="gen4611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3206"/>Will you keep <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> way of old<l eID="gen4611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4612"/>that <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people of mischief have trod, <l eID="gen4612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3207"/><l level="1" sID="gen4613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3207"/>who were snatched away <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before their time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and not time”</note><l eID="gen4613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4614"/>whose foundation was washed away <transChange type="added">by</transChange> a current? <l eID="gen4614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3208"/><l level="1" sID="gen4615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3208"/><transChange type="added">Those</transChange> who said to God, ‘Turn away from us,’<l eID="gen4615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4616"/>and ‘What can Shaddai do to us?’ <l eID="gen4616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3209"/><l level="1" sID="gen4617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3209"/>Yet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> he himself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> filled up their houses <transChange type="added">with</transChange> good <transChange type="added">things</transChange>,<l eID="gen4617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4618"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> schemes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked are repugnant to me. <l eID="gen4618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3210"/><l level="1" sID="gen4619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3210"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> righteous see, and they rejoice,<l eID="gen4619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4620"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> innocent <transChange type="added">one</transChange> mocks at them. <l eID="gen4620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3211"/><l level="1" sID="gen4621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3211"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If not”</note> our foe perishes,<l eID="gen4621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4622"/>and fire has consumed their remainder.<note placement="foot">Or “their wealth”</note> <l eID="gen4622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3212"/><l level="1" sID="gen4623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3212"/>“Please reconcile yourself with him,<l eID="gen4623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4624"/>and be at peace; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in this way⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “by them”</note> good will come to you. <l eID="gen4624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3213"/><l level="1" sID="gen4625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3213"/>Please receive instruction from his mouth,<l eID="gen4625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4626"/>and place his words in your heart. <l eID="gen4626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3214"/><l level="1" sID="gen4627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3214"/>If you return to Shaddai, you will be restored;<l eID="gen4627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4628"/><transChange type="added">if</transChange> you remove wickedness from your tent, <l eID="gen4628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3215"/><l level="1" sID="gen4629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3215"/>and <transChange type="added">if you</transChange> put gold ore in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust,<l eID="gen4629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4630"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gold of Ophir in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rock of wadis, <l eID="gen4630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3216"/><l level="1" sID="gen4631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3216"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Shaddai will be your gold ore<l eID="gen4631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4632"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your precious silver⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “silver of the best for you,” or “silver of the best belonging to you”</note> <l eID="gen4632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3217"/><l level="1" sID="gen4633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3217"/>Indeed, then you will delight yourself in Shaddai,<l eID="gen4633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4634"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will expect that God will be good to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you will lift up to God your face”</note> <l eID="gen4634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3218"/><l level="1" sID="gen4635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3218"/>You will pray to him, and he will hear you,<l eID="gen4635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4636"/>and you will pay your vows. <l eID="gen4636" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3219"/><l level="1" sID="gen4637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3219"/>And you will decide on a matter, and it will be established for you,<l eID="gen4637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4638"/>and light will shine on your ways. <l eID="gen4638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3220"/><l level="1" sID="gen4639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3220"/>When they are humiliated, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and you say,” or “then you say”</note> ‘<transChange type="added">It is</transChange> pride,’<l eID="gen4639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4640"/>for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he saves <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the humble⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “downward of eyes”</note> <l eID="gen4640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3221"/><l level="1" sID="gen4641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3221"/>He will deliver the guilty,<l eID="gen4641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4642"/>and he will escape because of the cleanness of your hands.” <l eID="gen4642" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4584"/> <chapter eID="Job.22"/>

verses.name: Job 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3222"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Eighth Speech: A Response to Eliphaz</title> <div sID="gen4643" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3222"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job answered and said,  <div eID="gen4643" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3223"/><lg sID="gen4644"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3223"/>“Even today my complaint <transChange type="added">is</transChange> bitter;<l eID="gen4645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4646"/>my hand is heavy in addition to my groaning. <l eID="gen4646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3224"/><l level="1" sID="gen4647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3224"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who shall give”</note> I knew and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I might find him;<l eID="gen4647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4648"/><transChange type="added">O that</transChange> I might come to his dwelling. <l eID="gen4648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3225"/><l level="1" sID="gen4649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3225"/>I would lay <transChange type="added">my</transChange> case <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to his face”</note><l eID="gen4649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4650"/>and I would fill my mouth <transChange type="added">with</transChange> arguments. <l eID="gen4650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3226"/><l level="1" sID="gen4651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3226"/>I want to know <transChange type="added">the</transChange> words <transChange type="added">with which</transChange> he would answer me,<l eID="gen4651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4652"/>and I want to understand what he would say to me. <l eID="gen4652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3227"/><l level="1" sID="gen4653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3227"/>Would he contend with me in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> greatness of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> strength?<l eID="gen4653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4654"/>No, but he himself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> would give heed to me. <l eID="gen4654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3228"/><l level="1" sID="gen4655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3228"/>There an upright person could reason with him,<l eID="gen4655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4656"/>and I would be acquitted forever by my judge. <l eID="gen4656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3229"/><l level="1" sID="gen4657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3229"/>“When I go forward, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he is not there⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and there is not he,” or “and he is not”</note><l eID="gen4657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4658"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> backward, I cannot see him.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and I cannot see him”</note> <l eID="gen4658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3230"/><l level="1" sID="gen4659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3230"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When he works⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At his working”</note> on the left, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I cannot perceive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and I cannot see”</note> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>;<l eID="gen4659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4660"/>he turns to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> right, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I cannot see <transChange type="added">him</transChange>. <l eID="gen4660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:10
