verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3231"/><l level="1" sID="gen4661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3231"/>But he knows <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the way that I take⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “way with me”</note><l eID="gen4661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4662"/>he tests me—I shall come out like gold. <l eID="gen4662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3232"/><l level="1" sID="gen4663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3232"/>My foot has held on to his steps;<l eID="gen4663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4664"/>I have kept his way, and I have not turned aside. <l eID="gen4664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3233"/><l level="1" sID="gen4665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3233"/><transChange type="added">From</transChange> the commandment of his lips, indeed<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I have not departed;<l eID="gen4665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4666"/>I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my daily food. <l eID="gen4666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3234"/><l level="1" sID="gen4667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3234"/>“But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> he is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as one”</note> and who can dissuade him?<l eID="gen4667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4668"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whatever he desires⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his inner self desires,” or “his soul desires”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞indeed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he does <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <l eID="gen4668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3235"/><l level="1" sID="gen4669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3235"/>For he will carry out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what he appoints for me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “my portion,” or “my allotment”</note><l eID="gen4669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4670"/>and many <transChange type="added">things</transChange> like these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with him. <l eID="gen4670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3236"/><l level="1" sID="gen4671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3236"/>Therefore, I am horrified because of his presence;<l eID="gen4671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4672"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> I consider, I tremble<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and I tremble,” or “then I tremble”</note> because of him. <l eID="gen4672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3237"/><l level="1" sID="gen4673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3237"/>Indeed,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> God has made my heart faint,<l eID="gen4673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4674"/>and Shaddai has terrified me. <l eID="gen4674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3238"/><l level="1" sID="gen4675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3238"/>Indeed, I have not been silenced <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of darkness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of darkness”</note><l eID="gen4675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4676"/>and because of me he<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> conceals thick darkness. <l eID="gen4676" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4644"/> <chapter eID="Job.23"/>

verses.name: Job 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3239"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Eighth Speech, Continued</title> <div sID="gen4677" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen4677" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4678"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3239"/>“Why are not times kept by Shaddai,<l eID="gen4679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4680"/>and <transChange type="added">why</transChange> do not <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> know him see his days? <l eID="gen4680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3240"/><l level="1" sID="gen4681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3240"/>They<note placement="foot">Or “Some” (NASU, ESV) or “Men” (NIV, NET)</note> remove border <transChange type="added">stones</transChange>;<l eID="gen4681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4682"/>they seize flocks, and they pasture <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <l eID="gen4682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3241"/><l level="1" sID="gen4683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3241"/>They drive away <transChange type="added">the</transChange> donkey of orphans;<l eID="gen4683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4684"/>they take <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow’s ox as a pledge. <l eID="gen4684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3242"/><l level="1" sID="gen4685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3242"/>They thrust <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor off the road;<l eID="gen4685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4686"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth hide themselves together.<note placement="foot">Or “altogether”</note> <l eID="gen4686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3243"/><l level="1" sID="gen4687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3243"/>“Look, <transChange type="added">like</transChange> wild donkeys in the desert<l eID="gen4687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4688"/>they<note placement="foot">That is, the poor</note> go out to their labor <transChange type="added">as</transChange> searchers for the prey;<l eID="gen4688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4689"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> wilderness <transChange type="added">is</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “provides”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “for their”</note> food for the young. <l eID="gen4689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3244"/><l level="1" sID="gen4690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3244"/>They reap their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> fodder in the field,<l eID="gen4690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4691"/>and they glean <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> vineyard of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked. <l eID="gen4691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3245"/><l level="1" sID="gen4692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3245"/>They spend the night naked, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from not”</note> clothing,<l eID="gen4692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4693"/>and <transChange type="added">they</transChange> have no garment in the cold. <l eID="gen4693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3246"/><l level="1" sID="gen4694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3246"/>They are wet from the rainstorm of the mountains,<note placement="foot">Or “from the mountain rainstorm”</note><l eID="gen4694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4695"/>and they cling to the rock <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from not”</note> refuge. <l eID="gen4695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3247"/><l level="1" sID="gen4696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3247"/>“They<note placement="foot">That is, those who oppress the poor</note> snatch <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> breast,<l eID="gen4696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4697"/>and they take a pledge against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy.<note placement="foot">Or “And they take the child of the needy as a pledge”</note> <l eID="gen4697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3248"/><l level="1" sID="gen4698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3248"/>They<note placement="foot">That is, the poor</note> go about naked, without clothing,<l eID="gen4698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4699"/>and hungry, they carry <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sheaves.<note placement="foot">Or “and they carry the sheaves though hungry”</note> <l eID="gen4699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3249"/><l level="1" sID="gen4700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3249"/>Between their terraces they press out oil;<l eID="gen4700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4701"/>they tread <transChange type="added">the</transChange> presses, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> they are thirsty. <l eID="gen4701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3250"/><l level="1" sID="gen4702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3250"/>From <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city people groan,<l eID="gen4702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4703"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> throat<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wounded cries for help;<l eID="gen4703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4704"/>yet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> God does not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞regard it as unseemly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he puts offensiveness”</note> <l eID="gen4704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3251"/><l level="1" sID="gen4705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3251"/>“Those are among <transChange type="added">the ones</transChange> rebelling <transChange type="added">against the</transChange> light;<l eID="gen4705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4706"/>they do not recognize his ways,<l eID="gen4706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4707"/>and they do not stay in his paths. <l eID="gen4707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3252"/><l level="1" sID="gen4708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3252"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞At dusk⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At the light”</note> the murderer rises;<l eID="gen4708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4709"/>he kills <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor,<l eID="gen4709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4710"/>and in the night he is like a<note placement="foot">Or “the”</note> thief. <l eID="gen4710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3253"/><l level="1" sID="gen4711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3253"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eye of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> adulterer waits for dusk,<l eID="gen4711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4712"/>saying, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞‘No eye will see me,’⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “ ‘An eye will not see me’ ”</note><l eID="gen4712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4713"/>and he places a covering <transChange type="added">on his</transChange> face. <l eID="gen4713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3254"/><l level="1" sID="gen4714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3254"/>He digs through houses in the darkness;<l eID="gen4714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4715"/>by day they shut themselves in—<l eID="gen4715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4716"/>they do not know <transChange type="added">the</transChange> light <l eID="gen4716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3255"/><l level="1" sID="gen4717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3255"/>because morning likewise is to them deep darkness;<l eID="gen4717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4718"/>indeed, they know about <transChange type="added">the</transChange> terrors of deep darkness. <l eID="gen4718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3256"/><l level="1" sID="gen4719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3256"/>“He himself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> swift on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> water’s surface;<l eID="gen4719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4720"/>their portion is cursed in the land.<l eID="gen4720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4721"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞No one turns toward the path of their vineyards⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “He does not turn toward the path of the vineyard”</note> <l eID="gen4721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3257"/><l level="1" sID="gen4722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3257"/>Drought and heat snatch away <transChange type="added">the</transChange> snow waters,<l eID="gen4722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4723"/><transChange type="added">like</transChange> Sheol <transChange type="added">snatches away</transChange> those<note placement="foot">Or “they/them”</note> <transChange type="added">who have</transChange> sinned. <l eID="gen4723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3258"/><l level="1" sID="gen4724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3258"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> womb forgets him.<l eID="gen4724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4725"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> maggot feasts on him <transChange type="added">until</transChange> he is no longer remembered,<l eID="gen4725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4726"/>and wickedness is broken like a<note placement="foot">Or “the”</note> tree. <l eID="gen4726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3259"/><l level="1" sID="gen4727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3259"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> feeds on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> barren, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> does not have a child,<l eID="gen4727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4728"/>and does no good to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow. <l eID="gen4728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3260"/><l level="1" sID="gen4729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3260"/>Yet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> he<note placement="foot">The probable antecedent is God</note> carries off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tyrants by his strength;<l eID="gen4729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4730"/><transChange type="added">if</transChange> he rises up, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he<note placement="foot">The antecedent of the singular here probably changes to the wicked person</note> cannot be certain of life.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the life”</note> <l eID="gen4730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3261"/><l level="1" sID="gen4731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3261"/>He<note placement="foot">The probable antecedent is God</note> gives security to him, and he is<note placement="foot">Or “they are”</note> supported,<l eID="gen4731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4732"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> his eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> upon their ways. <l eID="gen4732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3262"/><l level="1" sID="gen4733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3262"/>They are exalted a little while, then<note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they are gone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he is not”</note><l eID="gen4733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4734"/>And they are brought low; they are cut off like all <transChange type="added">others</transChange>,<l eID="gen4734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4735"/>and like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heads of grain they wither away. <l eID="gen4735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3263"/><l level="1" sID="gen4736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3263"/>“And if <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, then who can prove me a liar<l eID="gen4736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4737"/>and reduce my word to nothing?” <l eID="gen4737" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4678"/> <chapter eID="Job.24"/>

verses.name: Job 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3264"/><title type="x-s">Bildad’s Third Speech</title> <div sID="gen4738" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3264"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Bildad the Shuhite answered and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he said”</note>  <div eID="gen4738" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 25:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3265"/><lg sID="gen4739"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3265"/>“Domination and dread <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with him<l eID="gen4740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4741"/>who makes peace in his high heavens. <l eID="gen4741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 25:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3266"/><l level="1" sID="gen4742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3266"/>Is there a number to his troops?<l eID="gen4742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4743"/>And upon whom does his light not rise? <l eID="gen4743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3267"/><l level="1" sID="gen4744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3267"/>“Indeed,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> how can a human being be righteous before God?<l eID="gen4744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4745"/>And how will he who is born of a woman be pure? <l eID="gen4745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3268"/><l level="1" sID="gen4746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3268"/>Look, even <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moon <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is not bright⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and it is not bright”</note><l eID="gen4746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4747"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stars are not pure in his sight. <l eID="gen4747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3269"/><l level="1" sID="gen4748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3269"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How much less⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Also”</note> for a human being <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> a maggot,<l eID="gen4748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4749"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a human⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of man,” or “a son of Adam”</note> <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> a worm?” <l eID="gen4749" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4739"/> <chapter eID="Job.25"/>

verses.name: Job 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3270"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Ninth Speech: A Response to Bildad</title> <div sID="gen4750" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3270"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job answered and said,  <div eID="gen4750" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3271"/><lg sID="gen4751"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3271"/>“How you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> have helped <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one who has no power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “for not power”</note><l eID="gen4752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4753"/><transChange type="added">How</transChange> you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> have assisted the arm <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that has no strength⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “not strength”</note> <l eID="gen4753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3272"/><l level="1" sID="gen4754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3272"/>How you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> have advised <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one who has no wisdom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “for not wisdom”</note><l eID="gen4754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4755"/>And <transChange type="added">what</transChange> sound wisdom you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> have made known <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in abundance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “as far as the multitude,” or “for multitude”</note> <l eID="gen4755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3273"/><l level="1" sID="gen4756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3273"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞With whose help⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “With whom”</note> have you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> uttered words,<l eID="gen4756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4757"/>and whose breath has come forth from you?<note placement="foot">Singular</note> <l eID="gen4757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3274"/><l level="1" sID="gen4758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3274"/>“The spirits of the dead tremble<l eID="gen4758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4759"/>below <transChange type="added">the</transChange> waters and their inhabitants. <l eID="gen4759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3275"/><l level="1" sID="gen4760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3275"/>Sheol <transChange type="added">is</transChange> naked before him,<l eID="gen4760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4761"/>and there is no covering for Abaddon. <l eID="gen4761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3276"/><l level="1" sID="gen4762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3276"/>He stretches out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north over emptiness;<l eID="gen4762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4763"/><transChange type="added">he</transChange> hangs <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞over nothing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “over not what”</note> <l eID="gen4763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3277"/><l level="1" sID="gen4764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3277"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> ties up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> water in its clouds,<l eID="gen4764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4765"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cloud is not torn open beneath it.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “them”; antecedent for “them” is “water” (literally “waters”)</note> <l eID="gen4765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3278"/><l level="1" sID="gen4766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3278"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> covers <transChange type="added">the</transChange> face of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> full moon;<note placement="foot">Text reads “throne”; “full moon” is based on a change of the vowels</note><l eID="gen4766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4767"/><transChange type="added">he</transChange> spreads his cloud over it. <l eID="gen4767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3279"/><l level="1" sID="gen4768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3279"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He has described a circle⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">NRSV; literally “a limit he has circled”</note> on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> face of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> water<l eID="gen4768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4769"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞between light and darkness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “at the end of light with darkness”</note> <l eID="gen4769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3280"/><l level="1" sID="gen4770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3280"/>“<transChange type="added">The</transChange> pillars of heaven tremble,<l eID="gen4770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4771"/>and they are astounded at his rebuke. <l eID="gen4771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3281"/><l level="1" sID="gen4772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3281"/>By his power he stilled the sea,<l eID="gen4772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4773"/>and by his understanding he struck down Rahab. <l eID="gen4773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3282"/><l level="1" sID="gen4774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3282"/>By his breath <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the heavens were made clear⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “heavens clearness”</note><l eID="gen4774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4775"/>his hand pierced <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fleeing snake. <l eID="gen4775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3283"/><l level="1" sID="gen4776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3283"/>Look, these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the outer fringes of his ways,<l eID="gen4776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4777"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how faint is the word⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “how whisper of word”</note> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> we hear of him!<l eID="gen4777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4778"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> who can understand the thunder of his power?” <l eID="gen4778" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4751"/> <chapter eID="Job.26"/>

verses.name: Job 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3284"/><title type="x-s">Job Continues His Final Speech</title> <div sID="gen4779" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3284"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job again took up his discourse and said,  <div eID="gen4779" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 27:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3285"/><lg sID="gen4780"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3285"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As God lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “The life of God”</note> he has removed my justice,<l eID="gen4781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4782"/>and Shaddai has made my inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> bitter. <l eID="gen4782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3286"/><l level="1" sID="gen4783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3286"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as long as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of still”</note> my breath <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in me,<l eID="gen4783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4784"/>and the spirit of God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in my nose, <l eID="gen4784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3287"/><l level="1" sID="gen4785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3287"/>my lips surely will not speak falseness,<l eID="gen4785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4786"/>and my tongue surely will not utter deceit. <l eID="gen4786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3288"/><l level="1" sID="gen4787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3288"/>Far be it from me that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I would say that you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> are right⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “I would declare you as in the right”</note><l eID="gen4787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4788"/>until I pass away, I will not put away from me my blamelessness. <l eID="gen4788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3289"/><l level="1" sID="gen4789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3289"/>I hold fast to my righteousness, and I will not let it go;<l eID="gen4789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4790"/>my heart will not blame <transChange type="added">any</transChange> of my days. <l eID="gen4790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3290"/><l level="1" sID="gen4791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3290"/>“Let my enemy be like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked<l eID="gen4791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4792"/>and my opponent like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> unrighteous, <l eID="gen4792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3291"/><l level="1" sID="gen4793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3291"/>for what <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> hope of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> godless when he cuts <transChange type="added">them</transChange> off,<l eID="gen4793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4794"/>when God takes away his life? <l eID="gen4794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3292"/><l level="1" sID="gen4795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3292"/>Will God hear his cry of distress<l eID="gen4795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4796"/>when distress comes upon him? <l eID="gen4796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3293"/><l level="1" sID="gen4797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3293"/>Or, in Shaddai will he find delight?<l eID="gen4797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4798"/>Will he call upon God at all times? <l eID="gen4798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3294"/><l level="1" sID="gen4799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3294"/>“I will teach you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> about<note placement="foot">Or “concerning”</note> God’s hand;<l eID="gen4799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4800"/>I will not conceal that <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> with Shaddai. <l eID="gen4800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3295"/><l level="1" sID="gen4801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3295"/>Look, you all have seen,<l eID="gen4801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4802"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞why in the world⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “why this”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have you become altogether vain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “vain you have become vain”</note> <l eID="gen4802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3296"/><l level="1" sID="gen4803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3296"/>“This <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> portion of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked human being with God,<l eID="gen4803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4804"/>and they receive from Shaddai <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inheritance of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ruthless. <l eID="gen4804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3297"/><l level="1" sID="gen4805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3297"/>If their children multiply, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword,<l eID="gen4805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4806"/>and his offspring <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞do not have enough to eat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they are not satisfied with bread”</note> <l eID="gen4806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3298"/><l level="1" sID="gen4807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3298"/>Their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “His”</note> survivors are buried through<note placement="foot">Or “because of”</note> the plague,<l eID="gen4807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4808"/>and their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> widows do not weep. <l eID="gen4808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3299"/><l level="1" sID="gen4809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3299"/>If he heaps up silver like the dust<l eID="gen4809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4810"/>and fashions clothing like the clay, <l eID="gen4810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3300"/><l level="1" sID="gen4811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3300"/>he makes <transChange type="added">it</transChange> ready, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous will wear <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,<l eID="gen4811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4812"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> innocent will divide <transChange type="added">the</transChange> silver. <l eID="gen4812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3301"/><l level="1" sID="gen4813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3301"/>“He builds his house like the moth,<l eID="gen4813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4814"/>and like a booth <transChange type="added">that</transChange> a watchman has made. <l eID="gen4814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3302"/><l level="1" sID="gen4815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3302"/>He goes to bed <transChange type="added">with</transChange> wealth, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will do so no more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “he will not do again”</note><l eID="gen4815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4816"/>he opens his eyes, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is gone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it is not”</note> <l eID="gen4816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3303"/><l level="1" sID="gen4817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3303"/>Terrors overtake him like the water;<l eID="gen4817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4818"/>a storm wind carries him off <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> night. <l eID="gen4818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3304"/><l level="1" sID="gen4819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3304"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> east wind lifts him up, and he is gone,<l eID="gen4819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4820"/>and it sweeps him away from his place. <l eID="gen4820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3305"/><l level="1" sID="gen4821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3305"/>And it hurls at him, and it has no compassion;<l eID="gen4821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4822"/>he will quickly flee from its power. <l eID="gen4822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3306"/><l level="1" sID="gen4823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3306"/>It claps its hands over him,<l eID="gen4823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4824"/>and it hisses at him from its place. <l eID="gen4824" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4780"/> <chapter eID="Job.27"/>

verses.name: Job 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3307"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Discourse on Wisdom</title> <div sID="gen4825" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen4825" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4826"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3307"/>“Indeed, there is a mine for silver<l eID="gen4827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4828"/>and a place <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for gold to be refined⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for the gold they refine”</note> <l eID="gen4828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3308"/><l level="1" sID="gen4829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3308"/>Iron is taken from dust,<l eID="gen4829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4830"/>and he pours out copper <transChange type="added">from</transChange> ore. <l eID="gen4830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3309"/><l level="1" sID="gen4831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3309"/>He puts an end to darkness,<l eID="gen4831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4832"/>and he searches out the farthest limits<l eID="gen4832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4833"/><transChange type="added">for the</transChange> ore <transChange type="added">in</transChange> gloom and deep shadow. <l eID="gen4833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3310"/><l level="1" sID="gen4834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3310"/>He breaks open a mine shaft <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞away from where people dwell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “from with dwelling”</note><l eID="gen4834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4835"/><transChange type="added">those</transChange> who are forgotten <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by travelers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “by feet”</note><l eID="gen4835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4836"/>they dangle, they sway <transChange type="added">far away</transChange> from human beings. <l eID="gen4836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3311"/><l level="1" sID="gen4837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3311"/><transChange type="added">As for the</transChange> earth, from it comes food,<note placement="foot">Or “bread”</note><l eID="gen4837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4838"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> underneath it, it is turned up as <transChange type="added">by</transChange> fire. <l eID="gen4838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3312"/><l level="1" sID="gen4839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3312"/>Its stones <transChange type="added">are the</transChange> place of sapphire,<l eID="gen4839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4840"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earthen dirt <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞has⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for it”</note> gold. <l eID="gen4840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3313"/><l level="1" sID="gen4841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3313"/>“<transChange type="added">It is</transChange> a path a bird of prey does not know<l eID="gen4841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4842"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> black kite’s eye has not seen. <l eID="gen4842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3314"/><l level="1" sID="gen4843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3314"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Proud wild animals⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The sons of pride”</note> have not trodden it;<l eID="gen4843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4844"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> lion in its prime has not prowled over it. <l eID="gen4844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3315"/><l level="1" sID="gen4845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3315"/>He puts his hand on the hard rock;<l eID="gen4845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4846"/>he overturns mountains by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roots. <l eID="gen4846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3316"/><l level="1" sID="gen4847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3316"/>He cuts out tunnels in the rocks,<l eID="gen4847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4848"/>and his eye sees every treasure. <l eID="gen4848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3317"/><l level="1" sID="gen4849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3317"/>He dams up rivers from <transChange type="added">their</transChange> sources,<l eID="gen4849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4850"/>and he brings secret things to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> light. <l eID="gen4850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3318"/><l level="1" sID="gen4851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3318"/>“But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> from where will wisdom be found?<l eID="gen4851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4852"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where in the world⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “where this”</note> <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> place of understanding? <l eID="gen4852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3319"/><l level="1" sID="gen4853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3319"/>A human being does not know its proper value,<l eID="gen4853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4854"/>and it is not found in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of the living. <l eID="gen4854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3320"/><l level="1" sID="gen4855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3320"/>The deep says, ‘It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not in me,’<l eID="gen4855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4856"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea says, ‘It is not with me.’ <l eID="gen4856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3321"/><l level="1" sID="gen4857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3321"/>“Refined gold cannot be gotten in its place,<l eID="gen4857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4858"/>and silver cannot be weighed out <transChange type="added">as</transChange> its price. <l eID="gen4858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3322"/><l level="1" sID="gen4859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3322"/>It cannot be bought for the gold of Ophir,<l eID="gen4859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4860"/>for precious onyx or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> sapphire. <l eID="gen4860" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3323"/><l level="1" sID="gen4861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3323"/>Gold and glass cannot be compared with it,<l eID="gen4861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4862"/>and its substitution <transChange type="added">cannot be</transChange> an ornament of refined gold. <l eID="gen4862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3324"/><l level="1" sID="gen4863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3324"/>Black corals and crystal will not be mentioned,<l eID="gen4863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4864"/>and wisdom’s price <transChange type="added">is</transChange> more than red corals. <l eID="gen4864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3325"/><l level="1" sID="gen4865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3325"/>The topaz of Cush cannot be compared with it;<l eID="gen4865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4866"/>it cannot be bought for pure gold. <l eID="gen4866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3326"/><l level="1" sID="gen4867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3326"/>Indeed,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> from where does wisdom come?<l eID="gen4867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4868"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where in the world⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “where this”</note> <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> place of understanding? <l eID="gen4868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3327"/><l level="1" sID="gen4869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3327"/>It is hidden from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of all living,<l eID="gen4869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4870"/>and it is concealed from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> birds of the heaven. <l eID="gen4870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3328"/><l level="1" sID="gen4871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3328"/>Abaddon and Death say,<l eID="gen4871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4872"/>‘We heard its rumor with our ears.’ <l eID="gen4872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3329"/><l level="1" sID="gen4873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3329"/>“God understands its way,<l eID="gen4873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4874"/>and he knows its place, <l eID="gen4874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3330"/><l level="1" sID="gen4875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3330"/>for he himself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> looks to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end of the earth;<l eID="gen4875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4876"/>he sees under all the heaven. <l eID="gen4876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3331"/><l level="1" sID="gen4877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3331"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When he gave⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To give”</note> weight to the wind<l eID="gen4877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4878"/>and he apportioned <transChange type="added">the</transChange> waters by measure, <l eID="gen4878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3332"/><l level="1" sID="gen4879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3332"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at his making”</note> a rule for the rain<l eID="gen4879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4880"/>and a way for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thunder’s lightning bolt, <l eID="gen4880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3333"/><l level="1" sID="gen4881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3333"/>then he saw it and talked about it;<l eID="gen4881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4882"/>he established it, and moreover, he explored it. <l eID="gen4882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3334"/><l level="1" sID="gen4883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3334"/>And to the human beings he said,<l eID="gen4883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4884"/>‘Look, the fear of the Lord <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wisdom,<l eID="gen4884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4885"/>and to depart from evil <transChange type="added">is</transChange> understanding.’ ” <l eID="gen4885" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4826"/> <chapter eID="Job.28"/>

verses.name: Job 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3335"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Final Defense</title> <div sID="gen4886" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3335"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job again took up his discourse and said,  <div eID="gen4886" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 29:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3336"/><lg sID="gen4887"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3336"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O that I were⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who shall give me”</note> as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the months before,<l eID="gen4888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4889"/>as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the days <transChange type="added">when</transChange> God watched over me, <l eID="gen4889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3337"/><l level="1" sID="gen4890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3337"/>when his shining lamp <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over my head—<l eID="gen4890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4891"/>by his light I walked through darkness— <l eID="gen4891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3338"/><l level="1" sID="gen4892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3338"/>as when I was in the days of my prime,<l eID="gen4892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4893"/>when God’s confiding <transChange type="added">was</transChange> over my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “tent”</note> <l eID="gen4893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3339"/><l level="1" sID="gen4894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3339"/>when Shaddai<transChange type="added">was</transChange> still with me,<l eID="gen4894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4895"/>my children <transChange type="added">were</transChange> all around me, <l eID="gen4895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3340"/><l level="1" sID="gen4896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3340"/>when my paths were washed in sour milk,<l eID="gen4896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4897"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rock poured out streams of oil for me. <l eID="gen4897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3341"/><l level="1" sID="gen4898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3341"/>“At my going out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gate to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city,<l eID="gen4898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4899"/>I secured my seat in the square. <l eID="gen4899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3342"/><l level="1" sID="gen4900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3342"/>Young men saw me and stepped aside,<l eID="gen4900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4901"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> aged rose up <transChange type="added">and</transChange> stood. <l eID="gen4901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3343"/><l level="1" sID="gen4902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3343"/>Officials refrained from talking,<l eID="gen4902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4903"/>and they laid <transChange type="added">their</transChange> hand on their mouth. <l eID="gen4903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3344"/><l level="1" sID="gen4904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3344"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> voices<note placement="foot">Hebrew “voice”; collective singular by context, governing a plural verb</note> of nobles were hushed,<l eID="gen4904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4905"/>and their tongue stuck to their palate. <l eID="gen4905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3345"/><l level="1" sID="gen4906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3345"/>“When <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ear heard and commended me,<l eID="gen4906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4907"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eye saw and testified in support of me <l eID="gen4907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3346"/><l level="1" sID="gen4908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3346"/>because I saved <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy who cried for help,<l eID="gen4908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4909"/>and <transChange type="added">I saved</transChange><note placement="foot">Supplying the elided verb from the preceding parallel line</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan for whom <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> no helper. <l eID="gen4909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3347"/><l level="1" sID="gen4910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3347"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> blessing of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wretched came upon me,<l eID="gen4910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4911"/>and I caused <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow’s heart to sing for joy. <l eID="gen4911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3348"/><l level="1" sID="gen4912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3348"/>I put on righteousness, and it clothed me;<l eID="gen4912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4913"/>my justice <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like a robe and a headband. <l eID="gen4913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3349"/><l level="1" sID="gen4914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3349"/>“I was eyes to the blind,<l eID="gen4914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4915"/>and I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> feet to the lame. <l eID="gen4915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3350"/><l level="1" sID="gen4916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3350"/>I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a father to the poor,<l eID="gen4916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4917"/>and I investigated <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the stranger’s⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the one I knew not”</note> legal dispute. <l eID="gen4917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3351"/><l level="1" sID="gen4918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3351"/>And I broke <transChange type="added">the</transChange> evil one’s jaw bones,<l eID="gen4918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4919"/>and I made <transChange type="added">his</transChange> prey drop from his teeth. <l eID="gen4919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3352"/><l level="1" sID="gen4920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3352"/>“And I thought, ‘I will pass away in my nest,<l eID="gen4920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4921"/>and like the phoenix I shall multiply <transChange type="added">my</transChange> days. <l eID="gen4921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3353"/><l level="1" sID="gen4922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3353"/>My roots <transChange type="added">were</transChange> open to water,<l eID="gen4922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4923"/>and dew spent the night on my branches; <l eID="gen4923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3354"/><l level="1" sID="gen4924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3354"/>My glory <transChange type="added">was</transChange> new with me,<l eID="gen4924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4925"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I was revitalized regularly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">See NJPS; literally “my bow in my hand was new”</note> <l eID="gen4925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3355"/><l level="1" sID="gen4926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3355"/>“They listened to me and waited,<l eID="gen4926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4927"/>and they kept silent for my counsel. <l eID="gen4927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3356"/><l level="1" sID="gen4928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3356"/>After my word, they did not speak again,<l eID="gen4928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4929"/>and my word dropped down <transChange type="added">like dew</transChange> upon them. <l eID="gen4929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3357"/><l level="1" sID="gen4930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3357"/>And they waited for me as <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the rain,<l eID="gen4930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4931"/>and they opened their mouth wide <transChange type="added">as</transChange> for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spring rain. <l eID="gen4931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3358"/><l level="1" sID="gen4932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3358"/>I smiled for them <transChange type="added">when</transChange> they had no confidence <transChange type="added">in anything</transChange>,<l eID="gen4932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4933"/>and they did not extinguish the light of my face. <l eID="gen4933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3359"/><l level="1" sID="gen4934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3359"/>I chose their way, and I sat <transChange type="added">as</transChange> head,<l eID="gen4934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4935"/>and I dwelled like a king among the troops,<l eID="gen4935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4936"/>like <transChange type="added">one</transChange> who comforts mourners. <l eID="gen4936" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4887"/> <chapter eID="Job.29"/>

verses.name: Job 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3360"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Final Defense Continued</title> <div sID="gen4937" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen4937" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4938"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3360"/>“But now <transChange type="added">those</transChange> younger than I, as far as days, laugh at me,<l eID="gen4939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4940"/>whose fathers I rejected for setting with the dogs of my sheep and goats. <l eID="gen4940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3361"/><l level="1" sID="gen4941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3361"/>Moreover, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what use to me is the strength of their hands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “the strength of their hands what is for me”</note><l eID="gen4941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4942"/>With them, vigor is destroyed. <l eID="gen4942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3362"/><l level="1" sID="gen4943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3362"/>Through want and through barren hunger<l eID="gen4943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4944"/>they are gnawing <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> dry region <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> darkness of desolation and waste. <l eID="gen4944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3363"/><l level="1" sID="gen4945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3363"/>They are picking salt herbs, the leaves of bushes,<l eID="gen4945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4946"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roots of broom trees to warm themselves. <l eID="gen4946" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3364"/><l level="1" sID="gen4947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3364"/>They were driven out from fellow people;<l eID="gen4947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4948"/>they shout at them as <transChange type="added">at</transChange> a<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> thief, <l eID="gen4948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3365"/><l level="1" sID="gen4949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3365"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that they dwell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to dwell”</note><l eID="gen4949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4950"/><transChange type="added">in</transChange> holes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ground and <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> rocks. <l eID="gen4950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3366"/><l level="1" sID="gen4951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3366"/>They bray among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bushes;<l eID="gen4951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4952"/>they are gathered under <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nettles. <l eID="gen4952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3367"/><l level="1" sID="gen4953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3367"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞A senseless crowd⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of good-for-nothing”</note> yes, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a disreputable brood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of no name”</note><l eID="gen4953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4954"/>they were cast out from the land. <l eID="gen4954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3368"/><l level="1" sID="gen4955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3368"/>“But now I am their mocking song,<l eID="gen4955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4956"/>and I have become a byword for them. <l eID="gen4956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3369"/><l level="1" sID="gen4957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3369"/>They abhor me; they keep aloof from me,<l eID="gen4957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4958"/>and they do not withhold spit from my face <l eID="gen4958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3370"/><l level="1" sID="gen4959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3370"/>because he has loosened his bowstring and humbled me,<l eID="gen4959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4960"/>and they have thrown off restraint <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in my presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from my face”</note> <l eID="gen4960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3371"/><l level="1" sID="gen4961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3371"/>On <transChange type="added">the</transChange> right hand the brood rises<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rise”</note> up;<l eID="gen4961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4962"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they put me to flight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “my feet they send away”</note><l eID="gen4962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4963"/>and they build up their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞siege ramps⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ways/paths of their disaster”</note> against me. <l eID="gen4963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3372"/><l level="1" sID="gen4964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3372"/>They destroy my path;<l eID="gen4964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4965"/>they promote my destruction;<l eID="gen4965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4966"/>they have no helper. <l eID="gen4966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3373"/><l level="1" sID="gen4967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3373"/>As <transChange type="added">through</transChange> a wide breach they come;<l eID="gen4967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4968"/>amid a crash they rush on. <l eID="gen4968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3374"/><l level="1" sID="gen4969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3374"/>Terrors are turned upon me;<l eID="gen4969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4970"/>my honor is pursued as <transChange type="added">by</transChange> the wind,<l eID="gen4970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4971"/>and my hope of deliverance passed by like a cloud. <l eID="gen4971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3375"/><l level="1" sID="gen4972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3375"/>“And now my life is poured out onto me;<l eID="gen4972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4973"/>days of misery have taken hold of me. <l eID="gen4973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3376"/><l level="1" sID="gen4974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3376"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞At night I am in great pain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “night my bones he pierces upon me,” or “night pierces my bones upon me”</note><l eID="gen4974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4975"/>my pains do not take a rest. <l eID="gen4975" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3377"/><l level="1" sID="gen4976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3377"/>He seizes my clothing with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞great power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “much of strength”</note><l eID="gen4976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4977"/>he grasps me by my tunic’s collar. <l eID="gen4977" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3378"/><l level="1" sID="gen4978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3378"/>He has cast me into the dirt,<l eID="gen4978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4979"/>and I have become like dust<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the dust”</note> and ashes. <l eID="gen4979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3379"/><l level="1" sID="gen4980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3379"/>I cry to you for help, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you do not answer me;<l eID="gen4980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4981"/>I stand, and you <transChange type="added">merely</transChange> look at me. <l eID="gen4981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3380"/><l level="1" sID="gen4982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3380"/>You have turned cruel to me;<l eID="gen4982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4983"/>you persecute me with your hand’s might. <l eID="gen4983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3381"/><l level="1" sID="gen4984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3381"/>You lift me up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind—you make me ride <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,<l eID="gen4984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4985"/>and you toss me about <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the storm. <l eID="gen4985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3382"/><l level="1" sID="gen4986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3382"/>Indeed, I know <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you will bring me to death<l eID="gen4986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4987"/>and <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> house of assembly for all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living. <l eID="gen4987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3383"/><l level="1" sID="gen4988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3383"/>“Surely someone must not send a hand against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy<l eID="gen4988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4989"/>when, in his misfortune, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> a cry of help for them. <l eID="gen4989" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3384"/><l level="1" sID="gen4990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3384"/>Have I not wept for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the unfortunate⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “hard of day”</note><l eID="gen4990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4991"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> grieved myself over the poor? <l eID="gen4991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3385"/><l level="1" sID="gen4992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3385"/>Indeed, I hoped for good, but evil came,<l eID="gen4992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4993"/>and I waited for light, but darkness came. <l eID="gen4993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3386"/><l level="1" sID="gen4994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3386"/>My bowels are in turmoil, and they are not still;<l eID="gen4994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4995"/>days of misery come to confront me. <l eID="gen4995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3387"/><l level="1" sID="gen4996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3387"/>I go <transChange type="added">about</transChange> in mourning garb, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> not in sunlight;<l eID="gen4996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4997"/>I stand up in the assembly, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> I cry for help. <l eID="gen4997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3388"/><l level="1" sID="gen4998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3388"/>I am a companion for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> jackals<l eID="gen4998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4999"/>and a companion for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ostriches⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “daughters of ostrich”</note> <l eID="gen4999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3389"/><l level="1" sID="gen5000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3389"/>My skin turns black on me,<l eID="gen5000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5001"/>and my bones burn with heat. <l eID="gen5001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3390"/><l level="1" sID="gen5002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3390"/>So<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> my lyre came to be <transChange type="added">used</transChange> for mourning,<l eID="gen5002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5003"/>and my flute <transChange type="added">for the</transChange> voice of <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> weep. <l eID="gen5003" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4938"/> <chapter eID="Job.30"/>

verses.name: Job 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3391"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Final Defense Continued</title> <div sID="gen5004" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen5004" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5005"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3391"/>“I made a covenant with my eyes,<l eID="gen5006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5007"/>so<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> how could I look closely upon a virgin? <l eID="gen5007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3392"/><l level="1" sID="gen5008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3392"/>And what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the portion of God from above<l eID="gen5008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5009"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> the heritage of Shaddai from on high? <l eID="gen5009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3393"/><l level="1" sID="gen5010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3393"/>Is not disaster for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> evil one<l eID="gen5010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5011"/>and ruin for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> workers of mischief? <l eID="gen5011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3394"/><l level="1" sID="gen5012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3394"/>Does he not see my ways<l eID="gen5012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5013"/>and count all my steps? <l eID="gen5013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3395"/><l level="1" sID="gen5014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3395"/>“If I have walked with falseness,<l eID="gen5014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5015"/>and my foot has hastened to deceit, <l eID="gen5015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3396"/><l level="1" sID="gen5016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3396"/>let him weigh me in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> balance of justice,<l eID="gen5016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5017"/>and let God know my blamelessness. <l eID="gen5017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:7
