verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3397"/><l level="1" sID="gen5018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3397"/>If my steps have turned aside from the way,<l eID="gen5018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5019"/>and my heart has walked after my eyes,<l eID="gen5019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5020"/>and my hand has clung to a spot, <l eID="gen5020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3398"/><l level="1" sID="gen5021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3398"/>let me sow, and let another eat,<l eID="gen5021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5022"/>and let my crops be rooted out. <l eID="gen5022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3399"/><l level="1" sID="gen5023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3399"/>“If my heart has been enticed by a woman,<l eID="gen5023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5024"/>and at my neighbor’s doorway I have lain in wait, <l eID="gen5024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3400"/><l level="1" sID="gen5025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3400"/>let my wife grind for another,<l eID="gen5025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5026"/>and let other <transChange type="added">men</transChange> kneel over her, <l eID="gen5026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3401"/><l level="1" sID="gen5027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3401"/>for that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a shameful act,<l eID="gen5027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5028"/>and that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a criminal offense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “an iniquity of judges”</note> <l eID="gen5028" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3402"/><l level="1" sID="gen5029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3402"/>Indeed, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a fire that will consume up to Abaddon,<l eID="gen5029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5030"/>and it would uproot all my crop. <l eID="gen5030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3403"/><l level="1" sID="gen5031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3403"/>“If I have rejected my male or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> female slave’s case<l eID="gen5031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5032"/>when their complaint <transChange type="added">was</transChange> against me, <l eID="gen5032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3404"/><l level="1" sID="gen5033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3404"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> what shall I do when God rises up?<l eID="gen5033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5034"/>And when he enquires, how shall I answer him? <l eID="gen5034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3405"/><l level="1" sID="gen5035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3405"/>Did not he <transChange type="added">who</transChange> made me in the womb make them?<l eID="gen5035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5036"/>And did not one fashion us in the womb? <l eID="gen5036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3406"/><l level="1" sID="gen5037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3406"/>“If I have withheld <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desire of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor from <transChange type="added">them</transChange>,<l eID="gen5037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5038"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I have caused <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow’s eyes to fail, <l eID="gen5038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3407"/><l level="1" sID="gen5039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3407"/>or I have eaten my morsel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to alone me”</note><l eID="gen5039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5040"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan has not eaten from it <l eID="gen5040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3408"/><l level="1" sID="gen5041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3408"/>(for from my childhood he<note placement="foot">Probably referring to “the orphan”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞grew up with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “reared”</note> me like a father,<l eID="gen5041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5042"/>and from my mother’s womb I guided her<note placement="foot">Probably referring to “the widow”</note>), <l eID="gen5042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3409"/><l level="1" sID="gen5043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3409"/>if I have seen <transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> perishes because of no clothing<l eID="gen5043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5044"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> there is no covering for the poor, <l eID="gen5044" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3410"/><l level="1" sID="gen5045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3410"/>if his loins have not blessed me,<l eID="gen5045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5046"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> by means of my sheep’s fleece he has warmed himself, <l eID="gen5046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3411"/><l level="1" sID="gen5047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3411"/>if I have raised my hand against an orphan<l eID="gen5047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5048"/>because I saw my supporters at the gate, <l eID="gen5048" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3412"/><l level="1" sID="gen5049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3412"/><transChange type="added">then</transChange> let my shoulder blade fall from <transChange type="added">my</transChange> shoulder,<l eID="gen5049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5050"/>and let my arm be broken from its socket. <l eID="gen5050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3413"/><l level="1" sID="gen5051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3413"/>Indeed, the disaster from God <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a dread for me,<l eID="gen5051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5052"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I was powerless⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I was not able”</note> because of his majesty. <l eID="gen5052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3414"/><l level="1" sID="gen5053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3414"/>“If I have made gold my trust,<l eID="gen5053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5054"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I have called fine gold my security, <l eID="gen5054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3415"/><l level="1" sID="gen5055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3415"/>if I have rejoiced because my wealth <transChange type="added">was</transChange> great<l eID="gen5055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5056"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> because my hand found a fortune, <l eID="gen5056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3416"/><l level="1" sID="gen5057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3416"/>if I looked at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun when it shone<l eID="gen5057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5058"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">at the</transChange> moon moving <transChange type="added">in</transChange> splendor, <l eID="gen5058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3417"/><l level="1" sID="gen5059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3417"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I was secretly enticed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “it was gullible in the secrecy of my heart”</note><l eID="gen5059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5060"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my hand threw them a kiss⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “my hand kissed for my mouth”</note> <l eID="gen5060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3418"/><l level="1" sID="gen5061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3418"/>this also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an iniquity <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> judged,<l eID="gen5061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5062"/>for I have deceived God above. <l eID="gen5062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3419"/><l level="1" sID="gen5063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3419"/>“If I have rejoiced at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ruin of <transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> hated me<l eID="gen5063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5064"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> have exulted when evil overtook him— <l eID="gen5064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3420"/><l level="1" sID="gen5065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3420"/>no,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I have not allowed my mouth to sin,<l eID="gen5065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5066"/>to ask his life with a curse. <l eID="gen5066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3421"/><l level="1" sID="gen5067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3421"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Have the people of my tent not said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “If the people of my tent have not said”</note><l eID="gen5067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5068"/>‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who shall give”</note> someone<note placement="foot">Or “he”</note> had not been satisfied with his meat’? <l eID="gen5068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3422"/><l level="1" sID="gen5069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3422"/>An alien has not lodged in the street;<l eID="gen5069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5070"/>I have opened my door to the traveler. <l eID="gen5070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3423"/><l level="1" sID="gen5071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3423"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Have I concealed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If I have concealed”</note> my transgressions as <transChange type="added">other</transChange> human beings<l eID="gen5071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5072"/>to hide my iniquity in my bosom <l eID="gen5072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3424"/><l level="1" sID="gen5073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3424"/>because I dreaded <transChange type="added">the</transChange> great multitude,<l eID="gen5073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5074"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> contempt of clans terrified me,<l eID="gen5074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5075"/>so that I kept quiet, I did not go out of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> doorway? <l eID="gen5075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3425"/><l level="1" sID="gen5076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3425"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who shall give”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I had⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for me”</note> someone hearing me!<l eID="gen5076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5077"/>Here is my signature;<l eID="gen5077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5078"/>let Shaddai answer me!<l eID="gen5078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5079"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “And,” or “But”</note> the written communication that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my adversary⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the man of my indictment”</note> has written, <l eID="gen5079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3426"/><l level="1" sID="gen5080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3426"/>I would <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> carry it on my shoulder;<l eID="gen5080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5081"/>I would bind it on me <transChange type="added">like</transChange> a crown. <l eID="gen5081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3427"/><l level="1" sID="gen5082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3427"/>I would give him an account of my steps;<l eID="gen5082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5083"/>I would approach him like a noble. <l eID="gen5083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3428"/><l level="1" sID="gen5084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3428"/>If my land has cried out against me,<l eID="gen5084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5085"/>and its furrows have wept together, <l eID="gen5085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3429"/><l level="1" sID="gen5086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3429"/>if I have eaten its yield without payment,<l eID="gen5086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5087"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I have caused <transChange type="added">the</transChange> breath of its owners to die, <l eID="gen5087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3430"/><l level="1" sID="gen5088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3430"/>let thorns grow in place of wheat<l eID="gen5088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5089"/>and noxious weeds in place of barley.”<l eID="gen5089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5090"/>The words of Job are ended. <l eID="gen5090" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5005"/> <chapter eID="Job.31"/>

verses.name: Job 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3431"/><title type="x-s">Elihu Rebukes Job and His Three Friends</title> <div sID="gen5091" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3431"/>Then these three men ceased from answering Job because he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> righteous in his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> eyes.

verses.name: Job 32:2
verses.text: So Elihu the son of Barakel the Buzite, from the clan of Ram, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞became angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the nose of Elihu became hot”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He became angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “His nose became hot”</note> at Job because he justified himself rather than God,

verses.name: Job 32:3
verses.text: and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he became angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his nose became hot”</note> at his three friends because they had not found an answer, and they had declared Job guilty.

verses.name: Job 32:4
verses.text: Thus Elihu had waited for Job <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to speak⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in words”</note> because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they were older than he⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they were older than he as far as days”</note>

verses.name: Job 32:5
verses.text: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he became angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his nose became hot”</note>

verses.name: Job 32:6
verses.text: Then Elihu the son of Barakel the Buzite <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spoke up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answered”; see NET</note> and said, <div eID="gen5091" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5092"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5093"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am young⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Young I am as far as days”</note> but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> are old;<l eID="gen5093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5094"/>therefore I feared and became afraid of explaining my knowledge to you.<note placement="foot">Plural</note> <l eID="gen5094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3432"/><l level="1" sID="gen5095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3432"/>I thought,<note placement="foot">Or “said”</note> ‘Let days<note placement="foot">Compare the idiom of “as far as days” in vv. <reference osisRef="Job.32.4">4</reference> and 6</note> speak,<l eID="gen5095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5096"/>and let many years teach wisdom.’ <l eID="gen5096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3433"/><l level="1" sID="gen5097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3433"/>“Truly, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a spirit in a human being,<l eID="gen5097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5098"/>and the breath of Shaddai teaches them. <l eID="gen5098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3434"/><l level="1" sID="gen5099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3434"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the aged⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “many in days”</note> <transChange type="added">who</transChange> are wise,<l eID="gen5099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5100"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">it is not</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> elders <transChange type="added">who</transChange> understand justice. <l eID="gen5100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3435"/><l level="1" sID="gen5101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3435"/>Therefore I say, ‘Listen to me;<l eID="gen5101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5102"/>let me also declare my knowledge myself.’ <l eID="gen5102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3436"/><l level="1" sID="gen5103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3436"/>“Look, I waited for your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> words;<l eID="gen5103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5104"/>I listened for your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> insight,<l eID="gen5104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5105"/>until you searched out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what to say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “words,” or “sentences”</note> <l eID="gen5105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3437"/><l level="1" sID="gen5106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3437"/>And I directed my attention to you;<note placement="foot">Plural</note><l eID="gen5106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5107"/>and, look, there is no <transChange type="added">one</transChange> for Job <transChange type="added">who</transChange> refuted,<l eID="gen5107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5108"/>answering his words among you. <l eID="gen5108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3438"/><l level="1" sID="gen5109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3438"/>So do not say, ‘We have found wisdom;<l eID="gen5109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5110"/>let God refute him, not a man.’ <l eID="gen5110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3439"/><l level="1" sID="gen5111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3439"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> he did not direct his words<note placement="foot">Or “sentences,” or “what he said”</note> to me,<l eID="gen5111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5112"/>and I will not answer him with your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> words. <l eID="gen5112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3440"/><l level="1" sID="gen5113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3440"/>“They are dismayed; they no longer answer;<l eID="gen5113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5114"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they have nothing to say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “words fail from them,” or “sentences fail from them,” or “what to say fails from them”</note> <l eID="gen5114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3441"/><l level="1" sID="gen5115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3441"/>And I have waited because they do not speak,<l eID="gen5115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5116"/>because they stand <transChange type="added">there</transChange> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> no longer answer. <l eID="gen5116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3442"/><l level="1" sID="gen5117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3442"/>I myself will answer my share also;<l eID="gen5117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5118"/>I myself will declare my knowledge also, <l eID="gen5118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3443"/><l level="1" sID="gen5119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3443"/>for I am full of words;<note placement="foot">Or “sentences,” or “what to say”</note><l eID="gen5119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5120"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the spirit within me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the spirit of my stomach”</note> urges me. <l eID="gen5120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3444"/><l level="1" sID="gen5121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3444"/>“Look, my internal organs <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like unopened wine,<l eID="gen5121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5122"/>like new wineskins it<note placement="foot">Antecedent is “wine”</note> is <transChange type="added">ready</transChange> to burst open. <l eID="gen5122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3445"/><l level="1" sID="gen5123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3445"/>Let me speak <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that I may find relief⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “and let it find relief for me”</note><l eID="gen5123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5124"/>let me open my lips, and let me answer. <l eID="gen5124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3446"/><l level="1" sID="gen5125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3446"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Please let me not show partiality to anyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Not please I will lift up face of a man”</note><l eID="gen5125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5126"/>and let me not show flattery to human beings, <l eID="gen5126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3447"/><l level="1" sID="gen5127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3447"/>for I do not know <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to flatter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I will flatter”</note><l eID="gen5127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5128"/><transChange type="added">else</transChange> my Maker would <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞soon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “like little”</note> put an end to me. <l eID="gen5128" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5092"/> <chapter eID="Job.32"/>

verses.name: Job 33:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3448"/><title type="x-s">Elihu Rebukes Job</title> <div sID="gen5129" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen5129" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5130"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3448"/>“But now, please hear my speeches,<note placement="foot">Or “my sentences,” or “what I have to say”</note> Job,<l eID="gen5131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5132"/>and hear<note placement="foot">Or “give ear to”</note> all my words. <l eID="gen5132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3449"/><l level="1" sID="gen5133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3449"/>Please look, I open my mouth;<l eID="gen5133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5134"/>my tongue in my mouth speaks. <l eID="gen5134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3450"/><l level="1" sID="gen5135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3450"/>My words <transChange type="added">declare</transChange> my heart’s uprightness,<l eID="gen5135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5136"/>and my lips sincerely speak <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what my lips know⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the knowledge of my lips”</note> <l eID="gen5136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3451"/><l level="1" sID="gen5137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3451"/>The Spirit of God has made me,<l eID="gen5137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5138"/>and the breath of Shaddai gives life to me. <l eID="gen5138" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3452"/><l level="1" sID="gen5139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3452"/>“If you are able, answer me.<l eID="gen5139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5140"/>Present <transChange type="added">your argument</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> take your stand. <l eID="gen5140" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3453"/><l level="1" sID="gen5141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3453"/>Look, before God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am like you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “I am like your mouth”</note><l eID="gen5141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5142"/>I myself was also formed from clay. <l eID="gen5142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3454"/><l level="1" sID="gen5143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3454"/>Look, dread of me should not terrify you,<l eID="gen5143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5144"/>and my hand will not be heavy upon you. <l eID="gen5144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3455"/><l level="1" sID="gen5145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3455"/>“Surely you have spoken in my ears,<l eID="gen5145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5146"/>and I have heard <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of <transChange type="added">your</transChange> words:<note placement="foot">Or “sentences,” or “what you say”</note> <l eID="gen5146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3456"/><l level="1" sID="gen5147"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3456"/>‘I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> clean, without transgression;<l eID="gen5147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5148"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> pure, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no guilt in me. <l eID="gen5148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3457"/><l level="1" sID="gen5149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3457"/>Look, he finds fault against me;<l eID="gen5149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5150"/>he reckons me as his enemy; <l eID="gen5150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3458"/><l level="1" sID="gen5151"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3458"/>he puts my feet in the block;<l eID="gen5151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5152"/>he watches all my paths.’ <l eID="gen5152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3459"/><l level="1" sID="gen5153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3459"/>“Look, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> this you are not right—I will answer you:<l eID="gen5153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5154"/>Indeed, God is greater than a human being. <l eID="gen5154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3460"/><l level="1" sID="gen5155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3460"/>Why do you contend against him,<l eID="gen5155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5156"/>that he will not answer all a person’s words? <l eID="gen5156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3461"/><l level="1" sID="gen5157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3461"/>Indeed, God speaks in one <transChange type="added">way</transChange>,<l eID="gen5157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5158"/>even<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> in two,<note placement="foot">Or “time and again” (NJPS, HCSB)</note> <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <transChange type="added">someone</transChange> does not perceive it. <l eID="gen5158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3462"/><l level="1" sID="gen5159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3462"/>“In a dream, a vision of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night,<l eID="gen5159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5160"/>when a deep sleep falls on men slumbering on <transChange type="added">their</transChange> bed, <l eID="gen5160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3463"/><l level="1" sID="gen5161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3463"/>then he opens <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ear of men,<l eID="gen5161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5162"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he frightens them with a warning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with their warning he frightens”</note> <l eID="gen5162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3464"/><l level="1" sID="gen5163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3464"/>to turn human beings aside <transChange type="added">from their</transChange> deeds,<l eID="gen5163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5164"/>and he keeps man from pride. <l eID="gen5164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3465"/><l level="1" sID="gen5165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3465"/>He spares his life from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit<l eID="gen5165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5166"/>and his life from passing over the river <transChange type="added">of death</transChange>. <l eID="gen5166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3466"/><l level="1" sID="gen5167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3466"/>“And he is reproved with pain on his bed,<l eID="gen5167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5168"/>even<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the strife of his bones continually, <l eID="gen5168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3467"/><l level="1" sID="gen5169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3467"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> his life loathes bread,<l eID="gen5169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5170"/>and his inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> loathes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞appetizing food⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “food of desire”</note> <l eID="gen5170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3468"/><l level="1" sID="gen5171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3468"/>His flesh is wasted away from sight,<l eID="gen5171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5172"/>and his bones, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> are invisible, are bared. <l eID="gen5172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3469"/><l level="1" sID="gen5173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3469"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his inner self/soul”</note> draws near to the pit<l eID="gen5173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5174"/>and his life to the killers. <l eID="gen5174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3470"/><l level="1" sID="gen5175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3470"/>“If there is a messenger beside him, a mediator, one of a thousand,<note placement="foot">That is, “unique,” or “one of a kind”</note><l eID="gen5175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5176"/>to declare to a human being his uprightness <l eID="gen5176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3471"/><l level="1" sID="gen5177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3471"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he is gracious <transChange type="added">to</transChange> him, and he says,<l eID="gen5177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5178"/>‘Deliver him from descending into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit;<l eID="gen5178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5179"/>I have found a ransom.’ <l eID="gen5179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3472"/><l level="1" sID="gen5180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3472"/>His flesh is renewed with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> youth;<l eID="gen5180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5181"/>he returns to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days of his youthful strength. <l eID="gen5181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3473"/><l level="1" sID="gen5182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3473"/>He prays to God, then he accepts him,<l eID="gen5182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5183"/>and he sees his face with a shout of joy,<l eID="gen5183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5184"/>and he repays to the human being his righteousness. <l eID="gen5184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3474"/><l level="1" sID="gen5185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3474"/>“He will sing to men, and he will say,<l eID="gen5185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5186"/>‘I have sinned and have perverted <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> right,<l eID="gen5186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5187"/>and it was not paid back to me. <l eID="gen5187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3475"/><l level="1" sID="gen5188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3475"/>He redeemed my life from going down into the pit,<l eID="gen5188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5189"/>so<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will enjoy the light⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “my life in the light will see”</note> <l eID="gen5189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3476"/><l level="1" sID="gen5190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3476"/>Look, God does all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange><l eID="gen5190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5191"/>twice, three times<note placement="foot">Or “time and again,” or “oftentimes” (NASB, NASU), or “several times”</note> with a person <l eID="gen5191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3477"/><l level="1" sID="gen5192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3477"/>to bring his life back from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit<l eID="gen5192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5193"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that he may enjoy the light of life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to be lighted with the light of the life”</note> <l eID="gen5193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3478"/><l level="1" sID="gen5194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3478"/>“Listen attentively, Job; listen to me;<l eID="gen5194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5195"/>be silent, and I will speak. <l eID="gen5195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3479"/><l level="1" sID="gen5196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3479"/>If <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you have anything to say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “If there are words,” or “If there are sentences”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞answer me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “return to me”</note><l eID="gen5196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5197"/>speak, for I desire <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to justify you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “your righteousness”</note> <l eID="gen5197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3480"/><l level="1" sID="gen5198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3480"/>If not, you listen to me;<l eID="gen5198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5199"/>be silent, and I will teach you wisdom.” <l eID="gen5199" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5130"/> <chapter eID="Job.33"/>

verses.name: Job 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3481"/><title type="x-s">Elihu Asserts God’s Justice</title> <div sID="gen5200" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3481"/>Thus<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Elihu <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spoke up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answered”; see NET</note> and said,  <div eID="gen5200" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 34:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3482"/><lg sID="gen5201"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3482"/>“Hear my words, you wise men,<l eID="gen5202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5203"/>and listen to me, you who know, <l eID="gen5203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3483"/><l level="1" sID="gen5204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3483"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ear tests words,<l eID="gen5204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5205"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> palate tastes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞food⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to eat”</note> <l eID="gen5205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3484"/><l level="1" sID="gen5206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3484"/>Let us choose justice for ourselves;<l eID="gen5206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5207"/>let us determine among ourselves what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good— <l eID="gen5207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3485"/><l level="1" sID="gen5208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3485"/>for Job has said, ‘I am righteous,<l eID="gen5208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5209"/>but God has taken away my justice. <l eID="gen5209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3486"/><l level="1" sID="gen5210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3486"/>Should I lie concerning my justice?<l eID="gen5210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5211"/><transChange type="added">Though I am</transChange> without transgression, my wound caused by an arrow is incurable.’ <l eID="gen5211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3487"/><l level="1" sID="gen5212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3487"/>What man <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like Job,<l eID="gen5212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5213"/>who drinks scorn like water? <l eID="gen5213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3488"/><l level="1" sID="gen5214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3488"/>And he goes on the road in company with instigators of mischief,<l eID="gen5214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5215"/>and walks with men of wickedness. <l eID="gen5215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3489"/><l level="1" sID="gen5216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3489"/>Indeed, he says, ‘A man does not profit<l eID="gen5216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5217"/>when he takes delight in God.’ <l eID="gen5217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3490"/><l level="1" sID="gen5218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3490"/>“Therefore, listen to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people who have sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “men of heart”</note><l eID="gen5218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5219"/>far be it from God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that he should commit wickedness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from wickedness”</note><l eID="gen5219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5220"/>and that Shaddai <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞should do wrong⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from wrong”</note> <l eID="gen5220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3491"/><l level="1" sID="gen5221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3491"/>Indeed, he will repay <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> a human being’s deeds,<l eID="gen5221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5222"/>and according to a man’s way he will let <transChange type="added">it</transChange> happen <transChange type="added">to</transChange> him. <l eID="gen5222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3492"/><l level="1" sID="gen5223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3492"/>What’s more, God truly does not act wickedly,<l eID="gen5223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5224"/>and Shaddai does not pervert justice. <l eID="gen5224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3493"/><l level="1" sID="gen5225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3493"/>Who gave him charge <transChange type="added">over the</transChange> earth?<l eID="gen5225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5226"/>Or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> who laid on <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> whole world? <l eID="gen5226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3494"/><l level="1" sID="gen5227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3494"/>If he should set his heart to it,<l eID="gen5227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5228"/>and he should gather his spirit and his breath to himself, <l eID="gen5228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3495"/><l level="1" sID="gen5229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3495"/>all flesh would perish together,<l eID="gen5229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5230"/>and humankind would return to dust. <l eID="gen5230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3496"/><l level="1" sID="gen5231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3496"/>“But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> if <transChange type="added">you have</transChange> understanding, hear this;<l eID="gen5231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5232"/>listen to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what I say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the voice/sound of my words”</note> <l eID="gen5232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3497"/><l level="1" sID="gen5233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3497"/>Shall <transChange type="added">he who</transChange> hates justice really govern?<l eID="gen5233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5234"/>Or will you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> declare <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Righteous One, the Mighty, guilty?— <l eID="gen5234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3498"/><l level="1" sID="gen5235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3498"/>the one who says to a king,<l eID="gen5235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5236"/>‘You worthless man,’ to noblemen, ‘You wicked man,’ <l eID="gen5236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3499"/><l level="1" sID="gen5237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3499"/>who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shows no partiality to officials⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he does not lift the face of officials”</note><l eID="gen5237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5238"/>and <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞does not take note of the noble more than of the insignificant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he does not regard the eminent to the face of the poor/insignificant”</note><l eID="gen5238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5239"/>for all of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the work of his hands? <l eID="gen5239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3500"/><l level="1" sID="gen5240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3500"/><transChange type="added">In</transChange> a moment they die,<l eID="gen5240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5241"/>and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the middle of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people are shaken, and they pass away,<l eID="gen5241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5242"/>and they take away <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞effortlessly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not by a hand”</note> <l eID="gen5242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3501"/><l level="1" sID="gen5243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3501"/>“Indeed, his eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> upon <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ways of man,<l eID="gen5243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5244"/>and he sees all his steps. <l eID="gen5244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3502"/><l level="1" sID="gen5245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3502"/>There is no darkness, and there is no deep shadow<l eID="gen5245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5246"/>where instigators of mischief might hide themselves. <l eID="gen5246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3503"/><l level="1" sID="gen5247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3503"/>Indeed, he has not yet appointed <transChange type="added">a time</transChange> for man<l eID="gen5247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5248"/>to go to God in the judgment. <l eID="gen5248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3504"/><l level="1" sID="gen5249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3504"/>He shatters the mighty without investigation,<l eID="gen5249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5250"/>and he sets others in their place. <l eID="gen5250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3505"/><l level="1" sID="gen5251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3505"/>Therefore he knows their works,<l eID="gen5251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5252"/>and he overturns <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> night<l eID="gen5252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5253"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> they are crushed. <l eID="gen5253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3506"/><l level="1" sID="gen5254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3506"/>He strikes them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where the wicked stood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “among the wicked”</note><l eID="gen5254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5255"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where there are onlookers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the place of seers”</note> <l eID="gen5255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3507"/><l level="1" sID="gen5256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3507"/>because they have turned aside from him<l eID="gen5256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5257"/>and have not understood any of his ways, <l eID="gen5257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3508"/><l level="1" sID="gen5258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3508"/>so that <transChange type="added">they</transChange> cause <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cry of distress from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> helpless to come to him,<l eID="gen5258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5259"/>and he hears <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cry of distress from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy, <l eID="gen5259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3509"/><l level="1" sID="gen5260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3509"/>but he remains quiet, and who can condemn?<l eID="gen5260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5261"/>And he hides <transChange type="added">his</transChange> face, and who can behold him?<l eID="gen5261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5262"/>Yet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> over a nation and over a person alike, <l eID="gen5262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3510"/><l level="1" sID="gen5263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3510"/>so that godless human beings should not reign,<l eID="gen5263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5264"/>nor those who ensnare <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people. <l eID="gen5264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3511"/><l level="1" sID="gen5265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3511"/>“Indeed, does anyone say to God, ‘I have endured <transChange type="added">chastisement</transChange>;<l eID="gen5265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5266"/>I will not act corruptly <transChange type="added">again</transChange>; <l eID="gen5266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3512"/><l level="1" sID="gen5267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3512"/>teach me yourself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what I cannot see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “apart from what I can see”</note><l eID="gen5267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5268"/>if I have done wrong, I will not repeat <transChange type="added">it</transChange>’? <l eID="gen5268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3513"/><l level="1" sID="gen5269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3513"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞According to your judgment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from with you”</note> must he repay <transChange type="added">it</transChange> because you rejected <transChange type="added">this</transChange>?<l eID="gen5269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5270"/>Indeed, you must choose, and not I, so<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> declare what you know. <l eID="gen5270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3514"/><l level="1" sID="gen5271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3514"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Those who have sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Men of heart”</note> say to me,<l eID="gen5271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5272"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise man hearing me <transChange type="added">says</transChange>: <l eID="gen5272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3515"/><l level="1" sID="gen5273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3515"/>‘Job speaks without knowledge,<l eID="gen5273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5274"/>and his words <transChange type="added">are</transChange> without insight. <l eID="gen5274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3516"/><l level="1" sID="gen5275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3516"/>Would that Job were tested up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end<l eID="gen5275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5276"/>because <transChange type="added">his</transChange> answers <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like <transChange type="added">those from</transChange> men of mischief, <l eID="gen5276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3517"/><l level="1" sID="gen5277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3517"/>for he adds transgression to his sin;<l eID="gen5277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5278"/>he claps hands among us,<l eID="gen5278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5279"/>and he multiplies his words against God.’ ” <l eID="gen5279" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5201"/> <chapter eID="Job.34"/>

verses.name: Job 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3518"/><title type="x-s">Elihu Condemns Job</title> <div sID="gen5280" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3518"/>Moreover,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Elihu <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spoke up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answered”; see NET</note> and said,  <div eID="gen5280" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 35:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3519"/><lg sID="gen5281"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3519"/>“Do you think this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> justice when you say,<l eID="gen5282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5283"/>‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am right⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “My righteousness”</note> before God’? <l eID="gen5283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3520"/><l level="1" sID="gen5284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3520"/>If you ask what it profits you:<l eID="gen5284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5285"/>‘How do I benefit <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by refraining from my sin⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?’<note placement="foot">Literally “from my sin”</note> <l eID="gen5285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3521"/><l level="1" sID="gen5286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3521"/>I myself<note placement="foot">Emphatic personal pronoun</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will give answer to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will return you words”</note><l eID="gen5286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5287"/>and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> your friends with you. <l eID="gen5287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3522"/><l level="1" sID="gen5288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3522"/>“Look at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens, and see;<l eID="gen5288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5289"/>and observe <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clouds <transChange type="added">that</transChange> are higher than you. <l eID="gen5289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3523"/><l level="1" sID="gen5290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3523"/>If you have sinned, what do you accomplish against him?<l eID="gen5290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5291"/>And <transChange type="added">if</transChange> your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him? <l eID="gen5291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3524"/><l level="1" sID="gen5292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3524"/>If you are righteous, what do you give to him,<l eID="gen5292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5293"/>or what does he receive from your hand? <l eID="gen5293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3525"/><l level="1" sID="gen5294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3525"/>Your wickedness <transChange type="added">affects</transChange> a person like yourself,<l eID="gen5294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5295"/>and your righteousness <transChange type="added">affects</transChange> humans. <l eID="gen5295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3526"/><l level="1" sID="gen5296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3526"/>“Because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> multitude of oppressions, they cry out;<l eID="gen5296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5297"/>they cry for help because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> arm of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty. <l eID="gen5297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3527"/><l level="1" sID="gen5298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3527"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> no one says, ‘Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> God my Maker,<l eID="gen5298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5299"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> gives songs in the night, <l eID="gen5299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3528"/><l level="1" sID="gen5300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3528"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> teaches us more than <transChange type="added">the</transChange> animals of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth<l eID="gen5300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5301"/>and makes us wiser than the birds of the heavens?’ <l eID="gen5301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3529"/><l level="1" sID="gen5302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3529"/>There they cry out, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he does not answer<l eID="gen5302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5303"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of the pride of evildoers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of the pride of evildoers”</note> <l eID="gen5303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3530"/><l level="1" sID="gen5304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3530"/>“Surely God does not hear an empty plea,<l eID="gen5304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5305"/>and Shaddai does not regard it. <l eID="gen5305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3531"/><l level="1" sID="gen5306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3531"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How much less⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Also for”</note> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> you say <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you do not see him,<l eID="gen5306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5307"/>that <transChange type="added">the</transChange> case <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of him”</note> and you are waiting for him! <l eID="gen5307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3532"/><l level="1" sID="gen5308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3532"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> now, because his anger does not punish,<l eID="gen5308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5309"/>and he does not acknowledge the transgression at all, <l eID="gen5309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3533"/><l level="1" sID="gen5310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3533"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “and,” or “so”</note> Job opens his mouth in empty talk—<l eID="gen5310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5311"/>without knowledge he multiplies words.” <l eID="gen5311" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5281"/> <chapter eID="Job.35"/>

verses.name: Job 36:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3534"/><title type="x-s">Elihu Extols God’s Greatness</title> <div sID="gen5312" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3534"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Elihu continued and said,  <div eID="gen5312" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 36:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3535"/><lg sID="gen5313"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3535"/>“Bear with me a little longer, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will explain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I will show you”</note><l eID="gen5314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5315"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I still have something to say on God’s behalf⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “yet on behalf of God words/sentences”</note> <l eID="gen5315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3536"/><l level="1" sID="gen5316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3536"/>I will bring my knowledge from far away,<l eID="gen5316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5317"/>and I will ascribe righteousness to my maker, <l eID="gen5317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3537"/><l level="1" sID="gen5318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3537"/>for truly my words<note placement="foot">Or “what I have to say”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not falsehood;<l eID="gen5318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5319"/><transChange type="added">one who has</transChange> perfect knowledge <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with you.<note placement="foot">In other words, “Somebody who knows what he is talking about is addressing you”</note> <l eID="gen5319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3538"/><l level="1" sID="gen5320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3538"/>Look, God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mighty but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> does not despise <transChange type="added">anyone</transChange>;<l eID="gen5320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5321"/><transChange type="added">he is</transChange> mighty <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞good in understanding⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “strength of heart”</note> <l eID="gen5321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3539"/><l level="1" sID="gen5322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3539"/>He does not keep <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked alive<l eID="gen5322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5323"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> grants justice <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> afflicted. <l eID="gen5323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3540"/><l level="1" sID="gen5324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3540"/>He does not withdraw his eyes from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous,<l eID="gen5324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5325"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he sets them forever with kings on the throne, and they are exalted. <l eID="gen5325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3541"/><l level="1" sID="gen5326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3541"/>“And if <transChange type="added">they</transChange> are tied up with fetters,<l eID="gen5326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5327"/><transChange type="added">if</transChange> they are caught in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cords of misery, <l eID="gen5327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3542"/><l level="1" sID="gen5328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3542"/>then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he declares their work to them,<l eID="gen5328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5329"/>and their transgressions, that they are behaving arrogantly. <l eID="gen5329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3543"/><l level="1" sID="gen5330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3543"/>So<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> he opens their ear to the discipline,<l eID="gen5330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5331"/>and he commands that they return from mischief. <l eID="gen5331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3544"/><l level="1" sID="gen5332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3544"/>If they listen and serve <transChange type="added">him</transChange>,<l eID="gen5332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5333"/>they complete their days in prosperity and their years in pleasantness. <l eID="gen5333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3545"/><l level="1" sID="gen5334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3545"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> if they do not listen, they perish by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword,<l eID="gen5334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5335"/>and they pass away without knowledge. <l eID="gen5335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3546"/><l level="1" sID="gen5336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3546"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> godless of heart cherish anger;<l eID="gen5336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5337"/>they do not cry for help when he binds them. <l eID="gen5337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3547"/><l level="1" sID="gen5338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3547"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They die in their youth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “It dies in the youth of their self”</note><l eID="gen5338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5339"/>and their life <transChange type="added">ends</transChange> among the male shrine prostitutes. <l eID="gen5339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3548"/><l level="1" sID="gen5340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3548"/>He delivers <transChange type="added">the</transChange> afflicted by his misery,<l eID="gen5340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5341"/>and he opens their ears by the adversity. <l eID="gen5341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3549"/><l level="1" sID="gen5342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3549"/>And what’s more, he allured you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞out of distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the mouth of distress”</note><l eID="gen5342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5343"/><transChange type="added">into</transChange> a broad place, <transChange type="added">where</transChange> in place of it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> no constraint;<l eID="gen5343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5344"/>and <transChange type="added">what</transChange> was set on your table is full of fatness. <l eID="gen5344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3550"/><l level="1" sID="gen5345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3550"/>But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> you are obsessed with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> judgment of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked;<l eID="gen5345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5346"/>judgment and justice take hold of you. <l eID="gen5346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3551"/><l level="1" sID="gen5347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3551"/>Yes,<note placement="foot">Or “Indeed”</note> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> wrath, so that it will not incite you into mockery;<l eID="gen5347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5348"/>and do not let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ransom’s greatness turn you aside. <l eID="gen5348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3552"/><l level="1" sID="gen5349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3552"/>Will your cry for help sustain <transChange type="added">you</transChange> without distress,<l eID="gen5349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5350"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> efforts of <transChange type="added">your</transChange> strength? <l eID="gen5350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3553"/><l level="1" sID="gen5351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3553"/>You must not long for the night,<l eID="gen5351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5352"/>to cut off people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in place of them”</note> <l eID="gen5352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3554"/><l level="1" sID="gen5353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3554"/>Take care, you must not turn to mischief,<l eID="gen5353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5354"/>for because of this you have been tried by misery. <l eID="gen5354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3555"/><l level="1" sID="gen5355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3555"/>“Look, God is exalted in his power;<l eID="gen5355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5356"/>who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a teacher like him? <l eID="gen5356" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3556"/><l level="1" sID="gen5357"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3556"/>Who has prescribed his way for him?<l eID="gen5357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5358"/>Or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> who says, ‘You have done wrong’? <l eID="gen5358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3557"/><l level="1" sID="gen5359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3557"/>Remember that you should extol his work,<l eID="gen5359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5360"/><transChange type="added">of</transChange> which people have sung. <l eID="gen5360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3558"/><l level="1" sID="gen5361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3558"/>All human beings have looked on it;<l eID="gen5361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5362"/>everyone watches from afar. <l eID="gen5362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3559"/><l level="1" sID="gen5363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3559"/>“Look, God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> exalted, and we do not know <transChange type="added">him</transChange>;<l eID="gen5363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5364"/>the number of his years is unsearchable. <l eID="gen5364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3560"/><l level="1" sID="gen5365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3560"/>Indeed, he draws up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> drops of water;<l eID="gen5365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5366"/>he distills <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rain into its mist, <l eID="gen5366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3561"/><l level="1" sID="gen5367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3561"/>which <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clouds pour down;<l eID="gen5367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5368"/>they shower abundantly on human beings. <l eID="gen5368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:29
