verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3562"/><l level="1" sID="gen5369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3562"/>“Moreover, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞can anyone understand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if he can understand”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spreading of clouds,<l eID="gen5369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5370"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> thundering of his dwelling place? <l eID="gen5370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3563"/><l level="1" sID="gen5371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3563"/>Look, he scatters his lightning around him,<l eID="gen5371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5372"/>and he covers the roots of the sea. <l eID="gen5372" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3564"/><l level="1" sID="gen5373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3564"/>Indeed, he judges people by them;<l eID="gen5373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5374"/>he gives food <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in abundance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as far as providing in abundance”</note> <l eID="gen5374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3565"/><l level="1" sID="gen5375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3565"/>He covers <transChange type="added">his</transChange> hands <transChange type="added">with</transChange> lightning,<l eID="gen5375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5376"/>and he commands it the place at <transChange type="added">which</transChange> to strike. <l eID="gen5376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3566"/><l level="1" sID="gen5377"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3566"/>His thundering tells about him;<l eID="gen5377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5378"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> livestock also <transChange type="added">tell</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concerning what rises⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “about going up”</note> <l eID="gen5378" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5313"/> <chapter eID="Job.36"/>

verses.name: Job 37:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3567"/><title type="x-s">Elihu Extols God’s Majesty</title> <div sID="gen5379" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen5379" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5380"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3567"/>“About this also my heart trembles,<l eID="gen5381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5382"/>and it leaps from its place. <l eID="gen5382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3568"/><l level="1" sID="gen5383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3568"/>Listen carefully to his voice’s thunder<l eID="gen5383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5384"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rumbling <transChange type="added">that</transChange> goes out from his mouth. <l eID="gen5384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3569"/><l level="1" sID="gen5385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3569"/>He lets it loose under all the heavens,<l eID="gen5385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5386"/>and his lightning to the earth’s corners. <l eID="gen5386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3570"/><l level="1" sID="gen5387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3570"/>After it, his voice roars;<l eID="gen5387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5388"/>it thunders <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with his majestic voice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with the voice of his majesty”</note><l eID="gen5388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5389"/>and he does not restrain it when his voice is heard. <l eID="gen5389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3571"/><l level="1" sID="gen5390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3571"/>“God thunders with his voice in marvelous ways;<l eID="gen5390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5391"/>he does great things, and we cannot comprehend. <l eID="gen5391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3572"/><l level="1" sID="gen5392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3572"/>For to the snow he says, ‘Fall <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> earth’;<l eID="gen5392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5393"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the shower of rain, his heavy shower of rain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the shower of rain and the show of rains of his strength”</note>— <l eID="gen5393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3573"/><l level="1" sID="gen5394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3573"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he stops all human beings from working⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the hand of all man he seals”</note><l eID="gen5394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5395"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that everyone whom he has made may know it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to know all men of his work”</note> <l eID="gen5395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3574"/><l level="1" sID="gen5396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3574"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> animal goes into <transChange type="added">its</transChange> den,<l eID="gen5396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5397"/>and it remains in its den. <l eID="gen5397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3575"/><l level="1" sID="gen5398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3575"/>“<transChange type="added">The</transChange> storm wind comes from its chamber<l eID="gen5398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5399"/>and cold from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north wind. <l eID="gen5399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3576"/><l level="1" sID="gen5400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3576"/>By God’s breath, ice is given,<l eID="gen5400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5401"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> broad waters <transChange type="added">are</transChange> frozen. <l eID="gen5401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3577"/><l level="1" sID="gen5402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3577"/>Also, he loads down thick clouds with moisture;<l eID="gen5402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5403"/>his lightning scatters <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clouds. <l eID="gen5403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3578"/><l level="1" sID="gen5404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3578"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Collective “clouds” in the first line takes the singular “it” here with the plural meaning</note> turn around by his guidance<l eID="gen5404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5405"/>to accomplish all that he has commanded them<l eID="gen5405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5406"/>on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> face of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the habitable world⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “world of earth”</note> <l eID="gen5406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3579"/><l level="1" sID="gen5407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3579"/>Whether as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞correction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a rod”</note> or for his land,<l eID="gen5407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5408"/>or as loyal love, he lets it happen. <l eID="gen5408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3580"/><l level="1" sID="gen5409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3580"/>“Hear this, Job;<l eID="gen5409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5410"/>stand <transChange type="added">still</transChange> and consider carefully God’s wondrous works. <l eID="gen5410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3581"/><l level="1" sID="gen5411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3581"/>Do you know <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how God commands them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at the putting of God upon them”</note><l eID="gen5411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5412"/>and <transChange type="added">how</transChange> he causes his cloud’s lightning to shine? <l eID="gen5412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3582"/><l level="1" sID="gen5413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3582"/>Do you know about the hovering of the clouds,<l eID="gen5413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5414"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the marvelous works of the one with perfect knowledge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “the marvelous works of perfect knowledge”</note> <l eID="gen5414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3583"/><l level="1" sID="gen5415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3583"/><transChange type="added">You</transChange> whose garments <transChange type="added">are</transChange> hot,<l eID="gen5415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5416"/>when <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth is being still because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south wind, <l eID="gen5416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3584"/><l level="1" sID="gen5417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3584"/>with him can you spread out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> skies,<l eID="gen5417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5418"/>hard as a molten mirror? <l eID="gen5418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3585"/><l level="1" sID="gen5419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3585"/>“Teach us what we should say to him;<l eID="gen5419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5420"/>we cannot draw up our case because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> presence of darkness. <l eID="gen5420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3586"/><l level="1" sID="gen5421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3586"/>Should he be told that I want to speak?<l eID="gen5421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5422"/>Or did a man say that he would be communicated with? <l eID="gen5422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3587"/><l level="1" sID="gen5423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3587"/>So then, they do not look at the light <transChange type="added">when it is</transChange> bright in the skies,<l eID="gen5423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5424"/>when<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind has passed and has cleansed them. <l eID="gen5424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3588"/><l level="1" sID="gen5425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3588"/>From <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north comes gold—<l eID="gen5425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5426"/>awesome majesty <transChange type="added">is</transChange> around God. <l eID="gen5426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3589"/><l level="1" sID="gen5427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3589"/><transChange type="added">As for</transChange> Shaddai, we cannot attain him;<l eID="gen5427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5428"/><transChange type="added">he is</transChange> exalted <transChange type="added">in</transChange> power,<l eID="gen5428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5429"/>and he does not oppress justice and abundant righteousness. <l eID="gen5429" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3590"/><l level="1" sID="gen5430"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3590"/>Therefore people revered him;<l eID="gen5430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5431"/>he does not regard any<note placement="foot">Or “all”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who think that they are wise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “the wise of heart”</note> <l eID="gen5431" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5380"/> <chapter eID="Job.37"/>

verses.name: Job 38:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3591"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Challenges Job</title> <div sID="gen5432" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3591"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Yahweh answered Job from the storm, and he said,  <div eID="gen5432" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 38:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3592"/><lg sID="gen5433"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3592"/>“Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this darkening counsel<l eID="gen5434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5435"/>by words without knowledge? <l eID="gen5435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3593"/><l level="1" sID="gen5436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3593"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Prepare yourself for a difficult task like a man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Gird up like a man your loins”</note><l eID="gen5436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5437"/>and I will question you, and you shall declare to me.<l eID="gen5437" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5433"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh Interrogates Job</title> <div sID="gen5438" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen5438" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 38:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3594"/><lg sID="gen5439"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3594"/>“Where were you at my laying the foundation of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth?<l eID="gen5440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5441"/>Tell <transChange type="added">me</transChange>, if you possess understanding. <l eID="gen5441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3595"/><l level="1" sID="gen5442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3595"/>Who determined its measurement? Yes, you do know.<l eID="gen5442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5443"/>Or who stretched <transChange type="added">the</transChange> measuring line upon it? <l eID="gen5443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3596"/><l level="1" sID="gen5444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3596"/>On what were its bases sunk?<l eID="gen5444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5445"/>Or who laid its cornerstone, <l eID="gen5445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3597"/><l level="1" sID="gen5446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3597"/>when <transChange type="added">the</transChange> morning stars were singing together<l eID="gen5446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5447"/>and all the sons of God<note placement="foot">Or “heavenly beings”</note> shouted for joy? <l eID="gen5447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3598"/><l level="1" sID="gen5448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3598"/>“Or <transChange type="added">who</transChange> shut <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea in with doors<l eID="gen5448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5449"/>at its bursting, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> it went out of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb, <l eID="gen5449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3599"/><l level="1" sID="gen5450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3599"/>at my making <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clouds its garment<l eID="gen5450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5451"/>and thick darkness its swaddling band, <l eID="gen5451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3600"/><l level="1" sID="gen5452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3600"/>and I prescribed my rule for it,<l eID="gen5452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5453"/>and I set bars and doors, <l eID="gen5453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3601"/><l level="1" sID="gen5454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3601"/>and I said, ‘You shall come up to here, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you shall not go further,<l eID="gen5454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5455"/>and here it will set <transChange type="added">a boundary</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for your proud surging waves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>’?<note placement="foot">Literally “for the pride of your surging waves”</note> <l eID="gen5455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3602"/><l level="1" sID="gen5456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3602"/>“Have you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ever in your life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from your days”</note> commanded <transChange type="added">the</transChange> morning?<l eID="gen5456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5457"/>Have you made the dawn know its place, <l eID="gen5457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3603"/><l level="1" sID="gen5458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3603"/>to take hold of the earth’s skirts<l eID="gen5458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5459"/>so that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> the wicked might be shaken off from it? <l eID="gen5459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3604"/><l level="1" sID="gen5460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3604"/>It is changed like clay <transChange type="added">under</transChange> a seal,<l eID="gen5460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5461"/>and they appear like a garment. <l eID="gen5461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3605"/><l level="1" sID="gen5462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3605"/>And their light is withheld from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked,<l eID="gen5462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5463"/>and <transChange type="added">their</transChange> uplifted arm is broken. <l eID="gen5463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3606"/><l level="1" sID="gen5464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3606"/>“Have you entered into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea’s sources?<l eID="gen5464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5465"/>Or have you walked around in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> recesses of the deep? <l eID="gen5465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3607"/><l level="1" sID="gen5466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3607"/>Have <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gates of death been revealed to you?<l eID="gen5466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5467"/>Or have you seen <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gates of deep shadow? <l eID="gen5467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3608"/><l level="1" sID="gen5468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3608"/>Have you considered closely <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth’s vast expanse?<l eID="gen5468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5469"/>Declare <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, if you know all of it. <l eID="gen5469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3609"/><l level="1" sID="gen5470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3609"/>“Where then<note placement="foot">Or “Where exactly”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the way <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> light dwells?<l eID="gen5470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5471"/>And where then<note placement="foot">Or “where exactly”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> its place, <l eID="gen5471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3610"/><l level="1" sID="gen5472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3610"/>that you may take it to its territory,<l eID="gen5472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5473"/>and that you might discern the paths to its home? <l eID="gen5473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3611"/><l level="1" sID="gen5474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3611"/>You know, for you were born then,<l eID="gen5474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5475"/>and the number of your days <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great. <l eID="gen5475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3612"/><l level="1" sID="gen5476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3612"/>Have you entered into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> storehouses of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> snow,<l eID="gen5476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5477"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> have you seen <transChange type="added">the</transChange> storehouses of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hail, <l eID="gen5477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3613"/><l level="1" sID="gen5478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3613"/>which I have reserved for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of trouble,<l eID="gen5478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5479"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of battle and war? <l eID="gen5479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3614"/><l level="1" sID="gen5480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3614"/>Where then<note placement="foot">Or “Where exactly”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the way <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> light is distributed,<l eID="gen5480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5481"/><transChange type="added">where</transChange> he scatters <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east wind upon <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth? <l eID="gen5481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3615"/><l level="1" sID="gen5482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3615"/>“Who has cut open a channel for the torrents<l eID="gen5482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5483"/>and a way for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞thunder bolts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “bolt of thunders”</note> <l eID="gen5483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3616"/><l level="1" sID="gen5484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3616"/>to bring rain on a land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where no one lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “not a man”</note><l eID="gen5484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5485"/>a desert <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where no humans live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “not humans in it”</note> <l eID="gen5485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3617"/><l level="1" sID="gen5486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3617"/>to satisfy desert and wasteland,<l eID="gen5486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5487"/>and to cause <transChange type="added">the ground</transChange> to put forth <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rising of grass? <l eID="gen5487" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3618"/><l level="1" sID="gen5488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3618"/>Is there a father for the rain,<l eID="gen5488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5489"/>or who fathered <transChange type="added">the</transChange> drops of dew? <l eID="gen5489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3619"/><l level="1" sID="gen5490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3619"/>From whose womb did the ice come forth,<l eID="gen5490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5491"/>and who fathered <transChange type="added">the</transChange> frost of heaven? <l eID="gen5491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3620"/><l level="1" sID="gen5492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3620"/>Like stone <transChange type="added">the</transChange> waters become hard,<l eID="gen5492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5493"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> faces of the deep freeze. <l eID="gen5493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3621"/><l level="1" sID="gen5494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3621"/>“Can you bind <transChange type="added">the</transChange> chains of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Pleiades,<l eID="gen5494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5495"/>or can you loosen <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cords of Orion? <l eID="gen5495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3622"/><l level="1" sID="gen5496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3622"/>Can you lead forth the southern constellations at their appointed time,<l eID="gen5496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5497"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> can you lead <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Bear with its children? <l eID="gen5497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3623"/><l level="1" sID="gen5498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3623"/>Do you know heaven’s statutes,<l eID="gen5498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5499"/>or can you establish their rule on the earth? <l eID="gen5499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3624"/><l level="1" sID="gen5500"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3624"/>Can you lift up your voice to the clouds<l eID="gen5500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5501"/>so that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> a flood of water may cover you? <l eID="gen5501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3625"/><l level="1" sID="gen5502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3625"/>Can you send forth lightnings, that they may go?<l eID="gen5502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5503"/>And will they say to you, ‘Here we are’? <l eID="gen5503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3626"/><l level="1" sID="gen5504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3626"/>Who has put wisdom in the ibis,<note placement="foot">Or “inner parts”</note><l eID="gen5504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5505"/>or who has given understanding to the rooster?<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> <l eID="gen5505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3627"/><l level="1" sID="gen5506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3627"/>Who can number <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clouds with wisdom?<l eID="gen5506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5507"/>Or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> who can tilt heaven’s jars, <l eID="gen5507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3628"/><l level="1" sID="gen5508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3628"/>at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flowing of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust into a cast<l eID="gen5508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5509"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clods cling together? <l eID="gen5509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3629"/><l level="1" sID="gen5510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3629"/>“Can you hunt prey for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lion?<l eID="gen5510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5511"/>And can you satisfy <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hunger of strong lions <l eID="gen5511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3630"/><l level="1" sID="gen5512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3630"/>when they are crouched in the dens,<l eID="gen5512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5513"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> they lie in the thicket in an ambush? <l eID="gen5513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3631"/><l level="1" sID="gen5514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3631"/>Who prepares for the crow its prey,<l eID="gen5514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5515"/>when its young ones cry to God for help,<l eID="gen5515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5516"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> they wander around <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for lack of food⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “for no food”</note> <l eID="gen5516" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5439"/> <chapter eID="Job.38"/>

verses.name: Job 39:1
verses.text: “Do you know <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time when <transChange type="added">the</transChange> goats of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rocks give birth?<l eID="gen5519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5520"/>Do you observe <transChange type="added">the</transChange> doe deer’s giving birth? <l eID="gen5520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3632"/><l level="1" sID="gen5521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3632"/>Can you number <transChange type="added">the</transChange> months they fulfill,<l eID="gen5521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5522"/>and do you know <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of its giving birth? <l eID="gen5522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3633"/><l level="1" sID="gen5523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3633"/>When they crouch, they bring forth their young ones;<l eID="gen5523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5524"/>they get rid of their labor pains.<note placement="foot">Or “deliver their fetuses”</note> <l eID="gen5524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3634"/><l level="1" sID="gen5525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3634"/>Their young ones grow strong; they grow up in the open;<l eID="gen5525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5526"/>they go forth and do not return to them. <l eID="gen5526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3635"/><l level="1" sID="gen5527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3635"/>“Who has sent forth <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wild ass free?<l eID="gen5527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5528"/>And who has released <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wild donkey’s bonds, <l eID="gen5528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3636"/><l level="1" sID="gen5529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3636"/><transChange type="added">to</transChange> which I have given <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wilderness <transChange type="added">as</transChange> its house<l eID="gen5529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5530"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> salt flat <transChange type="added">as</transChange> its dwelling place? <l eID="gen5530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3637"/><l level="1" sID="gen5531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3637"/>It scorns <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city’s turmoil;<l eID="gen5531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5532"/>it does not hear <transChange type="added">the</transChange> driver’s shouts. <l eID="gen5532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3638"/><l level="1" sID="gen5533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3638"/>It explores <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains <transChange type="added">as</transChange> its pasture<l eID="gen5533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5534"/>and searches after every kind of green plant. <l eID="gen5534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3639"/><l level="1" sID="gen5535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3639"/>“Is <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wild ox willing to serve you,<l eID="gen5535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5536"/>or will he spend the night at your feeding trough? <l eID="gen5536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3640"/><l level="1" sID="gen5537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3640"/>Can you tie <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wild ox <transChange type="added">with</transChange> its rope to a furrow,<l eID="gen5537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5538"/>or will it harrow <transChange type="added">the</transChange> valleys after you? <l eID="gen5538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3641"/><l level="1" sID="gen5539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3641"/>Can you trust it because its strength <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great,<l eID="gen5539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5540"/>or will you hand your labor over to it? <l eID="gen5540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3642"/><l level="1" sID="gen5541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3642"/>Can you rely on it that it will return your grain<l eID="gen5541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5542"/>and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> it will gather <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to your threshing floor? <l eID="gen5542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3643"/><l level="1" sID="gen5543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3643"/>“<transChange type="added">The</transChange> wings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wing”</note> of the female ostrich flap<note placement="foot">Or “flaps”</note>—<l eID="gen5543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5544"/><transChange type="added">are they</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “if,” or “or”</note> the pinions of the stork or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> falcon? <l eID="gen5544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3644"/><l level="1" sID="gen5545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3644"/>Indeed, it leaves its eggs to the earth,<l eID="gen5545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5546"/>and it lets <transChange type="added">them</transChange> be warmed on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ground, <l eID="gen5546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3645"/><l level="1" sID="gen5547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3645"/>and it forgets that a foot might crush an egg,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”; or a collective singular (“them”) referring to “eggs” in v. <reference osisRef="Job.39.14">14</reference></note><l eID="gen5547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5548"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a wild animal⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “an animal of the field”</note> might trample it.<note placement="foot">Or a collective singular (“them”) referring to “eggs” in v. <reference osisRef="Job.39.14">14</reference></note> <l eID="gen5548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3646"/><l level="1" sID="gen5549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3646"/>It deals cruelly with its young ones, as <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> not its <transChange type="added">own</transChange>,<l eID="gen5549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5550"/>as <transChange type="added">if</transChange> without fear <transChange type="added">that</transChange> its labor <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in vain, <l eID="gen5550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3647"/><l level="1" sID="gen5551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3647"/>because God made it forget wisdom,<l eID="gen5551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5552"/>and he did not give it a share in understanding. <l eID="gen5552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3648"/><l level="1" sID="gen5553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3648"/>When it spreads its wings <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞aloft⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the height”</note><l eID="gen5553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5554"/>it laughs at the horse and its rider. <l eID="gen5554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3649"/><l level="1" sID="gen5555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3649"/>“Do you give power to the horse?<l eID="gen5555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5556"/>Do you clothe its neck <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a mane? <l eID="gen5556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3650"/><l level="1" sID="gen5557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3650"/>Do you make it leap like the locust?<l eID="gen5557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5558"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> majesty of its snorting <transChange type="added">is</transChange> terrifying. <l eID="gen5558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3651"/><l level="1" sID="gen5559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3651"/>They paw in the valley, and it exults with strength;<l eID="gen5559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5560"/>it goes out to meet <transChange type="added">the</transChange> battle. <l eID="gen5560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3652"/><l level="1" sID="gen5561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3652"/>It laughs at danger and is not dismayed,<l eID="gen5561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5562"/>and it does not turn back from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from faces of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword. <l eID="gen5562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3653"/><l level="1" sID="gen5563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3653"/>Upon it <transChange type="added">the</transChange> quiver rattles<l eID="gen5563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5564"/><transChange type="added">along with</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flash of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spear and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> short sword. <l eID="gen5564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3654"/><l level="1" sID="gen5565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3654"/>With roar and rage <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it races over the ground⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “it paws the ground”; literally “it swallows the earth/ground”</note><l eID="gen5565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5566"/>and it cannot stand still at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> horn. <l eID="gen5566" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3655"/><l level="1" sID="gen5567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3655"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Whenever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At enough”</note> a horn <transChange type="added">sounds</transChange>, it says, ‘Aha!’<l eID="gen5567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5568"/>And it smells <transChange type="added">the</transChange> battle from a distance—<l eID="gen5568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5569"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> thunder of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> commanders and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> war cry. <l eID="gen5569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3656"/><l level="1" sID="gen5570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3656"/>“Does <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hawk soar by your wisdom?<l eID="gen5570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5571"/>Does it spread its wings to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south? <l eID="gen5571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3657"/><l level="1" sID="gen5572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3657"/>Or does <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eagle fly high at your command<l eID="gen5572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5573"/>and construct its nest high? <l eID="gen5573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3658"/><l level="1" sID="gen5574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3658"/>It lives <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> rock and spends the night<l eID="gen5574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5575"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the rock point and the mountain stronghold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on the tooth of the rock and the stronghold”</note> <l eID="gen5575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3659"/><l level="1" sID="gen5576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3659"/>From there it spies out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prey;<l eID="gen5576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5577"/>its eyes look from far away. <l eID="gen5577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3660"/><l level="1" sID="gen5578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3660"/>And its young ones lick blood greedily,<l eID="gen5578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5579"/>and where <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dead carcasses <transChange type="added">are</transChange>, there they <transChange type="added">are</transChange>.” <l eID="gen5579" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5518"/> <chapter eID="Job.39"/>

verses.name: Job 40:1
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Yahweh answered Job and said,  <div eID="gen5580" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 40:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3661"/><lg sID="gen5581"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3661"/>“Shall a faultfinder contend with Shaddai?<l eID="gen5582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5583"/>Anyone who argues with God must answer it.”<l eID="gen5583" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5581"/> <title type="x-s">Job Responds to Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen5584" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen5584" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 40:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3662"/><lg sID="gen5585"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3662"/>So Job answered Yahweh and said, <l eID="gen5586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3663"/><l level="1" sID="gen5587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3663"/>“Look, I am insignificant.<l eID="gen5587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5588"/>What shall I answer you?<l eID="gen5588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5589"/>I lay my hand on my mouth. <l eID="gen5589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3664"/><l level="1" sID="gen5590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3664"/>Once I have spoken, and I will not answer;<l eID="gen5590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5591"/>even<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> twice, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will not proceed.”<l eID="gen5591" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5585"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh Challenges Job Again</title> <div sID="gen5592" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen5592" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 40:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3665"/><lg sID="gen5593"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3665"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh answered Job from the storm, and he said, <l eID="gen5594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3666"/><l level="1" sID="gen5595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3666"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Prepare yourself for a difficult task like a man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Gird up like a man your loins”</note><l eID="gen5595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5596"/>and I will question you, and you shall declare to me.<l eID="gen5596" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5593"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh Interrogates Job Again</title> <div sID="gen5597" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen5597" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 40:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3667"/><lg sID="gen5598"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3667"/>“Indeed, would you annul my justice?<l eID="gen5599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5600"/>Would you condemn me, so that you might be righteous? <l eID="gen5600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3668"/><l level="1" sID="gen5601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3668"/>Or do you have an arm like God,<l eID="gen5601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5602"/>and can you thunder with a voice like his? <l eID="gen5602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3669"/><l level="1" sID="gen5603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3669"/>Adorn<note placement="foot">The particle sometimes translated “please” is present, but an almighty God or sovereign king does not say “please” when commanding his subjects</note> yourself <transChange type="added">with</transChange> pride and dignity,<l eID="gen5603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5604"/>and clothe yourself <transChange type="added">with</transChange> splendor. <l eID="gen5604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3670"/><l level="1" sID="gen5605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3670"/>Pour out the overflowing of your anger,<l eID="gen5605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5606"/>and look at all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> proud, and humble them. <l eID="gen5606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3671"/><l level="1" sID="gen5607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3671"/>Look at all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> proud, humble them,<l eID="gen5607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5608"/>and tread down <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where they stand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in place of them”</note> <l eID="gen5608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3672"/><l level="1" sID="gen5609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3672"/>Hide them in the dust together;<l eID="gen5609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5610"/>bind their faces in the grave. <l eID="gen5610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3673"/><l level="1" sID="gen5611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3673"/>And I will also praise you,<l eID="gen5611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5612"/>that your <transChange type="added">own</transChange> right hand can save you. <l eID="gen5612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3674"/><l level="1" sID="gen5613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3674"/>“Look, Behemoth,<note placement="foot">Some interpret as a hippopotamus</note> which I have made just as <transChange type="added">I made</transChange> you;<l eID="gen5613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5614"/>it eats grass like the ox. <l eID="gen5614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3675"/><l level="1" sID="gen5615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3675"/>Look, its strength <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in its loins<l eID="gen5615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5616"/>and its power in the muscles of its stomach. <l eID="gen5616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3676"/><l level="1" sID="gen5617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3676"/>It keeps its tail straight like a cedar;<l eID="gen5617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5618"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> sinews of its thighs are tightly wound. <l eID="gen5618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3677"/><l level="1" sID="gen5619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3677"/>Its bones <transChange type="added">are</transChange> tubes of copper,<l eID="gen5619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5620"/>its limbs like rods of iron. <l eID="gen5620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3678"/><l level="1" sID="gen5621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3678"/>“It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the first of God’s actions;<l eID="gen5621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5622"/>the <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> made him furnishes <transChange type="added">it with</transChange> his sword.<note placement="foot">See NET; nearly all other English translations: “Only his Maker can draw the sword against him” (NJPS; compare NLT), or “only its Maker can approach it with the sword” (NRSV, NIV, ESV, HCSB, NASU)</note> <l eID="gen5622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3679"/><l level="1" sID="gen5623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3679"/>Yes, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains yield produce for it,<l eID="gen5623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5624"/>and all <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wild animals⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all the animals of the field”</note> play there. <l eID="gen5624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3680"/><l level="1" sID="gen5625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3680"/>Under <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lotus tree it lies,<l eID="gen5625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5626"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hiding place of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> reeds and <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> marsh. <l eID="gen5626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3681"/><l level="1" sID="gen5627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3681"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> lotus trees cover it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their shade;<l eID="gen5627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5628"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> wadi’s<note placement="foot">A seasonal stream that is often dry</note> poplar trees surround it. <l eID="gen5628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3682"/><l level="1" sID="gen5629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3682"/>Look, <transChange type="added">if the</transChange> river is turbulent, it is not frightened;<l eID="gen5629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5630"/>it is confident even though <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Jordan rushes against its mouth. <l eID="gen5630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3683"/><l level="1" sID="gen5631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3683"/>Can anyone take it by its eyes?<l eID="gen5631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5632"/>Can he pierce <transChange type="added">its</transChange> nose with a snare? <l eID="gen5632" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5598"/> <chapter eID="Job.40"/>

verses.name: Job 41:1
verses.text: <note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Job.41.1-Job.41.34">Job 41:1–34 </reference>in the English Bible is 40:25–41:26 in the Hebrew Bible</note> “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fishhook?<l eID="gen5635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5636"/>Or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞can you tie down its mouth with a cord⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “with a cord can you press down its tongue”</note> <l eID="gen5636" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3684"/><l level="1" sID="gen5637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3684"/>Can you put a rope in its nose?<l eID="gen5637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5638"/>Or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> can you pierce its jawbone with a hook? <l eID="gen5638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3685"/><l level="1" sID="gen5639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3685"/>Will it make numerous pleas for mercy to you?<l eID="gen5639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5640"/>Or will it speak gentle words to you? <l eID="gen5640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3686"/><l level="1" sID="gen5641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3686"/>Will it make a covenant with you?<l eID="gen5641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5642"/>Will you take it as a slave forever? <l eID="gen5642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3687"/><l level="1" sID="gen5643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3687"/>Will you play with it as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> birds<l eID="gen5643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5644"/>and put it on a leash for your girls? <l eID="gen5644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3688"/><l level="1" sID="gen5645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3688"/>Will guildsmen bargain over it?<l eID="gen5645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5646"/>Will they divide it between tradesmen? <l eID="gen5646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3689"/><l level="1" sID="gen5647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3689"/>Can you fill its kin with harpoons<l eID="gen5647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5648"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> its head with fish spears? <l eID="gen5648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3690"/><l level="1" sID="gen5649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3690"/>Lay your hands on it;<l eID="gen5649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5650"/>think about <transChange type="added">the</transChange> battle—you will not do <transChange type="added">it</transChange> again! <l eID="gen5650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3691"/><l level="1" sID="gen5651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3691"/>“Look, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the hope of capturing it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “its hope”</note> is false.<l eID="gen5651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5652"/>Will one be hurled down even at its sight? <l eID="gen5652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3692"/><l level="1" sID="gen5653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3692"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> it not fierce when somebody stirs it?<l eID="gen5653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5654"/>Who <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he <transChange type="added">who</transChange> would stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Or “Who is he thenwho could stand before me?”; literally “to the face of me”</note> <l eID="gen5654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3693"/><l level="1" sID="gen5655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3693"/>Who has come to confront me, that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I should repay <transChange type="added">him</transChange>?<l eID="gen5655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5656"/>Under all the heavens, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it belongs to me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to me”</note> <l eID="gen5656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3694"/><l level="1" sID="gen5657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3694"/>“I will not keep quiet <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> its limbs<l eID="gen5657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5658"/>or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> concerning <transChange type="added">the</transChange> extent of its might and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gracefulness of its frame. <l eID="gen5658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3695"/><l level="1" sID="gen5659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3695"/>Who can strip off <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its outer covering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “the surface of its garment”</note><l eID="gen5659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5660"/>Who can penetrate its double harness? <l eID="gen5660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3696"/><l level="1" sID="gen5661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3696"/>Who can open <transChange type="added">the</transChange> doors of its face?<l eID="gen5661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5662"/>Its teeth all around <transChange type="added">are</transChange> fearsome. <l eID="gen5662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3697"/><l level="1" sID="gen5663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3697"/>Its back<note placement="foot">LXX; or “pride”</note> <transChange type="added">has</transChange> scales of shields;<l eID="gen5663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5664"/>it is shut up closely <transChange type="added">as with</transChange> a seal. <l eID="gen5664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3698"/><l level="1" sID="gen5665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3698"/>They are close <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>—<note placement="foot">Literally “one to one”</note><l eID="gen5665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5666"/>even<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> air cannot come between them. <l eID="gen5666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3699"/><l level="1" sID="gen5667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3699"/>They are joined <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one to another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a man to his brother”</note><l eID="gen5667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5668"/>they cling together and cannot be separated. <l eID="gen5668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3700"/><l level="1" sID="gen5669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3700"/>“Its snorting flashes forth light,<l eID="gen5669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5670"/>and its eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞red like dawn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “like eyelids of dawn”</note> <l eID="gen5670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3701"/><l level="1" sID="gen5671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3701"/>Torches go from its mouth;<l eID="gen5671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5672"/>sparks of fire shoot out. <l eID="gen5672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3702"/><l level="1" sID="gen5673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3702"/>Smoke comes from its nostrils<l eID="gen5673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5674"/>as <transChange type="added">from</transChange> a kettle boiling and <transChange type="added">burning</transChange> bulrushes. <l eID="gen5674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3703"/><l level="1" sID="gen5675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3703"/>Its breath kindles charcoal,<l eID="gen5675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5676"/>and a flame comes from its mouth. <l eID="gen5676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3704"/><l level="1" sID="gen5677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3704"/>“Strength abides in its neck,<l eID="gen5677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5678"/>and dismay<note placement="foot">Or “strength”</note> dances <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of him/it”</note> <l eID="gen5678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3705"/><l level="1" sID="gen5679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3705"/>Its flesh’s folds of skin cling together;<l eID="gen5679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5680"/>it is cast on it—it will not be moved. <l eID="gen5680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3706"/><l level="1" sID="gen5681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3706"/>Its heart is cast as stone;<l eID="gen5681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5682"/>yes,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it is cast as <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lower millstone. <l eID="gen5682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3707"/><l level="1" sID="gen5683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3707"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When it raises itself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “From his/its rising up”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty ones are terrified;<l eID="gen5683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5684"/>they retreat because of its thrashing. <l eID="gen5684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3708"/><l level="1" sID="gen5685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3708"/>Reaching it <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> sword does not avail,<l eID="gen5685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5686"/><transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> spear, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dart, or<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> javelin. <l eID="gen5686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3709"/><l level="1" sID="gen5687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3709"/>It regards iron as straw,<l eID="gen5687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5688"/>bronze as rotten wood. <l eID="gen5688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3710"/><l level="1" sID="gen5689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3710"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞An arrow⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “A son of a bow”</note> will not make it flee;<l eID="gen5689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5690"/>sling stones are turned to stubble for it. <l eID="gen5690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3711"/><l level="1" sID="gen5691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3711"/>Clubs are regarded as stubble,<l eID="gen5691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5692"/>and it laughs at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> short sword’s rattle. <l eID="gen5692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3712"/><l level="1" sID="gen5693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3712"/>“Its underparts <transChange type="added">are</transChange> shards of a potsherd;<l eID="gen5693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5694"/>it moves over mud <transChange type="added">like</transChange> a threshing sledge. <l eID="gen5694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3713"/><l level="1" sID="gen5695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3713"/>It makes <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deep boil like a cooking pot;<l eID="gen5695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5696"/>it makes <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea like a pot of ointment. <l eID="gen5696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3714"/><l level="1" sID="gen5697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3714"/>Behind it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it leaves a glistening wake⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “it lights up the path”</note><l eID="gen5697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5698"/>one would think <transChange type="added">that</transChange> the deep <transChange type="added">has</transChange> gray hair. <l eID="gen5698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3715"/><l level="1" sID="gen5699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3715"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞On the ground it has no equal⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “There is not on the ground its likeness”</note>—<l eID="gen5699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5700"/>a<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> creature without fear. <l eID="gen5700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3716"/><l level="1" sID="gen5701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3716"/>It observes all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lofty;<l eID="gen5701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5702"/>it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> king <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞over all that are proud⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “over all sons of pride”</note> <l eID="gen5702" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5634"/> <chapter eID="Job.41"/>

verses.name: Job 42:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3717"/><title type="x-s">Job’s Repentance and Restoration</title> <div sID="gen5703" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3717"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Job answered Yahweh and said,  <div eID="gen5703" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 42:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3718"/><lg sID="gen5704"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3718"/>“I know that you can do all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>,<l eID="gen5705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5706"/>and <transChange type="added">any</transChange> scheme from you will not be thwarted. <l eID="gen5706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 42:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3719"/><l level="1" sID="gen5707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3719"/>‘Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this darkening counsel without knowledge?’<l eID="gen5707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5708"/>Therefore I uttered, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> I did not understand;<l eID="gen5708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5709"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞things too wonderful for me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “wonderful things from me”</note> but I did not know. <l eID="gen5709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 42:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3720"/><l level="1" sID="gen5710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3720"/>‘Hear and I will speak;<l eID="gen5710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5711"/>I will question you, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> inform me.’ <l eID="gen5711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 42:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3721"/><l level="1" sID="gen5712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3721"/>By the ear’s hearing I heard <transChange type="added">of</transChange> you,<l eID="gen5712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5713"/>but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> now my eye has seen you. <l eID="gen5713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 42:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3722"/><l level="1" sID="gen5714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3722"/>Therefore I despise <transChange type="added">myself</transChange><l eID="gen5714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5715"/>and repent in dust and ashes.” <l eID="gen5715" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5704"/>

verses.name: Job 42:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3723"/><div sID="gen5716" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3723"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it happened”</note> after Yahweh spoke these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞My wrath has been kindled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “My nose became hot”</note> against you<note placement="foot">Singular</note> and against the two of your friends, for you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> have not spoken to me what is right as my servant Job <transChange type="added">has</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 42:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞So then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “And now,” or “Therefore”</note> take for yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job and offer a burnt offering for yourselves. And my servant Job will pray for you,<note placement="foot">Plural</note> for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will certainly accept his prayer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “if his face I will lift up,” or “indeed his face I will lift up” (“if” used as an oath particle)</note> so that it will not be done with you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> according to your folly, for you<note placement="foot">Plural</note> have not spoken to me what is right as my servant Job <transChange type="added">has</transChange>.”  <div eID="gen5716" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 42:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3724"/><div sID="gen5717" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3724"/>So<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did just as Yahweh had told them, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh accepted Job’s prayer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Yahweh lifted up the face of Job”</note>  <div eID="gen5717" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 42:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3725"/><div sID="gen5718" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3725"/>Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Yahweh returned Job’s fortune when he prayed to him on behalf of his friends. Thus<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Yahweh increased <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all that Job had twice as much as before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all which for Job to twice”</note>

verses.name: Job 42:11
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> all his brothers and all his sisters and all those who had known him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to faces”</note> came to him, and they ate bread<note placement="foot">Or “food”</note> with him in his house and showed sympathy to him and comforted him for all the disaster<note placement="foot">Or “evil”</note> that Yahweh had brought upon him. Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> each one gave to him one piece of money, and each one <transChange type="added">gave to him</transChange> one ornamental ring of gold.  <div eID="gen5718" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 42:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3726"/><div sID="gen5719" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3726"/>So<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Yahweh blessed Job’s latter days more than his beginning. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Thus he had⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it came to be for him,” or “And it was for him”</note> fourteen thousand sheep and goats and six thousand camels and a thousand pair of oxen and a thousand female donkeys.

verses.name: Job 42:13
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And he had⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it came to be for him,” or “And it was for him”</note> seven sons and three daughters.

verses.name: Job 42:14
verses.text: And he called the name of the first Jemimah and the name of the second Keziah and the name of the third Qeren-Happuk.

verses.name: Job 42:15
