verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3877"/><l level="1" sID="gen6129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3877"/>He who walks blamelessly and does what is right.<l eID="gen6129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6130"/>He who speaks honestly in his heart. <l eID="gen6130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3878"/><l level="1" sID="gen6131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3878"/>He does not slander with his tongue.<l eID="gen6131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6132"/>He does not harm his friend,<l eID="gen6132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6133"/>nor <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bring up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lift up”</note> a disgrace against his neighbor. <l eID="gen6133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3879"/><l level="1" sID="gen6134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3879"/>In his eyes a rejected one <transChange type="added">is</transChange> contemptible,<l eID="gen6134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6135"/>but he honors those who respect Yahweh.<l eID="gen6135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6136"/>He takes an oath to <transChange type="added">his own</transChange> injury and does not retract it. <l eID="gen6136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3880"/><l level="1" sID="gen6137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3880"/>He does not lend his money at interest,<l eID="gen6137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6138"/>and does not take a bribe against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> innocent.<l eID="gen6138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6139"/>He who does these <transChange type="added">things</transChange><l eID="gen6139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6140"/>will never be shaken. <l eID="gen6140" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6126"/> <chapter eID="Ps.15"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3881"/><title type="x-s">Confidence in Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen6141" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6141" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6142"/> <lg eID="gen6142"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A miktam<note placement="foot">Meaning uncertain</note> of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6143"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3881"/>Protect me, O God,<l eID="gen6144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6145"/>for I take refuge in you. <l eID="gen6145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3882"/><l level="1" sID="gen6146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3882"/><transChange type="added">Oh my soul</transChange> you have said<note placement="foot">Reading a feminine singular verb; some Hebrew manuscripts and translations read “I said”</note> to Yahweh, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my Lord.<l eID="gen6146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6147"/>I have no good apart from you.” <l eID="gen6147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3883"/><l level="1" sID="gen6148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3883"/>With regard to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> saints who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the land,<l eID="gen6148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6149"/>they <transChange type="added">are the</transChange> noble ones in <transChange type="added">whom is</transChange> all my desire. <l eID="gen6149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3884"/><l level="1" sID="gen6150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3884"/>Those <transChange type="added">who</transChange> hurry <transChange type="added">after</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “they who acquire”</note> another <transChange type="added">god</transChange> increase their sorrows.<l eID="gen6150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6151"/>I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood,<l eID="gen6151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6152"/>nor take up their names on my lips. <l eID="gen6152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3885"/><l level="1" sID="gen6153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3885"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the portion <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> my share and my cup.<l eID="gen6153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6154"/>You hold my lot. <l eID="gen6154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3886"/><l level="1" sID="gen6155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3886"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> measuring lines have fallen for me in pleasant places.<l eID="gen6155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6156"/>Yes, <transChange type="added">my</transChange> inheritance is delightful for me. <l eID="gen6156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3887"/><l level="1" sID="gen6157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3887"/>I will bless Yahweh who advises me;<l eID="gen6157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6158"/>yes, <transChange type="added">at</transChange> night my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞innermost being⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “kidneys”</note> instructs me. <l eID="gen6158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3888"/><l level="1" sID="gen6159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3888"/>I have set Yahweh before me always.<l eID="gen6159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6160"/>Because <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> at my right hand I will not be shaken. <l eID="gen6160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3889"/><l level="1" sID="gen6161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3889"/>Therefore my heart is glad and my glory rejoices.<l eID="gen6161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6162"/>Yes, my body will dwell in safety, <l eID="gen6162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3890"/><l level="1" sID="gen6163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3890"/>for you will not abandon my soul to Sheol;<l eID="gen6163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6164"/>you will not give your faithful one to see <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grave. <l eID="gen6164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3891"/><l level="1" sID="gen6165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3891"/>You will make known to me <transChange type="added">the</transChange> path of life.<l eID="gen6165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6166"/>In your presence <transChange type="added">is</transChange> fullness of joy.<l eID="gen6166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6167"/>At your right hand <transChange type="added">are</transChange> pleasures forever. <l eID="gen6167" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6143"/> <chapter eID="Ps.16"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3892"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for Vindication and Protection</title> <div sID="gen6168" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6168" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6169"/> <lg eID="gen6169"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A prayer of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6170"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3892"/>O Yahweh, hear a just cause.<l eID="gen6171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6172"/>Hear my cry; heed my prayer<l eID="gen6172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6173"/><transChange type="added">I make</transChange> without deceitful lips. <l eID="gen6173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3893"/><l level="1" sID="gen6174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3893"/>Let my vindication come forth from you;<l eID="gen6174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6175"/>let your eyes see fairness. <l eID="gen6175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3894"/><l level="1" sID="gen6176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3894"/>You have tried my heart;<l eID="gen6176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6177"/>you have examined <transChange type="added">me</transChange> by night;<l eID="gen6177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6178"/>you have tested me; you found nothing.<l eID="gen6178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6179"/>I have decided <transChange type="added">that</transChange> my mouth will not transgress. <l eID="gen6179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3895"/><l level="1" sID="gen6180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3895"/>As for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> works of humankind,<l eID="gen6180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6181"/>by the word of your lips,<l eID="gen6181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6182"/>I have kept <transChange type="added">from</transChange> the ways of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> violent. <l eID="gen6182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3896"/><l level="1" sID="gen6183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3896"/><transChange type="added">I have</transChange> held my steps in your path<l eID="gen6183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6184"/>My feet will not slip. <l eID="gen6184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3897"/><l level="1" sID="gen6185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3897"/>As for me, I have called on you<l eID="gen6185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6186"/>because you will answer me, O God.<l eID="gen6186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6187"/>Incline your ear to me.<l eID="gen6187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6188"/>Hear my words.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “word”</note> <l eID="gen6188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3898"/><l level="1" sID="gen6189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3898"/>Show wondrously your acts of loyal love,<l eID="gen6189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6190"/>O Savior of those who take refuge<l eID="gen6190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6191"/>at your right hand<note placement="foot">Or “saving by your right hand those”</note><l eID="gen6191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6192"/>from those who rise up against <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <l eID="gen6192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3899"/><l level="1" sID="gen6193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3899"/>Keep me as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the apple of your eye⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the little man of the daughter of your eye”</note><l eID="gen6193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6194"/>Hide me in the shadow of your wings <l eID="gen6194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3900"/><l level="1" sID="gen6195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3900"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked who destroy me,<l eID="gen6195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6196"/><transChange type="added">those</transChange> enemies against my life,<l eID="gen6196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6197"/><transChange type="added">they that</transChange> surround me. <l eID="gen6197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3901"/><l level="1" sID="gen6198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3901"/>They have shut off their calloused<note placement="foot">Or “fat”</note> <transChange type="added">heart</transChange>;<l eID="gen6198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6199"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> their mouth they speak arrogantly. <l eID="gen6199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3902"/><l level="1" sID="gen6200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3902"/>Now they surround us at our <transChange type="added">every</transChange> step.<l eID="gen6200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6201"/>They <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞intend⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “set their eyes”</note><l eID="gen6201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6202"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to pin⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to stretch”</note> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> to the ground. <l eID="gen6202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3903"/><l level="1" sID="gen6203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3903"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He is like⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “His image”</note> a lion; he longs to tear apart,<l eID="gen6203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6204"/>and like a strong lion crouching in hiding places. <l eID="gen6204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3904"/><l level="1" sID="gen6205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3904"/>Rise up, O Yahweh, confront <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his face”</note><l eID="gen6205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6206"/>Make him bow down.<l eID="gen6206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6207"/>Rescue with your sword my life from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked, <l eID="gen6207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3905"/><l level="1" sID="gen6208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3905"/>from men by your hand, O Yahweh, from men of <transChange type="added">this</transChange> world.<l eID="gen6208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6209"/>Their share <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the life”</note> and you fill their stomach <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your treasure.<l eID="gen6209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6210"/>They are satisfied <transChange type="added">with</transChange> children.<l eID="gen6210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6211"/>They bequeath their excess to their children. <l eID="gen6211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3906"/><l level="1" sID="gen6212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3906"/><transChange type="added">By contrast,</transChange> I in righteousness shall see your face.<l eID="gen6212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6213"/>Upon awakening I will be satisfied <transChange type="added">seeing</transChange> your form. <l eID="gen6213" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6170"/> <chapter eID="Ps.17"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3907"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for His Deliverance</title> <div sID="gen6214" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6214" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6215"/> <lg eID="gen6215"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of David, the servant of Yahweh,</title> <lg sID="gen6216"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6217"/>who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song<l eID="gen6217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6218"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the day”</note> Yahweh delivered him from the hand of all his enemies,<l eID="gen6218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6219"/>and from the hand of Saul.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen6219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3907"/>And he said:<l eID="gen6220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6221"/>“I love you, O Yahweh, my strength.” <l eID="gen6221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3908"/><l level="1" sID="gen6222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3908"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my rock and my fortress and my deliverer,<l eID="gen6222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6223"/>my God, my rock in whom I have taken refuge,<l eID="gen6223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6224"/>my shield and the horn of my deliverance, my stronghold. <l eID="gen6224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3909"/><l level="1" sID="gen6225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3909"/>I called upon Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised,<l eID="gen6225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6226"/>and I was saved from my enemies. <l eID="gen6226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3910"/><l level="1" sID="gen6227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3910"/>The ropes of death encircled me,<l eID="gen6227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6228"/>and streams of ruin overwhelmed me. <l eID="gen6228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3911"/><l level="1" sID="gen6229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3911"/>The ropes of Sheol surrounded me;<l eID="gen6229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6230"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> snares of death confronted me. <l eID="gen6230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3912"/><l level="1" sID="gen6231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3912"/>In my trouble I called on Yahweh,<l eID="gen6231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6232"/>and to my God I cried for help.<l eID="gen6232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6233"/>He heard my voice from his temple,<l eID="gen6233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6234"/>and my cry for help<l eID="gen6234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6235"/>came up before his presence into his ears. <l eID="gen6235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3913"/><l level="1" sID="gen6236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3913"/>Then the earth shook and quaked,<l eID="gen6236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6237"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> foundations of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains trembled,<l eID="gen6237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6238"/>and they staggered because he was angry. <l eID="gen6238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3914"/><l level="1" sID="gen6239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3914"/>Smoke went forth from his nose,<l eID="gen6239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6240"/>and fire from his mouth consumed.<l eID="gen6240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6241"/>Burning coals blazed from him. <l eID="gen6241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3915"/><l level="1" sID="gen6242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3915"/>So he bowed <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens and came down<l eID="gen6242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6243"/>with a thick cloud under his feet. <l eID="gen6243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3916"/><l level="1" sID="gen6244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3916"/>And he mounted a cherub and flew,<l eID="gen6244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6245"/>and he swooped down on wings of wind. <l eID="gen6245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3917"/><l level="1" sID="gen6246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3917"/>He made darkness his hiding place;<l eID="gen6246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6247"/>all about him his covering<l eID="gen6247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6248"/><transChange type="added">was</transChange> a darkness of waters, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞thick clouds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “clouds of clouds”</note> <l eID="gen6248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3918"/><l level="1" sID="gen6249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3918"/>From the brightness before him<l eID="gen6249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6250"/>his clouds passed over<l eID="gen6250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6251"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> hail and coals of fire. <l eID="gen6251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3919"/><l level="1" sID="gen6252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3919"/>And Yahweh thundered from the heavens,<l eID="gen6252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6253"/>and the Most High uttered his voice<l eID="gen6253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6254"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> hail and coals of fire. <l eID="gen6254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3920"/><l level="1" sID="gen6255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3920"/>And he shot his arrows and scattered them,<note placement="foot">That is, the enemy</note><l eID="gen6255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6256"/>and many lightning bolts and routed them. <l eID="gen6256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3921"/><l level="1" sID="gen6257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3921"/>Then the channels of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea became visible,<l eID="gen6257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6258"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> foundations of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world were uncovered<l eID="gen6258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6259"/>by your rebuke, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen6259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6260"/>by the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞blast⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “breath”</note> of the wind of your nose. <l eID="gen6260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3922"/><l level="1" sID="gen6261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3922"/>He reached<note placement="foot">Or “sent”</note> from on high; he seized me.<l eID="gen6261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6262"/>He drew me from many waters. <l eID="gen6262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3923"/><l level="1" sID="gen6263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3923"/>He delivered me from my strong enemy,<l eID="gen6263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6264"/>and from <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> hated me<l eID="gen6264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6265"/>because they were stronger than I. <l eID="gen6265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3924"/><l level="1" sID="gen6266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3924"/>They confronted me on the day of disaster,<l eID="gen6266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6267"/>but Yahweh was my support. <l eID="gen6267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3925"/><l level="1" sID="gen6268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3925"/>So he brought me out to a spacious place.<l eID="gen6268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6269"/>He delivered me because he delighted in me. <l eID="gen6269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3926"/><l level="1" sID="gen6270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3926"/>Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness;<l eID="gen6270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6271"/>According to the cleanness of my hands<l eID="gen6271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6272"/>he has repaid me. <l eID="gen6272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3927"/><l level="1" sID="gen6273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3927"/>Because I have kept the ways of Yahweh,<l eID="gen6273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6274"/>and have not acted wickedly against my God, <l eID="gen6274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3928"/><l level="1" sID="gen6275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3928"/>because all his ordinances <transChange type="added">are</transChange> before me,<l eID="gen6275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6276"/>and his statutes I have not removed from me, <l eID="gen6276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3929"/><l level="1" sID="gen6277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3929"/>and I was blameless before him,<l eID="gen6277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6278"/>and I kept myself from my guilt. <l eID="gen6278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3930"/><l level="1" sID="gen6279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3930"/>Therefore Yahweh has repaid me according to my righteousness,<l eID="gen6279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6280"/>according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight. <l eID="gen6280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3931"/><l level="1" sID="gen6281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3931"/>To <transChange type="added">the</transChange> loyal you show yourself loyal.<l eID="gen6281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6282"/>To <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blameless you show yourself blameless. <l eID="gen6282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3932"/><l level="1" sID="gen6283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3932"/>To <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pure you show yourself pure.<l eID="gen6283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6284"/>but to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked you show yourself shrewd. <l eID="gen6284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3933"/><l level="1" sID="gen6285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3933"/>For you deliver humble people,<l eID="gen6285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6286"/>but haughty eyes you humiliate. <l eID="gen6286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3934"/><l level="1" sID="gen6287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3934"/>For you light my lamp;<l eID="gen6287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6288"/>Yahweh, my God, lights up my darkness. <l eID="gen6288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3935"/><l level="1" sID="gen6289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3935"/>For with you I can charge a troop,<l eID="gen6289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6290"/>and with my God I can scale a wall. <l eID="gen6290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3936"/><l level="1" sID="gen6291"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3936"/>This<note placement="foot">Hebrew “The”</note> God—his way <transChange type="added">is</transChange> blameless.<l eID="gen6291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6292"/>The word of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> flawless.<note placement="foot">Or “refined”</note><l eID="gen6292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6293"/>He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a shield for all those who take refuge in him. <l eID="gen6293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3937"/><l level="1" sID="gen6294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3937"/>For who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> God apart from Yahweh,<l eID="gen6294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6295"/>and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a rock except our God? <l eID="gen6295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3938"/><l level="1" sID="gen6296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3938"/>The God who girded me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> strength,<l eID="gen6296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6297"/>and made safe<note placement="foot">Or “blameless”</note> my way, <l eID="gen6297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3939"/><l level="1" sID="gen6298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3939"/>he made my feet like the deer’s,<l eID="gen6298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6299"/>and on my high places he makes me stand. <l eID="gen6299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3940"/><l level="1" sID="gen6300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3940"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> trains my hands for war,<l eID="gen6300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6301"/>so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze. <l eID="gen6301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3941"/><l level="1" sID="gen6302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3941"/>You also gave me the shield of your salvation,<l eID="gen6302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6303"/>and your right hand supported me,<l eID="gen6303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6304"/>and your humility made me great. <l eID="gen6304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3942"/><l level="1" sID="gen6305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3942"/>You enlarged my step under me,<l eID="gen6305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6306"/>and my ankles did not slip. <l eID="gen6306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3943"/><l level="1" sID="gen6307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3943"/>I chased my enemies and overtook them;<l eID="gen6307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6308"/>I did not turn back until they were finished <transChange type="added">off</transChange>. <l eID="gen6308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3944"/><l level="1" sID="gen6309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3944"/>I struck them and they were not able to stand up;<l eID="gen6309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6310"/>they fell under my feet. <l eID="gen6310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3945"/><l level="1" sID="gen6311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3945"/>And you girded me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> strength for the battle;<l eID="gen6311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6312"/><transChange type="added">those</transChange> rising against me you made to kneel under me. <l eID="gen6312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3946"/><l level="1" sID="gen6313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3946"/>And you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made my enemies turn their backs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “turned to me my enemies’ neck”</note><l eID="gen6313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6314"/>then I destroyed those <transChange type="added">who</transChange> hated me. <l eID="gen6314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3947"/><l level="1" sID="gen6315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3947"/>They cried out but there was no rescuer,<l eID="gen6315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6316"/><transChange type="added">even</transChange> to Yahweh, but he did not answer them. <l eID="gen6316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3948"/><l level="1" sID="gen6317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3948"/>And I ground them like dust <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the wind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “on the face of the wind”</note><l eID="gen6317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6318"/>I emptied them<note placement="foot">Many Hebrew manuscripts, the LXX, Syriac, and <reference osisRef="2Sam.22.43">2 Sam 22:43 </reference>read “I crushed them”</note> out like mud of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> streets. <l eID="gen6318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3949"/><l level="1" sID="gen6319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3949"/>You rescued me from strife with people;<l eID="gen6319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6320"/>you set me as head (over) nations.<l eID="gen6320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6321"/>People I did not know served me; <l eID="gen6321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3950"/><l level="1" sID="gen6322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3950"/>as soon as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they heard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “hearing of ear”</note> they obeyed me.<l eID="gen6322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6323"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> children of a foreign land feigned obedience before me. <l eID="gen6323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3951"/><l level="1" sID="gen6324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3951"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> children of a foreign land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lost heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sunk down”</note><l eID="gen6324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6325"/>and they came trembling from their strongholds. <l eID="gen6325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3952"/><l level="1" sID="gen6326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3952"/>Yahweh lives, and blessed <transChange type="added">be</transChange> my rock,<l eID="gen6326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6327"/>and may the God of my salvation be exalted— <l eID="gen6327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3953"/><l level="1" sID="gen6328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3953"/>the God who executed vengeance for me,<l eID="gen6328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6329"/>and subdued peoples under me, <l eID="gen6329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3954"/><l level="1" sID="gen6330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3954"/>who delivered me from my enemies.<l eID="gen6330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6331"/>Indeed, you exalted me higher than <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> rose against me.<l eID="gen6331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6332"/>You delivered me from the man of violence. <l eID="gen6332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3955"/><l level="1" sID="gen6333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3955"/>Therefore I will give thanks to you among the nations, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen6333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6334"/>and I will sing <transChange type="added">the praise</transChange> of your name: <l eID="gen6334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3956"/><l level="1" sID="gen6335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3956"/>the one who makes great victories for his king,<l eID="gen6335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6336"/>and <transChange type="added">who</transChange> shows loyal love for his anointed,<l eID="gen6336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6337"/>to David and to his descendants forever. <l eID="gen6337" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6216"/> <chapter eID="Ps.18"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3957"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Creation and Law</title> <div sID="gen6338" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6338" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6339"/> <lg eID="gen6339"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen6340"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3957"/>The heavens <transChange type="added">are</transChange> telling the glory of God,<l eID="gen6341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6342"/>and the firmament proclaims the work of his hands. <l eID="gen6342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3958"/><l level="1" sID="gen6343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3958"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Every day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “day to day”</note> <transChange type="added">they</transChange> pour forth speech,<l eID="gen6343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6344"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every night⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “night to night”</note> <transChange type="added">they</transChange> tell knowledge. <l eID="gen6344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3959"/><l level="1" sID="gen6345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3959"/>There is no speech and there are no words;<l eID="gen6345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6346"/>their sound is inaudible. <l eID="gen6346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3960"/><l level="1" sID="gen6347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3960"/><transChange type="added">Yet</transChange> in all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world their line<note placement="foot">LXX “line”</note> goes out,<l eID="gen6347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6348"/>and their words to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world.<l eID="gen6348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6349"/>In them<note placement="foot">That is, the heavens</note> he has pitched a tent for the sun, <l eID="gen6349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3961"/><l level="1" sID="gen6350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3961"/>and it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a bridegroom<l eID="gen6350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6351"/>who comes out of his bridal chamber.<l eID="gen6351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6352"/>It is glad like a strong man<l eID="gen6352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6353"/>to run <transChange type="added">its</transChange> course. <l eID="gen6353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3962"/><l level="1" sID="gen6354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3962"/>Its rising <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from <transChange type="added">one</transChange><note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> end of the heavens<l eID="gen6354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6355"/>and its circuit to the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> end<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ends”</note> of them;<l eID="gen6355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6356"/>and nothing <transChange type="added">is</transChange> hidden from its heat. <l eID="gen6356" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3963"/><l level="1" sID="gen6357"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3963"/>The law of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> perfect, reviving life.<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note><l eID="gen6357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6358"/>The testimony of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> firm, making wise <transChange type="added">the</transChange> simple. <l eID="gen6358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3964"/><l level="1" sID="gen6359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3964"/>The precepts of Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> right, making <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart rejoice.<l eID="gen6359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6360"/>The command of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> pure, enlightening <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes. <l eID="gen6360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3965"/><l level="1" sID="gen6361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3965"/>The fear of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> pure, enduring forever.<l eID="gen6361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6362"/>The ordinances of Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> true; they are righteous altogether, <l eID="gen6362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3966"/><l level="1" sID="gen6363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3966"/>more desirable than gold, even much fine gold;<l eID="gen6363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6364"/>and sweeter than honey, even honey <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> comb. <l eID="gen6364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3967"/><l level="1" sID="gen6365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3967"/>Moreover, your servant <transChange type="added">is</transChange> warned<note placement="foot">Or “illumined”</note> by them;<l eID="gen6365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6366"/>in keeping them <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great reward. <l eID="gen6366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3968"/><l level="1" sID="gen6367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3968"/>Who can perceive <transChange type="added">his</transChange> errors?<l eID="gen6367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6368"/>Acquit me from hidden <transChange type="added">faults</transChange>. <l eID="gen6368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3969"/><l level="1" sID="gen6369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3969"/>Also, keep back your servant from arrogant <transChange type="added">sins</transChange>;<note placement="foot">Usage elsewhere might suggest “arrogant people”</note><l eID="gen6369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6370"/>let them not rule over me.<l eID="gen6370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6371"/>Then I shall be blameless,<l eID="gen6371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6372"/>and I shall be innocent of great transgression. <l eID="gen6372" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3970"/><l level="1" sID="gen6373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3970"/>Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart<l eID="gen6373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6374"/>be acceptable in your presence,<l eID="gen6374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6375"/>O Yahweh, my rock and my redeemer. <l eID="gen6375" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6340"/> <chapter eID="Ps.19"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3971"/><title type="x-s">God’s Blessing on the King</title> <div sID="gen6376" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6376" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6377"/> <lg eID="gen6377"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen6378"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3971"/>May Yahweh answer you in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of trouble.<l eID="gen6379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6380"/>May the name of Jacob’s God protect<note placement="foot">The sense is that of making something inaccessibly high, like a fortress</note> you. <l eID="gen6380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3972"/><l level="1" sID="gen6381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3972"/>May he send you help<note placement="foot">Hebrew “your help”</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sanctuary,<l eID="gen6381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6382"/>and from Zion may he sustain you. <l eID="gen6382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3973"/><l level="1" sID="gen6383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3973"/>May he remember all your offerings,<l eID="gen6383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6384"/>and your burnt offering may he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞regard favorably⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “find to be fat”</note> <l eID="gen6384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3974"/><l level="1" sID="gen6385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3974"/>May he give to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your heart’s desire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “according to your heart”</note><l eID="gen6385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6386"/>and your every plan may he fulfill. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen6386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3975"/><l level="1" sID="gen6387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3975"/>May we shout for joy over your victory,<l eID="gen6387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6388"/>and in the name of our God may we set up banners.<l eID="gen6388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6389"/>May Yahweh fulfill all your requests. <l eID="gen6389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3976"/><l level="1" sID="gen6390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3976"/>Now I know that Yahweh will help his anointed.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “messiah”</note><l eID="gen6390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6391"/>He will answer him from his holy heaven<l eID="gen6391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6392"/>with the victorious power of his right hand. <l eID="gen6392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3977"/><l level="1" sID="gen6393"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3977"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Some boast in chariots and others in horses⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “These in the chariots and those in the horses”</note><l eID="gen6393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6394"/>but we boast in the name of Yahweh, our God. <l eID="gen6394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3978"/><l level="1" sID="gen6395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3978"/>They will collapse and fall,<l eID="gen6395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6396"/>and we will rise and stand firm. <l eID="gen6396" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3979"/><l level="1" sID="gen6397"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3979"/>Rescue,<note placement="foot">Or “Grant victory”</note> O Yahweh.<l eID="gen6397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6398"/>Let the king answer us when we call. <l eID="gen6398" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6378"/> <chapter eID="Ps.20"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3980"/><title type="x-s">Joy in the Salvation of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen6399" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6399" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6400"/> <lg eID="gen6400"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen6401"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3980"/>O Yahweh, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king will rejoice in your strength,<l eID="gen6402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6403"/>and how greatly he will delight in your help.<note placement="foot">Or “victory”</note> <l eID="gen6403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3981"/><l level="1" sID="gen6404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3981"/>You have given him the desire of his heart,<l eID="gen6404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6405"/>and have not withheld the request of his lips. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen6405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3982"/><l level="1" sID="gen6406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3982"/>For you meet him <transChange type="added">with</transChange> blessings of good <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.<l eID="gen6406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6407"/>You set on his head a crown of fine gold. <l eID="gen6407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3983"/><l level="1" sID="gen6408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3983"/>He asked life from you; you gave <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to him—<l eID="gen6408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6409"/>length of days forever and ever. <l eID="gen6409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3984"/><l level="1" sID="gen6410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3984"/>His honor <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great because of your help.<note placement="foot">Or “victory”</note><l eID="gen6410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6411"/>Splendor and majesty you have bestowed upon him. <l eID="gen6411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3985"/><l level="1" sID="gen6412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3985"/>For you set <transChange type="added">on</transChange> him blessings forever.<l eID="gen6412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6413"/>You make him glad with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> joy <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your presence. <l eID="gen6413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3986"/><l level="1" sID="gen6414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3986"/>Because the king trusts Yahweh,<l eID="gen6414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6415"/>and through the steadfast love<note placement="foot">Or “loyal love”</note> of the Most High<l eID="gen6415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6416"/>he shall not be moved. <l eID="gen6416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3987"/><l level="1" sID="gen6417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3987"/>Your hand will find all your enemies;<l eID="gen6417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6418"/>your right hand will find those who hate you. <l eID="gen6418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3988"/><l level="1" sID="gen6419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3988"/>You will make them like your fiery furnace<l eID="gen6419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6420"/>at the time of your appearance.<l eID="gen6420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6421"/>Yahweh will swallow them in his wrath<l eID="gen6421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6422"/>and fire will consume them. <l eID="gen6422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3989"/><l level="1" sID="gen6423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3989"/>You will destroy their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞offspring⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fruit”</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen6423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6424"/>and their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞descendants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “seed”</note> from among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of humankind. <l eID="gen6424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3990"/><l level="1" sID="gen6425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3990"/>Though they have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞plotted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “spread out”</note> evil against you,<l eID="gen6425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6426"/><transChange type="added">though</transChange> they have planned a scheme, they will not prevail. <l eID="gen6426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3991"/><l level="1" sID="gen6427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3991"/>For you will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞turn them to flight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “make them a shoulder”</note><l eID="gen6427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6428"/>you will aim <transChange type="added">arrows</transChange> on your bowstrings at their faces. <l eID="gen6428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3992"/><l level="1" sID="gen6429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3992"/>Be exalted, O Yahweh, in your strength,<l eID="gen6429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6430"/>and we sing and praise your power. <l eID="gen6430" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6401"/> <chapter eID="Ps.21"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3993"/><title type="x-s">Suffering and Waiting for Deliverance</title> <div sID="gen6431" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6431" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6432"/> <lg eID="gen6432"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director; according to The Doe of the Dawn. A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen6433"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3993"/>My God, my God why have you forsaken me?<l eID="gen6434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6435"/><transChange type="added">Why are you</transChange> far from helping me, <transChange type="added">far from</transChange> the words of my groaning? <l eID="gen6435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3994"/><l level="1" sID="gen6436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3994"/>O my God, I call by day and you do not answer,<l eID="gen6436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6437"/>and <transChange type="added">by</transChange> night but I have no rest.<note placement="foot">Or “I am not silent”</note> <l eID="gen6437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3995"/><l level="1" sID="gen6438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3995"/>Yet you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> holy,<l eID="gen6438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6439"/>enthroned on the praises of Israel. <l eID="gen6439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3996"/><l level="1" sID="gen6440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3996"/>Our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> trusted you;<l eID="gen6440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6441"/>they trusted and you delivered them. <l eID="gen6441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3997"/><l level="1" sID="gen6442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3997"/>They cried to you and were saved;<l eID="gen6442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6443"/>they trusted you and were not ashamed. <l eID="gen6443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3998"/><l level="1" sID="gen6444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3998"/>But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a worm and not a man,<l eID="gen6444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6445"/>scorned by humankind and despised by people. <l eID="gen6445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3999"/><l level="1" sID="gen6446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3999"/>All <transChange type="added">who</transChange> see me mock me.<l eID="gen6446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6447"/>They open wide <transChange type="added">their</transChange> lips;<l eID="gen6447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6448"/>they shake <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>: <l eID="gen6448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4000"/><l level="1" sID="gen6449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4000"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He trusts Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Commit to Yahweh”</note> Let him rescue him.<l eID="gen6449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6450"/>Let him deliver him because he delights in him.” <l eID="gen6450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4001"/><l level="1" sID="gen6451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4001"/>Yet <transChange type="added">you</transChange> took me from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> belly;<l eID="gen6451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6452"/>you made me trust <transChange type="added">while</transChange> on my mother’s breasts. <l eID="gen6452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4002"/><l level="1" sID="gen6453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4002"/>On you I was cast from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb.<l eID="gen6453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6454"/>From my mother’s belly you <transChange type="added">have been</transChange> my God. <l eID="gen6454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4003"/><l level="1" sID="gen6455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4003"/>Do not be far from me<l eID="gen6455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6456"/>because trouble <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near;<l eID="gen6456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6457"/>because there is no helper. <l eID="gen6457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4004"/><l level="1" sID="gen6458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4004"/>Many bulls have encircled me;<l eID="gen6458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6459"/>mighty <transChange type="added">bulls</transChange> of Bashan have surrounded me. <l eID="gen6459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4005"/><l level="1" sID="gen6460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4005"/>They open their mouth against me<l eID="gen6460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6461"/><transChange type="added">like</transChange> a lion tearing and roaring. <l eID="gen6461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4006"/><l level="1" sID="gen6462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4006"/>I am poured out like water,<l eID="gen6462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6463"/>and all my bones are out of joint.<l eID="gen6463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6464"/>My heart is like wax;<l eID="gen6464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6465"/>it is melted <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the midst of my intestines”</note> <l eID="gen6465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4007"/><l level="1" sID="gen6466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4007"/>My strength is dry like a potsherd,<l eID="gen6466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6467"/>and my tongue is sticking <transChange type="added">to</transChange> my jaws;<l eID="gen6467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6468"/>and you have placed me in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust of death. <l eID="gen6468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4008"/><l level="1" sID="gen6469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4008"/>Because dogs have surrounded me;<l eID="gen6469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6470"/>a gang of evildoers has encircled me.<l eID="gen6470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6471"/>Like the lion<note placement="foot">Or “they gouge out” or “they bind.” Not the same word for “lion” found in vv. <reference osisRef="Ps.22.14">14</reference>(13), 22(21). The Hebrew text presents such problems that any interpretation must be lightly held.</note> <transChange type="added">they are at</transChange> my hands and my feet. <l eID="gen6471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4009"/><l level="1" sID="gen6472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4009"/>I can count all my bones;<l eID="gen6472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6473"/>they gaze, they look at me. <l eID="gen6473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4010"/><l level="1" sID="gen6474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4010"/>They divide my garments among them,<l eID="gen6474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6475"/>and for my clothing they cast lots.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lot”</note> <l eID="gen6475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4011"/><l level="1" sID="gen6476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4011"/>But you, O Yahweh, do not remain distant.<l eID="gen6476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6477"/>O my help, hasten to help me. <l eID="gen6477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4012"/><l level="1" sID="gen6478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4012"/>Rescue my life from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword,<l eID="gen6478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6479"/>my only <transChange type="added">life</transChange> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> power of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dogs.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dog”</note> <l eID="gen6479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4013"/><l level="1" sID="gen6480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4013"/>Save me from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mouth of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lion,<l eID="gen6480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6481"/>and from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> horns of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wild oxen answer me. <l eID="gen6481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4014"/><l level="1" sID="gen6482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4014"/>I will tell your name to my brothers;<l eID="gen6482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6483"/>inside <transChange type="added">the</transChange> assembly I will praise you. <l eID="gen6483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4015"/><l level="1" sID="gen6484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4015"/>You who revere Yahweh, praise him!<l eID="gen6484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6485"/>Glorify him, all <transChange type="added">you</transChange> seed of Jacob,<l eID="gen6485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6486"/>and be in awe of him, all <transChange type="added">you</transChange> seed of Israel, <l eID="gen6486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4016"/><l level="1" sID="gen6487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4016"/>because he has not despised nor abhorred <transChange type="added">the</transChange> affliction of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> afflicted,<l eID="gen6487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6488"/>and has not hid his face from him;<l eID="gen6488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6489"/>but he listened to him when he cried for help. <l eID="gen6489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4017"/><l level="1" sID="gen6490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4017"/>From you <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my praise.<l eID="gen6490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6491"/>In <transChange type="added">the</transChange> great assembly,<l eID="gen6491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6492"/>I will pay my vows before those who revere him. <l eID="gen6492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4018"/><l level="1" sID="gen6493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4018"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> afflicted will eat and will be satisfied.<l eID="gen6493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6494"/>Those who seek him will praise Yahweh.<l eID="gen6494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6495"/>May your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> heart live forever. <l eID="gen6495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4019"/><l level="1" sID="gen6496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4019"/>All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ends of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth<l eID="gen6496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6497"/>will remember and turn to Yahweh.<l eID="gen6497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6498"/>All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> families of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations<l eID="gen6498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6499"/>will worship before you. <l eID="gen6499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4020"/><l level="1" sID="gen6500"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4020"/>Because the kingship belongs to Yahweh,<l eID="gen6500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6501"/>and <transChange type="added">he</transChange> rules over the nations. <l eID="gen6501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4021"/><l level="1" sID="gen6502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4021"/>All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞healthy ones⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “prosperous”; Literally “fat ones”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth will eat and worship.<l eID="gen6502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6503"/>Before him all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> those descending <transChange type="added">into the</transChange> dust will kneel,<l eID="gen6503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6504"/>even he <transChange type="added">who</transChange> cannot keep his soul alive. <l eID="gen6504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4022"/><l level="1" sID="gen6505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4022"/>Descendants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Descendant”</note> will serve him.<l eID="gen6505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6506"/>Regarding the Lord, it will be told to the <transChange type="added">next</transChange> generation. <l eID="gen6506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4023"/><l level="1" sID="gen6507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4023"/>They will come and tell his saving<note placement="foot">Or “righteousness”</note> <transChange type="added">deeds</transChange><l eID="gen6507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6508"/>to a people <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> to be born, that he has done <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <l eID="gen6508" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6433"/> <chapter eID="Ps.22"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4024"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh the Shepherd</title> <div sID="gen6509" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6509" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6510"/> <lg eID="gen6510"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6511"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4024"/>Yahweh is my shepherd;<l eID="gen6512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6513"/>I will not lack <transChange type="added">for anything</transChange>. <l eID="gen6513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4025"/><l level="1" sID="gen6514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4025"/>In grassy pastures he makes me lie down;<l eID="gen6514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6515"/>by quiet waters he leads me. <l eID="gen6515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4026"/><l level="1" sID="gen6516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4026"/>He restores my life.<note placement="foot">Or “my soul”</note><l eID="gen6516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6517"/>He leads me in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞correct paths⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “paths of righteousness”</note><l eID="gen6517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6518"/>for the sake of his name. <l eID="gen6518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4027"/><l level="1" sID="gen6519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4027"/>Even when I walk in a dark valley, I fear no evil<l eID="gen6519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6520"/>because you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with me.<l eID="gen6520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6521"/>Your rod and your staff, they comfort me. <l eID="gen6521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4028"/><l level="1" sID="gen6522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4028"/>You prepare before me a table<l eID="gen6522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6523"/>in the presence of my oppressors.<l eID="gen6523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6524"/>You anoint my head with oil;<l eID="gen6524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6525"/>my cup <transChange type="added">is</transChange> overflowing. <l eID="gen6525" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4029"/><l level="1" sID="gen6526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4029"/>Surely goodness and loyal love will pursue me<l eID="gen6526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6527"/>all the days of my life,<l eID="gen6527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6528"/>and I will stay<note placement="foot">Hebrew “return”</note> in the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh<l eID="gen6528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6529"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for a very long time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for length of days”</note> <l eID="gen6529" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6511"/> <chapter eID="Ps.23"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4030"/><title type="x-s">The King of Glory</title> <div sID="gen6530" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6530" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6531"/> <lg eID="gen6531"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6532"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4030"/>The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness,<l eID="gen6533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6534"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> world and those who live in it, <l eID="gen6534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4031"/><l level="1" sID="gen6535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4031"/>because he has founded it on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas,<l eID="gen6535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6536"/>and has established it on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rivers. <l eID="gen6536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4032"/><l level="1" sID="gen6537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4032"/>Who may ascend <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountain of Yahweh?<l eID="gen6537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6538"/>And who may stand in his holy place? <l eID="gen6538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4033"/><l level="1" sID="gen6539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4033"/>He who is innocent of hands and pure of heart,<l eID="gen6539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6540"/>who does not lift up his soul to falseness,<l eID="gen6540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6541"/>and does not swear deceitfully. <l eID="gen6541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4034"/><l level="1" sID="gen6542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4034"/>He will receive blessing from Yahweh,<l eID="gen6542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6543"/>and justice<note placement="foot">Or “vindication”</note> from the God of his salvation. <l eID="gen6543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4035"/><l level="1" sID="gen6544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4035"/>Such <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> sort of those who seek<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere)</hi></note> him,<l eID="gen6544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6545"/>those who seek your face, even Jacob. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen6545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:7
