verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4036"/><l level="1" sID="gen6546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4036"/>Lift up your heads, O gates,<l eID="gen6546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6547"/>and rise up, O ancient doorways,<l eID="gen6547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6548"/>that the king of glory<note placement="foot">Literally “the king of the glory”</note> may enter. <l eID="gen6548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4037"/><l level="1" sID="gen6549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4037"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the king of glory?<note placement="foot">Literally “the king of the glory”</note><l eID="gen6549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6550"/>Yahweh, strong and mighty;<l eID="gen6550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6551"/>Yahweh, mighty in war! <l eID="gen6551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4038"/><l level="1" sID="gen6552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4038"/>Lift up your heads, O gates,<l eID="gen6552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6553"/>and lift up, O ancient doorways,<l eID="gen6553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6554"/>that the king of glory<note placement="foot">Literally “the king of the glory”</note> may enter. <l eID="gen6554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4039"/><l level="1" sID="gen6555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4039"/>Who is the king of glory?<note placement="foot">Literally “the king of the glory”</note><l eID="gen6555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6556"/>Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen6556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6557"/>He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the king of glory!<note placement="foot">Literally “the king of the glory”</note> <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen6557" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6532"/> <chapter eID="Ps.24"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4040"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Guidance, Deliverance, and Forgiveness</title> <div sID="gen6558" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6558" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6559"/> <lg eID="gen6559"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6560"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4040"/>To you, O Yahweh, I lift up my soul. <l eID="gen6561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4041"/><l level="1" sID="gen6562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4041"/>O my God, I trust you; let me not be put to shame.<l eID="gen6562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6563"/>Do not let my enemies exult over me. <l eID="gen6563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4042"/><l level="1" sID="gen6564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4042"/>Indeed, none who wait for you should be put to shame.<l eID="gen6564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6565"/>Those who betray without cause should be put to shame. <l eID="gen6565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4043"/><l level="1" sID="gen6566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4043"/>Make me know your ways, O Yahweh.<l eID="gen6566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6567"/>Teach me your paths. <l eID="gen6567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4044"/><l level="1" sID="gen6568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4044"/>Cause me to walk in your truth and teach me,<l eID="gen6568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6569"/>because you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the God of my salvation.<l eID="gen6569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6570"/>I await you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all day long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all of the day”</note> <l eID="gen6570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4045"/><l level="1" sID="gen6571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4045"/>Remember your compassion, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen6571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6572"/>and your acts of loyal love,<l eID="gen6572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6573"/>because they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> from of old. <l eID="gen6573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4046"/><l level="1" sID="gen6574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4046"/>Do not remember<l eID="gen6574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6575"/>the sins of my youth or my transgressions.<l eID="gen6575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6576"/>According to your loyal love remember me <transChange type="added">if</transChange> you <transChange type="added">will</transChange>,<l eID="gen6576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6577"/>for the sake of your goodness, O Yahweh. <l eID="gen6577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4047"/><l level="1" sID="gen6578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4047"/>Good and right <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh;<l eID="gen6578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6579"/>therefore he instructs sinners in the way. <l eID="gen6579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4048"/><l level="1" sID="gen6580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4048"/>He causes <transChange type="added">the</transChange> humble to walk in justice,<l eID="gen6580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6581"/>and teaches <transChange type="added">the</transChange> humble his way. <l eID="gen6581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4049"/><l level="1" sID="gen6582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4049"/>All the paths of Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> loyal love and faithfulness<l eID="gen6582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6583"/>for those who keep his covenant and statutes.<note placement="foot">Or “covenant statutes”</note> <l eID="gen6583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4050"/><l level="1" sID="gen6584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4050"/>Also, for the sake of your name, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen6584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6585"/>forgive my sin, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great. <l eID="gen6585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4051"/><l level="1" sID="gen6586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4051"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the man fearing Yahweh?<l eID="gen6586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6587"/>He will instruct him in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way he should choose. <l eID="gen6587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4052"/><l level="1" sID="gen6588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4052"/>His soul will lodge in prosperity,<l eID="gen6588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6589"/>and his offspring will possess <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land. <l eID="gen6589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4053"/><l level="1" sID="gen6590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4053"/>Intimate fellowship with Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for those who fear him,<l eID="gen6590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6591"/>and <transChange type="added">he</transChange> makes known his covenant to them. <l eID="gen6591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4054"/><l level="1" sID="gen6592"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4054"/>My eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> continually toward Yahweh,<l eID="gen6592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6593"/>because he will take my feet from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> net. <l eID="gen6593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4055"/><l level="1" sID="gen6594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4055"/>Turn to me and have mercy on me<l eID="gen6594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6595"/>because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> lonely and afflicted. <l eID="gen6595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4056"/><l level="1" sID="gen6596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4056"/>Remove the troubles of my heart;<l eID="gen6596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6597"/>bring me out from my distresses. <l eID="gen6597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4057"/><l level="1" sID="gen6598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4057"/>Consider my affliction and trouble,<l eID="gen6598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6599"/>and forgive<note placement="foot">Or “take away”</note> all my sins. <l eID="gen6599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4058"/><l level="1" sID="gen6600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4058"/>Consider that my enemies are many,<l eID="gen6600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6601"/>and they hate me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> violent hatred. <l eID="gen6601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4059"/><l level="1" sID="gen6602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4059"/>Protect my life and deliver me.<l eID="gen6602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6603"/>Let me not be put to shame, because I take shelter in you. <l eID="gen6603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4060"/><l level="1" sID="gen6604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4060"/>Let integrity and uprightness preserve me,<l eID="gen6604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6605"/>because I wait for you. <l eID="gen6605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4061"/><l level="1" sID="gen6606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4061"/>O God, redeem Israel<l eID="gen6606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6607"/>from all its troubles. <l eID="gen6607" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6560"/> <chapter eID="Ps.25"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4062"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Vindication</title> <div sID="gen6608" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6608" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6609"/> <lg eID="gen6609"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6610"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4062"/>Judge me, O Yahweh, because I have walked in my integrity,<l eID="gen6611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6612"/>and I have trusted Yahweh and not wavered. <l eID="gen6612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4063"/><l level="1" sID="gen6613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4063"/>Prove me, O Yahweh, and test me.<l eID="gen6613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6614"/>Try my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞innermost being⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “kidneys,” the locus of intense thoughts and emotions in biblical Hebrew</note> and my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> <l eID="gen6614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4064"/><l level="1" sID="gen6615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4064"/>Because your loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> before my eyes,<l eID="gen6615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6616"/>and I walk about in your faithfulness. <l eID="gen6616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4065"/><l level="1" sID="gen6617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4065"/>I do not sit with deceitful people,<l eID="gen6617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6618"/>nor will I go about with hypocrites. <l eID="gen6618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4066"/><l level="1" sID="gen6619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4066"/>I hate <transChange type="added">the</transChange> crowd of evildoers,<l eID="gen6619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6620"/>and with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked I will not sit. <l eID="gen6620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4067"/><l level="1" sID="gen6621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4067"/>I will wash my hands in innocence,<l eID="gen6621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6622"/>and I will walk about your altar, O Yahweh, <l eID="gen6622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4068"/><l level="1" sID="gen6623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4068"/>to declare with a voice of thanksgiving,<l eID="gen6623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6624"/>and tell of all your wondrous deeds. <l eID="gen6624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4069"/><l level="1" sID="gen6625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4069"/>O Yahweh, I love <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dwelling of your house,<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note><l eID="gen6625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6626"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the place where your glory abides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the place of the dwelling place of your glory”</note> <l eID="gen6626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4070"/><l level="1" sID="gen6627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4070"/>Do not destroy me<note placement="foot">Or “gather my soul for judgment”</note> with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sinners,<l eID="gen6627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6628"/>nor my life with men of bloodshed, <l eID="gen6628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4071"/><l level="1" sID="gen6629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4071"/>in whose hands <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an evil plan,<l eID="gen6629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6630"/>and whose right hand is full of bribes.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bribe”</note> <l eID="gen6630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4072"/><l level="1" sID="gen6631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4072"/>But as for me, I will walk in my integrity.<l eID="gen6631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6632"/>Redeem me and be gracious to me. <l eID="gen6632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4073"/><l level="1" sID="gen6633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4073"/>My foot stands on level ground.<l eID="gen6633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6634"/>In assemblies I will bless Yahweh. <l eID="gen6634" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6610"/> <chapter eID="Ps.26"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4074"/><title type="x-s">A Declaration of Trust</title> <div sID="gen6635" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6635" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6636"/> <lg eID="gen6636"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6637"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4074"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my light and my salvation;<l eID="gen6638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6639"/>whom shall I fear?<l eID="gen6639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6640"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the refuge of my life;<l eID="gen6640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6641"/>of whom shall I be afraid? <l eID="gen6641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4075"/><l level="1" sID="gen6642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4075"/>When evildoers drew near against me to eat my flesh—<l eID="gen6642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6643"/>my adversaries and my enemies <transChange type="added">who drew near</transChange> to me—<l eID="gen6643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6644"/>they themselves stumbled and fell. <l eID="gen6644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4076"/><l level="1" sID="gen6645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4076"/>Though an army encamp against me,<l eID="gen6645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6646"/>my heart will not fear.<l eID="gen6646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6647"/>Though war arise against me,<l eID="gen6647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6648"/><transChange type="added">even</transChange> in this I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> remain confident. <l eID="gen6648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4077"/><l level="1" sID="gen6649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4077"/>One <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> I have asked from Yahweh;<l eID="gen6649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6650"/>it I will seek:<l eID="gen6650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6651"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> I may dwell in the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh all the days of my life,<l eID="gen6651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6652"/>to behold the beauty of Yahweh,<l eID="gen6652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6653"/>and to consider<note placement="foot">Or “inquire in”</note> his temple. <l eID="gen6653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4078"/><l level="1" sID="gen6654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4078"/>Because he will hide me in his shelter in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of trouble.<l eID="gen6654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6655"/>He will conceal me in the hiding place of his tent.<l eID="gen6655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6656"/>He will set me high upon a rock. <l eID="gen6656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4079"/><l level="1" sID="gen6657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4079"/>And now my head will be high over my enemies round about me.<l eID="gen6657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6658"/>And I will offer in his tent sacrifices with shouts of joy.<l eID="gen6658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6659"/>I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh. <l eID="gen6659" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4080"/><l level="1" sID="gen6660"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4080"/>Hear, O Yahweh, my voice <transChange type="added">when</transChange> I call,<l eID="gen6660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6661"/>and be gracious to me and answer me. <l eID="gen6661" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4081"/><l level="1" sID="gen6662"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4081"/>On your behalf my heart says, “Seek my face.”<l eID="gen6662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6663"/>Your face, O Yahweh, I do seek. <l eID="gen6663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4082"/><l level="1" sID="gen6664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4082"/>Do not hide your face from me;<l eID="gen6664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6665"/>do not turn your servant away in anger.<l eID="gen6665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6666"/>You have been my help; do not abandon nor forsake me,<l eID="gen6666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6667"/>O God of my salvation. <l eID="gen6667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4083"/><l level="1" sID="gen6668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4083"/>If my father or my mother forsake me,<l eID="gen6668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6669"/>then Yahweh will receive me. <l eID="gen6669" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4084"/><l level="1" sID="gen6670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4084"/>Teach me, O Yahweh, your way,<l eID="gen6670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6671"/>and lead me on a level path because of my enemies. <l eID="gen6671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4085"/><l level="1" sID="gen6672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4085"/>Do not give me over to the desire of my enemies,<l eID="gen6672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6673"/>because false witnesses have arisen against me,<l eID="gen6673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6674"/>and <transChange type="added">each</transChange> breathing out violence.<note placement="foot">Or “and each a witness of violence”</note> <l eID="gen6674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4086"/><l level="1" sID="gen6675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4086"/>Surely<note placement="foot">Hebrew text is uncertain</note> I believe <transChange type="added">that I will</transChange> see the goodness of Yahweh<l eID="gen6675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6676"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living. <l eID="gen6676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4087"/><l level="1" sID="gen6677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4087"/>Wait for Yahweh.<l eID="gen6677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6678"/>Be strong and let your heart show strength,<l eID="gen6678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6679"/>and wait for Yahweh. <l eID="gen6679" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6637"/> <chapter eID="Ps.27"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4088"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Help, and Joy in Its Answer</title> <div sID="gen6680" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6680" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6681"/> <lg eID="gen6681"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6682"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4088"/>To you, O Yahweh, I call.<l eID="gen6683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6684"/>O my rock, do not be deaf to me.<l eID="gen6684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6685"/>Or else, if you are silent to me,<l eID="gen6685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6686"/>then I will become like those descending to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit. <l eID="gen6686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4089"/><l level="1" sID="gen6687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4089"/>Hear the voice of my supplications<l eID="gen6687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6688"/>when I cry to you for help,<l eID="gen6688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6689"/>when I lift up my hands<l eID="gen6689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6690"/>toward your holy inner sanctuary. <l eID="gen6690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4090"/><l level="1" sID="gen6691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4090"/>Do not drag me away with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked<l eID="gen6691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6692"/>or with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> workers of evil,<l eID="gen6692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6693"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> speak of peace with their neighbors,<l eID="gen6693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6694"/>while evil <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in their heart. <l eID="gen6694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4091"/><l level="1" sID="gen6695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4091"/>Give to them according to their work,<l eID="gen6695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6696"/>even according to the evil of their deeds.<l eID="gen6696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6697"/>Give to them according to the work of their hands;<l eID="gen6697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6698"/>repay them their rightful due. <l eID="gen6698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4092"/><l level="1" sID="gen6699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4092"/>Because they do not regard the works of Yahweh,<l eID="gen6699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6700"/>nor the work of his hands,<l eID="gen6700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6701"/>he will destroy them<l eID="gen6701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6702"/>and not rebuild them. <l eID="gen6702" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4093"/><l level="1" sID="gen6703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4093"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen6703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6704"/>because he has heard the voice of my supplications. <l eID="gen6704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4094"/><l level="1" sID="gen6705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4094"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my strength and my shield.<l eID="gen6705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6706"/>My heart trusts him and I am helped.<l eID="gen6706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6707"/>So my heart rejoices,<l eID="gen6707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6708"/>and with my song I will give thanks to him. <l eID="gen6708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4095"/><l level="1" sID="gen6709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4095"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their strength,<l eID="gen6709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6710"/>and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the refuge for the salvation of his anointed one. <l eID="gen6710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4096"/><l level="1" sID="gen6711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4096"/>Save your people<l eID="gen6711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6712"/>and bless your heritage.<l eID="gen6712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6713"/>Shepherd them also and carry them always. <l eID="gen6713" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6682"/> <chapter eID="Ps.28"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4097"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for His Glory and Strength</title> <div sID="gen6714" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6714" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6715"/> <lg eID="gen6715"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6716"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4097"/>Ascribe to Yahweh, O sons of God,<note placement="foot">Or “heavenly beings”</note><l eID="gen6717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6718"/>ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength. <l eID="gen6718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4098"/><l level="1" sID="gen6719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4098"/>Ascribe to Yahweh the glory <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞due⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> his name.<l eID="gen6719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6720"/>Worship Yahweh in holy array. <l eID="gen6720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4099"/><l level="1" sID="gen6721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4099"/>The voice of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> over the waters;<l eID="gen6721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6722"/>the God of glory thunders.<l eID="gen6722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6723"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> over many waters. <l eID="gen6723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4100"/><l level="1" sID="gen6724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4100"/>The voice of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> powerful.<l eID="gen6724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6725"/>The voice of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> majestic. <l eID="gen6725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4101"/><l level="1" sID="gen6726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4101"/>The voice of Yahweh breaks <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cedars.<l eID="gen6726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6727"/>Yahweh shatters even the cedars of Lebanon. <l eID="gen6727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4102"/><l level="1" sID="gen6728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4102"/>And he makes them skip like a calf;<l eID="gen6728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6729"/>Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox. <l eID="gen6729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4103"/><l level="1" sID="gen6730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4103"/>The voice of Yahweh flashes<note placement="foot">Or “divides”</note> flames of fire. <l eID="gen6730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4104"/><l level="1" sID="gen6731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4104"/>The voice of Yahweh shakes <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wilderness.<l eID="gen6731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6732"/>Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh. <l eID="gen6732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4105"/><l level="1" sID="gen6733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4105"/>The voice of Yahweh causes deer<note placement="foot">A slightly different Hebrew word here yields, “makes the oaks tremble”</note> to give birth<l eID="gen6733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6734"/>and strips <transChange type="added">the</transChange> forests bare.<l eID="gen6734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6735"/>And at his temple all in it say, “Glory!” <l eID="gen6735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4106"/><l level="1" sID="gen6736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4106"/>Yahweh sits <transChange type="added">enthroned</transChange> at the flood,<l eID="gen6736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6737"/>and Yahweh sits <transChange type="added">as</transChange> king forever. <l eID="gen6737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4107"/><l level="1" sID="gen6738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4107"/>May Yahweh give strength to his people.<l eID="gen6738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6739"/>May Yahweh bless his people with peace. <l eID="gen6739" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6716"/> <chapter eID="Ps.29"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4108"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for Answered Prayer</title> <div sID="gen6740" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6740" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6741"/> <lg eID="gen6741"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm; a song for the dedication of the house.<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen6742"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4108"/>I will exalt you, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen6743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6744"/>because you have drawn me up,<l eID="gen6744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6745"/>and have not made my enemies rejoice over me. <l eID="gen6745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4109"/><l level="1" sID="gen6746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4109"/>O Yahweh, my God,<l eID="gen6746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6747"/>I cried for help to you,<l eID="gen6747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6748"/>and you healed me. <l eID="gen6748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4110"/><l level="1" sID="gen6749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4110"/>O Yahweh, you have brought my life up from Sheol.<l eID="gen6749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6750"/>You preserved me alive<l eID="gen6750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6751"/>from among those going down<note placement="foot">According to the <hi type="italic">Kethib</hi>; the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) reads “so I would not go down”</note> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit. <l eID="gen6751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4111"/><l level="1" sID="gen6752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4111"/>Sing praises to Yahweh, you his faithful ones,<l eID="gen6752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6753"/>and give thanks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to his holy fame⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the fame of his holiness”</note> <l eID="gen6753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4112"/><l level="1" sID="gen6754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4112"/>For <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> a moment in his anger;<l eID="gen6754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6755"/><transChange type="added">there is</transChange> a lifetime in his favor.<l eID="gen6755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6756"/>Weeping lodges for the evening,<l eID="gen6756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6757"/>but in the morning <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> rejoicing. <l eID="gen6757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4113"/><l level="1" sID="gen6758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4113"/>But as for me, I had said in my prosperity,<l eID="gen6758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6759"/>“I shall not be moved ever.” <l eID="gen6759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4114"/><l level="1" sID="gen6760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4114"/>O Yahweh, by your favor<l eID="gen6760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6761"/>you caused my strong mountain to stand.<l eID="gen6761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6762"/>You hid your face. I was bewildered. <l eID="gen6762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4115"/><l level="1" sID="gen6763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4115"/>To you, O Yahweh, I called,<l eID="gen6763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6764"/>and to the Lord I pleaded for grace <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <l eID="gen6764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4116"/><l level="1" sID="gen6765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4116"/>“What gain <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> in my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞death⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “blood”</note><l eID="gen6765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6766"/>in my going down into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit?<l eID="gen6766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6767"/>Will <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust praise you?<l eID="gen6767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6768"/>Will it tell of your faithfulness? <l eID="gen6768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4117"/><l level="1" sID="gen6769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4117"/>“O Yahweh, hear and be gracious to me.<l eID="gen6769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6770"/>O Yahweh, be my helper.” <l eID="gen6770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4118"/><l level="1" sID="gen6771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4118"/>You have turned my wailing into my dancing.<l eID="gen6771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6772"/>You have removed my sackcloth<l eID="gen6772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6773"/>and clothed me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> joy <l eID="gen6773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4119"/><l level="1" sID="gen6774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4119"/>so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my glory”</note> may sing praises to you<l eID="gen6774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6775"/>and not be quiet.<l eID="gen6775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6776"/>O Yahweh, my God,<l eID="gen6776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6777"/>I will give thanks to you forever. <l eID="gen6777" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6742"/> <chapter eID="Ps.30"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4120"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Is a Fortress</title> <div sID="gen6778" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6778" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6779"/> <lg eID="gen6779"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen6780"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4120"/>In you, O Yahweh, I have taken refuge.<l eID="gen6781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6782"/>Let me not be put to shame ever.<l eID="gen6782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6783"/>Deliver me by your righteousness. <l eID="gen6783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4121"/><l level="1" sID="gen6784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4121"/>Incline your ear to me.<l eID="gen6784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6785"/>Quickly deliver me.<l eID="gen6785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6786"/>Become my rock of refuge,<l eID="gen6786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6787"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a fortified keep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a house of strongholds”</note> to save me. <l eID="gen6787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4122"/><l level="1" sID="gen6788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4122"/>For you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my rock and my fortress.<l eID="gen6788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6789"/>So, for the sake of your name,<l eID="gen6789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6790"/>lead me and guide me. <l eID="gen6790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4123"/><l level="1" sID="gen6791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4123"/>Bring me out of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> net that they have secretly set for me,<l eID="gen6791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6792"/>for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my refuge. <l eID="gen6792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4124"/><l level="1" sID="gen6793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4124"/>Into your hand I commit my spirit.<l eID="gen6793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6794"/>You have redeemed me, O Yahweh, faithful God.<note placement="foot">Or “God of truth”</note> <l eID="gen6794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4125"/><l level="1" sID="gen6795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4125"/>I hate those devoted to useless idols,<l eID="gen6795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6796"/>but I trust Yahweh. <l eID="gen6796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4126"/><l level="1" sID="gen6797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4126"/>I will exult and rejoice in your loyal love.<l eID="gen6797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6798"/>Because you have seen my misery,<l eID="gen6798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6799"/>you know the distresses of my life.<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> <l eID="gen6799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4127"/><l level="1" sID="gen6800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4127"/>And you have not delivered me<l eID="gen6800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6801"/>into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy.<l eID="gen6801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6802"/>You have set my feet in a broad place. <l eID="gen6802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4128"/><l level="1" sID="gen6803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4128"/>Be gracious <transChange type="added">to</transChange> me, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen6803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6804"/>because I have distress.<l eID="gen6804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6805"/>My eye wastes away because of vexation,<l eID="gen6805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6806"/><transChange type="added">along with</transChange> my soul and my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “belly”</note> <l eID="gen6806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4129"/><l level="1" sID="gen6807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4129"/>For my life is at an end with sorrow,<l eID="gen6807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6808"/>and my years with sighing.<l eID="gen6808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6809"/>My strength stumbles because of my iniquity,<l eID="gen6809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6810"/>and my bones waste away. <l eID="gen6810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4130"/><l level="1" sID="gen6811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4130"/>Because of all my adversaries I have become a disgrace,<l eID="gen6811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6812"/>especially to my neighbors,<l eID="gen6812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6813"/>and a dread to my acquaintances.<l eID="gen6813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6814"/><transChange type="added">Those who</transChange> see me in the street flee from me. <l eID="gen6814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4131"/><l level="1" sID="gen6815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4131"/>I have become forgotten like <transChange type="added">one</transChange> dead, out of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note><l eID="gen6815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6816"/>I am like a destroyed vessel. <l eID="gen6816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4132"/><l level="1" sID="gen6817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4132"/>For I hear <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rumor of many,<l eID="gen6817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6818"/>“Terror on every side!”<l eID="gen6818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6819"/>When conspiring together against me,<l eID="gen6819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6820"/>they have plotted to take my life. <l eID="gen6820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4133"/><l level="1" sID="gen6821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4133"/>But as for me, I trust you, O Yahweh.<l eID="gen6821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6822"/>I say, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my God.” <l eID="gen6822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4134"/><l level="1" sID="gen6823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4134"/>My times<note placement="foot">Or “destiny”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in your hand.<l eID="gen6823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6824"/>Deliver me from the hand of my enemies<l eID="gen6824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6825"/>and from <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> pursue me. <l eID="gen6825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4135"/><l level="1" sID="gen6826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4135"/>Shine your face upon your servant.<l eID="gen6826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6827"/>Save me by your loyal love. <l eID="gen6827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4136"/><l level="1" sID="gen6828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4136"/>O Yahweh, let me not be put to shame, for I call on you.<l eID="gen6828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6829"/>Let the wicked be put to shame.<l eID="gen6829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6830"/>Let them <transChange type="added">go</transChange> silently<note placement="foot">Or “let them with wailing enter”</note> to Sheol. <l eID="gen6830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4137"/><l level="1" sID="gen6831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4137"/>Let lying lips be dumb,<l eID="gen6831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6832"/>that speak against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous<note placement="foot">Or “the innocent one”</note> unrestrained<l eID="gen6832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6833"/>with arrogance and contempt. <l eID="gen6833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4138"/><l level="1" sID="gen6834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4138"/>How abundant <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your goodness<l eID="gen6834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6835"/>that you have stored up for <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> fear you,<l eID="gen6835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6836"/>that you perform for those who take refuge in you<l eID="gen6836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6837"/>before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of humankind. <l eID="gen6837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4139"/><l level="1" sID="gen6838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4139"/>You will hide them in the protection of your presence<l eID="gen6838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6839"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> plots of man.<l eID="gen6839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6840"/>You will hide them in a shelter from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> strife of tongues. <l eID="gen6840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4140"/><l level="1" sID="gen6841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4140"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen6841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6842"/>because he has worked marvelously his loyal love to me<l eID="gen6842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6843"/>in a besieged city. <l eID="gen6843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4141"/><l level="1" sID="gen6844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4141"/>As for me, I said in my alarm,<l eID="gen6844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6845"/>“I am cut off from before your eyes.”<l eID="gen6845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6846"/>However you heard the voice of my supplications<l eID="gen6846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6847"/>when I cried to you for help. <l eID="gen6847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4142"/><l level="1" sID="gen6848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4142"/>Love Yahweh, all you his faithful ones.<l eID="gen6848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6849"/>Yahweh preserves <transChange type="added">the</transChange> faithful<l eID="gen6849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6850"/>but repays abundantly <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who acts arrogantly. <l eID="gen6850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4143"/><l level="1" sID="gen6851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4143"/>Be strong and let your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> heart show strength,<l eID="gen6851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6852"/>all <transChange type="added">you</transChange> who wait for Yahweh. <l eID="gen6852" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6780"/> <chapter eID="Ps.31"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4144"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for Forgiveness of Sins</title> <div sID="gen6853" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6853" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6854"/> <lg eID="gen6854"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David. A maskil.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6855"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4144"/>Happy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he whose transgression is taken away,<l eID="gen6856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6857"/>whose sin is covered. <l eID="gen6857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4145"/><l level="1" sID="gen6858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4145"/>Happy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a person to whom Yahweh does not impute iniquity<l eID="gen6858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6859"/>and in whose spirit there is not deceit. <l eID="gen6859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4146"/><l level="1" sID="gen6860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4146"/>When I kept silent, my bones were worn out<l eID="gen6860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6861"/>due to my groaning all the day. <l eID="gen6861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4147"/><l level="1" sID="gen6862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4147"/>For day and night your hand was heavy upon me.<l eID="gen6862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6863"/>My vigor was changed into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dry heat of summer. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen6863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4148"/><l level="1" sID="gen6864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4148"/>I made known my sin to you, and my iniquity I did not cover.<l eID="gen6864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6865"/>I said, “I will confess concerning my transgressions to Yahweh,”<l eID="gen6865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6866"/>and you took away the guilt of my sin. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen6866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4149"/><l level="1" sID="gen6867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4149"/>Therefore let all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> faithful pray to you<l eID="gen6867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6868"/>at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time <transChange type="added">for</transChange> finding <transChange type="added">you</transChange>.<l eID="gen6868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6869"/>Surely at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flood of many waters they will not reach him. <l eID="gen6869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4150"/><l level="1" sID="gen6870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4150"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my hiding place;<l eID="gen6870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6871"/>from trouble you preserve me.<l eID="gen6871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6872"/><transChange type="added">With</transChange> cries of deliverance you surround me. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen6872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4151"/><l level="1" sID="gen6873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4151"/>I<note placement="foot">Yahweh is speaking in vv. <reference osisRef="Ps.32.8-Ps.32.9">8–9</reference></note> will instruct you and teach you<l eID="gen6873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6874"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way that you should go.<l eID="gen6874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6875"/>I will advise <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> my eye upon you. <l eID="gen6875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4152"/><l level="1" sID="gen6876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4152"/>Do not be like a horse <transChange type="added">or</transChange> like a mule, without understanding;<l eID="gen6876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6877"/><transChange type="added">that needs</transChange> his tackle—bridle and rein—for restraint<l eID="gen6877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6878"/><transChange type="added">or he would not</transChange> come near you. <l eID="gen6878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4153"/><l level="1" sID="gen6879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4153"/>Many are <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pains of the wicked,<l eID="gen6879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6880"/>but <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the one who trusts Yahweh<l eID="gen6880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6881"/>loyal love surrounds him. <l eID="gen6881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4154"/><l level="1" sID="gen6882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4154"/>Be glad in Yahweh and rejoice, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> righteous,<l eID="gen6882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6883"/>and shout for joy, all <transChange type="added">you</transChange> upright of heart. <l eID="gen6883" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6855"/> <chapter eID="Ps.32"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4155"/><title type="x-s">Praise to Yahweh for His Character and Creation</title> <div sID="gen6884" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6884" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6885"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4155"/>Exult in Yahweh, O <transChange type="added">you</transChange> righteous,<l eID="gen6886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6887"/><transChange type="added">for</transChange> praise <transChange type="added">is</transChange> fitting for the upright. <l eID="gen6887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4156"/><l level="1" sID="gen6888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4156"/>Give thanks to Yahweh with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lyre;<l eID="gen6888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6889"/>with a harp of ten strings play to him. <l eID="gen6889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4157"/><l level="1" sID="gen6890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4157"/>Sing to him a new song;<l eID="gen6890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6891"/>play skillfully with jubilant shout. <l eID="gen6891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4158"/><l level="1" sID="gen6892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4158"/>For the word of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upright,<l eID="gen6892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6893"/>and all his work <transChange type="added">is done</transChange> in faithfulness. <l eID="gen6893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4159"/><l level="1" sID="gen6894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4159"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> loves righteousness and justice.<l eID="gen6894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6895"/>The earth is full of the loyal love of Yahweh. <l eID="gen6895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4160"/><l level="1" sID="gen6896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4160"/>By the word of Yahweh <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens were made,<l eID="gen6896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6897"/>and by the breath of his mouth all their host. <l eID="gen6897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4161"/><l level="1" sID="gen6898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4161"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> gathered the waters of the sea like a heap.<l eID="gen6898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6899"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> put <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deeps in storehouses. <l eID="gen6899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4162"/><l level="1" sID="gen6900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4162"/>Let all the earth fear Yahweh.<l eID="gen6900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6901"/>Let all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world stand in awe of him. <l eID="gen6901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4163"/><l level="1" sID="gen6902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4163"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he himself spoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he, he spoke”</note> and it came to pass.<l eID="gen6902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6903"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He himself commanded⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “He, he commanded”</note> and it stood firm. <l eID="gen6903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4164"/><l level="1" sID="gen6904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4164"/>Yahweh brings to nothing<note placement="foot">Or “breaks”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> plan of nations;<l eID="gen6904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6905"/>he frustrates<note placement="foot">Or “nullifies”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> intents of peoples. <l eID="gen6905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4165"/><l level="1" sID="gen6906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4165"/>The plan of Yahweh stands firm forever,<l eID="gen6906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6907"/>the intents of his heart <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from one generation to the next⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to a generation and a generation”</note> <l eID="gen6907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4166"/><l level="1" sID="gen6908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4166"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the nation whose God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen6908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6909"/>the people he has chosen for his inheritance. <l eID="gen6909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4167"/><l level="1" sID="gen6910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4167"/>From heaven Yahweh looks;<l eID="gen6910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6911"/>he sees all the children of humankind. <l eID="gen6911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4168"/><l level="1" sID="gen6912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4168"/>From his dwelling place<note placement="foot">Or “the place where he sits enthroned”</note> he gazes<l eID="gen6912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6913"/>on all the inhabitants of the earth, <l eID="gen6913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4169"/><l level="1" sID="gen6914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4169"/>he who fashions altogether their heart,<l eID="gen6914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6915"/>he who understands all their works. <l eID="gen6915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4170"/><l level="1" sID="gen6916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4170"/>The king <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not saved by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> greatness of an army.<l eID="gen6916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6917"/>The warrior is not delivered by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> greatness of strength. <l eID="gen6917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4171"/><l level="1" sID="gen6918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4171"/>The horse <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a false hope for victory,<l eID="gen6918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6919"/>nor can it save by the greatness of its power. <l eID="gen6919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4172"/><l level="1" sID="gen6920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4172"/>Behold, the eye of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on those who fear him,<l eID="gen6920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6921"/>on those who hope<note placement="foot">Or “wait expectantly”</note> for his loyal love <l eID="gen6921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4173"/><l level="1" sID="gen6922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4173"/>to deliver their soul from death<l eID="gen6922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6923"/>and to keep them alive in famine. <l eID="gen6923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4174"/><l level="1" sID="gen6924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4174"/>Our soul waits for Yahweh;<l eID="gen6924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6925"/>he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our help and our shield. <l eID="gen6925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4175"/><l level="1" sID="gen6926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4175"/>For in him our heart rejoices<l eID="gen6926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6927"/>because in his holy name we trust. <l eID="gen6927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4176"/><l level="1" sID="gen6928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4176"/>Let your loyal love, O Yahweh, be upon us,<l eID="gen6928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6929"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞even as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as which”</note> we hope in you. <l eID="gen6929" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6885"/> <chapter eID="Ps.33"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4177"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for Yahweh’s Deliverance</title> <div sID="gen6930" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6930" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6931"/> <lg eID="gen6931"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David, when he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pretended to be crazy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he changed his discernment”</note> in front of Abimelech<note placement="foot">Literally “my father is king” whereas <reference osisRef="1Sam.21.10">1 Sam 21:10</reference>(9) has “Achish.” “Abimelech” is perhaps an honorific title, since its literal meaning suggests a legitimate right to rule</note></title> <lg sID="gen6932"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6933"/>so that he drove him out, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> he departed.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen6933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4177"/>I will bless Yahweh at all times;<l eID="gen6934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6935"/>his praise <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> in my mouth continually. <l eID="gen6935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4178"/><l level="1" sID="gen6936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4178"/>My soul makes its boast in Yahweh;<l eID="gen6936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6937"/>let the humble hear and be glad. <l eID="gen6937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4179"/><l level="1" sID="gen6938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4179"/>Magnify Yahweh with me,<l eID="gen6938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6939"/>and let us exalt his name together. <l eID="gen6939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4180"/><l level="1" sID="gen6940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4180"/>I sought Yahweh and he answered me,<l eID="gen6940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6941"/>and from all my terrors he delivered me. <l eID="gen6941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4181"/><l level="1" sID="gen6942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4181"/>They looked to him and were radiant,<l eID="gen6942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6943"/>and their faces shall not be ashamed.<note placement="foot">Or “and let not their faces be ashamed”</note> <l eID="gen6943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4182"/><l level="1" sID="gen6944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4182"/>This poor <transChange type="added">man</transChange> called and Yahweh heard,<l eID="gen6944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6945"/>and saved him from all his troubles. <l eID="gen6945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4183"/><l level="1" sID="gen6946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4183"/>The angel of Yahweh encamps<l eID="gen6946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6947"/>around <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> fear him,<l eID="gen6947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6948"/>and he rescues them. <l eID="gen6948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4184"/><l level="1" sID="gen6949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4184"/>Taste and see that Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good;<l eID="gen6949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6950"/>blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the man <transChange type="added">who</transChange> takes refuge in him. <l eID="gen6950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4185"/><l level="1" sID="gen6951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4185"/>Fear Yahweh, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> his saints,<note placement="foot">Or “holy ones”</note><l eID="gen6951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6952"/>for there is no lack for <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> fear him. <l eID="gen6952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4186"/><l level="1" sID="gen6953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4186"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> young lions are in want and suffer hunger,<l eID="gen6953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6954"/>but those who seek Yahweh will not lack for any good thing. <l eID="gen6954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4187"/><l level="1" sID="gen6955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4187"/>Come, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> children, listen to me;<l eID="gen6955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6956"/>I will teach you the fear of Yahweh. <l eID="gen6956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4188"/><l level="1" sID="gen6957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4188"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the man who desires life,<l eID="gen6957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6958"/>who loves <transChange type="added">many</transChange> days in order to see good? <l eID="gen6958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4189"/><l level="1" sID="gen6959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4189"/>Keep your tongue from evil<l eID="gen6959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6960"/>and your lips from speaking deceit. <l eID="gen6960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4190"/><l level="1" sID="gen6961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4190"/>Turn from evil and do good.<l eID="gen6961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6962"/>Seek peace and pursue it. <l eID="gen6962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4191"/><l level="1" sID="gen6963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4191"/>The eyes of Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> toward <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous,<l eID="gen6963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6964"/>and his ears toward their cry for help. <l eID="gen6964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4192"/><l level="1" sID="gen6965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4192"/>The face of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> against evildoers,<l eID="gen6965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6966"/>to cut off the remembrance of them from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen6966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4193"/><l level="1" sID="gen6967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4193"/>They<note placement="foot">That is, the righteous</note> cry out and Yahweh hears<l eID="gen6967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6968"/>and delivers them from all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> their troubles. <l eID="gen6968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4194"/><l level="1" sID="gen6969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4194"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near to <transChange type="added">those who are</transChange> heartbroken<l eID="gen6969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6970"/>and saves <transChange type="added">those who are</transChange> crushed in spirit. <l eID="gen6970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4195"/><l level="1" sID="gen6971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4195"/>Many <transChange type="added">are the</transChange> distresses of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous,<l eID="gen6971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6972"/>but Yahweh delivers him out of them all. <l eID="gen6972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4196"/><l level="1" sID="gen6973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4196"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> protects all his bones;<l eID="gen6973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6974"/>not one of them is broken. <l eID="gen6974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4197"/><l level="1" sID="gen6975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4197"/>Evil will slay <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked,<l eID="gen6975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6976"/>and <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> hate <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous will incur guilt. <l eID="gen6976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4198"/><l level="1" sID="gen6977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4198"/>Yahweh redeems the life of his servants,<l eID="gen6977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6978"/>and none who take refuge in him will incur guilt. <l eID="gen6978" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6932"/> <chapter eID="Ps.34"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4199"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Rescue from Enemies</title> <div sID="gen6979" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen6979" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6980"/> <lg eID="gen6980"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen6981"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4199"/>Contend, O Yahweh, with my contenders;<l eID="gen6982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6983"/>fight <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> fight me. <l eID="gen6983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4200"/><l level="1" sID="gen6984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4200"/>Grasp buckler and shield<l eID="gen6984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6985"/>and rise to my aid. <l eID="gen6985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4201"/><l level="1" sID="gen6986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4201"/>And draw <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spear and javelin to meet <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> pursue me.<l eID="gen6986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6987"/>Say to my soul, “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> your salvation.” <l eID="gen6987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:4
