verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4202"/><l level="1" sID="gen6988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4202"/>Let those who seek my life be shamed and humiliated.<l eID="gen6988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6989"/>Let those who plot calamity against me be repulsed and ashamed. <l eID="gen6989" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4203"/><l level="1" sID="gen6990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4203"/>Let them be like chaff before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind,<l eID="gen6990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6991"/>with the angel of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞driving them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “pushing”</note> <l eID="gen6991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4204"/><l level="1" sID="gen6992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4204"/>Let their way be dark and slippery,<l eID="gen6992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6993"/>with the angel of Yahweh pursuing them. <l eID="gen6993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4205"/><l level="1" sID="gen6994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4205"/>For without cause they secretly hide the pit with their net for me;<l eID="gen6994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6995"/>without cause they dug <transChange type="added">it</transChange> for my life. <l eID="gen6995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4206"/><l level="1" sID="gen6996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4206"/>Let <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞unforeseen ruin⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “ruin he does not know”</note> come on him,<l eID="gen6996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6997"/>and his net that he hid, let it catch him.<l eID="gen6997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6998"/>Let him fall into it in ruin. <l eID="gen6998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4207"/><l level="1" sID="gen6999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4207"/>Then my soul will rejoice in Yahweh;<l eID="gen6999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7000"/>it will rejoice in his salvation. <l eID="gen7000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4208"/><l level="1" sID="gen7001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4208"/>All of my bones shall say, “O Yahweh, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like you,<l eID="gen7001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7002"/>who delivers <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> stronger than he<l eID="gen7002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7003"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor and needy from <transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> robs him?” <l eID="gen7003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4209"/><l level="1" sID="gen7004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4209"/>Violent witnesses rise up;<l eID="gen7004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7005"/>they ask me <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> what I do not know. <l eID="gen7005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4210"/><l level="1" sID="gen7006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4210"/>They repay me evil in place of good.<l eID="gen7006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7007"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> bereavement to my soul. <l eID="gen7007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4211"/><l level="1" sID="gen7008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4211"/>But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing <transChange type="added">was</transChange> sackcloth.<l eID="gen7008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7009"/>I weakened my soul with fasting,<l eID="gen7009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7010"/>and my prayer <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞returned to me unanswered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “upon my lap it will return”</note> <l eID="gen7010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4212"/><l level="1" sID="gen7011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4212"/>I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞behaved⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “walked about”</note> as <transChange type="added">though he were</transChange> a friend <transChange type="added">or</transChange> as a brother to me.<l eID="gen7011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7012"/>As one lamenting a mother, I was bowed down <transChange type="added">in</transChange> mourning. <l eID="gen7012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4213"/><l level="1" sID="gen7013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4213"/>But at my stumbling they rejoiced and gathered together;<l eID="gen7013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7014"/>smiters whom I did not know gathered against me.<l eID="gen7014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7015"/>They tore and did not cease. <l eID="gen7015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4214"/><l level="1" sID="gen7016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4214"/>Among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ungodly of the mockers at feasts,<note placement="foot">With a slight change the Hebrew might read, “The ungodly boldly mocked”</note><l eID="gen7016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7017"/><transChange type="added">they</transChange> gnashed at me with their teeth. <l eID="gen7017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4215"/><l level="1" sID="gen7018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4215"/>My Lord, how long will you watch?<l eID="gen7018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7019"/>Restore my life from their ravages,<note placement="foot">Or “roaring”</note><l eID="gen7019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7020"/>my only <transChange type="added">life</transChange> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young lions. <l eID="gen7020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4216"/><l level="1" sID="gen7021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4216"/>I will give thanks <transChange type="added">to</transChange> you in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> great assembly;<l eID="gen7021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7022"/>among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty people I will praise you. <l eID="gen7022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4217"/><l level="1" sID="gen7023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4217"/>Let not those who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> wrongfully my enemies<note placement="foot">Or “those who oppose me with falsehood”</note> rejoice over me.<l eID="gen7023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7024"/><transChange type="added">Nor let</transChange> those who hate me without cause wink <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eye. <l eID="gen7024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4218"/><l level="1" sID="gen7025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4218"/>For they do not speak peace,<l eID="gen7025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7026"/>but against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> quiet <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land<l eID="gen7026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7027"/>they plan deceitful words. <l eID="gen7027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4219"/><l level="1" sID="gen7028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4219"/>They also made wide their mouths<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mouth”</note> against me.<l eID="gen7028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7029"/>They said, “Aha! Aha!<l eID="gen7029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7030"/>Our eyes have seen <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.” <l eID="gen7030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4220"/><l level="1" sID="gen7031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4220"/>You have seen, O Yahweh. Do not be deaf.<l eID="gen7031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7032"/>O Lord, do not be far from me. <l eID="gen7032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4221"/><l level="1" sID="gen7033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4221"/>Wake up and rouse yourself for my right,<l eID="gen7033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7034"/>for my cause, O my God and my Lord. <l eID="gen7034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4222"/><l level="1" sID="gen7035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4222"/>Vindicate me according to your righteousness,<l eID="gen7035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7036"/>O Yahweh my God,<l eID="gen7036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7037"/>and do not let them rejoice over me. <l eID="gen7037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4223"/><l level="1" sID="gen7038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4223"/>Do not let them say in their hearts,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> “Aha, our desire.”<l eID="gen7038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7039"/>Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up.” <l eID="gen7039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4224"/><l level="1" sID="gen7040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4224"/>Let them be shamed and abashed altogether,<l eID="gen7040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7041"/>who rejoice at my misfortune.<l eID="gen7041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7042"/>Let them put on shame and insult,<l eID="gen7042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7043"/>who magnify themselves against me. <l eID="gen7043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4225"/><l level="1" sID="gen7044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4225"/>Let them shout for joy and be glad,<l eID="gen7044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7045"/>who delight in my vindication;<l eID="gen7045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7046"/>and let them say continually, “Yahweh is great,<l eID="gen7046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7047"/>who delights in the welfare of his servant.” <l eID="gen7047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4226"/><l level="1" sID="gen7048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4226"/>Then my tongue will proclaim your righteousness,<l eID="gen7048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7049"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> your praise all day. <l eID="gen7049" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6981"/> <chapter eID="Ps.35"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4227"/><title type="x-s">Human Wickedness and God’s Love</title> <div sID="gen7050" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7050" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7051"/> <lg eID="gen7051"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of David, the servant of Yahweh.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen7052"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4227"/>An oracle: the wicked has rebellion<l eID="gen7053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7054"/>in the midst of his<note placement="foot">Reading with a few Hebrew manuscripts and some versions; MT reads “my”</note> heart.<l eID="gen7054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7055"/>There is no fear of God before his eyes. <l eID="gen7055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4228"/><l level="1" sID="gen7056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4228"/>For he flatters himself in his eyes,<l eID="gen7056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7057"/>hating to detect his iniquity.<note placement="foot">Or “when finding his iniquity and when hating”</note> <l eID="gen7057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4229"/><l level="1" sID="gen7058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4229"/>The words of his mouth <transChange type="added">are</transChange> wickedness and deceit.<l eID="gen7058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7059"/>He has ceased to have insight <transChange type="added">and</transChange> to do good. <l eID="gen7059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4230"/><l level="1" sID="gen7060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4230"/>He plans sin on his bed.<l eID="gen7060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7061"/>He puts himself on a way <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> not good.<l eID="gen7061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7062"/>He does not reject evil. <l eID="gen7062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4231"/><l level="1" sID="gen7063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4231"/>O Yahweh, your loyal love <transChange type="added">extends</transChange> into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens,<l eID="gen7063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7064"/>your faithfulness unto <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clouds. <l eID="gen7064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4232"/><l level="1" sID="gen7065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4232"/>Your righteousness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞like the mighty mountains⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “like the mountains of God”</note><l eID="gen7065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7066"/>your judgments <transChange type="added">like the</transChange> great deep.<l eID="gen7066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7067"/>You save man and beast, O Yahweh. <l eID="gen7067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4233"/><l level="1" sID="gen7068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4233"/>How precious <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your loyal love, O God,<l eID="gen7068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7069"/>and the children of humankind<l eID="gen7069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7070"/>take refuge in the shadow of your wings. <l eID="gen7070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4234"/><l level="1" sID="gen7071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4234"/>They are refreshed with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fullness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fatness”</note> of your house,<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note><l eID="gen7071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7072"/>and you give them drink <transChange type="added">from</transChange> the river of your delights. <l eID="gen7072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4235"/><l level="1" sID="gen7073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4235"/>For with you is <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fountain of life;<l eID="gen7073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7074"/>in your light we see light. <l eID="gen7074" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4236"/><l level="1" sID="gen7075"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4236"/>Prolong your loyal love to those who know you,<l eID="gen7075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7076"/>and your righteousness to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> upright of heart. <l eID="gen7076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4237"/><l level="1" sID="gen7077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4237"/>Do not let a foot of pride come against me,<l eID="gen7077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7078"/>nor let a wicked hand make me to wander homeless. <l eID="gen7078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4238"/><l level="1" sID="gen7079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4238"/>There doers of evil have fallen;<l eID="gen7079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7080"/>they are thrust down and not able to rise. <l eID="gen7080" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7052"/> <chapter eID="Ps.36"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4239"/><title type="x-s">The Protection of the Righteous and the Destruction of the Wicked</title> <div sID="gen7081" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7081" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7082"/> <lg eID="gen7082"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen7083"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4239"/>Do not fret because of evildoers;<l eID="gen7084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7085"/>do not be envious of doers of wickedness. <l eID="gen7085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4240"/><l level="1" sID="gen7086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4240"/>For like the grass they will dry up quickly,<l eID="gen7086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7087"/>and like green vegetation they will wither. <l eID="gen7087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4241"/><l level="1" sID="gen7088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4241"/>Trust Yahweh and do good.<l eID="gen7088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7089"/>Abide <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> land and feed on faithfulness.<note placement="foot">That is, God’s faithfulness</note> <l eID="gen7089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4242"/><l level="1" sID="gen7090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4242"/>Take pleasure in Yahweh as well,<l eID="gen7090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7091"/>and he will give to you the requests of your heart. <l eID="gen7091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4243"/><l level="1" sID="gen7092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4243"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Commit to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Roll upon”</note> Yahweh your way;<l eID="gen7092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7093"/>Trust also on him and he will act. <l eID="gen7093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4244"/><l level="1" sID="gen7094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4244"/>Then he will bring forth your righteousness like the light,<l eID="gen7094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7095"/>and your justice like the noonday. <l eID="gen7095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4245"/><l level="1" sID="gen7096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4245"/>Be quiet before Yahweh and wait for him.<l eID="gen7096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7097"/>Do not fret about one who succeeds <transChange type="added">in</transChange> his way,<l eID="gen7097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7098"/>about a man making plots. <l eID="gen7098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4246"/><l level="1" sID="gen7099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4246"/>Refrain from anger and forsake wrath.<l eID="gen7099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7100"/>Do not fret; <transChange type="added">it</transChange> only brings evil. <l eID="gen7100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4247"/><l level="1" sID="gen7101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4247"/>For evildoers will be cut off,<l eID="gen7101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7102"/>but those who wait for Yahweh—<l eID="gen7102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7103"/>they will possess <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land. <l eID="gen7103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4248"/><l level="1" sID="gen7104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4248"/>And<note placement="foot">Or “But”</note> yet a little <transChange type="added">while</transChange> and the wicked will not be,<l eID="gen7104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7105"/>and you will look carefully upon his place, but he will not be. <l eID="gen7105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4249"/><l level="1" sID="gen7106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4249"/>But <transChange type="added">the</transChange> afflicted will possess <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen7106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7107"/>and they will take pleasure in an abundance of peace. <l eID="gen7107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4250"/><l level="1" sID="gen7108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4250"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> wicked plans <transChange type="added">evil</transChange> against the righteous,<l eID="gen7108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7109"/>and gnashes at him <transChange type="added">with</transChange> his teeth. <l eID="gen7109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4251"/><l level="1" sID="gen7110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4251"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> Lord laughs at him,<l eID="gen7110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7111"/>for he sees that his day is coming. <l eID="gen7111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4252"/><l level="1" sID="gen7112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4252"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> wicked have drawn <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword and have bent their bow<l eID="gen7112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7113"/>to throw down <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy,<l eID="gen7113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7114"/>to kill <transChange type="added">those</transChange> upright in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> way. <l eID="gen7114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4253"/><l level="1" sID="gen7115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4253"/>Their sword will enter into their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> heart,<l eID="gen7115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7116"/>and their bows shall be broken. <l eID="gen7116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4254"/><l level="1" sID="gen7117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4254"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> little belonging to the righteous <transChange type="added">is</transChange> better<l eID="gen7117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7118"/>than <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wealth of many wicked. <l eID="gen7118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4255"/><l level="1" sID="gen7119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4255"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> arms of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked shall be broken,<l eID="gen7119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7120"/>but Yahweh supports <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous. <l eID="gen7120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4256"/><l level="1" sID="gen7121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4256"/>Yahweh knows <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blameless,<l eID="gen7121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7122"/>and their inheritance will be forever. <l eID="gen7122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4257"/><l level="1" sID="gen7123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4257"/>They will not be put to shame in distressing times,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “time”</note><l eID="gen7123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7124"/>and in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days of famine they will be satisfied. <l eID="gen7124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4258"/><l level="1" sID="gen7125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4258"/>But <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked will perish,<l eID="gen7125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7126"/>and the enemies of Yahweh <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> splendor of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pastures.<l eID="gen7126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7127"/>They vanish; in smoke they vanish. <l eID="gen7127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4259"/><l level="1" sID="gen7128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4259"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> wicked borrows and does not repay,<l eID="gen7128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7129"/>but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous <transChange type="added">is</transChange> gracious and gives. <l eID="gen7129" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4260"/><l level="1" sID="gen7130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4260"/>For those blessed <transChange type="added">by</transChange> him shall possess <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen7130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7131"/>but those cursed <transChange type="added">by</transChange> him shall be cut off. <l eID="gen7131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4261"/><l level="1" sID="gen7132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4261"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> steps of a man are established by Yahweh,<l eID="gen7132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7133"/>and he takes pleasure in his way. <l eID="gen7133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4262"/><l level="1" sID="gen7134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4262"/>Though he fall, he will not be cast headlong,<l eID="gen7134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7135"/>for Yahweh supports <transChange type="added">him with</transChange> his hand. <l eID="gen7135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4263"/><l level="1" sID="gen7136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4263"/>I was a youth, but I am <transChange type="added">now</transChange> old;<l eID="gen7136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7137"/>yet I have not seen <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous forsaken<l eID="gen7137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7138"/>or his children <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞begging for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “searching”</note> bread. <l eID="gen7138" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4264"/><l level="1" sID="gen7139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4264"/>All the day he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> gracious and lends,<l eID="gen7139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7140"/>and his children <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a blessing. <l eID="gen7140" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4265"/><l level="1" sID="gen7141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4265"/>Turn aside from evil and do good<l eID="gen7141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7142"/>and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> abide forever. <l eID="gen7142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4266"/><l level="1" sID="gen7143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4266"/>For Yahweh loves justice<l eID="gen7143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7144"/>and will not forsake his faithful ones.<l eID="gen7144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7145"/>They are protected forever.<l eID="gen7145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7146"/>But <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked will be cut off. <l eID="gen7146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4267"/><l level="1" sID="gen7147"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4267"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> righteous will possess <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land<l eID="gen7147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7148"/>and abide in it forever. <l eID="gen7148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4268"/><l level="1" sID="gen7149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4268"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> mouth of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous utters wisdom,<l eID="gen7149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7150"/>and his tongue speaks justice. <l eID="gen7150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4269"/><l level="1" sID="gen7151"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4269"/>The law of his God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in his heart.<l eID="gen7151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7152"/>His steps will not slip. <l eID="gen7152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4270"/><l level="1" sID="gen7153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4270"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> wicked watches for the righteous<l eID="gen7153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7154"/>and seeks to kill him. <l eID="gen7154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4271"/><l level="1" sID="gen7155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4271"/>Yahweh will not abandon him into his hand,<l eID="gen7155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7156"/>and he will not let him be condemned when he is judged. <l eID="gen7156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4272"/><l level="1" sID="gen7157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4272"/>Wait for Yahweh and keep his way,<l eID="gen7157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7158"/>and he will exalt you to possess <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land.<l eID="gen7158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7159"/>When <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked are cut off, you will see <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <l eID="gen7159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4273"/><l level="1" sID="gen7160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4273"/>I have seen <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked acting violently<l eID="gen7160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7161"/>and spreading himself out<l eID="gen7161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7162"/>like a luxuriant native tree. <l eID="gen7162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4274"/><l level="1" sID="gen7163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4274"/>Then he passed on<note placement="foot">Dead Sea Scrolls and the versions read “I passed by”</note> and behold, he was not.<l eID="gen7163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7164"/>And I sought him, but he could not be found. <l eID="gen7164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4275"/><l level="1" sID="gen7165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4275"/>Observe <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blameless and look at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> upright,<l eID="gen7165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7166"/>for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> a future for a man of peace. <l eID="gen7166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4276"/><l level="1" sID="gen7167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4276"/>But transgressors shall be destroyed altogether.<l eID="gen7167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7168"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> future of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked shall be cut off. <l eID="gen7168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4277"/><l level="1" sID="gen7169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4277"/>And<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts omit “and,” preserving the acrostic</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> salvation of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from Yahweh,<l eID="gen7169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7170"/>their refuge in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of trouble. <l eID="gen7170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4278"/><l level="1" sID="gen7171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4278"/>And Yahweh helps them and he rescues them.<l eID="gen7171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7172"/>He rescues them from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked and saves them,<l eID="gen7172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7173"/>because they take refuge in him. <l eID="gen7173" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7083"/> <chapter eID="Ps.37"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4279"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer of Repentance</title> <div sID="gen7174" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7174" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7175"/> <lg eID="gen7175"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of David. To bring to remembrance.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen7176"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4279"/>O Yahweh, do not rebuke me in your anger<l eID="gen7177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7178"/>or chastise me in your wrath. <l eID="gen7178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4280"/><l level="1" sID="gen7179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4280"/>For your arrows have sunk into me,<l eID="gen7179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7180"/>and your hand has pressed down on me. <l eID="gen7180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4281"/><l level="1" sID="gen7181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4281"/>There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation.<l eID="gen7181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7182"/>There is no health in my bones because of my sin. <l eID="gen7182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4282"/><l level="1" sID="gen7183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4282"/>For my iniquities have passed over my head;<l eID="gen7183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7184"/>like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me. <l eID="gen7184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4283"/><l level="1" sID="gen7185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4283"/>My wounds start to stink; they rot<l eID="gen7185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7186"/>because of my foolishness. <l eID="gen7186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4284"/><l level="1" sID="gen7187"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4284"/>I am bowed down; I am bent over greatly.<l eID="gen7187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7188"/>All the day I go about mourning. <l eID="gen7188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4285"/><l level="1" sID="gen7189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4285"/>For my loins are full <transChange type="added">of</transChange> burning,<l eID="gen7189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7190"/>and there is no soundness in my flesh. <l eID="gen7190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4286"/><l level="1" sID="gen7191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4286"/>I am faint and crushed greatly;<l eID="gen7191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7192"/>I groan because of the roaring of my heart. <l eID="gen7192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4287"/><l level="1" sID="gen7193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4287"/>O Lord, all my longing is before you,<l eID="gen7193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7194"/>and my sighing is not hidden from you. <l eID="gen7194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4288"/><l level="1" sID="gen7195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4288"/>My heart throbs violently, my strength leaves me;<l eID="gen7195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7196"/>and the light of my eyes, that also is not with me. <l eID="gen7196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4289"/><l level="1" sID="gen7197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4289"/>My friends and companions stand aloof from my affliction,<l eID="gen7197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7198"/>and my relatives stand afar off. <l eID="gen7198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4290"/><l level="1" sID="gen7199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4290"/>Those who seek my life lay snares as well,<l eID="gen7199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7200"/>and those intent on my harm speak threats.<l eID="gen7200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7201"/>They also plot deceit all day. <l eID="gen7201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4291"/><l level="1" sID="gen7202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4291"/>But as for me, like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deaf I cannot hear,<l eID="gen7202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7203"/>and <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mute <transChange type="added">who</transChange> cannot open his mouth. <l eID="gen7203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4292"/><l level="1" sID="gen7204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4292"/>And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I am like a man who hears not,<l eID="gen7204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7205"/>and in whose mouth there are no retorts. <l eID="gen7205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4293"/><l level="1" sID="gen7206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4293"/>Rather for you I wait, O Yahweh.<l eID="gen7206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7207"/>You will answer, O Lord my God. <l eID="gen7207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4294"/><l level="1" sID="gen7208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4294"/>For I said, “<transChange type="added">Help,</transChange> lest they rejoice over me,<l eID="gen7208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7209"/><transChange type="added">lest</transChange> they boast against me when my foot slips.” <l eID="gen7209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4295"/><l level="1" sID="gen7210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4295"/>For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> ready to stumble,<l eID="gen7210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7211"/>and my pain <transChange type="added">is</transChange> before me continually. <l eID="gen7211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4296"/><l level="1" sID="gen7212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4296"/>For my iniquity I confess;<l eID="gen7212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7213"/>I am anxious because of my sin. <l eID="gen7213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4297"/><l level="1" sID="gen7214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4297"/>And my enemies without cause<note placement="foot">Or “vigorous”</note> are numerous,<l eID="gen7214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7215"/>and those who hate me wrongfully<note placement="foot">Or “those who hate me with falsehood”</note> are many. <l eID="gen7215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4298"/><l level="1" sID="gen7216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4298"/>And those who repay evil in return for good<l eID="gen7216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7217"/>accuse me in return for my pursuing good. <l eID="gen7217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4299"/><l level="1" sID="gen7218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4299"/>Do not forsake me, O Yahweh.<l eID="gen7218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7219"/>O my God, do not be far from me. <l eID="gen7219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4300"/><l level="1" sID="gen7220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4300"/>Hurry to help me,<l eID="gen7220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7221"/>O Lord, my salvation. <l eID="gen7221" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7176"/> <chapter eID="Ps.38"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4301"/><title type="x-s">The Brevity of Human Life</title> <div sID="gen7222" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7222" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7223"/> <lg eID="gen7223"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. For Jeduthun.<note placement="foot">One of David’s musicians (<reference osisRef="1Chr.16.41">1 Chr 16:41</reference>)</note> A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen7224"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4301"/>I said, “I will guard my ways<l eID="gen7225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7226"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that I may not sin⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from sinning”</note> with my tongue.<l eID="gen7226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7227"/>I will keep a muzzle over my mouth<l eID="gen7227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7228"/>as long as <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked <transChange type="added">are</transChange> before me.” <l eID="gen7228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4302"/><l level="1" sID="gen7229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4302"/>I was mute <transChange type="added">with</transChange> silence. I was silent <transChange type="added">even</transChange> from <transChange type="added">saying</transChange> good <transChange type="added">things</transChange>,<l eID="gen7229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7230"/>and my pain was stirred up. <l eID="gen7230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4303"/><l level="1" sID="gen7231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4303"/>My heart grew hot inside me;<l eID="gen7231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7232"/>in my sighing a fire burned.<l eID="gen7232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7233"/><transChange type="added">Then</transChange> I spoke with my tongue, <l eID="gen7233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4304"/><l level="1" sID="gen7234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4304"/>“Let me know, O Yahweh, my end,<l eID="gen7234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7235"/>and what is the measure of my days.<l eID="gen7235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7236"/>Let me know how transient I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>.” <l eID="gen7236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4305"/><l level="1" sID="gen7237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4305"/>Look, you have made my days <transChange type="added">mere</transChange> handbreadths,<l eID="gen7237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7238"/>and my lifespan as nothing next to you.<l eID="gen7238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7239"/>Surely every person standing firm <transChange type="added">is</transChange> complete vanity. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4306"/><l level="1" sID="gen7240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4306"/>Surely a man walks about as a <transChange type="added">mere</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shadow⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “image”</note><l eID="gen7240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7241"/>surely in vain they bustle about.<l eID="gen7241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7242"/>He heaps up <transChange type="added">possessions</transChange> but does not know who <transChange type="added">will</transChange> gather them <transChange type="added">in</transChange>. <l eID="gen7242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4307"/><l level="1" sID="gen7243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4307"/>And now, O Lord, for what do I wait?<l eID="gen7243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7244"/>My hope is for you. <l eID="gen7244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4308"/><l level="1" sID="gen7245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4308"/>From all my transgressions deliver me;<l eID="gen7245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7246"/>do not make me <transChange type="added">the</transChange> taunt of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fool. <l eID="gen7246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4309"/><l level="1" sID="gen7247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4309"/>I am mute. I do not open my mouth,<l eID="gen7247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7248"/>for you, yourself, have done <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <l eID="gen7248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4310"/><l level="1" sID="gen7249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4310"/>Remove from me your affliction.<l eID="gen7249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7250"/>By the opposition of your hand I perish. <l eID="gen7250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4311"/><l level="1" sID="gen7251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4311"/><transChange type="added">When</transChange> with rebukes you chastise a man for sin,<l eID="gen7251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7252"/>you<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and/then you”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞consume⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause to melt”</note> like a moth his delightful <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.<l eID="gen7252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7253"/>Surely everyone <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a <transChange type="added">mere</transChange> vapor.<note placement="foot">The word translated “vanity” in vv. <reference osisRef="Ps.39.6">6</reference>, 7</note> <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4312"/><l level="1" sID="gen7254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4312"/>Hear my prayer, O Yahweh, and listen <transChange type="added">to</transChange> my cry for help;<l eID="gen7254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7255"/>do not be deaf to my tears.<l eID="gen7255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7256"/>For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> an alien<note placement="foot">Or “stranger”</note> with you,<l eID="gen7256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7257"/>a sojourner like all my ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> <l eID="gen7257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4313"/><l level="1" sID="gen7258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4313"/>Look <transChange type="added">away</transChange> from me that I may be cheerful,<l eID="gen7258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7259"/>before I depart and I am no more. <l eID="gen7259" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7224"/> <chapter eID="Ps.39"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4314"/><title type="x-s">God’s Faithfulness and Deliverance</title> <div sID="gen7260" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7260" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7261"/> <lg eID="gen7261"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of David. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen7262"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4314"/>I waited patiently for Yahweh,<l eID="gen7263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7264"/>And he inclined to me<l eID="gen7264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7265"/>and heard my cry for help. <l eID="gen7265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4315"/><l level="1" sID="gen7266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4315"/>And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> he brought me up from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roaring pit,<note placement="foot">Some read “pit of destruction”</note><l eID="gen7266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7267"/>from the miry clay.<l eID="gen7267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7268"/>And he put my feet upon a rock;<l eID="gen7268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7269"/>he made my steps steady. <l eID="gen7269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4316"/><l level="1" sID="gen7270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4316"/>Then he put a new song in my mouth,<l eID="gen7270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7271"/>a praise to our God.<l eID="gen7271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7272"/>Many will see and fear,<l eID="gen7272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7273"/>and will trust Yahweh. <l eID="gen7273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4317"/><l level="1" sID="gen7274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4317"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the man who makes Yahweh his trust<l eID="gen7274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7275"/>and does not turn to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> proud and <transChange type="added">to those who</transChange> fall away <transChange type="added">to</transChange> a lie.<note placement="foot">Or “false god”</note> <l eID="gen7275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4318"/><l level="1" sID="gen7276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4318"/>Many things, O Yahweh my God, you have done—<l eID="gen7276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7277"/>your wonderful deeds and your thoughts toward us.<l eID="gen7277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7278"/>There is none to compare with you.<l eID="gen7278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7279"/>If I <transChange type="added">tried to</transChange> proclaim and tell <transChange type="added">of them</transChange>,<l eID="gen7279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7280"/>they would be too numerous to count. <l eID="gen7280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4319"/><l level="1" sID="gen7281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4319"/>A sacrifice and offering you do not desire.<l eID="gen7281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7282"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞My ears you have opened⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Ears you have dug for me.”</note><l eID="gen7282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7283"/>Burnt offering and sin offering you have not demanded. <l eID="gen7283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4320"/><l level="1" sID="gen7284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4320"/>Then I said, “Look, I come.<l eID="gen7284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7285"/>In <transChange type="added">the</transChange> scroll of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> book<l eID="gen7285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7286"/>it is written concerning me: <l eID="gen7286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4321"/><l level="1" sID="gen7287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4321"/>‘I delight to do your will, O my God,<l eID="gen7287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7288"/>and your law <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deep within me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “in the midst of my intestines”</note> <l eID="gen7288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4322"/><l level="1" sID="gen7289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4322"/>I have brought good tidings <transChange type="added">of</transChange> righteousness in the great congregation.<l eID="gen7289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7290"/>Look, I have not shut my lips.<l eID="gen7290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7291"/>O Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you surely know that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you, you know”</note> <l eID="gen7291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4323"/><l level="1" sID="gen7292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4323"/>Your righteousness I have not hidden in the midst of my heart.<l eID="gen7292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7293"/>I have spoken of your faithfulness and your salvation.<l eID="gen7293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7294"/>I have not concealed your loyal love or your faithfulness<l eID="gen7294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7295"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> great congregation. <l eID="gen7295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4324"/><l level="1" sID="gen7296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4324"/>As for you, O Yahweh, do not withhold your mercies from me.<l eID="gen7296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7297"/>Let your loyal love and your faithfulness<l eID="gen7297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7298"/>continually preserve me. <l eID="gen7298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4325"/><l level="1" sID="gen7299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4325"/>For evils without number have encompassed me.<l eID="gen7299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7300"/>My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to see.<l eID="gen7300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7301"/>They are more than the hairs of my head,<l eID="gen7301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7302"/>and my heart fails me. <l eID="gen7302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4326"/><l level="1" sID="gen7303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4326"/>Be pleased, O Yahweh, to deliver me.<l eID="gen7303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7304"/>O Yahweh, hurry to help me. <l eID="gen7304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4327"/><l level="1" sID="gen7305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4327"/>Let them be shamed and abashed altogether<l eID="gen7305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7306"/>who seek to take away my life.<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note><l eID="gen7306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7307"/>Let them be repulsed and humiliated<l eID="gen7307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7308"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> desire my harm. <l eID="gen7308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4328"/><l level="1" sID="gen7309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4328"/>Let them be appalled because of their shame,<l eID="gen7309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7310"/>those who say to me, “Aha! Aha!” <l eID="gen7310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4329"/><l level="1" sID="gen7311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4329"/>Let them rejoice and be glad in you,<l eID="gen7311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7312"/>all those who seek you.<l eID="gen7312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7313"/>Let them say continually, “Yahweh is great!”<l eID="gen7313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7314"/>—those who love your salvation. <l eID="gen7314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4330"/><l level="1" sID="gen7315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4330"/>But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> poor and needy.<l eID="gen7315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7316"/>Let my Lord consider me.<l eID="gen7316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7317"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my help and my deliverer.<l eID="gen7317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7318"/>O my God, do not delay. <l eID="gen7318" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7262"/> <chapter eID="Ps.40"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4331"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for God’s Provision in Time of Sickness</title> <div sID="gen7319" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7319" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7320"/> <lg eID="gen7320"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen7321"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4331"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is the one who</transChange> has regard for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor;<l eID="gen7322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7323"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of disaster, Yahweh delivers him. <l eID="gen7323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4332"/><l level="1" sID="gen7324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4332"/>Yahweh protects him and keeps him alive;<l eID="gen7324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7325"/>he is blessed in the land,<l eID="gen7325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7326"/>and you do not give him<l eID="gen7326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7327"/>into the will<note placement="foot">Hebrew “soul”</note> of his enemies. <l eID="gen7327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4333"/><l level="1" sID="gen7328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4333"/>Yahweh sustains him on <transChange type="added">his</transChange> sick bed.<l eID="gen7328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7329"/>In his illness, you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞restore to health⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his every bed you change”</note> <l eID="gen7329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4334"/><l level="1" sID="gen7330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4334"/>As for me, I said, “O Yahweh, be gracious <transChange type="added">to</transChange> me.<l eID="gen7330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7331"/>Heal me,<note placement="foot">Or “my soul”</note> for I have sinned against you.” <l eID="gen7331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4335"/><l level="1" sID="gen7332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4335"/>My enemies speak evil about me,<l eID="gen7332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7333"/>“When will he die and his name perish?” <l eID="gen7333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4336"/><l level="1" sID="gen7334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4336"/>And when one comes to see <transChange type="added">me</transChange>, he speaks falsely;<l eID="gen7334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7335"/>his heart gathers disaster for itself.<l eID="gen7335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7336"/>He goes out to the street; he speaks. <l eID="gen7336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4337"/><l level="1" sID="gen7337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4337"/>All who hate me speak together against me.<l eID="gen7337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7338"/>Against me they assume the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞worst⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “evil”</note> for me: <l eID="gen7338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4338"/><l level="1" sID="gen7339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4338"/>“A ruinous thing is poured out on him,<l eID="gen7339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7340"/>and <transChange type="added">now</transChange> that he lies down, he will not rise up again.” <l eID="gen7340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4339"/><l level="1" sID="gen7341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4339"/>Even <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my close friend⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the man of my peace”</note> whom I trusted,<l eID="gen7341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7342"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> ate my bread,<l eID="gen7342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7343"/>has lifted <transChange type="added">his</transChange> heel against me. <l eID="gen7343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4340"/><l level="1" sID="gen7344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4340"/>But you, O Yahweh, be gracious to me and raise me up<l eID="gen7344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7345"/>that I may repay them. <l eID="gen7345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4341"/><l level="1" sID="gen7346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4341"/>By this I know that you delight in me:<l eID="gen7346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7347"/>because my enemy has not shouted in triumph over me. <l eID="gen7347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4342"/><l level="1" sID="gen7348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4342"/>As for me, you have upheld me in my integrity,<l eID="gen7348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7349"/>and you have set me in your presence forever. <l eID="gen7349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4343"/><l level="1" sID="gen7350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4343"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">be</transChange> Yahweh, the God of Israel,<l eID="gen7350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7351"/>from everlasting to everlasting.<l eID="gen7351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7352"/>Amen and Amen. <l eID="gen7352" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7321"/> <chapter eID="Ps.41"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4344"/><title type="x-s">Hope in God in the Midst of Despair</title> <div sID="gen7353" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7353" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7354"/> <lg eID="gen7354"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A maskil of the sons of Korah.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen7355"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4344"/>As a deer longs for streams of water,<l eID="gen7356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7357"/>so my soul longs for you, O God. <l eID="gen7357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4345"/><l level="1" sID="gen7358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4345"/>My soul thirsts for God, for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living God.<l eID="gen7358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7359"/>When shall I come and appear before God?<note placement="foot">Some Hebrew manuscripts and versions read “and see the face of God?”</note> <l eID="gen7359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4346"/><l level="1" sID="gen7360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4346"/>My tears have been my food day and night,<l eID="gen7360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7361"/>while <transChange type="added">they</transChange> say to me all day <transChange type="added">long</transChange>,<l eID="gen7361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7362"/>“Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your God?” <l eID="gen7362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4347"/><l level="1" sID="gen7363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4347"/>These I remember and I pour out my soul within me:<l eID="gen7363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7364"/>that I would go with the multitude;<l eID="gen7364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7365"/>I led them <transChange type="added">in procession</transChange> to the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of God,<l eID="gen7365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7366"/>with a voice of rejoicing and thanksgiving,<l eID="gen7366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7367"/>a crowd celebrating a festival. <l eID="gen7367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4348"/><l level="1" sID="gen7368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4348"/>Why are you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in despair⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “bowed down”</note> O my soul,<l eID="gen7368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7369"/>and disturbed within me?<l eID="gen7369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7370"/>Hope in God, because I will again praise him,<l eID="gen7370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7371"/><transChange type="added">for</transChange> the salvation of his presence. <l eID="gen7371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4349"/><l level="1" sID="gen7372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4349"/>O my God, within me my soul is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in despair⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “bowed down”</note><l eID="gen7372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7373"/>therefore I remember you from the land of Jordan<l eID="gen7373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7374"/>and the heights of Hermon, from the mountain of Mizar. <l eID="gen7374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4350"/><l level="1" sID="gen7375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4350"/>Deep <transChange type="added">is</transChange> calling to deep<l eID="gen7375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7376"/>at<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> the thunder of your waterfalls.<l eID="gen7376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7377"/>All your breakers and your waves<l eID="gen7377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7378"/>have passed over me. <l eID="gen7378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4351"/><l level="1" sID="gen7379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4351"/>By day Yahweh commands his loyal love,<l eID="gen7379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7380"/>and in the night his song <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with me,<l eID="gen7380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7381"/>a prayer to the God of my life. <l eID="gen7381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4352"/><l level="1" sID="gen7382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4352"/>I say to God, my rock,<l eID="gen7382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7383"/>“Why have you forgotten me?<l eID="gen7383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7384"/>Why must I walk about mourning<l eID="gen7384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7385"/>because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppression of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy?” <l eID="gen7385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4353"/><l level="1" sID="gen7386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4353"/><transChange type="added">As</transChange> with a shattering in my bones<l eID="gen7386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7387"/>my oppressors taunt me,<l eID="gen7387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7388"/>while they say to me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all the day”</note><l eID="gen7388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7389"/>“Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your God?” <l eID="gen7389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4354"/><l level="1" sID="gen7390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4354"/>Why are you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in despair⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “bowed down”</note> O my soul?<l eID="gen7390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7391"/>And why are you disturbed within me?<l eID="gen7391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7392"/>Hope in God, because I shall again praise him,<l eID="gen7392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7393"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my salvation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the salvation of my face”</note> and my God. <l eID="gen7393" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7355"/> <chapter eID="Ps.42"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4355"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Rescue</title> <div sID="gen7394" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7394" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7395"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4355"/>Judge me, O God, and plead my case<l eID="gen7396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7397"/>against<note placement="foot">Or “because of”</note> an unfaithful<note placement="foot">Or “disloyal”</note> nation.<l eID="gen7397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7398"/>From a man of deceit and wickedness rescue me, <l eID="gen7398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4356"/><l level="1" sID="gen7399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4356"/>because you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the God of my refuge.<l eID="gen7399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7400"/>Why have you rejected me?<l eID="gen7400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7401"/>Why must I go about mourning<l eID="gen7401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7402"/>because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppression of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy? <l eID="gen7402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4357"/><l level="1" sID="gen7403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4357"/>Send your light and your truth;<l eID="gen7403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7404"/>they shall lead<note placement="foot">Or “let them lead”</note> me.<l eID="gen7404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7405"/>They shall bring me to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of your holiness”</note><l eID="gen7405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7406"/>and to your dwelling places. <l eID="gen7406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4358"/><l level="1" sID="gen7407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4358"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> I will go to the altar of God,<l eID="gen7407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7408"/>to God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my surpassing joy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the joy of my gladness”</note><l eID="gen7408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7409"/>and I will praise you with lyre,<l eID="gen7409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7410"/>O God, my God. <l eID="gen7410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4359"/><l level="1" sID="gen7411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4359"/>Why are you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in despair⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “bowed down”</note> O my soul?<l eID="gen7411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7412"/>And why are you disturbed within me?<l eID="gen7412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7413"/>Hope in God, because I will again praise him,<l eID="gen7413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7414"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my salvation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “the salvation of my face”</note> and my God. <l eID="gen7414" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7395"/> <chapter eID="Ps.43"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4360"/><title type="x-s">Present Defeat and Past Deliverance</title> <div sID="gen7415" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7415" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7416"/> <lg eID="gen7416"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of the sons of Korah.
