A maskil.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen7417"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4360"/>O God, we have heard with our ears;<l eID="gen7418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7419"/>our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> have told us<l eID="gen7419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7420"/>of work you worked in their days,<l eID="gen7420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7421"/>in days of old. <l eID="gen7421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4361"/><l level="1" sID="gen7422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4361"/>You <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your hand drove out the nations,<l eID="gen7422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7423"/>but them<note placement="foot">That is, Israel</note> you planted.<l eID="gen7423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7424"/>You harmed <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen7424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7425"/>but them<note placement="foot">That is, Israel</note> you let spread out. <l eID="gen7425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4362"/><l level="1" sID="gen7426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4362"/>For not with their sword<l eID="gen7426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7427"/>did they possess <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen7427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7428"/>and their arm did not give them victory.<l eID="gen7428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7429"/>Rather <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> your right hand and your arm<l eID="gen7429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7430"/>and the light of your presence,<l eID="gen7430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7431"/>because you delighted in them. <l eID="gen7431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4363"/><l level="1" sID="gen7432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4363"/>You are my king, O God.<l eID="gen7432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7433"/>Command<note placement="foot">Or “who commands,” see LXX</note> victories for Jacob. <l eID="gen7433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4364"/><l level="1" sID="gen7434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4364"/>By you we push down our enemies;<l eID="gen7434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7435"/>by your name we tread down those who rise up against us. <l eID="gen7435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4365"/><l level="1" sID="gen7436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4365"/>For I do not trust my bow,<l eID="gen7436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7437"/>and my sword cannot give me victory. <l eID="gen7437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4366"/><l level="1" sID="gen7438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4366"/>Rather you have saved us from our enemies,<note placement="foot">Or “made us victorious over our enemies”</note><l eID="gen7438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7439"/>and have humiliated those who hate us. <l eID="gen7439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4367"/><l level="1" sID="gen7440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4367"/>In God we boast all the day,<l eID="gen7440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7441"/>and we will give thanks <transChange type="added">to</transChange> your name forever. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4368"/><l level="1" sID="gen7442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4368"/>Surely you have rejected and disgraced us,<l eID="gen7442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7443"/>and have not gone out with our armies. <l eID="gen7443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4369"/><l level="1" sID="gen7444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4369"/>You have caused us to pull back from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy,<l eID="gen7444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7445"/>and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> those who hate us have plundered for themselves. <l eID="gen7445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4370"/><l level="1" sID="gen7446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4370"/>You have given us as sheep <transChange type="added">for</transChange> food,<l eID="gen7446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7447"/>and among the nations you have scattered us. <l eID="gen7447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4371"/><l level="1" sID="gen7448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4371"/>You have sold your people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cheaply⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for what is not wealth”</note><l eID="gen7448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7449"/>and did not profit by their price. <l eID="gen7449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4372"/><l level="1" sID="gen7450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4372"/>You have made us a taunt to our neighbors,<l eID="gen7450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7451"/>a derision and a scorn to those around us. <l eID="gen7451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4373"/><l level="1" sID="gen7452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4373"/>You have made us a byword among the nations,<l eID="gen7452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7453"/>a shaking of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples. <l eID="gen7453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4374"/><l level="1" sID="gen7454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4374"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞All day long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All of the day”</note> my disgrace <transChange type="added">is</transChange> before me,<l eID="gen7454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7455"/>and the shame of my face covers me, <l eID="gen7455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4375"/><l level="1" sID="gen7456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4375"/>because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> taunter and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> reviler,<l eID="gen7456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7457"/>because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> avenger. <l eID="gen7457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4376"/><l level="1" sID="gen7458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4376"/>All this has befallen us, though we have not forgotten you,<l eID="gen7458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7459"/>and we have not been false to your covenant. <l eID="gen7459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4377"/><l level="1" sID="gen7460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4377"/>Our heart has not turned back,<l eID="gen7460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7461"/>and our steps have <transChange type="added">not</transChange> turned aside from your way. <l eID="gen7461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4378"/><l level="1" sID="gen7462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4378"/>But you have crushed us in a place of jackals,<l eID="gen7462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7463"/>and have covered us with deep shadow. <l eID="gen7463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4379"/><l level="1" sID="gen7464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4379"/>If we had forgotten the name of our God,<l eID="gen7464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7465"/>or had spread out our hands <transChange type="added">in prayer</transChange> to a foreign god, <l eID="gen7465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4380"/><l level="1" sID="gen7466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4380"/>would not God discover this,<l eID="gen7466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7467"/>for he knows <transChange type="added">the</transChange> secrets of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart? <l eID="gen7467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4381"/><l level="1" sID="gen7468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4381"/>Rather, on account of you we are killed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all day long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “all of the day”</note><l eID="gen7468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7469"/>we are accounted as sheep for slaughter. <l eID="gen7469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4382"/><l level="1" sID="gen7470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4382"/>Wake up! Why do you sleep, O Lord?<l eID="gen7470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7471"/>Awake! Do not reject forever. <l eID="gen7471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4383"/><l level="1" sID="gen7472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4383"/>Why do you hide your face?<l eID="gen7472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7473"/><transChange type="added">Have</transChange> you forgotten our misery and our oppression? <l eID="gen7473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4384"/><l level="1" sID="gen7474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4384"/>For our soul is bowed down to the dust.<l eID="gen7474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7475"/>Our <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “belly”</note> clings to the ground. <l eID="gen7475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4385"/><l level="1" sID="gen7476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4385"/>Rise up! <transChange type="added">Be a</transChange> help for us,<l eID="gen7476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7477"/>and redeem us for the sake of your loyal love. <l eID="gen7477" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7417"/> <chapter eID="Ps.44"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4386"/><title type="x-s">Celebration of a Royal Wedding</title> <div sID="gen7478" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7478" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7479"/> <lg eID="gen7479"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director; according to <transChange type="added">The</transChange> Lilies. Of the sons of Korah.</title> <lg sID="gen7480"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7481"/>A maskil. A song of love.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen7481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4386"/>My heart is moved <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a good word;<l eID="gen7482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7483"/>I recite my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞compositions⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “works,” that is, the song he has composed</note> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king.<l eID="gen7483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7484"/>My tongue <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> pen <transChange type="added">of</transChange> a skilled scribe. <l eID="gen7484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4387"/><l level="1" sID="gen7485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4387"/>You are <transChange type="added">the most</transChange> handsome of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sons of humankind;<l eID="gen7485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7486"/>grace is poured out on your lips;<l eID="gen7486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7487"/>therefore God has blessed you forever. <l eID="gen7487" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4388"/><l level="1" sID="gen7488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4388"/>Gird your sword on <transChange type="added">your</transChange> thigh, O mighty one,<l eID="gen7488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7489"/><transChange type="added">in</transChange> your splendor and your majesty. <l eID="gen7489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4389"/><l level="1" sID="gen7490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4389"/>And <transChange type="added">in</transChange> your majesty <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ride victoriously⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Succeed! Ride!”</note><l eID="gen7490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7491"/>because of truth and humility <transChange type="added">and</transChange> righteousness.<l eID="gen7491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7492"/>And let your right hand teach you awesome deeds. <l eID="gen7492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4390"/><l level="1" sID="gen7493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4390"/>Your arrows <transChange type="added">are</transChange> sharp;<l eID="gen7493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7494"/>peoples fall under you<l eID="gen7494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7495"/>in the midst of the king’s enemies. <l eID="gen7495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4391"/><l level="1" sID="gen7496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4391"/>Your throne, O God, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forever and ever.<l eID="gen7496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7497"/>A scepter of uprightness <transChange type="added">is</transChange><l eID="gen7497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7498"/>the scepter of your kingdom. <l eID="gen7498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4392"/><l level="1" sID="gen7499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4392"/>You love righteousness and hate wickedness.<l eID="gen7499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7500"/>Therefore God, your God, has anointed you<l eID="gen7500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7501"/>from among your companions <transChange type="added">with</transChange> festive oil. <l eID="gen7501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4393"/><l level="1" sID="gen7502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4393"/>All your robes <transChange type="added">are scented with</transChange> myrrh and aloes <transChange type="added">and</transChange> cassia.<l eID="gen7502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7503"/>From palaces of ivory stringed instruments gladden you. <l eID="gen7503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4394"/><l level="1" sID="gen7504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4394"/>Kings’ daughters <transChange type="added">are</transChange> among your noble ladies.<l eID="gen7504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7505"/>The queen stands at your right hand in gold of Ophir. <l eID="gen7505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4395"/><l level="1" sID="gen7506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4395"/>Hear, O daughter, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞discern⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “see”</note> and incline your ear,<l eID="gen7506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7507"/>and forget your people and your father’s house. <l eID="gen7507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4396"/><l level="1" sID="gen7508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4396"/>Let the king desire your beauty.<note placement="foot">Or “Should the king desire … then bow down …”</note><l eID="gen7508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7509"/>Because he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your lord, therefore<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> bow down to him. <l eID="gen7509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4397"/><l level="1" sID="gen7510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4397"/>Even the daughter of Tyre <transChange type="added">will come</transChange> with a gift.<l eID="gen7510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7511"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> rich from among people will seek your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞favor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> <l eID="gen7511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4398"/><l level="1" sID="gen7512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4398"/>The king’s daughter is all glorious within;<note placement="foot">That is, within her bridal chamber</note><l eID="gen7512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7513"/>her garment <transChange type="added">is</transChange> of gold embroidered cloth. <l eID="gen7513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4399"/><l level="1" sID="gen7514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4399"/>She is brought to the king <transChange type="added">in</transChange> colorful garments.<l eID="gen7514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7515"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> young women behind her, her attendants,<l eID="gen7515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7516"/><transChange type="added">are</transChange> being brought to you. <l eID="gen7516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4400"/><l level="1" sID="gen7517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4400"/>They are led with joy and gladness.<l eID="gen7517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7518"/>They enter <transChange type="added">the</transChange> palace of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king. <l eID="gen7518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4401"/><l level="1" sID="gen7519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4401"/>In place of your<note placement="foot">The pronouns and verbal forms are masculine in this verse</note> fathers will be your sons.<l eID="gen7519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7520"/>You will make them princes in all the land.<note placement="foot">Or “earth”</note> <l eID="gen7520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4402"/><l level="1" sID="gen7521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4402"/>I will cause your name to be remembered in all generations;<l eID="gen7521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7522"/>therefore peoples will praise you forever and ever. <l eID="gen7522" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7480"/> <chapter eID="Ps.45"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4403"/><title type="x-s">God Provides for and Protects His People</title> <div sID="gen7523" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7523" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7524"/> <lg eID="gen7524"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of the sons of Korah.</title> <lg sID="gen7525"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7526"/>According to Alamoth. A song.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen7526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4403"/>God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our refuge and strength,<l eID="gen7527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7528"/>a very sufficient help in troubles. <l eID="gen7528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4404"/><l level="1" sID="gen7529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4404"/>Therefore we will not fear though <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth change,<l eID="gen7529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7530"/>and though the mountains totter into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞midst⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea, <l eID="gen7530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4405"/><l level="1" sID="gen7531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4405"/>though its waters roar <transChange type="added">and</transChange> foam,<l eID="gen7531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7532"/>though mountains shake with its surging <transChange type="added">water</transChange>. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4406"/><l level="1" sID="gen7533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4406"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> a river whose streams gladden the city of God,<l eID="gen7533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7534"/>the holiest of the dwellings of the Most High. <l eID="gen7534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4407"/><l level="1" sID="gen7535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4407"/>God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the midst of her;<l eID="gen7535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7536"/>she will not be made to totter.<l eID="gen7536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7537"/>God will help her <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at daybreak⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “at the turning of the morning”</note> <l eID="gen7537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4408"/><l level="1" sID="gen7538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4408"/>Nations roar, kingdoms shake;<l eID="gen7538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7539"/>he utters his voice, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth melts. <l eID="gen7539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4409"/><l level="1" sID="gen7540"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4409"/>Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with us;<l eID="gen7540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7541"/>our <transChange type="added">high</transChange> stronghold <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the God of Jacob. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4410"/><l level="1" sID="gen7542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4410"/>Come, see the works of Yahweh,<l eID="gen7542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7543"/>who has placed desolations on the earth. <l eID="gen7543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4411"/><l level="1" sID="gen7544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4411"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> makes wars cease to the ends of the earth;<l eID="gen7544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7545"/>he breaks <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bow and cuts off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spear.<l eID="gen7545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7546"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> wagons <transChange type="added">of war</transChange> he burns with fire. <l eID="gen7546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4412"/><l level="1" sID="gen7547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4412"/>Be still, and know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> God.<l eID="gen7547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7548"/>I will be exalted among the nations;<l eID="gen7548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7549"/>I will be exalted in the earth. <l eID="gen7549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4413"/><l level="1" sID="gen7550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4413"/>Yahweh of Hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with us;<l eID="gen7550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7551"/>the God of Jacob <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our <transChange type="added">high</transChange> stronghold. <l eID="gen7551" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7525"/> <chapter eID="Ps.46"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4414"/><title type="x-s">God Is King over All the Earth</title> <div sID="gen7552" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7552" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7553"/> <lg eID="gen7553"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen7554"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4414"/>All <transChange type="added">you</transChange> peoples, clap <transChange type="added">your</transChange> hands.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “hand”</note><l eID="gen7555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7556"/>Shout to God with a voice of rejoicing. <l eID="gen7556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4415"/><l level="1" sID="gen7557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4415"/>For Yahweh Most High <transChange type="added">is</transChange> awesome,<note placement="foot">Or “to be feared”</note><l eID="gen7557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7558"/>a great king over all the earth. <l eID="gen7558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4416"/><l level="1" sID="gen7559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4416"/>He subdues peoples under us<l eID="gen7559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7560"/>and nations under our feet. <l eID="gen7560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4417"/><l level="1" sID="gen7561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4417"/>He chooses for us our inheritance,<l eID="gen7561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7562"/>the pride of Jacob whom he loves. <l eID="gen7562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4418"/><l level="1" sID="gen7563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4418"/>God has gone up with a shout,<l eID="gen7563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7564"/>Yahweh with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of a trumpet. <l eID="gen7564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4419"/><l level="1" sID="gen7565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4419"/>Sing praises <transChange type="added">to</transChange> God, sing praises.<l eID="gen7565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7566"/>Sing praises to our king, sing praises. <l eID="gen7566" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4420"/><l level="1" sID="gen7567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4420"/>For God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> king of all the earth.<l eID="gen7567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7568"/>Sing praises with understanding.<note placement="foot">Or “sing a maskil”</note> <l eID="gen7568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4421"/><l level="1" sID="gen7569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4421"/>God reigns over nations;<l eID="gen7569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7570"/>God sits on his holy throne. <l eID="gen7570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4422"/><l level="1" sID="gen7571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4422"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> princes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples are gathered together<l eID="gen7571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7572"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> the people of Abraham’s God.<l eID="gen7572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7573"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shields of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth belong to God.<l eID="gen7573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7574"/>He is very exalted. <l eID="gen7574" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7554"/> <chapter eID="Ps.47"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4423"/><title type="x-s">The Greatness of God in Zion</title> <div sID="gen7575" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7575" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7576"/> <lg eID="gen7576"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen7577"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4423"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great and very worthy of praise<l eID="gen7578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7579"/>in the city of our God, in his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “mountain of holiness”</note> <l eID="gen7579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4424"/><l level="1" sID="gen7580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4424"/>Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth,<l eID="gen7580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7581"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Zion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Zion”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the far north⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “far of north”; the word translated “north” could refer to Mount Zaphon</note><l eID="gen7581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7582"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> city of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> great king. <l eID="gen7582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4425"/><l level="1" sID="gen7583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4425"/>God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in her citadels;<l eID="gen7583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7584"/>he is known as a <transChange type="added">high</transChange> stronghold. <l eID="gen7584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4426"/><l level="1" sID="gen7585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4426"/>For see, the kings assembled;<note placement="foot">That is, preparing for battle</note><l eID="gen7585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7586"/>they advanced together. <l eID="gen7586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4427"/><l level="1" sID="gen7587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4427"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They themselves saw⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “They, they saw”</note> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, so they were astonished.<l eID="gen7587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7588"/>They were terrified; they ran off. <l eID="gen7588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4428"/><l level="1" sID="gen7589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4428"/>Trembling seized them there—<l eID="gen7589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7590"/>pain as of a woman in labor. <l eID="gen7590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4429"/><l level="1" sID="gen7591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4429"/>With an east wind<l eID="gen7591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7592"/>you shatter<note placement="foot">A few Hebrew manuscripts read “like an east wind that shatters”</note> the ships of Tarshish.<note placement="foot">That is, ships that can sail to Tarshish, i.e. well built, able to traverse great distances</note> <l eID="gen7592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4430"/><l level="1" sID="gen7593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4430"/>As we have heard, so we have seen<l eID="gen7593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7594"/>in the city of Yahweh of hosts, in the city of our God.<l eID="gen7594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7595"/>God will establish her forever. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4431"/><l level="1" sID="gen7596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4431"/>We have pondered your loyal love, O God,<l eID="gen7596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7597"/>in the midst of your temple. <l eID="gen7597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4432"/><l level="1" sID="gen7598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4432"/>As <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your name, O God, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your praise<l eID="gen7598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7599"/>to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ends of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth.<l eID="gen7599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7600"/>Your right hand is full of righteousness. <l eID="gen7600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4433"/><l level="1" sID="gen7601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4433"/>Let <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Zion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Zion”</note> rejoice;<l eID="gen7601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7602"/>let the daughters of Judah rejoice<l eID="gen7602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7603"/>because of your judgments. <l eID="gen7603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4434"/><l level="1" sID="gen7604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4434"/>Walk about Zion and circle it;<l eID="gen7604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7605"/>count her towers. <l eID="gen7605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4435"/><l level="1" sID="gen7606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4435"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Consider well⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Set your heart to”</note> her ramparts.<l eID="gen7606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7607"/>Go through her citadels<l eID="gen7607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7608"/>so that you can tell <transChange type="added">the</transChange> next generation <l eID="gen7608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4436"/><l level="1" sID="gen7609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4436"/>that this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> God, our God forever and ever.<l eID="gen7609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7610"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he, he will …”</note> will guide us until death. <l eID="gen7610" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7577"/> <chapter eID="Ps.48"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4437"/><title type="x-s">Wealth and the Fate of the Wicked</title> <div sID="gen7611" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7611" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7612"/> <lg eID="gen7612"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen7613"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4437"/>Hear this, all <transChange type="added">you</transChange> peoples;<l eID="gen7614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7615"/>give ear, all <transChange type="added">you</transChange> inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world, <l eID="gen7615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4438"/><l level="1" sID="gen7616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4438"/>both low and high,<l eID="gen7616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7617"/>rich and poor together. <l eID="gen7617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4439"/><l level="1" sID="gen7618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4439"/>My mouth will speak wisdom,<l eID="gen7618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7619"/>and the meditation of my heart <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> understanding. <l eID="gen7619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4440"/><l level="1" sID="gen7620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4440"/>I will incline my ear to a proverb;<l eID="gen7620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7621"/>I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞propound⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “open”</note> my riddle on a lyre. <l eID="gen7621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4441"/><l level="1" sID="gen7622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4441"/>Why should I fear in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞times of calamity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the days of evil”</note><l eID="gen7622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7623"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> iniquity surrounds me at my heels, <l eID="gen7623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4442"/><l level="1" sID="gen7624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4442"/>those who trust their wealth<l eID="gen7624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7625"/>and boast about the abundance of their riches? <l eID="gen7625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4443"/><l level="1" sID="gen7626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4443"/>Surely a man cannot redeem a brother.<l eID="gen7626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7627"/>He cannot give to God his ransom <l eID="gen7627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4444"/><l level="1" sID="gen7628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4444"/>(since<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> the redemption price for their life is costly<l eID="gen7628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7629"/>and it always fails), <l eID="gen7629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4445"/><l level="1" sID="gen7630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4445"/>so that he may stay alive forever<l eID="gen7630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7631"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> not see the pit. <l eID="gen7631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4446"/><l level="1" sID="gen7632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4446"/>For he sees <transChange type="added">that</transChange> the wise die,<l eID="gen7632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7633"/>together <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> fool and brute they perish,<l eID="gen7633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7634"/>and leave their wealth to the next <transChange type="added">generation</transChange>. <l eID="gen7634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4447"/><l level="1" sID="gen7635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4447"/>Within them <transChange type="added">they think</transChange> their houses <transChange type="added">are</transChange> forever,<l eID="gen7635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7636"/>their dwelling places from generation to generation.<l eID="gen7636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7637"/>They <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “call”</note> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> lands by their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> names. <l eID="gen7637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4448"/><l level="1" sID="gen7638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4448"/>But man cannot continue in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> pomp.<l eID="gen7638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7639"/>He is like the beasts <transChange type="added">that</transChange> perish. <l eID="gen7639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4449"/><l level="1" sID="gen7640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4449"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the journey<note placement="foot">Hebrew “way”</note> <transChange type="added">of those who</transChange> have foolish <transChange type="added">confidence</transChange>,<l eID="gen7640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7641"/>and those after them <transChange type="added">who</transChange> accept their sayings. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4450"/><l level="1" sID="gen7642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4450"/>Like sheep they are destined to Sheol;<l eID="gen7642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7643"/>death will shepherd them.<l eID="gen7643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7644"/>But the upright will rule over them in the morning,<l eID="gen7644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7645"/>and their forms <transChange type="added">will be for</transChange> Sheol to consume,<l eID="gen7645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7646"/><transChange type="added">far from</transChange> his lofty abode. <l eID="gen7646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4451"/><l level="1" sID="gen7647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4451"/>Surely God will ransom my life<l eID="gen7647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7648"/>from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> of Sheol,<l eID="gen7648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7649"/>because he will receive me. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7649" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4452"/><l level="1" sID="gen7650"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4452"/>Do not fear when a man becomes rich,<l eID="gen7650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7651"/>when the wealth<note placement="foot">Or “honor”</note> of his house increases, <l eID="gen7651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4453"/><l level="1" sID="gen7652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4453"/>because when he dies he will not take <transChange type="added">away</transChange> any <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>.<l eID="gen7652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7653"/>His wealth will not follow down after him. <l eID="gen7653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4454"/><l level="1" sID="gen7654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4454"/>Though he congratulated his soul while he was living<l eID="gen7654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7655"/>—and <transChange type="added">people</transChange> will praise you when you do well for yourself— <l eID="gen7655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4455"/><l level="1" sID="gen7656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4455"/>it<note placement="foot">That is, his soul</note> will go to the generation of his fathers.<l eID="gen7656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7657"/>Never will they see light. <l eID="gen7657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4456"/><l level="1" sID="gen7658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4456"/>Humankind in <transChange type="added">its</transChange> pomp, but does not understand,<l eID="gen7658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7659"/>is like the beasts <transChange type="added">that</transChange> perish. <l eID="gen7659" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7613"/> <chapter eID="Ps.49"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4457"/><title type="x-s">An Oracle Concerning Sacrifices</title> <div sID="gen7660" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7660" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7661"/> <lg eID="gen7661"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of Asaph.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen7662"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4457"/>The Supreme God, God, Yahweh, has spoken<l eID="gen7663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7664"/>and summoned <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen7664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7665"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rising of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun<l eID="gen7665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7666"/>to its setting. <l eID="gen7666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4458"/><l level="1" sID="gen7667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4458"/>From Zion, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> perfection of beauty,<l eID="gen7667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7668"/>God shines forth. <l eID="gen7668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4459"/><l level="1" sID="gen7669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4459"/>Our God comes and he is not silent.<l eID="gen7669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7670"/>Before him fire devours,<l eID="gen7670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7671"/>and around him it is very tempestuous. <l eID="gen7671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4460"/><l level="1" sID="gen7672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4460"/>He summons the heavens above<l eID="gen7672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7673"/>and the earth that he might judge his people: <l eID="gen7673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4461"/><l level="1" sID="gen7674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4461"/>“Gather to me my loyal ones,<l eID="gen7674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7675"/><transChange type="added">those</transChange> who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.” <l eID="gen7675" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4462"/><l level="1" sID="gen7676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4462"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens declare his righteousness,<l eID="gen7676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7677"/>because God himself is judge. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7677" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4463"/><l level="1" sID="gen7678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4463"/>“Hear, O my people, and I will speak,<l eID="gen7678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7679"/>O Israel, and I will testify against you.<l eID="gen7679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7680"/>I am God, your God. <l eID="gen7680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4464"/><l level="1" sID="gen7681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4464"/>It is not concerning <transChange type="added">a lack of</transChange> your sacrifices <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I rebuke you,<l eID="gen7681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7682"/>and your burnt offerings <transChange type="added">are</transChange> before me continually. <l eID="gen7682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4465"/><l level="1" sID="gen7683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4465"/>I will not take from your house a bull<l eID="gen7683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7684"/><transChange type="added">or</transChange> from your stalls a he-goat, <l eID="gen7684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4466"/><l level="1" sID="gen7685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4466"/>because every animal of the forest is mine,<l eID="gen7685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7686"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> cattle on a thousand hills. <l eID="gen7686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4467"/><l level="1" sID="gen7687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4467"/>I know every bird of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains,<l eID="gen7687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7688"/>and <transChange type="added">every</transChange> moving creature in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> field <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine. <l eID="gen7688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4468"/><l level="1" sID="gen7689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4468"/>If I were hungry I would not tell you,<l eID="gen7689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7690"/>because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world and its fullness <transChange type="added">are</transChange> mine. <l eID="gen7690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4469"/><l level="1" sID="gen7691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4469"/>Do I eat <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flesh of bulls<l eID="gen7691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7692"/>or drink <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blood of goats? <l eID="gen7692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4470"/><l level="1" sID="gen7693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4470"/>Offer to God a thank offering<l eID="gen7693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7694"/>and pay your vows to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Most High. <l eID="gen7694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4471"/><l level="1" sID="gen7695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4471"/>And call me in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of trouble;<l eID="gen7695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7696"/>I will deliver you, and you will glorify me.” <l eID="gen7696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4472"/><l level="1" sID="gen7697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4472"/>But to the wicked God says,<l eID="gen7697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7698"/>“What <transChange type="added">right</transChange> have you to recite my statutes<l eID="gen7698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7699"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mention my covenant with your mouth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “take my covenant on your mouth”</note> <l eID="gen7699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4473"/><l level="1" sID="gen7700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4473"/>while you yourself hate discipline,<l eID="gen7700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7701"/>and cast my words behind you? <l eID="gen7701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4474"/><l level="1" sID="gen7702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4474"/>When you see a thief, then you are pleased with him,<l eID="gen7702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7703"/>and your association <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with adulterers. <l eID="gen7703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4475"/><l level="1" sID="gen7704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4475"/>You give your mouth free rein for evil,<l eID="gen7704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7705"/>and you harness your tongue to deceit. <l eID="gen7705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4476"/><l level="1" sID="gen7706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4476"/>You sit and speak against your brother;<l eID="gen7706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7707"/>you slander your mother’s son. <l eID="gen7707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4477"/><l level="1" sID="gen7708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4477"/>These <transChange type="added">things</transChange> you have done, and I have been silent;<l eID="gen7708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7709"/>You imagined that I was just like you.<l eID="gen7709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7710"/>I will rebuke you and present <transChange type="added">an argument</transChange> before your eyes. <l eID="gen7710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4478"/><l level="1" sID="gen7711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4478"/>Now consider this, you who forget God,<l eID="gen7711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7712"/>lest I tear <transChange type="added">you</transChange> apart, and there <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> none to deliver. <l eID="gen7712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4479"/><l level="1" sID="gen7713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4479"/>He who sacrifices a thank offering honors me,<l eID="gen7713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7714"/>and he <transChange type="added">who</transChange> orders <transChange type="added">his</transChange> way;<l eID="gen7714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7715"/>I will show him the salvation of God.” <l eID="gen7715" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7662"/> <chapter eID="Ps.50"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4480"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer of Repentance and Plea for Mercy</title> <div sID="gen7716" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7716" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7717"/> <lg eID="gen7717"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen7718"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7719"/>When Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first two verses of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by two</note><l eID="gen7719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4480"/>Be gracious to me, O God, according to your loyal love.<l eID="gen7720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7721"/>According to your abundant mercies,<l eID="gen7721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7722"/>blot out my transgressions. <l eID="gen7722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4481"/><l level="1" sID="gen7723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4481"/>Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity,<l eID="gen7723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7724"/>and from my sin cleanse me. <l eID="gen7724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4482"/><l level="1" sID="gen7725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4482"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself know⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I, I know”</note> my transgressions,<note placement="foot">Or “rebellions”</note><l eID="gen7725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7726"/>and my sin <transChange type="added">is</transChange> ever before me. <l eID="gen7726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4483"/><l level="1" sID="gen7727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4483"/>Against you, only you, I have sinned<l eID="gen7727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7728"/>and have done this evil<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the evil”</note> in your eyes,<l eID="gen7728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7729"/>so that you are correct when you speak,<l eID="gen7729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7730"/>you are blameless when you judge. <l eID="gen7730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4484"/><l level="1" sID="gen7731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4484"/>Behold, in iniquity I was born,<l eID="gen7731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7732"/>and in sin my mother conceived me. <l eID="gen7732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4485"/><l level="1" sID="gen7733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4485"/>Behold, you delight <transChange type="added">in</transChange> truth in the inward parts,<l eID="gen7733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7734"/>and in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hidden <transChange type="added">parts</transChange> you make me to know wisdom. <l eID="gen7734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4486"/><l level="1" sID="gen7735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4486"/>Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean.<l eID="gen7735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7736"/>Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow. <l eID="gen7736" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4487"/><l level="1" sID="gen7737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4487"/>Make me hear joy and gladness;<l eID="gen7737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7738"/>let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bones you have crushed rejoice. <l eID="gen7738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4488"/><l level="1" sID="gen7739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4488"/>Hide your face from my sins,<l eID="gen7739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7740"/>and all my iniquities blot out. <l eID="gen7740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4489"/><l level="1" sID="gen7741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4489"/>Create a clean heart for me, O God,<l eID="gen7741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7742"/>and renew a steadfast spirit <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in my inner parts”</note> <l eID="gen7742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4490"/><l level="1" sID="gen7743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4490"/>Do not cast me away from your presence,<l eID="gen7743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7744"/>and do not take your Holy Spirit from me. <l eID="gen7744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4491"/><l level="1" sID="gen7745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4491"/>Restore to me the joy of your salvation,<l eID="gen7745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7746"/>and with a willing spirit sustain me. <l eID="gen7746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4492"/><l level="1" sID="gen7747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4492"/><transChange type="added">Then</transChange> I will teach transgressors your ways,<l eID="gen7747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7748"/>and sinners will turn back to you. <l eID="gen7748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4493"/><l level="1" sID="gen7749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4493"/>Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God,<l eID="gen7749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7750"/>the God of my salvation;<l eID="gen7750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7751"/><transChange type="added">then</transChange> my tongue will sing aloud <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your righteousness. <l eID="gen7751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4494"/><l level="1" sID="gen7752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4494"/>O Lord, open my lips,<l eID="gen7752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7753"/>and my mouth will proclaim your praise. <l eID="gen7753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4495"/><l level="1" sID="gen7754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4495"/>For you do not delight <transChange type="added">in</transChange> sacrifice or I would give <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<l eID="gen7754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7755"/><transChange type="added">With</transChange> a burnt offering you are not pleased. <l eID="gen7755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4496"/><l level="1" sID="gen7756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4496"/>The sacrifices of God <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a broken spirit;<l eID="gen7756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7757"/>A broken and contrite heart,<l eID="gen7757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7758"/>O God, you will not despise. <l eID="gen7758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4497"/><l level="1" sID="gen7759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4497"/>Do good in your favor toward Zion.<l eID="gen7759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7760"/>Build the walls of Jerusalem. <l eID="gen7760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4498"/><l level="1" sID="gen7761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4498"/>Then you will delight <transChange type="added">in</transChange> righteous sacrifices,<l eID="gen7761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7762"/>burnt offering and whole burnt offering.<l eID="gen7762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7763"/>Then bulls will be offered on your altar. <l eID="gen7763" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7718"/> <chapter eID="Ps.51"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4499"/><title type="x-s">God’s Judgment on the Wicked and Love for the Faithful</title> <div sID="gen7764" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7764" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7765"/> <lg eID="gen7765"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A maskil of David.</title> <lg sID="gen7766"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7767"/>When Doeg the Edomite came and informed Saul.<l eID="gen7767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7768"/>And he said to him, “David has come to the house of Ahimelech.”<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first two verses of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by two</note><l eID="gen7768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4499"/>Why do you boast about evil, O mighty man?<l eID="gen7769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7770"/>The loyal love of God <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continually⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all the day”</note> <l eID="gen7770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4500"/><l level="1" sID="gen7771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4500"/>Your tongue plans destruction,<l eID="gen7771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7772"/>like a sharp razor, working deceit. <l eID="gen7772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4501"/><l level="1" sID="gen7773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4501"/>You love evil more than good,<l eID="gen7773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7774"/>a lie more than speaking <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what is right⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “righteousness”</note> <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4502"/><l level="1" sID="gen7775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4502"/>You love all devouring words,<l eID="gen7775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7776"/>O deceitful tongue, <l eID="gen7776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4503"/><l level="1" sID="gen7777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4503"/>but God will pull you down forever.<l eID="gen7777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7778"/>He will snatch you and tear you away from <transChange type="added">your</transChange> tent,<l eID="gen7778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7779"/>and <transChange type="added">he</transChange> will uproot you from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4504"/><l level="1" sID="gen7780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4504"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous will see and fear,<l eID="gen7780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7781"/>and will laugh at him, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <l eID="gen7781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4505"/><l level="1" sID="gen7782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4505"/>“Look, the man <transChange type="added">who</transChange> would not make God his refuge,<l eID="gen7782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7783"/>but he trusted in the greatness of his wealth;<l eID="gen7783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7784"/>he took refuge in his destructiveness.” <l eID="gen7784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4506"/><l level="1" sID="gen7785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4506"/>But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> like an olive tree flourishing<l eID="gen7785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7786"/>in the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of God.<l eID="gen7786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7787"/>I trust the loyal love of God forever and ever. <l eID="gen7787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4507"/><l level="1" sID="gen7788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4507"/>I will give thanks to you forever, because <transChange type="added">of what</transChange> you have done,<l eID="gen7788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7789"/>and I will wait on your name, because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> good,<l eID="gen7789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7790"/>in the presence of your faithful ones. <l eID="gen7790" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7766"/> <chapter eID="Ps.52"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4508"/><title type="x-s">The Folly of the Godless and Salvation for Israel</title> <div sID="gen7791" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7791" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7792"/> <lg eID="gen7792"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, according to Mahalath.</title> <lg sID="gen7793"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7794"/>A maskil of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen7794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4508"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> fool says in his heart, “There is no God.”<l eID="gen7795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7796"/>They are corrupt and they have done abominable iniquity.<l eID="gen7796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7797"/>There is none who does good. <l eID="gen7797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4509"/><l level="1" sID="gen7798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4509"/>God looks down from heaven upon the children of humankind<l eID="gen7798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7799"/>to see whether there is one who has insight,<l eID="gen7799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7800"/>one who seeks God. <l eID="gen7800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4510"/><l level="1" sID="gen7801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4510"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞All of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The whole of it,” i.e. all of humankind</note> have turned back.<l eID="gen7801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7802"/>They are altogether corrupt.<l eID="gen7802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7803"/>There is none who does good;<l eID="gen7803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7804"/>there is not even one. <l eID="gen7804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4511"/><l level="1" sID="gen7805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4511"/>Do not evildoers know,<l eID="gen7805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7806"/><transChange type="added">they</transChange> who eat my people <transChange type="added">as though</transChange> they were eating bread?<l eID="gen7806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7807"/>They do not call on God. <l eID="gen7807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4512"/><l level="1" sID="gen7808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4512"/>There <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they are very fearful⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they feared a fear”</note><l eID="gen7808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7809"/><transChange type="added">where</transChange> no fear had been,<l eID="gen7809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7810"/>because God has scattered the bones of him who encamps <transChange type="added">against</transChange> you.<l eID="gen7810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7811"/>You have put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to shame, because God has rejected them. <l eID="gen7811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4513"/><l level="1" sID="gen7812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4513"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Oh, that from Zion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who will give that from Zion”</note> would come salvation <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Israel!<l eID="gen7812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7813"/>When God returns the fortunes<note placement="foot">Or “captivity”</note> of his people,<l eID="gen7813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7814"/>let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad. <l eID="gen7814" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7793"/> <chapter eID="Ps.53"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4514"/><title type="x-s">Answered Prayer for Deliverance from Adversaries</title> <div sID="gen7815" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7815" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7816"/> <lg eID="gen7816"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, with stringed instruments.</title> <lg sID="gen7817"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7818"/>A maskil of David,<l eID="gen7818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7819"/>when the Ziphites went and said to Saul,<l eID="gen7819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7820"/>“Is not David hiding himself among us?”<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen7820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4514"/>O God, by your name save me,<l eID="gen7821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7822"/>and by your power vindicate me. <l eID="gen7822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4515"/><l level="1" sID="gen7823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4515"/>O God, hear my prayer;<l eID="gen7823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7824"/>heed the words of my mouth. <l eID="gen7824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4516"/><l level="1" sID="gen7825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4516"/>For foreigners have risen against me,<l eID="gen7825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7826"/>and ruthless <transChange type="added">men</transChange> seek my life.<l eID="gen7826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7827"/>They have not set God before them. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4517"/><l level="1" sID="gen7828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4517"/>See, God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my helper;<l eID="gen7828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7829"/>The Lord <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with those who sustain my life.<note placement="foot">Or “The Lord is the sustainer of my life.”</note> <l eID="gen7829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4518"/><l level="1" sID="gen7830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4518"/>He will repay<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> my enemies for their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> evil;<l eID="gen7830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7831"/>in your faithfulness destroy them. <l eID="gen7831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4519"/><l level="1" sID="gen7832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4519"/>I will freely sacrifice to you;<l eID="gen7832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7833"/>I will give thanks <transChange type="added">to</transChange> your name,<l eID="gen7833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7834"/>O Yahweh, because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> good. <l eID="gen7834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:7
