verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4520"/><l level="1" sID="gen7835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4520"/>Because he has delivered me from all trouble,<l eID="gen7835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7836"/>and my eye has looked <transChange type="added">with satisfaction</transChange> on my enemies. <l eID="gen7836" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7817"/> <chapter eID="Ps.54"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4521"/><title type="x-s">Betrayal of a Friend and Trust in God</title> <div sID="gen7837" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7837" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7838"/> <lg eID="gen7838"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, with stringed instruments.</title> <lg sID="gen7839"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7840"/>A maskil of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen7840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4521"/>Give ear, O God, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> my prayer,<l eID="gen7841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7842"/>and do not hide yourself from my plea. <l eID="gen7842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4522"/><l level="1" sID="gen7843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4522"/>Attend to me and answer me.<l eID="gen7843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7844"/>I am restless in my lamenting and I groan, <l eID="gen7844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4523"/><l level="1" sID="gen7845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4523"/>because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice <transChange type="added">of</transChange> an enemy,<l eID="gen7845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7846"/>because of the oppression of the wicked,<l eID="gen7846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7847"/>because they bring down evil on me,<l eID="gen7847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7848"/>and in anger they hold a grudge <transChange type="added">against</transChange> me. <l eID="gen7848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4524"/><l level="1" sID="gen7849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4524"/>My heart trembles within me,<l eID="gen7849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7850"/>and deathly terrors fall on me. <l eID="gen7850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4525"/><l level="1" sID="gen7851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4525"/>Fear and trembling come on me,<l eID="gen7851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7852"/>and horror overwhelms me. <l eID="gen7852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4526"/><l level="1" sID="gen7853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4526"/>So I say, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Oh, that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who will give that”</note> I had wings like a dove.<l eID="gen7853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7854"/>I would fly away and be at rest. <l eID="gen7854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4527"/><l level="1" sID="gen7855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4527"/>Look, I would flee far away.<l eID="gen7855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7856"/>I would dwell in the wilderness. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4528"/><l level="1" sID="gen7857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4528"/>I would hurry to my refuge<l eID="gen7857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7858"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> raging wind <transChange type="added">and</transChange> storm.” <l eID="gen7858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4529"/><l level="1" sID="gen7859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4529"/>Confuse, O Lord; divide their speech,<l eID="gen7859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7860"/>because I see violence and strife in the city. <l eID="gen7860" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4530"/><l level="1" sID="gen7861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4530"/>Day and night they go around it on its walls,<l eID="gen7861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7862"/>and iniquity and trouble <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in its midst. <l eID="gen7862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4531"/><l level="1" sID="gen7863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4531"/>Destruction <transChange type="added">is</transChange> within it,<l eID="gen7863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7864"/>and oppression and deceit<l eID="gen7864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7865"/>do not depart from its public square. <l eID="gen7865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4532"/><l level="1" sID="gen7866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4532"/>For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not an enemy <transChange type="added">that</transChange> taunts me,<l eID="gen7866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7867"/>or I could bear <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<l eID="gen7867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7868"/><transChange type="added">It is not</transChange> one who hates me <transChange type="added">that</transChange> magnifies himself over me,<l eID="gen7868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7869"/>or I could hide myself from him. <l eID="gen7869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4533"/><l level="1" sID="gen7870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4533"/>But <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> you, a man my equal,<l eID="gen7870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7871"/>my friend and confidant. <l eID="gen7871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4534"/><l level="1" sID="gen7872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4534"/><transChange type="added">We</transChange> who would take sweet counsel together;<l eID="gen7872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7873"/>in the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of God<l eID="gen7873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7874"/>we would walk with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> throng. <l eID="gen7874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4535"/><l level="1" sID="gen7875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4535"/>Let death deceive them. May they descend to Sheol alive,<l eID="gen7875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7876"/>because evil <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in their home <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “inward part”</note> <l eID="gen7876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4536"/><l level="1" sID="gen7877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4536"/>As for me, I will call to God,<l eID="gen7877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7878"/>and Yahweh will save me. <l eID="gen7878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4537"/><l level="1" sID="gen7879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4537"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Morning, noon and night⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “evening and morning and noon”</note> I will lament and groan loudly,<l eID="gen7879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7880"/>and he will hear my voice. <l eID="gen7880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4538"/><l level="1" sID="gen7881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4538"/>He safely redeems my life from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> battle against me,<note placement="foot">Or “my battle”</note><l eID="gen7881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7882"/>because <transChange type="added">those standing</transChange> against me are among many. <l eID="gen7882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4539"/><l level="1" sID="gen7883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4539"/>God will hear and answer them,<note placement="foot">Or “and humble them”</note><l eID="gen7883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7884"/><transChange type="added">he</transChange> who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> enthroned from of old, <hi type="italic">Selah</hi><l eID="gen7884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7885"/>Because they do not change,<l eID="gen7885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7886"/>and they do not fear God. <l eID="gen7886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4540"/><l level="1" sID="gen7887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4540"/>He has put forth his hands against <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his friends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “those at peace with him”</note><l eID="gen7887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7888"/>he has defiled his covenant. <l eID="gen7888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4541"/><l level="1" sID="gen7889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4541"/>The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞buttery words⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “butter”</note> of his mouth were smooth,<l eID="gen7889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7890"/>but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> battle in his heart.<l eID="gen7890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7891"/>His words were smoother than oil,<l eID="gen7891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7892"/>but they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> drawn swords. <l eID="gen7892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4542"/><l level="1" sID="gen7893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4542"/>Cast your burden on Yahweh,<l eID="gen7893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7894"/>and he will sustain you.<l eID="gen7894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7895"/>He will never allow the righteous to be moved.<note placement="foot">Or “shaken”</note> <l eID="gen7895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4543"/><l level="1" sID="gen7896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4543"/>But you, O God, you will bring them down to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit of corruption.<l eID="gen7896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7897"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> men of bloodshed and deceit will not live half their days,<l eID="gen7897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7898"/>but I will trust you. <l eID="gen7898" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7839"/> <chapter eID="Ps.55"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4544"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for Deliverance and Confidence in God</title> <div sID="gen7899" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7899" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7900"/> <lg eID="gen7900"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, according to The Silent Dove of Distant <transChange type="added">Lands</transChange>.</title> <lg sID="gen7901"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7902"/>Of David. A miktam.<l eID="gen7902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7903"/>When <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Philistines seized him in Gath.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen7903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4544"/>Be gracious to me, O God, because humankind has trampled me;<l eID="gen7904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7905"/>fighting all the day he oppresses me. <l eID="gen7905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4545"/><l level="1" sID="gen7906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4545"/>My enemies<note placement="foot">Or “lurking foes”</note> trample all day,<l eID="gen7906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7907"/>because many <transChange type="added">are</transChange> attacking me proudly. <l eID="gen7907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4546"/><l level="1" sID="gen7908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4546"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The day”</note> I fear, I trust you. <l eID="gen7908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4547"/><l level="1" sID="gen7909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4547"/>God, whose word I praise,<l eID="gen7909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7910"/>God I trust; I do not fear.<l eID="gen7910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7911"/>What can <transChange type="added">mere</transChange> flesh do to me? <l eID="gen7911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4548"/><l level="1" sID="gen7912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4548"/>All day they twist my words;<l eID="gen7912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7913"/>all their thoughts <transChange type="added">are</transChange> against me for evil. <l eID="gen7913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4549"/><l level="1" sID="gen7914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4549"/>They attack,<note placement="foot">Or “they stir up strife”</note> they hide, they watch my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞steps⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heels”</note><l eID="gen7914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7915"/>as they <transChange type="added">lie in</transChange> wait for my life. <l eID="gen7915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4550"/><l level="1" sID="gen7916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4550"/>Because of iniquity will they escape?<l eID="gen7916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7917"/>In anger cast down <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples, O God. <l eID="gen7917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4551"/><l level="1" sID="gen7918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4551"/>You have kept count of my wonderings.<l eID="gen7918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7919"/>Put my tears in your bottle;<l eID="gen7919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7920"/><transChange type="added">are they</transChange> not in your book? <l eID="gen7920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4552"/><l level="1" sID="gen7921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4552"/>Then my enemies will turn back <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the day”</note> I call.<note placement="foot">i.e., call on God</note><l eID="gen7921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7922"/>This I know because<note placement="foot">Or “that”</note> God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for me. <l eID="gen7922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4553"/><l level="1" sID="gen7923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4553"/>God, <transChange type="added">whose</transChange> word I praise,<l eID="gen7923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7924"/>Yahweh, <transChange type="added">whose</transChange> word I praise, <l eID="gen7924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4554"/><l level="1" sID="gen7925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4554"/>God I trust; I do not fear.<l eID="gen7925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7926"/>What can <transChange type="added">mere</transChange> humankind do to me? <l eID="gen7926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4555"/><l level="1" sID="gen7927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4555"/><transChange type="added">My</transChange> vows <transChange type="added">to you</transChange>, O God, <transChange type="added">are binding</transChange> upon me.<l eID="gen7927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7928"/>I will pay thank offerings to you, <l eID="gen7928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4556"/><l level="1" sID="gen7929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4556"/>because you have delivered my soul from death.<l eID="gen7929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7930"/><transChange type="added">Have you</transChange> not <transChange type="added">kept</transChange> my feet from stumbling,<l eID="gen7930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7931"/>that I may walk before God<l eID="gen7931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7932"/>in the light of the living? <l eID="gen7932" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7901"/> <chapter eID="Ps.56"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4557"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for Rescue from Enemies</title> <div sID="gen7933" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7933" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7934"/> <lg eID="gen7934"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> Do Not Destroy.</title> <lg sID="gen7935"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7936"/>Of David. A miktam.<l eID="gen7936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7937"/>When he fled from Saul into the cave.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen7937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4557"/>Be gracious to me, O God, be gracious to me,<l eID="gen7938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7939"/>because in you my soul takes refuge.<l eID="gen7939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7940"/>In the shadow of your wings I will take refuge<l eID="gen7940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7941"/>until destruction passes by. <l eID="gen7941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4558"/><l level="1" sID="gen7942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4558"/>I will call to God Most High,<l eID="gen7942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7943"/>to God who accomplishes <transChange type="added">things</transChange> concerning me. <l eID="gen7943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4559"/><l level="1" sID="gen7944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4559"/>He will send from heaven and save me;<l eID="gen7944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7945"/>he will reproach <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who tramples me. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi><l eID="gen7945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7946"/>God will send his loyal love and his faithfulness. <l eID="gen7946" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4560"/><l level="1" sID="gen7947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4560"/>My soul <transChange type="added">is</transChange> among lions.<l eID="gen7947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7948"/>I lie down <transChange type="added">among those who</transChange> devour—<l eID="gen7948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7949"/>the children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of humankind whose teeth <transChange type="added">are</transChange> spears and arrows<l eID="gen7949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7950"/>and whose tongues <transChange type="added">are</transChange> sharp swords. <l eID="gen7950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4561"/><l level="1" sID="gen7951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4561"/>Be exalted above the heavens, O God.<l eID="gen7951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7952"/><transChange type="added">Let</transChange> your glory <transChange type="added">be</transChange> above all the earth. <l eID="gen7952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4562"/><l level="1" sID="gen7953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4562"/>They have set a net for my steps;<l eID="gen7953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7954"/>my soul is bowed down.<l eID="gen7954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7955"/>They have dug a pit before me;<l eID="gen7955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7956"/>they have fallen into the midst of it. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen7956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4563"/><l level="1" sID="gen7957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4563"/>My heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> steadfast, O God;<l eID="gen7957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7958"/>My heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> steadfast.<l eID="gen7958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7959"/>I will sing and give praise. <l eID="gen7959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4564"/><l level="1" sID="gen7960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4564"/>Awake, my glory;<l eID="gen7960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7961"/>Awake, harp and lyre.<l eID="gen7961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7962"/>I will awake <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dawn.<note placement="foot">Or “at dawn”</note> <l eID="gen7962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4565"/><l level="1" sID="gen7963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4565"/>I will give you thanks among the peoples, O Lord;<l eID="gen7963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7964"/>I will give you praise among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations. <l eID="gen7964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4566"/><l level="1" sID="gen7965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4566"/>Because your loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> high to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens,<l eID="gen7965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7966"/>and your faithfulness to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clouds. <l eID="gen7966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4567"/><l level="1" sID="gen7967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4567"/>Be exalted above <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens, O God.<l eID="gen7967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7968"/><transChange type="added">Let</transChange> your glory <transChange type="added">be</transChange> above all the earth. <l eID="gen7968" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7935"/> <chapter eID="Ps.57"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4568"/><title type="x-s">Judgment on the Wicked</title> <div sID="gen7969" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7969" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7970"/> <lg eID="gen7970"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> Do not Destroy.</title> <lg sID="gen7971"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7972"/>Of David. A miktam.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen7972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4568"/>Do you really speak <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> right <transChange type="added">when</transChange> silent?<note placement="foot">A slight emendation of the Hebrew text yields “what is right, O gods,” or “O mighty ones”</note><l eID="gen7973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7974"/><transChange type="added">Do</transChange> you judge fairly the children of humankind?<note placement="foot">Or “Do you judge fairly, O sons of humankind?”</note> <l eID="gen7974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4569"/><l level="1" sID="gen7975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4569"/>No, in <transChange type="added">your</transChange> heart you plan injustices;<l eID="gen7975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7976"/>in the land<note placement="foot">Or “on the earth”</note> you weigh out the violence of your hands. <l eID="gen7976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4570"/><l level="1" sID="gen7977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4570"/>The wicked are estranged from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb.<l eID="gen7977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7978"/>They go astray from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> belly, speaking lies. <l eID="gen7978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4571"/><l level="1" sID="gen7979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4571"/>Their venom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like snake venom;<l eID="gen7979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7980"/><transChange type="added">They are</transChange> like a deaf viper that closes its ear <l eID="gen7980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4572"/><l level="1" sID="gen7981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4572"/>so that it does not hear <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of charmers<l eID="gen7981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7982"/><transChange type="added">or the</transChange> skilled caster of spells. <l eID="gen7982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4573"/><l level="1" sID="gen7983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4573"/>O God, break their teeth in their mouth.<l eID="gen7983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7984"/>Break off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fangs of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young lions, O Yahweh. <l eID="gen7984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4574"/><l level="1" sID="gen7985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4574"/>Let them run <transChange type="added">away</transChange> like water <transChange type="added">that</transChange> runs off.<l eID="gen7985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7986"/><transChange type="added">When</transChange> he bends <transChange type="added">the bow</transChange>, let his arrows <transChange type="added">be</transChange> as though they were cut off.<note placement="foot">Or “as though they were withered stalks”</note> <l eID="gen7986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4575"/><l level="1" sID="gen7987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4575"/><transChange type="added">Let them be</transChange> like a snail <transChange type="added">that</transChange> melts away <transChange type="added">as</transChange> it goes;<l eID="gen7987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7988"/><transChange type="added">like the</transChange> stillborn of woman <transChange type="added">that</transChange> do not see <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun. <l eID="gen7988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4576"/><l level="1" sID="gen7989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4576"/>Before your pots can feel <transChange type="added">the heat of</transChange> a thornbush,<l eID="gen7989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7990"/>whether green <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞dry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “burning”</note> he will sweep it away.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew of this verse is difficult to interpret</note> <l eID="gen7990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4577"/><l level="1" sID="gen7991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4577"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> righteous will rejoice when he sees <transChange type="added">the</transChange> vengeance;<l eID="gen7991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7992"/>he will wash his feet in the blood of the wicked. <l eID="gen7992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4578"/><l level="1" sID="gen7993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4578"/>And people<note placement="foot">Hebrew “a person”</note> will say, “Surely there is a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞reward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fruit”</note> for the righteous.<l eID="gen7993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7994"/>Surely there is a God <transChange type="added">who</transChange> judges in the land.”<note placement="foot">Or “on the earth”</note> <l eID="gen7994" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7971"/> <chapter eID="Ps.58"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4579"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Protection</title> <div sID="gen7995" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen7995" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7996"/> <lg eID="gen7996"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> Do Not Destroy.</title> <lg sID="gen7997"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7998"/>Of David. A miktam.<l eID="gen7998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7999"/>When Saul dispatched <transChange type="added">men</transChange> and they watched the house to kill him.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen7999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4579"/>Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.<l eID="gen8000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8001"/>Protect<note placement="foot">The sense is that of making something inaccessibly high, like a fortress</note> me from those who rise up against me. <l eID="gen8001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4580"/><l level="1" sID="gen8002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4580"/>Deliver me from workers of iniquity,<l eID="gen8002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8003"/>and from men of bloodshed save me. <l eID="gen8003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4581"/><l level="1" sID="gen8004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4581"/>For look, they lie in wait for my life.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “soul”</note><l eID="gen8004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8005"/>The mighty attack<note placement="foot">Or “stir up strife”</note> against me,<l eID="gen8005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8006"/>not <transChange type="added">because of</transChange> my transgression or my sin, O Yahweh. <l eID="gen8006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4582"/><l level="1" sID="gen8007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4582"/>Without guilt on my part they run and ready themselves.<l eID="gen8007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8008"/>Awake to meet me and see. <l eID="gen8008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4583"/><l level="1" sID="gen8009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4583"/>And you, Yahweh, God <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hosts, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the God of Israel.<l eID="gen8009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8010"/>Rouse yourself to punish all the nations.<l eID="gen8010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8011"/>Do not be gracious to any <transChange type="added">who</transChange> treacherously plot evil. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4584"/><l level="1" sID="gen8012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4584"/>They return at evening; they howl like dogs<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dog”</note><l eID="gen8012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8013"/>while they prowl <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city. <l eID="gen8013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4585"/><l level="1" sID="gen8014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4585"/>Look, they pour out <transChange type="added">talk</transChange> with their mouth.<l eID="gen8014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8015"/>Swords <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on their lips,<l eID="gen8015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8016"/>for <transChange type="added">they say</transChange>, “Who hears?” <l eID="gen8016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4586"/><l level="1" sID="gen8017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4586"/>But you, O Yahweh, will laugh at them;<l eID="gen8017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8018"/>you will mock all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations. <l eID="gen8018" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4587"/><l level="1" sID="gen8019"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4587"/>O my strength,<note placement="foot">Reading with a few Hebrew manuscripts and the LXX, Targum and v. <reference osisRef="Ps.59.17">17</reference></note> I will watch for you,<l eID="gen8019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8020"/>because <transChange type="added">you</transChange>, O God, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my (high) stronghold. <l eID="gen8020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4588"/><l level="1" sID="gen8021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4588"/>My<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>), some Hebrew manuscripts and the LXX</note> God of loyal love will meet me;<l eID="gen8021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8022"/>God will cause me to look <transChange type="added">in triumph</transChange> on my enemies. <l eID="gen8022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4589"/><l level="1" sID="gen8023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4589"/>Do not kill them, lest my people forget.<l eID="gen8023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8024"/>Make them <transChange type="added">to</transChange> wander by your power,<l eID="gen8024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8025"/>and bring them down, O Lord, our shield. <l eID="gen8025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4590"/><l level="1" sID="gen8026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4590"/><transChange type="added">By</transChange> the sin of their mouth <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the words of their lips,<l eID="gen8026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8027"/>even in their pride, let them be trapped,<l eID="gen8027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8028"/>and for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> curses<note placement="foot">Hebrew “curse”</note> and lies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note> they proclaim. <l eID="gen8028" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4591"/><l level="1" sID="gen8029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4591"/>Destroy in anger; destroy so they are no more,<l eID="gen8029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8030"/>so that they may know that God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> ruling in Jacob<l eID="gen8030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8031"/>to the ends of the earth. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4592"/><l level="1" sID="gen8032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4592"/>They return at evening; they howl like dogs<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dog”</note><l eID="gen8032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8033"/>while they prowl <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city. <l eID="gen8033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4593"/><l level="1" sID="gen8034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4593"/>As for them, they wander for food.<l eID="gen8034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8035"/>If they are not satisfied, then they continue all night.<note placement="foot">Or “then they growl”</note> <l eID="gen8035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4594"/><l level="1" sID="gen8036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4594"/>But as for me, I will sing <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your strength,<l eID="gen8036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8037"/>and I will hail your loyal love in the morning,<l eID="gen8037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8038"/>because you have been my <transChange type="added">high</transChange> stronghold<l eID="gen8038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8039"/>and a refuge in my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “day”</note> of trouble. <l eID="gen8039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4595"/><l level="1" sID="gen8040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4595"/>O my strength, to you I will give praise,<l eID="gen8040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8041"/>because God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my <transChange type="added">high</transChange> stronghold,<l eID="gen8041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8042"/>my God of loyal love. <l eID="gen8042" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7997"/> <chapter eID="Ps.59"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4596"/><title type="x-s">A Lament After a Defeat and a Prayer for Restoration</title> <div sID="gen8043" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8043" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8044"/> <lg eID="gen8044"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, according to Shushan Eduth.<note placement="foot">Perhaps “The Lily of Testimony”</note></title> <lg sID="gen8045"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8046"/>A miktam of David. To teach.<l eID="gen8046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8047"/>When he fought Mesopotamia and Aram Zobah, and Joab returned and struck Edom in the Valley of Salt, twelve thousand <transChange type="added">persons</transChange>.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first two verses of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by two</note><l eID="gen8047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4596"/>O God, you have rejected us. You have broken us.<l eID="gen8048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8049"/>You have been angry. Restore us! <l eID="gen8049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4597"/><l level="1" sID="gen8050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4597"/>You have made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land quake. You have split it open.<l eID="gen8050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8051"/>Heal its fissures, because it totters. <l eID="gen8051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4598"/><l level="1" sID="gen8052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4598"/>You have shown your people hard <transChange type="added">things</transChange>;<l eID="gen8052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8053"/>You have given us wine that staggers. <l eID="gen8053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4599"/><l level="1" sID="gen8054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4599"/>You have rallied those who fear you round a banner<l eID="gen8054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8055"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞out of bowshot⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the presence of the bow”</note> <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4600"/><l level="1" sID="gen8056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4600"/>so that your beloved ones may be rescued.<l eID="gen8056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8057"/>Save by your right hand and answer us. <l eID="gen8057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4601"/><l level="1" sID="gen8058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4601"/>God has spoken in his holiness,<l eID="gen8058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8059"/>“I will rejoice;<l eID="gen8059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8060"/>I will divide up Shechem,<l eID="gen8060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8061"/>and portion out the valley of Succoth. <l eID="gen8061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4602"/><l level="1" sID="gen8062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4602"/>Gilead <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine, and Manasseh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine,<l eID="gen8062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8063"/>and Ephraim <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞helmet for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “protection of”</note> my head;<l eID="gen8063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8064"/>Judah <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my scepter.<note placement="foot">Or “commander’s rod”</note> <l eID="gen8064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4603"/><l level="1" sID="gen8065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4603"/>Moab <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my washing pot;<l eID="gen8065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8066"/>over Edom, I will cast my sandal.<l eID="gen8066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8067"/>On account of me, O Philistia, raise a shout.” <l eID="gen8067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4604"/><l level="1" sID="gen8068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4604"/>Who will bring me to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fortified city?<l eID="gen8068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8069"/>Who will lead me to Edom? <l eID="gen8069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4605"/><l level="1" sID="gen8070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4605"/>Have not you yourself rejected us, O God,<l eID="gen8070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8071"/>and not gone out with our armies, O God? <l eID="gen8071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4606"/><l level="1" sID="gen8072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4606"/>Give us help against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> adversary,<l eID="gen8072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8073"/>for the help of humankind <transChange type="added">is</transChange> futile. <l eID="gen8073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4607"/><l level="1" sID="gen8074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4607"/>Through God we will do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞valiantly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “might”</note><l eID="gen8074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8075"/>and <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> he <transChange type="added">who</transChange> will tread down our enemies. <l eID="gen8075" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8045"/> <chapter eID="Ps.60"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4608"/><title type="x-s">Confidence in God’s Protection</title> <div sID="gen8076" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8076" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8077"/> <lg eID="gen8077"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, upon stringed instruments.<note placement="foot">Reading with many Hebrew manuscripts and several translations</note> Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen8078"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4608"/>Hear, O God, my cry;<l eID="gen8079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8080"/>attend to my prayer. <l eID="gen8080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4609"/><l level="1" sID="gen8081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4609"/>From the end of the earth<note placement="foot">Or “the far reaches of the land”</note> I call to you<l eID="gen8081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8082"/>when my heart grows faint.<l eID="gen8082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8083"/>You will lead me to a rock <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> higher than I. <l eID="gen8083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4610"/><l level="1" sID="gen8084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4610"/>For you have been my refuge,<l eID="gen8084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8085"/>a strong tower from the enemy. <l eID="gen8085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4611"/><l level="1" sID="gen8086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4611"/>Let me reside in your tent forever.<l eID="gen8086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8087"/>Let me take refuge under the covering of your wings. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4612"/><l level="1" sID="gen8088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4612"/>For you, O God, you have heard my vows.<l eID="gen8088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8089"/>You have given <transChange type="added">me</transChange> the heritage of those who fear your name. <l eID="gen8089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4613"/><l level="1" sID="gen8090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4613"/>You will add days to the days of the king,<l eID="gen8090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8091"/>his years like <transChange type="added">those of</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞many generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a generation and a generation”</note> <l eID="gen8091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4614"/><l level="1" sID="gen8092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4614"/>May he live<note placement="foot">Or “be enthroned”</note> forever in the presence of God.<l eID="gen8092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8093"/>Appoint loyal love and faithfulness to preserve him. <l eID="gen8093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4615"/><l level="1" sID="gen8094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4615"/>So I will sing the praise of your name forever,<l eID="gen8094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8095"/>that I may fulfill<note placement="foot">Or “pay”</note> my vows <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞daily⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “day, day”</note> <l eID="gen8095" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8078"/> <chapter eID="Ps.61"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4616"/><title type="x-s">Confidence in God’s Salvation</title> <div sID="gen8096" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8096" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8097"/> <lg eID="gen8097"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, on Jeduthun.<note placement="foot">One of David’s musicians (<reference osisRef="1Chr.16.41">1 Chr 16:41</reference>)</note></title> <lg sID="gen8098"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8099"/>A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen8099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4616"/>Only for God my soul <transChange type="added">waits in</transChange> silence.<l eID="gen8100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8101"/>From him <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my salvation. <l eID="gen8101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4617"/><l level="1" sID="gen8102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4617"/>Only he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my rock and my salvation,<l eID="gen8102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8103"/>my <transChange type="added">high</transChange> stronghold; I shall not be greatly shaken. <l eID="gen8103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4618"/><l level="1" sID="gen8104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4618"/>How long will you attack a man?<l eID="gen8104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8105"/>All of you will be shattered<note placement="foot">Or “All of you shatter him”</note><l eID="gen8105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8106"/>like a leaning wall, a tottering fence. <l eID="gen8106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4619"/><l level="1" sID="gen8107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4619"/>They only<note placement="foot">This word appears first in the Hebrew verse.</note> plan to thrust <transChange type="added">him</transChange> down from his high position;<l eID="gen8107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8108"/>they are pleased <transChange type="added">with</transChange> deception.<l eID="gen8108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8109"/>With their mouths<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his mouth”</note> they bless,<l eID="gen8109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8110"/>but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞inwardly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the midst of them”</note> they curse. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4620"/><l level="1" sID="gen8111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4620"/>Only for God wait in silence, O my soul,<l eID="gen8111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8112"/>because my hope <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from him. <l eID="gen8112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4621"/><l level="1" sID="gen8113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4621"/>Only he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my rock and my salvation,<l eID="gen8113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8114"/>my <transChange type="added">high</transChange> stronghold; I shall not be shaken. <l eID="gen8114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4622"/><l level="1" sID="gen8115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4622"/>On God <transChange type="added">rests</transChange> my salvation and my glory;<l eID="gen8115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8116"/>God<note placement="foot">Or “In God”</note> is my strong rock, my refuge. <l eID="gen8116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4623"/><l level="1" sID="gen8117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4623"/>Trust him at all times, O people;<l eID="gen8117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8118"/>pour out before him your heart.<l eID="gen8118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8119"/>God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a refuge for us. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4624"/><l level="1" sID="gen8120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4624"/>Only a vapor<note placement="foot">Or “breath”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> men of low degree,<l eID="gen8120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8121"/>a deception <transChange type="added">are</transChange> men of high degree.<l eID="gen8121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8122"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Weighed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To go up”</note> in a balance,<l eID="gen8122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8123"/>together they <transChange type="added">are lighter</transChange> than a vapor. <l eID="gen8123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4625"/><l level="1" sID="gen8124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4625"/>Do not trust in extortion,<l eID="gen8124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8125"/>and do not put vain <transChange type="added">confidence</transChange> in robbery.<l eID="gen8125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8126"/>If wealth increases,<l eID="gen8126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8127"/>do not set <transChange type="added">your</transChange> heart <transChange type="added">on it</transChange>. <l eID="gen8127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4626"/><l level="1" sID="gen8128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4626"/>Once God has spoken;<l eID="gen8128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8129"/>twice I have heard this:<l eID="gen8129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8130"/>that strength <transChange type="added">belongs</transChange> to God. <l eID="gen8130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4627"/><l level="1" sID="gen8131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4627"/>And to you <transChange type="added">belongs</transChange> loyal love, O Lord,<l eID="gen8131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8132"/>because you will render to each according to his work. <l eID="gen8132" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8098"/> <chapter eID="Ps.62"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4628"/><title type="x-s">Longing for God</title> <div sID="gen8133" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8133" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8134"/> <lg eID="gen8134"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of David, when <transChange type="added">he</transChange> was in the wilderness of Judah.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen8135"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4628"/>O God, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my God;<l eID="gen8136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8137"/>I will seek you diligently.<l eID="gen8137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8138"/>My soul thirsts for you; my flesh longs for you<l eID="gen8138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8139"/><transChange type="added">as</transChange> in a dry and weary land without water. <l eID="gen8139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4629"/><l level="1" sID="gen8140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4629"/>Thus I have seen you in the sanctuary,<l eID="gen8140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8141"/>beholding your strength and glory. <l eID="gen8141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4630"/><l level="1" sID="gen8142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4630"/>Because your loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> better than life,<l eID="gen8142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8143"/>my lips will praise you. <l eID="gen8143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4631"/><l level="1" sID="gen8144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4631"/>So I will bless you while I live.<l eID="gen8144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8145"/>I will lift up my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “palms”</note> in your name. <l eID="gen8145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4632"/><l level="1" sID="gen8146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4632"/>My soul will be satisfied <transChange type="added">as with the</transChange> best and richest <transChange type="added">food</transChange>,<l eID="gen8146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8147"/>and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> joyful lips my mouth will praise. <l eID="gen8147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4633"/><l level="1" sID="gen8148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4633"/>When I remember you on my bed,<l eID="gen8148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8149"/>I meditate on you in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night watches. <l eID="gen8149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4634"/><l level="1" sID="gen8150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4634"/>Because you have been my help,<l eID="gen8150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8151"/>therefore<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> in the shadow of your wings I will sing for joy. <l eID="gen8151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4635"/><l level="1" sID="gen8152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4635"/>My soul clings to<note placement="foot">Or “follows hard after”</note> you;<l eID="gen8152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8153"/>your right hand upholds me. <l eID="gen8153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4636"/><l level="1" sID="gen8154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4636"/>But as for them <transChange type="added">who</transChange> seek my life for ruin,<l eID="gen8154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8155"/>they will go into the depths of the earth. <l eID="gen8155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4637"/><l level="1" sID="gen8156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4637"/>They <transChange type="added">who</transChange> would <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deliver him to the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “pour him out to the hands of the sword”</note><l eID="gen8156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8157"/>will become a portion for jackals. <l eID="gen8157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4638"/><l level="1" sID="gen8158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4638"/>However, the king will rejoice in God.<l eID="gen8158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8159"/>Everyone who swears an oath by him will boast,<l eID="gen8159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8160"/>because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mouth of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> liars will be stopped. <l eID="gen8160" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8135"/> <chapter eID="Ps.63"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4639"/><title type="x-s">A Plea for Divine Retribution</title> <div sID="gen8161" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8161" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8162"/> <lg eID="gen8162"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen8163"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4639"/>Hear my voice, O God, in my lamenting.<l eID="gen8164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8165"/>Preserve my life from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fear of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy. <l eID="gen8165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4640"/><l level="1" sID="gen8166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4640"/>Hide me from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> secret plots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “plot”</note> of evildoers,<l eID="gen8166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8167"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> unrest of <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> do iniquity, <l eID="gen8167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4641"/><l level="1" sID="gen8168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4641"/>who sharpen their tongue like a sword.<l eID="gen8168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8169"/>They bend <transChange type="added">their bow to shoot</transChange> their arrows—bitter words, <l eID="gen8169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4642"/><l level="1" sID="gen8170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4642"/>to shoot from<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> hiding places <transChange type="added">at the</transChange> blameless.<l eID="gen8170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8171"/>Suddenly they shoot <transChange type="added">at</transChange> him and do not fear. <l eID="gen8171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4643"/><l level="1" sID="gen8172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4643"/>They encourage themselves <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> evil matter.<l eID="gen8172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8173"/>They talk of secretly laying snares.<l eID="gen8173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8174"/>They say, “Who will see them?” <l eID="gen8174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4644"/><l level="1" sID="gen8175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4644"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They carefully plot⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “They search out”</note> injustices <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,<l eID="gen8175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8176"/>“We have perfected <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the perfect plot⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!”<note placement="foot">Literally “a plotted plot”</note><l eID="gen8176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8177"/>Both <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞inner thought⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “inward part”</note> and heart of <transChange type="added">a</transChange> man <transChange type="added">are</transChange> deep. <l eID="gen8177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4645"/><l level="1" sID="gen8178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4645"/>But God will shoot them;<l eID="gen8178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8179"/>with an arrow they will suddenly be wounded. <l eID="gen8179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4646"/><l level="1" sID="gen8180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4646"/><note placement="foot">The Hebrew of this verse is very difficult</note> And they who would cause him<note placement="foot">That is, the psalmist</note> to stumble,<l eID="gen8180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8181"/>their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> tongue <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> against them.<l eID="gen8181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8182"/>All who gaze on them will shake.<note placement="foot">Perhaps a shaking of the head; a similar Hebrew form could be translated “will flee”</note> <l eID="gen8182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4647"/><l level="1" sID="gen8183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4647"/>And then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> all men<note placement="foot">Hebrew “man”</note> will fear,<l eID="gen8183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8184"/>and will declare the working of God,<l eID="gen8184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8185"/>and will understand his doing. <l eID="gen8185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4648"/><l level="1" sID="gen8186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4648"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> righteous will rejoice in Yahweh and take refuge in him,<l eID="gen8186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8187"/>and all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> upright in heart will boast. <l eID="gen8187" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8163"/> <chapter eID="Ps.64"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4649"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for God’s Provision</title> <div sID="gen8188" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8188" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8189"/> <lg eID="gen8189"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A psalm of David. A song.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen8190"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4649"/>Praise awaits you, O God, in Zion,<l eID="gen8191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8192"/>and to you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> vow shall be fulfilled. <l eID="gen8192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4650"/><l level="1" sID="gen8193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4650"/>O <transChange type="added">you who</transChange> hear prayer,<l eID="gen8193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8194"/>to you all flesh will come. <l eID="gen8194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4651"/><l level="1" sID="gen8195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4651"/>Iniquities<note placement="foot">Hebrew “matters of iniquities”</note> prevail over me.<l eID="gen8195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8196"/>As for our transgressions, you will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forgive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “provide atonement for”</note> them. <l eID="gen8196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4652"/><l level="1" sID="gen8197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4652"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is one whom</transChange> you choose and bring near,<l eID="gen8197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8198"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> he may abide in your courts.<l eID="gen8198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8199"/>We will be satisfied with the goodness of your house,<l eID="gen8199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8200"/>your holy temple. <l eID="gen8200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4653"/><l level="1" sID="gen8201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4653"/>By awesome deeds in righteousness you will answer us,<l eID="gen8201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8202"/>O God of our salvation,<l eID="gen8202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8203"/><transChange type="added">you who are the</transChange> confidence <transChange type="added">of</transChange> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ends of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth<l eID="gen8203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8204"/>and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the far-off seas, <l eID="gen8204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4654"/><l level="1" sID="gen8205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4654"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> established the mountains by his strength,<l eID="gen8205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8206"/><transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> is girded with might, <l eID="gen8206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4655"/><l level="1" sID="gen8207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4655"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> stills <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roar of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas,<l eID="gen8207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8208"/>the roar of their waves,<l eID="gen8208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8209"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> commotion of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples, <l eID="gen8209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4656"/><l level="1" sID="gen8210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4656"/>so that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> farthest reaches are in awe of your signs.<l eID="gen8210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8211"/>You make the dawn and sunset sing for joy. <l eID="gen8211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4657"/><l level="1" sID="gen8212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4657"/>You care for<note placement="foot">Or “visit”</note> the land<note placement="foot">Or “earth”</note> and water it;<l eID="gen8212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8213"/>you greatly enrich it.<l eID="gen8213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8214"/>The stream of God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> filled with waters.<l eID="gen8214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8215"/>You provide their grain,<l eID="gen8215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8216"/>for so you have established it. <l eID="gen8216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4658"/><l level="1" sID="gen8217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4658"/>You drench its furrows,<l eID="gen8217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8218"/>penetrating its ridges.<l eID="gen8218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8219"/>With rains you soften it;<l eID="gen8219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8220"/>its growth you bless. <l eID="gen8220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4659"/><l level="1" sID="gen8221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4659"/>You crown the year with your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bounty⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “goodness”</note><l eID="gen8221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8222"/>and your wagon paths drip with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞richness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “fatness”</note> <l eID="gen8222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4660"/><l level="1" sID="gen8223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4660"/>They drop <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> pastures of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wilderness,<l eID="gen8223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8224"/>and the hills gird themselves with joy. <l eID="gen8224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4661"/><l level="1" sID="gen8225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4661"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> pasturelands put on flocks,<l eID="gen8225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8226"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> valleys clothe themselves with grain.<l eID="gen8226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8227"/>They shout in triumph;<l eID="gen8227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8228"/>they even sing. <l eID="gen8228" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8190"/> <chapter eID="Ps.65"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4662"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving to God for His Works</title> <div sID="gen8229" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8229" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8230"/> <lg eID="gen8230"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A song. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen8231"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4662"/>Shout joyfully to God, all the earth. <l eID="gen8232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4663"/><l level="1" sID="gen8233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4663"/>Sing the glory of his name.<l eID="gen8233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8234"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Set forth his glorious praise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “set for glory—his praise”</note> <l eID="gen8234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4664"/><l level="1" sID="gen8235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4664"/>Say to God, “How awesome are your works!<l eID="gen8235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8236"/>Because of the greatness of your strength,<l eID="gen8236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8237"/>your enemies will cringe before you. <l eID="gen8237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4665"/><l level="1" sID="gen8238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4665"/>All the earth will bow in worship to you,<l eID="gen8238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8239"/>and sing <transChange type="added">praise</transChange> to you.<l eID="gen8239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8240"/>They will sing <transChange type="added">the praise of</transChange> your name.” <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4666"/><l level="1" sID="gen8241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4666"/>Come and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞consider⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “see”</note> the works of God;<l eID="gen8241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8242"/><transChange type="added">he is</transChange> awesome <transChange type="added">in his</transChange> dealings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dealing”</note> with the children of humankind. <l eID="gen8242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4667"/><l level="1" sID="gen8243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4667"/>He turned <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea into dry ground;<l eID="gen8243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8244"/>they passed through the river on foot.<l eID="gen8244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8245"/>There we rejoiced in him. <l eID="gen8245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:7
