verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4668"/><l level="1" sID="gen8246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4668"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> rules by his might forever;<l eID="gen8246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8247"/>his eyes keep watch on the nations.<l eID="gen8247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8248"/>Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves.<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4669"/><l level="1" sID="gen8249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4669"/>Bless our God, O peoples,<l eID="gen8249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8250"/>and cause the sound of his praise to be heard, <l eID="gen8250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4670"/><l level="1" sID="gen8251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4670"/>the one who has kept our soul among the living,<l eID="gen8251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8252"/>and has not allowed our foot to slip. <l eID="gen8252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4671"/><l level="1" sID="gen8253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4671"/>For you have tested us, O God;<l eID="gen8253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8254"/>you have tried us as silver is tried. <l eID="gen8254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4672"/><l level="1" sID="gen8255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4672"/>You brought us into the net;<l eID="gen8255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8256"/>you placed a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞heavy burden⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “oppression”</note> on our backs. <l eID="gen8256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4673"/><l level="1" sID="gen8257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4673"/>You let men<note placement="foot">Hebrew “man”</note> ride over our heads.<l eID="gen8257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8258"/>We went through fire and through water,<l eID="gen8258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8259"/>but you have brought us out to the place of abundance.<note placement="foot">A slightly different Hebrew word yields “a broad place”</note> <l eID="gen8259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4674"/><l level="1" sID="gen8260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4674"/>I will come into your house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> with burnt offerings.<l eID="gen8260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8261"/>I will pay to you my vows <l eID="gen8261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4675"/><l level="1" sID="gen8262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4675"/>that my lips uttered,<l eID="gen8262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8263"/>and my mouth spoke in my distress. <l eID="gen8263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4676"/><l level="1" sID="gen8264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4676"/>Burnt offerings of fat animals I will offer to you,<l eID="gen8264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8265"/>with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> smoke of rams.<l eID="gen8265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8266"/>I will do<note placement="foot">That is, “offer”</note> cattle with rams. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4677"/><l level="1" sID="gen8267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4677"/>Come <transChange type="added">and</transChange> hear, all you God-fearers, and I will tell<l eID="gen8267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8268"/>what he has done for me.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “my soul”</note> <l eID="gen8268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4678"/><l level="1" sID="gen8269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4678"/>I called to him with my mouth,<l eID="gen8269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8270"/>and he was extolled with my tongue.<note placement="foot">A slightly different Hebrew word yields “his exaltation was under my tongue”</note> <l eID="gen8270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4679"/><l level="1" sID="gen8271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4679"/>If I had considered evil in my heart,<l eID="gen8271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8272"/>the Lord would not have listened. <l eID="gen8272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4680"/><l level="1" sID="gen8273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4680"/>However, God has listened;<l eID="gen8273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8274"/>he has attended to the sound of my prayer. <l eID="gen8274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4681"/><l level="1" sID="gen8275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4681"/>Blessed be God,<l eID="gen8275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8276"/>who has not turned aside my prayer,<l eID="gen8276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8277"/>or his loyal love from me. <l eID="gen8277" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8231"/> <chapter eID="Ps.66"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4682"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer of Blessing</title> <div sID="gen8278" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8278" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8279"/> <lg eID="gen8279"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, with stringed instruments. A psalm. A song.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen8280"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4682"/>May God be gracious to us and bless us.<l eID="gen8281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8282"/>May he cause his face to shine toward us, <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4683"/><l level="1" sID="gen8283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4683"/>that your way may be known on the earth,<l eID="gen8283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8284"/>your salvation among all nations. <l eID="gen8284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4684"/><l level="1" sID="gen8285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4684"/>Let the peoples praise you, O God;<l eID="gen8285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8286"/>let all of the peoples praise you. <l eID="gen8286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4685"/><l level="1" sID="gen8287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4685"/>Let the nations be glad and sing for joy,<l eID="gen8287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8288"/>because you judge <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples with equity<l eID="gen8288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8289"/>and guide the nations on the earth. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4686"/><l level="1" sID="gen8290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4686"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples praise you, O God;<l eID="gen8290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8291"/>let all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples praise you. <l eID="gen8291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4687"/><l level="1" sID="gen8292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4687"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> earth has yielded its produce.<l eID="gen8292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8293"/>God, our God, will bless us. <l eID="gen8293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4688"/><l level="1" sID="gen8294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4688"/>God will bless us,<l eID="gen8294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8295"/>and all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ends of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth will fear him. <l eID="gen8295" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8280"/> <chapter eID="Ps.67"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4689"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for Providing Victory</title> <div sID="gen8296" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8296" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8297"/> <lg eID="gen8297"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of David. A psalm. A song.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen8298"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4689"/>God will arise; his enemies will be scattered,<l eID="gen8299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8300"/>and those who hate him will flee from before him. <l eID="gen8300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4690"/><l level="1" sID="gen8301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4690"/>As smoke is driven off, you will drive <transChange type="added">them</transChange> off.<l eID="gen8301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8302"/>As wax melts before fire,<l eID="gen8302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8303"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked will perish before God. <l eID="gen8303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4691"/><l level="1" sID="gen8304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4691"/>But <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous will be glad; they will exalt before God,<l eID="gen8304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8305"/>and will rejoice with joy. <l eID="gen8305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4692"/><l level="1" sID="gen8306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4692"/>Sing to God, sing praises to his name.<l eID="gen8306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8307"/>Lift up <transChange type="added">a song</transChange> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rider on the clouds—his name is Yah—<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen8307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8308"/>and rejoice before him. <l eID="gen8308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4693"/><l level="1" sID="gen8309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4693"/>A father to orphans and a judge for widows<l eID="gen8309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8310"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> God in his holy habitation. <l eID="gen8310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4694"/><l level="1" sID="gen8311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4694"/>God settles the lonely in a home;<l eID="gen8311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8312"/>he brings prisoners out into prosperity.<l eID="gen8312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8313"/>But the rebellious abide in a barren land. <l eID="gen8313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4695"/><l level="1" sID="gen8314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4695"/>O God, when you went out before your people,<l eID="gen8314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8315"/>when you marched through <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert, <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4696"/><l level="1" sID="gen8316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4696"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth shook; <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens also dripped <transChange type="added">rain</transChange><l eID="gen8316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8317"/>at the presence of God who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> at Sinai,<l eID="gen8317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8318"/>at the presence of God, the God of Israel. <l eID="gen8318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4697"/><l level="1" sID="gen8319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4697"/>You caused abundant rain to fall, O God.<l eID="gen8319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8320"/>When your inheritance was weary you revived it. <l eID="gen8320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4698"/><l level="1" sID="gen8321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4698"/>Your community dwelled in it.<l eID="gen8321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8322"/>You provided in your goodness for the poor, O God. <l eID="gen8322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4699"/><l level="1" sID="gen8323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4699"/>The Lord gives <transChange type="added">the</transChange> word.<l eID="gen8323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8324"/>Great is the company of women who announce: <l eID="gen8324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4700"/><l level="1" sID="gen8325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4700"/>“<transChange type="added">The</transChange> kings of armies flee, they flee,<l eID="gen8325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8326"/>and she <transChange type="added">who</transChange> remains at home divides <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spoil. <l eID="gen8326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4701"/><l level="1" sID="gen8327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4701"/>Though you <transChange type="added">men</transChange> lie down between the sheepfolds,<l eID="gen8327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8328"/><transChange type="added">you will be like the</transChange> wings of a dove covered in silver<l eID="gen8328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8329"/>and its pinions in yellow gold.” <l eID="gen8329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4702"/><l level="1" sID="gen8330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4702"/>When Shaddai scattered kings on it,<l eID="gen8330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8331"/>on Zalmon it snowed.<note placement="foot">Or “you caused it to snow on”</note> <l eID="gen8331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4703"/><l level="1" sID="gen8332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4703"/>A mountain of God<note placement="foot">Or “A mighty mountain”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the mountain of Bashan;<l eID="gen8332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8333"/>a mountain of <transChange type="added">many</transChange> peaks <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the mountain of Bashan. <l eID="gen8333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4704"/><l level="1" sID="gen8334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4704"/>Why do you look with hostility, O many-peaked mountains?<l eID="gen8334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8335"/>This<note placement="foot">Hebrew “The”</note> mountain God desires for his dwelling.<l eID="gen8335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8336"/>Yes, Yahweh will abide <transChange type="added">in it</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen8336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4705"/><l level="1" sID="gen8337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4705"/>The chariots of God<l eID="gen8337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8338"/><transChange type="added">are</transChange> twice ten thousand, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> thousands doubled.<l eID="gen8338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8339"/>The Lord <transChange type="added">is</transChange> among them <transChange type="added">at</transChange> Sinai, distinctive <transChange type="added">in victory</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Or “as at Sinai, in the sanctuary”</note> <l eID="gen8339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4706"/><l level="1" sID="gen8340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4706"/>You have ascended on high; you have led away captives.<l eID="gen8340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8341"/>You have received gifts <transChange type="added">from</transChange> among humankind,<l eID="gen8341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8342"/>and even <transChange type="added">from the</transChange> rebellious, so that Yah<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note> God may dwell <transChange type="added">there</transChange>. <l eID="gen8342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4707"/><l level="1" sID="gen8343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4707"/>Blessed be the Lord. Daily he loads us <transChange type="added">with benefits</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Or “daily carries our burden”</note><l eID="gen8343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8344"/>the God <transChange type="added">of</transChange> our salvation.<note placement="foot">Or “victory”</note> <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4708"/><l level="1" sID="gen8345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4708"/>Our God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a God of deliverances,<l eID="gen8345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8346"/>and to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Yahweh the Lord belong escapes from death. <l eID="gen8346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4709"/><l level="1" sID="gen8347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4709"/>But God will shatter the head of his enemies,<l eID="gen8347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8348"/>the hairy scalp <transChange type="added">of the one who</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continues on⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “is walking about”</note> in his guilt. <l eID="gen8348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4710"/><l level="1" sID="gen8349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4710"/>The Lord said, “I will bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> back from Bashan;<l eID="gen8349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8350"/>I will bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> back from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea, <l eID="gen8350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4711"/><l level="1" sID="gen8351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4711"/>so that your foot may shatter <transChange type="added">them</transChange> bloody<l eID="gen8351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8352"/><transChange type="added">for</transChange> the tongues of your dogs <transChange type="added">to have</transChange> their share from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemies.” <l eID="gen8352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4712"/><l level="1" sID="gen8353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4712"/>They have seen your processions, O God,<l eID="gen8353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8354"/>the processions of my God, my king, distinctive <transChange type="added">in victory</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Or “into the sanctuary”</note> <l eID="gen8354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4713"/><l level="1" sID="gen8355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4713"/>Singers went up front, those playing stringed instruments last,<l eID="gen8355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8356"/>between <transChange type="added">them</transChange> young women <transChange type="added">playing</transChange> tambourines. <l eID="gen8356" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4714"/><l level="1" sID="gen8357"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4714"/>Bless God in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> assemblies,<l eID="gen8357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8358"/>Yahweh from the fountain of Israel. <l eID="gen8358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4715"/><l level="1" sID="gen8359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4715"/>There <transChange type="added">is</transChange> little Benjamin ruling them,<l eID="gen8359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8360"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> the princes of Judah <transChange type="added">in</transChange> their throng,<l eID="gen8360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8361"/>the princes of Zebulun <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the princes of Naphtali. <l eID="gen8361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4716"/><l level="1" sID="gen8362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4716"/>Your God has commanded your strength.<l eID="gen8362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8363"/>Show yourself strong, O God, <transChange type="added">by</transChange> what you perform<note placement="foot">Or “you who have worked”</note> for us. <l eID="gen8363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4717"/><l level="1" sID="gen8364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4717"/>Because your temple <transChange type="added">is</transChange> above Jerusalem,<l eID="gen8364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8365"/>kings will bring tribute to you. <l eID="gen8365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4718"/><l level="1" sID="gen8366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4718"/>Rebuke <transChange type="added">the</transChange> beasts in<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> reeds,<l eID="gen8366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8367"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> herd of bulls with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> calves of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen8367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8368"/>trampling the pieces of silver.<note placement="foot">Or “until each humbles himself by offering pieces of silver”</note><l eID="gen8368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8369"/>Scatter <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations <transChange type="added">who</transChange> delight in battles. <l eID="gen8369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4719"/><l level="1" sID="gen8370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4719"/>Ambassadors<note placement="foot">Reading with the LXX; meaning uncertain</note> will come from Egypt;<l eID="gen8370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8371"/>Cush will quickly stretch out her hands to God. <l eID="gen8371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4720"/><l level="1" sID="gen8372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4720"/>O kingdoms of the earth, sing to God;<l eID="gen8372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8373"/>sing praise to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Lord, <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4721"/><l level="1" sID="gen8374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4721"/>to the one who rides in the highest heavens of old.<l eID="gen8374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8375"/>See, he gives forth his voice, a mighty voice. <l eID="gen8375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4722"/><l level="1" sID="gen8376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4722"/>Ascribe strength to God.<l eID="gen8376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8377"/>His majesty <transChange type="added">is</transChange> over Israel,<l eID="gen8377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8378"/>and his strength <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the clouds. <l eID="gen8378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4723"/><l level="1" sID="gen8379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4723"/>Awesome <transChange type="added">are you</transChange>, O God, from your sanctuary.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sanctuaries”</note><l eID="gen8379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8380"/>The God of Israel, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> he who gives strength and might to the people.<l eID="gen8380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8381"/>Blessed be God. <l eID="gen8381" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8298"/> <chapter eID="Ps.68"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4724"/><title type="x-s">A Plea for Deliverance from Persecution</title> <div sID="gen8382" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8382" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8383"/> <lg eID="gen8383"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, according to <transChange type="added">The</transChange> Lilies. Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen8384"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4724"/>Save me, O God,<l eID="gen8385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8386"/>because waters have come up to <transChange type="added">my</transChange> neck.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “soul” or “life”</note> <l eID="gen8386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4725"/><l level="1" sID="gen8387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4725"/>I sink in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mud of the deep, and there is no foothold.<l eID="gen8387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8388"/>I have come to watery depths,<l eID="gen8388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8389"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> torrent floods over me. <l eID="gen8389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4726"/><l level="1" sID="gen8390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4726"/>I am weary with my calling <transChange type="added">out</transChange>; my throat is parched.<l eID="gen8390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8391"/>My eyes are exhausted <transChange type="added">in my</transChange> waiting for my God. <l eID="gen8391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4727"/><l level="1" sID="gen8392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4727"/>More numerous than the hairs of my head<l eID="gen8392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8393"/>are <transChange type="added">those</transChange> hating me without a cause.<l eID="gen8393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8394"/><transChange type="added">Those who are</transChange> destroying me—my enemies wrongfully<note placement="foot">Or, “those who oppose me with falsehood”</note>— are mighty.<l eID="gen8394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8395"/>What I did not steal, I then must restore. <l eID="gen8395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4728"/><l level="1" sID="gen8396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4728"/>O God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you yourself know⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you, you know”</note> my foolishness,<l eID="gen8396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8397"/>and my guilty deeds are not hidden from you. <l eID="gen8397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4729"/><l level="1" sID="gen8398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4729"/>Let those who wait for you not be put to shame because of me,<l eID="gen8398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8399"/>O Lord Yahweh <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hosts.<l eID="gen8399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8400"/>Let those who seek you not be disgraced because of me,<l eID="gen8400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8401"/>O God of Israel. <l eID="gen8401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4730"/><l level="1" sID="gen8402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4730"/>Because on account of you I have borne reproach;<l eID="gen8402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8403"/>disgrace has covered my face. <l eID="gen8403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4731"/><l level="1" sID="gen8404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4731"/>I have become a stranger to my brothers<l eID="gen8404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8405"/>and a foreigner to my mother’s sons, <l eID="gen8405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4732"/><l level="1" sID="gen8406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4732"/>because the zeal for your house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> has consumed me,<l eID="gen8406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8407"/>and the reproaches of those reproaching you have fallen on me. <l eID="gen8407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4733"/><l level="1" sID="gen8408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4733"/>When I wept in the fasting of my soul,<l eID="gen8408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8409"/>it became reproaches for me. <l eID="gen8409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4734"/><l level="1" sID="gen8410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4734"/>When I made sackcloth my clothing,<l eID="gen8410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8411"/>I became for them a byword. <l eID="gen8411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4735"/><l level="1" sID="gen8412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4735"/>Those sitting at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gate talk about me<l eID="gen8412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8413"/><transChange type="added">as</transChange> also<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> songs of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> drunkards. <l eID="gen8413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4736"/><l level="1" sID="gen8414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4736"/>But as for me, my prayer <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to you, O Yahweh, for a favorable time,<l eID="gen8414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8415"/>O God, according to the abundance of your loyal love.<l eID="gen8415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8416"/>Answer me with the faithfulness of your salvation. <l eID="gen8416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4737"/><l level="1" sID="gen8417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4737"/>Deliver me from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mud and do not let me sink.<l eID="gen8417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8418"/>Let me be delivered from <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> hate me<l eID="gen8418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8419"/>and from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> watery depths. <l eID="gen8419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4738"/><l level="1" sID="gen8420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4738"/>Do not let the torrent of waters flood over me,<l eID="gen8420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8421"/>or <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deep swallow me,<l eID="gen8421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8422"/>or the pit close its mouth over me. <l eID="gen8422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4739"/><l level="1" sID="gen8423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4739"/>Answer me, O Yahweh, because your loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good;<l eID="gen8423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8424"/>according to your abundant mercies, turn to me, <l eID="gen8424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4740"/><l level="1" sID="gen8425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4740"/>and do not hide your face from your servant.<l eID="gen8425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8426"/>Because I am in trouble, answer me quickly. <l eID="gen8426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4741"/><l level="1" sID="gen8427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4741"/>Draw near to my soul; redeem it.<l eID="gen8427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8428"/>Because of my enemies, ransom me. <l eID="gen8428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4742"/><l level="1" sID="gen8429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4742"/>You know my reproach, my shame and my disgrace.<l eID="gen8429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8430"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Fully known⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “right in front of”</note> to you are all my adversaries. <l eID="gen8430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4743"/><l level="1" sID="gen8431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4743"/>Reproach has broken my heart and I am sick.<l eID="gen8431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8432"/>And I hoped for sympathy, but there was none,<l eID="gen8432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8433"/>and for comforters, but I found none. <l eID="gen8433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4744"/><l level="1" sID="gen8434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4744"/>They also gave me gall for food,<note placement="foot">Or “they put poison in my food”</note><l eID="gen8434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8435"/>and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink. <l eID="gen8435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4745"/><l level="1" sID="gen8436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4745"/>Let their table before them be a trap,<l eID="gen8436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8437"/>and their <transChange type="added">times of</transChange> peace a snare. <l eID="gen8437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4746"/><l level="1" sID="gen8438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4746"/>Let their eyes be dark so they cannot see,<l eID="gen8438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8439"/>and make their loins continually tremble. <l eID="gen8439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4747"/><l level="1" sID="gen8440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4747"/>Pour out your indignation on them,<l eID="gen8440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8441"/>and let your burning anger overtake them. <l eID="gen8441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4748"/><l level="1" sID="gen8442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4748"/>Let their camp be desolate.<l eID="gen8442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8443"/>Let none dwell in their tents, <l eID="gen8443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4749"/><l level="1" sID="gen8444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4749"/>because they persecute <transChange type="added">those</transChange> whom you, yourself, have struck,<l eID="gen8444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8445"/>and they tell of the pain of <transChange type="added">those</transChange> you have wounded. <l eID="gen8445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4750"/><l level="1" sID="gen8446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4750"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Add guilt on top of their guilt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Give guilt on their guilt”</note><l eID="gen8446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8447"/>and do not let them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞be acquitted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “come into your righteousness”</note> <l eID="gen8447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4751"/><l level="1" sID="gen8448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4751"/>Let them be blotted out of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> book of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living,<l eID="gen8448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8449"/>and let them not be recorded with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous. <l eID="gen8449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4752"/><l level="1" sID="gen8450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4752"/>But as for me, <transChange type="added">though</transChange> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> afflicted and pained,<l eID="gen8450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8451"/>your salvation will protect<note placement="foot">The sense is that of making something inaccessibly high, like a fortress</note> me, O God. <l eID="gen8451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4753"/><l level="1" sID="gen8452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4753"/>I will praise the name of God in song,<l eID="gen8452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8453"/>and magnify him with thanksgiving. <l eID="gen8453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4754"/><l level="1" sID="gen8454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4754"/>For Yahweh it will be better than an ox <transChange type="added">or</transChange> bull,<l eID="gen8454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8455"/>horned <transChange type="added">and</transChange> hoofed.<note placement="foot">That is, mature and ritually clean</note> <l eID="gen8455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4755"/><l level="1" sID="gen8456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4755"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> afflicted will see <transChange type="added">and</transChange> rejoice.<l eID="gen8456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8457"/>O God seekers, let your heart revive,<note placement="foot">Or “live”</note> <l eID="gen8457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4756"/><l level="1" sID="gen8458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4756"/>because Yahweh hears <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy<l eID="gen8458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8459"/>and does not despise his <transChange type="added">own who are</transChange> prisoners. <l eID="gen8459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4757"/><l level="1" sID="gen8460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4757"/>Let heavens and earth praise him,<l eID="gen8460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8461"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas and all that moves in them, <l eID="gen8461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4758"/><l level="1" sID="gen8462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4758"/>because God will save Zion<l eID="gen8462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8463"/>and build the cities of Judah,<l eID="gen8463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8464"/>that they may dwell there and possess it. <l eID="gen8464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4759"/><l level="1" sID="gen8465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4759"/>And the offspring of his servants will inherit it,<l eID="gen8465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8466"/>and <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> love his name will abide in it. <l eID="gen8466" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8384"/> <chapter eID="Ps.69"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4760"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Deliverance from Enemies</title> <div sID="gen8467" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8467" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8468"/> <lg eID="gen8468"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of David. To bring to remembrance.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen8469"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4760"/>O God, <transChange type="added">make haste</transChange> to deliver me.<l eID="gen8470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8471"/>O Yahweh, make haste to help me. <l eID="gen8471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4761"/><l level="1" sID="gen8472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4761"/>Let them be ashamed and abashed<l eID="gen8472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8473"/>who seek my life.<l eID="gen8473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8474"/>Let them be repulsed and humiliated<l eID="gen8474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8475"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> desire my harm. <l eID="gen8475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4762"/><l level="1" sID="gen8476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4762"/>let them turn back because of their shame,<l eID="gen8476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8477"/>those who say, “Aha! Aha!” <l eID="gen8477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4763"/><l level="1" sID="gen8478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4763"/>Let them rejoice and be glad in you,<l eID="gen8478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8479"/>all those who seek you.<l eID="gen8479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8480"/>Let them say continually, “God is great!”<l eID="gen8480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8481"/><transChange type="added">those</transChange> who love your salvation. <l eID="gen8481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4764"/><l level="1" sID="gen8482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4764"/>But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> poor and needy;<l eID="gen8482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8483"/>O God hasten to me.<l eID="gen8483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8484"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my help and my deliverer.<l eID="gen8484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8485"/>O Yahweh, do not delay. <l eID="gen8485" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8469"/> <chapter eID="Ps.70"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4765"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer to God the Rock of Refuge</title> <div sID="gen8486" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8486" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8487"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4765"/>In you, O Yahweh, I have taken refuge;<l eID="gen8488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8489"/>let me never be put to shame. <l eID="gen8489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4766"/><l level="1" sID="gen8490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4766"/>In your righteousness deliver me and rescue me;<l eID="gen8490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8491"/>incline your ear to me and save me. <l eID="gen8491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4767"/><l level="1" sID="gen8492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4767"/>Be for me a rock of refuge to resort to always;<l eID="gen8492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8493"/>you have ordained<note placement="foot">Or “commanded”</note> to save me,<l eID="gen8493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8494"/>because you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my rock and my fortress. <l eID="gen8494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4768"/><l level="1" sID="gen8495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4768"/>My God, rescue me from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked,<l eID="gen8495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8496"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞grasp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “palm”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> evildoer and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppressor, <l eID="gen8496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4769"/><l level="1" sID="gen8497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4769"/>because you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my hope,<l eID="gen8497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8498"/>O Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth. <l eID="gen8498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4770"/><l level="1" sID="gen8499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4770"/>Upon you I have leaned <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from birth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from the belly”</note><l eID="gen8499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8500"/><transChange type="added">It was</transChange> you who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞took⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut,” that is, the umbilical cord</note> me from the womb of my mother.<l eID="gen8500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8501"/>My praise <transChange type="added">is</transChange> of you continually. <l eID="gen8501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4771"/><l level="1" sID="gen8502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4771"/>I have become a wonder to many,<l eID="gen8502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8503"/>but you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my strong refuge. <l eID="gen8503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4772"/><l level="1" sID="gen8504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4772"/>My mouth is filled with your praise,<l eID="gen8504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8505"/>with your glory all the day. <l eID="gen8505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4773"/><l level="1" sID="gen8506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4773"/>Do not cast me away in the time of old age;<l eID="gen8506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8507"/>when my strength fails do not abandon me. <l eID="gen8507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4774"/><l level="1" sID="gen8508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4774"/>For my enemies talk concerning me,<l eID="gen8508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8509"/>and those who watch for my life conspire together, <l eID="gen8509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4775"/><l level="1" sID="gen8510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4775"/>saying, “His God has abandoned him.<l eID="gen8510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8511"/>Pursue and seize him, because there is no deliverer.” <l eID="gen8511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4776"/><l level="1" sID="gen8512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4776"/>O God, do not be far from me.<l eID="gen8512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8513"/>My God, hurry to help me. <l eID="gen8513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4777"/><l level="1" sID="gen8514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4777"/>Let them be ashamed; let them perish<l eID="gen8514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8515"/>who are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my adversaries⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “adversaries of my soul”</note><l eID="gen8515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8516"/>Let <transChange type="added">them</transChange> wrap themselves with scorn and disgrace<l eID="gen8516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8517"/>who seek my harm. <l eID="gen8517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4778"/><l level="1" sID="gen8518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4778"/>But as for me, I will hope continually<l eID="gen8518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8519"/>and increase your praise. <l eID="gen8519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4779"/><l level="1" sID="gen8520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4779"/>My mouth will tell of your righteousness,<l eID="gen8520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8521"/>your salvation <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all day long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all the day”</note><l eID="gen8521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8522"/>though I do not know <transChange type="added">the full</transChange> sum <transChange type="added">of them</transChange>. <l eID="gen8522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4780"/><l level="1" sID="gen8523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4780"/>I will come in <transChange type="added">to tell</transChange> the mighty deeds of Lord Yahweh.<l eID="gen8523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8524"/>I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make known⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “bring to remembrance”</note> your righteousness, yours only. <l eID="gen8524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4781"/><l level="1" sID="gen8525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4781"/>O God, you have taught me from my youth,<l eID="gen8525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8526"/>and up to now I have proclaimed your wonderful deeds. <l eID="gen8526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4782"/><l level="1" sID="gen8527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4782"/>And even when <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> old and gray,<l eID="gen8527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8528"/>O God, do not abandon me<l eID="gen8528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8529"/>until I proclaim your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞strength⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “arm”</note> to <transChange type="added">this</transChange> generation,<l eID="gen8529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8530"/>your power to every <transChange type="added">one that</transChange> comes <transChange type="added">after</transChange>. <l eID="gen8530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4783"/><l level="1" sID="gen8531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4783"/>And your righteousness, O God, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> height <transChange type="added">of heaven</transChange>.<l eID="gen8531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8532"/>You who have done great things,<l eID="gen8532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8533"/>O God, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like you? <l eID="gen8533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4784"/><l level="1" sID="gen8534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4784"/>You who have caused me<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> to see many troubles and evils,<l eID="gen8534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8535"/>you will again revive me.<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note><l eID="gen8535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8536"/>And from the depths of the earth<l eID="gen8536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8537"/>you will again bring me up. <l eID="gen8537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4785"/><l level="1" sID="gen8538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4785"/>You will increase my greatness,<l eID="gen8538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8539"/>and you will comfort me all around.<note placement="foot">A slightly different vocalization yields, “… comfort me again”; compare the LXX.</note> <l eID="gen8539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4786"/><l level="1" sID="gen8540"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4786"/>On my part, I will praise you with a stringed instrument,<l eID="gen8540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8541"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> your faithfulness, O my God.<l eID="gen8541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8542"/>I will sing praises to you with a lyre,<l eID="gen8542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8543"/>O Holy One of Israel. <l eID="gen8543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4787"/><l level="1" sID="gen8544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4787"/>My lips will sing for joy when I sing praises to you,<l eID="gen8544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8545"/>and my soul, which you have redeemed. <l eID="gen8545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4788"/><l level="1" sID="gen8546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4788"/>My tongue also<l eID="gen8546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8547"/>will speak of your righteousness all the day,<l eID="gen8547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8548"/>because they have been put to shame, because they have been humiliated<l eID="gen8548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8549"/>who seek my harm. <l eID="gen8549" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8487"/> <chapter eID="Ps.71"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4789"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for the Prosperity of God’s Anointed King</title> <div sID="gen8550" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8550" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8551"/> <lg eID="gen8551"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of Solomon.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen8552"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4789"/>O God, give your judgments to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king,<l eID="gen8553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8554"/>and your righteousness to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king’s son. <l eID="gen8554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4790"/><l level="1" sID="gen8555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4790"/>May he judge your people with righteousness,<l eID="gen8555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8556"/>and your poor with justice. <l eID="gen8556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4791"/><l level="1" sID="gen8557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4791"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains yield prosperity<note placement="foot">Or “peace”</note> for the people,<l eID="gen8557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8558"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hills in righteousness. <l eID="gen8558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4792"/><l level="1" sID="gen8559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4792"/>May he provide justice <transChange type="added">for the</transChange> poor of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people,<l eID="gen8559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8560"/>save <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy,<l eID="gen8560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8561"/>and crush <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppressor. <l eID="gen8561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4793"/><l level="1" sID="gen8562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4793"/>May he live long<note placement="foot">This presupposes the reading, suggested by the LXX, that might indicate that two of the Hebrew root letters have been inverted. The Hebrew reads “They will/Let them fear”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞while the sun endures⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with the sun”</note><l eID="gen8562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8563"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as long as the moon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of the moon”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for all generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “generation of generations”</note> <l eID="gen8563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4794"/><l level="1" sID="gen8564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4794"/>May he descend like rain on mown grass,<l eID="gen8564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8565"/>like showers watering <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen8565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4795"/><l level="1" sID="gen8566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4795"/>May <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> right blossom in his days<l eID="gen8566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8567"/>and an abundance of peace, until <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moon is no more. <l eID="gen8567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4796"/><l level="1" sID="gen8568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4796"/>And may he rule from sea up to sea,<l eID="gen8568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8569"/>and from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> River<note placement="foot">That is, the Euphrates</note> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> edges of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land. <l eID="gen8569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4797"/><l level="1" sID="gen8570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4797"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert dwellers bow down before him,<l eID="gen8570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8571"/>and his enemies lick the dust. <l eID="gen8571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4798"/><l level="1" sID="gen8572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4798"/>Let the kings of Tarshish and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> islands bring tribute.<l eID="gen8572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8573"/>Let the kings of Sheba and Seba present gifts, <l eID="gen8573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4799"/><l level="1" sID="gen8574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4799"/>and let all kings bow down to him.<l eID="gen8574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8575"/>Let all nations serve him. <l eID="gen8575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4800"/><l level="1" sID="gen8576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4800"/>Indeed he will deliver <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> crying for help,<l eID="gen8576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8577"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> afflicted <transChange type="added">who</transChange> has no helper. <l eID="gen8577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4801"/><l level="1" sID="gen8578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4801"/>He will take pity on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> helpless and needy,<l eID="gen8578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8579"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lives of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy he will save. <l eID="gen8579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4802"/><l level="1" sID="gen8580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4802"/>From oppression and from violence<l eID="gen8580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8581"/>he will redeem their lives,<l eID="gen8581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8582"/>and their blood will be precious in his eyes. <l eID="gen8582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4803"/><l level="1" sID="gen8583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4803"/>So may he live, and may gold from Sheba be given to him,<l eID="gen8583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8584"/>and may prayers be offered for him continually.<l eID="gen8584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8585"/>May blessings be invoked for him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all day long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all the day”</note> <l eID="gen8585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4804"/><l level="1" sID="gen8586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4804"/>May there be an abundance of grain in the land<l eID="gen8586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8587"/><transChange type="added">even</transChange> on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> top of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains.<l eID="gen8587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8588"/>May his crop<note placement="foot">Or “May his descendants”</note> sway like the <transChange type="added">trees of</transChange> Lebanon,<l eID="gen8588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8589"/>and may <transChange type="added">those</transChange> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city blossom like the grass of the earth. <l eID="gen8589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4805"/><l level="1" sID="gen8590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4805"/>May his name endure forever.<l eID="gen8590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8591"/>May his name increase <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as long as the sun shines⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the presence of the sun”</note><l eID="gen8591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8592"/>and let them be blessed in him.<l eID="gen8592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8593"/>Let all nations call him blessed. <l eID="gen8593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4806"/><l level="1" sID="gen8594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4806"/>Blessed be Yahweh God, the God of Israel,<l eID="gen8594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8595"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> alone does wonderful things. <l eID="gen8595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4807"/><l level="1" sID="gen8596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4807"/>And blessed be his glorious name forever,<l eID="gen8596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8597"/>and may the whole earth be filled with his glory.<l eID="gen8597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8598"/>Amen and Amen. <l eID="gen8598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4808"/><l level="1" sID="gen8599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4808"/>The prayers of David, the son of Jesse, are completed. <l eID="gen8599" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8552"/> <chapter eID="Ps.72"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4809"/><title type="x-s">The Wicked and the Righteous Contrasted</title> <div sID="gen8600" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8600" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8601"/> <lg eID="gen8601"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of Asaph.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen8602"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4809"/>Surely God is good to Israel,<l eID="gen8603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8604"/>to those pure of heart. <l eID="gen8604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4810"/><l level="1" sID="gen8605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4810"/>But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled.<l eID="gen8605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8606"/>My steps had nearly slipped, <l eID="gen8606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4811"/><l level="1" sID="gen8607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4811"/>because I envied the boastful<l eID="gen8607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8608"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> I saw <transChange type="added">the</transChange> well-being<note placement="foot">Or “peace” or “prosperity”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked. <l eID="gen8608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4812"/><l level="1" sID="gen8609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4812"/>For there are no pains up to their death,<l eID="gen8609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8610"/>and their bodies <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞healthy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “fat”</note> <l eID="gen8610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4813"/><l level="1" sID="gen8611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4813"/>They do not have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ordinary trouble⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the trouble of man”</note><l eID="gen8611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8612"/>and they are not plagued as <transChange type="added">other</transChange> people.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “humankind”</note> <l eID="gen8612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4814"/><l level="1" sID="gen8613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4814"/>Therefore pride is their necklace;<l eID="gen8613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8614"/>an outfit of violence covers them. <l eID="gen8614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4815"/><l level="1" sID="gen8615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4815"/>Their eye bulges from fat.<note placement="foot">A slightly different Hebrew reading might be reflected in the LXX’s “their iniquity comes out of fatness”</note><l eID="gen8615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8616"/>Imaginings overflow <transChange type="added">their</transChange> heart. <l eID="gen8616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4816"/><l level="1" sID="gen8617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4816"/>They mock and speak maliciously of oppression;<l eID="gen8617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8618"/>they speak <transChange type="added">as though</transChange> from on high. <l eID="gen8618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4817"/><l level="1" sID="gen8619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4817"/>They set their mouth against the heavens,<l eID="gen8619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8620"/>and their tongue roams the earth. <l eID="gen8620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4818"/><l level="1" sID="gen8621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4818"/>Therefore his people turn there,<note placement="foot">That is, toward the wicked</note><l eID="gen8621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8622"/>and abundant waters are slurped up by them. <l eID="gen8622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4819"/><l level="1" sID="gen8623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4819"/>And they say, “How does God know?”<l eID="gen8623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8624"/>and, “Does the Most High have knowledge?” <l eID="gen8624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4820"/><l level="1" sID="gen8625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4820"/>See, these <transChange type="added">are the</transChange> wicked,<l eID="gen8625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8626"/>and they increase wealth, ever carefree. <l eID="gen8626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4821"/><l level="1" sID="gen8627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4821"/>Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure,<l eID="gen8627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8628"/>and washed my hands in innocence. <l eID="gen8628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4822"/><l level="1" sID="gen8629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4822"/>And I have been plagued all day<l eID="gen8629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8630"/>and rebuked <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the mornings”</note> <l eID="gen8630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4823"/><l level="1" sID="gen8631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4823"/>If I had said, “I will speak thus,”<l eID="gen8631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8632"/>behold, I would have acted treacherously<l eID="gen8632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8633"/>against your children’s generation. <l eID="gen8633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4824"/><l level="1" sID="gen8634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4824"/>When I thought about <transChange type="added">how</transChange> to understand this,<l eID="gen8634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8635"/>it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> troubling in my eyes <l eID="gen8635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4825"/><l level="1" sID="gen8636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4825"/>until I went into the sanctuary of God.<l eID="gen8636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8637"/><transChange type="added">Then</transChange> I understood their fate. <l eID="gen8637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4826"/><l level="1" sID="gen8638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4826"/>Surely you set them on slippery places.<l eID="gen8638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8639"/>You cause them to fall onto ruin.<note placement="foot">Or “fall for deceptions”</note> <l eID="gen8639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4827"/><l level="1" sID="gen8640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4827"/>How they become a desolation in a moment!<l eID="gen8640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8641"/>They come to a complete end by terrors. <l eID="gen8641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4828"/><l level="1" sID="gen8642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4828"/>Like a dream upon awakening,<l eID="gen8642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8643"/>when <transChange type="added">you</transChange> wake up, O Lord,<l eID="gen8643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8644"/>you will despise their fleeting form.<note placement="foot">Or “image”</note> <l eID="gen8644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4829"/><l level="1" sID="gen8645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4829"/>When my heart was embittered<l eID="gen8645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8646"/>and I felt stabbed in my kidneys, <l eID="gen8646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4830"/><l level="1" sID="gen8647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4830"/>then I was brutish and ignorant.<l eID="gen8647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8648"/>With you I was <transChange type="added">like</transChange> the beasts. <l eID="gen8648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4831"/><l level="1" sID="gen8649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4831"/>But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> continually with you;<l eID="gen8649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8650"/>you have hold of my right hand. <l eID="gen8650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4832"/><l level="1" sID="gen8651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4832"/>You will guide me with your advice,<l eID="gen8651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8652"/>and afterward you will take me <transChange type="added">into</transChange> honor.<note placement="foot">Or “to glory”</note> <l eID="gen8652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4833"/><l level="1" sID="gen8653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4833"/>Whom do I have in the heavens <transChange type="added">except you</transChange>?<l eID="gen8653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8654"/>And with you I have no <transChange type="added">other</transChange> desire on earth. <l eID="gen8654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:26
