verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4834"/><l level="1" sID="gen8655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4834"/>My flesh and heart failed,<l eID="gen8655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8656"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞strength⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “rock”</note> of my heart and my reward forever. <l eID="gen8656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4835"/><l level="1" sID="gen8657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4835"/>For indeed, <transChange type="added">those</transChange> distancing themselves from you will be ruined.<l eID="gen8657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8658"/>You destroy each who abandons you for harlotry. <l eID="gen8658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4836"/><l level="1" sID="gen8659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4836"/>But as for me, the approach to God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for my good.<l eID="gen8659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8660"/>I have set the Lord Yahweh <transChange type="added">as</transChange> my refuge,<l eID="gen8660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8661"/>in order to tell all your works. <l eID="gen8661" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8602"/> <chapter eID="Ps.73"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4837"/><title type="x-s">A Lament in Time of National Defeat</title> <div sID="gen8662" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8662" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8663"/> <lg eID="gen8663"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A maskil of Asaph.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen8664"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4837"/>Why, O God, have you rejected <transChange type="added">us</transChange> forever?<l eID="gen8665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8666"/><transChange type="added">Why</transChange> does your anger smoke<l eID="gen8666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8667"/>against the sheep of your pasture? <l eID="gen8667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4838"/><l level="1" sID="gen8668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4838"/>Remember your congregation <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you bought long ago,<l eID="gen8668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8669"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> you redeemed the tribe of your inheritance.<l eID="gen8669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8670"/><transChange type="added">Remember</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Zion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Zion”</note> where you have dwelt. <l eID="gen8670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4839"/><l level="1" sID="gen8671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4839"/>Lift your steps to the perpetual ruins,<l eID="gen8671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8672"/><transChange type="added">to</transChange> all <transChange type="added">that the</transChange> enemy has ruined in the sanctuary. <l eID="gen8672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4840"/><l level="1" sID="gen8673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4840"/>Your enemies have roared in the midst of your meeting place;<l eID="gen8673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8674"/>they have set up their signs <transChange type="added">for</transChange> signs. <l eID="gen8674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4841"/><l level="1" sID="gen8675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4841"/>They are<note placement="foot">Hebrew “He is”</note> known to be like those who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wield⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lift up”</note><l eID="gen8675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8676"/>axes in a thicket of trees. <l eID="gen8676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4842"/><l level="1" sID="gen8677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4842"/>And now<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> its<note placement="foot">That is, the temple’s</note> carved works altogether<l eID="gen8677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8678"/>they have smashed with axe and hammer. <l eID="gen8678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4843"/><l level="1" sID="gen8679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4843"/>They have set fire to your sanctuary.<l eID="gen8679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8680"/>They have defiled to the ground,<l eID="gen8680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8681"/>the dwelling place for your name. <l eID="gen8681" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4844"/><l level="1" sID="gen8682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4844"/>They have said in their heart,<l eID="gen8682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8683"/>“We will completely<note placement="foot">Hebrew “altogether”</note> oppress them.”<l eID="gen8683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8684"/>They burned all the meeting places of God in the land. <l eID="gen8684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4845"/><l level="1" sID="gen8685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4845"/>We do not see our signs,<l eID="gen8685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8686"/>and there is no longer a prophet.<l eID="gen8686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8687"/>No one with us knows how long. <l eID="gen8687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4846"/><l level="1" sID="gen8688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4846"/>How long, O God, will <transChange type="added">the</transChange> adversary taunt?<l eID="gen8688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8689"/>Will <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy treat your name with contempt forever? <l eID="gen8689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4847"/><l level="1" sID="gen8690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4847"/>Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand?<l eID="gen8690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8691"/><transChange type="added">Take it</transChange> from your bosom;<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> destroy <transChange type="added">them</transChange>! <l eID="gen8691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4848"/><l level="1" sID="gen8692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4848"/>But God <transChange type="added">has been</transChange> my king from long ago,<l eID="gen8692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8693"/>working salvation in the midst of the earth. <l eID="gen8693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4849"/><l level="1" sID="gen8694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4849"/>You split open <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea by your strength;<l eID="gen8694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8695"/>You broke <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heads of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea monsters in the waters. <l eID="gen8695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4850"/><l level="1" sID="gen8696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4850"/>You crushed the heads of Leviathan;<l eID="gen8696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8697"/>you gave him <transChange type="added">as</transChange> food to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert dwelling creatures. <l eID="gen8697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4851"/><l level="1" sID="gen8698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4851"/>You split open spring and wadi.<note placement="foot">A seasonal stream that is often dry</note><l eID="gen8698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8699"/>You dried up ever-flowing rivers. <l eID="gen8699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4852"/><l level="1" sID="gen8700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4852"/>Yours <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> day, yours <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> night also.<l eID="gen8700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8701"/>You established light and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun. <l eID="gen8701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4853"/><l level="1" sID="gen8702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4853"/>You defined<note placement="foot">Or “set”</note> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> boundaries of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth;<l eID="gen8702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8703"/>Summer and winter—you formed them. <l eID="gen8703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4854"/><l level="1" sID="gen8704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4854"/>O Yahweh, remember this: <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy taunts,<l eID="gen8704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8705"/>and foolish people treat your name with contempt. <l eID="gen8705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4855"/><l level="1" sID="gen8706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4855"/>Do not give to beasts the life of your dove;<l eID="gen8706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8707"/>do not ever forget the life of your afflicted ones. <l eID="gen8707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4856"/><l level="1" sID="gen8708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4856"/>Have regard for the covenant,<l eID="gen8708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8709"/>because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dark places of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land are full of<l eID="gen8709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8710"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> haunts of violence. <l eID="gen8710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4857"/><l level="1" sID="gen8711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4857"/>Do not let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppressed turn back humiliated;<l eID="gen8711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8712"/>let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor and needy praise your name. <l eID="gen8712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4858"/><l level="1" sID="gen8713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4858"/>Rise up, O God, plead your cause;<l eID="gen8713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8714"/>remember the reproaching of you by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> foolish <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all day long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all the day”</note> <l eID="gen8714" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4859"/><l level="1" sID="gen8715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4859"/>Do not forget the sound of your adversaries,<l eID="gen8715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8716"/>the roar of those rising up against you ascending continually. <l eID="gen8716" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8664"/> <chapter eID="Ps.74"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4860"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for God’s Future Help</title> <div sID="gen8717" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8717" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8718"/> <lg eID="gen8718"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> Do Not Destroy.</title> <lg sID="gen8719"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8720"/>A psalm of Asaph. A song.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen8720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4860"/>We give thanks to you, O God;<l eID="gen8721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8722"/>we give thanks, and your name is near.<l eID="gen8722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8723"/>Your wonderful deeds are told.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “They tell your wonderful deeds”</note> <l eID="gen8723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4861"/><l level="1" sID="gen8724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4861"/>“I will indeed set an appointed time;<l eID="gen8724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8725"/>I will judge fairly.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “I, I will judge” might be emphatic</note> <l eID="gen8725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4862"/><l level="1" sID="gen8726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4862"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> earth and all its inhabitants <transChange type="added">are</transChange> shaking;<note placement="foot">Or “melting away”</note><l eID="gen8726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8727"/>I steady<note placement="foot">Hebrew “I, I steady” might be emphatic</note> its columns. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4863"/><l level="1" sID="gen8728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4863"/>I say to the boastful, ‘Do not boast!’<l eID="gen8728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8729"/>and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up <transChange type="added">your</transChange> horn! <l eID="gen8729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4864"/><l level="1" sID="gen8730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4864"/>Do not lift up high your<note placement="foot">Plural</note> horn.<l eID="gen8730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8731"/>Do <transChange type="added">not</transChange> speak with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞arrogant pride⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “an unrestrained neck”</note> <l eID="gen8731" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4865"/><l level="1" sID="gen8732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4865"/>For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east or <transChange type="added">the</transChange> west<l eID="gen8732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8733"/>and not from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wilderness”</note> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> lifting up <transChange type="added">comes</transChange>, <l eID="gen8733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4866"/><l level="1" sID="gen8734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4866"/>rather God <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> judge;<l eID="gen8734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8735"/>one he brings low, and another he lifts up. <l eID="gen8735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4867"/><l level="1" sID="gen8736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4867"/>For <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> a cup in the hand of Yahweh<l eID="gen8736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8737"/>with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> wine <transChange type="added">that</transChange> foams, fully mixed,<l eID="gen8737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8738"/>and he pours out from this.<l eID="gen8738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8739"/>Surely all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land<l eID="gen8739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8740"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will quaff it down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> its dregs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they will drain, they will drink its dregs”</note> <l eID="gen8740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4868"/><l level="1" sID="gen8741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4868"/>But as for me, I will proclaim forever;<l eID="gen8741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8742"/>I will sing praise to the God of Jacob. <l eID="gen8742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4869"/><l level="1" sID="gen8743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4869"/>“And all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> horns of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked I will cut off.<l eID="gen8743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8744"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> horns of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous will be lifted up.” <l eID="gen8744" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8719"/> <chapter eID="Ps.75"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4870"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for His Rescue of Israel</title> <div sID="gen8745" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8745" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8746"/> <lg eID="gen8746"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, with stringed instruments.</title> <lg sID="gen8747"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8748"/>A psalm of Asaph. A song.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen8748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4870"/>God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> known in Judah.<l eID="gen8749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8750"/>His name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great in Israel. <l eID="gen8750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4871"/><l level="1" sID="gen8751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4871"/>His den<note placement="foot">Or “shelter”; but the image of the lion appears in view</note> has been in Salem,<l eID="gen8751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8752"/>his lair<note placement="foot">Or “refuge”</note> in Zion. <l eID="gen8752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4872"/><l level="1" sID="gen8753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4872"/>There he broke <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flames of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bow,<l eID="gen8753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8754"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> shield and sword and battle. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4873"/><l level="1" sID="gen8755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4873"/>Radiant<note placement="foot">A possible change in the Hebrew text yields, “You are feared, majestic …” a form found in vv. <reference osisRef="Ps.76.8">8</reference>(7), 13(12). This is possibly reflected in the reading of Theodotian</note> you <transChange type="added">are</transChange>, majestic,<l eID="gen8755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8756"/>from<note placement="foot">Or “more than”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains of prey. <l eID="gen8756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4874"/><l level="1" sID="gen8757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4874"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> stouthearted are plundered;<l eID="gen8757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8758"/>they sleep their sleep,<l eID="gen8758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8759"/>and all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> able men cannot <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞use⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “find”</note> their hands. <l eID="gen8759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4875"/><l level="1" sID="gen8760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4875"/>At your rebuke, O God of Jacob,<l eID="gen8760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8761"/>both rider<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot,” that is, charioteer</note> and horse slumber. <l eID="gen8761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4876"/><l level="1" sID="gen8762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4876"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You, indeed, are to be feared⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “You, feared you are”</note><l eID="gen8762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8763"/>and who can stand before you<l eID="gen8763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8764"/>when you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> angry?<note placement="foot">A slight change in the vocalization of the MT yields, “from the strength of your anger”</note> <l eID="gen8764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4877"/><l level="1" sID="gen8765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4877"/>From heaven you proclaimed judgment.<l eID="gen8765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8766"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> earth feared and was still <l eID="gen8766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4878"/><l level="1" sID="gen8767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4878"/>when God rose for justice,<l eID="gen8767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8768"/>to save all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> afflicted of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4879"/><l level="1" sID="gen8769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4879"/>For the anger of humankind will praise you.<l eID="gen8769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8770"/>You will put on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> remnant of anger.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “angers”</note> <l eID="gen8770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4880"/><l level="1" sID="gen8771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4880"/>Make vows and fulfill them to Yahweh, your God;<l eID="gen8771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8772"/>let all surrounding him<l eID="gen8772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8773"/>bring tribute to the <transChange type="added">one to be</transChange> feared.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to the fear”</note> <l eID="gen8773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4881"/><l level="1" sID="gen8774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4881"/>He cuts off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spirit of leaders.<l eID="gen8774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8775"/><transChange type="added">He is to be</transChange> feared by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen8775" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8747"/> <chapter eID="Ps.76"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4882"/><title type="x-s">Remembering God’s Help for Israel</title> <div sID="gen8776" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8776" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8777"/> <lg eID="gen8777"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, on Jeduthun.<note placement="foot">One of David’s musicians (<reference osisRef="1Chr.16.41">1 Chr 16:41</reference>)</note></title> <lg sID="gen8778"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8779"/>Of Asaph. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen8779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4882"/>I cry out with my voice to God;<l eID="gen8780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8781"/>with my voice to God, that he may hear me. <l eID="gen8781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4883"/><l level="1" sID="gen8782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4883"/>In the day I <transChange type="added">have</transChange> trouble, I seek<note placement="foot">Or “make supplication to”</note> the Lord.<l eID="gen8782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8783"/>At night my hand stretches out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continually⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “it does not grow weary”</note><l eID="gen8783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8784"/>my soul refuses to be comforted. <l eID="gen8784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4884"/><l level="1" sID="gen8785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4884"/>I remember God and I groan loudly;<l eID="gen8785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8786"/>I meditate and my spirit grows faint. <l eID="gen8786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4885"/><l level="1" sID="gen8787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4885"/>You hold <transChange type="added">open</transChange> my eyelids.<l eID="gen8787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8788"/>I am troubled and cannot speak. <l eID="gen8788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4886"/><l level="1" sID="gen8789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4886"/>I think about <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days from long ago,<l eID="gen8789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8790"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> years of ancient times. <l eID="gen8790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4887"/><l level="1" sID="gen8791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4887"/>I remember my song in the night.<l eID="gen8791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8792"/>With my heart I meditate,<l eID="gen8792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8793"/>and my spirit searches <transChange type="added">to understand</transChange>. <l eID="gen8793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4888"/><l level="1" sID="gen8794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4888"/>Will the Lord reject <transChange type="added">us</transChange> forever,<l eID="gen8794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8795"/>and will he never be pleased <transChange type="added">with us</transChange> again? <l eID="gen8795" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4889"/><l level="1" sID="gen8796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4889"/>Has his loyal love ceased forever?<l eID="gen8796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8797"/>Is <transChange type="added">his</transChange> promise<note placement="foot">Hebrew “word”</note> ended throughout generations? <l eID="gen8797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4890"/><l level="1" sID="gen8798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4890"/>Has God forgotten to have compassion?<l eID="gen8798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8799"/>Or has he closed off his mercies in anger? <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4891"/><l level="1" sID="gen8800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4891"/>So I said, “This pierces me—<note placement="foot">Or “this is my sickness”</note><l eID="gen8800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8801"/>the right <transChange type="added">hand</transChange> of the Most High <transChange type="added">has</transChange> changed.” <l eID="gen8801" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4892"/><l level="1" sID="gen8802"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4892"/>I will remember the deeds of Yah.<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen8802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8803"/>Surely I will remember your wonders<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wonder”</note> from long ago. <l eID="gen8803" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4893"/><l level="1" sID="gen8804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4893"/>I will also muse on all your work,<l eID="gen8804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8805"/>and meditate on your deeds. <l eID="gen8805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4894"/><l level="1" sID="gen8806"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4894"/>O God, your way <transChange type="added">is</transChange> distinctive.<note placement="foot">Or “holy” or “set apart”</note><l eID="gen8806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8807"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a great god like <transChange type="added">our</transChange> God? <l eID="gen8807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4895"/><l level="1" sID="gen8808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4895"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the God who works wonders;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wonder”</note><l eID="gen8808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8809"/>you have made known your might among the peoples. <l eID="gen8809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4896"/><l level="1" sID="gen8810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4896"/>With <transChange type="added">your</transChange> arm you redeemed your people,<l eID="gen8810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8811"/>the children of Jacob and Joseph. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen8811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4897"/><l level="1" sID="gen8812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4897"/>Waters saw you, O God;<l eID="gen8812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8813"/>waters saw you <transChange type="added">and</transChange> they trembled.<l eID="gen8813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8814"/>Surely <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deeps shook. <l eID="gen8814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4898"/><l level="1" sID="gen8815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4898"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> clouds poured out water.<l eID="gen8815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8816"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> skies <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞thundered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “gave voice”</note><l eID="gen8816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8817"/>Your arrows also <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞flew about⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “walked back and forth”</note> <l eID="gen8817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4899"/><l level="1" sID="gen8818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4899"/>The sound of your thunder <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in the whirlwind;<note placement="foot">Or “in your chariot wheel”</note><l eID="gen8818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8819"/>lightnings lit <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world;<l eID="gen8819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8820"/>the earth shook and quaked. <l eID="gen8820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4900"/><l level="1" sID="gen8821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4900"/>Your way <transChange type="added">was</transChange> through the sea,<l eID="gen8821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8822"/>and your path<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> through many waters.<l eID="gen8822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8823"/>Yet your footprints were not discerned.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “were not known”</note> <l eID="gen8823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4901"/><l level="1" sID="gen8824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4901"/>You led your people like a flock<l eID="gen8824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8825"/>by the hand of Moses and Aaron. <l eID="gen8825" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8778"/> <chapter eID="Ps.77"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4902"/><title type="x-s">God’s Faithfulness in Israel’s History</title> <div sID="gen8826" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8826" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8827"/> <lg eID="gen8827"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A maskil of Asaph.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen8828"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4902"/>Listen, O my people, to my teaching.<l eID="gen8829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8830"/>Incline your ears to the words of my mouth. <l eID="gen8830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4903"/><l level="1" sID="gen8831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4903"/>I will offer<note placement="foot">Hebrew “open”</note> a parable <transChange type="added">with</transChange> my mouth.<l eID="gen8831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8832"/>I will pour out riddles from long ago, <l eID="gen8832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4904"/><l level="1" sID="gen8833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4904"/>that we have heard and known,<l eID="gen8833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8834"/>and our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> have told us. <l eID="gen8834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4905"/><l level="1" sID="gen8835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4905"/>We will not hide <transChange type="added">them</transChange> from their children,<note placement="foot">Or “descendants”</note><l eID="gen8835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8836"/>telling the next generation the praises of Yahweh,<l eID="gen8836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8837"/>and his power and his wonders that he has done. <l eID="gen8837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4906"/><l level="1" sID="gen8838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4906"/>For he established a testimony in Jacob,<l eID="gen8838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8839"/>and appointed a law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> in Israel,<l eID="gen8839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8840"/>which he commanded our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note><l eID="gen8840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8841"/>to teach to their children, <l eID="gen8841" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4907"/><l level="1" sID="gen8842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4907"/>so that <transChange type="added">the</transChange> next generation might know—<l eID="gen8842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8843"/>children <transChange type="added">yet to</transChange> be born—<l eID="gen8843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8844"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> they might rise up and tell their children, <l eID="gen8844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4908"/><l level="1" sID="gen8845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4908"/>that they might set their confidence in God,<l eID="gen8845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8846"/>and not forget the deeds of God,<l eID="gen8846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8847"/>but keep his commandments, <l eID="gen8847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4909"/><l level="1" sID="gen8848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4909"/>and not be like their ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note><l eID="gen8848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8849"/>a stubborn and rebellious generation,<l eID="gen8849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8850"/>a generation <transChange type="added">that</transChange> did not make ready its heart,<l eID="gen8850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8851"/>whose spirit was not faithful <transChange type="added">to</transChange> God. <l eID="gen8851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4910"/><l level="1" sID="gen8852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4910"/>The sons of Ephraim, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞armed with archers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “armed with shooters of the bow”</note><l eID="gen8852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8853"/>turned back on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of battle. <l eID="gen8853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4911"/><l level="1" sID="gen8854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4911"/>They did not keep the covenant of God<l eID="gen8854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8855"/>and refused to go in his law.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> <l eID="gen8855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4912"/><l level="1" sID="gen8856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4912"/>They also forgot his deeds,<l eID="gen8856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8857"/>and his wonders that he had shown them. <l eID="gen8857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4913"/><l level="1" sID="gen8858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4913"/>In front of their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> he did a wonder,<l eID="gen8858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8859"/>in the land of Egypt, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the region of Zoan. <l eID="gen8859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4914"/><l level="1" sID="gen8860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4914"/>He split the sea and caused them to go over,<l eID="gen8860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8861"/>and he caused waters to stand like a heap. <l eID="gen8861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4915"/><l level="1" sID="gen8862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4915"/>And he led them with the cloud by day,<l eID="gen8862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8863"/>and all night with a fiery light. <l eID="gen8863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4916"/><l level="1" sID="gen8864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4916"/>He caused rocks to split in the wilderness<l eID="gen8864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8865"/>and provided drink abundantly as <transChange type="added">from the</transChange> depths. <l eID="gen8865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4917"/><l level="1" sID="gen8866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4917"/>And he brought streams out of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rock<l eID="gen8866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8867"/>and caused water to flow down like rivers. <l eID="gen8867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4918"/><l level="1" sID="gen8868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4918"/>But they sinned still further against him<l eID="gen8868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8869"/>by rebelling <transChange type="added">against the</transChange> Most High in the desert. <l eID="gen8869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4919"/><l level="1" sID="gen8870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4919"/>And they tested God in their heart<l eID="gen8870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8871"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange> asking food <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for their craving⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for their soul”</note> <l eID="gen8871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4920"/><l level="1" sID="gen8872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4920"/>And they spoke against God.<l eID="gen8872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8873"/>They said, “Is God able<l eID="gen8873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8874"/>to prepare a table in the wilderness? <l eID="gen8874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4921"/><l level="1" sID="gen8875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4921"/>Yes, he struck <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rock and water flowed<l eID="gen8875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8876"/>and streams gushed out,<l eID="gen8876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8877"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> can he also give food<l eID="gen8877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8878"/>or provide meat for his people?” <l eID="gen8878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4922"/><l level="1" sID="gen8879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4922"/>Therefore Yahweh heard<l eID="gen8879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8880"/>and he was very angry,<l eID="gen8880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8881"/>and a fire was kindled against Jacob,<l eID="gen8881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8882"/>and <transChange type="added">his</transChange> anger also rose up against Israel, <l eID="gen8882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4923"/><l level="1" sID="gen8883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4923"/>because they did not believe God,<l eID="gen8883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8884"/>and they did not trust his salvation. <l eID="gen8884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4924"/><l level="1" sID="gen8885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4924"/>Nevertheless, he commanded <transChange type="added">the</transChange> skies above<l eID="gen8885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8886"/>and opened <transChange type="added">the</transChange> doors of heaven, <l eID="gen8886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4925"/><l level="1" sID="gen8887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4925"/>and rained down on them manna to eat<l eID="gen8887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8888"/>and gave them the grain of heaven. <l eID="gen8888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4926"/><l level="1" sID="gen8889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4926"/>Humankind ate <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bread of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞angels⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “mighty ones”</note><l eID="gen8889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8890"/>He sent them food <transChange type="added">enough</transChange> to be satisfied. <l eID="gen8890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4927"/><l level="1" sID="gen8891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4927"/>He caused <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east wind to blow in the heavens<l eID="gen8891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8892"/>and drove along <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south wind by his strength. <l eID="gen8892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4928"/><l level="1" sID="gen8893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4928"/>Then he rained meat on them like dust,<l eID="gen8893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8894"/>even winged birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas. <l eID="gen8894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4929"/><l level="1" sID="gen8895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4929"/>He caused <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to fall in the midst of his camp,<l eID="gen8895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8896"/>all around his dwellings. <l eID="gen8896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4930"/><l level="1" sID="gen8897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4930"/>So they ate and were well filled,<l eID="gen8897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8898"/>and he brought about <transChange type="added">what</transChange> they craved. <l eID="gen8898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4931"/><l level="1" sID="gen8899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4931"/>They had not yet turned aside from their craving,<l eID="gen8899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8900"/><transChange type="added">while</transChange> their food <transChange type="added">was</transChange> still in their mouth, <l eID="gen8900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4932"/><l level="1" sID="gen8901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4932"/>the anger of God rose against them,<l eID="gen8901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8902"/>and he killed some of the stoutest of them,<l eID="gen8902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8903"/>even the young men of Israel he caused to bow down <transChange type="added">in death</transChange>. <l eID="gen8903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4933"/><l level="1" sID="gen8904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4933"/>In spite of all this they sinned further<l eID="gen8904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8905"/>and did not believe his wonders. <l eID="gen8905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4934"/><l level="1" sID="gen8906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4934"/>And he consumed their days with futility<note placement="foot">Or “he ended their days like a breath”</note><l eID="gen8906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8907"/>their years with terror.<note placement="foot">Or “and their years suddenly”</note> <l eID="gen8907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4935"/><l level="1" sID="gen8908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4935"/>When he killed <transChange type="added">some of</transChange> them, then they sought him,<l eID="gen8908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8909"/>and repented and earnestly sought God. <l eID="gen8909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4936"/><l level="1" sID="gen8910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4936"/>And they remembered that God <transChange type="added">was</transChange> their rock,<l eID="gen8910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8911"/>and God Most High their redeemer. <l eID="gen8911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4937"/><l level="1" sID="gen8912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4937"/>But they enticed him with their mouth<l eID="gen8912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8913"/>and lied to him with their tongue. <l eID="gen8913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4938"/><l level="1" sID="gen8914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4938"/>For their heart was not steadfast with him,<l eID="gen8914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8915"/>nor were they faithful to his covenant. <l eID="gen8915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4939"/><l level="1" sID="gen8916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4939"/>But he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> compassionate; he pardoned<note placement="foot">Or “covered,” or “atoned for”</note> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> guilt<l eID="gen8916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8917"/>and did not destroy <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.<l eID="gen8917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8918"/>And many <transChange type="added">times</transChange> he turned back his anger<l eID="gen8918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8919"/>and did not stir up all his wrath, <l eID="gen8919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4940"/><l level="1" sID="gen8920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4940"/>for he remembered that they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> flesh,<l eID="gen8920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8921"/>a passing wind that does not return. <l eID="gen8921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4941"/><l level="1" sID="gen8922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4941"/>How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness<l eID="gen8922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8923"/>and vexed him in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wasteland! <l eID="gen8923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4942"/><l level="1" sID="gen8924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4942"/>So they again tested God<l eID="gen8924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8925"/>and distressed<note placement="foot">Or perhaps, “pressed to the limit”</note> the Holy One of Israel. <l eID="gen8925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4943"/><l level="1" sID="gen8926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4943"/>And they did not remember his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note><l eID="gen8926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8927"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day that”</note> he redeemed them from the enemy, <l eID="gen8927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4944"/><l level="1" sID="gen8928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4944"/>how he performed<note placement="foot">Hebrew “set”</note> his signs in Egypt<l eID="gen8928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8929"/>and his wonders in the region of Zoan, <l eID="gen8929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4945"/><l level="1" sID="gen8930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4945"/>when he turned their rivers<note placement="foot">Normally the word for the Nile, with the plural here suggesting perhaps it and its canals</note> to blood<l eID="gen8930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8931"/>so they could not drink <transChange type="added">from</transChange> their streams. <l eID="gen8931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4946"/><l level="1" sID="gen8932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4946"/>He sent among them flies that devoured them<l eID="gen8932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8933"/>and frogs that destroyed them. <l eID="gen8933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4947"/><l level="1" sID="gen8934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4947"/>And he gave their crop to the locusts<l eID="gen8934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8935"/>and their labor to the locust.<note placement="foot">Two different words translated “locusts”</note> <l eID="gen8935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4948"/><l level="1" sID="gen8936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4948"/>He destroyed their vines with hail<l eID="gen8936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8937"/>and their sycamore trees with sleet.<note placement="foot">The word for “sleet” is only used here, and the translation is a guess based on context</note> <l eID="gen8937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4949"/><l level="1" sID="gen8938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4949"/>He also handed their cattle over to the hail<l eID="gen8938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8939"/>and their livestock to the lightning bolts. <l eID="gen8939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4950"/><l level="1" sID="gen8940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4950"/>He sent against them his fierce anger,<l eID="gen8940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8941"/>rage and indignation and trouble,<l eID="gen8941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8942"/>a band of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞destroying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “evil”</note> angels. <l eID="gen8942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4951"/><l level="1" sID="gen8943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4951"/>He cleared a path for his anger.<l eID="gen8943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8944"/>He did not spare them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “their soul”</note> from death<l eID="gen8944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8945"/>but handed their life over to the plague. <l eID="gen8945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4952"/><l level="1" sID="gen8946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4952"/>And he struck down all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstborn in Egypt,<l eID="gen8946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8947"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> first of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> virility in the tents of Ham. <l eID="gen8947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4953"/><l level="1" sID="gen8948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4953"/>Then he led out his people like sheep<l eID="gen8948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8949"/>and guided them like a herd in the wilderness. <l eID="gen8949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4954"/><l level="1" sID="gen8950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4954"/>And he led them safely and they were not afraid,<l eID="gen8950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8951"/>but the sea covered their enemies. <l eID="gen8951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4955"/><l level="1" sID="gen8952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4955"/>So he brought them to his holy territory,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “border”</note><l eID="gen8952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8953"/>this mountain his right hand acquired.<note placement="foot">Or “had created”</note> <l eID="gen8953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4956"/><l level="1" sID="gen8954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4956"/>And he drove out nations before them<l eID="gen8954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8955"/>and allocated them for an inheritance by <transChange type="added">boundary</transChange> line,<l eID="gen8955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8956"/>and settled the tribes of Israel in their tents. <l eID="gen8956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4957"/><l level="1" sID="gen8957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4957"/>But they tested and rebelled against God Most High<l eID="gen8957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8958"/>and did not keep his statutes. <l eID="gen8958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4958"/><l level="1" sID="gen8959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4958"/>And they turned and were treacherous like their ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note><l eID="gen8959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8960"/>They twisted like a crooked<note placement="foot">Or “deceitful”</note> bow. <l eID="gen8960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4959"/><l level="1" sID="gen8961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4959"/>For they provoked him to anger with their high places,<l eID="gen8961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8962"/>and made him jealous with their images. <l eID="gen8962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4960"/><l level="1" sID="gen8963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4960"/>God heard and he was very angry<l eID="gen8963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8964"/>and rejected Israel utterly. <l eID="gen8964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4961"/><l level="1" sID="gen8965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4961"/>So he abandoned the dwelling place at Shiloh,<l eID="gen8965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8966"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent he had placed among humankind. <l eID="gen8966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4962"/><l level="1" sID="gen8967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4962"/>And he gave his strength into captivity<l eID="gen8967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8968"/>and his splendor into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy. <l eID="gen8968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4963"/><l level="1" sID="gen8969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4963"/>He also handed his people over to the sword,<l eID="gen8969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8970"/>and he was very angry with his inheritance. <l eID="gen8970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4964"/><l level="1" sID="gen8971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4964"/>Fire devoured his young men,<l eID="gen8971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8972"/>and his young women<note placement="foot">Or “virgins”</note> were not praised. <l eID="gen8972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:64
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4965"/><l level="1" sID="gen8973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4965"/>His priests fell by the sword,<l eID="gen8973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8974"/>and his widows did not weep. <l eID="gen8974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4966"/><l level="1" sID="gen8975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4966"/>Then the Lord awoke like <transChange type="added">one who had been</transChange> asleep,<l eID="gen8975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8976"/><transChange type="added">awoke</transChange> like a warrior who had been drunk with wine.<note placement="foot">Or “like a warrior shouting because of wine”</note> <l eID="gen8976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4967"/><l level="1" sID="gen8977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4967"/>And he beat back his enemies;<l eID="gen8977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8978"/>he gave them over to perpetual scorn. <l eID="gen8978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:67
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4968"/><l level="1" sID="gen8979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4968"/>And he rejected the tent of Joseph,<l eID="gen8979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8980"/>and did not chose the tribe of Ephraim, <l eID="gen8980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:68
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4969"/><l level="1" sID="gen8981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4969"/>but chose the tribe of Judah,<l eID="gen8981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8982"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Zion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Zion”</note> that he loved. <l eID="gen8982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:69
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4970"/><l level="1" sID="gen8983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4970"/>And he built his sanctuary like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heights,<l eID="gen8983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8984"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth that he established forever. <l eID="gen8984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:70
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4971"/><l level="1" sID="gen8985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4971"/>And he chose David his servant<l eID="gen8985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8986"/>and took him from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sheepfolds. <l eID="gen8986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:71
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4972"/><l level="1" sID="gen8987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4972"/>He brought him from following nursing ewes<l eID="gen8987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8988"/>to shepherd Jacob, his people,<l eID="gen8988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8989"/>and Israel, his inheritance. <l eID="gen8989" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:72
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4973"/><l level="1" sID="gen8990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4973"/>And he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart,<l eID="gen8990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8991"/>and led them by the skillfulness of his hands. <l eID="gen8991" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8828"/> <chapter eID="Ps.78"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4974"/><title type="x-s">A Lament for Jerusalem after Its Destruction</title> <div sID="gen8992" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen8992" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8993"/> <lg eID="gen8993"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of Asaph.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen8994"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4974"/>O God, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations have entered your inheritance;<l eID="gen8995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8996"/>they have defiled your holy temple;<l eID="gen8996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8997"/>they have reduced Jerusalem to ruins. <l eID="gen8997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4975"/><l level="1" sID="gen8998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4975"/>They have given the bodies of your servants<l eID="gen8998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8999"/>as food for the birds of the heavens,<l eID="gen8999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9000"/>the flesh of your faithful to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> beasts of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen9000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4976"/><l level="1" sID="gen9001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4976"/>They have poured out their blood like water<l eID="gen9001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9002"/>all around Jerusalem,<l eID="gen9002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9003"/>and there was none to bury <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <l eID="gen9003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4977"/><l level="1" sID="gen9004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4977"/>We have become a taunt to our neighbors,<l eID="gen9004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9005"/>a derision and a scorn to those around us. <l eID="gen9005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4978"/><l level="1" sID="gen9006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4978"/>How long, O Yahweh? Will you be angry forever?<l eID="gen9006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9007"/>Will your jealousy burn like fire? <l eID="gen9007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4979"/><l level="1" sID="gen9008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4979"/>Pour out your anger on the nations<l eID="gen9008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9009"/>that do not know you,<l eID="gen9009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9010"/>and on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kingdoms<l eID="gen9010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9011"/>that do not call on your name, <l eID="gen9011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4980"/><l level="1" sID="gen9012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4980"/>because they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> have devoured Jacob<l eID="gen9012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9013"/>and have laid waste his habitation. <l eID="gen9013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4981"/><l level="1" sID="gen9014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4981"/>Do not remember against us former iniquities;<l eID="gen9014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9015"/>let your mercies meet us quickly<l eID="gen9015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9016"/>because we are brought very low. <l eID="gen9016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4982"/><l level="1" sID="gen9017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4982"/>Help us, O God of our salvation,<l eID="gen9017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9018"/>for the glory of your name;<l eID="gen9018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9019"/>and deliver us and forgive<note placement="foot">Hebrew “make atonement for”</note> our sins<l eID="gen9019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9020"/>for the sake of your name. <l eID="gen9020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4983"/><l level="1" sID="gen9021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4983"/>Why should the nations say,<l eID="gen9021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9022"/>“Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their God?”<l eID="gen9022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9023"/>Let it<note placement="foot">That is, God’s name</note> be known among the nations before our eyes,<l eID="gen9023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9024"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange> the avenging of the blood of your servants<l eID="gen9024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9025"/>that was poured out. <l eID="gen9025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4984"/><l level="1" sID="gen9026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4984"/>Let the groaning of the prisoner come before you.<l eID="gen9026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9027"/>According to the greatness of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “arm”</note><l eID="gen9027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9028"/>spare<note placement="foot">Or “leave a remnant of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children <transChange type="added">appointed to</transChange> death. <l eID="gen9028" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4985"/><l level="1" sID="gen9029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4985"/>And return to our neighbors sevenfold <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upon them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “into their bosom”</note><l eID="gen9029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9030"/>their taunts <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which they taunted you, O Lord. <l eID="gen9030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4986"/><l level="1" sID="gen9031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4986"/>Then we, your people and the flock of your pasture,<l eID="gen9031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9032"/>we will give thanks to you forever.<l eID="gen9032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9033"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Generation after generation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to a generation and a generation”</note><l eID="gen9033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9034"/>we will tell of your praise. <l eID="gen9034" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8994"/> <chapter eID="Ps.79"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4987"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer to Restore Israel</title> <div sID="gen9035" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9035" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9036"/> <lg eID="gen9036"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director, according to <transChange type="added">The</transChange> Lilies.</title> <lg sID="gen9037"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9038"/>A testimony. Of Asaph. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen9038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4987"/>Give ear, O shepherd of Israel,<l eID="gen9039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9040"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> leads Joseph like a flock.<l eID="gen9040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9041"/>Shine forth, <transChange type="added">you who</transChange> sits <transChange type="added">enthroned above</transChange> the cherubim. <l eID="gen9041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4988"/><l level="1" sID="gen9042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4988"/>Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh,<l eID="gen9042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9043"/>stir up your power<l eID="gen9043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9044"/>and come for our salvation. <l eID="gen9044" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4989"/><l level="1" sID="gen9045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4989"/>O God, restore us,<l eID="gen9045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9046"/>and cause your face to shine that we may be saved. <l eID="gen9046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4990"/><l level="1" sID="gen9047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4990"/>O Yahweh God <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hosts,<l eID="gen9047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9048"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how long will you be angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until when your anger smoke”</note><l eID="gen9048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9049"/>against the prayer of your people? <l eID="gen9049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4991"/><l level="1" sID="gen9050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4991"/>You have fed them <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bread of tears;<l eID="gen9050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9051"/>you have given them tears to drink in full measure.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew “threefold” or “a third of a measure” is difficult</note> <l eID="gen9051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4992"/><l level="1" sID="gen9052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4992"/>You have made us <transChange type="added">an object of</transChange> strife to our neighbors,<l eID="gen9052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9053"/>and our enemies mock among themselves. <l eID="gen9053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4993"/><l level="1" sID="gen9054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4993"/>O God <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hosts, restore us<l eID="gen9054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9055"/>and cause your face to shine that we may be saved. <l eID="gen9055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4994"/><l level="1" sID="gen9056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4994"/>You uprooted a vine from Egypt;<l eID="gen9056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9057"/>you drove out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations and planted it. <l eID="gen9057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4995"/><l level="1" sID="gen9058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4995"/>You prepared <transChange type="added">a place</transChange> before it,<l eID="gen9058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9059"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it took deep root⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “its root rooted”</note> and filled <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land. <l eID="gen9059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4996"/><l level="1" sID="gen9060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4996"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> mountains were covered with its shade,<l eID="gen9060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9061"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty cedars <transChange type="added">with</transChange> its boughs. <l eID="gen9061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4997"/><l level="1" sID="gen9062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4997"/>It spread its branches to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea<l eID="gen9062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9063"/>and its shoots to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> river. <l eID="gen9063" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:12
