verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4998"/><l level="1" sID="gen9064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4998"/>Why have you broken down its walls,<l eID="gen9064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9065"/>so that all <transChange type="added">who</transChange> pass on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> road pluck <transChange type="added">fruit from</transChange> it? <l eID="gen9065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4999"/><l level="1" sID="gen9066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4999"/>Swine from the forests devour<note placement="foot">Hebrew “devours”</note> it<l eID="gen9066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9067"/>and creatures of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> field feed on it. <l eID="gen9067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5000"/><l level="1" sID="gen9068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5000"/>Please return, O God <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hosts.<l eID="gen9068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9069"/>Observe from heaven and see,<l eID="gen9069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9070"/>and pay attention to this vine, <l eID="gen9070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5001"/><l level="1" sID="gen9071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5001"/>even<transChange type="added">the</transChange> stalk that your right hand planted,<l eID="gen9071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9072"/>and concerning <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shoot<note placement="foot">Hebrew “son”</note> you strengthened for yourself. <l eID="gen9072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5002"/><l level="1" sID="gen9073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5002"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> burned with fire, cut down.<l eID="gen9073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9074"/>They perish at the rebuke of your face. <l eID="gen9074" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5003"/><l level="1" sID="gen9075"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5003"/>Let your hand be on the man of your right hand,<l eID="gen9075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9076"/>on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> son of humankind <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> you made strong for yourself. <l eID="gen9076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5004"/><l level="1" sID="gen9077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5004"/>Then we will not turn back from you.<l eID="gen9077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9078"/>Restore us to life, and we will proclaim your name. <l eID="gen9078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5005"/><l level="1" sID="gen9079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5005"/>O Yahweh God <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hosts, restore us;<l eID="gen9079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9080"/>cause your face to shine that we may be saved. <l eID="gen9080" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9037"/> <chapter eID="Ps.80"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5006"/><title type="x-s">An Appeal from God to Israel</title> <div sID="gen9081" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9081" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9082"/> <lg eID="gen9082"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director; on the Gittith. Of Asaph.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen9083"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5006"/>Shout out to God our strength;<l eID="gen9084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9085"/>shout joyfully to the God of Jacob. <l eID="gen9085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5007"/><l level="1" sID="gen9086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5007"/>Lift up a song and strike<note placement="foot">Hebrew “give”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tambourine,<l eID="gen9086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9087"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> pleasant lyre, together with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> harp. <l eID="gen9087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5008"/><l level="1" sID="gen9088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5008"/>Blow <transChange type="added">the</transChange> horn at new moon,<l eID="gen9088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9089"/>at full moon, for our feast day, <l eID="gen9089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5009"/><l level="1" sID="gen9090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5009"/>because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a statute for Israel,<l eID="gen9090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9091"/>an ordinance of the God of Jacob. <l eID="gen9091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5010"/><l level="1" sID="gen9092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5010"/>He made it a statute<note placement="foot">Hebrew “testimony” or “witness”</note> in Joseph<l eID="gen9092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9093"/>when he went out against the land of Egypt,<l eID="gen9093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9094"/><transChange type="added">where</transChange> I heard a language I did not know.<note placement="foot">The meaning of this line is uncertain. The above is based on perhaps a similar thought in <reference osisRef="Ps.114.1">Psa 114:1</reference></note> <l eID="gen9094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5011"/><l level="1" sID="gen9095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5011"/>“I removed his shoulder from a burden.<l eID="gen9095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9096"/>His hands were freed from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> basket. <l eID="gen9096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5012"/><l level="1" sID="gen9097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5012"/>In this<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> trouble you called, and I rescued you.<l eID="gen9097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9098"/>Within <transChange type="added">the</transChange> secret place of thunder I answered you;<l eID="gen9098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9099"/>I tested you at the waters of Meribah. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5013"/><l level="1" sID="gen9100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5013"/>Hear, O my people, and I will admonish you;<l eID="gen9100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9101"/>O Israel, if you would <transChange type="added">but</transChange> listen to me. <l eID="gen9101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5014"/><l level="1" sID="gen9102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5014"/>There shall be no strange god among you,<l eID="gen9102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9103"/>and you shall not bow down to a foreign god. <l eID="gen9103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5015"/><l level="1" sID="gen9104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5015"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God,<l eID="gen9104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9105"/>who brought you up from the land of Egypt.<l eID="gen9105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9106"/>Open wide your mouth and I will fill it. <l eID="gen9106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5016"/><l level="1" sID="gen9107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5016"/>But my people did not listen to my voice,<l eID="gen9107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9108"/>and Israel did not yield to me. <l eID="gen9108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5017"/><l level="1" sID="gen9109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5017"/>So I let them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> go in the stubbornness of their heart;<l eID="gen9109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9110"/>they walked in their counsels. <l eID="gen9110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5018"/><l level="1" sID="gen9111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5018"/>Oh that my people would listen to me;<l eID="gen9111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9112"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> Israel would walk in my ways. <l eID="gen9112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5019"/><l level="1" sID="gen9113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5019"/>I would subdue their enemies quickly,<l eID="gen9113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9114"/>and turn my hand against their adversaries. <l eID="gen9114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5020"/><l level="1" sID="gen9115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5020"/>Those who hate Yahweh would cringe before him,<l eID="gen9115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9116"/>and their fate<note placement="foot">Hebrew “time”</note> would be forever. <l eID="gen9116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5021"/><l level="1" sID="gen9117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5021"/>But he would feed him<note placement="foot">That is, Israel</note> from the choicest wheat,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the fat of wheat”</note><l eID="gen9117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9118"/>and I would satisfy you with honey from a rock.” <l eID="gen9118" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9083"/> <chapter eID="Ps.81"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5022"/><title type="x-s">God Commands Justice</title> <div sID="gen9119" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9119" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9120"/> <lg eID="gen9120"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of Asaph.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen9121"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5022"/>God stands in the divine assembly;<note placement="foot">Or “assembly of <hi type="italic">El</hi> ”</note><l eID="gen9122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9123"/>he administers judgment in the midst of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gods.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">elohim</hi></note> <l eID="gen9123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5023"/><l level="1" sID="gen9124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5023"/>“How long will you judge unjustly<l eID="gen9124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9125"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞show favoritism to the wicked⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “lift up the faces of the wicked”</note> <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5024"/><l level="1" sID="gen9126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5024"/>Judge <transChange type="added">on behalf of the</transChange> helpless and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan;<l eID="gen9126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9127"/>provide justice <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> afflicted and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor. <l eID="gen9127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5025"/><l level="1" sID="gen9128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5025"/>Rescue <transChange type="added">the</transChange> helpless and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy;<l eID="gen9128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9129"/>deliver <transChange type="added">them</transChange> from the hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked.” <l eID="gen9129" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5026"/><l level="1" sID="gen9130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5026"/>They do not know or consider.<note placement="foot">Or “understand”</note><l eID="gen9130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9131"/>They go about in the darkness,<l eID="gen9131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9132"/><transChange type="added">so that</transChange> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> foundations of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth are shaken. <l eID="gen9132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5027"/><l level="1" sID="gen9133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5027"/>I have said,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “I, I have said”</note> “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> gods,<l eID="gen9133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9134"/>and sons of the Most High, all of you. <l eID="gen9134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5028"/><l level="1" sID="gen9135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5028"/>However, you will die like men,<note placement="foot">Singular</note><l eID="gen9135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9136"/>and you will fall like one of the princes.” <l eID="gen9136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5029"/><l level="1" sID="gen9137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5029"/>Rise up, O God, judge the earth,<l eID="gen9137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9138"/>because you shall inherit<note placement="foot">Or “receive an inheritance”</note> all the nations. <l eID="gen9138" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9121"/> <chapter eID="Ps.82"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5030"/><title type="x-s">A Request to Act against Israel’s Neighbors</title> <div sID="gen9139" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9139" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9140"/> <lg eID="gen9140"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song. A psalm of Asaph.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen9141"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5030"/>O God, do not rest <transChange type="added">silently</transChange>.<l eID="gen9142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9143"/>Do not keep silent or be still, O God. <l eID="gen9143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5031"/><l level="1" sID="gen9144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5031"/>For look, your enemies roar,<l eID="gen9144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9145"/>and those who hate you have lifted <transChange type="added">their</transChange> head. <l eID="gen9145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5032"/><l level="1" sID="gen9146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5032"/>They devise cunning schemes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “scheme”</note> against your people,<l eID="gen9146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9147"/>and consult together against your protected ones.<note placement="foot">Or “your treasured ones”</note> <l eID="gen9147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5033"/><l level="1" sID="gen9148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5033"/>They say, “Come, let us annihilate them from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> a nation,<l eID="gen9148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9149"/>so that the name of Israel will be remembered no more.” <l eID="gen9149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5034"/><l level="1" sID="gen9150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5034"/>For they have consulted together <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with a unified purpose⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with a heart together”</note><l eID="gen9150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9151"/>They have made a covenant against you: <l eID="gen9151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5035"/><l level="1" sID="gen9152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5035"/>the tents of Edom and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Ishmaelites,<l eID="gen9152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9153"/>Moab and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Hagrites, <l eID="gen9153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5036"/><l level="1" sID="gen9154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5036"/>Gebal and Ammon and Amalek,<l eID="gen9154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9155"/>Philistia, with the inhabitants of Tyre. <l eID="gen9155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5037"/><l level="1" sID="gen9156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5037"/>Assyria also has joined with them.<l eID="gen9156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9157"/>They <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞provide help⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they have become an arm for”</note> to the children of Lot. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5038"/><l level="1" sID="gen9158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5038"/>Do to them as <transChange type="added">you did with</transChange> Midian,<l eID="gen9158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9159"/>as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> Sisera, as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> Jabin at the wadi of Kishon. <l eID="gen9159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5039"/><l level="1" sID="gen9160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5039"/>They were destroyed at En-dor;<l eID="gen9160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9161"/>they became dung for the ground. <l eID="gen9161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5040"/><l level="1" sID="gen9162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5040"/>Make their leaders like Oreb and Zeeb,<l eID="gen9162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9163"/>and all their chiefs like Zebah and Zalmunna, <l eID="gen9163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5041"/><l level="1" sID="gen9164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5041"/>who said, “Let us take <transChange type="added">as</transChange> our possession<l eID="gen9164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9165"/>the pastures of God.” <l eID="gen9165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5042"/><l level="1" sID="gen9166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5042"/>O my God, make them like the tumbleweed,<l eID="gen9166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9167"/>like the chaff before wind. <l eID="gen9167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5043"/><l level="1" sID="gen9168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5043"/>As fire burns a forest,<l eID="gen9168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9169"/>and as a flame sets afire mountains, <l eID="gen9169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5044"/><l level="1" sID="gen9170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5044"/>so pursue them with your tempest<l eID="gen9170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9171"/>and terrify them with your storm. <l eID="gen9171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5045"/><l level="1" sID="gen9172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5045"/>Fill their faces with shame,<l eID="gen9172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9173"/>that they may seek your name, O Yahweh. <l eID="gen9173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5046"/><l level="1" sID="gen9174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5046"/>Let them be ashamed and terrified forever,<l eID="gen9174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9175"/>and let them be humiliated and perish <l eID="gen9175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5047"/><l level="1" sID="gen9176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5047"/>that they may know that you,<l eID="gen9176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9177"/><transChange type="added">whose</transChange> name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh, you alone,<l eID="gen9177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9178"/><transChange type="added">are the</transChange> Most High over the whole earth. <l eID="gen9178" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9141"/> <chapter eID="Ps.83"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5048"/><title type="x-s">The Joy of Worshiping in the Temple</title> <div sID="gen9179" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9179" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9180"/> <lg eID="gen9180"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director; on the Gittith.</title> <lg sID="gen9181"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9182"/>Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen9182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5048"/>How lovely <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your dwelling places,<l eID="gen9183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9184"/>O Yahweh of hosts! <l eID="gen9184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5049"/><l level="1" sID="gen9185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5049"/>My soul longs and even fails<l eID="gen9185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9186"/>for the courtyards of Yahweh.<l eID="gen9186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9187"/>My heart and flesh sing for joy<l eID="gen9187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9188"/>to the living God. <l eID="gen9188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5050"/><l level="1" sID="gen9189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5050"/>Even a bird finds a home, and a swallow a nest for herself,<l eID="gen9189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9190"/>where she may lay her young,<l eID="gen9190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9191"/>near your altars, O Yahweh <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hosts,<l eID="gen9191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9192"/>my king and my God. <l eID="gen9192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5051"/><l level="1" sID="gen9193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5051"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> those who dwell in your house;<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note><l eID="gen9193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9194"/>they can ever praise you. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5052"/><l level="1" sID="gen9195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5052"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> man whose strength <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in you;<l eID="gen9195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9196"/>in their heart <transChange type="added">are the</transChange> highways <transChange type="added">to Zion</transChange>. <l eID="gen9196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5053"/><l level="1" sID="gen9197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5053"/>Passing through the Valley of Baca,<note placement="foot">Or “Valley of Weeping”</note><l eID="gen9197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9198"/>they make it a spring.<l eID="gen9198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9199"/>The early rain covers <transChange type="added">it with</transChange> blessings<note placement="foot">A change in vocalization of the Hebrew yields “it with pools”</note> as well. <l eID="gen9199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5054"/><l level="1" sID="gen9200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5054"/>They go from strength to strength,<l eID="gen9200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9201"/><transChange type="added">until each</transChange> appears before God in Zion.<note placement="foot">Or “the God of gods will be seen in Zion”</note> <l eID="gen9201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5055"/><l level="1" sID="gen9202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5055"/>O Yahweh, God of hosts, hear my prayer;<l eID="gen9202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9203"/>give ear, O God of Jacob. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5056"/><l level="1" sID="gen9204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5056"/>Look at our shield, O God,<l eID="gen9204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9205"/>and have regard for the face of your anointed one. <l eID="gen9205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5057"/><l level="1" sID="gen9206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5057"/>Because better <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a day in your courtyards<l eID="gen9206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9207"/>than a thousand <transChange type="added">elsewhere</transChange>.<l eID="gen9207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9208"/>I would rather be at the threshold of the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of my God<l eID="gen9208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9209"/>than to dwell in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tents of wickedness. <l eID="gen9209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5058"/><l level="1" sID="gen9210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5058"/>Because Yahweh God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sun and a shield;<l eID="gen9210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9211"/>Yahweh gives grace and honor.<l eID="gen9211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9212"/>He does not withhold good from those who walk blamelessly. <l eID="gen9212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5059"/><l level="1" sID="gen9213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5059"/>O Yahweh <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hosts,<l eID="gen9213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9214"/>blessed <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> man who trusts you. <l eID="gen9214" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9181"/> <chapter eID="Ps.84"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5060"/><title type="x-s">Hope in God’s Future Help</title> <div sID="gen9215" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9215" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9216"/> <lg eID="gen9216"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen9217"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5060"/>O Yahweh, you favored your land.<l eID="gen9218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9219"/>You restored the fortunes<note placement="foot">Or “captivity”</note> of Jacob. <l eID="gen9219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5061"/><l level="1" sID="gen9220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5061"/>You took away the guilt<note placement="foot">Or “You forgave the iniquity”</note> of your people;<l eID="gen9220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9221"/>you covered all their sin. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5062"/><l level="1" sID="gen9222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5062"/>You withdrew all your wrath;<l eID="gen9222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9223"/>you turned from your burning anger. <l eID="gen9223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5063"/><l level="1" sID="gen9224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5063"/>Restore us, O God of our salvation,<l eID="gen9224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9225"/>and annul your vexation with us. <l eID="gen9225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5064"/><l level="1" sID="gen9226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5064"/>Will you be angry against us forever?<l eID="gen9226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9227"/>Will you prolong your anger generation after generation? <l eID="gen9227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5065"/><l level="1" sID="gen9228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5065"/>Will you not again revive us,<l eID="gen9228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9229"/>that your people might rejoice in you? <l eID="gen9229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5066"/><l level="1" sID="gen9230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5066"/>Show us, O Yahweh, your loyal love,<l eID="gen9230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9231"/>and grant us your salvation. <l eID="gen9231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5067"/><l level="1" sID="gen9232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5067"/>I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak,<l eID="gen9232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9233"/>because he will speak peace<l eID="gen9233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9234"/>to his people, even his faithful <transChange type="added">ones</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and to his faithful”</note><l eID="gen9234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9235"/>but let them not return to folly. <l eID="gen9235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5068"/><l level="1" sID="gen9236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5068"/>Surely his salvation <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near for those who fear him,<l eID="gen9236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9237"/>that glory may abide in our land. <l eID="gen9237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5069"/><l level="1" sID="gen9238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5069"/>Loyal love and faithfulness<note placement="foot">Or “truth”</note> will meet one another;<l eID="gen9238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9239"/>righteousness and peace will kiss. <l eID="gen9239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5070"/><l level="1" sID="gen9240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5070"/>Faithfulness<note placement="foot">Or “Truth”</note> will sprout from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ground,<l eID="gen9240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9241"/>and righteousness will look down from heaven. <l eID="gen9241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5071"/><l level="1" sID="gen9242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5071"/>Yes, Yahweh will give <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> good,<l eID="gen9242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9243"/>and our land will give its produce. <l eID="gen9243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5072"/><l level="1" sID="gen9244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5072"/>Righteousness will go before him,<l eID="gen9244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9245"/>and it will make his steps a pathway. <l eID="gen9245" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9217"/> <chapter eID="Ps.85"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5073"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Help against Ruthless Men</title> <div sID="gen9246" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9246" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9247"/> <lg eID="gen9247"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A prayer of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen9248"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5073"/>Incline, O Yahweh, your ear <transChange type="added">and</transChange> answer me,<l eID="gen9249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9250"/>because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> poor and needy. <l eID="gen9250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5074"/><l level="1" sID="gen9251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5074"/>Watch over my life because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> faithful.<l eID="gen9251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9252"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my God; save your servant.<l eID="gen9252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9253"/><transChange type="added">I am</transChange> the one who trusts you. <l eID="gen9253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5075"/><l level="1" sID="gen9254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5075"/>Be gracious to me, O Lord,<l eID="gen9254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9255"/>because I call to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all day long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all the day”</note> <l eID="gen9255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5076"/><l level="1" sID="gen9256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5076"/>Make glad the soul of your servant,<l eID="gen9256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9257"/>because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I desire you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I lift up my soul to you”</note> O Lord. <l eID="gen9257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5077"/><l level="1" sID="gen9258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5077"/>For you, O Lord, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> good and forgiving,<l eID="gen9258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9259"/>and abundant in loyal love<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and great with respect to loyal love”</note> for all who call to you. <l eID="gen9259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5078"/><l level="1" sID="gen9260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5078"/>Heed, O Yahweh, my prayer,<l eID="gen9260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9261"/>and attend to the voice of my supplications. <l eID="gen9261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5079"/><l level="1" sID="gen9262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5079"/>In the day of my trouble I call to you,<l eID="gen9262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9263"/>because you answer me. <l eID="gen9263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5080"/><l level="1" sID="gen9264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5080"/>There is none like you among the gods, O Lord,<l eID="gen9264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9265"/>and there are no works like yours. <l eID="gen9265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5081"/><l level="1" sID="gen9266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5081"/>All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations that you have made will come<l eID="gen9266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9267"/>and bow down<note placement="foot">Or “worship”</note> before you, O Lord,<l eID="gen9267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9268"/>and glorify your name. <l eID="gen9268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5082"/><l level="1" sID="gen9269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5082"/>For you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> great and doing wondrous things;<l eID="gen9269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9270"/>you alone <transChange type="added">are</transChange> God. <l eID="gen9270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5083"/><l level="1" sID="gen9271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5083"/>Teach me, O Yahweh, your way,<l eID="gen9271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9272"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> I may walk in your truth.<l eID="gen9272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9273"/>Unite my heart<note placement="foot">That is, give singleness of heart</note> to fear your name. <l eID="gen9273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5084"/><l level="1" sID="gen9274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5084"/>I will give you thanks, O Lord my God, with all my heart,<l eID="gen9274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9275"/>and glorify your name forever, <l eID="gen9275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5085"/><l level="1" sID="gen9276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5085"/>because your loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great toward me,<l eID="gen9276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9277"/>and you will have delivered my life from Sheol<note placement="foot">The nether world, the place of departed spirits.</note> below. <l eID="gen9277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5086"/><l level="1" sID="gen9278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5086"/>O God, arrogant men have risen up against me,<l eID="gen9278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9279"/>even a gang of ruthless men seek my life,<l eID="gen9279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9280"/>but they do not set you before them.<note placement="foot">That is, they do not factor God into their actions</note> <l eID="gen9280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5087"/><l level="1" sID="gen9281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5087"/>But you, O Lord, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a compassionate and gracious God,<l eID="gen9281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9282"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞slow to anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “long of nostrils”</note> and abundant in loyal love and faithfulness. <l eID="gen9282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5088"/><l level="1" sID="gen9283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5088"/>Turn to me and be gracious to me.<l eID="gen9283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9284"/>Give your strength to your servant,<l eID="gen9284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9285"/>and grant victory to the son<note placement="foot">Or “Save the son”</note> of your maidservant. <l eID="gen9285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5089"/><l level="1" sID="gen9286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5089"/>Do a sign <transChange type="added">that</transChange> benefits me,<l eID="gen9286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9287"/>that those who hate me may see and be put to shame,<l eID="gen9287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9288"/>because you, O Yahweh, have helped me and comforted me. <l eID="gen9288" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9248"/> <chapter eID="Ps.86"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5090"/><title type="x-s">Foreign Nations Come to Worship in Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen9289" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9289" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9290"/> <lg eID="gen9290"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. A song.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen9291"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5090"/>His foundation <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy mountains. <l eID="gen9292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5091"/><l level="1" sID="gen9293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5091"/>Yahweh loves the gates of Zion<l eID="gen9293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9294"/>more than all the dwellings of Jacob. <l eID="gen9294" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5092"/><l level="1" sID="gen9295"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5092"/>Glorious things <transChange type="added">are</transChange> spoken about<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> you,<l eID="gen9295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9296"/>O city of God. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5093"/><l level="1" sID="gen9297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5093"/>I will record<note placement="foot">Or “mention”</note> those who know me<l eID="gen9297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9298"/><transChange type="added">in</transChange> Rahab<note placement="foot">That is, Egypt; compare <reference osisRef="Isa.30.7">Isa 30:7</reference></note> and Babylon,<l eID="gen9298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9299"/>behold <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Philistia and Tyre with Cush,<l eID="gen9299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9300"/>“This one was born there.” <l eID="gen9300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5094"/><l level="1" sID="gen9301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5094"/>But with respect to Zion it shall be said,<l eID="gen9301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9302"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Each one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “A man and a man”</note> was born in her,”<l eID="gen9302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9303"/>for the Most High himself will establish her. <l eID="gen9303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5095"/><l level="1" sID="gen9304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5095"/>Yahweh will record in writing <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen9304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9305"/>“This <transChange type="added">one</transChange> was born there.” <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5096"/><l level="1" sID="gen9306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5096"/>And while dancing, singers <transChange type="added">will sing</transChange>,<l eID="gen9306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9307"/>“All my springs <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in you.” <l eID="gen9307" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9291"/> <chapter eID="Ps.87"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5097"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Help in Despair</title> <div sID="gen9308" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9308" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9309"/> <lg eID="gen9309"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah.</title> <lg sID="gen9310"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9311"/>For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director; according to Mahalath Leannoth.<l eID="gen9311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9312"/>A maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen9312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5097"/>O Yahweh, God of my salvation,<l eID="gen9313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9314"/>I cry out by day <transChange type="added">and</transChange> through the night before you. <l eID="gen9314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5098"/><l level="1" sID="gen9315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5098"/>Let my prayer come before you;<l eID="gen9315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9316"/>incline your ear to my cry. <l eID="gen9316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5099"/><l level="1" sID="gen9317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5099"/>For my soul is full with troubles,<l eID="gen9317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9318"/>and my life approaches Sheol. <l eID="gen9318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5100"/><l level="1" sID="gen9319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5100"/>I am reckoned with <transChange type="added">those</transChange> descending to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit.<l eID="gen9319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9320"/>I am like a man<note placement="foot">The Hebrew suggests a strong, vigorous man</note> without strength,<note placement="foot">Or “without help”</note> <l eID="gen9320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5101"/><l level="1" sID="gen9321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5101"/>set free<note placement="foot">Or “forsaken”</note> among the dead,<l eID="gen9321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9322"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slain lying in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grave,<l eID="gen9322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9323"/>whom you no longer remember,<l eID="gen9323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9324"/>even those cut off from your hand. <l eID="gen9324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5102"/><l level="1" sID="gen9325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5102"/>You have set me in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit below,<l eID="gen9325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9326"/>in dark places, in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths. <l eID="gen9326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5103"/><l level="1" sID="gen9327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5103"/>Your wrath presses upon me,<l eID="gen9327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9328"/>and you afflict <transChange type="added">me with</transChange> all your waves. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5104"/><l level="1" sID="gen9329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5104"/>You have removed my acquaintances far from me.<l eID="gen9329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9330"/>You have made me detestable<note placement="foot">Hebrew “an abomination”</note> to them.<l eID="gen9330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9331"/><transChange type="added">I am</transChange> confined and cannot go out. <l eID="gen9331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5105"/><l level="1" sID="gen9332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5105"/>My eye languishes from misery.<l eID="gen9332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9333"/>I call on you, O Yahweh, every day;<l eID="gen9333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9334"/>I spread out my hands<note placement="foot">Hebrew “palms”</note> to you. <l eID="gen9334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5106"/><l level="1" sID="gen9335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5106"/>Do you work wonders<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wonder”</note> for the dead?<l eID="gen9335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9336"/>Or do <transChange type="added">the</transChange> departed spirits<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">rephaim</hi>, sometimes translated “shades”; the weakened state of those who have died</note> rise up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> praise you? <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5107"/><l level="1" sID="gen9337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5107"/>Is your loyal love told in the grave,<l eID="gen9337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9338"/><transChange type="added">or</transChange> your faithfulness in the underworld?<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">abaddon</hi>, the place of destruction</note> <l eID="gen9338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5108"/><l level="1" sID="gen9339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5108"/>Are your wonders<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wonder”</note> known in the darkness,<l eID="gen9339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9340"/><transChange type="added">or</transChange> your righteousness<note placement="foot">Or “deed of justice”</note> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of forgetfulness? <l eID="gen9340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5109"/><l level="1" sID="gen9341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5109"/>But as for me, I cry for help to you, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen9341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9342"/>and in the morning my prayer comes before you. <l eID="gen9342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5110"/><l level="1" sID="gen9343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5110"/>Why do you reject my soul, O Yahweh?<l eID="gen9343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9344"/><transChange type="added">Why</transChange> do you hide your face from me? <l eID="gen9344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5111"/><l level="1" sID="gen9345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5111"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> afflicted and perishing from <transChange type="added">my</transChange> youth.<l eID="gen9345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9346"/>I bear your terrors. I am distraught.<note placement="foot">Hebrew meaning uncertain</note> <l eID="gen9346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5112"/><l level="1" sID="gen9347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5112"/>Your burning anger has passed over me;<l eID="gen9347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9348"/>your sudden fears have destroyed me. <l eID="gen9348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5113"/><l level="1" sID="gen9349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5113"/>They surround me like water all the day;<l eID="gen9349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9350"/>they circle about me altogether. <l eID="gen9350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5114"/><l level="1" sID="gen9351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5114"/>You have removed loved one and friend far from me,<l eID="gen9351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9352"/>my acquaintances <transChange type="added">far from my</transChange> darkness. <l eID="gen9352" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9310"/> <chapter eID="Ps.88"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5115"/><title type="x-s">Remembering the Covenant with David, and Sorrow for Lost Blessings</title> <div sID="gen9353" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9353" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9354"/> <lg eID="gen9354"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen9355"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5115"/>I will sing forever of Yahweh’s acts of loyal love.<l eID="gen9356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9357"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞From generation to generation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To a generation and a generation”</note><l eID="gen9357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9358"/>I will make known your faithfulness with my mouth. <l eID="gen9358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5116"/><l level="1" sID="gen9359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5116"/>For I say, “Forever <transChange type="added">your</transChange> loyal love is built up.<l eID="gen9359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9360"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> heavens you have established <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your faithfulness in them.” <l eID="gen9360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5117"/><l level="1" sID="gen9361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5117"/>“I made a covenant with my chosen one;<l eID="gen9361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9362"/>I swore <transChange type="added">an oath</transChange> to David my servant: <l eID="gen9362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5118"/><l level="1" sID="gen9363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5118"/>‘I will establish your descendants forever,<l eID="gen9363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9364"/>and I will build up your throne <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from generation to generation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “To a generation and a generation”</note> <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5119"/><l level="1" sID="gen9365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5119"/>And <transChange type="added">so the</transChange> heavens will praise your wonderful deed, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen9365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9366"/>even your faithfulness, in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> assembly of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy ones. <l eID="gen9366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5120"/><l level="1" sID="gen9367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5120"/>For who in the sky<note placement="foot">Hebrew singular collective “clouds”</note> is equal to Yahweh?<l eID="gen9367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9368"/><transChange type="added">Who is</transChange> like Yahweh among the sons of God, <l eID="gen9368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5121"/><l level="1" sID="gen9369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5121"/>a God feared greatly in the council of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy ones,<l eID="gen9369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9370"/>and awesome above all surrounding him? <l eID="gen9370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5122"/><l level="1" sID="gen9371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5122"/>O Yahweh God <transChange type="added">of</transChange> hosts,<l eID="gen9371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9372"/>who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mighty like you, O Yah,<l eID="gen9372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9373"/>with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> your faithfulness surrounding you? <l eID="gen9373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5123"/><l level="1" sID="gen9374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5123"/>You are ruling the surging of the sea.<l eID="gen9374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9375"/>When its waves rise, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you yourself still⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you, you calm”</note> them. <l eID="gen9375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5124"/><l level="1" sID="gen9376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5124"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You yourself crushed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “You, you crushed”</note> Rahab like one <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> slain;<l eID="gen9376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9377"/>you scattered your enemies with your strong arm. <l eID="gen9377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5125"/><l level="1" sID="gen9378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5125"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> heavens are yours, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth yours as well,<l eID="gen9378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9379"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> world with its fullness, <transChange type="added">because</transChange> you founded them. <l eID="gen9379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5126"/><l level="1" sID="gen9380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5126"/>North and south, you created them;<l eID="gen9380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9381"/>Tabor and Hermon shout joyfully over your name. <l eID="gen9381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5127"/><l level="1" sID="gen9382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5127"/>You have a mighty arm;<l eID="gen9382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9383"/>Your hand is strong; your right hand reaches high. <l eID="gen9383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5128"/><l level="1" sID="gen9384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5128"/>Righteousness and justice <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the foundation of your throne.<l eID="gen9384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9385"/>Loyal love and faithfulness<note placement="foot">Or “truth”</note> come before your face.<note placement="foot">That is, enjoy continual access</note> <l eID="gen9385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5129"/><l level="1" sID="gen9386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5129"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the people who know <transChange type="added">the</transChange> joyful shout;<l eID="gen9386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9387"/>O Yahweh, they walk about in the light of your countenance. <l eID="gen9387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5130"/><l level="1" sID="gen9388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5130"/>In your name they rejoice all the day,<l eID="gen9388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9389"/>and in your righteousness they rise up. <l eID="gen9389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5131"/><l level="1" sID="gen9390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5131"/>For you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the glory of their strength,<l eID="gen9390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9391"/>and by your favor our horn rises up,<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>). The <hi type="italic">Kethib</hi> reads “you exalt our horn”</note> <l eID="gen9391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5132"/><l level="1" sID="gen9392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5132"/>because our shield belongs to Yahweh,<note placement="foot">Or “Yahweh is our shield.”</note><l eID="gen9392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9393"/>and our king to the Holy One of Israel.<note placement="foot">Or “The Holy One of Israel is our king.”</note> <l eID="gen9393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5133"/><l level="1" sID="gen9394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5133"/>Formerly you spoke in a vision<l eID="gen9394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9395"/>to your faithful ones, and said,<l eID="gen9395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9396"/>“I have bestowed help on a mighty man;<l eID="gen9396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9397"/>I have exalted one chosen from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people. <l eID="gen9397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5134"/><l level="1" sID="gen9398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5134"/>I have found David, my servant.<l eID="gen9398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9399"/>With my holy oil I have anointed him, <l eID="gen9399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5135"/><l level="1" sID="gen9400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5135"/>with whom my hand will be steadfast.<l eID="gen9400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9401"/>Surely my arm will strengthen him. <l eID="gen9401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5136"/><l level="1" sID="gen9402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5136"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> enemy will not deceive him,<l eID="gen9402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9403"/>and no <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞evil man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of wickedness”</note> will afflict him. <l eID="gen9403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5137"/><l level="1" sID="gen9404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5137"/>But I will crush his adversaries before him,<l eID="gen9404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9405"/>and I will strike those who hate him. <l eID="gen9405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5138"/><l level="1" sID="gen9406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5138"/>And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> my faithfulness<l eID="gen9406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9407"/>and my loyal love <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> with him,<l eID="gen9407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9408"/>and in my name his horn will rise up. <l eID="gen9408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5139"/><l level="1" sID="gen9409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5139"/>And I will set his hand on the sea<l eID="gen9409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9410"/>and his right hand on the rivers. <l eID="gen9410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5140"/><l level="1" sID="gen9411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5140"/>He will call out <transChange type="added">to</transChange> me, ‘You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my Father,<l eID="gen9411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9412"/>my God, and the rock of my salvation.’ <l eID="gen9412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5141"/><l level="1" sID="gen9413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5141"/>I will also make him <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstborn,<l eID="gen9413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9414"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> highest of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen9414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5142"/><l level="1" sID="gen9415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5142"/>Forever I will keep my loyal love for him,<l eID="gen9415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9416"/>and my covenant <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> reliable for him. <l eID="gen9416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5143"/><l level="1" sID="gen9417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5143"/>I will also establish his offspring forever,<l eID="gen9417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9418"/>and his throne as <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens. <l eID="gen9418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5144"/><l level="1" sID="gen9419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5144"/>If his sons forsake my law<l eID="gen9419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9420"/>and do not walk in my judgments, <l eID="gen9420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5145"/><l level="1" sID="gen9421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5145"/>if they defile<note placement="foot">Hebrew “profane; treat as common”</note> my statutes<l eID="gen9421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9422"/>and do not keep my commandments, <l eID="gen9422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5146"/><l level="1" sID="gen9423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5146"/>then I will punish their transgression with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> rod,<l eID="gen9423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9424"/>and their guilt with wounds. <l eID="gen9424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5147"/><l level="1" sID="gen9425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5147"/>But I will not break off my loyal love from him,<l eID="gen9425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9426"/>and I will not be false against my faithfulness. <l eID="gen9426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5148"/><l level="1" sID="gen9427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5148"/>I will not defile<note placement="foot">Hebrew “profane; treat as common”</note> my covenant,<l eID="gen9427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9428"/>or alter what proceeded from my lips. <l eID="gen9428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5149"/><l level="1" sID="gen9429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5149"/>Once<note placement="foot">Hebrew “One”</note> I have sworn by my holiness,<l eID="gen9429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9430"/>‘I will surely not lie to David, <l eID="gen9430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5150"/><l level="1" sID="gen9431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5150"/>His offspring will endure<note placement="foot">Hebrew “be”</note> forever,<l eID="gen9431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9432"/>and his throne as the sun before me. <l eID="gen9432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5151"/><l level="1" sID="gen9433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5151"/>Like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moon it will be steadfast forever,<l eID="gen9433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9434"/>and <transChange type="added">like</transChange> an enduring witness in the sky.’ ” <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5152"/><l level="1" sID="gen9435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5152"/>But you have spurned and rejected;<l eID="gen9435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9436"/>you are very angry with your anointed one. <l eID="gen9436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5153"/><l level="1" sID="gen9437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5153"/>You have repudiated the covenant with your servant;<l eID="gen9437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9438"/>you have defiled<note placement="foot">Hebrew “profane; treat as common”</note> his crown in<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> the dirt. <l eID="gen9438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5154"/><l level="1" sID="gen9439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5154"/>You have broken down all his walls;<l eID="gen9439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9440"/>you have made his fortifications a ruin. <l eID="gen9440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5155"/><l level="1" sID="gen9441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5155"/>All passing along <transChange type="added">the</transChange> road plunder him;<l eID="gen9441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9442"/>he has become a taunt to his neighbors. <l eID="gen9442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5156"/><l level="1" sID="gen9443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5156"/>You have raised the right hand<note placement="foot">That is, given them victory</note> of his adversaries.<l eID="gen9443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9444"/>You have made all his enemies rejoice. <l eID="gen9444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5157"/><l level="1" sID="gen9445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5157"/>You have also turned back the edge of his sword<l eID="gen9445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9446"/>and have not helped him stand <transChange type="added">his ground</transChange> in the battle. <l eID="gen9446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5158"/><l level="1" sID="gen9447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5158"/>You have made his splendor to cease,<l eID="gen9447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9448"/>and cast his throne to the ground. <l eID="gen9448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5159"/><l level="1" sID="gen9449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5159"/>You have cut short the days of his youth;<l eID="gen9449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9450"/>you have covered him with shame. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5160"/><l level="1" sID="gen9451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5160"/>How long, O Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever?<l eID="gen9451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9452"/>Will your wrath burn like fire <transChange type="added">forever</transChange>? <l eID="gen9452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5161"/><l level="1" sID="gen9453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5161"/>Remember what my lifespan <transChange type="added">is</transChange>.<l eID="gen9453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9454"/><transChange type="added">Remember</transChange> for what vanity<l eID="gen9454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9455"/>you have created all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of humankind. <l eID="gen9455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5162"/><l level="1" sID="gen9456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5162"/>What man can live <transChange type="added">on</transChange> and not see death?<l eID="gen9456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9457"/>Can he deliver his life from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand””</note> of Sheol? <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen9457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5163"/><l level="1" sID="gen9458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5163"/>Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your former acts of loyal love, O Lord,<l eID="gen9458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9459"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> you swore to David by your faithfulness? <l eID="gen9459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5164"/><l level="1" sID="gen9460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5164"/>Remember, O Lord the taunting of your servants,<l eID="gen9460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9461"/><transChange type="added">how</transChange> I bear in my bosom <transChange type="added">the taunts of</transChange> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> many peoples, <l eID="gen9461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5165"/><l level="1" sID="gen9462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5165"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange> which your enemies taunt, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen9462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9463"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange> which they taunt the steps of your anointed one. <l eID="gen9463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5166"/><l level="1" sID="gen9464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5166"/>Blessed be Yahweh forever.<l eID="gen9464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9465"/>Amen and Amen. <l eID="gen9465" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9355"/> <chapter eID="Ps.89"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5167"/><title type="x-s">God’s Eternity and Human Frailty</title> <div sID="gen9466" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9466" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9467"/> <lg eID="gen9467"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A prayer of Moses, the man of God.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen9468"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5167"/>O Lord, you have been our help<note placement="foot">Or “dwelling place”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in all generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in a generation and a generation”</note> <l eID="gen9469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:2
