verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5168"/><l level="1" sID="gen9470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5168"/>Before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains were born<l eID="gen9470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9471"/>and you brought forth <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world,<l eID="gen9471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9472"/>even from everlasting to everlasting, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> God. <l eID="gen9472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5169"/><l level="1" sID="gen9473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5169"/>You return man to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust,<l eID="gen9473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9474"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and you say”</note> “Return, O sons of man.” <l eID="gen9474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5170"/><l level="1" sID="gen9475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5170"/>For a thousand years in your eyes<l eID="gen9475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9476"/><transChange type="added">are</transChange> like yesterday when it passes,<l eID="gen9476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9477"/>or <transChange type="added">like</transChange> a watch in the night. <l eID="gen9477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5171"/><l level="1" sID="gen9478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5171"/>You sweep them away <transChange type="added">like a flood</transChange>.<l eID="gen9478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9479"/>They fall asleep.<note placement="foot">The interpretation of 5a is difficult</note><l eID="gen9479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9480"/>In the morning <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> like grass <transChange type="added">that</transChange> sprouts anew. <l eID="gen9480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5172"/><l level="1" sID="gen9481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5172"/>In the morning it blossoms and sprouts anew;<l eID="gen9481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9482"/>by evening it withers and dries up. <l eID="gen9482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5173"/><l level="1" sID="gen9483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5173"/>For we are brought to an end by your anger,<l eID="gen9483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9484"/>and we hasten <transChange type="added">off</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “we are terrified”</note> by your wrath. <l eID="gen9484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5174"/><l level="1" sID="gen9485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5174"/>You have put our iniquities before you,<l eID="gen9485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9486"/>our hidden <transChange type="added">sins</transChange> into the light of your countenance. <l eID="gen9486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5175"/><l level="1" sID="gen9487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5175"/>For all of our days dwindle away in your rage;<l eID="gen9487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9488"/>we complete our years like a sigh. <l eID="gen9488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5176"/><l level="1" sID="gen9489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5176"/>As for the days of our years, within them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> seventy years<l eID="gen9489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9490"/>or if by strength eighty years, and their pride<note placement="foot">Or “span”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> trouble and disaster,<l eID="gen9490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9491"/>for it passes quickly and we fly <transChange type="added">away</transChange>. <l eID="gen9491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5177"/><l level="1" sID="gen9492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5177"/>Who knows the strength of your anger,<l eID="gen9492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9493"/>and your rage consistent with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “according to”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fear due you? <l eID="gen9493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5178"/><l level="1" sID="gen9494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5178"/>So teach <transChange type="added">us</transChange> to number our days<l eID="gen9494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9495"/>that we may gain a heart of wisdom. <l eID="gen9495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5179"/><l level="1" sID="gen9496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5179"/>Return,<note placement="foot">Or “Turn back your wrath”</note> O Yahweh. How long?<l eID="gen9496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9497"/>And have compassion on<note placement="foot">Or “change your mind concerning”</note> your servants. <l eID="gen9497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5180"/><l level="1" sID="gen9498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5180"/>Satisfy us in the morning with your loyal love,<l eID="gen9498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9499"/>that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days. <l eID="gen9499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5181"/><l level="1" sID="gen9500"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5181"/>Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us,<l eID="gen9500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9501"/><transChange type="added">for as many</transChange> years <transChange type="added">as</transChange> we have seen calamity. <l eID="gen9501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5182"/><l level="1" sID="gen9502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5182"/>Let your work be visible to your servants,<l eID="gen9502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9503"/>and your majesty to their children. <l eID="gen9503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5183"/><l level="1" sID="gen9504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5183"/>And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us,<l eID="gen9504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9505"/>and establish for us the work of our hands,<l eID="gen9505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9506"/>yes, the work of our hands, establish it. <l eID="gen9506" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9468"/> <chapter eID="Ps.90"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5184"/><title type="x-s">God’s Protection in Times of Crisis</title> <div sID="gen9507" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9507" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9508"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5184"/><transChange type="added">One who</transChange> lives in the secret place<note placement="foot">Or “shelter”</note> of the Most High<l eID="gen9509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9510"/>will lodge in the shadow of Shaddai.<note placement="foot">Often translated “the Almighty,” this is perhaps better understood as “God of the Mountain”</note> <l eID="gen9510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5185"/><l level="1" sID="gen9511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5185"/>I will say to Yahweh, “<transChange type="added">You are</transChange> my refuge and my fortress,<l eID="gen9511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9512"/>my God <transChange type="added">in whom</transChange> I trust.” <l eID="gen9512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5186"/><l level="1" sID="gen9513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5186"/>For he will deliver<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he, he will deliver” is perhaps emphatic, “He will certainly deliver”</note> you from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> snare of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fowler,<l eID="gen9513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9514"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> plague of destruction. <l eID="gen9514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5187"/><l level="1" sID="gen9515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5187"/>With his feathers he will cover you,<l eID="gen9515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9516"/>and under his wings you can take refuge.<l eID="gen9516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9517"/>His faithfulness <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> a shield and a buckler.<note placement="foot">That is, a small, round shield, or perhaps a surrounding bulwark</note> <l eID="gen9517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5188"/><l level="1" sID="gen9518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5188"/>You need not fear <transChange type="added">the</transChange> terror of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night,<l eID="gen9518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9519"/><transChange type="added">or the</transChange> arrow <transChange type="added">that</transChange> flies by day, <l eID="gen9519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5189"/><l level="1" sID="gen9520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5189"/><transChange type="added">or the</transChange> plague <transChange type="added">that</transChange> spreads in the darkness,<l eID="gen9520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9521"/><transChange type="added">or the</transChange> destruction <transChange type="added">that</transChange> devastates at noon. <l eID="gen9521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5190"/><l level="1" sID="gen9522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5190"/>A thousand may fall at your side,<l eID="gen9522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9523"/>and ten thousand at your right <transChange type="added">hand</transChange>,<l eID="gen9523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9524"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> it will not come near you. <l eID="gen9524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5191"/><l level="1" sID="gen9525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5191"/>You will only look with your eyes,<l eID="gen9525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9526"/>and see <transChange type="added">the</transChange> punishment of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked. <l eID="gen9526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5192"/><l level="1" sID="gen9527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5192"/>For you, O Yahweh, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my refuge.<l eID="gen9527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9528"/>You have made the Most High your dwelling place.<note placement="foot">This is the most straightforward translation of the Hebrew, though the “you” of each line would refer to a different person. A more unusual rendering would be “Because Yahweh, my refuge, even the Most High, you have made your dwelling place …”</note> <l eID="gen9528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5193"/><l level="1" sID="gen9529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5193"/>No harm will befall you,<l eID="gen9529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9530"/>and no plague will come near your tent. <l eID="gen9530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5194"/><l level="1" sID="gen9531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5194"/>For he will command his angels concerning you,<l eID="gen9531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9532"/>to watch over you in all your ways. <l eID="gen9532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5195"/><l level="1" sID="gen9533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5195"/>In <transChange type="added">their</transChange> hands they will bear you up,<l eID="gen9533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9534"/>lest you strike your foot against a stone. <l eID="gen9534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5196"/><l level="1" sID="gen9535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5196"/>You will tread on lion and viper;<l eID="gen9535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9536"/>you will trample young lion and serpent. <l eID="gen9536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5197"/><l level="1" sID="gen9537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5197"/>Because he loves me, therefore I will deliver him;<l eID="gen9537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9538"/>I will protect<note placement="foot">The sense is that of making something inaccessibly high, like a fortress</note> him because he knows my name. <l eID="gen9538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5198"/><l level="1" sID="gen9539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5198"/>He will call upon me and I will answer him;<l eID="gen9539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9540"/>I <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> with him in trouble;<l eID="gen9540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9541"/>I will rescue and honor him. <l eID="gen9541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5199"/><l level="1" sID="gen9542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5199"/><transChange type="added">With</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞long life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a length of days”</note> I will satisfy him,<l eID="gen9542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9543"/>and show him my salvation. <l eID="gen9543" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9508"/> <chapter eID="Ps.91"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5200"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving to Yahweh for Victory</title> <div sID="gen9544" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9544" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9545"/> <lg eID="gen9545"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm. A song. For the Sabbath day.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen9546"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5200"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> good to give thanks to Yahweh,<l eID="gen9547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9548"/>and to sing praise concerning your name, O Most High; <l eID="gen9548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5201"/><l level="1" sID="gen9549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5201"/>to declare in the morning your loyal love<l eID="gen9549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9550"/>and your faithfulness in the night, <l eID="gen9550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5202"/><l level="1" sID="gen9551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5202"/>on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ten <transChange type="added">string</transChange>, and on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> harp,<l eID="gen9551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9552"/>with a melody on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lyre. <l eID="gen9552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5203"/><l level="1" sID="gen9553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5203"/>For you, O Yahweh, have made me glad by your work;<l eID="gen9553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9554"/>by the deeds of your hands I sing for joy. <l eID="gen9554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5204"/><l level="1" sID="gen9555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5204"/>How great are your deeds, O Yahweh;<l eID="gen9555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9556"/><transChange type="added">how</transChange> very deep are your thoughts. <l eID="gen9556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5205"/><l level="1" sID="gen9557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5205"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> brutish man does not know,<l eID="gen9557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9558"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fool cannot understand this. <l eID="gen9558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5206"/><l level="1" sID="gen9559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5206"/>When the wicked flourish like grass<l eID="gen9559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9560"/>and all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> workers of evil blossom,<l eID="gen9560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9561"/><transChange type="added">it is</transChange> so they can be destroyed forever. <l eID="gen9561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5207"/><l level="1" sID="gen9562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5207"/>But you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on high forever, O Yahweh. <l eID="gen9562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5208"/><l level="1" sID="gen9563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5208"/>For behold, your enemies, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen9563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9564"/>for behold, your enemies will perish.<l eID="gen9564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9565"/>All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> workers of evil will be scattered. <l eID="gen9565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5209"/><l level="1" sID="gen9566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5209"/>But you have exalted my horn like <transChange type="added">that of</transChange> a wild ox;<l eID="gen9566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9567"/>you have anointed me<note placement="foot">The Hebrew’s “that I have moistened with fresh oil” seems unlikely. The above translation presupposes the loss of a letter in the Hebrew textual tradition (<hi type="italic">ballotani</hi> for the MT’s <hi type="italic">balloti</hi>)</note> with fresh oil. <l eID="gen9567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5210"/><l level="1" sID="gen9568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5210"/>And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> my eye looks on my enemies.<note placement="foot">This word for “enemies” suggests those watching for any advantage</note><l eID="gen9568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9569"/>My ears hear those evildoers who rise up against me. <l eID="gen9569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5211"/><l level="1" sID="gen9570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5211"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> righteous<note placement="foot">Hebrew singular, but used as a collective. The verbs of this verse are also singular</note> will flourish like the date palm.<l eID="gen9570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9571"/>They will grow like a cedar in Lebanon. <l eID="gen9571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5212"/><l level="1" sID="gen9572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5212"/>Planted in the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh,<l eID="gen9572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9573"/>they will flourish in the courts of our God. <l eID="gen9573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5213"/><l level="1" sID="gen9574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5213"/>They will still prosper in old age.<l eID="gen9574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9575"/>They will be fat and luxuriant,<note placement="foot">This is the same word used of the oil in v. <reference osisRef="Ps.92.11">11</reference> and translated “fresh”</note> <l eID="gen9575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5214"/><l level="1" sID="gen9576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5214"/>to declare that Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upright.<l eID="gen9576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9577"/><transChange type="added">He is</transChange> my rock, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no injustice<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> in him. <l eID="gen9577" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9546"/> <chapter eID="Ps.92"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5215"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Is King Over All the Earth</title> <div sID="gen9578" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9578" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9579"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5215"/>Yahweh is king; he clothes himself with majesty.<l eID="gen9580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9581"/>Yahweh clothes himself; he girds himself with might.<l eID="gen9581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9582"/>Yes, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world is established <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> it will not be moved. <l eID="gen9582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5216"/><l level="1" sID="gen9583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5216"/>Your throne <transChange type="added">is</transChange> established from of old;<l eID="gen9583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9584"/>you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> from everlasting. <l eID="gen9584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5217"/><l level="1" sID="gen9585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5217"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> rivers have lifted up, O Yahweh;<l eID="gen9585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9586"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> rivers have lifted up their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rumbling⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “voice”</note><l eID="gen9586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9587"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> rivers have lifted up their pounding. <l eID="gen9587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5218"/><l level="1" sID="gen9588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5218"/><transChange type="added">Mightier</transChange> than the rumblings of many waters,<l eID="gen9588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9589"/><transChange type="added">mightier</transChange> than <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty breakers of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea,<l eID="gen9589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9590"/>Yahweh on high <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mighty. <l eID="gen9590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5219"/><l level="1" sID="gen9591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5219"/>Your testimonies are fully reliable.<l eID="gen9591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9592"/>Holiness is fitting for your house,<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note><l eID="gen9592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9593"/>O Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for a length of days”</note> <l eID="gen9593" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9579"/> <chapter eID="Ps.93"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5220"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Retribution against Oppressors</title> <div sID="gen9594" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9594" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9595"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5220"/>O Yahweh, God of vengeance,<l eID="gen9596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9597"/>God of vengeance, shine forth. <l eID="gen9597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5221"/><l level="1" sID="gen9598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5221"/>Rise up, O Judge of the earth.<l eID="gen9598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9599"/>Repay upon the proud what is <transChange type="added">their</transChange> rightful due. <l eID="gen9599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5222"/><l level="1" sID="gen9600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5222"/>How long <transChange type="added">will the</transChange> wicked, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen9600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9601"/>how long will <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked exult? <l eID="gen9601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5223"/><l level="1" sID="gen9602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5223"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They gush words⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “They gush, they speak,” which is probably a hendiadys</note> unrestrained.<l eID="gen9602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9603"/>All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> evildoers boast. <l eID="gen9603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5224"/><l level="1" sID="gen9604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5224"/>They crush your people, O Yahweh;<l eID="gen9604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9605"/>they oppress your inheritance. <l eID="gen9605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5225"/><l level="1" sID="gen9606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5225"/>They kill widow and stranger,<l eID="gen9606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9607"/>and they murder orphans, <l eID="gen9607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5226"/><l level="1" sID="gen9608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5226"/>while<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> they say, “Yah<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note> does not see,”<l eID="gen9608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9609"/>and “The God of Jacob does not pay attention.” <l eID="gen9609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5227"/><l level="1" sID="gen9610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5227"/>You pay attention, O brutes among the people.<l eID="gen9610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9611"/>And <transChange type="added">you</transChange> fools, when you will show insight? <l eID="gen9611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5228"/><l level="1" sID="gen9612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5228"/>Will <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who planted <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ear not hear?<l eID="gen9612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9613"/>Will <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who formed <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eye not see? <l eID="gen9613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5229"/><l level="1" sID="gen9614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5229"/>Will <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who instructs nations not rebuke,<l eID="gen9614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9615"/>the one who teaches humankind knowledge? <l eID="gen9615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5230"/><l level="1" sID="gen9616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5230"/>Yahweh knows <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thoughts of humankind,<l eID="gen9616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9617"/>that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> to no purpose⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they are a breath” or “a vanity”</note> <l eID="gen9617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5231"/><l level="1" sID="gen9618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5231"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the man, O Yah, whom you instruct<l eID="gen9618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9619"/>and teach from your law, <l eID="gen9619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5232"/><l level="1" sID="gen9620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5232"/>to give him rest from days of trouble,<l eID="gen9620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9621"/>until a pit is dug for the wicked. <l eID="gen9621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5233"/><l level="1" sID="gen9622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5233"/>For Yahweh will not abandon his people,<l eID="gen9622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9623"/>nor forsake his inheritance. <l eID="gen9623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5234"/><l level="1" sID="gen9624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5234"/>For judgment will return to righteousness,<note placement="foot">That is, the court system will operate correctly</note><l eID="gen9624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9625"/>and all the upright in heart <transChange type="added">will follow</transChange> after it. <l eID="gen9625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5235"/><l level="1" sID="gen9626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5235"/>Who rose up for me against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked?<l eID="gen9626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9627"/>Who stood up for me against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> workers of iniquity? <l eID="gen9627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5236"/><l level="1" sID="gen9628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5236"/>If Yahweh had not been my help,<l eID="gen9628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9629"/>my soul would soon have dwelt in silence. <l eID="gen9629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5237"/><l level="1" sID="gen9630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5237"/>When I thought,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “If/When I said,” that is, said to myself</note> “My foot is slipping,”<l eID="gen9630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9631"/>your loyal love, O Yahweh, supported me. <l eID="gen9631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5238"/><l level="1" sID="gen9632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5238"/>When my troubled thoughts were many <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in my inward parts”</note><l eID="gen9632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9633"/>your consolations cheered my soul. <l eID="gen9633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5239"/><l level="1" sID="gen9634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5239"/>Can there be allied with you a throne of destruction,<l eID="gen9634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9635"/>one that forms trouble based on statute? <l eID="gen9635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5240"/><l level="1" sID="gen9636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5240"/>They band together against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> life of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous,<l eID="gen9636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9637"/>and declare <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blameless guilty of blood.<note placement="foot">Or “condemn innocent blood”</note> <l eID="gen9637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5241"/><l level="1" sID="gen9638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5241"/>But Yahweh has become my <transChange type="added">high</transChange> stronghold,<l eID="gen9638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9639"/>and my God <transChange type="added">has become</transChange> my rock of refuge. <l eID="gen9639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5242"/><l level="1" sID="gen9640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5242"/>And he will repay on them their iniquity,<l eID="gen9640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9641"/>and by<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> their evil he will destroy them.<l eID="gen9641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9642"/>Yahweh our God will destroy them. <l eID="gen9642" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9595"/> <chapter eID="Ps.94"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5243"/><title type="x-s">A Call to Worship and Obey</title> <div sID="gen9643" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9643" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9644"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5243"/>Come, let us sing for joy to Yahweh;<l eID="gen9645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9646"/>let us shout joyfully to the rock of our salvation. <l eID="gen9646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5244"/><l level="1" sID="gen9647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5244"/>Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving;<l eID="gen9647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9648"/>with songs let us shout joyfully to him. <l eID="gen9648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5245"/><l level="1" sID="gen9649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5245"/>For Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange><note placement="foot">The Hebrew does not have the definite article used twice in the translation of this verse</note> great God,<l eID="gen9649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9650"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> great king over all gods, <l eID="gen9650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5246"/><l level="1" sID="gen9651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5246"/>in whose hand <transChange type="added">are the</transChange> unexplored places<note placement="foot">Or “the deep places”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen9651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9652"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heights of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains <transChange type="added">are</transChange> his, <l eID="gen9652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5247"/><l level="1" sID="gen9653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5247"/>to whom belongs the sea that he made,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and he made it”</note><l eID="gen9653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9654"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dry land <transChange type="added">that</transChange> his hands formed. <l eID="gen9654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5248"/><l level="1" sID="gen9655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5248"/>Come in, let us worship and bow down;<l eID="gen9655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9656"/>let us kneel before Yahweh, our maker. <l eID="gen9656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5249"/><l level="1" sID="gen9657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5249"/>For he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our God,<l eID="gen9657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9658"/>and we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the people of his pasture<l eID="gen9658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9659"/>and the sheep of his hand.<l eID="gen9659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9660"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The day”</note> if you will hear his voice:<note placement="foot">Or “If only you would hear his voice today”</note> <l eID="gen9660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5250"/><l level="1" sID="gen9661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5250"/>“Do not harden your heart as <transChange type="added">at</transChange> Meribah,<l eID="gen9661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9662"/>as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the day of Massah in the wilderness, <l eID="gen9662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5251"/><l level="1" sID="gen9663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5251"/>when your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> tried me.<l eID="gen9663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9664"/>They put me to the test,<l eID="gen9664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9665"/><transChange type="added">even</transChange> though they had seen my work. <l eID="gen9665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5252"/><l level="1" sID="gen9666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5252"/>For forty years I loathed <transChange type="added">that</transChange> generation,<l eID="gen9666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9667"/>and said, ‘<transChange type="added">They are</transChange> a people <transChange type="added">whose</transChange> heart wanders.<l eID="gen9667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9668"/>And my ways they do not know.’ <l eID="gen9668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5253"/><l level="1" sID="gen9669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5253"/>Therefore I swore in my anger,<l eID="gen9669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9670"/>‘They shall surely not enter into my rest.’ ” <l eID="gen9670" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9644"/> <chapter eID="Ps.95"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5254"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh the King Comes in Judgment</title> <div sID="gen9671" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9671" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9672"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5254"/>Sing to<note placement="foot">Or “concerning”</note> Yahweh a new song;<l eID="gen9673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9674"/>sing to<note placement="foot">Or “concerning”</note> Yahweh, all the earth. <l eID="gen9674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5255"/><l level="1" sID="gen9675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5255"/>Sing to<note placement="foot">Or “concerning”</note> Yahweh; bless his name.<l eID="gen9675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9676"/>Announce<note placement="foot">Or “bring good news concerning”</note> his salvation from day to day. <l eID="gen9676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5256"/><l level="1" sID="gen9677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5256"/>Tell his glory among the nations,<l eID="gen9677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9678"/>his marvelous works among all the peoples. <l eID="gen9678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5257"/><l level="1" sID="gen9679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5257"/>For Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great and very worthy of praise;<l eID="gen9679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9680"/>he <transChange type="added">is to be</transChange> feared above all gods. <l eID="gen9680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5258"/><l level="1" sID="gen9681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5258"/>For all the gods of the peoples <transChange type="added">are</transChange> idols,<note placement="foot">This word for idols suggests something worthless or insignificant</note><l eID="gen9681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9682"/>but Yahweh made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens. <l eID="gen9682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5259"/><l level="1" sID="gen9683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5259"/>Splendor and majesty <transChange type="added">are</transChange> before him;<l eID="gen9683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9684"/>strength and beauty <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in his sanctuary. <l eID="gen9684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5260"/><l level="1" sID="gen9685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5260"/>Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen9685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9686"/>ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength. <l eID="gen9686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5261"/><l level="1" sID="gen9687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5261"/>Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due his name;<l eID="gen9687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9688"/>bring an offering and come into his courts. <l eID="gen9688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5262"/><l level="1" sID="gen9689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5262"/>Worship Yahweh in holy array;<l eID="gen9689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9690"/>tremble before him, all the earth. <l eID="gen9690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5263"/><l level="1" sID="gen9691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5263"/>Say among the nations, “Yahweh is king!<l eID="gen9691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9692"/>Yes, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world is established <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> it will not be moved.<l eID="gen9692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9693"/>He will judge <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples fairly.” <l eID="gen9693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5264"/><l level="1" sID="gen9694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5264"/>Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice.<l eID="gen9694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9695"/>Let the sea with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> its fullness roar. <l eID="gen9695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5265"/><l level="1" sID="gen9696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5265"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> field with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in it exult.<l eID="gen9696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9697"/>Then all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> trees of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> forests will sing for joy <l eID="gen9697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5266"/><l level="1" sID="gen9698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5266"/>before Yahweh, for he is coming;<l eID="gen9698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9699"/>for he is coming to judge the earth.<l eID="gen9699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9700"/>He will judge <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world with righteousness,<l eID="gen9700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9701"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples with his faithfulness. <l eID="gen9701" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9672"/> <chapter eID="Ps.96"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5267"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Glorious Reign</title> <div sID="gen9702" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9702" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9703"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5267"/>Yahweh is king! Let the earth rejoice;<l eID="gen9704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9705"/>let many coastlands be glad. <l eID="gen9705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5268"/><l level="1" sID="gen9706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5268"/>Cloud and thick darkness <transChange type="added">are</transChange> surrounding him;<l eID="gen9706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9707"/>righteousness and justice <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the foundation of his throne. <l eID="gen9707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5269"/><l level="1" sID="gen9708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5269"/>Fire goes before him,<l eID="gen9708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9709"/>and devours his enemies round about. <l eID="gen9709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5270"/><l level="1" sID="gen9710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5270"/>His lightnings light <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world;<l eID="gen9710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9711"/>the earth sees and trembles. <l eID="gen9711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5271"/><l level="1" sID="gen9712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5271"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh,<l eID="gen9712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9713"/>at the presence of the Lord of all the earth. <l eID="gen9713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5272"/><l level="1" sID="gen9714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5272"/>The heavens declare his righteousness,<l eID="gen9714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9715"/>and all the peoples see his glory. <l eID="gen9715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5273"/><l level="1" sID="gen9716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5273"/>Let all who serve an image be ashamed,<l eID="gen9716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9717"/>those who boast about idols.<note placement="foot">This word for idols suggests something worthless or insignificant</note><l eID="gen9717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9718"/>Worship him, all you gods. <l eID="gen9718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5274"/><l level="1" sID="gen9719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5274"/>Zion hears and is glad,<l eID="gen9719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9720"/>and the daughters of Judah rejoice<l eID="gen9720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9721"/>because of your judgments, O Yahweh. <l eID="gen9721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5275"/><l level="1" sID="gen9722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5275"/>For you, O Yahweh, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> most high over all the earth.<l eID="gen9722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9723"/>You are highly<note placement="foot">Hebrew “very”</note> exalted above all gods. <l eID="gen9723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5276"/><l level="1" sID="gen9724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5276"/>You who love Yahweh, hate evil.<l eID="gen9724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9725"/>He protects the lives of his faithful;<l eID="gen9725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9726"/>he delivers them from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked. <l eID="gen9726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5277"/><l level="1" sID="gen9727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5277"/>Light <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sown for the righteous,<l eID="gen9727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9728"/>and joy for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> upright in heart. <l eID="gen9728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5278"/><l level="1" sID="gen9729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5278"/>Be glad in Yahweh, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> righteous,<l eID="gen9729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9730"/>and give thanks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to his holy name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to his holy remembrance” or “to his memorable holiness”</note> <l eID="gen9730" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9703"/> <chapter eID="Ps.97"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5279"/><title type="x-s">Praise to Yahweh for His Salvation and Judgment</title> <div sID="gen9731" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9731" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9732"/> <lg eID="gen9732"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen9733"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5279"/>Sing to<note placement="foot">Or “sing concerning”</note> Yahweh a new song, for he has done wonders.<l eID="gen9734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9735"/>His right hand and his holy arm have secured his victory. <l eID="gen9735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5280"/><l level="1" sID="gen9736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5280"/>Yahweh has made known his salvation;<note placement="foot">Or “victory”</note><l eID="gen9736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9737"/>to the eyes of the nations he has revealed his righteousness. <l eID="gen9737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5281"/><l level="1" sID="gen9738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5281"/>He has remembered his loyal love and his faithfulness<l eID="gen9738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9739"/>to the house of Israel.<l eID="gen9739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9740"/>All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ends of the earth have seen<l eID="gen9740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9741"/>the salvation<note placement="foot">Or “victory”</note> of our God. <l eID="gen9741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5282"/><l level="1" sID="gen9742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5282"/>Shout joyfully to Yahweh, all the earth.<l eID="gen9742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9743"/>Be cheerful<note placement="foot">Or “Burst forth”</note> and sing for joy and sing praises. <l eID="gen9743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5283"/><l level="1" sID="gen9744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5283"/>Sing praises to Yahweh with lyre,<l eID="gen9744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9745"/>with lyre and melodious sound. <l eID="gen9745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5284"/><l level="1" sID="gen9746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5284"/>With trumpets and sound of horn,<l eID="gen9746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9747"/>shout joyfully before the king, Yahweh. <l eID="gen9747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5285"/><l level="1" sID="gen9748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5285"/>Let the sea with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> its fullness roar,<l eID="gen9748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9749"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> world and those who live in it. <l eID="gen9749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5286"/><l level="1" sID="gen9750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5286"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rivers clap <transChange type="added">their</transChange> hands.<l eID="gen9750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9751"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hills sing joyfully together <l eID="gen9751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5287"/><l level="1" sID="gen9752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5287"/>before Yahweh, for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> coming<l eID="gen9752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9753"/>to judge the earth.<l eID="gen9753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9754"/>He will judge <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world with righteousness<l eID="gen9754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9755"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples with equity. <l eID="gen9755" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9733"/> <chapter eID="Ps.98"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5288"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Is a Holy King</title> <div sID="gen9756" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9756" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9757"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5288"/>Yahweh is king; let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples tremble.<l eID="gen9758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9759"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> sits enthroned<note placement="foot">Or “dwells”</note> <transChange type="added">between the</transChange> cherubim. Let the earth shake. <l eID="gen9759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5289"/><l level="1" sID="gen9760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5289"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great in Zion,<l eID="gen9760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9761"/>and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> exalted over all the peoples. <l eID="gen9761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5290"/><l level="1" sID="gen9762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5290"/>Let them praise your great and fearful name.<l eID="gen9762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9763"/>He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> holy. <l eID="gen9763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5291"/><l level="1" sID="gen9764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5291"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> strength of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king loves justice.<note placement="foot">The interpretation of this line is uncertain</note><l eID="gen9764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9765"/>You have established equity;<l eID="gen9765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9766"/>you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob. <l eID="gen9766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5292"/><l level="1" sID="gen9767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5292"/>Exalt Yahweh our God,<l eID="gen9767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9768"/>and worship at his footstool.<l eID="gen9768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9769"/>He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> holy. <l eID="gen9769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5293"/><l level="1" sID="gen9770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5293"/>Moses and Aaron <transChange type="added">were</transChange> among his priests;<l eID="gen9770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9771"/>Samuel also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> among <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> called on his name.<l eID="gen9771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9772"/>They called to Yahweh, and he answered them. <l eID="gen9772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5294"/><l level="1" sID="gen9773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5294"/>He spoke to them in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pillar of cloud.<l eID="gen9773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9774"/>They kept his testimonies and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> statute he gave to them. <l eID="gen9774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5295"/><l level="1" sID="gen9775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5295"/>O Yahweh our God, you answered them.<l eID="gen9775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9776"/>You were a forgiving God to them,<l eID="gen9776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9777"/>but an avenger of their <transChange type="added">wrong</transChange> deeds. <l eID="gen9777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5296"/><l level="1" sID="gen9778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5296"/>Exalt Yahweh our God,<l eID="gen9778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9779"/>and worship at his holy mountain,<l eID="gen9779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9780"/>for Yahweh our God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> holy. <l eID="gen9780" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9757"/> <chapter eID="Ps.99"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5297"/><title type="x-s">Worship God with Joy</title> <div sID="gen9781" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9781" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9782"/> <lg eID="gen9782"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of thanksgiving.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen9783"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5297"/>Shout in triumph to Yahweh, all the earth. <l eID="gen9784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5298"/><l level="1" sID="gen9785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5298"/>Serve<note placement="foot">Or “Worship”</note> Yahweh with joy;<l eID="gen9785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9786"/>come into his presence with exultation. <l eID="gen9786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5299"/><l level="1" sID="gen9787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5299"/>Know that Yahweh, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> God;<l eID="gen9787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9788"/>he made us and we are his.<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>); the <hi type="italic">Kethib</hi> reads “and not we ourselves”</note><l eID="gen9788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9789"/><transChange type="added">We are</transChange> his people and the sheep of his pasture. <l eID="gen9789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5300"/><l level="1" sID="gen9790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5300"/>Enter his gates with thanksgiving,<l eID="gen9790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9791"/>his courts with praise.<l eID="gen9791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9792"/>Give thanks to him; bless his name. <l eID="gen9792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5301"/><l level="1" sID="gen9793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5301"/>For Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good; his loyal love is forever,<l eID="gen9793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9794"/>and his faithfulness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from generation to generation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “unto a generation and a generation”</note> <l eID="gen9794" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9783"/> <chapter eID="Ps.100"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5302"/><title type="x-s">A Promise to Act with Integrity</title> <div sID="gen9795" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9795" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9796"/> <lg eID="gen9796"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen9797"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5302"/>I will sing of loyal love and justice;<l eID="gen9798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9799"/>I will sing praises to you, O Yahweh. <l eID="gen9799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5303"/><l level="1" sID="gen9800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5303"/>I will give attention to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way of integrity.<l eID="gen9800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9801"/>When will you come to me?<l eID="gen9801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9802"/>I will walk in the integrity of my heart<l eID="gen9802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9803"/>in the midst of my house. <l eID="gen9803" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5304"/><l level="1" sID="gen9804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5304"/>I will not set before my eyes<l eID="gen9804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9805"/>any wicked thing.<l eID="gen9805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9806"/>I hate the work of those who fall away;<note placement="foot">The term “those who fall away” is a rare noun. The verb from the same root is found in <reference osisRef="Ps.40.5">Psa 40:5</reference>(4)</note><l eID="gen9806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9807"/>it will not cling to me. <l eID="gen9807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5305"/><l level="1" sID="gen9808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5305"/>A perverse heart will depart from me;<l eID="gen9808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9809"/>I will not know evil. <l eID="gen9809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5306"/><l level="1" sID="gen9810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5306"/>One who slanders his neighbor in secret,<l eID="gen9810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9811"/>him I will destroy.<l eID="gen9811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9812"/><transChange type="added">One</transChange> haughty of eyes and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞arrogant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wide”</note> of heart,<l eID="gen9812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9813"/>him I will not endure. <l eID="gen9813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5307"/><l level="1" sID="gen9814"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5307"/>My eyes <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> faithful of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen9814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9815"/>that <transChange type="added">they may</transChange> live with me.<l eID="gen9815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9816"/><transChange type="added">He who</transChange> walks in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way of integrity,<l eID="gen9816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9817"/>he shall minister to me. <l eID="gen9817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5308"/><l level="1" sID="gen9818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5308"/>There will not live in the midst of my house<l eID="gen9818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9819"/>a worker of deceit.<l eID="gen9819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9820"/>One who speaks lies<l eID="gen9820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9821"/>will not remain<note placement="foot">Hebrew “be established”</note> before my eyes. <l eID="gen9821" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5309"/><l level="1" sID="gen9822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5309"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Each morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the mornings”</note><l eID="gen9822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9823"/>I will destroy all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen9823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9824"/>cutting off from the city of Yahweh all evildoers. <l eID="gen9824" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9797"/> <chapter eID="Ps.101"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5310"/><title type="x-s">A Plea for Personal and National Help</title> <div sID="gen9825" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9825" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9826"/> <lg eID="gen9826"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A prayer of <transChange type="added">one</transChange> afflicted, when he grows faint</title> <lg sID="gen9827"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9828"/>and pours out his lament before Yahweh.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen9828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5310"/>O Yahweh, hear my prayer,<l eID="gen9829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9830"/>and let my cry for help come to you. <l eID="gen9830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5311"/><l level="1" sID="gen9831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5311"/>Do not hide your face from me<l eID="gen9831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9832"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day <transChange type="added">of</transChange> my trouble.<l eID="gen9832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9833"/>Incline your ear to me.<l eID="gen9833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9834"/>In the day I call, answer me quickly, <l eID="gen9834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5312"/><l level="1" sID="gen9835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5312"/>for my days vanish in smoke,<l eID="gen9835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9836"/>and my bones are charred like a hearth. <l eID="gen9836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5313"/><l level="1" sID="gen9837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5313"/>My heart is struck like grass and withers.<l eID="gen9837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9838"/>Indeed, I forget to eat<note placement="foot">A rare homonym might yield “I am too wilted to eat”</note> my bread. <l eID="gen9838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5314"/><l level="1" sID="gen9839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5314"/>Because of the sound of my groaning<l eID="gen9839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9840"/>my bones<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bone”</note> cling to my skin.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “flesh”</note> <l eID="gen9840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5315"/><l level="1" sID="gen9841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5315"/>I am like an owl<note placement="foot">The identity of the birds in this verse is uncertain</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wilderness;<l eID="gen9841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9842"/>I am like a little owl of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ruins. <l eID="gen9842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5316"/><l level="1" sID="gen9843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5316"/>I lie awake and I am<l eID="gen9843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9844"/>like a lone bird on a roof. <l eID="gen9844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5317"/><l level="1" sID="gen9845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5317"/>All the day my enemies reproach me;<l eID="gen9845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9846"/>those who mock me swear <transChange type="added">oaths</transChange> against me. <l eID="gen9846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5318"/><l level="1" sID="gen9847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5318"/>Indeed, I eat ashes like bread<l eID="gen9847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9848"/>and mix my drink with tears<note placement="foot">Hebrew “weeping”</note> <l eID="gen9848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5319"/><l level="1" sID="gen9849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5319"/>because of your indignation and anger,<l eID="gen9849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9850"/>for you have picked me up and thrown me away. <l eID="gen9850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5320"/><l level="1" sID="gen9851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5320"/>My days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like a lengthened shadow,<l eID="gen9851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9852"/>and I wither like grass. <l eID="gen9852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5321"/><l level="1" sID="gen9853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5321"/>But you, O Yahweh, abide<note placement="foot">Or “sit enthroned”</note> forever,<l eID="gen9853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9854"/>and your remembrance<note placement="foot">Or “name”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from generation to generation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to a generation and a generation”</note> <l eID="gen9854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5322"/><l level="1" sID="gen9855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5322"/>You rise up and take pity on Zion,<l eID="gen9855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9856"/>because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> time to favor it,<l eID="gen9856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9857"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appointed time has come. <l eID="gen9857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5323"/><l level="1" sID="gen9858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5323"/>Your servants take pleasure in her stones,<l eID="gen9858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9859"/>and show favor to its dust. <l eID="gen9859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5324"/><l level="1" sID="gen9860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5324"/>Then <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations will fear the name of Yahweh,<l eID="gen9860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9861"/>and all the kings of the earth your glory. <l eID="gen9861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5325"/><l level="1" sID="gen9862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5325"/>For Yahweh will rebuild Zion;<l eID="gen9862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9863"/>he will appear in his glory. <l eID="gen9863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5326"/><l level="1" sID="gen9864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5326"/>He will turn his attention to the prayer of the destitute<l eID="gen9864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9865"/>and will not despise their prayer. <l eID="gen9865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5327"/><l level="1" sID="gen9866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5327"/>Let this be written for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> next generation,<l eID="gen9866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9867"/>so that a people <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> to be created may praise Yah,<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note> <l eID="gen9867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5328"/><l level="1" sID="gen9868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5328"/>that he looked down from his holy height.<l eID="gen9868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9869"/>Yahweh looked from heaven over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth <l eID="gen9869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5329"/><l level="1" sID="gen9870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5329"/>to hear <transChange type="added">the</transChange> groaning of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prisoner,<l eID="gen9870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9871"/>to liberate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those destined to die⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the sons of death”</note> <l eID="gen9871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5330"/><l level="1" sID="gen9872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5330"/>so that <transChange type="added">they<note placement="foot">That is, the generation that reads what is written</note> may</transChange> make known in Zion the name of Yahweh,<l eID="gen9872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9873"/>and his praise in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen9873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5331"/><l level="1" sID="gen9874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5331"/>when the peoples assemble,<l eID="gen9874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9875"/>together with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> kingdoms, to serve Yahweh. <l eID="gen9875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5332"/><l level="1" sID="gen9876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5332"/>He has broken my strength along the way;<l eID="gen9876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9877"/>he has cut short my days. <l eID="gen9877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5333"/><l level="1" sID="gen9878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5333"/>I say, “My God, do not carry me off<l eID="gen9878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9879"/>from my life in the middle of my days.”<l eID="gen9879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9880"/>Your years <transChange type="added">continue</transChange> throughout all generations. <l eID="gen9880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:25
