verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5334"/><l level="1" sID="gen9881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5334"/>Long ago you laid the foundation of the earth,<l eID="gen9881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9882"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the work of your hands. <l eID="gen9882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5335"/><l level="1" sID="gen9883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5335"/>They will perish, but you will endure.<l eID="gen9883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9884"/>And like a garment they will all wear out,<l eID="gen9884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9885"/>you will replace them like clothing, and they will be set aside. <l eID="gen9885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5336"/><l level="1" sID="gen9886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5336"/>But you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the same,<l eID="gen9886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9887"/>and your years do not end. <l eID="gen9887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5337"/><l level="1" sID="gen9888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5337"/>The children of your servants will continue,<l eID="gen9888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9889"/>and their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞descendants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “seed”</note> will be established before you. <l eID="gen9889" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9827"/> <chapter eID="Ps.102"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5338"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for Yahweh’s Compassion</title> <div sID="gen9890" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9890" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9891"/> <lg eID="gen9891"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen9892"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5338"/>Bless Yahweh, O my soul,<l eID="gen9893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9894"/>and all within me, <transChange type="added">bless</transChange> his holy name. <l eID="gen9894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5339"/><l level="1" sID="gen9895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5339"/>Bless Yahweh, O my soul,<l eID="gen9895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9896"/>and do not forget all his benefits: <l eID="gen9896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5340"/><l level="1" sID="gen9897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5340"/>who forgives all your iniquity,<l eID="gen9897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9898"/>who heals all your diseases, <l eID="gen9898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5341"/><l level="1" sID="gen9899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5341"/>who redeems your life from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit,<l eID="gen9899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9900"/>who crowns you with loyal love and mercies, <l eID="gen9900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5342"/><l level="1" sID="gen9901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5342"/>who satisfies your life with good<l eID="gen9901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9902"/>so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s. <l eID="gen9902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5343"/><l level="1" sID="gen9903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5343"/>Yahweh does deeds of justice<l eID="gen9903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9904"/>and judgments for all <transChange type="added">who</transChange> are oppressed, <l eID="gen9904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5344"/><l level="1" sID="gen9905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5344"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> made known his ways to Moses,<l eID="gen9905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9906"/>his deeds to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons”</note> of Israel. <l eID="gen9906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5345"/><l level="1" sID="gen9907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5345"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> compassionate and gracious,<l eID="gen9907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9908"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞slow to anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “long of nostrils”</note> and abundant in loyal love. <l eID="gen9908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5346"/><l level="1" sID="gen9909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5346"/>He does not dispute continually,<l eID="gen9909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9910"/>nor keep <transChange type="added">his anger</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen9910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5347"/><l level="1" sID="gen9911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5347"/>He has not dealt with us according to our sins,<l eID="gen9911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9912"/>nor repaid us according to our iniquities. <l eID="gen9912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5348"/><l level="1" sID="gen9913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5348"/>For as <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens are high above the earth,<l eID="gen9913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9914"/><transChange type="added">so</transChange> his loyal love prevails over those who fear him. <l eID="gen9914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5349"/><l level="1" sID="gen9915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5349"/>As far as east <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from west,<l eID="gen9915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9916"/><transChange type="added">so</transChange> he has removed far from us <transChange type="added">the guilt of</transChange> our transgressions. <l eID="gen9916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5350"/><l level="1" sID="gen9917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5350"/>As a father pities<note placement="foot">Or “shows compassion to”</note> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> children,<l eID="gen9917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9918"/><transChange type="added">so</transChange> Yahweh pities<note placement="foot">Or “shows compassion to”</note> those who fear him. <l eID="gen9918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5351"/><l level="1" sID="gen9919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5351"/>For he knows our frame.<note placement="foot">That is, how we are formed</note><l eID="gen9919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9920"/>He remembers that we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> dust. <l eID="gen9920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5352"/><l level="1" sID="gen9921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5352"/>As for man, his days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like the grass.<l eID="gen9921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9922"/>As the flower of the field, so he blossoms. <l eID="gen9922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5353"/><l level="1" sID="gen9923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5353"/>When <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind passes over it, it is no more,<l eID="gen9923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9924"/>and its place knows it no longer. <l eID="gen9924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5354"/><l level="1" sID="gen9925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5354"/>But the loyal love of Yahweh<l eID="gen9925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9926"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear him,<l eID="gen9926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9927"/>and his righteousness to <transChange type="added">their</transChange> children’s children, <l eID="gen9927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5355"/><l level="1" sID="gen9928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5355"/>to those who keep his covenant<l eID="gen9928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9929"/>and remember to do his precepts. <l eID="gen9929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5356"/><l level="1" sID="gen9930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5356"/>Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens,<l eID="gen9930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9931"/>and his kingdom rules over all. <l eID="gen9931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5357"/><l level="1" sID="gen9932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5357"/>Bless Yahweh, you his angels,<l eID="gen9932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9933"/><transChange type="added">you</transChange> mighty heroes who do his word<l eID="gen9933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9934"/>by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞obeying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hearing”</note> the sound of his word. <l eID="gen9934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5358"/><l level="1" sID="gen9935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5358"/>Bless Yahweh, all you his hosts,<l eID="gen9935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9936"/><transChange type="added">you</transChange> his attendants who do his will. <l eID="gen9936" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5359"/><l level="1" sID="gen9937"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5359"/>Bless Yahweh, all his works,<note placement="foot">That is, created things</note><l eID="gen9937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9938"/>in all the places of his dominion.<l eID="gen9938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9939"/>Bless Yahweh, O my soul. <l eID="gen9939" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9892"/> <chapter eID="Ps.103"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5360"/><title type="x-s">Praise to Yahweh for His Creation and Providence</title> <div sID="gen9940" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen9940" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9941"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5360"/>Bless Yahweh, O my soul.<l eID="gen9942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9943"/>O Yahweh my God, you are very great.<l eID="gen9943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9944"/>You clothe yourself <transChange type="added">with</transChange> splendor and majesty, <l eID="gen9944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5361"/><l level="1" sID="gen9945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5361"/><transChange type="added">you</transChange> who cover <transChange type="added">yourself</transChange> with light as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a garment,<l eID="gen9945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9946"/>who stretch out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens like a tent curtain, <l eID="gen9946" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5362"/><l level="1" sID="gen9947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5362"/>the one who sets beams in the waters <transChange type="added">for</transChange> his upper chambers,<l eID="gen9947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9948"/>who makes clouds his chariot,<l eID="gen9948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9949"/>who rides<note placement="foot">Hebrew “goes”</note> on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind, <l eID="gen9949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5363"/><l level="1" sID="gen9950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5363"/>who makes his messengers <transChange type="added">the</transChange> winds,<l eID="gen9950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9951"/>his attendants a flame of fire. <l eID="gen9951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5364"/><l level="1" sID="gen9952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5364"/>He established <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth on her foundations,<l eID="gen9952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9953"/><transChange type="added">so that</transChange> it will not be moved forever and ever. <l eID="gen9953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5365"/><l level="1" sID="gen9954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5365"/>You covered it with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deep as with a garment.<l eID="gen9954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9955"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> waters stood above <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains. <l eID="gen9955" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5366"/><l level="1" sID="gen9956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5366"/>At your rebuke they fled;<l eID="gen9956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9957"/>at the sound of your thunder they ran off. <l eID="gen9957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5367"/><l level="1" sID="gen9958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5367"/>They ascended <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains <transChange type="added">and</transChange> drained though the valleys<l eID="gen9958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9959"/>to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> place that you established<note placement="foot">Or “appointed”</note> for them. <l eID="gen9959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5368"/><l level="1" sID="gen9960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5368"/>You set a boundary that they may not cross over,<l eID="gen9960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9961"/><transChange type="added">so that</transChange> they would not return to cover the earth. <l eID="gen9961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5369"/><l level="1" sID="gen9962"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5369"/><transChange type="added">You are</transChange> the one who sends forth springs into the valleys;<l eID="gen9962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9963"/>they flow between <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains. <l eID="gen9963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5370"/><l level="1" sID="gen9964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5370"/>They give drink for every beast of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> field.<l eID="gen9964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9965"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> wild donkeys <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞quench⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “break”</note> their thirst. <l eID="gen9965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5371"/><l level="1" sID="gen9966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5371"/>Along them the birds of the heavens abide.<l eID="gen9966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9967"/>From among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> branches they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “give voice”</note> <l eID="gen9967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5372"/><l level="1" sID="gen9968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5372"/><transChange type="added">You are the one who</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞waters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “give drink”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains<l eID="gen9968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9969"/>from his upper chambers.<l eID="gen9969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9970"/>The earth is full<note placement="foot">Or “is sated”</note> with the fruit of your labors: <l eID="gen9970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5373"/><l level="1" sID="gen9971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5373"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> causes grass to grow for the cattle<l eID="gen9971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9972"/>and herbs for the service of humankind,<l eID="gen9972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9973"/>to bring forth food from the earth, <l eID="gen9973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5374"/><l level="1" sID="gen9974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5374"/>and wine <transChange type="added">that</transChange> makes glad <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of man,<l eID="gen9974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9975"/>so that <transChange type="added">their</transChange> faces shine from oil,<l eID="gen9975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9976"/>and bread <transChange type="added">that</transChange> strengthens the heart of man. <l eID="gen9976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5375"/><l level="1" sID="gen9977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5375"/>The trees of Yahweh drink their fill,<l eID="gen9977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9978"/>the cedars of Lebanon that he planted, <l eID="gen9978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5376"/><l level="1" sID="gen9979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5376"/>where birds make <transChange type="added">their</transChange> nest.<l eID="gen9979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9980"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> stork <transChange type="added">has</transChange> its home in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fir trees. <l eID="gen9980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5377"/><l level="1" sID="gen9981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5377"/>The high mountains <transChange type="added">are</transChange> for the wild goats;<l eID="gen9981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9982"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> cliffs <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a refuge for the rock badgers. <l eID="gen9982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5378"/><l level="1" sID="gen9983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5378"/>He made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moon for appointed times;<l eID="gen9983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9984"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun knows its <transChange type="added">time for</transChange> setting. <l eID="gen9984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5379"/><l level="1" sID="gen9985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5379"/>You make darkness, and it is night,<l eID="gen9985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9986"/>when<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in it”</note> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> animals of the forest creep about. <l eID="gen9986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5380"/><l level="1" sID="gen9987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5380"/>The young lions <transChange type="added">are</transChange> roaring for the prey<l eID="gen9987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9988"/>and seeking their food from God. <l eID="gen9988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5381"/><l level="1" sID="gen9989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5381"/><transChange type="added">When</transChange> the sun rises, they gather together<l eID="gen9989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9990"/>and lie down in their dens. <l eID="gen9990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5382"/><l level="1" sID="gen9991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5382"/>Humankind goes out to its work,<l eID="gen9991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9992"/>and to its labor until evening. <l eID="gen9992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5383"/><l level="1" sID="gen9993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5383"/>How many are your works, O Yahweh;<l eID="gen9993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9994"/>all of them you have done in wisdom.<l eID="gen9994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9995"/>The earth is full of your creatures. <l eID="gen9995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5384"/><l level="1" sID="gen9996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5384"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the great and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wide⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “broad of hands”</note> sea,<l eID="gen9996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9997"/>in which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> moving animals without number,<l eID="gen9997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9998"/>living things small and great. <l eID="gen9998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5385"/><l level="1" sID="gen9999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5385"/>There <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ships sail.<l eID="gen9999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10000"/>Leviathan <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> that you formed to play with.<note placement="foot">For this construction meaning “to play with,” see Job 40:29 (Eng: 41:5)</note> <l eID="gen10000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5386"/><l level="1" sID="gen10001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5386"/>They all wait for you<l eID="gen10001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10002"/>to give <transChange type="added">them</transChange> their food <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the proper time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in its season”</note> <l eID="gen10002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5387"/><l level="1" sID="gen10003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5387"/>You give to them; they gather <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<l eID="gen10003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10004"/>You open your hand, they are filled with <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> good. <l eID="gen10004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5388"/><l level="1" sID="gen10005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5388"/>You hide your face, they are terrified.<l eID="gen10005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10006"/>You take away their breath, they die<l eID="gen10006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10007"/>and return to their dust. <l eID="gen10007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5389"/><l level="1" sID="gen10008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5389"/>You send forth your Spirit,<note placement="foot">Or “breath”</note> they are created,<l eID="gen10008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10009"/>and you renew the face of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ground. <l eID="gen10009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5390"/><l level="1" sID="gen10010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5390"/>May the glory of Yahweh endure forever.<l eID="gen10010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10011"/>May Yahweh be glad in his works, <l eID="gen10011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5391"/><l level="1" sID="gen10012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5391"/>the one who looks at the earth and it quakes,<l eID="gen10012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10013"/>and touches the mountains and they smoke. <l eID="gen10013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5392"/><l level="1" sID="gen10014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5392"/>I will sing to Yahweh throughout my life;<l eID="gen10014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10015"/>I will sing praise to my God while <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I remain alive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “while I am still”</note> <l eID="gen10015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5393"/><l level="1" sID="gen10016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5393"/>May my meditation be pleasing to him.<l eID="gen10016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10017"/>I will be glad in Yahweh. <l eID="gen10017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5394"/><l level="1" sID="gen10018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5394"/>Let sinners perish completely from the earth,<l eID="gen10018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10019"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞not remain alive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they are not still”</note><l eID="gen10019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10020"/>Bless Yahweh, O my soul.<l eID="gen10020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10021"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen10021" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9941"/> <chapter eID="Ps.104"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5395"/><title type="x-s">Praise to Yahweh for His Work on Behalf of Israel</title> <div sID="gen10022" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10022" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10023"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5395"/>Give thanks to Yahweh; proclaim his name;<l eID="gen10024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10025"/>make known his deeds among the peoples. <l eID="gen10025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5396"/><l level="1" sID="gen10026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5396"/>Sing to him; sing praises concerning him;<l eID="gen10026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10027"/>tell of all his wonderful works. <l eID="gen10027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5397"/><l level="1" sID="gen10028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5397"/>Boast about his holy name.<l eID="gen10028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10029"/>Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice. <l eID="gen10029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5398"/><l level="1" sID="gen10030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5398"/>Make supplication to Yahweh and his might;<l eID="gen10030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10031"/>seek his face continually. <l eID="gen10031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5399"/><l level="1" sID="gen10032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5399"/>Remember his wonders that he has done,<l eID="gen10032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10033"/>his signs and the judgments of his mouth, <l eID="gen10033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5400"/><l level="1" sID="gen10034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5400"/>O offspring of Abraham his servant,<l eID="gen10034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10035"/><transChange type="added">you</transChange> descendants<note placement="foot">Or “children,” or “sons”</note> of Jacob, his chosen ones. <l eID="gen10035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5401"/><l level="1" sID="gen10036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5401"/>He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh our God;<l eID="gen10036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10037"/>his judgments <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in all the earth. <l eID="gen10037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5402"/><l level="1" sID="gen10038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5402"/>He remembers his covenant forever,<l eID="gen10038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10039"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> word <transChange type="added">that</transChange> he commanded<l eID="gen10039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10040"/>for a thousand generations, <l eID="gen10040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5403"/><l level="1" sID="gen10041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5403"/>that he made with Abraham,<l eID="gen10041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10042"/>and by his oath <transChange type="added">swore</transChange> to Isaac. <l eID="gen10042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5404"/><l level="1" sID="gen10043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5404"/>He then confirmed it to Jacob as a statute,<l eID="gen10043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10044"/>to Israel <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an everlasting covenant, <l eID="gen10044" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5405"/><l level="1" sID="gen10045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5405"/>saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan<l eID="gen10045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10046"/><transChange type="added">as</transChange> the allotment <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> your<note placement="foot">Hebrew plural</note> inheritance.” <l eID="gen10046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5406"/><l level="1" sID="gen10047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5406"/>When they were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞few in number⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “men of number,” that is, so few you could count them</note>—<l eID="gen10047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10048"/>a trifle—and <transChange type="added">were</transChange> sojourners in it, <l eID="gen10048" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5407"/><l level="1" sID="gen10049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5407"/>and they wandered about <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among the nations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from people to people”</note><l eID="gen10049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10050"/>from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> kingdom to another people, <l eID="gen10050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5408"/><l level="1" sID="gen10051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5408"/>he allowed no one to oppress them,<l eID="gen10051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10052"/>and he rebuked kings on account of them, <l eID="gen10052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5409"/><l level="1" sID="gen10053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5409"/>“Do not touch my anointed ones,<l eID="gen10053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10054"/>nor harm my prophets.” <l eID="gen10054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5410"/><l level="1" sID="gen10055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5410"/>Then he called for a famine upon the land;<l eID="gen10055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10056"/>he broke every <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞supply⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “staff”</note> of bread. <l eID="gen10056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5411"/><l level="1" sID="gen10057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5411"/>He sent a man on ahead of them;<l eID="gen10057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10058"/>Joseph was sold as a slave. <l eID="gen10058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5412"/><l level="1" sID="gen10059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5412"/>They clamped<note placement="foot">Hebrew “oppressed, hurt”</note> his feet in fetters.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fetter”</note><l eID="gen10059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10060"/>His neck<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">nephesh</hi> can designate the life, soul, appetite, desire, or throat/neck.</note> went into irons.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “iron”</note> <l eID="gen10060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5413"/><l level="1" sID="gen10061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5413"/>Until <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time his word came about,<l eID="gen10061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10062"/>the word of Yahweh tested<note placement="foot">Or “refined”</note> him. <l eID="gen10062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5414"/><l level="1" sID="gen10063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5414"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> king sent and he freed him;<l eID="gen10063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10064"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> ruler of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples <transChange type="added">sent</transChange> and let him loose. <l eID="gen10064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5415"/><l level="1" sID="gen10065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5415"/>He made him lord of his house<l eID="gen10065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10066"/>and ruler of all his possessions, <l eID="gen10066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5416"/><l level="1" sID="gen10067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5416"/>to obligate<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to bind, imprison” The LXX’s “to instruct” presupposes <hi type="italic">ysr</hi> instead of <hi type="italic">'sr</hi>, and might be correct in light of the parallelism that is fairly tight in this psalm</note> his officials <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as he saw fit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his desire soul”</note><l eID="gen10067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10068"/>and teach his elders wisdom. <l eID="gen10068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5417"/><l level="1" sID="gen10069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5417"/>Then Israel came <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt,<l eID="gen10069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10070"/>and Jacob was a sojourner in the land of Ham. <l eID="gen10070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5418"/><l level="1" sID="gen10071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5418"/>And he<note placement="foot">That is, God</note> made his people very fruitful.<l eID="gen10071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10072"/>He also made them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> stronger than their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> enemies. <l eID="gen10072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5419"/><l level="1" sID="gen10073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5419"/>He turned their heart to hate his people,<l eID="gen10073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10074"/>to deal deceitfully against his servants. <l eID="gen10074" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5420"/><l level="1" sID="gen10075"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5420"/>He sent his servant Moses,<l eID="gen10075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10076"/>together with Aaron whom he had chosen. <l eID="gen10076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5421"/><l level="1" sID="gen10077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5421"/>They set before them the words concerning his signs<l eID="gen10077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10078"/>and portents in the land of Ham. <l eID="gen10078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5422"/><l level="1" sID="gen10079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5422"/>He sent darkness and made <transChange type="added">it</transChange> dark,<l eID="gen10079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10080"/>and they did not rebel against his words. <l eID="gen10080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5423"/><l level="1" sID="gen10081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5423"/>He turned their waters into blood<l eID="gen10081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10082"/>and it killed their fish. <l eID="gen10082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5424"/><l level="1" sID="gen10083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5424"/>Their land swarmed with frogs,<l eID="gen10083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10084"/><transChange type="added">even</transChange> in the chambers of their kings. <l eID="gen10084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5425"/><l level="1" sID="gen10085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5425"/>He spoke, and there came flies<l eID="gen10085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10086"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> gnats throughout all their territory.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “borders”</note> <l eID="gen10086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5426"/><l level="1" sID="gen10087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5426"/>He gave hail for their rains<l eID="gen10087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10088"/><transChange type="added">and the</transChange> fire of lightning in their land. <l eID="gen10088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5427"/><l level="1" sID="gen10089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5427"/>And he struck their vines and fig trees,<l eID="gen10089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10090"/>and shattered the trees of their territory. <l eID="gen10090" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5428"/><l level="1" sID="gen10091"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5428"/>He spoke and there came locusts<l eID="gen10091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10092"/>and young locusts without number. <l eID="gen10092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5429"/><l level="1" sID="gen10093"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5429"/>And they ate up all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> vegetation in their land,<l eID="gen10093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10094"/>and they ate up the fruit of their ground. <l eID="gen10094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5430"/><l level="1" sID="gen10095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5430"/>And he struck down all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstborn in their land,<l eID="gen10095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10096"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> first of all their virility. <l eID="gen10096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5431"/><l level="1" sID="gen10097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5431"/>Then he brought them out with silver and gold,<l eID="gen10097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10098"/>and there was none among his tribes who stumbled. <l eID="gen10098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5432"/><l level="1" sID="gen10099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5432"/>Egypt was glad when they departed,<l eID="gen10099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10100"/>because the fear of them<note placement="foot">That is, Israel</note> had fallen upon them. <l eID="gen10100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5433"/><l level="1" sID="gen10101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5433"/>He spread out a cloud for a covering,<l eID="gen10101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10102"/>and fire to give light at night. <l eID="gen10102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5434"/><l level="1" sID="gen10103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5434"/>They<note placement="foot">Hebrew “He”</note> asked, and he brought quail,<l eID="gen10103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10104"/>and satisfied them with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bread of heaven. <l eID="gen10104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5435"/><l level="1" sID="gen10105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5435"/>He opened <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rock and waters flowed;<l eID="gen10105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10106"/>they coursed<note placement="foot">Or “surged”</note> through the dry places <transChange type="added">like</transChange> a river. <l eID="gen10106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5436"/><l level="1" sID="gen10107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5436"/>For he remembered his holy <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞promise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “word”</note><l eID="gen10107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10108"/><transChange type="added">he remembered</transChange> Abraham his servant. <l eID="gen10108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5437"/><l level="1" sID="gen10109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5437"/>And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> he brought out his people with joy,<l eID="gen10109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10110"/>his chosen ones with rejoicing. <l eID="gen10110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5438"/><l level="1" sID="gen10111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5438"/>And he gave to them <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lands of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations,<l eID="gen10111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10112"/>and they inherited <transChange type="added">the</transChange> labor of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples, <l eID="gen10112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5439"/><l level="1" sID="gen10113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5439"/>so that they might observe his statutes,<l eID="gen10113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10114"/>and keep his laws.<l eID="gen10114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10115"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen10115" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10023"/> <chapter eID="Ps.105"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5440"/><title type="x-s">Praise to Yahweh for His Faithfulness in Israel’s History</title> <div sID="gen10116" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10116" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10117"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5440"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> Give thanks to Yahweh, for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> good,<l eID="gen10118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10119"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen10119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5441"/><l level="1" sID="gen10120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5441"/>Who can utter the mighty deeds of Yahweh,<l eID="gen10120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10121"/><transChange type="added">or</transChange> proclaim all his praise? <l eID="gen10121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5442"/><l level="1" sID="gen10122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5442"/>Blessed are <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> observe justice,<l eID="gen10122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10123"/><transChange type="added">he who</transChange> does righteousness at all times. <l eID="gen10123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5443"/><l level="1" sID="gen10124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5443"/>Remember me, O Yahweh, when <transChange type="added">you show</transChange> favor to your people.<l eID="gen10124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10125"/>Look after me when you deliver, <l eID="gen10125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5444"/><l level="1" sID="gen10126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5444"/>that <transChange type="added">I</transChange> may see the good <transChange type="added">done</transChange> your chosen ones,<l eID="gen10126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10127"/>to be glad in the joy of your nation,<l eID="gen10127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10128"/>to glory together with your inheritance. <l eID="gen10128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5445"/><l level="1" sID="gen10129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5445"/>We have sinned <transChange type="added">along</transChange> with our ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note><l eID="gen10129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10130"/>We have committed iniquity; we have incurred guilt. <l eID="gen10130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5446"/><l level="1" sID="gen10131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5446"/>Our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> in Egypt did not understand your wonderful works.<l eID="gen10131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10132"/>They did not remember your many acts of loyal love,<l eID="gen10132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10133"/>and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> they rebelled by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea at <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reed”</note> <l eID="gen10133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5447"/><l level="1" sID="gen10134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5447"/>Yet he saved them for the sake of his name,<l eID="gen10134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10135"/>to make known his might. <l eID="gen10135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5448"/><l level="1" sID="gen10136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5448"/>So he rebuked <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reed”</note> and it dried up,<l eID="gen10136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10137"/>and he led them through the deep as <transChange type="added">through</transChange> a desert. <l eID="gen10137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5449"/><l level="1" sID="gen10138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5449"/>Thus he saved them from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hater<l eID="gen10138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10139"/>and redeemed them from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy. <l eID="gen10139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5450"/><l level="1" sID="gen10140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5450"/>But waters covered their adversaries;<l eID="gen10140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10141"/>not one of them survived. <l eID="gen10141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5451"/><l level="1" sID="gen10142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5451"/>Then they believed his words;<l eID="gen10142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10143"/>they sang his praise. <l eID="gen10143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5452"/><l level="1" sID="gen10144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5452"/>They quickly forgot his works;<l eID="gen10144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10145"/>they did not wait for his counsel. <l eID="gen10145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5453"/><l level="1" sID="gen10146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5453"/>And they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞craved intensely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “craved a craving”</note> in the wilderness,<l eID="gen10146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10147"/>and tested God in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert. <l eID="gen10147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5454"/><l level="1" sID="gen10148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5454"/>So he gave to them their request,<l eID="gen10148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10149"/>but he sent leanness into their souls.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “soul” or “inner self”</note> <l eID="gen10149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5455"/><l level="1" sID="gen10150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5455"/>And they were jealous of Moses in the camp,<l eID="gen10150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10151"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> of Aaron, the holy one of Yahweh. <l eID="gen10151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5456"/><l level="1" sID="gen10152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5456"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> earth opened and swallowed up Dathan,<l eID="gen10152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10153"/>and it covered over the gang of Abiram. <l eID="gen10153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5457"/><l level="1" sID="gen10154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5457"/>Also fire burned in their assembly;<l eID="gen10154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10155"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> flame devoured <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked. <l eID="gen10155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5458"/><l level="1" sID="gen10156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5458"/>They made a calf at Horeb<l eID="gen10156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10157"/>and bowed down to a cast image. <l eID="gen10157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5459"/><l level="1" sID="gen10158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5459"/>And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> they exchanged their glory<l eID="gen10158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10159"/>for an image of an ox that eats grass. <l eID="gen10159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5460"/><l level="1" sID="gen10160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5460"/>They forgot God their Savior,<l eID="gen10160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10161"/>who had done great things in Egypt, <l eID="gen10161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5461"/><l level="1" sID="gen10162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5461"/>wonders in the land of Ham,<l eID="gen10162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10163"/>awesome deeds by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reed”</note> <l eID="gen10163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5462"/><l level="1" sID="gen10164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5462"/>So he said he would exterminate them,<l eID="gen10164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10165"/>had not Moses, his chosen one,<l eID="gen10165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10166"/>stood in the breach before him,<l eID="gen10166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10167"/>to reverse his wrath from destroying <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <l eID="gen10167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5463"/><l level="1" sID="gen10168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5463"/>Then they refused the desirable land;<l eID="gen10168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10169"/>they did not believe his word, <l eID="gen10169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5464"/><l level="1" sID="gen10170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5464"/>but grumbled in their tents.<l eID="gen10170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10171"/>They did not obey the voice of Yahweh. <l eID="gen10171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5465"/><l level="1" sID="gen10172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5465"/>So <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he made an oath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he lifted his hand,” an act accompanying an oath</note> against them,<l eID="gen10172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10173"/>to make them drop in the wilderness, <l eID="gen10173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5466"/><l level="1" sID="gen10174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5466"/>and to disperse<note placement="foot">Or “let drop”</note> their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞descendants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “seed”</note> among the nations<l eID="gen10174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10175"/>and to scatter them among the lands. <l eID="gen10175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5467"/><l level="1" sID="gen10176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5467"/>They also attached themselves to Baal of Peor,<l eID="gen10176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10177"/>and they ate sacrifices offered to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dead.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sacrifices of dead”</note> <l eID="gen10177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5468"/><l level="1" sID="gen10178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5468"/>Thus they provoked to anger by their deeds,<l eID="gen10178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10179"/>and a plague broke out among them. <l eID="gen10179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5469"/><l level="1" sID="gen10180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5469"/>Then Phinehas stood up and intervened,<l eID="gen10180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10181"/>and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> the plague was stopped, <l eID="gen10181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5470"/><l level="1" sID="gen10182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5470"/>and it was reckoned to him as righteousness<l eID="gen10182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10183"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout all generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for a generation and a generation”</note> <l eID="gen10183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5471"/><l level="1" sID="gen10184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5471"/>They also angered <transChange type="added">God</transChange> at the waters of Meribah,<l eID="gen10184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10185"/>and it went badly for Moses on account of them, <l eID="gen10185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5472"/><l level="1" sID="gen10186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5472"/>because they rebelled against his Spirit,<note placement="foot">A slightly different verbal form yields “they embittered his spirit”</note><l eID="gen10186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10187"/>and he spoke thoughtlessly with his lips. <l eID="gen10187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5473"/><l level="1" sID="gen10188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5473"/>They did not exterminate the peoples,<l eID="gen10188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10189"/>as Yahweh had commanded them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “said to them”</note> <l eID="gen10189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5474"/><l level="1" sID="gen10190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5474"/>but they mingled with the nations<l eID="gen10190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10191"/>and learned their works, <l eID="gen10191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5475"/><l level="1" sID="gen10192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5475"/>and served their idols,<l eID="gen10192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10193"/>which became<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and they became”</note> a snare to them. <l eID="gen10193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5476"/><l level="1" sID="gen10194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5476"/>They even sacrificed their sons and daughters<l eID="gen10194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10195"/>to the demons, <l eID="gen10195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5477"/><l level="1" sID="gen10196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5477"/>and they poured out innocent blood,<l eID="gen10196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10197"/>the blood of their sons and daughters,<l eID="gen10197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10198"/>whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan,<l eID="gen10198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10199"/>and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> the land was defiled with the blood.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bloods,” that is, bloodshed</note> <l eID="gen10199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5478"/><l level="1" sID="gen10200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5478"/>And they became unclean by their works,<l eID="gen10200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10201"/>and were unfaithful in their deeds. <l eID="gen10201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5479"/><l level="1" sID="gen10202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5479"/>So Yahweh’s anger burned against his people,<l eID="gen10202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10203"/>and he abhorred his inheritance. <l eID="gen10203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5480"/><l level="1" sID="gen10204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5480"/>Then he gave them into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations,<l eID="gen10204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10205"/>and those who hated them ruled over them. <l eID="gen10205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5481"/><l level="1" sID="gen10206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5481"/>And their enemies oppressed them,<l eID="gen10206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10207"/>and they were subdued under their hand. <l eID="gen10207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5482"/><l level="1" sID="gen10208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5482"/>Many times he delivered them,<l eID="gen10208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10209"/>but they rebelled in their counsel,<l eID="gen10209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10210"/>and were brought low by their iniquity. <l eID="gen10210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5483"/><l level="1" sID="gen10211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5483"/>Yet he looked upon their distress<l eID="gen10211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10212"/>when he heard their cry. <l eID="gen10212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5484"/><l level="1" sID="gen10213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5484"/>And he remembered his covenant with them,<l eID="gen10213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10214"/>and relented based on the abundance of his loyal love. <l eID="gen10214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5485"/><l level="1" sID="gen10215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5485"/>And he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞let them find compassion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gave them to have mercies”</note><l eID="gen10215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10216"/>before all their captors. <l eID="gen10216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5486"/><l level="1" sID="gen10217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5486"/>Save us, O Yahweh our God,<l eID="gen10217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10218"/>and gather us from the nations,<l eID="gen10218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10219"/>so that <transChange type="added">we may</transChange> give thanks to your holy name<l eID="gen10219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10220"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> boast in your praise. <l eID="gen10220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5487"/><l level="1" sID="gen10221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5487"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh, the God of Israel,<l eID="gen10221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10222"/>from everlasting and to everlasting.<l eID="gen10222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10223"/>And let all the people say, “Amen!”<l eID="gen10223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10224"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen10224" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10117"/> <chapter eID="Ps.106"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5488"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving to Yahweh for His of Deliverance</title> <div sID="gen10225" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10225" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10226"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5488"/>Give thanks to Yahweh, for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> good,<l eID="gen10227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10228"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen10228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5489"/><l level="1" sID="gen10229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5489"/>Let the redeemed of Yahweh declare<note placement="foot">Hebrew “say”</note> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,<l eID="gen10229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10230"/><transChange type="added">those</transChange> whom he has redeemed from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy <l eID="gen10230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5490"/><l level="1" sID="gen10231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5490"/>and gathered from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lands,<l eID="gen10231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10232"/>from east and from west, from north and from south.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sea” (<hi type="italic">yam</hi>), which usually means “west” in a listing of directions. The word “south” is expected (Hebrew <hi type="italic">yamin</hi>). Either the MT was corrupted early (along with <reference osisRef="Isa.49.12">Isa 49:12; </reference>the LXX reads “sea” in both) or it looks to the bodies of waters to the south (see also the Targum)</note> <l eID="gen10232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5491"/><l level="1" sID="gen10233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5491"/>They wandered in the wilderness, in a desert.<l eID="gen10233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10234"/>They could find no way<note placement="foot">The MT reads “way” with the previous line.</note> to a city to inhabit. <l eID="gen10234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5492"/><l level="1" sID="gen10235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5492"/>Hungry and thirsty,<l eID="gen10235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10236"/>their soul grew faint within them. <l eID="gen10236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5493"/><l level="1" sID="gen10237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5493"/>Then they cried out to Yahweh in their trouble.<l eID="gen10237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10238"/>He delivered them from their distresses <l eID="gen10238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5494"/><l level="1" sID="gen10239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5494"/>and led them by a straight way<l eID="gen10239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10240"/>to get to a city to inhabit. <l eID="gen10240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5495"/><l level="1" sID="gen10241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5495"/>Let them give thanks to Yahweh for his loyal love,<l eID="gen10241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10242"/>and his wonderful deeds for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of humankind, <l eID="gen10242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5496"/><l level="1" sID="gen10243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5496"/>for he satisfies <transChange type="added">the</transChange> longing soul,<note placement="foot">Thirst is perhaps in view</note><l eID="gen10243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10244"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hungry soul he fills with good. <l eID="gen10244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5497"/><l level="1" sID="gen10245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5497"/><transChange type="added">Those who</transChange> sat in darkness and gloom,<l eID="gen10245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10246"/>prisoners of misery and iron— <l eID="gen10246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5498"/><l level="1" sID="gen10247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5498"/>because they rebelled against the words of God<l eID="gen10247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10248"/>and spurned the counsel of the Most High, <l eID="gen10248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5499"/><l level="1" sID="gen10249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5499"/>he therefore humbled their heart with trouble.<l eID="gen10249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10250"/>They stumbled and there was no helper. <l eID="gen10250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5500"/><l level="1" sID="gen10251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5500"/>Then they called to Yahweh for help in their trouble;<l eID="gen10251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10252"/>he saved them from their distresses. <l eID="gen10252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5501"/><l level="1" sID="gen10253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5501"/>He brought them out of darkness and gloom,<l eID="gen10253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10254"/>and tore off their bonds. <l eID="gen10254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5502"/><l level="1" sID="gen10255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5502"/>Let them give thanks to Yahweh for his loyal love<l eID="gen10255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10256"/>and his wonderful deeds for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of humankind, <l eID="gen10256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5503"/><l level="1" sID="gen10257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5503"/>for he shatters <transChange type="added">the</transChange> doors of bronze,<l eID="gen10257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10258"/>and cuts through <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bars of iron. <l eID="gen10258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5504"/><l level="1" sID="gen10259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5504"/>Fools, because of their rebellious way<l eID="gen10259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10260"/>and their iniquities, were afflicted. <l eID="gen10260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5505"/><l level="1" sID="gen10261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5505"/>Their soul abhorred all food,<l eID="gen10261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10262"/>and they approached <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gates of death. <l eID="gen10262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5506"/><l level="1" sID="gen10263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5506"/>Then they called to Yahweh for help in their trouble.<l eID="gen10263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10264"/>He saved them from their distresses. <l eID="gen10264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5507"/><l level="1" sID="gen10265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5507"/>He sent his word and healed them,<l eID="gen10265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10266"/>and he delivered <transChange type="added">them</transChange> from their pits.<note placement="foot">This word is only found elsewhere in <reference osisRef="Lam.4.20">Lam 4:20 </reference>with the sense of “traps”</note> <l eID="gen10266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5508"/><l level="1" sID="gen10267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5508"/>Let them give thanks to Yahweh for his loyal love,<l eID="gen10267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10268"/>and his wonderful deeds for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of humankind, <l eID="gen10268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5509"/><l level="1" sID="gen10269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5509"/>and let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving,<l eID="gen10269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10270"/>and tell of his works with rejoicing. <l eID="gen10270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5510"/><l level="1" sID="gen10271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5510"/><transChange type="added">Those who</transChange> went down to the sea into ships,<l eID="gen10271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10272"/>doing business on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞high seas⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “many waters”</note> <l eID="gen10272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5511"/><l level="1" sID="gen10273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5511"/>they saw the works of Yahweh,<l eID="gen10273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10274"/>and his wonderful deeds in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deep. <l eID="gen10274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5512"/><l level="1" sID="gen10275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5512"/>For he spoke and raised up a stormy wind,<l eID="gen10275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10276"/>and it whipped up its waves. <l eID="gen10276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5513"/><l level="1" sID="gen10277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5513"/>They rose to the heavens; they plunged to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths.<l eID="gen10277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10278"/>Their soul melted in their calamity. <l eID="gen10278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:27
