verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5514"/><l level="1" sID="gen10279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5514"/>They reeled and staggered like a drunkard,<l eID="gen10279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10280"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they were at their wits’ end⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all their wisdom was swallowed up”</note> <l eID="gen10280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5515"/><l level="1" sID="gen10281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5515"/>Then they cried out to Yahweh in their trouble,<l eID="gen10281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10282"/>and he brought them out of their distresses. <l eID="gen10282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5516"/><l level="1" sID="gen10283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5516"/>He made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> storm be still<l eID="gen10283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10284"/>and their waves became calm. <l eID="gen10284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5517"/><l level="1" sID="gen10285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5517"/>Then they were glad because they grew silent,<l eID="gen10285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10286"/>so he guided them to their desired harbor. <l eID="gen10286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5518"/><l level="1" sID="gen10287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5518"/>Let them give thanks to Yahweh for his loyal love<l eID="gen10287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10288"/>and his wonderful deeds for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of humankind, <l eID="gen10288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5519"/><l level="1" sID="gen10289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5519"/>and let them exalt him in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> congregation of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people,<l eID="gen10289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10290"/>and praise him in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> assembly of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> elders. <l eID="gen10290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5520"/><l level="1" sID="gen10291"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5520"/>He turns rivers into a wilderness<l eID="gen10291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10292"/>and springs of water into thirsty ground, <l eID="gen10292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5521"/><l level="1" sID="gen10293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5521"/>a fruitful land into a salty place,<l eID="gen10293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10294"/>because of the evil of its inhabitants. <l eID="gen10294" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5522"/><l level="1" sID="gen10295"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5522"/>He turns a wilderness into a pool of water<l eID="gen10295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10296"/>and a dry land into springs of water. <l eID="gen10296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5523"/><l level="1" sID="gen10297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5523"/>And he settles <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hungry there,<l eID="gen10297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10298"/>so that they may establish a city to inhabit, <l eID="gen10298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5524"/><l level="1" sID="gen10299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5524"/>and sow fields and plant vineyards,<l eID="gen10299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10300"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that they may yield fruit at harvest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and make a fruit of produce”</note> <l eID="gen10300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5525"/><l level="1" sID="gen10301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5525"/>And he blesses them and they multiply greatly,<l eID="gen10301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10302"/>and he does not let their cattle become few. <l eID="gen10302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5526"/><l level="1" sID="gen10303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5526"/>When they become few and they are bent down<l eID="gen10303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10304"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppression of calamity and grief, <l eID="gen10304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5527"/><l level="1" sID="gen10305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5527"/><transChange type="added">he</transChange> pours contempt on princes<l eID="gen10305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10306"/>and causes them to wander in a trackless waste. <l eID="gen10306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5528"/><l level="1" sID="gen10307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5528"/>But he protects<note placement="foot">The sense is that of making something inaccessibly high, like a fortress</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy from misery,<l eID="gen10307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10308"/>and he makes <transChange type="added">their</transChange> families like a flock. <l eID="gen10308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5529"/><l level="1" sID="gen10309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5529"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> upright see <transChange type="added">it</transChange> and are glad,<l eID="gen10309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10310"/>and all wickedness shuts its mouth. <l eID="gen10310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5530"/><l level="1" sID="gen10311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5530"/>Whoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wise, then let him observe these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>,<l eID="gen10311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10312"/>and let them consider Yahweh’s acts of loyal love. <l eID="gen10312" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10226"/> <chapter eID="Ps.107"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5531"/><title type="x-s">Prayer to Yahweh for Victory over Enemies</title> <div sID="gen10313" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10313" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10314"/> <lg eID="gen10314"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song. A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen10315"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5531"/>My heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> steadfast, O God.<l eID="gen10316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10317"/>I will sing and give praise, even <transChange type="added">with</transChange> my glory. <l eID="gen10317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5532"/><l level="1" sID="gen10318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5532"/>Awake, harp and lyre.<l eID="gen10318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10319"/>I will awake <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dawn.<note placement="foot">Or “I will awake at dawn”</note> <l eID="gen10319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5533"/><l level="1" sID="gen10320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5533"/>I will give you thanks among the peoples, O Yahweh;<l eID="gen10320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10321"/>I will give you praise among the nations, <l eID="gen10321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5534"/><l level="1" sID="gen10322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5534"/>because your loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great above <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens,<l eID="gen10322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10323"/>and your faithfulness <transChange type="added">reaches</transChange> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clouds. <l eID="gen10323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5535"/><l level="1" sID="gen10324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5535"/>Be exalted above <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens, O God,<l eID="gen10324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10325"/>and <transChange type="added">let</transChange> your glory <transChange type="added">be</transChange> above all the earth, <l eID="gen10325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5536"/><l level="1" sID="gen10326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5536"/>so that your beloved ones may be rescued.<l eID="gen10326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10327"/>Save by your right hand and answer me. <l eID="gen10327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5537"/><l level="1" sID="gen10328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5537"/>God has spoken in his holiness,<l eID="gen10328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10329"/>“I will exult, I will divide up Shechem,<l eID="gen10329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10330"/>and portion out the valley of Succoth. <l eID="gen10330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5538"/><l level="1" sID="gen10331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5538"/>Gilead <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine. Manasseh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine.<l eID="gen10331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10332"/>And Ephraim <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞helmet for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “protection of”</note> my head.<l eID="gen10332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10333"/>Judah <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my scepter;<note placement="foot">Or “commander’s rod”</note> <l eID="gen10333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5539"/><l level="1" sID="gen10334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5539"/>Moab <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my washing pot.<l eID="gen10334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10335"/>Over Edom I will cast my sandal;<l eID="gen10335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10336"/>Over Philistia I will shout in triumph.” <l eID="gen10336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5540"/><l level="1" sID="gen10337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5540"/>Who will bring me to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fortified city?<l eID="gen10337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10338"/>Who will lead me to Edom? <l eID="gen10338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5541"/><l level="1" sID="gen10339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5541"/>Have you not rejected us, O God,<l eID="gen10339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10340"/>and not gone out with our armies, O God? <l eID="gen10340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5542"/><l level="1" sID="gen10341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5542"/>Give us help against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy,<l eID="gen10341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10342"/>for the help of humankind <transChange type="added">is</transChange> futile. <l eID="gen10342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5543"/><l level="1" sID="gen10343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5543"/>Through God we will do valiantly,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “do might”</note><l eID="gen10343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10344"/>and <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> he <transChange type="added">who</transChange> will tread down our enemies. <l eID="gen10344" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10315"/> <chapter eID="Ps.108"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5544"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Help against Enemies</title> <div sID="gen10345" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10345" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10346"/> <lg eID="gen10346"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen10347"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5544"/>O God of my praise, do not keep silent, <l eID="gen10348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5545"/><l level="1" sID="gen10349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5545"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wicked and deceitful mouths⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a wicked mouth and a deceitful mouth”</note><l eID="gen10349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10350"/>have opened against me.<l eID="gen10350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10351"/>They speak to me with a lying tongue. <l eID="gen10351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5546"/><l level="1" sID="gen10352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5546"/>They also surround me with words of hate,<l eID="gen10352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10353"/>and fight me without cause. <l eID="gen10353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5547"/><l level="1" sID="gen10354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5547"/>In return for my love they accuse me,<l eID="gen10354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10355"/>though I <transChange type="added">am in</transChange> prayer.<note placement="foot">Or perhaps “I have a plea of innocence”</note> <l eID="gen10355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5548"/><l level="1" sID="gen10356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5548"/>So they inflicted evil against me in return for good<l eID="gen10356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10357"/>and hatred in return for my love. <l eID="gen10357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5549"/><l level="1" sID="gen10358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5549"/>Appoint over him a wicked <transChange type="added">man</transChange>,<l eID="gen10358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10359"/>and let an accuser stand at his right <transChange type="added">hand</transChange>. <l eID="gen10359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5550"/><l level="1" sID="gen10360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5550"/>When he is judged, let him come out guilty,<l eID="gen10360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10361"/>and let his prayer<note placement="foot">Or perhaps “plea of innocence”</note> become as sin. <l eID="gen10361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5551"/><l level="1" sID="gen10362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5551"/>Let his days be few;<l eID="gen10362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10363"/>let another take his office. <l eID="gen10363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5552"/><l level="1" sID="gen10364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5552"/>Let his children be orphans,<l eID="gen10364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10365"/>and his wife a widow, <l eID="gen10365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5553"/><l level="1" sID="gen10366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5553"/>and let his children wander aimlessly and beg,<l eID="gen10366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10367"/>and let them plead from their ruins. <l eID="gen10367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5554"/><l level="1" sID="gen10368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5554"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> creditor seize all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his,<l eID="gen10368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10369"/>and let strangers plunder his property. <l eID="gen10369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5555"/><l level="1" sID="gen10370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5555"/>Let there be none <transChange type="added">who</transChange> extend to him loyal love,<l eID="gen10370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10371"/>nor any who pities his orphans. <l eID="gen10371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5556"/><l level="1" sID="gen10372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5556"/>Let his descendants<note placement="foot">Or “posterity”; Hebrew is singular</note> be cut off.<l eID="gen10372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10373"/>Let their name be blotted out in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> next generation. <l eID="gen10373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5557"/><l level="1" sID="gen10374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5557"/>Let the iniquity of his ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> be remembered before Yahweh,<l eID="gen10374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10375"/>and let the sin of his mother not be blotted out. <l eID="gen10375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5558"/><l level="1" sID="gen10376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5558"/>Let them be before Yahweh continually,<l eID="gen10376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10377"/>that he may cut off their<note placement="foot">That is, the family</note> memory from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth, <l eID="gen10377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5559"/><l level="1" sID="gen10378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5559"/>because he did not remember to show loyal love,<l eID="gen10378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10379"/>but he pursued anyone,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “a man”</note> poor or needy<l eID="gen10379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10380"/>or brokenhearted, to slay <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <l eID="gen10380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5560"/><l level="1" sID="gen10381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5560"/>Because he loved cursing, let it come <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> him.<l eID="gen10381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10382"/>Because he did not delight in blessing,<l eID="gen10382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10383"/>let it be far from him. <l eID="gen10383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5561"/><l level="1" sID="gen10384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5561"/>Because he wore a curse as his robe,<l eID="gen10384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10385"/>let it enter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his inward part”</note> like water,<l eID="gen10385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10386"/>and into his bones like oil. <l eID="gen10386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5562"/><l level="1" sID="gen10387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5562"/>May it be for him like a garment <transChange type="added">in which</transChange> he wraps,<l eID="gen10387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10388"/>and a belt <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he continually wears⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “continually he girds it”</note> <l eID="gen10388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5563"/><l level="1" sID="gen10389"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5563"/>Let this <transChange type="added">be</transChange> the punishment for my accusers from Yahweh,<l eID="gen10389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10390"/>even those who speak evil against my life. <l eID="gen10390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5564"/><l level="1" sID="gen10391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5564"/>But you, O Yahweh my Lord,<l eID="gen10391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10392"/>deal with me for your name’s sake.<l eID="gen10392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10393"/>Because your loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good, deliver me, <l eID="gen10393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5565"/><l level="1" sID="gen10394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5565"/>for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> poor and needy,<l eID="gen10394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10395"/>and my heart is wounded within me. <l eID="gen10395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5566"/><l level="1" sID="gen10396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5566"/>Like a lengthening shadow I am passing away;<l eID="gen10396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10397"/>I am shaken off like a locust. <l eID="gen10397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5567"/><l level="1" sID="gen10398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5567"/>My knees <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞buckle⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “stumble”</note> from fasting,<l eID="gen10398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10399"/>and my body grows lean without fat. <l eID="gen10399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5568"/><l level="1" sID="gen10400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5568"/>And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I am a disgrace to them;<l eID="gen10400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10401"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> they see me, they shake their heads.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “head”</note> <l eID="gen10401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5569"/><l level="1" sID="gen10402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5569"/>Help me, O Yahweh my God;<l eID="gen10402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10403"/>save me according to your loyal love, <l eID="gen10403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5570"/><l level="1" sID="gen10404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5570"/>that they may know that this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your hand,<l eID="gen10404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10405"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> you, O Yahweh, you have done it. <l eID="gen10405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5571"/><l level="1" sID="gen10406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5571"/>Let them curse, but you bless.<l eID="gen10406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10407"/><transChange type="added">When</transChange> they arise, let them be put to shame,<l eID="gen10407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10408"/>that your servant may be glad. <l eID="gen10408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5572"/><l level="1" sID="gen10409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5572"/>Let my accusers put on disgrace,<l eID="gen10409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10410"/>and let them cover <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> with their shame as with a robe. <l eID="gen10410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5573"/><l level="1" sID="gen10411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5573"/>I will give thanks to Yahweh exceedingly with my mouth,<l eID="gen10411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10412"/>and in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> midst of many I will praise him, <l eID="gen10412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5574"/><l level="1" sID="gen10413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5574"/>for he stands at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> right <transChange type="added">hand</transChange> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy,<l eID="gen10413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10414"/>to save <transChange type="added">him</transChange> from those judging his life.<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> <l eID="gen10414" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10347"/> <chapter eID="Ps.109"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5575"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Gives Authority to His Messiah</title> <div sID="gen10415" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10415" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10416"/> <lg eID="gen10416"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen10417"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5575"/>A declaration of Yahweh to my lord,<l eID="gen10418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10419"/>“Sit at my right <transChange type="added">hand</transChange><l eID="gen10419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10420"/>until I make your enemies your footstool.” <l eID="gen10420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5576"/><l level="1" sID="gen10421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5576"/>Yahweh will send out your mighty scepter from Zion;<l eID="gen10421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10422"/>rule in the midst of your enemies. <l eID="gen10422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5577"/><l level="1" sID="gen10423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5577"/>Your people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will volunteer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will be freewill offerings”; see the related verbal form in <reference osisRef="Judeg.5.2">Judg 5:2</reference></note> in the day of your power.<note placement="foot">Or “day of your army,” or “day of battle”</note><l eID="gen10423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10424"/>In holy splendor, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dawn,<l eID="gen10424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10425"/>you will have the dew of your youth.<note placement="foot">The meaning of this verse is obscure</note> <l eID="gen10425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5578"/><l level="1" sID="gen10426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5578"/>Yahweh has sworn and he will not change <transChange type="added">his mind</transChange>,<l eID="gen10426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10427"/>“You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a priest forever<l eID="gen10427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10428"/>according to the manner of Melchizedek.” <l eID="gen10428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5579"/><l level="1" sID="gen10429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5579"/>O Lord, at your right <transChange type="added">hand</transChange><l eID="gen10429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10430"/>he will shatter kings in the day of his anger. <l eID="gen10430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5580"/><l level="1" sID="gen10431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5580"/>He will judge among the nations;<l eID="gen10431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10432"/>he will fill <transChange type="added">them</transChange> with corpses.<l eID="gen10432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10433"/>He will shatter <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rulers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note> of many countries. <l eID="gen10433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5581"/><l level="1" sID="gen10434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5581"/>He will drink from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stream by the road;<l eID="gen10434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10435"/>therefore he will lift up <transChange type="added">his</transChange> head. <l eID="gen10435" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10417"/> <chapter eID="Ps.110"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5582"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for His Work and Commands</title> <div sID="gen10436" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10436" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10437"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5582"/>Praise Yah!<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note><l eID="gen10438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10439"/>I will give thanks to Yahweh with all <transChange type="added">my</transChange> heart,<l eID="gen10439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10440"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> assembly of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> upright and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> congregation. <l eID="gen10440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5583"/><l level="1" sID="gen10441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5583"/>The works of Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> great,<l eID="gen10441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10442"/>studied<note placement="foot">Or “pondered”</note> by all <transChange type="added">who</transChange> delight <transChange type="added">in</transChange> them. <l eID="gen10442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5584"/><l level="1" sID="gen10443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5584"/><transChange type="added">Full of</transChange> splendor and majesty <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his work,<l eID="gen10443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10444"/>and his righteousness endures forever. <l eID="gen10444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5585"/><l level="1" sID="gen10445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5585"/>He has made his wonders <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to be remembered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a remembrance”</note><l eID="gen10445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10446"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> gracious and compassionate. <l eID="gen10446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5586"/><l level="1" sID="gen10447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5586"/>He gives food to those who fear him;<l eID="gen10447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10448"/>he remembers his covenant forever. <l eID="gen10448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5587"/><l level="1" sID="gen10449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5587"/>He has declared the power of his works for his people,<l eID="gen10449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10450"/>by giving to them <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inheritance of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations. <l eID="gen10450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5588"/><l level="1" sID="gen10451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5588"/>The works of his hands <transChange type="added">are</transChange> faithfulness and justice;<l eID="gen10451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10452"/>all his precepts <transChange type="added">are</transChange> reliable. <l eID="gen10452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5589"/><l level="1" sID="gen10453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5589"/><transChange type="added">They are</transChange> sustained forever <transChange type="added">and</transChange> ever,<l eID="gen10453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10454"/>done with faithfulness and uprightness. <l eID="gen10454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5590"/><l level="1" sID="gen10455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5590"/>He has sent redemption to his people;<l eID="gen10455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10456"/>he has commanded his covenant forever;<l eID="gen10456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10457"/>holy and fearful <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name. <l eID="gen10457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5591"/><l level="1" sID="gen10458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5591"/>The fear of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> beginning of wisdom;<l eID="gen10458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10459"/>all who do them<note placement="foot">That is, his precepts (v. <reference osisRef="Ps.111.7">7</reference>), or the stipulations of his covenant (v. <reference osisRef="Ps.111.9">9</reference>)</note> have a good understanding.<l eID="gen10459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10460"/>His praise endures forever. <l eID="gen10460" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10437"/> <chapter eID="Ps.111"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5592"/><title type="x-s">The Path of the Righteous and the Path of the Wicked</title> <div sID="gen10461" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10461" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10462"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5592"/>Praise Yah!<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note><l eID="gen10463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10464"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> man <transChange type="added">who</transChange> fears Yahweh;<l eID="gen10464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10465"/>he takes great delight in his commands. <l eID="gen10465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5593"/><l level="1" sID="gen10466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5593"/>His <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞descendants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “seed”</note> will be mighty in the land;<l eID="gen10466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10467"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> generation of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> upright will be blessed. <l eID="gen10467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5594"/><l level="1" sID="gen10468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5594"/>Wealth and riches <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in his house,<l eID="gen10468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10469"/>and his righteousness endures forever. <l eID="gen10469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5595"/><l level="1" sID="gen10470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5595"/><transChange type="added">His</transChange> light rises in the darkness for the upright;<l eID="gen10470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10471"/><transChange type="added">he is</transChange> gracious and compassionate and righteous. <l eID="gen10471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5596"/><l level="1" sID="gen10472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5596"/><transChange type="added">It goes</transChange> well <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a man <transChange type="added">who</transChange> is gracious and lends,<l eID="gen10472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10473"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> conducts his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞business properly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “matters in justice”</note> <l eID="gen10473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5597"/><l level="1" sID="gen10474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5597"/>For he will not be shaken forever;<l eID="gen10474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10475"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will be remembered forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “will be for an eternal remembrance”</note> <l eID="gen10475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5598"/><l level="1" sID="gen10476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5598"/>He is not afraid of bad news;<l eID="gen10476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10477"/>his heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> steadfast, secure<note placement="foot">Or “full of trust”</note> in Yahweh. <l eID="gen10477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5599"/><l level="1" sID="gen10478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5599"/>His heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sustained; he will not be afraid,<l eID="gen10478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10479"/>until he looks <transChange type="added">in triumph</transChange> on his enemies. <l eID="gen10479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5600"/><l level="1" sID="gen10480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5600"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He gives lavishly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “He distributes freely, he gives”</note> to the needy;<l eID="gen10480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10481"/>his righteousness endures forever.<l eID="gen10481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10482"/>His horn rises high in honor. <l eID="gen10482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5601"/><l level="1" sID="gen10483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5601"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> wicked<note placement="foot">Singular</note> sees <transChange type="added">it</transChange> and is vexed.<l eID="gen10483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10484"/>He gnashes his teeth and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞becomes weak⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and melts”</note><l eID="gen10484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10485"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> desire of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked<note placement="foot">Plural</note> perishes. <l eID="gen10485" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10462"/> <chapter eID="Ps.112"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5602"/><title type="x-s">God’s Majesty and Care for the Needy</title> <div sID="gen10486" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10486" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10487"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5602"/>Praise Yah!<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note><l eID="gen10488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10489"/>Praise, O servants of Yahweh,<l eID="gen10489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10490"/>praise the name of Yahweh. <l eID="gen10490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5603"/><l level="1" sID="gen10491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5603"/>Let the name of Yahweh be blessed,<l eID="gen10491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10492"/>from now until forever. <l eID="gen10492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5604"/><l level="1" sID="gen10493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5604"/>From <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rising of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun to its setting,<l eID="gen10493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10494"/><transChange type="added">let</transChange> the name of Yahweh be blessed. <l eID="gen10494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5605"/><l level="1" sID="gen10495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5605"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> high above all nations;<l eID="gen10495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10496"/>his glory <transChange type="added">is</transChange> above the heavens. <l eID="gen10496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5606"/><l level="1" sID="gen10497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5606"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like Yahweh our God,<l eID="gen10497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10498"/>who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> enthroned on high,<note placement="foot">Or “who dwells on high”</note> <l eID="gen10498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5607"/><l level="1" sID="gen10499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5607"/>who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞condescends to look at⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “makes low to see”</note><l eID="gen10499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10500"/><transChange type="added">what is</transChange> in the heavens and in the earth? <l eID="gen10500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5608"/><l level="1" sID="gen10501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5608"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> raises <transChange type="added">the</transChange> helpless from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust;<l eID="gen10501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10502"/>he lifts <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ash heap, <l eID="gen10502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5609"/><l level="1" sID="gen10503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5609"/>to seat <transChange type="added">them</transChange> with princes,<l eID="gen10503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10504"/>with the princes of his people. <l eID="gen10504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5610"/><l level="1" sID="gen10505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5610"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> causes the barren woman of the house to dwell<l eID="gen10505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10506"/><transChange type="added">as</transChange> the happy mother of children.<l eID="gen10506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10507"/>Praise Yah!<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen10507" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10487"/> <chapter eID="Ps.113"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5611"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for His Works During the Exodus</title> <div sID="gen10508" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10508" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10509"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5611"/>When Israel went out from Egypt,<l eID="gen10510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10511"/>the house of Jacob from a people of a strange language, <l eID="gen10511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5612"/><l level="1" sID="gen10512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5612"/>Judah became his sanctuary,<l eID="gen10512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10513"/>Israel his dominion. <l eID="gen10513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5613"/><l level="1" sID="gen10514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5613"/>The sea looked and fled;<l eID="gen10514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10515"/>the Jordan turned back. <l eID="gen10515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5614"/><l level="1" sID="gen10516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5614"/>The mountains skipped like rams,<l eID="gen10516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10517"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> hills like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lambs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of the flock”</note> <l eID="gen10517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5615"/><l level="1" sID="gen10518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5615"/>What’s with you, O sea, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you fled?<l eID="gen10518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10519"/>O Jordan, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you turned back? <l eID="gen10519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5616"/><l level="1" sID="gen10520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5616"/>O mountains, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you skipped like rams?<l eID="gen10520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10521"/>O hills, like lambs? <l eID="gen10521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5617"/><l level="1" sID="gen10522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5617"/>At the presence of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Lord writhe, O earth,<note placement="foot">Or “O land”</note><l eID="gen10522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10523"/>at the presence of the God of Jacob, <l eID="gen10523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5618"/><l level="1" sID="gen10524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5618"/>who turned the rock into a pool of water,<l eID="gen10524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10525"/>flinty stone into a spring of water. <l eID="gen10525" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10509"/> <chapter eID="Ps.114"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5619"/><title type="x-s">Dead Idols and the Living God</title> <div sID="gen10526" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10526" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10527"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5619"/>Not to us, O Yahweh, not to us,<l eID="gen10528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10529"/>but to your name give glory,<l eID="gen10529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10530"/>because of your loyal love,<l eID="gen10530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10531"/>because of your faithfulness. <l eID="gen10531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5620"/><l level="1" sID="gen10532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5620"/>Why should the nations say,<l eID="gen10532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10533"/>“Where, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pray tell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “please”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their God?” <l eID="gen10533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5621"/><l level="1" sID="gen10534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5621"/>But our God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the heavens;<l eID="gen10534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10535"/>all that he desires, he does. <l eID="gen10535" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5622"/><l level="1" sID="gen10536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5622"/>Their idols <transChange type="added">are</transChange> silver and gold,<l eID="gen10536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10537"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of human hands. <l eID="gen10537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5623"/><l level="1" sID="gen10538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5623"/>They have mouths, but cannot speak;<l eID="gen10538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10539"/>they have eyes, but cannot see; <l eID="gen10539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5624"/><l level="1" sID="gen10540"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5624"/>they have ears, but cannot hear;<l eID="gen10540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10541"/>they have noses, but cannot smell; <l eID="gen10541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5625"/><l level="1" sID="gen10542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5625"/><transChange type="added">they have</transChange> their hands, but they cannot feel,<l eID="gen10542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10543"/>their feet, but they cannot walk;<l eID="gen10543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10544"/>they cannot utter a sound in their throats. <l eID="gen10544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5626"/><l level="1" sID="gen10545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5626"/><transChange type="added">Those who</transChange> make them become like them,<l eID="gen10545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10546"/><transChange type="added">as does</transChange> everyone who trusts in them. <l eID="gen10546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5627"/><l level="1" sID="gen10547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5627"/>O Israel, trust Yahweh;<l eID="gen10547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10548"/>he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their help and their shield. <l eID="gen10548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5628"/><l level="1" sID="gen10549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5628"/>O house of Aaron, trust in Yahweh;<l eID="gen10549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10550"/>he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their help and their shield. <l eID="gen10550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5629"/><l level="1" sID="gen10551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5629"/><transChange type="added">You who</transChange> fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh;<l eID="gen10551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10552"/>he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their help and their shield. <l eID="gen10552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5630"/><l level="1" sID="gen10553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5630"/>Yahweh remembers us; he will bless <transChange type="added">us</transChange>.<l eID="gen10553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10554"/>He will bless the house of Israel;<l eID="gen10554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10555"/>he will bless the house of Aaron. <l eID="gen10555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5631"/><l level="1" sID="gen10556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5631"/>He will bless <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> fear Yahweh,<l eID="gen10556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10557"/>the small with the great. <l eID="gen10557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5632"/><l level="1" sID="gen10558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5632"/>May Yahweh give you increase,<l eID="gen10558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10559"/>you and your children. <l eID="gen10559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5633"/><l level="1" sID="gen10560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5633"/>May you be blessed by Yahweh,<l eID="gen10560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10561"/>who made heaven and earth. <l eID="gen10561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5634"/><l level="1" sID="gen10562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5634"/>The heavens <transChange type="added">are</transChange> Yahweh’s heavens,<l eID="gen10562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10563"/>but the earth he has given to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of humankind. <l eID="gen10563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5635"/><l level="1" sID="gen10564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5635"/>The dead do not praise Yah,<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen10564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10565"/>nor any descending into silence. <l eID="gen10565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5636"/><l level="1" sID="gen10566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5636"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> we, we will bless Yah<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen10566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10567"/>from now until forever.<l eID="gen10567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10568"/>Praise Yah!<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen10568" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10527"/> <chapter eID="Ps.115"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5637"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for God’s Deliverance</title> <div sID="gen10569" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10569" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10570"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5637"/>I love <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, because Yahweh has heard<l eID="gen10571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10572"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the voice of my supplications⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “my voice, my supplications”</note> <l eID="gen10572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5638"/><l level="1" sID="gen10573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5638"/>Because he has inclined his ear to me,<l eID="gen10573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10574"/>I will call <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all my days⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in my days”</note> <l eID="gen10574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5639"/><l level="1" sID="gen10575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5639"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> ropes of death encircled me,<l eID="gen10575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10576"/>and the distresses of Sheol found me.<l eID="gen10576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10577"/>I found trouble and grief. <l eID="gen10577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5640"/><l level="1" sID="gen10578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5640"/>Then I called on the name of Yahweh:<l eID="gen10578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10579"/>“O Yahweh, please save my life!” <l eID="gen10579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5641"/><l level="1" sID="gen10580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5641"/>Gracious <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh and righteous,<l eID="gen10580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10581"/>and our God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> merciful. <l eID="gen10581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5642"/><l level="1" sID="gen10582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5642"/>Yahweh watches over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> simple.<l eID="gen10582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10583"/>I was brought low, but he gave me victory. <l eID="gen10583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5643"/><l level="1" sID="gen10584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5643"/>Return, O my soul, to your repose,<l eID="gen10584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10585"/>for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you. <l eID="gen10585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5644"/><l level="1" sID="gen10586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5644"/>For you have rescued me<note placement="foot">Hebrew “my soul.” If “soul” is accepted, then “death” means “the place of death,” that is, the netherworld.</note> from death,<l eID="gen10586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10587"/>my eyes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “eye”</note> from tears, my feet from stumbling. <l eID="gen10587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5645"/><l level="1" sID="gen10588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5645"/>I will walk before Yahweh<l eID="gen10588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10589"/>in the land<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lands”</note> of the living. <l eID="gen10589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5646"/><l level="1" sID="gen10590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5646"/>I believed when I spoke,<l eID="gen10590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10591"/>“I am afflicted greatly.” <l eID="gen10591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5647"/><l level="1" sID="gen10592"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5647"/>I said in my haste,<l eID="gen10592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10593"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Everyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All of the humankind”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a liar.” <l eID="gen10593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5648"/><l level="1" sID="gen10594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5648"/>What shall I give back to Yahweh<l eID="gen10594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10595"/><transChange type="added">for</transChange> all his benefits to me? <l eID="gen10595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5649"/><l level="1" sID="gen10596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5649"/>I will lift up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cup of salvation<l eID="gen10596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10597"/>and proclaim the name of Yahweh. <l eID="gen10597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5650"/><l level="1" sID="gen10598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5650"/>I will pay my vows <transChange type="added">made</transChange> to Yahweh<l eID="gen10598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10599"/>in the presence of all his people. <l eID="gen10599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5651"/><l level="1" sID="gen10600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5651"/>Costly <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in Yahweh’s view⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the eyes of Yahweh”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange><l eID="gen10600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10601"/>the death of his faithful <transChange type="added">ones</transChange>. <l eID="gen10601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5652"/><l level="1" sID="gen10602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5652"/>Ah, Yahweh, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> indeed your servant;<l eID="gen10602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10603"/>I am your servant, the child of your maidservant.<l eID="gen10603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10604"/>You have loosed my bonds. <l eID="gen10604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5653"/><l level="1" sID="gen10605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5653"/>I will offer to you a sacrifice of thanksgiving,<l eID="gen10605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10606"/>and proclaim the name of Yahweh. <l eID="gen10606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5654"/><l level="1" sID="gen10607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5654"/>I will pay my vows <transChange type="added">made</transChange> to Yahweh<l eID="gen10607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10608"/>in the presence of all his people, <l eID="gen10608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5655"/><l level="1" sID="gen10609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5655"/>in the courts of the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh,<l eID="gen10609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10610"/>in the midst of you, O Jerusalem.<l eID="gen10610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10611"/>Praise Yah!<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen10611" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10570"/> <chapter eID="Ps.116"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5656"/><title type="x-s">Let All Peoples Praise Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen10612" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10612" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10613"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5656"/>Praise Yahweh, all you nations;<l eID="gen10614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10615"/>extol him, all you peoples. <l eID="gen10615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5657"/><l level="1" sID="gen10616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5657"/>For his loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mighty on our behalf,<l eID="gen10616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10617"/>and the faithfulness of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forever.<l eID="gen10617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10618"/>Praise Yah!<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen10618" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10613"/> <chapter eID="Ps.117"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5658"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for His Loyal Love</title> <div sID="gen10619" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10619" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10620"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5658"/>Give thanks to Yahweh for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> good,<l eID="gen10621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10622"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen10622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5659"/><l level="1" sID="gen10623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5659"/>Let Israel say,<l eID="gen10623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10624"/>“His loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forever.” <l eID="gen10624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5660"/><l level="1" sID="gen10625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5660"/>Let the house of Aaron say,<l eID="gen10625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10626"/>“His loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forever.” <l eID="gen10626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5661"/><l level="1" sID="gen10627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5661"/>Let <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> fear Yahweh say,<l eID="gen10627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10628"/>“His loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forever.” <l eID="gen10628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5662"/><l level="1" sID="gen10629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5662"/>Out of <transChange type="added">my</transChange> distress I called to Yah.<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen10629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10630"/>Yah answered me, <transChange type="added">setting me</transChange> in a broad place. <l eID="gen10630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5663"/><l level="1" sID="gen10631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5663"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for me; I do not fear.<l eID="gen10631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10632"/>What can <transChange type="added">mere</transChange> humans<note placement="foot">Or “humankind”</note> do to me? <l eID="gen10632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5664"/><l level="1" sID="gen10633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5664"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for me as my helper,<l eID="gen10633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10634"/>and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I will look <transChange type="added">in triumph</transChange> on those who hate me. <l eID="gen10634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5665"/><l level="1" sID="gen10635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5665"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> better to take refuge in Yahweh<l eID="gen10635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10636"/>than to trust in humans.<note placement="foot">Or “humankind”</note> <l eID="gen10636" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5666"/><l level="1" sID="gen10637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5666"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> better to take refuge in Yahweh<l eID="gen10637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10638"/>than to trust princes. <l eID="gen10638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5667"/><l level="1" sID="gen10639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5667"/>All nations surrounded me.<l eID="gen10639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10640"/>In the name of Yahweh I opposed them indeed. <l eID="gen10640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5668"/><l level="1" sID="gen10641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5668"/>They surrounded me; yes, they surrounded me.<l eID="gen10641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10642"/>In the name of Yahweh I opposed them indeed. <l eID="gen10642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5669"/><l level="1" sID="gen10643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5669"/>They surrounded me like bees;<l eID="gen10643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10644"/>they were extinguished like a fire of thorns.<l eID="gen10644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10645"/>In the name of Yahweh I opposed them indeed. <l eID="gen10645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5670"/><l level="1" sID="gen10646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5670"/>You pushed me hard<note placement="foot">Hebrew intensive “pushing, you pushed me”</note> to <transChange type="added">make me</transChange> fall,<l eID="gen10646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10647"/>but Yahweh helped me. <l eID="gen10647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5671"/><l level="1" sID="gen10648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5671"/>Yah<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note> is my strength and my song,<note placement="foot">Or “my might”</note><l eID="gen10648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10649"/>and he has become my salvation.<note placement="foot">Or “victory”</note> <l eID="gen10649" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5672"/><l level="1" sID="gen10650"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5672"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> sound of rejoicing and salvation<note placement="foot">Or “victory”</note><l eID="gen10650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10651"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tents of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous;<l eID="gen10651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10652"/>the right hand of Yahweh <transChange type="added">has</transChange> done valiantly. <l eID="gen10652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5673"/><l level="1" sID="gen10653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5673"/>The right hand of Yahweh <transChange type="added">has</transChange> exalted;<l eID="gen10653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10654"/>the right hand of Yahweh <transChange type="added">has</transChange> done valiantly. <l eID="gen10654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5674"/><l level="1" sID="gen10655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5674"/>I will not die but live,<l eID="gen10655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10656"/>and tell of the works of Yah.<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note> <l eID="gen10656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5675"/><l level="1" sID="gen10657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5675"/>Yah has disciplined me severely,<l eID="gen10657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10658"/>but he did not consign<note placement="foot">Hebrew “give”</note> me to death. <l eID="gen10658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5676"/><l level="1" sID="gen10659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5676"/>Open to me <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gates of righteousness,<l eID="gen10659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10660"/>that I may enter through them<l eID="gen10660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10661"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> give thanks to Yah.<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note> <l eID="gen10661" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5677"/><l level="1" sID="gen10662"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5677"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the gate of Yahweh,<l eID="gen10662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10663"/>through <transChange type="added">which the</transChange> righteous will enter. <l eID="gen10663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5678"/><l level="1" sID="gen10664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5678"/>I will give thanks <transChange type="added">to</transChange> you for you have answered me,<l eID="gen10664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10665"/>and you have become my salvation.<note placement="foot">Or “victory”</note> <l eID="gen10665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5679"/><l level="1" sID="gen10666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5679"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> stone the builders rejected<l eID="gen10666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10667"/>has become <transChange type="added">the</transChange> chief cornerstone. <l eID="gen10667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5680"/><l level="1" sID="gen10668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5680"/>This is from Yahweh;<l eID="gen10668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10669"/>it is wonderful in our eyes. <l eID="gen10669" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5681"/><l level="1" sID="gen10670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5681"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the day Yahweh has worked;<note placement="foot">Or “made”</note><l eID="gen10670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10671"/>let us rejoice and be glad in him.<note placement="foot">Or “in it”</note> <l eID="gen10671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5682"/><l level="1" sID="gen10672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5682"/>O Yahweh, please save;<l eID="gen10672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10673"/>O Yahweh, please grant success. <l eID="gen10673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5683"/><l level="1" sID="gen10674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5683"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he who comes in the name of Yahweh.<l eID="gen10674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10675"/>We bless you<note placement="foot">Hebrew plural</note> from the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh. <l eID="gen10675" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5684"/><l level="1" sID="gen10676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5684"/>Yahweh is God, and he has given us light.<note placement="foot">Or “made his light to shine upon to us”</note><l eID="gen10676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10677"/>Bind <transChange type="added">the</transChange> festal sacrifice<note placement="foot">Or “festal procession”</note> with cords<note placement="foot">Or “branches”</note><l eID="gen10677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10678"/>to the horns<note placement="foot">Or “and lead up to the horns”</note> of the altar. <l eID="gen10678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5685"/><l level="1" sID="gen10679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5685"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my God, and I will give thanks to you.<l eID="gen10679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10680"/><transChange type="added">You are</transChange> my God; I will exalt you. <l eID="gen10680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:29
