verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5686"/><l level="1" sID="gen10681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5686"/>Give thanks to Yahweh for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> good,<l eID="gen10681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10682"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen10682" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10620"/> <chapter eID="Ps.118"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5687"/><title type="x-s">Aleph<note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Ps.119.1">Psalm 119 </reference>is an acrostic psalm, with twenty-two stanzas corresponding to the letters of the Hebrew alphabet</note></title> <div sID="gen10683" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen10683" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10684"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5687"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">are those whose</transChange> way is blameless,<l eID="gen10685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10686"/>who walk in the law of Yahweh. <l eID="gen10686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5688"/><l level="1" sID="gen10687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5688"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> those who keep his testimonies;<l eID="gen10687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10688"/>they seek him with a whole heart. <l eID="gen10688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5689"/><l level="1" sID="gen10689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5689"/>They also do no wrong;<l eID="gen10689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10690"/>they walk in his ways. <l eID="gen10690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5690"/><l level="1" sID="gen10691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5690"/>You have commanded<note placement="foot">Perhaps emphatic; Hebrew “you, you have commanded”</note> your precepts,<l eID="gen10691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10692"/>that <transChange type="added">we</transChange> should keep <transChange type="added">them</transChange> diligently. <l eID="gen10692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5691"/><l level="1" sID="gen10693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5691"/>Oh that my ways were steadfast,<l eID="gen10693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10694"/>to keep your statutes! <l eID="gen10694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5692"/><l level="1" sID="gen10695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5692"/>Then I would not be ashamed<l eID="gen10695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10696"/>when I look to all your commands. <l eID="gen10696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5693"/><l level="1" sID="gen10697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5693"/>I will give you thanks with an upright heart,<l eID="gen10697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10698"/>when I learn your righteous laws. <l eID="gen10698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5694"/><l level="1" sID="gen10699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5694"/>I will heed your statutes;<l eID="gen10699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10700"/>do not utterly forsake me.<l eID="gen10700" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10684"/> <title type="x-s">Beth</title> <div sID="gen10701" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10701" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5695"/><lg sID="gen10702"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5695"/>How can a young man keep his way pure?<l eID="gen10703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10704"/>By taking heed according to your word. <l eID="gen10704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5696"/><l level="1" sID="gen10705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5696"/>With my whole heart I have sought you;<l eID="gen10705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10706"/>do not let me stray from your commands. <l eID="gen10706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5697"/><l level="1" sID="gen10707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5697"/>In my heart I have hidden your word,<note placement="foot">Or “promise”</note><l eID="gen10707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10708"/>so that I may not sin against you. <l eID="gen10708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5698"/><l level="1" sID="gen10709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5698"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you, O Yahweh.<l eID="gen10709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10710"/>Teach me your statutes. <l eID="gen10710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5699"/><l level="1" sID="gen10711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5699"/>With my lips I have told <transChange type="added">of</transChange><l eID="gen10711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10712"/>all the ordinances of your mouth. <l eID="gen10712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5700"/><l level="1" sID="gen10713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5700"/>In the way of your testimonies I have rejoiced<l eID="gen10713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10714"/>as <transChange type="added">I would</transChange> over all riches. <l eID="gen10714" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5701"/><l level="1" sID="gen10715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5701"/>I will meditate on your precepts<l eID="gen10715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10716"/>and look at<note placement="foot">That is, “examine”</note> your ways. <l eID="gen10716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5702"/><l level="1" sID="gen10717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5702"/>I will take delight in your statutes;<l eID="gen10717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10718"/>I will not forget your word.<l eID="gen10718" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10702"/> <title type="x-s">Gimel</title> <div sID="gen10719" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10719" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5703"/><lg sID="gen10720"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5703"/>Deal bountifully with your servant, that I may live<l eID="gen10721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10722"/>and heed your word. <l eID="gen10722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5704"/><l level="1" sID="gen10723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5704"/>Uncover my eyes, that I may look at<note placement="foot">That is, “examine”</note><l eID="gen10723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10724"/>wonderful things from your law. <l eID="gen10724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5705"/><l level="1" sID="gen10725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5705"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a sojourner on the earth;<note placement="foot">That is, “here for a short time”</note><l eID="gen10725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10726"/>do not hide your commands from me. <l eID="gen10726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5706"/><l level="1" sID="gen10727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5706"/>My soul is crushed with longing<l eID="gen10727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10728"/>for your ordinances at all times. <l eID="gen10728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5707"/><l level="1" sID="gen10729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5707"/>You rebuke <transChange type="added">the</transChange> arrogant, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> accursed,<l eID="gen10729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10730"/>who stray from your commands. <l eID="gen10730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5708"/><l level="1" sID="gen10731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5708"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Remove from⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Roll off of”</note> me scorn and contempt,<l eID="gen10731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10732"/>for I have kept your testimonies. <l eID="gen10732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5709"/><l level="1" sID="gen10733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5709"/>Even <transChange type="added">though</transChange> princes sit <transChange type="added">and</transChange> speak against me,<l eID="gen10733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10734"/>your servant meditates on your statutes. <l eID="gen10734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5710"/><l level="1" sID="gen10735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5710"/>Your testimonies <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my delight,<l eID="gen10735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10736"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my counselors⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the men of my counsel”</note><l eID="gen10736" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10720"/> <title type="x-s">Daleth</title> <div sID="gen10737" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10737" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5711"/><lg sID="gen10738"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5711"/>My soul clings to the dust;<l eID="gen10739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10740"/>revive me according to your word. <l eID="gen10740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5712"/><l level="1" sID="gen10741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5712"/>I told of my ways, and you answered me;<l eID="gen10741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10742"/>teach me your statutes. <l eID="gen10742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5713"/><l level="1" sID="gen10743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5713"/>Make me understand the way of your precepts,<l eID="gen10743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10744"/>that I may meditate on your wonderful things. <l eID="gen10744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5714"/><l level="1" sID="gen10745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5714"/>My soul weeps<note placement="foot">Or “is sleepless”</note> because of grief;<l eID="gen10745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10746"/>strengthen me according to your word. <l eID="gen10746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5715"/><l level="1" sID="gen10747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5715"/>Remove from me <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deceptive way,<l eID="gen10747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10748"/>and graciously give me your law. <l eID="gen10748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5716"/><l level="1" sID="gen10749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5716"/>I have chosen <transChange type="added">the</transChange> faithful way;<l eID="gen10749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10750"/>I have set your ordinances <transChange type="added">before me</transChange>. <l eID="gen10750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5717"/><l level="1" sID="gen10751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5717"/>I cling to your testimonies;<l eID="gen10751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10752"/>O Yahweh, do not let me be put to shame. <l eID="gen10752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5718"/><l level="1" sID="gen10753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5718"/>I will run the way of your commands,<l eID="gen10753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10754"/>for you will enlarge my heart.<note placement="foot">That is, “give greater understanding”</note><l eID="gen10754" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10738"/> <title type="x-s">Heʼ</title> <div sID="gen10755" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10755" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5719"/><lg sID="gen10756"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5719"/>Teach me, O Yahweh, the way of your statutes,<l eID="gen10757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10758"/>and I will keep it to the end. <l eID="gen10758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5720"/><l level="1" sID="gen10759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5720"/>Give me understanding, that I may keep your law<l eID="gen10759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10760"/>and heed it with <transChange type="added">my</transChange> whole heart. <l eID="gen10760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5721"/><l level="1" sID="gen10761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5721"/>Cause me to walk in the path of your commands,<l eID="gen10761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10762"/>for I delight in it. <l eID="gen10762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5722"/><l level="1" sID="gen10763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5722"/>Incline my heart to your testimonies,<l eID="gen10763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10764"/>and not to <transChange type="added">dishonest</transChange> gain. <l eID="gen10764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5723"/><l level="1" sID="gen10765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5723"/>Turn away my eyes from looking at <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> worthless;<l eID="gen10765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10766"/>revive me in your ways. <l eID="gen10766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5724"/><l level="1" sID="gen10767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5724"/>Fulfill your word<note placement="foot">Or “your promise”</note> to your servant,<l eID="gen10767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10768"/>which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to <transChange type="added">bring about</transChange> a reverence for you. <l eID="gen10768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5725"/><l level="1" sID="gen10769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5725"/>Turn away my disgrace that I dread,<l eID="gen10769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10770"/>for your ordinances <transChange type="added">are</transChange> good. <l eID="gen10770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5726"/><l level="1" sID="gen10771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5726"/>Look, I have longed for your precepts;<l eID="gen10771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10772"/>revive me in your righteousness.<l eID="gen10772" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10756"/> <title type="x-s">Waw</title> <div sID="gen10773" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10773" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5727"/><lg sID="gen10774"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5727"/>Let your acts of loyal love also come to me, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen10775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10776"/>your salvation according to your word.<note placement="foot">Or “your promise”</note> <l eID="gen10776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5728"/><l level="1" sID="gen10777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5728"/>Then I will have an answer <transChange type="added">for the</transChange> one who taunts me,<l eID="gen10777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10778"/>for I trust your word. <l eID="gen10778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5729"/><l level="1" sID="gen10779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5729"/>And do not snatch <transChange type="added">the</transChange> word of truth utterly from my mouth,<l eID="gen10779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10780"/>for I hope in your ordinances. <l eID="gen10780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5730"/><l level="1" sID="gen10781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5730"/>So I will heed your law continually,<l eID="gen10781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10782"/>forever and ever. <l eID="gen10782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5731"/><l level="1" sID="gen10783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5731"/>And I will go about <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞freely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the wide place”</note><l eID="gen10783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10784"/>for I have sought your precepts. <l eID="gen10784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5732"/><l level="1" sID="gen10785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5732"/>And I will speak of your testimonies before kings,<l eID="gen10785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10786"/>and will not be ashamed. <l eID="gen10786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5733"/><l level="1" sID="gen10787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5733"/>And I will take delight in your commands,<l eID="gen10787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10788"/>which I love. <l eID="gen10788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5734"/><l level="1" sID="gen10789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5734"/>And I will lift up my hands<note placement="foot">Hebrew “palms”</note> to your commands, which I love,<l eID="gen10789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10790"/>and I will meditate on your statutes.<l eID="gen10790" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10774"/> <title type="x-s">Zayin</title> <div sID="gen10791" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10791" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5735"/><lg sID="gen10792"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5735"/>Remember <transChange type="added">your</transChange> word to your servant,<l eID="gen10793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10794"/>upon which you have caused me to hope. <l eID="gen10794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5736"/><l level="1" sID="gen10795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5736"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my comfort in my misery:<l eID="gen10795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10796"/>that your word<note placement="foot">Or “your promise”</note> preserves my life. <l eID="gen10796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5737"/><l level="1" sID="gen10797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5737"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> arrogant utterly deride me;<l eID="gen10797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10798"/>I have not turned aside from your law. <l eID="gen10798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5738"/><l level="1" sID="gen10799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5738"/>I remember your ordinances of old, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen10799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10800"/>and I take comfort. <l eID="gen10800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5739"/><l level="1" sID="gen10801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5739"/>Rage seizes me because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked,<l eID="gen10801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10802"/>those who forsake your law. <l eID="gen10802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5740"/><l level="1" sID="gen10803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5740"/>Your statutes have been my songs<l eID="gen10803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10804"/>in the house of my sojourning. <l eID="gen10804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5741"/><l level="1" sID="gen10805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5741"/>I remember your name in the night, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen10805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10806"/>and I heed your law. <l eID="gen10806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5742"/><l level="1" sID="gen10807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5742"/>This has been mine,<l eID="gen10807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10808"/>that I have kept your precepts.<l eID="gen10808" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10792"/> <title type="x-s">Heth</title> <div sID="gen10809" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10809" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5743"/><lg sID="gen10810"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5743"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my portion;<l eID="gen10811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10812"/>I intend to heed your words. <l eID="gen10812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5744"/><l level="1" sID="gen10813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5744"/>I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞seek your favor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “entreat your face”</note> with my whole heart;<l eID="gen10813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10814"/>be gracious <transChange type="added">to</transChange> me according to your word.<note placement="foot">Or “your promise”</note> <l eID="gen10814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5745"/><l level="1" sID="gen10815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5745"/>I think about my ways,<l eID="gen10815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10816"/>and turn my feet to your testimonies. <l eID="gen10816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5746"/><l level="1" sID="gen10817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5746"/>I hurry and do not delay<l eID="gen10817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10818"/>to heed your commands. <l eID="gen10818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5747"/><l level="1" sID="gen10819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5747"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> cords of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked surround me,<l eID="gen10819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10820"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> I do not forget your law. <l eID="gen10820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5748"/><l level="1" sID="gen10821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5748"/><transChange type="added">In the</transChange> middle of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night I rise to give you thanks,<l eID="gen10821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10822"/>because of your righteous ordinances. <l eID="gen10822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5749"/><l level="1" sID="gen10823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5749"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a companion of all <transChange type="added">who</transChange> fear you<l eID="gen10823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10824"/>and heed your precepts. <l eID="gen10824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:64
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5750"/><l level="1" sID="gen10825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5750"/>The earth, O Yahweh, is full of your loyal love.<l eID="gen10825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10826"/>Teach me your statutes.<l eID="gen10826" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10810"/> <title type="x-s">Teth</title> <div sID="gen10827" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10827" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5751"/><lg sID="gen10828"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5751"/>You have dealt well with your servant,<l eID="gen10829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10830"/>O Yahweh, according to your word. <l eID="gen10830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5752"/><l level="1" sID="gen10831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5752"/>Teach me good discernment and knowledge,<l eID="gen10831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10832"/>for I believe your commands. <l eID="gen10832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:67
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5753"/><l level="1" sID="gen10833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5753"/>Before I was afflicted, I was going astray,<l eID="gen10833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10834"/>but now I heed your word. <l eID="gen10834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:68
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5754"/><l level="1" sID="gen10835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5754"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> good and do good;<l eID="gen10835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10836"/>teach me your statutes. <l eID="gen10836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:69
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5755"/><l level="1" sID="gen10837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5755"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> arrogant smear me with lies;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note><l eID="gen10837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10838"/>I keep your precepts with <transChange type="added">my</transChange> whole heart. <l eID="gen10838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:70
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5756"/><l level="1" sID="gen10839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5756"/>Their heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> insensitive like fat;<note placement="foot">See <reference osisRef="Isa.6.10">Isa 6:10 </reference>for a similar idea, but a different word for “fat”</note><l eID="gen10839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10840"/>As for me, I take delight in your law. <l eID="gen10840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:71
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5757"/><l level="1" sID="gen10841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5757"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> good for me that I was afflicted,<l eID="gen10841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10842"/>so that I might learn your statutes. <l eID="gen10842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:72
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5758"/><l level="1" sID="gen10843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5758"/>The law of your mouth <transChange type="added">is</transChange> better to me<l eID="gen10843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10844"/>than thousands of gold and silver <transChange type="added">coins</transChange>.<l eID="gen10844" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10828"/> <title type="x-s">Yod</title> <div sID="gen10845" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10845" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:73
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5759"/><lg sID="gen10846"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5759"/>Your hands have made me and established me;<l eID="gen10847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10848"/>give me understanding that I may learn your commands. <l eID="gen10848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:74
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5760"/><l level="1" sID="gen10849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5760"/>Those who fear you will see me and be glad,<l eID="gen10849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10850"/>because I hope in your word. <l eID="gen10850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:75
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5761"/><l level="1" sID="gen10851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5761"/>I know, O Yahweh, that your judgments <transChange type="added">are</transChange> right,<l eID="gen10851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10852"/>and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> in faithfulness you afflicted me. <l eID="gen10852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:76
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5762"/><l level="1" sID="gen10853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5762"/>Please let your loyal love comfort me,<l eID="gen10853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10854"/>according to your word<note placement="foot">Or “your promise”</note> to your servant. <l eID="gen10854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:77
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5763"/><l level="1" sID="gen10855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5763"/>Let your mercies come <transChange type="added">to</transChange> me, that I may live,<l eID="gen10855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10856"/>for your law <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my delight. <l eID="gen10856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:78
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5764"/><l level="1" sID="gen10857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5764"/>Let the arrogant be put to shame,<l eID="gen10857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10858"/>because they have wronged me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> lies.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note><l eID="gen10858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10859"/>As for me, I will meditate on your precepts. <l eID="gen10859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:79
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5765"/><l level="1" sID="gen10860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5765"/>Let those who fear you turn to me,<l eID="gen10860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10861"/>even those who know<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> your testimonies. <l eID="gen10861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:80
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5766"/><l level="1" sID="gen10862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5766"/>May my heart be blameless in your statutes,<l eID="gen10862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10863"/>so that I may not be ashamed.<l eID="gen10863" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10846"/> <title type="x-s">Kaph</title> <div sID="gen10864" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10864" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:81
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5767"/><lg sID="gen10865"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5767"/>My soul languishes for your salvation;<l eID="gen10866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10867"/>I hope in your word. <l eID="gen10867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:82
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5768"/><l level="1" sID="gen10868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5768"/>My eyes long for<note placement="foot">Or “long to see”</note> your word,<note placement="foot">Or “your promise”</note><l eID="gen10868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10869"/>saying, “When will you comfort me?” <l eID="gen10869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:83
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5769"/><l level="1" sID="gen10870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5769"/>For I have become like a wineskin in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> smoke,<l eID="gen10870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10871"/><transChange type="added">yet</transChange> I have not forgotten your statutes. <l eID="gen10871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:84
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5770"/><l level="1" sID="gen10872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5770"/>How many <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the days of your servant?<l eID="gen10872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10873"/>When will you execute justice against those who persecute me? <l eID="gen10873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:85
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5771"/><l level="1" sID="gen10874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5771"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> arrogant have dug pits<note placement="foot">That is, traps</note> for me,<l eID="gen10874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10875"/>which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not according to<note placement="foot">Or “who are not in accord with”</note> your law. <l eID="gen10875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:86
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5772"/><l level="1" sID="gen10876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5772"/>All your commands <transChange type="added">are</transChange> faithful.<l eID="gen10876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10877"/>They persecute me deceitfully; help me! <l eID="gen10877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:87
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5773"/><l level="1" sID="gen10878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5773"/>They have almost destroyed me on the earth,<l eID="gen10878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10879"/>but I have not forsaken your precepts. <l eID="gen10879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:88
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5774"/><l level="1" sID="gen10880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5774"/>According to your loyal love preserve me alive,<l eID="gen10880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10881"/>so that I may heed the testimony from your mouth.<l eID="gen10881" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10865"/> <title type="x-s">Lamed</title> <div sID="gen10882" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10882" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:89
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5775"/><lg sID="gen10883"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5775"/>Forever, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen10884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10885"/>your word <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is settled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “stands firm”</note> in heaven. <l eID="gen10885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:90
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5776"/><l level="1" sID="gen10886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5776"/>Your faithfulness <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout all generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for a generation and a generation”</note><l eID="gen10886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10887"/>You have established <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth and it stands. <l eID="gen10887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:91
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5777"/><l level="1" sID="gen10888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5777"/>By your ordinances they stand today,<l eID="gen10888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10889"/>for all <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your servants. <l eID="gen10889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:92
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5778"/><l level="1" sID="gen10890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5778"/>Unless your law <transChange type="added">had been</transChange> my delight,<l eID="gen10890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10891"/>then I would have perished in my misery. <l eID="gen10891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:93
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5779"/><l level="1" sID="gen10892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5779"/>I will not ever forget your precepts,<l eID="gen10892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10893"/>for by them you revive me.<note placement="foot">Or “give me life”</note> <l eID="gen10893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:94
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5780"/><l level="1" sID="gen10894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5780"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> yours. Save me,<l eID="gen10894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10895"/>for I have sought your precepts. <l eID="gen10895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:95
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5781"/><l level="1" sID="gen10896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5781"/>For me <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked <transChange type="added">lie in</transChange> wait to destroy me.<l eID="gen10896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10897"/>I give attention to your testimonies. <l eID="gen10897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:96
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5782"/><l level="1" sID="gen10898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5782"/>I have seen a limit to every perfection;<note placement="foot">The meaning of this line is uncertain.</note><l eID="gen10898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10899"/>your command <transChange type="added">is</transChange> very broad.<l eID="gen10899" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10883"/> <title type="x-s">Mem</title> <div sID="gen10900" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10900" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:97
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5783"/><lg sID="gen10901"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5783"/>How I love your law!<l eID="gen10902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10903"/>The whole day it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my meditation. <l eID="gen10903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:98
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5784"/><l level="1" sID="gen10904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5784"/>Your commands make me wiser than my enemies,<l eID="gen10904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10905"/>because they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it is”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> ever with me. <l eID="gen10905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:99
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5785"/><l level="1" sID="gen10906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5785"/>I have more insight than all my teachers,<l eID="gen10906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10907"/>for your testimonies <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my meditation. <l eID="gen10907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:100
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5786"/><l level="1" sID="gen10908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5786"/>I understand more than <transChange type="added">the</transChange> elders,<l eID="gen10908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10909"/>for I keep your precepts. <l eID="gen10909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:101
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5787"/><l level="1" sID="gen10910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5787"/>I have restrained my feet from every evil way,<l eID="gen10910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10911"/>so that I may heed your word. <l eID="gen10911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:102
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5788"/><l level="1" sID="gen10912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5788"/>I have not turned aside from your ordinances,<l eID="gen10912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10913"/>for you have taught me. <l eID="gen10913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:103
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5789"/><l level="1" sID="gen10914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5789"/>How smooth<note placement="foot">Or “sweet”</note> are your words<note placement="foot">Hebrew “word”</note> to my palate,<l eID="gen10914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10915"/>more than honey in my mouth. <l eID="gen10915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:104
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5790"/><l level="1" sID="gen10916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5790"/>From your precepts I get understanding,<l eID="gen10916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10917"/>therefore I hate every false way.<l eID="gen10917" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10901"/> <title type="x-s">Nun</title> <div sID="gen10918" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10918" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:105
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5791"/><lg sID="gen10919"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5791"/>Your word <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a lamp to my feet<l eID="gen10920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10921"/>and a light to my path. <l eID="gen10921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:106
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5792"/><l level="1" sID="gen10922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5792"/>I have sworn <transChange type="added">an oath</transChange> and confirmed <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,<l eID="gen10922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10923"/>to heed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your righteous ordinances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the ordinances of your righteousness”</note> <l eID="gen10923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:107
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5793"/><l level="1" sID="gen10924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5793"/>I am very much afflicted;<l eID="gen10924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10925"/>O Yahweh, revive me according to your word. <l eID="gen10925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:108
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5794"/><l level="1" sID="gen10926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5794"/>Please accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen10926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10927"/>and teach me your ordinances. <l eID="gen10927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:109
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5795"/><l level="1" sID="gen10928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5795"/>My life <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in danger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in my hand”</note> continually,<l eID="gen10928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10929"/>yet I do not forget your law. <l eID="gen10929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:110
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5796"/><l level="1" sID="gen10930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5796"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> wicked have laid a snare for me,<l eID="gen10930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10931"/>yet I do not wander from your precepts. <l eID="gen10931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:111
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5797"/><l level="1" sID="gen10932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5797"/>I have taken as my own your testimonies forever,<l eID="gen10932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10933"/>for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the joy of my heart. <l eID="gen10933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:112
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5798"/><l level="1" sID="gen10934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5798"/>I have inclined my heart to do your statutes<l eID="gen10934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10935"/>forever, to the end.<l eID="gen10935" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10919"/> <title type="x-s">Samek</title> <div sID="gen10936" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10936" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:113
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5799"/><lg sID="gen10937"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5799"/>I hate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the double-minded⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the divided”</note><l eID="gen10938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10939"/>but I love your law. <l eID="gen10939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:114
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5800"/><l level="1" sID="gen10940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5800"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my hiding place and my shield;<l eID="gen10940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10941"/>I hope in your word. <l eID="gen10941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:115
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5801"/><l level="1" sID="gen10942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5801"/>Turn aside from me, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> evildoers,<l eID="gen10942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10943"/>for I will keep the commands of my God. <l eID="gen10943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:116
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5802"/><l level="1" sID="gen10944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5802"/>Sustain me according to your word,<note placement="foot">Or “promise”</note> that I may live,<l eID="gen10944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10945"/>and do not let me be ashamed of my hope. <l eID="gen10945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:117
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5803"/><l level="1" sID="gen10946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5803"/>Uphold me, that I may be delivered,<l eID="gen10946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10947"/>and have regard for your statutes continually. <l eID="gen10947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:118
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5804"/><l level="1" sID="gen10948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5804"/>You reject all <transChange type="added">who</transChange> stray from your statutes,<l eID="gen10948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10949"/>for their deceit <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a breach of faith. <l eID="gen10949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:119
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5805"/><l level="1" sID="gen10950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5805"/>You remove all the wicked of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth <transChange type="added">like</transChange> dross,<l eID="gen10950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10951"/>therefore I love your testimonies. <l eID="gen10951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:120
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5806"/><l level="1" sID="gen10952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5806"/>My flesh trembles for fear of you,<l eID="gen10952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10953"/>and I am afraid of your judgments.<l eID="gen10953" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10937"/> <title type="x-s">ʽAyin</title> <div sID="gen10954" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10954" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:121
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5807"/><lg sID="gen10955"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5807"/>I have done justice and righteousness;<note placement="foot">Or “done what is proper and right”</note><l eID="gen10956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10957"/>do not leave me to my oppressors. <l eID="gen10957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:122
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5808"/><l level="1" sID="gen10958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5808"/>Pledge good for your servant;<l eID="gen10958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10959"/>do not let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> arrogant oppress me. <l eID="gen10959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:123
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5809"/><l level="1" sID="gen10960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5809"/>My eyes long for<note placement="foot">Or “long to see”</note> your salvation,<l eID="gen10960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10961"/>and your righteous word.<note placement="foot">Or “promise”</note> <l eID="gen10961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:124
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5810"/><l level="1" sID="gen10962"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5810"/>Deal with your servant according to your loyal love,<l eID="gen10962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10963"/>and teach me your statutes. <l eID="gen10963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:125
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5811"/><l level="1" sID="gen10964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5811"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> your servant; give me understanding,<l eID="gen10964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10965"/>that I may know your statutes. <l eID="gen10965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:126
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5812"/><l level="1" sID="gen10966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5812"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> time for Yahweh to act,<note placement="foot">Or “time to act, O Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen10966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10967"/><transChange type="added">for</transChange> they have broken your law. <l eID="gen10967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:127
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5813"/><l level="1" sID="gen10968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5813"/>Therefore I love your commands<l eID="gen10968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10969"/>more than gold, even fine gold. <l eID="gen10969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:128
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5814"/><l level="1" sID="gen10970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5814"/>Therefore all <transChange type="added">your</transChange> precepts of everything I regard as right;<l eID="gen10970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10971"/>I hate every false way.<l eID="gen10971" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10955"/> <title type="x-s">Pe</title> <div sID="gen10972" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10972" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:129
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5815"/><lg sID="gen10973"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5815"/>Your testimonies <transChange type="added">are</transChange> miracles,<l eID="gen10974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10975"/>therefore my soul keeps them. <l eID="gen10975" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:130
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5816"/><l level="1" sID="gen10976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5816"/>The unfolding of your words gives light,<l eID="gen10976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10977"/>giving understanding to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> simple. <l eID="gen10977" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:131
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5817"/><l level="1" sID="gen10978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5817"/>I open my mouth and pant,<l eID="gen10978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10979"/>because I long for your commands. <l eID="gen10979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:132
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5818"/><l level="1" sID="gen10980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5818"/>Turn to me and be gracious to me,<l eID="gen10980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10981"/>as <transChange type="added">is</transChange> proper for those who love your name. <l eID="gen10981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:133
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5819"/><l level="1" sID="gen10982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5819"/>Direct my steps in your word,<note placement="foot">Or “through your promise”</note><l eID="gen10982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10983"/>and do not let any iniquity gain power over me. <l eID="gen10983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:134
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5820"/><l level="1" sID="gen10984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5820"/>Redeem me from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppression of humankind,<l eID="gen10984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10985"/>that I may heed your precepts. <l eID="gen10985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:135
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5821"/><l level="1" sID="gen10986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5821"/>Shine your face on your servant,<l eID="gen10986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10987"/>and teach me your statutes. <l eID="gen10987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:136
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5822"/><l level="1" sID="gen10988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5822"/>Streams of water flow down <transChange type="added">from</transChange> my eyes,<l eID="gen10988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10989"/>because <transChange type="added">people</transChange> do not heed your law.<l eID="gen10989" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10973"/> <title type="x-s">Tsade</title> <div sID="gen10990" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen10990" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:137
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5823"/><lg sID="gen10991"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5823"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> righteous, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen10992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10993"/>and your ordinances <transChange type="added">are</transChange> upright. <l eID="gen10993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:138
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5824"/><l level="1" sID="gen10994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5824"/>You have ordained your testimonies <transChange type="added">in</transChange> righteousness,<l eID="gen10994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10995"/>and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> exceeding faithfulness. <l eID="gen10995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:139
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5825"/><l level="1" sID="gen10996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5825"/>My zeal consumes me,<l eID="gen10996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10997"/>because my enemies have forgotten your words. <l eID="gen10997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:140
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5826"/><l level="1" sID="gen10998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5826"/>Your word <transChange type="added">is</transChange> very pure,<l eID="gen10998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10999"/>and your servant loves it. <l eID="gen10999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:141
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5827"/><l level="1" sID="gen11000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5827"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> small and despised,<l eID="gen11000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11001"/><transChange type="added">yet</transChange> I do not forget your precepts. <l eID="gen11001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:142
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5828"/><l level="1" sID="gen11002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5828"/>Your righteousness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an everlasting righteousness,<l eID="gen11002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11003"/>and your law <transChange type="added">is</transChange> truth. <l eID="gen11003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:143
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5829"/><l level="1" sID="gen11004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5829"/>Trouble and anguish have found me;<l eID="gen11004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11005"/>your commands delight me. <l eID="gen11005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:144
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5830"/><l level="1" sID="gen11006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5830"/>The righteousness of your testimonies <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forever;<l eID="gen11006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11007"/>give me understanding that I may live.<l eID="gen11007" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10991"/> <title type="x-s">Qoph</title> <div sID="gen11008" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen11008" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:145
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5831"/><lg sID="gen11009"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5831"/>I call with <transChange type="added">my</transChange> whole heart; answer me, O Yahweh.<l eID="gen11010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11011"/>I will keep your statutes. <l eID="gen11011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:146
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5832"/><l level="1" sID="gen11012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5832"/>I call to you. Save me,<l eID="gen11012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11013"/>and I will heed your testimonies. <l eID="gen11013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:147
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5833"/><l level="1" sID="gen11014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5833"/>I rise early in the dawn and cry for help;<l eID="gen11014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11015"/>I hope in your word.<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> <l eID="gen11015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:148
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5834"/><l level="1" sID="gen11016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5834"/>My eyes anticipate <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night watches,<l eID="gen11016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11017"/>that <transChange type="added">I may</transChange> meditate on your word. <l eID="gen11017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:149
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5835"/><l level="1" sID="gen11018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5835"/>Hear my voice according to your loyal love;<l eID="gen11018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11019"/>O Yahweh, preserve my life according to your justice. <l eID="gen11019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:150
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5836"/><l level="1" sID="gen11020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5836"/><transChange type="added">Those who</transChange> pursue a <transChange type="added">wicked</transChange> purpose draw near;<l eID="gen11020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11021"/>they are far from your law. <l eID="gen11021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:151
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5837"/><l level="1" sID="gen11022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5837"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> near, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen11022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11023"/>and all your commands <transChange type="added">are</transChange> truth. <l eID="gen11023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:152
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5838"/><l level="1" sID="gen11024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5838"/>Concerning your testimonies, I knew long ago<l eID="gen11024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11025"/>that you have established them forever.<l eID="gen11025" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen11009"/> <title type="x-s">Resh</title> <div sID="gen11026" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen11026" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:153
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5839"/><lg sID="gen11027"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5839"/>See my misery and rescue me,<l eID="gen11028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11029"/>for I do not forget your law. <l eID="gen11029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:154
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5840"/><l level="1" sID="gen11030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5840"/>Plead my cause and redeem me;<l eID="gen11030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11031"/>preserve my life according to your word.<note placement="foot">Or “promise”</note> <l eID="gen11031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:155
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5841"/><l level="1" sID="gen11032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5841"/>Salvation <transChange type="added">is</transChange> far from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked,<l eID="gen11032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11033"/>for they do not seek your statutes. <l eID="gen11033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:156
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5842"/><l level="1" sID="gen11034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5842"/>Your mercies <transChange type="added">are</transChange> great, O Yahweh;<l eID="gen11034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11035"/>preserve my life according to your ordinances. <l eID="gen11035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:157
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5843"/><l level="1" sID="gen11036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5843"/>My persecutors and enemies <transChange type="added">are</transChange> many,<l eID="gen11036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11037"/><transChange type="added">yet</transChange> I do not turn aside from your testimonies. <l eID="gen11037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:158
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5844"/><l level="1" sID="gen11038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5844"/>I see <transChange type="added">the</transChange> treacherous and I feel disgust,<l eID="gen11038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11039"/>because they do not heed your word. <l eID="gen11039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:159
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5845"/><l level="1" sID="gen11040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5845"/>Consider<note placement="foot">Hebrew “See”</note> that I love your precepts;<l eID="gen11040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11041"/>O Yahweh, according to your loyal love preserve my life. <l eID="gen11041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:160
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5846"/><l level="1" sID="gen11042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5846"/>The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whole⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note> of your word <transChange type="added">is</transChange> truth,<l eID="gen11042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11043"/>and your every righteous judgment <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever.<l eID="gen11043" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen11027"/> <title type="x-s">Sin/Shin</title> <div sID="gen11044" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen11044" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:161
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5847"/><lg sID="gen11045"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5847"/>Princes persecute me without cause,<l eID="gen11046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11047"/>but my heart trembles because of your word.<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> <l eID="gen11047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:162
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5848"/><l level="1" sID="gen11048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5848"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> rejoicing over your word,<l eID="gen11048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11049"/>like one who finds great spoil. <l eID="gen11049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:163
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5849"/><l level="1" sID="gen11050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5849"/>I hate and abhor falsehood;<l eID="gen11050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11051"/>I love your law. <l eID="gen11051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:164
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5850"/><l level="1" sID="gen11052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5850"/>I praise you seven <transChange type="added">times</transChange> in the day<l eID="gen11052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11053"/>for your righteous ordinances. <l eID="gen11053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:165
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5851"/><l level="1" sID="gen11054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5851"/>Great peace <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for those who love your law,<l eID="gen11054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11055"/>and they do not have a cause for stumbling. <l eID="gen11055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:166
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5852"/><l level="1" sID="gen11056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5852"/>I hope for your salvation, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen11056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11057"/>and do your commands. <l eID="gen11057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:167
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5853"/><l level="1" sID="gen11058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5853"/>My soul heeds your testimonies,<l eID="gen11058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11059"/>and I love them exceedingly. <l eID="gen11059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:168
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5854"/><l level="1" sID="gen11060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5854"/>I heed your precepts and testimonies,<l eID="gen11060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11061"/>because all my ways <transChange type="added">are</transChange> before you.<l eID="gen11061" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen11045"/> <title type="x-s">Taw</title> <div sID="gen11062" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen11062" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:169
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5855"/><lg sID="gen11063"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5855"/>Let my cry come before you, O Yahweh;<l eID="gen11064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11065"/>give me understanding according to your word. <l eID="gen11065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:170
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5856"/><l level="1" sID="gen11066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5856"/>Let my plea come before you;<l eID="gen11066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11067"/>Deliver me according to your word.<note placement="foot">Or “promise”</note> <l eID="gen11067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:171
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5857"/><l level="1" sID="gen11068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5857"/>Let my lips pour out praise,<l eID="gen11068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11069"/>because you teach me your statutes. <l eID="gen11069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:172
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5858"/><l level="1" sID="gen11070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5858"/>Let my tongue sing <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your word,<note placement="foot">Or “promise”</note><l eID="gen11070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11071"/>because all your commands <transChange type="added">are</transChange> right. <l eID="gen11071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:173
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5859"/><l level="1" sID="gen11072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5859"/>Let your hand be my help,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to help me”</note><l eID="gen11072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11073"/>because I have chosen your precepts. <l eID="gen11073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:174
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5860"/><l level="1" sID="gen11074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5860"/>I long for your salvation, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen11074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11075"/>and your law <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my delight. <l eID="gen11075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:175
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5861"/><l level="1" sID="gen11076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5861"/>Let my soul<note placement="foot">Or “my life”</note> live that it may praise you,<l eID="gen11076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11077"/>and let your ordinances help me. <l eID="gen11077" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:176
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5862"/><l level="1" sID="gen11078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5862"/>I have wandered like a lost sheep; seek your servant,<l eID="gen11078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11079"/>because I do not forget your commands. <l eID="gen11079" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11063"/> <chapter eID="Ps.119"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5863"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for Deliverance from Enemies</title> <div sID="gen11080" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11080" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11081"/> <lg eID="gen11081"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11082"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5863"/>In my distress I called to Yahweh,<l eID="gen11083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11084"/>and he answered me. <l eID="gen11084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5864"/><l level="1" sID="gen11085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5864"/>“Deliver my life, O Yahweh, from lying lips,<l eID="gen11085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11086"/>from a deceitful tongue.” <l eID="gen11086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5865"/><l level="1" sID="gen11087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5865"/>What shall be given to you,<note placement="foot">That is, by God against the false accuser</note><l eID="gen11087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11088"/>and what more shall be done to you,<l eID="gen11088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11089"/>deceitful tongue? <l eID="gen11089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5866"/><l level="1" sID="gen11090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5866"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> sharpened arrows of a warrior,<l eID="gen11090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11091"/>with burning charcoals from broom trees. <l eID="gen11091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5867"/><l level="1" sID="gen11092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5867"/>Woe to me, that I sojourn in Meshech,<l eID="gen11092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11093"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> I dwell among the tents of Kedar. <l eID="gen11093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5868"/><l level="1" sID="gen11094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5868"/>Too long my soul has had its dwelling<l eID="gen11094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11095"/>near <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> hates peace. <l eID="gen11095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5869"/><l level="1" sID="gen11096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5869"/>I <transChange type="added">am for</transChange> peace, but when I speak,<l eID="gen11096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11097"/>they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> for war. <l eID="gen11097" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11082"/> <chapter eID="Ps.120"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5870"/><title type="x-s">Trust in God’s Protection</title> <div sID="gen11098" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11098" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11099"/> <lg eID="gen11099"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song for the ascents.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11100"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5870"/>I lift up my eyes to the mountains;<l eID="gen11101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11102"/>whence will my help come? <l eID="gen11102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5871"/><l level="1" sID="gen11103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5871"/>My help <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from Yahweh,<l eID="gen11103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11104"/>maker of heaven and earth. <l eID="gen11104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5872"/><l level="1" sID="gen11105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5872"/>He will not allow your foot to be moved;<l eID="gen11105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11106"/>he who protects you will not slumber. <l eID="gen11106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5873"/><l level="1" sID="gen11107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5873"/>Look, he will not slumber and he will not sleep—<l eID="gen11107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11108"/>he who protects Israel. <l eID="gen11108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5874"/><l level="1" sID="gen11109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5874"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your protector;<l eID="gen11109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11110"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your shade at your right hand. <l eID="gen11110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5875"/><l level="1" sID="gen11111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5875"/>The sun will not strike you by day,<l eID="gen11111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11112"/>nor <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moon by night. <l eID="gen11112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5876"/><l level="1" sID="gen11113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5876"/>Yahweh will protect you from all evil;<note placement="foot">Or “all calamity”</note><l eID="gen11113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11114"/>he will protect your life. <l eID="gen11114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5877"/><l level="1" sID="gen11115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5877"/>Yahweh will protect your going out and your coming in<l eID="gen11115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11116"/>from now until forever. <l eID="gen11116" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11100"/> <chapter eID="Ps.121"/>
