verses.name: Psalms 122:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5878"/><title type="x-s">Jerusalem the Site of God’s Presence</title> <div sID="gen11117" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11117" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11118"/> <lg eID="gen11118"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents. Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11119"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5878"/>I rejoiced in <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> said to me,<l eID="gen11120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11121"/>“Let us go to the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh.” <l eID="gen11121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5879"/><l level="1" sID="gen11122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5879"/>Our feet are standing<l eID="gen11122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11123"/>within your gates, O Jerusalem— <l eID="gen11123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5880"/><l level="1" sID="gen11124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5880"/>Jerusalem that is built<l eID="gen11124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11125"/>as a city that is joined together, <l eID="gen11125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5881"/><l level="1" sID="gen11126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5881"/>where <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tribes go up,<l eID="gen11126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11127"/>the tribes of Yah<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a testimony for Israel,<l eID="gen11127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11128"/>to give thanks to the name of Yahweh. <l eID="gen11128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5882"/><l level="1" sID="gen11129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5882"/>For there <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thrones sit<note placement="foot">That is, rulers or judges on thrones</note> for judgment,<l eID="gen11129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11130"/>thrones of David’s house. <l eID="gen11130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5883"/><l level="1" sID="gen11131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5883"/>Pray<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Ask”</note> for the peace of Jerusalem:<l eID="gen11131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11132"/>“May those who love you be at ease. <l eID="gen11132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5884"/><l level="1" sID="gen11133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5884"/>May peace be within your walls,<l eID="gen11133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11134"/>security within your palaces.” <l eID="gen11134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5885"/><l level="1" sID="gen11135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5885"/>For the sake of my brothers and my friends,<l eID="gen11135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11136"/>I will say, “Peace <transChange type="added">be</transChange> within you.” <l eID="gen11136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5886"/><l level="1" sID="gen11137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5886"/>For the sake of the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh our God,<l eID="gen11137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11138"/>I will seek your good. <l eID="gen11138" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11119"/> <chapter eID="Ps.122"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5887"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for Yahweh’s Action in the Face of Scorn</title> <div sID="gen11139" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11139" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11140"/> <lg eID="gen11140"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11141"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5887"/>I lift up my eyes to you,<l eID="gen11142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11143"/>the one enthroned<note placement="foot">Or “the one who dwells”</note> in the heavens. <l eID="gen11143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5888"/><l level="1" sID="gen11144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5888"/>Behold, as <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of servants<l eID="gen11144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11145"/><transChange type="added">look</transChange> to the hand of their master,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “masters”</note><l eID="gen11145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11146"/>as <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,<l eID="gen11146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11147"/>so our eyes <transChange type="added">look</transChange> to Yahweh our God,<l eID="gen11147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11148"/>until he is gracious to us. <l eID="gen11148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5889"/><l level="1" sID="gen11149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5889"/>Be gracious to us, O Yahweh, be gracious to us,<l eID="gen11149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11150"/>for long enough we have had our fill of contempt. <l eID="gen11150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5890"/><l level="1" sID="gen11151"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5890"/>For long enough our soul has had its fill of<l eID="gen11151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11152"/>the derision of the self-confident,<l eID="gen11152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11153"/>the contempt of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> arrogant. <l eID="gen11153" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11141"/> <chapter eID="Ps.123"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5891"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for Yahweh’s Help</title> <div sID="gen11154" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11154" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11155"/> <lg eID="gen11155"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents. Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11156"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5891"/>“If <transChange type="added">it had</transChange> not <transChange type="added">been</transChange> Yahweh who was on our side,”<l eID="gen11157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11158"/>do let Israel say, <l eID="gen11158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5892"/><l level="1" sID="gen11159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5892"/>“If <transChange type="added">it had</transChange> not <transChange type="added">been</transChange> Yahweh who was on our side,<l eID="gen11159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11160"/>when men rose up against us, <l eID="gen11160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5893"/><l level="1" sID="gen11161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5893"/>then they would have swallowed us alive,<l eID="gen11161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11162"/>when their anger was kindled against us. <l eID="gen11162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5894"/><l level="1" sID="gen11163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5894"/>Then the waters would have flooded over us,<l eID="gen11163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11164"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> torrent would have passed over our soul. <l eID="gen11164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5895"/><l level="1" sID="gen11165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5895"/>Then over our soul would have passed<l eID="gen11165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11166"/>the raging waters.” <l eID="gen11166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5896"/><l level="1" sID="gen11167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5896"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">be</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen11167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11168"/>who has not made<note placement="foot">Hebrew “given”</note> us prey for their teeth. <l eID="gen11168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5897"/><l level="1" sID="gen11169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5897"/>Our soul has escaped like a bird<l eID="gen11169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11170"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> snare of fowlers.<l eID="gen11170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11171"/>The snare <transChange type="added">is</transChange> broken, and we have escaped. <l eID="gen11171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5898"/><l level="1" sID="gen11172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5898"/>Our help <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the name of Yahweh,<l eID="gen11172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11173"/>maker of heaven and earth. <l eID="gen11173" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11156"/> <chapter eID="Ps.124"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5899"/><title type="x-s">Confidence in Yahweh’s Protection</title> <div sID="gen11174" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11174" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11175"/> <lg eID="gen11175"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11176"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5899"/>Those who trust in Yahweh<l eID="gen11177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11178"/><transChange type="added">are</transChange> like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved,<l eID="gen11178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11179"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> abides forever. <l eID="gen11179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5900"/><l level="1" sID="gen11180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5900"/><transChange type="added">As</transChange> mountains <transChange type="added">are</transChange> round about Jerusalem,<l eID="gen11180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11181"/>so Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> round about his people,<l eID="gen11181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11182"/>from now until forever. <l eID="gen11182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5901"/><l level="1" sID="gen11183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5901"/>For the scepter of wickedness shall not rest<l eID="gen11183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11184"/>on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lot,” that is, land allotted</note> of the righteous,<l eID="gen11184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11185"/>lest the righteous stretch out<l eID="gen11185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11186"/>their hands to do wickedness.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in wickedness”</note> <l eID="gen11186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5902"/><l level="1" sID="gen11187"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5902"/>Do good, O Yahweh, to the good,<l eID="gen11187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11188"/>and to <transChange type="added">those</transChange> upright in their hearts. <l eID="gen11188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5903"/><l level="1" sID="gen11189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5903"/>But regarding those who turn aside to their crooked ways,<l eID="gen11189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11190"/>Yahweh will lead them away with the evildoers.<l eID="gen11190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11191"/>Peace <transChange type="added">be</transChange> upon Israel. <l eID="gen11191" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11176"/> <chapter eID="Ps.125"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5904"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Restoration</title> <div sID="gen11192" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11192" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11193"/> <lg eID="gen11193"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11194"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5904"/>When Yahweh restored the fortunes<note placement="foot">Or “captivity”</note> of Zion,<note placement="foot">Or “those returned of belonging to Zion”</note><l eID="gen11195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11196"/>we were like dreamers. <l eID="gen11196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5905"/><l level="1" sID="gen11197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5905"/>Then our mouth was filled with laughter,<l eID="gen11197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11198"/>and our tongue with rejoicing.<l eID="gen11198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11199"/>Then they said among the nations,<l eID="gen11199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11200"/>“Yahweh has done great <transChange type="added">things</transChange> for these <transChange type="added">people</transChange>.” <l eID="gen11200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5906"/><l level="1" sID="gen11201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5906"/>Yahweh has done great <transChange type="added">things</transChange> for us;<l eID="gen11201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11202"/>we are glad. <l eID="gen11202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5907"/><l level="1" sID="gen11203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5907"/>Restore, O Yahweh, our fortunes<note placement="foot">Or “captivity”</note><l eID="gen11203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11204"/>like the streams in the Negeb.<note placement="foot">Or “South”</note> <l eID="gen11204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5908"/><l level="1" sID="gen11205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5908"/>Those who sow with tears<l eID="gen11205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11206"/>shall reap with rejoicing. <l eID="gen11206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5909"/><l level="1" sID="gen11207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5909"/>He who diligently goes <transChange type="added">out</transChange> with weeping,<l eID="gen11207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11208"/>carrying the seed bag,<l eID="gen11208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11209"/>shall certainly come <transChange type="added">in</transChange> with rejoicing,<l eID="gen11209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11210"/>carrying his sheaves. <l eID="gen11210" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11194"/> <chapter eID="Ps.126"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5910"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Protection and Prosperity</title> <div sID="gen11211" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11211" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11212"/> <lg eID="gen11212"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents. Of Solomon.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11213"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5910"/>Unless Yahweh builds a house,<l eID="gen11214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11215"/>its builders labor at it in vain.<l eID="gen11215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11216"/>Unless Yahweh guards a city,<l eID="gen11216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11217"/>a guard watches in vain. <l eID="gen11217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5911"/><l level="1" sID="gen11218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5911"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> in vain for you who rise early <transChange type="added">and</transChange> sit late,<l eID="gen11218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11219"/>eating the bread of anxious toil,<l eID="gen11219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11220"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> thus he<note placement="foot">That is, Yahweh</note> provides<note placement="foot">Hebrew “gives”</note> for his beloved in his sleep.<note placement="foot">Or “so he gives sleep to his beloved”</note> <l eID="gen11220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5912"/><l level="1" sID="gen11221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5912"/>Look, children<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sons”</note> are the heritage<note placement="foot">That is, gift</note> of Yahweh;<l eID="gen11221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11222"/>the fruit of the womb <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a reward. <l eID="gen11222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5913"/><l level="1" sID="gen11223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5913"/>Like arrows in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of a warrior,<l eID="gen11223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11224"/>so <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the children<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sons”</note> of <transChange type="added">one’s</transChange> youth. <l eID="gen11224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5914"/><l level="1" sID="gen11225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5914"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the man who fills his quiver with them.<note placement="foot">Or “whose quiver he Yahweh fills with them”</note><l eID="gen11225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11226"/>They shall not be put to shame<l eID="gen11226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11227"/>when they speak with enemies at the gate. <l eID="gen11227" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11213"/> <chapter eID="Ps.127"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5915"/><title type="x-s">Blessed Is Everyone Who Fears Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen11228" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11228" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11229"/> <lg eID="gen11229"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11230"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5915"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> everyone who fears Yahweh,<l eID="gen11231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11232"/>who walks in his ways. <l eID="gen11232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5916"/><l level="1" sID="gen11233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5916"/>You will indeed eat of the labor of your hands;<l eID="gen11233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11234"/>you <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> happy and <transChange type="added">it will be</transChange> well with you. <l eID="gen11234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5917"/><l level="1" sID="gen11235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5917"/>Your wife <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> like a fruitful vine<l eID="gen11235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11236"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the recesses of”</note> your house.<l eID="gen11236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11237"/>Your children<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sons”</note> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> like olive shoots<l eID="gen11237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11238"/>about your table. <l eID="gen11238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5918"/><l level="1" sID="gen11239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5918"/>Look, for thus shall a man be blessed<l eID="gen11239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11240"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who fears Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a fearer of Yahweh”</note> <l eID="gen11240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5919"/><l level="1" sID="gen11241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5919"/>May Yahweh bless you from Zion,<l eID="gen11241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11242"/>that you may see the good of Jerusalem<l eID="gen11242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11243"/>all the days of your life, <l eID="gen11243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5920"/><l level="1" sID="gen11244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5920"/>and that you may see your children’s children.<l eID="gen11244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11245"/><transChange type="added">May</transChange> peace <transChange type="added">be</transChange> upon Israel. <l eID="gen11245" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11230"/> <chapter eID="Ps.128"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5921"/><title type="x-s">Victory Over the Enemies of Zion</title> <div sID="gen11246" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11246" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11247"/> <lg eID="gen11247"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11248"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5921"/>“Too often<note placement="foot">Or “Greatly”</note> they have attacked me from my youth.”<l eID="gen11249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11250"/>Let Israel say, <l eID="gen11250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5922"/><l level="1" sID="gen11251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5922"/>“Too often<note placement="foot">Or “Greatly”</note> they have attacked me from my youth,<l eID="gen11251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11252"/>yet they have not prevailed against me. <l eID="gen11252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5923"/><l level="1" sID="gen11253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5923"/>On my back plowmen have plowed.<l eID="gen11253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11254"/>They have made their furrows<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> long.” <l eID="gen11254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5924"/><l level="1" sID="gen11255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5924"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> righteous.<l eID="gen11255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11256"/>He has cut <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ropes<note placement="foot">That is, the yoke and tackle on a beast of burden</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked. <l eID="gen11256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5925"/><l level="1" sID="gen11257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5925"/>Let all be put to shame and repulsed<l eID="gen11257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11258"/>who hate Zion. <l eID="gen11258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5926"/><l level="1" sID="gen11259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5926"/>Let them be like grass on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> housetops,<l eID="gen11259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11260"/>that withers before it grows up, <l eID="gen11260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5927"/><l level="1" sID="gen11261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5927"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> which a reaper cannot fill his hand,<l eID="gen11261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11262"/>nor the binder of sheaves his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞arms⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “bosom”</note> <l eID="gen11262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5928"/><l level="1" sID="gen11263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5928"/>so that passersby do not say,<l eID="gen11263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11264"/>“The blessing of Yahweh <transChange type="added">be</transChange> upon you.<l eID="gen11264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11265"/>We bless you in the name of Yahweh.” <l eID="gen11265" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11248"/> <chapter eID="Ps.129"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5929"/><title type="x-s">Hope for the Redemption of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen11266" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11266" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11267"/> <lg eID="gen11267"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11268"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5929"/>Out of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths I call to you, O Yahweh. <l eID="gen11269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5930"/><l level="1" sID="gen11270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5930"/>“O Lord, hear my voice.<l eID="gen11270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11271"/>Let your ears be attentive<l eID="gen11271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11272"/>to the voice of my supplications. <l eID="gen11272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5931"/><l level="1" sID="gen11273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5931"/>If you, O Yah,<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note> should <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞keep track of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “keep”</note> iniquities,<l eID="gen11273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11274"/>O Lord, who could stand? <l eID="gen11274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5932"/><l level="1" sID="gen11275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5932"/>But with you <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forgiveness,<l eID="gen11275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11276"/>so that you may be feared.” <l eID="gen11276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5933"/><l level="1" sID="gen11277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5933"/>I await Yahweh; my soul awaits,<l eID="gen11277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11278"/>and I wait<note placement="foot">Or “hope,” here and v. <reference osisRef="Ps.130.7">7</reference>, though the Hebrew uses a different verbal stem in v. <reference osisRef="Ps.130.7">7</reference></note> for his word. <l eID="gen11278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5934"/><l level="1" sID="gen11279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5934"/>My soul <transChange type="added">waits</transChange> for the Lord<l eID="gen11279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11280"/>more than watchmen for the morning.<l eID="gen11280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11281"/>Yes, <transChange type="added">more than</transChange> watchmen for the morning. <l eID="gen11281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5935"/><l level="1" sID="gen11282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5935"/>O Israel, wait<note placement="foot">Or “hope”</note> for Yahweh.<l eID="gen11282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11283"/>For with Yahweh <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> loyal love,<l eID="gen11283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11284"/>and with him <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> abundant redemption. <l eID="gen11284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5936"/><l level="1" sID="gen11285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5936"/>And he will redeem Israel<l eID="gen11285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11286"/>from all its iniquities. <l eID="gen11286" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11268"/> <chapter eID="Ps.130"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5937"/><title type="x-s">Calm Trust in Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen11287" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11287" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11288"/> <lg eID="gen11288"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents. Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11289"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5937"/>My heart is not haughty nor my eyes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞arrogant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “raised”</note><l eID="gen11290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11291"/>And I do not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concern myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “walk about”</note><l eID="gen11291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11292"/>with things too great and difficult for me. <l eID="gen11292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5938"/><l level="1" sID="gen11293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5938"/>Rather I have soothed and quieted my soul,<l eID="gen11293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11294"/>like a weaned child with its mother,<l eID="gen11294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11295"/>like the weaned child <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my soul with me. <l eID="gen11295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5939"/><l level="1" sID="gen11296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5939"/>O Israel, hope in Yahweh<l eID="gen11296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11297"/>from now until forever. <l eID="gen11297" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11289"/> <chapter eID="Ps.131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5940"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Dwells in Zion</title> <div sID="gen11298" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11298" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11299"/> <lg eID="gen11299"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11300"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5940"/>O Yahweh, remember with regard to David<l eID="gen11301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11302"/>all his affliction.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his being afflicted”</note> <l eID="gen11302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5941"/><l level="1" sID="gen11303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5941"/>How he swore to Yahweh,<l eID="gen11303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11304"/>he vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob: <l eID="gen11304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5942"/><l level="1" sID="gen11305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5942"/>“I will not enter into the tent of my house,<l eID="gen11305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11306"/>I will not go up to the couch of my bed, <l eID="gen11306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5943"/><l level="1" sID="gen11307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5943"/>I will give no sleep to my eyes,<l eID="gen11307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11308"/><transChange type="added">no</transChange> slumber to my eyelids, <l eID="gen11308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5944"/><l level="1" sID="gen11309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5944"/>until I find a place for Yahweh,<l eID="gen11309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11310"/>a dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob.” <l eID="gen11310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5945"/><l level="1" sID="gen11311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5945"/>Look, we heard of it in Ephrathah;<l eID="gen11311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11312"/>we found her in the fields of Jaar.<note placement="foot">Or “the fields of the woods”</note> <l eID="gen11312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5946"/><l level="1" sID="gen11313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5946"/>Let us go to his dwelling places;<note placement="foot">That is, the temple</note><l eID="gen11313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11314"/>Let us worship at his footstool. <l eID="gen11314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5947"/><l level="1" sID="gen11315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5947"/>Arise, O Yahweh, to your resting place,<l eID="gen11315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11316"/>you and your mighty ark. <l eID="gen11316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5948"/><l level="1" sID="gen11317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5948"/>Let your priests clothe themselves with righteousness,<l eID="gen11317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11318"/>and let your faithful sing for joy. <l eID="gen11318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5949"/><l level="1" sID="gen11319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5949"/>For the sake of your servant David,<l eID="gen11319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11320"/>do not turn away the face of your anointed one. <l eID="gen11320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5950"/><l level="1" sID="gen11321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5950"/>Yahweh swore <transChange type="added">in</transChange> truth to David;<l eID="gen11321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11322"/>he will not turn back from it.<l eID="gen11322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11323"/>“One from the fruit of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “belly”</note><l eID="gen11323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11324"/>I will set on your throne. <l eID="gen11324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5951"/><l level="1" sID="gen11325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5951"/>If your sons will heed my covenant<l eID="gen11325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11326"/>and my testimonies that I will teach them,<l eID="gen11326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11327"/>their sons also forever<l eID="gen11327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11328"/>will sit on your throne.” <l eID="gen11328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5952"/><l level="1" sID="gen11329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5952"/>For Yahweh has chosen Zion;<l eID="gen11329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11330"/>he has desired it for his habitation. <l eID="gen11330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5953"/><l level="1" sID="gen11331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5953"/>“This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my resting place forever;<l eID="gen11331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11332"/>here I will dwell, for I have desired it. <l eID="gen11332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5954"/><l level="1" sID="gen11333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5954"/>I will bless its provisions abundantly;<l eID="gen11333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11334"/>I will satisfy its poor with bread. <l eID="gen11334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5955"/><l level="1" sID="gen11335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5955"/>I will also clothe its priests with salvation,<l eID="gen11335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11336"/>and its faithful will shout exuberantly for joy. <l eID="gen11336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5956"/><l level="1" sID="gen11337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5956"/>There I will cause a horn to grow for David;<l eID="gen11337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11338"/>I will set a lamp for my anointed one. <l eID="gen11338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5957"/><l level="1" sID="gen11339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5957"/>I will clothe his enemies with shame,<l eID="gen11339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11340"/>but on him his crown will flourish.”<note placement="foot">Or “shine”</note> <l eID="gen11340" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11300"/> <chapter eID="Ps.132"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5958"/><title type="x-s">The People of God Dwell in Unity</title> <div sID="gen11341" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11341" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11342"/> <lg eID="gen11342"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents. Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11343"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5958"/>Look, how good and how pleasant <transChange type="added">it is</transChange><l eID="gen11344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11345"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> brothers dwell together in unity. <l eID="gen11345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5959"/><l level="1" sID="gen11346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5959"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> like the fragrant oil upon the head,<l eID="gen11346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11347"/>running down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron,<l eID="gen11347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11348"/>that runs down upon the edges of his robes. <l eID="gen11348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5960"/><l level="1" sID="gen11349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5960"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> like the dew of Hermon that runs down<l eID="gen11349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11350"/>upon the mountains of Zion,<l eID="gen11350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11351"/>because there Yahweh commanded the blessing—<l eID="gen11351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11352"/>life forever. <l eID="gen11352" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11343"/> <chapter eID="Ps.133"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5961"/><title type="x-s">Praising Yahweh in the Temple at Night</title> <div sID="gen11353" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11353" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11354"/> <lg eID="gen11354"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song of ascents.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11355"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5961"/>Look, bless Yahweh, all <transChange type="added">you</transChange> the servants of Yahweh,<l eID="gen11356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11357"/>who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞serve⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “stand”</note> in the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh by night. <l eID="gen11357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5962"/><l level="1" sID="gen11358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5962"/>Lift up your hands in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sanctuary<l eID="gen11358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11359"/>and bless Yahweh. <l eID="gen11359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5963"/><l level="1" sID="gen11360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5963"/>May Yahweh bless you from Zion,<l eID="gen11360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11361"/><transChange type="added">he who</transChange> made heaven and earth. <l eID="gen11361" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11355"/> <chapter eID="Ps.134"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5964"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for His Power and Redemption</title> <div sID="gen11362" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11362" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11363"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5964"/>Praise Yah!<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> Praise the name of Yahweh.<l eID="gen11364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11365"/>Praise <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, O servants of Yahweh, <l eID="gen11365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5965"/><l level="1" sID="gen11366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5965"/>who stand in the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh,<l eID="gen11366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11367"/>in the courts of the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of our God. <l eID="gen11367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5966"/><l level="1" sID="gen11368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5966"/>Praise Yah,<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note> for Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good.<l eID="gen11368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11369"/>Sing praises concerning his name, for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> pleasant. <l eID="gen11369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5967"/><l level="1" sID="gen11370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5967"/>For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself,<l eID="gen11370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11371"/>Israel as his special possession. <l eID="gen11371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5968"/><l level="1" sID="gen11372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5968"/>For I know that Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great,<l eID="gen11372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11373"/>and our Lord <transChange type="added">is greater</transChange> than all gods. <l eID="gen11373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5969"/><l level="1" sID="gen11374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5969"/>All that Yahweh desires, he does,<l eID="gen11374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11375"/>in heaven and on earth,<l eID="gen11375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11376"/>in the seas and all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths. <l eID="gen11376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5970"/><l level="1" sID="gen11377"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5970"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> causes clouds to rise from the edge of the earth;<l eID="gen11377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11378"/>he makes lightnings for the rain;<l eID="gen11378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11379"/><transChange type="added">he</transChange> brings out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind from his storehouses. <l eID="gen11379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5971"/><l level="1" sID="gen11380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5971"/>Who struck the firstborn of Egypt,<l eID="gen11380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11381"/>both of humans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note> and animals.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> <l eID="gen11381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5972"/><l level="1" sID="gen11382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5972"/>He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt,<l eID="gen11382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11383"/>against Pharaoh and all his servants. <l eID="gen11383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5973"/><l level="1" sID="gen11384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5973"/>Who struck many nations<l eID="gen11384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11385"/>and killed mighty kings— <l eID="gen11385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5974"/><l level="1" sID="gen11386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5974"/>Sihon the king of the Amorites,<l eID="gen11386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11387"/>and Og the king of Bashan,<l eID="gen11387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11388"/>and all the kingdoms of Canaan— <l eID="gen11388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5975"/><l level="1" sID="gen11389"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5975"/>and he gave their land as an inheritance,<l eID="gen11389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11390"/>an inheritance for his people Israel. <l eID="gen11390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5976"/><l level="1" sID="gen11391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5976"/>O Yahweh, your name <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever,<l eID="gen11391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11392"/>your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞renown⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “remembrance”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout all generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for a generation and a generation”</note> <l eID="gen11392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5977"/><l level="1" sID="gen11393"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5977"/>for Yahweh will plead <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cause <transChange type="added">of</transChange> his people<l eID="gen11393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11394"/>and will have compassion on his servants. <l eID="gen11394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5978"/><l level="1" sID="gen11395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5978"/>The idols of the nations <transChange type="added">are</transChange> silver and gold,<l eID="gen11395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11396"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of the hands of humankind. <l eID="gen11396" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5979"/><l level="1" sID="gen11397"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5979"/>They have mouths, but cannot speak;<l eID="gen11397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11398"/>they have eyes, but cannot see; <l eID="gen11398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5980"/><l level="1" sID="gen11399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5980"/>they have ears, but cannot hear;<l eID="gen11399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11400"/>there is not even breath in their mouths. <l eID="gen11400" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5981"/><l level="1" sID="gen11401"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5981"/><transChange type="added">Those who</transChange> make them become like them,<l eID="gen11401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11402"/><transChange type="added">as does</transChange> everyone who trusts in them. <l eID="gen11402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5982"/><l level="1" sID="gen11403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5982"/>O house of Israel, bless Yahweh.<l eID="gen11403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11404"/>O house of Aaron, bless Yahweh. <l eID="gen11404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5983"/><l level="1" sID="gen11405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5983"/>O house of Levi, bless Yahweh.<l eID="gen11405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11406"/><transChange type="added">You who</transChange> fear Yahweh, bless Yahweh. <l eID="gen11406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5984"/><l level="1" sID="gen11407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5984"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">be</transChange> Yahweh from Zion,<l eID="gen11407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11408"/>who dwells <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Jerusalem. Praise Yah!<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen11408" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11363"/> <chapter eID="Ps.135"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5985"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for His Creation and Deliverance</title> <div sID="gen11409" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11409" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11410"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5985"/>Give thanks to Yahweh, for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> good,<l eID="gen11411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11412"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5986"/><l level="1" sID="gen11413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5986"/>Give thanks to the God of gods,<l eID="gen11413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11414"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5987"/><l level="1" sID="gen11415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5987"/>Give thanks to the Lord of lords,<l eID="gen11415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11416"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5988"/><l level="1" sID="gen11417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5988"/>To <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> alone does great wonders,<l eID="gen11417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11418"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5989"/><l level="1" sID="gen11419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5989"/>To <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> made the heavens with skill,<note placement="foot">Or “understanding”</note><l eID="gen11419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11420"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5990"/><l level="1" sID="gen11421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5990"/>To <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> spread out the earth above the waters,<l eID="gen11421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11422"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5991"/><l level="1" sID="gen11423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5991"/>To <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> great lights,<l eID="gen11423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11424"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5992"/><l level="1" sID="gen11425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5992"/>The sun to rule the day,<l eID="gen11425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11426"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5993"/><l level="1" sID="gen11427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5993"/>The moon and stars to rule the night,<l eID="gen11427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11428"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5994"/><l level="1" sID="gen11429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5994"/>To <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> struck Egypt through their firstborn,<l eID="gen11429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11430"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5995"/><l level="1" sID="gen11431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5995"/>And he brought Israel out from among them,<l eID="gen11431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11432"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5996"/><l level="1" sID="gen11433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5996"/>With a strong hand and an outstretched arm,<l eID="gen11433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11434"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5997"/><l level="1" sID="gen11435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5997"/>To <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> divided <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reed”</note> in two,<l eID="gen11435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11436"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5998"/><l level="1" sID="gen11437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5998"/>And he let Israel cross over through the midst of it,<l eID="gen11437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11438"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5999"/><l level="1" sID="gen11439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5999"/>But he tossed Pharaoh and his army into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sea of reed”</note><l eID="gen11439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11440"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6000"/><l level="1" sID="gen11441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6000"/>To <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> led his people through the wilderness,<l eID="gen11441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11442"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6001"/><l level="1" sID="gen11443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6001"/>To <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> struck great kings,<l eID="gen11443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11444"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6002"/><l level="1" sID="gen11445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6002"/>And he killed mighty kings,<l eID="gen11445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11446"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6003"/><l level="1" sID="gen11447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6003"/>Sihon the king of the Amorites,<l eID="gen11447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11448"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6004"/><l level="1" sID="gen11449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6004"/>And Og the king of Bashan,<l eID="gen11449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11450"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6005"/><l level="1" sID="gen11451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6005"/>And he gave their land as an inheritance,<l eID="gen11451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11452"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6006"/><l level="1" sID="gen11453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6006"/>An inheritance to Israel his servant,<l eID="gen11453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11454"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6007"/><l level="1" sID="gen11455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6007"/>Who remembered us in our low estate,<l eID="gen11455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11456"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6008"/><l level="1" sID="gen11457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6008"/>And he rescued us from our enemies,<l eID="gen11457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11458"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6009"/><l level="1" sID="gen11459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6009"/><transChange type="added">The one who</transChange> gives food to all flesh,<l eID="gen11459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11460"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6010"/><l level="1" sID="gen11461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6010"/>Give thanks to the God of heaven,<l eID="gen11461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11462"/>for his loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever. <l eID="gen11462" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11410"/> <chapter eID="Ps.136"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6011"/><title type="x-s">Lament During the Babylonian Exile</title> <div sID="gen11463" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11463" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11464"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6011"/>By the rivers of Babylon,<l eID="gen11465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11466"/>there we sat, yes, we wept,<l eID="gen11466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11467"/>when we remembered Zion. <l eID="gen11467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6012"/><l level="1" sID="gen11468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6012"/>On <transChange type="added">the</transChange> willows<note placement="foot">Species of tree uncertain</note> in her midst,<l eID="gen11468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11469"/>we hung up our lyres. <l eID="gen11469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6013"/><l level="1" sID="gen11470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6013"/>For there our captors asked of us<l eID="gen11470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11471"/>words of a song,<l eID="gen11471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11472"/>and our tormentors<note placement="foot">Only occurring once in the MT, this interpretation is uncertain. The LXX’s “carried us captive” is a guess. If related to the Hebrew root <hi type="italic">yll</hi> it might have the idea of “mockers/yammerers”</note> <transChange type="added">asked of us</transChange> jubilation,<l eID="gen11472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11473"/>“Sing for us from a song of Zion.” <l eID="gen11473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6014"/><l level="1" sID="gen11474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6014"/>How could we sing the song of Yahweh<l eID="gen11474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11475"/>in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a foreign land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “a land of a foreigner”</note> <l eID="gen11475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6015"/><l level="1" sID="gen11476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6015"/>If I forget you, O Jerusalem,<l eID="gen11476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11477"/>let my right hand forget.<note placement="foot">That is, how to play a musical instrument</note> <l eID="gen11477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6016"/><l level="1" sID="gen11478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6016"/>Let my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth,<l eID="gen11478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11479"/>if I do not remember you,<l eID="gen11479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11480"/>if do not I exalt Jerusalem<l eID="gen11480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11481"/>above my highest joy. <l eID="gen11481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6017"/><l level="1" sID="gen11482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6017"/>Remember, O Yahweh, against the sons of Edom<l eID="gen11482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11483"/>the day of Jerusalem,<l eID="gen11483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11484"/>the ones who said, “Lay <transChange type="added">it</transChange> bare! Lay <transChange type="added">it</transChange> bare<l eID="gen11484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11485"/>to its foundation!” <l eID="gen11485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6018"/><l level="1" sID="gen11486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6018"/>O daughter of Babylon, about to be devastated,<l eID="gen11486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11487"/>happy <transChange type="added">shall be he</transChange> who pays back to you<l eID="gen11487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11488"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what you paid out to us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with what you treated us”</note> <l eID="gen11488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6019"/><l level="1" sID="gen11489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6019"/>Happy <transChange type="added">shall be he</transChange> who seizes<l eID="gen11489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11490"/>and smashes your children<l eID="gen11490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11491"/>against the rock. <l eID="gen11491" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11464"/> <chapter eID="Ps.137"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6020"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for Yahweh’s Goodness</title> <div sID="gen11492" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11492" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11493"/> <lg eID="gen11493"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11494"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6020"/>I give you thanks with my whole heart;<l eID="gen11495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11496"/>before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gods I sing your praise. <l eID="gen11496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6021"/><l level="1" sID="gen11497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6021"/>I bow down toward your holy temple<l eID="gen11497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11498"/>and give thanks to your name,<l eID="gen11498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11499"/>because of your loyal love and faithfulness,<l eID="gen11499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11500"/>for you have magnified your word<note placement="foot">Or “promise”</note> according to all your name.<note placement="foot">Or “beyond all your name”</note> <l eID="gen11500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6022"/><l level="1" sID="gen11501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6022"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In the day”</note> I called and you answered me,<l eID="gen11501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11502"/>you emboldened me in my soul <transChange type="added">with</transChange> strength. <l eID="gen11502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6023"/><l level="1" sID="gen11503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6023"/>All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth<l eID="gen11503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11504"/>will praise you, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen11504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11505"/>when they have heard the words<note placement="foot">Or “heard about the words”</note> of your mouth, <l eID="gen11505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6024"/><l level="1" sID="gen11506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6024"/>and they will sing of the ways of Yahweh,<l eID="gen11506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11507"/>because Yahweh’s glory <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great. <l eID="gen11507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6025"/><l level="1" sID="gen11508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6025"/>Though Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> high, yet he sees <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lowly,<l eID="gen11508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11509"/>but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> proud he perceives<note placement="foot">Hebrew “knows”</note> at a distance. <l eID="gen11509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6026"/><l level="1" sID="gen11510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6026"/>Though I walk in the midst of trouble,<l eID="gen11510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11511"/>you preserve me alive.<l eID="gen11511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11512"/>You stretch out your hand against the anger of my enemies,<l eID="gen11512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11513"/>and you save me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your right hand. <l eID="gen11513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6027"/><l level="1" sID="gen11514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6027"/>Yahweh accomplishes <transChange type="added">things</transChange> for my benefit.<l eID="gen11514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11515"/>O Yahweh, your loyal love <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> forever;<l eID="gen11515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11516"/>do not abandon the works of your hands. <l eID="gen11516" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11494"/> <chapter eID="Ps.138"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6028"/><title type="x-s">The Knowledge of God</title> <div sID="gen11517" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11517" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11518"/> <lg eID="gen11518"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. Of David. A psalm.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11519"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6028"/>O Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know <transChange type="added">me</transChange>. <l eID="gen11520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6029"/><l level="1" sID="gen11521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6029"/>You know my sitting down and my rising up.<l eID="gen11521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11522"/>You understand my thought from afar. <l eID="gen11522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6030"/><l level="1" sID="gen11523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6030"/>You search out<note placement="foot">Hebrew “winnow”; or perhaps from another root, “measure”</note> my wandering and my lying down,<l eID="gen11523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11524"/>and are acquainted with all my ways. <l eID="gen11524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6031"/><l level="1" sID="gen11525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6031"/>For <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> not a word <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> on my tongue,<l eID="gen11525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11526"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> behold, O Yahweh, you know it completely. <l eID="gen11526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6032"/><l level="1" sID="gen11527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6032"/>You barricade me behind and in front,<l eID="gen11527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11528"/>and set your hand upon me. <l eID="gen11528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6033"/><l level="1" sID="gen11529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6033"/><transChange type="added">Such</transChange> knowledge is too wonderful for me.<l eID="gen11529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11530"/>It is set high; I cannot <transChange type="added">prevail</transChange> against it. <l eID="gen11530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6034"/><l level="1" sID="gen11531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6034"/>Where I can go from your Spirit,<l eID="gen11531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11532"/>or where can I flee from your presence? <l eID="gen11532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6035"/><l level="1" sID="gen11533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6035"/>If I ascend to heaven, there you <transChange type="added">are</transChange>,<l eID="gen11533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11534"/>and if I make my bed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Sheol, look! <transChange type="added">There</transChange> you <transChange type="added">are</transChange>. <l eID="gen11534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6036"/><l level="1" sID="gen11535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6036"/>If I lift up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dawn,<l eID="gen11535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11536"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> I alight on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> far side of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea, <l eID="gen11536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6037"/><l level="1" sID="gen11537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6037"/>even there your hand would lead me,<l eID="gen11537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11538"/>and your right hand would hold me fast. <l eID="gen11538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6038"/><l level="1" sID="gen11539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6038"/>And if I should say, “Surely darkness will cover me,<l eID="gen11539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11540"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> light around me <transChange type="added">will be as</transChange> night,” <l eID="gen11540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6039"/><l level="1" sID="gen11541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6039"/>even <transChange type="added">the</transChange> darkness is not too dark for you,<note placement="foot">Or “does not obscure from you”</note><l eID="gen11541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11542"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night shines as the day—<l eID="gen11542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11543"/>the darkness <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the light are alike <transChange type="added">for you</transChange>. <l eID="gen11543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6040"/><l level="1" sID="gen11544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6040"/>Indeed you created my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞inward parts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “kidneys”</note><l eID="gen11544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11545"/>you wove me in my mother’s womb. <l eID="gen11545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:14
