verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6041"/><l level="1" sID="gen11546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6041"/>I praise you, because I am fearfully<l eID="gen11546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11547"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> wonderfully <transChange type="added">made</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Or “I am made wonderful fearfully”</note><l eID="gen11547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11548"/>Wonderful <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your works,<l eID="gen11548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11549"/>and my soul knows <transChange type="added">it</transChange> well. <l eID="gen11549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6042"/><l level="1" sID="gen11550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6042"/>My <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞frame⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “bone”</note> was not hidden from you,<l eID="gen11550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11551"/>when I was created secretly,<note placement="foot">Or “in the secret place”</note><l eID="gen11551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11552"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> intricately woven<l eID="gen11552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11553"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen11553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6043"/><l level="1" sID="gen11554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6043"/>Your eyes saw my embryo,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “unformed substance”</note><l eID="gen11554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11555"/>and in your book they all were written—<l eID="gen11555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11556"/>days fashioned <transChange type="added">for me</transChange> when <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> not one of them. <l eID="gen11556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6044"/><l level="1" sID="gen11557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6044"/>And to me, how precious<note placement="foot">Or “difficult”</note> are your thoughts, O God;<l eID="gen11557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11558"/>how vast is their sum. <l eID="gen11558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6045"/><l level="1" sID="gen11559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6045"/>If I should count them,<l eID="gen11559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11560"/>they would outnumber <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sand.<l eID="gen11560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11561"/>I awaken, and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> still with you. <l eID="gen11561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6046"/><l level="1" sID="gen11562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6046"/>If only you would kill the wicked, O God—<l eID="gen11562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11563"/>so get away from me, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bloodthirsty men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>—<note placement="foot">Literally “men of bloods”</note> <l eID="gen11563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6047"/><l level="1" sID="gen11564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6047"/>who speak against you deceitfully.<l eID="gen11564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11565"/>Your enemies take <transChange type="added">your name</transChange> in vain. <l eID="gen11565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6048"/><l level="1" sID="gen11566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6048"/>Do I not hate those who hate you, O Yahweh?<l eID="gen11566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11567"/>And do I <transChange type="added">not</transChange> loathe those who rise up against you? <l eID="gen11567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6049"/><l level="1" sID="gen11568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6049"/>I hate them with a complete hatred;<l eID="gen11568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11569"/>they have become my enemies. <l eID="gen11569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6050"/><l level="1" sID="gen11570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6050"/>Search me, O God, and know my heart;<l eID="gen11570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11571"/>test me and know my anxious thoughts. <l eID="gen11571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6051"/><l level="1" sID="gen11572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6051"/>And see if <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> in me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the worship of false gods⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a way of an idol”</note><l eID="gen11572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11573"/>and lead me in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way everlasting. <l eID="gen11573" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11519"/> <chapter eID="Ps.139"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6052"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for Help in the Face of Enemies</title> <div sID="gen11574" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11574" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11575"/> <lg eID="gen11575"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">For the <transChange type="added">music</transChange> director. A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note></title> <lg sID="gen11576"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6052"/>Rescue me, O Yahweh, from evil men.<note placement="foot">The several uses of the singular “man” in this psalm are probably collective</note><l eID="gen11577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11578"/>Preserve me from violent men, <l eID="gen11578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6053"/><l level="1" sID="gen11579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6053"/>who plan evil <transChange type="added">things</transChange> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> heart.<l eID="gen11579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11580"/>They stir up wars continually. <l eID="gen11580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6054"/><l level="1" sID="gen11581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6054"/>They sharpen their tongue as <transChange type="added">sharp as</transChange> a snake’s;<l eID="gen11581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11582"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> venom of a viper <transChange type="added">is</transChange> under their lips. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen11582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6055"/><l level="1" sID="gen11583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6055"/>Protect me, O Yahweh, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hands of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked.<l eID="gen11583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11584"/>Preserve me from violent men,<l eID="gen11584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11585"/>who have planned to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make me stumble⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “push my steps”</note> <l eID="gen11585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6056"/><l level="1" sID="gen11586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6056"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> proud have hidden a trap for me, and cords.<l eID="gen11586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11587"/>They have spread out a net along <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> path.<l eID="gen11587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11588"/>They have set snares for me. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen11588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6057"/><l level="1" sID="gen11589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6057"/>I say to Yahweh, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my God.”<l eID="gen11589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11590"/>Listen, O Yahweh, to the voice of my supplications. <l eID="gen11590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6058"/><l level="1" sID="gen11591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6058"/>O Yahweh, my Lord, the strength of my salvation,<l eID="gen11591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11592"/>you have covered my head in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of battle. <l eID="gen11592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6059"/><l level="1" sID="gen11593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6059"/>Do not grant, O Yahweh, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desires of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked.<l eID="gen11593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11594"/>Do not allow <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to attain their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> plan, lest they be exalted. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen11594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6060"/><l level="1" sID="gen11595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6060"/><transChange type="added">With respect to the</transChange> head of <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> surround me,<l eID="gen11595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11596"/>may the harm of their lips cover them. <l eID="gen11596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6061"/><l level="1" sID="gen11597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6061"/>Let burning coals fall on them;<l eID="gen11597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11598"/>let them be dropped into the fire,<l eID="gen11598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11599"/>into bottomless pits <transChange type="added">from which</transChange> they cannot rise. <l eID="gen11599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6062"/><l level="1" sID="gen11600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6062"/>Do not let a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞slanderer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “man of tongue”</note> be established in the land;<l eID="gen11600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11601"/>as for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> man of violence, let evil hunt him quickly. <l eID="gen11601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6063"/><l level="1" sID="gen11602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6063"/>I know<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> that Yahweh will maintain <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cause of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> afflicted,<l eID="gen11602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11603"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> justice for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy. <l eID="gen11603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6064"/><l level="1" sID="gen11604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6064"/>Surely <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous will give thanks to your name;<l eID="gen11604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11605"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> upright will dwell in your presence. <l eID="gen11605" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11576"/> <chapter eID="Ps.140"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6065"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for God’s Help in Maintaining Integrity</title> <div sID="gen11606" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11606" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11607"/> <lg eID="gen11607"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11608"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6065"/>I call on you, O Yahweh; hasten to me.<l eID="gen11609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11610"/>Listen to my voice when I call to you. <l eID="gen11610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6066"/><l level="1" sID="gen11611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6066"/>Let my prayer be set before you <transChange type="added">as</transChange> incense,<l eID="gen11611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11612"/>the lifting up of my palms <transChange type="added">as the</transChange> evening offering. <l eID="gen11612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6067"/><l level="1" sID="gen11613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6067"/>Set a guard, O Yahweh, over my mouth;<l eID="gen11613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11614"/>keep watch over the door of my lips. <l eID="gen11614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6068"/><l level="1" sID="gen11615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6068"/>Do not incline my heart to any evil thing,<l eID="gen11615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11616"/>to practice wicked deeds<l eID="gen11616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11617"/>with men <transChange type="added">who</transChange> do iniquity;<l eID="gen11617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11618"/>and do not let me eat of their delicacies. <l eID="gen11618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6069"/><l level="1" sID="gen11619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6069"/>Let a righteous one strike me in kindness,<l eID="gen11619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11620"/>and let him chasten me.<l eID="gen11620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11621"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> oil for <transChange type="added">my</transChange> head;<note placement="foot">Or “It is choice oil”</note> let not my head refuse.<l eID="gen11621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11622"/>For still my prayer <transChange type="added">is</transChange> against their evil deeds. <l eID="gen11622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6070"/><l level="1" sID="gen11623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6070"/><transChange type="added">When</transChange> their judges are thrown down <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sides of a cliff,<note placement="foot">Or “are dropped into the hands of the Rock,” that is, Yahweh. The interpretation of vv. <reference osisRef="Ps.141.6-Ps.141.7">6–7</reference> is uncertain.</note><l eID="gen11623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11624"/>then they will understand that my words were pleasant. <l eID="gen11624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6071"/><l level="1" sID="gen11625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6071"/>As <transChange type="added">when one</transChange> plows and breaks up the earth,<l eID="gen11625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11626"/><transChange type="added">so</transChange> our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol. <l eID="gen11626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6072"/><l level="1" sID="gen11627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6072"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “Because”</note> my eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> toward you, O Yahweh, my Lord;<l eID="gen11627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11628"/>I have taken refuge in you. Do not lay bare my soul.<note placement="foot">Or “Do not raze my life”</note> <l eID="gen11628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6073"/><l level="1" sID="gen11629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6073"/>Protect me from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞grasp⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> trap they have laid for me,<l eID="gen11629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11630"/>and <transChange type="added">from the</transChange> snares of evildoers. <l eID="gen11630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6074"/><l level="1" sID="gen11631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6074"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked fall into their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> nets,<l eID="gen11631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11632"/>while I escape altogether. <l eID="gen11632" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11608"/> <chapter eID="Ps.141"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6075"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Deliverance from Pursuers</title> <div sID="gen11633" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11633" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11634"/> <lg eID="gen11634"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A maskil of David.</title> <lg sID="gen11635"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11636"/>When he was in the cave. A prayer.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm; the English verse number is reduced by one</note><l eID="gen11636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6075"/>I cry out with my voice to Yahweh;<l eID="gen11637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11638"/>I implore favor with my voice to Yahweh. <l eID="gen11638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6076"/><l level="1" sID="gen11639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6076"/>I pour out my complaint before him;<l eID="gen11639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11640"/>I declare my trouble before him. <l eID="gen11640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6077"/><l level="1" sID="gen11641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6077"/>When my spirit faints within me,<l eID="gen11641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11642"/>you know my way.<l eID="gen11642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11643"/>On the path where I walk,<l eID="gen11643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11644"/>they have hidden a trap for me; <l eID="gen11644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6078"/><l level="1" sID="gen11645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6078"/>look to <transChange type="added">my</transChange> right and see.<l eID="gen11645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11646"/>There is no one looking out for me;<l eID="gen11646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11647"/>there is no escape for me;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “a refuge has perished from me”</note><l eID="gen11647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11648"/>no one cares for my soul.<note placement="foot">Or “life”</note> <l eID="gen11648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6079"/><l level="1" sID="gen11649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6079"/>I cry out to you, O Yahweh.<l eID="gen11649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11650"/>I say, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my refuge,<l eID="gen11650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11651"/>my portion in the land of the living.” <l eID="gen11651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6080"/><l level="1" sID="gen11652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6080"/>Attend to my cry,<l eID="gen11652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11653"/>for I am brought very low.<l eID="gen11653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11654"/>Deliver me from my pursuers,<l eID="gen11654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11655"/>for they are stronger than I. <l eID="gen11655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6081"/><l level="1" sID="gen11656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6081"/>Bring me<note placement="foot">Hebrew “my soul”</note> out of prison,<l eID="gen11656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11657"/>that I may give thanks to your name.<l eID="gen11657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11658"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> righteous will encircle me,<l eID="gen11658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11659"/>because you will deal bountifully with me. <l eID="gen11659" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11635"/> <chapter eID="Ps.142"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6082"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for Rescue from Enemies</title> <div sID="gen11660" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11660" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11661"/> <lg eID="gen11661"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A psalm of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11662"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6082"/>O Yahweh, hear my prayer;<l eID="gen11663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11664"/>listen to my supplications.<l eID="gen11664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11665"/>In your faithfulness answer me,<l eID="gen11665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11666"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> in your righteousness. <l eID="gen11666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6083"/><l level="1" sID="gen11667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6083"/>And do not enter into judgment with your servant,<l eID="gen11667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11668"/>because no one alive <transChange type="added">is</transChange> righteous before you. <l eID="gen11668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6084"/><l level="1" sID="gen11669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6084"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy has pursued my soul;<l eID="gen11669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11670"/>he has crushed my life to the ground.<l eID="gen11670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11671"/>He has made me dwell in dark places<l eID="gen11671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11672"/>like <transChange type="added">those</transChange> long dead. <l eID="gen11672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6085"/><l level="1" sID="gen11673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6085"/>And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> my spirit grows faint within me;<l eID="gen11673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11674"/>my heart <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the midst of”</note> me is desolate. <l eID="gen11674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6086"/><l level="1" sID="gen11675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6086"/>I remember <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days of long ago;<l eID="gen11675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11676"/>I meditate on all your doings.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “doing”</note><l eID="gen11676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11677"/>I muse on the labor of your hands. <l eID="gen11677" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6087"/><l level="1" sID="gen11678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6087"/>I stretch out my hands to you;<l eID="gen11678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11679"/>my soul <transChange type="added">longs</transChange> for you like a dry land. <hi type="italic">Selah</hi> <l eID="gen11679" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6088"/><l level="1" sID="gen11680"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6088"/>Quickly answer me, O Yahweh;<l eID="gen11680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11681"/>my spirit fails.<l eID="gen11681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11682"/>Do not hide your face from me,<l eID="gen11682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11683"/>or I will become<l eID="gen11683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11684"/>like <transChange type="added">those</transChange> descending to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit. <l eID="gen11684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6089"/><l level="1" sID="gen11685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6089"/>Cause me to hear your loyal love in the morning,<l eID="gen11685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11686"/>for I trust you.<l eID="gen11686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11687"/>Cause me to know the way that I should go,<l eID="gen11687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11688"/>for I lift up my soul to you. <l eID="gen11688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6090"/><l level="1" sID="gen11689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6090"/>Deliver me from my enemies, O Yahweh.<l eID="gen11689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11690"/>I take refuge in you.<note placement="foot">This reading for the difficult Hebrew “I cover to you” is suggested by the LXX</note> <l eID="gen11690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6091"/><l level="1" sID="gen11691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6091"/>Teach me to do your will, for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my God;<l eID="gen11691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11692"/>your Spirit <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good.<l eID="gen11692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11693"/>Lead me onto level ground. <l eID="gen11693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6092"/><l level="1" sID="gen11694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6092"/>For your name’s sake, O Yahweh, preserve my life;<l eID="gen11694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11695"/>in your righteousness bring me<note placement="foot">Hebrew “my soul”</note> out of trouble. <l eID="gen11695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6093"/><l level="1" sID="gen11696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6093"/>And in your loyal love destroy my enemies,<l eID="gen11696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11697"/>and exterminate all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> adversaries of my soul,<l eID="gen11697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11698"/>for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> your servant. <l eID="gen11698" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11662"/> <chapter eID="Ps.143"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6094"/><title type="x-s">A Prayer for National Safety</title> <div sID="gen11699" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11699" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11700"/> <lg eID="gen11700"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">Of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11701"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6094"/>Blessed be Yahweh, my rock,<l eID="gen11702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11703"/>the one who trains my hands for battle,<l eID="gen11703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11704"/>my fingers for war— <l eID="gen11704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6095"/><l level="1" sID="gen11705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6095"/>my loyal love and my fortress,<l eID="gen11705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11706"/>my stronghold and my deliverer,<l eID="gen11706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11707"/>my shield, and <transChange type="added">one</transChange> in whom I take refuge,<l eID="gen11707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11708"/>the one who subdues peoples<note placement="foot">Reading with many Hebrew manuscripts and versions; MT reads “my people”</note> under me. <l eID="gen11708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6096"/><l level="1" sID="gen11709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6096"/>O Yahweh, what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> humankind that you take knowledge of him,<l eID="gen11709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11710"/><transChange type="added">or the</transChange> son of man that you take thought of him? <l eID="gen11710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6097"/><l level="1" sID="gen11711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6097"/>Humankind is like a breath,<l eID="gen11711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11712"/>his days like a passing shadow. <l eID="gen11712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6098"/><l level="1" sID="gen11713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6098"/>O Yahweh, bow the heavens and come down;<l eID="gen11713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11714"/>touch the mountains so that they smoke. <l eID="gen11714" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6099"/><l level="1" sID="gen11715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6099"/>Flash forth lightning and scatter them;<l eID="gen11715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11716"/>dispatch your arrows and rout them. <l eID="gen11716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6100"/><l level="1" sID="gen11717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6100"/>Stretch out your hands from on high;<l eID="gen11717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11718"/>Rescue me and deliver me from many waters,<l eID="gen11718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11719"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of foreigners, <l eID="gen11719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6101"/><l level="1" sID="gen11720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6101"/>whose mouth speaks falsely,<l eID="gen11720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11721"/>and their right hand <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a false right hand. <l eID="gen11721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6102"/><l level="1" sID="gen11722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6102"/>O God, I will sing a new song to you.<l eID="gen11722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11723"/>With a lyre of ten <transChange type="added">strings</transChange> I will sing praise to you, <l eID="gen11723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6103"/><l level="1" sID="gen11724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6103"/>who gives victory to kings,<l eID="gen11724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11725"/>who rescues David his servant<l eID="gen11725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11726"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> evil sword. <l eID="gen11726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6104"/><l level="1" sID="gen11727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6104"/>Rescue me and deliver me<l eID="gen11727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11728"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of foreigners,<l eID="gen11728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11729"/>whose mouth speaks falsely,<l eID="gen11729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11730"/>and whose right hand <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a false right hand, <l eID="gen11730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6105"/><l level="1" sID="gen11731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6105"/>that our sons <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> like plants,<l eID="gen11731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11732"/>full grown in their youth,<l eID="gen11732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11733"/>our daughters like corner pillars,<l eID="gen11733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11734"/>carved in the style of a palace, <l eID="gen11734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6106"/><l level="1" sID="gen11735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6106"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> our granaries <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> full,<l eID="gen11735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11736"/>providing <transChange type="added">produce</transChange> of all kinds,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from kind to kind”</note><l eID="gen11736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11737"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> our sheep <transChange type="added">may</transChange> produce by the thousands,<l eID="gen11737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11738"/>by the tens of thousands in our open fields, <l eID="gen11738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6107"/><l level="1" sID="gen11739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6107"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> our cattle <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> pregnant;<l eID="gen11739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11740"/><transChange type="added">that there be</transChange> no breach <transChange type="added">in our walls</transChange>,<l eID="gen11740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11741"/>and no going out <transChange type="added">in exile</transChange>,<l eID="gen11741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11742"/>and no outcry in our plazas. <l eID="gen11742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6108"/><l level="1" sID="gen11743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6108"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the people who have <transChange type="added">it</transChange> thus.<l eID="gen11743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11744"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the people whose God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh. <l eID="gen11744" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11701"/> <chapter eID="Ps.144"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6109"/><title type="x-s">A Song of God’s Majesty and Love</title> <div sID="gen11745" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11745" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11746"/> <lg eID="gen11746"/> <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A praise of David.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew Bible counts the superscription as the first verse of the psalm</note></title> <lg sID="gen11747"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6109"/>I will exalt you, my God, O king,<l eID="gen11748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11749"/>and I will bless<note placement="foot">That is, praise; here and v. <reference osisRef="Ps.145.2">2</reference></note> your name forever and ever. <l eID="gen11749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6110"/><l level="1" sID="gen11750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6110"/>Every day I will bless you<l eID="gen11750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11751"/>and praise your name forever and ever. <l eID="gen11751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6111"/><l level="1" sID="gen11752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6111"/>Great <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh, and very worthy of praise,<l eID="gen11752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11753"/>and his greatness is unsearchable. <l eID="gen11753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6112"/><l level="1" sID="gen11754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6112"/>One generation will laud your works to another,<l eID="gen11754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11755"/>and will declare your mighty deeds. <l eID="gen11755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6113"/><l level="1" sID="gen11756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6113"/>On the splendor of the glory of your majesty,<l eID="gen11756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11757"/>and on your wonderful deeds, I will meditate. <l eID="gen11757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6114"/><l level="1" sID="gen11758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6114"/>And they will speak of the power of your awesome deeds,<note placement="foot">That is, deeds that evoke a fearful reverence</note><l eID="gen11758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11759"/>and I will tell of your greatness.<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> <l eID="gen11759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6115"/><l level="1" sID="gen11760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6115"/>They will utter<note placement="foot">Hebrew “pour forth”</note> the renown of your abundant goodness,<l eID="gen11760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11761"/>and they will proclaim with joy your righteousness. <l eID="gen11761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6116"/><l level="1" sID="gen11762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6116"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> gracious and compassionate,<l eID="gen11762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11763"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞slow to anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “long of nostrils”</note> and great in loyal love. <l eID="gen11763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6117"/><l level="1" sID="gen11764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6117"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good to all,<l eID="gen11764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11765"/>and his mercies <transChange type="added">are</transChange> over all his works. <l eID="gen11765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6118"/><l level="1" sID="gen11766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6118"/>All your works will praise you, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen11766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11767"/>and your faithful ones will bless<note placement="foot">That is, praise</note> you. <l eID="gen11767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6119"/><l level="1" sID="gen11768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6119"/>They will speak of the glory of your kingdom,<l eID="gen11768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11769"/>and talk of your power, <l eID="gen11769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6120"/><l level="1" sID="gen11770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6120"/>to make known to the children of humankind his mighty deeds,<l eID="gen11770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11771"/>and the glory of the majesty of his kingdom. <l eID="gen11771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6121"/><l level="1" sID="gen11772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6121"/>Your kingdom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an everlasting kingdom,<l eID="gen11772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11773"/>and your dominion <transChange type="added">endures</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout all generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for a generation and a generation”</note> <l eID="gen11773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6122"/><l level="1" sID="gen11774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6122"/>Yahweh upholds all who are falling,<l eID="gen11774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11775"/>and raises up all who are bowed down. <l eID="gen11775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6123"/><l level="1" sID="gen11776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6123"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> eyes of all look hopefully to you,<l eID="gen11776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11777"/>and you give them their food in due time, <l eID="gen11777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6124"/><l level="1" sID="gen11778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6124"/>opening your hand,<l eID="gen11778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11779"/>and satisfying <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desire <transChange type="added">of</transChange> every living creature. <l eID="gen11779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6125"/><l level="1" sID="gen11780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6125"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> righteous in all his ways,<l eID="gen11780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11781"/>and loyal in all his works. <l eID="gen11781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6126"/><l level="1" sID="gen11782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6126"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near to all who call on him,<l eID="gen11782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11783"/>to all who call on him in truth. <l eID="gen11783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6127"/><l level="1" sID="gen11784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6127"/>He fulfills the desire of those who fear him;<l eID="gen11784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11785"/>he also hears their cry for help, and saves them. <l eID="gen11785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6128"/><l level="1" sID="gen11786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6128"/>Yahweh protects all those who love him,<l eID="gen11786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11787"/>but all the wicked he will exterminate. <l eID="gen11787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6129"/><l level="1" sID="gen11788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6129"/>My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh,<l eID="gen11788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11789"/>and all flesh will bless his holy name<l eID="gen11789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11790"/>forever and ever. <l eID="gen11790" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11747"/> <chapter eID="Ps.145"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6130"/><title type="x-s">Praise to Yahweh for His Help</title> <div sID="gen11791" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11791" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11792"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6130"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note><l eID="gen11793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11794"/>Praise Yahweh, O my soul. <l eID="gen11794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6131"/><l level="1" sID="gen11795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6131"/>I will praise Yahweh while I live;<l eID="gen11795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11796"/>I will sing praises to my God while I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> still <transChange type="added">alive</transChange>. <l eID="gen11796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6132"/><l level="1" sID="gen11797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6132"/>Do not place trust in princes,<l eID="gen11797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11798"/>in a son of humankind with whom there is no deliverance. <l eID="gen11798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6133"/><l level="1" sID="gen11799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6133"/>His breath departs; he returns to his plot;<note placement="foot">A Hebrew wordplay: “humankind,” <hi type="italic">adam</hi> (v. <reference osisRef="Ps.146.3">3</reference>), returns to his ground/plot, <hi type="italic">adamah</hi></note><l eID="gen11799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11800"/>on that day his plans perish. <l eID="gen11800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6134"/><l level="1" sID="gen11801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6134"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is the one</transChange> whose help <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the God of Jacob,<l eID="gen11801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11802"/>whose hope <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on Yahweh <transChange type="added">as</transChange> his God, <l eID="gen11802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6135"/><l level="1" sID="gen11803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6135"/>who made heaven and earth,<l eID="gen11803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11804"/>the sea and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in them,<l eID="gen11804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11805"/>the one who keeps faith<note placement="foot">Or “remains faithful”</note> forever, <l eID="gen11805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6136"/><l level="1" sID="gen11806"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6136"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> executes justice for the oppressed,<l eID="gen11806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11807"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> gives food for the hungry.<l eID="gen11807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11808"/>Yahweh sets prisoners free; <l eID="gen11808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6137"/><l level="1" sID="gen11809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6137"/>Yahweh opens <transChange type="added">the eyes of the</transChange> blind;<l eID="gen11809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11810"/>Yahweh raises up <transChange type="added">those</transChange> bowed down;<l eID="gen11810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11811"/>Yahweh loves <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous; <l eID="gen11811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6138"/><l level="1" sID="gen11812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6138"/>Yahweh protects<note placement="foot">Or “watches over”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> strangers.<l eID="gen11812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11813"/>He helps up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow,<l eID="gen11813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11814"/>but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞thwarts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “makes crooked”</note> <l eID="gen11814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6139"/><l level="1" sID="gen11815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6139"/>Yahweh will reign forever,<l eID="gen11815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11816"/>Your God, O Zion, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout all generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for a generation and a generation”</note><l eID="gen11816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11817"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen11817" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11792"/> <chapter eID="Ps.146"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6140"/><title type="x-s">Praise to Yahweh for His Providence</title> <div sID="gen11818" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11818" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11819"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6140"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi>; here and v. <reference osisRef="Ps.147.20">20</reference></note><l eID="gen11820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11821"/>For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> good to sing praises <transChange type="added">to</transChange> our God;<l eID="gen11821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11822"/>for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> pleasant; praise is fitting. <l eID="gen11822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6141"/><l level="1" sID="gen11823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6141"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> building Jerusalem;<l eID="gen11823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11824"/>he gathers <transChange type="added">the</transChange> scattered ones of Israel. <l eID="gen11824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6142"/><l level="1" sID="gen11825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6142"/><transChange type="added">He is</transChange> the one who heals the brokenhearted,<l eID="gen11825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11826"/>and binds up their wounds. <l eID="gen11826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6143"/><l level="1" sID="gen11827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6143"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> counts <transChange type="added">the</transChange> number of the stars;<l eID="gen11827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11828"/>he gives names to all of them. <l eID="gen11828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6144"/><l level="1" sID="gen11829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6144"/>Great <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our Lord, and abundant in power;<l eID="gen11829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11830"/>his understanding is unlimited. <l eID="gen11830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6145"/><l level="1" sID="gen11831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6145"/>Yahweh helps the afflicted up;<l eID="gen11831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11832"/><transChange type="added">he</transChange> brings <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked down to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ground. <l eID="gen11832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6146"/><l level="1" sID="gen11833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6146"/>Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving;<l eID="gen11833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11834"/>sing praises to our God with lyre, <l eID="gen11834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6147"/><l level="1" sID="gen11835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6147"/>who covers <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens with clouds,<l eID="gen11835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11836"/>who provides rain for the earth,<l eID="gen11836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11837"/>who causes grass to grow on the mountains. <l eID="gen11837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6148"/><l level="1" sID="gen11838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6148"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> gives to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> animal its food,<l eID="gen11838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11839"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young ravens that cry. <l eID="gen11839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6149"/><l level="1" sID="gen11840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6149"/>He does not delight in the strength of the horse;<l eID="gen11840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11841"/>he takes no pleasure in the legs of the man. <l eID="gen11841" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6150"/><l level="1" sID="gen11842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6150"/>Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him,<l eID="gen11842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11843"/>the ones who hope<note placement="foot">That is, “wait expectantly”</note> for his loyal love. <l eID="gen11843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6151"/><l level="1" sID="gen11844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6151"/>Laud Yahweh, O Jerusalem;<l eID="gen11844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11845"/>praise your God, O Zion, <l eID="gen11845" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6152"/><l level="1" sID="gen11846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6152"/>for he strengthens the bars of your gates.<l eID="gen11846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11847"/>He blesses your children within you; <l eID="gen11847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6153"/><l level="1" sID="gen11848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6153"/><transChange type="added">he</transChange> makes your border peaceful;<l eID="gen11848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11849"/>he satisfies you with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞finest of wheat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the fat of the wheat”</note> <l eID="gen11849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6154"/><l level="1" sID="gen11850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6154"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> sends out his command<note placement="foot">Or “utterance”</note> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth;<l eID="gen11850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11851"/>his word runs swiftly. <l eID="gen11851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6155"/><l level="1" sID="gen11852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6155"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> gives snow like wool;<l eID="gen11852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11853"/>he scatters frost like ashes; <l eID="gen11853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6156"/><l level="1" sID="gen11854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6156"/><transChange type="added">he</transChange> throws his hail like crumbs.<l eID="gen11854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11855"/>Who can stand before his cold?<note placement="foot">With slight alteration of the Hebrew, the line might read “before his cold water stands”</note> <l eID="gen11855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6157"/><l level="1" sID="gen11856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6157"/>He sends out his word and melts them;<l eID="gen11856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11857"/>he blows his breath, the water flows. <l eID="gen11857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6158"/><l level="1" sID="gen11858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6158"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> declares his word to Jacob,<l eID="gen11858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11859"/>his statutes and his ordinances to Israel. <l eID="gen11859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6159"/><l level="1" sID="gen11860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6159"/>He has not done so for any nation,<l eID="gen11860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11861"/>and they do not know <transChange type="added">his</transChange> ordinances.<l eID="gen11861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11862"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen11862" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11819"/> <chapter eID="Ps.147"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6160"/><title type="x-s">Let All Creation Praise Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen11863" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11863" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11864"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6160"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note><l eID="gen11865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11866"/>Praise Yahweh from the heavens;<l eID="gen11866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11867"/>praise him in the heights. <l eID="gen11867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6161"/><l level="1" sID="gen11868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6161"/>Praise him, all his angels;<l eID="gen11868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11869"/>praise him, all his hosts.<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> <l eID="gen11869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6162"/><l level="1" sID="gen11870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6162"/>Praise him, sun and moon;<l eID="gen11870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11871"/>praise him, all stars of light. <l eID="gen11871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6163"/><l level="1" sID="gen11872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6163"/>Praise him, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞highest heavens⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heavens of the heavens”</note><l eID="gen11872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11873"/>and waters above the heavens. <l eID="gen11873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6164"/><l level="1" sID="gen11874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6164"/>Let them praise the name of Yahweh,<l eID="gen11874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11875"/>because he commanded and they were created. <l eID="gen11875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6165"/><l level="1" sID="gen11876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6165"/>And he put them in place forever and ever,<l eID="gen11876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11877"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange> a decree he gave that will not pass away. <l eID="gen11877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6166"/><l level="1" sID="gen11878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6166"/>Praise Yahweh from the earth—<l eID="gen11878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11879"/>great sea creatures and all deeps, <l eID="gen11879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6167"/><l level="1" sID="gen11880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6167"/>fire and hail, snow and cloud,<note placement="foot">The meaning of “cloud” is uncertain</note><l eID="gen11880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11881"/>stormy wind doing his bidding,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his word”</note> <l eID="gen11881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6168"/><l level="1" sID="gen11882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6168"/>the mountains and all hills,<l eID="gen11882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11883"/>fruit trees and all cedars, <l eID="gen11883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6169"/><l level="1" sID="gen11884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6169"/>beasts and all cattle,<note placement="foot">That is, wild and domesticated</note><l eID="gen11884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11885"/>creeping things and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞flying birds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “bird of wing”</note> <l eID="gen11885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6170"/><l level="1" sID="gen11886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6170"/>kings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth and all peoples,<l eID="gen11886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11887"/>princes and all judges of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth, <l eID="gen11887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6171"/><l level="1" sID="gen11888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6171"/>young men and young women as well,<l eID="gen11888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11889"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> old <transChange type="added">together</transChange> with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young— <l eID="gen11889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6172"/><l level="1" sID="gen11890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6172"/>let them praise the name of Yahweh,<l eID="gen11890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11891"/>because his name alone <transChange type="added">is</transChange> is exalted.<l eID="gen11891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11892"/>His splendor <transChange type="added">is</transChange> above earth and heavens. <l eID="gen11892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6173"/><l level="1" sID="gen11893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6173"/>And he has raised high a horn for his people,<l eID="gen11893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11894"/>praise for all his faithful—<l eID="gen11894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11895"/>for the children of Israel,<l eID="gen11895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11896"/>a people close to him.<l eID="gen11896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11897"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen11897" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11864"/> <chapter eID="Ps.148"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6174"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for His Future Judgment</title> <div sID="gen11898" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11898" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11899"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6174"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note><l eID="gen11900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11901"/>Sing to Yahweh a new song,<l eID="gen11901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11902"/>his praise in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> assembly of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> faithful. <l eID="gen11902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6175"/><l level="1" sID="gen11903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6175"/>Let Israel be glad in its maker;<l eID="gen11903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11904"/>let the children of Zion rejoice in their king. <l eID="gen11904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6176"/><l level="1" sID="gen11905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6176"/>Let them praise his name with dancing;<l eID="gen11905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11906"/>let them sing praises to him with tambourine and lyre. <l eID="gen11906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6177"/><l level="1" sID="gen11907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6177"/>For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people;<l eID="gen11907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11908"/>he glorifies <transChange type="added">the</transChange> afflicted with salvation. <l eID="gen11908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6178"/><l level="1" sID="gen11909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6178"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> faithful exult in glory;<l eID="gen11909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11910"/>let them sing for joy on their beds. <l eID="gen11910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6179"/><l level="1" sID="gen11911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6179"/>Let the extolling of God <transChange type="added">be</transChange> in their throat,<l eID="gen11911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11912"/>and a double-edged sword in their hand, <l eID="gen11912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6180"/><l level="1" sID="gen11913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6180"/>to execute vengeance on the nations<l eID="gen11913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11914"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> punishment on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<note placement="foot">Reading against the MT and with the LXX</note> <l eID="gen11914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6181"/><l level="1" sID="gen11915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6181"/>to bind their kings with chains<l eID="gen11915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11916"/>and their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞nobles⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “honorable ones”</note> with fetters of iron, <l eID="gen11916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6182"/><l level="1" sID="gen11917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6182"/>to execute on them <transChange type="added">the</transChange> judgment that is decreed.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “written”</note><l eID="gen11917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11918"/>This <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> honor for all his faithful ones;<l eID="gen11918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11919"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen11919" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11899"/> <chapter eID="Ps.149"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6183"/><title type="x-s">Let Everything Praise Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen11920" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11920" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11921"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6183"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note><l eID="gen11922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11923"/>Praise God in his sanctuary;<l eID="gen11923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11924"/>praise him in his mighty firmament. <l eID="gen11924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6184"/><l level="1" sID="gen11925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6184"/>Praise him for his mighty deeds;<l eID="gen11925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11926"/>praise him according to the abundance of his greatness. <l eID="gen11926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6185"/><l level="1" sID="gen11927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6185"/>Praise him with blast of horn;<l eID="gen11927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11928"/>praise him with harp and lyre. <l eID="gen11928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6186"/><l level="1" sID="gen11929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6186"/>Praise him with tambourine and dancing;<l eID="gen11929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11930"/>praise him with strings and flute. <l eID="gen11930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6187"/><l level="1" sID="gen11931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6187"/>Praise him with sounding cymbals;<l eID="gen11931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11932"/>praise him with clashing cymbals. <l eID="gen11932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6188"/><l level="1" sID="gen11933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6188"/>Every breathing thing,<l eID="gen11933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11934"/>let it praise Yah.<note placement="foot">A shortened form of “Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen11934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11935"/>Praise Yah.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">hallelujah</hi></note> <l eID="gen11935" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen11921"/> <chapter eID="Ps.150"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen5721" osisID="Ps" type="book"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6189"/><title type="x-s">Prologue</title> <div sID="gen11937" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11937" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11938"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6189"/>Proverbs of Solomon, son of David, king of Israel: <l eID="gen11939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6190"/><l level="1" sID="gen11940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6190"/>To know wisdom and instruction,<l eID="gen11940" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11941"/>to understand sayings of understanding, <l eID="gen11941" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6191"/><l level="1" sID="gen11942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6191"/>to gain <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞insightful instruction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the instruction of insight”</note><l eID="gen11942" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11943"/>righteousness and justice and equity, <l eID="gen11943" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6192"/><l level="1" sID="gen11944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6192"/>to give shrewdness<note placement="foot">Or “cleverness,” or “prudence”</note> to the simple,<l eID="gen11944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11945"/>knowledge and purpose<note placement="foot">Or “plan”</note> to the young, <l eID="gen11945" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6193"/><l level="1" sID="gen11946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6193"/>may the wise hear and increase learning,<l eID="gen11946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11947"/>and the one who understands gain direction,<note placement="foot">Or “guidance”</note> <l eID="gen11947" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6194"/><l level="1" sID="gen11948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6194"/>to understand a proverb and an expression,<l eID="gen11948" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11949"/>words of wisdom and their riddles. <l eID="gen11949" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6195"/><l level="1" sID="gen11950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6195"/>Fear of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> beginning of knowledge;<l eID="gen11950" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11951"/>wisdom and instruction, fools despise.<l eID="gen11951" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen11938"/> <title type="x-s">Lecture Against Gang Behavior</title> <div sID="gen11952" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen11952" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6196"/><lg sID="gen11953"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6196"/>My child, may you keep<note placement="foot">Or “obey,” or “hear”</note> your father’s instruction,<l eID="gen11954" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11955"/>and do not reject your mother’s teachings, <l eID="gen11955" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6197"/><l level="1" sID="gen11956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6197"/>for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a garland of favor for your head,<l eID="gen11956" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11957"/>and pendants for your neck. <l eID="gen11957" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6198"/><l level="1" sID="gen11958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6198"/>My child, if sinners entice you, do not consent. <l eID="gen11958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6199"/><l level="1" sID="gen11959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6199"/>If they say,<l eID="gen11959" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11960"/>“Come with us!<l eID="gen11960" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11961"/>We shall lie in wait for blood;<l eID="gen11961" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11962"/>we shall ambush the innocent without cause.<note placement="foot">Or “wantonly,” or “for nothing”</note> <l eID="gen11962" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6200"/><l level="1" sID="gen11963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6200"/>Like Sheol,<note placement="foot">A term for the place where the dead reside, i.e., the Underworld</note> we will swallow them alive<l eID="gen11963" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11964"/>and whole, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞like those who descend to the pit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “like the descenders of a pit”</note> <l eID="gen11964" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6201"/><l level="1" sID="gen11965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6201"/>We shall find all precious wealth,<l eID="gen11965" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11966"/>we shall fill our houses <transChange type="added">with</transChange> booty, <l eID="gen11966" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6202"/><l level="1" sID="gen11967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6202"/>you shall throw your lot in our midst,<l eID="gen11967" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11968"/>there will be one purse for all of us.” <l eID="gen11968" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6203"/><l level="1" sID="gen11969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6203"/>My child, do not walk in their way.<note placement="foot">Or “on their road”</note><l eID="gen11969" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11970"/>Keep your foot from their paths, <l eID="gen11970" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:16
