verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6204"/><l level="1" sID="gen11971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6204"/>for their feet run to evil,<l eID="gen11971" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11972"/>and they hurry to shed blood, <l eID="gen11972" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6205"/><l level="1" sID="gen11973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6205"/>for “in vain<note placement="foot">Or “without cause,” or “for nothing”</note> is the net scattered,<l eID="gen11973" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11974"/>in the sight of any <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞winged bird⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “bird of wing”</note> <l eID="gen11974" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6206"/><l level="1" sID="gen11975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6206"/>They lie in wait for their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> blood.<l eID="gen11975" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11976"/>They ambush their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> lives. <l eID="gen11976" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6207"/><l level="1" sID="gen11977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6207"/>Thus are the ways of all who are greedy <transChange type="added">for</transChange> gain—<l eID="gen11977" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11978"/>it will take the life of its possessors.<l eID="gen11978" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen11953"/> <title type="x-s">The Call of Lady Wisdom</title> <div sID="gen11979" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen11979" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6208"/><lg sID="gen11980"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6208"/>Wisdom calls out in the streets,<l eID="gen11981" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11982"/>in the squares she raises her voice. <l eID="gen11982" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6209"/><l level="1" sID="gen11983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6209"/>On a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞busy corner⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “head of commotion,” or “head of stirring, bustling”</note> she cries out,<l eID="gen11983" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11984"/>at the entrances of the gates in the city, she speaks her sayings: <l eID="gen11984" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6210"/><l level="1" sID="gen11985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6210"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Until when”</note> O simple ones, will you love simplicity?<l eID="gen11985" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11986"/>And <transChange type="added">how long</transChange> will scoffers delight in their scoffing,<l eID="gen11986" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11987"/>and fools hate knowledge? <l eID="gen11987" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6211"/><l level="1" sID="gen11988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6211"/>May you turn to my argument!<note placement="foot">Or “turn at my reproach”</note><l eID="gen11988" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11989"/>Behold, I shall pour out my spirit upon you;<l eID="gen11989" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11990"/>I will make my words known to you. <l eID="gen11990" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6212"/><l level="1" sID="gen11991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6212"/>Because I called out and you refused me,<l eID="gen11991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11992"/>I stretched out my hand, yet there is none who heeds. <l eID="gen11992" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6213"/><l level="1" sID="gen11993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6213"/>You have ignored all my counsel,<l eID="gen11993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11994"/>and my reproof you are not willing <transChange type="added">to accept</transChange>. <l eID="gen11994" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6214"/><l level="1" sID="gen11995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6214"/>I will also laugh at your calamity;<note placement="foot">Or “downfall”</note><l eID="gen11995" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11996"/>I will mock when panic<note placement="foot">Or “dread, fear”</note> comes <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> you. <l eID="gen11996" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6215"/><l level="1" sID="gen11997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6215"/>When your panic comes like a storm,<l eID="gen11997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11998"/>and your calamity arrives like a whirlwind,<l eID="gen11998" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen11999"/>when distress and anguish come upon you, <l eID="gen11999" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6216"/><l level="1" sID="gen12000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6216"/>then they will call<note placement="foot">Or “cry out to”</note> me, but I will not answer;<l eID="gen12000" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12001"/>they will seek me diligently but not find me. <l eID="gen12001" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6217"/><l level="1" sID="gen12002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6217"/>Since they hated knowledge,<l eID="gen12002" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12003"/>and did not choose the fear of Yahweh, <l eID="gen12003" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6218"/><l level="1" sID="gen12004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6218"/>they were not willing <transChange type="added">to accept</transChange> my counsel,<l eID="gen12004" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12005"/>they despised all my reproof. <l eID="gen12005" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6219"/><l level="1" sID="gen12006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6219"/>They shall eat from the fruit of their way,<l eID="gen12006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12007"/>and they shall be sated from their own schemes, <l eID="gen12007" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6220"/><l level="1" sID="gen12008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6220"/>for the waywardness of the simple ones will kill them,<l eID="gen12008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12009"/>and the complacency of fools will destroy them. <l eID="gen12009" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6221"/><l level="1" sID="gen12010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6221"/>Whoever listens to me will dwell in security<l eID="gen12010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12011"/>and rest securely<note placement="foot">Or “be at ease, peace”</note> from dread and disaster.” <l eID="gen12011" level="2"/><lg eID="gen11980"/> <chapter eID="Prov.1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6222"/><title type="x-s">The Benefits of Wisdom</title> <div sID="gen12012" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen12012" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen12013"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6222"/>My child, if you will receive<note placement="foot">Or “take, seize”</note> my sayings,<l eID="gen12014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12015"/>and hide my commands with you, <l eID="gen12015" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6223"/><l level="1" sID="gen12016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6223"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to incline your ear toward wisdom,<l eID="gen12016" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12017"/><transChange type="added">then</transChange> you shall apply your heart to understanding. <l eID="gen12017" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6224"/><l level="1" sID="gen12018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6224"/>For if you cry out for understanding,<note placement="foot">Or “call to understanding”</note><l eID="gen12018" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12019"/><transChange type="added">if</transChange> you lift<note placement="foot">Or “carry, give”</note> your voice for insight, <l eID="gen12019" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6225"/><l level="1" sID="gen12020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6225"/>if you seek her like silver<l eID="gen12020" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12021"/>and search her out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞like treasure⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “like the treasures”</note> <l eID="gen12021" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6226"/><l level="1" sID="gen12022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6226"/>then you will understand the fear of Yahweh,<l eID="gen12022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12023"/>and the knowledge of God you will find. <l eID="gen12023" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6227"/><l level="1" sID="gen12024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6227"/>For Yahweh will give wisdom;<l eID="gen12024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12025"/>from his mouth <transChange type="added">come</transChange> knowledge and understanding. <l eID="gen12025" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6228"/><l level="1" sID="gen12026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6228"/>For the upright, he stores<note placement="foot">Or “hides, keeps”</note> sound judgment, a shield for those who walk uprightly, <l eID="gen12026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6229"/><l level="1" sID="gen12027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6229"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to guard paths of justice<l eID="gen12027" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12028"/>and keep<note placement="foot">Or “preserve, guard, watch”</note> the way of his faithful <transChange type="added">ones</transChange>. <l eID="gen12028" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6230"/><l level="1" sID="gen12029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6230"/>Then you will understand righteousness and justice<l eID="gen12029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12030"/>and uprightness—every good course— <l eID="gen12030" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6231"/><l level="1" sID="gen12031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6231"/>for wisdom will enter your heart,<l eID="gen12031" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12032"/>and knowledge will be pleasing to your soul.<note placement="foot">Or “inner self”</note> <l eID="gen12032" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6232"/><l level="1" sID="gen12033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6232"/>Discretion will watch over you;<l eID="gen12033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12034"/>understanding will protect you, <l eID="gen12034" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6233"/><l level="1" sID="gen12035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6233"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to deliver you from the way of evil,<note placement="foot">Or “evildoer”</note><l eID="gen12035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12036"/>from a man who speaks devious things— <l eID="gen12036" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6234"/><l level="1" sID="gen12037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6234"/>those who forsake the paths of uprightness<l eID="gen12037" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12038"/>to walk in ways of darkness, <l eID="gen12038" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6235"/><l level="1" sID="gen12039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6235"/>those who are happy to do evil,<l eID="gen12039" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12040"/><transChange type="added">for</transChange> they delight in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deviousness of evil, <l eID="gen12040" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6236"/><l level="1" sID="gen12041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6236"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who are crooked in their ways⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “that in their ways are crooked”</note><l eID="gen12041" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12042"/>and devious in their paths; <l eID="gen12042" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6237"/><l level="1" sID="gen12043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6237"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to deliver you from a strange woman,<l eID="gen12043" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12044"/>from a foreign woman <transChange type="added">who</transChange> flatters<note placement="foot">Or “makes smooth”</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> her sayings, <l eID="gen12044" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6238"/><l level="1" sID="gen12045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6238"/>she who forsakes the partner of her youth<l eID="gen12045" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12046"/>and has forgotten the covenant of her God, <l eID="gen12046" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6239"/><l level="1" sID="gen12047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6239"/>for her house sinks to death,<l eID="gen12047" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12048"/>and to the dead<note placement="foot">Or “Rephaim”</note> are her paths. <l eID="gen12048" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6240"/><l level="1" sID="gen12049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6240"/><transChange type="added">Of</transChange> all who go to her, none shall return,<l eID="gen12049" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12050"/>nor do they reach paths of life. <l eID="gen12050" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6241"/><l level="1" sID="gen12051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6241"/>So that you will walk on the road of those who are good,<l eID="gen12051" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12052"/>and the paths of those who are righteous you shall keep. <l eID="gen12052" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6242"/><l level="1" sID="gen12053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6242"/>For those who are upright will dwell <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> land,<note placement="foot">Or “earth”</note><l eID="gen12053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12054"/>and those who are blameless<note placement="foot">Or “innocent”</note> will remain in it. <l eID="gen12054" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6243"/><l level="1" sID="gen12055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6243"/>And those who are wicked will be cut off from the land,<l eID="gen12055" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12056"/>and those who are treacherous will be uprooted from it. <l eID="gen12056" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12013"/> <chapter eID="Prov.2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6244"/><title type="x-s">Wisdom and Piety</title> <div sID="gen12057" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen12057" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen12058"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6244"/>My child, do not forget my instruction,<l eID="gen12059" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12060"/>and may your heart guard my commands. <l eID="gen12060" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6245"/><l level="1" sID="gen12061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6245"/>For length of days, years of life,<l eID="gen12061" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12062"/>and peace they<note placement="foot">That is, “my commands” (3:1)</note> shall add to you. <l eID="gen12062" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6246"/><l level="1" sID="gen12063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6246"/>May loyal love<note placement="foot">Or “kindness, mercy”</note> and truth not forsake you;<l eID="gen12063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12064"/>bind them around your neck,<l eID="gen12064" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12065"/>write them upon your heart. <l eID="gen12065" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6247"/><l level="1" sID="gen12066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6247"/>And you shall find favor and good sense<note placement="foot">Or “understanding, prudence”</note><l eID="gen12066" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12067"/>in the eyes of God and humankind. <l eID="gen12067" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6248"/><l level="1" sID="gen12068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6248"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Trust Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “trust toward Yahweh”</note> with all your heart;<l eID="gen12068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12069"/>do not lean toward your own understanding. <l eID="gen12069" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6249"/><l level="1" sID="gen12070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6249"/>In all your ways acknowledge him,<l eID="gen12070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12071"/>and he will straighten your paths. <l eID="gen12071" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6250"/><l level="1" sID="gen12072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6250"/>Do not be wise in your own eyes;<l eID="gen12072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12073"/>fear Yahweh and retreat from evil. <l eID="gen12073" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6251"/><l level="1" sID="gen12074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6251"/>There shall be healing for your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞flesh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “navel”</note><l eID="gen12074" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12075"/>and refreshment for your body. <l eID="gen12075" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6252"/><l level="1" sID="gen12076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6252"/>Honor Yahweh from your substance,<note placement="foot">Or “wealth, property”</note><l eID="gen12076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12077"/>and from the firstfruits of all that will come to you, <l eID="gen12077" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6253"/><l level="1" sID="gen12078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6253"/>and your barns shall be full of plenty,<l eID="gen12078" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12079"/>and your vats shall burst <transChange type="added">with</transChange> new wine.<l eID="gen12079" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12058"/> <title type="x-s">Happy Is the One Who Finds Wisdom</title> <div sID="gen12080" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12080" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6254"/><lg sID="gen12081"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6254"/>Do not despise the discipline of Yahweh, my child.<l eID="gen12082" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12083"/>Do not be weary of his reproof <l eID="gen12083" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6255"/><l level="1" sID="gen12084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6255"/>because whomever Yahweh will love, he will rebuke,<l eID="gen12084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12085"/>as a father delights in his son. <l eID="gen12085" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6256"/><l level="1" sID="gen12086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6256"/>Happy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man”</note> who finds wisdom,<l eID="gen12086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12087"/>and one who obtains understanding. <l eID="gen12087" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6257"/><l level="1" sID="gen12088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6257"/>For her<note placement="foot">Or “its”; both “wisdom” and “understanding” are feminine nouns and can be read as either “she” or “it”</note> income is better than the income of silver,<l eID="gen12088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12089"/>and her revenue than <transChange type="added">that of</transChange> gold. <l eID="gen12089" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6258"/><l level="1" sID="gen12090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6258"/>She is more precious than rubies,<l eID="gen12090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12091"/>and all your desires shall not compare with her. <l eID="gen12091" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6259"/><l level="1" sID="gen12092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6259"/>Length of days <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in her right hand;<l eID="gen12092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12093"/>in her left hand <transChange type="added">are</transChange> riches and honor. <l eID="gen12093" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6260"/><l level="1" sID="gen12094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6260"/>Her ways <transChange type="added">are</transChange> ways of pleasantness,<l eID="gen12094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12095"/>and all her paths <transChange type="added">are</transChange> peace. <l eID="gen12095" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6261"/><l level="1" sID="gen12096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6261"/>She is a tree of life for those who seize her;<l eID="gen12096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12097"/>those who take hold of her are considered happy.<l eID="gen12097" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12081"/> <title type="x-s">Role of Wisdom in Creation and Society</title> <div sID="gen12098" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12098" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6262"/><lg sID="gen12099"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6262"/>Yahweh in wisdom founded the earth;<l eID="gen12100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12101"/>he established the heavens in understanding. <l eID="gen12101" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6263"/><l level="1" sID="gen12102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6263"/>With his knowledge, depths broke open,<l eID="gen12102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12103"/>and clouds dropped dew. <l eID="gen12103" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6264"/><l level="1" sID="gen12104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6264"/>My child, may they<note placement="foot">Grammatically, “they” most likely refers to clouds (3:20). In context, “they” may refer to wisdom and understanding (3:13).</note> not escape from your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “eyes”</note><l eID="gen12104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12105"/>may you keep sound wisdom and prudence. <l eID="gen12105" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6265"/><l level="1" sID="gen12106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6265"/>They shall be life for your soul<note placement="foot">Or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen12106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12107"/>and adornment<note placement="foot">Or “favor”</note> for your neck. <l eID="gen12107" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6266"/><l level="1" sID="gen12108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6266"/>Then you will walk in the confidence of your ways,<l eID="gen12108" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12109"/>and your foot will not stumble. <l eID="gen12109" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6267"/><l level="1" sID="gen12110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6267"/>If you sit down, you will not panic,<note placement="foot">Or “fear, dread”</note><l eID="gen12110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12111"/>and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> you lie down, then your sleep shall be sweet. <l eID="gen12111" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6268"/><l level="1" sID="gen12112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6268"/>Do not be afraid of sudden panic,<note placement="foot">Or “fear, dread”</note><l eID="gen12112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12113"/>or the storm of wickedness that will come. <l eID="gen12113" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6269"/><l level="1" sID="gen12114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6269"/>Yahweh will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your confidence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in your confidence”</note><l eID="gen12114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12115"/>and guard your foot from capture. <l eID="gen12115" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6270"/><l level="1" sID="gen12116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6270"/>Do not withhold good from its owner<note placement="foot">Or “lord”</note><l eID="gen12116" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12117"/>when it is in the power of your hand to do. <l eID="gen12117" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6271"/><l level="1" sID="gen12118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6271"/>Do not say to your neighbor,<l eID="gen12118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12119"/>“Go and return and tomorrow I will give <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,”<l eID="gen12119" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12120"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when it is with you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and there is with you”</note> <l eID="gen12120" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6272"/><l level="1" sID="gen12121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6272"/>Do not plot harm against your neighbor<l eID="gen12121" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12122"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> dwells in confidence beside you. <l eID="gen12122" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6273"/><l level="1" sID="gen12123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6273"/>Do not quarrel with anyone without cause,<l eID="gen12123" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12124"/>when he did not do you harm. <l eID="gen12124" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6274"/><l level="1" sID="gen12125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6274"/>Do not envy a man of violence,<l eID="gen12125" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12126"/>and do not choose any of his ways, <l eID="gen12126" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6275"/><l level="1" sID="gen12127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6275"/>for he who is perverse <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an abomination of Yahweh,<l eID="gen12127" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12128"/>but those who are upright <transChange type="added">are</transChange> his confidence. <l eID="gen12128" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6276"/><l level="1" sID="gen12129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6276"/>The curse of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the house of the wicked,<l eID="gen12129" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12130"/>and the abode of the righteous ones he blesses. <l eID="gen12130" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6277"/><l level="1" sID="gen12131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6277"/>With those who scorn, he is scornful,<l eID="gen12131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12132"/>but to those who are humble, he gives favor. <l eID="gen12132" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6278"/><l level="1" sID="gen12133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6278"/>They will inherit the honor of the wise,<l eID="gen12133" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12134"/>but stubborn fools, disgrace. <l eID="gen12134" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12099"/> <chapter eID="Prov.3"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6279"/><title type="x-s">The Father’s Wisdom</title> <div sID="gen12135" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen12135" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen12136"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6279"/>Children, listen <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> instruction of a father,<l eID="gen12137" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12138"/>and be attentive <transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to know insight. <l eID="gen12138" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6280"/><l level="1" sID="gen12139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6280"/>For I have given you good instruction;<l eID="gen12139" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12140"/>do not forsake my teaching. <l eID="gen12140" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6281"/><l level="1" sID="gen12141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6281"/>When I was a son to my father,<l eID="gen12141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12142"/>tender and alone before my mother, <l eID="gen12142" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6282"/><l level="1" sID="gen12143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6282"/>he taught me and said to me,<l eID="gen12143" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12144"/>“May your heart hold fast <transChange type="added">to</transChange> my words;<l eID="gen12144" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12145"/>guard my commandments and live. <l eID="gen12145" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6283"/><l level="1" sID="gen12146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6283"/>Get wisdom and insight;<l eID="gen12146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12147"/>do not forget and do not turn from the sayings of my mouth. <l eID="gen12147" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6284"/><l level="1" sID="gen12148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6284"/>Do not forsake her—then she will guard you;<l eID="gen12148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12149"/>love her and she will keep you. <l eID="gen12149" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6285"/><l level="1" sID="gen12150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6285"/>The beginning of wisdom: Get wisdom!<l eID="gen12150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12151"/>With all <transChange type="added">that is in</transChange> your possession, gain insight. <l eID="gen12151" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6286"/><l level="1" sID="gen12152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6286"/>Cherish her and she will exalt you;<l eID="gen12152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12153"/>she will honor you if you embrace her. <l eID="gen12153" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6287"/><l level="1" sID="gen12154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6287"/>She will give a garland for your head;<l eID="gen12154" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12155"/>she shall bestow a crown of glory upon you.”<l eID="gen12155" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12136"/> <title type="x-s">The Right Path</title> <div sID="gen12156" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12156" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6288"/><lg sID="gen12157"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6288"/>Listen, my child, take my sayings,<l eID="gen12158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12159"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> years of your life shall be great. <l eID="gen12159" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6289"/><l level="1" sID="gen12160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6289"/>In the way of wisdom I have instructed you;<l eID="gen12160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12161"/>I have led you in the path of uprightness. <l eID="gen12161" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6290"/><l level="1" sID="gen12162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6290"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When you walk⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “In your walking”</note> your step will not be hampered,<l eID="gen12162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12163"/>and if you run, you will not stumble. <l eID="gen12163" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6291"/><l level="1" sID="gen12164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6291"/>Seize the instruction! Do not let go!<l eID="gen12164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12165"/>Guard her, for she is your life. <l eID="gen12165" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6292"/><l level="1" sID="gen12166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6292"/>In the path of the wicked do not go;<l eID="gen12166" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12167"/>do not walk in the way of those who do evil. <l eID="gen12167" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6293"/><l level="1" sID="gen12168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6293"/>Avoid it; do not transgress it;<l eID="gen12168" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12169"/>turn away from it and pass by. <l eID="gen12169" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6294"/><l level="1" sID="gen12170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6294"/>For they will not sleep if they have not done wrong,<l eID="gen12170" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12171"/>and they are robbed of their sleep if they do not cause stumbling. <l eID="gen12171" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6295"/><l level="1" sID="gen12172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6295"/>For they ate the bread of wickedness,<l eID="gen12172" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12173"/>and they drank the wine of violence. <l eID="gen12173" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6296"/><l level="1" sID="gen12174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6296"/>But the path of the righteous ones <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the light of dawn,<l eID="gen12174" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12175"/>leading and shining until the day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is full⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “is correct”</note> <l eID="gen12175" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6297"/><l level="1" sID="gen12176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6297"/>The way of the wicked ones <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like deep darkness;<l eID="gen12176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12177"/>they do not know what they stumble over.<l eID="gen12177" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12157"/> <title type="x-s">Staying the Course</title> <div sID="gen12178" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12178" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6298"/><lg sID="gen12179"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6298"/>My child, be attentive to my words;<l eID="gen12180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12181"/>to my sayings incline your ear. <l eID="gen12181" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6299"/><l level="1" sID="gen12182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6299"/>May they not escape from your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “eyes”</note><l eID="gen12182" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12183"/>keep them in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> midst of your heart. <l eID="gen12183" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6300"/><l level="1" sID="gen12184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6300"/>For they are life to those who find them<l eID="gen12184" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12185"/>and healing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the entire body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for all his flesh”</note> <l eID="gen12185" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6301"/><l level="1" sID="gen12186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6301"/>With all vigilance, keep your heart,<l eID="gen12186" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12187"/>for from it <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> the source<note placement="foot">Or “extremity”</note> of life. <l eID="gen12187" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6302"/><l level="1" sID="gen12188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6302"/>Remove from yourself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deceitful speech⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “crookedness of mouth”</note><l eID="gen12188" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12189"/>and abolish <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞devious talk⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “deviousness of lips”</note> from yourself. <l eID="gen12189" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6303"/><l level="1" sID="gen12190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6303"/>May your eyes look forward<note placement="foot">Or “opposite”</note><l eID="gen12190" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12191"/>and your gaze be straight before you. <l eID="gen12191" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6304"/><l level="1" sID="gen12192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6304"/>May the path of your foot be balanced<l eID="gen12192" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12193"/>and all your ways be sure. <l eID="gen12193" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6305"/><l level="1" sID="gen12194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6305"/>Do not swerve right or left;<l eID="gen12194" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12195"/>remove your foot from evil. <l eID="gen12195" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12179"/> <chapter eID="Prov.4"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:1
verses.text: My child, be attentive to my wisdom,<l eID="gen12198" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12199"/>and to my understanding incline your ear; <l eID="gen12199" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6306"/><l level="1" sID="gen12200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6306"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to keep prudence,<l eID="gen12200" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12201"/>and knowledge will guard your lips. <l eID="gen12201" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6307"/><l level="1" sID="gen12202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6307"/>For the lips of the strange woman will drip honey,<l eID="gen12202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12203"/>and smoother than oil is her mouth.<note placement="foot">Or “palate”</note> <l eID="gen12203" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6308"/><l level="1" sID="gen12204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6308"/>But her end is bitter as the wormwood,<l eID="gen12204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12205"/>sharp as a two-edged sword. <l eID="gen12205" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6309"/><l level="1" sID="gen12206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6309"/>Her feet go down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> death;<l eID="gen12206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12207"/>her steps take hold <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Sheol.<note placement="foot">A term for the place where the dead reside, i.e., the Underworld</note> <l eID="gen12207" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6310"/><l level="1" sID="gen12208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6310"/>She does not observe<note placement="foot">Or “examine, weigh”</note> the path of life;<l eID="gen12208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12209"/>her ways wander, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> she does not know <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<l eID="gen12209" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12197"/> <title type="x-s">Do Not Commit Adultery Against Wisdom</title> <div sID="gen12210" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12210" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6311"/><lg sID="gen12211"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6311"/>Now, O children, listen to me;<l eID="gen12212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12213"/>do not depart from the sayings of my mouth. <l eID="gen12213" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6312"/><l level="1" sID="gen12214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6312"/>Keep your paths far from her,<l eID="gen12214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12215"/>and do not go near to the door of her house, <l eID="gen12215" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6313"/><l level="1" sID="gen12216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6313"/>lest you give your honor to the others,<l eID="gen12216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12217"/>and your years to the merciless, <l eID="gen12217" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6314"/><l level="1" sID="gen12218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6314"/>lest strangers take <transChange type="added">their</transChange> fill of your strength,<l eID="gen12218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12219"/>and your labors <transChange type="added">go</transChange> to the house of a foreigner, <l eID="gen12219" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6315"/><l level="1" sID="gen12220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6315"/>and you groan at your end,<l eID="gen12220" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12221"/>when your flesh and body are consumed, <l eID="gen12221" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6316"/><l level="1" sID="gen12222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6316"/>and say “How I hated discipline,<l eID="gen12222" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12223"/>and I despised reproof!” <l eID="gen12223" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6317"/><l level="1" sID="gen12224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6317"/>and “I did not listen to the voice of my teachers,<l eID="gen12224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12225"/>and I did not incline my ear to my instructors! <l eID="gen12225" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6318"/><l level="1" sID="gen12226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6318"/>I was almost at utter<note placement="foot">Or “all, every, whole”</note> ruin<note placement="foot">Or “evil”</note><l eID="gen12226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12227"/>in the midst of the assembly and congregation.” <l eID="gen12227" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6319"/><l level="1" sID="gen12228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6319"/>Drink water from your <transChange type="added">own</transChange> cistern<l eID="gen12228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12229"/>and flowing waters from inside your own well. <l eID="gen12229" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6320"/><l level="1" sID="gen12230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6320"/>Shall your springs be scattered outward?<l eID="gen12230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12231"/>In the streets, <transChange type="added">shall there be</transChange> streams of water? <l eID="gen12231" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6321"/><l level="1" sID="gen12232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6321"/>May they be yours alone,<l eID="gen12232" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12233"/>and not for strangers <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> with you. <l eID="gen12233" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6322"/><l level="1" sID="gen12234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6322"/>May your fountain be blessed,<l eID="gen12234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12235"/>and rejoice in the wife<note placement="foot">Or “woman”</note> of your youth. <l eID="gen12235" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6323"/><l level="1" sID="gen12236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6323"/><transChange type="added">She is</transChange> a deer of love and a doe of grace;<l eID="gen12236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12237"/>may her breasts satisfy you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞always⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “at all time”</note><l eID="gen12237" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12238"/>by her love may you be intoxicated continually. <l eID="gen12238" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6324"/><l level="1" sID="gen12239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6324"/>Why should you be intoxicated, my child, by a strange woman,<l eID="gen12239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12240"/>and embrace the bosom of a foreigner? <l eID="gen12240" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6325"/><l level="1" sID="gen12241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6325"/>For before the eyes of Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞human ways⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the ways of man/humankind”</note><l eID="gen12241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12242"/>and all his paths he examines. <l eID="gen12242" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6326"/><l level="1" sID="gen12243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6326"/>His iniquities shall ensnare him, the evildoer,<l eID="gen12243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12244"/>and in the vanity of his sin he shall be caught. <l eID="gen12244" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6327"/><l level="1" sID="gen12245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6327"/>He shall die <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for lack of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with there is no”</note> discipline,<l eID="gen12245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12246"/>and in the greatness of his folly he shall be lost. <l eID="gen12246" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12211"/> <chapter eID="Prov.5"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6328"/><title type="x-s">Against Pledges</title> <div sID="gen12247" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen12247" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen12248"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6328"/>My child, if you have pledged to your neighbor,<l eID="gen12249" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12250"/><transChange type="added">if</transChange> you have bound <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “palms of your hands”</note> to the stranger, <l eID="gen12250" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6329"/><l level="1" sID="gen12251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6329"/><transChange type="added">if</transChange> you are snared by the sayings of your mouth,<l eID="gen12251" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12252"/><transChange type="added">if</transChange> you are caught by the sayings of your mouth, <l eID="gen12252" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6330"/><l level="1" sID="gen12253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6330"/>do this, then, my child, and save yourself,<l eID="gen12253" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12254"/>for you have come into <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the palm of your neighbor’s hand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “the palm of the hand of your neighbor”</note><l eID="gen12254" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12255"/>Go, humble yourself, plead with your neighbor. <l eID="gen12255" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6331"/><l level="1" sID="gen12256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6331"/>Do not give sleep to your eyes,<l eID="gen12256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12257"/>or slumber to your eyelids. <l eID="gen12257" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6332"/><l level="1" sID="gen12258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6332"/>Save yourself like a gazelle from a hand,<l eID="gen12258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12259"/>or like a bird from the hand of a fowler.<l eID="gen12259" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12248"/> <title type="x-s">Against Sloth</title> <div sID="gen12260" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12260" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6333"/><lg sID="gen12261"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6333"/>Go to the ant, lazy!<l eID="gen12262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12263"/>Consider its ways and be wise. <l eID="gen12263" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6334"/><l level="1" sID="gen12264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6334"/>It has no chief,<l eID="gen12264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12265"/>officer, or ruler. <l eID="gen12265" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6335"/><l level="1" sID="gen12266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6335"/>In the summer, it prepares its food;<l eID="gen12266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12267"/>in the harvest, it gathers its sustenance. <l eID="gen12267" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6336"/><l level="1" sID="gen12268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6336"/>How long will you lie down, lazy?<l eID="gen12268" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12269"/>When will you rise up from your sleep? <l eID="gen12269" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6337"/><l level="1" sID="gen12270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6337"/>A little sleep, a little slumber,<l eID="gen12270" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12271"/>a little folding of the hands for rest— <l eID="gen12271" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6338"/><l level="1" sID="gen12272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6338"/>like a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞robber⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one who walks,” that is, a vagabond</note> shall your poverty come,<l eID="gen12272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12273"/>and what you lack like an armed man.<l eID="gen12273" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12261"/> <title type="x-s">Against Worthlessness</title> <div sID="gen12274" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12274" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6339"/><lg sID="gen12275"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6339"/>A worthless man, an evil man,<l eID="gen12276" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12277"/>goes around with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deceitful speech⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “crookedness of mouth”</note> <l eID="gen12277" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6340"/><l level="1" sID="gen12278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6340"/>Winking in his eye, shuffling in his foot,<l eID="gen12278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12279"/>pointing in his fingers, <l eID="gen12279" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6341"/><l level="1" sID="gen12280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6341"/>perversion in his heart, he devises evil;<l eID="gen12280" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12281"/>at all times he will send out discord.<note placement="foot">Or “quarrels”</note> <l eID="gen12281" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6342"/><l level="1" sID="gen12282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6342"/>Upon <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞such a man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “thus”</note> suddenly shall his calamity come;<l eID="gen12282" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12283"/>in a moment he will be damaged and there is no healing.<note placement="foot">Or “repair”</note><l eID="gen12283" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12275"/> <title type="x-s">What Yahweh Hates</title> <div sID="gen12284" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12284" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6343"/><lg sID="gen12285"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6343"/>There are six <transChange type="added">things</transChange> Yahweh hates,<l eID="gen12286" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12287"/>and seven <transChange type="added">things are</transChange> abominations of his soul:<note placement="foot">Or “inner self”</note> <l eID="gen12287" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6344"/><l level="1" sID="gen12288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6344"/>haughty eyes, a lying tongue,<l eID="gen12288" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12289"/>and hands that shed innocent blood, <l eID="gen12289" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6345"/><l level="1" sID="gen12290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6345"/>a devising heart, plans of deception,<l eID="gen12290" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12291"/>feet that hurry to run to evil,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the evil”</note> <l eID="gen12291" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6346"/><l level="1" sID="gen12292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6346"/>a false witness who breathes lies<l eID="gen12292" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12293"/>and sends out discord<note placement="foot">Or “quarrels”</note> between brothers.<l eID="gen12293" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12285"/> <title type="x-s">Commandment and Instruction as Guardians</title> <div sID="gen12294" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12294" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6347"/><lg sID="gen12295"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6347"/>My child, keep <transChange type="added">the</transChange> commandment of your father,<l eID="gen12296" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12297"/>and do not disregard <transChange type="added">the</transChange> instruction of your mother. <l eID="gen12297" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6348"/><l level="1" sID="gen12298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6348"/>Bind them on your heart continually;<l eID="gen12298" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12299"/>tie them upon your neck. <l eID="gen12299" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6349"/><l level="1" sID="gen12300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6349"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When you walk⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “In your walking”</note> she<note placement="foot">That is, “commandment” and “instruction”</note> will lead you,<l eID="gen12300" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12301"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When you lie down⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “In your lying down”</note> she will watch over you,<l eID="gen12301" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12302"/>and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> you awake, she will converse <transChange type="added">with</transChange> you. <l eID="gen12302" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6350"/><l level="1" sID="gen12303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6350"/>For <transChange type="added">like</transChange> a lamp <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a commandment, and instruction <transChange type="added">is</transChange> light,<l eID="gen12303" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12304"/>and the way of life<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lives”</note> <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> reproof of discipline, <l eID="gen12304" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6351"/><l level="1" sID="gen12305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6351"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to preserve you from an evil woman,<note placement="foot">Or “wife”</note><l eID="gen12305" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12306"/>from the smoothness of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tongue of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an adulteress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a foreign woman”</note> <l eID="gen12306" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6352"/><l level="1" sID="gen12307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6352"/>Do not desire her beauty in your heart;<l eID="gen12307" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12308"/>may she not capture you with her eyelashes. <l eID="gen12308" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6353"/><l level="1" sID="gen12309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6353"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> price of a woman, a prostitute,<note placement="foot">Or “whore”</note> <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> price of a loaf of bread,<l eID="gen12309" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12310"/>but the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞woman belonging to a man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the woman of a man”</note> hunts precious life.<l eID="gen12310" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12295"/> <title type="x-s">Warning Against Relations with a Married Woman</title> <div sID="gen12311" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12311" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6354"/><lg sID="gen12312"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6354"/>Can a man carry fire in his lap,<l eID="gen12313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12314"/>and his clothes not burn? <l eID="gen12314" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6355"/><l level="1" sID="gen12315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6355"/>If a man walks upon the hot coals,<l eID="gen12315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12316"/>will his feet not be burned? <l eID="gen12316" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6356"/><l level="1" sID="gen12317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6356"/>Thus, he who goes to the wife of his neighbor,<l eID="gen12317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12318"/>any who touches her shall not go unpunished. <l eID="gen12318" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6357"/><l level="1" sID="gen12319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6357"/><transChange type="added">People</transChange> do not despise a thief when he steals<l eID="gen12319" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12320"/>to fill himself<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> when he is hungry. <l eID="gen12320" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6358"/><l level="1" sID="gen12321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6358"/>But <transChange type="added">if</transChange> he is found, he will pay sevenfold,<l eID="gen12321" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12322"/>every possession of his house he shall give. <l eID="gen12322" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6359"/><l level="1" sID="gen12323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6359"/>He who commits adultery <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a woman lacks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note><l eID="gen12323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12324"/>he destroys himself<note placement="foot">Or “his soul,” or “his life”</note> who does it. <l eID="gen12324" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6360"/><l level="1" sID="gen12325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6360"/>A wound and dishonor he will find,<l eID="gen12325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12326"/>and his disgrace will not be wiped out. <l eID="gen12326" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6361"/><l level="1" sID="gen12327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6361"/>For jealousy <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> fury of a husband,<l eID="gen12327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12328"/>and he will not show restraint on the day of revenge. <l eID="gen12328" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6362"/><l level="1" sID="gen12329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6362"/>He will not accept <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any compensation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the face of any compensation”</note><l eID="gen12329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12330"/>and he will not be willing, though the bribe is large. <l eID="gen12330" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12312"/> <chapter eID="Prov.6"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6363"/><title type="x-s">Warning Against the Strange Woman</title> <div sID="gen12331" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen12331" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen12332"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6363"/>My child, guard my sayings;<l eID="gen12333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12334"/>store my commandments with you. <l eID="gen12334" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6364"/><l level="1" sID="gen12335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6364"/>Keep my commands and live,<l eID="gen12335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12336"/>and my teaching like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞apple of your eye⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">A single word meaning “pupil of the eye”</note> <l eID="gen12336" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6365"/><l level="1" sID="gen12337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6365"/>Bind them on your fingers;<l eID="gen12337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12338"/>write them on the tablet of your heart. <l eID="gen12338" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6366"/><l level="1" sID="gen12339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6366"/>Say to wisdom,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the wisdom”</note> “you are my sister,”<l eID="gen12339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12340"/>and you shall call insight,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the insight”</note> “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞intimate friend⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “one who is known.” To “know” is often a euphemism for intercourse. Therefore “intimate friend” may also be read “lover.”</note> <l eID="gen12340" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6367"/><l level="1" sID="gen12341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6367"/><transChange type="added">In order</transChange> to guard yourself from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an adulteress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a strange woman”</note><l eID="gen12341" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12342"/>from the foreigner who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞makes her words smooth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “causes to be smooth her words”</note> <l eID="gen12342" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6368"/><l level="1" sID="gen12343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6368"/>For at the window of my house,<l eID="gen12343" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12344"/>through my lattice, I looked down. <l eID="gen12344" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6369"/><l level="1" sID="gen12345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6369"/>And I saw among the simple,<l eID="gen12345" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12346"/>I observed among the youth,<l eID="gen12346" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12347"/>a young man lacking <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> <l eID="gen12347" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6370"/><l level="1" sID="gen12348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6370"/>passing on the street <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at the place of”</note> her corner,<l eID="gen12348" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12349"/>and he takes the road <transChange type="added">to</transChange> her house, <l eID="gen12349" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6371"/><l level="1" sID="gen12350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6371"/>at twilight, at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day’s evening,<l eID="gen12350" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12351"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> midst of night and the darkness. <l eID="gen12351" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6372"/><l level="1" sID="gen12352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6372"/>Then behold! A woman <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> to meet him<l eID="gen12352" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12353"/><transChange type="added">with the</transChange> garment of a prostitute<note placement="foot">Or “whore”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a secret heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “secret of heart”</note> <l eID="gen12353" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6373"/><l level="1" sID="gen12354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6373"/>She is loud and stubborn;<l eID="gen12354" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12355"/>her feet do not stay at her house. <l eID="gen12355" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6374"/><l level="1" sID="gen12356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6374"/>Now in the street, now in the square,<l eID="gen12356" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12357"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at the place of”</note> every corner she lies in wait. <l eID="gen12357" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6375"/><l level="1" sID="gen12358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6375"/>She took hold of<note placement="foot">Or “strengthened”</note> him and kissed him.<l eID="gen12358" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12359"/>Her face was impudent, and she said to him, <l eID="gen12359" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6376"/><l level="1" sID="gen12360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6376"/>“Sacrifices of peace offerings <transChange type="added">are</transChange> upon me;<l eID="gen12360" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12361"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> I completed my vows. <l eID="gen12361" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6377"/><l level="1" sID="gen12362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6377"/>So<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thus”</note> I have come out to meet you,<l eID="gen12362" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12363"/>to seek your face, and I have found you. <l eID="gen12363" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6378"/><l level="1" sID="gen12364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6378"/><transChange type="added">With</transChange> coverings I have adorned my couch,<l eID="gen12364" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12365"/>spreads of the linen of Egypt; <l eID="gen12365" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6379"/><l level="1" sID="gen12366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6379"/>I have perfumed my bed <transChange type="added">with</transChange> myrrh,<l eID="gen12366" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12367"/>aloes, and cinnamon. <l eID="gen12367" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6380"/><l level="1" sID="gen12368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6380"/>Come, let us take <transChange type="added">our</transChange> fill of love making,<l eID="gen12368" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12369"/>until the morning let us delight in love. <l eID="gen12369" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6381"/><l level="1" sID="gen12370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6381"/>For there is no man<note placement="foot">Or “husband”</note> in his home;<l eID="gen12370" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12371"/>he has gone on a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞long journey⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a journey from far”</note> <l eID="gen12371" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6382"/><l level="1" sID="gen12372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6382"/>The bag of money he took in his hand,<l eID="gen12372" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12373"/>for <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the day of the full moon he will come home.” <l eID="gen12373" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6383"/><l level="1" sID="gen12374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6383"/>She persuades him with the greatness of her teachings;<l eID="gen12374" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12375"/>with her smooth lips she compels him. <l eID="gen12375" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6384"/><l level="1" sID="gen12376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6384"/>He goes after her suddenly;<l eID="gen12376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12377"/>like an ox to the slaughter he goes,<l eID="gen12377" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12378"/>and like a stag to the instruction of a fool, <l eID="gen12378" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:23
