verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6385"/><l level="1" sID="gen12379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6385"/>until an arrow pierces his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞entrails⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heaviness,” often referring to the liver</note><l eID="gen12379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12380"/>like a bird rushing into a snare,<l eID="gen12380" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12381"/>but he does not know that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it will cost him his life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it is against his life”</note><l eID="gen12381" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12332"/> <title type="x-s">Reiteration of the Warning Against a Strange Woman</title> <div sID="gen12382" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12382" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6386"/><lg sID="gen12383"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6386"/>And now, my children, listen to me,<l eID="gen12384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12385"/>and be attentive to the sayings of my mouth. <l eID="gen12385" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6387"/><l level="1" sID="gen12386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6387"/>May your heart not turn aside to her ways;<l eID="gen12386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12387"/>do not stray into her path. <l eID="gen12387" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6388"/><l level="1" sID="gen12388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6388"/>For many slain she has laid low,<l eID="gen12388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12389"/>and countless<note placement="foot">Or “strong men”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all of her killings. <l eID="gen12389" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6389"/><l level="1" sID="gen12390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6389"/>The ways of Sheol<note placement="foot">A term for the place where the dead reside, i.e., the Underworld</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> her house,<l eID="gen12390" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12391"/>descending to chambers of death. <l eID="gen12391" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12383"/> <chapter eID="Prov.7"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6390"/><title type="x-s">Wisdom Calls</title> <div sID="gen12392" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen12392" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen12393"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6390"/>Does not wisdom call,<l eID="gen12394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12395"/>and understanding raise its voice? <l eID="gen12395" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6391"/><l level="1" sID="gen12396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6391"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Atop the heights⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At a head of the heights”</note> beside the road,<l eID="gen12396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12397"/>at the crossroads she stands. <l eID="gen12397" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6392"/><l level="1" sID="gen12398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6392"/>Beside gates, before towns,<l eID="gen12398" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12399"/><transChange type="added">at the</transChange> entrance of doors, she cries out: <l eID="gen12399" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6393"/><l level="1" sID="gen12400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6393"/>“To you, O <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “men”</note> I call,<l eID="gen12400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12401"/>and my cry is to the children of humankind. <l eID="gen12401" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6394"/><l level="1" sID="gen12402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6394"/>Learn prudence, O simple ones;<l eID="gen12402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12403"/>fools, learn <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞intelligence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> <l eID="gen12403" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6395"/><l level="1" sID="gen12404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6395"/>Listen! For noble things I will speak,<l eID="gen12404" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12405"/>and upright things from the opening of my lips. <l eID="gen12405" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6396"/><l level="1" sID="gen12406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6396"/>My mouth will utter truth,<l eID="gen12406" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12407"/>and wickedness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an abomination to my lips. <l eID="gen12407" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6397"/><l level="1" sID="gen12408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6397"/>All sayings of my mouth <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in righteousness;<l eID="gen12408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12409"/>none of them are twisted and crooked. <l eID="gen12409" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6398"/><l level="1" sID="gen12410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6398"/>All of them are straight to him who understands,<l eID="gen12410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12411"/>and upright to those who find knowledge. <l eID="gen12411" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6399"/><l level="1" sID="gen12412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6399"/>Take my teaching and not silver;<l eID="gen12412" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12413"/>may you choose knowledge rather than choice gold. <l eID="gen12413" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6400"/><l level="1" sID="gen12414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6400"/>For wisdom is better than jewels,<l eID="gen12414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12415"/>and all desires shall not compare with her. <l eID="gen12415" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6401"/><l level="1" sID="gen12416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6401"/>I, wisdom, live with prudence,<l eID="gen12416" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12417"/>and I find knowledge and discretion. <l eID="gen12417" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6402"/><l level="1" sID="gen12418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6402"/>The fear of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> hatred of evil,<l eID="gen12418" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12419"/>pride, and arrogance and an evil way.<l eID="gen12419" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12420"/>And I hate a mouth of perversity. <l eID="gen12420" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6403"/><l level="1" sID="gen12421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6403"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Advice and sound judgment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To/for me are advice and sound judgment”</note> are mine;<l eID="gen12421" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12422"/>I am understanding, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞strength is mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to/for me is strength”</note> <l eID="gen12422" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6404"/><l level="1" sID="gen12423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6404"/>By me kings reign,<l eID="gen12423" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12424"/>and rulers decree righteousness. <l eID="gen12424" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6405"/><l level="1" sID="gen12425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6405"/>By me rulers rule,<l eID="gen12425" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12426"/>and nobles—all judges of righteousness. <l eID="gen12426" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6406"/><l level="1" sID="gen12427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6406"/>I love <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who love me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “her lovers”</note><l eID="gen12427" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12428"/>and those who seek me diligently shall find me. <l eID="gen12428" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6407"/><l level="1" sID="gen12429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6407"/>Fortune and glory <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with me,<l eID="gen12429" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12430"/>enduring wealth and righteousness. <l eID="gen12430" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6408"/><l level="1" sID="gen12431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6408"/>My fruit is better than gold,<note placement="foot">Literally “fine gold”</note> even refined gold,<l eID="gen12431" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12432"/>and my yield than choice silver. <l eID="gen12432" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6409"/><l level="1" sID="gen12433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6409"/>In the way of righteousness I walk,<l eID="gen12433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12434"/>in the midst of paths of justice, <l eID="gen12434" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6410"/><l level="1" sID="gen12435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6410"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to endow those who love me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> wealth,<l eID="gen12435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12436"/>and I will fill their treasuries.<l eID="gen12436" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12393"/> <title type="x-s">Wisdom at Creation</title> <div sID="gen12437" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12437" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6411"/><lg sID="gen12438"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6411"/>“Yahweh possessed<note placement="foot">Or “gained,” or “acquired”</note> me, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first of his ways,<l eID="gen12439" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12440"/>before his acts <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from before” or “from then”</note> <l eID="gen12440" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6412"/><l level="1" sID="gen12441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6412"/>From eternity, I was set up from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first,<l eID="gen12441" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12442"/>from the beginning<note placement="foot">Hebrew “beginnings”</note> of the earth. <l eID="gen12442" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6413"/><l level="1" sID="gen12443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6413"/>When there were no depths, I was brought forth,<l eID="gen12443" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12444"/>when there were no springs of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞abounding⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “made heavy”</note> water. <l eID="gen12444" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6414"/><l level="1" sID="gen12445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6414"/>Before mountains had been shaped,<l eID="gen12445" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12446"/>before hills, I was brought forth. <l eID="gen12446" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6415"/><l level="1" sID="gen12447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6415"/>When he had not yet made earth and fields,<l eID="gen12447" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12448"/>or the first dust of the world, <l eID="gen12448" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6416"/><l level="1" sID="gen12449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6416"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he established⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his establishing”</note> the heavens, there I <transChange type="added">was</transChange>,<l eID="gen12449" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12450"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he drew⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his drawing”</note> a circle upon the face of the deep, <l eID="gen12450" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6417"/><l level="1" sID="gen12451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6417"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his making”</note> skies from above,<l eID="gen12451" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12452"/>when he founded fountains of the deep, <l eID="gen12452" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6418"/><l level="1" sID="gen12453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6418"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he assigned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his assigning”</note> his limits to the sea,<l eID="gen12453" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12454"/>that waters shall not transgress his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞command⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “mouth”</note><l eID="gen12454" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12455"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he marked⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his marking”</note> the foundations of the earth, <l eID="gen12455" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6419"/><l level="1" sID="gen12456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6419"/>I was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at the place of”</note> him, a master workman,<l eID="gen12456" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12457"/>and I was delighting day by day,<l eID="gen12457" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12458"/>rejoicing before him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞always⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in all of time”</note> <l eID="gen12458" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6420"/><l level="1" sID="gen12459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6420"/>rejoicing in the world of his earth,<l eID="gen12459" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12460"/>and my delight <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with the children of humankind.<l eID="gen12460" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12438"/> <title type="x-s">Benefits of Following Wisdom</title> <div sID="gen12461" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12461" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6421"/><lg sID="gen12462"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6421"/>“And now, children, listen to me;<l eID="gen12463" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12464"/>happy <transChange type="added">are</transChange> those who will keep my ways. <l eID="gen12464" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6422"/><l level="1" sID="gen12465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6422"/>Hear teaching and be wise;<l eID="gen12465" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12466"/>do not neglect <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <l eID="gen12466" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6423"/><l level="1" sID="gen12467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6423"/>Happy <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> person who listens to me,<l eID="gen12467" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12468"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to keep watch at my doors day by day,<l eID="gen12468" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12469"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to guard the frames of my entrances. <l eID="gen12469" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6424"/><l level="1" sID="gen12470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6424"/>For he who finds me <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he who finds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “those who find”</note> life,<l eID="gen12470" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12471"/>and he obtains favor from Yahweh. <l eID="gen12471" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6425"/><l level="1" sID="gen12472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6425"/>But he who misses me injures himself.<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen12472" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12473"/>All those who hate me love death.” <l eID="gen12473" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12462"/> <chapter eID="Prov.8"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6426"/><title type="x-s">Wisdom’s Banquet</title> <div sID="gen12474" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen12474" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen12475"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6426"/>Wisdom has built her house;<l eID="gen12476" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12477"/>she has hewn her seven pillars. <l eID="gen12477" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6427"/><l level="1" sID="gen12478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6427"/>She has slaughtered her slaughtering, mixed her wine,<l eID="gen12478" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12479"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> also set her table. <l eID="gen12479" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6428"/><l level="1" sID="gen12480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6428"/>She has sent her servant girls,<note placement="foot">Or “young maidens”</note> she calls<l eID="gen12480" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12481"/>upon the wings of the high places of town, <l eID="gen12481" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6429"/><l level="1" sID="gen12482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6429"/>“Whoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> simple, let him turn here.”<l eID="gen12482" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12483"/>As for the one who lacks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> she says to him, <l eID="gen12483" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6430"/><l level="1" sID="gen12484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6430"/>“Come, eat with my bread;<l eID="gen12484" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12485"/>drink with the wine I have mixed. <l eID="gen12485" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6431"/><l level="1" sID="gen12486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6431"/>Lay aside simplicity and live;<l eID="gen12486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12487"/>walk in the way of understanding.” <l eID="gen12487" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6432"/><l level="1" sID="gen12488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6432"/>He who corrects a scoffer gains abuse for himself,<l eID="gen12488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12489"/>and he who rebukes the wicked <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞gets hurt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “abuse him”</note> <l eID="gen12489" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6433"/><l level="1" sID="gen12490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6433"/>Do not rebuke a scoffer, lest he hate you;<l eID="gen12490" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12491"/>rebuke the wise and he will love you. <l eID="gen12491" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6434"/><l level="1" sID="gen12492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6434"/>Give to a wise one and he will become more wise;<l eID="gen12492" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12493"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞teach⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “make known to”</note> a righteous one and he will increase learning.<l eID="gen12493" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen12475"/> <title type="x-s">Foolishness’ Banquet</title> <div sID="gen12494" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen12494" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6435"/><lg sID="gen12495"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6435"/>The start of wisdom is fear of Yahweh,<l eID="gen12496" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12497"/>and knowledge of the Holy One,<note placement="foot">Or “holy ones”</note> insight. <l eID="gen12497" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6436"/><l level="1" sID="gen12498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6436"/>For by me your days shall increase,<l eID="gen12498" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12499"/>and years of life shall multiply for you. <l eID="gen12499" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6437"/><l level="1" sID="gen12500"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6437"/>If you are wise, you are wise for yourself,<l eID="gen12500" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12501"/>and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> you scoff, alone you shall bear <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <l eID="gen12501" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6438"/><l level="1" sID="gen12502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6438"/>A woman of foolishness is loud,<l eID="gen12502" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12503"/>simple, and does not know <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “what”</note> <l eID="gen12503" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6439"/><l level="1" sID="gen12504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6439"/>She sits at the door of her house,<l eID="gen12504" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12505"/>upon a throne <transChange type="added">at the</transChange> high places of town, <l eID="gen12505" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6440"/><l level="1" sID="gen12506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6440"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to call to those who pass by the road,<l eID="gen12506" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12507"/>those who go straight <transChange type="added">on</transChange> their way: <l eID="gen12507" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6441"/><l level="1" sID="gen12508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6441"/>“Whoever is simple, may he turn here!”<l eID="gen12508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12509"/>As for he who lacks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> she says to him, <l eID="gen12509" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6442"/><l level="1" sID="gen12510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6442"/>“Stolen waters are sweet,<l eID="gen12510" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12511"/>and bread of secrecy is pleasant.” <l eID="gen12511" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6443"/><l level="1" sID="gen12512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6443"/>But he does not know that the dead<note placement="foot">Or “Rephaim”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> there,<l eID="gen12512" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12513"/>in the depths of Sheol<note placement="foot">A term for the place where the dead reside, i.e., the Underworld</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> her guests. <l eID="gen12513" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12495"/> <chapter eID="Prov.9"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6444"/><title type="x-s">Proverbs of Solomon</title> <div sID="gen12514" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen12514" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen12515"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6444"/>The proverbs of Solomon:<l eID="gen12516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12517"/>A wise child makes a father glad,<l eID="gen12517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12518"/>but a foolish child grieves his mother. <l eID="gen12518" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6445"/><l level="1" sID="gen12519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6445"/>Treasures of wickedness do not profit,<l eID="gen12519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12520"/>but righteousness delivers from death. <l eID="gen12520" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6446"/><l level="1" sID="gen12521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6446"/>Yahweh will not cause a righteous person<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> to go hungry,<l eID="gen12521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12522"/>but the craving of the wicked he will thwart. <l eID="gen12522" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6447"/><l level="1" sID="gen12523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6447"/>A slack hand causes poverty,<l eID="gen12523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12524"/>but the hand of the diligent enriches. <l eID="gen12524" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6448"/><l level="1" sID="gen12525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6448"/>He who gathers in the summer <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a child who is prudent;<l eID="gen12525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12526"/>he who sleeps at the harvest <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a child who brings shame. <l eID="gen12526" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6449"/><l level="1" sID="gen12527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6449"/>Blessings <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> to the head of the righteous,<l eID="gen12527" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12528"/>but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence. <l eID="gen12528" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6450"/><l level="1" sID="gen12529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6450"/>The memory of righteousness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a blessing,<l eID="gen12529" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12530"/>but the name of the wicked will rot. <l eID="gen12530" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6451"/><l level="1" sID="gen12531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6451"/>A heart of wisdom will heed commandments,<l eID="gen12531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12532"/>but a babbling fool will come to ruin. <l eID="gen12532" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6452"/><l level="1" sID="gen12533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6452"/>Whoever walks in integrity<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in the integrity”</note> will walk securely,<l eID="gen12533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12534"/>but whoever follows perversity, his ways will be made known. <l eID="gen12534" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6453"/><l level="1" sID="gen12535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6453"/>The winking of an eye causes<note placement="foot">Or “gives, sets up”</note> trouble,<l eID="gen12535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12536"/>and the foolishness of lips comes to ruin. <l eID="gen12536" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6454"/><l level="1" sID="gen12537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6454"/>A fountain of life <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a mouth of righteousness,<l eID="gen12537" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12538"/>and a mouth of wickedness conceals violence. <l eID="gen12538" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6455"/><l level="1" sID="gen12539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6455"/>Hatred stirs up strife,<l eID="gen12539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12540"/>but love covers over all offenses. <l eID="gen12540" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6456"/><l level="1" sID="gen12541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6456"/>On the lips of one who has understanding, wisdom is found,<l eID="gen12541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12542"/>but a rod <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the back of one who lacks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> <l eID="gen12542" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6457"/><l level="1" sID="gen12543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6457"/>Those who are wise lay up knowledge,<l eID="gen12543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12544"/>but <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the mouth of the fool, ruin draws near. <l eID="gen12544" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6458"/><l level="1" sID="gen12545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6458"/>The wealth of the rich <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the city of his strength;<l eID="gen12545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12546"/>the ruin of the poor <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their poverty. <l eID="gen12546" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6459"/><l level="1" sID="gen12547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6459"/>The wage of the righteous <transChange type="added">leads</transChange> to life;<l eID="gen12547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12548"/>the gain of the wicked to sin. <l eID="gen12548" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6460"/><l level="1" sID="gen12549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6460"/><transChange type="added">On</transChange> the path to life is he who guards instruction,<l eID="gen12549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12550"/>but he who rejects rebuke goes astray. <l eID="gen12550" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6461"/><l level="1" sID="gen12551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6461"/>He who conceals hatred <transChange type="added">has</transChange> lips of deceit,<l eID="gen12551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12552"/>and he who utters slander—he is a fool. <l eID="gen12552" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6462"/><l level="1" sID="gen12553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6462"/>In many words, transgression is not lacking,<l eID="gen12553" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12554"/>but he who restrains his lips is prudent. <l eID="gen12554" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6463"/><l level="1" sID="gen12555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6463"/>Choice silver is a tongue of righteousness,<l eID="gen12555" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12556"/>a heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of wickedness is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of little worth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “like a little”</note> <l eID="gen12556" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6464"/><l level="1" sID="gen12557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6464"/>Lips of righteousness feed many,<l eID="gen12557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12558"/>but fools <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞die for lack of sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the lack of heart, they die”</note> <l eID="gen12558" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6465"/><l level="1" sID="gen12559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6465"/>The blessing of Yahweh makes <transChange type="added">one</transChange> rich,<l eID="gen12559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12560"/>and he does not increase sorrow with it. <l eID="gen12560" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6466"/><l level="1" sID="gen12561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6466"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> like a sport for a fool to do wrong,<l eID="gen12561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12562"/>wisdom for a person of understanding. <l eID="gen12562" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6467"/><l level="1" sID="gen12563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6467"/>The dread of the wicked will come upon him,<l eID="gen12563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12564"/>but the desire of the righteous will be granted. <l eID="gen12564" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6468"/><l level="1" sID="gen12565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6468"/>With the passing of the tempest, there is no wickedness,<l eID="gen12565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12566"/>but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous have a foundation forever. <l eID="gen12566" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6469"/><l level="1" sID="gen12567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6469"/>Like vinegar to the tooth and like smoke to the eyes,<l eID="gen12567" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12568"/>thus <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the lazy to one who employs<note placement="foot">Or “sends”</note> him. <l eID="gen12568" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6470"/><l level="1" sID="gen12569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6470"/>The fear of Yahweh adds life,<l eID="gen12569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12570"/>but the years of the wicked are shortened. <l eID="gen12570" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6471"/><l level="1" sID="gen12571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6471"/>The hope of the righteous <transChange type="added">is</transChange> gladness,<l eID="gen12571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12572"/>but the expectation of the wicked comes to nothing. <l eID="gen12572" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6472"/><l level="1" sID="gen12573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6472"/>A stronghold for the upright is the way of Yahweh,<l eID="gen12573" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12574"/>but ruin <transChange type="added">belongs</transChange> to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞evildoers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “them who do evil”</note> <l eID="gen12574" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6473"/><l level="1" sID="gen12575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6473"/>The righteous one is forever; he will not be removed.<l eID="gen12575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12576"/>But the wicked will not remain in the land.<note placement="foot">Or “earth”</note> <l eID="gen12576" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6474"/><l level="1" sID="gen12577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6474"/>The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom,<l eID="gen12577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12578"/>but a tongue of perversity will be cut off. <l eID="gen12578" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6475"/><l level="1" sID="gen12579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6475"/>The lips of the righteous know <transChange type="added">the</transChange> acceptable,<l eID="gen12579" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12580"/>but the mouth of the wicked, the perverse. <l eID="gen12580" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12515"/> <chapter eID="Prov.10"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:1
verses.text: Balances of deceit <transChange type="added">are</transChange> an abomination of Yahweh,<l eID="gen12583" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12584"/>but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an accurate weight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a full stone” or “a pure stone”</note> delights him. <l eID="gen12584" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6476"/><l level="1" sID="gen12585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6476"/>Pride comes, then disgrace comes,<l eID="gen12585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12586"/>but wisdom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with the humble. <l eID="gen12586" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6477"/><l level="1" sID="gen12587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6477"/>The integrity of the upright guides them,<l eID="gen12587" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12588"/>but the crookedness of the treacherous destroys them. <l eID="gen12588" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6478"/><l level="1" sID="gen12589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6478"/>Wealth does not profit on the day of wrath,<l eID="gen12589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12590"/>but righteousness will deliver from death. <l eID="gen12590" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6479"/><l level="1" sID="gen12591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6479"/>The righteousness of the blameless will keep his ways straight,<l eID="gen12591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12592"/>but the wicked will fall by his wickedness. <l eID="gen12592" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6480"/><l level="1" sID="gen12593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6480"/>The righteousness of the upright will save them,<l eID="gen12593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12594"/>but by a scheme the treacherous will be taken captive. <l eID="gen12594" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6481"/><l level="1" sID="gen12595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6481"/>With the death of a wicked person, hope will die,<l eID="gen12595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12596"/>and the expectation of the godless perishes. <l eID="gen12596" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6482"/><l level="1" sID="gen12597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6482"/>The righteous is delivered from trouble,<l eID="gen12597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12598"/>but the wicked enters into it. <l eID="gen12598" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6483"/><l level="1" sID="gen12599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6483"/>With a mouth, the godless shall destroy his neighbor,<l eID="gen12599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12600"/>but by knowledge the righteous are delivered. <l eID="gen12600" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6484"/><l level="1" sID="gen12601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6484"/>When good <transChange type="added">is with</transChange> the righteous, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city rejoices,<l eID="gen12601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12602"/>and with the perishing of the wicked, jubilation. <l eID="gen12602" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6485"/><l level="1" sID="gen12603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6485"/>By the blessing of the upright, a city will be exalted,<l eID="gen12603" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12604"/>but by the mouth of the wicked, it will be overthrown. <l eID="gen12604" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6486"/><l level="1" sID="gen12605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6486"/>He who lacks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> belittles his neighbor,<l eID="gen12605" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12606"/>but a person of intelligence will remain silent. <l eID="gen12606" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6487"/><l level="1" sID="gen12607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6487"/>A gossip walks <transChange type="added">about</transChange> telling a secret,<l eID="gen12607" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12608"/>but the trustworthy in spirit keeps <transChange type="added">the</transChange> matter. <l eID="gen12608" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6488"/><l level="1" sID="gen12609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6488"/>Where there is no guidance, a nation<note placement="foot">Or “people”</note> shall fall,<l eID="gen12609" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12610"/>but <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> safety in an abundance of counsel. <l eID="gen12610" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6489"/><l level="1" sID="gen12611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6489"/>He will suffer trouble when he loans to a stranger,<l eID="gen12611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12612"/>but he who refuses a pledge is safe. <l eID="gen12612" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6490"/><l level="1" sID="gen12613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6490"/>A woman of grace receives honor,<l eID="gen12613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12614"/>but the ruthless gets wealth. <l eID="gen12614" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6491"/><l level="1" sID="gen12615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6491"/>A person of kindness rewards himself,<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen12615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12616"/>but a cruel <transChange type="added">person</transChange> harms his own flesh. <l eID="gen12616" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6492"/><l level="1" sID="gen12617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6492"/>The wicked earns<note placement="foot">Or “does, makes”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deceptive gain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “gain of deception”</note><l eID="gen12617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12618"/>but he who sows righteousness, a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞true reward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a reward of truth”</note> <l eID="gen12618" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6493"/><l level="1" sID="gen12619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6493"/>He who is steadfast in righteousness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to life<l eID="gen12619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12620"/>as<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> he who pursues evil <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to death. <l eID="gen12620" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6494"/><l level="1" sID="gen12621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6494"/>An abomination of Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞crooked of heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “crooked ones of heart”; “heart” may also be translated “mind”</note><l eID="gen12621" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12622"/>but his delight <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those with blameless ways⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “blameless ones of ways”</note> <l eID="gen12622" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6495"/><l level="1" sID="gen12623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6495"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Rest assured⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Hand to hand”</note> the wicked will not go unpunished,<l eID="gen12623" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12624"/>but the offspring<note placement="foot">Or “seed”</note> of the righteous will escape. <l eID="gen12624" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6496"/><l level="1" sID="gen12625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6496"/>A ring of gold in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> snout of a pig<l eID="gen12625" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12626"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> a woman <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> beautiful but without discretion. <l eID="gen12626" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6497"/><l level="1" sID="gen12627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6497"/>The desire of the righteous <transChange type="added">is</transChange> only good,<l eID="gen12627" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12628"/>but the expectation of the wicked, wrath. <l eID="gen12628" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6498"/><l level="1" sID="gen12629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6498"/>There is one who gives yet <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞grows richer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “adding more”</note><l eID="gen12629" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12630"/>but he who withholds <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what is right⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from what is right”</note> only <transChange type="added">finds</transChange> need. <l eID="gen12630" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6499"/><l level="1" sID="gen12631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6499"/>A person of blessing will be enriched,<l eID="gen12631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12632"/>and he who gives water also will be refreshed. <l eID="gen12632" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6500"/><l level="1" sID="gen12633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6500"/>He who withholds grain, the people curse him,<l eID="gen12633" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12634"/>but a blessing <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the head of him who sells. <l eID="gen12634" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6501"/><l level="1" sID="gen12635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6501"/>He who diligently seeks good seeks favor,<l eID="gen12635" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12636"/>but he who inquires of evil, it will come to him. <l eID="gen12636" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6502"/><l level="1" sID="gen12637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6502"/>He who trusts in his wealth <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he who will fall,<l eID="gen12637" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12638"/>but like a green leaf the righteous will flourish. <l eID="gen12638" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6503"/><l level="1" sID="gen12639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6503"/>He who brings trouble <transChange type="added">to</transChange> his household, he will inherit wind,<note placement="foot">Or “breath, spirit”</note><l eID="gen12639" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12640"/>and a fool will serve the wise of heart. <l eID="gen12640" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6504"/><l level="1" sID="gen12641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6504"/>The fruit of righteousness is a tree of life,<l eID="gen12641" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12642"/>and he who captures souls<note placement="foot">Or “persons,” or “inner selves”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wise. <l eID="gen12642" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6505"/><l level="1" sID="gen12643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6505"/>If the righteous on earth will be repaid,<l eID="gen12643" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12644"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how much more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “more for”</note> the wicked and sinner. <l eID="gen12644" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12582"/> <chapter eID="Prov.11"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:1
verses.text: He who loves discipline loves knowledge,<l eID="gen12647" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12648"/>but he who hates rebuke <transChange type="added">is</transChange> stupid. <l eID="gen12648" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6506"/><l level="1" sID="gen12649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6506"/>The good obtains favor from Yahweh,<l eID="gen12649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12650"/>but anyone who schemes, he condemns. <l eID="gen12650" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6507"/><l level="1" sID="gen12651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6507"/>A person will not be established by wickedness,<l eID="gen12651" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12652"/>but the root of the righteous will not be moved. <l eID="gen12652" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6508"/><l level="1" sID="gen12653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6508"/>A woman of strength<note placement="foot">Or “honor”</note> is the crown of her master,<note placement="foot">Or “lord, owner”</note><l eID="gen12653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12654"/>but like rot in his bones is she who brings shame. <l eID="gen12654" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6509"/><l level="1" sID="gen12655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6509"/>The thoughts of the righteous are<note placement="foot">Hebrew “is”</note> just;<l eID="gen12655" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12656"/>the advice of the wicked is treacherous. <l eID="gen12656" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6510"/><l level="1" sID="gen12657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6510"/>The words of the wicked <transChange type="added">are</transChange> an ambush of blood,<l eID="gen12657" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12658"/>but the mouth of the upright delivers them. <l eID="gen12658" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6511"/><l level="1" sID="gen12659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6511"/>The wicked are overthrown and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are no more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “there is no them”</note><l eID="gen12659" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12660"/>but the house of the righteous shall stand. <l eID="gen12660" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6512"/><l level="1" sID="gen12661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6512"/>For his mouth of good sense, a man will be recommended,<l eID="gen12661" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12662"/>but he who is of perverse <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> will be despised. <l eID="gen12662" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6513"/><l level="1" sID="gen12663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6513"/>It is better to be lowly and a servant <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to someone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for him,” “belonging to him”</note><l eID="gen12663" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12664"/>than self-glorifying and lacking food. <l eID="gen12664" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6514"/><l level="1" sID="gen12665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6514"/>The righteous knows the life<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> of his animal,<l eID="gen12665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12666"/>but the compassion<note placement="foot">Hebrew “compassions”</note> of the wicked is cruel. <l eID="gen12666" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6515"/><l level="1" sID="gen12667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6515"/>He who works his land will have plenty of food,<l eID="gen12667" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12668"/>but he who follows worthless things lacks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> <l eID="gen12668" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6516"/><l level="1" sID="gen12669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6516"/>The wicked covets the proceeds of evil,<l eID="gen12669" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12670"/>but the root of the righteous <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bears fruit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “gives, sets up”</note> <l eID="gen12670" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6517"/><l level="1" sID="gen12671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6517"/>By the transgression of lips, evil is ensnared,<l eID="gen12671" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12672"/>but the righteous escapes from trouble. <l eID="gen12672" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6518"/><l level="1" sID="gen12673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6518"/>From the fruit of the mouth of a man, he is filled with good,<l eID="gen12673" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12674"/>and the reward of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a man’s labor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the hands of a man”</note> will return to him. <l eID="gen12674" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6519"/><l level="1" sID="gen12675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6519"/>The way of a fool is upright in his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> eyes,<l eID="gen12675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12676"/>but he who listens to advice <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wise. <l eID="gen12676" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6520"/><l level="1" sID="gen12677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6520"/>As for a fool, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on that very day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the day”</note> he makes his anger known,<l eID="gen12677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12678"/>but he who ignores an insult <transChange type="added">is</transChange> prudent. <l eID="gen12678" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6521"/><l level="1" sID="gen12679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6521"/>He who will speak truth will reveal righteousness,<l eID="gen12679" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12680"/>but the witness of falsehood, deceit. <l eID="gen12680" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6522"/><l level="1" sID="gen12681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6522"/>There is one who speaks rashly, like the thrust of a sword,<l eID="gen12681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12682"/>but the tongue of the wise brings healing. <l eID="gen12682" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6523"/><l level="1" sID="gen12683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6523"/>A lip of truth endures forever,<l eID="gen12683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12684"/>but a tongue of deception lasts only a moment. <l eID="gen12684" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6524"/><l level="1" sID="gen12685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6524"/>Deceit <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who plan⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the planners of”</note> evil,<l eID="gen12685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12686"/>but to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who plan⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the planners of”</note> peace, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> joy. <l eID="gen12686" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6525"/><l level="1" sID="gen12687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6525"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞No evil will happen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All evil will not happen”</note> to the righteous,<l eID="gen12687" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12688"/>but the wicked are filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> trouble. <l eID="gen12688" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6526"/><l level="1" sID="gen12689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6526"/>An abomination of Yahweh are lips of deceit,<l eID="gen12689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12690"/>but they who act faithfully <transChange type="added">are</transChange> his delight. <l eID="gen12690" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6527"/><l level="1" sID="gen12691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6527"/>A clever person conceals knowledge,<l eID="gen12691" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12692"/>but the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of a fool<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fools”</note> announces folly. <l eID="gen12692" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6528"/><l level="1" sID="gen12693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6528"/>The hand of the diligent ones will rule,<l eID="gen12693" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12694"/>but the lazy will belong to forced labor. <l eID="gen12694" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6529"/><l level="1" sID="gen12695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6529"/>Anxiety in the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of a man will weigh him down,<l eID="gen12695" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12696"/>but a good word will cheer him. <l eID="gen12696" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6530"/><l level="1" sID="gen12697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6530"/>A righteous person will seek out his neighbor,<l eID="gen12697" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12698"/>but the way of the wicked will lead them astray. <l eID="gen12698" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6531"/><l level="1" sID="gen12699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6531"/>The lazy will not roast his game,<l eID="gen12699" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12700"/>but diligence is the precious wealth of a man. <l eID="gen12700" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6532"/><l level="1" sID="gen12701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6532"/>On the road of righteousness is life,<l eID="gen12701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12702"/>and <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the way of the path, <transChange type="added">may there be</transChange> no death. <l eID="gen12702" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12646"/> <chapter eID="Prov.12"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:1
verses.text: A wise child <transChange type="added">hears</transChange> the discipline of a father,<l eID="gen12705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12706"/>but a scoffer does not listen to a rebuke. <l eID="gen12706" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6533"/><l level="1" sID="gen12707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6533"/>From the fruit of the mouth of a man, he shall eat what is good,<l eID="gen12707" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12708"/>but the desire<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> of the treacherous, wrongdoing. <l eID="gen12708" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6534"/><l level="1" sID="gen12709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6534"/>He who keeps his mouth guards his life;<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen12709" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12710"/>he who opens his lips, ruin <transChange type="added">belongs</transChange> to him. <l eID="gen12710" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6535"/><l level="1" sID="gen12711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6535"/>The soul<note placement="foot">Or “life”</note> of the lazy craves, but there is nothing,<l eID="gen12711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12712"/>but the person of diligence is richly supplied. <l eID="gen12712" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6536"/><l level="1" sID="gen12713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6536"/>The righteous hates a word of falsehood;<l eID="gen12713" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12714"/>the wicked will bring shame and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞disgrace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he will bring disgrace”</note> <l eID="gen12714" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6537"/><l level="1" sID="gen12715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6537"/>Righteousness will guard the upright of way,<l eID="gen12715" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12716"/>but wickedness will overthrow sin. <l eID="gen12716" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6538"/><l level="1" sID="gen12717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6538"/>There is one who acts rich but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞has nothing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “there is no”</note><l eID="gen12717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12718"/>another who pretends to be poor but <transChange type="added">has</transChange> wealth. <l eID="gen12718" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6539"/><l level="1" sID="gen12719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6539"/>The ransom of the life of a man <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his wealth,<l eID="gen12719" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12720"/>but the poor does not receive a threat. <l eID="gen12720" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6540"/><l level="1" sID="gen12721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6540"/>The light of the righteous will rejoice,<l eID="gen12721" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12722"/>but the lamp of the wicked will die out. <l eID="gen12722" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6541"/><l level="1" sID="gen12723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6541"/>Only by insolence is strife set up,<l eID="gen12723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12724"/>and wisdom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with those who take advice. <l eID="gen12724" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6542"/><l level="1" sID="gen12725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6542"/>Wealth <transChange type="added">gained</transChange> from haste<note placement="foot">Or “vanity”</note> will dwindle,<l eID="gen12725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12726"/>but he who gathers <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞little by little⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “upon the hand”</note> will increase it. <l eID="gen12726" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6543"/><l level="1" sID="gen12727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6543"/>Hope that is deferred makes the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> sick,<l eID="gen12727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12728"/>but a desire fulfilled <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a tree of life. <l eID="gen12728" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6544"/><l level="1" sID="gen12729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6544"/>He who despises a word will bring destruction on himself,<l eID="gen12729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12730"/>but he who respects a commandment will be rewarded. <l eID="gen12730" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6545"/><l level="1" sID="gen12731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6545"/>The teaching of the wise <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a fountain of life,<l eID="gen12731" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12732"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to avoid the snares of death. <l eID="gen12732" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6546"/><l level="1" sID="gen12733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6546"/>Good sense grants favor,<l eID="gen12733" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12734"/>but the way of the faithless is coarse. <l eID="gen12734" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6547"/><l level="1" sID="gen12735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6547"/>Anyone who is clever will act with intelligence,<l eID="gen12735" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12736"/>but the fool will display folly. <l eID="gen12736" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6548"/><l level="1" sID="gen12737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6548"/>A messenger of wickedness will fall into trouble,<l eID="gen12737" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12738"/>but an envoy of the faithful <transChange type="added">brings</transChange> healing. <l eID="gen12738" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6549"/><l level="1" sID="gen12739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6549"/>Poverty and disgrace <transChange type="added">belong to</transChange> him who ignores instruction,<l eID="gen12739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12740"/>but he who guards reproof will be honored. <l eID="gen12740" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6550"/><l level="1" sID="gen12741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6550"/>A desire <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fulfilled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “made to be,” “brought about”</note> will be sweet to the soul,<l eID="gen12741" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12742"/>but an abomination of fools is turning from evil. <l eID="gen12742" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6551"/><l level="1" sID="gen12743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6551"/>Walk with the wise and be wise,<l eID="gen12743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12744"/>but as for the companion of fools, he will suffer harm. <l eID="gen12744" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6552"/><l level="1" sID="gen12745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6552"/>Misfortune will pursue sinners,<l eID="gen12745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12746"/>but the righteous <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will be rewarded with prosperity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it will reward prosperity”</note> <l eID="gen12746" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6553"/><l level="1" sID="gen12747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6553"/>He who is good will leave an inheritance to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his grandchildren⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of sons”</note><l eID="gen12747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12748"/>and stored up for the righteous <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the wealth of a sinner. <l eID="gen12748" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6554"/><l level="1" sID="gen12749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6554"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> much food <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the field of the poor,<l eID="gen12749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12750"/>but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is swept away⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there is sweeping away”</note> by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞injustice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “no justice”</note> <l eID="gen12750" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6555"/><l level="1" sID="gen12751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6555"/>He who withholds his rod hates his child,<l eID="gen12751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12752"/>but he who loves him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞gives him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “visits him”</note> discipline. <l eID="gen12752" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6556"/><l level="1" sID="gen12753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6556"/>The righteous eats to satisfy his life,<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen12753" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12754"/>but the belly of the wicked will lack. <l eID="gen12754" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12704"/> <chapter eID="Prov.13"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:1
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wisest of women⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wise ones of women”</note> builds her house,<l eID="gen12757" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12758"/>but the foolish tears it down with her hands. <l eID="gen12758" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6557"/><l level="1" sID="gen12759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6557"/>He who walks in uprightness fears Yahweh,<l eID="gen12759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12760"/>but he who is devious <transChange type="added">in</transChange> his ways displeases him. <l eID="gen12760" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6558"/><l level="1" sID="gen12761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6558"/>In the mouth of a fool is the rod of pride,<l eID="gen12761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12762"/>but the lips of the wise preserve them. <l eID="gen12762" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6559"/><l level="1" sID="gen12763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6559"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When there are no⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In there is no”</note> oxen the manger is empty,<l eID="gen12763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12764"/>but an abundance of crops <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> by the strength of an ox.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bull”</note> <l eID="gen12764" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6560"/><l level="1" sID="gen12765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6560"/>A faithful witness does not lie,<l eID="gen12765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12766"/>but he who breathes out falsehood is a witness of deceit. <l eID="gen12766" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6561"/><l level="1" sID="gen12767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6561"/>A scoffer seeks wisdom, but there is none,<l eID="gen12767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12768"/>but knowledge <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞comes easily to him who understands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to one who understands it comes easy”</note> <l eID="gen12768" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:7
