verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6562"/><l level="1" sID="gen12769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6562"/>Leave <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the presence of a foolish man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the presence belonging to a man of foolishness”</note><l eID="gen12769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12770"/><transChange type="added">for</transChange> you will not <transChange type="added">come to</transChange> know <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞words of knowledge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “lips of knowledge”</note> <l eID="gen12770" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6563"/><l level="1" sID="gen12771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6563"/>The wisdom of the clever is understanding his ways,<l eID="gen12771" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12772"/>but the folly of fools is deceit. <l eID="gen12772" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6564"/><l level="1" sID="gen12773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6564"/>Fools mock<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he mocks”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guilt offering,<l eID="gen12773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12774"/>but among the upright, it is favorable. <l eID="gen12774" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6565"/><l level="1" sID="gen12775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6565"/>The heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> knows the bitterness of its soul,<note placement="foot">Or “life,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen12775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12776"/>but in its joy, it will not share itself with a stranger. <l eID="gen12776" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6566"/><l level="1" sID="gen12777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6566"/>The house of the wicked will be destroyed,<l eID="gen12777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12778"/>but the tent of the upright will flourish. <l eID="gen12778" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6567"/><l level="1" sID="gen12779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6567"/>There is a way <transChange type="added">that seems</transChange> upright <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> a man,<l eID="gen12779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12780"/>but its end <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the way of death. <l eID="gen12780" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6568"/><l level="1" sID="gen12781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6568"/>Even in laughter, a heart may be sad,<l eID="gen12781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12782"/>and the end of joy <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> grief. <l eID="gen12782" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6569"/><l level="1" sID="gen12783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6569"/>From his ways, the perverse of heart will be satisfied,<l eID="gen12783" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12784"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from his own⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from upon him”</note> <transChange type="added">so shall</transChange> a good man. <l eID="gen12784" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6570"/><l level="1" sID="gen12785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6570"/>The simple will believe every word,<l eID="gen12785" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12786"/>but the clever will consider his step. <l eID="gen12786" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6571"/><l level="1" sID="gen12787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6571"/>The wise is cautious and turns from evil,<l eID="gen12787" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12788"/>but the fool throws off restraint and is confident. <l eID="gen12788" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6572"/><l level="1" sID="gen12789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6572"/>He who is short of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞temper⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “nostril”</note> will act foolishly,<l eID="gen12789" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12790"/>and the man who schemes will be hated. <l eID="gen12790" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6573"/><l level="1" sID="gen12791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6573"/>The simple are adorned <transChange type="added">with</transChange> folly,<l eID="gen12791" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12792"/>but the clever are crowned with knowledge. <l eID="gen12792" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6574"/><l level="1" sID="gen12793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6574"/>The evil bow down before the good,<l eID="gen12793" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12794"/>and the wicked at the gates of the righteous. <l eID="gen12794" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6575"/><l level="1" sID="gen12795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6575"/>The poor is disliked even by his neighbor,<l eID="gen12795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12796"/>but the lovers of the rich are many. <l eID="gen12796" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6576"/><l level="1" sID="gen12797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6576"/>He who despises his neighbor is a sinner,<l eID="gen12797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12798"/>but he who has mercy on the poor blesses him. <l eID="gen12798" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6577"/><l level="1" sID="gen12799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6577"/>Have they not erred, those who plan evil?<l eID="gen12799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12800"/>But loyalty and faithfulness <transChange type="added">belong to</transChange> those who plan good. <l eID="gen12800" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6578"/><l level="1" sID="gen12801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6578"/>In all toil, there is profit,<l eID="gen12801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12802"/>but the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞talk⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “word, matter, thing”</note> of lips <transChange type="added">leads</transChange> only to poverty. <l eID="gen12802" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6579"/><l level="1" sID="gen12803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6579"/>The crown of the wise <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their wealth;<l eID="gen12803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12804"/>the folly of fools is folly. <l eID="gen12804" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6580"/><l level="1" sID="gen12805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6580"/>He who saves lives<note placement="foot">Or “souls,” or “inner selves”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a witness of truth,<l eID="gen12805" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12806"/>but he who utters lies <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a betrayer. <l eID="gen12806" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6581"/><l level="1" sID="gen12807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6581"/>In the fear of Yahweh, there is confidence of strength,<l eID="gen12807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12808"/>and for his children, there will be refuge. <l eID="gen12808" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6582"/><l level="1" sID="gen12809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6582"/>The fear of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a fountain of life,<l eID="gen12809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12810"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to turn from the snares of death. <l eID="gen12810" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6583"/><l level="1" sID="gen12811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6583"/>In the multitude of people is the glory of the king,<l eID="gen12811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12812"/>but without a population, a prince <transChange type="added">is</transChange> ruined. <l eID="gen12812" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6584"/><l level="1" sID="gen12813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6584"/><transChange type="added">He who is</transChange> slow to anger <transChange type="added">has</transChange> great understanding,<l eID="gen12813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12814"/>but the hasty of spirit<note placement="foot">Or “breath”</note> exalts folly. <l eID="gen12814" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6585"/><l level="1" sID="gen12815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6585"/>A heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of tranquility<note placement="foot">Or “he who heals”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> life <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> flesh,<l eID="gen12815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12816"/>but causes bones of passion to rot. <l eID="gen12816" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6586"/><l level="1" sID="gen12817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6586"/>He who oppresses the poor insults him who made him,<l eID="gen12817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12818"/>but he who has mercy on the poor honors him. <l eID="gen12818" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6587"/><l level="1" sID="gen12819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6587"/>By his evildoing, the wicked will be overthrown,<l eID="gen12819" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12820"/>and the righteous will find refuge in his death. <l eID="gen12820" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6588"/><l level="1" sID="gen12821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6588"/>In the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of him who has understanding, wisdom rests,<l eID="gen12821" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12822"/>but <transChange type="added">even</transChange> in the midst of fools it becomes known. <l eID="gen12822" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6589"/><l level="1" sID="gen12823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6589"/>Righteousness will exalt a nation,<l eID="gen12823" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12824"/>but sin <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a reproach to a people. <l eID="gen12824" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6590"/><l level="1" sID="gen12825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6590"/>The favor of a king <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the servant who deals wisely,<l eID="gen12825" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12826"/>but his wrath will be <transChange type="added">on</transChange> him who acts shamefully. <l eID="gen12826" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12756"/> <chapter eID="Prov.14"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:1
verses.text: A soft answer will turn away wrath,<l eID="gen12829" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12830"/>but a word of trouble will stir <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “nostril”</note> <l eID="gen12830" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6591"/><l level="1" sID="gen12831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6591"/>The tongue of the wise will dispense knowledge,<l eID="gen12831" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12832"/>but the mouth of fools will pour out folly. <l eID="gen12832" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6592"/><l level="1" sID="gen12833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6592"/>In every place, the eyes of Yahweh<l eID="gen12833" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12834"/>keep watch over the evil and the good. <l eID="gen12834" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6593"/><l level="1" sID="gen12835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6593"/>Gentleness<note placement="foot">Or “Healing”</note> of tongue is a tree of life,<l eID="gen12835" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12836"/>but perverseness in it<note placement="foot">That is, the tongue</note> <transChange type="added">causes</transChange> a break in spirit. <l eID="gen12836" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6594"/><l level="1" sID="gen12837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6594"/>A fool will despise the instruction of his father,<l eID="gen12837" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12838"/>but he who guards reproof is prudent. <l eID="gen12838" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6595"/><l level="1" sID="gen12839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6595"/><transChange type="added">In</transChange> the house of the righteous <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> much treasure,<l eID="gen12839" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12840"/>but the income of the wicked brings trouble. <l eID="gen12840" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6596"/><l level="1" sID="gen12841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6596"/>The lips of the wise will spread knowledge,<l eID="gen12841" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12842"/>but the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of fools, not so. <l eID="gen12842" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6597"/><l level="1" sID="gen12843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6597"/>The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination of Yahweh,<l eID="gen12843" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12844"/>but the prayer of the upright <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his delight. <l eID="gen12844" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6598"/><l level="1" sID="gen12845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6598"/>An abomination of Yahweh is the way of the wicked,<l eID="gen12845" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12846"/>but he who pursues righteousness he will love. <l eID="gen12846" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6599"/><l level="1" sID="gen12847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6599"/>Severe discipline <transChange type="added">belongs</transChange> to him who forsakes the way;<l eID="gen12847" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12848"/>he who hates a rebuke will die. <l eID="gen12848" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6600"/><l level="1" sID="gen12849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6600"/>Sheol<note placement="foot">A term for the place where the dead reside, i.e., the Underworld</note> and Abaddon<note placement="foot">Poetic synonym for “Sheol.” Only mentioned in the <sc>ot</sc> in relation to Sheol, the grave, or death.</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> before Yahweh,<l eID="gen12849" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12850"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how much more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “more for”</note> the hearts of the children of men! <l eID="gen12850" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6601"/><l level="1" sID="gen12851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6601"/>A scoffer does not like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his rebuke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “rebuke belonging to him”</note><l eID="gen12851" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12852"/>to the wise he will not go. <l eID="gen12852" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6602"/><l level="1" sID="gen12853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6602"/>A heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of gladness will make good <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞countenance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “faces”</note><l eID="gen12853" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12854"/>but in sorrow of heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> a spirit is broken. <l eID="gen12854" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6603"/><l level="1" sID="gen12855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6603"/>The heart of him who understands will seek knowledge,<l eID="gen12855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12856"/>but the faces of fools, they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he/it”</note> will feed on folly. <l eID="gen12856" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6604"/><l level="1" sID="gen12857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6604"/>All the days of the poor <transChange type="added">are</transChange> hard,<l eID="gen12857" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12858"/>but goodness of heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a continuous feast. <l eID="gen12858" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6605"/><l level="1" sID="gen12859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6605"/>Better <transChange type="added">is</transChange> little with the fear of Yahweh<l eID="gen12859" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12860"/>than great treasure and trouble with it.<note placement="foot">Or “him”</note> <l eID="gen12860" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6606"/><l level="1" sID="gen12861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6606"/>Better <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a dinner of vegetables when<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> there<l eID="gen12861" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12862"/>than a fattened ox and hatred with it.<note placement="foot">Or “him”</note> <l eID="gen12862" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6607"/><l level="1" sID="gen12863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6607"/>A man who is hot-tempered will stir up strife,<l eID="gen12863" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12864"/>but he who is slow <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “nostrils”</note> he will calm contention. <l eID="gen12864" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6608"/><l level="1" sID="gen12865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6608"/>The way of the lazy is like a hedge of thorns,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thorn”</note><l eID="gen12865" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12866"/>but the path of the upright <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a highway. <l eID="gen12866" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6609"/><l level="1" sID="gen12867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6609"/>A child of wisdom will make a father glad,<l eID="gen12867" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12868"/>but a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foolish person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “foolishness of humankind”</note> he despises his mother. <l eID="gen12868" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6610"/><l level="1" sID="gen12869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6610"/>Folly is a joy to him who lacks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note><l eID="gen12869" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12870"/>and a person of understanding <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will walk upright⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he will walk upright walking”</note> <l eID="gen12870" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6611"/><l level="1" sID="gen12871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6611"/>Plans go wrong when there is no counsel,<l eID="gen12871" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12872"/>but with many advisors it will succeed. <l eID="gen12872" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6612"/><l level="1" sID="gen12873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6612"/>Joy <transChange type="added">belongs</transChange> to a man with answers in his mouth,<l eID="gen12873" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12874"/>and a word in its time, how good <transChange type="added">it is</transChange>! <l eID="gen12874" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6613"/><l level="1" sID="gen12875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6613"/>The path of life <transChange type="added">leads</transChange> upward for him who has insight,<l eID="gen12875" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12876"/>in order to turn away from Sheol below. <l eID="gen12876" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6614"/><l level="1" sID="gen12877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6614"/>The house of the proud, Yahweh will tear <transChange type="added">it</transChange> down,<l eID="gen12877" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12878"/>but he will maintain the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞property line⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “boundary”</note> of the widow. <l eID="gen12878" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6615"/><l level="1" sID="gen12879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6615"/>Plans of evil <transChange type="added">are</transChange> an abomination of Yahweh,<l eID="gen12879" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12880"/>but gracious words are pure. <l eID="gen12880" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6616"/><l level="1" sID="gen12881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6616"/>He who makes trouble for his house <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he who is greedy for unjust gain,<l eID="gen12881" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12882"/>but he who hates bribes will live. <l eID="gen12882" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6617"/><l level="1" sID="gen12883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6617"/>A heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of righteousness will ponder the answer,<l eID="gen12883" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12884"/>but a mouth of wickedness will pour out deceit. <l eID="gen12884" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6618"/><l level="1" sID="gen12885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6618"/>Yahweh is far from the wicked,<l eID="gen12885" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12886"/>but the prayers of the righteous he will hear. <l eID="gen12886" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6619"/><l level="1" sID="gen12887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6619"/>From the light of the eyes, the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> will rejoice,<l eID="gen12887" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12888"/>and good news will enliven the bones.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bone”</note> <l eID="gen12888" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6620"/><l level="1" sID="gen12889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6620"/>The ear of him who listens <transChange type="added">to</transChange> admonitions of life,<l eID="gen12889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12890"/>in the midst of the wise it will lodge. <l eID="gen12890" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6621"/><l level="1" sID="gen12891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6621"/>He who ignores instruction despises himself,<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen12891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12892"/>but he who hears admonition gains heart.<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> <l eID="gen12892" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6622"/><l level="1" sID="gen12893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6622"/>Fear of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the instruction of the wise,<l eID="gen12893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12894"/>and before honor <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> humility. <l eID="gen12894" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12828"/> <chapter eID="Prov.15"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:1
verses.text: To mortals <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> the plans of the heart,<l eID="gen12897" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12898"/>but from Yahweh <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> the answer of the tongue. <l eID="gen12898" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6623"/><l level="1" sID="gen12899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6623"/>All the ways of a man <transChange type="added">are</transChange> pure in his own eyes,<l eID="gen12899" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12900"/>but Yahweh weighs the spirit.<note placement="foot">Or “breath”</note> <l eID="gen12900" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6624"/><l level="1" sID="gen12901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6624"/>Commit your work to Yahweh,<l eID="gen12901" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12902"/>and your plans will be established. <l eID="gen12902" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6625"/><l level="1" sID="gen12903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6625"/>All Yahweh has made <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for his<note placement="foot">Or “its”</note> purpose,<l eID="gen12903" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12904"/>and even the wicked for the day of trouble. <l eID="gen12904" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6626"/><l level="1" sID="gen12905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6626"/>An abomination of Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all who are arrogant of heart;<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note><l eID="gen12905" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12906"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rest assured⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “hand to hand”</note> he will not go unpunished. <l eID="gen12906" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6627"/><l level="1" sID="gen12907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6627"/>By loyalty and faithfulness, iniquity will be covered over,<note placement="foot">Or “atoned for”</note><l eID="gen12907" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12908"/>and by fear of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one turns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “turning”</note> from evil. <l eID="gen12908" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6628"/><l level="1" sID="gen12909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6628"/>When the ways of a man are pleasing <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen12909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12910"/>even his enemies he will cause to make peace with him. <l eID="gen12910" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6629"/><l level="1" sID="gen12911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6629"/>Better is little with righteousness<l eID="gen12911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12912"/>than great income with no justice. <l eID="gen12912" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6630"/><l level="1" sID="gen12913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6630"/>The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> of a person will plan his ways,<l eID="gen12913" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12914"/>and Yahweh will direct his steps. <l eID="gen12914" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6631"/><l level="1" sID="gen12915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6631"/>A decision is upon the lips of a king;<l eID="gen12915" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12916"/>in judgment his mouth will not sin. <l eID="gen12916" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6632"/><l level="1" sID="gen12917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6632"/>A balance and scales of justice <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> to Yahweh;<l eID="gen12917" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12918"/>all the weights of the bag <transChange type="added">are</transChange> his work. <l eID="gen12918" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6633"/><l level="1" sID="gen12919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6633"/>An abomination to kings <transChange type="added">is</transChange> doing evil,<l eID="gen12919" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12920"/>for by righteousness the throne will be established. <l eID="gen12920" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6634"/><l level="1" sID="gen12921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6634"/>The delight of kings <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the lips of righteousness,<l eID="gen12921" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12922"/>and he who speaks what is upright he will love. <l eID="gen12922" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6635"/><l level="1" sID="gen12923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6635"/>The wrath of a king <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a messenger of death,<l eID="gen12923" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12924"/>but one who is wise will appease<note placement="foot">Or “atone, cover over”</note> it. <l eID="gen12924" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6636"/><l level="1" sID="gen12925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6636"/>In the light of the face of the king <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> life,<l eID="gen12925" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12926"/>and his favor <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a cloud of spring rain. <l eID="gen12926" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6637"/><l level="1" sID="gen12927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6637"/>Getting wisdom: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how much⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “what”</note> better than gold!<l eID="gen12927" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12928"/>And getting understanding: it is chosen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞over⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> silver. <l eID="gen12928" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6638"/><l level="1" sID="gen12929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6638"/>The highway of the upright, it turns from evil,<l eID="gen12929" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12930"/>he who guards himself<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> keeps his way. <l eID="gen12930" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6639"/><l level="1" sID="gen12931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6639"/>Before destruction <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> pride,<l eID="gen12931" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12932"/>and before a fall, a haughty spirit.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “a haughty of spirit”</note> <l eID="gen12932" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6640"/><l level="1" sID="gen12933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6640"/>Better a lowly spirit with the poor<l eID="gen12933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12934"/>than dividing the spoil with the proud. <l eID="gen12934" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6641"/><l level="1" sID="gen12935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6641"/>He who is attentive to a matter will find goodness,<l eID="gen12935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12936"/>and he who trusts in Yahweh, his own happiness. <l eID="gen12936" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6642"/><l level="1" sID="gen12937"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6642"/>The wise of heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> is called perceptive,<l eID="gen12937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12938"/>but he who is pleasant of lips will increase persuasiveness. <l eID="gen12938" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6643"/><l level="1" sID="gen12939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6643"/>A fountain of life is wisdom for its owner,<note placement="foot">Or “master”</note><l eID="gen12939" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12940"/>but the instruction<note placement="foot">Or “punishment”</note> of fools is folly. <l eID="gen12940" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6644"/><l level="1" sID="gen12941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6644"/>The heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of the wise will make his mouth judicious,<l eID="gen12941" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12942"/>and upon his lips, it<note placement="foot">Or “he”</note> will add persuasiveness. <l eID="gen12942" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6645"/><l level="1" sID="gen12943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6645"/>Pleasant sayings <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a honeycomb,<l eID="gen12943" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12944"/>sweetness to the soul and healing to the bones. <l eID="gen12944" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6646"/><l level="1" sID="gen12945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6646"/>There is a way <transChange type="added">that seems</transChange> upright <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> a man,<l eID="gen12945" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12946"/>but its end <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the way of death. <l eID="gen12946" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6647"/><l level="1" sID="gen12947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6647"/>The life<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> of a worker works for him,<l eID="gen12947" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12948"/>for his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hunger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth”</note> urges him. <l eID="gen12948" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6648"/><l level="1" sID="gen12949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6648"/>A man of wickedness concocts evil,<l eID="gen12949" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12950"/>and his lips <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like a scorching fire. <l eID="gen12950" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6649"/><l level="1" sID="gen12951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6649"/>A person of perversity will spread dissent,<l eID="gen12951" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12952"/>and he who whispers separates a close friend. <l eID="gen12952" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6650"/><l level="1" sID="gen12953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6650"/>A person of violence will entice his neighbor<l eID="gen12953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12954"/>and cause him to walk on a way <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> not good. <l eID="gen12954" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6651"/><l level="1" sID="gen12955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6651"/>He who winks his eyes <transChange type="added">does so in order</transChange> to plan perverse things;<l eID="gen12955" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12956"/>he who purses his lips will bring evil to pass. <l eID="gen12956" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6652"/><l level="1" sID="gen12957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6652"/>A crown of glory is gray hair;<l eID="gen12957" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12958"/>by a righteous life it is gained. <l eID="gen12958" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6653"/><l level="1" sID="gen12959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6653"/>He who is slow to anger<note placement="foot">Literally “nostrils”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> better than him who is mighty,<l eID="gen12959" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12960"/>and he who controls his spirit than him who captures a city. <l eID="gen12960" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6654"/><l level="1" sID="gen12961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6654"/>The lot will be cast into the lap,<l eID="gen12961" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12962"/>but all of its decisions are from Yahweh. <l eID="gen12962" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12896"/> <chapter eID="Prov.16"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:1
verses.text: Better a dry morsel and quiet with it<l eID="gen12965" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12966"/>than a house filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> feasts of strife. <l eID="gen12966" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6655"/><l level="1" sID="gen12967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6655"/>A slave who deals wisely will rule over a child who acts shamefully,<l eID="gen12967" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12968"/>and in the midst of brothers he will share his inheritance. <l eID="gen12968" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6656"/><l level="1" sID="gen12969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6656"/>A crucible <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the silver, and a furnace <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the gold,<l eID="gen12969" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12970"/>but Yahweh will test hearts. <l eID="gen12970" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6657"/><l level="1" sID="gen12971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6657"/>He who does evil listens to lips of wickedness,<l eID="gen12971" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12972"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> the liar gives heed to the tongue of mischief. <l eID="gen12972" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6658"/><l level="1" sID="gen12973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6658"/>He who mocks the poor insults him who made him;<l eID="gen12973" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12974"/>he who rejoices at calamity will not go unpunished. <l eID="gen12974" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6659"/><l level="1" sID="gen12975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6659"/>The crown of the elderly <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞grandchildren⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of sons”</note><l eID="gen12975" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12976"/>and the glory of children <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their fathers. <l eID="gen12976" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6660"/><l level="1" sID="gen12977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6660"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Fine speech⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “A lip of fineness”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not becoming a fool,<l eID="gen12977" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12978"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞still less⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “only for”</note> is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞false speech⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lip of deceit”</note> for a ruler. <l eID="gen12978" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6661"/><l level="1" sID="gen12979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6661"/>The bribe <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a stone of magic in the eyes of its owner;<note placement="foot">Or “master”</note><l eID="gen12979" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12980"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everywhere⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to all which”</note> he will turn, he will prosper. <l eID="gen12980" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6662"/><l level="1" sID="gen12981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6662"/>He who forgives an affront fosters love,<l eID="gen12981" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12982"/>but he who waits on a matter will alienate a friend. <l eID="gen12982" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6663"/><l level="1" sID="gen12983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6663"/>A rebuke strikes him who understands<l eID="gen12983" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12984"/>deeper than one hundred blows to a fool. <l eID="gen12984" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6664"/><l level="1" sID="gen12985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6664"/>An evil person will seek only rebellion,<l eID="gen12985" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12986"/>and a cruel messenger will be sent against him. <l eID="gen12986" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6665"/><l level="1" sID="gen12987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6665"/><transChange type="added">May</transChange> a man meet a she-bear robbed of offspring<l eID="gen12987" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12988"/>and not a fool in his folly. <l eID="gen12988" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6666"/><l level="1" sID="gen12989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6666"/><transChange type="added">For</transChange> he who returns evil for good,<l eID="gen12989" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12990"/>evil will not depart from his house. <l eID="gen12990" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6667"/><l level="1" sID="gen12991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6667"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> the release of water <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the beginning of strife;<l eID="gen12991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12992"/>before it breaks out, stop the quarrel. <l eID="gen12992" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6668"/><l level="1" sID="gen12993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6668"/>He who justifies the wicked and he who condemns the righteous,<l eID="gen12993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12994"/>the two of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> both abominations of Yahweh. <l eID="gen12994" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6669"/><l level="1" sID="gen12995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6669"/>Why <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this? A price in the hand of a fool,<l eID="gen12995" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12996"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to buy wisdom where<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> there is no <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> <l eID="gen12996" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6670"/><l level="1" sID="gen12997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6670"/>The friend loves at all times<note placement="foot">Hebrew “time”</note>,<l eID="gen12997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12998"/>but a brother is born for adversity. <l eID="gen12998" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6671"/><l level="1" sID="gen12999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6671"/>A person who lacks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pledges⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “pledges a hand”</note><l eID="gen12999" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13000"/>he becomes security before his neighbor. <l eID="gen13000" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6672"/><l level="1" sID="gen13001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6672"/>He who loves transgression loves strife;<l eID="gen13001" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13002"/>he who builds his high thresholds seeks destruction. <l eID="gen13002" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6673"/><l level="1" sID="gen13003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6673"/>He who is crooked of heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> will not find goodness,<l eID="gen13003" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13004"/>and he who is perverse, by his tongue he will fall into calamity. <l eID="gen13004" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6674"/><l level="1" sID="gen13005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6674"/>He who begets a fool, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> trouble for him;<l eID="gen13005" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13006"/>the father of a fool will not rejoice. <l eID="gen13006" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6675"/><l level="1" sID="gen13007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6675"/>A cheerful heart is good medicine,<l eID="gen13007" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13008"/>but a downcast spirit will dry out bones. <l eID="gen13008" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6676"/><l level="1" sID="gen13009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6676"/>The wicked will accept a bribe from the lap,<l eID="gen13009" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13010"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to pervert the ways of justice. <l eID="gen13010" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6677"/><l level="1" sID="gen13011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6677"/>He who understands sets <transChange type="added">his</transChange> face <transChange type="added">toward</transChange> wisdom,<l eID="gen13011" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13012"/>but the eyes of a fool, to the end of the earth.<note placement="foot">Or “land”</note> <l eID="gen13012" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6678"/><l level="1" sID="gen13013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6678"/>A grief to his father <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the child of a fool,<l eID="gen13013" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13014"/>and bitterness to her who bore him. <l eID="gen13014" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6679"/><l level="1" sID="gen13015"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6679"/>Also, imposing a fine on the righteous is not good,<l eID="gen13015" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13016"/><transChange type="added">nor</transChange> to flog nobles for uprightness. <l eID="gen13016" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6680"/><l level="1" sID="gen13017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6680"/>He who spares his sayings knows knowledge,<l eID="gen13017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13018"/>and a cool spirit is a man of understanding. <l eID="gen13018" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6681"/><l level="1" sID="gen13019"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6681"/>Even a fool who keeps silent <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall be considered wise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “wise, he shall be considered”</note><l eID="gen13019" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13020"/>he who closes his lips <transChange type="added">is</transChange> intelligent. <l eID="gen13020" level="2"/><lg eID="gen12964"/> <chapter eID="Prov.17"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:1
verses.text: He who is selfish seeks a craving;<note placement="foot">Or “boundary”</note><l eID="gen13023" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13024"/>against all sound judgment he shows contempt. <l eID="gen13024" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6682"/><l level="1" sID="gen13025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6682"/>A fool will not take pleasure in understanding,<l eID="gen13025" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13026"/>but in expressing his heart.<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> <l eID="gen13026" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6683"/><l level="1" sID="gen13027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6683"/>With the coming of wickedness comes contempt also,<l eID="gen13027" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13028"/>and with dishonor, disgrace. <l eID="gen13028" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6684"/><l level="1" sID="gen13029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6684"/>Deep waters <transChange type="added">are</transChange> words of the mouth of a man;<l eID="gen13029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13030"/>a gushing stream <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a fountain of wisdom. <l eID="gen13030" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6685"/><l level="1" sID="gen13031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6685"/>Being partial <transChange type="added">to</transChange> faces of evil <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not good,<l eID="gen13031" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13032"/><transChange type="added">nor</transChange> to subvert the righteous at the judgment. <l eID="gen13032" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6686"/><l level="1" sID="gen13033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6686"/>The lips of a fool will bring strife,<l eID="gen13033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13034"/>and his mouth calls out for a flogging. <l eID="gen13034" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6687"/><l level="1" sID="gen13035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6687"/>The mouth of a fool <transChange type="added">is</transChange> ruin to him,<l eID="gen13035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13036"/>and his lips <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a snare to his soul.<note placement="foot">Or “life,” or “inner self”</note> <l eID="gen13036" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6688"/><l level="1" sID="gen13037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6688"/>The words of a whisper <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like delicious morsels,<l eID="gen13037" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13038"/>and they themselves go down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> inner parts of the body. <l eID="gen13038" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6689"/><l level="1" sID="gen13039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6689"/>Even he who is slack in his work,<l eID="gen13039" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13040"/>he is brother to a master<note placement="foot">Or “owner”</note> of destruction. <l eID="gen13040" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6690"/><l level="1" sID="gen13041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6690"/>A tower of strength is the name of Yahweh;<l eID="gen13041" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13042"/>into him<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> the righteous will run and be safe. <l eID="gen13042" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6691"/><l level="1" sID="gen13043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6691"/>The wealth of the rich <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his strong city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a city of his strength”</note><l eID="gen13043" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13044"/>and like a wall, it is high in his imagination. <l eID="gen13044" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6692"/><l level="1" sID="gen13045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6692"/>In the presence of destruction, the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of a man will be haughty,<l eID="gen13045" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13046"/>but in the presence of honor, humble. <l eID="gen13046" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6693"/><l level="1" sID="gen13047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6693"/>He who returns a word before he will hear,<l eID="gen13047" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13048"/>folly itself <transChange type="added">belongs</transChange> to him as well as<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> shame. <l eID="gen13048" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6694"/><l level="1" sID="gen13049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6694"/>The spirit of a man will endure his sickness,<l eID="gen13049" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13050"/>but a broken spirit, who may bear it? <l eID="gen13050" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6695"/><l level="1" sID="gen13051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6695"/>An intelligent <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> will acquire knowledge,<l eID="gen13051" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13052"/>and the ear of the wise will seek knowledge. <l eID="gen13052" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6696"/><l level="1" sID="gen13053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6696"/>The gift of a person will open doors for him,<l eID="gen13053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13054"/>and before the great, it gives him access. <l eID="gen13054" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6697"/><l level="1" sID="gen13055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6697"/>The first in his dispute is <transChange type="added">deemed</transChange> righteous,<l eID="gen13055" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13056"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> his neighbor will come and examine him. <l eID="gen13056" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6698"/><l level="1" sID="gen13057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6698"/>The lot will put an end to disputes,<l eID="gen13057" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13058"/>and between powerful contenders it will decide. <l eID="gen13058" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6699"/><l level="1" sID="gen13059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6699"/>A brother who is offended <transChange type="added">is worse</transChange> than a city of strength,<l eID="gen13059" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13060"/>and quarrels <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like the bars of a fortification. <l eID="gen13060" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6700"/><l level="1" sID="gen13061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6700"/>From the fruit of a man’s mouth, his stomach will be satisfied,<l eID="gen13061" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13062"/>as for the yield of his lips, it will satisfy. <l eID="gen13062" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6701"/><l level="1" sID="gen13063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6701"/>Death and life <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> of the tongue,<l eID="gen13063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13064"/>and those who love her<note placement="foot">That is, the power of the tongue</note> will eat of her fruit. <l eID="gen13064" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6702"/><l level="1" sID="gen13065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6702"/>He who finds a wife<note placement="foot">Or “woman”</note> finds good,<l eID="gen13065" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13066"/>and he will obtain favor from Yahweh. <l eID="gen13066" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6703"/><l level="1" sID="gen13067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6703"/>The poor may speak entreaties,<l eID="gen13067" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13068"/>but the rich will answer roughly. <l eID="gen13068" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6704"/><l level="1" sID="gen13069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6704"/>A man of <transChange type="added">many</transChange> friends will come to ruin,<l eID="gen13069" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13070"/>but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother. <l eID="gen13070" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13022"/> <chapter eID="Prov.18"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:1
verses.text: Better a poor person walking in integrity<l eID="gen13073" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13074"/>than one who is perverse <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in his speech⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his lips”</note> and is a fool. <l eID="gen13074" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6705"/><l level="1" sID="gen13075"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6705"/>Also, a life<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> without knowledge is not good,<l eID="gen13075" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13076"/>and he who moves quickly with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> feet <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞misses the mark⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Or “sins”</note> <l eID="gen13076" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6706"/><l level="1" sID="gen13077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6706"/>As for the folly of humankind, its way leads to ruin,<l eID="gen13077" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13078"/>and against Yahweh his heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> will rage. <l eID="gen13078" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6707"/><l level="1" sID="gen13079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6707"/>Wealth adds many friends,<l eID="gen13079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13080"/>but the poor will be left by his friends. <l eID="gen13080" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6708"/><l level="1" sID="gen13081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6708"/>A witness of falsehood will not go unpunished,<l eID="gen13081" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13082"/>and he who breathes lies will not escape. <l eID="gen13082" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6709"/><l level="1" sID="gen13083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6709"/>Many will seek favor before the generous,<l eID="gen13083" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13084"/>and everyone <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the friend of a man of gifts.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “gift”</note> <l eID="gen13084" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6710"/><l level="1" sID="gen13085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6710"/>All the brothers of the poor, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> they hate him,<l eID="gen13085" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13086"/>how much more will his friends keep away from him.<l eID="gen13086" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13087"/>He pursues <transChange type="added">them with</transChange> words, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> they are gone.<note placement="foot">Or “when he pursues words and not them”</note> <l eID="gen13087" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6711"/><l level="1" sID="gen13088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6711"/>He who acquires wisdom loves himself;<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen13088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13089"/>he who guards understanding <transChange type="added">loves</transChange> to find good. <l eID="gen13089" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6712"/><l level="1" sID="gen13090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6712"/>A false witness will not go unpunished,<l eID="gen13090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13091"/>and he who breathes lies will perish. <l eID="gen13091" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6713"/><l level="1" sID="gen13092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6713"/>For a fool living in luxury is not fitting,<l eID="gen13092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13093"/><transChange type="added">any</transChange> more <transChange type="added">than it is</transChange> for a slave to rule over princes. <l eID="gen13093" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6714"/><l level="1" sID="gen13094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6714"/>The understanding of a person makes him slow to his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “nostril”</note><l eID="gen13094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13095"/>and his glory overlooks offense. <l eID="gen13095" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6715"/><l level="1" sID="gen13096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6715"/>The rage of a king growls like a lion,<l eID="gen13096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13097"/>but his favor is like dew on the grass. <l eID="gen13097" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6716"/><l level="1" sID="gen13098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6716"/>A foolish child is a ruin to his father,<l eID="gen13098" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13099"/>and the quarreling of a woman<note placement="foot">Or “wife”</note> is a continuous dripping. <l eID="gen13099" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6717"/><l level="1" sID="gen13100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6717"/>A house and wealth <transChange type="added">are</transChange> an inheritance <transChange type="added">from</transChange> fathers,<l eID="gen13100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13101"/>but from Yahweh <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> a woman<note placement="foot">Or “wife”</note> who is prudent. <l eID="gen13101" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6718"/><l level="1" sID="gen13102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6718"/>Laziness will bring on a deep sleep,<l eID="gen13102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13103"/>and a person<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “life”</note> of idleness will suffer hunger. <l eID="gen13103" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6719"/><l level="1" sID="gen13104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6719"/>He who guards commandments guards his life;<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen13104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13105"/>he who is careless of his ways will be killed. <l eID="gen13105" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6720"/><l level="1" sID="gen13106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6720"/>He who lends to Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he who is kind to the poor,<l eID="gen13106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13107"/>and his benefits he will repay to him. <l eID="gen13107" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6721"/><l level="1" sID="gen13108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6721"/>Discipline your child, for there is hope,<l eID="gen13108" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13109"/>but on his destruction do not set your desire.<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> <l eID="gen13109" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6722"/><l level="1" sID="gen13110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6722"/>A hot-tempered person pays a penalty;<l eID="gen13110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13111"/>if you rescue <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, you will do <transChange type="added">it</transChange> yet again. <l eID="gen13111" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6723"/><l level="1" sID="gen13112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6723"/>Listen <transChange type="added">to</transChange> advice and accept instruction<l eID="gen13112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13113"/>so that you will gain wisdom for your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞future⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “after things”</note> <l eID="gen13113" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6724"/><l level="1" sID="gen13114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6724"/>Many plans <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of a man,<l eID="gen13114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13115"/>but the purpose of Yahweh will be established. <l eID="gen13115" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6725"/><l level="1" sID="gen13116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6725"/>The craving of a man <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his steadfast loyalty,<l eID="gen13116" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13117"/>and <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> better <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> poor than a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞liar⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “man of lying”</note> <l eID="gen13117" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6726"/><l level="1" sID="gen13118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6726"/>Fear of Yahweh <transChange type="added">leads</transChange> to life;<l eID="gen13118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13119"/>he who is filled <transChange type="added">with it</transChange> will rest—he will not suffer harm. <l eID="gen13119" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6727"/><l level="1" sID="gen13120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6727"/>A lazy person buries his hand in the dish,<l eID="gen13120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13121"/>and even to his mouth he will not bring it back. <l eID="gen13121" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6728"/><l level="1" sID="gen13122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6728"/>The scoffer you shall strike, and the simple, may they learn prudence,<l eID="gen13122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13123"/>and reprove the intelligent <transChange type="added">and</transChange> he will gain knowledge. <l eID="gen13123" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6729"/><l level="1" sID="gen13124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6729"/>He who does violence to a father, he who chases away a mother,<l eID="gen13124" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13125"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> a child who causes shame and brings reproach. <l eID="gen13125" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6730"/><l level="1" sID="gen13126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6730"/>Cease to listen to instruction, my child,<l eID="gen13126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13127"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and you will stray⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in order to stray”</note> from sayings of knowledge. <l eID="gen13127" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6731"/><l level="1" sID="gen13128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6731"/>A worthless witness will mock justice,<l eID="gen13128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13129"/>and the mouth of the wicked will devour iniquity. <l eID="gen13129" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6732"/><l level="1" sID="gen13130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6732"/>Judgments<note placement="foot">Or “Punishments,” or “Condemnations”</note> are prepared for the scoffers,<l eID="gen13130" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13131"/>and flogging for the back of fools. <l eID="gen13131" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13072"/> <chapter eID="Prov.19"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:1
verses.text: Wine <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a mocker, strong drink a brawler,<l eID="gen13134" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13135"/>and any who go astray by it are not wise. <l eID="gen13135" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6733"/><l level="1" sID="gen13136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6733"/>Roaring like the lion <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> dreaded anger of a king;<l eID="gen13136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13137"/>he who provokes him forfeits his life.<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> <l eID="gen13137" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6734"/><l level="1" sID="gen13138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6734"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> honorable for the man to refrain from strife,<l eID="gen13138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13139"/>but every fool will be quick to quarrel. <l eID="gen13139" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6735"/><l level="1" sID="gen13140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6735"/>The lazy person will not plow in season;<l eID="gen13140" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13141"/>he will expect at the harvest, but there <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> nothing. <l eID="gen13141" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6736"/><l level="1" sID="gen13142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6736"/>Deep waters <transChange type="added">are like</transChange> purpose in the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of a man,<l eID="gen13142" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13143"/>and a man of understanding will draw it<note placement="foot">Or “her”; referring to “purpose”</note> out. <l eID="gen13143" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6737"/><l level="1" sID="gen13144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6737"/>Many a person will proclaim his loyalty <transChange type="added">for</transChange> himself,<l eID="gen13144" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13145"/>but a man <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> trustworthy, who can find? <l eID="gen13145" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:7
