verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6738"/><l level="1" sID="gen13146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6738"/>He who walks in his integrity <transChange type="added">is</transChange> righteous;<l eID="gen13146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13147"/>happy are his children who follow him. <l eID="gen13147" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6739"/><l level="1" sID="gen13148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6739"/>A king who sits on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> throne of judgment<l eID="gen13148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13149"/>winnows all evil with his eyes. <l eID="gen13149" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6740"/><l level="1" sID="gen13150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6740"/>Who will say “I have made my heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> clean;<l eID="gen13150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13151"/>I am pure from my sin”? <l eID="gen13151" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6741"/><l level="1" sID="gen13152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6741"/>Stone and stone, measure and measure,<l eID="gen13152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13153"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞both of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “also the two of them”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> an abomination of Yahweh. <l eID="gen13153" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6742"/><l level="1" sID="gen13154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6742"/>Even by his acts, a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞young man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “young boy,” or “adolescent”</note> will make himself known,<l eID="gen13154" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13155"/>whether his acts are pure and upright. <l eID="gen13155" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6743"/><l level="1" sID="gen13156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6743"/>The ear that hears and the eye that sees,<l eID="gen13156" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13157"/>Yahweh has made <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞them both⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “also the two of them”</note> <l eID="gen13157" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6744"/><l level="1" sID="gen13158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6744"/>Do not love sleep, lest you become poor;<l eID="gen13158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13159"/>open your eyes <transChange type="added">and</transChange> have plenty bread. <l eID="gen13159" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6745"/><l level="1" sID="gen13160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6745"/>“Bad, bad,” the buyer will say,<l eID="gen13160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13161"/>but <transChange type="added">when</transChange> one goes to him, then he will boast. <l eID="gen13161" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6746"/><l level="1" sID="gen13162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6746"/>There is gold and many costly stones,<l eID="gen13162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13163"/>but precious jewels are lips of knowledge. <l eID="gen13163" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6747"/><l level="1" sID="gen13164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6747"/>Take his garment, for he has given security <transChange type="added">to</transChange> a stranger,<l eID="gen13164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13165"/>and on behalf of a foreigner—take it as pledge. <l eID="gen13165" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6748"/><l level="1" sID="gen13166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6748"/>Bread gained by deceit is sweet for the man,<l eID="gen13166" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13167"/>but afterward, his mouth will be filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> gravel. <l eID="gen13167" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6749"/><l level="1" sID="gen13168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6749"/>A plan<note placement="foot">Hebrew “plans”</note> will be established by advice,<l eID="gen13168" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13169"/>and with guidance make war. <l eID="gen13169" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6750"/><l level="1" sID="gen13170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6750"/>He reveals a secret, he who walks <transChange type="added">about with</transChange> gossip,<l eID="gen13170" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13171"/>and do not associate with a babbler’s lips. <l eID="gen13171" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6751"/><l level="1" sID="gen13172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6751"/>He who curses his father and his mother,<l eID="gen13172" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13173"/>his lamp will be extinguished <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the midst of darkness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in a pupil of darkness”</note> <l eID="gen13173" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6752"/><l level="1" sID="gen13174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6752"/>An inheritance acquired <transChange type="added">hastily</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the beginning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at the first”</note><l eID="gen13174" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13175"/>will not be blessed at its end. <l eID="gen13175" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6753"/><l level="1" sID="gen13176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6753"/>Do not say “I will repay evil”;<l eID="gen13176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13177"/>wait for Yahweh and he will deliver you. <l eID="gen13177" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6754"/><l level="1" sID="gen13178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6754"/>An abomination of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a stone and a weight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a stone and a stone”</note><l eID="gen13178" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13179"/>and scales of falsehood are not good. <l eID="gen13179" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6755"/><l level="1" sID="gen13180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6755"/><transChange type="added">Away</transChange> from Yahweh are the steps of a strong man,<l eID="gen13180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13181"/>and how will humankind understand his ways? <l eID="gen13181" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6756"/><l level="1" sID="gen13182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6756"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> a snare to humankind to say rashly “<transChange type="added">It is</transChange> holy,”<l eID="gen13182" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13183"/>and after vows, to scrutinize. <l eID="gen13183" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6757"/><l level="1" sID="gen13184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6757"/>A wise king winnows the wicked,<l eID="gen13184" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13185"/>and he will drive a wheel over them. <l eID="gen13185" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6758"/><l level="1" sID="gen13186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6758"/>The lamp of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the spirit<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> of humankind,<l eID="gen13186" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13187"/>he who searches every <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞innermost part⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “parts of the inmost”</note> <l eID="gen13187" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6759"/><l level="1" sID="gen13188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6759"/>Loyalty and faithfulness will preserve a king,<l eID="gen13188" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13189"/>and he is upheld with the righteousness of his throne. <l eID="gen13189" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6760"/><l level="1" sID="gen13190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6760"/>The glory of young men <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their strength,<note placement="foot">Or “strengthens them”</note><l eID="gen13190" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13191"/>but the beauty of the aged <transChange type="added">is</transChange> gray hair. <l eID="gen13191" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6761"/><l level="1" sID="gen13192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6761"/>The blows of a wound will cleanse evil,<l eID="gen13192" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13193"/>as will<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> beatings of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞innermost part⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “parts of the inmost”</note> <l eID="gen13193" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13133"/> <chapter eID="Prov.20"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:1
verses.text: Streams of water <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of a king in the hand of Yahweh;<l eID="gen13196" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13197"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wherever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “upon all that”</note> he will desire, he will turn. <l eID="gen13197" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6762"/><l level="1" sID="gen13198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6762"/>Every way of a man is upright in his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> eyes,<l eID="gen13198" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13199"/>but Yahweh weighs hearts.<note placement="foot">Or “minds”</note> <l eID="gen13199" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6763"/><l level="1" sID="gen13200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6763"/>Doing righteousness and justice is <transChange type="added">more</transChange> acceptable<l eID="gen13200" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13201"/>to Yahweh than sacrifice. <l eID="gen13201" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6764"/><l level="1" sID="gen13202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6764"/>Haughtiness of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes and pride of heart,<l eID="gen13202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13203"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> lamp of the wicked <transChange type="added">are</transChange> sin. <l eID="gen13203" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6765"/><l level="1" sID="gen13204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6765"/>The plans of the diligent only <transChange type="added">lead</transChange> to abundance,<l eID="gen13204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13205"/>but all who are hasty, only to want. <l eID="gen13205" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6766"/><l level="1" sID="gen13206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6766"/>He who makes treasure by a lying tongue<l eID="gen13206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13207"/><transChange type="added">is a</transChange> fleeting vapor <transChange type="added">and</transChange> seeker<note placement="foot">Hebrew “seekers”</note> of death. <l eID="gen13207" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6767"/><l level="1" sID="gen13208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6767"/>The violence of the wicked will sweep them away,<l eID="gen13208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13209"/>for they refuse to do justice. <l eID="gen13209" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6768"/><l level="1" sID="gen13210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6768"/>Crooked is the way of a man and a foreigner,<l eID="gen13210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13211"/>but the pure <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upright <transChange type="added">in</transChange> his conduct. <l eID="gen13211" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6769"/><l level="1" sID="gen13212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6769"/>Better to dwell on the corner of a roof<l eID="gen13212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13213"/>than <transChange type="added">to</transChange> share a house with a woman<note placement="foot">Or “wife”</note> of contention. <l eID="gen13213" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6770"/><l level="1" sID="gen13214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6770"/>The soul<note placement="foot">Or “soul, life, throat”</note> of the wicked desires evil;<l eID="gen13214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13215"/>his neighbor will not find mercy in his eyes. <l eID="gen13215" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6771"/><l level="1" sID="gen13216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6771"/>With the punishment of a scoffer, the simple will become wise,<l eID="gen13216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13217"/>and with the instruction of the wise, he will obtain knowledge. <l eID="gen13217" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6772"/><l level="1" sID="gen13218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6772"/>The righteous observes the house of the wicked;<l eID="gen13218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13219"/>he throws the wicked to ruin. <l eID="gen13219" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6773"/><l level="1" sID="gen13220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6773"/>He who closes his ear from the cry of the poor,<l eID="gen13220" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13221"/>he also will cry out and not be heard. <l eID="gen13221" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6774"/><l level="1" sID="gen13222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6774"/>A gift in secret<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the secret”</note> will avert <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “nostril”</note><l eID="gen13222" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13223"/>and a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concealed bribe⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “bribe in the bosom”</note> strong wrath. <l eID="gen13223" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6775"/><l level="1" sID="gen13224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6775"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> a joy to the righteous to do justice,<l eID="gen13224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13225"/>but dismay to those who do evil. <l eID="gen13225" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6776"/><l level="1" sID="gen13226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6776"/>Whoever wanders from the way of understanding,<l eID="gen13226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13227"/>in the assembly of the dead<note placement="foot">Or “Rephaim”</note> he will rest. <l eID="gen13227" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6777"/><l level="1" sID="gen13228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6777"/>A man of want <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he who loves pleasure;<l eID="gen13228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13229"/>he who loves wine and oil<note placement="foot">Or “fat”</note> will not become rich. <l eID="gen13229" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6778"/><l level="1" sID="gen13230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6778"/>A ransom for the righteous is the wicked,<l eID="gen13230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13231"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> faithless instead of the upright. <l eID="gen13231" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6779"/><l level="1" sID="gen13232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6779"/>Better to live in a land of wilderness<l eID="gen13232" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13233"/>than <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a wife of quarrels and provocation. <l eID="gen13233" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6780"/><l level="1" sID="gen13234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6780"/>Precious treasure and oil <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the house of the wise,<l eID="gen13234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13235"/>but the foolish person<note placement="foot">Or “foolish of mankind”</note> will devour them.<note placement="foot">Literally “it”</note> <l eID="gen13235" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6781"/><l level="1" sID="gen13236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6781"/>He who pursues righteousness and kindness<l eID="gen13236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13237"/>will find life, righteousness, and honor. <l eID="gen13237" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6782"/><l level="1" sID="gen13238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6782"/>To a city of warriors, the wise ascends,<l eID="gen13238" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13239"/>and he will bring down the stronghold—its object of trust. <l eID="gen13239" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6783"/><l level="1" sID="gen13240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6783"/>He who guards his mouth and his tongue,<l eID="gen13240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13241"/>he guards his life<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> from danger. <l eID="gen13241" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6784"/><l level="1" sID="gen13242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6784"/>The proud, haughty one: “scoffer” <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name;<l eID="gen13242" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13243"/>he acts with arrogance of pride. <l eID="gen13243" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6785"/><l level="1" sID="gen13244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6785"/>The craving of a lazy person will kill him,<l eID="gen13244" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13245"/>for his hands refuse to work.<note placement="foot">Or “make”</note> <l eID="gen13245" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6786"/><l level="1" sID="gen13246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6786"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞All day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All the day”</note> he craves a craving,<l eID="gen13246" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13247"/>but the righteous will give and not hold back. <l eID="gen13247" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6787"/><l level="1" sID="gen13248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6787"/>The sacrifice of the wicked <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an abomination;<l eID="gen13248" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13249"/>how much more when he brings it in divisiveness! <l eID="gen13249" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6788"/><l level="1" sID="gen13250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6788"/>A false witness will perish,<l eID="gen13250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13251"/>but a man who listens will testify with<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to the”</note> success. <l eID="gen13251" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6789"/><l level="1" sID="gen13252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6789"/>A wicked man is strong in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his countenance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his face”</note><l eID="gen13252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13253"/>but the upright will appoint his paths. <l eID="gen13253" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6790"/><l level="1" sID="gen13254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6790"/>There is no wisdom, nor understanding,<l eID="gen13254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13255"/>nor counsel to oppose Yahweh. <l eID="gen13255" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6791"/><l level="1" sID="gen13256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6791"/>A horse is prepared for the day of battle,<l eID="gen13256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13257"/>but to Yahweh <transChange type="added">belongs</transChange> the victory. <l eID="gen13257" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13195"/> <chapter eID="Prov.21"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:1
verses.text: A <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞reputation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “name”</note> is to be chosen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rather than⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> great riches;<l eID="gen13260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13261"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞favor is better than silver and gold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from silver and from gold, favor is better”</note> <l eID="gen13261" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6792"/><l level="1" sID="gen13262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6792"/>Rich and poor have <transChange type="added">much</transChange> in common;<l eID="gen13262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13263"/>Yahweh is the maker of all of them. <l eID="gen13263" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6793"/><l level="1" sID="gen13264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6793"/>The clever sees danger and hides,<l eID="gen13264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13265"/>but the simple go on and suffer. <l eID="gen13265" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6794"/><l level="1" sID="gen13266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6794"/>The reward of humility <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the fear of Yahweh—<l eID="gen13266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13267"/>wealth and honor and life. <l eID="gen13267" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6795"/><l level="1" sID="gen13268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6795"/>Thorns <transChange type="added">and</transChange> snares <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the way of the perverse;<l eID="gen13268" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13269"/>he who guards himself<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “life”</note> will keep away from them. <l eID="gen13269" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6796"/><l level="1" sID="gen13270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6796"/>Train the child <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concerning his way⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “on the mouth of his way”</note><l eID="gen13270" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13271"/>even when he is old, he will not stray from it. <l eID="gen13271" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6797"/><l level="1" sID="gen13272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6797"/>The rich will rule over the poor,<l eID="gen13272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13273"/>and the borrower is a slave of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the lender⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the borrower belonging to a man”</note> <l eID="gen13273" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6798"/><l level="1" sID="gen13274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6798"/>He who sows injustice will reap calamity,<l eID="gen13274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13275"/>and the rod of his anger will fail. <l eID="gen13275" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6799"/><l level="1" sID="gen13276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6799"/>He <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is generous⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the generous of eye”</note> will be blessed,<l eID="gen13276" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13277"/>for he gives to the poor from his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> bread. <l eID="gen13277" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6800"/><l level="1" sID="gen13278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6800"/>Drive out a scoffer and strife will go out;<l eID="gen13278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13279"/>quarrel and abuse will cease. <l eID="gen13279" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6801"/><l level="1" sID="gen13280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6801"/>He who loves purity of heart<l eID="gen13280" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13281"/><transChange type="added">and has</transChange><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞gracious speech⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “grace of his lips”</note> his friend <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> king. <l eID="gen13281" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6802"/><l level="1" sID="gen13282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6802"/>The eyes of Yahweh keep watch over knowledge,<l eID="gen13282" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13283"/>but he will overthrow the words of the faithless. <l eID="gen13283" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6803"/><l level="1" sID="gen13284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6803"/>A lazy person says “A lion in the street!<l eID="gen13284" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13285"/>In the middle of the highway, I shall be killed!” <l eID="gen13285" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6804"/><l level="1" sID="gen13286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6804"/>A deep pit is the mouth of an <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞adulteress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a strange woman”</note><l eID="gen13286" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13287"/><transChange type="added">he with whom</transChange> Yahweh is angry will fall there. <l eID="gen13287" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6805"/><l level="1" sID="gen13288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6805"/>Folly is bound up in the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of a boy;<note placement="foot">Or “young man,” or “adolescent”</note><l eID="gen13288" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13289"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> rod of discipline will drive it<note placement="foot">That is, folly</note> from him. <l eID="gen13289" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6806"/><l level="1" sID="gen13290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6806"/>He who oppresses the poor <transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to enrich himself,<l eID="gen13290" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13291"/><transChange type="added">or</transChange> gives to the rich, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will come to poverty⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “only loss”</note><l eID="gen13291" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen13259"/> <title type="x-s">Words of the Wise</title> <div sID="gen13292" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen13292" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6807"/><lg sID="gen13293"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6807"/>Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise;<l eID="gen13294" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13295"/>you shall apply your heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> to my teaching. <l eID="gen13295" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6808"/><l level="1" sID="gen13296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6808"/>For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> pleasant if you guard them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “in your belly/womb”</note><l eID="gen13296" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13297"/>together they will be ready upon your lips. <l eID="gen13297" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6809"/><l level="1" sID="gen13298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6809"/><transChange type="added">In order</transChange> for your trust to be in Yahweh,<l eID="gen13298" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13299"/>I have made <transChange type="added">them</transChange> known to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note>—even<note placement="foot">Or “only”</note> you. <l eID="gen13299" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6810"/><l level="1" sID="gen13300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6810"/>Have I not written for you thirty <transChange type="added">sayings</transChange><l eID="gen13300" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13301"/>with admonitions and knowledge? <l eID="gen13301" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6811"/><l level="1" sID="gen13302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6811"/><transChange type="added">In order</transChange> to show you what is right—sayings of truth—<l eID="gen13302" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13303"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to return a true saying to him who sent you. <l eID="gen13303" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6812"/><l level="1" sID="gen13304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6812"/>Do not rob the poor because he is poor,<l eID="gen13304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13305"/>and do not crush the afflicted at the gate; <l eID="gen13305" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6813"/><l level="1" sID="gen13306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6813"/>For Yahweh will plead their case<l eID="gen13306" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13307"/>and despoil those who despoil them of life.<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> <l eID="gen13307" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6814"/><l level="1" sID="gen13308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6814"/>Do not befriend an owner<note placement="foot">Or “master”</note> of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “nostril”</note><l eID="gen13308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13309"/>and with a man of wrath you shall not associate; <l eID="gen13309" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6815"/><l level="1" sID="gen13310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6815"/>lest you learn his way<l eID="gen13310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13311"/>and become entangled in a snare to yourself.<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> <l eID="gen13311" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6816"/><l level="1" sID="gen13312"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6816"/>Do not be with those who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞give a pledge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “strike a hand”</note><l eID="gen13312" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13313"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by becoming⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the becomings of”</note> surety. <l eID="gen13313" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6817"/><l level="1" sID="gen13314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6817"/>If there is nothing for you to pay,<note placement="foot">Or “complete”</note><l eID="gen13314" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13315"/>why will he take your bed from under you? <l eID="gen13315" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6818"/><l level="1" sID="gen13316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6818"/>Do not remove an ancient boundary marker<l eID="gen13316" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13317"/>which your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> made. <l eID="gen13317" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6819"/><l level="1" sID="gen13318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6819"/>A man who is skillful in his work, you shall see:<l eID="gen13318" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13319"/>before kings, he will serve;<l eID="gen13319" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13320"/>he will not serve before the commoners. <l eID="gen13320" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13293"/> <chapter eID="Prov.22"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:1
verses.text: When you sit to eat with a ruler,<l eID="gen13323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13324"/>you shall surely observe what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> before you, <l eID="gen13324" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6820"/><l level="1" sID="gen13325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6820"/>and you shall put a knife to your throat<l eID="gen13325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13326"/>if you have a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞big appetite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “lord/master of life”</note> <l eID="gen13326" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6821"/><l level="1" sID="gen13327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6821"/>Do not desire his delicacies,<l eID="gen13327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13328"/>for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> it is food of deception. <l eID="gen13328" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6822"/><l level="1" sID="gen13329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6822"/>Do not tire <transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to become rich;<l eID="gen13329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13330"/>out of your understanding, <transChange type="added">may you</transChange> desist. <l eID="gen13330" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6823"/><l level="1" sID="gen13331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6823"/>Your eyes will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause to fly”</note> on it, but there is nothing <transChange type="added">to</transChange> it,<l eID="gen13331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13332"/>for suddenly it will make for itself wings<l eID="gen13332" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13333"/>like an eagle and it will be exhausted <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the heavens. <l eID="gen13333" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6824"/><l level="1" sID="gen13334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6824"/>Do not eat the bread of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the stingy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “stingy of eye”</note><l eID="gen13334" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13335"/>and do not desire his delicacies. <l eID="gen13335" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6825"/><l level="1" sID="gen13336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6825"/>For, like hair in his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “soul,” or “inner self”</note> so it is.<note placement="foot">Or “is he”</note><l eID="gen13336" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13337"/>“Eat and drink!” he will say to you,<l eID="gen13337" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13338"/>but his heart will not be with you. <l eID="gen13338" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6826"/><l level="1" sID="gen13339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6826"/>Your morsel you have eaten, you will vomit it up,<l eID="gen13339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13340"/>and you will waste your pleasant words. <l eID="gen13340" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6827"/><l level="1" sID="gen13341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6827"/>In the ears of a fool do not speak,<l eID="gen13341" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13342"/>for he will despise the wisdom of your words. <l eID="gen13342" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6828"/><l level="1" sID="gen13343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6828"/>Do not remove an ancient boundary marker,<l eID="gen13343" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13344"/>and on the fields of orphans do not encroach; <l eID="gen13344" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6829"/><l level="1" sID="gen13345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6829"/>For their redeemer is strong,<l eID="gen13345" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13346"/>he himself will plead their cause against you. <l eID="gen13346" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6830"/><l level="1" sID="gen13347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6830"/>Apply your heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> to instruction,<l eID="gen13347" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13348"/>and your ear to sayings of knowledge. <l eID="gen13348" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6831"/><l level="1" sID="gen13349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6831"/>Do not withhold discipline from a child,<l eID="gen13349" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13350"/>if you will beat him with the rod, he will not die. <l eID="gen13350" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6832"/><l level="1" sID="gen13351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6832"/>As for you, with the rod you shall beat him,<l eID="gen13351" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13352"/>and his life<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> you will save from Sheol.<note placement="foot">A term for the place where the dead reside, i.e., the Underworld</note> <l eID="gen13352" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6833"/><l level="1" sID="gen13353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6833"/>My child, if your heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> is wise,<l eID="gen13353" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13354"/>my heart will be glad—even me! <l eID="gen13354" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6834"/><l level="1" sID="gen13355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6834"/>And my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞insides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “kidneys”</note> will rejoice<l eID="gen13355" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13356"/>when your lips speak what is upright. <l eID="gen13356" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6835"/><l level="1" sID="gen13357"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6835"/>May your heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> not envy the sinners,<l eID="gen13357" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13358"/>but <transChange type="added">live</transChange> in fear of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all the day”</note> <l eID="gen13358" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6836"/><l level="1" sID="gen13359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6836"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “For if”</note> there is a future,<l eID="gen13359" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13360"/>and your hope will not be cut off. <l eID="gen13360" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6837"/><l level="1" sID="gen13361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6837"/>You, my child, hear and be wise,<l eID="gen13361" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13362"/>and direct your heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> on the road. <l eID="gen13362" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6838"/><l level="1" sID="gen13363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6838"/>Do not be among drinkers of wine,<l eID="gen13363" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13364"/>among gluttonous eaters of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their meat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “meat for them”</note> <l eID="gen13364" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6839"/><l level="1" sID="gen13365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6839"/>For the drunkard and gluttonous, they will become poor,<l eID="gen13365" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13366"/>and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> rags, drowsiness will clothe them. <l eID="gen13366" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6840"/><l level="1" sID="gen13367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6840"/>Listen to your father—he who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞gave you life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “caused you to be born”</note><l eID="gen13367" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13368"/>and do not despise your mother when<note placement="foot">Or “for, because”</note> she is old. <l eID="gen13368" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6841"/><l level="1" sID="gen13369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6841"/>Buy truth and do not sell <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,<l eID="gen13369" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13370"/>wisdom and instruction and understanding. <l eID="gen13370" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6842"/><l level="1" sID="gen13371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6842"/>The father of the righteous will surely rejoice;<l eID="gen13371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13372"/>he who bears a wise person will be happy with him. <l eID="gen13372" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6843"/><l level="1" sID="gen13373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6843"/>May your father and your mother be glad,<l eID="gen13373" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13374"/>and may she who bore you rejoice. <l eID="gen13374" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6844"/><l level="1" sID="gen13375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6844"/>My child, may you give your heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> to me,<l eID="gen13375" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13376"/>and may your eyes delight in my ways. <l eID="gen13376" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6845"/><l level="1" sID="gen13377"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6845"/>For a deep pit is a prostitute,<note placement="foot">Or “whore”</note><l eID="gen13377" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13378"/>and a narrow well is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an adulteress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a foreign woman”</note> <l eID="gen13378" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6846"/><l level="1" sID="gen13379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6846"/>She <transChange type="added">is</transChange> also like a robber lying in wait,<l eID="gen13379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13380"/>and the faithless among mankind she increases. <l eID="gen13380" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6847"/><l level="1" sID="gen13381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6847"/>To whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> woe? To whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sorrow? To whom <transChange type="added">are</transChange> quarrels? To whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> complaint?<l eID="gen13381" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13382"/>To whom <transChange type="added">are</transChange> wounds without cause? To whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> redness of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes? <l eID="gen13382" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6848"/><l level="1" sID="gen13383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6848"/>To those who linger over wine,<l eID="gen13383" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13384"/>to those who come to try mixed wine. <l eID="gen13384" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6849"/><l level="1" sID="gen13385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6849"/>Do not look at wine when it is red,<l eID="gen13385" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13386"/>when it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sparkles⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gives its eye”</note> on the cup,<l eID="gen13386" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13387"/>going down smoothly. <l eID="gen13387" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6850"/><l level="1" sID="gen13388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6850"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In the end⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “end him”</note> it will bite like a serpent,<l eID="gen13388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13389"/>and it will sting like an adder. <l eID="gen13389" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6851"/><l level="1" sID="gen13390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6851"/>Your eyes will see strange things,<l eID="gen13390" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13391"/>and your heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> will speak perverse things. <l eID="gen13391" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6852"/><l level="1" sID="gen13392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6852"/>And you will be like him who lies down in the heart of the sea,<l eID="gen13392" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13393"/>and like him who lies down on top of a mast. <l eID="gen13393" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6853"/><l level="1" sID="gen13394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6853"/>“They struck me; I was not hurt. They beat me; I did not know <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<l eID="gen13394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13395"/>When I will awake, I will continue; I will seek it again.” <l eID="gen13395" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13322"/> <chapter eID="Prov.23"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:1
verses.text: Do not envy men of evil,<l eID="gen13398" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13399"/>and do not desire to be with them. <l eID="gen13399" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6854"/><l level="1" sID="gen13400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6854"/>For their minds will devise violence,<l eID="gen13400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13401"/>and their lips will speak mischief. <l eID="gen13401" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6855"/><l level="1" sID="gen13402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6855"/>By wisdom a house is built,<l eID="gen13402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13403"/>and by understanding it is established. <l eID="gen13403" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6856"/><l level="1" sID="gen13404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6856"/>And by knowledge, rooms are filled<l eID="gen13404" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13405"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> all riches, precious and pleasant. <l eID="gen13405" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6857"/><l level="1" sID="gen13406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6857"/>The warrior of wisdom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in strength,<l eID="gen13406" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13407"/>and a man of knowledge is strong <transChange type="added">in</transChange> power. <l eID="gen13407" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6858"/><l level="1" sID="gen13408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6858"/>For with wise guidance you shall make war for yourself,<l eID="gen13408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13409"/>and victory <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in an abundance of counsel. <l eID="gen13409" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6859"/><l level="1" sID="gen13410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6859"/>Wisdom <transChange type="added">is too</transChange> high for fools;<l eID="gen13410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13411"/>at the gate he will not open his mouth. <l eID="gen13411" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6860"/><l level="1" sID="gen13412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6860"/>He who plans to do evil for<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> himself,<l eID="gen13412" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13413"/>they will call <transChange type="added">him</transChange> “master<note placement="foot">Or “owner”</note> of mischief.” <l eID="gen13413" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6861"/><l level="1" sID="gen13414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6861"/>Devising folly <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sin,<l eID="gen13414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13415"/>and an abomination to humankind <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a scoffer. <l eID="gen13415" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6862"/><l level="1" sID="gen13416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6862"/><transChange type="added">If</transChange> you faint on the day of adversity,<l eID="gen13416" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13417"/>little <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your strength. <l eID="gen13417" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6863"/><l level="1" sID="gen13418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6863"/>Rescue those who are led away to the death<l eID="gen13418" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13419"/>and those who stagger to the slaughter. If you hold back, <l eID="gen13419" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6864"/><l level="1" sID="gen13420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6864"/>if you say, “Look, we do not know this,”<l eID="gen13420" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13421"/>does not he who weighs hearts perceive <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?<l eID="gen13421" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13422"/>And he who keeps your soul,<note placement="foot">Or “life,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen13422" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13423"/>he knows and will repay humankind according to his deeds. <l eID="gen13423" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6865"/><l level="1" sID="gen13424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6865"/>My child, eat honey, for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> good,<l eID="gen13424" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13425"/>and the dripping of the honeycomb <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sweet to your taste. <l eID="gen13425" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6866"/><l level="1" sID="gen13426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6866"/>Thus know wisdom for <transChange type="added">the sake of</transChange> your soul,<note placement="foot">Or “life,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen13426" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13427"/>if you find <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, then there is a future,<l eID="gen13427" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13428"/>and your hope will not be cut off. <l eID="gen13428" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6867"/><l level="1" sID="gen13429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6867"/>Do not lie in wait <transChange type="added">like</transChange> an outlaw against the home of the righteous;<l eID="gen13429" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13430"/>do not do violence <transChange type="added">to</transChange> his dwelling place. <l eID="gen13430" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6868"/><l level="1" sID="gen13431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6868"/>For seven <transChange type="added">times</transChange> the righteous will fall, but he will rise,<l eID="gen13431" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13432"/>but the wicked will be overthrown by calamity. <l eID="gen13432" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6869"/><l level="1" sID="gen13433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6869"/>While your enemies are falling, do not rejoice;<l eID="gen13433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13434"/>when he trips himself, may your heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> not be glad <l eID="gen13434" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6870"/><l level="1" sID="gen13435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6870"/>lest Yahweh see and <transChange type="added">it</transChange> be evil in his eyes,<l eID="gen13435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13436"/>and turn his anger away from him. <l eID="gen13436" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6871"/><l level="1" sID="gen13437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6871"/>Do not fret because of the evildoers;<l eID="gen13437" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13438"/>do not envy the wicked. <l eID="gen13438" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6872"/><l level="1" sID="gen13439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6872"/>For there will not be a future for the evil;<l eID="gen13439" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13440"/>the lamp of the wicked will die out. <l eID="gen13440" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6873"/><l level="1" sID="gen13441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6873"/>Fear Yahweh, my son, and the king;<l eID="gen13441" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13442"/>with those who change, do not associate. <l eID="gen13442" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6874"/><l level="1" sID="gen13443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6874"/>For suddenly their disaster will come,<l eID="gen13443" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13444"/>and the ruin of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞both of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the two of them”</note> who knows? <l eID="gen13444" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6875"/><l level="1" sID="gen13445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6875"/>These <transChange type="added">sayings</transChange> are also for the wise:<l eID="gen13445" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13446"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Partiality⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “acknowledge faces”</note> in judgment is not good. <l eID="gen13446" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6876"/><l level="1" sID="gen13447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6876"/>Whoever says to the guilty, “You are righteous,” the people will curse him;<l eID="gen13447" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13448"/>the nations will abhor him. <l eID="gen13448" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6877"/><l level="1" sID="gen13449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6877"/>But they who rebuke will have delight,<l eID="gen13449" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13450"/>and upon them blessings of goodness will come. <l eID="gen13450" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6878"/><l level="1" sID="gen13451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6878"/>He will kiss <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lips,<l eID="gen13451" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13452"/>he who gives an honest answer. <l eID="gen13452" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6879"/><l level="1" sID="gen13453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6879"/>Prepare your work in the street and get it ready for yourself in the field;<l eID="gen13453" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13454"/>afterward, then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you shall build your house. <l eID="gen13454" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6880"/><l level="1" sID="gen13455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6880"/>Do not be a witness without cause against your neighbor<l eID="gen13455" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13456"/>nor deceive with your lips. <l eID="gen13456" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6881"/><l level="1" sID="gen13457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6881"/>Do not say, “Just as he has done to me, so shall I do to him;<l eID="gen13457" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13458"/>I will pay back the man according to his deed.” <l eID="gen13458" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6882"/><l level="1" sID="gen13459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6882"/>I passed by the field of a lazy person,<l eID="gen13459" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13460"/>and over the vineyard of a person lacking <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> <l eID="gen13460" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6883"/><l level="1" sID="gen13461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6883"/>and behold, it was overgrown—all of it was covered <transChange type="added">with</transChange> thorns, its surface with nettles,<l eID="gen13461" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13462"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its stone wall⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a wall of his/its stones”</note> was broken down. <l eID="gen13462" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6884"/><l level="1" sID="gen13463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6884"/>Then I myself saw and my heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> considered;<l eID="gen13463" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13464"/>I looked, and I took hold of instruction: <l eID="gen13464" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6885"/><l level="1" sID="gen13465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6885"/>A little sleep, a little slumber,<l eID="gen13465" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13466"/>a little folding of the hands for rest, <l eID="gen13466" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6886"/><l level="1" sID="gen13467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6886"/>and your poverty will come running,<l eID="gen13467" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13468"/>and your lack like an armed warrior. <l eID="gen13468" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13397"/> <chapter eID="Prov.24"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6887"/><title type="x-s">More Proverbs of Solomon</title> <div sID="gen13469" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen13469" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen13470"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6887"/>These are also proverbs of Solomon which officials of Hezekiah king of Judah copied: <l eID="gen13471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6888"/><l level="1" sID="gen13472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6888"/>The glory of God<note placement="foot">Or “gods”</note> conceals things,<l eID="gen13472" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13473"/>but the glory of kings searches out things. <l eID="gen13473" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6889"/><l level="1" sID="gen13474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6889"/>As heaven is to height and the earth is to depth,<l eID="gen13474" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13475"/>so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> of kings—there is no searching. <l eID="gen13475" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6890"/><l level="1" sID="gen13476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6890"/>Remove the dross from silver,<l eID="gen13476" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13477"/>and it will become a vessel for the smith. <l eID="gen13477" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6891"/><l level="1" sID="gen13478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6891"/>Remove the wicked before a king,<l eID="gen13478" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13479"/>and his throne will be established in righteousness.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in the righteousness”</note> <l eID="gen13479" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6892"/><l level="1" sID="gen13480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6892"/>Do not promote yourself before the king,<l eID="gen13480" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13481"/>and in the place of the great ones do not stand. <l eID="gen13481" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6893"/><l level="1" sID="gen13482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6893"/>For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> better <transChange type="added">that</transChange> he say to you, “Ascend here,”<l eID="gen13482" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13483"/>than he humble you before a noble.<l eID="gen13483" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13484"/>What your eyes have seen, <l eID="gen13484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6894"/><l level="1" sID="gen13485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6894"/>do not hastily bring out to court,<l eID="gen13485" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13486"/>for<note placement="foot">Or “lest”</note> what will you do at its end,<l eID="gen13486" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13487"/>when your neighbor puts you to shame? <l eID="gen13487" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6895"/><l level="1" sID="gen13488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6895"/>Argue your argument with your neighbor <transChange type="added">himself</transChange>,<l eID="gen13488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13489"/>the secret of another do not disclose, <l eID="gen13489" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6896"/><l level="1" sID="gen13490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6896"/>lest he who hears shame you<l eID="gen13490" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13491"/>and your ill repute will not end. <l eID="gen13491" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6897"/><l level="1" sID="gen13492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6897"/>Apples of gold in a setting of silver<l eID="gen13492" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13493"/>is a matter spoken at<note placement="foot">Hebrew “on”</note> its proper time. <l eID="gen13493" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6898"/><l level="1" sID="gen13494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6898"/>A ring of gold and an ornament of fine gold<l eID="gen13494" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13495"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> a rebuke of the wise to the ear of a listener. <l eID="gen13495" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6899"/><l level="1" sID="gen13496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6899"/>Like the cold of snow on a day<note placement="foot">Or “at a season”</note> of harvest<l eID="gen13496" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13497"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> a faithful messenger to those who send him,<l eID="gen13497" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13498"/>and the soul<note placement="foot">Or “life,” or “inner self”</note> of his master is refreshed.<note placement="foot">Or “returned”</note> <l eID="gen13498" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6900"/><l level="1" sID="gen13499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6900"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> clouds and wind when there is no rain,<l eID="gen13499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13500"/><transChange type="added">so too is</transChange> a man who boasts in a gift of deception. <l eID="gen13500" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6901"/><l level="1" sID="gen13501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6901"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞With patience⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “With length of face”</note> a ruler may be persuaded,<l eID="gen13501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13502"/>and a soft tongue will break a bone.<note placement="foot">Or “strength”</note> <l eID="gen13502" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6902"/><l level="1" sID="gen13503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6902"/><transChange type="added">If</transChange> you find honey, eat what is sufficient for you,<l eID="gen13503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13504"/>lest you have your fill of it and vomit it out. <l eID="gen13504" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6903"/><l level="1" sID="gen13505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6903"/>Make your foot scarce in the house of your neighbor,<l eID="gen13505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13506"/>lest he become weary of you and hate you. <l eID="gen13506" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6904"/><l level="1" sID="gen13507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6904"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> a club and sword and a sharp arrow<l eID="gen13507" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13508"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> a man who bears false witness against his neighbor. <l eID="gen13508" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6905"/><l level="1" sID="gen13509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6905"/>A bad tooth and a lame foot<l eID="gen13509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13510"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> the trust of a faithless person <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in a time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on a day”</note> of trouble. <l eID="gen13510" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6906"/><l level="1" sID="gen13511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6906"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> one who removes a garment on a cold day, <transChange type="added">or like</transChange> vinegar on natron,<note placement="foot">A mineral salt found on dry lake beds often used as a preservative.</note><l eID="gen13511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13512"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> he who sings songs to a heavy heart. <l eID="gen13512" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6907"/><l level="1" sID="gen13513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6907"/>If your enemy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> hungry, feed him bread,<l eID="gen13513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13514"/>and if thirsty, let him drink water. <l eID="gen13514" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6908"/><l level="1" sID="gen13515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6908"/>For coals of fire you will heap upon his head,<l eID="gen13515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13516"/>and Yahweh will reward you. <l eID="gen13516" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6909"/><l level="1" sID="gen13517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6909"/>The wind of the north produces rain,<l eID="gen13517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13518"/>and a backbiting tongue, angry faces. <l eID="gen13518" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6910"/><l level="1" sID="gen13519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6910"/>Better to live upon the corner of a roof<l eID="gen13519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13520"/>than <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a woman<note placement="foot">Or “wife”</note> of contention and <transChange type="added">in a</transChange> shared house. <l eID="gen13520" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6911"/><l level="1" sID="gen13521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6911"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> cold water<note placement="foot">Hebrew “waters”</note> upon a weary soul,<note placement="foot">Or “life,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen13521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13522"/><transChange type="added">so too is</transChange> good news from a distant place. <l eID="gen13522" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6912"/><l level="1" sID="gen13523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6912"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> a muddied spring or a polluted fountain<l eID="gen13523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13524"/>is the righteous who gives way before the wicked. <l eID="gen13524" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6913"/><l level="1" sID="gen13525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6913"/>To eat much honey is not good,<l eID="gen13525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13526"/>nor <transChange type="added">is</transChange> seeking one’s honor<note placement="foot">Hebrew “their honor”</note> honorable. <l eID="gen13526" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6914"/><l level="1" sID="gen13527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6914"/>A breached city <transChange type="added">where</transChange> there is no wall<l eID="gen13527" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13528"/><transChange type="added">is like</transChange> a man who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞has no⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there is no”</note> self-control for his spirit. <l eID="gen13528" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13470"/> <chapter eID="Prov.25"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:1
verses.text: Like snow in the summer and like rain at the harvest,<l eID="gen13531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13532"/>so honor is not fitting for a fool. <l eID="gen13532" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:2
