verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6915"/><l level="1" sID="gen13533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6915"/>Like the sparrow <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to fluttering and like the swallow <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to flying,<l eID="gen13533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13534"/>so an undeserved curse does not go forth. <l eID="gen13534" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6916"/><l level="1" sID="gen13535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6916"/>A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey,<l eID="gen13535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13536"/>and a rod for the back of fools. <l eID="gen13536" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6917"/><l level="1" sID="gen13537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6917"/>Do not answer a fool according to his folly<l eID="gen13537" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13538"/>lest you become like him—even you. <l eID="gen13538" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6918"/><l level="1" sID="gen13539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6918"/>Answer a fool according to his folly,<l eID="gen13539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13540"/>or else he will be wise in his own eyes. <l eID="gen13540" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6919"/><l level="1" sID="gen13541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6919"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> cutting off feet <transChange type="added">or</transChange> drinking violence,<l eID="gen13541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13542"/>so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he who sends messages in the hand of a fool. <l eID="gen13542" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6920"/><l level="1" sID="gen13543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6920"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> legs that hang limp from a lame person,<l eID="gen13543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13544"/>so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a proverb in the mouth of fools. <l eID="gen13544" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6921"/><l level="1" sID="gen13545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6921"/>Like binding a stone in a sling,<l eID="gen13545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13546"/>so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> giving honor to a fool. <l eID="gen13546" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6922"/><l level="1" sID="gen13547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6922"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> a thorn that goes up in the hand of a drunkard,<l eID="gen13547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13548"/>so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a proverb in the mouth of fools. <l eID="gen13548" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6923"/><l level="1" sID="gen13549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6923"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> an archer who wounds everyone,<l eID="gen13549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13550"/>so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he who hires a fool or he who hires passersby. <l eID="gen13550" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6924"/><l level="1" sID="gen13551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6924"/>Like a dog returning to his vomit<l eID="gen13551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13552"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> a fool reverting to his folly. <l eID="gen13552" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6925"/><l level="1" sID="gen13553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6925"/><transChange type="added">Do</transChange> you see a man wise in his own eyes?<l eID="gen13553" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13554"/><transChange type="added">There is more</transChange> hope for a fool than for him. <l eID="gen13554" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6926"/><l level="1" sID="gen13555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6926"/>A lazy person says “A lion <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the road!<l eID="gen13555" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13556"/>A lion among the streets!” <l eID="gen13556" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6927"/><l level="1" sID="gen13557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6927"/>The door turns on its hinge,<l eID="gen13557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13558"/>and a lazy person on his bed. <l eID="gen13558" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6928"/><l level="1" sID="gen13559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6928"/>A lazy person buries his hands in the dish;<l eID="gen13559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13560"/>he is <transChange type="added">too</transChange> tired to return it to his mouth. <l eID="gen13560" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6929"/><l level="1" sID="gen13561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6929"/>A lazy person is wiser in his eyes<l eID="gen13561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13562"/>than seven who answer discreetly. <l eID="gen13562" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6930"/><l level="1" sID="gen13563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6930"/>Grabbing onto the ears of a dog<l eID="gen13563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13564"/>passing by <transChange type="added">is</transChange> one who meddles in a quarrel <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> not his own. <l eID="gen13564" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6931"/><l level="1" sID="gen13565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6931"/>Like a maniac who shoots<l eID="gen13565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13566"/>firebrands, arrows, and death, <l eID="gen13566" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6932"/><l level="1" sID="gen13567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6932"/>so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a man who deceives his neighbor,<l eID="gen13567" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13568"/>but says “Am I not joking?” <l eID="gen13568" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6933"/><l level="1" sID="gen13569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6933"/>For lack of wood, a fire goes out,<l eID="gen13569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13570"/>and where there is no whisperer, quarreling will cease. <l eID="gen13570" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6934"/><l level="1" sID="gen13571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6934"/><transChange type="added">As</transChange> charcoal <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to hot embers and wood <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to fire,<l eID="gen13571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13572"/>so a man of quarrels <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to kindling strife. <l eID="gen13572" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6935"/><l level="1" sID="gen13573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6935"/>The words of a whisperer <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like delicious morsels,<l eID="gen13573" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13574"/>and they go down to the inner parts of the body. <l eID="gen13574" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6936"/><l level="1" sID="gen13575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6936"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞impure silver⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “silver of impurities”</note> which overlays an earthen vessel,<l eID="gen13575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13576"/><transChange type="added">so are</transChange> smooth lips and an evil heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note>. <l eID="gen13576" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6937"/><l level="1" sID="gen13577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6937"/>On his lips, an enemy will pretend,<l eID="gen13577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13578"/>but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞inside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his midst”</note> he will harbor deceit. <l eID="gen13578" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6938"/><l level="1" sID="gen13579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6938"/>When he makes his voice gracious, do not believe him,<l eID="gen13579" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13580"/>for seven abominations <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in his heart. <l eID="gen13580" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6939"/><l level="1" sID="gen13581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6939"/>Though hatred is covered with guile,<l eID="gen13581" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13582"/>its evil will be exposed in the assembly. <l eID="gen13582" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6940"/><l level="1" sID="gen13583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6940"/>He who digs a pit, in it he will fall,<l eID="gen13583" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13584"/>and he who rolls a stone, on him it will come back. <l eID="gen13584" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6941"/><l level="1" sID="gen13585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6941"/>A tongue of deceit hates its victim,<l eID="gen13585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13586"/>and a flattering mouth makes ruin. <l eID="gen13586" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13530"/> <chapter eID="Prov.26"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:1
verses.text: Do not boast <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞about tomorrow⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “on the day of tomorrow”</note><l eID="gen13589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13590"/>for you do not know what the day will bring. <l eID="gen13590" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6942"/><l level="1" sID="gen13591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6942"/>May another praise you and not your own mouth,<l eID="gen13591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13592"/>a stranger and not your own lips. <l eID="gen13592" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6943"/><l level="1" sID="gen13593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6943"/>Heavy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a stone and weighty <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sand,<l eID="gen13593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13594"/>but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> provocation of a fool <transChange type="added">is</transChange> heavier than both of them. <l eID="gen13594" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6944"/><l level="1" sID="gen13595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6944"/>Cruel <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wrath and overwhelming <transChange type="added">is</transChange> anger,<l eID="gen13595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13596"/>but who will stand before jealousy? <l eID="gen13596" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6945"/><l level="1" sID="gen13597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6945"/>Better a rebuke that is open<l eID="gen13597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13598"/>than a love that is hidden. <l eID="gen13598" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6946"/><l level="1" sID="gen13599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6946"/>The wounds of a friend mean well,<l eID="gen13599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13600"/>but the kisses of an enemy are profane. <l eID="gen13600" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6947"/><l level="1" sID="gen13601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6947"/>An <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞appetite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “soul”</note> that is sated spurns honey,<l eID="gen13601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13602"/>but <transChange type="added">to</transChange> an <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞appetite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “soul”</note> that is ravenous, all bitterness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sweet. <l eID="gen13602" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6948"/><l level="1" sID="gen13603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6948"/>Like a bird that strays from its nest,<l eID="gen13603" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13604"/>so is a man who strays from his place. <l eID="gen13604" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6949"/><l level="1" sID="gen13605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6949"/>Perfume and incense will gladden a heart,<l eID="gen13605" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13606"/>and the pleasantness of one’s friend <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞personal advice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “because of advice of a person”</note> <l eID="gen13606" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6950"/><l level="1" sID="gen13607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6950"/>As for your friend and a friend of your father, do not forsake <transChange type="added">them</transChange>,<l eID="gen13607" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13608"/>and the house of your brother, do not enter on the day of your calamity.<l eID="gen13608" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13609"/>Better is a close neighbor than a distant brother. <l eID="gen13609" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6951"/><l level="1" sID="gen13610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6951"/>Be wise, my child, and make my heart glad,<l eID="gen13610" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13611"/>and I will answer him who reproaches me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a word. <l eID="gen13611" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6952"/><l level="1" sID="gen13612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6952"/><transChange type="added">When</transChange> the clever sees danger, he hides;<l eID="gen13612" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13613"/>the simple go on <transChange type="added">and</transChange> suffer. <l eID="gen13613" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6953"/><l level="1" sID="gen13614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6953"/>Take his garment, for he gives surety <transChange type="added">to</transChange> a stranger,<l eID="gen13614" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13615"/>and to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an adulteress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a foreign woman”</note>—<transChange type="added">so</transChange> take his pledge. <l eID="gen13615" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6954"/><l level="1" sID="gen13616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6954"/>He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice<l eID="gen13616" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13617"/>early in the morning,<l eID="gen13617" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13618"/>a curse will be reckoned to him. <l eID="gen13618" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6955"/><l level="1" sID="gen13619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6955"/>Dripping constantly on a day of heavy rain<l eID="gen13619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13620"/>and a woman<note placement="foot">Or “wife”</note> of contention are alike. <l eID="gen13620" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6956"/><l level="1" sID="gen13621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6956"/><transChange type="added">In</transChange> restraining her, he restrains wind,<note placement="foot">Or “breath, or “spirit”</note><l eID="gen13621" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13622"/>and his right hand will grasp oil<note placement="foot">Or “fat”</note>. <l eID="gen13622" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6957"/><l level="1" sID="gen13623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6957"/><transChange type="added">As</transChange> iron sharpens<note placement="foot">Or “is united with”</note> iron,<l eID="gen13623" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13624"/>so <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one man sharpens another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a man sharpens the faces of his friend”</note> <l eID="gen13624" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6958"/><l level="1" sID="gen13625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6958"/>He who tends a fig tree will eat its fruit,<l eID="gen13625" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13626"/>and he who guards his master<note placement="foot">Or “lord”</note> will be honored. <l eID="gen13626" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6959"/><l level="1" sID="gen13627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6959"/>As the waters <transChange type="added">reflect</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞face to face⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the faces to the faces”</note><l eID="gen13627" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13628"/>so the heart of a person <transChange type="added">reflects</transChange> the person. <l eID="gen13628" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6960"/><l level="1" sID="gen13629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6960"/>Sheol<note placement="foot">A term for the place where the dead reside, i.e., the Underworld</note> and Abaddon<note placement="foot">Poetic synonym for “Sheol.” Only mentioned in the <sc>ot</sc> in relation to Sheol, the grave, or death.</note> will not be satisfied,<l eID="gen13629" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13630"/>and the eyes of a person will not be satisfied <transChange type="added">either</transChange>. <l eID="gen13630" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6961"/><l level="1" sID="gen13631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6961"/>A crucible <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the silver, and a furnace for the gold,<l eID="gen13631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13632"/>but a man <transChange type="added">is tested by</transChange> the mouth of him who praises him. <l eID="gen13632" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6962"/><l level="1" sID="gen13633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6962"/>If you crush a fool in the mortar with the pestle <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞along with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “in the midst of”</note> the crushed grain,<l eID="gen13633" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13634"/>it will not drive folly from upon him. <l eID="gen13634" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6963"/><l level="1" sID="gen13635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6963"/>You will surely know the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞condition⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “faces”</note> of your flock;<l eID="gen13635" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13636"/>your heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> attends to the herds. <l eID="gen13636" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6964"/><l level="1" sID="gen13637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6964"/>For riches <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not forever,<l eID="gen13637" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13638"/>nor a crown for generation <transChange type="added">after</transChange> generation. <l eID="gen13638" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6965"/><l level="1" sID="gen13639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6965"/>When the grass is gone, then green growth will appear,<l eID="gen13639" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13640"/>and the herbs of the mountains will be gathered. <l eID="gen13640" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6966"/><l level="1" sID="gen13641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6966"/>Lambs <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> your clothing,<l eID="gen13641" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13642"/>and goats the price of the field. <l eID="gen13642" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6967"/><l level="1" sID="gen13643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6967"/>And <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> enough goats’ milk for your food,<l eID="gen13643" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13644"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> food of your household and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞nourishment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “life”</note> of your maidservants. <l eID="gen13644" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13588"/> <chapter eID="Prov.27"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:1
verses.text: The wicked flee, but no one pursues,<l eID="gen13647" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13648"/>but the righteous is bold like a lion. <l eID="gen13648" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6968"/><l level="1" sID="gen13649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6968"/>By the rebellion of a land, her rulers increase,<l eID="gen13649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13650"/>but by a person of intelligence who knows justice, it will last. <l eID="gen13650" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6969"/><l level="1" sID="gen13651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6969"/>A man <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> poor and oppresses the impoverished<l eID="gen13651" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13652"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> a beating rain <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that leaves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and there is”</note> no food. <l eID="gen13652" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6970"/><l level="1" sID="gen13653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6970"/>Those who forsake instruction will praise the wicked,<l eID="gen13653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13654"/>but they who guard instruction will struggle against them. <l eID="gen13654" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6971"/><l level="1" sID="gen13655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6971"/>Men of evil do not understand justice,<l eID="gen13655" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13656"/>but seekers of Yahweh understand completely.<note placement="foot">Or “everything”</note> <l eID="gen13656" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6972"/><l level="1" sID="gen13657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6972"/>Better <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> poor and walking in one’s integrity<l eID="gen13657" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13658"/>than to be crooked of ways when one <transChange type="added">is</transChange> rich. <l eID="gen13658" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6973"/><l level="1" sID="gen13659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6973"/>He who keeps instruction <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a child of understanding,<l eID="gen13659" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13660"/>but the companion of gluttons will shame his father. <l eID="gen13660" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6974"/><l level="1" sID="gen13661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6974"/>He who augments his wealth with interest and with usury<l eID="gen13661" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13662"/>gathers it for him who is kind to the poor. <l eID="gen13662" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6975"/><l level="1" sID="gen13663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6975"/>He who turns his ear from listening to instruction,<l eID="gen13663" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13664"/>even his prayer <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an abomination. <l eID="gen13664" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6976"/><l level="1" sID="gen13665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6976"/>He who misleads the upright onto the way of evil,<l eID="gen13665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13666"/>into his pits he will fall.<l eID="gen13666" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13667"/>But as for the blameless, they will inherit good. <l eID="gen13667" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6977"/><l level="1" sID="gen13668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6977"/>A man of wealth <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wise in his own eyes,<l eID="gen13668" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13669"/>but the intelligent poor sees through him. <l eID="gen13669" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6978"/><l level="1" sID="gen13670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6978"/>When the righteous triumphs, great <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the glory,<l eID="gen13670" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13671"/>but with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rising of the wicked, a person will be hidden. <l eID="gen13671" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6979"/><l level="1" sID="gen13672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6979"/>He who conceals his transgression will not prosper,<l eID="gen13672" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13673"/>but he who confesses and forsakes will obtain mercy. <l eID="gen13673" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6980"/><l level="1" sID="gen13674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6980"/>Happy is the person who fears continuously,<l eID="gen13674" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13675"/>but he who is stubborn of heart,<note placement="foot">Or “mind”</note> will fall into calamity. <l eID="gen13675" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6981"/><l level="1" sID="gen13676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6981"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> a roaring lion and a charging bear<l eID="gen13676" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13677"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> a wicked ruler over a poor people. <l eID="gen13677" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6982"/><l level="1" sID="gen13678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6982"/>A ruler who lacks understanding is<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> a cruel oppressor,<l eID="gen13678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13679"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> those who hate unjust gain will have long<note placement="foot">Or “prolong”</note> days. <l eID="gen13679" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6983"/><l level="1" sID="gen13680"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6983"/>A person who is burdened with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blood of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “life”</note><l eID="gen13680" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13681"/>until death he will flee;<l eID="gen13681" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13682"/>do not take hold of him. <l eID="gen13682" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6984"/><l level="1" sID="gen13683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6984"/>He who walks in integrity will be safe,<l eID="gen13683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13684"/>but he who takes crooked paths will fall in one. <l eID="gen13684" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6985"/><l level="1" sID="gen13685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6985"/>He who tills his ground will have plenty bread,<l eID="gen13685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13686"/>but he who follows fantasies will have plenty <transChange type="added">of</transChange> poverty. <l eID="gen13686" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6986"/><l level="1" sID="gen13687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6986"/>A man of faithfulness <transChange type="added">has</transChange> abundant blessings,<l eID="gen13687" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13688"/>but he who hurries to become rich will not go unpunished. <l eID="gen13688" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6987"/><l level="1" sID="gen13689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6987"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Showing partiality⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Recognizing faces”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not good,<l eID="gen13689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13690"/>and over a morsel of bread, a strong man will do wrong. <l eID="gen13690" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6988"/><l level="1" sID="gen13691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6988"/>He who hurries for wealth is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a man with an evil eye⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a man of evil of eye”</note><l eID="gen13691" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13692"/>but he does not know that poverty will come upon him. <l eID="gen13692" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6989"/><l level="1" sID="gen13693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6989"/>He who rebukes a person will afterward find <transChange type="added">more</transChange> favor<l eID="gen13693" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13694"/>than he who flatters <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> tongue. <l eID="gen13694" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6990"/><l level="1" sID="gen13695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6990"/>He who robs his father and his mother and says, “There is no crime,”<l eID="gen13695" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13696"/>is partner to a man who corrupts. <l eID="gen13696" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6991"/><l level="1" sID="gen13697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6991"/>The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞greedy person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wide soul”</note> will stir up strife,<l eID="gen13697" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13698"/>but he who trusts in Yahweh will be enriched. <l eID="gen13698" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6992"/><l level="1" sID="gen13699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6992"/>He who trusts in his own heart<note placement="foot">Or “mind,” or “sense”</note> is a fool,<l eID="gen13699" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13700"/>but he who walks in wisdom will be saved. <l eID="gen13700" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6993"/><l level="1" sID="gen13701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6993"/><transChange type="added">For</transChange> he who gives to the poor, there is no lacking,<l eID="gen13701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13702"/>but <transChange type="added">for</transChange> he<note placement="foot">Hebrew “those”</note> who turns his eyes, <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> many curses. <l eID="gen13702" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6994"/><l level="1" sID="gen13703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6994"/>With <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rising of the wicked, humankind will be hidden,<l eID="gen13703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13704"/>and with their perishing, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous will multiply. <l eID="gen13704" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13646"/> <chapter eID="Prov.28"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:1
verses.text: A man who is reproved, being stubborn of neck—<l eID="gen13707" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13708"/>suddenly he will be broken, and there will not be healing. <l eID="gen13708" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6995"/><l level="1" sID="gen13709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6995"/>When the righteous are numerous, the people will rejoice,<l eID="gen13709" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13710"/>but when the wicked are ruling, people will groan. <l eID="gen13710" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6996"/><l level="1" sID="gen13711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6996"/>A man who loves wisdom will make his parents glad,<l eID="gen13711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13712"/>but the friend of prostitutes<note placement="foot">Or “whores”</note> will squander his wealth. <l eID="gen13712" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6997"/><l level="1" sID="gen13713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6997"/>By justice a king gives stability <transChange type="added">to</transChange> a land,<l eID="gen13713" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13714"/>but a man of bribes will ruin it. <l eID="gen13714" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6998"/><l level="1" sID="gen13715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6998"/>A strong man who flatters his neighbor<l eID="gen13715" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13716"/>is spreading a net for his feet. <l eID="gen13716" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6999"/><l level="1" sID="gen13717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6999"/>In transgression, an evil man <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a snare,<l eID="gen13717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13718"/>but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous will sing and rejoice.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he will rejoice”</note> <l eID="gen13718" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7000"/><l level="1" sID="gen13719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7000"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> righteous knows <transChange type="added">the</transChange> case of the poor,<l eID="gen13719" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13720"/>but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked does not understand knowledge. <l eID="gen13720" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7001"/><l level="1" sID="gen13721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7001"/>Men of scoffing set a city aflame,<l eID="gen13721" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13722"/>but the wise turn away wrath. <l eID="gen13722" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7002"/><l level="1" sID="gen13723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7002"/><transChange type="added">If</transChange> a wise man goes to court with a foolish man,<l eID="gen13723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13724"/>then there is rankling and ridicule,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “there is ridicule”</note> but there is no relief. <l eID="gen13724" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7003"/><l level="1" sID="gen13725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7003"/>Men of blood hate <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blameless,<l eID="gen13725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13726"/>and they seek the life of the upright.<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note> <l eID="gen13726" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7004"/><l level="1" sID="gen13727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7004"/>A fool gives all his breath,<note placement="foot">Or “spirit”</note><l eID="gen13727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13728"/>but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise holds back in quiet. <l eID="gen13728" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7005"/><l level="1" sID="gen13729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7005"/>A ruler listening to a word of falsehood,<l eID="gen13729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13730"/>all his officials are wicked. <l eID="gen13730" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7006"/><l level="1" sID="gen13731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7006"/>The poor and a man of oppression have <transChange type="added">this</transChange> in common:<l eID="gen13731" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13732"/>Yahweh gives <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞light to the eyes of them both⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “light of the eyes of the two of them”</note> <l eID="gen13732" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7007"/><l level="1" sID="gen13733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7007"/>A king who judges with truthfulness <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the poor,<l eID="gen13733" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13734"/>his throne will be established forever. <l eID="gen13734" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7008"/><l level="1" sID="gen13735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7008"/>As for a rod and reproof, they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> will give wisdom,<l eID="gen13735" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13736"/>but a neglected child is disgraced <transChange type="added">by</transChange> his mother. <l eID="gen13736" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7009"/><l level="1" sID="gen13737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7009"/>With the increase of the wicked, transgression will increase,<l eID="gen13737" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13738"/>but the righteous will look on his downfall. <l eID="gen13738" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7010"/><l level="1" sID="gen13739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7010"/>Discipline your children, and they will give you rest,<l eID="gen13739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13740"/>and they will give delight to your soul.<note placement="foot">Or “life,” or “inner self”</note> <l eID="gen13740" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7011"/><l level="1" sID="gen13741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7011"/>When there is no prophecy, the people cast off restraint,<l eID="gen13741" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13742"/>but as for he who guards instruction, happiness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his. <l eID="gen13742" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7012"/><l level="1" sID="gen13743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7012"/>By words, a servant is not disciplined,<l eID="gen13743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13744"/>for he will understand, but there is no giving heed. <l eID="gen13744" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7013"/><l level="1" sID="gen13745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7013"/>You see a man who is hasty in his words:<l eID="gen13745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13746"/><transChange type="added">there is more</transChange> hope for a fool than him. <l eID="gen13746" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7014"/><l level="1" sID="gen13747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7014"/>He who pampers his servant from childhood,<l eID="gen13747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13748"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞arrogance will be his end⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and its/his end will be arrogance”</note> <l eID="gen13748" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7015"/><l level="1" sID="gen13749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7015"/>A man of anger will stir strife,<l eID="gen13749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13750"/>and the owner of anger, much transgression. <l eID="gen13750" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7016"/><l level="1" sID="gen13751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7016"/>The pride of a person will bring him humiliation,<l eID="gen13751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13752"/>and the lowly of spirit will obtain honor. <l eID="gen13752" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7017"/><l level="1" sID="gen13753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7017"/>Being a partner with a thief is hating one’s life;<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “inner self”</note><l eID="gen13753" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13754"/>a curse he will hear, but not disclose. <l eID="gen13754" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7018"/><l level="1" sID="gen13755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7018"/>The fear of a person will lay a snare,<l eID="gen13755" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13756"/>but he who trusts in Yahweh will be secure. <l eID="gen13756" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7019"/><l level="1" sID="gen13757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7019"/>Many are those who seek the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞favor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “faces”</note> of a ruler,<l eID="gen13757" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13758"/>but from Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one obtains justice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “comes justice for a man”</note> <l eID="gen13758" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7020"/><l level="1" sID="gen13759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7020"/>A man of injustice is an abomination to the righteous,<l eID="gen13759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13760"/>but the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upright⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “upright of way”</note> is an abomination to the wicked. <l eID="gen13760" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13706"/> <chapter eID="Prov.29"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7021"/><title type="x-s">The Oracle of Agur</title> <div sID="gen13761" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen13761" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen13762"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7021"/>The words of Agur, son of Yakeh, the oracle.<l eID="gen13763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13764"/>Thus says the man to Ithiel, to Ithiel, and Ucal:<note placement="foot">Or “I am weary, O God; I am weary, O God, and worn out”</note> <l eID="gen13764" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7022"/><l level="1" sID="gen13765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7022"/>Certainly I <transChange type="added">am more</transChange> stupid than a man,<l eID="gen13765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13766"/>and the understanding of humankind <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not for me. <l eID="gen13766" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7023"/><l level="1" sID="gen13767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7023"/>And I have not learned wisdom,<l eID="gen13767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13768"/>nor will I know knowledge of the Holy One.<note placement="foot">Or “holy ones”</note> <l eID="gen13768" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7024"/><l level="1" sID="gen13769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7024"/>Who has ascended <transChange type="added">to</transChange> heaven and come down?<l eID="gen13769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13770"/>Who has gathered <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind in the hollow of his hand?<l eID="gen13770" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13771"/>Who has wrapped water in a<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> garment?<l eID="gen13771" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13772"/>Who has established all the ends of the earth?<l eID="gen13772" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13773"/>What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name and what is the name of his child?<l eID="gen13773" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13774"/>For <transChange type="added">surely</transChange> you know. <l eID="gen13774" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7025"/><l level="1" sID="gen13775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7025"/>Every word of God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> flawless;<l eID="gen13775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13776"/>he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a shield for him who takes refuge in him. <l eID="gen13776" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7026"/><l level="1" sID="gen13777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7026"/>Do not add to his words<l eID="gen13777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13778"/>lest he rebuke you and you be found a liar. <l eID="gen13778" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7027"/><l level="1" sID="gen13779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7027"/>Two things I ask from you;<l eID="gen13779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13780"/>do not deny me before I die: <l eID="gen13780" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7028"/><l level="1" sID="gen13781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7028"/>Keep falsehood and a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lying word⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “word of a lie”</note> far from me;<l eID="gen13781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13782"/>do not give me poverty or wealth;<l eID="gen13782" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13783"/>provide me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> food <transChange type="added">only for</transChange> my need. <l eID="gen13783" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7029"/><l level="1" sID="gen13784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7029"/>Or else I will be satisfied and will deny <transChange type="added">him</transChange><l eID="gen13784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13785"/>and say “Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh?”<l eID="gen13785" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13786"/>Or<note placement="foot">Or “Lest”</note> I will be poor and will steal<l eID="gen13786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13787"/>and profane the name of my God. <l eID="gen13787" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7030"/><l level="1" sID="gen13788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7030"/>Do not slander a servant to his master,<l eID="gen13788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13789"/>or else he will curse you and you will be guilty. <l eID="gen13789" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7031"/><l level="1" sID="gen13790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7031"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> a generation <transChange type="added">that</transChange> will curse its father,<l eID="gen13790" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13791"/>and its mother it will not bless. <l eID="gen13791" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7032"/><l level="1" sID="gen13792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7032"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> a generation <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> pure in its own eyes,<l eID="gen13792" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13793"/>but from its filthiness it will not be cleansed. <l eID="gen13793" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7033"/><l level="1" sID="gen13794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7033"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> a generation—how lofty <transChange type="added">are</transChange> their eyes!<l eID="gen13794" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13795"/>And their eyelids they will lift. <l eID="gen13795" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7034"/><l level="1" sID="gen13796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7034"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> a generation whose teeth <transChange type="added">are</transChange> swords,<l eID="gen13796" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13797"/>and its jawbones, knives,<l eID="gen13797" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13798"/><transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to devour the poor from the earth<note placement="foot">Or “land”</note><l eID="gen13798" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13799"/>and the needy from humankind. <l eID="gen13799" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7035"/><l level="1" sID="gen13800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7035"/>For the leech, <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> two daughters;<l eID="gen13800" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13801"/>“Give, give!” <transChange type="added">they cry</transChange>.<l eID="gen13801" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13802"/>As for three of these, they are not satisfied;<l eID="gen13802" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13803"/>as for four, they do not say enough. <l eID="gen13803" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7036"/><l level="1" sID="gen13804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7036"/>Sheol<note placement="foot">A term for the place where the dead reside, i.e., the Underworld</note> and barrenness of womb,<l eID="gen13804" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13805"/>the land is not satisfied <transChange type="added">with</transChange> water,<l eID="gen13805" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13806"/>and fire does not say “enough!” <l eID="gen13806" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7037"/><l level="1" sID="gen13807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7037"/>The eye <transChange type="added">that</transChange> mocks a father<l eID="gen13807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13808"/>and scorns the obedience of a mother—<l eID="gen13808" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13809"/>the ravens of the valley will peck it out,<l eID="gen13809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13810"/>and the offspring of vultures will eat it. <l eID="gen13810" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7038"/><l level="1" sID="gen13811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7038"/>Three of these are <transChange type="added">too</transChange> wonderful for me,<l eID="gen13811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13812"/>and four, I do not understand them: <l eID="gen13812" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7039"/><l level="1" sID="gen13813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7039"/>the way of the eagle in the sky,<l eID="gen13813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13814"/>the way of a snake on a rock,<l eID="gen13814" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13815"/>the way of a ship in the heart of the sea,<l eID="gen13815" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13816"/>and the way of a man with a young woman. <l eID="gen13816" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7040"/><l level="1" sID="gen13817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7040"/>This is the way of a woman committing adultery:<l eID="gen13817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13818"/>she eats and wipes her mouth,<l eID="gen13818" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13819"/>and says “I have not done wrong.” <l eID="gen13819" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7041"/><l level="1" sID="gen13820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7041"/>Under three <transChange type="added">things</transChange> the earth<note placement="foot">Or “land”</note> trembles,<l eID="gen13820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13821"/>and under four, it is not able to bear up: <l eID="gen13821" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7042"/><l level="1" sID="gen13822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7042"/>under a slave when he becomes king,<l eID="gen13822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13823"/>and a fool when he is satisfied <transChange type="added">with</transChange> food; <l eID="gen13823" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7043"/><l level="1" sID="gen13824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7043"/>under an unloved woman when she gets married,<l eID="gen13824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13825"/>and a maid when she succeeds her mistress. <l eID="gen13825" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7044"/><l level="1" sID="gen13826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7044"/>There <transChange type="added">are</transChange> four small things on the earth,<l eID="gen13826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13827"/>and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞exceedingly wise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “wise ones from wise ones”</note> <l eID="gen13827" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7045"/><l level="1" sID="gen13828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7045"/>The ants <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a people <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> not strong,<l eID="gen13828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13829"/>yet they prepare their food in the summer; <l eID="gen13829" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7046"/><l level="1" sID="gen13830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7046"/>the badgers <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a people <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> not mighty,<l eID="gen13830" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13831"/>yet they set their house on the rock; <l eID="gen13831" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7047"/><l level="1" sID="gen13832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7047"/>there is no king for the locust,<l eID="gen13832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13833"/>yet it marches in rank; <l eID="gen13833" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7048"/><l level="1" sID="gen13834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7048"/>a lizard you <transChange type="added">can</transChange> seize with hands,<l eID="gen13834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13835"/>yet it is in palaces of kings. <l eID="gen13835" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7049"/><l level="1" sID="gen13836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7049"/>There <transChange type="added">are</transChange> three <transChange type="added">things</transChange> that are magnificent of stride,<l eID="gen13836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13837"/>and four that are magnificent <transChange type="added">when</transChange> moving: <l eID="gen13837" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7050"/><l level="1" sID="gen13838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7050"/>a mighty lion among the beasts,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “beasts”</note><l eID="gen13838" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13839"/>but he will not turn back from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any face⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “faces of all”</note> <l eID="gen13839" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7051"/><l level="1" sID="gen13840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7051"/>a strutting rooster or he-goat,<l eID="gen13840" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13841"/>and a king <transChange type="added">whose</transChange> army <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with him. <l eID="gen13841" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7052"/><l level="1" sID="gen13842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7052"/>If you have been foolish by exalting yourself,<l eID="gen13842" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13843"/>and if you have devised evil, <transChange type="added">put your</transChange> hand to <transChange type="added">your</transChange> mouth. <l eID="gen13843" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7053"/><l level="1" sID="gen13844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7053"/>For pressing milk produces curd,<l eID="gen13844" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13845"/>and pressing the nose produces blood,<l eID="gen13845" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13846"/>so pressing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “nostrils”</note> produces strife. <l eID="gen13846" level="2"/><lg eID="gen13762"/> <chapter eID="Prov.30"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7054"/><title type="x-s">The Oracle of King Lemuel</title> <div sID="gen13847" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen13847" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen13848"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7054"/>The words of Lemuel, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king—an oracle<l eID="gen13849" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13850"/>that his mother taught him: <l eID="gen13850" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7055"/><l level="1" sID="gen13851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7055"/>What, my son? And what, my son in my womb?<l eID="gen13851" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13852"/>And what, son of my vows? <l eID="gen13852" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7056"/><l level="1" sID="gen13853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7056"/>Do not give your strength to the women,<l eID="gen13853" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13854"/>and your ways to destroy kings. <l eID="gen13854" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7057"/><l level="1" sID="gen13855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7057"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> not for the kings, O Lemuel;<l eID="gen13855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13856"/>drinking wine <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not for the kings,<l eID="gen13856" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13857"/>nor <transChange type="added">is</transChange> strong drink for rulers. <l eID="gen13857" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7058"/><l level="1" sID="gen13858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7058"/>Or else he will drink and forget what has been decreed,<l eID="gen13858" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13859"/>and he will pervert the rights<note placement="foot">Hebrew “right”</note> of all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞afflicted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of affliction”</note> <l eID="gen13859" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7059"/><l level="1" sID="gen13860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7059"/>Give strong drink to him who is perishing,<l eID="gen13860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13861"/>and wine to those <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in bitter distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to bitterness of soul”</note> <l eID="gen13861" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7060"/><l level="1" sID="gen13862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7060"/>He will drink and forget his poverty,<l eID="gen13862" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13863"/>and his misery he will not remember <transChange type="added">any</transChange> more. <l eID="gen13863" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7061"/><l level="1" sID="gen13864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7061"/>Open your mouth for the mute,<l eID="gen13864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13865"/>for the rights<note placement="foot">Hebrew “right”</note> of all the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞needy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the sons of the needy”</note> <l eID="gen13865" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7062"/><l level="1" sID="gen13866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7062"/>Open your mouth, judge righteousness,<l eID="gen13866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13867"/>and defend <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor and needy.<l eID="gen13867" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen13848"/> <title type="x-s">An Excellent Woman<note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Prov.31.10-Prov.31.31">Prov 31:10–31 </reference>is an acrostic poem</note></title> <div sID="gen13868" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen13868" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7063"/><lg sID="gen13869"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7063"/>A woman<note placement="foot">Or “wife”</note> of excellence,<note placement="foot">Or “strength,” or “valor,” or “ability,” or “efficiency”</note> who will find?<l eID="gen13870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13871"/>For her worth <transChange type="added">is</transChange> far more than precious jewels. <l eID="gen13871" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7064"/><l level="1" sID="gen13872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7064"/>The heart of her husband<note placement="foot">Or “lord”</note> trusts in her,<l eID="gen13872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13873"/>and gain he will not lack. <l eID="gen13873" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7065"/><l level="1" sID="gen13874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7065"/>She does him good, but not harm<l eID="gen13874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13875"/>all the days of her life. <l eID="gen13875" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7066"/><l level="1" sID="gen13876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7066"/>She seeks wool and flax,<l eID="gen13876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13877"/>and she works with the diligence of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞her hands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “her palms”</note> <l eID="gen13877" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7067"/><l level="1" sID="gen13878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7067"/>She is like the ships of a merchant;<l eID="gen13878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13879"/>from far off she brings her food;<note placement="foot">Or “bread”</note> <l eID="gen13879" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7068"/><l level="1" sID="gen13880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7068"/>And she arises while <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> still night,<l eID="gen13880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13881"/>and gives food to her household,<l eID="gen13881" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13882"/>and tasks to her servant girls. <l eID="gen13882" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7069"/><l level="1" sID="gen13883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7069"/>She considers a field and buys it,<l eID="gen13883" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13884"/>from the fruit of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞her hand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “her palm”</note> she plants a vineyard. <l eID="gen13884" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7070"/><l level="1" sID="gen13885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7070"/>She girds her waist in strength,<l eID="gen13885" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13886"/>and makes her arms strong. <l eID="gen13886" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7071"/><l level="1" sID="gen13887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7071"/>She perceives that her merchandise <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good;<l eID="gen13887" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13888"/>her lamp does not go out in the night. <l eID="gen13888" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7072"/><l level="1" sID="gen13889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7072"/>Her hands she puts onto the distaff,<note placement="foot">A stick or spindle onto which wool or flax is wound in preparation for spinning</note><l eID="gen13889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13890"/>and her palms hold a spindle. <l eID="gen13890" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7073"/><l level="1" sID="gen13891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7073"/>Her palm she opens to the poor,<l eID="gen13891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13892"/>and her hand she reaches <transChange type="added">out</transChange> to the needy. <l eID="gen13892" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7074"/><l level="1" sID="gen13893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7074"/>She does not fear for her house <transChange type="added">when</transChange> it snows,<l eID="gen13893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13894"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞her entire household⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all her house, household”</note> is clothed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> crimson. <l eID="gen13894" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7075"/><l level="1" sID="gen13895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7075"/>She makes for herself coverings;<l eID="gen13895" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13896"/>her clothing <transChange type="added">is</transChange> fine linen and purple. <l eID="gen13896" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7076"/><l level="1" sID="gen13897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7076"/>Her husband<note placement="foot">Or “lord”</note> is known at the gates,<l eID="gen13897" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13898"/>in his seat among the elders of the land. <l eID="gen13898" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7077"/><l level="1" sID="gen13899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7077"/>Linen garments she makes and sells,<l eID="gen13899" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13900"/>and she supplies sashes for the merchants. <l eID="gen13900" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7078"/><l level="1" sID="gen13901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7078"/>Strength and dignity are her clothing,<l eID="gen13901" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13902"/>and she laughs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the future⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the day/time coming after”</note> <l eID="gen13902" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7079"/><l level="1" sID="gen13903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7079"/>She opens her mouth with wisdom,<l eID="gen13903" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13904"/>and instruction of kindness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon her tongue. <l eID="gen13904" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7080"/><l level="1" sID="gen13905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7080"/>She looks after the ways of her household,<l eID="gen13905" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13906"/>and the bread of idleness she will not eat. <l eID="gen13906" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7081"/><l level="1" sID="gen13907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7081"/>Her children rise and consider her happy,<l eID="gen13907" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13908"/>her husband<note placement="foot">Or “lord”</note> <transChange type="added">also</transChange>, and he praises her; <l eID="gen13908" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7082"/><l level="1" sID="gen13909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7082"/>“Many daughters have done excellence,<note placement="foot">Or “strength,” or “valor,” or “ability,” or “efficiency”</note><l eID="gen13909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13910"/>but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you surpass⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you ascend over”</note> all of them.” <l eID="gen13910" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7083"/><l level="1" sID="gen13911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7083"/>Charm<note placement="foot">Hebrew “The charm”</note> is deceit and beauty<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the beauty”</note> is vain;<note placement="foot">Or “vapor,” or “emptiness,” or “breath”</note><l eID="gen13911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13912"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> a woman who fears Yahweh shall be praised. <l eID="gen13912" level="2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7084"/><l level="1" sID="gen13913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7084"/>Give to her from the fruit of her hand,<l eID="gen13913" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13914"/>and may they praise her works in the city gates. <l eID="gen13914" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen13869"/> <chapter eID="Prov.31"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen11936" osisID="Prov" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7085"/><title type="x-s">Prologue</title> <div sID="gen13916" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7085"/>The words of the Teacher,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Qohelet”</note> the son of David, king in Jerusalem. <div eID="gen13916" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">Motto Introduced</title> <div sID="gen13917" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen13917" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7086"/><lg sID="gen13918"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7086"/>“Vanity of vanities!” says the Teacher,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Qohelet”</note><l eID="gen13919" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13920"/>“Vanity of vanities! All <transChange type="added">is</transChange> vanity!”<l eID="gen13920" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen13918"/> <title type="x-s">All Toil is Profitless and Repetitious</title> <div sID="gen13921" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen13921" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7087"/><lg sID="gen13922"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7087"/>What does a person gain in all his toil<l eID="gen13923" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13924"/>with which he toils under the sun? <l eID="gen13924" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7088"/><l level="1" sID="gen13925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7088"/>A generation goes, and a generation comes,<l eID="gen13925" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13926"/>but the earth stands forever. <l eID="gen13926" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:5
