verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7315"/><l level="1" sID="gen14599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7315"/>My beloved has gone down to his garden,<l eID="gen14599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14600"/>to the garden bed of the spice,<l eID="gen14600" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14601"/>to pasture his flock and to gather lilies in the garden.<l eID="gen14601" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen14594"/> <title type="x-s">Mutual Possession Refrain</title> <div sID="gen14602" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14602" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7316"/><lg sID="gen14603"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7316"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I belong to my beloved and he belongs to me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “I for my beloved and he for me”</note><l eID="gen14604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14605"/>he pastures his flock among the lilies.<l eID="gen14605" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen14603"/> <title type="x-s">Solomon’s Praise of His Beloved</title> <div sID="gen14606" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14606" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7317"/><lg sID="gen14607"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7317"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> beautiful, my beloved, as Tirzah,<l eID="gen14608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14609"/>lovely as Jerusalem,<l eID="gen14609" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14610"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞overwhelming as an army with banners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “terrible as the bannered ones”</note> <l eID="gen14610" level="3"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7318"/><l level="1" sID="gen14611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7318"/>Turn away your eyes from before me,<l eID="gen14611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14612"/>for they overwhelm me.<l eID="gen14612" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14613"/>Your hair <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a flock of the goats<l eID="gen14613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14614"/>that moves down from Gilead. <l eID="gen14614" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7319"/><l level="1" sID="gen14615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7319"/>Your teeth <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like a flock of the ewes<l eID="gen14615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14616"/>that have come up from the washing,<l eID="gen14616" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14617"/>all of them bearing twins,<l eID="gen14617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14618"/>and there is none bereaved among them. <l eID="gen14618" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7320"/><l level="1" sID="gen14619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7320"/>Your cheeks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞behind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from behind”</note> your veil<l eID="gen14619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14620"/><transChange type="added">are</transChange> like halves of a pomegranate.<l eID="gen14620" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen14607"/> <title type="x-s">The Maiden’s Beauty Is without Peer</title> <div sID="gen14621" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14621" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7321"/><lg sID="gen14622"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7321"/>Sixty queens there <transChange type="added">are</transChange>, eighty concubines,<l eID="gen14623" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14624"/>and maidens beyond number. <l eID="gen14624" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7322"/><l level="1" sID="gen14625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7322"/>My dove, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she is the one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “she is one”</note><note placement="foot">The term “one” functions here as an adjective of quality: “unique, singular, the only one”</note><l eID="gen14625" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14626"/>my perfect, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she is the only one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “she is one”</note><note placement="foot">Or “the only daughter of her mother.” Although the latter option is permissible, the term is used elsewhere of the heir as the favored child (e.g., <reference osisRef="Gen.22.2">Gen 22:2</reference>; <reference osisRef="Prov.4.3">Prov 4:3</reference>). This nuance is supported by the parallel term “favorite”</note><l eID="gen14626" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14627"/>she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the favorite of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “she is the pure one.” Since there are two Hebrew terms spelled the same way, some relate this to the adjective that means “pure.” Others relate it to the verb that means “to choose, select.” The parallelism favors the latter</note><note placement="foot">Literally “the favorite for”</note> her mother who bore her.<l eID="gen14627" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14628"/>Maidens see her and consider her fortunate;<note placement="foot">Or “call her happy” or “call her blessed” or “bless her”</note><l eID="gen14628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14629"/>queens and concubines praise her: <l eID="gen14629" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7323"/><l level="1" sID="gen14630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7323"/>“Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this that looks down like the dawn,<l eID="gen14630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14631"/>beautiful as the moon,<l eID="gen14631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14632"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bright as the sun⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “pure as the glow”</note><note placement="foot">Or “bright as the heat of the sun.” The Hebrew term “glow” poetically refers to the bright rays of the sun (<reference osisRef="Ps.19.7">Psa 19:7</reference>; <reference osisRef="Isa.24.23">Isa 24:23</reference>; <reference osisRef="Isa.30.26">30:26</reference>)</note><l eID="gen14632" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14633"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞overwhelming as an army with banners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “terrible as the bannered ones”</note><l eID="gen14633" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen14622"/> <title type="x-s">The Journey to the Valley</title> <div sID="gen14634" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14634" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7324"/><lg sID="gen14635"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7324"/>I went down to the orchard of the walnut trees<l eID="gen14636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14637"/>to look at the blossoms of the valley,<l eID="gen14637" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14638"/>to see <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> the vine<transChange type="added">s</transChange> have sprouted,<l eID="gen14638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14639"/><transChange type="added">whether</transChange> the pomegranates have blossomed. <l eID="gen14639" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7325"/><l level="1" sID="gen14640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7325"/>I did not know my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “soul”</note> set me<l eID="gen14640" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14641"/><transChange type="added">in</transChange> a chariot of my princely people.<note placement="foot">Or “Before I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib” (KJV, ASV) or “Before I knew it, my desire set me mid the chariots of Ammi-nadib” (JPS) or “Before I was aware, my soul set me over the chariots of my noble people” (NASB) or “Before I realized it, my desire set me among the royal chariots of my people” (NIV) or “… among the chariots of Amminadab” (NIV margin) or “… among the chariots of the people of the prince” (NIV margin)</note> <l eID="gen14641" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7326"/><l level="1" sID="gen14642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7326"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Song.6.13-Song.7.13">Song of Songs 6:13–7:13 </reference>in the English Bible is 7:1–14 in the Hebrew Bible</note> Turn, turn,<note placement="foot">Or “Return, return …!”</note> O Shulammite!<note placement="foot">Or “O perfect one,” “O peaceful one,” “O bride.” Many interpreters take this moniker as suggesting the maiden was from the village of Shulem (alternately called Shunem)</note><l eID="gen14642" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14643"/>Turn, turn<note placement="foot">Or “Return, return …!”</note> so that we may look upon you!<l eID="gen14643" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14644"/>Why do you look upon the Shulammite<l eID="gen14644" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14645"/>as <transChange type="added">at</transChange> a dance of the two armies? <l eID="gen14645" level="2"/><lg eID="gen14635"/> <chapter eID="Song.6"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7327"/><title type="x-s">Solomon’s Praise of His Dancing Maiden</title> <div sID="gen14646" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen14646" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen14647"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7327"/>How beautiful are your feet in sandals,<l eID="gen14648" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14649"/>O royal princess!<note placement="foot">Or “O daughter of leader”</note><l eID="gen14649" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14650"/>The curves of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞thighs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “thigh”</note> are like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞jewels⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “ornaments”</note><l eID="gen14650" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14651"/>the work of the hands of a craftsman. <l eID="gen14651" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7328"/><l level="1" sID="gen14652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7328"/>Your navel <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a round wine-mixing bowl⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a bowl of the roundness”</note><l eID="gen14652" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14653"/>that does not lack mixed<note placement="foot">Or “blended”</note> wine!<l eID="gen14653" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14654"/>Your belly <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a heap of wheat<l eID="gen14654" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14655"/>encircled with lilies. <l eID="gen14655" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7329"/><l level="1" sID="gen14656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7329"/>Your two breasts <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like two fawns,<l eID="gen14656" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14657"/>twins of a gazelle. <l eID="gen14657" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7330"/><l level="1" sID="gen14658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7330"/>Your neck <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a tower of ivory;<l eID="gen14658" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14659"/>your eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> pools in Heshbon at the gate of Beth Rabbim.<l eID="gen14659" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14660"/>Your nose <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the tower of Lebanon<l eID="gen14660" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14661"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞looking out over Damascus⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “looking out over the face of Damascus”</note> <l eID="gen14661" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7331"/><l level="1" sID="gen14662"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7331"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Your head crowns you like Carmel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “Your head is on you like the Carmel”</note><note placement="foot">Because of its height and fertility, Mount Carmel is often associated with royalty</note><l eID="gen14662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14663"/>the flowing locks of your head <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞purple tapestry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the purple”</note><l eID="gen14663" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14664"/>a king is held captive in the tresses! <l eID="gen14664" level="3"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7332"/><l level="1" sID="gen14665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7332"/>How beautiful you are and how pleasant,<l eID="gen14665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14666"/>O loved one in the delights! <l eID="gen14666" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7333"/><l level="1" sID="gen14667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7333"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Your stature⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “this your height”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the palm tree,<l eID="gen14667" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14668"/>and your breasts <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like clusters. <l eID="gen14668" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7334"/><l level="1" sID="gen14669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7334"/>I say, “I will climb up the palm tree;<l eID="gen14669" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14670"/>I will lay hold of its fruit clusters.”<l eID="gen14670" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14671"/>Let your breasts <transChange type="added">be pleasing</transChange> like clusters of the vine<l eID="gen14671" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14672"/>and the scent of your breath like the apples. <l eID="gen14672" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7335"/><l level="1" sID="gen14673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7335"/>Your palate <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the best wine that goes down for my beloved,<l eID="gen14673" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14674"/>smoothly gliding over my lips and teeth.<note placement="foot">Or “over lips of sleepers.” One Hebrew textual tradition preserves the reading “lips of those who sleep” (MT). Another Hebrew tradition reads “my lips and my teeth,” as reflected by the ancient versions (LXX, Latin Vulgate, Aramaic Targum, Syriac Peshitta). The latter is adopted here since it makes the most sense poetically</note><l eID="gen14674" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen14647"/> <title type="x-s">Mutual Possession Refrain</title> <div sID="gen14675" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14675" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7336"/><lg sID="gen14676"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7336"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I belong to my beloved⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I am for my beloved”</note><l eID="gen14677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14678"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and he desires me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “and his desire is for me.” Or “and his desire belongs to me”</note><l eID="gen14678" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen14676"/> <title type="x-s">Rendezvous in the Countryside</title> <div sID="gen14679" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14679" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7337"/><lg sID="gen14680"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7337"/>Come, my beloved, let us <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞go out to the countryside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “go forth into the field”</note><l eID="gen14681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14682"/>let us spend the night<note placement="foot">Or “lodge”</note> in the villages. <l eID="gen14682" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7338"/><l level="1" sID="gen14683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7338"/>Let us rise early <transChange type="added">to go</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “let us go”</note> to the vineyards;<l eID="gen14683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14684"/>let us see whether the vine has budded,<note placement="foot">Or “sprouted”</note><l eID="gen14684" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14685"/><transChange type="added">whether</transChange> the grape blossom has opened,<l eID="gen14685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14686"/>and <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> the pomegranates <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are in bloom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “have bloomed”</note><l eID="gen14686" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14687"/>there I will give my love to you. <l eID="gen14687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7339"/><l level="1" sID="gen14688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7339"/>The mandrakes give <transChange type="added">off their</transChange> fragrance,<l eID="gen14688" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14689"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞over our doorway is every kind of delicious fruit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Or “over our doorways all choice things”</note><l eID="gen14689" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14690"/>both <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fresh and dried fruit I have stored up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “new also old I have laid up”</note> for you, O my beloved. <l eID="gen14690" level="1"/><lg eID="gen14680"/> <chapter eID="Song.7"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7340"/><title type="x-s">Maiden’s Fanciful Wish</title> <div sID="gen14691" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen14691" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen14692"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7340"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How I wish that you were my little brother⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “O that he would give you like a brother to me”</note><note placement="foot">The Hebrew construction (which is somewhat misleading if rendered in a woodenly literal sense) is an idiom expressing one’s fanciful wish</note><l eID="gen14693" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14694"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> nursed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upon my mother’s breasts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “at the breast of my mother”</note><l eID="gen14694" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14695"/><transChange type="added">If</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I met you outside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I will find you in the street”</note> I would kiss you,<l eID="gen14695" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14696"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and no one would despise me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “also they would not despise me”</note> <l eID="gen14696" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7341"/><l level="1" sID="gen14697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7341"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I would surely bring you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I would lead you and I would bring you”</note><note placement="foot">The combination of the two verbs creates a hendiadys which may be rendered more cogently as “I would surely bring you …”</note> to the house of my mother,<l eID="gen14697" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14698"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who would surely teach me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “she will teach me”</note><l eID="gen14698" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14699"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I would give you spiced wine to drink⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I would give you to drink from the wine of the spice”</note><l eID="gen14699" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14700"/>the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sweet wine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “juice”</note> of my pomegranates.<note placement="foot">The traditional Hebrew reads the singular “my pomegranate.” However, the plural reading “my pomegranates” is attested in numerous medieval Hebrew manuscripts and is reflected in the ancient versions (Greek Septuagint, Aramaic Targum, Syriac Peshitta). The latter makes the most sense in this context as a euphemistic description of the maiden’s delights</note><l eID="gen14700" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen14692"/> <title type="x-s">Double Refrain: Embrace and Adjuration</title> <div sID="gen14701" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14701" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7342"/><lg sID="gen14702"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7342"/>His left <transChange type="added">hand is</transChange> under my head,<l eID="gen14703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14704"/>and his right <transChange type="added">hand</transChange> embraces<note placement="foot">Or “embraced”</note> me. <l eID="gen14704" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7343"/><l level="1" sID="gen14705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7343"/>I adjure you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O maidens of Jerusalem⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “O daughters of Jerusalem”</note><l eID="gen14705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14706"/>do not<note placement="foot">Or “Why must you … before it pleases?”</note> arouse or awaken love until it pleases!<note placement="foot">Or “Do not stir up or awaken the love until it is willing,” or “Do not disturb or interrupt our lovemaking until it is satisfied”</note><l eID="gen14706" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen14702"/> <title type="x-s">Up from the Wilderness and under the Apple Tree</title> <div sID="gen14707" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14707" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7344"/><lg sID="gen14708"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7344"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this coming up from the wilderness,<l eID="gen14709" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14710"/>leaning upon her beloved?<l eID="gen14710" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14711"/>Under the apple tree I awakened you;<l eID="gen14711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14712"/>there your mother <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞conceived you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “was in labor with you”</note><l eID="gen14712" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14713"/>there she who was in labor gave birth to you.<l eID="gen14713" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen14708"/> <title type="x-s">The Nature of Genuine Romantic Love</title> <div sID="gen14714" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14714" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7345"/><lg sID="gen14715"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7345"/>Set me as a seal upon your heart,<l eID="gen14716" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14717"/>as a seal upon your arm;<l eID="gen14717" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14718"/>for love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> strong as death;<l eID="gen14718" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14719"/>passion <transChange type="added">is</transChange> fierce as Sheol;<l eID="gen14719" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14720"/>its flashes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> flashes of fire;<l eID="gen14720" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14721"/><transChange type="added">it is</transChange> a blazing flame. <l eID="gen14721" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7346"/><l level="1" sID="gen14722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7346"/>Many waters cannot quench love;<l eID="gen14722" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14723"/>rivers cannot sweep it away.<note placement="foot">Or “and rivers cannot engulf it”</note><l eID="gen14723" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14724"/>If a man were to give all the wealth of his house <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for love⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the love”</note><l eID="gen14724" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14725"/>he would be utterly scorned.<note placement="foot">Literally “they will utterly scorn him”</note><l eID="gen14725" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen14715"/> <title type="x-s">Maiden’s Virtuous Chastity and Voluptuous Beauty</title> <div sID="gen14726" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14726" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7347"/><lg sID="gen14727"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7347"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞We have a little sister⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a little sister for us”</note><l eID="gen14728" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14729"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and she does not yet have any breasts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and there is no breast for her”</note><l eID="gen14729" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14730"/>What should we do for our sister<l eID="gen14730" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14731"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the day when she is betrothed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “on the day when it is spoken of her”</note><note placement="foot">Or “on the day when she is spoken for”</note> <l eID="gen14731" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7348"/><l level="1" sID="gen14732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7348"/>If she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a wall,<l eID="gen14732" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14733"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞we will adorn her with a turret of silver⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “we will build upon her a camp of silver”</note><note placement="foot">The term translated “turret” refers to the decorative parapet adorning the top of a building. This image is likely figurative for a silver tiara set upon the head</note><l eID="gen14733" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14734"/>but if she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a door,<l eID="gen14734" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14735"/>we will barricade her with boards of cedar.<note placement="foot">Or “we will enclose her”</note> <l eID="gen14735" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7349"/><l level="1" sID="gen14736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7349"/>I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a wall, and my breasts <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like the towers,<l eID="gen14736" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14737"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so <transChange type="added">my betrothed</transChange> viewed me with great delight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “then I was in his eyes as one who finds peace”</note><l eID="gen14737" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen14727"/> <title type="x-s">Solomon’s Vineyard and the Maiden’s Gift</title> <div sID="gen14738" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14738" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7350"/><lg sID="gen14739"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7350"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Solomon had a vineyard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “A vineyard was for Solomon”</note> at Baal-hamon;<l eID="gen14740" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14741"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he entrusted his vineyard to the keepers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “he gave the vineyard to the keepers”</note><l eID="gen14741" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14742"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people paid a thousand silver <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> for its fruit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “each one brought a thousand silver pieces for his fruit”</note> <l eID="gen14742" level="2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7351"/><l level="1" sID="gen14743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7351"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞My own “vineyard” belongs to me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “My vineyard that for me before my face”</note><l eID="gen14743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14744"/>the “thousand” are for you, O Solomon,<l eID="gen14744" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14745"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and “two hundred” for those who tend its fruit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and two hundred for the keepers of his fruit”</note><l eID="gen14745" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen14739"/> <title type="x-s">Closing Words of Mutual Love</title> <div sID="gen14746" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14746" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7352"/><lg sID="gen14747"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7352"/>O you who dwell in the garden,<l eID="gen14748" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14749"/><transChange type="added">my</transChange> companions are listening to your voice.<l eID="gen14749" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14750"/>Let me hear <transChange type="added">it</transChange>! <l eID="gen14750" level="3"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7353"/><l level="1" sID="gen14751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7353"/>Flee, my beloved!<l eID="gen14751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14752"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Be like a gazelle⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and be like for you to a gazelle”</note> or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a young stag⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the fawn of the stag”</note><l eID="gen14752" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14753"/>upon <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the perfumed mountains⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountains of spices”</note> <l eID="gen14753" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen14747"/> <chapter eID="Song.8"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen14315" osisID="Song" type="book"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7354"/><title type="x-s">Superscription</title> <div sID="gen14755" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7354"/>The vision of Isaiah son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> Hezekiah, kings of Judah. <div eID="gen14755" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">Rebellious Judah</title> <div sID="gen14756" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14756" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7355"/><lg sID="gen14757"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7355"/>Hear, heavens,<l eID="gen14758" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14759"/>and listen, earth,<l eID="gen14759" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14760"/>for Yahweh has spoken:<l eID="gen14760" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14761"/>“I reared children<l eID="gen14761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14762"/>and I brought <transChange type="added">them</transChange> up,<l eID="gen14762" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14763"/>but they rebelled against me. <l eID="gen14763" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7356"/><l level="1" sID="gen14764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7356"/>An ox knows its owner<l eID="gen14764" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14765"/>and a donkey the manger of its master.<l eID="gen14765" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14766"/>Israel does not know;<l eID="gen14766" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14767"/>my people do not understand. <l eID="gen14767" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7357"/><l level="1" sID="gen14768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7357"/>Ah, sinful nation,<l eID="gen14768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14769"/>a people heavy <transChange type="added">with</transChange> iniquity,<l eID="gen14769" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14770"/>offspring of evildoers,<l eID="gen14770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14771"/>children who deal corruptly.<l eID="gen14771" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14772"/>They have forsaken Yahweh;<l eID="gen14772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14773"/>they have despised the holy one of Israel.<l eID="gen14773" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14774"/>They are estranged <transChange type="added">and gone</transChange> backward. <l eID="gen14774" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7358"/><l level="1" sID="gen14775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7358"/>Why do you want to be beaten again?<l eID="gen14775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14776"/>You continue <transChange type="added">in</transChange> rebellion.<l eID="gen14776" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14777"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> whole of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sick,<l eID="gen14777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14778"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> whole of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> faint. <l eID="gen14778" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7359"/><l level="1" sID="gen14779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7359"/>From the sole of the foot and up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head<l eID="gen14779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14780"/>there is no health in it;<l eID="gen14780" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14781"/>bruise and sore and bleeding wound have not been cleansed,<l eID="gen14781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14782"/>and they have not been bound up<l eID="gen14782" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14783"/>and not softened with the oil. <l eID="gen14783" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7360"/><l level="1" sID="gen14784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7360"/>Your country <transChange type="added">is</transChange> desolate,<l eID="gen14784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14785"/>your cities <transChange type="added">are</transChange> burned <transChange type="added">with</transChange> fire;<l eID="gen14785" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14786"/><transChange type="added">As for</transChange> your land, aliens are devouring it in your presence,<l eID="gen14786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14787"/>and <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> desolate, like devastation <transChange type="added">by</transChange> foreigners. <l eID="gen14787" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7361"/><l level="1" sID="gen14788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7361"/>And the daughter of Zion is left like a booth in a vineyard,<l eID="gen14788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14789"/>like a shelter in a cucumber field,<l eID="gen14789" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14790"/>like a city that is besieged.<note placement="foot">Or “preserved”</note> <l eID="gen14790" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7362"/><l level="1" sID="gen14791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7362"/>If Yahweh of hosts had not left us survivors,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “survivor”</note><l eID="gen14791" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14792"/>we would have been as few as Sodom,<l eID="gen14792" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14793"/>we would have become like Gomorrah. <l eID="gen14793" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7363"/><l level="1" sID="gen14794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7363"/>Hear the word of Yahweh, rulers of Sodom!<l eID="gen14794" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14795"/>Listen <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the teaching of our God, people of Gomorrah! <l eID="gen14795" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7364"/><l level="1" sID="gen14796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7364"/>What <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> abundance of your sacrifices to me? says Yahweh.<l eID="gen14796" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14797"/>I have had enough <transChange type="added">of</transChange> burnt offerings of rams<l eID="gen14797" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14798"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fat <transChange type="added">of</transChange> fattened animals<l eID="gen14798" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14799"/>and I do not delight in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blood of bulls<l eID="gen14799" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14800"/>and ram-lambs and goats. <l eID="gen14800" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7365"/><l level="1" sID="gen14801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7365"/>When you come to appear before me,<l eID="gen14801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14802"/>who asked for this from your hand:<l eID="gen14802" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14803"/>you trampling my courts? <l eID="gen14803" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7366"/><l level="1" sID="gen14804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7366"/>You must not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continue⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “increase” or “add to”</note> to bring offerings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “offering”</note> of futility,<l eID="gen14804" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14805"/>incense—it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an abomination to me;<l eID="gen14805" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14806"/>new moon and Sabbath, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> calling of a convocation—<l eID="gen14806" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14807"/>I cannot endure iniquity with <transChange type="added">solemn</transChange> assembly. <l eID="gen14807" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7367"/><l level="1" sID="gen14808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7367"/>Your new moons and your appointed festivals my soul hates;<l eID="gen14808" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14809"/>they have become to me like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> burden,<l eID="gen14809" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14810"/>I am not able to bear <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <l eID="gen14810" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7368"/><l level="1" sID="gen14811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7368"/>And when you stretch out your hands,<l eID="gen14811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14812"/>I will hide my eyes from you;<l eID="gen14812" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14813"/>even though you make many prayers,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “prayer”</note><l eID="gen14813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14814"/>I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> not be listening.<l eID="gen14814" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14815"/>Your hands are full of blood.

verses.name: Isaiah 1:16
verses.text: Wash! Make yourselves clean!<l eID="gen14815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14816"/>Remove the evil of your doings from before my eyes!<l eID="gen14816" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14817"/>Cease to do evil!

verses.name: Isaiah 1:17
verses.text: Learn to do good!<l eID="gen14817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14818"/>Seek justice! Rescue <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppressed!<l eID="gen14818" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14819"/>Defend <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan! Plead for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow! <l eID="gen14819" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7369"/><l level="1" sID="gen14820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7369"/>“Come now, and let us argue,” says Yahweh.<l eID="gen14820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14821"/>“Even though your sins are like scarlet, they will be white like snow;<l eID="gen14821" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14822"/>even though they are red like crimson, they shall become like wool. <l eID="gen14822" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7370"/><l level="1" sID="gen14823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7370"/>If you are willing and you are obedient,<l eID="gen14823" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14824"/>you shall eat the good of the land. <l eID="gen14824" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7371"/><l level="1" sID="gen14825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7371"/>But if you refuse and you rebel, you shall be devoured <transChange type="added">by the</transChange> sword.<l eID="gen14825" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen14757"/> <div sID="gen14826" type="x-p"/> For the mouth of Yahweh has spoken.” <div eID="gen14826" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">Purifying Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen14827" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14827" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7372"/><lg sID="gen14828"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7372"/>How has a faithful city become like a whore?<l eID="gen14829" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14830"/>Full of justice, righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers. <l eID="gen14830" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7373"/><l level="1" sID="gen14831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7373"/>Your silver has become <transChange type="added">as</transChange> dross;<l eID="gen14831" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14832"/>Your wine <transChange type="added">is</transChange> diluted with waters. <l eID="gen14832" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7374"/><l level="1" sID="gen14833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7374"/>Your princes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> rebels<l eID="gen14833" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14834"/>and companions of thieves.<l eID="gen14834" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14835"/>Every one loves a bribe<l eID="gen14835" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14836"/>and runs after gifts.<l eID="gen14836" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14837"/>They do not defend <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan<l eID="gen14837" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14838"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> legal dispute of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow does not come before them. <l eID="gen14838" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7375"/><l level="1" sID="gen14839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7375"/>Therefore, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel:<l eID="gen14839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14840"/>“Ah, I will be relieved of my enemies,<l eID="gen14840" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14841"/>and I will avenge myself on my foes. <l eID="gen14841" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7376"/><l level="1" sID="gen14842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7376"/>And I will turn my hand against you;<l eID="gen14842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14843"/>I will purify your dross like lye,<l eID="gen14843" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14844"/>and I will remove all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your tin. <l eID="gen14844" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7377"/><l level="1" sID="gen14845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7377"/>And I will restore your judges, as at the first,<l eID="gen14845" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14846"/>and your counselors, as at the beginning.<l eID="gen14846" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14847"/>After this <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will be called⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it will be called for you”</note> the city of righteousness,<l eID="gen14847" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14848"/>faithful city. <l eID="gen14848" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7378"/><l level="1" sID="gen14849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7378"/>Zion will be redeemed by justice,<l eID="gen14849" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14850"/>and those of her who repent, by righteousness. <l eID="gen14850" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7379"/><l level="1" sID="gen14851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7379"/>But <transChange type="added">the</transChange> destruction <transChange type="added">of</transChange> rebels and sinners <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> together,<l eID="gen14851" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14852"/>and those who forsake Yahweh will perish. <l eID="gen14852" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7380"/><l level="1" sID="gen14853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7380"/>For you<note placement="foot">Literally “they,” but a few manuscripts read “you,” which fits the context better</note> will be ashamed of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oaks <transChange type="added">in</transChange> which you delighted,<l eID="gen14853" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14854"/>and you will be disgraced because of the gardens that you have chosen. <l eID="gen14854" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7381"/><l level="1" sID="gen14855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7381"/>For you shall be like an oak withering its leaves,<l eID="gen14855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14856"/>and like a garden where there is no water for her. <l eID="gen14856" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7382"/><l level="1" sID="gen14857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7382"/>And the strong <transChange type="added">man</transChange> shall become like tinder,<l eID="gen14857" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14858"/>and his work like a spark.<l eID="gen14858" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14859"/>And both of them shall burn together,<l eID="gen14859" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14860"/>and there is not one to quench <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.” <l eID="gen14860" level="2"/><lg eID="gen14828"/> <chapter eID="Isa.1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7383"/><title type="x-s">The Mountain of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen14861" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7383"/>The word that Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem:  <div eID="gen14861" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7384"/><lg sID="gen14862"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7384"/>And it shall happen in the future of the days<l eID="gen14863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14864"/>the mountain of the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> be established;<l eID="gen14864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14865"/>it will be among the highest<note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note> of the mountains,<l eID="gen14865" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14866"/>and it shall be raised from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hills.<l eID="gen14866" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14867"/>All <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the nations shall travel to him; <l eID="gen14867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7385"/><l level="2" sID="gen14868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7385"/>many peoples shall come.<l eID="gen14868" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14869"/>And they shall say,<l eID="gen14869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14870"/>“Come, let us go up to the mountain of Yahweh,<l eID="gen14870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14871"/>to the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of the God of Jacob,<l eID="gen14871" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14872"/>and may he teach us part of his ways,<l eID="gen14872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14873"/>and let us walk in his paths.”<l eID="gen14873" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14874"/>For instruction shall go out from Zion,<l eID="gen14874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14875"/>and the word of Yahweh from Jerusalem. <l eID="gen14875" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7386"/><l level="1" sID="gen14876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7386"/>He shall judge between the nations<l eID="gen14876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14877"/>and he shall arbitrate for many peoples.<l eID="gen14877" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14878"/>They shall beat their swords into ploughshares<l eID="gen14878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14879"/>and their spears into pruning hooks.<l eID="gen14879" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14880"/>A nation shall not lift up a sword against a nation,<l eID="gen14880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14881"/>and they shall not learn war again.<l eID="gen14881" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen14862"/> <title type="x-s">The Day of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen14882" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14882" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7387"/><lg sID="gen14883"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7387"/>House of Jacob, come and let us walk in the light of Yahweh. <l eID="gen14884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7388"/><l level="1" sID="gen14885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7388"/>For you have forsaken your people, house of Jacob,<l eID="gen14885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14886"/>because they are full<note placement="foot">Possibly “of diviners” was part of the original text here</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east,<l eID="gen14886" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14887"/>and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> soothsayers like the Philistines,<l eID="gen14887" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14888"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they make alliances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they clap hands”</note> with the offspring of foreigners. <l eID="gen14888" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7389"/><l level="1" sID="gen14889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7389"/>And its land is filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> silver and gold,<l eID="gen14889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14890"/>and there is no end to its treasures;<l eID="gen14890" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14891"/>and its land is filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> horses,<l eID="gen14891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14892"/>and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no end to its chariots. <l eID="gen14892" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7390"/><l level="1" sID="gen14893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7390"/>Its land is filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> idols;<l eID="gen14893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14894"/>they bow down to the work of their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> hands,<l eID="gen14894" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14895"/>to what they made <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> fingers. <l eID="gen14895" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7391"/><l level="1" sID="gen14896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7391"/>So humanity is humbled;<l eID="gen14896" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14897"/>everyone is humbled,<l eID="gen14897" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14898"/>and you must not forgive them. <l eID="gen14898" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7392"/><l level="1" sID="gen14899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7392"/>Enter into the rock<l eID="gen14899" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14900"/>and hide yourself in the dust<l eID="gen14900" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14901"/>from the presence of the terror of Yahweh<l eID="gen14901" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14902"/>and from the glory of his majesty. <l eID="gen14902" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7393"/><l level="1" sID="gen14903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7393"/>The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞haughty eyes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “eyes of the haughtiness”</note> of humanity will<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is singular</note> be brought low,<l eID="gen14903" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14904"/>and the pride of everyone will be humbled,<l eID="gen14904" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14905"/>and Yahweh alone will be exalted on that day. <l eID="gen14905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7394"/><l level="1" sID="gen14906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7394"/>For <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> a day for Yahweh of hosts<l eID="gen14906" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14907"/>against all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> proud and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lofty<l eID="gen14907" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14908"/>and against all that is lifted up and humble,<note placement="foot">Or “it will be humbled”</note> <l eID="gen14908" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7395"/><l level="1" sID="gen14909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7395"/>and against all the lofty and lifted up cedars of Lebanon,<l eID="gen14909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14910"/>and against all the large trees of Bashan, <l eID="gen14910" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7396"/><l level="1" sID="gen14911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7396"/>and against all the high mountains,<l eID="gen14911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14912"/>and against all the lofty hills, <l eID="gen14912" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7397"/><l level="1" sID="gen14913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7397"/>and against every kind of high tower,<l eID="gen14913" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14914"/>and against every kind of fortified wall, <l eID="gen14914" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7398"/><l level="1" sID="gen14915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7398"/>and against all the ships of Tarshish,<l eID="gen14915" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14916"/>and against all the ships of desire. <l eID="gen14916" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7399"/><l level="1" sID="gen14917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7399"/>And the haughtiness of the people shall be humbled,<l eID="gen14917" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14918"/>and the pride of everyone shall be brought low,<l eID="gen14918" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14919"/>and Yahweh alone will be exalted on that day. <l eID="gen14919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7400"/><l level="1" sID="gen14920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7400"/>And the idols shall pass away entirely, <l eID="gen14920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7401"/><l level="1" sID="gen14921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7401"/>and they will enter into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> caves of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rocks<l eID="gen14921" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14922"/>and into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ground<l eID="gen14922" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14923"/>from the presence of the terror of Yahweh<l eID="gen14923" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14924"/>and from the glory of his majesty<l eID="gen14924" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14925"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he rises⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his rising”</note> to terrify the earth. <l eID="gen14925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7402"/><l level="1" sID="gen14926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7402"/>On that day humanity will throw away its idols of silver<l eID="gen14926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14927"/>and its idols of gold,<l eID="gen14927" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14928"/>which they made for it to worship,<l eID="gen14928" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14929"/>to the rodents<note placement="foot">Or “moles”</note> and to the bats— <l eID="gen14929" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7403"/><l level="1" sID="gen14930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7403"/>to enter into the crevices of the rocks<l eID="gen14930" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14931"/>and into the clefts of the crags<l eID="gen14931" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14932"/>from the presence of the terror of Yahweh<l eID="gen14932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14933"/>and from the glory of his majesty,<l eID="gen14933" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14934"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he rises⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his rising”</note> to terrify the earth. <l eID="gen14934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7404"/><l level="1" sID="gen14935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7404"/>Turn away from humanity,<l eID="gen14935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14936"/>who <transChange type="added">has</transChange> breath in its nostrils,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “nostril”</note><l eID="gen14936" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14937"/>for by<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> it esteemed? <l eID="gen14937" level="1"/><lg eID="gen14883"/> <chapter eID="Isa.2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7405"/><title type="x-s">Leaders of Judah and Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen14938" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen14938" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen14939"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7405"/>For look, the Lord Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> removing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every source of support⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “supplies and supplies”</note><l eID="gen14940" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14941"/>from Jerusalem and from Judah:<l eID="gen14941" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14942"/>all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> supplies of bread<l eID="gen14942" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14943"/>and all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> supplies of water, <l eID="gen14943" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7406"/><l level="1" sID="gen14944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7406"/>mighty warrior and man of war,<l eID="gen14944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14945"/>judge and prophet,<l eID="gen14945" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14946"/>and diviner and elder, <l eID="gen14946" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7407"/><l level="1" sID="gen14947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7407"/>captain of fifty and the honorable men of rank,<l eID="gen14947" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14948"/>and counselor and skillful magicians and skillful enchanter. <l eID="gen14948" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7408"/><l level="1" sID="gen14949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7408"/>And I will make boys their princes,<l eID="gen14949" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14950"/>and children shall rule over them. <l eID="gen14950" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7409"/><l level="1" sID="gen14951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7409"/>And the people will be oppressed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by each other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “man by man”</note><l eID="gen14951" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14952"/>and a man by his neighbor.<l eID="gen14952" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14953"/>The boy will act arrogantly toward the elder,<l eID="gen14953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14954"/>and the dishonorable toward the honorable. <l eID="gen14954" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7410"/><l level="1" sID="gen14955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7410"/>Indeed, a man will seize his brother<l eID="gen14955" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14956"/><transChange type="added">in</transChange> the house of his father:<l eID="gen14956" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14957"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You have a cloak⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a cloak for you”</note><l eID="gen14957" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14958"/>you shall be a leader for us,<l eID="gen14958" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14959"/>and this heap of ruins <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> under your hand!” <l eID="gen14959" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7411"/><l level="1" sID="gen14960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7411"/>He will lift up <transChange type="added">his voice</transChange> on that day, saying,<l eID="gen14960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14961"/>“I will not be a healer;<l eID="gen14961" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14962"/>in my house there is no bread<l eID="gen14962" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14963"/>and there is no cloak.<l eID="gen14963" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14964"/>You shall not make me <transChange type="added">the</transChange> leader of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people!” <l eID="gen14964" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7412"/><l level="1" sID="gen14965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7412"/>For Jerusalem has stumbled,<l eID="gen14965" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14966"/>and Judah has fallen<l eID="gen14966" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14967"/>because their speech and their deeds <transChange type="added">are</transChange> against Yahweh,<l eID="gen14967" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14968"/>defying the eyes of his glory. <l eID="gen14968" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7413"/><l level="1" sID="gen14969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7413"/>The look on their faces testifies against them<l eID="gen14969" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14970"/>and they declare their sin like Sodom;<l eID="gen14970" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14971"/>they do not hide <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<l eID="gen14971" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14972"/>Woe to their soul!<l eID="gen14972" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14973"/>For they have dealt out evil to themselves. <l eID="gen14973" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7414"/><l level="1" sID="gen14974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7414"/>Tell <transChange type="added">the</transChange> innocent<note placement="foot">Singular</note> that <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> good<l eID="gen14974" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14975"/>for they shall eat the fruit of their deeds. <l eID="gen14975" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7415"/><l level="1" sID="gen14976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7415"/>Woe to the wicked!<note placement="foot">Singular</note> <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> bad!<l eID="gen14976" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14977"/>For what is done <transChange type="added">by</transChange> his hands will be done to him. <l eID="gen14977" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7416"/><l level="1" sID="gen14978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7416"/>My people—children are their oppressors,<l eID="gen14978" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14979"/>and women rule over them.<l eID="gen14979" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14980"/>My people, your leaders are misleading <transChange type="added">you</transChange>,<l eID="gen14980" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14981"/>and they confuse the course of your paths. <l eID="gen14981" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7417"/><l level="1" sID="gen14982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7417"/>Yahweh takes his stand to conduct a legal case<l eID="gen14982" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14983"/>and takes his stand to judge <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples. <l eID="gen14983" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7418"/><l level="1" sID="gen14984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7418"/>Yahweh enters into judgment with the elders of his people and its princes.<l eID="gen14984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14985"/>“And you! You have devoured the vineyard;<l eID="gen14985" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14986"/>the spoil of the poor <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your houses! <l eID="gen14986" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7419"/><l level="1" sID="gen14987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7419"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Why⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “What to you”</note> do you crush my people<l eID="gen14987" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14988"/>and grind <transChange type="added">the</transChange> face of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor?”<l eID="gen14988" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen14939"/> <div sID="gen14989" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh of hosts. <div eID="gen14989" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">The Pride of Jerusalem’s Women</title> <div sID="gen14990" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen14990" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7420"/><lg sID="gen14991"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7420"/>And Yahweh said: “Because<note placement="foot">There are two Hebrew words for “because” here</note> the daughters of Zion are haughty,<l eID="gen14992" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14993"/>and they walk <transChange type="added">with</transChange> outstretched neck,<l eID="gen14993" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14994"/>and they give flirting glances <transChange type="added">with their</transChange> eyes,<l eID="gen14994" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen14995"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mincing along as they go⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they go walking and mincing along”</note><l eID="gen14995" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14996"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with their feet they rattle their bangles⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they tinkle with their feet”</note> <l eID="gen14996" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7421"/><l level="1" sID="gen14997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7421"/>the Lord will make the heads<note placement="foot">Hebrew “head”</note> of the daughters of Zion scabby,<l eID="gen14997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14998"/>and Yahweh will lay their foreheads bare.” <l eID="gen14998" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7422"/><l level="1" sID="gen14999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7422"/>In that day the Lord will take away the finery of the anklets<l eID="gen14999" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15000"/>and the headbands and the crescent necklaces, <l eID="gen15000" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7423"/><l level="1" sID="gen15001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7423"/>the pendants and the bracelets and the veils, <l eID="gen15001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7424"/><l level="2" sID="gen15002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7424"/>the headdresses and the armlets and the sashes,<l eID="gen15002" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15003"/>and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞perfume boxes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “houses of the breath”</note> and the amulets, <l eID="gen15003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7425"/><l level="2" sID="gen15004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7425"/>the signet rings and the nose rings, <l eID="gen15004" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7426"/><l level="1" sID="gen15005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7426"/>the festal robes and the mantles,<l eID="gen15005" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15006"/>and the cloaks and the handbags, <l eID="gen15006" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7427"/><l level="1" sID="gen15007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7427"/>and the mirrors and the linen garments,<l eID="gen15007" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15008"/>and the turbans and the wraps. <l eID="gen15008" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7428"/><l level="1" sID="gen15009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7428"/>And this shall happen: There will be<l eID="gen15009" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15010"/>a stench instead of perfume,<l eID="gen15010" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15011"/>and a rope instead of a sash,<l eID="gen15011" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15012"/>and baldness instead of a well-set hairdo,<l eID="gen15012" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15013"/>and a clothing wrap of sackcloth instead of a rich robe,<l eID="gen15013" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15014"/>branding instead of beauty. <l eID="gen15014" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7429"/><l level="1" sID="gen15015"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7429"/>Your men shall fall by the sword,<l eID="gen15015" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15016"/>and your warriors in battle. <l eID="gen15016" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7430"/><l level="1" sID="gen15017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7430"/>And her<note placement="foot">That is, Jerusalem’s</note> gates shall lament and mourn,<l eID="gen15017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15018"/>and she shall be banished;<l eID="gen15018" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15019"/>she shall sit upon the ground. <l eID="gen15019" level="3"/><lg eID="gen14991"/> <chapter eID="Isa.3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:1
verses.text: And seven women shall grasp at one man on that day, saying,<l eID="gen15022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15023"/>“We will eat our own bread,<l eID="gen15023" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15024"/>and we will wear our own clothing;<l eID="gen15024" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15025"/>only <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞let us be called by your name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “let your name be called upon us”</note><l eID="gen15025" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15026"/>Take away our disgrace!”<l eID="gen15026" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15021"/> <title type="x-s">The Glory of the Branch of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen15027" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen15027" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7431"/><lg sID="gen15028"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7431"/>On that day the branch of Yahweh shall become beautiful and glorious,<l eID="gen15029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15030"/>and the fruit of the land <transChange type="added">shall become the</transChange> pride and glory of the survivors<note placement="foot">Hebrew “survivor”</note> of Israel. <l eID="gen15030" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7432"/><l level="1" sID="gen15031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7432"/>And this shall happen: He who is left in Zion<l eID="gen15031" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15032"/>and he who remains in Jerusalem will be called holy,<l eID="gen15032" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15033"/>everyone written for life in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen15033" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7433"/><l level="1" sID="gen15034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7433"/>when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion<l eID="gen15034" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15035"/>and cleansed the blood of Jerusalem from her midst<l eID="gen15035" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15036"/>by a spirit of judgment<l eID="gen15036" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15037"/>and by a spirit of burning. <l eID="gen15037" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:5
