verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7434"/><l level="1" sID="gen15038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7434"/>Then Yahweh will create over all of the site<note placement="foot">Or “place”</note> of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Zion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Zion”</note><l eID="gen15038" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15039"/>and over her assembly a cloud by day<l eID="gen15039" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15040"/>and smoke and the brightness of flaming fire <transChange type="added">by</transChange> night.<l eID="gen15040" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15041"/>Indeed, over all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> glory <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> a canopy, <l eID="gen15041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7435"/><l level="2" sID="gen15042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7435"/>and it will be a shelter for shade from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heat by day,<l eID="gen15042" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15043"/>and a refuge and a hiding place from rainstorm and from rain. <l eID="gen15043" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15028"/> <chapter eID="Isa.4"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7436"/><title type="x-s">The Song of the Vineyard</title> <div sID="gen15044" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen15044" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15045"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7436"/>Let me sing for my beloved<l eID="gen15046" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15047"/>a song of my love concerning his vineyard:<l eID="gen15047" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15048"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞My beloved had a vineyard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “A vineyard was for my beloved”</note> on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a fertile hill⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a horn of a son of olive oil.” The Hebrew for horn, <hi type="italic">qeren</hi>, sounds like the Hebrew for vineyard, <hi type="italic">kerem</hi></note> <l eID="gen15048" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7437"/><l level="1" sID="gen15049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7437"/>And he dug it and cleared it of stones,<l eID="gen15049" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15050"/>and he planted it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> choice vines,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “vine”</note><l eID="gen15050" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15051"/>and he built a watchtower in the middle of it,<l eID="gen15051" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15052"/>and he even hewed out a wine vat in it,<l eID="gen15052" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15053"/>and he waited for <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to yield grapes—<l eID="gen15053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15054"/>but it yielded wild grapes. <l eID="gen15054" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7438"/><l level="1" sID="gen15055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7438"/>And now, inhabitants of Jerusalem<l eID="gen15055" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15056"/>and men<note placement="foot">Hebrew “man”</note> of Judah, judge between me and my vineyard. <l eID="gen15056" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7439"/><l level="1" sID="gen15057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7439"/>What more <transChange type="added">was there</transChange> to do for my vineyard that I have not done in it?<l eID="gen15057" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15058"/>Why did I hope for <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to yield grapes, and it yielded wild grapes? <l eID="gen15058" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15045"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7440"/><div sID="gen15059" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7440"/>And now let me tell you what I myself am about to do to my vineyard. <div eID="gen15059" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15060"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15061"/><transChange type="added">I will</transChange> remove its hedge, and it shall become a devastation.<l eID="gen15061" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15062"/><transChange type="added">I will</transChange> break down its wall, and it shall become a trampling. <l eID="gen15062" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7441"/><l level="1" sID="gen15063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7441"/>And I will make it a wasteland;<l eID="gen15063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15064"/>it shall not be pruned and hoed,<l eID="gen15064" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15065"/>and it shall be overgrown <transChange type="added">with</transChange> briers<note placement="foot">Hebrew “brier”</note> and thornbushes.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thornbush”</note><l eID="gen15065" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15066"/>And concerning the clouds, I will command <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞them not to send⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from sending”</note> rain down upon it. <l eID="gen15066" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7442"/><l level="1" sID="gen15067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7442"/>For the vineyard of Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the house of Israel,<l eID="gen15067" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15068"/>and the man<note placement="foot">Or “people”</note> of Judah <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the plantation of his delight.<l eID="gen15068" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15069"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> he waited for justice,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew word, <hi type="italic">mishpat,</hi> sounds like <hi type="italic">mishpakh</hi> in the next line</note><l eID="gen15069" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15070"/>but look! Bloodshed!<note placement="foot">The Hebrew word, <hi type="italic">mishpakh</hi>, sounds like <hi type="italic">mishpat</hi> in the previous line</note><l eID="gen15070" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15071"/>For righteousness,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew word, <hi type="italic">tsedaqah,</hi> sounds like <hi type="italic">tsa`aqah</hi> in the next line</note><l eID="gen15071" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15072"/>but look! A cry of distress!<note placement="foot">The Hebrew word, <hi type="italic">tsa`aqah,</hi> sounds like <hi type="italic">tsedaqah</hi> in the previous line</note><l eID="gen15072" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15060"/> <title type="x-s">Woes on the Wicked</title> <div sID="gen15073" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen15073" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7443"/><lg sID="gen15074"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15075"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7443"/>Ah! Those who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞join⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “touch”</note> house with house,<l eID="gen15075" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15076"/>they join field together with field<l eID="gen15076" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15077"/>until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there is no place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “an end of place”</note><l eID="gen15077" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15078"/>and you are caused to dwell alone in the midst of the land. <l eID="gen15078" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15074"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7444"/><div sID="gen15079" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7444"/>Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">said</transChange> in my ears: <div eID="gen15079" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15080"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15081"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If not”</note> many houses shall become a desolation,<l eID="gen15081" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15082"/>large and beautiful <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> without inhabitant. <l eID="gen15082" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7445"/><l level="1" sID="gen15083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7445"/>For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath,<note placement="foot">A bath is a liquid measure</note><l eID="gen15083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15084"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seed of a homer will yield an ephah.<note placement="foot">An ephah is a dry measure equal to one-tenth of a homer</note> <l eID="gen15084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7446"/><l level="1" sID="gen15085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7446"/>Ah! Those who rise early in the morning,<l eID="gen15085" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15086"/>they pursue strong drink.<l eID="gen15086" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15087"/>Those who linger in the evening,<l eID="gen15087" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15088"/>wine inflames them. <l eID="gen15088" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7447"/><l level="1" sID="gen15089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7447"/>And <transChange type="added">there</transChange> will be lyre and harp,<l eID="gen15089" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15090"/>tambourine and flute,<l eID="gen15090" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15091"/>and wine <transChange type="added">at</transChange> their feasts,<l eID="gen15091" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15092"/>but they do not look at the deeds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “deed”</note> of Yahweh,<l eID="gen15092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15093"/>and they do not see the work of his hands. <l eID="gen15093" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7448"/><l level="1" sID="gen15094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7448"/>Therefore my people will go into exile without knowledge,<l eID="gen15094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15095"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “its”</note> nobles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “noble”</note> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> men of hunger,<l eID="gen15095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15096"/>and their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “its”</note> multitude <transChange type="added">is</transChange> parched <transChange type="added">with</transChange> thirst. <l eID="gen15096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7449"/><l level="1" sID="gen15097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7449"/>Therefore Sheol has enlarged its throat,<l eID="gen15097" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15098"/>and it has opened wide its mouth without limit,<l eID="gen15098" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15099"/>and her<note placement="foot">That is, Jerusalem’s</note> nobles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “noble”</note> will go down, and her multitude,<l eID="gen15099" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15100"/>her tumult and those who revel in her. <l eID="gen15100" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7450"/><l level="1" sID="gen15101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7450"/>And humankind is bowed down,<l eID="gen15101" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15102"/>and man is brought low,<l eID="gen15102" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15103"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> haughty are humiliated. <l eID="gen15103" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7451"/><l level="1" sID="gen15104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7451"/>But Yahweh of hosts is exalted by justice,<l eID="gen15104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15105"/>and the holy God shows himself holy by righteousness. <l eID="gen15105" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7452"/><l level="1" sID="gen15106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7452"/>And then <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lambs will graze as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> their pasture,<l eID="gen15106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15107"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fatlings, kids<note placement="foot">Following the Septuagint, which reads the Hebrew <hi type="italic">grym</hi> (resident aliens) as <hi type="italic">gdym</hi> (young goats/sheep)</note> will eat among the sites of ruins.⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and ruins, fatlings, resident aliens, will eat”</note> <l eID="gen15107" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7453"/><l level="1" sID="gen15108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7453"/>Ah! Those who drag iniquity along with the cords of falsehood<l eID="gen15108" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15109"/>and sin as with rope of the cart, <l eID="gen15109" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7454"/><l level="1" sID="gen15110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7454"/>those who say,<l eID="gen15110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15111"/>“Let him make haste;<l eID="gen15111" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15112"/>let him hurry his work<l eID="gen15112" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15113"/>so that we may see it<l eID="gen15113" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15114"/>and let it draw near<l eID="gen15114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15115"/>and let the plan of the holy one of Israel come<l eID="gen15115" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15116"/>so that we may know <transChange type="added">it</transChange>!” <l eID="gen15116" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7455"/><l level="1" sID="gen15117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7455"/>Ah! Those who call evil good and good evil,<l eID="gen15117" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15118"/>those who put darkness for light and light for darkness,<l eID="gen15118" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15119"/>those who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter! <l eID="gen15119" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7456"/><l level="1" sID="gen15120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7456"/>Ah! <transChange type="added">Those who are</transChange> wise in their own eyes<l eID="gen15120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15121"/>and have understanding <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their view⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “before their faces”</note> <l eID="gen15121" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7457"/><l level="1" sID="gen15122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7457"/>Ah! Heroes at drinking wine,<l eID="gen15122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15123"/>and men of capability at mixing strong drink! <l eID="gen15123" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7458"/><l level="1" sID="gen15124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7458"/>Those who acquit the guilty because of a bribe<l eID="gen15124" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15125"/>and remove <transChange type="added">the</transChange> justice of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> innocent from him. <l eID="gen15125" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7459"/><l level="1" sID="gen15126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7459"/>Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble,<l eID="gen15126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15127"/>and dry grass sinks down <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> flame,<l eID="gen15127" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15128"/>so their root will become like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stench,<l eID="gen15128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15129"/>and their blossom will go up like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust.<l eID="gen15129" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15130"/>For they have rejected the instruction of Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen15130" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15131"/>and they have treated the word of the holy one of Israel with contempt. <l eID="gen15131" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7460"/><l level="1" sID="gen15132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7460"/>Therefore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh’s wrath was kindled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the anger of Yahweh became hot”</note> against his people,<l eID="gen15132" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15133"/>and he stretched out his hand against them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> and struck them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note><l eID="gen15133" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15134"/>and the mountains quaked,<l eID="gen15134" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15135"/>and their corpses<note placement="foot">Hebrew “corpse”</note> were like refuse in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> middle of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> streets.<l eID="gen15135" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15080"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Outstretched Hand</title> <div sID="gen15136" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen15136" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15137"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15138"/>In all of this his anger has not turned back,<l eID="gen15138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15139"/>and still his hand is stretched out. <l eID="gen15139" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7461"/><l level="1" sID="gen15140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7461"/>And he will raise a signal for a nation<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is plural, but the following verses refer to the nation as singular</note> from afar,<l eID="gen15140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15141"/>and he will whistle for it from the end of the earth.<l eID="gen15141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15142"/>And look! It comes quickly, swiftly! <l eID="gen15142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7462"/><l level="1" sID="gen15143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7462"/>None <transChange type="added">is</transChange> weary,<l eID="gen15143" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15144"/>and none among him stumbles;<l eID="gen15144" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15145"/>none slumbers and none sleeps.<l eID="gen15145" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15146"/>And no loincloth on his waist is opened,<l eID="gen15146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15147"/>and no thong of his sandals is drawn away. <l eID="gen15147" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7463"/><l level="1" sID="gen15148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7463"/>Whose arrows are sharp,<l eID="gen15148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15149"/>and all of his bows are bent.<l eID="gen15149" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15150"/>The hoofs of his horses are reckoned like flint,<l eID="gen15150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15151"/>and his wheels like the storm wind. <l eID="gen15151" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7464"/><l level="1" sID="gen15152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7464"/>His roaring <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the lion,<l eID="gen15152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15153"/>and he roars like young lions.<l eID="gen15153" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15154"/>And he growls and seizes his prey,<l eID="gen15154" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15155"/>and he carries <transChange type="added">it</transChange> off,<l eID="gen15155" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15156"/>and not one can rescue <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <l eID="gen15156" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7465"/><l level="1" sID="gen15157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7465"/>And he will roar over him on that day<l eID="gen15157" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15158"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roaring of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea,<l eID="gen15158" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15159"/>and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> one looks to the land, look! Darkness! Distress!<l eID="gen15159" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15160"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> light grows dark with its<note placement="foot">Presumably the land’s</note> clouds. <l eID="gen15160" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15137"/> <chapter eID="Isa.5"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7466"/><title type="x-s">Isaiah’s Commission</title> <div sID="gen15161" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7466"/>In the year of the death of Uzziah the king, I saw the Lord sitting on a high and raised throne, and the hem of his robe <transChange type="added">was</transChange> filling the temple.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:2
verses.text: Seraphs <transChange type="added">were</transChange> standing above him. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Each had six wings⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “six wings six wings for one”</note> with two he covered his face, and with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew.  <div eID="gen15161" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7467"/><div sID="gen15162" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7467"/>And the one called to the other and said, <div eID="gen15162" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15163"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15164"/>“Holy, holy, holy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh of hosts!<l eID="gen15164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15165"/>The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whole earth is full of his glory⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “fullness of all of the earth glory him”</note> <l eID="gen15165" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15163"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7468"/><div sID="gen15166" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7468"/>And the pivots of the thresholds shook from the sound of those who called, and the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> was filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> smoke.  <div eID="gen15166" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7469"/><div sID="gen15167" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7469"/>And I said, “Woe to me! For I am destroyed!<note placement="foot">Or “silenced”</note> For I am a man <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of unclean lips⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “unclean of lips”</note> and I am living among<note placement="foot">With an emphatic sense: “in the very heart and midst of”</note> a people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of unclean lips⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “unclean of lips”</note> for my eyes have seen the king, Yahweh of hosts!”  <div eID="gen15167" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7470"/><div sID="gen15168" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7470"/>Then one of the seraphs flew to me, and in his hand <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a hot coal he had taken from the altar with tongs.  <div eID="gen15168" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7471"/><div sID="gen15169" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7471"/>And he touched my mouth, and he said, <div eID="gen15169" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15170"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15171"/>“Look! This has touched your lips<l eID="gen15171" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15172"/>and has removed your guilt,<l eID="gen15172" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15173"/>and your sin is annulled.” <l eID="gen15173" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15170"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7472"/><div sID="gen15174" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7472"/>Then I heard <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of the Lord saying, <div eID="gen15174" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15175"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15176"/>“Whom shall I send?<l eID="gen15176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15177"/>And who will go for us?”<l eID="gen15177" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15175"/> <div sID="gen15178" type="x-p"/> And I said, <div eID="gen15178" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15179"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15180"/>“I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> here!<l eID="gen15180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15181"/>Send me!” <l eID="gen15181" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15179"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7473"/><div sID="gen15182" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7473"/>And he said, “Go and say to this people, <div eID="gen15182" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15183"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15184"/>‘Keep on listening and do not comprehend!<l eID="gen15184" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15185"/>And keep on looking and do not understand!’ <l eID="gen15185" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7474"/><l level="1" sID="gen15186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7474"/>Make the heart of this people insensitive,<l eID="gen15186" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15187"/>and make its ears unresponsive,<l eID="gen15187" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15188"/>and shut its eyes<l eID="gen15188" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15189"/>so that it may not look with its eyes<l eID="gen15189" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15190"/>and listen with its ears<l eID="gen15190" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15191"/>and comprehend <transChange type="added">with</transChange> its mind<l eID="gen15191" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15192"/>and turn back, and it may be healed <transChange type="added">for</transChange> him.” <l eID="gen15192" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15183"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7475"/><div sID="gen15193" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7475"/>Then I said, “Until when, Lord?” <div eID="gen15193" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen15194" type="x-p"/> And he said, <div eID="gen15194" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15195"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15196"/>“Until <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cities lie wasted without inhabitant,<l eID="gen15196" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15197"/>and houses without people,<l eID="gen15197" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15198"/>and the land is ruined <transChange type="added">and</transChange> a waste, <l eID="gen15198" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7476"/><l level="1" sID="gen15199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7476"/>and Yahweh sends the people far away,<l eID="gen15199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15200"/>and the abandonment is great in the midst of the land. <l eID="gen15200" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7477"/><l level="1" sID="gen15201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7477"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞even if only a tenth part remain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “still in her a tenth”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞again she will be destroyed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and she will again and she will be to burn”</note><l eID="gen15201" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15202"/>like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> terebinth or like <transChange type="added">an</transChange> oak,<l eID="gen15202" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15203"/>which although felled, a tree stump <transChange type="added">remains</transChange> in them.<l eID="gen15203" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15204"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> seed of holiness <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> her tree stump.” <l eID="gen15204" level="1"/><lg eID="gen15195"/> <chapter eID="Isa.6"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7478"/><title type="x-s">The Sign to Ahaz</title> <div sID="gen15205" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7478"/>This happened in the days of Ahaz, son of Jotham, son of Uzziah, king of Judah. Rezin, king of Aram, and Pekah, son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is singular</note> up to Jerusalem for warfare against it,<note placement="foot">Literally “her”</note> but he was not able to fight against it.<note placement="foot">Literally “her”</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:2
verses.text: When it was reported to the house of David, saying “Aram stands by Ephraim,” his heart and the heart of his people shook like the shaking of the trees of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> forest because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind.  <div eID="gen15205" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7479"/><div sID="gen15206" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7479"/>Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out to meet Ahaz, you and Shear-Jashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> highway of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> washer’s field.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:4
verses.text: And you must say to him, ‘Take heed and be quiet! You must not fear, and your heart must not be faint because of these two stumps of smoldering firebrands, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of the fierce anger of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because of the fierceness of the anger of”</note> Rezin and Aram and the son of Remaliah.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:5
verses.text: Because Aram has plotted evil against you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> Ephraim and the son of Remaliah, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 7:6
verses.text: “Let us go up against Judah and let us tear her apart, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and let us lay it open and so bring it unto ourselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and let us break through her to us”</note> and let us install the son of Tabeel <transChange type="added">as</transChange> king in her midst.”

verses.name: Isaiah 7:7
verses.text: Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “It shall not stand, and it shall not come to pass.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:8
verses.text: For the head of Aram <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Damascus, and the head of Damascus <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Rezin, and in sixty-five years from now Ephraim will be too shattered to be a people.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:9
verses.text: And the head of Ephraim <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Samaria, and the head of Samaria <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the son of Remaliah. If you do not believe then you will not endure.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen15206" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7480"/><div sID="gen15207" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7480"/>And Yahweh continued to speak to Ahaz, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 7:11
verses.text: “Ask for a sign for yourself from Yahweh God; make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> deep <transChange type="added">as</transChange> Sheol or make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> high as above.”

verses.name: Isaiah 7:12
verses.text: But Ahaz said, “I will not ask, and I will not put Yahweh to the test.”  <div eID="gen15207" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7481"/><div sID="gen15208" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7481"/>Then he said, “Hear, house of David! <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> too little for you to make men weary, that you should also make my God weary?

verses.name: Isaiah 7:14
verses.text: Therefore the Lord himself will give you<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is plural</note> a sign. Look! the virgin<note placement="foot">Or “young woman”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with child and she is about to give birth <transChange type="added">to</transChange> a son, and she shall call his name ‘God with us.’

verses.name: Isaiah 7:15
verses.text: He shall eat curds and honey until he knows to reject the evil and to choose the good.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:16
verses.text: For before the boy knows to reject the evil and to choose the good, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the land whose two kings you dread will be abandoned.⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the land which you dread will be abandoned because of the face of her two kings”</note>  <div eID="gen15208" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7482"/><title type="x-s">That Day</title> <div sID="gen15209" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7482"/>“Yahweh will bring on you and on your people and on the house of your ancestor<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> days that have not come since <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day Ephraim departed from Judah: the king of Assyria.”

verses.name: Isaiah 7:18
verses.text: And this shall happen: On that day, Yahweh will whistle for the fly that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> at the end of the stream of Egypt and the bee that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the land of Assyria.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:19
verses.text: And all of them will come and settle in the rivers of the cliffs and in the clefts of the rocks and on all of the thornbushes and watering places.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:20
verses.text: On that day, the Lord will shave the head and the hair of the feet with a razor of the one hired from beyond <transChange type="added">the</transChange> river—with the king of Assyria—and it will even take off the beard.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:21
verses.text: And this shall happen: on that day, a young man will keep a young cow of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> herd and two sheep alive.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:22
verses.text: And this shall happen: because of the abundance of milk production, he will eat curds, for every one that is left in the midst of the land will eat curds and honey.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:23
verses.text: And this shall happen on that day: Every place where there are a thousand vines<note placement="foot">Hebrew “vine”</note> for a thousand silver pieces will become briers,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “brier”</note> and it will be thornbushes.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thornbush”</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:24
verses.text: One will go there with arrows and bow, for all of the land will be briers<note placement="foot">Hebrew “brier”</note> and thornbushes.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thornbush”</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:25
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> all of the hills that they hoed with the hoe, you will not go there, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> fear of briers<note placement="foot">Hebrew “brier”</note> and thornbushes.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thornbush”</note> And it will become like pastureland <transChange type="added">for</transChange> cattle and overtrodden land <transChange type="added">for</transChange> sheep.  <chapter eID="Isa.7"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7483"/><title type="x-s">Signs of the Assyrian Invasion</title> <div sID="gen15210" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7483"/>Then Yahweh said to me, “Take yourself a large tablet and write on it with a common stylus pen: Maher-Halal-Hash-Baz.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:2
verses.text: And I will require reliable witnesses as a witness for me: Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah.”

verses.name: Isaiah 8:3
verses.text: And I approached the prophetess, and she conceived, and she gave birth to a son. And Yahweh said to me, “Call his name Maher-Halal-Hash-Baz.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:4
verses.text: For before the boy knows to call ‘my father’ and ‘my mother,’ <transChange type="added">one</transChange> will carry away the wealth of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria in the presence of the king of Assyria.”  <div eID="gen15210" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7484"/><title type="x-s">Shiloah Waters and Euphrates Flood</title> <div sID="gen15211" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7484"/>And Yahweh continued to speak to me again, saying,  <div eID="gen15211" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7485"/><div sID="gen15212" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7485"/>“Because this people has refused the gently flowing waters of Shiloah and rejoices <transChange type="added">over</transChange> Rezin and the son of Remaliah,

verses.name: Isaiah 8:7
verses.text: therefore look! The Lord <transChange type="added">is</transChange> bringing up the waters of the great and mighty river against them, the king of Assyria and all his glory. <div eID="gen15212" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15213"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15214"/>And he will rise above all his channels,<l eID="gen15214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15215"/>and he will flow over all his banks. <l eID="gen15215" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7486"/><l level="1" sID="gen15216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7486"/>And he will sweep into Judah;<l eID="gen15216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15217"/>he will overflow and he will flood up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> neck.<l eID="gen15217" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15218"/>He will reach, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will spread his wings out over your entire land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the outspreading of his wings will be the fullness of the breadth of your land”</note> God with us.” <l eID="gen15218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7487"/><l level="1" sID="gen15219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7487"/>Be broken, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> peoples, and be dismayed.<l eID="gen15219" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15220"/>And listen, all distant <transChange type="added">parts of the</transChange> earth;<l eID="gen15220" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15221"/>gird yourselves and be dismayed;<l eID="gen15221" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15222"/>gird yourselves and be dismayed! <l eID="gen15222" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7488"/><l level="1" sID="gen15223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7488"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Make a plan⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Plan counsel”</note> but it will be frustrated!<l eID="gen15223" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15224"/>Speak a word, but it will not stand,<l eID="gen15224" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15225"/>for God is with us!<l eID="gen15225" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen15213"/> <title type="x-s">Wait for Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen15226" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen15226" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7489"/><lg sID="gen15227"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7489"/>For Yahweh said this to me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞while his hand weighed heavily on me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with the strength of the hand”</note><l eID="gen15228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15229"/>and he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞warned me not to walk⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “instructed me from walking”</note> in the way of this people, saying, <l eID="gen15229" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7490"/><l level="1" sID="gen15230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7490"/>“You must not call conspiracy everything that this people calls conspiracy,<l eID="gen15230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15231"/>and you must not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞share its fear⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “fear its fear”</note> and you must not be in dread. <l eID="gen15231" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7491"/><l level="1" sID="gen15232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7491"/>You shall regard Yahweh of hosts as holy,<l eID="gen15232" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15233"/>and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is plural</note> fear, and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your dread. <l eID="gen15233" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7492"/><l level="1" sID="gen15234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7492"/>And he will become like a sanctuary and a stumbling-stone,<l eID="gen15234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15235"/>and like a stumbling-rock for the two houses of Israel,<l eID="gen15235" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15236"/>like a trap and a snare for the inhabitants of Jerusalem. <l eID="gen15236" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7493"/><l level="1" sID="gen15237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7493"/>And many shall stumble among them,<l eID="gen15237" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15238"/>and they shall fall and they shall be broken,<l eID="gen15238" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15239"/>and they shall be ensnared and they shall be caught.” <l eID="gen15239" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7494"/><l level="1" sID="gen15240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7494"/>Bind up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> testimony;<l eID="gen15240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15241"/>seal <transChange type="added">the</transChange> teaching among my disciples. <l eID="gen15241" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7495"/><l level="1" sID="gen15242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7495"/>And I will wait for Yahweh,<l eID="gen15242" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15243"/>who hides his face from the house of Jacob,<l eID="gen15243" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15244"/>and I will await him. <l eID="gen15244" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen15227"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7496"/><div sID="gen15245" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7496"/>Look! I and the children whom Yahweh has given to me <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like signs and portents in Israel from Yahweh of hosts, the one who dwells on the mountain of Zion.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:19
verses.text: Now if they tell you, “Consult the ghosts and the spirits, those who chirp and those who mutter. Should not a people consult its gods, the dead on behalf of the living,

verses.name: Isaiah 8:20
verses.text: for teaching and for testimony?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surely they <transChange type="added">who</transChange> speak like this have no dawn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “if not, they say like this word that there is no dawn for him,” which could also mean “if not, let them say a word like this: that there is no dawn for him”</note>  <div eID="gen15245" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7497"/><div sID="gen15246" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7497"/>And it<note placement="foot">That is, the nation</note> will pass through it<note placement="foot">That is, the land</note> distressed and hungry, and this shall happen: when it is hungry, it will be enraged, and it will curse its king and its gods,<note placement="foot">Or “God”</note> and it will face upwar

verses.name: Isaiah 8:22
verses.text: or look to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. But look! Distress and darkness, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gloom of affliction! And <transChange type="added">it will be</transChange> thrust <transChange type="added">into</transChange> darkness!  <chapter eID="Isa.8"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7498"/><title type="x-s">New Light: The Birth of a King</title> <div sID="gen15247" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7498"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Isa.9.1-Isa.9.21">Isaiah 9:1–21 </reference>in the English Bible is 8:23–9:20 in the Hebrew Bible</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞But there will be no gloom for those who were in distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Indeed there is no gloom for the one to whom there was anxiety for her”</note> <div eID="gen15247" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen15248" type="x-p"/> In former times he<note placement="foot">That is, Yahweh</note> treated <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of Zebulun and Naphtali with contempt, but in the future he will honor the way of the sea beyond the Jordan, Galilee <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the nations.  <div eID="gen15248" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7499"/><lg sID="gen15249"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7499"/>The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light;<l eID="gen15250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15251"/>light has shined on those who lived in a land of darkness. <l eID="gen15251" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7500"/><l level="1" sID="gen15252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7500"/>You have made the nation numerous;<l eID="gen15252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15253"/>you have not<note placement="foot">The written text (<hi type="italic">Kethib</hi>) is “not,” but the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) is “for it”</note> made the joy great.<l eID="gen15253" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15254"/>They rejoice in your presence as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> joy at the harvest,<l eID="gen15254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15255"/>as they rejoice when they divide plunder. <l eID="gen15255" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7501"/><l level="1" sID="gen15256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7501"/>For you have shattered the yoke of its burden<l eID="gen15256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15257"/>and the stick of its shoulder,<l eID="gen15257" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15258"/>the rod of its oppressor, on<note placement="foot">Hebrew “like”; the Hebrew letters for “like” and “on” look alike</note> the day of Midian. <l eID="gen15258" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7502"/><l level="1" sID="gen15259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7502"/>For every boot <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that marches and shakes the earth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “marching with shaking,” which might mean “marching is with shaking”</note><l eID="gen15259" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15260"/>and garment rolled in blood<l eID="gen15260" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15261"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it will”</note> be for burning—fire fuel. <l eID="gen15261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7503"/><l level="1" sID="gen15262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7503"/>For a child has been born for us;<l eID="gen15262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15263"/>a son has been given to us.<l eID="gen15263" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15264"/>And the dominion will be on his shoulder,<l eID="gen15264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15265"/>and his name is called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God,<l eID="gen15265" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15266"/>Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace. <l eID="gen15266" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7504"/><l level="1" sID="gen15267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7504"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞His dominion will grow continually, <milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><l eID="gen15267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15268"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>and to peace there will be no end⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “There is no end to the increase of the dominion and to peace”</note><l eID="gen15268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15269"/>on<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> the throne of David and over<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> his kingdom,<l eID="gen15269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15270"/>to establish it<note placement="foot">That is, the kingdom</note> and sustain it<l eID="gen15270" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15271"/>with justice and righteousness<l eID="gen15271" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15272"/>now and forever.<l eID="gen15272" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15273"/>The zeal of Yahweh of hosts will do this.<l eID="gen15273" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen15249"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Anger against Arrogance</title> <div sID="gen15274" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen15274" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7505"/><lg sID="gen15275"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7505"/>The Lord has sent out a word against Jacob,<l eID="gen15276" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15277"/>and it fell on Israel. <l eID="gen15277" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7506"/><l level="1" sID="gen15278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7506"/>And all of the people knew it,<l eID="gen15278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15279"/>Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria<l eID="gen15279" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15280"/>in pride and arrogance of heart, saying, <l eID="gen15280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7507"/><l level="1" sID="gen15281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7507"/>“<transChange type="added">The</transChange> bricks have fallen, but we will build <transChange type="added">with</transChange> dressed stone.<l eID="gen15281" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15282"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> sycamore-fig trees were felled, but we will replace <transChange type="added">them with</transChange> cedars.” <l eID="gen15282" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7508"/><l level="1" sID="gen15283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7508"/>So Yahweh strengthened <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the adversaries of Rezin⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “his adversaries” if a copyist added “of Rezin” in error</note> against him,<l eID="gen15283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15284"/>and he provoked his enemies— <l eID="gen15284" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7509"/><l level="1" sID="gen15285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7509"/>Aram from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east<l eID="gen15285" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15286"/>and Philistines<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Philistine”</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> west—<l eID="gen15286" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15287"/>and they devoured Israel with the whole mouth.<l eID="gen15287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15288"/>He has not turned away his anger in all of this,<l eID="gen15288" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15289"/>and his hand is still stretched out. <l eID="gen15289" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7510"/><l level="1" sID="gen15290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7510"/>And the people did not turn to the one who struck it,<note placement="foot">That is, the people</note><l eID="gen15290" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15291"/>and they did not seek Yahweh of hosts. <l eID="gen15291" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7511"/><l level="1" sID="gen15292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7511"/>So Yahweh cut off head and tail from Israel,<l eID="gen15292" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15293"/>palm branch and reed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> one day. <l eID="gen15293" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7512"/><l level="1" sID="gen15294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7512"/>Elders<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Elder”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the respectable⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one lifted up of face”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the head,<l eID="gen15294" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15295"/>and prophets<note placement="foot">Hebrew “prophet”</note> who teach lies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the tail. <l eID="gen15295" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7513"/><l level="1" sID="gen15296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7513"/>And the leaders of this people were misleading <transChange type="added">them</transChange>,<l eID="gen15296" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15297"/>and those who were led <transChange type="added">were</transChange> confused. <l eID="gen15297" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7514"/><l level="1" sID="gen15298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7514"/>Therefore the Lord did not rejoice over its young men,<l eID="gen15298" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15299"/>and he did not have compassion on its orphans and widows,<l eID="gen15299" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15300"/>for everyone <transChange type="added">was</transChange> godless and an evildoer,<l eID="gen15300" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15301"/>and every mouth <transChange type="added">was</transChange> speaking folly.<l eID="gen15301" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15302"/>In all of this his anger did not turn away,<l eID="gen15302" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15303"/>and still his hand <transChange type="added">is</transChange> stretched out. <l eID="gen15303" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7515"/><l level="1" sID="gen15304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7515"/>For wickedness burned like fire;<l eID="gen15304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15305"/>it consumed brier and thorn.<l eID="gen15305" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15306"/>And it kindled the thickets of the forest,<l eID="gen15306" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15307"/>and they swirled upward <transChange type="added">in</transChange> a column of smoke. <l eID="gen15307" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7516"/><l level="1" sID="gen15308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7516"/>The land was burned through the wrath of Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen15308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15309"/>and the people became like fire fuel.<l eID="gen15309" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15310"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞People had no compassion toward each other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “A man does not have compassion toward his brother”</note> <l eID="gen15310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7517"/><l level="1" sID="gen15311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7517"/>They devoured on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> right but <transChange type="added">still</transChange> were hungry<l eID="gen15311" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15312"/>and devoured on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> left but they were not satisfied.<l eID="gen15312" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15313"/>Each one devoured the flesh of his arm, <l eID="gen15313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7518"/><l level="2" sID="gen15314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7518"/>Manasseh <transChange type="added">devoured</transChange> Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh;<l eID="gen15314" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15315"/>together they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> against Judah.<l eID="gen15315" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15316"/>In all of this his anger has not turned away,<l eID="gen15316" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15317"/>and still his hand <transChange type="added">is</transChange> stretched out. <l eID="gen15317" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15275"/> <chapter eID="Isa.9"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7519"/><title type="x-s">Woes on the Wicked</title> <div sID="gen15318" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen15318" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15319"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7519"/>Ah! Those who decree decrees of evil,<l eID="gen15320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15321"/>and writers who have written harm, <l eID="gen15321" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7520"/><l level="1" sID="gen15322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7520"/>to guide <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy away from legal claims,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “claim”</note><l eID="gen15322" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15323"/>and to rob the justice from the poor of my people,<l eID="gen15323" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15324"/>to make widows their spoil;<l eID="gen15324" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15325"/>and they plunder orphans. <l eID="gen15325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7521"/><l level="1" sID="gen15326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7521"/>And what will you do at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of punishment,<l eID="gen15326" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15327"/>and at calamity? It comes from afar!<l eID="gen15327" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15328"/>To whom will you flee for help,<l eID="gen15328" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15329"/>and where will you leave your wealth, <l eID="gen15329" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7522"/><l level="1" sID="gen15330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7522"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞save that they bow down under the prisoners <milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><l eID="gen15330" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15331"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>and fall under the slain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “except he will bow down under a prisoner and under slain they will fall”; “under” could also mean “in the place of”</note><l eID="gen15331" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15332"/>In all of this his anger has not turned away,<l eID="gen15332" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15333"/>and still his hand <transChange type="added">is</transChange> stretched out.<l eID="gen15333" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15319"/> <title type="x-s">Judgment on Assyria’s Arrogance</title> <div sID="gen15334" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen15334" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7523"/><lg sID="gen15335"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7523"/>Ah! Assyria, the rod of my anger,<l eID="gen15336" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15337"/>and a staff is in their hand: my wrath! <l eID="gen15337" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7524"/><l level="1" sID="gen15338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7524"/>I send him against a godless nation,<l eID="gen15338" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15339"/>and I command him against the people of my wrath,<l eID="gen15339" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15340"/>to capture spoil<l eID="gen15340" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15341"/>and to carry off plunder,<l eID="gen15341" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15342"/>and to make them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> a trampling place,<l eID="gen15342" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15343"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clay of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> streets. <l eID="gen15343" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7525"/><l level="1" sID="gen15344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7525"/>But he does not think this,<note placement="foot">Or “so”</note><l eID="gen15344" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15345"/>and his heart does not plan this.<l eID="gen15345" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15346"/>For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> in his heart to destroy<l eID="gen15346" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15347"/>and to cut off not a few nations. <l eID="gen15347" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7526"/><l level="1" sID="gen15348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7526"/>For he says, “<transChange type="added">Are</transChange> not my commanders altogether kings? <l eID="gen15348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7527"/><l level="2" sID="gen15349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7527"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not Calno like Carchemish?<l eID="gen15349" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15350"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not Hamath like Arpad?<l eID="gen15350" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15351"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not Samaria like Damascus? <l eID="gen15351" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7528"/><l level="1" sID="gen15352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7528"/>As my hand has reached to the kingdoms of the idols<note placement="foot">Hebrew “idol”</note><l eID="gen15352" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15353"/>—and their images were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞greater than those of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> Jerusalem and Samaria— <l eID="gen15353" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7529"/><l level="1" sID="gen15354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7529"/>shall I not do to Jerusalem and its idols<l eID="gen15354" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15355"/>what I have done to Samaria and her idols?” <l eID="gen15355" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15335"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7530"/><div sID="gen15356" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7530"/>And this shall happen: when the Lord has finished all his work against <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Zion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Zion”</note> and Jerusalem, “I will punish the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞arrogance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fruit of the greatness of the heart”</note> of the king of Assyria and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his haughtiness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “the pride of the height of his eyes”</note>  <div eID="gen15356" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7531"/><div sID="gen15357" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7531"/>For he says, <div eID="gen15357" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15358"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15359"/>“I have done <transChange type="added">it</transChange> by the strength of my hand<l eID="gen15359" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15360"/>and by my wisdom, for I have understanding,<l eID="gen15360" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15361"/>and I have removed <transChange type="added">the</transChange> boundaries of peoples,<l eID="gen15361" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15362"/>and I have plundered their stores,<l eID="gen15362" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15363"/>and like a bull I have brought down <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the inhabitants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Or, “those sitting,” that is, rulers sitting on thrones</note> <l eID="gen15363" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7532"/><l level="1" sID="gen15364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7532"/>And my hand has found, like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> nest, the wealth of the peoples,<l eID="gen15364" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15365"/>and like the gathering of forsaken eggs, I myself have gathered all the earth.<l eID="gen15365" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15366"/>And <transChange type="added">there</transChange> was no fluttering wing or open mouth or chirp.” <l eID="gen15366" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7533"/><l level="1" sID="gen15367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7533"/>Does the ax boast against the one who cuts with it,<l eID="gen15367" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15368"/>or the saw magnify itself against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who moves it to and fro?<l eID="gen15368" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15369"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As if a rod should move the one who lifts it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “As a rod waving even the one who lifts it up”</note><l eID="gen15369" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15370"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As if a staff should lift up that which is not wood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “As a staff lifting up not wood”</note> <l eID="gen15370" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7534"/><l level="1" sID="gen15371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7534"/>Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of hosts, will send leanness among his sturdy warriors,<l eID="gen15371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15372"/>and a burning like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> burning of fire will burn under his glory. <l eID="gen15372" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7535"/><l level="1" sID="gen15373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7535"/>And the light of Israel will become like a fire,<l eID="gen15373" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15374"/>and his holy one like a flame,<l eID="gen15374" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15375"/>and it will burn and devour his thorns<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thorn”</note> and briers<note placement="foot">Hebrew “brier”</note> in one day. <l eID="gen15375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7536"/><l level="1" sID="gen15376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7536"/>And he will destroy the glory of his forest and orchard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞completely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from soul and to body”</note><l eID="gen15376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15377"/>and it will be like the wasting away of one who is sick. <l eID="gen15377" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7537"/><l level="1" sID="gen15378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7537"/>And the rest of the trees<note placement="foot">Hebrew “tree”</note> of his forest will be a small number,<l eID="gen15378" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15379"/>and a boy can write them <transChange type="added">down</transChange>.<l eID="gen15379" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15358"/> <title type="x-s">The Return of the Remnant</title> <div sID="gen15380" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen15380" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7538"/><lg sID="gen15381"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7538"/>And this shall happen: on that day, the remnant of Israel and the survivors<note placement="foot">Hebrew “survivor”</note> of the house of Jacob will not continue to lean on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who struck it<l eID="gen15382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15383"/>but will lean on Yahweh, the holy one of Israel, in truth. <l eID="gen15383" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7539"/><l level="1" sID="gen15384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7539"/>A remnant will return—<l eID="gen15384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15385"/>the remnant of Jacob—to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty God. <l eID="gen15385" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7540"/><l level="1" sID="gen15386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7540"/>For though your people Israel was like the sand of the sea,<l eID="gen15386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15387"/><transChange type="added">only</transChange> a remnant of it will return.<l eID="gen15387" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15388"/>Annihilation <transChange type="added">is</transChange> determined,<l eID="gen15388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15389"/>overflowing <transChange type="added">with</transChange> righteousness. <l eID="gen15389" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7541"/><l level="1" sID="gen15390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7541"/>For the Lord Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> about to make a complete destruction<l eID="gen15390" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15391"/>and a determined end in the midst of all the earth. <l eID="gen15391" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15381"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7542"/><div sID="gen15392" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7542"/>Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh of hosts: <div eID="gen15392" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15393"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15394"/>“My people who live <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Zion,<l eID="gen15394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15395"/>you must not be afraid of Assyria.<l eID="gen15395" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15396"/>It beats you with the rod,<l eID="gen15396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15397"/>and it lifts up its staff against you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as the Egyptians did⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the way of Egypt”</note> <l eID="gen15397" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7543"/><l level="1" sID="gen15398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7543"/><transChange type="added">My</transChange> indignation will come to an end <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in just a very little while⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for still a little a trifle”</note><l eID="gen15398" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15399"/>and my anger <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> directed to their destruction.” <l eID="gen15399" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7544"/><l level="1" sID="gen15400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7544"/>And Yahweh of hosts is going to swing a whip against him,<l eID="gen15400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15401"/>as when Midian was defeated at the rock of Oreb;<l eID="gen15401" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15402"/>and his staff <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> over the sea,<l eID="gen15402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15403"/>and he will lift him up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as he did in Egypt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the way of Egypt”</note> <l eID="gen15403" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15393"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7545"/><div sID="gen15404" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7545"/>And this shall happen: on that day, <div eID="gen15404" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15405"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15406"/>he will remove his burden from your shoulder<l eID="gen15406" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15407"/>and his yoke from your neck,<l eID="gen15407" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15408"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and a yoke will be destroyed because of fat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">The meaning of this phrase is uncertain, leading to the conjecture that it belongs with the next verse and by a different word division could mean “he has gone up from Jeshimon”; alternatively, “fat” could be a metaphor for prosperity</note> <l eID="gen15408" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7546"/><l level="1" sID="gen15409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7546"/>He has come to Aiath,<l eID="gen15409" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15410"/>he has passed through Migron;<l eID="gen15410" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15411"/>at Micmash he deposited his baggage. <l eID="gen15411" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7547"/><l level="1" sID="gen15412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7547"/>They crossed over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pass;<l eID="gen15412" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15413"/>Geba <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a place of overnight lodging for us.<l eID="gen15413" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15414"/>Ramah trembles;<l eID="gen15414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15415"/>Gibeah of Saul has fled. <l eID="gen15415" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7548"/><l level="1" sID="gen15416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7548"/>Daughter of Gallim, cry out <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your voice;<l eID="gen15416" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15417"/>Laishah, listen!<l eID="gen15417" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15418"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Anathoth is poor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Or with different vocalization, “Answer her, Anathoth!” which fits the parallelism better</note> <l eID="gen15418" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7549"/><l level="1" sID="gen15419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7549"/>Madmenah flees!<l eID="gen15419" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15420"/>The inhabitants of Gebim bring themselves into safety! <l eID="gen15420" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:32
