verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7550"/><l level="1" sID="gen15421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7550"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞This day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Yet today”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞taking a stand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to stand”</note> at Nob,<l eID="gen15421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15422"/>he will shake his fist <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the mountain of the daughter<note placement="foot">Following the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>); the consonantal text has “house”</note> of Zion,<l eID="gen15422" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15423"/><transChange type="added">at</transChange> the hill of Jerusalem. <l eID="gen15423" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7551"/><l level="1" sID="gen15424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7551"/>Look! The Lord Yahweh of hosts is about to lop off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> branches<note placement="foot">Hebrew “branch”</note> with great power,<l eID="gen15424" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15425"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the towering trees⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the haughty of the height”</note> will be felled,<l eID="gen15425" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15426"/>and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞tall trees⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “height”</note> will be brought low. <l eID="gen15426" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7552"/><l level="1" sID="gen15427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7552"/>And he will cut down the thickets of the forest with the axe,<l eID="gen15427" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15428"/>and Lebanon will fall by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty <transChange type="added">one</transChange>. <l eID="gen15428" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15405"/> <chapter eID="Isa.10"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7553"/><title type="x-s">The Branch’s Righteous Reign</title> <div sID="gen15429" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen15429" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15430"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7553"/>And a shoot will come out from the stump of Jesse,<l eID="gen15431" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15432"/>and a branch from its roots will bear fruit. <l eID="gen15432" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7554"/><l level="1" sID="gen15433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7554"/>And the spirit of Yahweh shall rest on him—<l eID="gen15433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15434"/>a spirit of wisdom and understanding,<l eID="gen15434" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15435"/>a spirit of counsel and might,<l eID="gen15435" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15436"/>a spirit of knowledge and the fear of Yahweh. <l eID="gen15436" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7555"/><l level="2" sID="gen15437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7555"/>And his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞breath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “smelling,” perhaps metaphorically as “delight” as in <reference osisRef="Amos.5.14">Amos 5:14; </reference>perhaps this line was accidentally copied twice from the preceding line</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the fear of Yahweh.<l eID="gen15437" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15438"/>And he shall judge not by his eyesight,<l eID="gen15438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15439"/>and he shall rebuke not by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what he hears with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the rumors of”</note> his ears. <l eID="gen15439" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7556"/><l level="1" sID="gen15440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7556"/>But he shall judge <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor with righteousness,<l eID="gen15440" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15441"/>and he shall decide for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth with rectitude.<l eID="gen15441" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15442"/>And he shall strike <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth with the rod of his mouth,<l eID="gen15442" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15443"/>and he shall kill <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked person with the breath of his lips. <l eID="gen15443" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7557"/><l level="1" sID="gen15444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7557"/>And righteousness shall be the belt around his waist,<l eID="gen15444" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15445"/>and faithfulness the belt around his loins. <l eID="gen15445" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7558"/><l level="1" sID="gen15446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7558"/>And a wolf shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞stay⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “dwell as an alien”</note> with a lamb,<l eID="gen15446" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15447"/>and a leopard shall lie down with a kid,<l eID="gen15447" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15448"/>and a calf and a lion and a fatling together<l eID="gen15448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15449"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as a small boy leads⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and a small boy leading”</note> them. <l eID="gen15449" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7559"/><l level="1" sID="gen15450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7559"/>And a cow and a bear shall graze;<l eID="gen15450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15451"/>their young shall lie down together.<l eID="gen15451" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15452"/>And a lion shall eat straw like the cattle. <l eID="gen15452" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7560"/><l level="1" sID="gen15453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7560"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an infant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one nursing”</note> shall play over a serpent’s hole,<l eID="gen15453" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15454"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a toddler⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one who is weaned”</note> shall put his hand on a viper’s hole. <l eID="gen15454" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7561"/><l level="1" sID="gen15455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7561"/>They will not injure and they will not destroy on all of my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “mountain of holiness”</note><l eID="gen15455" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15456"/>for the earth will be full <transChange type="added">of the</transChange> knowledge <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen15456" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15457"/>as the waters cover the sea. <l eID="gen15457" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen15430"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7562"/><div sID="gen15458" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7562"/>And this shall happen on that day: <div eID="gen15458" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15459"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15460"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations shall inquire of the root of Jesse,<l eID="gen15460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15461"/>which shall be standing as a signal to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen15461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15462"/>and his resting place shall be glorious. <l eID="gen15462" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen15459"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7563"/><title type="x-s">The Regathered Remnant</title> <div sID="gen15463" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7563"/>And this shall happen on that day: <div eID="gen15463" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15464"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15465"/>The Lord will again <transChange type="added">extend</transChange> his hand a second <transChange type="added">time</transChange><l eID="gen15465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15466"/>to acquire the remnant of his people that is left,<l eID="gen15466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15467"/>from Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Cush, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the coastlands of the sea, <l eID="gen15467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7564"/><l level="1" sID="gen15468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7564"/>and he will raise a signal for the nations.<l eID="gen15468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15469"/>And he will gather the outcasts of Israel,<l eID="gen15469" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15470"/>and he will gather the scattered ones of Judah together from the four <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞corners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wings”</note> of the earth. <l eID="gen15470" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7565"/><l level="1" sID="gen15471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7565"/>And the jealousy of Ephraim shall depart,<l eID="gen15471" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15472"/>and the enemies of Judah shall be cut off.<l eID="gen15472" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15473"/>Ephraim shall not be jealous <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Judah,<l eID="gen15473" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15474"/>and Judah shall not be an enemy <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Ephraim. <l eID="gen15474" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7566"/><l level="1" sID="gen15475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7566"/>But they shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞swoop⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fly”</note> upon the Philistine shoulder,<note placement="foot">That is, the hill country west of Judah</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞westward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sea”</note><l eID="gen15475" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15476"/>Together they shall plunder <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sons of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east.<l eID="gen15476" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15477"/>Edom and Moab <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will be under their command⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the stretching of their hand”</note><l eID="gen15477" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15478"/>and the sons of Ammon <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> their subjugated people. <l eID="gen15478" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7567"/><l level="1" sID="gen15479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7567"/>And Yahweh will divide<note placement="foot">Or “utterly destroy”</note> the tongue<note placement="foot">Probably the “gulf”</note> of the sea of Egypt,<note placement="foot">That is, the Red Sea</note><l eID="gen15479" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15480"/>and he will wave his hand over the river<note placement="foot">That is, the Euphrates River</note> with his scorching wind;<l eID="gen15480" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15481"/>and he will strike it into seven streams,<l eID="gen15481" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15482"/>and he will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make it passable by foot⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “cause to walk with the sandal”</note> <l eID="gen15482" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7568"/><l level="1" sID="gen15483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7568"/>So there shall be a highway from Assyria for the remnant of his people that remains,<l eID="gen15483" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15484"/>as there was for Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the day”</note> it went up from the land of Egypt. <l eID="gen15484" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15464"/> <chapter eID="Isa.11"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7569"/><title type="x-s">A Song of Thanksgiving</title> <div sID="gen15485" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen15485" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15486"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7569"/>And you will say on that day,<l eID="gen15487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15488"/>“I will give you thanks, Yahweh,<l eID="gen15488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15489"/>for though you were angry with me,<l eID="gen15489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15490"/>your anger turned away,<l eID="gen15490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15491"/>and you comforted me. <l eID="gen15491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7570"/><l level="1" sID="gen15492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7570"/>Look! God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my salvation;<l eID="gen15492" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15493"/>I will trust, and I will not be afraid,<l eID="gen15493" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15494"/>for my strength and might <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yah, Yahweh;<l eID="gen15494" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15495"/>and he has become salvation for me.” <l eID="gen15495" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15486"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7571"/><div sID="gen15496" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7571"/>And you will draw water from the wells of salvation in joy.

verses.name: Isaiah 12:4
verses.text: And you will say on that day, <div eID="gen15496" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15497"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15498"/>“Give thanks to Yahweh;<l eID="gen15498" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15499"/>call on his name.<l eID="gen15499" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15500"/>Make his deeds known among the peoples;<l eID="gen15500" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15501"/>bring to remembrance that his name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> exalted. <l eID="gen15501" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7572"/><l level="1" sID="gen15502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7572"/>Sing praises <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Yahweh, for he has done a glorious thing;<l eID="gen15502" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15503"/>this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> known in all the earth. <l eID="gen15503" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7573"/><l level="1" sID="gen15504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7573"/>Inhabitant of Zion, shout out and sing for joy,<l eID="gen15504" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15505"/>for the holy one of Israel <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great in your midst.” <l eID="gen15505" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15497"/> <chapter eID="Isa.12"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7574"/><title type="x-s">An Oracle against Babylon</title> <div sID="gen15506" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7574"/>The oracle of Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz saw:  <div eID="gen15506" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7575"/><lg sID="gen15507"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7575"/>Raise a signal on a bare hill,<l eID="gen15508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15509"/>lift up <transChange type="added">your</transChange> voice to them;<l eID="gen15509" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15510"/>wave <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand and may they enter <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gateways of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> noblemen. <l eID="gen15510" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7576"/><l level="1" sID="gen15511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7576"/>I myself I have commanded my consecrated ones,<l eID="gen15511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15512"/>I have also summoned my mighty warriors concerning my anger,<l eID="gen15512" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15513"/>the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones who exalt over⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “exultant of”</note> my majesty. <l eID="gen15513" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7577"/><l level="1" sID="gen15514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7577"/>A sound, a noise <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the mountains,<l eID="gen15514" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15515"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> likeness <transChange type="added">of</transChange> many people!<l eID="gen15515" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15516"/>A sound of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roar of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kingdoms,<l eID="gen15516" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15517"/>of nations gathering!<l eID="gen15517" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15518"/>Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mustering an army for battle. <l eID="gen15518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7578"/><l level="1" sID="gen15519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7578"/><transChange type="added">They are</transChange> coming from a distant land,<l eID="gen15519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15520"/>from the end of the heavens,<l eID="gen15520" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15521"/>Yahweh and the weapons of his indignation,<l eID="gen15521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15522"/>to destroy <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the whole earth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all of the land/earth”</note> <l eID="gen15522" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7579"/><l level="1" sID="gen15523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7579"/>Wail, for the day of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near;<l eID="gen15523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15524"/>it will come like destruction from Shaddai!<note placement="foot">Often translated “the Almighty”</note> <l eID="gen15524" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7580"/><l level="1" sID="gen15525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7580"/>Therefore all hands will grow slack,<l eID="gen15525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15526"/>and every human heart will melt, <l eID="gen15526" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7581"/><l level="2" sID="gen15527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7581"/>and they will be dismayed.<l eID="gen15527" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15528"/>Pangs and labor pains will seize <transChange type="added">them</transChange>;<l eID="gen15528" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15529"/>they will tremble like a woman giving birth.<l eID="gen15529" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15530"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They will stare at one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “A man will stare at his neighbor”</note><l eID="gen15530" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15531"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their faces flushing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “faces of flames”</note> <l eID="gen15531" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7582"/><l level="1" sID="gen15532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7582"/>Look! The day of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> coming,<l eID="gen15532" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15533"/>cruel and wrath and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> burning <transChange type="added">of</transChange> anger,<l eID="gen15533" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15534"/>to make the earth a desolation,<l eID="gen15534" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15535"/>and he will destroy its sinners from it. <l eID="gen15535" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7583"/><l level="1" sID="gen15536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7583"/>For the stars of the heavens and their constellations will not flash forth their light;<l eID="gen15536" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15537"/>the sun will keep back when it comes out,<l eID="gen15537" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15538"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moon will not cause its light to shine. <l eID="gen15538" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7584"/><l level="1" sID="gen15539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7584"/>And I will punish <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world <transChange type="added">for its</transChange> evil<l eID="gen15539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15540"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked <transChange type="added">for</transChange> their iniquity.<l eID="gen15540" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15541"/>And I will put an end to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pride of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> arrogant,<l eID="gen15541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15542"/>and I will bring <transChange type="added">the</transChange> haughtiness of tyrants low. <l eID="gen15542" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7585"/><l level="1" sID="gen15543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7585"/>I will make humanity more rare than gold<l eID="gen15543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15544"/>and humankind more than the gold of Ophir. <l eID="gen15544" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7586"/><l level="1" sID="gen15545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7586"/>Therefore I will make <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens tremble,<l eID="gen15545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15546"/>and the earth will quake from its place<l eID="gen15546" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15547"/>because of the wrath of Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen15547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15548"/>and in the day his anger burns. <l eID="gen15548" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15507"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7587"/><div sID="gen15549" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7587"/>And this shall happen: <div eID="gen15549" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15550"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15551"/>like a hunted gazelle or sheep <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with none to gather them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and without one who gathers”</note><l eID="gen15551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15552"/>they will each turn to his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> people,<l eID="gen15552" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15553"/>and they will each flee to his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> land. <l eID="gen15553" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7588"/><l level="1" sID="gen15554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7588"/>Everyone who is found will be pierced through,<l eID="gen15554" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15555"/>and everyone who is carried away will fall by the sword. <l eID="gen15555" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7589"/><l level="1" sID="gen15556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7589"/>And their children will be dashed into pieces before their eyes;<l eID="gen15556" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15557"/>their houses will be plundered, and their wives will be raped.<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) softens this to “slept with”</note> <l eID="gen15557" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7590"/><l level="1" sID="gen15558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7590"/>Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> stirring the Medes up against them,<l eID="gen15558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15559"/>who do not value silver<l eID="gen15559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15560"/>and do not delight in gold. <l eID="gen15560" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7591"/><l level="1" sID="gen15561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7591"/>And <transChange type="added">their</transChange> bows will shatter young men.<l eID="gen15561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15562"/>And they will not show mercy on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fruit of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb;<l eID="gen15562" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15563"/>their eyes will not look compassionately on children. <l eID="gen15563" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15550"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7592"/><div sID="gen15564" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7592"/>And Babylon, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> glory of kingdoms, the splendor of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when God overthrew⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the overthrow by God of”</note> Sodom and Gomorrah.  <div eID="gen15564" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7593"/><lg sID="gen15565"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7593"/>It will not be inhabited forever,<l eID="gen15566" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15567"/>and it will not be dwelled in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “until generation and generation”</note><l eID="gen15567" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15568"/>and no Arab will pitch a tent there,<l eID="gen15568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15569"/>and shepherds will not allow <transChange type="added">their flocks</transChange> to lie down there. <l eID="gen15569" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7594"/><l level="1" sID="gen15570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7594"/>But wild animals will lie down there,<l eID="gen15570" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15571"/>and their houses will be full <transChange type="added">of</transChange> howling creatures,<l eID="gen15571" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15572"/>and the daughters of ostriches<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ostrich”</note> will live there,<l eID="gen15572" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15573"/>and goats will dance there. <l eID="gen15573" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7595"/><l level="1" sID="gen15574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7595"/>And hyenas will answer in its palaces,<l eID="gen15574" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15575"/>and jackals in the pleasure palaces;<l eID="gen15575" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15576"/>and its time <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is coming soon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “close to come”</note><l eID="gen15576" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15577"/>and its days will not be prolonged. <l eID="gen15577" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15565"/> <chapter eID="Isa.13"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7596"/><title type="x-s">The Restoration of Israel</title> <div sID="gen15578" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen15578" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15579"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7596"/>But Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob,<l eID="gen15580" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15581"/>and he will again choose Israel<l eID="gen15581" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15582"/>and set them on their land,<l eID="gen15582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15583"/>and the immigrant will join himself to them,<l eID="gen15583" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15584"/>and they will attach themselves to the house of Jacob. <l eID="gen15584" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7597"/><l level="1" sID="gen15585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7597"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations will take them<l eID="gen15585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15586"/>and bring them to their place,<l eID="gen15586" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15587"/>and the house of Israel will take possession of them<note placement="foot">That is, the nations</note> in the land of Yahweh<l eID="gen15587" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15588"/>as slaves and female slaves.<l eID="gen15588" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15579"/> <div sID="gen15589" type="x-p"/> And this will happen: <div eID="gen15589" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15590"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15591"/>they will take their captors captive<l eID="gen15591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15592"/>and rule over their oppressors. <l eID="gen15592" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15590"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7598"/><title type="x-s">The Downfall of the King of Babylon</title> <div sID="gen15593" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7598"/>And it shall happen on the day Yahweh gives you rest from your pain and turmoil and hard labor which <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you had to perform⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “was worked by you”</note>  <div eID="gen15593" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7599"/><lg sID="gen15594"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7599"/>that you will take this taunt against the king of Babylon,<l eID="gen15595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15596"/>and you will say:<l eID="gen15596" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15597"/>“How <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppressor has ceased!<l eID="gen15597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15598"/><transChange type="added">his</transChange> insolence<note placement="foot">The meaning of the word is uncertain; others translate it as “fury,” “hostility,” or even “golden city”</note> has ceased. <l eID="gen15598" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7600"/><l level="1" sID="gen15599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7600"/>Yahweh has broken <transChange type="added">the</transChange> staff of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked,<l eID="gen15599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15600"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> scepter of rulers, <l eID="gen15600" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7601"/><l level="1" sID="gen15601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7601"/>that struck <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples in wrath, a blow without ceasing,<l eID="gen15601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15602"/>that ruled <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations in anger<l eID="gen15602" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15603"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with unrestrained persecution⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “persecution without withholding”</note> <l eID="gen15603" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7602"/><l level="1" sID="gen15604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7602"/>All of the earth rests <transChange type="added">and</transChange> is quiet;<l eID="gen15604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15605"/>they break forth <transChange type="added">into</transChange> singing. <l eID="gen15605" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7603"/><l level="1" sID="gen15606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7603"/>Even <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cypresses rejoice over you,<l eID="gen15606" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15607"/>the cedars of Lebanon:<l eID="gen15607" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15608"/>‘Since you were laid down,<l eID="gen15608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15609"/>no <transChange type="added">wood</transChange> cutter comes up against us.’ <l eID="gen15609" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7604"/><l level="1" sID="gen15610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7604"/>Sheol below is getting excited over you,<l eID="gen15610" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15611"/>to meet <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you when you come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “your entrance”</note><l eID="gen15611" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15612"/>it arouses <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dead spirits for you,<l eID="gen15612" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15613"/>all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> leaders of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth.<l eID="gen15613" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15614"/>It raises all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations from their thrones. <l eID="gen15614" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7605"/><l level="1" sID="gen15615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7605"/>All of them will respond and say to you,<l eID="gen15615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15616"/>‘You yourself also were made weak like us!<l eID="gen15616" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15617"/>You have become the same as us!’ <l eID="gen15617" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7606"/><l level="1" sID="gen15618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7606"/>Your pride is brought down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Sheol,<l eID="gen15618" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15619"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> the sound of your harps;<l eID="gen15619" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15620"/>maggots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “maggot”</note> are spread out beneath you like a bed,<l eID="gen15620" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15621"/>and your covering is worms.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “worm”</note> <l eID="gen15621" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7607"/><l level="1" sID="gen15622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7607"/>How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of dawn!<l eID="gen15622" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15623"/>You are cut down to the ground, conqueror of nations! <l eID="gen15623" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15594"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7608"/><div sID="gen15624" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7608"/>And you yourself said in your heart, <div eID="gen15624" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15625"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15626"/>‘I will ascend <transChange type="added">to</transChange> heaven;<l eID="gen15626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15627"/>I will raise up my throne above the stars of God;<l eID="gen15627" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15628"/>and I will sit on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountain of assembly<l eID="gen15628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15629"/>on the summit of Zaphon;<note placement="foot">Or “of the north”</note> <l eID="gen15629" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7609"/><l level="1" sID="gen15630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7609"/>I will ascend to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> high places of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clouds,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cloud”</note><l eID="gen15630" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15631"/>I will make myself like the Most High.’ <l eID="gen15631" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7610"/><l level="1" sID="gen15632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7610"/>But you are brought down to Sheol,<l eID="gen15632" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15633"/>to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit. <l eID="gen15633" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7611"/><l level="1" sID="gen15634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7611"/>Those who see you will stare at you,<l eID="gen15634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15635"/>they will look closely at you:<l eID="gen15635" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15636"/>‘<transChange type="added">Is</transChange> this the man who made the earth tremble,<l eID="gen15636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15637"/>who caused kingdoms to shake, <l eID="gen15637" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7612"/><l level="1" sID="gen15638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7612"/>who made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world like the desert<l eID="gen15638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15639"/>and destroyed its cities,<l eID="gen15639" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15640"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> would not let his prisoners go home?’ <l eID="gen15640" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7613"/><l level="1" sID="gen15641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7613"/>All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations, all of them, lie in glory,<l eID="gen15641" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15642"/>each one in his house. <l eID="gen15642" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7614"/><l level="1" sID="gen15643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7614"/>But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> you, you are thrown away from your grave,<l eID="gen15643" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15644"/>like an abhorrent shoot,<l eID="gen15644" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15645"/>clothed with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slain,<l eID="gen15645" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15646"/>those pierced <transChange type="added">by the</transChange> sword,<l eID="gen15646" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15647"/>those who go down to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stones of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit,<l eID="gen15647" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15648"/>like a corpse that is trodden down. <l eID="gen15648" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7615"/><l level="1" sID="gen15649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7615"/>You will not be united with them in burial<l eID="gen15649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15650"/>because you have destroyed your land,<l eID="gen15650" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15651"/>you have killed your people.<l eID="gen15651" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15625"/> <div sID="gen15652" type="x-p"/> <transChange type="added">The</transChange> descendants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “descendant”</note> of evildoers will not be mentioned for eternity!  <div eID="gen15652" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7616"/><lg sID="gen15653"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7616"/>Prepare a place of slaughter for his sons<l eID="gen15654" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15655"/>because of the sin of their ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note><l eID="gen15655" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15656"/>Let them not rise and take possession of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth<l eID="gen15656" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15657"/>or fill up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> face of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world <transChange type="added">with</transChange> cities.” <l eID="gen15657" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7617"/><l level="1" sID="gen15658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7617"/>“And I will rise up against them,”<l eID="gen15658" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen15653"/> <div sID="gen15659" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts, <div eID="gen15659" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15660"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15661"/>“and I will cut off name and a remnant from Babylon,<l eID="gen15661" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15662"/>and offspring and posterity,”<l eID="gen15662" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15660"/> <div sID="gen15663" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen15663" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7618"/><lg sID="gen15664"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7618"/>“And I will make her a possession of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hedgehog,<l eID="gen15665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15666"/>and pools of water,<l eID="gen15666" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15667"/>and I will sweep her away with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> broom of destruction,”<l eID="gen15667" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15664"/> <div sID="gen15668" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts.  <div eID="gen15668" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7619"/><title type="x-s">Oracle of Judgment on Assyria</title> <div sID="gen15669" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7619"/>Yahweh of hosts has sworn, saying, <div eID="gen15669" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15670"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15671"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">The oath formula begins literally “If not”</note> just as I have intended, so it shall be.<l eID="gen15671" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15672"/>And just as I have planned, it shall stand: <l eID="gen15672" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7620"/><l level="1" sID="gen15673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7620"/>to break Assyria in my land,<l eID="gen15673" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15674"/>and I will trample him down on my mountains;<l eID="gen15674" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15675"/>and he shall remove his yoke from them,<l eID="gen15675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15676"/>and he shall remove his burden from his<note placement="foot">That is, their</note> shoulders.”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “shoulder”</note> <l eID="gen15676" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7621"/><l level="1" sID="gen15677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7621"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the plan that is planned concerning all of the earth;<l eID="gen15677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15678"/>and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the hand that is stretched out over all of the nations. <l eID="gen15678" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7622"/><l level="1" sID="gen15679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7622"/>For Yahweh of hosts has planned, and who will frustrate <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?<l eID="gen15679" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15680"/>And his hand <transChange type="added">is</transChange> stretched out, and who will turn it back? <l eID="gen15680" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15670"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7623"/><title type="x-s">Oracle of Judgment on Philistia</title> <div sID="gen15681" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7623"/>In the year of the death of king Ahaz there was this oracle:  <div eID="gen15681" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7624"/><lg sID="gen15682"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7624"/>You must not rejoice, all you Philistines,<l eID="gen15683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15684"/>that the rod that struck you is broken,<l eID="gen15684" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15685"/>for a viper will come forth from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> root of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> snake,<l eID="gen15685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15686"/>and its fruit <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> a flying serpent. <l eID="gen15686" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7625"/><l level="1" sID="gen15687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7625"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstborn of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor will graze,<l eID="gen15687" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15688"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy will lie down in security;<l eID="gen15688" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15689"/>but I will cause your root to die in famine,<l eID="gen15689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15690"/>and it will kill your remnant. <l eID="gen15690" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7626"/><l level="1" sID="gen15691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7626"/>Wail, gate! Cry, city!<l eID="gen15691" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15692"/>Melt,<note placement="foot">With fear or despair</note> Philistia, all of you!<l eID="gen15692" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15693"/>For smoke <transChange type="added">is</transChange> coming from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,<l eID="gen15693" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15694"/>and there is no straggler in his ranks. <l eID="gen15694" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15682"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7627"/><div sID="gen15695" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7627"/>And what will one answer <transChange type="added">the</transChange> messengers of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nation? <div eID="gen15695" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15696"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15697"/>That Yahweh has founded Zion,<l eID="gen15697" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15698"/>and the needy of his people will take refuge in it. <l eID="gen15698" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15696"/> <chapter eID="Isa.14"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7628"/><title type="x-s">Oracle of Judgment on Moab</title> <div sID="gen15699" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7628"/>An oracle of Moab: <div eID="gen15699" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15700"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15701"/>Because Ar is devastated in a night, Moab is destroyed;<l eID="gen15701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15702"/>because Kir of Moab is devastated in a night, it is destroyed. <l eID="gen15702" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7629"/><l level="1" sID="gen15703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7629"/>It has gone up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house,<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note><l eID="gen15703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15704"/>and Dibon <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the high places<l eID="gen15704" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15705"/>for weeping over Nebo,<l eID="gen15705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15706"/>and Moab wails over Medeba.<l eID="gen15706" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15707"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Every head is bald⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “On all its heads baldness”</note><l eID="gen15707" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15708"/>every beard <transChange type="added">is</transChange> shaved. <l eID="gen15708" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7630"/><l level="1" sID="gen15709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7630"/>They gird themselves <transChange type="added">with</transChange> sackcloth in its streets;<l eID="gen15709" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15710"/>on its roofs and public squares everyone wails,<l eID="gen15710" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15711"/>going down in weeping. <l eID="gen15711" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7631"/><l level="1" sID="gen15712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7631"/>And Heshbon and Elealeh cry<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is singular</note> out,<l eID="gen15712" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15713"/>their voice is heard as far as Jahaz;<l eID="gen15713" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15714"/>therefore the armed ones of Moab cry out;<l eID="gen15714" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15715"/>its soul quivers<note placement="foot">The Hebrew words for “cry out” and “quiver” are similar</note> for him. <l eID="gen15715" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7632"/><l level="1" sID="gen15716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7632"/>My heart cries out for Moab;<l eID="gen15716" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15717"/>its fugitives <transChange type="added">flee</transChange> up to Zoar,<l eID="gen15717" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15718"/>to Eglath-shelishiyah.<l eID="gen15718" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15719"/>For <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the ascent of Luhith it goes up it with weeping;<l eID="gen15719" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15720"/>for <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the road of Horonaim they raise up a cry of destruction. <l eID="gen15720" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7633"/><l level="1" sID="gen15721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7633"/>For the waters of Nimrim are wastelands;<l eID="gen15721" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15722"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grass has withered,<l eID="gen15722" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15723"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> vegetation has vanished,<l eID="gen15723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15724"/><transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no greenness. <l eID="gen15724" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7634"/><l level="1" sID="gen15725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7634"/>Therefore they carry <transChange type="added">the</transChange> abundance it has made<l eID="gen15725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15726"/>and their store of goods over the river of the poplars. <l eID="gen15726" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7635"/><l level="1" sID="gen15727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7635"/>For <transChange type="added">a</transChange> cry for help has encircled the territory of Moab,<l eID="gen15727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15728"/>her wailing <transChange type="added">is heard</transChange> as far as Eglaim,<l eID="gen15728" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15729"/>and her wailing <transChange type="added">as far as</transChange> Beer Elim. <l eID="gen15729" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7636"/><l level="1" sID="gen15730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7636"/>For the waters of Dimon<note placement="foot">One of the Dead Sea Scrolls reads “Dibon” here</note> are full <transChange type="added">of</transChange> blood;<l eID="gen15730" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15731"/>but I will place added things upon Dimon:<l eID="gen15731" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15732"/>a lion for the survivors<note placement="foot">Hebrew “survivor”</note> of Moab<l eID="gen15732" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15733"/>and for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> remnant of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land. <l eID="gen15733" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15700"/> <chapter eID="Isa.15"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:1
verses.text: Send a ram<note placement="foot">Possibly “rams” if a scribe accidentally omitted the Hebrew plural ending because the next word begins with that same letter</note> <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> ruler <transChange type="added">of the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen15736" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15737"/>from Sela <transChange type="added">across the</transChange> desert to the mountain of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞daughter Zion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the daughter of Zion”</note> <l eID="gen15737" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15735"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7637"/><div sID="gen15738" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7637"/>And this shall be: <div eID="gen15738" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15739"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15740"/>like a bird fleeing <transChange type="added">from</transChange> a thrust away nest<l eID="gen15740" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15741"/>shall be the daughters of Moab <transChange type="added">at the</transChange> fords of Arnon. <l eID="gen15741" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7638"/><l level="1" sID="gen15742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7638"/>“Bring counsel,<l eID="gen15742" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15743"/>make a decision;<l eID="gen15743" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15744"/>make your shade like the night<l eID="gen15744" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15745"/>in the middle of noonday.<l eID="gen15745" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15746"/>Hide <transChange type="added">the</transChange> outcasts;<l eID="gen15746" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15747"/>you must not betray the fugitive. <l eID="gen15747" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7639"/><l level="1" sID="gen15748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7639"/>Let my outcasts <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Moab dwell as aliens among you;<l eID="gen15748" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15749"/>be a hiding place for them from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> presence of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> destroyer.”<l eID="gen15749" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15750"/>When the oppressor is no more, destruction has stopped,<l eID="gen15750" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15751"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one who tramples has⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one who tramples have,” with mismatched singular and plural</note> disappeared from the land, <l eID="gen15751" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7640"/><l level="1" sID="gen15752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7640"/>then a throne shall be established in steadfast love,<l eID="gen15752" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15753"/>and one shall sit on it in faithfulness, in the tent of David,<l eID="gen15753" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15754"/>judging and seeking justice<l eID="gen15754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15755"/>and zealous for righteousness. <l eID="gen15755" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7641"/><l level="1" sID="gen15756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7641"/>We have heard <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the pride of Moab—exceedingly proud—<l eID="gen15756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15757"/><transChange type="added">of</transChange> his arrogance, pride, and insolence; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his boasting is not true⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not so his boasting”</note> <l eID="gen15757" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7642"/><l level="1" sID="gen15758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7642"/>Therefore Moab wails;<l eID="gen15758" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15759"/>all of it wails for Moab,<l eID="gen15759" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15760"/>for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth you moan, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞utterly devastated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “surely destroyed”</note> <l eID="gen15760" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7643"/><l level="1" sID="gen15761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7643"/>For Heshbon withers the fields, the vine of Sibmah;<l eID="gen15761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15762"/>rulers of nations have broken down her tendrils,<l eID="gen15762" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15763"/>they reached up to Jazer,<l eID="gen15763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15764"/>they wandered <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> desert;<l eID="gen15764" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15765"/>her shoots spread abroad,<l eID="gen15765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15766"/>they crossed over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea. <l eID="gen15766" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7644"/><l level="1" sID="gen15767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7644"/>Therefore I weep with the weeping of Jazer <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the vine of Sibmah.<l eID="gen15767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15768"/>I drench you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> my tears,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “tear”</note> Heshbon and Elealeh,<l eID="gen15768" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15769"/>for a jubilant shout has fallen over your summer fruit and harvest. <l eID="gen15769" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7645"/><l level="1" sID="gen15770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7645"/>And joy and gladness are<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is singular</note> taken away from the fruitful land,<l eID="gen15770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15771"/>and in the vineyards no one exults,<l eID="gen15771" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15772"/>no one shouts for joy;<l eID="gen15772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15773"/>no treader treads wine in the presses;<l eID="gen15773" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15774"/>I have put to an end to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> jubilant shout. <l eID="gen15774" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7646"/><l level="1" sID="gen15775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7646"/>Therefore my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞heart moans⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “intestines moan,”; in Hebrew, the “intestines” are the seat of the emotions, which would correspond to the “heart” in English</note> like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> harp for Moab<l eID="gen15775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15776"/>and my inner parts for Kir-heres. <l eID="gen15776" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15739"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7647"/><div sID="gen15777" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7647"/>And this shall happen: <div eID="gen15777" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15778"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15779"/>when Moab appears, when it is weary upon the high place<l eID="gen15779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15780"/>and it comes to its sanctuary to pray, it will not prevail. <l eID="gen15780" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15778"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7648"/><div sID="gen15781" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7648"/>This <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the word that Yahweh spoke to Moab <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the past⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from then”</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:14
verses.text: But now Yahweh speaks, saying, “In three years, like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> years of a hired worker, the glory of Moab will become contemptible, with all of the great multitude, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> remnant <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> a few, small, not strong.  <chapter eID="Isa.16"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7649"/><title type="x-s">Oracle of Judgment on Damascus</title> <div sID="gen15782" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7649"/>An oracle of Damascus: <div eID="gen15782" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15783"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15784"/>“Look! Damascus <transChange type="added">will</transChange> cease being a city<l eID="gen15784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15785"/>and will become a heap of ruins. <l eID="gen15785" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7650"/><l level="1" sID="gen15786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7650"/>The cities of Aroer will be deserted;<note placement="foot">These words in Hebrew (and “flocks” in the next line) all begin with the same letter, Ayin</note><l eID="gen15786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15787"/>they will be for the flocks,<l eID="gen15787" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15788"/>and they will lie down and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no one will frighten⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there is not one who frightens”</note> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <l eID="gen15788" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7651"/><l level="1" sID="gen15789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7651"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fortified city will disappear from Ephraim,<l eID="gen15789" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15790"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kingdom from Damascus;<l eID="gen15790" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15791"/>and the remnant of Aram will be like the glory of the children of Israel,”<l eID="gen15791" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen15783"/> <div sID="gen15792" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts.  <div eID="gen15792" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7652"/><div sID="gen15793" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7652"/>“And this shall happen: <div eID="gen15793" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15794"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15795"/>On that day, the glory of Jacob will be brought low,<l eID="gen15795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15796"/>and the fat of his flesh will become lean. <l eID="gen15796" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7653"/><l level="1" sID="gen15797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7653"/>And it shall be as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when a reaper gathers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a gathering of a reaper of”</note> standing grain<l eID="gen15797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15798"/>and he reaps grain <transChange type="added">with</transChange> his arm,<l eID="gen15798" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15799"/>and it shall be like one who gathers ears of grain<l eID="gen15799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15800"/>in the valley of Rephaim. <l eID="gen15800" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15794"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7654"/><div sID="gen15801" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7654"/>And gleanings will be left over in it, as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when an olive tree is beaten⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “beating of an olive tree”</note> <div eID="gen15801" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15802"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15803"/>two <transChange type="added">or</transChange> three ripe olive berries in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> top of a branch,<l eID="gen15803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15804"/>four <transChange type="added">or</transChange> five on its fruitful branches,”<l eID="gen15804" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15802"/> <div sID="gen15805" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh, the God of Israel.  <div eID="gen15805" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7655"/><lg sID="gen15806"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7655"/>On that day, mankind will look to its maker,<l eID="gen15807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15808"/>and its eyes will look to the holy one of Israel; <l eID="gen15808" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7656"/><l level="1" sID="gen15809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7656"/>it will not look to the altars,<l eID="gen15809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15810"/>the work of its hands,<l eID="gen15810" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15811"/>and it will not see what its fingers made<l eID="gen15811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15812"/>and the poles of Asherah worship and the incense altars. <l eID="gen15812" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15806"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7657"/><div sID="gen15813" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7657"/>On that day, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its fortified cities⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the cities of his fortress”</note> will be like the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞abandonment of the wooded place and the summit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Perhaps this difficult phrase originally read “abandonment of the wooded heights of the Amorites”</note> which they deserted because of the children of Israel; and there will be desolation.  <div eID="gen15813" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7658"/><lg sID="gen15814"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7658"/>For you have forgotten the God of your salvation,<l eID="gen15815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15816"/>and you have not remembered the rock of your refuge;<l eID="gen15816" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15817"/>therefore you plant plants of pleasantness,<l eID="gen15817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15818"/>and you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞plant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “plant it”</note> a vine of a foreigner. <l eID="gen15818" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7659"/><l level="1" sID="gen15819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7659"/>On your planting day you make <transChange type="added">them</transChange> grow,<l eID="gen15819" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15820"/>and in the morning <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your sowing you bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> into bloom,<l eID="gen15820" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15821"/><transChange type="added">yet</transChange> the harvest will flee<note placement="foot">Reading the same consonants as a verb, <hi type="italic">nad</hi>, rather than the noun <hi type="italic">ned,</hi> which would mean “a heap ofthe harvest”</note> in a day <transChange type="added">of</transChange> sickness and incurable pain.<l eID="gen15821" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen15814"/> <title type="x-s">The Roar of the Peoples</title> <div sID="gen15822" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen15822" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7660"/><lg sID="gen15823"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7660"/>Ah! <transChange type="added">The</transChange> noise of many peoples, they make a noise like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> noise of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas!<l eID="gen15824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15825"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roar of nations, they roar like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roar of mighty waters! <l eID="gen15825" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7661"/><l level="1" sID="gen15826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7661"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> nations roar like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roar of many waters,<l eID="gen15826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15827"/>but he will rebuke him, and he will flee far away.<l eID="gen15827" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15828"/>And they are chased like chaff of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind<l eID="gen15828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15829"/>and like tumbleweed before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> storm. <l eID="gen15829" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7662"/><l level="1" sID="gen15830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7662"/>At <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of evening, and look, terror!<l eID="gen15830" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15831"/>Before morning he is no more.<l eID="gen15831" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15832"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the fate of those who plunder us<l eID="gen15832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15833"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lot of those who plunder us. <l eID="gen15833" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15823"/> <chapter eID="Isa.17"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7663"/><title type="x-s">Oracle of Judgment on Cush</title> <div sID="gen15834" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen15834" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15835"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7663"/>Ah! land <transChange type="added">of the</transChange> whirring of wings,<l eID="gen15836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15837"/>which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> beyond the rivers of Cush, <l eID="gen15837" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7664"/><l level="1" sID="gen15838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7664"/>that sends messengers by the sea<l eID="gen15838" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15839"/>and in vessels of papyrus on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> surface of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> waters!<l eID="gen15839" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15840"/>Go, swift messengers, to a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞tall⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “stretched out”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞smooth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “peeled,” “wiped clean,” or “hairless”</note> nation,<l eID="gen15840" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15841"/>to a people feared <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞near and far⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from this and beyond”</note><l eID="gen15841" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15842"/>a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mighty, mighty⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Perhaps this is a gibberish phrase in Hebrew, <hi type="italic">qaw-qaw</hi></note> and trampling<note placement="foot">Meaning uncertain</note> nation,<l eID="gen15842" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15843"/>whose land rivers divide. <l eID="gen15843" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7665"/><l level="1" sID="gen15844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7665"/>All <transChange type="added">you</transChange> inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world<l eID="gen15844" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15845"/>and dwellers of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen15845" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15846"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when a signal is raised on the⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as a raising of a signal”</note> mountains, you must look,<l eID="gen15846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15847"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when a trumpet is blown⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as a blowing of a trumpet”</note> you must listen! <l eID="gen15847" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15835"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7666"/><div sID="gen15848" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7666"/>For Yahweh said this to me: <div eID="gen15848" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15849"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15850"/>“I will be quiet,<l eID="gen15850" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15851"/>and I will look from my dwelling place<l eID="gen15851" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15852"/>like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞clear heat because of light⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">The meaning of this phrase is uncertain; perhaps the “light” is sunlight</note><l eID="gen15852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15853"/>like a cloud of dew in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heat of harvest.” <l eID="gen15853" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7667"/><l level="1" sID="gen15854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7667"/>For before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> harvest, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the blossom is complete⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as a completion of a blossom”</note><l eID="gen15854" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15855"/>and a blossom becomes ripening fruit,<l eID="gen15855" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15856"/>and one cuts off the shoots with pruning hooks,<l eID="gen15856" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15857"/>and one removes, tears away the tendrils. <l eID="gen15857" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:6
