verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7668"/><l level="1" sID="gen15858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7668"/>They shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all be left⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “be left together”</note> for birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of prey of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains<l eID="gen15858" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15859"/>and for the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the earth.<l eID="gen15859" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15860"/>And the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of prey will pass the summer on it,<l eID="gen15860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15861"/>and every animal of the earth will winter on it. <l eID="gen15861" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15849"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7669"/><div sID="gen15862" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7669"/>At that time, a gift<note placement="foot">Perhaps tribute is meant</note> will be brought to Yahweh of hosts <div eID="gen15862" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15863"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15864"/><transChange type="added">from</transChange> a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞tall⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “stretched out”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞smooth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “peeled,” “wiped clean,” or “hairless”</note> people,<l eID="gen15864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15865"/>and from a people feared near and far,<l eID="gen15865" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15866"/>a mighty, mighty and trampling nation,<l eID="gen15866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15867"/>whose land <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rivers divide,<l eID="gen15867" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15868"/>to the place of the name of Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen15868" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15869"/>the mountain of Zion. <l eID="gen15869" level="2"/><lg eID="gen15863"/> <chapter eID="Isa.18"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7670"/><title type="x-s">Oracle of Judgment on Egypt</title> <div sID="gen15870" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7670"/>An oracle of Egypt: <div eID="gen15870" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15871"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15872"/>Look! Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> riding on a swift cloud<l eID="gen15872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15873"/>and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> coming <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt.<l eID="gen15873" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15874"/>And the idols of Egypt will tremble in front of him,<l eID="gen15874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15875"/>and the heart of Egypt melts in his inner parts. <l eID="gen15875" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7671"/><l level="1" sID="gen15876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7671"/>“And I will stir up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Egyptians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Egypt”</note> against <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Egyptians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Egypt”</note><l eID="gen15876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15877"/>and each one will fight against his brother<l eID="gen15877" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15878"/>and each one against his neighbor,<l eID="gen15878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15879"/>city against city, kingdom against kingdom. <l eID="gen15879" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7672"/><l level="1" sID="gen15880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7672"/>And the spirit of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Egyptians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Egypt”</note> will be disturbed in his midst,<l eID="gen15880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15881"/>and I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞confuse⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “engulf”</note> his plans,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “plan”</note><l eID="gen15881" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15882"/>and they will consult the idols and the spirits of the dead,<l eID="gen15882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15883"/>and the ghosts and the spiritists. <l eID="gen15883" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7673"/><l level="1" sID="gen15884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7673"/>And I will hand over <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Egyptians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Egypt”</note> into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of a hard master,<l eID="gen15884" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15885"/>and a powerful king will rule over them,”<l eID="gen15885" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15886"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh of hosts. <l eID="gen15886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7674"/><l level="1" sID="gen15887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7674"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> waters will be dried up from the sea,<l eID="gen15887" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15888"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> river will be parched and dry. <l eID="gen15888" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7675"/><l level="1" sID="gen15889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7675"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rivers will become foul-smelling;<l eID="gen15889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15890"/>the branches of the Nile of Egypt will become little and dry up;<l eID="gen15890" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15891"/>reed and rush will wither. <l eID="gen15891" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7676"/><l level="1" sID="gen15892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7676"/>Bare places by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Nile will be dried up,<l eID="gen15892" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15893"/>by the edge of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Nile and all the sown land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Nile;<l eID="gen15893" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15894"/>it will be driven about, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it will be no more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “there is none of it”</note> <l eID="gen15894" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7677"/><l level="1" sID="gen15895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7677"/>And the fishers will mourn,<l eID="gen15895" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15896"/>and all of those who cast fishhooks<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fishhook”</note> in the Nile will lament,<l eID="gen15896" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15897"/>and those who spread out fishing nets<note placement="foot">Hebrew “net”</note> on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surface⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> water will languish. <l eID="gen15897" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7678"/><l level="1" sID="gen15898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7678"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> workers of combed flax will be ashamed,<l eID="gen15898" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15899"/>and those who weave white linen. <l eID="gen15899" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7679"/><l level="1" sID="gen15900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7679"/>And her weavers will be crushed;<l eID="gen15900" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15901"/>all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hired workers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “workers of wage”</note> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> grieved of heart. <l eID="gen15901" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7680"/><l level="1" sID="gen15902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7680"/>Surely the princes of Zoan <transChange type="added">are</transChange> foolish;<l eID="gen15902" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15903"/>the wise of the counselors of Pharaoh <transChange type="added">give</transChange> senseless counsel.<l eID="gen15903" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15904"/>How can you say to Pharaoh,<l eID="gen15904" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15905"/>“I myself <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a son of sages,<l eID="gen15905" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15906"/>a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞descendant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “son”</note> of ancient kings”? <l eID="gen15906" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7681"/><l level="1" sID="gen15907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7681"/>Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your sages then?<l eID="gen15907" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15908"/>Now, let them tell you,<l eID="gen15908" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15909"/>and let them know what Yahweh of hosts has planned against Egypt. <l eID="gen15909" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7682"/><l level="1" sID="gen15910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7682"/>The princes of Zoan have become foolish;<l eID="gen15910" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15911"/>the princes of Memphis are deceived;<l eID="gen15911" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15912"/>the leaders of her tribes have led Egypt astray. <l eID="gen15912" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7683"/><l level="1" sID="gen15913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7683"/>Yahweh has mixed a spirit of confusion into her midst,<l eID="gen15913" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15914"/>and they have caused Egypt to stagger in all of its doings,<l eID="gen15914" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen15915"/>as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when a drunkard staggers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the staggering of a drunkard”</note> in his vomit. <l eID="gen15915" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7684"/><l level="1" sID="gen15916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7684"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there will be nothing for Egypt to do⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “not it will be for Egypt a deed which he can do”</note><l eID="gen15916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15917"/>head or tail, palm branch or reed. <l eID="gen15917" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15871"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7685"/><title type="x-s">The Future Blessing of Egypt, Assyria, and Egypt</title> <div sID="gen15918" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7685"/>On that day, Egypt will be like women, and will tremble and be afraid before the waving hand of Yahweh of hosts that he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> waving against it.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:17
verses.text: And the land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt, everyone <transChange type="added">to</transChange> whom one mentions it will be afraid in himself because of the plan of Yahweh of hosts that he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> planning against him.  <div eID="gen15918" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7686"/><div sID="gen15919" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7686"/>On that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞language⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lip”</note> of Canaan and swear an oath to Yahweh of hosts. One will be called “City of the Sun.”  <div eID="gen15919" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7687"/><div sID="gen15920" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7687"/>On that day, there will be an altar for Yahweh <transChange type="added">in</transChange> in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a stone pillar for Yahweh at her border.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:20
verses.text: And it will be a sign and a witness to Yahweh of hosts in the land of Egypt; when they cry out to Yahweh because of oppressors, he will send them a savior and a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞defender⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “contender”</note> and he will deliver them.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:21
verses.text: And Yahweh will make himself known to Egypt, and Egypt will know Yahweh on that day, and they will worship <transChange type="added">with</transChange> sacrifice and offering, and they will make vows<note placement="foot">Hebrew “vow”</note> to Yahweh, and they will fulfill <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Isaiah 19:22
verses.text: And Yahweh will strike Egypt, striking and healing; and they will return to Yahweh, and he will respond to their prayer, and he will heal them.  <div eID="gen15920" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7688"/><div sID="gen15921" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7688"/>On that day, there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria, and Assyria will come into Egypt, and Egypt into Assyria, and Egypt will worship together with Assyria.  <div eID="gen15921" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7689"/><div sID="gen15922" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7689"/>On that day, Israel will be <transChange type="added">the</transChange> third with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth,

verses.name: Isaiah 19:25
verses.text: whom Yahweh of hosts blessed, saying, “May Egypt my people be blessed, and Assyria, the work of my hands, and my inheritance, Israel.”  <chapter eID="Isa.19"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7690"/><title type="x-s">A Sign regarding Egypt and Cush</title> <div sID="gen15923" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7690"/>In <transChange type="added">the</transChange> year <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the commander-in-chief came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of the coming of the commander in chief”</note> to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and he took it,

verses.name: Isaiah 20:2
verses.text: at that time, Yahweh had spoken by the hand of Isaiah son of Amoz, saying, <div eID="gen15923" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15924"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15925"/>“Go and loosen the sackcloth from your loins,<l eID="gen15925" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15926"/>and take off your sandals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sandal”</note> from your feet,”<l eID="gen15926" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15924"/> <div sID="gen15927" type="x-p"/> and he had done so, walking naked and barefoot.  <div eID="gen15927" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7691"/><div sID="gen15928" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7691"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh said, “Just as my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a sign and a portent against Egypt and Cush,

verses.name: Isaiah 20:4
verses.text: so shall the king of Assyria lead the captives<note placement="foot">Hebrew “captive”</note> of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old, naked and barefoot, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with bared buttocks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and bare of buttocks”</note> the shame of Egypt.  <div eID="gen15928" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7692"/><lg sID="gen15929"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7692"/>And they shall be dismayed,<l eID="gen15930" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15931"/>and they shall be ashamed<l eID="gen15931" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15932"/>because of Cush, their hope,<l eID="gen15932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15933"/>and because of Egypt, their pride. <l eID="gen15933" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15929"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7693"/><div sID="gen15934" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7693"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inhabitant<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the coastland will say this on that day: <div eID="gen15934" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen15935" type="x-p"/> ‘Look! This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our hope <transChange type="added">to</transChange> whom we fled for help, to be delivered <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of”</note> the king of Assyria, and how shall we escape?’ ”  <chapter eID="Isa.20"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7694"/><title type="x-s">The Fall of Babylon</title> <div sID="gen15936" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7694"/>The oracle of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wilderness of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea: <div eID="gen15936" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen15937" type="x-p"/> As storm winds passing over in the Negev, <div eID="gen15937" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15938"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15939"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it comes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to come”</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert,<l eID="gen15939" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15940"/>from a frightful land. <l eID="gen15940" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15938"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7695"/><div sID="gen15941" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7695"/>A hard revelation is told to me; <div eID="gen15941" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15942"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15943"/>the treacherous deals treacherously,<l eID="gen15943" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15944"/>and the destroyer destroys.<l eID="gen15944" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15945"/>Go up, Elam;<l eID="gen15945" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15946"/>lay siege, Media!<l eID="gen15946" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15942"/> <div sID="gen15947" type="x-p"/> I put an end to all of her sighing.  <div eID="gen15947" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7696"/><lg sID="gen15948"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7696"/>Therefore my loins are filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> anguish;<l eID="gen15949" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15950"/>pangs have seized me, like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pangs of a woman giving birth.<l eID="gen15950" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15951"/>I am <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞too bent to hear⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “bent from hearing,” which could also mean “bent because of what I heard”</note><l eID="gen15951" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15952"/>I am <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞too dismayed to see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “dismayed from seeing,” which could also mean “dismayed because of what I saw”</note> <l eID="gen15952" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7697"/><l level="1" sID="gen15953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7697"/>My <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> staggers; fear terrifies me;<l eID="gen15953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15954"/>the twilight <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I desired⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of my desire”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞brought⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “put”</note> me fear. <l eID="gen15954" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7698"/><l level="1" sID="gen15955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7698"/>Set out the table in order!<l eID="gen15955" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15956"/>Spread out the rugs!<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rug”</note><l eID="gen15956" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15957"/>Eat! drink!<l eID="gen15957" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15958"/>Rise up, commanders;<l eID="gen15958" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15959"/>smear<note placement="foot">That is, prepare with oil</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shield! <l eID="gen15959" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15948"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7699"/><div sID="gen15960" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7699"/>For the Lord said this to me: <div eID="gen15960" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15961"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15962"/>“Go, set <transChange type="added">a</transChange> watchman in position.<l eID="gen15962" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15963"/>He must announce what he sees. <l eID="gen15963" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7700"/><l level="1" sID="gen15964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7700"/>When<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he sees riders,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rider”</note><l eID="gen15964" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15965"/>a pair of horsemen,<l eID="gen15965" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15966"/>riders<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rider”</note> of donkeys,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “donkey”</note><l eID="gen15966" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15967"/>riders<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rider”</note> of camels,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “camel”</note><l eID="gen15967" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15968"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he must listen attentively,<l eID="gen15968" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15969"/>paying attention, paying <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞special⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “much”</note> attention.” <l eID="gen15969" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15961"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7701"/><div sID="gen15970" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7701"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞watchman⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lion”</note> called, <div eID="gen15970" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15971"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15972"/>“Lord, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> standing on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> watchtower continually by day,<l eID="gen15972" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15973"/>and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> standing at my post <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of”</note> the night. <l eID="gen15973" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7702"/><l level="1" sID="gen15974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7702"/>And look <transChange type="added">at</transChange> this! A man’s a chariot <transChange type="added">is</transChange> coming,<l eID="gen15974" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15975"/>a pair of horsemen!”<l eID="gen15975" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15971"/> <div sID="gen15976" type="x-p"/> Then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he responded and said, <div eID="gen15976" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15977"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15978"/>“It has fallen! Babylon has fallen!<l eID="gen15978" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15979"/>And all the images of her gods are<note placement="foot">Hebrew “is”</note> smashed on the ground!” <l eID="gen15979" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7703"/><l level="1" sID="gen15980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7703"/>My downtrodden people<l eID="gen15980" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15981"/>and the son of my threshing floor,<l eID="gen15981" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15977"/> <div sID="gen15982" type="x-p"/> I will announce to you what I have heard from Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel.  <div eID="gen15982" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7704"/><title type="x-s">Oracle regarding Dumah</title> <div sID="gen15983" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7704"/>The oracle of Dumah: <div eID="gen15983" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen15984" type="x-p"/> <transChange type="added">One is</transChange> calling to me from Seir, <div eID="gen15984" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15985"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15986"/>“Watchman, what <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night?<l eID="gen15986" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15987"/>Watchman, what <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night?” <l eID="gen15987" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15985"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7705"/><div sID="gen15988" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7705"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> watchman says, <div eID="gen15988" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15989"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15990"/>“Morning comes,<l eID="gen15990" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15991"/>and also <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night.<l eID="gen15991" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15992"/>If you will inquire, inquire;<l eID="gen15992" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15993"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞come back again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “return come”</note> <l eID="gen15993" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15989"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7706"/><title type="x-s">Oracle against Arabia</title> <div sID="gen15994" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7706"/>An oracle <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concerning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in”</note> Arabia: <div eID="gen15994" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15995"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15996"/>You will spend the night in the thicket in a desert-plateau,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew for “in a desert-plateau” is the same as for “concerning Arabia” in the preceding line</note><l eID="gen15996" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15997"/>caravans of Dedanites. <l eID="gen15997" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7707"/><l level="1" sID="gen15998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7707"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When you happen to meet⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Toward encountering”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thirsty, bring water.<l eID="gen15998" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen15999"/>Inhabitants of the land of Tema came to meet <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fugitive with his bread. <l eID="gen15999" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7708"/><l level="1" sID="gen16000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7708"/>For they have fled from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> swords,<l eID="gen16000" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16001"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> drawn sword and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bent bow,<l eID="gen16001" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16002"/>and from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heaviness of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> battle. <l eID="gen16002" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen15995"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7709"/><div sID="gen16003" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7709"/>For the Lord said this to me: <div eID="gen16003" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen16004" type="x-p"/> “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In one more year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “In yet a year”</note> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> years of a hired worker, <div eID="gen16004" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16005"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16006"/>all the glory of Kedar will come to an end. <l eID="gen16006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7710"/><l level="2" sID="gen16007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7710"/>And the remainder of the number of the bows<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bow”</note> of the warriors of the sons of Kedar will be few.”<l eID="gen16007" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16005"/> <div sID="gen16008" type="x-p"/> For Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken.  <chapter eID="Isa.21"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7711"/><title type="x-s">Oracle against Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen16009" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7711"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> oracle of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> valley of vision: <div eID="gen16009" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen16010" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What business do you have going⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “What to you then that you have gone”</note> up, all of you, to the roofs,  <div eID="gen16010" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7712"/><lg sID="gen16011"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7712"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞noisy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “full of noises”</note> tumultuous city,<l eID="gen16012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16013"/>exultant town?<l eID="gen16013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16014"/>Your slain <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not slain by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword,<l eID="gen16014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16015"/>nor <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> dead from battle. <l eID="gen16015" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7713"/><l level="1" sID="gen16016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7713"/>All of your rulers have fled together without a bow;<l eID="gen16016" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16017"/>all of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you who were found⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your found ones”</note> were captured.<l eID="gen16017" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16018"/>They were captured together;<l eID="gen16018" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16019"/>they had fled far away. <l eID="gen16019" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16011"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7714"/><div sID="gen16020" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7714"/>Therefore I said, <div eID="gen16020" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16021"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16022"/>“Look away from me,<l eID="gen16022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16023"/>let me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞weep bitterly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “be bitter in weeping”</note><l eID="gen16023" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16024"/>you must not insist on comforting me<l eID="gen16024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16025"/>for the destruction of the daughter of my people.” <l eID="gen16025" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7715"/><l level="1" sID="gen16026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7715"/>For the Lord Yahweh of hosts has a day of tumult and trampling and confusion<note placement="foot">These three Hebrew words are alliterative: <hi type="italic">m</hi><hi type="italic">e</hi><hi type="italic">hûm</hi><hi type="italic">â</hi><hi type="italic">ûm</hi><hi type="italic">e</hi><hi type="italic">ḇûs</hi><hi type="italic">â</hi><hi type="italic">ûm</hi><hi type="italic">e</hi><hi type="italic">ḇû</hi><hi type="italic">ḵâ</hi></note> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> valley of vision,<l eID="gen16026" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16027"/><transChange type="added">a</transChange> tearing down of walls<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wall”</note> and a cry for help to the mountains.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mountain”</note> <l eID="gen16027" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7716"/><l level="1" sID="gen16028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7716"/>And Elam lifted up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> quiver,<l eID="gen16028" level="1"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16029"/>with chariots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note> of men<note placement="foot">Hebrew “man”</note> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> cavalry.<l eID="gen16029" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16030"/>And Kir uncovered <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shield. <l eID="gen16030" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16021"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7717"/><div sID="gen16031" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7717"/>And this happened: <div eID="gen16031" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16032"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16033"/>the choicest of your valleys were full of chariots,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note><l eID="gen16033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16034"/>and the cavalry confidently stood at the gate. <l eID="gen16034" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7718"/><l level="3" sID="gen16035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7718"/>And he uncovered the covering of Judah.<l eID="gen16035" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16036"/>And you looked, on that day, to the weapons<note placement="foot">Hebrew “weapon”</note> of the House of the Forest, <l eID="gen16036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7719"/><l level="2" sID="gen16037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7719"/>and you saw that the breaches in the walls of the city of David were many,<l eID="gen16037" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16038"/>and you gathered the waters of the lower pool. <l eID="gen16038" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7720"/><l level="1" sID="gen16039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7720"/>And you counted the houses of Jerusalem,<l eID="gen16039" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16040"/>and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall. <l eID="gen16040" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7721"/><l level="3" sID="gen16041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7721"/>And you made a reservoir between the walls for the waters of the old pool,<l eID="gen16041" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16042"/>but you did not look to its maker,<l eID="gen16042" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16043"/>and you did not see <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the one who created it long ago⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “its creator from far away”</note> <l eID="gen16043" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16032"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7722"/><div sID="gen16044" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7722"/>And the Lord, Yahweh of hosts, called on that day <div eID="gen16044" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16045"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16046"/>for weeping and mourning,<l eID="gen16046" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16047"/>and for baldness and girding <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> sackcloth. <l eID="gen16047" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7723"/><l level="1" sID="gen16048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7723"/>But look! Joy and gladness,<l eID="gen16048" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16049"/>the killing of oxen<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ox”</note> and the slaughtering of sheep,<l eID="gen16049" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16050"/>the eating of meat and the drinking of wine!<l eID="gen16050" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16051"/>“Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!” <l eID="gen16051" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16045"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7724"/><div sID="gen16052" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7724"/>And it was revealed in my ears <transChange type="added">by</transChange> Yahweh of hosts: <div eID="gen16052" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16053"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16054"/>“Surely this sin will not be atoned for you until you die!”<l eID="gen16054" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16055"/>says the Lord, Yahweh of hosts. <l eID="gen16055" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16053"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7725"/><title type="x-s">Oracle regarding Shebna</title> <div sID="gen16056" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7725"/>The Lord, Yahweh of hosts, says this: <div eID="gen16056" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16057"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16058"/>“Go! Go to this steward, to Shebna,<l eID="gen16058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16059"/>who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> over the house: <l eID="gen16059" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7726"/><l level="1" sID="gen16060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7726"/>‘What <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞business do you have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to you”</note> here,<l eID="gen16060" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16061"/>and who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞do you have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to you”</note> here,<l eID="gen16061" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16062"/>that you have cut a grave cutting here for yourself,<l eID="gen16062" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16063"/>carving his grave <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the height,<l eID="gen16063" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16064"/>a dwelling place for him in the rock? <l eID="gen16064" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7727"/><l level="1" sID="gen16065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7727"/>Look! Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> about to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞really hurl⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hurl a hurling”</note> you, man!<l eID="gen16065" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16066"/>And he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> about to grasp you firmly; <l eID="gen16066" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7728"/><l level="3" sID="gen16067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7728"/>he will wind a winding tightly around you like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> ball, to a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wide land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “land broad of sides”</note><l eID="gen16067" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16068"/>There you shall die,<l eID="gen16068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16069"/>and there the chariots of your splendor <transChange type="added">will be</transChange>,<l eID="gen16069" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16070"/>disgrace to your master’s house! <l eID="gen16070" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7729"/><l level="1" sID="gen16071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7729"/>And I will push you from your office,<l eID="gen16071" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16072"/>and he will throw you down from your position. <l eID="gen16072" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16057"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7730"/><div sID="gen16073" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7730"/>And this shall happen: <div eID="gen16073" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16074"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16075"/>On that day I will call to my servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah, <l eID="gen16075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7731"/><l level="2" sID="gen16076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7731"/>and I will clothe him <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your tunic,<l eID="gen16076" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16077"/>and I will bind your sash firmly about him,<l eID="gen16077" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16078"/>and I will put your authority into his hand,<l eID="gen16078" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16079"/>and he shall be like a father to the inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of Jerusalem<l eID="gen16079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16080"/>and to the house of Judah. <l eID="gen16080" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7732"/><l level="1" sID="gen16081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7732"/>And I will put the key of the house of David on his shoulder,<l eID="gen16081" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16082"/>and he shall open and no one <transChange type="added">will be able to</transChange> shut;<l eID="gen16082" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16083"/>and he shall shut and no one <transChange type="added">will be able to</transChange> open. <l eID="gen16083" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7733"/><l level="1" sID="gen16084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7733"/>And I will drive him in <transChange type="added">like</transChange> a peg into a secure place,<l eID="gen16084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16085"/>and he will become like a throne of glory to the house of his father. <l eID="gen16085" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7734"/><l level="1" sID="gen16086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7734"/>And they will hang all of the heaviness of his father’s house on him,<l eID="gen16086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16087"/>the offspring and the offshoot,<l eID="gen16087" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16088"/>all of the small vessels,<l eID="gen16088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16089"/>from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bowls to the jars⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “vessels of the bowls to all of the vessels of the jars”</note> <l eID="gen16089" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16074"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7735"/><div sID="gen16090" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7735"/>On that day, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts, the peg that was driven will move away into a secure place, and it will be cut down and fall, and the load that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on her will be cut off. For Yahweh has spoken.’ ”  <chapter eID="Isa.22"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7736"/><title type="x-s">Oracle against Tyre</title> <div sID="gen16091" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7736"/>The oracle of Tyre: <div eID="gen16091" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16092"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16093"/>Wail, ships of Tarshish, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the house is destroyed so that no one can enter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “it is destroyed from a house from entering”</note><l eID="gen16093" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16094"/>it is announced to them from the land of Cyprus. <l eID="gen16094" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7737"/><l level="1" sID="gen16095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7737"/>Be still, inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> coast,<l eID="gen16095" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16096"/>merchant of Sidon, who travels over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea, they filled you. <l eID="gen16096" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7738"/><l level="1" sID="gen16097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7738"/>And on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> great waters <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the seed of Shihor,<l eID="gen16097" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16098"/>the harvest of the Nile <transChange type="added">is</transChange> its produce,<l eID="gen16098" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16099"/>and she was <transChange type="added">the</transChange> merchandise of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations. <l eID="gen16099" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7739"/><l level="1" sID="gen16100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7739"/>Be ashamed, Sidon, for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea,<l eID="gen16100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16101"/>the fortress of the sea said, saying,<l eID="gen16101" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16102"/>“I was not in labor,<l eID="gen16102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16103"/>and I have not given birth,<l eID="gen16103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16104"/>and I have not reared young men,<l eID="gen16104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16105"/>brought<note placement="foot">Or “I have brought”</note> up young women.” <l eID="gen16105" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7740"/><l level="1" sID="gen16106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7740"/>When <transChange type="added">the</transChange> report <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> to Egypt,<l eID="gen16106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16107"/>they will be in anguish at the report <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞about⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> Tyre. <l eID="gen16107" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7741"/><l level="1" sID="gen16108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7741"/>Cross over <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Tarshish!<l eID="gen16108" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16109"/>Wail, inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> coast! <l eID="gen16109" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7742"/><l level="1" sID="gen16110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7742"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Is this your exultant one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “this to you, exultant”</note> her origin from the days of long ago?<l eID="gen16110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16111"/>Her feet brought her to dwell afar as an alien. <l eID="gen16111" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7743"/><l level="1" sID="gen16112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7743"/>Who has planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “crown”</note><l eID="gen16112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16113"/>whose merchants <transChange type="added">were</transChange> princes,<l eID="gen16113" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16114"/>her traders <transChange type="added">the</transChange> honored ones of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth? <l eID="gen16114" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7744"/><l level="1" sID="gen16115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7744"/>Yahweh of hosts has planned it:<l eID="gen16115" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16116"/>to defile <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pride of all glory,<l eID="gen16116" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16117"/>to humble all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> honored ones of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen16117" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7745"/><l level="1" sID="gen16118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7745"/>Cross over your <transChange type="added">own</transChange> land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish;<l eID="gen16118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16119"/>there is no longer a harbor.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “waistband” is emended to “harbor” by transposing two consonants</note> <l eID="gen16119" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7746"/><l level="1" sID="gen16120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7746"/>He has stretched his hand out over the sea;<l eID="gen16120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16121"/>he has made kingdoms shake.<l eID="gen16121" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16122"/>Yahweh has commanded concerning Canaan<l eID="gen16122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16123"/>to destroy her fortresses. <l eID="gen16123" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16092"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7747"/><div sID="gen16124" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7747"/>And he said, <div eID="gen16124" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16125"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16126"/>“You will not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continue⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do again longer”</note> to exult, crushed one, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞virgin⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “virgin of the”</note> daughter of Sidon.<l eID="gen16126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16127"/>Arise, cross over <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Cyprus! There will be no rest for you even there.” <l eID="gen16127" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7748"/><l level="1" sID="gen16128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7748"/>Look <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the land of the Chaldeans!<l eID="gen16128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16129"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞This people no longer exists. <milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><l eID="gen16129" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16130"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>Assyria destined⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “this people was not Assyria destined,” which could be translated “It was this people! It was not Assyria. They destined”</note> it for wild animals.<l eID="gen16130" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16131"/>They erected its siege towers;<l eID="gen16131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16132"/>they demolished its citadel fortresses.<l eID="gen16132" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16133"/>It made her like a ruin. <l eID="gen16133" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7749"/><l level="1" sID="gen16134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7749"/>Wail, ships of Tarshish!<l eID="gen16134" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16135"/>For your fortress is destroyed. <l eID="gen16135" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16125"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7750"/><div sID="gen16136" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7750"/>And this will happen on that day: And Tyre <transChange type="added">will</transChange> be forgotten seventy years,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> <div eID="gen16136" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen16137" type="x-p"/> like the days of one king. At <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end of seventy years,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> it will be for Tyre like the song of the prostitute:  <div eID="gen16137" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7751"/><lg sID="gen16138"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7751"/>“Take a harp,<l eID="gen16139" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16140"/>go around <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city, forgotten prostitute!<l eID="gen16140" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16141"/>Do <transChange type="added">it</transChange> well, playing a stringed instrument!<l eID="gen16141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16142"/>Make numerous songs,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “song”</note> that you may be remembered.” <l eID="gen16142" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16138"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7752"/><div sID="gen16143" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7752"/>And this shall happen: <div eID="gen16143" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen16144" type="x-p"/> at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end of seventy years,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> Yahweh will visit Tyre, <div eID="gen16144" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16145"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16146"/>and she will return to her harlot’s wages,<l eID="gen16146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16147"/>and she will commit fornication<l eID="gen16147" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16148"/>with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth. <l eID="gen16148" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen16145"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7753"/><div sID="gen16149" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7753"/>And this shall happen: <div eID="gen16149" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen16150" type="x-p"/> her merchandise and her harlot’s wages <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> set apart for Yahweh; <div eID="gen16150" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16151"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16152"/>it will not be stored up,<l eID="gen16152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16153"/>and it will not be hoarded,<l eID="gen16153" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16154"/>but her merchandise will be for those who live before the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> of Yahweh,<l eID="gen16154" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16155"/>for eating to satiation and for fine clothing. <l eID="gen16155" level="2"/><lg eID="gen16151"/> <chapter eID="Isa.23"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7754"/><title type="x-s">The Judgment on the Earth</title> <div sID="gen16156" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen16156" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16157"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7754"/>Look! Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> about to lay the earth waste<l eID="gen16158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16159"/>and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> about to devastate it,<l eID="gen16159" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16160"/>and he will twist her surface,<l eID="gen16160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16161"/>and he will scatter her inhabitants. <l eID="gen16161" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7755"/><l level="1" sID="gen16162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7755"/>And it shall be as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the people, so <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the priest;<l eID="gen16162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16163"/>as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the slave, so <transChange type="added">with</transChange> his master;<l eID="gen16163" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16164"/>as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the female slave, so <transChange type="added">with</transChange> her mistress;<l eID="gen16164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16165"/>as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the buyer, so <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the seller;<l eID="gen16165" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16166"/>as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the lender, so <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the borrower;<l eID="gen16166" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16167"/>as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the creditor, so <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> to whom he lends. <l eID="gen16167" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7756"/><l level="1" sID="gen16168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7756"/>The earth shall be utterly laid waste,<l eID="gen16168" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16169"/>and it shall be utterly plundered,<l eID="gen16169" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16157"/> <div sID="gen16170" type="x-p"/> for Yahweh has spoken this word.  <div eID="gen16170" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7757"/><lg sID="gen16171"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7757"/>The earth dries up, it withers;<l eID="gen16172" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16173"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> world languishes, it withers.<l eID="gen16173" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16174"/>The elevated of the people of the earth languish, <l eID="gen16174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7758"/><l level="2" sID="gen16175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7758"/>and the earth is defiled beneath its inhabitants.<l eID="gen16175" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16176"/>For they have transgressed laws;<l eID="gen16176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16177"/>they have passed by statutes;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “statute”</note><l eID="gen16177" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16178"/>they have broken <transChange type="added">the</transChange> everlasting covenant. <l eID="gen16178" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7759"/><l level="1" sID="gen16179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7759"/>Therefore a curse devours <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen16179" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16180"/>and the inhabitants in it suffer for their guilt.<l eID="gen16180" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16181"/>Therefore <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth burn,<l eID="gen16181" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16182"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞few men are left⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he is left a man of smallness”</note> <l eID="gen16182" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7760"/><l level="1" sID="gen16183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7760"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> new wine dries up;<l eID="gen16183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16184"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> vine languishes.<l eID="gen16184" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16185"/>All <transChange type="added">the</transChange> merry of heart sigh; <l eID="gen16185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7761"/><l level="2" sID="gen16186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7761"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> joy of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tambourine has stopped.<l eID="gen16186" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16187"/>The noise of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> jubilant has ceased;<l eID="gen16187" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16188"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> joy of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lyre has stopped. <l eID="gen16188" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7762"/><l level="1" sID="gen16189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7762"/>They do not drink wine with song;<l eID="gen16189" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16190"/>strong drink is bitter to those who drink it. <l eID="gen16190" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7763"/><l level="1" sID="gen16191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7763"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> city of emptiness is broken;<l eID="gen16191" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16192"/>every house is shut <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that no one can enter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “from entering”</note> <l eID="gen16192" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7764"/><l level="2" sID="gen16193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7764"/><transChange type="added">there is</transChange> an outcry over the wine in the streets.<l eID="gen16193" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16194"/>All joy turns into <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞darkness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “evening”</note><l eID="gen16194" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16195"/>the joy of the earth disappears. <l eID="gen16195" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7765"/><l level="1" sID="gen16196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7765"/>Desolation is left in the city;<l eID="gen16196" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16197"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> gate is crushed <transChange type="added">into</transChange> a state of ruin. <l eID="gen16197" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7766"/><l level="1" sID="gen16198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7766"/>For it shall be like this in the midst of the earth,<l eID="gen16198" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16199"/>among the nations,<l eID="gen16199" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16200"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> beating of an olive tree,<l eID="gen16200" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16201"/>like gleanings when a grape harvest is at an end. <l eID="gen16201" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7767"/><l level="1" sID="gen16202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7767"/>They lift up their voices;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “voice”</note> they sing for joy;<l eID="gen16202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16203"/>they shout out from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> west over the majesty of Yahweh. <l eID="gen16203" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7768"/><l level="1" sID="gen16204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7768"/>Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east,<l eID="gen16204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16205"/>the name of Yahweh the God of Israel in the coastlands of the sea. <l eID="gen16205" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7769"/><l level="1" sID="gen16206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7769"/>We hear songs from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞edge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wing”</note> of the earth:<l eID="gen16206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16207"/>“Glory to the righteous <transChange type="added">one</transChange>!”<l eID="gen16207" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16208"/>But I say, “Ruin to me!<l eID="gen16208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16209"/>Ruin to me! Woe to me!<l eID="gen16209" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16210"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> treacherous ones deal treacherously,<l eID="gen16210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16211"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> treacherous ones deal treacherously <transChange type="added">with</transChange> treachery!” <l eID="gen16211" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16171"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7770"/><div sID="gen16212" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7770"/>Terror and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> snare <transChange type="added">are</transChange> upon you, inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of the earth!  <div eID="gen16212" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7771"/><div sID="gen16213" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7771"/>And this shall happen: <div eID="gen16213" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16214"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16215"/>The one who flees from the sound of the terror shall fall into the pit,<l eID="gen16215" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16216"/>and the one who goes up from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞inside the pit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the middle of the pit”</note> shall be caught in the snare,<l eID="gen16216" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16217"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> windows from heaven are opened,<l eID="gen16217" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16218"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> foundations of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth tremble. <l eID="gen16218" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7772"/><l level="1" sID="gen16219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7772"/>The earth is utterly broken;<l eID="gen16219" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16220"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth is torn asunder;<l eID="gen16220" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16221"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth is shaken violently. <l eID="gen16221" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7773"/><l level="1" sID="gen16222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7773"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> earth staggers to and fro like the drunkard,<l eID="gen16222" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16223"/>and it sways like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> hut,<l eID="gen16223" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16224"/>and its transgression is heavy upon it,<l eID="gen16224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16225"/>and it falls and does not rise again. <l eID="gen16225" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16214"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7774"/><div sID="gen16226" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7774"/>And this shall happen on that day: <div eID="gen16226" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16227"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16228"/>Yahweh will punish the host of heaven in heaven,<l eID="gen16228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16229"/>and the kings of the earth on the earth. <l eID="gen16229" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7775"/><l level="1" sID="gen16230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7775"/>And they will be gathered <transChange type="added">in</transChange> a gathering, <transChange type="added">like</transChange> a prisoner <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on”</note> a pit.<l eID="gen16230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16231"/>And they will be shut <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on”</note> a prison and be punished <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞after⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> many days. <l eID="gen16231" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7776"/><l level="1" sID="gen16232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7776"/>And the full moon will be ashamed<l eID="gen16232" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16233"/>and the sun will be ashamed,<l eID="gen16233" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16234"/>for Yahweh of hosts will rule on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Mount Zion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of Zion”</note> and in Jerusalem,<l eID="gen16234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16235"/>and before his elders <transChange type="added">in</transChange> glory. <l eID="gen16235" level="2"/><lg eID="gen16227"/> <chapter eID="Isa.24"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7777"/><title type="x-s">Praise for Salvation</title> <div sID="gen16236" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen16236" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16237"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7777"/>Yahweh, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my God; I will exalt you.<l eID="gen16238" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16239"/>I will praise your name,<l eID="gen16239" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16240"/>for you have done wonderful things,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing”</note><l eID="gen16240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16241"/>plans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “plan”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from far away “</note> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> faithfulness, trustworthiness. <l eID="gen16241" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7778"/><l level="1" sID="gen16242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7778"/>For you have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “placed”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city <transChange type="added">a</transChange> heap,<l eID="gen16242" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16243"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> fortified city a ruin,<l eID="gen16243" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16244"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> palace of foreigners <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is no longer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> a city;<l eID="gen16244" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16245"/>it will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞never⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity not”</note> be rebuilt. <l eID="gen16245" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7779"/><l level="1" sID="gen16246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7779"/>Therefore strong peoples will glorify you;<l eID="gen16246" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16247"/>a city of ruthless nations, they will fear you. <l eID="gen16247" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7780"/><l level="1" sID="gen16248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7780"/>For you have been a refuge to the poor,<l eID="gen16248" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16249"/>a refuge to the needy in his distress,<l eID="gen16249" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16250"/>a shelter from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rainstorm,<l eID="gen16250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16251"/>a shade from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heat.<l eID="gen16251" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16252"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> breath of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ruthless <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like a rainstorm against a wall,<note placement="foot">The same consonants with different vowels can be translated “winter rainstorm”</note> <l eID="gen16252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7781"/><l level="2" sID="gen16253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7781"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> noise of foreigners like heat in a dry land.<l eID="gen16253" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16254"/>You subdued <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heat with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shade of a cloud;<l eID="gen16254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16255"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> song of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ruthless was silenced. <l eID="gen16255" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7782"/><l level="1" sID="gen16256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7782"/>And on this mountain Yahweh of hosts will make for all peoples a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rich feast⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “feast of fat”</note><l eID="gen16256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16257"/>a feast of aged wines, fat filled with marrow, filtered aged wine. <l eID="gen16257" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7783"/><l level="1" sID="gen16258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7783"/>And on this mountain he will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞destroy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “engulf”</note> the face of the shroud,<l eID="gen16258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16259"/>the shroud over all peoples,<l eID="gen16259" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16260"/>and the woven covering over all nations. <l eID="gen16260" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7784"/><l level="1" sID="gen16261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7784"/>He will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞destroy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “engulf”</note> death forever,<l eID="gen16261" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16262"/>and the Lord Yahweh will wipe off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tears from all faces,<l eID="gen16262" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16263"/>and he will remove the disgrace of his people from all the earth,<l eID="gen16263" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16237"/> <div sID="gen16264" type="x-p"/> for Yahweh has spoken.  <div eID="gen16264" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7785"/><div sID="gen16265" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7785"/>And one will say, on that day, <div eID="gen16265" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16266"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16267"/>“Look! This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our God! We have waited for him and he saved us!<l eID="gen16267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16268"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh; we waited for him!<l eID="gen16268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16269"/>Let us be glad,<l eID="gen16269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16270"/>and let us rejoice in his salvation.” <l eID="gen16270" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:10
