verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7786"/><l level="1" sID="gen16271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7786"/>For the hand of Yahweh will rest on this mountain,<l eID="gen16271" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16272"/>and Moab shall be trampled down under him<l eID="gen16272" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16273"/>as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a heap of straw is trampled down⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the trampling down of a heap of straw”</note> in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞waters of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">These words are in the written Hebrew text, but not in the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> a dung heap. <l eID="gen16273" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7787"/><l level="1" sID="gen16274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7787"/>And it<note placement="foot">Moab</note> will spread out its hands in the midst of it,<l eID="gen16274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16275"/>just as the swimmer spreads out to swim,<l eID="gen16275" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16276"/>and its pride will be brought low with the movement<note placement="foot">Meaning uncertain</note> of its hands. <l eID="gen16276" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7788"/><l level="1" sID="gen16277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7788"/>And he will throw down the fortification of the high point of your walls;<l eID="gen16277" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16278"/>he will bring <transChange type="added">it</transChange> low;<l eID="gen16278" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16279"/>he will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞send it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause it to touch”</note> to the ground,<l eID="gen16279" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16280"/>to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust. <l eID="gen16280" level="2"/><lg eID="gen16266"/> <chapter eID="Isa.25"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7789"/><title type="x-s">Judah’s Song of Praise</title> <div sID="gen16281" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7789"/>On that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: <div eID="gen16281" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16282"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16283"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞We have a strong city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a city of strength for us”</note><l eID="gen16283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16284"/>he sets up victory <transChange type="added">like</transChange> walls and ramparts!<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rampart”</note> <l eID="gen16284" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16282"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7790"/><div sID="gen16285" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7790"/>Open <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gates <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous nation who keeps faithfulness may enter!  <div eID="gen16285" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7791"/><lg sID="gen16286"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7791"/>You will protect a firm inclination <transChange type="added">in</transChange> peace,<l eID="gen16287" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16288"/><transChange type="added">in</transChange> peace because he trusts in you. <l eID="gen16288" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7792"/><l level="1" sID="gen16289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7792"/>Trust in Yahweh forever,<l eID="gen16289" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16290"/>for in Yah, Yahweh <transChange type="added">you have</transChange> an everlasting rock. <l eID="gen16290" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7793"/><l level="1" sID="gen16291"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7793"/>For he has thrown down <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> height,<l eID="gen16291" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16292"/>he lays low <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lofty city.<l eID="gen16292" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16293"/>He lays it low to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ground;<l eID="gen16293" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16294"/>he throws her to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust. <l eID="gen16294" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7794"/><l level="1" sID="gen16295"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7794"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> foot tramples it,<l eID="gen16295" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16296"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> feet of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> steps of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy.”<l eID="gen16296" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16286"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh’s People Vindicated</title> <div sID="gen16297" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen16297" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7795"/><lg sID="gen16298"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7795"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> way of the righteous <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a straight path;<l eID="gen16299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16300"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you clear the level path of the righteous⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the level path of the righteous you make level”; the meaning of this phrase is uncertain</note> <l eID="gen16300" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7796"/><l level="1" sID="gen16301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7796"/>Surely we wait for you <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the path of your judgments, Yahweh,<l eID="gen16301" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16302"/>for your name and renown <transChange type="added">are the</transChange> desire of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> soul. <l eID="gen16302" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7797"/><l level="1" sID="gen16303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7797"/>I desire you <transChange type="added">with all</transChange> my soul in the night;<l eID="gen16303" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16304"/>also I seek you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> my spirit within me,<l eID="gen16304" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16305"/>for when your judgments <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> the earth,<l eID="gen16305" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16306"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world learn righteousness. <l eID="gen16306" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16298"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7798"/><div sID="gen16307" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7798"/><transChange type="added">Though the</transChange> wicked person is shown compassion, he does not learn righteousness; <div eID="gen16307" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16308"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16309"/>he acts unjustly in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land <transChange type="added">of</transChange> uprightness,<l eID="gen16309" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16310"/>and he does not see the majesty of Yahweh. <l eID="gen16310" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16308"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7799"/><div sID="gen16311" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7799"/>Yahweh, <transChange type="added">though</transChange> your hand reaches high, they do not see <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <div eID="gen16311" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16312"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16313"/>Let them see, and let them be ashamed of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> zeal of people.<l eID="gen16313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16314"/>Indeed, let the fire of your enemies consume them. <l eID="gen16314" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7800"/><l level="1" sID="gen16315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7800"/>Yahweh, you will establish peace for us,<l eID="gen16315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16316"/>for you have done even all of our works for us. <l eID="gen16316" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7801"/><l level="1" sID="gen16317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7801"/>Yahweh, our God, lords besides you ruled over us,<l eID="gen16317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16318"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but we praise your name alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “alone in you we praise name you”</note> <l eID="gen16318" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7802"/><l level="1" sID="gen16319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7802"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> dead do not live;<l eID="gen16319" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16320"/>dead spirits do not rise<l eID="gen16320" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16321"/>because you have punished and destroyed them,<l eID="gen16321" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16322"/>and you have destroyed all memory of them. <l eID="gen16322" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7803"/><l level="1" sID="gen16323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7803"/>You have added to the nation, Yahweh.<l eID="gen16323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16324"/>You have added to the nation; you are honored.<l eID="gen16324" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16325"/>You have extended all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ends of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land. <l eID="gen16325" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7804"/><l level="1" sID="gen16326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7804"/>Yahweh, in distress they have visited you;<l eID="gen16326" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16327"/>they poured out an <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞incantation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “whispering”</note><l eID="gen16327" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16328"/>your discipline <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on them. <l eID="gen16328" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7805"/><l level="1" sID="gen16329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7805"/>Like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> pregnant woman on the point of giving birth, she writhes;<l eID="gen16329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16330"/>she cries in her labor pains.<l eID="gen16330" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16312"/> <div sID="gen16331" type="x-p"/> So we were because of your presence, Yahweh.  <div eID="gen16331" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7806"/><lg sID="gen16332"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7806"/>We became pregnant, we writhed;<l eID="gen16333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16334"/>we gave birth <transChange type="added">to</transChange> wind.<l eID="gen16334" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16335"/>We cannot bring about deliverance <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen16335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16336"/>and no inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world are born. <l eID="gen16336" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7807"/><l level="1" sID="gen16337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7807"/>Your dead shall live; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their corpses⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my corpse;” some manuscripts propose an emendation to the suffix to change it to third person masculine plural (“their corpses”), which makes better sense</note> shall rise.<l eID="gen16337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16338"/>Wake up and sing for joy, dwellers of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust,<l eID="gen16338" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16339"/>for your dew <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞celestial dew⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “dew of light”</note><l eID="gen16339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16340"/>and the earth will give birth to dead spirits.<note placement="foot">Or “you make the land of Rephaim fall”</note> <l eID="gen16340" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7808"/><l level="1" sID="gen16341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7808"/>Go, my people, enter into your chambers<l eID="gen16341" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16342"/>and shut your doors<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) is singular</note> behind you;<l eID="gen16342" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16343"/>hide for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a very little⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a little a little”</note> while,<l eID="gen16343" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16344"/>until <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wrath has passed over. <l eID="gen16344" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7809"/><l level="1" sID="gen16345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7809"/>For look! Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> about to come out from his place<l eID="gen16345" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16346"/>to punish the iniquity of the inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of the earth against him,<l eID="gen16346" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16347"/>and the earth will disclose her blood<l eID="gen16347" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16348"/>and will no longer cover her slain. <l eID="gen16348" level="2"/><lg eID="gen16332"/> <chapter eID="Isa.26"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7810"/><title type="x-s">Israel Rescued</title> <div sID="gen16349" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7810"/>On that day, Yahweh will punish with his cruel, great and strong sword Leviathan, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fleeing serpent, and Leviathan, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twisting serpent, and he will kill the sea monster that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the sea.  <div eID="gen16349" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7811"/><div sID="gen16350" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7811"/>On that day: <div eID="gen16350" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16351"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16352"/>“A vineyard of beauty! Sing in praise of it! <l eID="gen16352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7812"/><l level="2" sID="gen16353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7812"/>I, Yahweh, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> her keeper;<l eID="gen16353" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16354"/>I water it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞again and again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “by moments”</note><l eID="gen16354" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16355"/>Lest one afflict <transChange type="added">harm</transChange> on it,<l eID="gen16355" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16356"/>I guard it night and day; <l eID="gen16356" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7813"/><l level="2" sID="gen16357"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7813"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have no wrath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “There is no wrath for me”</note><l eID="gen16357" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16358"/>Whatever gives me thorns <transChange type="added">and</transChange> briers,<l eID="gen16358" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16359"/>I will step forth against in battle.<l eID="gen16359" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16360"/>I will set it on fire altogether. <l eID="gen16360" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7814"/><l level="1" sID="gen16361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7814"/>Or let it grasp at my protection;<l eID="gen16361" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16362"/>let it make peace with me;<l eID="gen16362" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16363"/>peace let it make with me.” <l eID="gen16363" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7815"/><l level="1" sID="gen16364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7815"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Days are coming⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “The coming ones”</note> let Jacob take root;<l eID="gen16364" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16365"/>Israel will blossom and send out shoots,<l eID="gen16365" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16366"/>and they will fill <transChange type="added">the</transChange> face of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world <transChange type="added">with</transChange> fruit. <l eID="gen16366" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7816"/><l level="1" sID="gen16367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7816"/>Does he strike him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as he struck down those who struck him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “like the striking of one striking him”</note><l eID="gen16367" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16368"/>Or is he killed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as those who killed him were killed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “like the killing of his killed ones”</note> <l eID="gen16368" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7817"/><l level="1" sID="gen16369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7817"/>By expelling<note placement="foot">Meaning uncertain, derived from the following parallel expression</note> her, by her sending away, you argue with her.<l eID="gen16369" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16370"/>He removed <transChange type="added">them</transChange> with his strong wind,<l eID="gen16370" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16371"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east wind. <l eID="gen16371" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7818"/><l level="1" sID="gen16372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7818"/>Therefore by this he will make atonement <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the guilt of Jacob,<l eID="gen16372" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16373"/>and this <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fruit <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the removal of his sin:<l eID="gen16373" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16374"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he makes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his setting”</note> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stones of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> altar like crushed stones of chalk,<l eID="gen16374" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16375"/>no poles of Asherah worship or incense altars will stand. <l eID="gen16375" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7819"/><l level="1" sID="gen16376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7819"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fortified city <transChange type="added">is</transChange> solitary,<l eID="gen16376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16377"/>a settlement deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness;<l eID="gen16377" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16378"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> calf grazes there,<l eID="gen16378" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16379"/>lies down there and destroys its branches. <l eID="gen16379" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7820"/><l level="1" sID="gen16380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7820"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When its branches are dry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “In her branch being dry”</note> they are broken;<l eID="gen16380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16381"/>women <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming <transChange type="added">and</transChange> setting light to it.<l eID="gen16381" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen16351"/> <div sID="gen16382" type="x-p"/> For it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not a people of understanding; <div eID="gen16382" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16383"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16384"/>therefore his maker will not have compassion on him,<l eID="gen16384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16385"/>and his creator will not show him favor. <l eID="gen16385" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16383"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7821"/><div sID="gen16386" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7821"/>And this shall happen: <div eID="gen16386" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen16387" type="x-p"/> on that day, Yahweh will thresh from the floodwaters of the Euphrates to the wadi<note placement="foot">A seasonal stream that is often dry</note> of Egypt, and <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> you, you will be gathered one by one, sons of Israel.  <div eID="gen16387" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7822"/><div sID="gen16388" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7822"/>And this shall happen: <div eID="gen16388" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen16389" type="x-p"/> on that day, a great trumpet will be blown, <div eID="gen16389" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16390"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16391"/>and those who were lost in the land of Assyria will come,<l eID="gen16391" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16392"/>and those who were scattered in the land of Egypt,<l eID="gen16392" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16390"/> <div sID="gen16393" type="x-p"/> and they will bow down to Yahweh on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mountain of holiness”</note> at Jerusalem.  <chapter eID="Isa.27"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7823"/><title type="x-s">Judgment against the Leaders of Ephraim</title> <div sID="gen16394" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen16394" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16395"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7823"/>Ah! The garland of the pride of the drunkards of Ephraim<l eID="gen16396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16397"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> withering flower of the glory of his beauty,<l eID="gen16397" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16398"/>which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the rich valley⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a valley of fat”</note><l eID="gen16398" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16399"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ones overcome⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “ones struck”</note> with wine! <l eID="gen16399" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7824"/><l level="1" sID="gen16400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7824"/>Look! The Lord has <transChange type="added">a</transChange> mighty and strong <transChange type="added">one</transChange>,<l eID="gen16400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16401"/>like a rainstorm of hail, a wind storm of destruction,<l eID="gen16401" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16402"/>like a rainstorm of mighty overflowing waters,<l eID="gen16402" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16403"/>he will put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to the earth with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> hand. <l eID="gen16403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7825"/><l level="1" sID="gen16404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7825"/>The garland of the pride of the drunkards of Ephraim<l eID="gen16404" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16405"/>will be trampled<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is plural</note> by feet, <l eID="gen16405" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7826"/><l level="1" sID="gen16406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7826"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> withering flower of the glory of its beauty<l eID="gen16406" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16407"/>which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the rich valley⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a valley of fat”</note><l eID="gen16407" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16408"/>will be like its early fig before summer,<l eID="gen16408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16409"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞which the one who sees it swallows⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Which, when the one who sees it sees it, he swallows it”</note> while it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> still in his hand. <l eID="gen16409" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7827"/><l level="1" sID="gen16410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7827"/>In that day, Yahweh of hosts will become a garland of glory<l eID="gen16410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16411"/>and a diadem of beauty to the remnant of his people, <l eID="gen16411" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7828"/><l level="1" sID="gen16412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7828"/>and a spirit of justice to the one who sits over judgment,<l eID="gen16412" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16413"/>and strength <transChange type="added">to</transChange> those who turn back <transChange type="added">the</transChange> battle <transChange type="added">at the</transChange> gate. <l eID="gen16413" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7829"/><l level="1" sID="gen16414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7829"/>And these also stagger because of wine<l eID="gen16414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16415"/>and stagger because of strong drink;<l eID="gen16415" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16416"/>priest and prophet stagger because of strong drink;<l eID="gen16416" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16417"/>they are confused<note placement="foot">Or “swallowed”</note> because of wine.<l eID="gen16417" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16418"/>They stagger because of strong drink;<l eID="gen16418" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16419"/>they err in vision.<l eID="gen16419" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16420"/>They stagger <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> rendering of a decision, <l eID="gen16420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7830"/><l level="2" sID="gen16421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7830"/>for all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tables are full <transChange type="added">of</transChange> disgusting vomit, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with no place left⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “without a place”</note> <l eID="gen16421" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7831"/><l level="1" sID="gen16422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7831"/><transChange type="added">To</transChange> whom will he teach knowledge,<l eID="gen16422" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16423"/>and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> whom will he explain <transChange type="added">the</transChange> message?<l eID="gen16423" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16424"/>Those who are weaned from milk,<l eID="gen16424" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16425"/><transChange type="added">those</transChange> taken from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> breast? <l eID="gen16425" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7832"/><l level="1" sID="gen16426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7832"/>For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> blah-blah upon blah-blah,<l eID="gen16426" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16427"/>blah-blah upon blah-blah,<l eID="gen16427" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16428"/>gah-gah upon gah-gah,<l eID="gen16428" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16429"/>gah-gah upon gah-gah,<note placement="foot">In this context, the Hebrew expressions <hi type="italic">tsaw-tsaw</hi> and <hi type="italic">qaw-qaw</hi> are likely meant to sound like baby talk, but they could mean “command upon command” and “rule upon rule”</note><l eID="gen16429" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16430"/>a little here, a little there. <l eID="gen16430" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen16395"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7833"/><div sID="gen16431" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7833"/>For he will speak with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞stammering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “stammer of lip”</note> and another tongue to this people,

verses.name: Isaiah 28:12
verses.text: to whom he has said, <div eID="gen16431" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16432"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16433"/>“This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> rest; give rest to the weary;<l eID="gen16433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16434"/>and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> repose”; yet<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they were not willing to hear. <l eID="gen16434" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16432"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7834"/><div sID="gen16435" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7834"/>And to them the word of Yahweh will be <div eID="gen16435" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16436"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16437"/>blah-blah upon blah-blah<l eID="gen16437" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16438"/>blah-blah upon blah-blah<l eID="gen16438" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16439"/>gah-gah upon gah-gah<l eID="gen16439" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16440"/>gah-gah upon gah-gah,<note placement="foot">In this context, the Hebrew expressions <hi type="italic">tsaw-tsaw</hi> and <hi type="italic">qaw-qaw</hi> are likely meant to sound like baby talk, but they could mean “command upon command” and “rule upon rule”</note><l eID="gen16440" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16441"/>a little here, a little there,<l eID="gen16441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16442"/>so that they may go and stumble backward<l eID="gen16442" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16443"/>and be broken and ensnared and captured.<l eID="gen16443" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16436"/> <title type="x-s">The Cornerstone of Zion</title> <div sID="gen16444" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen16444" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7835"/><lg sID="gen16445"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7835"/>Therefore hear the word of Yahweh, men of mockery,<l eID="gen16446" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16447"/>rulers of these people in Jerusalem: <l eID="gen16447" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16445"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7836"/><div sID="gen16448" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7836"/>Because you have said, <div eID="gen16448" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16449"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16450"/>“We have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> a covenant with death,<l eID="gen16450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16451"/>and we have made an agreement with Sheol.<l eID="gen16451" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16449"/> <div sID="gen16452" type="x-p"/> <transChange type="added">The</transChange> overwhelming flood, when it passes through, will not come to us, <div eID="gen16452" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16453"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16454"/>for we have made lies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note> our refuge,<l eID="gen16454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16455"/>and we have hidden ourselves in falsehood.” <l eID="gen16455" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen16453"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7837"/><div sID="gen16456" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7837"/>Therefore the Lord Yahweh says this: <div eID="gen16456" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16457"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16458"/>“Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> laying a stone in Zion,<l eID="gen16458" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16459"/>a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞tested⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “testing”</note> stone,<l eID="gen16459" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16460"/>a precious cornerstone,<l eID="gen16460" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16461"/>a founded foundation:<l eID="gen16461" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16457"/> <div sID="gen16462" type="x-p"/> ‘The one who trusts will not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞panic⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “hurry”</note>  <div eID="gen16462" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7838"/><lg sID="gen16463"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7838"/>And I will make justice <transChange type="added">the</transChange> measuring line,<l eID="gen16464" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16465"/>and righteousness <transChange type="added">the</transChange> plumb line;<l eID="gen16465" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16466"/>and hail will sweep away <transChange type="added">the</transChange> refuge of lies,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note><l eID="gen16466" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16467"/>and waters will flood over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hiding place. <l eID="gen16467" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7839"/><l level="1" sID="gen16468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7839"/>And your covenant with death will be annulled,<l eID="gen16468" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16469"/>and your agreement with Sheol will not stand;<l eID="gen16469" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16470"/>you will become a trampling place for the overwhelming flood when it passes through. <l eID="gen16470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7840"/><l level="2" sID="gen16471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7840"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As often as it passes through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “From enough his passing through”</note> it will take you,<l eID="gen16471" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16472"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞morning by morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the morning in the morning”</note> it will pass through,<l eID="gen16472" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16473"/>in the day and in the night,<l eID="gen16473" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16463"/> <div sID="gen16474" type="x-p"/> and understanding <transChange type="added">the</transChange> message will be only terror.”  <div eID="gen16474" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7841"/><lg sID="gen16475"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7841"/>For the bed is too short <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to stretch out on⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from stretching oneself”</note><l eID="gen16476" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16477"/>and the covering is <transChange type="added">too</transChange> narrow when wrapping oneself. <l eID="gen16477" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7842"/><l level="1" sID="gen16478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7842"/>For Yahweh will rise up as <transChange type="added">at</transChange> Mount Perazim;<l eID="gen16478" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16479"/>he will rave as <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> valley at Gibeon<l eID="gen16479" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16480"/>to do his deed—his deed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> strange—<l eID="gen16480" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16481"/>and to work his work—his work <transChange type="added">is</transChange> alien! <l eID="gen16481" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7843"/><l level="1" sID="gen16482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7843"/>And now you must not scoff,<l eID="gen16482" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16483"/>or your bonds will be strong,<l eID="gen16483" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16475"/> <div sID="gen16484" type="x-p"/> for I have heard from the Lord, Yahweh of hosts: <div eID="gen16484" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16485"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16486"/>complete destruction<l eID="gen16486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16487"/>decreed upon all the land.<l eID="gen16487" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16485"/> <title type="x-s">A Parable of Yahweh’s Work</title> <div sID="gen16488" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen16488" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7844"/><lg sID="gen16489"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7844"/>Listen, and hear my voice!<l eID="gen16490" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16491"/>Listen attentively, and hear my word! <l eID="gen16491" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7845"/><l level="1" sID="gen16492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7845"/>Is it all day <transChange type="added">that</transChange> the plowman plows,<l eID="gen16492" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16493"/>opens to sow seed, harrows his ground? <l eID="gen16493" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7846"/><l level="1" sID="gen16494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7846"/>When he has leveled its <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surface⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> does he not scatter dill,<l eID="gen16494" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16495"/>and sow cumin seed,<l eID="gen16495" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16496"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞plant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “place”</note> wheat in planted rows,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “row”</note><l eID="gen16496" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16497"/>and barley <transChange type="added">in</transChange> an appointed place,<l eID="gen16497" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16498"/>and spelt grain <transChange type="added">as</transChange> its border? <l eID="gen16498" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7847"/><l level="1" sID="gen16499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7847"/>And his God instructs him about the prescription;<note placement="foot">That is, “the proper way”</note><l eID="gen16499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16500"/>he teaches him. <l eID="gen16500" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7848"/><l level="1" sID="gen16501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7848"/>For dill is not threshed with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> threshing sledge,<l eID="gen16501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16502"/>nor is a wheel of a utility cart <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rolled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “turned”</note> over cumin,<l eID="gen16502" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16503"/>but dill is beaten out with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> stick,<l eID="gen16503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16504"/>and cumin with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> rod. <l eID="gen16504" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7849"/><l level="1" sID="gen16505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7849"/>Grain is crushed fine,<l eID="gen16505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16506"/>but certainly one does not thresh it forever;<l eID="gen16506" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16507"/>and one drives the wheel of his cart,<l eID="gen16507" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16508"/>but his horses do not crush it. <l eID="gen16508" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16489"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7850"/><div sID="gen16509" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7850"/>This also comes forth from Yahweh of hosts. <div eID="gen16509" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16510"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16511"/>He is wonderful <transChange type="added">in</transChange> advice;<l eID="gen16511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16512"/>he makes great wisdom. <l eID="gen16512" level="2"/><lg eID="gen16510"/> <chapter eID="Isa.28"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7851"/><title type="x-s">Woe to Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen16513" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7851"/>Ah! Ariel, Ariel, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city <transChange type="added">where</transChange> David encamped! <div eID="gen16513" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16514"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16515"/>Add year to year,<l eID="gen16515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16516"/>let festivals recur. <l eID="gen16516" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7852"/><l level="1" sID="gen16517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7852"/>Yet<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> I will inflict Ariel,<l eID="gen16517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16518"/>and there shall be mourning and lamentation,<l eID="gen16518" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16519"/>and it shall be to me like an altar hearth.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Ariel,” which might mean “altar hearth”</note> <l eID="gen16519" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7853"/><l level="1" sID="gen16520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7853"/>And I will encamp <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in a circle⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">The Hebrew text literally reads “like the ball”; the LXX supports an emendation to “David”</note> against you,<l eID="gen16520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16521"/>and I will lay siege to you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> towers<note placement="foot">Hebrew “tower”</note><l eID="gen16521" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16522"/>and I will raise up siegeworks against you. <l eID="gen16522" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7854"/><l level="1" sID="gen16523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7854"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you shall be low;<l eID="gen16523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16524"/>you shall speak from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen16524" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16525"/>and your words<note placement="foot">Hebrew “word”</note> will be low, from dust.<l eID="gen16525" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16526"/>And your voice will be from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth, like a ghost,<l eID="gen16526" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16527"/>and your word will whisper from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust. <l eID="gen16527" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7855"/><l level="1" sID="gen16528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7855"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the multitude of your strangers shall be like fine dust,<l eID="gen16528" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16529"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> multitude of tyrants like chaff that passes by.<l eID="gen16529" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16514"/> <div sID="gen16530" type="x-p"/> And it will happen <transChange type="added">in</transChange> an instant, suddenly.  <div eID="gen16530" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7856"/><div sID="gen16531" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7856"/>You will be punished by Yahweh of hosts <div eID="gen16531" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16532"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16533"/>with thunder and earthquake and great sound,<l eID="gen16533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16534"/>storm wind and tempest and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flame of a devouring fire. <l eID="gen16534" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7857"/><l level="1" sID="gen16535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7857"/>And the multitude of all the nations who fight against Ariel,<l eID="gen16535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16536"/>all those who fight <transChange type="added">against</transChange> her and her stronghold,<l eID="gen16536" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16537"/>and those who inflict her shall be like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> dream, a vision of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night. <l eID="gen16537" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7858"/><l level="1" sID="gen16538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7858"/>And it shall be as when the hungry person dreams—look, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> eating!<l eID="gen16538" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16539"/>And he wakes up and his inner self <transChange type="added">is</transChange> empty.<l eID="gen16539" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16540"/>Or<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> as when the thirsty person dreams—look, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> drinking!<l eID="gen16540" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16541"/>And he wakes up and look, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> faint,<l eID="gen16541" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16542"/>and his inner self <transChange type="added">is</transChange> longing for water.<l eID="gen16542" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16543"/>So shall be the multitude of all the nations who fight against Mount Zion. <l eID="gen16543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7859"/><l level="1" sID="gen16544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7859"/>Be astonished and be amazed!<l eID="gen16544" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16545"/>Blind yourselves and be blinded!<l eID="gen16545" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16546"/>They are drunk but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> not <transChange type="added">from</transChange> wine;<l eID="gen16546" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16547"/>they stagger but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> not <transChange type="added">from</transChange> strong drink. <l eID="gen16547" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7860"/><l level="1" sID="gen16548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7860"/>For Yahweh has poured out upon you a spirit of deep sleep,<l eID="gen16548" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16549"/>and he has shut your eyes, the prophets,<l eID="gen16549" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16550"/>and he has covered your heads, the seers. <l eID="gen16550" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16532"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7861"/><div sID="gen16551" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7861"/>And the vision of all this has become for you like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> words of <transChange type="added">a</transChange> sealed document. When they give it to one who knows the<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) has “a” instead of “the”</note> document, saying, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Read⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Call”</note> this now!” He says, “I am not able, for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sealed.”

verses.name: Isaiah 29:12
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">if</transChange> the document is given to <transChange type="added">one</transChange> who does not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞know how to read⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “know a document”</note> saying, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Read⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Call”</note> this now!” he says, “I do not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞know how to read⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “know a document”</note>  <div eID="gen16551" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7862"/><div sID="gen16552" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7862"/>And the Lord said, <div eID="gen16552" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16553"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16554"/>“Because this people draw near with its mouth,<l eID="gen16554" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16555"/>and with its lips it honors me,<l eID="gen16555" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16556"/>and its heart is far from me,<l eID="gen16556" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16557"/>and their fear of me is a commandment of men that has been taught, <l eID="gen16557" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16553"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7863"/><div sID="gen16558" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7863"/>therefore look, I am again doing something spectacular <div eID="gen16558" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16559"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16560"/>and a spectacle with this spectacular people.<l eID="gen16560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16561"/>And the wisdom of its wise men shall perish,<l eID="gen16561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16562"/>and the discernment of its discerning ones shall keep itself hidden.” <l eID="gen16562" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7864"/><l level="1" sID="gen16563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7864"/>Ah! Those who make a plan deep, to hide <transChange type="added">it</transChange> from Yahweh,<l eID="gen16563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16564"/>and their deeds are<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is singular</note> in a dark place.<l eID="gen16564" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16565"/>And they say, “Who sees us?<l eID="gen16565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16566"/>And who knows us?” <l eID="gen16566" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7865"/><l level="1" sID="gen16567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7865"/>Your perversity!<l eID="gen16567" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16568"/>As if <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a potter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of the one who creates”</note> shall be regarded as <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clay!<l eID="gen16568" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16569"/>That <transChange type="added">the</transChange> product of its maker <transChange type="added">says</transChange>,<l eID="gen16569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16570"/>“He did not make me,”<l eID="gen16570" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16571"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thing made into shape says of its <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞potter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “one who creates”</note><l eID="gen16571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16572"/>“He has no understanding.”<l eID="gen16572" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16559"/> <title type="x-s">Blessing after Punishment</title> <div sID="gen16573" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen16573" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7866"/><lg sID="gen16574"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7866"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In a very little while⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Not still a trifling of time”</note> shall not Lebanon change into <transChange type="added">a</transChange> fruitful land,<l eID="gen16575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16576"/>and the fruitful land be regarded as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> forest? <l eID="gen16576" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7867"/><l level="1" sID="gen16577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7867"/>And on that day, the deaf shall hear <transChange type="added">the</transChange> words of a scroll,<l eID="gen16577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16578"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blind shall see out of gloom and darkness. <l eID="gen16578" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7868"/><l level="1" sID="gen16579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7868"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> meek <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have joy after joy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shall add joy”</note> in Yahweh,<l eID="gen16579" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16580"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people shall rejoice in the holy one of Israel. <l eID="gen16580" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7869"/><l level="1" sID="gen16581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7869"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tyrant shall be no more,<l eID="gen16581" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16582"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> scoffer shall come to an end.<l eID="gen16582" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16583"/>And all those lying in wait for evil shall be cut off; <l eID="gen16583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7870"/><l level="2" sID="gen16584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7870"/>those who mislead a person into sin with a word<l eID="gen16584" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16585"/>and set a trap for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞arbitrator⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one who argues”</note> in the gate<l eID="gen16585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16586"/>and guide away <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous by emptiness. <l eID="gen16586" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16574"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7871"/><div sID="gen16587" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7871"/>Therefore Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, says this to the house of Jacob: <div eID="gen16587" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16588"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16589"/>“Jacob will no longer be ashamed,<l eID="gen16589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16590"/>and his face will no longer grow pale. <l eID="gen16590" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7872"/><l level="1" sID="gen16591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7872"/>For when he sees his children,<l eID="gen16591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16592"/>the work of my hands, in his midst,<l eID="gen16592" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16593"/>they will treat my name as holy,<l eID="gen16593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16594"/>and they will treat the holy one of Jacob as holy,<l eID="gen16594" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16595"/>and they will stand in awe <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the God of Israel. <l eID="gen16595" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7873"/><l level="1" sID="gen16596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7873"/>And those who err <transChange type="added">in</transChange> spirit will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞acquire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “know”</note> understanding,<l eID="gen16596" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16597"/>and those who grumble will learn instruction. <l eID="gen16597" level="2"/><lg eID="gen16588"/> <chapter eID="Isa.29"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7874"/><title type="x-s">Warning against Alliance with Egypt</title> <div sID="gen16598" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7874"/>“Oh rebellious children!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh, <div eID="gen16598" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16599"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16600"/>“to make a plan, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> not from me,<l eID="gen16600" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16601"/>and pour out a libation, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> not <transChange type="added">from</transChange> my Spirit,<l eID="gen16601" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16602"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so as to add⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the sake of adding”</note> sin to sin. <l eID="gen16602" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7875"/><l level="1" sID="gen16603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7875"/>Who go to go down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt,<l eID="gen16603" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16604"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they do not ask <transChange type="added">of</transChange> my mouth,<l eID="gen16604" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16605"/>to take refuge in the protection of Pharaoh<l eID="gen16605" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16606"/>and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt. <l eID="gen16606" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7876"/><l level="1" sID="gen16607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7876"/>And the protection of Pharaoh shall be shame to you,<l eID="gen16607" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16608"/>and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt, humiliation. <l eID="gen16608" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7877"/><l level="1" sID="gen16609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7877"/>For his officials are at Zoan,<l eID="gen16609" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16610"/>and his envoys reach to Hanes. <l eID="gen16610" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16599"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7878"/><div sID="gen16611" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7878"/>Everyone will start to stink because of a people <transChange type="added">that</transChange> cannot profit them, <div eID="gen16611" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16612"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16613"/>not for help and not for profiting,<l eID="gen16613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16614"/>but for shame and also for disgrace.” <l eID="gen16614" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16612"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7879"/><title type="x-s">Oracle regarding the Negev</title> <div sID="gen16615" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7879"/>An oracle of the animals of the Negev: <div eID="gen16615" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16616"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16617"/>Through a land of trouble and distress,<l eID="gen16617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16618"/><transChange type="added">of</transChange> lioness and lion,<l eID="gen16618" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16619"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> snake and flying serpent;<l eID="gen16619" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16620"/>they carry their wealth on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞backs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shoulder”</note> of male donkeys<l eID="gen16620" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16621"/>and their treasures on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> humps<note placement="foot">Hebrew “hump”</note> of camels,<l eID="gen16621" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16622"/>to a people <transChange type="added">that</transChange> cannot profit <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <l eID="gen16622" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7880"/><l level="1" sID="gen16623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7880"/>For<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Egyptians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Egypt”</note> help <transChange type="added">with</transChange> vanity and emptiness,<l eID="gen16623" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16624"/>therefore I have called this one “Rahab, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> sitting.” <l eID="gen16624" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7881"/><l level="1" sID="gen16625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7881"/>Now go, write it on a tablet with them,<l eID="gen16625" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16626"/>and inscribe it on a scroll,<l eID="gen16626" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16627"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> it may be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the time to come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for last day”</note><l eID="gen16627" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16628"/>forever, forever. <l eID="gen16628" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7882"/><l level="1" sID="gen16629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7882"/>For it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a people of rebellion, deceitful children,<l eID="gen16629" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16630"/>children <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> not willing to hear the instruction of Yahweh, <l eID="gen16630" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7883"/><l level="1" sID="gen16631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7883"/>who say to those who do see, “You must not see!”<l eID="gen16631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16632"/>and to the seers, “You must not see truth for us;<l eID="gen16632" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16633"/>speak smooth things to us,<l eID="gen16633" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16634"/>see illusions, <l eID="gen16634" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7884"/><l level="1" sID="gen16635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7884"/>turn aside from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way, turn aside from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> path,<l eID="gen16635" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16636"/>put an end to the holy one of Israel from our face.” <l eID="gen16636" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16616"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7885"/><div sID="gen16637" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7885"/>Therefore the holy one of Israel says this: <div eID="gen16637" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16638"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16639"/>“Because you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> rejecting this word<l eID="gen16639" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16640"/>and you trust in oppression and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cunning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “going wrong”</note><l eID="gen16640" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16641"/>and you rely on it, <l eID="gen16641" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7886"/><l level="1" sID="gen16642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7886"/>therefore this iniquity shall come for you like a breach about to fall,<l eID="gen16642" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16643"/>bulging out on a high wall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that breaks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “whose breaking comes”</note> suddenly, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> an instant. <l eID="gen16643" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7887"/><l level="1" sID="gen16644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7887"/>And he breaks it like a vessel of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a potter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “someone who forms”</note> breaks,<l eID="gen16644" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16645"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> is crushed; he has no compassion,<l eID="gen16645" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16646"/>and no potsherd is found among its fragments<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fragment”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to take fire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the taking away of fire”</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hearth,<l eID="gen16646" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16647"/>or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to skim⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the skimming off of”</note> water from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cistern.” <l eID="gen16647" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16638"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7888"/><div sID="gen16648" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7888"/>For the Lord Yahweh, the holy one of Israel, said this: <div eID="gen16648" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16649"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16650"/>“In returning and rest you shall be saved;<l eID="gen16650" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16651"/>your strength shall be in quietness and in trust.”<l eID="gen16651" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16649"/> <div sID="gen16652" type="x-p"/> But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you were not willing,

verses.name: Isaiah 30:16
verses.text: and you said, <div eID="gen16652" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16653"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16654"/>“No! For we will flee on horses!”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “horse”</note> Therefore you shall flee!<l eID="gen16654" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16655"/>And, “We will ride on swift horses!”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “horse”</note> Therefore your pursuers shall be swift! <l eID="gen16655" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7889"/><l level="1" sID="gen16656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7889"/>One thousand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of”</note> a threat of one,<l eID="gen16656" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16657"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face”</note> of a threat of five you shall flee,<l eID="gen16657" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16658"/>until you are left like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> flagstaff on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞top⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note> of <transChange type="added">a</transChange> mountain,<l eID="gen16658" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16659"/>and like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> signal on <transChange type="added">a</transChange> hill.<l eID="gen16659" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16653"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh Will Show Mercy</title> <div sID="gen16660" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen16660" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7890"/><lg sID="gen16661"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16662"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7890"/>Therefore Yahweh waits to be gracious <transChange type="added">to</transChange> you,<l eID="gen16662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16663"/>and therefore he will rise up to show you mercy,<l eID="gen16663" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16664"/>for Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a God of justice;<l eID="gen16664" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16665"/>blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all those who wait for him. <l eID="gen16665" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7891"/><l level="1" sID="gen16666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7891"/>For people will live in Zion;<l eID="gen16666" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16667"/>in Jerusalem, you will surely not weep.<l eID="gen16667" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16668"/>Surely he will be gracious to you;<l eID="gen16668" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16669"/>when he hears the sound of your cry, he will answer you. <l eID="gen16669" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7892"/><l level="1" sID="gen16670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7892"/>And the Lord will give you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bread <transChange type="added">of</transChange> distress<l eID="gen16670" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16671"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> water <transChange type="added">of</transChange> oppression,<l eID="gen16671" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16672"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your teachers will not hide themselves<note placement="foot">Hebrew “himself”</note> any longer.<l eID="gen16672" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16673"/>And your eyes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “be seeing”</note> your teachers. <l eID="gen16673" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7893"/><l level="1" sID="gen16674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7893"/>And your ears shall hear a word from behind you, saying,<l eID="gen16674" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16675"/>“this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the way; walk in it,”<l eID="gen16675" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16676"/>when you go to your right<l eID="gen16676" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16677"/>and when you go to your left. <l eID="gen16677" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7894"/><l level="1" sID="gen16678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7894"/>And you will defile the plating of your silver idols<l eID="gen16678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16679"/>and the covering of your gold image.<l eID="gen16679" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16680"/>You will scatter them like contaminated things;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “contaminated thing”</note><l eID="gen16680" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16681"/>you will say to it, “Filth!”<note placement="foot">Or “Get out!”</note> <l eID="gen16681" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7895"/><l level="1" sID="gen16682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7895"/>And he will give rain for your seed <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which you sow the ground,<l eID="gen16682" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16683"/>and grain, the produce of the ground, and it will be rich and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fertile⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “fat”</note><l eID="gen16683" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16684"/>On that day, your cattle will graze <transChange type="added">in</transChange> broad pastures;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “pasture”</note> <l eID="gen16684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7896"/><l level="2" sID="gen16685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7896"/>and the oxen and the donkeys that till<note placement="foot">Or “tilling”</note> the ground will eat fodder, sorrel<l eID="gen16685" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16686"/>that <transChange type="added">has</transChange> been winnowed with shovel and pitchfork. <l eID="gen16686" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7897"/><l level="1" sID="gen16687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7897"/>And there will be streams on every high mountain and elevated hill,<l eID="gen16687" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16688"/>watercourses of water, on a day of great slaughter, when towers fall. <l eID="gen16688" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7898"/><l level="1" sID="gen16689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7898"/>And the light of the full moon will be like the light of the sun,<l eID="gen16689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16690"/>and the light of the sun will be sevenfold, like the light of seven days,<l eID="gen16690" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16691"/>on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day <transChange type="added">when</transChange> Yahweh binds up the breakage of his people,<l eID="gen16691" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16692"/>and he heals the wound of his blow.<l eID="gen16692" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16661"/> <title type="x-s">Judgment against Assyria</title> <div sID="gen16693" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen16693" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7899"/><lg sID="gen16694"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7899"/>Look! The name of Yahweh comes from afar,<l eID="gen16695" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16696"/>burning <transChange type="added">with</transChange> his anger and heaviness of cloud.<l eID="gen16696" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16697"/>His lips are full <transChange type="added">of</transChange> indignation,<l eID="gen16697" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16698"/>and his tongue <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a devouring fire. <l eID="gen16698" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:28
