verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7900"/><l level="1" sID="gen16699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7900"/>And his breath <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like an overflowing river;<l eID="gen16699" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16700"/>it reaches up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> neck<l eID="gen16700" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16701"/>to shake <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sieve of worthlessness;<l eID="gen16701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16702"/>and a bridle that leads astray <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> jawbones of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples. <l eID="gen16702" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7901"/><l level="1" sID="gen16703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7901"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You shall have a song⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “There shall be a song for you”</note> as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night when a holy festival is kept,<l eID="gen16703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16704"/>and a gladness of heart like one who goes with the flute,<l eID="gen16704" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16705"/>to go to the mountain of Yahweh, to the rock of Israel. <l eID="gen16705" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7902"/><l level="1" sID="gen16706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7902"/>And Yahweh will cause the majesty of his voice to be heard,<l eID="gen16706" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16707"/>and he will cause the descent of his arm to be seen,<l eID="gen16707" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16708"/>in furious anger and a flame of devouring fire,<l eID="gen16708" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16709"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> a cloudburst and a rainstorm and stones<note placement="foot">Hebrew “stone”</note> of hail. <l eID="gen16709" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7903"/><l level="1" sID="gen16710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7903"/>Indeed, Assyria will be shattered by the voice of Yahweh;<l eID="gen16710" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16711"/>he strikes with the rod. <l eID="gen16711" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7904"/><l level="1" sID="gen16712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7904"/>And every stroke of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> staff of foundation<note placement="foot">Some translations emend this to “discipline”</note> that Yahweh lays will be on it with timbrels and lyres,<l eID="gen16712" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16713"/>and he will fight against it<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) has “them”</note> with battles of brandishing. <l eID="gen16713" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7905"/><l level="1" sID="gen16714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7905"/>For Topheth has been prepared from yesterday;<l eID="gen16714" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16715"/>indeed, it is made ready for the king.<l eID="gen16715" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16716"/>He makes its pile of wood deep and wide;<l eID="gen16716" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16717"/>he makes fire and wood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞abundant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “numerous”</note><l eID="gen16717" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16718"/>The breath of Yahweh burns in it like a stream of sulfur. <l eID="gen16718" level="3"/><lg eID="gen16694"/> <chapter eID="Isa.30"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7906"/><title type="x-s">The Egyptians are No Help</title> <div sID="gen16719" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7906"/>Ah! Those who go down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt for help! <div eID="gen16719" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen16720" type="x-p"/> They rely on horses <div eID="gen16720" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16721"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16722"/>and trust in chariots because <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> many,<l eID="gen16722" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16723"/>and in horsemen because they are very numerous,<l eID="gen16723" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16724"/>and they do not look to the holy one of Israel,<l eID="gen16724" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16725"/>and they do not consult Yahweh. <l eID="gen16725" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7907"/><l level="1" sID="gen16726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7907"/>And indeed, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wise, and he brings disaster,<l eID="gen16726" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16727"/>and he does not remove his words,<l eID="gen16727" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16728"/>and he will rise against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> house of evildoers<l eID="gen16728" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16729"/>and against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> help of workers of iniquity. <l eID="gen16729" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7908"/><l level="1" sID="gen16730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7908"/>And the Egyptians <transChange type="added">are</transChange> human and not God,<l eID="gen16730" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16731"/>and their horses <transChange type="added">are</transChange> flesh and not spirit.<l eID="gen16731" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16732"/>And Yahweh stretches out his hand,<l eID="gen16732" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16733"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> helper will stumble,<l eID="gen16733" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16734"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one being helped will fall,<l eID="gen16734" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16735"/>and together all of them will come to an end.<note placement="foot">Or “perish”</note> <l eID="gen16735" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16721"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7909"/><div sID="gen16736" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7909"/>For Yahweh said this to me: <div eID="gen16736" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16737"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16738"/>“As which <transChange type="added">a</transChange> lion growls<l eID="gen16738" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16739"/>and <transChange type="added">a</transChange> young lion over its prey<l eID="gen16739" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16737"/> <div sID="gen16740" type="x-p"/> when <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a full group⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fullness”</note> of shepherds is called against him, <div eID="gen16740" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16741"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16742"/>it is not terrified by their voice,<l eID="gen16742" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16743"/>and to their noise it does not respond,<l eID="gen16743" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16744"/>so Yahweh of hosts will come down to fight upon Mount Zion<l eID="gen16744" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16745"/>and upon its hill. <l eID="gen16745" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16741"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7910"/><div sID="gen16746" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7910"/>Like birds flying <transChange type="added">overhead</transChange>, so Yahweh of hosts will protect Jerusalem; <div eID="gen16746" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16747"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16748"/>he will protect and deliver <transChange type="added">it</transChange>;<l eID="gen16748" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16749"/>he will pass over and rescue <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <l eID="gen16749" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16747"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7911"/><div sID="gen16750" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7911"/>Turn back to <transChange type="added">the one against</transChange> whom the sons of Israel have made deep rebellion.  <div eID="gen16750" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7912"/><lg sID="gen16751"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7912"/>For on that day, each one will reject his idols of silver<l eID="gen16752" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16753"/>and his idols of gold which your hands have made <transChange type="added">in</transChange> sin for you. <l eID="gen16753" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7913"/><l level="1" sID="gen16754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7913"/>And Assyria shall fall by a sword not <transChange type="added">of</transChange> a man,<l eID="gen16754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16755"/>and a sword not <transChange type="added">of</transChange> a human shall devour him;<l eID="gen16755" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16756"/>and he shall flee from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword,<l eID="gen16756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16757"/>and his young men shall be <transChange type="added">put</transChange> to forced labor. <l eID="gen16757" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7914"/><l level="1" sID="gen16758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7914"/>And his rock will pass over because of terror,<l eID="gen16758" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16759"/>and his officers will be terrified because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flag,”<l eID="gen16759" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16760"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen16760" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16761"/>who has a fire in Zion<l eID="gen16761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16762"/>and has a furnace in Jerusalem. <l eID="gen16762" level="2"/><lg eID="gen16751"/> <chapter eID="Isa.31"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7915"/><title type="x-s">The Kingdom of Righteousness</title> <div sID="gen16763" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen16763" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16764"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7915"/>See, a king will rule according to righteousness,<l eID="gen16765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16766"/>and princes will rule according to justice. <l eID="gen16766" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7916"/><l level="1" sID="gen16767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7916"/>And each one will be like a hiding place from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind<l eID="gen16767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16768"/>and a covering from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rainstorm,<l eID="gen16768" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16769"/>like streams of water in a dry region,<l eID="gen16769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16770"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shade of a large rock in a weary land. <l eID="gen16770" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7917"/><l level="1" sID="gen16771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7917"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of those who see will not gaze,<note placement="foot">The same consonants with different vowels would be translated “be blinded,” which fits the context better</note><l eID="gen16771" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16772"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ears of those who hear will listen. <l eID="gen16772" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7918"/><l level="1" sID="gen16773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7918"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞minds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> of the rash will understand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞knowledge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to know”</note><l eID="gen16773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16774"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tongues<note placement="foot">Hebrew “tongue”</note> of stammerers will hasten to speak clearly. <l eID="gen16774" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7919"/><l level="1" sID="gen16775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7919"/>A fool will no longer be called noble,<l eID="gen16775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16776"/>and a scoundrel will not be said <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> eminent. <l eID="gen16776" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7920"/><l level="1" sID="gen16777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7920"/>For a fool speaks folly,<l eID="gen16777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16778"/>and his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> does iniquity:<l eID="gen16778" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16779"/>to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞behave wickedly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “do ungodliness”</note><l eID="gen16779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16780"/>and to speak error concerning Yahweh,<l eID="gen16780" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16781"/>to leave <transChange type="added">the</transChange> throat of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hungry empty,<l eID="gen16781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16782"/>and he deprives <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thirsty <transChange type="added">of</transChange> drink. <l eID="gen16782" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7921"/><l level="1" sID="gen16783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7921"/>And a scoundrel, his weapons <transChange type="added">are</transChange> evil;<l eID="gen16783" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16784"/>he plans evil devices<l eID="gen16784" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16785"/>to ruin <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor with words of deception<l eID="gen16785" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16786"/>even<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> when the speech of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> right. <l eID="gen16786" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7922"/><l level="1" sID="gen16787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7922"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nobleman plans noble things,<l eID="gen16787" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16788"/>and he stands upon noble things.<l eID="gen16788" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16764"/> <title type="x-s">Against the Carefree Women</title> <div sID="gen16789" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen16789" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7923"/><lg sID="gen16790"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7923"/>Women <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> at ease, rise up; hear my voice!<l eID="gen16791" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16792"/>Carefree daughters, listen <transChange type="added">to</transChange> my word! <l eID="gen16792" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16790"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7924"/><div sID="gen16793" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7924"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In a year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In days upon a year”</note> you will tremble, carefree ones, <div eID="gen16793" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16794"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16795"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> vintage will come to an end;<l eID="gen16795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16796"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> harvest will not come. <l eID="gen16796" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7925"/><l level="1" sID="gen16797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7925"/>Tremble, <transChange type="added">you who are</transChange> at ease;<l eID="gen16797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16798"/>tremble, carefree ones;<l eID="gen16798" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16799"/>strip, and strip yourself,<l eID="gen16799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16800"/>and gird yourself on <transChange type="added">your</transChange> loins,<note placement="foot">Although the carefree and at ease addressees in this verse are feminine plural (“you women”), the commands are masculine singular in form</note> <l eID="gen16800" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7926"/><l level="1" sID="gen16801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7926"/>mourning over breasts,<l eID="gen16801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16802"/>over fields of delight,<l eID="gen16802" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16803"/>over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fruitful vine, <l eID="gen16803" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7927"/><l level="2" sID="gen16804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7927"/>over the soil of my people.<l eID="gen16804" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16805"/>It goes up <transChange type="added">in</transChange> thorns<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thorn”</note> and briers,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “brier”</note><l eID="gen16805" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16806"/>indeed over all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> houses of joy <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> jubilant city. <l eID="gen16806" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7928"/><l level="1" sID="gen16807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7928"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> palace will be forsaken,<l eID="gen16807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16808"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞crowded city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “crowd of the city”</note> deserted;<l eID="gen16808" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16809"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> hill and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> watchtower will become<note placement="foot">The Hebrew text has “for the benefit of” following “become”</note> a cave forever,<l eID="gen16809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16810"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> joy of wild asses, a pasture <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> flocks. <l eID="gen16810" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16794"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7929"/><div sID="gen16811" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7929"/>Until a spirit is poured out on us from on high, <div eID="gen16811" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16812"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16813"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wilderness becomes <transChange type="added">a</transChange> fruitful field,<l eID="gen16813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16814"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fruitful field is reckoned as the forest. <l eID="gen16814" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7930"/><l level="1" sID="gen16815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7930"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> justice will dwell in the wilderness,<l eID="gen16815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16816"/>and righteousness will live in the fruitful field. <l eID="gen16816" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7931"/><l level="1" sID="gen16817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7931"/>And the work of righteousness will be peace,<l eID="gen16817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16818"/>and the work of righteousness, quietness and security forever. <l eID="gen16818" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7932"/><l level="1" sID="gen16819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7932"/>And my people will dwell in a settlement of peace<l eID="gen16819" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16820"/>and in a dwelling place of security<l eID="gen16820" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16821"/>and in undisturbed resting places. <l eID="gen16821" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7933"/><l level="1" sID="gen16822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7933"/>And it hails when <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the forest comes down⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the coming down of the forest”</note><l eID="gen16822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16823"/>and the city will become low in humiliation. <l eID="gen16823" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7934"/><l level="1" sID="gen16824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7934"/>Happy <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you who sow by all waters,<l eID="gen16824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16825"/>who let the foot of the ox and the donkey go free. <l eID="gen16825" level="2"/><lg eID="gen16812"/> <chapter eID="Isa.32"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7935"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Judgment and Help</title> <div sID="gen16826" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen16826" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16827"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7935"/>Ah, destroyer, and yourself not destroyed!<l eID="gen16828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16829"/>And treacherous one, and no one has dealt treacherously with him!<note placement="foot">Many manuscripts suggest “you” rather than “him”</note><l eID="gen16829" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16830"/>When you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cease⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “finishing”</note> destroying, you will be destroyed.<l eID="gen16830" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16831"/>When you stop dealing treacherously, one will deal treacherously with you. <l eID="gen16831" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7936"/><l level="1" sID="gen16832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7936"/>Yahweh, be gracious to us, we wait for you.<l eID="gen16832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16833"/>Be our<note placement="foot">Hebrew “their”</note> arm in the mornings,<l eID="gen16833" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16834"/>indeed our salvation in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of trouble. <l eID="gen16834" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7937"/><l level="1" sID="gen16835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7937"/>At <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of tumult, peoples fled;<l eID="gen16835" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16836"/>because of your exaltation, nations scattered. <l eID="gen16836" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7938"/><l level="1" sID="gen16837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7938"/>And your spoil is gathered,<l eID="gen16837" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16838"/><transChange type="added">as</transChange> the gathering of the locust,<l eID="gen16838" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16839"/>as a swarm of locusts storming on it. <l eID="gen16839" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7939"/><l level="1" sID="gen16840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7939"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> exalted, for <transChange type="added">he</transChange> dwells <transChange type="added">on</transChange> high;<l eID="gen16840" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16841"/>he filled Zion <transChange type="added">with</transChange> justice and righteousness, <l eID="gen16841" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7940"/><l level="1" sID="gen16842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7940"/>and he will be the security of your times,<l eID="gen16842" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16843"/>an abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge.<l eID="gen16843" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16827"/> <div sID="gen16844" type="x-p"/> The fear of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his treasure.  <div eID="gen16844" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7941"/><lg sID="gen16845"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7941"/>Look! Their heroes cry out <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> street;<l eID="gen16846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16847"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> messengers of peace weep bitterly. <l eID="gen16847" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7942"/><l level="1" sID="gen16848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7942"/>Highways are deserted;<l eID="gen16848" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16849"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> traveler <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> road ceases.<l eID="gen16849" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16850"/>One breaks a treaty,<l eID="gen16850" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16851"/>he rejects <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cities,<note placement="foot">A Dead Sea Scroll reads “witnesses”</note><l eID="gen16851" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16852"/>he does not hold man in high regard. <l eID="gen16852" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7943"/><l level="1" sID="gen16853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7943"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> land mourns; it languishes.<l eID="gen16853" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16854"/>Lebanon feels abashed; it withers.<l eID="gen16854" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16855"/>Sharon is like the desert,<l eID="gen16855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16856"/>and Bashan and Carmel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are losing their leaves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “shaking off”</note> <l eID="gen16856" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7944"/><l level="1" sID="gen16857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7944"/>“Now I will arise,” says Yahweh.<l eID="gen16857" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16858"/>“Now I will lift myself up proudly;<l eID="gen16858" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16859"/>now I will raise myself. <l eID="gen16859" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7945"/><l level="1" sID="gen16860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7945"/>You conceive dry grass, you bring forth stubble;<l eID="gen16860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16861"/>your breath <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a fire; it will consume you. <l eID="gen16861" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7946"/><l level="1" sID="gen16862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7946"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples will be burning <transChange type="added">to</transChange> lime—<l eID="gen16862" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16863"/>they are burned <transChange type="added">like</transChange> thorns <transChange type="added">that have been</transChange> cut down in the fire. <l eID="gen16863" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7947"/><l level="1" sID="gen16864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7947"/><transChange type="added">You who are</transChange> far away, hear what I have done;<l eID="gen16864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16865"/>and <transChange type="added">you who are</transChange> near, know my might!” <l eID="gen16865" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7948"/><l level="1" sID="gen16866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7948"/>Sinners are afraid in Zion;<l eID="gen16866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16867"/>trembling has seized <transChange type="added">the</transChange> godless:<l eID="gen16867" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16868"/>“Who of us can <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “dwell as an alien”</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> devouring fire?<l eID="gen16868" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16869"/>Who of us can <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “dwell as an alien”</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> everlasting consuming hearths?” <l eID="gen16869" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7949"/><l level="1" sID="gen16870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7949"/>He who walks <transChange type="added">in</transChange> righteousness<l eID="gen16870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16871"/>and speaks uprightness,<l eID="gen16871" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16872"/>who rejects <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gain of extortion,<l eID="gen16872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16873"/>who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞refuses⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shakes his hand from the taking of”</note> <transChange type="added">a</transChange> bribe,<l eID="gen16873" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16874"/>who stops up his ears<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ear”</note> from hearing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bloodshed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “blood”</note><l eID="gen16874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16875"/>and shuts his eyes from seeing evil. <l eID="gen16875" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7950"/><l level="1" sID="gen16876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7950"/>That one will live <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> heights;<l eID="gen16876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16877"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> fortresses of rocks <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> his refuge.<l eID="gen16877" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16878"/>His food <transChange type="added">will</transChange> be given;<l eID="gen16878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16879"/>his waters<note placement="foot">Hebrew “water”</note> <transChange type="added">will</transChange> endure. <l eID="gen16879" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7951"/><l level="1" sID="gen16880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7951"/>Your eyes will see <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king in his beauty;<l eID="gen16880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16881"/>they will see a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞distant land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “land of distance”</note> <l eID="gen16881" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7952"/><l level="1" sID="gen16882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7952"/>Your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> will meditate <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> terror:<l eID="gen16882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16883"/>“Where <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> one who counted?<l eID="gen16883" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16884"/>Where <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> one who weighed out?<l eID="gen16884" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16885"/>Where <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> one who counted the towers?” <l eID="gen16885" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7953"/><l level="1" sID="gen16886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7953"/>You will not see <transChange type="added">the</transChange> insolent people,<l eID="gen16886" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16887"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose language is too obscure to understand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “obscure of lip than to hear”</note><l eID="gen16887" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16888"/><transChange type="added">whose</transChange> stammering of tongue <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cannot be understood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “there is no understanding”</note> <l eID="gen16888" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7954"/><l level="1" sID="gen16889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7954"/>Look <transChange type="added">on</transChange> Zion, the city of our appointed festivals!<l eID="gen16889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16890"/>Your eyes will see Jerusalem,<l eID="gen16890" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16891"/>an undisturbed settlement,<l eID="gen16891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16892"/>a tent <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that is not moved⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not he is loaded”</note><l eID="gen16892" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16893"/>No one will ever pull out its tent pegs,<l eID="gen16893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16894"/>and none of its ropes will be torn in two. <l eID="gen16894" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7955"/><l level="1" sID="gen16895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7955"/>Rather, there Yahweh <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> mighty for us,<l eID="gen16895" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16896"/>a place of rivers <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞broad streams⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “streams broad of hands”</note><l eID="gen16896" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16897"/>a galley ship with<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> oars<note placement="foot">Hebrew “oar”</note> cannot go in it,<l eID="gen16897" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16898"/>and a mighty ship cannot pass through it. <l eID="gen16898" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7956"/><l level="1" sID="gen16899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7956"/>For Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our judge; Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our lawgiver.<l eID="gen16899" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16900"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our king; he <transChange type="added">is the one who</transChange> will save us. <l eID="gen16900" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7957"/><l level="1" sID="gen16901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7957"/>Your riggings hang slack;<l eID="gen16901" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16902"/>they do not hold the base of their mast firm,<l eID="gen16902" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen16903"/>they do not spread out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sail.<l eID="gen16903" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16904"/>Then <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prey of spoil <transChange type="added">in</transChange> abundance will be divided;<l eID="gen16904" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16905"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> lame will take plunder. <l eID="gen16905" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7958"/><l level="1" sID="gen16906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7958"/>And no inhabitant will say, “I am sick”;<l eID="gen16906" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16907"/>the people who live in it, <transChange type="added">their</transChange> iniquity <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> taken away. <l eID="gen16907" level="2"/><lg eID="gen16845"/> <chapter eID="Isa.33"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7959"/><title type="x-s">Judgment on the Nations</title> <div sID="gen16908" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen16908" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16909"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7959"/>Come near, nations, to hear;<l eID="gen16910" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16911"/>and peoples, listen attentively!<l eID="gen16911" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16912"/>Let the earth hear, and that which fills it;<l eID="gen16912" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16913"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> world and all its offspring. <l eID="gen16913" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7960"/><l level="1" sID="gen16914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7960"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> anger of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> against all the nations,<l eID="gen16914" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16915"/>and <transChange type="added">his</transChange> wrath <transChange type="added">is</transChange> against all their armies;<l eID="gen16915" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16916"/>he has put them under a ban,<l eID="gen16916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16917"/>he has given them up for slaughter. <l eID="gen16917" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7961"/><l level="1" sID="gen16918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7961"/>And their slain shall be cast out;<l eID="gen16918" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16919"/>as for<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> their corpses, their stench shall go up.<l eID="gen16919" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16920"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains shall melt with<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> their blood, <l eID="gen16920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7962"/><l level="2" sID="gen16921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7962"/>and all the host of heaven shall rot.<l eID="gen16921" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16922"/>And the skies shall roll up like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> scroll,<l eID="gen16922" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16923"/>and all their host shall wither<l eID="gen16923" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16924"/>like the withering of a leaf from a vine,<l eID="gen16924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16925"/>or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> withering from a fig tree. <l eID="gen16925" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16909"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7963"/><div sID="gen16926" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7963"/>When my sword is drenched in the heavens, <div eID="gen16926" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16927"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16928"/>look! It will descend upon Edom,<l eID="gen16928" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16929"/>and upon the people of my ban, for judgment. <l eID="gen16929" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16927"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7964"/><div sID="gen16930" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7964"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh has a sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “A sword for Yahweh”</note> <div eID="gen16930" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16931"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16932"/>it is full <transChange type="added">of</transChange> blood.<l eID="gen16932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16933"/>It is covered with<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> fat,<l eID="gen16933" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16934"/>with<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blood of lambs and goats,<l eID="gen16934" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16935"/>with<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fat of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kidneys of rams,<l eID="gen16935" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16936"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh has a sacrifice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a sacrifice for Yahweh”</note> in Bozrah<l eID="gen16936" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16937"/>and a great slaughter in the land of Edom. <l eID="gen16937" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7965"/><l level="1" sID="gen16938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7965"/>And wild oxen shall go down with them,<l eID="gen16938" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16939"/>and steers with strong bulls.<l eID="gen16939" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16940"/>And their land shall be drenched with<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> blood,<l eID="gen16940" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16941"/>and their soil shall be fattened with<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> fat. <l eID="gen16941" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7966"/><l level="1" sID="gen16942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7966"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh has a day of vengeance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a day of vengeance for Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen16942" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16943"/>a year of retribution for the strife of Zion. <l eID="gen16943" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7967"/><l level="1" sID="gen16944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7967"/>And its streams shall be changed to pitch and its soil to sulfur,<l eID="gen16944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16945"/>and its land shall become like burning pitch. <l eID="gen16945" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7968"/><l level="1" sID="gen16946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7968"/>Night and day it shall not be quenched;<l eID="gen16946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16947"/>its smoke shall go up forever.<l eID="gen16947" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16948"/>From generation to generation it shall be in ruins;<l eID="gen16948" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16949"/>forever and ever there will be no one who passes through her. <l eID="gen16949" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7969"/><l level="1" sID="gen16950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7969"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> large bird and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hedgehog shall take possession of it,<l eID="gen16950" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16951"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> owl and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> raven shall live in it.<l eID="gen16951" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16952"/>And he shall stretch <transChange type="added">the</transChange> measuring line of confusion out over it,<l eID="gen16952" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16953"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> plumb line of emptiness. <l eID="gen16953" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7970"/><l level="1" sID="gen16954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7970"/>Its nobles—but no kingdom is there—shall call,<l eID="gen16954" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16955"/>and all its princes shall be nothing. <l eID="gen16955" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7971"/><l level="1" sID="gen16956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7971"/>And thorns shall go up her citadel fortress,<l eID="gen16956" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16957"/>weeds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “weed”</note> and thistle plants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thistle plant”</note> in her fortresses;<l eID="gen16957" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16958"/>and it shall be <transChange type="added">the</transChange> settlement of jackals,<l eID="gen16958" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16959"/>green grass for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> daughters of an ostrich. <l eID="gen16959" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7972"/><l level="1" sID="gen16960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7972"/>And desert creatures shall meet with hyenas,<l eID="gen16960" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16961"/>and a goat-demon shall call to his neighbor;<l eID="gen16961" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16962"/>surely there Lilith<note placement="foot">Hebrew transliteration; possibly a proper name for a Mesopotamian night-demon</note> shall repose,<l eID="gen16962" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16963"/>and she shall find a resting place for herself. <l eID="gen16963" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7973"/><l level="1" sID="gen16964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7973"/>There <transChange type="added">the</transChange> owl shall nest and lay<l eID="gen16964" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16965"/>and hatch and care for her chicks in her shadow;<l eID="gen16965" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16966"/>surely there <transChange type="added">the</transChange> birds of prey shall be gathered,<l eID="gen16966" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16967"/>each one <transChange type="added">with</transChange> her mate. <l eID="gen16967" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16931"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7974"/><div sID="gen16968" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7974"/>Seek from the book of Yahweh and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞read⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “call”</note> <div eID="gen16968" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16969"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16970"/>none of these shall be missing;<l eID="gen16970" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16971"/>none shall miss her mate.<l eID="gen16971" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16972"/>For my<note placement="foot">The Dead Sea Scroll has “his”</note> mouth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is the one that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he”</note> has commanded,<l eID="gen16972" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16973"/>and his spirit <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is the one that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he”</note> has gathered them. <l eID="gen16973" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7975"/><l level="1" sID="gen16974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7975"/>And he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is the one that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he”</note> has cast <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lot for them,<l eID="gen16974" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16975"/>and his hand has apportioned it to them with the measuring line;<l eID="gen16975" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16976"/>they shall take possession of it forever,<l eID="gen16976" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16977"/>they shall live in it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from generation to generation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to generation and generation”</note> <l eID="gen16977" level="2"/><lg eID="gen16969"/> <chapter eID="Isa.34"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7976"/><title type="x-s">The Ransomed Return to Zion</title> <div sID="gen16978" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen16978" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16979"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7976"/>Wilderness and dry land shall be glad,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew has an extra “them,” probably from an accidental of the first letter of the next word</note><l eID="gen16980" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16981"/>and desert shall rejoice and blossom like the crocus. <l eID="gen16981" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7977"/><l level="1" sID="gen16982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7977"/>It shall blossom abundantly,<l eID="gen16982" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16983"/>and it shall rejoice indeed with rejoicing and exulting.<l eID="gen16983" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16984"/>The glory of Lebanon shall be given to it,<l eID="gen16984" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16985"/>the majesty of Carmel and Sharon.<l eID="gen16985" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16986"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They are the ones who⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they”</note> shall see the glory of Yahweh,<l eID="gen16986" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16987"/>the majesty of our God. <l eID="gen16987" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7978"/><l level="1" sID="gen16988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7978"/>Strengthen <transChange type="added">the</transChange> weak hands<l eID="gen16988" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16989"/>and make <transChange type="added">the</transChange> staggering knees firm. <l eID="gen16989" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16979"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7979"/><div sID="gen16990" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7979"/>Say to those who are hasty of heart, <div eID="gen16990" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen16991"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16992"/>“Be strong; you must not fear!<l eID="gen16992" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16993"/>Look! your God will come <transChange type="added">with</transChange> vengeance,<l eID="gen16993" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16994"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞divine retribution⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the retribution of gods”</note><l eID="gen16994" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16995"/>He <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is the one who⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he”</note> will come and save you.” <l eID="gen16995" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7980"/><l level="1" sID="gen16996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7980"/>Then <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blind shall be opened,<l eID="gen16996" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16997"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ears of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> deaf shall be opened. <l eID="gen16997" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7981"/><l level="1" sID="gen16998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7981"/>Then <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lame shall leap like the deer,<l eID="gen16998" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen16999"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tongue of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dumb shall sing for joy,<l eID="gen16999" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17000"/>for waters shall break forth in the wilderness<l eID="gen17000" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17001"/>and streams in the desert. <l eID="gen17001" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7982"/><l level="1" sID="gen17002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7982"/>And the parched ground shall become <transChange type="added">a</transChange> pool,<l eID="gen17002" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17003"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thirsty ground springs of water.<l eID="gen17003" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17004"/>Her resting place <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in a settlement of jackals;<l eID="gen17004" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17005"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> grass <transChange type="added">shall become</transChange> like reeds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “reed”</note> and rushes.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rush”</note> <l eID="gen17005" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7983"/><l level="1" sID="gen17006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7983"/>And a highway shall be there, and a way,<l eID="gen17006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17007"/>and it shall be called the way of holiness.<l eID="gen17007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17008"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> unclean shall not travel through it,<l eID="gen17008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17009"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for them, he who walks <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> way;<l eID="gen17009" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17010"/>and fools shall not wander about. <l eID="gen17010" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7984"/><l level="1" sID="gen17011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7984"/>No lion shall be there,<l eID="gen17011" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17012"/>and no ferocious wild beast shall go up it.<l eID="gen17012" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17013"/>It shall not be found there,<l eID="gen17013" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17014"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> redeemed shall walk <transChange type="added">there</transChange>. <l eID="gen17014" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7985"/><l level="1" sID="gen17015"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7985"/>And the ransomed of Yahweh shall return,<l eID="gen17015" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17016"/>and they shall come <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Zion with rejoicing.<l eID="gen17016" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17017"/>And everlasting joy <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> on their head;<l eID="gen17017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17018"/>joy and gladness shall overtake <transChange type="added">them</transChange>,<l eID="gen17018" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17019"/>and sorrow and sighing shall flee. <l eID="gen17019" level="3"/><lg eID="gen16991"/> <chapter eID="Isa.35"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7986"/><title type="x-s">Sennacherib Threatens Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen17020" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7986"/>And this happened: In <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the fourteenth year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “four ten year”</note> of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria went up against all the fortified cities of Judah, and he captured them.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:2
verses.text: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh<note placement="foot">Rabshekah is the title of a high Assyrian official</note> from Lachish to Jerusalem, to King Hezekiah, with a large army, and he stood by the conduit of the upper pool on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> highway of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> field of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> washer.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:3
verses.text: And Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was in charge of the palace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “was over the house”</note> came out to him, and Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph, the reminder.  <div eID="gen17020" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7987"/><div sID="gen17021" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7987"/>And Rabshakeh said to them, “Now say to Hezekiah, ‘Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: “What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this confidence <transChange type="added">in</transChange> which you trust?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:5
verses.text: I said, ‘Only a word of lips! <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞War has power and a plan⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!’<note placement="foot">The Hebrew here is awkward; literally “Plan and power for war”</note> Now, in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:6
verses.text: Look, you trust in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt, which <transChange type="added">if</transChange> a man leans on it, goes into his hand and bores through it! Such <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to all those who trust in him.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:7
verses.text: And if you say to me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ <transChange type="added">was it</transChange> not he whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed? And he said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall bow down in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> of this altar.’ ”

verses.name: Isaiah 36:8
verses.text: And now please make a wager with my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, <transChange type="added">that is,</transChange> if you are able <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞put⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “give”</note> riders for yourself on them!

verses.name: Isaiah 36:9
verses.text: But how can you drive back <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one governor among the least of my master’s servants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the face of the governor of the one of the insignificant servants of my master”</note> when<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you trust in Egypt for chariots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note> and horsemen?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:10
verses.text: And now was it without Yahweh that I have come up against this land to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, “Go up against this land and destroy it!” ’ ”  <div eID="gen17021" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7988"/><div sID="gen17022" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7988"/>And Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we can understand<note placement="foot">Or “hear”</note> it, and you must not speak to us in Judean in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “ear”</note> of the people who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on the wall.”  <div eID="gen17022" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7989"/><div sID="gen17023" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7989"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me to speak these words to your masters and you? Was it not for the people who sit on the wall, to eat their dung and drink their urine<note placement="foot">So Masoretic Hebrew text (<hi type="italic">Kethib</hi>); the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) has “feet-water”</note> with you?”  <div eID="gen17023" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7990"/><div sID="gen17024" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7990"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Rabshakeh stood and called in a great voice in Judean and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:14
verses.text: Thus says the king: ‘<transChange type="added">Do</transChange> not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you!

verses.name: Isaiah 36:15
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">do</transChange> not let Hezekiah make you rely on Yahweh, saying, “Surely Yahweh will deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria!”

verses.name: Isaiah 36:16
verses.text: You must not listen to Hezekiah, for thus says the king of Assyria: “Make a blessing<note placement="foot">That is, a gesture of surrender</note> with me, and come out to me, and each one will eat from his vine and from his fig tree and drink water from<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> his cistern,

verses.name: Isaiah 36:17
verses.text: until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my coming”</note> and take you to a land like your land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards,

verses.name: Isaiah 36:18
verses.text: lest Hezekiah mislead you, saying, ‘Yahweh will save us!’ Did the gods of the nations each save his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:19
verses.text: Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the gods of Sepharvaim? Indeed, <transChange type="added">have</transChange> they delivered Samaria from my hand?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:20
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">are there</transChange> among all the gods of these countries who have saved their land from my hand, that Yahweh should save Jerusalem from my hand?” ’ ”  <div eID="gen17024" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7991"/><div sID="gen17025" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7991"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> they were silent and did not answer him a word, for the command of the king was, “You must not answer him.”

verses.name: Isaiah 36:22
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was over the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞palace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “house”</note> Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph, the reminder, came to Hezekiah <transChange type="added">with</transChange> torn garments and told him the words of Rabshakeh.  <chapter eID="Isa.36"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7992"/><title type="x-s">Hezekiah Consults Isaiah</title> <div sID="gen17026" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7992"/>And this happened: When King Hezekiah heard, he tore his garments, covered himself with sackcloth, and entered the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> of Yahweh.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:2
verses.text: And he sent Eliakim, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in charge of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “over”</note> the palace,<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> and Shebna the secretary, and the elders of the priests <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞covered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “covering themselves”</note> with sackcloth to Isaiah son of Amoz, the prophet.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:3
verses.text: And they said to him, “Thus says Hezekiah: ‘This day <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace, for children have come to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cervical opening, and there is no strength to give birth.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:4
verses.text: Maybe Yahweh your God heard <transChange type="added">the</transChange> words of Rabshakeh whom the king of Assyria, his master, has sent to taunt <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living God, and he will rebuke the words that Yahweh your God hears. And you must lift up a prayer for the benefit of the remnant that is found.’ ”  <div eID="gen17026" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7993"/><div sID="gen17027" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7993"/>When<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:6
verses.text: Isaiah said to them, “You must say this to your master: ‘Thus says Yahweh: “You must not be afraid because of the words that you have heard, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:7
verses.text: Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞put⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “give”</note> a spirit in him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he shall hear a rumor and he shall return to his land, and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his land.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen17027" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7994"/><div sID="gen17028" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7994"/>And Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he had heard that he had left from Lachish.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:9
verses.text: Now<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he<note placement="foot">That is, the king</note> heard concerning Tirhakah the king of Cush, saying, “He has set out to fight against<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> you.” <div eID="gen17028" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen17029" type="x-p"/> When<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he heard <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:10
verses.text: “You shall say this to Hezekiah, king of Judah: ‘<transChange type="added">Do</transChange> not let your God in whom you trust in him deceive you by saying, “Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

verses.name: Isaiah 37:11
verses.text: Look! you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands to destroy them, and you—shall you be delivered?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:12
verses.text: Did the gods of the nations that my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞predecessors⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> destroyed deliver them—Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the sons of Eden who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in Telassar?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:13
verses.text: Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> Ivvah?’ ”  <div eID="gen17029" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7995"/><title type="x-s">Hezekiah’s Prayer</title> <div sID="gen17030" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7995"/>And Hezekiah took the letter from the hand of the messengers, and he read<note placement="foot">Or “called”</note> it. Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he went up to the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> of Yahweh, and Hezekiah spread it out before the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> of Yahweh.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:15
verses.text: And Hezekiah prayed to Yahweh, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:16
verses.text: “Yahweh of hosts, God of Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who is enthroned on⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sitting”</note> the cherubim, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the one, God by yourself, of all the kingdoms of the earth; you are the one who made the heavens and the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:17
verses.text: Yahweh, extend your ear and hear! Yahweh, open your eyes and see, and hear all the words of Sennacherib that he has sent to taunt the living God!

verses.name: Isaiah 37:18
verses.text: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the lands<note placement="foot">The parallel text in 2 Kings has “nations”</note> and their land,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:19
verses.text: to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞set⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “give”</note> their gods in the fire, for they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> not gods, but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of human hands, wood and stone, and they destroyed them.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:20
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> now, Yahweh, our God, save us from his hand so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> Yahweh, you alone!”  <div eID="gen17030" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7996"/><title type="x-s">God’s Answer</title> <div sID="gen17031" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7996"/>And Isaiah son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Thus says Yahweh the God of Israel: ‘Because you have prayed to me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concerning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> Sennacherib, king of Assyria,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:22
verses.text: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the word that Yahweh has spoken concerning him: <div eID="gen17031" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17032"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17033"/>She shows contempt for you; she derides you, virgin daughter of Zion;<l eID="gen17033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17034"/>she shakes <transChange type="added">her</transChange> head behind you, daughter of Jerusalem. <l eID="gen17034" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7997"/><l level="1" sID="gen17035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7997"/>Whom have you taunted and blasphemed,<l eID="gen17035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17036"/>and against whom have you raised up <transChange type="added">your</transChange> voice and lifted your eyes upward?<l eID="gen17036" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17032"/> <div sID="gen17037" type="x-p"/> To the holy one of Israel!  <div eID="gen17037" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7998"/><lg sID="gen17038"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7998"/>By the hand of your servants you have taunted the Lord,<l eID="gen17039" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17040"/>and you have said, “With my many chariots,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note><l eID="gen17040" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17041"/>I myself have gone up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> height of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains,<l eID="gen17041" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17042"/><transChange type="added">to</transChange> the remote areas of Lebanon.<l eID="gen17042" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17043"/>And I cut off <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its tall cedars⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the height of its cedars”</note><l eID="gen17043" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17044"/>the choicest of its junipers.<l eID="gen17044" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17045"/>And I came <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the height of its limit,<l eID="gen17045" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17046"/>the forest of its orchard.<note placement="foot">Or “Carmel”</note> <l eID="gen17046" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7999"/><l level="1" sID="gen17047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7999"/>I myself dug and drank waters,<l eID="gen17047" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17048"/>and I caused all the streams of Egypt to dry up by the sole of my feet.” <l eID="gen17048" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8000"/><l level="1" sID="gen17049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8000"/>Have you not heard from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a long time ago⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “distant”</note> I have made it<l eID="gen17049" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17050"/>from days of primeval time, and I formed it.<l eID="gen17050" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17051"/>Now I have brought it <transChange type="added">about</transChange>,<l eID="gen17051" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17052"/>and it is for fortified cities to collapse into heaps of destroyed stones. <l eID="gen17052" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8001"/><l level="1" sID="gen17053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8001"/>And their inhabitants <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞weak⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “short of hand”</note><l eID="gen17053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17054"/>they are dismayed, and they are ashamed;<l eID="gen17054" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17055"/>they have become <transChange type="added">like</transChange> plants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “plant”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> field,<l eID="gen17055" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17056"/>and <transChange type="added">like</transChange> greens of grass,<l eID="gen17056" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17057"/><transChange type="added">like</transChange> grass on<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roofs<l eID="gen17057" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17058"/>and a cultivated field <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the face of”</note> the standing grain. <l eID="gen17058" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8002"/><l level="1" sID="gen17059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8002"/>And I know your sitting down and your going out,<l eID="gen17059" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17060"/>and your coming in, and your raging <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> me. <l eID="gen17060" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8003"/><l level="1" sID="gen17061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8003"/>Because you were enraged <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> me,<l eID="gen17061" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17062"/>and your noise<note placement="foot">Or “complacency”</note> has come up to<note placement="foot">Literally “in”</note> my ears,<l eID="gen17062" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17063"/>I will put my hook in your nose<l eID="gen17063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17064"/>and my bridle on your lips,<l eID="gen17064" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17065"/>and I will turn you back<l eID="gen17065" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17066"/>on the way <transChange type="added">by</transChange> which you came. <l eID="gen17066" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17038"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8004"/><div sID="gen17067" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8004"/>And this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> the sign for you: the eating of volunteer plants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “plant”</note> this<note placement="foot">Literally “the”</note> year, and in the second year self-seeded plants,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “plant”</note> and in the third year sow, reap, plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:31
