verses.text: And the remnant of the house of Judah that remain shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞grow⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “add”</note> roots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “root”</note> downwards and make fruit upwards.  <div eID="gen17067" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8005"/><lg sID="gen17068"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8005"/>For a remnant shall go out from Jerusalem<l eID="gen17069" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17070"/>and survivors<note placement="foot">Hebrew “survivor”</note> from mountain Zion.<l eID="gen17070" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17068"/> <div sID="gen17071" type="x-p"/> The zeal of Yahweh of hosts will do this.’  <div eID="gen17071" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8006"/><div sID="gen17072" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8006"/>Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> the king of Assyria: <div eID="gen17072" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17073"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17074"/>‘He shall not come to this city,<l eID="gen17074" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17075"/>and he shall not shoot an arrow there,<l eID="gen17075" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17076"/>and he shall not meet it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a shield,<l eID="gen17076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17077"/>and he shall not heap a siege ramp up against her. <l eID="gen17077" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8007"/><l level="1" sID="gen17078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8007"/>He shall return by the way that he came,<l eID="gen17078" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17079"/>and he shall not come to this city,’<l eID="gen17079" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17073"/> <div sID="gen17080" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen17080" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8008"/><div sID="gen17081" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8008"/>‘And I will defend this city, to save it for my sake and for the sake of David, my servant.’ ”  <div eID="gen17081" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8009"/><title type="x-s">Sennacherib’s Defeat</title> <div sID="gen17082" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8009"/>And the angel of Yahweh set out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians. When<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> they rose in the morning, look! All of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> dead corpses.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:37
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Sennacherib king of Assyria left, went, and returned and lived at Nineveh.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:38
verses.text: And this happened: he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> bowing in worship <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the house of Nisroch his god, and Adrammelech and Sharezer, his sons, struck him with the sword. And they themselves escaped <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the land of Ararat, and Esar-haddon his son reigned as king in his place.  <chapter eID="Isa.37"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8010"/><title type="x-s">Hezekiah’s Illness</title> <div sID="gen17083" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8010"/>In those days, Hezekiah became sick to death, and Isaiah son of Amoz, the prophet, came to him and said to him, “Thus says Yahweh: ‘Order your house, for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to die, and you shall not recover.’ ”

verses.name: Isaiah 38:2
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to Yahweh,

verses.name: Isaiah 38:3
verses.text: and he said, “O Yahweh, please remember how<note placement="foot">Or “that”</note> I have walked before your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> in faithfulness with a whole heart, and I have done the good in your eyes!” And Hezekiah wept <transChange type="added">with</transChange> great weeping.  <div eID="gen17083" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8011"/><div sID="gen17084" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8011"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the word of Yahweh came<note placement="foot">Or “was”</note> to Isaiah, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 38:5
verses.text: “Go and say to Hezekiah, ‘Thus says Yahweh, the God of David your ancestor:<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> “I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Look, I am going to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally, “Behold me; he will add,” but in this context it makes better sense to change the “he” to “I”; most translations follow this emendation</note> add fifteen years to your days.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:6
verses.text: And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.” ’  <div eID="gen17084" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8012"/><div sID="gen17085" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8012"/>And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do this thing that he has spoken:

verses.name: Isaiah 38:8
verses.text: Look! I will cause <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shadow of the steps, which it had gone down on the steps of Ahaz with the sun, to turn backwards ten steps.” And the sun turned back ten steps on the steps which it had gone down.  <div eID="gen17085" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8013"/><div sID="gen17086" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8013"/>A writing of Hezekiah, king of Judah, when he was sick and had recovered from his sickness:  <div eID="gen17086" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8014"/><lg sID="gen17087"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8014"/>I was the one who said, “I must go in the quiet of my days;<l eID="gen17088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17089"/>I am summoned through the gates of Sheol <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the rest of my years.” <l eID="gen17089" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8015"/><l level="1" sID="gen17090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8015"/>I said, “I shall not see Yah! Yah in the land of the living!<l eID="gen17090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17091"/>I shall no more look at humankind among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world. <l eID="gen17091" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8016"/><l level="1" sID="gen17092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8016"/>My dwelling place is pulled up and removed from me like the tent of my shepherd;<l eID="gen17092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17093"/>I have rolled up my life like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> weaver.<l eID="gen17093" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17094"/>He cuts me off from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thrum;<l eID="gen17094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17095"/>from day to night you bring me to an end. <l eID="gen17095" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8017"/><l level="1" sID="gen17096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8017"/>I lie down<note placement="foot">Or “cry out”</note> until morning;<l eID="gen17096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17097"/>like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> lion, so he breaks all my bones;<l eID="gen17097" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17098"/>from day to night you bring me to an end. <l eID="gen17098" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8018"/><l level="1" sID="gen17099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8018"/>Like a horse or a crane, so I chirp;<l eID="gen17099" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17100"/>I moan like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> dove.<l eID="gen17100" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17101"/>My eyes are weak toward the height.<l eID="gen17101" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17102"/>Lord, I have oppression; lend me support! <l eID="gen17102" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8019"/><l level="1" sID="gen17103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8019"/>What can I say? For<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he has spoken to me,<l eID="gen17103" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17104"/>and he himself has done <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<l eID="gen17104" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17105"/>I will walk slowly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul. <l eID="gen17105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8020"/><l level="1" sID="gen17106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8020"/>Lord, they live by them, and the life of my spirit belongs to all among them.<l eID="gen17106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17107"/>And restore me to health and keep me alive! <l eID="gen17107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8021"/><l level="1" sID="gen17108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8021"/>Look! Bitterness was bitter to me for peace.<l eID="gen17108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17109"/>And you were the one who loved<note placement="foot">Or possibly “kept back,” which sounds similar in Hebrew</note> my life from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit of destruction,<l eID="gen17109" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17110"/>for you have cast all my sins behind your back. <l eID="gen17110" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8022"/><l level="1" sID="gen17111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8022"/>For Sheol cannot praise you; death <transChange type="added">cannot</transChange> praise you.<l eID="gen17111" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17112"/>Those who go down <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> pit cannot hope for your faithfulness. <l eID="gen17112" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8023"/><l level="1" sID="gen17113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8023"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> living, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living one praises you like me today;<l eID="gen17113" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17114"/>a father will make your faithfulness known to children. <l eID="gen17114" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8024"/><l level="1" sID="gen17115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8024"/>Yahweh, save me, and we will play my music <transChange type="added">on</transChange> stringed instruments all the days of our lives at the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> of Yahweh.” <l eID="gen17115" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen17087"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8025"/><div sID="gen17116" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8025"/>And Isaiah said, “Let them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞take⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lift up”</note> a lump of figs, and let them rub it on the boil <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he may recover.”

verses.name: Isaiah 38:22
verses.text: And Hezekiah said, “What <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> sign that I shall go up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> of Yahweh?”  <chapter eID="Isa.38"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 39:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8026"/><title type="x-s">The Delegation from Babylon</title> <div sID="gen17117" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8026"/>At that time, Merodach-Baladan, son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he heard that he had been sick and recovered.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:2
verses.text: And Hezekiah rejoiced over them and showed them his house of aromatic gum, the silver, gold, spices, good oil, all the house of his weapons, and all that was found in his storehouses. There was nothing that Hezekiah had not shown them in his house or in all his dominion.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:3
verses.text: And Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, “What did these men say, and from where did they come to you?” And Hezekiah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞answered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “said”</note> “They came to me from a distant country, from Babylon.”

verses.name: Isaiah 39:4
verses.text: And he<note placement="foot">That is, Isaiah</note> said, “What have they seen in your house?” And Hezekiah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞answered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “said”</note> “They have seen all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in my house. There is nothing that I have not shown them in my storehouses.”  <div eID="gen17117" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 39:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8027"/><div sID="gen17118" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8027"/>And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of Yahweh of hosts:

verses.name: Isaiah 39:6
verses.text: ‘Look! days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming, and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your house and that which your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> have stored up to this day shall be carried off <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon. Nothing shall be left,’ says Yahweh.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:7
verses.text: ‘And some of your sons who go out from you, whom you fathered, shall be taken, and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’ ”

verses.name: Isaiah 39:8
verses.text: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The word of Yahweh that you have spoken <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good,” for<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞thought⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “said”</note> “Surely there will be peace and security in my days.”  <chapter eID="Isa.39"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8028"/><title type="x-s">Comfort for God’s People</title> <div sID="gen17119" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen17119" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17120"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8028"/>“Comfort; comfort my people,” says your God. <l eID="gen17121" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen17120"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8029"/><div sID="gen17122" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8029"/>“Speak to the heart of Jerusalem, and call to her, <div eID="gen17122" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17123"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17124"/>that her compulsory labor is fulfilled, that her sin is paid for,<l eID="gen17124" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17125"/>that she has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞received⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “taken”</note> from the hand of Yahweh double for all her sins.” <l eID="gen17125" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8030"/><l level="1" sID="gen17126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8030"/>A voice <transChange type="added">is</transChange> calling in the wilderness, “Clear the way of Yahweh!<l eID="gen17126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17127"/>Make a highway smooth in the desert for our God! <l eID="gen17127" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8031"/><l level="1" sID="gen17128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8031"/>Every valley shall be lifted up,<l eID="gen17128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17129"/>and every mountain and hill shall become low,<l eID="gen17129" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17130"/>And the rough ground shall be like a plain,<l eID="gen17130" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17131"/>and the rugged ground like a valley-plain. <l eID="gen17131" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8032"/><l level="1" sID="gen17132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8032"/>And the glory of Yahweh shall be revealed,<l eID="gen17132" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17133"/>and all <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞humankind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “flesh”</note> together shall see <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,<l eID="gen17133" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17123"/> <div sID="gen17134" type="x-p"/> for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken.”  <div eID="gen17134" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8033"/><lg sID="gen17135"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8033"/>A voice <transChange type="added">is</transChange> saying, “Call!”<l eID="gen17136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17137"/>And he said, “What shall I call?”<l eID="gen17137" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17138"/>All <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞humankind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “flesh”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> grass,<l eID="gen17138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17139"/>and all his loyalty <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the flowers of the field. <l eID="gen17139" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8034"/><l level="1" sID="gen17140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8034"/>Grass withers; <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flower withers<l eID="gen17140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17141"/>when the breath of Yahweh blows on it.<l eID="gen17141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17142"/>Surely the people <transChange type="added">are</transChange> grass. <l eID="gen17142" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8035"/><l level="1" sID="gen17143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8035"/>Grass withers; <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flower withers,<l eID="gen17143" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17144"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> the word of our God will stand forever. <l eID="gen17144" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8036"/><l level="1" sID="gen17145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8036"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Get yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Go for you”</note> up to a high mountain, Zion, bringer of good news!<l eID="gen17145" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17146"/>Lift up your voice with strength, Jerusalem, bringer of good news!<l eID="gen17146" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17147"/>Lift <transChange type="added">it</transChange> up; you must not fear!<l eID="gen17147" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17148"/>Say to the cities of Judah, “Here <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your God!” <l eID="gen17148" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8037"/><l level="1" sID="gen17149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8037"/>Look! The Lord Yahweh comes with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞strength⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “strong”</note><l eID="gen17149" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17150"/>and his arm rules for him.<l eID="gen17150" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17151"/>Look! His reward <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with him,<l eID="gen17151" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17152"/>and his recompense <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in his presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “before his face”</note> <l eID="gen17152" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8038"/><l level="1" sID="gen17153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8038"/>He will feed his flock like a shepherd;<l eID="gen17153" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17154"/>he will gather <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lambs in his arm,<l eID="gen17154" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17155"/>and he will carry <transChange type="added">them</transChange> in his bosom;<l eID="gen17155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17156"/>he will lead those who nurse. <l eID="gen17156" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8039"/><l level="1" sID="gen17157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8039"/>Who has measured <transChange type="added">the</transChange> waters in the hollow of his hand<l eID="gen17157" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17158"/>and marked off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> span,<l eID="gen17158" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17159"/>comprehended the dust of the earth in <transChange type="added">a</transChange> third of a measure<l eID="gen17159" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17160"/>and weighed out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains in the scales,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “scale”</note> and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hills in a balance? <l eID="gen17160" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8040"/><l level="1" sID="gen17161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8040"/>Who has measured up the spirit of Yahweh<l eID="gen17161" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17162"/>or informed him <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his counselor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the man of his counsel”</note>? <l eID="gen17162" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8041"/><l level="1" sID="gen17163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8041"/>With whom has he consulted, that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he enlightened him<note placement="foot">Or “made him understand”</note><l eID="gen17163" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17164"/>and taught him <transChange type="added">the</transChange> path of justice,<l eID="gen17164" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17165"/>and taught him knowledge,<l eID="gen17165" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17166"/>and made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way of understanding known to him? <l eID="gen17166" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8042"/><l level="1" sID="gen17167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8042"/>Look! <transChange type="added">The</transChange> nations <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like a drop from a bucket,<l eID="gen17167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17168"/>and they are counted like dust of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> balances!<l eID="gen17168" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17169"/>Look! He weighs <transChange type="added">the</transChange> islands like a thin covering. <l eID="gen17169" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8043"/><l level="1" sID="gen17170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8043"/>And Lebanon <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not enough to light a fire,<l eID="gen17170" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17171"/>and its animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> not enough for a burnt offering. <l eID="gen17171" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8044"/><l level="1" sID="gen17172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8044"/>All the nations <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like nothing before him;<l eID="gen17172" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17173"/>they are counted by him as<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> nothing and emptiness. <l eID="gen17173" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8045"/><l level="1" sID="gen17174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8045"/>And to whom will you liken God?<l eID="gen17174" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17175"/>And to what likeness will you compare him? <l eID="gen17175" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8046"/><l level="1" sID="gen17176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8046"/>A craftsman pours out the idol,<l eID="gen17176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17177"/>and a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞goldsmith⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “refiner”</note> overlays it with gold,<l eID="gen17177" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17178"/>and <transChange type="added">he</transChange> smelts chains of silver. <l eID="gen17178" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8047"/><l level="1" sID="gen17179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8047"/>The one who is <transChange type="added">too</transChange> impoverished <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a gift chooses wood <transChange type="added">that</transChange> will not rot;<l eID="gen17179" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17180"/>he seeks a skillful artisan for himself to set up an image <transChange type="added">that</transChange> will not be knocked over. <l eID="gen17180" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8048"/><l level="1" sID="gen17181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8048"/>Have you not known?<l eID="gen17181" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17182"/>Have you not heard?<l eID="gen17182" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17183"/>Has it not been told to you from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beginning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note><l eID="gen17183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17184"/>Have you not understood <transChange type="added">from</transChange> the foundation of the earth? <l eID="gen17184" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8049"/><l level="1" sID="gen17185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8049"/><transChange type="added">He is</transChange> the one who sits above the circle of the earth,<l eID="gen17185" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17186"/>and its inhabitants <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like grasshoppers;<l eID="gen17186" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17187"/>the one who stretches out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens like a veil<l eID="gen17187" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17188"/>and spreads them out like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> tent to live <transChange type="added">in</transChange>, <l eID="gen17188" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8050"/><l level="1" sID="gen17189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8050"/>the one who brings<note placement="foot">Or “gives”</note> princes to nothing;<l eID="gen17189" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17190"/>he makes rulers of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth like nothing. <l eID="gen17190" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8051"/><l level="1" sID="gen17191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8051"/>Indeed, hardly are they planted; indeed, hardly <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> sown;<l eID="gen17191" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17192"/>indeed, hardly has their shoot taken root in the earth<l eID="gen17192" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17193"/>when<note placement="foot">Or “also”</note> he blows on them and they wither,<l eID="gen17193" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17194"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tempest carries them like stubble. <l eID="gen17194" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17135"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8052"/><div sID="gen17195" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8052"/>“And to whom you will compare me, and am I equal?” says <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy one.  <div eID="gen17195" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8053"/><lg sID="gen17196"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8053"/>Lift your eyes up <transChange type="added">on</transChange> high, and see! Who created these?<l eID="gen17197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17198"/>The one who brings out their host by number.<l eID="gen17198" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17199"/>He calls all them by name.<l eID="gen17199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17200"/>Because <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> great of power<l eID="gen17200" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17201"/>and mighty of power, no man is missing. <l eID="gen17201" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8054"/><l level="1" sID="gen17202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8054"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Why⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To what”</note> do you say, Jacob,<l eID="gen17202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17203"/>and you speak, Israel,<l eID="gen17203" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17204"/>“My way is hidden from Yahweh,<l eID="gen17204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17205"/>and my judgment is passed over by my God?” <l eID="gen17205" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8055"/><l level="1" sID="gen17206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8055"/>Have you not known,<l eID="gen17206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17207"/>or have you not heard?<l eID="gen17207" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17208"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the God of eternity,<l eID="gen17208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17209"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> creator <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the ends of the earth!<l eID="gen17209" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17210"/>He is not faint, and he does not grow weary!<l eID="gen17210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17211"/>There is no searching his understanding. <l eID="gen17211" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8056"/><l level="1" sID="gen17212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8056"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> gives power to the weary,<l eID="gen17212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17213"/>and he increases power for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the powerless⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not power”</note> <l eID="gen17213" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8057"/><l level="1" sID="gen17214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8057"/>Even<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> young people will be faint and grow weary,<l eID="gen17214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17215"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young will stumble, exhausted. <l eID="gen17215" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8058"/><l level="1" sID="gen17216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8058"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> those who wait for Yahweh shall renew <transChange type="added">their</transChange> strength.<l eID="gen17216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17217"/>They shall go up <transChange type="added">with</transChange> wings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wing”</note> like eagles;<l eID="gen17217" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17218"/>they shall run and not grow weary;<l eID="gen17218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17219"/>they shall walk and not be faint. <l eID="gen17219" level="2"/><lg eID="gen17196"/> <chapter eID="Isa.40"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8059"/><title type="x-s">God Helps Israel</title> <div sID="gen17220" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen17220" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17221"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8059"/>Listen to me in silence, coastlands,<l eID="gen17222" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17223"/>and let nations renew <transChange type="added">their</transChange> strength.<l eID="gen17223" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17224"/>Let them approach, then let them speak;<l eID="gen17224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17225"/>let us draw near together for judgment. <l eID="gen17225" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8060"/><l level="1" sID="gen17226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8060"/>Who has roused salvation from the east,<l eID="gen17226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17227"/>summoned<note placement="foot">Or “called”</note> him to his foot,<l eID="gen17227" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17228"/>gives nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in his presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “before his face”</note><l eID="gen17228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17229"/>and subjugates kings?<l eID="gen17229" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17230"/>He makes<note placement="foot">Or “gives”</note> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> like the dust <transChange type="added">with</transChange> his sword,<l eID="gen17230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17231"/>like scattered stubble <transChange type="added">with</transChange> his bow. <l eID="gen17231" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8061"/><l level="1" sID="gen17232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8061"/>He pursues them <transChange type="added">and</transChange> passes on <transChange type="added">in</transChange> peace;<l eID="gen17232" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17233"/>he does not enter <transChange type="added">the</transChange> path with his feet. <l eID="gen17233" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8062"/><l level="1" sID="gen17234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8062"/>Who has accomplished and done <transChange type="added">this</transChange>,<l eID="gen17234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17235"/>calling the generations from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beginning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note><l eID="gen17235" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17236"/>I, Yahweh, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> first;<l eID="gen17236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17237"/>and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> the one with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> last. <l eID="gen17237" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8063"/><l level="1" sID="gen17238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8063"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> coastlands have seen and are afraid;<l eID="gen17238" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17239"/>the ends of the earth tremble.<l eID="gen17239" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17240"/>They have drawn near,<l eID="gen17240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17241"/>and they have come. <l eID="gen17241" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8064"/><l level="1" sID="gen17242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8064"/>Each one helps<note placement="foot">Hebrew “help”</note> his neighbor;<l eID="gen17242" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17243"/>he says to his brother, “Take courage!” <l eID="gen17243" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8065"/><l level="1" sID="gen17244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8065"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> artisan encourages <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞goldsmith⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “refiner”</note><l eID="gen17244" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17245"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who makes smooth with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hammer <transChange type="added">encourages the</transChange> one who strikes <transChange type="added">the</transChange> anvil,<l eID="gen17245" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17246"/>saying of the soldering, “It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good!”<l eID="gen17246" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17247"/>And they strengthen it with nails <transChange type="added">so</transChange> it cannot be knocked over. <l eID="gen17247" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8066"/><l level="1" sID="gen17248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8066"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you, Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen,<l eID="gen17248" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17249"/>you, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞offspring⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “seed”</note> of Abraham my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞friend⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “beloved”</note> <l eID="gen17249" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8067"/><l level="1" sID="gen17250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8067"/>you whom I grasped from the ends of the earth<l eID="gen17250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17251"/>and called from its remotest parts<l eID="gen17251" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17252"/>and told, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my servant;<l eID="gen17252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17253"/>I have chosen you and I have not rejected you.” <l eID="gen17253" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8068"/><l level="1" sID="gen17254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8068"/>You must not fear, for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> with you;<l eID="gen17254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17255"/>you must not be afraid, for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> your God.<l eID="gen17255" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17256"/>I will strengthen you, indeed I will help you,<l eID="gen17256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17257"/>indeed I will take hold of you with the right hand of my salvation. <l eID="gen17257" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8069"/><l level="1" sID="gen17258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8069"/>Look! All those who are angry with you shall be ashamed and humiliated;<l eID="gen17258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17259"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your opponents⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the men of your strife”</note> shall be like nothing and shall become lost. <l eID="gen17259" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8070"/><l level="1" sID="gen17260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8070"/>You shall seek them,<l eID="gen17260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17261"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you shall not find them;<l eID="gen17261" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17262"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your opponents⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the men of your strife”</note> shall be like nothing,<l eID="gen17262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17263"/>and the men of your war like nothing. <l eID="gen17263" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8071"/><l level="1" sID="gen17264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8071"/>For I, Yahweh your God, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> grasping your right hand;<l eID="gen17264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17265"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is I who say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the sayer”</note> to you,<l eID="gen17265" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17266"/>“You must not fear;<l eID="gen17266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17267"/>I myself, I will help you. <l eID="gen17267" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8072"/><l level="1" sID="gen17268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8072"/>You must not fear, O worm of Jacob;<l eID="gen17268" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17269"/>people of Israel,<l eID="gen17269" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17270"/>I myself, I will help you,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen17270" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17271"/>“and your redeemer <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the holy one of Israel. <l eID="gen17271" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8073"/><l level="1" sID="gen17272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8073"/>Look! I will make you into a new sharp threshing sledge,<l eID="gen17272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17273"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “owner of”</note> sharp edges.<l eID="gen17273" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17274"/>You shall thresh and crush <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains,<l eID="gen17274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17275"/>and you shall make <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hills like chaff. <l eID="gen17275" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8074"/><l level="1" sID="gen17276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8074"/>You shall winnow them and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind shall carry them,<l eID="gen17276" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17277"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tempest shall scatter them.<l eID="gen17277" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17278"/>And you yourself shall rejoice in Yahweh;<l eID="gen17278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17279"/>you shall boast in the holy one of Israel. <l eID="gen17279" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8075"/><l level="1" sID="gen17280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8075"/>The poor and the needy <transChange type="added">are</transChange> seeking water and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none;<l eID="gen17280" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17281"/>their tongue is dried up with thirst.<l eID="gen17281" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17282"/>I, Yahweh, will answer them;<l eID="gen17282" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17283"/>I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them. <l eID="gen17283" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8076"/><l level="1" sID="gen17284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8076"/>I will open rivers on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> barren heights<l eID="gen17284" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17285"/>and fountains in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> midst of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> valleys.<l eID="gen17285" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17286"/>I will make <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wilderness like a pool of water<l eID="gen17286" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17287"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of dryness like springs of water. <l eID="gen17287" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8077"/><l level="1" sID="gen17288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8077"/>I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞put⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “give”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cedar, acacia, myrtle, and olive oil tree in the wilderness;<l eID="gen17288" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17289"/>I will set <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cypress, elm, and box tree together in the desert <l eID="gen17289" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8078"/><l level="1" sID="gen17290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8078"/>so that they may see and know,<l eID="gen17290" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17291"/>and take to heart and understand together<l eID="gen17291" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17292"/>that the hand of Yahweh has done this,<l eID="gen17292" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17293"/>and the holy one of Israel has created it.” <l eID="gen17293" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8079"/><l level="1" sID="gen17294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8079"/>“Present your legal case,” says Yahweh.<l eID="gen17294" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17295"/>“Bring your evidence,” says the king of Jacob. <l eID="gen17295" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8080"/><l level="1" sID="gen17296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8080"/>Let them bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange>,<l eID="gen17296" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17297"/>and let them tell us what will happen.<l eID="gen17297" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17298"/>Tell us what the former things <transChange type="added">are</transChange><l eID="gen17298" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17299"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> we may take <transChange type="added">them to</transChange> our heart<l eID="gen17299" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17300"/>and know their outcome.<note placement="foot">Or “end”</note><l eID="gen17300" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17301"/>Declare to us the things to come; <l eID="gen17301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8081"/><l level="2" sID="gen17302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8081"/>tell <transChange type="added">us</transChange> the things coming <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hereafter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “later”</note><l eID="gen17302" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17303"/>that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> we may know that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> gods.<l eID="gen17303" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17304"/>Indeed, do good or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> do evil,<l eID="gen17304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17305"/>that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> we may be afraid and see<note placement="foot">Following the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>); the written text (<hi type="italic">Kethib</hi>) has “fear”</note> together. <l eID="gen17305" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8082"/><l level="1" sID="gen17306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8082"/>Look! you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> nothing,<l eID="gen17306" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17307"/>and your work <transChange type="added">is</transChange> something worthless;<l eID="gen17307" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17308"/>whoever chooses you <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an abomination. <l eID="gen17308" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8083"/><l level="1" sID="gen17309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8083"/>I stirred up <transChange type="added">one</transChange> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,<l eID="gen17309" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17310"/>and he has come from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rising of the sun.<l eID="gen17310" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17221"/> <div sID="gen17311" type="x-p"/> He shall call on my name, <div eID="gen17311" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17312"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17313"/>and he shall come <transChange type="added">on</transChange> officials as <transChange type="added">on</transChange> mortar,<l eID="gen17313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17314"/>and as <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞potter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “creator”</note> treads clay. <l eID="gen17314" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8084"/><l level="1" sID="gen17315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8084"/>Who declared <transChange type="added">it</transChange> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beginning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> we might know,<l eID="gen17315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17316"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beforehand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from before faces”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> we might say, “He is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞right⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!”<note placement="foot">Literally “righteous”</note><l eID="gen17316" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17317"/>Indeed, there was no one who declared <transChange type="added">it</transChange>;<l eID="gen17317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17318"/>Indeed, there was no one who proclaimed <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<l eID="gen17318" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17319"/>Indeed there was no one who heard your words. <l eID="gen17319" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen17312"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8085"/><div sID="gen17320" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8085"/>First to Zion, look! Look at them! <div eID="gen17320" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen17321" type="x-p"/> And I give a herald<note placement="foot">Or “bringer”</note> of good tidings to Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen17321" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8086"/><lg sID="gen17322"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8086"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> I look and there is no man,<l eID="gen17323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17324"/>and <transChange type="added">I look</transChange> among these and there is no counselor,<l eID="gen17324" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17325"/>that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I might ask them and they might answer a word. <l eID="gen17325" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8087"/><l level="1" sID="gen17326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8087"/>Look! All of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> deception;<l eID="gen17326" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17327"/>their works <transChange type="added">are</transChange> nothing;<l eID="gen17327" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17328"/>their images <transChange type="added">are</transChange> wind and emptiness. <l eID="gen17328" level="3"/><lg eID="gen17322"/> <chapter eID="Isa.41"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8088"/><title type="x-s">The Mission of Yahweh’s Servant</title> <div sID="gen17329" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen17329" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17330"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8088"/>Look! <transChange type="added">here is</transChange> my servant; I hold him,<l eID="gen17331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17332"/>my chosen one, <transChange type="added">in whom</transChange> my soul delights.<l eID="gen17332" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17333"/>I have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞put⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “given”</note> my spirit on him;<l eID="gen17333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17334"/>he will bring justice forth to the nations. <l eID="gen17334" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8089"/><l level="1" sID="gen17335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8089"/>He will not cry out and lift up<l eID="gen17335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17336"/>and make his voice heard in the street. <l eID="gen17336" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8090"/><l level="1" sID="gen17337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8090"/>He will not break a broken reed,<l eID="gen17337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17338"/>and he not will extinguish a dim wick.<l eID="gen17338" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17339"/>He will bring justice forth in<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> faithfulness. <l eID="gen17339" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8091"/><l level="1" sID="gen17340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8091"/>He will not grow faint,<l eID="gen17340" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17341"/>and he will not be broken<l eID="gen17341" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17342"/>until he has established justice in the earth.<l eID="gen17342" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17343"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> coastlands wait for his teaching. <l eID="gen17343" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8092"/><l level="1" sID="gen17344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8092"/>Thus says the God, Yahweh,<l eID="gen17344" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17345"/>who created the heavens<l eID="gen17345" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17346"/>and stretched them out,<l eID="gen17346" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17347"/>who spread out the earth and its offspring,<l eID="gen17347" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17348"/>who gives breath to the people upon it<l eID="gen17348" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17349"/>and spirit to those who walk in it. <l eID="gen17349" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8093"/><l level="1" sID="gen17350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8093"/>“I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh; I have called you in righteousness,<l eID="gen17350" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17351"/>and I have grasped your hand and watched over you;<l eID="gen17351" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17352"/>and I have given you as a covenant of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people,<l eID="gen17352" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17353"/>as a light of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations, <l eID="gen17353" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8094"/><l level="1" sID="gen17354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8094"/>to open <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blind eyes,<l eID="gen17354" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17355"/>to bring <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prisoner out from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dungeon,<l eID="gen17355" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17356"/>those who sit <transChange type="added">in</transChange> darkness from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> house of imprisonment. <l eID="gen17356" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen17330"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8095"/><div sID="gen17357" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8095"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh; that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my name, <div eID="gen17357" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17358"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17359"/>and I do not give my glory to another,<l eID="gen17359" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17360"/>nor<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> my praise to the idols. <l eID="gen17360" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8096"/><l level="1" sID="gen17361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8096"/>Look! the former things have come,<l eID="gen17361" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17362"/>and I declare new things.<l eID="gen17362" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17363"/>I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞announce⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause to hear”</note> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to you before they sprout up.”<l eID="gen17363" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen17358"/> <title type="x-s">A Song of Praise to Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen17364" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen17364" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8097"/><lg sID="gen17365"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8097"/>Sing a new song to Yahweh;<l eID="gen17366" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17367"/>praise him from the end of the earth,<l eID="gen17367" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17368"/>you<note placement="foot">Or “those”</note> who go down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the sea and that which fills it,<l eID="gen17368" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17369"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> coastlands and their inhabitants. <l eID="gen17369" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8098"/><l level="1" sID="gen17370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8098"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert and its towns lift up their voice,<l eID="gen17370" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17371"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> villages <transChange type="added">that</transChange> Kedar inhabits.<l eID="gen17371" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17372"/>Let the inhabitants of Sela sing for joy;<l eID="gen17372" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17373"/>let them shout loudly from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞top⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains. <l eID="gen17373" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8099"/><l level="1" sID="gen17374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8099"/>Let them give<note placement="foot">Or “establish”</note> glory to Yahweh<l eID="gen17374" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17375"/>and declare his praise in the coastlands. <l eID="gen17375" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8100"/><l level="1" sID="gen17376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8100"/>Yahweh goes forth like a mighty warrior;<l eID="gen17376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17377"/>he stirs up zeal like a man of war.<l eID="gen17377" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17378"/>He raises the war cry, indeed he raises the battle shout;<l eID="gen17378" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17379"/>he prevails against his foes. <l eID="gen17379" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8101"/><l level="1" sID="gen17380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8101"/>I have been silent for a long time;<l eID="gen17380" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17381"/>I have kept silent;<l eID="gen17381" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17382"/>I have restrained myself like one giving birth;<l eID="gen17382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17383"/>I will moan, pant, and gasp together. <l eID="gen17383" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8102"/><l level="1" sID="gen17384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8102"/>I will cause mountains and hills to dry up,<l eID="gen17384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17385"/>and I will cause all their herbage to wither;<l eID="gen17385" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17386"/>and I will make rivers like islands,<l eID="gen17386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17387"/>and I will cause pools to dry up. <l eID="gen17387" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8103"/><l level="1" sID="gen17388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8103"/>And I will lead the blind by a road they do not know;<l eID="gen17388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17389"/>I will cause <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to tread on paths they have not known.<l eID="gen17389" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17390"/>I will make darkness <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before their face”</note> into light<l eID="gen17390" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17391"/>and rough places into level ground.<l eID="gen17391" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17392"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the things I will do,<l eID="gen17392" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17393"/>and I will not forsake them. <l eID="gen17393" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8104"/><l level="1" sID="gen17394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8104"/>They shall turn back;<l eID="gen17394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17395"/>they shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞greatly ashamed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “ashamed with shame”</note><l eID="gen17395" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17396"/>those who trust in an image,<l eID="gen17396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17397"/>who say to a cast image, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> our gods.”<l eID="gen17397" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17365"/> <title type="x-s">Blind and Deaf Israel</title> <div sID="gen17398" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen17398" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8105"/><lg sID="gen17399"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8105"/>Deaf people, listen!<l eID="gen17400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17401"/>And blind people, look to see! <l eID="gen17401" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8106"/><l level="1" sID="gen17402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8106"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> blind but my servant<l eID="gen17402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17403"/>or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> deaf like my messenger <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> I sent?<l eID="gen17403" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17404"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> blind like the one who is repaid<l eID="gen17404" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17405"/>or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> blind like the servant of Yahweh? <l eID="gen17405" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8107"/><l level="1" sID="gen17406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8107"/>You see many <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you do not observe.<l eID="gen17406" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17407"/><transChange type="added">His</transChange> ears are open, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he does not hear. <l eID="gen17407" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8108"/><l level="1" sID="gen17408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8108"/>Yahweh was willing for the sake of his righteousness;<l eID="gen17408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17409"/>he showed <transChange type="added">his</transChange> teaching to be great and proved <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to be glorious. <l eID="gen17409" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8109"/><l level="1" sID="gen17410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8109"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a people plundered and looted; all of them are trapped in holes,<l eID="gen17410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17411"/>and they are kept hidden in houses of imprisonment.<l eID="gen17411" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17412"/>They have become like plunder, and there is no one who saves;<l eID="gen17412" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17413"/><transChange type="added">like</transChange> booty, and there is no one who says, “Restore!” <l eID="gen17413" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8110"/><l level="1" sID="gen17414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8110"/>Who among you will heed this,<l eID="gen17414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17415"/>will listen attentively and listen, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the time to come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “later”</note> <l eID="gen17415" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8111"/><l level="1" sID="gen17416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8111"/>Who gave Jacob to a plunderer<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) has “as plunder”</note><l eID="gen17416" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17417"/>and Israel to those who plunder?<l eID="gen17417" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17399"/> <div sID="gen17418" type="x-p"/> <transChange type="added">Was it</transChange> not Yahweh, against whom<note placement="foot">Or “this”</note> we have sinned? <div eID="gen17418" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17419"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17420"/>And they were not willing to walk in his ways,<l eID="gen17420" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17421"/>and they would not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞obey⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hear”</note> his law. <l eID="gen17421" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8112"/><l level="1" sID="gen17422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8112"/>So<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he poured <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wrath <transChange type="added">of</transChange> his anger upon him<l eID="gen17422" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17423"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> strength of war.<l eID="gen17423" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17424"/>And it set him afire all around, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he did not understand;<note placement="foot">Or “did not know”</note><l eID="gen17424" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17425"/>and it burned him, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he did not take <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to heart. <l eID="gen17425" level="2"/><lg eID="gen17419"/> <chapter eID="Isa.42"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8113"/><title type="x-s">The Restorer of Israel</title> <div sID="gen17426" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8113"/>But now thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen17426" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17427"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17428"/>he who created you, Jacob,<l eID="gen17428" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17429"/>and he who formed you, Israel:<l eID="gen17429" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17430"/>“You must not fear, for I have redeemed you.<l eID="gen17430" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17431"/>I have called <transChange type="added">you</transChange> by your name; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you are mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to me you”</note> <l eID="gen17431" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8114"/><l level="1" sID="gen17432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8114"/>When you pass through the waters, I <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> with you,<l eID="gen17432" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17433"/>and through the rivers, they shall not flow over you.<l eID="gen17433" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17434"/>When you walk through fire, you shall not be burned,<l eID="gen17434" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17435"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flame shall not scorch<note placement="foot">Or “burn”</note> you. <l eID="gen17435" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8115"/><l level="1" sID="gen17436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8115"/>For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, your God,<l eID="gen17436" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17437"/>the holy one of Israel, your savior.<l eID="gen17437" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17438"/>I give you Egypt <transChange type="added">as</transChange> ransom,<l eID="gen17438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17439"/>Cush and Seba in place of you. <l eID="gen17439" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8116"/><l level="1" sID="gen17440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8116"/>Because you are precious in my eyes,<l eID="gen17440" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17441"/>you are honored, and I myself love you,<l eID="gen17441" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17442"/>and I give people in place of you,<l eID="gen17442" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17443"/>and nations in place of your life. <l eID="gen17443" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8117"/><l level="1" sID="gen17444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8117"/>You must not fear,<l eID="gen17444" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17445"/>for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> with you.<l eID="gen17445" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17446"/>I will bring your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞offspring⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “seed”</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east,<l eID="gen17446" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17447"/>and I will gather you from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> west. <l eID="gen17447" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8118"/><l level="1" sID="gen17448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8118"/>I will say to the north, ‘Give!’<l eID="gen17448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17449"/>and to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south, ‘You must not withhold!’<l eID="gen17449" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17450"/>Bring my sons from far away,<l eID="gen17450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17451"/>and my daughters from the end of the earth— <l eID="gen17451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8119"/><l level="1" sID="gen17452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8119"/>everyone who is called by my name,<l eID="gen17452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17453"/>and whom I created for my glory,<l eID="gen17453" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17454"/>whom I formed,<l eID="gen17454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17455"/>indeed whom I made.” <l eID="gen17455" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8120"/><l level="1" sID="gen17456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8120"/>Bring out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people blind yet<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> with eyes,<l eID="gen17456" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17457"/>and deaf, though<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they have ears. <l eID="gen17457" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8121"/><l level="1" sID="gen17458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8121"/>Let all the nations gather together,<l eID="gen17458" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17459"/>and let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples assemble.<l eID="gen17459" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17460"/>Who among them has declared this,<l eID="gen17460" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17461"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declared⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “caused to hear”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> former things to us?<l eID="gen17461" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17462"/>Let them bring<note placement="foot">Or “give”</note> their witnesses, that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they may be in the right,<l eID="gen17462" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17463"/>and let them hear and say, “<transChange type="added">It is</transChange> true!” <l eID="gen17463" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8122"/><l level="1" sID="gen17464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8122"/>“You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my witnesses,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen17464" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17465"/>“and my servant whom I have chosen<l eID="gen17465" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17466"/>so that you may know and believe <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> me<l eID="gen17466" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17467"/>and understand that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he.<l eID="gen17467" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17468"/>No god was formed before <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my face”</note>,<l eID="gen17468" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17469"/>and none shall be after me. <l eID="gen17469" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8123"/><l level="1" sID="gen17470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8123"/>I myself <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen17470" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17471"/>and there is no savior besides me! <l eID="gen17471" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8124"/><l level="1" sID="gen17472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8124"/>I myself declared and saved,<l eID="gen17472" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17473"/>and I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞proclaimed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “caused to hear”</note> And there was no <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞strange god⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “stranger”</note> among you.<l eID="gen17473" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17474"/>And you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my witnesses,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen17474" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17475"/>“and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> God. <l eID="gen17475" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:13
