verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8125"/><l level="1" sID="gen17476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8125"/>Indeed, from <transChange type="added">this</transChange> day I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> the one,<l eID="gen17476" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17477"/>and no one can deliver from my hand.<l eID="gen17477" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17478"/>I perform,<note placement="foot">Or “make”</note> and who can <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cancel it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “bring it back”</note><l eID="gen17478" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen17427"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh Rescues His People</title> <div sID="gen17479" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen17479" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8126"/><lg sID="gen17480"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8126"/>Thus says Yahweh, your redeemer,<l eID="gen17481" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17482"/>the holy one of Israel:<l eID="gen17482" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17483"/>“For your sake I will send <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon,<l eID="gen17483" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17484"/>and I will cause all of them to fall down <transChange type="added">as</transChange> fugitives,<l eID="gen17484" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17485"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Chaldeans⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldea”</note> their rejoicing on the ships. <l eID="gen17485" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8127"/><l level="1" sID="gen17486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8127"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, your holy one,<l eID="gen17486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17487"/>the creator of Israel, your king.” <l eID="gen17487" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8128"/><l level="1" sID="gen17488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8128"/>Thus says Yahweh, who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞makes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gives”</note> a way in the sea<l eID="gen17488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17489"/>and a path in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty waters, <l eID="gen17489" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8129"/><l level="1" sID="gen17490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8129"/>who brings out chariot and horse,<l eID="gen17490" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17491"/>army and mighty one.<l eID="gen17491" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17492"/>Together they lie down;<l eID="gen17492" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17493"/>they cannot rise.<l eID="gen17493" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17494"/>They are extinguished,<l eID="gen17494" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17495"/>quenched like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> wick. <l eID="gen17495" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8130"/><l level="1" sID="gen17496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8130"/>“You must not remember <transChange type="added">the</transChange> former things,<l eID="gen17496" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17497"/>and you not must consider <transChange type="added">the</transChange> former things. <l eID="gen17497" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8131"/><l level="1" sID="gen17498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8131"/>Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to do a new thing! Now it sprouts!<l eID="gen17498" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17499"/>Do you not perceive<note placement="foot">Or “know”</note> it?<l eID="gen17499" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17500"/>Indeed, I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “put”</note> a way in the wilderness,<l eID="gen17500" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17501"/>rivers in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert. <l eID="gen17501" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8132"/><l level="1" sID="gen17502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8132"/>The animals of the field will honor me,<l eID="gen17502" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17503"/>jackals and daughters of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ostrich,<l eID="gen17503" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17504"/>for I give water in the wilderness,<l eID="gen17504" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17505"/>rivers in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert,<l eID="gen17505" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17506"/>to give a drink <transChange type="added">to</transChange> my chosen people, <l eID="gen17506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8133"/><l level="2" sID="gen17507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8133"/>this people whom I formed for myself,<l eID="gen17507" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17508"/>so they might <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make known⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “count out”</note> my praise. <l eID="gen17508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8134"/><l level="1" sID="gen17509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8134"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you did not call me, Jacob;<l eID="gen17509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17510"/>for you have become weary of me, Israel. <l eID="gen17510" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8135"/><l level="1" sID="gen17511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8135"/>You have not brought me your sheep for a burnt offering<l eID="gen17511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17512"/>nor<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> honored me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your sacrifice.<l eID="gen17512" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17513"/>I have not made you serve with offerings,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “offering”</note><l eID="gen17513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17514"/>nor have I made you weary with frankincense. <l eID="gen17514" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8136"/><l level="1" sID="gen17515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8136"/>You have not bought me spice reed with money<l eID="gen17515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17516"/>or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> satisfied me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the fat of sacrifices.<l eID="gen17516" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17517"/>But you have burdened me with your sins;<l eID="gen17517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17518"/>you have made me weary with your iniquities. <l eID="gen17518" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8137"/><l level="1" sID="gen17519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8137"/>I, I am the one who blots out your transgressions for my sake,<l eID="gen17519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17520"/>and I will not remember your sins. <l eID="gen17520" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8138"/><l level="1" sID="gen17521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8138"/>Take me to court; let us enter into judgment together.<l eID="gen17521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17522"/>You, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make an account⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “count up”</note> so that you may be in the right. <l eID="gen17522" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8139"/><l level="1" sID="gen17523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8139"/>Your first ancestor<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> sinned,<l eID="gen17523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17524"/>and your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞representatives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “scoffers” or “spokesmen”</note> transgressed against me. <l eID="gen17524" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8140"/><l level="1" sID="gen17525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8140"/>And I profaned <transChange type="added">the</transChange> princes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sanctuary,<l eID="gen17525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17526"/>and I gave Jacob to destruction, and Israel to reviling. <l eID="gen17526" level="2"/><lg eID="gen17480"/> <chapter eID="Isa.43"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8141"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Blesses Chosen Israel</title> <div sID="gen17527" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen17527" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17528"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8141"/>“But now hear, Jacob my servant,<l eID="gen17529" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17530"/>and Israel, whom I have chosen. <l eID="gen17530" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8142"/><l level="1" sID="gen17531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8142"/>Thus says Yahweh, who made you,<l eID="gen17531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17532"/>and who formed you in<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb and will help you:<l eID="gen17532" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17533"/>you must not fear, my servant Jacob,<l eID="gen17533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17534"/>and Jeshurun whom I have chosen. <l eID="gen17534" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8143"/><l level="1" sID="gen17535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8143"/>For I will pour out water on a thirsty <transChange type="added">land</transChange><l eID="gen17535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17536"/>and streams on dry ground.<l eID="gen17536" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17537"/>I will pour my spirit out on your descendants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “descendant”</note><l eID="gen17537" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17538"/>and my blessing on your offspring. <l eID="gen17538" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8144"/><l level="1" sID="gen17539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8144"/>And they shall sprout <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in between”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grass<l eID="gen17539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17540"/>like willows by a watercourse of water. <l eID="gen17540" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8145"/><l level="1" sID="gen17541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8145"/>This <transChange type="added">one</transChange> will say, ‘I belong to Yahweh!’<l eID="gen17541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17542"/>And that <transChange type="added">one</transChange> will be called by the name of Jacob,<l eID="gen17542" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17543"/>and another will write <transChange type="added">on</transChange> his hand ‘Yahweh’s’<l eID="gen17543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17544"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞take the name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he will be titled by the name”</note> of Israel.”<l eID="gen17544" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17528"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh the Only God</title> <div sID="gen17545" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen17545" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8146"/><lg sID="gen17546"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8146"/>Thus says Yahweh, the king of Israel,<l eID="gen17547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17548"/>and its redeemer, Yahweh of hosts:<l eID="gen17548" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17549"/>“I <transChange type="added">am the</transChange> first, and I <transChange type="added">am the</transChange> last,<l eID="gen17549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17550"/>and there is no god besides me. <l eID="gen17550" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8147"/><l level="1" sID="gen17551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8147"/>And who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like me? Let him proclaim<note placement="foot">Or “call”</note> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>!<l eID="gen17551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17552"/>And let him declare it and set it in order for me<l eID="gen17552" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17553"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞since I established an eternal people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from my placing a people of eternity”</note> and things that are to come,<l eID="gen17553" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17554"/>and let them tell them <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> that are coming. <l eID="gen17554" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8148"/><l level="1" sID="gen17555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8148"/>You must not tremble,<note placement="foot">Or “be startled”</note><l eID="gen17555" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17556"/>and you must not be paralyzed with fear.<l eID="gen17556" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17557"/>Have I not made you hear from of old<note placement="foot">Or “then”</note><l eID="gen17557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17558"/>and declared <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my witnesses?<l eID="gen17558" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17559"/>Is there a god besides me?<l eID="gen17559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17560"/>And there is no rock! I know none!”<l eID="gen17560" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17546"/> <title type="x-s">Idolatry Is Ridiculous</title> <div sID="gen17561" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen17561" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8149"/><lg sID="gen17562"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8149"/>All those who form an idol <transChange type="added">are</transChange> nothing,<l eID="gen17563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17564"/>and their delightful things do not profit.<l eID="gen17564" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17565"/>And their witnesses do not see or know,<l eID="gen17565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17566"/>so they will be ashamed. <l eID="gen17566" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8150"/><l level="2" sID="gen17567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8150"/>Who would form a god<l eID="gen17567" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17568"/>and cast an image of <transChange type="added">which</transChange> he cannot profit? <l eID="gen17568" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8151"/><l level="1" sID="gen17569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8151"/>Look! all his companions shall be ashamed,<l eID="gen17569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17570"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> artisans <transChange type="added">are</transChange> human!<l eID="gen17570" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17571"/>Let all of them assemble;<l eID="gen17571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17572"/>let them stand up.<l eID="gen17572" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17573"/>They shall tremble;<note placement="foot">Or “be startled”</note><l eID="gen17573" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17574"/>they shall be ashamed together. <l eID="gen17574" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8152"/><l level="1" sID="gen17575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8152"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ironsmith⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “craftsman of iron”</note> works in the coals <transChange type="added">with his</transChange> tool<l eID="gen17575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17576"/>and forms it with hammers.<l eID="gen17576" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17577"/>And he makes it with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his strong arm⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the arm of his strength”</note><l eID="gen17577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17578"/>indeed, he becomes hungry, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he lacks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there is no”</note> strength;<l eID="gen17578" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17579"/>he does not drink water, and he is faint. <l eID="gen17579" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8153"/><l level="1" sID="gen17580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8153"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞woodworker⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “craftsman of wood”</note> stretches out a line;<l eID="gen17580" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17581"/>he makes an outline <transChange type="added">of</transChange> it with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> marker.<l eID="gen17581" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17582"/>He makes it with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> knife<l eID="gen17582" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17583"/>and makes an outline <transChange type="added">of</transChange> it with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> compass.<l eID="gen17583" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17584"/>He makes it like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> image of a man,<l eID="gen17584" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17585"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> beauty of a human, to dwell <transChange type="added">in</transChange> a temple.<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> <l eID="gen17585" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8154"/><l level="1" sID="gen17586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8154"/>Cutting down cedars for himself,<l eID="gen17586" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17587"/>he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞chooses⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “takes”</note> a holm tree and an oak,<l eID="gen17587" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17588"/>and he lets it grow strong for him among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> trees of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> forest.<l eID="gen17588" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17589"/>He plants a cedar, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rain makes <transChange type="added">it</transChange> grow. <l eID="gen17589" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8155"/><l level="1" sID="gen17590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8155"/>And it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞becomes fuel for a human⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “will become for a man as burning”</note><l eID="gen17590" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17591"/>and he takes some of it and grows warm;<l eID="gen17591" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17592"/>also, he kindles a fire and bakes bread.<l eID="gen17592" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17593"/>Also, he makes a god and bows in worship;<l eID="gen17593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17594"/>he makes himself an image and bows down to it! <l eID="gen17594" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8156"/><l level="1" sID="gen17595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8156"/>He burns half of it in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fire;<l eID="gen17595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17596"/>he eats meat over half of it;<l eID="gen17596" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17597"/>he roasts a roast and is satisfied.<l eID="gen17597" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17598"/>Also he grows warm and says, “Ah!<l eID="gen17598" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17599"/>I am warm! I see <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fire!” <l eID="gen17599" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8157"/><l level="1" sID="gen17600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8157"/>And he makes the remainder of it into a god!<l eID="gen17600" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17601"/>He bows down to his idol,<l eID="gen17601" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17602"/>and he bows in worship and prays to him,<l eID="gen17602" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17603"/>and he says, “Save me, for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my god!” <l eID="gen17603" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8158"/><l level="1" sID="gen17604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8158"/>They do not know,<l eID="gen17604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17605"/>and they do not understand,<l eID="gen17605" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17606"/>for their eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> besmeared <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that they cannot see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from seeing”</note><l eID="gen17606" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17607"/>their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞minds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hearts”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that they have no insight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from having insight”</note> <l eID="gen17607" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8159"/><l level="1" sID="gen17608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8159"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no one takes it to heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he does not bring back to his heart”</note> and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no knowledge<l eID="gen17608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17609"/>and no understanding to say, “I burned half of it in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fire<l eID="gen17609" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17610"/>and also I baked bread on its coals;<l eID="gen17610" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17611"/>I roasted meat, and I have eaten.<l eID="gen17611" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17612"/>And I shall make <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rest of it into an abomination!<l eID="gen17612" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17613"/>I shall bow down to a block of wood!” <l eID="gen17613" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8160"/><l level="1" sID="gen17614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8160"/><transChange type="added">He</transChange> feeds <transChange type="added">on</transChange> ashes; a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deceived mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart deceived”</note> misleads him.<l eID="gen17614" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17615"/>And he cannot save <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his soul”</note> and he cannot say,<l eID="gen17615" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17616"/>“Is <transChange type="added">this</transChange> not an illusion in my right hand?”<l eID="gen17616" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen17562"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh Remembers Israel</title> <div sID="gen17617" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen17617" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8161"/><lg sID="gen17618"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8161"/>“Remember these things, Jacob,<l eID="gen17619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17620"/>and Israel, for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my servant:<l eID="gen17620" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17621"/>I formed you; you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my servant;<l eID="gen17621" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17622"/>Israel, you will not be forgotten by me! <l eID="gen17622" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8162"/><l level="1" sID="gen17623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8162"/>I have wiped your transgressions out like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> cloud<l eID="gen17623" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17624"/>and your sins like mist.<l eID="gen17624" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17625"/>Return to me,<l eID="gen17625" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17626"/>for I have redeemed you!” <l eID="gen17626" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8163"/><l level="1" sID="gen17627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8163"/>Sing for joy, heavens, for Yahweh has done <transChange type="added">it</transChange>!<l eID="gen17627" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17628"/>Shout, depths of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth!<l eID="gen17628" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17629"/>Break forth, mountains, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> rejoicing,<l eID="gen17629" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17630"/>forest and every tree in it,<l eID="gen17630" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17631"/>for Yahweh has redeemed Jacob,<l eID="gen17631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17632"/>and he will show his glory in Israel!<l eID="gen17632" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17618"/> <title type="x-s">Jerusalem Restored through Cyrus</title> <div sID="gen17633" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen17633" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8164"/><lg sID="gen17634"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8164"/>Thus says Yahweh, your redeemer,<l eID="gen17635" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17636"/>and he who formed you in<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb:<l eID="gen17636" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17637"/>“I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, who made everything,<l eID="gen17637" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17638"/>who stretched out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens alone,<l eID="gen17638" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17639"/>who spread out the earth—who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with me?— <l eID="gen17639" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8165"/><l level="1" sID="gen17640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8165"/>who frustrates<note placement="foot">Or “breaks”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> signs of oracle priests<l eID="gen17640" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17641"/>and makes a fool of diviners,<l eID="gen17641" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17642"/>who drives <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise men back<l eID="gen17642" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17643"/>and makes their knowledge foolish, <l eID="gen17643" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8166"/><l level="1" sID="gen17644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8166"/>who keeps<note placement="foot">Or “erects”</note> the word of his servant<l eID="gen17644" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17645"/>and carries out the plan of his messengers,<l eID="gen17645" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17646"/>who says of Jerusalem, ‘It shall be inhabited,’<l eID="gen17646" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17647"/>and of the cities of Judah, ‘They shall be rebuilt,<l eID="gen17647" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17648"/>and I will restore its ruins’; <l eID="gen17648" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8167"/><l level="1" sID="gen17649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8167"/>who says to the deep, ‘Dry up!<l eID="gen17649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17650"/>And I will cause your rivers to dry up’; <l eID="gen17650" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8168"/><l level="1" sID="gen17651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8168"/>who says of Cyrus, ‘My shepherd,’<l eID="gen17651" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17652"/>and he shall carry out all my wishes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wish”</note>;<l eID="gen17652" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17653"/>and saying of Jerusalem, ‘It shall be rebuilt,’<l eID="gen17653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17654"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> temple, ‘It shall be founded.’ ” <l eID="gen17654" level="2"/><lg eID="gen17634"/> <chapter eID="Isa.44"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:1
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh to his anointed one,<l eID="gen17657" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17658"/>to Cyrus, whose right hand I have grasped<l eID="gen17658" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17659"/>to subjugate nations before him,<l eID="gen17659" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17660"/>and I uncover<note placement="foot">Or “let loose”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> loins of kings<l eID="gen17660" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17661"/>to open doors before him,<l eID="gen17661" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17662"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gates shall not be shut: <l eID="gen17662" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8169"/><l level="1" sID="gen17663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8169"/>“I myself will go before you,<l eID="gen17663" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17664"/>and I will level <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mountains⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “swells”</note><l eID="gen17664" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17665"/>I will break <transChange type="added">the</transChange> doors of bronze<l eID="gen17665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17666"/>and cut through<transChange type="added">the</transChange> bars of iron. <l eID="gen17666" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8170"/><l level="1" sID="gen17667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8170"/>And I will give you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> treasures of darkness<l eID="gen17667" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17668"/>and treasures of secret places<l eID="gen17668" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17669"/>so that you may know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen17669" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17670"/>the one who calls <transChange type="added">you</transChange> by your name, the God of Israel, <l eID="gen17670" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8171"/><l level="1" sID="gen17671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8171"/>for the sake of my servant Jacob,<l eID="gen17671" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17672"/>and Israel my chosen one.<l eID="gen17672" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17673"/>And I call you by your name;<l eID="gen17673" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17674"/>I give you a name of honor, though<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you do not know me. <l eID="gen17674" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8172"/><l level="1" sID="gen17675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8172"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, and there is none besides <transChange type="added">me</transChange>;<l eID="gen17675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17676"/>besides me there is no god.<l eID="gen17676" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17677"/>I gird you though<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you do not know me, <l eID="gen17677" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8173"/><l level="1" sID="gen17678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8173"/>so that they may know from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rising of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun<l eID="gen17678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17679"/>and from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> west that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none besides me;<l eID="gen17679" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17680"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh and there is none besides <transChange type="added">me</transChange>. <l eID="gen17680" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8174"/><l level="1" sID="gen17681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8174"/><transChange type="added">I</transChange> form light and <transChange type="added">I</transChange> create darkness;<l eID="gen17681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17682"/><transChange type="added">I</transChange> make peace and <transChange type="added">I</transChange> create evil;<l eID="gen17682" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17683"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh; <transChange type="added">I</transChange> do all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>. <l eID="gen17683" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8175"/><l level="1" sID="gen17684"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8175"/>Trickle, O heavens, from above,<l eID="gen17684" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17685"/>and let clouds trickle <transChange type="added">with</transChange> righteousness;<l eID="gen17685" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17686"/>let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth open so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> salvation may be fruitful,<l eID="gen17686" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17687"/>and let it cause righteousness to sprout along with it.<note placement="foot">Or “together”</note><l eID="gen17687" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17688"/>I myself, Yahweh, have created it. <l eID="gen17688" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8176"/><l level="1" sID="gen17689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8176"/>Woe <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> one who strives with his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞maker⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “one who forms”</note><l eID="gen17689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17690"/>a potsherd among<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> potsherds of earth!<l eID="gen17690" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17691"/>Does <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clay say to the one who fashions it,<l eID="gen17691" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17692"/>‘What are you making?’<l eID="gen17692" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17693"/>and ‘Your work has no hands’? <l eID="gen17693" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8177"/><l level="1" sID="gen17694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8177"/>Woe <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> one who says to a father, ‘What you are begetting?’<l eID="gen17694" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17695"/>or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> to a woman, ‘<transChange type="added">With</transChange> what are you in labor?’ ” <l eID="gen17695" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8178"/><l level="1" sID="gen17696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8178"/>Thus says Yahweh, the holy one of Israel,<l eID="gen17696" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17697"/>and its <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞maker⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “one who forms”</note><l eID="gen17697" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17698"/>“Ask me of the things to come <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞about⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “over”</note> my children,<l eID="gen17698" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17699"/>and you command me about the work of my hands. <l eID="gen17699" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8179"/><l level="1" sID="gen17700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8179"/>I myself made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen17700" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17701"/>and I created humankind upon it.<l eID="gen17701" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17702"/>I, my hands, stretched out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens,<l eID="gen17702" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17703"/>and I commanded all their host. <l eID="gen17703" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8180"/><l level="1" sID="gen17704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8180"/>I myself have stirred him up in righteousness,<l eID="gen17704" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17705"/>and I will make all his paths smooth.<l eID="gen17705" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17706"/>He himself shall build my city,<l eID="gen17706" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17707"/>and he shall set my exiles free,<l eID="gen17707" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17656"/> <div sID="gen17708" type="x-p"/> not for price or a gift,” says Yahweh of hosts. <div eID="gen17708" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh the Only Savior</title> <div sID="gen17709" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen17709" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8181"/><lg sID="gen17710"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8181"/>Thus says Yahweh:<l eID="gen17711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17712"/>“The acquisition of Egypt<l eID="gen17712" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17713"/>and the merchandise of Cush<l eID="gen17713" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17714"/>and the Sabeans, tall men,<l eID="gen17714" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17715"/>shall pass over to you;<l eID="gen17715" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17716"/>they shall be yours,<l eID="gen17716" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17717"/>and they shall walk behind you.<l eID="gen17717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17718"/>They shall pass over in chains,<l eID="gen17718" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17719"/>and they shall bow down to you;<l eID="gen17719" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17720"/>they will pray to you:<l eID="gen17720" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17721"/>‘Surely God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with you, and there is no <transChange type="added">other</transChange>.<l eID="gen17721" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17722"/>Besides <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no God.’ ” <l eID="gen17722" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8182"/><l level="1" sID="gen17723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8182"/>Surely you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a God who keeps yourself hidden,<l eID="gen17723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17724"/>God of Israel, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> savior. <l eID="gen17724" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8183"/><l level="1" sID="gen17725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8183"/>All of them are ashamed and indeed humiliated;<l eID="gen17725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17726"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> craftsmen of idols go together in insult. <l eID="gen17726" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8184"/><l level="1" sID="gen17727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8184"/>Israel is saved by Yahweh <transChange type="added">with</transChange> everlasting salvation;<l eID="gen17727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17728"/>you shall not be ashamed,<l eID="gen17728" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17729"/>and you shall not be humiliated <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to all eternity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for eternity, forever”</note> <l eID="gen17729" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8185"/><l level="1" sID="gen17730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8185"/>For thus says Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who created⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “creating”</note> the heavens,<l eID="gen17730" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17731"/>he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who formed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “forming”</note> the earth<l eID="gen17731" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17732"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “making”</note> it.<l eID="gen17732" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17733"/>He himself established it;<l eID="gen17733" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17734"/>he did not create it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> emptiness—<l eID="gen17734" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17735"/>he formed it for inhabiting.<l eID="gen17735" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17710"/> <div sID="gen17736" type="x-p"/> “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh and there is none besides <transChange type="added">me</transChange>.  <div eID="gen17736" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8186"/><lg sID="gen17737"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8186"/>I have spoken not in secrecy, in a place, a land, of darkness,<l eID="gen17738" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17739"/>I have not said to the descendants of Jacob, ‘Seek me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in vain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!’<note placement="foot">Literally “in emptiness,” as in verse <reference osisRef="Isa.45.18">18</reference></note><l eID="gen17739" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17740"/>I, Yahweh, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> speaking righteousness,<l eID="gen17740" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17741"/>declaring uprightness. <l eID="gen17741" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8187"/><l level="1" sID="gen17742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8187"/>Assemble and come;<l eID="gen17742" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17743"/>draw near together, survivors of the nations!<l eID="gen17743" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17744"/>They do not know, those who carry <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their wooden idols⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the wood of their idol”</note><l eID="gen17744" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17745"/>and pray to a god who cannot save. <l eID="gen17745" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8188"/><l level="1" sID="gen17746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8188"/>Declare and present <transChange type="added">your case</transChange>,<l eID="gen17746" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17747"/>also let them consult together!<l eID="gen17747" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17748"/>Who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made this known⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “caused to hear this”</note> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞former times⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “before”</note><l eID="gen17748" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17749"/>declared it from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “then”</note><l eID="gen17749" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17750"/><transChange type="added">Was it</transChange> not I, Yahweh?<l eID="gen17750" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17751"/>And there is no <transChange type="added">other</transChange> god besides <transChange type="added">me</transChange>,<l eID="gen17751" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17752"/>a righteous God besides me,<l eID="gen17752" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17753"/>and no savior besides me. <l eID="gen17753" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8189"/><l level="1" sID="gen17754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8189"/>Turn to me and be saved, all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ends of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen17754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17755"/>for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> God and there is none besides <transChange type="added">me</transChange>. <l eID="gen17755" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8190"/><l level="1" sID="gen17756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8190"/>I have sworn by myself;<l eID="gen17756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17757"/>a word that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> shall not return has gone forth from my mouth <transChange type="added">in</transChange> righteousness:<l eID="gen17757" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17758"/>‘Every knee shall kneel down to me;<l eID="gen17758" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17759"/>every tongue shall swear.’ <l eID="gen17759" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8191"/><l level="1" sID="gen17760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8191"/>‘Only in Yahweh,’ one shall say to me, ‘<transChange type="added">are</transChange> righteousness and strength.’<l eID="gen17760" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17761"/>He shall come to him, and all those who were angry with him shall be ashamed. <l eID="gen17761" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8192"/><l level="1" sID="gen17762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8192"/>In Yahweh all the offspring of Israel shall be in the right,<l eID="gen17762" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17763"/>and they shall boast.” <l eID="gen17763" level="2"/><lg eID="gen17737"/> <chapter eID="Isa.45"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8193"/><title type="x-s">Babylon’s Idols</title> <div sID="gen17764" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen17764" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17765"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8193"/>Bel bows down;<l eID="gen17766" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17767"/>Nebo <transChange type="added">is</transChange> stooping.<l eID="gen17767" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17768"/>Their idols are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> cattle;<l eID="gen17768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17769"/>your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cargo⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “things that are carried”</note> is carried as a burden <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> weary <transChange type="added">animals</transChange>. <l eID="gen17769" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8194"/><l level="1" sID="gen17770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8194"/>They stoop;<l eID="gen17770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17771"/>they bow down together.<l eID="gen17771" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17772"/>They are not able to save <transChange type="added">the</transChange> burden,<l eID="gen17772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17773"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they themselves go⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “their inner self goes”</note> in captivity. <l eID="gen17773" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8195"/><l level="1" sID="gen17774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8195"/>“Listen to me, house of Jacob,<l eID="gen17774" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17775"/>and all the remnant of the house of Israel<l eID="gen17775" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17776"/>who have been carried from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> belly,<l eID="gen17776" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17777"/>who have been carried from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb: <l eID="gen17777" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8196"/><l level="1" sID="gen17778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8196"/>Even<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> to <transChange type="added">your</transChange> old age I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he;<l eID="gen17778" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17779"/>even<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> to <transChange type="added">your</transChange> advanced age I myself will support <transChange type="added">you</transChange>.<l eID="gen17779" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17780"/>I myself have made <transChange type="added">you</transChange>,<l eID="gen17780" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17781"/>and I myself will carry <transChange type="added">you</transChange>,<l eID="gen17781" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17782"/>and I myself will support <transChange type="added">you</transChange>,<l eID="gen17782" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17783"/>and I will save <transChange type="added">you</transChange>. <l eID="gen17783" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8197"/><l level="1" sID="gen17784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8197"/>To whom will you liken me,<l eID="gen17784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17785"/>and count as equal,<l eID="gen17785" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17786"/>and compare with me,<l eID="gen17786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17787"/>as though<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> we were alike? <l eID="gen17787" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8198"/><l level="1" sID="gen17788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8198"/>Those who lavish gold from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> purse<l eID="gen17788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17789"/>and weigh out silver in the balance scales;<l eID="gen17789" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17790"/>hire <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a goldsmith⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one who smelts”</note><l eID="gen17790" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17791"/>and he makes him a god;<l eID="gen17791" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17792"/>they bow down,<l eID="gen17792" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17793"/>indeed they bow in worship. <l eID="gen17793" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8199"/><l level="1" sID="gen17794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8199"/>They carry it on <transChange type="added">their</transChange> shoulder;<l eID="gen17794" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17795"/>they support it and they set it <transChange type="added">in</transChange> its place,<l eID="gen17795" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17796"/>and it stands in position.<l eID="gen17796" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17797"/>It cannot be removed from its place;<l eID="gen17797" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17798"/>even <transChange type="added">when</transChange> he cries out to it, it does not answer.<l eID="gen17798" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17799"/>It does not save him from his trouble. <l eID="gen17799" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8200"/><l level="1" sID="gen17800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8200"/>Remember this and pluck up courage!<l eID="gen17800" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17801"/>Call to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> <transChange type="added">you</transChange> transgressors! <l eID="gen17801" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8201"/><l level="2" sID="gen17802"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8201"/>Remember <transChange type="added">the</transChange> former things from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a long time ago⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “forever”</note><l eID="gen17802" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17803"/>for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> God and there is none besides <transChange type="added">me</transChange>,<l eID="gen17803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17804"/>God and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none like me, <l eID="gen17804" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8202"/><l level="1" sID="gen17805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8202"/>who from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> beginning declares <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end,<l eID="gen17805" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17806"/>and from before, <transChange type="added">things</transChange> that have not been done,<l eID="gen17806" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17807"/>who says, ‘My plan shall stand,’<l eID="gen17807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17808"/>and, ‘I will accomplish<note placement="foot">Or “do”</note> all my wishes,’<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wish”</note> <l eID="gen17808" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8203"/><l level="1" sID="gen17809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8203"/>who calls a bird of prey from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east,<l eID="gen17809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17810"/>the man of his<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) has “my”</note> plan from a country from afar.<l eID="gen17810" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17811"/>Indeed I have spoken; indeed I will bring it <transChange type="added">to being</transChange>.<l eID="gen17811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17812"/>I have formed <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; indeed I will do it. <l eID="gen17812" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8204"/><l level="1" sID="gen17813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8204"/>Listen to me, strong of heart,<l eID="gen17813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17814"/>far from righteousness! <l eID="gen17814" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8205"/><l level="1" sID="gen17815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8205"/>I bring my righteousness near; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not far.<l eID="gen17815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17816"/>And my salvation will not delay;<l eID="gen17816" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17817"/>and I will put<note placement="foot">Or “give”</note> salvation in Zion,<l eID="gen17817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17818"/>for Israel my glory.” <l eID="gen17818" level="2"/><lg eID="gen17765"/> <chapter eID="Isa.46"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8206"/><title type="x-s">Babylon’s Fall</title> <div sID="gen17819" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen17819" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17820"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8206"/>Come down and sit on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust, virgin daughter of Babylon!<l eID="gen17821" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17822"/>Sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of Chaldea!<l eID="gen17822" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17823"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they shall no longer call⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you shall not add they shall call to”</note> you tender and delicate. <l eID="gen17823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8207"/><l level="2" sID="gen17824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8207"/>Take <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pair of mill stones and grind flour!<l eID="gen17824" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17825"/>Uncover your veil,<l eID="gen17825" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17826"/>strip off <transChange type="added">your</transChange> skirt,<l eID="gen17826" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17827"/>uncover <transChange type="added">your</transChange> thigh,<l eID="gen17827" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17828"/>pass through <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rivers! <l eID="gen17828" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8208"/><l level="1" sID="gen17829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8208"/>Your nakedness shall be exposed;<l eID="gen17829" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17830"/>indeed, your shame shall become visible.<l eID="gen17830" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17831"/>I will take vengeance<l eID="gen17831" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17832"/>and I will not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spare⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “plead with”</note> a person. <l eID="gen17832" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17820"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8209"/><div sID="gen17833" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8209"/>Our redeemer, Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name, the holy one of Israel.  <div eID="gen17833" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8210"/><lg sID="gen17834"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8210"/>Sit silently and go into the darkness, daughter of Chaldea,<l eID="gen17835" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17836"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they shall no longer call⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you shall not add they shall call to”</note> you mistress of kingdoms. <l eID="gen17836" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8211"/><l level="1" sID="gen17837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8211"/>I was angry with my people;<l eID="gen17837" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17838"/>I profaned my inheritance,<l eID="gen17838" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17839"/>and I gave them into your hand.<l eID="gen17839" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17840"/>You did not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞give⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “set up”</note> them mercy;<l eID="gen17840" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17841"/>on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> aged you made your yoke very heavy. <l eID="gen17841" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8212"/><l level="2" sID="gen17842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8212"/>And you said, “I shall be an eternal mistress forever!”<l eID="gen17842" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17843"/>You did not set these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> upon your heart;<l eID="gen17843" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17844"/>you did not remember its end. <l eID="gen17844" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8213"/><l level="1" sID="gen17845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8213"/>Therefore now hear this, luxuriant <transChange type="added">one</transChange> who sits<note placement="foot">Or “sitting”</note> in security,<l eID="gen17845" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17846"/>who says<note placement="foot">Or “saying”</note> in her heart, “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>, and besides me <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no one.<l eID="gen17846" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17847"/>I shall not sit <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a widow,<l eID="gen17847" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17848"/>and I shall not know <transChange type="added">the</transChange> loss of children.” <l eID="gen17848" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8214"/><l level="1" sID="gen17849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8214"/>And these two shall come to you <transChange type="added">in</transChange> a moment, in one day:<l eID="gen17849" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17850"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> loss of children and widowhood shall come on you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞completely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as their fullness”</note><l eID="gen17850" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17851"/>in spite of your many sorceries,<l eID="gen17851" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17852"/>in spite of the power of your great enchantments. <l eID="gen17852" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8215"/><l level="1" sID="gen17853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8215"/>And you felt secure in your wickedness;<l eID="gen17853" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17854"/>you said, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞No one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “none”</note> sees<note placement="foot">Or “is seeing”</note> me.”<l eID="gen17854" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17855"/>Your wisdom and your knowledge led you astray,<l eID="gen17855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17856"/>and you said in your heart, “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>, and besides me <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no one.” <l eID="gen17856" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8216"/><l level="1" sID="gen17857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8216"/>And evil shall come upon you, you will not know;<l eID="gen17857" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17858"/>it will be on the lookout for her.<l eID="gen17858" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17859"/>And disaster shall fall upon you; you will not be able to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞avert⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “make amends”</note> it.<l eID="gen17859" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17860"/>And ruin shall come on you suddenly; you do not know. <l eID="gen17860" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8217"/><l level="1" sID="gen17861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8217"/>Stand, now, in your enchantments,<l eID="gen17861" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17862"/>and in your many sorceries with which you have labored from your youth.<l eID="gen17862" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17863"/>Perhaps you may be able to benefit;<l eID="gen17863" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17864"/>perhaps you may <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞scare away⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “terrify”</note> <l eID="gen17864" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8218"/><l level="1" sID="gen17865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8218"/>You struggle with your many consultations;<note placement="foot">Or “advice”</note><l eID="gen17865" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17866"/>let them stand, now, and save you—<l eID="gen17866" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17867"/>those who see the stars, divide <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞celestial sphere⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heavens,” that is, for astrology</note><l eID="gen17867" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17868"/>who inform by new moons—<l eID="gen17868" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17869"/>from <transChange type="added">those things</transChange> that are coming upon you. <l eID="gen17869" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8219"/><l level="1" sID="gen17870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8219"/>Look! They are like stubble;<l eID="gen17870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17871"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> fire burns them completely.<l eID="gen17871" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17872"/>They cannot deliver <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “their lives”</note> from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flame;<l eID="gen17872" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17873"/>there is no coal <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for warming oneself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to grow warm”</note><l eID="gen17873" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17874"/><transChange type="added">no</transChange> fire before which to sit. <l eID="gen17874" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8220"/><l level="1" sID="gen17875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8220"/>So are to you <transChange type="added">those with</transChange> whom you have labored,<l eID="gen17875" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17876"/>your traders from your youth.<l eID="gen17876" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17877"/>They wander, each to his side;<l eID="gen17877" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17878"/>there is no one who can save you. <l eID="gen17878" level="2"/><lg eID="gen17834"/> <chapter eID="Isa.47"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8221"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Refines Stubborn Israel</title> <div sID="gen17879" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen17879" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17880"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8221"/>Hear this, house of Jacob,<l eID="gen17881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17882"/>who are called by the name of Israel<l eID="gen17882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17883"/>and came out from the waters of Judah,<l eID="gen17883" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17884"/>who swear by the name of Yahweh,<l eID="gen17884" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17885"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞invoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause to remember”</note> the God of Israel,<l eID="gen17885" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17886"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> not in truth<l eID="gen17886" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17887"/>and not in righteousness. <l eID="gen17887" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8222"/><l level="1" sID="gen17888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8222"/>For they call themselves <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞after the holy city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the city of the holiness”</note><l eID="gen17888" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17889"/>and they lean on the God of Israel—<l eID="gen17889" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17890"/>Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name. <l eID="gen17890" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8223"/><l level="1" sID="gen17891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8223"/>“I declared the former things from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “then”</note><l eID="gen17891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17892"/>and they went out from my mouth.<l eID="gen17892" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17893"/>And I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞announced⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “caused to hear”</note> them suddenly;<l eID="gen17893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17894"/>I acted,<note placement="foot">Or “did”</note> and they came <transChange type="added">to pass</transChange>, <l eID="gen17894" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8224"/><l level="1" sID="gen17895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8224"/>because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I know⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “knowing me”</note> that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> obstinate,<l eID="gen17895" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17896"/>and your neck an iron sinew,<l eID="gen17896" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17897"/>and your forehead bronze. <l eID="gen17897" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8225"/><l level="1" sID="gen17898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8225"/>And I declared <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to you from of old;<l eID="gen17898" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17899"/>I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ announced⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “caused to hear”</note> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to you before they came <transChange type="added">to pass</transChange><l eID="gen17899" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17900"/>so that you would not say, ‘My idol did them,<l eID="gen17900" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17901"/>and my image and my cast image commanded them.’ <l eID="gen17901" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8226"/><l level="1" sID="gen17902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8226"/>You have heard; see it all.<l eID="gen17902" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17903"/>And will you not declare <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?<l eID="gen17903" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17904"/>I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞announce⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause to hear”</note> new things to you from this time<l eID="gen17904" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17905"/>and hidden things that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you have not known. <l eID="gen17905" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8227"/><l level="1" sID="gen17906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8227"/>Now they are created, and not from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “then”</note><l eID="gen17906" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17907"/>and before today, and you have not heard them<l eID="gen17907" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17908"/>so that you could not say, “Look! I knew them.” <l eID="gen17908" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8228"/><l level="1" sID="gen17909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8228"/>Neither have you heard, nor have you known,<l eID="gen17909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17910"/>nor from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “then”</note> has your ear been opened.<l eID="gen17910" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17911"/>For I knew you would deal treacherously, very treacherously,<l eID="gen17911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17912"/>and you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> called a rebel from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb. <l eID="gen17912" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8229"/><l level="1" sID="gen17913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8229"/>For the sake of my name I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞refrain from⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “make long”</note> my anger,<l eID="gen17913" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17914"/>and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> my praise I restrain <transChange type="added">it</transChange> for you<l eID="gen17914" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17915"/><transChange type="added">so as</transChange> not to cut you off. <l eID="gen17915" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8230"/><l level="1" sID="gen17916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8230"/>Look! I have refined you, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> not like<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> silver;<l eID="gen17916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17917"/>I have chosen you in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> furnace of misery. <l eID="gen17917" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8231"/><l level="1" sID="gen17918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8231"/>For my own sake, for my own sake I do <transChange type="added">it</transChange>;<l eID="gen17918" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17919"/>for why should it<note placement="foot">That is, my name</note> be defiled?<l eID="gen17919" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17920"/>And I will not give my glory to another.”<l eID="gen17920" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen17880"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh Frees Israel</title> <div sID="gen17921" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen17921" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8232"/><lg sID="gen17922"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8232"/>“Listen to me, Jacob,<l eID="gen17923" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17924"/>and Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whom I called⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “who was called by me”</note><l eID="gen17924" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17925"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he. I <transChange type="added">am the</transChange> first;<l eID="gen17925" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17926"/>also I <transChange type="added">am the</transChange> last. <l eID="gen17926" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8233"/><l level="1" sID="gen17927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8233"/>Indeed, my hand founded <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen17927" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17928"/>and my right hand spread out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens;<l eID="gen17928" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17929"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> I summon<note placement="foot">Or “calling”</note> them, they stand in position together. <l eID="gen17929" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8234"/><l level="1" sID="gen17930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8234"/>Assemble, all of you, and hear!<l eID="gen17930" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17931"/>Who among them declared these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>?<l eID="gen17931" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17932"/>Yahweh loves him;<l eID="gen17932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17933"/>he shall perform<note placement="foot">Or “do”</note> his wish against Babylon<l eID="gen17933" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17934"/>and his arm <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Chaldeans⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldea”</note> <l eID="gen17934" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8235"/><l level="1" sID="gen17935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8235"/>I, I myself, I have spoken!<l eID="gen17935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17936"/>Indeed, I have called him.<l eID="gen17936" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17937"/>I have brought him,<l eID="gen17937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17938"/>and he will be successful <transChange type="added">in</transChange> his way. <l eID="gen17938" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8236"/><l level="1" sID="gen17939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8236"/>Draw near to me; hear this!
