I have not spoken in secrecy from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beginning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note><l eID="gen17939" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17940"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it came to be⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “of becoming it”</note> there I <transChange type="added">have been</transChange>;<l eID="gen17940" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17941"/>And now the Lord Yahweh has sent me and his Spirit.” <l eID="gen17941" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen17922"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8237"/><div sID="gen17942" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8237"/>Thus says Yahweh, your redeemer, the holy one of Israel: <div eID="gen17942" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17943"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17944"/>“I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who teaches⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “teaching”</note> you to profit,<l eID="gen17944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17945"/>leads you in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way you should go. <l eID="gen17945" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17943"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8238"/><div sID="gen17946" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8238"/>O that you had listened attentively to my commandments! <div eID="gen17946" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17947"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17948"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your prosperity would have been like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> river,<l eID="gen17948" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17949"/>and your righteousness like the waves of the sea. <l eID="gen17949" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8239"/><l level="1" sID="gen17950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8239"/>And your offspring would have been like the sand,<l eID="gen17950" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17951"/>and the descendants of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “intestines”</note> like its grains.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “grain”</note><l eID="gen17951" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17952"/>It would not be cut off,<l eID="gen17952" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17953"/>and its name would not be destroyed from my presence.” <l eID="gen17953" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8240"/><l level="1" sID="gen17954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8240"/>Go out from Babylon!<l eID="gen17954" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17955"/>Flee from Chaldea!<l eID="gen17955" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17956"/>Proclaim<note placement="foot">Or “announce”</note> it with a shout<note placement="foot">Or “sound”</note> of rejoicing; proclaim<note placement="foot">Or “cause to hear”</note> this!<l eID="gen17956" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17957"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Send it forth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Cause it to go out”</note> to the end of the earth;<l eID="gen17957" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen17958"/>say, “Yahweh has redeemed his servant Jacob!” <l eID="gen17958" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8241"/><l level="1" sID="gen17959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8241"/>And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> he led them through the deserts, they were not thirsty;<l eID="gen17959" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17960"/>he made water flow from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rock for them,<l eID="gen17960" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17961"/>and he split <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rock,<l eID="gen17961" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17962"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> water gushed out. <l eID="gen17962" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17947"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8242"/><div sID="gen17963" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8242"/>“There is no peace,” says Yahweh, “for the wicked.”  <chapter eID="Isa.48"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8243"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Servant Brings Salvation</title> <div sID="gen17964" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen17964" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17965"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8243"/>Listen to me, coastlands,<l eID="gen17966" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17967"/>and listen attentively, peoples from far away!<l eID="gen17967" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17968"/>Yahweh called me from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb;<l eID="gen17968" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17969"/>from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “intestines”</note> of my mother he made my name known. <l eID="gen17969" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8244"/><l level="1" sID="gen17970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8244"/>And he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “put”</note> my mouth like a sharp sword;<l eID="gen17970" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17971"/>he hid me in the shadow of his hand,<l eID="gen17971" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17972"/>and he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “put”</note> me like an sharpened arrow;<l eID="gen17972" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17973"/>he hid me in his quiver. <l eID="gen17973" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8245"/><l level="1" sID="gen17974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8245"/>And he said to me, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my servant,<l eID="gen17974" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17975"/>Israel, in whom I will show my glory.” <l eID="gen17975" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8246"/><l level="1" sID="gen17976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8246"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> I myself said, “I have labored in<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> vain;<l eID="gen17976" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17977"/>I have used up my strength for nothing and vanity!<l eID="gen17977" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17978"/>Nevertheless, my justice <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with Yahweh,<l eID="gen17978" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17979"/>and my reward <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with my God.” <l eID="gen17979" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8247"/><l level="1" sID="gen17980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8247"/>And now Yahweh says,<l eID="gen17980" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17981"/>who formed me from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb as a servant for him,<l eID="gen17981" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17982"/>to bring Jacob back to him,<l eID="gen17982" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17983"/>and that Israel might not<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) has “to him”</note> be gathered,<l eID="gen17983" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17984"/>for<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I am honored in the eyes of Yahweh,<l eID="gen17984" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17985"/>and my God has become my strength. <l eID="gen17985" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17965"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8248"/><div sID="gen17986" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8248"/>And he says, “It is trivial <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for you to be⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from being you”</note> a servant for me, <div eID="gen17986" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17987"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17988"/>to raise up the tribes of Jacob<l eID="gen17988" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17989"/>and to bring back the preserved of Israel.<l eID="gen17989" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17990"/>I will give you as a light <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> nations,<l eID="gen17990" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17991"/>to be my salvation to the end of the earth.” <l eID="gen17991" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17987"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8249"/><div sID="gen17992" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8249"/>Thus says Yahweh, the redeemer of Israel, his holy one, <div eID="gen17992" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17993"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17994"/>to the one who despises<note placement="foot">A Dead Sea Scroll reads “is despised with respect to”</note> life,<l eID="gen17994" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17995"/>to the one who abhors <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nation,<l eID="gen17995" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17996"/>to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slave of rulers:<l eID="gen17996" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17997"/>“Kings shall see and stand up;<l eID="gen17997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen17998"/>princes, and they shall bow down,<l eID="gen17998" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17999"/>for the sake of Yahweh, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> faithful,<l eID="gen17999" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18000"/>the holy one of Israel, and he has chosen you.” <l eID="gen18000" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen17993"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8250"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Restores the Afflicted</title> <div sID="gen18001" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8250"/>Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen18001" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18002"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18003"/>“I have answered you in a time of favor,<l eID="gen18003" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18004"/>and helped you on a day of salvation,<l eID="gen18004" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18005"/>and watched over you,<l eID="gen18005" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18006"/>and given you as a covenant of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people,<l eID="gen18006" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18007"/>to raise up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen18007" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18008"/>to give <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desolate hereditary property as an inheritance, <l eID="gen18008" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8251"/><l level="1" sID="gen18009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8251"/>saying to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞prisoners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “captured ones”</note> “Come out!”<l eID="gen18009" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18010"/>to those who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in darkness, “Show yourselves!”<l eID="gen18010" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18011"/>they shall feed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞along⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ways,<l eID="gen18011" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18012"/>and their pasturage <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> on all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> barren heights. <l eID="gen18012" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8252"/><l level="1" sID="gen18013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8252"/>They shall not be hungry or thirsty,<l eID="gen18013" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18014"/>and heat and sun shall not strike them,<l eID="gen18014" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18015"/>for he who takes pity on them will lead them,<l eID="gen18015" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18016"/>and he will guide them to springs of water. <l eID="gen18016" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8253"/><l level="1" sID="gen18017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8253"/>And I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “put”</note> all my mountains like a road,<l eID="gen18017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18018"/>and my highways shall lead up.<note placement="foot">Or “be high”</note> <l eID="gen18018" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8254"/><l level="1" sID="gen18019"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8254"/>Look! These shall come from afar,<l eID="gen18019" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18020"/>And look! These from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north and from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> west<l eID="gen18020" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18021"/>and these from the land of Sinim.” <l eID="gen18021" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8255"/><l level="1" sID="gen18022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8255"/>Sing for joy, heavens, and rejoice, earth!<l eID="gen18022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18023"/>Mountains must break forth <transChange type="added">in</transChange> rejoicing!<l eID="gen18023" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18024"/>For Yahweh has comforted his people,<l eID="gen18024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18025"/>and he will take pity on his afflicted ones.<l eID="gen18025" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18002"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh Remembers Zion</title> <div sID="gen18026" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen18026" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8256"/><lg sID="gen18027"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8256"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Zion said, “Yahweh has forsaken me,<l eID="gen18028" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18029"/>and the Lord has forgotten me!” <l eID="gen18029" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8257"/><l level="1" sID="gen18030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8257"/>Can a woman forget her suckling,<l eID="gen18030" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18031"/><transChange type="added">refrain</transChange> from having compassion on the child of her womb?<l eID="gen18031" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18032"/>Indeed, these may forget,<l eID="gen18032" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18033"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I, I will not forget you! <l eID="gen18033" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8258"/><l level="1" sID="gen18034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8258"/>Look, I have inscribed you on the palms of <transChange type="added">my</transChange> hands;<l eID="gen18034" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18035"/>your walls <transChange type="added">are</transChange> continually before me. <l eID="gen18035" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8259"/><l level="1" sID="gen18036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8259"/>Your children hasten;<l eID="gen18036" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18037"/>your destroyers and those who laid you waste depart<note placement="foot">Or “move away”</note> from you. <l eID="gen18037" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8260"/><l level="1" sID="gen18038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8260"/>Lift your eyes up all around and see;<l eID="gen18038" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18039"/>all of them gather; they come to you.<l eID="gen18039" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18040"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As surely as I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Life I”</note><l eID="gen18040" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18041"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen18041" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18042"/>surely you shall put on all of them like <transChange type="added">an</transChange> ornament,<l eID="gen18042" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18043"/>and you shall bind them on like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> bride. <l eID="gen18043" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18027"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8261"/><div sID="gen18044" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8261"/>Surely your sites of ruins and desolate <transChange type="added">places</transChange> and land of ruins,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ruin”</note> <div eID="gen18044" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18045"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18046"/>surely now you will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞too cramped for your⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cramped by”</note> inhabitants,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note><l eID="gen18046" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18047"/>and those who engulfed you will be far away. <l eID="gen18047" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18045"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8262"/><div sID="gen18048" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8262"/>Yet the children <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞born when you were bereaved⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of your bereavement”</note> will say in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “ears”</note> <div eID="gen18048" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18049"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18050"/>“The place is <transChange type="added">too</transChange> cramped for me;<l eID="gen18050" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18051"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make room⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “approach”</note> for me so that I can dwell.” <l eID="gen18051" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18049"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8263"/><div sID="gen18052" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8263"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you will say in your heart, <div eID="gen18052" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18053"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18054"/>“Who has borne me these?”<l eID="gen18054" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18055"/>And, “I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> bereaved and barren,<l eID="gen18055" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18056"/>exiled and thrust away;<l eID="gen18056" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18057"/>so<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> who raised these?<l eID="gen18057" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18058"/>Look at me! I was left alone;<l eID="gen18058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18059"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where have these come from⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “these where they”</note> <l eID="gen18059" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18053"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8264"/><div sID="gen18060" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8264"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen18060" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18061"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18062"/>“Look! I will lift my hand up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations,<l eID="gen18062" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18063"/>and I will raise my signal to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen18063" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18064"/>and they shall bring your sons in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> bosom,<l eID="gen18064" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18065"/>and your daughters shall be carried on <transChange type="added">their</transChange> shoulders.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “shoulder”</note> <l eID="gen18065" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8265"/><l level="1" sID="gen18066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8265"/>And kings shall be your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞guardians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “those who nurture”</note><l eID="gen18066" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18067"/>and their queens your nurses.<l eID="gen18067" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18068"/>They shall bow down, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞faces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “noses”</note> <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> ground, to you,<l eID="gen18068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18069"/>and they will lick up the dust of your feet.<l eID="gen18069" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18070"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh;<l eID="gen18070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18071"/>those who await me shall not be ashamed. <l eID="gen18071" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8266"/><l level="1" sID="gen18072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8266"/>Can war-booty be taken from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty?<l eID="gen18072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18073"/>or can a captive of a righteous<note placement="foot">The Dead Sea Scroll has “violent”</note> <transChange type="added">person</transChange> be rescued? <l eID="gen18073" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18061"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8267"/><div sID="gen18074" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8267"/>But thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen18074" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18075"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18076"/>“Indeed a captive of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty shall be taken,<l eID="gen18076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18077"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> war-booty <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tyrant shall be rescued,<l eID="gen18077" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18078"/>for<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I myself will dispute <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your opponent,<l eID="gen18078" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18079"/>and I myself will save your children. <l eID="gen18079" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8268"/><l level="1" sID="gen18080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8268"/>And I will feed your oppressors their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> flesh,<l eID="gen18080" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18081"/>and they shall be drunk <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their blood as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> wine.<l eID="gen18081" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18082"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> all flesh shall know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen18082" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18083"/>your savior and redeemer, the strong <transChange type="added">one</transChange> of Jacob.” <l eID="gen18083" level="2"/><lg eID="gen18075"/> <chapter eID="Isa.49"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:1
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen18084" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18085"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18086"/>“Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this divorce document of your mother’s divorce, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which I dismissed her?<l eID="gen18086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18087"/>or to whom of my creditors did I sell you?<l eID="gen18087" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18088"/>Look! you were sold because of your sin,<l eID="gen18088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18089"/>and your mother was dismissed because of your transgressions. <l eID="gen18089" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8269"/><l level="1" sID="gen18090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8269"/>Why was there no man when I came,<l eID="gen18090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18091"/>no one who answered when I called?<l eID="gen18091" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18092"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Do I lack the strength to save⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “short is short my hand from redemption”</note><l eID="gen18092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18093"/>Or <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> no power in me to deliver?<l eID="gen18093" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18094"/>Look! by my rebuke I dry up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea;<l eID="gen18094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18095"/>I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “put”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rivers a desert;<l eID="gen18095" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18096"/>their fish stink because there is no water,<l eID="gen18096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18097"/>and they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “she”</note> die because of thirst. <l eID="gen18097" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8270"/><l level="1" sID="gen18098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8270"/>I clothe <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens <transChange type="added">with</transChange> darkness,<l eID="gen18098" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18099"/>and I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “put”</note> their covering sackcloth.”<l eID="gen18099" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18085"/> <title type="x-s">The Servant’s Vindication</title> <div sID="gen18100" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen18100" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8271"/><lg sID="gen18101"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8271"/>The Lord Yahweh has given me <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tongue of <transChange type="added">a</transChange> pupil,<l eID="gen18102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18103"/>to know how to help <transChange type="added">the</transChange> weary <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a word.<l eID="gen18103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18104"/>He awakens <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞morning by morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the morning in the morning”</note><l eID="gen18104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18105"/>awakens an ear for me to listen as <transChange type="added">do</transChange> the pupils. <l eID="gen18105" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8272"/><l level="1" sID="gen18106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8272"/>The Lord Yahweh has opened an ear for me,<l eID="gen18106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18107"/>and I, I was not rebellious.<l eID="gen18107" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18108"/>I did not turn backwards; <l eID="gen18108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8273"/><l level="2" sID="gen18109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8273"/>I gave my back to those who struck <transChange type="added">me</transChange>,<l eID="gen18109" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18110"/>and my cheeks to those who pulled out my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note><l eID="gen18110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18111"/>I did not hide my face from insults and spittle. <l eID="gen18111" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18101"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8274"/><div sID="gen18112" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8274"/>And the Lord Yahweh helps me, <div eID="gen18112" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18113"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18114"/>therefore I have not been put to shame;<l eID="gen18114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18115"/>therefore I have set my face like flint.<l eID="gen18115" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18116"/>And I know that I shall not be ashamed; <l eID="gen18116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8275"/><l level="2" sID="gen18117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8275"/>he who obtains rights for me <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near.<l eID="gen18117" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18118"/>Who will contend with me? Let us stand together.<l eID="gen18118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18119"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the master of my judgment? Let him approach me. <l eID="gen18119" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8276"/><l level="1" sID="gen18120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8276"/>Look! The Lord Yahweh helps me.<l eID="gen18120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18121"/>Who is the one who will declare me guilty?<l eID="gen18121" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18122"/>Look! All of them will be worn out like a garment;<l eID="gen18122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18123"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> moth will eat them. <l eID="gen18123" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8277"/><l level="1" sID="gen18124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8277"/>Who among you <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in fear of Yahweh,<l eID="gen18124" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18125"/>obeys<note placement="foot">Or “listens”</note> the voice of his servant?<l eID="gen18125" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18126"/>Who walks <transChange type="added">in</transChange> darkness<l eID="gen18126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18127"/>and has no light,<l eID="gen18127" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18128"/>trusts in the name of Yahweh<l eID="gen18128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18129"/>and depends on his God? <l eID="gen18129" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8278"/><l level="1" sID="gen18130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8278"/>Look! All of you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> kindlers of fire,<l eID="gen18130" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18131"/>who gird yourselves with flaming arrows.<l eID="gen18131" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18132"/>Walk in the light of your fire,<l eID="gen18132" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18133"/>and among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flaming arrows you have kindled!<l eID="gen18133" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18134"/>You shall have this from my hand:<l eID="gen18134" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18135"/>you shall lie down in<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> a place of torment. <l eID="gen18135" level="2"/><lg eID="gen18113"/> <chapter eID="Isa.50"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8279"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Comforts Zion</title> <div sID="gen18136" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18136" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18137"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8279"/>“Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness,<l eID="gen18138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18139"/>who seek Yahweh.<l eID="gen18139" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18140"/>Look to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rock <transChange type="added">from which</transChange> you were hewn,<l eID="gen18140" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18141"/>and to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> excavation of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit <transChange type="added">from which</transChange> you were quarried. <l eID="gen18141" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8280"/><l level="1" sID="gen18142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8280"/>Look to Abraham your father,<l eID="gen18142" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18143"/>and to Sarah; she brought you forth.<l eID="gen18143" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18144"/>For I called him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “one”</note><l eID="gen18144" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18145"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I blessed him and made him numerous.” <l eID="gen18145" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8281"/><l level="1" sID="gen18146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8281"/>For Yahweh will comfort Zion;<l eID="gen18146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18147"/>he will comfort all its sites of ruins.<l eID="gen18147" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18148"/>And he will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “put”</note> its wilderness like Eden,<l eID="gen18148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18149"/>and its desert like the garden of Yahweh.<l eID="gen18149" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18150"/>Joy and gladness will be found in it,<l eID="gen18150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18151"/>thanksgiving and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sound⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “voice”</note> of song. <l eID="gen18151" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8282"/><l level="1" sID="gen18152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8282"/>“Listen attentively to me, my people,<l eID="gen18152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18153"/>and my nation, listen to me!<l eID="gen18153" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18154"/>For a teaching will go out from me,<l eID="gen18154" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18155"/>and I will cause my justice to rest for a light to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples. <l eID="gen18155" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8283"/><l level="1" sID="gen18156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8283"/>My righteousness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near; my salvation has gone out,<l eID="gen18156" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18157"/>and my arms will judge <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples.<l eID="gen18157" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18158"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> coastlands wait for me,<l eID="gen18158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18159"/>and for my arm they wait. <l eID="gen18159" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8284"/><l level="1" sID="gen18160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8284"/>Lift up your eyes to the heavens<l eID="gen18160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18161"/>and look to the earth beneath,<l eID="gen18161" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18162"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens will be torn to pieces like smoke,<l eID="gen18162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18163"/>and the earth will be worn out like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> garment,<l eID="gen18163" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18164"/>and those who inhabit her will die like gnats.<l eID="gen18164" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18165"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> my salvation will be forever,<l eID="gen18165" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18166"/>and my righteousness will not be broken to pieces. <l eID="gen18166" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8285"/><l level="1" sID="gen18167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8285"/>Listen to me, you who know righteousness,<l eID="gen18167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18168"/>people <transChange type="added">who have</transChange> my teaching in their heart;<l eID="gen18168" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18169"/>you must not fear <transChange type="added">the</transChange> reproach of men,<l eID="gen18169" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18170"/>or be terrified because of their abuse. <l eID="gen18170" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8286"/><l level="1" sID="gen18171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8286"/>For a moth will eat them like garments;<l eID="gen18171" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18172"/>a moth will devour<note placement="foot">Or “eat”</note> them like wool,<l eID="gen18172" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18173"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> my righteousness will be forever,<l eID="gen18173" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18174"/>and my salvation for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞generation after generation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “generation of generations”</note>” <l eID="gen18174" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8287"/><l level="1" sID="gen18175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8287"/>Awake! Awake; put on strength, O arm of Yahweh!<l eID="gen18175" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18176"/>Awake as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> days of long ago,<l eID="gen18176" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18177"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> generations of a long time back!<l eID="gen18177" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18178"/><transChange type="added">Are</transChange> you not the one who cut Rahab in pieces,<l eID="gen18178" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18179"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who pierced <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea-dragon? <l eID="gen18179" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8288"/><l level="1" sID="gen18180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8288"/>Are you not the one who dried up <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea,<l eID="gen18180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18181"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> waters of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> great deep,<l eID="gen18181" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18182"/>the one who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “placed”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea a way<l eID="gen18182" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18183"/>for those who are redeemed to cross over? <l eID="gen18183" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8289"/><l level="1" sID="gen18184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8289"/>So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the redeemed ones of Yahweh shall return,<l eID="gen18184" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18185"/>and they shall come <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Zion with singing,<l eID="gen18185" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18186"/>and everlasting joy <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> on their heads.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “head”</note><l eID="gen18186" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18187"/>Joy and gladness shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞appear⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “reach”</note><l eID="gen18187" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18188"/>sorrow and sighing shall flee away! <l eID="gen18188" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8290"/><l level="1" sID="gen18189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8290"/>“I, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he who comforts you;<l eID="gen18189" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18190"/>who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you are afraid of man? He dies!<l eID="gen18190" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18191"/>And of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> son of humankind? He is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sacrificed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “given”</note> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> grass! <l eID="gen18191" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8291"/><l level="1" sID="gen18192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8291"/>And you have forgotten Yahweh, your maker,<l eID="gen18192" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18193"/>who stretched out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens,<l eID="gen18193" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18194"/>and founded <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth.<l eID="gen18194" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18195"/>And you tremble continually, all day,<l eID="gen18195" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18196"/>because of the wrath of the oppressor<l eID="gen18196" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18197"/>when he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞takes aim⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sets up”</note> to destroy.<l eID="gen18197" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18198"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the wrath of the oppressor? <l eID="gen18198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8292"/><l level="2" sID="gen18199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8292"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> fettered one shall make haste to be freed.<l eID="gen18199" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18200"/>And he shall not die in<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> the pit,<l eID="gen18200" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18201"/>and he shall not lack his bread. <l eID="gen18201" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8293"/><l level="1" sID="gen18202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8293"/>For<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, your God,<l eID="gen18202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18203"/>who stirs up<note placement="foot">Or “stirring up”</note> the sea, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> its waves roar;<l eID="gen18203" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18204"/>Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name. <l eID="gen18204" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8294"/><l level="1" sID="gen18205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8294"/>And I have put my words in your mouth,<l eID="gen18205" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18206"/>and I have covered you in the shadow of my hand,<l eID="gen18206" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18207"/>to plant <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens<l eID="gen18207" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18208"/>and to found <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen18208" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18209"/>saying to Zion, ‘You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my people.’ ” <l eID="gen18209" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8295"/><l level="1" sID="gen18210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8295"/>Rouse yourself! Rouse yourself!<l eID="gen18210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18211"/>Stand up, Jerusalem, who have drunk from the hand of Yahweh the cup of his wrath;<l eID="gen18211" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18212"/>you have drunk the goblet, the cup of staggering;<l eID="gen18212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18213"/>you have drained <transChange type="added">it</transChange> out. <l eID="gen18213" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8296"/><l level="1" sID="gen18214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8296"/>There is no one who guides her among<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children she has borne,<l eID="gen18214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18215"/>and there is no one who grasps her by the hand among<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children she raised. <l eID="gen18215" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8297"/><l level="1" sID="gen18216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8297"/>Two <transChange type="added">things</transChange> here <transChange type="added">have</transChange> happened to you—who will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞show sympathy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wander”</note> for you?—<l eID="gen18216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18217"/>devastation and destruction, famine and sword—who will comfort you? <l eID="gen18217" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8298"/><l level="1" sID="gen18218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8298"/>Your children have fainted;<l eID="gen18218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18219"/>they lie at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head of all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> streets, like an antelope in<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> a snare,<l eID="gen18219" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18220"/>those who are full <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the wrath of Yahweh,<l eID="gen18220" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18221"/>the rebuke of your God. <l eID="gen18221" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8299"/><l level="1" sID="gen18222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8299"/>Therefore hear now this afflicted <transChange type="added">one</transChange><l eID="gen18222" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18223"/>and drunken <transChange type="added">one</transChange> but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> not from wine. <l eID="gen18223" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8300"/><l level="1" sID="gen18224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8300"/>Thus says your Lord, Yahweh,<l eID="gen18224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18225"/>and your God pleads the cause <transChange type="added">of</transChange> his people:<l eID="gen18225" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18226"/>“Look! I have taken from your hand the cup of staggering.<l eID="gen18226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18227"/>You shall not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continue⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do again”</note> to drink the goblet, the cup of my wrath, any longer. <l eID="gen18227" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8301"/><l level="1" sID="gen18228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8301"/>And I will put it in the hand of your tormenters,<l eID="gen18228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18229"/>who have said to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “your inner self”</note> ‘Bow down that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> we may <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pass⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “stride”</note> over <transChange type="added">you</transChange>!’<l eID="gen18229" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18230"/>And you have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “placed”</note> your back like the ground,<l eID="gen18230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18231"/>and like the street for those who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pass⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “stride”</note> over <transChange type="added">you</transChange>.” <l eID="gen18231" level="2"/><lg eID="gen18137"/> <chapter eID="Isa.51"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8302"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Redeems Zion</title> <div sID="gen18232" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18232" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18233"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8302"/>Awake! Awake; put on your strength, Zion!<l eID="gen18234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18235"/>Put on the garments of your beauty, Jerusalem, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holy city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “city of the holiness”</note><l eID="gen18235" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18236"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> uncircumcised and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> unclean shall not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continue to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do again he shall”</note> enter you any longer. <l eID="gen18236" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8303"/><l level="1" sID="gen18237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8303"/>Shake yourself free from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dust! Rise up; sit, Jerusalem!<l eID="gen18237" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18238"/>Free yourselves <transChange type="added">from</transChange> the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion! <l eID="gen18238" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18233"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8304"/><div sID="gen18239" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8304"/>For thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen18239" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18240"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18241"/>“You were sold for nothing,<l eID="gen18241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18242"/>and you shall be redeemed without money.” <l eID="gen18242" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18240"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8305"/><div sID="gen18243" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8305"/>For thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen18243" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen18244" type="x-p"/> “My people went down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt in the beginning, to dwell as aliens there, and Assyria oppressed him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without cause⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in nothing”</note>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:5
verses.text: And now what do I have here?”<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “for my people is taken without cause. Its rulers howl,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh—“and my name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> reviled continually, all day.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:6
verses.text: Therefore my people shall know my name, therefore in that day, that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> the one who speaks. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Here am I⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “Look at me”</note>  <div eID="gen18244" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8306"/><lg sID="gen18245"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8306"/>How delightful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news,<l eID="gen18246" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18247"/>who announces peace, who brings good news, who announces salvation,<l eID="gen18247" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18248"/>who says to Zion, “Your God reigns as a king.” <l eID="gen18248" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8307"/><l level="1" sID="gen18249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8307"/>The voices<note placement="foot">Hebrew “voice”</note> of your watchmen! They lift up their voices;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “voice”</note><l eID="gen18249" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18250"/>together they sing for joy;<l eID="gen18250" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18251"/>for they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞clearly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “eye in eye “</note> see Yahweh’s return <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Zion. <l eID="gen18251" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8308"/><l level="1" sID="gen18252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8308"/>Break forth,<l eID="gen18252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18253"/>sing for joy together, ruins of Jerusalem,<l eID="gen18253" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18254"/>for Yahweh has comforted his people;<l eID="gen18254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18255"/>he has redeemed Jerusalem. <l eID="gen18255" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8309"/><l level="1" sID="gen18256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8309"/>Yahweh has bared <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his holy arm⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the arm of his holiness”</note> to the eyes of all the nations,<l eID="gen18256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18257"/>and all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ends<note placement="foot">Hebrew “end”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth shall see the salvation of our God. <l eID="gen18257" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8310"/><l level="1" sID="gen18258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8310"/>Depart, depart, go out from there! You must not touch any unclean thing.<l eID="gen18258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18259"/>Go out from the midst of it, keep clean, you who carry the vessels of Yahweh. <l eID="gen18259" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8311"/><l level="1" sID="gen18260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8311"/>For you shall not go out in haste,<l eID="gen18260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18261"/>and you shall not go in flight,<l eID="gen18261" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18262"/>for Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> going before you,<l eID="gen18262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18263"/>and your rear guard <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the God of Israel.<l eID="gen18263" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18245"/> <title type="x-s">The Servant’s Suffering and Exaltation</title> <div sID="gen18264" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen18264" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8312"/><lg sID="gen18265"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8312"/>Look, my servant shall achieve success;<l eID="gen18266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18267"/>he shall be exalted,<l eID="gen18267" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18268"/>and he shall be lifted up,<l eID="gen18268" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18269"/>and he shall be very high. <l eID="gen18269" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8313"/><l level="1" sID="gen18270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8313"/>Just as many were appalled at you—<l eID="gen18270" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18271"/>such <transChange type="added">was</transChange> his appearance beyond human disfigurement,<l eID="gen18271" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18272"/>and his form beyond the sons of mankind— <l eID="gen18272" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8314"/><l level="1" sID="gen18273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8314"/>so he shall sprinkle many nations;<l eID="gen18273" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18274"/>because of him, kings shall shut their mouths.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mouth”</note><l eID="gen18274" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18275"/>For they shall see what has not been told them,<l eID="gen18275" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18276"/>and they shall consider with full attention what they have not heard. <l eID="gen18276" level="2"/><lg eID="gen18265"/> <chapter eID="Isa.52"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:1
verses.text: Who has believed our message,<l eID="gen18279" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18280"/>and to whom has the arm of Yahweh been revealed? <l eID="gen18280" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8315"/><l level="1" sID="gen18281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8315"/>For<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he went<note placement="foot">Or “grew”</note> up like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> shoot before him,<l eID="gen18281" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18282"/>and like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> root from dry ground.<l eID="gen18282" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18283"/>He had no form and no majesty that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> we should see him,<l eID="gen18283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18284"/>and no appearance that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> we should take pleasure in him. <l eID="gen18284" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8316"/><l level="1" sID="gen18285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8316"/><transChange type="added">He was</transChange> despised and rejected <transChange type="added">by</transChange> men,<l eID="gen18285" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18286"/>a man of suffering, and acquainted with<note placement="foot">Or “knowledgeable of”</note> sickness,<l eID="gen18286" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18287"/>and like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one from whom others hide their faces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “hiding of face from him”</note> <transChange type="added">he was</transChange> despised,<l eID="gen18287" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18288"/>and we did not hold him in high regard. <l eID="gen18288" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8317"/><l level="1" sID="gen18289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8317"/>However, he was the one who lifted up our sicknesses,<l eID="gen18289" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18290"/>and he carried our pain,<l eID="gen18290" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18291"/>yet<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> we ourselves assumed him stricken,<l eID="gen18291" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18292"/>struck down <transChange type="added">by</transChange> God and afflicted. <l eID="gen18292" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8318"/><l level="1" sID="gen18293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8318"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he was pierced<note placement="foot">Or “wounded”</note> because of our transgressions,<l eID="gen18293" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18294"/>crushed because of our iniquities;<l eID="gen18294" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18295"/>the chastisement for<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> our peace<note placement="foot">Or “healing”</note> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> upon him,<l eID="gen18295" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18296"/>and by his wounds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wound”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞we were healed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it was healed for us”</note> <l eID="gen18296" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8319"/><l level="1" sID="gen18297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8319"/>All of us have wandered about like sheep;<l eID="gen18297" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18298"/>we each have turned to his own way;<l eID="gen18298" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18299"/>and Yahweh let fall on him<l eID="gen18299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18300"/>the iniquity of us all. <l eID="gen18300" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8320"/><l level="1" sID="gen18301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8320"/>He was oppressed and afflicted,<l eID="gen18301" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18302"/>yet<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he did not open his mouth;<l eID="gen18302" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18303"/>he was brought like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> lamb to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slaughter,<l eID="gen18303" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18304"/>and like a sheep is dumb before its shearers,<l eID="gen18304" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18305"/>so<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he did not open his mouth. <l eID="gen18305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8321"/><l level="1" sID="gen18306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8321"/>He was taken by restraint of justice,<l eID="gen18306" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18307"/>and who concerned himself with his generation?<l eID="gen18307" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18308"/>For he was cut off from the land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living;<l eID="gen18308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18309"/>he <transChange type="added">received a</transChange> blow because of the transgression of my people. <l eID="gen18309" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8322"/><l level="1" sID="gen18310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8322"/>He made<note placement="foot">Or “gave”</note> his grave with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked,<l eID="gen18310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18311"/>and with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rich in his death,<l eID="gen18311" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18312"/>although he had done no violence,<l eID="gen18312" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18313"/>and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> no deceit in his mouth. <l eID="gen18313" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8323"/><l level="1" sID="gen18314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8323"/>Yet<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> Yahweh was pleased to crush him;<l eID="gen18314" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18315"/>he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made him sick⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he made sick”</note><l eID="gen18315" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18316"/>If she<note placement="foot">Or “you”</note> places<note placement="foot">Or “makes”</note> his life a guilt offering,<note placement="foot">Or “compensation”</note><l eID="gen18316" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18317"/>he will see offspring.<l eID="gen18317" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18318"/>He will prolong days,<l eID="gen18318" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18319"/>and the will of Yahweh will succeed in his hand. <l eID="gen18319" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8324"/><l level="1" sID="gen18320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8324"/>From the trouble of his life<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> he will see;<note placement="foot">Dead Sea Scrolls add “light”</note><l eID="gen18320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18321"/>he will be satisfied.<l eID="gen18321" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18322"/>In his knowledge, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous <transChange type="added">one</transChange>, my servant, shall declare many righteous,<note placement="foot">Or “right”</note><l eID="gen18322" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18323"/>and he is the one who will bear their iniquities. <l eID="gen18323" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8325"/><l level="1" sID="gen18324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8325"/>Therefore, I will divide to him <transChange type="added">a portion</transChange> among the many,<note placement="foot">Or “great”</note><l eID="gen18324" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18325"/>and with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> strong ones he will divide bounty,<l eID="gen18325" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18326"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Instead of that”</note> he poured his life out to death<l eID="gen18326" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18327"/>and was counted with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> transgressors;<l eID="gen18327" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18328"/>and<note placement="foot">Or “yet”</note> he was the one who bore the sin of many<l eID="gen18328" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18329"/>and will intercede for the transgressors. <l eID="gen18329" level="2"/><lg eID="gen18278"/> <chapter eID="Isa.53"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8326"/><title type="x-s">The Fertile Wife of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen18330" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18330" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18331"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8326"/>“Sing for joy, barren <transChange type="added">woman</transChange>; <transChange type="added">who</transChange> has not borne!<l eID="gen18332" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18333"/>Burst forth <transChange type="added">into</transChange> rejoicing and rejoice, <transChange type="added">she who</transChange> has not been in labor!<l eID="gen18333" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18334"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desolate woman <transChange type="added">are</transChange> more than <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> married woman,” says Yahweh. <l eID="gen18334" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8327"/><l level="1" sID="gen18335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8327"/>“Enlarge the site of your tent,<l eID="gen18335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18336"/>and let them stretch out the tent curtains of your dwelling place.<l eID="gen18336" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18337"/>You must not spare; make your tent cords long<l eID="gen18337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18338"/>and strengthen your pegs, <l eID="gen18338" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8328"/><l level="3" sID="gen18339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8328"/>for you will spread out <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> right and <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> left.<l eID="gen18339" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18340"/>And your descendants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “descendant”</note> will be heir <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> nations,<l eID="gen18340" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18341"/>and they will inhabit desolate towns. <l eID="gen18341" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8329"/><l level="1" sID="gen18342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8329"/>You must not fear, for you will not be ashamed,<l eID="gen18342" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18343"/>and you must not be confounded, for you will not feel abashed,<l eID="gen18343" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18344"/>for you will forget the shame of your youth,<l eID="gen18344" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18345"/>and you will no longer remember the disgrace of your widowhood. <l eID="gen18345" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8330"/><l level="1" sID="gen18346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8330"/>For your husband<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is plural</note> is your maker,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is plural</note> his name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh of hosts;<l eID="gen18346" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18347"/>and your redeemer <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the holy one of Israel, he is called the God of all of the earth. <l eID="gen18347" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8331"/><l level="1" sID="gen18348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8331"/>For Yahweh has called you like a wife forsaken and hurt of spirit,<l eID="gen18348" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18349"/>like<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wife of childhood when she is rejected, says your God. <l eID="gen18349" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8332"/><l level="1" sID="gen18350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8332"/>I abandoned you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for a short⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in a small”</note> moment,<l eID="gen18350" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18351"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will gather you with great compassion. <l eID="gen18351" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8333"/><l level="1" sID="gen18352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8333"/>I hid my face from you <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a moment, in the flowing of anger,<l eID="gen18352" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18353"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will have compassion on you with everlasting faithfulness” says your redeemer, Yahweh. <l eID="gen18353" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8334"/><l level="1" sID="gen18354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8334"/>“For this <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> the waters of Noah to me,<l eID="gen18354" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18355"/>when I swore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that the waters of Noah would never again pass⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the passing over of the waters of Noah again”</note> over the earth,<l eID="gen18355" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18356"/>so I swore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that I would not be⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from being “</note> angry at you and rebuke you. <l eID="gen18356" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8335"/><l level="1" sID="gen18357"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8335"/>For the mountains may depart,<l eID="gen18357" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18358"/>and the hills may sway,<l eID="gen18358" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18359"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> my faithfulness shall not depart from you,<l eID="gen18359" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18360"/>and my covenant of peace shall not sway,”<l eID="gen18360" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18361"/>says Yahweh, who has compassion on you, <l eID="gen18361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8336"/><l level="2" sID="gen18362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8336"/>“O afflicted <transChange type="added">one</transChange>, driven away, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> is not consoled.<l eID="gen18362" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18363"/>Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to set your stones in hard mortar,<l eID="gen18363" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18364"/>and I will lay your foundation with sapphires. <l eID="gen18364" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8337"/><l level="1" sID="gen18365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8337"/>And I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “place”</note> your battlements of ruby,<l eID="gen18365" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18366"/>and your gates of stones of beryl,<l eID="gen18366" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18367"/>and all your wall of precious stones. <l eID="gen18367" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8338"/><l level="1" sID="gen18368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8338"/>And all your children <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> pupils of Yahweh,<l eID="gen18368" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18369"/>and the peace of your children <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> great. <l eID="gen18369" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18331"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8339"/><div sID="gen18370" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8339"/>In righteousness you shall be established. <div eID="gen18370" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18371"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18372"/>Be far from oppression, for you shall not fear,<l eID="gen18372" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18373"/>and from terror, for it shall not come near you. <l eID="gen18373" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8340"/><l level="1" sID="gen18374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8340"/>If indeed one attacks, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not from me;<l eID="gen18374" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18375"/>whoever attacks you shall fall because of you. <l eID="gen18375" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8341"/><l level="1" sID="gen18376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8341"/>Look! I myself have created <transChange type="added">the</transChange> craftsman who blows<note placement="foot">Or “blowing”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fire <transChange type="added">of</transChange> coals,<l eID="gen18376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18377"/>and who produces<note placement="foot">Or “producing”</note> a weapon for his work;<l eID="gen18377" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18378"/>also<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I myself have created <transChange type="added">the</transChange> destroyer to destroy. <l eID="gen18378" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8342"/><l level="1" sID="gen18379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8342"/>Every weapon formed against you shall not succeed,<l eID="gen18379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18380"/>and you shall declare guilty every tongue <transChange type="added">that</transChange> rises against you for judgment.<l eID="gen18380" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18381"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the inheritance of the servants of Yahweh,<l eID="gen18381" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18382"/>and their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞legal right⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “justice”</note> from me,”<l eID="gen18382" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18371"/> <div sID="gen18383" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Isa.54"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8343"/><title type="x-s">Invitation to True Rewards</title> <div sID="gen18384" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18384" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18385"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8343"/>“Ho! Everyone thirsty, come to the waters!<l eID="gen18386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18387"/>And whoever has no money, come, buy and eat,<l eID="gen18387" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18388"/>and come, buy without money,<l eID="gen18388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18389"/>wine and milk without price! <l eID="gen18389" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:2
