verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8344"/><l level="1" sID="gen18390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8344"/>Why do you weigh out money for <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> not food,<l eID="gen18390" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18391"/>and your labor for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what cannot satisfy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “what is not for satiation”</note><l eID="gen18391" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18392"/>Listen carefully to me, and eat <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> good,<l eID="gen18392" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18393"/>and let your soul take pleasure in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rich⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fatty”</note> food. <l eID="gen18393" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8345"/><l level="1" sID="gen18394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8345"/>Extend your ear, and come to me!<l eID="gen18394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18395"/>Listen so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your soul may live,<l eID="gen18395" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18396"/>and I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> an everlasting covenant with<note placement="foot">or “for”</note> you,<l eID="gen18396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18397"/>the enduring proofs of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the mercies shown to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mercy of”</note> David. <l eID="gen18397" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8346"/><l level="1" sID="gen18398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8346"/>Look! I made<note placement="foot">Or “gave”</note> him a witness to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen18398" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18399"/>a leader and a commander <transChange type="added">for the</transChange> peoples. <l eID="gen18399" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8347"/><l level="1" sID="gen18400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8347"/>Look! You shall call a nation <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you do not know,<l eID="gen18400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18401"/>and a nation <transChange type="added">that</transChange> does not know you shall run to you,<l eID="gen18401" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18402"/>because of Yahweh your God,<l eID="gen18402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18403"/>and the holy one of Israel, for he has glorified you.” <l eID="gen18403" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8348"/><l level="1" sID="gen18404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8348"/>Seek Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞while he lets himself be found⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “in his letting himself be found”</note><l eID="gen18404" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18405"/>call him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞while he is⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his being”</note> near. <l eID="gen18405" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8349"/><l level="1" sID="gen18406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8349"/>Let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked forsake his way,<l eID="gen18406" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18407"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> man of sin his thoughts.<l eID="gen18407" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18408"/>And let him return to Yahweh, that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he may take pity on him,<l eID="gen18408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18409"/>and to our God, for he will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forgive manifold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “make numerous to”</note> <l eID="gen18409" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8350"/><l level="1" sID="gen18410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8350"/>“For my thoughts <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not your thoughts,<l eID="gen18410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18411"/>and your ways <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not my ways,”<l eID="gen18411" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18385"/> <div sID="gen18412" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen18412" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8351"/><lg sID="gen18413"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8351"/>“For <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞higher⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “high”</note> than <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen18414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18415"/>so my ways are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞higher⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “high”</note> than your ways,<l eID="gen18415" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18416"/>and my thoughts than your thoughts. <l eID="gen18416" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8352"/><l level="1" sID="gen18417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8352"/>For just as the rain and the snow come down from heaven,<l eID="gen18417" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18418"/>and they do not return there<l eID="gen18418" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18419"/>except they have watered the earth thoroughly<l eID="gen18419" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18420"/>and cause it to bring forth and sprout,<l eID="gen18420" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18421"/>and give seed to the sower<l eID="gen18421" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18422"/>and bread to the eater, <l eID="gen18422" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8353"/><l level="1" sID="gen18423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8353"/>so shall be my word that goes out from my mouth.<l eID="gen18423" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18424"/>It shall not return to me without success,<l eID="gen18424" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18425"/>but shall accomplish<note placement="foot">Or “do”</note> what I desire<l eID="gen18425" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18426"/>and be successful <transChange type="added">in the thing for</transChange> which I sent it. <l eID="gen18426" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8354"/><l level="1" sID="gen18427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8354"/>For you shall go out in joy,<l eID="gen18427" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18428"/>and you shall be led in peace.<l eID="gen18428" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18429"/>The mountains and the hills shall break forth before you, rejoicing<l eID="gen18429" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18430"/>and all the trees of the field shall clap hands.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “hand”</note> <l eID="gen18430" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8355"/><l level="1" sID="gen18431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8355"/>Instead of the thorn bush, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> juniper shall go up;<l eID="gen18431" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18432"/>instead of the brier, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> myrtle shall go up,<l eID="gen18432" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18433"/>and it shall serve as a memorial to Yahweh,<l eID="gen18433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18434"/>for an everlasting sign <transChange type="added">that</transChange> shall not be cut off.” <l eID="gen18434" level="2"/><lg eID="gen18413"/> <chapter eID="Isa.55"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8356"/><title type="x-s">Salvation for All Who Obey</title> <div sID="gen18435" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8356"/>Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen18435" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18436"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18437"/>“Observe justice<l eID="gen18437" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18438"/>and do righteousness,<l eID="gen18438" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18439"/>for my salvation <transChange type="added">is</transChange> close to coming,<l eID="gen18439" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18440"/>and my justice to being revealed. <l eID="gen18440" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8357"/><l level="1" sID="gen18441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8357"/>Happy <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> man <transChange type="added">who</transChange> does this,<l eID="gen18441" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18442"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> son of humankind <transChange type="added">who</transChange> keeps hold of it,<l eID="gen18442" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18443"/>who keeps <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Sabbath <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so as not to profane⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from profaning”</note> it,<l eID="gen18443" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18444"/>and who keeps his hand from doing any<note placement="foot">Or “all”</note> evil.” <l eID="gen18444" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8358"/><l level="1" sID="gen18445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8358"/>And do not let the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foreigner⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “son of the foreign country”</note> <transChange type="added">who</transChange> joins himself to Yahweh say, “Surely Yahweh will separate me from his people.”<l eID="gen18445" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18446"/>And do not let the eunuch say, “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a dry tree!” <l eID="gen18446" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8359"/><l level="1" sID="gen18447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8359"/>For thus says Yahweh, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths,<l eID="gen18447" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18448"/>and choose that in which I delight,<l eID="gen18448" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18449"/>and who keep hold of my covenant. <l eID="gen18449" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8360"/><l level="1" sID="gen18450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8360"/>And I will give them a monument and a name in my house and within my walls,<l eID="gen18450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18451"/>better than sons and daughters;<l eID="gen18451" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18452"/>I will give him an everlasting name<l eID="gen18452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18453"/>that shall not be cut off. <l eID="gen18453" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8361"/><l level="1" sID="gen18454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8361"/>And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foreigners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of the foreign country”</note> <transChange type="added">who</transChange> join themselves to Yahweh to serve him<l eID="gen18454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18455"/>and to love the name of Yahweh, to become his servants,<l eID="gen18455" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18456"/>every one who keeps <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Sabbath, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so as not to profane⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from profaning”</note> it,<l eID="gen18456" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18457"/>and those who keep hold of my covenant, <l eID="gen18457" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8362"/><l level="1" sID="gen18458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8362"/>I will bring them to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of my holiness”</note><l eID="gen18458" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18459"/>I will make them merry in my house of prayer.<l eID="gen18459" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18460"/>their burnt offerings and their sacrifices <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will be accepted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for acceptance”</note> on my altar,<l eID="gen18460" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18461"/>for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples,” <l eID="gen18461" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18436"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8363"/><div sID="gen18462" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8363"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, who gathers<note placement="foot">Or “gathering”</note> the scattered ones of Israel (still I will gather to<note placement="foot">Or “upon”</note> him, to his gathered ones). <div eID="gen18462" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">Wicked Leaders</title> <div sID="gen18463" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen18463" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8364"/><lg sID="gen18464"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8364"/>All wild animals <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> field, come,<l eID="gen18465" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18466"/>to devour,<note placement="foot">Or “eat”</note> all wild animals in the forest! <l eID="gen18466" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8365"/><l level="1" sID="gen18467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8365"/>His watchmen <transChange type="added">are</transChange> blind,<l eID="gen18467" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18468"/>none of them know.<l eID="gen18468" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18469"/>They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all dumb dogs;<l eID="gen18469" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18470"/>they are unable to bark,<l eID="gen18470" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18471"/>panting, lying down,<l eID="gen18471" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18472"/>loving to slumber. <l eID="gen18472" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8366"/><l level="1" sID="gen18473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8366"/>And the dogs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have a greedy appetite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “are strong of soul”</note><l eID="gen18473" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18474"/>they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are never satisfied⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “do not know satiation”</note><l eID="gen18474" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18475"/>And they are <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shepherds!<l eID="gen18475" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18476"/>They do not have<note placement="foot">Or “know”</note> understanding.<l eID="gen18476" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18477"/>They all turn to their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> way,<l eID="gen18477" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18478"/>each one for his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> gain, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every one of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from his end “</note> <l eID="gen18478" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8367"/><l level="1" sID="gen18479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8367"/>“Come, let me take wine,<l eID="gen18479" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18480"/>and let us carouse <transChange type="added">with</transChange> intoxicating drink,<l eID="gen18480" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18481"/>and tomorrow will be like today,<l eID="gen18481" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18482"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞very great indeed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “excessively”</note> <l eID="gen18482" level="2"/><lg eID="gen18464"/> <chapter eID="Isa.56"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8368"/><title type="x-s">Idolatry is Adultery</title> <div sID="gen18483" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18483" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18484"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8368"/>The righteous <transChange type="added">one</transChange> perishes, and there is no one who takes<note placement="foot">Or “sets”</note> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to heart.<l eID="gen18485" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18486"/>And men of faithfulness <transChange type="added">are</transChange> gathered, while there is no one who understands,<l eID="gen18486" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18487"/>for the righteous is gathered from the presence of wickedness. <l eID="gen18487" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8369"/><l level="2" sID="gen18488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8369"/>he enters <transChange type="added">into</transChange> peace;<l eID="gen18488" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18489"/>they will rest on their beds,<l eID="gen18489" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18490"/>walking straight ahead of him. <l eID="gen18490" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8370"/><l level="1" sID="gen18491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8370"/>“But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you, come near here, you children of a soothsayer,<l eID="gen18491" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18492"/>offspring <transChange type="added">of</transChange> an adulterer and she <transChange type="added">who</transChange> commits fornication. <l eID="gen18492" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8371"/><l level="1" sID="gen18493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8371"/>At whom do you make fun?<l eID="gen18493" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18494"/>At whom do you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞open⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “widen”</note> your mouth and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞stick out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “make long”</note> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> tongue?<l eID="gen18494" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18495"/><transChange type="added">Are</transChange> you not children of transgression,<l eID="gen18495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18496"/>offspring of deception, <l eID="gen18496" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8372"/><l level="1" sID="gen18497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8372"/>who burn with lust among the oaks,<l eID="gen18497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18498"/>under every leafy tree,<l eID="gen18498" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18499"/>who slaughter children in the valleys,<l eID="gen18499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18500"/>under the clefts of the rocks? <l eID="gen18500" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8373"/><l level="1" sID="gen18501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8373"/>Your portion <transChange type="added">is</transChange> among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> smooth <transChange type="added">stones</transChange> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> valley;<l eID="gen18501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18502"/>they, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your lot;<l eID="gen18502" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18503"/>indeed, to them you have poured out a drink offering,<l eID="gen18503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18504"/>you have brought a food offering.<l eID="gen18504" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18484"/> <div sID="gen18505" type="x-p"/> Shall I relent concerning these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>?  <div eID="gen18505" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8374"/><lg sID="gen18506"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8374"/>You have set your bed upon a high and lofty mountain;<l eID="gen18507" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18508"/>indeed, you went up there to slaughter sacrifice. <l eID="gen18508" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8375"/><l level="1" sID="gen18509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8375"/>And you have set your symbol behind the door and the doorpost;<l eID="gen18509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18510"/>for you depart<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) has “uncover,” which makes no sense in context, but with different vowels it would be “depart”</note> from me, and you go up;<l eID="gen18510" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18511"/>you make your bed wide, and you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make a deal with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut off for yourself from”</note> them,<l eID="gen18511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18512"/>you have loved their bed; you have seen <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞genitals⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> <l eID="gen18512" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8376"/><l level="1" sID="gen18513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8376"/>And you climbed down to the king with oil,<l eID="gen18513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18514"/>and you made your perfumes numerous,<l eID="gen18514" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18515"/>and you sent your envoys <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞far away⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to from far”</note><l eID="gen18515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18516"/>and you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sent down deep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “humiliated”</note> to Sheol. <l eID="gen18516" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8377"/><l level="1" sID="gen18517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8377"/>You grow weary by the greatness of your way,<l eID="gen18517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18518"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> you did not say, ‘Despairing!’<l eID="gen18518" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18519"/>You found the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞renewal⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “life”</note> of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞strength⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “hand;” compare the “hand” in verse <reference osisRef="Isa.57.8">8</reference></note><l eID="gen18519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18520"/>therefore you do not grow weak. <l eID="gen18520" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8378"/><l level="1" sID="gen18521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8378"/>And of whom were you afraid and feared, that you deceived<l eID="gen18521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18522"/>and did not remember me?<l eID="gen18522" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18523"/>Did you not place <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on your heart?<l eID="gen18523" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18524"/><transChange type="added">Have</transChange> I not been silent, even from long ago,<l eID="gen18524" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18525"/>and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you do not fear me? <l eID="gen18525" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8379"/><l level="1" sID="gen18526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8379"/>I myself will declare your righteousness and your works,<l eID="gen18526" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18527"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they will not benefit you. <l eID="gen18527" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8380"/><l level="1" sID="gen18528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8380"/>When <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you cry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “your crying”</note> let your collection deliver you,<l eID="gen18528" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18529"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind will carry all of them away;<l eID="gen18529" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18530"/>a breath will take <transChange type="added">them</transChange> away.<l eID="gen18530" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18531"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he who takes refuge in me shall take possession <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen18531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18532"/>and he shall inherit my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “mountain of holiness “</note><l eID="gen18532" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18506"/> <title type="x-s">Peace for the Contrite</title> <div sID="gen18533" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen18533" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8381"/><lg sID="gen18534"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8381"/>And one shall say, “Build up, build up! Clear <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way!<l eID="gen18535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18536"/>Remove <transChange type="added">the</transChange> obstacles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “obstacle”</note> from the way of my people!” <l eID="gen18536" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18534"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8382"/><div sID="gen18537" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8382"/>For thus says <transChange type="added">the</transChange> high and lofty one who resides forever, and <transChange type="added">whose</transChange> name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> holy: <div eID="gen18537" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18538"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18539"/>“I reside <transChange type="added">in</transChange> a high and holy place,<l eID="gen18539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18540"/>and with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞contrite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “crushed”</note> and humble of spirit,<l eID="gen18540" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18541"/>to revive <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spirit of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> humble,<l eID="gen18541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18542"/>and to revive <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞contrite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “crushed”</note> <l eID="gen18542" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8383"/><l level="1" sID="gen18543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8383"/>For I will not attack forever,<l eID="gen18543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18544"/>and I will not be angry forever,<l eID="gen18544" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18545"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spirit will grow faint before me,<l eID="gen18545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18546"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> breaths <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I myself I have made. <l eID="gen18546" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8384"/><l level="1" sID="gen18547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8384"/>I was angry because of his sin of gain, and I struck him;<l eID="gen18547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18548"/>I hid and I was angry, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he walked apostate, in the ways<note placement="foot">Hebrew “way”</note> of his heart. <l eID="gen18548" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8385"/><l level="1" sID="gen18549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8385"/>I have seen his ways, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I will heal him;<l eID="gen18549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18550"/>and I will lead him and give him and his mourners comfort as a recompense, <l eID="gen18550" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8386"/><l level="2" sID="gen18551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8386"/>creating fruit of lips.<l eID="gen18551" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18552"/>Peace, peace to the far and near,” says Yahweh, “and I will heal him. <l eID="gen18552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8387"/><l level="1" sID="gen18553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8387"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the wicked <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like the churning sea,<l eID="gen18553" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18554"/>that is not able to keep quiet,<l eID="gen18554" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18555"/>and its waters toss up mire and mud. <l eID="gen18555" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8388"/><l level="1" sID="gen18556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8388"/>There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.” <l eID="gen18556" level="1"/><lg eID="gen18538"/> <chapter eID="Isa.57"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8389"/><title type="x-s">True Fasts and Sabbaths</title> <div sID="gen18557" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18557" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18558"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8389"/>“Call with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> throat; you must not keep back!<l eID="gen18559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18560"/>lift up your voice like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> trumpet,<l eID="gen18560" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18561"/>and declare<note placement="foot">Or “announce”</note> to my people their rebellion,<l eID="gen18561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18562"/>and to the house of Jacob their sins. <l eID="gen18562" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8390"/><l level="1" sID="gen18563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8390"/>Yet<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> they seek me day <transChange type="added">by</transChange> day,<l eID="gen18563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18564"/>and they desire the knowledge of my ways<l eID="gen18564" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18565"/>like a nation that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞practiced⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “did”</note> righteousness,<l eID="gen18565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18566"/>and had not forsaken the judgment of its God;<l eID="gen18566" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18567"/>they ask me for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞righteous judgments⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “judgments of righteousness”</note><l eID="gen18567" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18568"/>they desire the closeness of God. <l eID="gen18568" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8391"/><l level="1" sID="gen18569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8391"/>‘Why do we fast, and you do not see <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?<l eID="gen18569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18570"/>We humiliate our soul, and you do not notice <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?’<l eID="gen18570" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18571"/>Look! You find delight on the day of your fast,<l eID="gen18571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18572"/>and you oppress all your workers! <l eID="gen18572" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8392"/><l level="1" sID="gen18573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8392"/>Look! You fast to quarrel and strife,<l eID="gen18573" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18574"/>and to strike with a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wicked fist⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “fist of wickedness”</note><l eID="gen18574" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18575"/>You shall not fast as <transChange type="added">you do</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note><l eID="gen18575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18576"/>to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make your voice heard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause to hear your voice”</note> on the height. <l eID="gen18576" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8393"/><l level="1" sID="gen18577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8393"/>Is <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fast I choose like this,<l eID="gen18577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18578"/>a day for humankind to humiliate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his soul”</note>?<l eID="gen18578" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18579"/>To bow his head like a reed,<l eID="gen18579" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18580"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he makes”</note> his bed <transChange type="added">on</transChange> sackcloth and ashes;<l eID="gen18580" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18581"/>you call this a fast<l eID="gen18581" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18582"/>and a day of pleasure to Yahweh? <l eID="gen18582" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8394"/><l level="1" sID="gen18583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8394"/>Is this not <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fast I choose: to release <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bonds of injustice,<l eID="gen18583" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18584"/>to untie <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ropes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> yoke,<l eID="gen18584" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18585"/>and to let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppressed go free,<l eID="gen18585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18586"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞tear⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you must tear”</note> every yoke to pieces? <l eID="gen18586" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8395"/><l level="1" sID="gen18587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8395"/><transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not to break your bread for the hungry?<l eID="gen18587" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18588"/>You must bring <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞home⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a house”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> homeless.<l eID="gen18588" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18589"/>When you see <transChange type="added">the</transChange> naked, you must cover him,<l eID="gen18589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18590"/>and you must not hide yourself from your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞relatives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “flesh”</note> <l eID="gen18590" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8396"/><l level="1" sID="gen18591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8396"/>Then your light shall break forth like the dawn,<l eID="gen18591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18592"/>and your healing shall grow quickly.<l eID="gen18592" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18593"/>And your salvation shall go before you;<l eID="gen18593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18594"/>the glory of Yahweh will be your rear guard. <l eID="gen18594" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8397"/><l level="1" sID="gen18595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8397"/>Then you shall call, and Yahweh himself will answer.<l eID="gen18595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18596"/>You shall cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>!’<l eID="gen18596" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18597"/>If you remove from among you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> yoke,<l eID="gen18597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18598"/>the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞finger-pointing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “stretching out of the finger”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞evil speech⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the speaking of evil”</note> <l eID="gen18598" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8398"/><l level="1" sID="gen18599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8398"/>if<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you offer your soul to the hungry,<l eID="gen18599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18600"/>and you satisfy <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appetite of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> afflicted,<l eID="gen18600" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18601"/>then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> your light shall rise in the darkness,<l eID="gen18601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18602"/>and your darkness <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> like noon. <l eID="gen18602" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8399"/><l level="1" sID="gen18603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8399"/>And Yahweh will lead you continually, and satisfy your soul in a barren land,<l eID="gen18603" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18604"/>and he will strengthen your bones,<l eID="gen18604" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18605"/>and you shall be like a well-watered garden,<l eID="gen18605" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18606"/>and like a spring of water whose water does not fail. <l eID="gen18606" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8400"/><l level="1" sID="gen18607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8400"/>And they shall rebuild ancient ruins from you;<l eID="gen18607" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18608"/>you shall erect <transChange type="added">the</transChange> foundations of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞many generations,⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “generation and generation”</note><l eID="gen18608" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18609"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall be called⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shall be called to you”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bricklayer <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> breach,<l eID="gen18609" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18610"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> restorer of paths to live <transChange type="added">in</transChange>. <l eID="gen18610" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8401"/><l level="1" sID="gen18611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8401"/>If you hold your foot back from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Sabbath,<l eID="gen18611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18612"/><transChange type="added">from</transChange> doing your affairs on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day of my holiness”</note><l eID="gen18612" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18613"/>if<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you call the Sabbath a pleasure,<l eID="gen18613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18614"/>the holy <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of Yahweh honorable,<l eID="gen18614" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18615"/>if<note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> you honor him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞more than⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> doing your ways,<l eID="gen18615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18616"/>than finding your affairs<note placement="foot">Hebrew “affair”</note> and speaking a word, <l eID="gen18616" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8402"/><l level="1" sID="gen18617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8402"/>then you shall take your pleasure in<note placement="foot">Or “on”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen18617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18618"/>and I will make you ride upon <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heights of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen18618" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18619"/>and I will feed you the heritage of Jacob your ancestor,<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note><l eID="gen18619" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18558"/> <div sID="gen18620" type="x-p"/> for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken.”  <chapter eID="Isa.58"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8403"/><title type="x-s">Rampant Transgression</title> <div sID="gen18621" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18621" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18622"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8403"/>Look! The hand of Yahweh is not too short <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to save⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from saving”</note><l eID="gen18623" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18624"/>and his ear is not <transChange type="added">too</transChange> dull <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to hear⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from hearing”</note> <l eID="gen18624" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8404"/><l level="1" sID="gen18625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8404"/>Rather, your iniquities have been <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞barriers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “dividers”</note> between you and your God,<l eID="gen18625" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18626"/>and your sins have hidden <transChange type="added">his</transChange> face from you, from hearing. <l eID="gen18626" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8405"/><l level="1" sID="gen18627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8405"/>For your hands are defiled with blood,<l eID="gen18627" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18628"/>and your fingers with iniquity.<l eID="gen18628" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18629"/>Your lips have spoken lies,<l eID="gen18629" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18630"/>your tongue speaks wickedness. <l eID="gen18630" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8406"/><l level="1" sID="gen18631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8406"/>There is nobody <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who pleads with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “calling in”</note> justice,<l eID="gen18631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18632"/>and there is nobody who judges with honesty.<l eID="gen18632" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18633"/>They rely on nothing<l eID="gen18633" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18634"/>and speak vanity.<l eID="gen18634" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18635"/>They conceive trouble<l eID="gen18635" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18636"/>and beget iniquity; <l eID="gen18636" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8407"/><l level="1" sID="gen18637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8407"/>they hatch viper eggs,<l eID="gen18637" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18638"/>and they weave a spider web.<l eID="gen18638" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18639"/>One who eats their eggs dies,<l eID="gen18639" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18640"/>and that which is pressed is hatched <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a serpent. <l eID="gen18640" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8408"/><l level="1" sID="gen18641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8408"/>Their webs cannot become clothing,<l eID="gen18641" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18642"/>and they cannot cover themselves with their works.<l eID="gen18642" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18643"/>Their works <transChange type="added">are</transChange> works of iniquity,<l eID="gen18643" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18644"/>and deeds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “deed”</note> of violence <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in their hands. <l eID="gen18644" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8409"/><l level="1" sID="gen18645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8409"/>Their feet run to evil,<l eID="gen18645" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18646"/>and they hasten to shed innocent blood.<l eID="gen18646" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18647"/>Their thoughts <transChange type="added">are</transChange> thoughts of iniquity;<l eID="gen18647" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18648"/>devastation and destruction <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in their highways. <l eID="gen18648" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8410"/><l level="1" sID="gen18649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8410"/>They do not know <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way of peace,<l eID="gen18649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18650"/>and there is no justice in their firm paths.<l eID="gen18650" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18651"/>They have made their paths crooked for themselves;<l eID="gen18651" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18652"/>everyone <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who walks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “walking”</note> in it knows no peace. <l eID="gen18652" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8411"/><l level="1" sID="gen18653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8411"/>Therefore justice is far from us,<l eID="gen18653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18654"/>and righteousness does not reach us.<l eID="gen18654" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18655"/>We wait for light, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> look! <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> darkness;<l eID="gen18655" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18656"/>for brightness, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> we walk in darkness. <l eID="gen18656" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8412"/><l level="1" sID="gen18657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8412"/>We grope like the blind <transChange type="added">along</transChange> a wall,<l eID="gen18657" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18658"/>and we grope <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “like there are no”</note> eyes.<l eID="gen18658" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18659"/>We stumble at noon as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the twilight;<l eID="gen18659" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18660"/>among the strong <transChange type="added">we are</transChange> like the dead. <l eID="gen18660" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8413"/><l level="1" sID="gen18661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8413"/>We all groan like bears,<l eID="gen18661" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18662"/>and we coo mutteringly like doves.<l eID="gen18662" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18663"/>We wait for justice, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> there is none;<l eID="gen18663" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18664"/>for salvation, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> it is far from us. <l eID="gen18664" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8414"/><l level="1" sID="gen18665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8414"/>For our transgressions are numerous before you,<l eID="gen18665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18666"/>and our sins <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞testify⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “answers”</note> against us.<l eID="gen18666" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18667"/>Indeed, our transgressions <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with us,<l eID="gen18667" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18668"/>and we know our iniquities: <l eID="gen18668" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8415"/><l level="1" sID="gen18669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8415"/>transgressing and denying Yahweh,<l eID="gen18669" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18670"/>and turning <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞away from following⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “back from behind”</note> our God;<l eID="gen18670" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18671"/>speaking oppression and falsehood,<l eID="gen18671" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18672"/>conceiving and uttering words of deception from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart. <l eID="gen18672" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8416"/><l level="1" sID="gen18673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8416"/>And justice is pushed back,<l eID="gen18673" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18674"/>and righteousness stands afar;<l eID="gen18674" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18675"/>for truth stumbles in the public square,<l eID="gen18675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18676"/>and straightforwardness is unable to enter, <l eID="gen18676" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8417"/><l level="1" sID="gen18677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8417"/>and truth is missing,<l eID="gen18677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18678"/>and he who turns aside from evil <transChange type="added">is</transChange> plundered.<l eID="gen18678" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18679"/>And Yahweh saw,<l eID="gen18679" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18680"/>and it was displeasing in his eyes that there was no justice <l eID="gen18680" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8418"/><l level="1" sID="gen18681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8418"/>And he saw that there was no man,<l eID="gen18681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18682"/>and he was appalled that there was no one who intercedes,<l eID="gen18682" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18683"/>so<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> his arm came to assist him,<l eID="gen18683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18684"/>and his righteousness <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was what⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it”</note> sustained him. <l eID="gen18684" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8419"/><l level="1" sID="gen18685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8419"/>And he put on righteousness like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> breastplate,<l eID="gen18685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18686"/>and a helmet of salvation on his head,<l eID="gen18686" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18687"/>and he put on garments of vengeance <transChange type="added">for</transChange> clothing,<l eID="gen18687" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18688"/>and he wrapped <transChange type="added">himself in</transChange> zeal as <transChange type="added">in a</transChange> robe. <l eID="gen18688" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8420"/><l level="1" sID="gen18689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8420"/>According to deeds, so he will repay;<l eID="gen18689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18690"/>wrath to his enemies, requital to those who are his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞enemies⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “hostile”</note><l eID="gen18690" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18691"/>He will repay requital to the coastlands. <l eID="gen18691" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8421"/><l level="1" sID="gen18692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8421"/>So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> they shall fear the name of Yahweh from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> west,<l eID="gen18692" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18693"/>and his glory from the sunrise,<l eID="gen18693" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18694"/>for he will come like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> narrow stream;<l eID="gen18694" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18695"/>the wind of Yahweh drives it on. <l eID="gen18695" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8422"/><l level="1" sID="gen18696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8422"/>“And a redeemer will come to Zion,<l eID="gen18696" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18697"/>to those in Jacob who turn away from transgression,”<l eID="gen18697" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18622"/> <div sID="gen18698" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen18698" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8423"/><div sID="gen18699" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8423"/>“And as for me, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my covenant with them, says Yahweh: <div eID="gen18699" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18700"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18701"/>my spirit that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon you,<l eID="gen18701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18702"/>and my words that I have placed in your mouth<l eID="gen18702" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18703"/>shall not depart from your mouth,<l eID="gen18703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18704"/>or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> from the mouths<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mouth”</note> of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞children⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “offspring”</note><l eID="gen18704" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18705"/>or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> from the mouths<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mouth”</note> of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your children’s children⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “the offspring of your offspring”</note><l eID="gen18705" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18706"/>says Yahweh, “from now on and forever.” <l eID="gen18706" level="3"/><lg eID="gen18700"/> <chapter eID="Isa.59"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8424"/><title type="x-s">Zion Glorified</title> <div sID="gen18707" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18707" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18708"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8424"/>“Arise, shine! For your light has come,<l eID="gen18709" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18710"/>and the glory of Yahweh has risen on you. <l eID="gen18710" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8425"/><l level="1" sID="gen18711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8425"/>For look! darkness shall cover <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen18711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18712"/>and thick darkness <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen18712" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18713"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> Yahweh will rise on you,<l eID="gen18713" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18714"/>and his glory will appear over you. <l eID="gen18714" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8426"/><l level="1" sID="gen18715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8426"/>And nations shall come to your light,<l eID="gen18715" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18716"/>and kings to the bright light of your sunrise. <l eID="gen18716" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8427"/><l level="1" sID="gen18717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8427"/>Lift up your eyes all around and see!<l eID="gen18717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18718"/>All of them gather; they come to you.<l eID="gen18718" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18719"/>Your sons shall come from afar,<l eID="gen18719" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18720"/>and your daughters shall be looked after on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hip. <l eID="gen18720" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8428"/><l level="1" sID="gen18721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8428"/>Then you shall see<l eID="gen18721" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18722"/>and you shall be radiant;<l eID="gen18722" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18723"/>and your heart shall tremble<l eID="gen18723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18724"/>and open itself wide,<l eID="gen18724" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18725"/>because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> abundance of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea shall fall upon you;<l eID="gen18725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18726"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> wealth of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations shall come to you. <l eID="gen18726" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8429"/><l level="1" sID="gen18727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8429"/>A multitude of camels shall cover you,<l eID="gen18727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18728"/>the young male camels of Midian and Ephah.<l eID="gen18728" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18729"/>All those from Sheba shall come;<l eID="gen18729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18730"/>they shall bring gold and frankincense,<l eID="gen18730" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18731"/>and they shall proclaim the praise of Yahweh. <l eID="gen18731" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8430"/><l level="1" sID="gen18732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8430"/>All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered to you;<l eID="gen18732" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18733"/>the rams of Nebaioth shall serve you.<l eID="gen18733" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18734"/>They shall present a sacrifice for favor <transChange type="added">on</transChange> my altar,<l eID="gen18734" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18735"/>and I will glorify <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my honorable house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “house of my honor”</note> <l eID="gen18735" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8431"/><l level="1" sID="gen18736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8431"/>Who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these? They fly like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> cloud,<l eID="gen18736" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18737"/>and like doves to their coops. <l eID="gen18737" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8432"/><l level="1" sID="gen18738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8432"/>Because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> coastlands wait for me,<l eID="gen18738" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18739"/>and the ships of Tarshish <transChange type="added">are</transChange> first<l eID="gen18739" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18740"/>to bring your children from afar,<l eID="gen18740" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18741"/>their silver and gold with them,<l eID="gen18741" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18742"/>for the name of Yahweh your God,<l eID="gen18742" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18743"/>and for the holy one of Israel, because he has glorified you. <l eID="gen18743" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8433"/><l level="1" sID="gen18744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8433"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foreigners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a foreign country”</note> shall build your walls,<l eID="gen18744" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18745"/>and their kings shall serve you,<l eID="gen18745" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18746"/>for in my anger I struck you,<l eID="gen18746" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18747"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> in my favor I have taken pity on you. <l eID="gen18747" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8434"/><l level="1" sID="gen18748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8434"/>And your gates shall continually be open,<l eID="gen18748" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18749"/>day and night they shall not be shut,<l eID="gen18749" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18750"/>to bring you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wealth of nations,<l eID="gen18750" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18751"/>and their kings shall be led. <l eID="gen18751" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8435"/><l level="1" sID="gen18752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8435"/>For the nation and the kingdom that will not serve you shall perish,<l eID="gen18752" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18753"/>and the nations shall be utterly devastated. <l eID="gen18753" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8436"/><l level="1" sID="gen18754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8436"/>The glory of Lebanon shall come to you;<l eID="gen18754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18755"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> cypress, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> plane, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pine together,<l eID="gen18755" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18756"/>to glorify the place of my sanctuary,<l eID="gen18756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18757"/>and I will do honor to the place of my feet. <l eID="gen18757" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8437"/><l level="1" sID="gen18758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8437"/>And the children of those who oppressed you shall come to you bending low,<l eID="gen18758" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18759"/>and all those who treated you disrespectfully shall bow down at the soles of your feet.<l eID="gen18759" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18760"/>And they shall call you the city of Yahweh,<l eID="gen18760" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18761"/>Zion <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the holy one of Israel. <l eID="gen18761" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8438"/><l level="1" sID="gen18762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8438"/>Instead of you being forsaken<l eID="gen18762" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18763"/>and hated <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with no one passing through,⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “and there is not one who passes through”</note><l eID="gen18763" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18764"/>I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “place”</note> you an everlasting <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞object of pride⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “pride”</note><l eID="gen18764" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18765"/>a joy of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞coming generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “generation and generation”</note> <l eID="gen18765" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8439"/><l level="1" sID="gen18766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8439"/>And you shall suck <transChange type="added">the</transChange> milk of nations,<l eID="gen18766" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18767"/>and suck <transChange type="added">the</transChange> breast of kings,<l eID="gen18767" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18768"/>and you shall know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your Savior,<l eID="gen18768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18769"/>and your Redeemer, the Strong One of Jacob. <l eID="gen18769" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8440"/><l level="1" sID="gen18770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8440"/>Instead of bronze I will bring gold,<l eID="gen18770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18771"/>and instead of iron I will bring silver,<l eID="gen18771" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18772"/>and instead of wood, bronze,<l eID="gen18772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18773"/>and instead of stones, iron.<l eID="gen18773" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18774"/>And I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞appoint⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “put”</note> peace <transChange type="added">as</transChange> your overseer,<l eID="gen18774" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18775"/>and righteousness <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your ruling body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they who force you to work”</note> <l eID="gen18775" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8441"/><l level="1" sID="gen18776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8441"/>Violence shall no longer be heard in your land;<l eID="gen18776" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18777"/>devastation or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> destruction on your borders.<l eID="gen18777" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18778"/>And you shall call your walls Salvation,<l eID="gen18778" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18779"/>and your gates, Praise. <l eID="gen18779" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8442"/><l level="1" sID="gen18780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8442"/>The sun shall no longer be your light by day,<l eID="gen18780" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18781"/>and for bright light the moon shall not give you light,<l eID="gen18781" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18782"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> Yahweh will be your everlasting light,<l eID="gen18782" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18783"/>and your God your glory. <l eID="gen18783" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8443"/><l level="1" sID="gen18784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8443"/>Your sun shall no longer go <transChange type="added">down</transChange>,<l eID="gen18784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18785"/>and your moon shall not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wane⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “be taken away”</note><l eID="gen18785" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18786"/>for Yahweh himself will be your everlasting light,<l eID="gen18786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18787"/>and your days of mourning shall come to an end. <l eID="gen18787" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8444"/><l level="1" sID="gen18788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8444"/>And all your people <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> righteous;<l eID="gen18788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18789"/>they shall take possession of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land forever,<l eID="gen18789" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18790"/>the shoot of his<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) has “my”</note> planting,<l eID="gen18790" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18791"/>the work of my hands, to show my glory. <l eID="gen18791" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8445"/><l level="1" sID="gen18792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8445"/>The small <transChange type="added">one</transChange> shall become <transChange type="added">a</transChange> tribe,<l eID="gen18792" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18793"/>and the smallest one a mighty nation.<l eID="gen18793" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18708"/> <div sID="gen18794" type="x-p"/> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh; I will hasten it in its time.”  <chapter eID="Isa.60"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8446"/><title type="x-s">The Year of Yahweh’s Favor</title> <div sID="gen18795" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18795" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18796"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8446"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> Spirit of the Lord Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon me,<l eID="gen18797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18798"/>because Yahweh has anointed me,<l eID="gen18798" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18799"/>he has sent me to bring good news <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> oppressed,<l eID="gen18799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18800"/>to bind up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the brokenhearted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “those broken of heart”</note><l eID="gen18800" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18801"/>to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞proclaim⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “call”</note> release to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> captives<l eID="gen18801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18802"/>and liberation to those who are bound, <l eID="gen18802" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8447"/><l level="1" sID="gen18803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8447"/>to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞proclaim⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “call”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> year of Yahweh’s favor,<l eID="gen18803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18804"/>and our God’s day of vengeance,<l eID="gen18804" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18805"/>to comfort all those in mourning, <l eID="gen18805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8448"/><l level="2" sID="gen18806"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8448"/>to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞give⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “place”</note> for those in mourning in Zion,<l eID="gen18806" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18807"/>to give them a head wrap instead of ashes,<l eID="gen18807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18808"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> oil of joy instead of mourning,<l eID="gen18808" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18809"/>a garment of praise instead of a faint spirit.<l eID="gen18809" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18810"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will be called⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it will be called to them”</note> oaks of righteousness,<l eID="gen18810" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18811"/>the planting of Yahweh, to show his glory. <l eID="gen18811" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8449"/><l level="1" sID="gen18812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8449"/>And they shall build <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ancient ruins,<l eID="gen18812" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18813"/>they shall erect <transChange type="added">the</transChange> former deserted <transChange type="added">places</transChange>.<l eID="gen18813" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18814"/>And they shall restore <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞devastated cities⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “cities of devastation”</note><l eID="gen18814" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18815"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> deserted <transChange type="added">places</transChange> of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞many generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “generation and generation”</note> <l eID="gen18815" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8450"/><l level="1" sID="gen18816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8450"/>And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “flock”</note><l eID="gen18816" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18817"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foreigners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a foreign country”</note> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> your farmers and vinedressers. <l eID="gen18817" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8451"/><l level="1" sID="gen18818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8451"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you shall be called the priests of Yahweh,<l eID="gen18818" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18819"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will be called⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it shall be said of you”</note> servers of our God.<l eID="gen18819" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18820"/>You shall eat <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wealth of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations,<l eID="gen18820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18821"/>and you shall boast in their riches. <l eID="gen18821" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8452"/><l level="1" sID="gen18822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8452"/>Instead of your shame, a double portion,<l eID="gen18822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18823"/>and <transChange type="added">instead of</transChange> insult, they will rejoice <transChange type="added">over</transChange> their portion.<l eID="gen18823" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18824"/>Therefore they will take a double portion in their land;<l eID="gen18824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18825"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they shall possess everlasting joy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “possession of joy everlasting shall be for them”</note> <l eID="gen18825" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:8
