verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8453"/><l level="1" sID="gen18826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8453"/>For I, Yahweh, love justice,<l eID="gen18826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18827"/>hate robbery and<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> injustice,<l eID="gen18827" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18828"/>and I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞faithfully⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the faithfulness”</note> give their reward,<l eID="gen18828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18829"/>and I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> an everlasting covenant <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> them. <l eID="gen18829" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8454"/><l level="1" sID="gen18830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8454"/>And their descendants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “descendant”</note> will be known among the nations,<l eID="gen18830" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18831"/>and their offspring in the midst of the peoples.<l eID="gen18831" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18832"/>All those who see them shall recognize them,<l eID="gen18832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18833"/>that they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> descendants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “descendant”</note> <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> Yahweh has blessed. <l eID="gen18833" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8455"/><l level="1" sID="gen18834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8455"/>I will rejoice greatly in Yahweh;<l eID="gen18834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18835"/>my being shall shout in exultation in my God.<l eID="gen18835" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18836"/>For he has clothed me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> garments of salvation,<l eID="gen18836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18837"/>he has covered me <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> robe of righteousness,<l eID="gen18837" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18838"/>as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> bridegroom adorns <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a head wrap like a priest,<l eID="gen18838" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18839"/>and as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> bride adorns herself <transChange type="added">with</transChange> her jewelry. <l eID="gen18839" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8456"/><l level="1" sID="gen18840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8456"/>For as the earth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞produces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “brings out”</note> its sprout,<l eID="gen18840" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18841"/>and as a garden makes its plants sprout,<l eID="gen18841" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18842"/>so the Lord Yahweh will make righteousness sprout,<l eID="gen18842" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18843"/>and praise before all the nations. <l eID="gen18843" level="2"/><lg eID="gen18796"/> <chapter eID="Isa.61"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8457"/><title type="x-s">Zion’s New Identity</title> <div sID="gen18844" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18844" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18845"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8457"/>For the sake of Zion I will not be silent,<l eID="gen18846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18847"/>and for the sake of Jerusalem I will not maintain a quiet attitude,<l eID="gen18847" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18848"/>until her righteousness goes out like the bright light,<l eID="gen18848" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18849"/>and her salvation burns like a torch. <l eID="gen18849" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8458"/><l level="1" sID="gen18850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8458"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations shall see your righteousness,<l eID="gen18850" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18851"/>and all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kings your glory,<l eID="gen18851" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18852"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will be called⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it shall be called to you”</note> a new name<l eID="gen18852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18853"/>that the mouth of Yahweh will designate. <l eID="gen18853" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8459"/><l level="1" sID="gen18854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8459"/>And you shall be a crown of beauty in the hand of Yahweh,<l eID="gen18854" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18855"/>and a headband of royalty in the hand of your God. <l eID="gen18855" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8460"/><l level="1" sID="gen18856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8460"/>It shall no longer be said of you, “Forsaken,”<l eID="gen18856" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18857"/>and it shall no longer be said of your land, “Desolation!”<l eID="gen18857" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18858"/>but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to you it shall”</note> be called “My Delight <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> In Her,”<l eID="gen18858" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18859"/>and your land, “Married,”<l eID="gen18859" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18860"/>for Yahweh delights in you,<l eID="gen18860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18861"/>and your land shall be married. <l eID="gen18861" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8461"/><l level="1" sID="gen18862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8461"/>For <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a young man marries a virgin,<l eID="gen18862" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18863"/><transChange type="added">so</transChange> shall your sons marry you,<l eID="gen18863" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18864"/>and <transChange type="added">as is the</transChange> joy of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bridegroom over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bride,<l eID="gen18864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18865"/><transChange type="added">so</transChange> shall your God rejoice over you. <l eID="gen18865" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8462"/><l level="1" sID="gen18866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8462"/>I have appointed watchmen upon your walls, Jerusalem;<l eID="gen18866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18867"/>all day and all night they shall never be silent.<l eID="gen18867" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18868"/>You who profess Yahweh have no rest. <l eID="gen18868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8463"/><l level="2" sID="gen18869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8463"/>And you must not give him rest until he establishes,<l eID="gen18869" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18870"/>and until he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞makes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “places”</note> Jerusalem <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an object of praise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a praise”</note> in the earth. <l eID="gen18870" level="3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8464"/><l level="1" sID="gen18871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8464"/>Yahweh has sworn by his right hand,<l eID="gen18871" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18872"/>and by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his mighty arm⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the arm of his might”</note><l eID="gen18872" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18873"/>“Surely I will never again give your grain <transChange type="added">as</transChange> food to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your enemies⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “those who are hostile to you”</note><l eID="gen18873" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18874"/>and surely <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foreigners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of a foreign country”</note> shall not drink your new wine at which you have labored.” <l eID="gen18874" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8465"/><l level="1" sID="gen18875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8465"/>But those who gather it shall eat it, and they shall praise Yahweh,<l eID="gen18875" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18876"/>and those who gather it shall drink it in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy courts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the courts of my holiness”</note> <l eID="gen18876" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8466"/><l level="1" sID="gen18877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8466"/>Pass through, pass through the gates!<l eID="gen18877" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18878"/>Make the way clear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> the people!<l eID="gen18878" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18879"/>Pile up, pile up the highway; clear <transChange type="added">it</transChange> of stones!<note placement="foot">Hebrew “stone”</note><l eID="gen18879" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18880"/>Lift up an ensign over the peoples! <l eID="gen18880" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18845"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8467"/><div sID="gen18881" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8467"/>Look! Yahweh has proclaimed to the end of the earth: <div eID="gen18881" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18882"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18883"/>Say to daughter Zion, “Look, your salvation <transChange type="added">is</transChange> coming!<l eID="gen18883" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18884"/>Look, his reward <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with him,<l eID="gen18884" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18885"/>and his reward before him. <l eID="gen18885" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8468"/><l level="1" sID="gen18886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8468"/>And they shall call them “The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Holy People⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “People of the Holiness”</note> The Redeemed Of Yahweh,”<l eID="gen18886" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18887"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to you it”</note> shall be called “Sought After, A City Is Not Forsaken.” <l eID="gen18887" level="2"/><lg eID="gen18882"/> <chapter eID="Isa.62"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8469"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Day of Vengeance</title> <div sID="gen18888" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18888" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18889"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8469"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this, coming from Edom,<l eID="gen18890" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18891"/>from Bozrah <transChange type="added">in</transChange> bright red garments?<l eID="gen18891" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18892"/><transChange type="added">Who is</transChange> this honored in his garment,<l eID="gen18892" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18893"/>lying down in his great strength?<l eID="gen18893" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18894"/>“<transChange type="added">It is</transChange> I, speaking in justice,<l eID="gen18894" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18895"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mighty⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “great”</note> to save!” <l eID="gen18895" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8470"/><l level="1" sID="gen18896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8470"/>Why <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your garments<note placement="foot">Hebrew “garment”</note> red,<l eID="gen18896" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18897"/>and your garments like he who treads in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> winepress? <l eID="gen18897" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8471"/><l level="1" sID="gen18898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8471"/>“I have trodden <transChange type="added">the</transChange> winepress alone,<l eID="gen18898" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18899"/>and there was no man from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples with me.<l eID="gen18899" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18900"/>And I trod them in my anger,<l eID="gen18900" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18901"/>and I trampled them in my wrath,<l eID="gen18901" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18902"/>and spattered their juice on my garments,<l eID="gen18902" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18903"/>and stained all my clothing, <l eID="gen18903" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8472"/><l level="1" sID="gen18904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8472"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of vengeance <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in my heart,<l eID="gen18904" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18905"/>and the year of my blood-vengeance has come! <l eID="gen18905" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8473"/><l level="1" sID="gen18906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8473"/>And I looked, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> there was no helper,<l eID="gen18906" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18907"/>and I was appalled, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> there was no one who sustains,<l eID="gen18907" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18908"/>so<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> my arm came to assist me,<l eID="gen18908" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18909"/>and my wrath <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was what⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it”</note> sustained me. <l eID="gen18909" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8474"/><l level="1" sID="gen18910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8474"/>And I trampled peoples in my anger,<l eID="gen18910" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18911"/>and I made them drunk in my wrath,<l eID="gen18911" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18912"/>and I brought their juice down to the earth.”<l eID="gen18912" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen18889"/> <title type="x-s">Remembering Yahweh’s Mercy</title> <div sID="gen18913" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen18913" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8475"/><lg sID="gen18914"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8475"/>I will mention the loyal love of Yahweh, the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has done for us,<l eID="gen18915" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18916"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> greatness of goodness to the house of Israel that he has done to them according to his mercy and the abundance of his loyal love. <l eID="gen18916" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18914"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8476"/><div sID="gen18917" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8476"/>And he said, “Surely my people <transChange type="added">are</transChange> children; they will not break faith.” And he became a Savior to them.  <div eID="gen18917" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8477"/><lg sID="gen18918"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8477"/>In all their distress, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there was no distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) has “he had distress”</note><l eID="gen18919" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18920"/>and the messenger of his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> saved them,<l eID="gen18920" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18921"/>in his love and compassion he himself redeemed them,<l eID="gen18921" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18922"/>and he lifted them up,<l eID="gen18922" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18923"/>and he supported them all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days of old. <l eID="gen18923" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8478"/><l level="1" sID="gen18924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8478"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were the ones who⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they”</note> rebelled,<l eID="gen18924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18925"/>and they grieved <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his Holy Spirit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the spirit of his holiness”</note><l eID="gen18925" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18926"/>so<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞became an enemy to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “was changed to them to one who is hostile”</note><l eID="gen18926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18927"/>he himself fought against them. <l eID="gen18927" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8479"/><l level="1" sID="gen18928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8479"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> his people remembered the days of old, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Moses.<l eID="gen18928" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18929"/>Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the one who led up them from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea with the shepherds of his flock?<l eID="gen18929" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18930"/>Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the one who puts <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his Holy Spirit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the spirit of his holiness”</note> inside him, <l eID="gen18930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8480"/><l level="2" sID="gen18931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8480"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “bringing”</note> his magnificent arm move <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> the right hand of Moses,<l eID="gen18931" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18932"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who divided⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “dividing”</note> the waters <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from their face”</note><l eID="gen18932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18933"/>to make an everlasting name for himself, <l eID="gen18933" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8481"/><l level="1" sID="gen18934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8481"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who led⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “leading”</note> them through the depths?<l eID="gen18934" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18935"/>They did not stumble like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> horse in the desert; <l eID="gen18935" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8482"/><l level="1" sID="gen18936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8482"/>like cattle in the valley <transChange type="added">that</transChange> goes down, the Spirit of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞gave him rest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “caused to rest”</note><l eID="gen18936" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18937"/>so you lead your people to make a magnificent name for yourself.<l eID="gen18937" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18918"/> <title type="x-s">Prayer for Mercy</title> <div sID="gen18938" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen18938" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8483"/><lg sID="gen18939"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8483"/>Look from heaven,<l eID="gen18940" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18941"/>and see from the lofty residence of your holiness and glory.<l eID="gen18941" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18942"/>Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your zeal and strength?<l eID="gen18942" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18943"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Your compassion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The agitation of your intestines”</note> and mercy to me hold themselves back. <l eID="gen18943" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8484"/><l level="1" sID="gen18944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8484"/>For you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> our father, although Abraham does not know us,<l eID="gen18944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18945"/>and Israel does not acknowledge us.<l eID="gen18945" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18946"/>You, Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> our father,<l eID="gen18946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18947"/>Our Redeemer from <transChange type="added">of</transChange> old <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your name. <l eID="gen18947" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8485"/><l level="1" sID="gen18948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8485"/>Why do you make us wander, Yahweh?<l eID="gen18948" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18949"/>You harden our heart from your ways <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that we do not fear⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the fear of”</note> you.<l eID="gen18949" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18950"/>Turn back for the sake of your servants,<l eID="gen18950" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18951"/>the tribes of your inheritance. <l eID="gen18951" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8486"/><l level="1" sID="gen18952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8486"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Your holy people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The people of your holiness”</note> took possession for <transChange type="added">a</transChange> little <transChange type="added">while</transChange>;<l eID="gen18952" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18953"/>our adversaries have trampled down your sanctuary. <l eID="gen18953" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8487"/><l level="1" sID="gen18954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8487"/>We have been since antiquity; you did not rule them;<l eID="gen18954" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18955"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they were not called by your name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “your name was not called over them”</note> <l eID="gen18955" level="2"/><lg eID="gen18939"/> <chapter eID="Isa.63"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:1
verses.text: <note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Isa.64.1">Isaiah 64:1 </reference>in the English Bible begins here. In the Hebrew Bible, 63:19 continues</note> Would that you would tear <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens <transChange type="added">and</transChange> come down;<l eID="gen18958" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18959"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains would quake before you, <l eID="gen18959" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8488"/><l level="1" sID="gen18960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8488"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Isa.64.2-Isa.64.12">Isaiah 64:2–12 </reference>in the English Bible is 64:1–11 in the Hebrew Bible</note> as fire kindles brushwood,<l eID="gen18960" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18961"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> fire causes water to boil,<l eID="gen18961" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18962"/>to make your name known to your adversaries,<l eID="gen18962" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18963"/><transChange type="added">that the</transChange> nations might tremble from your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> <l eID="gen18963" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8489"/><l level="1" sID="gen18964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8489"/>When you did terrible deeds <transChange type="added">which</transChange> we did not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞expect⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “await”</note> you came down;<l eID="gen18964" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18965"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains quaked because of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> <l eID="gen18965" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8490"/><l level="1" sID="gen18966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8490"/>And since ancient <transChange type="added">times</transChange> they have not heard,<l eID="gen18966" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18967"/>have not listened,<l eID="gen18967" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18968"/>no eye has seen a God except you;<l eID="gen18968" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18969"/>he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞acts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “makes”</note> for the one who waits for him. <l eID="gen18969" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8491"/><l level="1" sID="gen18970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8491"/>You meet with the one who rejoices,<l eID="gen18970" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18971"/>one who does righteousness.<l eID="gen18971" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18972"/>In your ways they remember you.<l eID="gen18972" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18973"/>Look! You were angry and we sinned against them <transChange type="added">in</transChange> ancient <transChange type="added">times</transChange> and we were saved. <l eID="gen18973" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8492"/><l level="1" sID="gen18974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8492"/>And we all have become like the unclean,<l eID="gen18974" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18975"/>and all our deeds of justice like a menstrual cloth,<l eID="gen18975" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18976"/>And we all wither like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> leaf,<l eID="gen18976" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18977"/>and our iniquities take us away like the wind. <l eID="gen18977" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8493"/><l level="1" sID="gen18978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8493"/>And there is no one who calls on your name,<l eID="gen18978" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18979"/>who pulls himself up to keep hold of you,<l eID="gen18979" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18980"/>for you have hidden your face from us,<note placement="foot">Or “him”</note><l eID="gen18980" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18981"/>and melted us into the hand of our iniquity. <l eID="gen18981" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8494"/><l level="1" sID="gen18982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8494"/>Yet now Yahweh, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> our father;<l eID="gen18982" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18983"/>we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the clay and you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> our <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞potter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “one who fashions”</note><l eID="gen18983" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18984"/>and we all <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the work of your hand. <l eID="gen18984" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8495"/><l level="1" sID="gen18985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8495"/>You must not be exceedingly angry, Yahweh,<l eID="gen18985" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18986"/>and you must not remember iniquity forever!<l eID="gen18986" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18957"/> <div sID="gen18987" type="x-p"/> Look! Behold, now! We all <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your people!  <div eID="gen18987" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8496"/><lg sID="gen18988"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8496"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Your holy cities⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The cities of your holiness”</note> have become a wilderness;<l eID="gen18989" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18990"/>Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation. <l eID="gen18990" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8497"/><l level="1" sID="gen18991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8497"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Our holy and beautiful temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of our holiness and our beauty”</note> where our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> praised you has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞been burned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “been for burning”</note> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> fire,<l eID="gen18991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18992"/>and all our precious objects have become ruins.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ruin”</note> <l eID="gen18992" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8498"/><l level="1" sID="gen18993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8498"/>Will you control yourself because of these, Yahweh?<l eID="gen18993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18994"/>Will you be silent?<l eID="gen18994" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen18995"/>And will you oppress us exceedingly? <l eID="gen18995" level="3"/><lg eID="gen18988"/> <chapter eID="Isa.64"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8499"/><title type="x-s">Judgment and Salvation</title> <div sID="gen18996" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen18996" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18997"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8499"/>“I let myself be sought by <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> did not ask;<l eID="gen18998" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18999"/>I let myself be found by <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> did not seek me.<l eID="gen18999" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19000"/>I said, ‘Here I am; here I am!’ to a nation <transChange type="added">that</transChange> did not call on my name; <l eID="gen19000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8500"/><l level="2" sID="gen19001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8500"/>I spread out my hands all day to a stubborn people,<l eID="gen19001" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19002"/>those who walk after their thoughts <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the way <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> not good, <l eID="gen19002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8501"/><l level="2" sID="gen19003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8501"/>the people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who provoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “provoking”</note> me to anger continually to my face,<l eID="gen19003" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19004"/>slaughtering for sacrifices in the garden,<l eID="gen19004" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19005"/>and making smoke offerings on bricks, <l eID="gen19005" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8502"/><l level="1" sID="gen19006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8502"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who sit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sitting”</note> in graves<l eID="gen19006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19007"/>and spend the night in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞secret places⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “watches”</note><l eID="gen19007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19008"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who eat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “eating”</note> the flesh of swine<l eID="gen19008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19009"/>with<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> a fragment<note placement="foot">The reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) has “broth”</note> of impurity <transChange type="added">in</transChange> their vessels, <l eID="gen19009" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8503"/><l level="1" sID="gen19010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8503"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “saying”</note> “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Keep to yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “Come near to you”</note><l eID="gen19010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19011"/>You must not come near me, for I am <transChange type="added">too</transChange> holy for you!”<l eID="gen19011" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19012"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a smoke in my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞nostrils⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “nose”</note><l eID="gen19012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19013"/>a fire burning all day. <l eID="gen19013" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8504"/><l level="1" sID="gen19014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8504"/>Look! <transChange type="added">It</transChange> is written before me: I will not be silent, but I will repay;<l eID="gen19014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19015"/>and I will repay in<note placement="foot">Or “on”</note> the fold of their garment <l eID="gen19015" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8505"/><l level="1" sID="gen19016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8505"/>your iniquities and the iniquities of your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> together, says Yahweh,<l eID="gen19016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19017"/>because they made smoke offerings on the mountains<l eID="gen19017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19018"/>and they taunted me on the hills,<l eID="gen19018" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19019"/>I will measure their punishment <transChange type="added">from the</transChange> beginning into the fold of their garment.” <l eID="gen19019" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen18997"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8506"/><div sID="gen19020" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8506"/>Thus says Yahweh: “Just as the new wine is found in the cluster, and they say ‘You must not destroy it, for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> a blessing in it,’ so I will do for the sake of my servants <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> not destroying <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all”</note>  <div eID="gen19020" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8507"/><lg sID="gen19021"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8507"/>And I will bring descendant s<note placement="foot">Hebrew “descendant”</note> out from Jacob,<l eID="gen19022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19023"/>and a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “man”</note> from Judah to take possession of my mountain,<l eID="gen19023" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19024"/>and my chosen ones shall inherit it,<l eID="gen19024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19025"/>and my servants shall settle there. <l eID="gen19025" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8508"/><l level="1" sID="gen19026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8508"/>And Sharon shall become a pasture for<note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> flocks,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “flock”</note><l eID="gen19026" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19027"/>and the valley of Achor a resting place for<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> herds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “herd”</note><l eID="gen19027" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19028"/>for my people who have sought me. <l eID="gen19028" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8509"/><l level="1" sID="gen19029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8509"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who forsake⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “forsaking”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19030"/>forgetting <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of my holiness”</note><l eID="gen19030" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19031"/>who set a table for Fortune,<l eID="gen19031" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19032"/>and who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pour out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fill”</note> a jug of mixed wine for Destiny, <l eID="gen19032" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8510"/><l level="1" sID="gen19033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8510"/>and I will remit you to the sword,<l eID="gen19033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19034"/>and all of you shall bow down to the slaughter,<l eID="gen19034" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19035"/>because I called, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you did not answer;<l eID="gen19035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19036"/>I spoke, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you did not listen,<l eID="gen19036" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19037"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you did the evil in my eyes,<l eID="gen19037" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19038"/>and you chose that in which I do not delight.” <l eID="gen19038" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19021"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8511"/><div sID="gen19039" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8511"/>Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen19039" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19040"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19041"/>“Look! My servants shall eat but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you, you shall be hungry.<l eID="gen19041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19042"/>Look! My servants shall drink but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you, you shall be thirsty.<l eID="gen19042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19043"/>Look! My servants shall rejoice but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you, you shall be ashamed. <l eID="gen19043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8512"/><l level="1" sID="gen19044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8512"/>Look! My servants shall shout <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for joy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from goodness of heart”</note> but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you, you shall cry out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for pain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from pain of heart”</note> and howl <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for sadness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from a breaking of the spirit”</note> <l eID="gen19044" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8513"/><l level="1" sID="gen19045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8513"/>And you shall leave your name to my chosen ones as a curse,<l eID="gen19045" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19046"/>and the Lord Yahweh will kill you, and he will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞give⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “call”</note> his servants another name. <l eID="gen19046" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8514"/><l level="1" sID="gen19047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8514"/>Whoever blesses himself in the land shall bless himself by the God of trustworthiness,<l eID="gen19047" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19048"/>and the one who swears an oath in the land shall swear by the God of trustworthiness,<l eID="gen19048" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19049"/>because the former troubles are forgotten,<l eID="gen19049" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19050"/>and they are hidden from my eyes.<l eID="gen19050" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19040"/> <title type="x-s">New Creation</title> <div sID="gen19051" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen19051" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8515"/><lg sID="gen19052"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8515"/>For look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to create new heavens and a new earth,<l eID="gen19053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19054"/>and the former things shall not be remembered,<l eID="gen19054" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19055"/>and they shall not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞come to mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “go up to heart”</note> <l eID="gen19055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8516"/><l level="2" sID="gen19056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8516"/>But rejoice and shout in exultation forever and ever <transChange type="added">over</transChange> what I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to create!<l eID="gen19056" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19057"/>For look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to create Jerusalem <transChange type="added">as a source of</transChange> rejoicing,<l eID="gen19057" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19058"/>and her people <transChange type="added">as a source of</transChange> joy. <l eID="gen19058" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8517"/><l level="1" sID="gen19059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8517"/>And I will shout in exultation over Jerusalem,<l eID="gen19059" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19060"/>and I will rejoice over my people,<l eID="gen19060" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19061"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of weeping shall no longer be heard in it,<l eID="gen19061" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19062"/>or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of a cry for help. <l eID="gen19062" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8518"/><l level="1" sID="gen19063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8518"/>There will no longer be a nursing infant <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who lives only a few⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of”</note> days,<l eID="gen19063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19064"/>or<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> an old man who does not fill his days,<l eID="gen19064" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19065"/>for the boy will die <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a hundred years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a son of a hundred year”</note><l eID="gen19065" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19066"/>and the one who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fails to reach⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “misses”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a hundred years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of a hundred year”</note> will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞considered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “treated”</note> accursed. <l eID="gen19066" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8519"/><l level="1" sID="gen19067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8519"/>And they shall build houses and inhabit <transChange type="added">them</transChange>,<l eID="gen19067" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19068"/>and they shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit. <l eID="gen19068" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8520"/><l level="1" sID="gen19069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8520"/>They shall not build and another inhabit;<l eID="gen19069" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19070"/>they shall not plant and another eat.<l eID="gen19070" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19071"/>For the days of my people <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> like the days of <transChange type="added">a</transChange> tree,<l eID="gen19071" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19072"/>and my chosen ones shall enjoy the work of their hands. <l eID="gen19072" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8521"/><l level="1" sID="gen19073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8521"/>They shall not labor for nothing,<l eID="gen19073" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19074"/>and they shall not give birth to horror,<l eID="gen19074" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19075"/>for they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shall be offspring blessed by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the offspring of the blessing of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19075" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19076"/>and their descendants with them. <l eID="gen19076" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8522"/><l level="1" sID="gen19077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8522"/>And this will happen: before they call, I myself will answer;<l eID="gen19077" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19078"/><transChange type="added">while</transChange> still they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> speaking, I myself will hear. <l eID="gen19078" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8523"/><l level="1" sID="gen19079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8523"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> wolf and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lamb shall feed like one,<l eID="gen19079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19080"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lion shall eat straw like the ox,<l eID="gen19080" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen19081"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> dust <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> serpent’s food.<l eID="gen19081" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19082"/>They shall do no evil,<l eID="gen19082" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19083"/>and they shall not destroy on all <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of my holiness”</note> says Yahweh. <l eID="gen19083" level="2"/><lg eID="gen19052"/> <chapter eID="Isa.65"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8524"/><title type="x-s">Proper Worship</title> <div sID="gen19084" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8524"/>Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen19084" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19085"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19086"/>“Heaven <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my throne,<l eID="gen19086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19087"/>and the earth <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the footstool for my feet.<l eID="gen19087" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19088"/>Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this house that you would build for me?<l eID="gen19088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19089"/>And where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this resting place for me? <l eID="gen19089" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8525"/><l level="1" sID="gen19090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8525"/>And my hand has made all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>,<l eID="gen19090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19091"/>and all these <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came to be⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “were”</note><l eID="gen19091" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19085"/> <div sID="gen19092" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I look to this <transChange type="added">one</transChange>: <div eID="gen19092" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19093"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19094"/>to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> humble and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> contrite of spirit<l eID="gen19094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19095"/>and <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> frightened at my word. <l eID="gen19095" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8526"/><l level="1" sID="gen19096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8526"/>The one who slaughters <transChange type="added">a</transChange> bull strikes a man;<l eID="gen19096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19097"/>the one who slaughters <transChange type="added">a</transChange> lamb for sacrifice breaks the neck <transChange type="added">of</transChange> a dog.<l eID="gen19097" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19098"/>The one who offers an offering, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blood of swine;<l eID="gen19098" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19099"/>the one who offers frankincense blesses an idol.<l eID="gen19099" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19100"/>Indeed, they themselves have chosen their ways,<l eID="gen19100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19101"/>and their soul delights in their abhorrence. <l eID="gen19101" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8527"/><l level="1" sID="gen19102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8527"/>Indeed, I myself I will choose their ill treatment,<l eID="gen19102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19103"/>and I will bring them objects of their dread,<l eID="gen19103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19104"/>because I called, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no one answered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “there was no one who answers”</note><l eID="gen19104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19105"/>I spoke and they did not listen,<l eID="gen19105" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19106"/>but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> they did the evil in my eyes,<l eID="gen19106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19107"/>and they chose that in which I do not delight.” <l eID="gen19107" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19093"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8528"/><div sID="gen19108" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8528"/>Hear the word of Yahweh, you who are frightened at his word: <div eID="gen19108" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19109"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19110"/>Your brothers who hate you,<l eID="gen19110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19111"/>who exclude you for my name’s sake have said,<l eID="gen19111" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19112"/>“Let Yahweh be honored so that<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> we may see your joy!”<l eID="gen19112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19113"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> they themselves shall be ashamed. <l eID="gen19113" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8529"/><l level="1" sID="gen19114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8529"/>A voice, an uproar from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city!<l eID="gen19114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19115"/>A voice from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> temple!<l eID="gen19115" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen19116"/>The voice of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞paying back⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “rewarding retribution to”</note> his enemies!<l eID="gen19116" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen19109"/> <title type="x-s">Zion’s Delivery</title> <div sID="gen19117" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen19117" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8530"/><lg sID="gen19118"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8530"/>Before she was in labor she gave birth;<l eID="gen19119" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19120"/>before labor pains<note placement="foot">Hebrew “pain”</note> came to her, she gave birth to a son. <l eID="gen19120" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8531"/><l level="1" sID="gen19121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8531"/>Who has heard <transChange type="added">anything</transChange> like this?<l eID="gen19121" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19122"/>Who has seen <transChange type="added">anything</transChange> like these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>?<l eID="gen19122" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19123"/>Can a land be born in one day?<l eID="gen19123" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19124"/>Or can a nation be born in a moment?<l eID="gen19124" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19118"/> <div sID="gen19125" type="x-p"/> <transChange type="added">Yet</transChange> when she was in labor, Zion indeed gave birth <transChange type="added">to</transChange> her children.  <div eID="gen19125" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8532"/><lg sID="gen19126"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8532"/>Shall I myself I break open and not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deliver⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “cause to bring forth”</note> says Yahweh,<l eID="gen19127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19128"/>“or I who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞delivers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “causes to bring forth”</note> lock up <transChange type="added">the womb</transChange>?” says your God. <l eID="gen19128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8533"/><l level="1" sID="gen19129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8533"/>“Rejoice with Jerusalem<l eID="gen19129" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19130"/>and shout in exultation with her, all those who love her!<l eID="gen19130" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19131"/>Rejoice with her <transChange type="added">in</transChange> joy, all those who mourn over her, <l eID="gen19131" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8534"/><l level="1" sID="gen19132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8534"/>so that you may suck and be satisfied from her <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞consoling breast⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “breast of consolation”</note><l eID="gen19132" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19133"/>so that you may drink deeply and refresh yourselves from her <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞heavy breast⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “breast of heaviness “</note> <l eID="gen19133" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19126"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8535"/><div sID="gen19134" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8535"/>For thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen19134" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19135"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19136"/>“Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to spread prosperity out to her like a river,<l eID="gen19136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19137"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wealth of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations like an overflowing stream,<l eID="gen19137" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19138"/>and you shall suck and be carried on the hip;<l eID="gen19138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19139"/>and you shall you shall be played with on the knees. <l eID="gen19139" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8536"/><l level="1" sID="gen19140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8536"/>As a man whose mother comforts him, so I myself will comfort you,<l eID="gen19140" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19141"/>and you shall be comforted in Jerusalem.<l eID="gen19141" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19135"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Final Judgment</title> <div sID="gen19142" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen19142" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8537"/><lg sID="gen19143"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8537"/>And you shall see and your heart shall rejoice,<l eID="gen19144" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19145"/>and your bones shall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞flourish⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sprout”</note> like the grass,<l eID="gen19145" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19146"/>and the hand of Yahweh shall make itself known <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with”</note> his servants,<l eID="gen19146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19147"/>and he shall curse his enemies. <l eID="gen19147" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8538"/><l level="1" sID="gen19148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8538"/>For look! Yahweh will come in fire,<l eID="gen19148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19149"/>and his chariots like the storm wind,<l eID="gen19149" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19150"/>to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞give back⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause to turn around”</note> his anger in wrath,<l eID="gen19150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19151"/>and his rebuke in flames of fire. <l eID="gen19151" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8539"/><l level="1" sID="gen19152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8539"/>For Yahweh enters into judgment <transChange type="added">on</transChange> all flesh with fire and his sword,<l eID="gen19152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19153"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those slain by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the slain of”</note> Yahweh shall be many. <l eID="gen19153" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8540"/><l level="1" sID="gen19154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8540"/>Those who sanctify themselves<l eID="gen19154" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19155"/>and those who cleanse themselves <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to go into⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “toward”</note> the gardens after <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one in the middle,<l eID="gen19155" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19156"/>eating the flesh of swine<l eID="gen19156" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19157"/>and detestable things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thing”</note> and rodents<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rodent”</note> together<l eID="gen19157" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19143"/> <div sID="gen19158" type="x-p"/> shall come to an end!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen19158" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8541"/><lg sID="gen19159"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8541"/>“And I—their works and thoughts!—<transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to come to gather all nations and tongues,<l eID="gen19160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19161"/>and they shall come and see my glory. <l eID="gen19161" level="2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8542"/><l level="1" sID="gen19162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8542"/>And I will set a sign among them,<l eID="gen19162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19163"/>and I will send survivors from them to the nations:<l eID="gen19163" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19164"/>Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bow;<l eID="gen19164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19165"/>Tubal and Javan, the faraway coastlands<l eID="gen19165" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19166"/>that have not heard <transChange type="added">of</transChange> my fame,<l eID="gen19166" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19167"/>and have not seen my glory.<l eID="gen19167" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19159"/> <div sID="gen19168" type="x-p"/> And they shall declare my glory among the nations,

verses.name: Isaiah 66:20
verses.text: and bring all your countrymen<note placement="foot">Or “brothers”</note> from all the nations as an offering to Yahweh on horses and chariots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note> and in litters and on mules and camels, to<note placement="foot">Or “on”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of holiness me”</note> Jerusalem,” says Yahweh, “just as the sons of Israel bring <transChange type="added">an</transChange> offering in a clean vessel <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of Yahweh.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:21
verses.text: And indeed, I will take some of them as priests <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the Levites,” says Yahweh.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:22
verses.text: “For just as the new heavens and earth that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to make shall stand before me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “so shall your descendants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “descendant”</note> and your name stand.  <div eID="gen19168" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8543"/><div sID="gen19169" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8543"/>And this shall happen: From <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞new moon to new moon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “enough of new moon in his new moon”</note> and from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Sabbath to Sabbath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “enough of Sabbath in his Sabbath”</note> all flesh shall come to bow in worship before me,” says Yahweh.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:24
verses.text: “And they shall go out and look at the corpses of the people<note placement="foot">Or “men”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who have rebelled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “rebelling”</note> against me, <div eID="gen19169" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19170"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19171"/>for their worm shall not die,<l eID="gen19171" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19172"/>and their fire shall not be quenched,<l eID="gen19172" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen19173"/>and they shall be an abhorrence to all flesh.” <l eID="gen19173" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen19170"/> <chapter eID="Isa.66"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen14754" osisID="Isa" type="book"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8544"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Appoints Jeremiah as a Prophet to the Nations</title> <div sID="gen19175" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8544"/>The words of Jeremiah, the son of Hilkiah, among the priests who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin,

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">to</transChange> whom the word of Yahweh came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, the king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:3
verses.text: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, the king of Judah, until the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, the king of Judah, until the exile of Jerusalem in the fifth month.  <div eID="gen19175" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8545"/><div sID="gen19176" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8545"/>And the word of Yahweh came to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>  <div eID="gen19176" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8546"/><lg sID="gen19177"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8546"/>“Before I formed you in the womb I knew you,<l eID="gen19178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19179"/>and before you came out from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb I consecrated you;<l eID="gen19179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19180"/>I appointed you <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a prophet to the nations.” <l eID="gen19180" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen19177"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8547"/><div sID="gen19181" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8547"/>Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Look, I do not know <transChange type="added">how</transChange> to speak, for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a youth.”<note placement="foot">Or “boy”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:7
verses.text: But Yahweh said to me, “You must not say, ‘I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a youth,’<note placement="foot">Or “boy”</note> for to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whomever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of whom”</note> I send you, you will go, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whatever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of that”</note> I command you, you will speak.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Do not be afraid of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you must not be afraid from the faces of them”</note> for I am with you to deliver you,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:9
verses.text: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand and he touched my mouth, and Yahweh said to me, <div eID="gen19181" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19182"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19183"/>“Look, I have put my words in your mouth. <l eID="gen19183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8548"/><l level="1" sID="gen19184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8548"/>See, I appoint you this day over the nations<l eID="gen19184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19185"/>and over the kingdoms,<l eID="gen19185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19186"/>to pluck up and to pull down,<l eID="gen19186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19187"/>and to destroy and to tear down,<l eID="gen19187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19188"/>to build and to plant.” <l eID="gen19188" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen19182"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8549"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Confirms Jeremiah’s Call</title> <div sID="gen19189" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8549"/>And the word of Yahweh came to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you seeing, Jeremiah?” And I said, “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> seeing a branch of an almond tree.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:12
verses.text: Then Yahweh said to me, “You did well to see, for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> watching over my word to perform it.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:13
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh came to me a second <transChange type="added">time</transChange>, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “What are you seeing?” And I said, “I am seeing a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞boiling⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “blown upon”</note> pot, and its face <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> face of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:14
verses.text: Then Yahweh said to me, “From <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north disaster will be unleashed<note placement="foot">Or “opened”</note> on all the inhabitants of the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:15
verses.text: For, look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> calling to all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clans<note placement="foot">Or “families”</note> of the kingdoms of the north,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and they will come and set each one his throne <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its surrounding walls, and against all the cities of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:16
verses.text: And I will pass<note placement="foot">Or “pronounce”</note> my judgments on them because of all their wickedness <transChange type="added">in</transChange> that they have forsaken me, and they made sacrifices to other gods, and they bowed in worship to the works of their hands.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:17
verses.text: But you, you must gird your loins, and stand, and speak to them all that I command you. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Do not be afraid of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “You must not be filled with terror from the faces of them”</note> or I will shatter you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the faces of”</note> them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:18
verses.text: Now look, I have made you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> as a fortified city and as an iron pillar and a bronze wall<note placement="foot">Hebrew “walls”</note> against all the land, against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:19
verses.text: And they will fight against you but they will not prevail against you, for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> with you,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “to deliver you.”  <chapter eID="Jer.1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8550"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Remembers Israel’s Faithfulness</title> <div sID="gen19190" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8550"/>And the word of Yahweh came to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:2
verses.text: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen19190" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19191"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19192"/>“I remember <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> you the loyal love of your childhood,<note placement="foot">Or “youth”</note><l eID="gen19192" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19193"/>the love of your betrothal-time,<l eID="gen19193" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19194"/>your going<note placement="foot">Or “walking”</note> after me in the desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note><l eID="gen19194" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19195"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land not sown. <l eID="gen19195" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8551"/><l level="1" sID="gen19196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8551"/>Israel <transChange type="added">was</transChange> holy to Yahweh,<l eID="gen19196" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19197"/>the first fruit of his produce.<l eID="gen19197" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19198"/>All <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> ate it were held guilty;<l eID="gen19198" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19199"/>disaster came to them,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.’ ” <l eID="gen19199" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19191"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8552"/><title type="x-s">The Unfaithfulness of Israel’s Ancestors</title> <div sID="gen19200" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8552"/>Hear the word of Yahweh, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> house of Jacob, and all the clans<note placement="foot">Or “families”</note> of the house of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:5
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen19200" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19201"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19202"/>“What injustice did your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> find in me<l eID="gen19202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19203"/>that they were far from me,<l eID="gen19203" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19204"/>and they went after the vanity,<l eID="gen19204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19205"/>and they became vain? <l eID="gen19205" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:6
