verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8553"/><l level="1" sID="gen19206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8553"/>And they did not say,<l eID="gen19206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19207"/>‘Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19207" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19208"/>the one who brought us up from the land of Egypt,<l eID="gen19208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19209"/>the one who led us in the desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note><l eID="gen19209" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19210"/>in a land of desert plains and gorges,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “gorge”</note><l eID="gen19210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19211"/>in a land of dryness and deep darkness,<l eID="gen19211" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19212"/>in a land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that no one passes through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “no man passes through in it”</note><l eID="gen19212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19213"/>and no human lives there?’ <l eID="gen19213" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8554"/><l level="1" sID="gen19214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8554"/>And I brought you to the land of the orchard,<l eID="gen19214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19215"/>to eat its fruit, and its good things.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “good thing”</note><l eID="gen19215" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19216"/>But you entered and defiled my land,<l eID="gen19216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19217"/>and my inheritance you made a detestable thing.<note placement="foot">Or “abomination”</note> <l eID="gen19217" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8555"/><l level="1" sID="gen19218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8555"/>The priests did not say, ‘Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh?’<l eID="gen19218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19219"/>and those who handle the law did not know me,<l eID="gen19219" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19220"/>and the shepherds have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rebelled against me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “broken with me”</note><l eID="gen19220" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19221"/>and the prophets prophesied by Baal,<l eID="gen19221" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19222"/>and they went after <transChange type="added">things which</transChange> do not profit.<l eID="gen19222" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen19201"/> <title type="x-s">The Unfaithfulness of Contemporary Israel</title> <div sID="gen19223" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen19223" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8556"/><lg sID="gen19224"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8556"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> I again bring a lawsuit against you,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19225" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19226"/>“and with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your children⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of your sons”</note> I bring a lawsuit. <l eID="gen19226" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8557"/><l level="1" sID="gen19227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8557"/>For go over <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the coasts of Cyprus and look,<l eID="gen19227" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19228"/>and send <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Kedar and consider very closely,<l eID="gen19228" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19229"/>and see if there has been <transChange type="added">a thing</transChange> like this: <l eID="gen19229" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8558"/><l level="1" sID="gen19230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8558"/>Has a nation exchanged gods? And they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not gods!<l eID="gen19230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19231"/>But my people have exchanged their glory for that which does not profit. <l eID="gen19231" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8559"/><l level="1" sID="gen19232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8559"/>Be appalled, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> heavens, at this, and shudder;<l eID="gen19232" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19233"/>be utterly desolate,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen19233" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8560"/><l level="1" sID="gen19234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8560"/>“For my people have committed two evils:<l eID="gen19234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19235"/>they have forsaken me, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> source<note placement="foot">Or “fountain”</note> of living water,<l eID="gen19235" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19236"/>to hew out for themselves cisterns, cracked cisterns that can hold no water. <l eID="gen19236" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8561"/><l level="1" sID="gen19237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8561"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> Israel a slave? Or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a slave born in a house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “born of a house”</note><l eID="gen19237" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19238"/>Why has he become plunder? <l eID="gen19238" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8562"/><l level="1" sID="gen19239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8562"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> young lions have roared against him,<l eID="gen19239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19240"/>they have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞raised⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “given”</note> their voices.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “voice”</note><l eID="gen19240" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19241"/>And they have made his land as horror;<l eID="gen19241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19242"/>his cities are destroyed, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from not”</note> an inhabitant. <l eID="gen19242" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8563"/><l level="1" sID="gen19243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8563"/>Moreover, people of Memphis and Tahpanhes<l eID="gen19243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19244"/>will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shave⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “pasture”</note> your skull.<note placement="foot">Or “crown of your head”</note> <l eID="gen19244" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8564"/><l level="1" sID="gen19245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8564"/>Did you not do this to yourself,<l eID="gen19245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19246"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange> forsaking Yahweh, your God,<l eID="gen19246" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19247"/>at the time of your leading in the way? <l eID="gen19247" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8565"/><l level="1" sID="gen19248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8565"/>And now <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞why do you go⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “what for you”</note> the way of Egypt<l eID="gen19248" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19249"/>to drink the waters of the Shihor?<l eID="gen19249" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19250"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞why do you go⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “what for you”</note> the way of Assyria<l eID="gen19250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19251"/>to drink the waters of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Euphrates⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “river”</note> <l eID="gen19251" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8566"/><l level="1" sID="gen19252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8566"/>Your wickedness will chastise you,<l eID="gen19252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19253"/>and your apostasies will reprove you.<l eID="gen19253" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19254"/>Therefore know and see that <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> evil and bitter,<l eID="gen19254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19255"/>your forsaking of Yahweh, your God,<l eID="gen19255" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19256"/>and fear of me <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not in you,”<l eID="gen19256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19257"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> the Lord, Yahweh of hosts. <l eID="gen19257" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8567"/><l level="1" sID="gen19258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8567"/>“For from long ago you have broken your yoke,<l eID="gen19258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19259"/>you tore to pieces your bonds.<l eID="gen19259" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19260"/>And you said, ‘I will not serve!’<l eID="gen19260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19261"/>But on every high hill and under every leafy tree<l eID="gen19261" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19262"/>you <transChange type="added">were</transChange> lying down <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a prostitute. <l eID="gen19262" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8568"/><l level="1" sID="gen19263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8568"/>Yet I planted you <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a choice vine,<l eID="gen19263" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19264"/>all of it a seed of trustworthiness.<l eID="gen19264" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19265"/>How then have you altered before me<l eID="gen19265" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19266"/><transChange type="added">into something that is</transChange> degenerate, the foreign vine? <l eID="gen19266" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8569"/><l level="1" sID="gen19267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8569"/>For if you wash with natron,<l eID="gen19267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19268"/>and you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞use much soap⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “make numerous for yourself alkaline salt”</note><l eID="gen19268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19269"/>your guilt <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sticking as a stain <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> me,”<l eID="gen19269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19270"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh. <l eID="gen19270" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8570"/><l level="1" sID="gen19271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8570"/>“How can you say, ‘I have not defiled myself,<l eID="gen19271" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19272"/>I have not gone after the Baals?’<l eID="gen19272" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19273"/>Look at your way in the valley,<l eID="gen19273" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19274"/>know what you have done.<l eID="gen19274" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19275"/><transChange type="added">You are</transChange> a young she-camel,<l eID="gen19275" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19276"/>interweaving her ways. <l eID="gen19276" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8571"/><l level="1" sID="gen19277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8571"/>A wild ass accustomed to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note><l eID="gen19277" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19278"/>in the desire of her soul.<l eID="gen19278" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19279"/>She gasps <transChange type="added">for</transChange> wind <transChange type="added">in</transChange> her rutting time.<l eID="gen19279" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19280"/>Who can quell<note placement="foot">Or “restrain”</note> her <transChange type="added">lust</transChange>?<l eID="gen19280" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19281"/>All <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> seek her will not grow weary,<l eID="gen19281" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19282"/>in her month they will find her. <l eID="gen19282" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8572"/><l level="1" sID="gen19283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8572"/>Restrain your foot from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> barefoot,<l eID="gen19283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19284"/>and your throat from thirst.<l eID="gen19284" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19285"/>But you said, ‘<transChange type="added">It is</transChange> hopeless.<l eID="gen19285" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19286"/>No! For I have loved strangers,<l eID="gen19286" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19287"/>and after them I will go.’<note placement="foot">Or “walk”</note> <l eID="gen19287" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8573"/><l level="1" sID="gen19288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8573"/>As <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shame of a thief when he is caught in the act,<l eID="gen19288" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19289"/>so the house of Israel will be ashamed.<l eID="gen19289" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19290"/>They, their kings, their officials,<l eID="gen19290" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19291"/>and their priests, and their prophets. <l eID="gen19291" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8574"/><l level="1" sID="gen19292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8574"/><transChange type="added">Those who</transChange> say to the tree, ‘You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my father,’<l eID="gen19292" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19293"/>and to the stone, ‘You gave birth <transChange type="added">to</transChange> me.’<l eID="gen19293" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19294"/>For they have turned <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞backs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “neck”</note> to me, and not <transChange type="added">their</transChange> faces.<l eID="gen19294" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19295"/>But in the time of their trouble they say, ‘Arise and save us.’ <l eID="gen19295" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8575"/><l level="1" sID="gen19296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8575"/>But where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your gods that you made for yourself?<l eID="gen19296" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19297"/>Let them arise if they can save you in the time of your trouble.<l eID="gen19297" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19298"/>For <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> the number of your towns<l eID="gen19298" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19299"/>are your gods, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Judah. <l eID="gen19299" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8576"/><l level="1" sID="gen19300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8576"/>Why do you complain to me?<l eID="gen19300" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19301"/>All of you have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rebelled against me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “broken with me”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen19301" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8577"/><l level="1" sID="gen19302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8577"/>“For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in vain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the vanity”</note> I have struck your children.<l eID="gen19302" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19303"/>They accepted no discipline.<l eID="gen19303" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19304"/>Your sword devoured your prophets,<l eID="gen19304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19305"/>like a ravening<note placement="foot">Or “destroying”</note> lion. <l eID="gen19305" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8578"/><l level="1" sID="gen19306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8578"/>O generation, you see the word of Yahweh.<l eID="gen19306" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19307"/>Have I been a desert<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note> to Israel? Or a land of great darkness?<l eID="gen19307" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19308"/>Why do my people say, ‘We roam about freely,<l eID="gen19308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19309"/>we will not come again to you’? <l eID="gen19309" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8579"/><l level="1" sID="gen19310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8579"/>Can a young woman forget her ornaments?<note placement="foot">Or “jewelry”</note> <transChange type="added">Or</transChange> a bride her sashes?<l eID="gen19310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19311"/>Yet my people have forgotten me days without number. <l eID="gen19311" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8580"/><l level="1" sID="gen19312"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8580"/>How well you do <transChange type="added">on</transChange> your way to seek love!<l eID="gen19312" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19313"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> even <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the wicked <transChange type="added">woman</transChange> you can teach your ways. <l eID="gen19313" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8581"/><l level="1" sID="gen19314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8581"/>Also on your skirts is found<l eID="gen19314" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19315"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> blood of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> life of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> innocent, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor.<l eID="gen19315" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19316"/>You did not find them in the act of breaking into a house.<l eID="gen19316" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19317"/>But in spite of all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <l eID="gen19317" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8582"/><l level="1" sID="gen19318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8582"/>yet you say, ‘But I am innocent,<l eID="gen19318" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19319"/>surely his anger has turned away from me.’<l eID="gen19319" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19320"/>Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> entering into judgment with you<l eID="gen19320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19321"/>because of your saying, ‘I have not sinned.’ <l eID="gen19321" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8583"/><l level="1" sID="gen19322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8583"/>How you go about so much changing your way!<l eID="gen19322" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19323"/>Also by Egypt you will be put to shame,<l eID="gen19323" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19324"/>just as you were put to shame by Assyria. <l eID="gen19324" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8584"/><l level="1" sID="gen19325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8584"/>Also from there you will come out<l eID="gen19325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19326"/>with your hands on your head,<l eID="gen19326" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19327"/>for Yahweh has rejected <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those in whom you trust⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in your objects of trust”</note><l eID="gen19327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19328"/>and you will not prosper through them. <l eID="gen19328" level="2"/><lg eID="gen19224"/> <chapter eID="Jer.2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:1
verses.text: A <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Look, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> a man divorces his wife,<l eID="gen19331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19332"/>and she goes from him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and she becomes another man’s wife⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and she becomes to a man another”</note><l eID="gen19332" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19333"/>will he return to her again?’<l eID="gen19333" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19334"/>Will not that land be greatly defiled?<l eID="gen19334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19335"/>And you have prostituted <transChange type="added">yourself</transChange> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> many lovers,<l eID="gen19335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19336"/><transChange type="added">would</transChange> you now return to me?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen19336" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8585"/><l level="1" sID="gen19337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8585"/>“Lift up your eyes at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> barren heights,<l eID="gen19337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19338"/>and see where you have not been ravished.<l eID="gen19338" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19339"/>Beside the roads you sat for them like an Arab in the desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note><l eID="gen19339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19340"/>and you have defiled <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land<l eID="gen19340" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19341"/>with your fornication<l eID="gen19341" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19342"/>and with your wickedness. <l eID="gen19342" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8586"/><l level="1" sID="gen19343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8586"/>Therefore rain showers have been withheld,<l eID="gen19343" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19344"/>and the spring rain has not come.<l eID="gen19344" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19345"/>Yet <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it is for you”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> forehead of a woman prostitute,<l eID="gen19345" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19346"/>you refuse to be ashamed. <l eID="gen19346" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8587"/><l level="1" sID="gen19347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8587"/>Have you not just now called to me,<l eID="gen19347" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19348"/>‘My father, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the close friend of my youth? <l eID="gen19348" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8588"/><l level="1" sID="gen19349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8588"/>Will he be angry <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note><l eID="gen19349" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19350"/>Will he maintain <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞always⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>’?<note placement="foot">Literally “to duration”</note><l eID="gen19350" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19351"/>Look, you have spoken,<l eID="gen19351" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19352"/>but you have done all the evil that you could.”<note placement="foot">Literally “you have done the evil and you were able”</note> <l eID="gen19352" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19330"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8589"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Gives Israel a Letter of Divorce</title> <div sID="gen19353" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8589"/>Then Yahweh said to me in the days of Josiah, the king, “Have you seen what apostate<note placement="foot">Or “unfaithful”</note> Israel has done? She has gone on every high hill and under every leafy tree and she has prostituted <transChange type="added">herself</transChange> there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:7
verses.text: And I thought, ‘After her doing all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to me she will return,’ but she did not return. And her treacherous sister Judah saw <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:8
verses.text: And I saw that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for this very reason, that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because of all”</note> on account of apostate<note placement="foot">Or “unfaithful”</note> Israel committing adultery I divorced her and gave the letter of divorce to her. Yet her treacherous sister Judah was not afraid and she went and prostituted <transChange type="added">herself</transChange> also.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:9
verses.text: And it was because of the frivolity of her fornication that she defiled the land and committed adultery with the stone and with the tree.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:10
verses.text: Yet even in all this her treacherous sister Judah did not return to me with all her heart, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but only⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “but if”</note> in pretense,”<note placement="foot">Or “deception”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen19353" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8590"/><title type="x-s">A Call for Repentance</title> <div sID="gen19354" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8590"/>Then Yahweh said to me, “Apostate<note placement="foot">Or “unfaithful”</note> Israel has proved herself more upright<note placement="foot">Or “righteous”</note> than treacherous Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:12
verses.text: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, <div eID="gen19354" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19355"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19356"/>‘Return, apostate<note placement="foot">Or “unfaithful”</note> Israel,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen19356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19357"/>‘I will not cause my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “faces”</note> to fall on you.<l eID="gen19357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19358"/>For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> loyal,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen19358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19359"/>‘I will not be angry <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note> <l eID="gen19359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8591"/><l level="1" sID="gen19360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8591"/>Only acknowledge your guilt,<l eID="gen19360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19361"/>that against Yahweh your God you have rebelled,<l eID="gen19361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19362"/>and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every leafy tree,<l eID="gen19362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19363"/>and you have not obeyed my voice,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.” <l eID="gen19363" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen19355"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8592"/><div sID="gen19364" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8592"/>“Return, apostate<note placement="foot">Or “unfaithful”</note> children,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. “For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am your master⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I rule over among you”</note> and I will take you one from a city and two from a clan,<note placement="foot">Or “family”</note> and I will bring you <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Zion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:15
verses.text: Then I will give you shepherds after my own heart and they will feed you knowledge and insight.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:16
verses.text: And it will be when you have multiplied and become fruitful in the land in those days,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “they will no longer say, ‘The ark of the covenant of Yahweh.’ And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it will not come to mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “it shall not go up on heart”</note> nor will they remember it, nor will they miss it,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> nor will it be made again.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:17
verses.text: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘The Throne of Yahweh,’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to the name of Yahweh, to Jerusalem, and they will no longer go after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:18
verses.text: In those days the house of Judah will walk along with the house of Israel and they will come together from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north to the land that I gave as an inheritance <transChange type="added">to</transChange> your ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>  <div eID="gen19364" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8593"/><lg sID="gen19365"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8593"/>Then I thought, ‘How I would set you among the children,<l eID="gen19366" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19367"/>and I would give you a land of desire,<l eID="gen19367" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19368"/>an inheritance of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> glory of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hosts of nations.’<l eID="gen19368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19369"/>And I thought, ‘You would call me, “My father,”<l eID="gen19369" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19370"/>and you would not turn back from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞behind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “following”</note> me.’ <l eID="gen19370" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8594"/><l level="1" sID="gen19371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8594"/>However, as a wife departs treacherously from her lover,<l eID="gen19371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19372"/>so you have dealt treacherously with me,<l eID="gen19372" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19373"/><transChange type="added">O</transChange> house of Israel,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen19373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8595"/><l level="1" sID="gen19374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8595"/>“A voice <transChange type="added">is</transChange> heard on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> barren heights,<l eID="gen19374" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19375"/>the weeping of the pleas for mercy of the children of Israel,<l eID="gen19375" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19376"/>because they have perverted their way,<l eID="gen19376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19377"/>they have forgotten Yahweh their God. <l eID="gen19377" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8596"/><l level="1" sID="gen19378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8596"/>Return, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> apostate<note placement="foot">Or “unfaithful”</note> children,<l eID="gen19378" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19379"/>I will heal your backsliding.<l eID="gen19379" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19380"/>‘Look, we come to you,<l eID="gen19380" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19381"/>for you are Yahweh our God. <l eID="gen19381" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8597"/><l level="1" sID="gen19382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8597"/>Surely, an illusion <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hills,<l eID="gen19382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19383"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> turmoil <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the mountains.<l eID="gen19383" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19384"/>Surely, in Yahweh our God<l eID="gen19384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19385"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> the salvation of Israel. <l eID="gen19385" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8598"/><l level="1" sID="gen19386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8598"/>But the shameful thing has devoured<l eID="gen19386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19387"/>the labor of our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> from our youth,<l eID="gen19387" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19388"/>their flocks, and their cattle,<l eID="gen19388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19389"/>their sons and their daughters. <l eID="gen19389" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8599"/><l level="1" sID="gen19390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8599"/>Let us lie down in our shame,<l eID="gen19390" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19391"/>and let our disgrace cover us.<l eID="gen19391" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19392"/>For against Yahweh our God we have sinned,<l eID="gen19392" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19393"/>we and our ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note><l eID="gen19393" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19394"/>from our youth and until this day.<l eID="gen19394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19395"/>and we have not obeyed the voice of Yahweh our God.’ <l eID="gen19395" level="2"/><lg eID="gen19365"/> <chapter eID="Jer.3"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:1
verses.text: If you return, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Israel,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19398" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19399"/>“you return to me.<l eID="gen19399" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19400"/>And if you remove your abominations from my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “faces”</note><l eID="gen19400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19401"/>and you do not wander, <l eID="gen19401" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8600"/><l level="1" sID="gen19402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8600"/>and you swear, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As Yahweh lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,’<note placement="foot">Literally “life of Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen19402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19403"/>in truth, in justice, and in righteousness,<l eID="gen19403" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19404"/>then nations will be blessed by him,<l eID="gen19404" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19405"/>and in him they will boast.” <l eID="gen19405" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8601"/><l level="1" sID="gen19406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8601"/>For thus says Yahweh<l eID="gen19406" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19407"/>to the men<note placement="foot">Hebrew “man”</note> of Judah and to Jerusalem,<l eID="gen19407" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19408"/>“Break up for yourselves prepared virgin soil,<l eID="gen19408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19409"/>and you must not sow among thornbushes. <l eID="gen19409" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8602"/><l level="1" sID="gen19410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8602"/>Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh,<l eID="gen19410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19411"/>and remove the foreskins of your hearts,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note><l eID="gen19411" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19412"/>men<note placement="foot">Hebrew “man”</note> of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem,<l eID="gen19412" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19413"/>lest my wrath goes forth like the fire and burns,<l eID="gen19413" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19414"/>and there is no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> extinguishes <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note><l eID="gen19414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19415"/>because of the evil of your deeds.”<l eID="gen19415" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19397"/> <title type="x-s">An Invasion from the North</title> <div sID="gen19416" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen19416" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8603"/><lg sID="gen19417"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8603"/>Declare in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem and say,<l eID="gen19418" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19419"/>“Blow a horn through the land,<l eID="gen19419" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19420"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞call with a loud voice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “call fill”</note> and say,<l eID="gen19420" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19421"/>‘Be gathered and let us go into the fortified cities.’ <l eID="gen19421" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8604"/><l level="1" sID="gen19422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8604"/>Lift up a signal toward Zion,<l eID="gen19422" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19423"/>bring yourselves to safety; you must not remain standing,<l eID="gen19423" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19424"/>for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> bringing evil from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,<l eID="gen19424" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19425"/>and a great destruction. <l eID="gen19425" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8605"/><l level="1" sID="gen19426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8605"/>A lion has gone up from his thicket,<l eID="gen19426" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19427"/>and a destroyer of nations has set out.<l eID="gen19427" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19428"/>He has gone out from his place to make your land as a horror,<l eID="gen19428" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19429"/>your cities will go to ruin <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from not”</note> inhabitant. <l eID="gen19429" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8606"/><l level="1" sID="gen19430"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8606"/>Because of this gird yourselves <transChange type="added">with</transChange> sackcloth,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sackcloths”</note> lament and wail,<l eID="gen19430" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19431"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the burning anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the blaze of the nose”</note> of Yahweh has not turned back from us. <l eID="gen19431" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8607"/><l level="1" sID="gen19432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8607"/>And then on that day,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19433"/>“the heart of the king and the heart of the officials will be destroyed,<l eID="gen19433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19434"/>and the priests will be appalled,<l eID="gen19434" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19435"/>and the prophets will be astonished.” <l eID="gen19435" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19417"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8608"/><div sID="gen19436" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8608"/>Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh, surely you have utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘It will be peace for you,’ while the sword reaches up to the throat.”  <div eID="gen19436" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8609"/><lg sID="gen19437"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8609"/>At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem,<l eID="gen19438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19439"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞A hot wind from the barren heights⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a wind of shimmering of barren heights”</note> in the desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note><l eID="gen19439" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19440"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the direction of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the way of”</note> the daughter of my people,<l eID="gen19440" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19441"/>not to winnow and not to cleanse, <l eID="gen19441" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8610"/><l level="1" sID="gen19442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8610"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a wind too strong for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a wind strong more than”</note> these will come for me,<l eID="gen19442" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19443"/>now also I speak judgments against them.” <l eID="gen19443" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8611"/><l level="1" sID="gen19444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8611"/>Look, he comes up like the clouds,<l eID="gen19444" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19445"/>and his chariots <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like the whirlwind,<l eID="gen19445" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19446"/>his horses are swifter than eagles,<l eID="gen19446" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19447"/>woe to us, for we are devastated. <l eID="gen19447" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8612"/><l level="1" sID="gen19448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8612"/>Cleanse your heart from wickedness, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Jerusalem,<l eID="gen19448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19449"/>so that you may be saved.<l eID="gen19449" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19450"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until when”</note> will your thoughts of mischief<l eID="gen19450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19451"/>dwell in your inner part? <l eID="gen19451" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8613"/><l level="1" sID="gen19452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8613"/>For a voice <transChange type="added">is</transChange> declaring from Dan,<l eID="gen19452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19453"/>and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> proclaiming disaster from the mountain of Ephraim. <l eID="gen19453" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8614"/><l level="1" sID="gen19454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8614"/>“Report to the nations, ‘Here they are!’<l eID="gen19454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19455"/>Proclaim against Jerusalem,<l eID="gen19455" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19456"/>‘Besiegers <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from a distant land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from a land the distance place”</note><l eID="gen19456" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19457"/>and they raise their voice against the cities of Judah.’ <l eID="gen19457" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8615"/><l level="1" sID="gen19458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8615"/>Like watchers of a field they were against her from all around,<l eID="gen19458" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19459"/>because she has rebelled against me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen19459" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8616"/><l level="1" sID="gen19460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8616"/>“You obtained this for yourself<l eID="gen19460" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19461"/><transChange type="added">because of</transChange> your way and your deeds.<l eID="gen19461" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19462"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your doom, for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> bitter,<l eID="gen19462" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19463"/>yes, it has reached up to your heart.” <l eID="gen19463" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8617"/><l level="1" sID="gen19464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8617"/>My bowels, my bowels! I writhe!<l eID="gen19464" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19465"/>The walls of my heart!<l eID="gen19465" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19466"/>My heart is restless within me, I cannot keep silent,<l eID="gen19466" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19467"/>for I hear <transChange type="added">in</transChange> my inner self the sound of a horn, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> alarm of war. <l eID="gen19467" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8618"/><l level="1" sID="gen19468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8618"/>Destruction on destruction is proclaimed,<l eID="gen19468" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19469"/>for all of the land is devastated.<l eID="gen19469" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19470"/>Suddenly my tents are devastated,<l eID="gen19470" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19471"/>my tent curtains in a moment. <l eID="gen19471" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8619"/><l level="1" sID="gen19472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8619"/>How long must I see <transChange type="added">the</transChange> banner,<l eID="gen19472" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19473"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> hear <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of a horn? <l eID="gen19473" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8620"/><l level="1" sID="gen19474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8620"/>“For my people <transChange type="added">are</transChange> foolish,<l eID="gen19474" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19475"/>they have not known me.<l eID="gen19475" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19476"/>They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> foolish children,<l eID="gen19476" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19477"/>and they do not have insight.<l eID="gen19477" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19478"/>They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> skillful at doing evil,<l eID="gen19478" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19479"/>and they do not know <transChange type="added">how</transChange> to do good.” <l eID="gen19479" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8621"/><l level="1" sID="gen19480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8621"/>I looked at the earth, and behold, it was wasteland and emptiness,<l eID="gen19480" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19481"/>and to the heavens, and <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> without their light. <l eID="gen19481" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8622"/><l level="1" sID="gen19482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8622"/>I looked at the mountains, and behold, they were quaking,<l eID="gen19482" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19483"/>and all of the hills were jolted to and fro. <l eID="gen19483" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8623"/><l level="1" sID="gen19484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8623"/>I looked and behold, there was no person,<l eID="gen19484" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19485"/>and all of the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the sky had fled. <l eID="gen19485" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8624"/><l level="1" sID="gen19486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8624"/>I looked and behold, the fruitful land <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note><l eID="gen19486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19487"/>and all of its cities were ruined before Yahweh,<l eID="gen19487" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19488"/>before the face of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his burning anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the blaze of his nose”</note> <l eID="gen19488" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8625"/><l level="1" sID="gen19489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8625"/>For thus says Yahweh, “All of the land will be a desolation,<l eID="gen19489" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19490"/>yet I will not make a complete desolation. <l eID="gen19490" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8626"/><l level="1" sID="gen19491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8626"/>Because of this the earth will mourn,<l eID="gen19491" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19492"/>and the heavens above will become dark.<l eID="gen19492" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19493"/>Because I have spoken, I have planned,<l eID="gen19493" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19494"/>and I have not relented, and I will not turn back from it.” <l eID="gen19494" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8627"/><l level="1" sID="gen19495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8627"/>From the sound of a horseman and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an archer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one who shoots arrows of a bow”</note> every town flees,<l eID="gen19495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19496"/>they enter in the thickets and among the rocks they climb.<l eID="gen19496" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19497"/>Every town <transChange type="added">is</transChange> forsaken,<l eID="gen19497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19498"/>and there is no person <transChange type="added">who</transChange> lives in them. <l eID="gen19498" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8628"/><l level="1" sID="gen19499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8628"/>And you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> devastated one, what <transChange type="added">do</transChange> you do,<l eID="gen19499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19500"/>that you put on crimson,<l eID="gen19500" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19501"/>that you adorn yourself <transChange type="added">with</transChange> ornaments of gold,<l eID="gen19501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19502"/>that you make your eyes look bigger with the eye make-up?<l eID="gen19502" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19503"/>In vain you beautify yourself.<l eID="gen19503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19504"/><transChange type="added">Your</transChange> lovers reject you;<l eID="gen19504" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19505"/>they seek your life. <l eID="gen19505" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8629"/><l level="1" sID="gen19506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8629"/>For I heard a voice like an ill woman,<l eID="gen19506" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19507"/>anxiety like <transChange type="added">a woman who</transChange> bears her first child,<l eID="gen19507" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19508"/>the voice of the daughter of Zion.<l eID="gen19508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19509"/>She is gasping for breath,<l eID="gen19509" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19510"/>she is spreading out her hands:<l eID="gen19510" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19511"/>“Woe is me, for I am becoming tired<note placement="foot">Or “fainting”</note> before killers.” <l eID="gen19511" level="1"/><lg eID="gen19437"/> <chapter eID="Jer.4"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:1
verses.text: “Roam about through the streets of Jerusalem,<l eID="gen19514" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19515"/>and look please, and take note,<l eID="gen19515" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19516"/>and search at its public squares,<l eID="gen19516" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19517"/>if you can find a person <transChange type="added">who</transChange> does justice,<l eID="gen19517" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19518"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> seeks honesty,<l eID="gen19518" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19519"/>so that I may forgive it. <l eID="gen19519" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8630"/><l level="1" sID="gen19520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8630"/>And though they say, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As Yahweh lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,’<note placement="foot">Literally “Life of Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen19520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19521"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to thus”</note> they swear falsely.” <l eID="gen19521" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8631"/><l level="1" sID="gen19522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8631"/><transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, do not your eyes <transChange type="added">look</transChange> for honesty?<l eID="gen19522" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19523"/>You have struck them, but they felt no pain,<l eID="gen19523" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19524"/>you have destroyed them, they refused to take discipline.<l eID="gen19524" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19525"/>They have hardened their faces more than rock,<l eID="gen19525" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19526"/>they have refused to turn back. <l eID="gen19526" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8632"/><l level="1" sID="gen19527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8632"/>Then I said, “<transChange type="added">They are</transChange> just simple people,<l eID="gen19527" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19528"/>they are foolish,<l eID="gen19528" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19529"/>for they know not the way of Yahweh,<l eID="gen19529" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19530"/>the law<note placement="foot">Or “ordinance”</note> of their God. <l eID="gen19530" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8633"/><l level="1" sID="gen19531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8633"/>Let me go to the great,<l eID="gen19531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19532"/>and let me speak with them,<l eID="gen19532" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19533"/>for they know the way of Yahweh,<l eID="gen19533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19534"/>the law<note placement="foot">Or “ordinance”</note> of their God.”<l eID="gen19534" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19535"/>However, they together have broken <transChange type="added">the</transChange> yoke,<l eID="gen19535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19536"/>they have torn to pieces <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bonds. <l eID="gen19536" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8634"/><l level="1" sID="gen19537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8634"/>Therefore a lion from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> forest will kill them,<l eID="gen19537" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19538"/>A wolf <transChange type="added">from the</transChange> desert plains<note placement="foot">Or “Arabah”</note> will devastate them.<l eID="gen19538" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19539"/>A leopard <transChange type="added">is</transChange> watching their cities,<l eID="gen19539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19540"/>everyone <transChange type="added">who</transChange> goes out from there will be torn,<l eID="gen19540" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19541"/>because their transgressions are many,<l eID="gen19541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19542"/>their apostasies are numerous. <l eID="gen19542" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8635"/><l level="1" sID="gen19543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8635"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Why to this”</note> can I forgive you?<l eID="gen19543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19544"/>Your children have forsaken me,<l eID="gen19544" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19545"/>and they have sworn by <transChange type="added">those who are</transChange> not gods.<l eID="gen19545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19546"/>But I fed them to the full,<l eID="gen19546" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19547"/>and they committed adultery,<l eID="gen19547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19548"/>and flocked <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of a prostitute. <l eID="gen19548" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8636"/><l level="1" sID="gen19549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8636"/>They were well-fed lusty horses,<l eID="gen19549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19550"/>they neighed each to the wife of his neighbor. <l eID="gen19550" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8637"/><l level="1" sID="gen19551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8637"/>Because of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> shall I not punish?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19552"/>“and on a nation who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like this, shall I not take revenge? <l eID="gen19552" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8638"/><l level="1" sID="gen19553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8638"/>Go up through her vineyards and destroy,<l eID="gen19553" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19554"/>but you must not make complete destruction.<l eID="gen19554" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19555"/>Remove her branches,<l eID="gen19555" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19556"/>for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not to Yahweh. <l eID="gen19556" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8639"/><l level="1" sID="gen19557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8639"/>For the house of Israel and the house of Judah<l eID="gen19557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19558"/>have dealt utterly treacherously with me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen19558" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8640"/><l level="1" sID="gen19559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8640"/>“They have denied Yahweh, and have said,<l eID="gen19559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19560"/>‘Not he, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> evil will not come on us,<l eID="gen19560" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19561"/>we will see neither sword nor famine. <l eID="gen19561" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8641"/><l level="1" sID="gen19562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8641"/>And the prophets are like wind,<l eID="gen19562" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19563"/>and the word <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not in them.’<l eID="gen19563" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19564"/>Thus it will be done to them.” <l eID="gen19564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8642"/><l level="1" sID="gen19565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8642"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh, the God of hosts,<l eID="gen19565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19566"/>“Because you have spoken this word,<l eID="gen19566" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19567"/>look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> making my words in your mouth like a fire,<l eID="gen19567" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19568"/>and this people wood, and it will devour them. <l eID="gen19568" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8643"/><l level="1" sID="gen19569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8643"/>Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to bring on you a nation from afar,<l eID="gen19569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19570"/><transChange type="added">O</transChange> house of Israel,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen19570" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19571"/>“It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an enduring nation, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an ancient nation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a nation from a long time ago”</note><l eID="gen19571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19572"/>A nation whose language you do not know,<l eID="gen19572" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19573"/>and you cannot understand what they speak. <l eID="gen19573" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8644"/><l level="1" sID="gen19574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8644"/>Their quiver <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like an open tomb,<l eID="gen19574" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19575"/>all of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> warriors. <l eID="gen19575" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8645"/><l level="1" sID="gen19576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8645"/>And they will eat your harvest and your food,<l eID="gen19576" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19577"/>they will eat your sons and your daughters,<l eID="gen19577" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19578"/>they will eat your flock and your herd,<l eID="gen19578" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19579"/>they will eat your vine and your fig tree,<l eID="gen19579" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19580"/>they will smash with the sword <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your fortified cities⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the cities of your fortification”</note><l eID="gen19580" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19581"/>in which you trust. <l eID="gen19581" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19513"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8646"/><div sID="gen19582" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8646"/>“But even in those days,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “I will not make you a complete destruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> when you people say, ‘Why has Yahweh our God done all of these things to us?’ Then you will say to them, ‘As you have forsaken me and have served gods of a foreign land in your land, so will you serve strangers in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a land that does not belong to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “a land not to you”</note>  <div eID="gen19582" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8647"/><lg sID="gen19583"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8647"/>“Declare this in the house of Jacob,<l eID="gen19584" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19585"/>and proclaim it in Judah, saying, <l eID="gen19585" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8648"/><l level="1" sID="gen19586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8648"/>‘Hear this please, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> foolish and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞senseless⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “without heart”</note> people,<l eID="gen19586" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19587"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who have eyes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “eyes for them”</note> but do not see,<l eID="gen19587" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19588"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who have ears⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “ears for them”</note> but do not hear.’ <l eID="gen19588" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8649"/><l level="1" sID="gen19589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8649"/>Do you not revere me?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19590"/>“Do you not tremble <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of me”</note><l eID="gen19590" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19591"/>For I have placed <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sand <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a boundary for the sea,<l eID="gen19591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19592"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as an everlasting limit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a limit of eternity”</note> and it cannot pass over it,<l eID="gen19592" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19593"/>and they rise and fall loudly, but they cannot prevail,<l eID="gen19593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19594"/>and its waves roar, but they cannot pass over it. <l eID="gen19594" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8650"/><l level="1" sID="gen19595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8650"/>But for this people is a stubborn and rebellious heart,<l eID="gen19595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19596"/>they have turned aside and have gone <transChange type="added">away</transChange>. <l eID="gen19596" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8651"/><l level="1" sID="gen19597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8651"/>And they do not say in their hearts,<l eID="gen19597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19598"/>‘Let us fear please Yahweh our God,<l eID="gen19598" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19599"/>the <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> gives <transChange type="added">the</transChange> autumn rain<note placement="foot">Hebrew “early rain”</note> and the spring rain<note placement="foot">Hebrew “late rain”</note> in its season,<l eID="gen19599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19600"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the set times of the harvest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “weeks due harvest”</note> he keeps for us.’ <l eID="gen19600" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8652"/><l level="1" sID="gen19601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8652"/>Your iniquities have disturbed these,<l eID="gen19601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19602"/>and your sins have kept away the good from you. <l eID="gen19602" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8653"/><l level="1" sID="gen19603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8653"/>For wicked people are found among my people,<l eID="gen19603" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19604"/>they lie in wait like the hiding of fowlers,<l eID="gen19604" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19605"/>they set up a trap,<l eID="gen19605" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19606"/>they catch humans. <l eID="gen19606" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8654"/><l level="1" sID="gen19607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8654"/>Like a cage full of birds,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note><l eID="gen19607" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19608"/>so their houses <transChange type="added">are</transChange> full of fraud.<l eID="gen19608" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19609"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> they have become great,<l eID="gen19609" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19610"/>and they have become rich. <l eID="gen19610" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8655"/><l level="1" sID="gen19611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8655"/>They have grown fat,<l eID="gen19611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19612"/>they have grown sleek,<l eID="gen19612" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19613"/>also, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their evil deeds have no limit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they cross over evil deeds”</note><l eID="gen19613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19614"/>They do not judge <transChange type="added">with</transChange> justice,<l eID="gen19614" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19615"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> legal cause of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan,<l eID="gen19615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19616"/>or allow it to succeed,<l eID="gen19616" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19617"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> legal case of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor,<l eID="gen19617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19618"/>they do not defend. <l eID="gen19618" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8656"/><l level="1" sID="gen19619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8656"/>Because of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> shall I not punish?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19620"/>“and on a nation who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like this, shall I not take revenge? <l eID="gen19620" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8657"/><l level="1" sID="gen19621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8657"/>A horrific event and something horrible has happened in the land. <l eID="gen19621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8658"/><l level="1" sID="gen19622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8658"/>The prophets prophesy <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the lie”</note><l eID="gen19622" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19623"/>and the priests rule <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by their own authority⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “by their hands”</note><l eID="gen19623" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19624"/>and my people love <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> so much.<l eID="gen19624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19625"/>But what will you do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the end comes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “to end her”</note> <l eID="gen19625" level="2"/><lg eID="gen19583"/> <chapter eID="Jer.5"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:1
verses.text: Flee for safety, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> children of Benjamin,<l eID="gen19628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19629"/>from the midst of Jerusalem.<l eID="gen19629" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19630"/>And in Tekoa blow a horn,<l eID="gen19630" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19631"/>and on Beth-haccherem lift up a signal,<l eID="gen19631" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19632"/>for evil looks down from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,<l eID="gen19632" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19633"/>and a great destruction. <l eID="gen19633" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8659"/><l level="1" sID="gen19634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8659"/>The lovely and the delicate,<l eID="gen19634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19635"/>the daughter of Jerusalem, I will destroy. <l eID="gen19635" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:3
