verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8660"/><l level="1" sID="gen19636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8660"/>Shepherds and their flocks will come against her,<l eID="gen19636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19637"/>they will pitch <transChange type="added">their</transChange> tents against her all around,<l eID="gen19637" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19638"/>they will pasture, each his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞portion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> <l eID="gen19638" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8661"/><l level="1" sID="gen19639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8661"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Sanctify⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “Consecrate”</note> war against her.<l eID="gen19639" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19640"/>Arise, and let us attack at noon.<l eID="gen19640" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19641"/>Woe to us, for the day turns,<l eID="gen19641" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19642"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shadows of evening are lengthened. <l eID="gen19642" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8662"/><l level="1" sID="gen19643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8662"/>Arise, and let us attack by night,<l eID="gen19643" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19644"/>and let us destroy her citadel fortresses.” <l eID="gen19644" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8663"/><l level="1" sID="gen19645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8663"/>For thus says Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen19645" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19646"/>“Cut down trees and heap up a siege ramp against Jerusalem.<l eID="gen19646" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19647"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the city that must be punished,<l eID="gen19647" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19648"/>its oppression <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in its midst. <l eID="gen19648" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8664"/><l level="1" sID="gen19649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8664"/>As a water well keeps its water cool,<l eID="gen19649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19650"/>so she keeps cool her wickedness.<l eID="gen19650" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19651"/>Violence and destruction are heard within her,<l eID="gen19651" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19652"/>sickness and wounds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wound”</note> are continually <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “at the face of me”</note> <l eID="gen19652" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8665"/><l level="1" sID="gen19653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8665"/>Be warned, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Jerusalem,<l eID="gen19653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19654"/>lest I turn away from you in disgust,<l eID="gen19654" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19655"/>lest I make you a desolation,<l eID="gen19655" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19656"/>a land that is not inhabited.” <l eID="gen19656" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8666"/><l level="1" sID="gen19657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8666"/>Thus says Yahweh of hosts:<l eID="gen19657" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19658"/>“They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine,<l eID="gen19658" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19659"/>turn back your hand over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> branches like a grape-gatherer. <l eID="gen19659" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8667"/><l level="1" sID="gen19660"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8667"/>To whom shall I speak and admonish,<l eID="gen19660" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19661"/>that they may hear?<l eID="gen19661" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19662"/>Look, their ears <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞closed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “uncircumcised”</note><l eID="gen19662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19663"/>and they are not able to listen attentively.<l eID="gen19663" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19664"/>Look, the word of Yahweh is to them an object of scorn,<l eID="gen19664" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19665"/>they do not delight in it. <l eID="gen19665" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8668"/><l level="1" sID="gen19666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8668"/>But I am full with the wrath of Yahweh,<l eID="gen19666" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19667"/>I struggle to hold <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> in.<l eID="gen19667" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19668"/>Pour <transChange type="added">it</transChange> out on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children<note placement="foot">Hebrew “child”</note> in the street,<l eID="gen19668" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19669"/>and on the assemblies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “assembly”</note> of young men at the same time.<l eID="gen19669" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19670"/>For even husband with wife will get trapped,<l eID="gen19670" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19671"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> old with <transChange type="added">him who is</transChange> full of days. <l eID="gen19671" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8669"/><l level="1" sID="gen19672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8669"/>And their houses will be turned over to others,<l eID="gen19672" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19673"/><transChange type="added">their</transChange> fields and <transChange type="added">their</transChange> wives together.<l eID="gen19673" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19674"/>For I will stretch out my hand<l eID="gen19674" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19675"/>against the inhabitants of the land,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen19675" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8670"/><l level="1" sID="gen19676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8670"/>“For from the smallest of them to the greatest of them,<l eID="gen19676" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19677"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of him”</note> makes profit for unlawful gain.<l eID="gen19677" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19678"/>And from the prophet to the priest,<l eID="gen19678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19679"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of him”</note> practices deceit. <l eID="gen19679" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8671"/><l level="1" sID="gen19680"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8671"/>And they have treated the wound of my people lightly,<l eID="gen19680" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19681"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Peace, peace,’ but there is no peace. <l eID="gen19681" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8672"/><l level="1" sID="gen19682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8672"/>Have they acted ashamed, for they have committed a detestable thing?<l eID="gen19682" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19683"/>Not at all, nor were they ashamed; they did not know to feel humiliated.<l eID="gen19683" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19684"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> they will fall among <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> fall at the time I punish them,<l eID="gen19684" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19685"/>they will stumble,” says Yahweh. <l eID="gen19685" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8673"/><l level="1" sID="gen19686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8673"/>Thus says Yahweh: “Stand at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> roads and look,<l eID="gen19686" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19687"/>and ask for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ancient paths, where the way of the good <transChange type="added">is</transChange>,<l eID="gen19687" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19688"/>and walk in it, and find rest for your inner selves.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inner self”</note><l eID="gen19688" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19689"/>But they said, ‘We will not walk <transChange type="added">in it</transChange>.’<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> <l eID="gen19689" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8674"/><l level="1" sID="gen19690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8674"/>And I raised up watchmen over you:<l eID="gen19690" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19691"/>‘Listen attentively to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of a horn.’<l eID="gen19691" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19692"/>But they said, ‘We will not listen attentively.’ <l eID="gen19692" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8675"/><l level="1" sID="gen19693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8675"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> hear, O nations, and know, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> community,<l eID="gen19693" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19694"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what will happen to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “what among them”</note> <l eID="gen19694" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8676"/><l level="1" sID="gen19695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8676"/>Hear, O earth,<l eID="gen19695" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19696"/>look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to bring disaster to this people,<l eID="gen19696" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19697"/>the fruit of their plans,<l eID="gen19697" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19698"/>because they have not listened attentively to my words,<l eID="gen19698" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19699"/>and my teaching, they have rejected it also. <l eID="gen19699" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8677"/><l level="1" sID="gen19700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8677"/>What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this to me?<l eID="gen19700" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19701"/>Frankincense comes from Sheba,<l eID="gen19701" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19702"/>and the precious spice reed from a distant land.<l eID="gen19702" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19703"/>Your burnt offerings <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞acceptable⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for acceptance”</note><l eID="gen19703" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19704"/>your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.” <l eID="gen19704" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8678"/><l level="1" sID="gen19705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8678"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh:<l eID="gen19705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19706"/>“Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to put before this people stumbling blocks,<l eID="gen19706" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19707"/>and they will stumble against them,<l eID="gen19707" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19708"/>fathers and children together,<l eID="gen19708" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19709"/>neighbor and his friend will perish.” <l eID="gen19709" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8679"/><l level="1" sID="gen19710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8679"/>Thus says Yahweh:<l eID="gen19710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19711"/>“Look, a people <transChange type="added">is</transChange> coming from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,<l eID="gen19711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19712"/>a great nation is woken up from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> farthest part of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen19712" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8680"/><l level="1" sID="gen19713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8680"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> bow and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> short sword they grasp <transChange type="added">are</transChange> cruel,<l eID="gen19713" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19714"/>and they show no mercy.<l eID="gen19714" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19715"/>Their sound roars like the sea, and on horses they ride,<l eID="gen19715" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19716"/>drawn up like a man for battle against you, O daughter of Zion.” <l eID="gen19716" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8681"/><l level="1" sID="gen19717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8681"/>We have heard news of it,<l eID="gen19717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19718"/>our hands grow slack,<l eID="gen19718" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19719"/>anxiety has grasped us,<l eID="gen19719" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19720"/>pain as a <transChange type="added">woman who</transChange> gives birth. <l eID="gen19720" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8682"/><l level="1" sID="gen19721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8682"/>You must not go out <transChange type="added">into</transChange> the field,<l eID="gen19721" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19722"/>and you must not walk on the road,<l eID="gen19722" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19723"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the enemy has a sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a sword for enemy”</note><l eID="gen19723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19724"/>terror <transChange type="added">is</transChange> all around. <l eID="gen19724" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8683"/><l level="1" sID="gen19725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8683"/>O daughter of my people,<l eID="gen19725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19726"/>gird yourself <transChange type="added">with</transChange> sackcloth,<l eID="gen19726" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19727"/>and roll about in the ashes in mourning,<l eID="gen19727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19728"/>a mourning ceremony <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> an only child.<l eID="gen19728" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19729"/>Make for yourself wailing of bitterness,<l eID="gen19729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19730"/>for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us. <l eID="gen19730" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8684"/><l level="1" sID="gen19731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8684"/>“I have made you an assayer among my people, a fortification,<l eID="gen19731" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19732"/>so that you may know and put to the test their ways.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “way”</note> <l eID="gen19732" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8685"/><l level="1" sID="gen19733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8685"/>All of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> stubborn rebels,<l eID="gen19733" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19734"/>going about <transChange type="added">talking</transChange> slander.<l eID="gen19734" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19735"/><transChange type="added">They are</transChange> bronze and iron,<l eID="gen19735" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19736"/>they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all behaving corruptly. <l eID="gen19736" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8686"/><l level="1" sID="gen19737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8686"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> bellows<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bellow”</note> are burned up,<l eID="gen19737" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19738"/>lead is consumed by fire.<l eID="gen19738" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19739"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In vain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To the vanity”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he keeps on refining⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he refines refining”</note><l eID="gen19739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19740"/>but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked are not torn apart. <l eID="gen19740" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8687"/><l level="1" sID="gen19741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8687"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They are called⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “They call to them”</note> rejected silver,<l eID="gen19741" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19742"/>For Yahweh has rejected them.” <l eID="gen19742" level="2"/><lg eID="gen19627"/> <chapter eID="Jer.6"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8688"/><title type="x-s">Jeremiah’s Proclamation at the Gate of the House of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen19743" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8688"/>The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:2
verses.text: “Stand in the gate of the house of Yahweh and proclaim there this word, and say, ‘Hear the word of Yahweh, all of Judah, <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> enter through these gates to bow in worship to Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:3
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, “Make your ways and your deeds good and let me dwell with you in this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:4
verses.text: Do not trust in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the deceitful words⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the words of the deception”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘The temple of Yahweh, the temple of Yahweh, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the temple of Yahweh.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:5
verses.text: For if you truly make your ways and your deeds good, if you truly do justice between a man and his neighbor,

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:6
verses.text: you do not oppress <transChange type="added">the</transChange> alien, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow, you do not shed innocent blood in this place, and you do not go after other gods <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to your harm⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to harm to you”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:7
verses.text: then I will let you dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from eternity and until eternity”</note>  <div eID="gen19743" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8689"/><div sID="gen19744" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8689"/>Look, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> relying for yourselves on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deceitful words⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the words of the deception”</note> without benefiting.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:9
verses.text: Will you steal? Will you murder? And will you commit adultery? And will you swear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “to the lie”</note> And will you make a smoke offering to the Baal? And will you go after other gods whom you have not known?

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:10
verses.text: And then you come and you stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> me in this house, which is called <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by my name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “my name over it”</note> and you say, ‘we are safe <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to go on doing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the sake of the doing of”</note> all of these detestable things.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:11
verses.text: Has this house, which is called <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by my name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “my name over it”</note> become a cave of robbers in your eyes? Look, I, even I, have seen it,”<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen19744" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8690"/><div sID="gen19745" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8690"/>“For go now to my place that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell in the beginning, and see what I did to it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from face”</note> the wickedness of my people Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:13
verses.text: And now, because of your doing all these things,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have spoken to you over and over again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I spoke to you doing early and speaking”</note> and you have not listened, and I called you, and you have not answered,

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:14
verses.text: therefore I will do to the house that is called <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by my name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “my name over it”</note> in which you are trusting, and to the place that I gave to you and to your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> I did to Shiloh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:15
verses.text: And I will cast you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞out of my sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from at my face”</note> just as I cast out all of your blood relatives,<note placement="foot">Or “brothers”</note> all of the offspring of Ephraim.” ’  <div eID="gen19745" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8691"/><div sID="gen19746" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8691"/>“And you, you must not pray for this people, and you must not lift up for them a cry of entreaty or a prayer, and you must not plead with me, for I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> not hear you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Do</transChange> you not see what they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:18
verses.text: The children <transChange type="added">are</transChange> gathering wood, and the fathers <transChange type="added">are</transChange> kindling the fire, and the women <transChange type="added">are</transChange> kneading dough to make sacrificial cakes for the queen of heaven, and they pour out libations to other gods for the sake of provoking me to anger.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> they provoking me to anger? ” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “<transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not themselves <transChange type="added">they hurt</transChange>, for the sake of the shame of their faces?”

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:20
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Look, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on the humankind, and on the animal, and on the tree of the field, and on the fruit of the ground, and it will not be extinguished.”  <div eID="gen19746" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8692"/><div sID="gen19747" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8692"/>Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flesh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:22
verses.text: For I did not speak with your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> nor did I command them in the day of bringing them out from the land of Egypt, concerning the matter of burnt offering and sacrifice.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:23
verses.text: But I only commanded them this word, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Obey my voice, and I will be to you God, and you will be to me people, and you must walk in all of the way that I command you, so that it goes well with you.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:24
verses.text: Yet they did not obey, and they did not incline their ear, but they walked in <transChange type="added">their own</transChange> plans, in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they became worse instead of better⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they were to backward and not to face”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:25
verses.text: From the day that your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> came out from the land of Egypt until this day I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, day after day, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sending again and again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “doing early and sending”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:26
verses.text: Yet they have not listened to me and they have not inclined their ear, but they have hardened their neck, they did more evil than their ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:27
verses.text: So you shall speak to them all these words, but they will not listen to you, and you shall call to them, but they will not answer you.  <div eID="gen19747" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8693"/><title type="x-s">The Valley of the Slaughter</title> <div sID="gen19748" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8693"/>“And you shall say to them, ‘This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the nation that has not obeyed the voice of Yahweh their God, and they have not accepted discipline. The truth has perished, and it is cut off from their mouths.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mouth”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:29
verses.text: Shear your hair and throw <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> away, and lift up a lament on the barren heights, for Yahweh has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:30
verses.text: For the people<note placement="foot">Or “children”</note> of Judah have done evil in my eyes,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “They have set their abominations in the house that is called <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by my name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “my name over it”</note> to defile it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:31
verses.text: And they built the high place of Topheth, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Valley of Ben Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I have not commanded, and it did not come into my mind.<note placement="foot">Or “heart”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:32
verses.text: Therefore look, days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to come,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and it will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of the Slaughter, and they will bury in Topheth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until there is no more place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from there is no place”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:33
verses.text: And the dead bodies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “body”</note> of this people will be as food for the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the heavens,<note placement="foot">Or “sky”</note> and for the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the earth, without anyone to scare them<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> away.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:34
verses.text: And I will cause to disappear from the towns of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of jubilation, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of joy, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bridegroom, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bride, for the land will become a site of ruins.  <chapter eID="Jer.7"/> <div eID="gen19748" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:1
verses.text: “At that time,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of its officials, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Judah from their graves.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:2
verses.text: And they shall spread them out before the sun, and before the moon, and before all the host of heaven, which they have loved, and which they have served, and which they have gone after, and which they have inquired about, and to which they have bowed in worship. They shall not be gathered, and they shall not be buried; they will be like dung on the surface of the ground.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:3
verses.text: And death will be preferred to life by all the remaining of this evil clan<note placement="foot">Or “family”</note> in all the remaining places where I have driven them away,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen19749" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8694"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Questions His People</title> <div sID="gen19750" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8694"/>“And you shall say to them, ‘Thus asks<note placement="foot">Or “says”</note> Yahweh: <div eID="gen19750" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19751"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19752"/>“Do men fall and not stand up?<l eID="gen19752" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19753"/>If one turns away does he not return? <l eID="gen19753" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8695"/><l level="1" sID="gen19754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8695"/>Why has this people, Jerusalem, turned away <transChange type="added">in</transChange> enduring apostasy?<l eID="gen19754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19755"/>They have kept hold of deceit, they have refused to return.<note placement="foot">Or “repent”</note> <l eID="gen19755" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8696"/><l level="1" sID="gen19756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8696"/>I have listened attentively,<l eID="gen19756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19757"/>and I have listened.<l eID="gen19757" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19758"/>They do not speak honestly,<l eID="gen19758" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19759"/>there is no man <transChange type="added">who</transChange> regrets his wickedness, saying, ‘What have I done?’<l eID="gen19759" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19760"/>All of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> turning to their ways of running,<l eID="gen19760" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19761"/>like a horse plunging into battle. <l eID="gen19761" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8697"/><l level="1" sID="gen19762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8697"/>Even <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stork in heaven knows its appointed time,<l eID="gen19762" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19763"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> turtledove, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> swallow, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> song bird,<l eID="gen19763" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19764"/>they observe the time of their coming.<l eID="gen19764" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19765"/>But my people do not know the ordinance<note placement="foot">Or “law”</note> of Yahweh. <l eID="gen19765" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8698"/><l level="1" sID="gen19766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8698"/>How can you say, ‘We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> wise and the law of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with us’?<l eID="gen19766" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19767"/>Look, surely <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the lying stylus of the scribes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “stylus of lie of scribes”</note> has made it a lie. <l eID="gen19767" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8699"/><l level="1" sID="gen19768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8699"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> wise will be put to shame,<l eID="gen19768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19769"/>they will be dismayed,<l eID="gen19769" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19770"/>and they will get taken.<l eID="gen19770" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19771"/>Look, they have rejected the word of Yahweh,<l eID="gen19771" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19772"/>and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wisdom to them? <l eID="gen19772" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8700"/><l level="1" sID="gen19773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8700"/>Therefore I will give their wives to others,<l eID="gen19773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19774"/>their fields to conquerors,<l eID="gen19774" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19775"/>because from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> smallest to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> greatest,<l eID="gen19775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19776"/>all of them make profit <transChange type="added">for</transChange> unlawful gain,<l eID="gen19776" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19777"/>from prophet to priest,<l eID="gen19777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19778"/>all of them practice deceit. <l eID="gen19778" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8701"/><l level="1" sID="gen19779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8701"/>And they have treated the wound of the daughter of my people lightly,<l eID="gen19779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19780"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Peace, peace,’ but there is no peace. <l eID="gen19780" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8702"/><l level="1" sID="gen19781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8702"/>Were they ashamed, for they had committed a detestable thing?<l eID="gen19781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19782"/>What’s worse,<note placement="foot">Or “also”</note> they were not ashamed at all,<l eID="gen19782" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19783"/>and they did not know to feel humiliated.<l eID="gen19783" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19784"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> they will fall among <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> fall;<l eID="gen19784" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19785"/>at the time of their punishment they will stumble,” says Yahweh. <l eID="gen19785" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8703"/><l level="1" sID="gen19786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8703"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will take away their harvest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “I will take away, I will make an end to them”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen19786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19787"/>“There are no grapes on the vine,<l eID="gen19787" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19788"/>and there are no figs on the fig tree,<l eID="gen19788" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19789"/>and the leaves wither,<l eID="gen19789" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19790"/>and <transChange type="added">what</transChange> I gave to them passed over them.” ’ ”<l eID="gen19790" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19751"/> <title type="x-s">The Nation Longs for Yahweh’s Help</title> <div sID="gen19791" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen19791" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8704"/><lg sID="gen19792"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8704"/>Why <transChange type="added">are</transChange> we sitting?<l eID="gen19793" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19794"/>Gather, and let us go into the fortified cities,<l eID="gen19794" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19795"/>and let us perish there,<l eID="gen19795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19796"/>for Yahweh our God has caused us to perish,<l eID="gen19796" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19797"/>and has provided drink for us, water of poison,<l eID="gen19797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19798"/>because we have sinned against Yahweh. <l eID="gen19798" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8705"/><l level="1" sID="gen19799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8705"/><transChange type="added">We</transChange> hope for peace,<l eID="gen19799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19800"/>but there is no good,<l eID="gen19800" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19801"/>for a time of healing,<l eID="gen19801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19802"/>but there is terror. <l eID="gen19802" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8706"/><l level="1" sID="gen19803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8706"/>“From Dan is heard the snorting of their horses,<l eID="gen19803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19804"/>from the sound of the neighing of their stallions all the land quakes,<l eID="gen19804" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19805"/>for they come and devour the land,<l eID="gen19805" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19806"/>and that which fills <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city,<l eID="gen19806" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19807"/>and <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> live in it. <l eID="gen19807" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8707"/><l level="1" sID="gen19808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8707"/>For look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> letting loose among you snakes,<l eID="gen19808" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19809"/>adders for which there is no incantation,<l eID="gen19809" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19810"/>and they will bite you,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen19810" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8708"/><l level="1" sID="gen19811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8708"/>“My comfort <transChange type="added">is gone</transChange> from me,<l eID="gen19811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19812"/>sorrow <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on me,<l eID="gen19812" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19813"/>my heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sick. <l eID="gen19813" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8709"/><l level="1" sID="gen19814"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8709"/>Look, the sound of the cry for help of the daughter of my people<l eID="gen19814" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19815"/>from a distant land,<l eID="gen19815" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19816"/>‘Is Yahweh not in Zion?<l eID="gen19816" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19817"/>Is her king not in her?’<l eID="gen19817" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19818"/>Why have they provoked me to anger with their images,<l eID="gen19818" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19819"/>with idols of a foreign land?” <l eID="gen19819" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8710"/><l level="1" sID="gen19820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8710"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> harvest has passed,<l eID="gen19820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19821"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> summer has come to an end,<l eID="gen19821" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19822"/>and we have not received help.<note placement="foot">Or “been saved”</note><l eID="gen19822" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen19792"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Lament</title> <div sID="gen19823" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen19823" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8711"/><lg sID="gen19824"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8711"/>“Because of the wound of the daughter of my people I am broken down,<l eID="gen19825" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19826"/>I mourn, horror has seized me. <l eID="gen19826" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8712"/><l level="1" sID="gen19827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8712"/>Is there no balm in Gilead?<l eID="gen19827" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19828"/>Is there no healer there?<l eID="gen19828" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19829"/>Why, then, has the healing of the daughter of my people not been restored? <l eID="gen19829" level="1"/><lg eID="gen19824"/> <chapter eID="Jer.8"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:1
verses.text: <note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Jer.9.1-Jer.9.26">Jeremiah 9:1–26 </reference>in the English Bible is 8:23–9:25 in the Hebrew Bible</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Oh that my head were waters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Who he gives my head waters”</note><l eID="gen19832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19833"/>and my eyes a fountain of tears,<l eID="gen19833" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19834"/>so that I might weep day and night,<l eID="gen19834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19835"/><transChange type="added">for</transChange> the slain of the daughter of my people. <l eID="gen19835" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8713"/><l level="1" sID="gen19836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8713"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Oh that I had⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who he gives me”</note> in the desert a place of overnight lodging for travelers,<l eID="gen19836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19837"/>that I may leave my people and go from them,<l eID="gen19837" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19838"/>for all of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> adulterers,<l eID="gen19838" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19839"/>a band of traitors. <l eID="gen19839" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8714"/><l level="1" sID="gen19840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8714"/>And they bend their tongue <transChange type="added">like</transChange> their bow,<l eID="gen19840" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19841"/><transChange type="added">for</transChange> falsehood and not truth is superior in the land,<l eID="gen19841" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19842"/>for they go forth<note placement="foot">Or “proceed”</note> from evil to evil,<l eID="gen19842" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19843"/>and they do not know me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen19843" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19831"/> <title type="x-s">A Nation Characterized by Deceit</title> <div sID="gen19844" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen19844" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8715"/><lg sID="gen19845"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8715"/>“Let everyone be on your guard against his neighbor,<l eID="gen19846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19847"/>and you must not trust in any brother,<l eID="gen19847" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19848"/>for everyone surely betrays,<l eID="gen19848" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19849"/>and every neighbor goes about <transChange type="added">with</transChange> slander. <l eID="gen19849" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8716"/><l level="1" sID="gen19850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8716"/>And everyone deceives his neighbor,<l eID="gen19850" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19851"/>and they do not speak <transChange type="added">the</transChange> truth,<l eID="gen19851" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19852"/>they have taught their tongues<note placement="foot">Hebrew “tongue”</note> to speak lies,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note><l eID="gen19852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19853"/>they are tired <transChange type="added">from</transChange> going astray. <l eID="gen19853" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8717"/><l level="1" sID="gen19854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8717"/>Your dwelling <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the midst of deceit,<l eID="gen19854" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19855"/>upon<note placement="foot">Or “through”</note> deceit they refuse to know me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen19855" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19845"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8718"/><div sID="gen19856" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8718"/>Therefore, thus says Yahweh of hosts: <div eID="gen19856" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19857"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19858"/>“Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to refine them,<l eID="gen19858" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19859"/>and I will test them,<l eID="gen19859" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19860"/>for what else can I do,<l eID="gen19860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19861"/>because of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “faces”</note> of the daughter of my people? <l eID="gen19861" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8719"/><l level="1" sID="gen19862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8719"/>Their tongue <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a murderous arrow,<l eID="gen19862" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19863"/>it speaks deceit.<l eID="gen19863" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19864"/>With his mouth he speaks peace with his neighbor,<l eID="gen19864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19865"/>but in his inner parts he sets up his ambush. <l eID="gen19865" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8720"/><l level="1" sID="gen19866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8720"/>Because of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> shall I not punish them?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19867"/>“On a nation that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like this shall I not take revenge? <l eID="gen19867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8721"/><l level="1" sID="gen19868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8721"/>For the mountains I lift up weeping and wailing,<l eID="gen19868" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19869"/>and for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pastures of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert a lament,<l eID="gen19869" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19870"/>because they are laid waste so that no man passes through.<l eID="gen19870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19871"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sounds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sound”</note> of cattle are not heard,<l eID="gen19871" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19872"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of heaven to the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note><l eID="gen19872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19873"/>they have fled, they are gone. <l eID="gen19873" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8722"/><l level="1" sID="gen19874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8722"/>And I will make Jerusalem as heaps <transChange type="added">of ruins</transChange>, a lair of jackals,<l eID="gen19874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19875"/>and the towns of Judah I will make a desolation, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without inhabitants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from no inhabitant”</note> <l eID="gen19875" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8723"/><l level="1" sID="gen19876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8723"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the wise man that can understand this?<l eID="gen19876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19877"/>And to whom has the mouth of Yahweh spoken, so that he may declare it?<l eID="gen19877" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19878"/>Why is the land destroyed?<l eID="gen19878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19879"/>It is laid waste like the desert<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note> so that no one passes through.” <l eID="gen19879" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19857"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8724"/><title type="x-s">The Nation is Judged by Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen19880" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8724"/>And Yahweh said, “Because of their forsaking my law that I set <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> them, and they have not obeyed my voice, and have not walked in it,

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:14
verses.text: but they went after the stubbornness of their heart, and after the Baals, which their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> taught them.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:15
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> feeding this people wormwood, and providing drink for them, water of poison,

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:16
verses.text: and I will scatter them among the nations that they have not known, they and their ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and I will send the sword after them until I bring them to an end.”  <div eID="gen19880" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8725"/><div sID="gen19881" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8725"/>Thus says Yahweh of hosts: <div eID="gen19881" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19882"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19883"/>“Consider closely, and call for the wailing women, so that they come,<l eID="gen19883" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19884"/>and for the skillful women, so that they come. <l eID="gen19884" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8726"/><l level="1" sID="gen19885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8726"/>And let them hasten,<l eID="gen19885" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19886"/>and let them lift up wailing over us,<l eID="gen19886" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19887"/>so that our eyes may melt <transChange type="added">with</transChange> tears,<l eID="gen19887" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19888"/>and our eyelids may flow <transChange type="added">with</transChange> water. <l eID="gen19888" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8727"/><l level="1" sID="gen19889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8727"/>For a sound of wailing is heard from Zion,<l eID="gen19889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19890"/>‘How we are devastated!<l eID="gen19890" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19891"/>We are very ashamed because we have left the land,<l eID="gen19891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19892"/>because they have overthrown our dwelling places.’ <l eID="gen19892" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8728"/><l level="1" sID="gen19893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8728"/>For hear, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> women, the word of Yahweh,<l eID="gen19893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19894"/>and let your ear receive the word of his mouth,<l eID="gen19894" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19895"/>and teach your daughters a lamentation,<l eID="gen19895" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19896"/>and each woman her neighbor a lament. <l eID="gen19896" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8729"/><l level="1" sID="gen19897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8729"/>For death has come into our windows,<l eID="gen19897" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19898"/>it has entered into our fortresses,<l eID="gen19898" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19899"/>to cut off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children<note placement="foot">Hebrew “child”</note> from the streets,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “street”</note><l eID="gen19899" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19900"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> young men from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> public squares. <l eID="gen19900" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19882"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8730"/><div sID="gen19901" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8730"/>Speak, ‘thus <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh: <div eID="gen19901" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19902"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19903"/>“The dead body of the human will fall<l eID="gen19903" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19904"/>like dung upon the surface of the field,<l eID="gen19904" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19905"/>and like cut grain behind the reaper,<l eID="gen19905" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19906"/>and there is no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> gathers.” ’ ” <l eID="gen19906" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19902"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8731"/><title type="x-s">The Things in Which Yahweh Delights</title> <div sID="gen19907" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8731"/>Thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen19907" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19908"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19909"/>“<transChange type="added">The</transChange> wise man must not boast in his wisdom,<l eID="gen19909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19910"/>and the warrior must not boast in his might,<l eID="gen19910" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19911"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> wealthy man must not boast in his wealth. <l eID="gen19911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8732"/><l level="1" sID="gen19912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8732"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞But only⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “But it”</note> in this must the one who boasts boast,<l eID="gen19912" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19913"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> he has insight,<l eID="gen19913" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19914"/>and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> he knows me,<l eID="gen19914" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19915"/>that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19915" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19916"/>showing loyal love, justice, and righteousness on the earth,<l eID="gen19916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19917"/>for in these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> I delight,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen19917" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19908"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8733"/><title type="x-s">The Way of the Nations</title> <div sID="gen19918" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8733"/>“Look, days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and I will call into account all those who are circumcised in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> foreskin:

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:26
verses.text: Egypt, Judah, and Edom, and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Ammon”</note> and Moab, and all those who are trimmed to the side, those who live in the desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note> for all the nations <transChange type="added">are</transChange> uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel <transChange type="added">are</transChange> uncircumcised of heart.”  <chapter eID="Jer.9"/> <div eID="gen19918" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:1
verses.text: Hear the word that Yahweh speaks to you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> house of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:2
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen19919" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19920"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19921"/>“You must not learn the way of the nations,<l eID="gen19921" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19922"/>and you must not be dismayed by the signs of the heavens,<l eID="gen19922" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19923"/>for the nations are dismayed by them. <l eID="gen19923" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8734"/><l level="1" sID="gen19924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8734"/>For the statutes of the peoples <transChange type="added">are</transChange> vanity,<l eID="gen19924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19925"/>for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a tree cut down from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> forest,<l eID="gen19925" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19926"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> work of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hands of a craftsman with the tool. <l eID="gen19926" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8735"/><l level="1" sID="gen19927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8735"/>He decorates it with silver and gold,<l eID="gen19927" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19928"/>they strengthen it with nails and hammers,<l eID="gen19928" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19929"/>so that it does not stagger. <l eID="gen19929" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8736"/><l level="1" sID="gen19930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8736"/>They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like scarecrows<note placement="foot">Hebrew “scarecrow”</note> in a cucumber field,<l eID="gen19930" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19931"/>they cannot speak.<l eID="gen19931" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19932"/>Indeed, they must be carried,<l eID="gen19932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19933"/>for they cannot march.<l eID="gen19933" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19934"/>You must not be afraid of them,<l eID="gen19934" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19935"/>for they cannot do evil;<l eID="gen19935" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19936"/>furthermore, to do good <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not in them.” <l eID="gen19936" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8737"/><l level="1" sID="gen19937"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8737"/>There is none like you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen19937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19938"/>you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> great and your name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great in might. <l eID="gen19938" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8738"/><l level="1" sID="gen19939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8738"/>Who would not revere you, O king of the nations?<l eID="gen19939" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19940"/>For you it is fitting.<l eID="gen19940" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19941"/>For among all the wise men of the nations,<l eID="gen19941" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19942"/>and in all their kingdoms,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “kingdom”</note><l eID="gen19942" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19943"/>there is none like you. <l eID="gen19943" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8739"/><l level="1" sID="gen19944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8739"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞At the same time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And in one”</note> they are stupid and foolish,<l eID="gen19944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19945"/><transChange type="added">in the</transChange> instruction of idols, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wood. <l eID="gen19945" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8740"/><l level="1" sID="gen19946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8740"/>Silver beaten from Tarshish is brought,<l eID="gen19946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19947"/>and gold from Uphaz,<l eID="gen19947" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19948"/>the work of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> craftsman and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hands of the goldsmith.<l eID="gen19948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19949"/>Blue and purple <transChange type="added">are</transChange> their clothing,<l eID="gen19949" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19950"/>all of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the work of skillful people. <l eID="gen19950" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8741"/><l level="1" sID="gen19951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8741"/>But Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the true God,<l eID="gen19951" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19952"/>he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the living God,<l eID="gen19952" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19953"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting king⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a king of eternity”</note><l eID="gen19953" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19954"/>Because of his wrath the earth quakes,<l eID="gen19954" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19955"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations cannot endure his anger. <l eID="gen19955" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19920"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8742"/><div sID="gen19956" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8742"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Thus⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Like this”</note> you shall say to them, <div eID="gen19956" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19957"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19958"/>‘Gods who did not make the heavens and the earth<l eID="gen19958" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19959"/>will perish from the earth and from under these heavens. <l eID="gen19959" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8743"/><l level="1" sID="gen19960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8743"/><transChange type="added">He is</transChange> the maker of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth by his power,<l eID="gen19960" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19961"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> created the world by his wisdom,<l eID="gen19961" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19962"/>and by his understanding he stretched out heaven. <l eID="gen19962" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8744"/><l level="1" sID="gen19963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8744"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When he utters his voice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At the voice of his giving”</note> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> a noise of water in the heavens,<l eID="gen19963" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19964"/>and he causes <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mist to rise from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ends<note placement="foot">Hebrew “end”</note> of the earth.<l eID="gen19964" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19965"/>He makes lightning for the rain,<l eID="gen19965" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19966"/>and he causes <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind to go out from his storehouses. <l eID="gen19966" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8745"/><l level="1" sID="gen19967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8745"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Everyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All humankind”</note> is stupid, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without knowledge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from knowledge”</note><l eID="gen19967" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19968"/>every goldsmith is ashamed by <transChange type="added">his</transChange> divine image,<l eID="gen19968" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19969"/>for his cast image <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an illusion,<l eID="gen19969" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19970"/>and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no breath in them. <l eID="gen19970" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8746"/><l level="1" sID="gen19971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8746"/>They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> vanity, a work of mockery,<l eID="gen19971" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19972"/>at the time of their punishment, they will perish. <l eID="gen19972" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8747"/><l level="1" sID="gen19973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8747"/>The portion of Jacob <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not like these,<l eID="gen19973" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19974"/>for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the creator of everything,<l eID="gen19974" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19975"/>and Israel <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the tribe of his inheritance,<l eID="gen19975" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19976"/>Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name. <l eID="gen19976" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8748"/><l level="1" sID="gen19977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8748"/>Gather your bundle from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ground,<l eID="gen19977" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19978"/>you who live under the siege.’ ” <l eID="gen19978" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19957"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8749"/><div sID="gen19979" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8749"/>For thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen19979" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19980"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19981"/>“Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time,<l eID="gen19981" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19982"/>and I will bring distress to them, so that they may feel it.”<l eID="gen19982" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen19980"/> <title type="x-s">The Nation Accepts Its Judgment</title> <div sID="gen19983" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen19983" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8750"/><lg sID="gen19984"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8750"/>Woe to me, because of my wound.<l eID="gen19985" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19986"/>My wound <transChange type="added">is</transChange> incurable.<l eID="gen19986" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19987"/>But I said, “Surely this <transChange type="added">is my</transChange> sickness,<l eID="gen19987" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19988"/>and I must bear it.” <l eID="gen19988" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8751"/><l level="1" sID="gen19989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8751"/>My tent is devastated,<l eID="gen19989" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19990"/>and all my tent cords are torn.<l eID="gen19990" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19991"/>My children have gone out <transChange type="added">from</transChange> me,<l eID="gen19991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19992"/>and they are not.<l eID="gen19992" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19993"/>There is no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> pitches my tent again,<l eID="gen19993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19994"/>or <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> puts up my tent curtains. <l eID="gen19994" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8752"/><l level="1" sID="gen19995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8752"/>For the shepherds have become stupid,<l eID="gen19995" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19996"/>they do not seek Yahweh.<l eID="gen19996" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19997"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> they do not have insight,<l eID="gen19997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen19998"/>and all of their flock are scattered. <l eID="gen19998" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8753"/><l level="1" sID="gen19999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8753"/>Listen, news:<note placement="foot">Or “a report”</note><l eID="gen19999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20000"/>Look, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> coming,<l eID="gen20000" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20001"/>a great roar from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,<l eID="gen20001" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20002"/>to make the cities of Judah a desolation,<l eID="gen20002" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20003"/>a lair of jackals. <l eID="gen20003" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8754"/><l level="1" sID="gen20004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8754"/>I know, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, that to the human <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> way,<l eID="gen20004" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20005"/>nor to a person <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> walking and the directing of his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> step. <l eID="gen20005" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8755"/><l level="1" sID="gen20006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8755"/>Chastise<note placement="foot">Or “Discipline”</note> me, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, but in moderation,<l eID="gen20006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20007"/>not in your anger, lest you eradicate me. <l eID="gen20007" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8756"/><l level="1" sID="gen20008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8756"/>Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not know you,<l eID="gen20008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20009"/>and on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples that do not call on your name,<l eID="gen20009" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20010"/>for they have devoured Jacob,<l eID="gen20010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20011"/>they have devoured and consumed him,<l eID="gen20011" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20012"/>and they have caused his settlement to be desolate. <l eID="gen20012" level="2"/><lg eID="gen19984"/> <chapter eID="Jer.10"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8757"/><title type="x-s">The Broken Covenant</title> <div sID="gen20013" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8757"/>The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:2
