verses.text: “Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “man”</note> of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:3
verses.text: and say to them, ‘Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: “The man is cursed who does not obey the words of this covenant,

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:4
verses.text: which I commanded your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> in the day of my bringing them from the land of Egypt, from the furnace of iron, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Listen to my voice and do according to all that I command you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so will you be my people, and I will be your God⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “and you shall be to me as people and I will be to you as God”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:5
verses.text: in order to keep the oath that I swore to your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day.” ’ ” Then I answered and said, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Let it be so⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Amen”</note> O Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen20013" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8758"/><div sID="gen20014" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8758"/>And Yahweh said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Hear the words of this covenant and do them,

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:7
verses.text: for I solemnly admonished your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> in the day of my leading them out from the land of Egypt and up to this day, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞admonishing persistently⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “do early and admonishing”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Obey my voice.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:8
verses.text: But they did not obey and they did not incline their ear. Instead each one walked in the stubbornness of his<note placement="foot">Hebrew “their”</note> evil heart. Therefore, I brought on them all the words of this covenant which I commanded them<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> to do, and they did not do it.’ ”<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note>  <div eID="gen20014" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8759"/><div sID="gen20015" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8759"/>And Yahweh said to me, “A conspiracy is found among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “man”</note> of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:10
verses.text: They have turned back to the iniquities of their former ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> who refused to obey my words, and they have gone after other gods, to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant that I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> with their ancestors.”<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>  <div eID="gen20015" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8760"/><div sID="gen20016" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8760"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh, “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to bring on them disaster from which they will not be able to escape. Though they cry out to me, yet I will not listen to them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:12
verses.text: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods <transChange type="added">to</transChange> whom they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> making smoke offerings, but they will certainly not save them in the time of their trouble.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:13
verses.text: For the number of your towns are your gods, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Judah, and the number of the streets of Jerusalem <transChange type="added">are the</transChange> altars you have set up to the shameful things, to make smoke offerings to Baal.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:14
verses.text: Therefore you must not pray for this people, and you must not lift up for them a cry of entreaty, or a prayer, for I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> not listen in the time of their calling to me, in the time of their trouble.  <div eID="gen20016" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8761"/><lg sID="gen20017"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8761"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What rights has my beloved in my house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “What for my beloved in my house”</note><l eID="gen20018" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20019"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> she has done many wicked things?<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wicked thing”</note><l eID="gen20019" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20020"/>Can the flesh of holiness pass over you?<l eID="gen20020" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20021"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you engage in your wickedness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “your wickedness”</note> then you exult. <l eID="gen20021" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8762"/><l level="1" sID="gen20022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8762"/>Yahweh called your name, ‘A leafy olive tree, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beautiful with fine fruit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “beautiful of fruit of appearance”</note><l eID="gen20022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20023"/>With the sound of a great storm he will set fire to it,<l eID="gen20023" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20024"/>and its branches will be good for nothing. <l eID="gen20024" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8763"/><l level="1" sID="gen20025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8763"/>And Yahweh of hosts, the <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> planted you,<l eID="gen20025" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20026"/>has spoken evil against you,<l eID="gen20026" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20027"/>because of the evil of the house of Israel and the house of Judah,<l eID="gen20027" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20028"/>that they have done to themselves,<l eID="gen20028" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20029"/>to provoke me to anger by making smoke offerings to Baal.”<l eID="gen20029" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen20017"/> <title type="x-s">A Warning for the People of Anathoth</title> <div sID="gen20030" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen20030" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8764"/><lg sID="gen20031"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8764"/>Moreover, Yahweh let <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> made known to me, and I knew.<l eID="gen20032" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20033"/>Then you showed me their deeds. <l eID="gen20033" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8765"/><l level="1" sID="gen20034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8765"/>And I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like a gentle ram-lamb that is brought to slaughter,<l eID="gen20034" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20035"/>and I did not know that they planned plans against me, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,<l eID="gen20035" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20036"/>“Let us destroy the tree with its fruit,<l eID="gen20036" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20037"/>and let us cut him off from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living,<l eID="gen20037" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20038"/>so that his name will no longer be remembered.” <l eID="gen20038" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8766"/><l level="1" sID="gen20039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8766"/>But <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh of hosts, who judges <transChange type="added">in</transChange> righteousness,<l eID="gen20039" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20040"/>who tests <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞inmost being⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “kidney”</note> and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note><l eID="gen20040" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20041"/>let me see your retribution upon them,<l eID="gen20041" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20042"/>for to you I have revealed my legal case. <l eID="gen20042" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20031"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8767"/><div sID="gen20043" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8767"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh concerning the people<note placement="foot">Or “men”</note> of Anathoth who seek your life, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “You shall not prophesy in the name of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞or⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not”</note> you will die by our hand.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:22
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh of hosts: “Look, I <transChange type="added">am about to</transChange> punish them. The young men will die by the sword. Their sons and their daughters will die by the famine.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:23
verses.text: And a remnant will not be <transChange type="added">left</transChange> for them, for I will bring disaster to the people<note placement="foot">Or “men”</note> of Anathoth, the year of their punishment.”  <chapter eID="Jer.11"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8768"/><title type="x-s">Jeremiah’s Complaint</title> <div sID="gen20044" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen20044" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20045"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8768"/>You <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> in the right, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, when I complain to you.<l eID="gen20046" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20047"/>Even so, let me speak <transChange type="added">my</transChange> claims with you.<l eID="gen20047" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20048"/>Why does <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked succeed?<l eID="gen20048" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20049"/>All those who deal treacherously with treachery are at ease. <l eID="gen20049" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8769"/><l level="1" sID="gen20050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8769"/>Not only do you plant them, they take root.<l eID="gen20050" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20051"/>They grow, but also they produce fruit.<l eID="gen20051" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20052"/>You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> near in their mouths,<l eID="gen20052" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20053"/>but far from their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞inmost beings⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “kidneys”</note> <l eID="gen20053" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8770"/><l level="1" sID="gen20054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8770"/>But you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, you know me,<l eID="gen20054" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20055"/>you see me, and you test <transChange type="added">that</transChange> my heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with you.<l eID="gen20055" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20056"/>Tear them apart like sheep for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slaughtering,<l eID="gen20056" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20057"/>and set them apart for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of slaughter. <l eID="gen20057" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8771"/><l level="1" sID="gen20058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8771"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Until when”</note> will the land mourn, and the vegetation of every field dry up,<l eID="gen20058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20059"/>because of the wickedness of those who live in it?<l eID="gen20059" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20060"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> animals and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> are swept away,<l eID="gen20060" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20061"/>because they have said, “He does not see our future.”<l eID="gen20061" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20045"/> <title type="x-s">The Lord’s Reply</title> <div sID="gen20062" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen20062" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8772"/><lg sID="gen20063"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8772"/>“If you run with foot soldiers and they have made you weary,<l eID="gen20064" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20065"/>then how will you compete with horses?<l eID="gen20065" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20066"/>If you have fallen in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a peaceful land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a land of peace”</note><l eID="gen20066" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20067"/>then how will you do in the thickets of the Jordan? <l eID="gen20067" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8773"/><l level="1" sID="gen20068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8773"/>For even your relatives, and the house of your father,<l eID="gen20068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20069"/>even they have dealt treacherously with you,<l eID="gen20069" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20070"/>even they call <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞loudly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “full”</note> after you.<l eID="gen20070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20071"/>You must not trust in them, though they speak kindly to you. <l eID="gen20071" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8774"/><l level="1" sID="gen20072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8774"/>I have forsaken my house, I have abandoned my inheritance.<l eID="gen20072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20073"/>I have given the beloved one of my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “soul”</note> into the hand of her enemies. <l eID="gen20073" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8775"/><l level="1" sID="gen20074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8775"/>My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest.<l eID="gen20074" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20075"/>She has lifted up against me her voice; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “unto thus”</note> I hate her. <l eID="gen20075" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8776"/><l level="1" sID="gen20076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8776"/>The lair of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hyena <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my inheritance to me,<l eID="gen20076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20077"/>the birds of prey<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird of prey”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all around her.<l eID="gen20077" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20078"/>Go, gather all of the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the field,<l eID="gen20078" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20079"/>bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to come and devour⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to food”</note> <l eID="gen20079" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8777"/><l level="1" sID="gen20080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8777"/>Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard,<l eID="gen20080" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20081"/>they have trampled down my plot of land.<l eID="gen20081" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20082"/>They have made <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my pleasant field⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the plot of land of my desire”</note><l eID="gen20082" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20083"/>like the desert<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note> of desolation. <l eID="gen20083" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8778"/><l level="1" sID="gen20084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8778"/>They have made it a desolation.<l eID="gen20084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20085"/>Desolate, it mourns to me.<l eID="gen20085" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20086"/>All the land is made desolate,<l eID="gen20086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20087"/>but there is no person taking <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to heart. <l eID="gen20087" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8779"/><l level="1" sID="gen20088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8779"/>Upon all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> barren heights in the desert<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note> destroyers have come,<l eID="gen20088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20089"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword of Yahweh devours,<l eID="gen20089" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20090"/>from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> end of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land to the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> end of the land,<l eID="gen20090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20091"/>there is no peace for all flesh. <l eID="gen20091" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8780"/><l level="1" sID="gen20092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8780"/>They have sown wheat and they have reaped thorns.<l eID="gen20092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20093"/>They are exhausted, they do not profit.<l eID="gen20093" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20094"/>And they will be ashamed of your produce,<l eID="gen20094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20095"/>because of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the burning anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the blaze of the nose”</note> of Yahweh.” <l eID="gen20095" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20063"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8781"/><div sID="gen20096" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8781"/>Thus says Yahweh concerning all of the evil neighbors who touch the inheritance that I gave as an inheritance <transChange type="added">to</transChange> my people Israel: “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to drive them out from their land, and the house of Judah I will drive out from among them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> after my driving them out, I will once again have compassion on them, and I will bring them back, each one to his inheritance, and each one to his land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:16
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> if they diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as Yahweh lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,’<note placement="foot">Literally “the life of Yahweh”</note> even as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will live in the midst of my people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:17
verses.text: But if they do not listen, then <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will completely uproot and destroy that nation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “I will drive out the nation that driving out and destroying”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Jer.12"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8782"/><title type="x-s">The Linen Loincloth</title> <div sID="gen20097" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8782"/>Thus Yahweh said to me: “Go and buy for yourself a loincloth of linen and put it on your loins, but you must not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “bring”</note> it in water.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:2
verses.text: So I bought the loincloth according to the word of Yahweh and I put <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> on my loins.  <div eID="gen20097" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8783"/><div sID="gen20098" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8783"/>Now the word of Yahweh came to me a second <transChange type="added">time</transChange>, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:4
verses.text: “Take the loincloth that you bought, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on your loins, and stand up, go <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> Euphrates and hide it there in the cleft of the rock.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:5
verses.text: So I went and hid it by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Euphrates just as Yahweh had commanded me.  <div eID="gen20098" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8784"/><div sID="gen20099" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8784"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “And it happened”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞after a long time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the end of many days”</note> then Yahweh said to me, “Stand up, go <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> Euphrates and take from there the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:7
verses.text: Then I went <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> Euphrates and I dug, and I took the loincloth from the place where I had hidden it, and look, the loincloth was ruined; it was not good for anything.  <div eID="gen20099" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8785"/><div sID="gen20100" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8785"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it happened”</note> the word of Yahweh came to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:9
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh: ‘So I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:10
verses.text: This evil people, who refuse to listen to my words, who go<note placement="foot">Or “walk”</note> in the stubbornness of their hearts,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> and have gone after other gods, to serve them, and to bow in worship to them, let them be like this loincloth which is not good for anything.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:11
verses.text: For as the loincloth clings to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> loins of a person, so I caused to cling to me all the house of Israel and all the house of Judah,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘to be for me a people, and a name, and a praise, and a glory, but they would not listen.’  <div eID="gen20100" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8786"/><div sID="gen20101" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8786"/>“Therefore, you shall say to them this word, ‘Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: “Every jar must be filled with wine.” ’ And they will say to you, ‘Do we not certainly know that every jar should be filled with wine?’

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:13
verses.text: Then you shall say to them, ‘Thus says Yahweh: “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to fill all the inhabitants of this land, and the kings who sit on David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem <transChange type="added">with</transChange> drunkenness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:14
verses.text: And I will smash them, each one against his brother, and the fathers and the sons together,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. “I will not have compassion, and I will not take pity, and I will not show compassion from destroying them.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen20101" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8787"/><lg sID="gen20102"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8787"/>Listen, and pay attention,<l eID="gen20103" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20104"/>you must not be haughty, for Yahweh has spoken. <l eID="gen20104" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8788"/><l level="1" sID="gen20105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8788"/>Give glory to Yahweh your God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at not yet”</note> he brings darkness,<l eID="gen20105" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20106"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at not yet”</note> your feet stumble on the mountains at twilight.<l eID="gen20106" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20107"/>And you will hope for light, but he makes it as gloom,<l eID="gen20107" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20108"/>he makes <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> as thick darkness. <l eID="gen20108" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8789"/><l level="1" sID="gen20109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8789"/>But if you will not listen to it,<l eID="gen20109" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20110"/>my inner self<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> will weep in secret places,<l eID="gen20110" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20111"/>because of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the presence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the face of”</note> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> pride.<l eID="gen20111" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20112"/>And my eyes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “eye”</note> will weep bitterly,<l eID="gen20112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20113"/>and they will melt <transChange type="added">in</transChange> tears,<l eID="gen20113" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20114"/>because the flock of Yahweh has been taken captive.<l eID="gen20114" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20102"/> <title type="x-s">A Message for the King and the Queen Mother</title> <div sID="gen20115" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen20115" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8790"/><lg sID="gen20116"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8790"/>“Say to the king and to the queen mother, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Take a lower seat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Bring low sit”</note><l eID="gen20117" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20118"/>for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your beautiful crown⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the crown of your beauty”</note> has come down from your head.’<note placement="foot">Or “at the head of you”</note> <l eID="gen20118" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8791"/><l level="1" sID="gen20119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8791"/>The towns of the Negev are shut up,<l eID="gen20119" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20120"/>and there is no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> opens <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note><l eID="gen20120" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20121"/>All of Judah is deported;<l eID="gen20121" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20122"/>it is deported <transChange type="added">in</transChange> completeness. <l eID="gen20122" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8792"/><l level="1" sID="gen20123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8792"/>Lift up your eyes<l eID="gen20123" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20124"/>and see those coming from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north.<l eID="gen20124" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20125"/>Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the flock that was given to you,<l eID="gen20125" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20126"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your magnificent flock⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “the flock of your splendor”</note> <l eID="gen20126" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8793"/><l level="1" sID="gen20127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8793"/>What will you say when he sets over you—<l eID="gen20127" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20128"/>and you have taught them—allies as head over you?<l eID="gen20128" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20129"/>Will not labor pains take hold of you,<l eID="gen20129" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20130"/>like a woman giving birth? <l eID="gen20130" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8794"/><l level="1" sID="gen20131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8794"/>And if you say in your heart,<l eID="gen20131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20132"/>‘Why have these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> happened to me?’<l eID="gen20132" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20133"/>Because of the greatness of your iniquity your skirts are uncovered;<l eID="gen20133" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20134"/>your heels have endured violence. <l eID="gen20134" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8795"/><l level="1" sID="gen20135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8795"/>Can a Cushite change his skin,<l eID="gen20135" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20136"/>or a leopard his spots?<l eID="gen20136" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20137"/><transChange type="added">Then</transChange> you also will be able to do good,<l eID="gen20137" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20138"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> are accustomed to doing evil. <l eID="gen20138" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8796"/><l level="1" sID="gen20139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8796"/>And I will scatter them<l eID="gen20139" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20140"/>like stubble scattered by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert.<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note> <l eID="gen20140" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8797"/><l level="1" sID="gen20141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8797"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your lot,<l eID="gen20141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20142"/>the portion of your measure from me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen20142" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20143"/>“because you have forgotten me,<l eID="gen20143" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20144"/>and you have trusted in the lie. <l eID="gen20144" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8798"/><l level="1" sID="gen20145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8798"/>So in turn I will bare your skirts over your face,<l eID="gen20145" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20146"/>and your shame will become visible. <l eID="gen20146" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8799"/><l level="1" sID="gen20147"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8799"/>Your adulteries, and your neighings,<l eID="gen20147" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20148"/>the shameful behavior of your fornications<l eID="gen20148" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20149"/>on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hills in the countryside,<l eID="gen20149" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20150"/>I have seen your abominations.<l eID="gen20150" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20151"/>Woe to you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Jerusalem!<l eID="gen20151" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20152"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long will you continue to be unclean⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “Not you are clean after how long still”</note>” <l eID="gen20152" level="2"/><lg eID="gen20116"/> <chapter eID="Jer.13"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8800"/><title type="x-s">The Severe Drought</title> <div sID="gen20153" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8800"/><transChange type="added">That</transChange> which came <transChange type="added">as</transChange> the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah concerning the matter<note placement="foot">Hebrew “matters”</note> of the severe drought.  <div eID="gen20153" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8801"/><lg sID="gen20154"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8801"/>“Judah mourns, and her gates languish,<l eID="gen20155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20156"/>they are in mourning on the ground,<l eID="gen20156" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20157"/>and the cry of lament of Jerusalem goes up. <l eID="gen20157" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8802"/><l level="1" sID="gen20158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8802"/>And their nobles send their servants for water.<l eID="gen20158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20159"/>They come to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pits, they find no water.<l eID="gen20159" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20160"/>They return <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their vessels <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞empty⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “without success”</note><l eID="gen20160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20161"/>They are ashamed, and they are confounded,<l eID="gen20161" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20162"/>and they cover their heads.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “head”</note> <l eID="gen20162" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8803"/><l level="1" sID="gen20163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8803"/>Because of the ground, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> is cracked<l eID="gen20163" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20164"/>because there was no rain on the ground.<l eID="gen20164" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20165"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> farmers are ashamed,<l eID="gen20165" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20166"/>they cover their heads.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “head”</note> <l eID="gen20166" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8804"/><l level="1" sID="gen20167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8804"/>For even <transChange type="added">the</transChange> doe in the field gives birth and forsakes <transChange type="added">her young</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note><l eID="gen20167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20168"/>because there is no green growth. <l eID="gen20168" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8805"/><l level="1" sID="gen20169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8805"/>And wild asses stand on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> barren heights,<l eID="gen20169" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20170"/>they gasp <transChange type="added">for</transChange> breath like the jackals.<l eID="gen20170" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20171"/>Their eyes fail<l eID="gen20171" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20172"/>because there is no vegetation.” <l eID="gen20172" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8806"/><l level="1" sID="gen20173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8806"/>Although our iniquities testify against us, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen20173" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20174"/>act for the sake of your name.<l eID="gen20174" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20175"/>Yes, our apostasies are many;<l eID="gen20175" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20176"/>we have sinned against you. <l eID="gen20176" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8807"/><l level="1" sID="gen20177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8807"/><transChange type="added">You are</transChange> the hope of Israel,<l eID="gen20177" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20178"/>its savior in time of distress.<l eID="gen20178" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20179"/>Why should you be like an alien in the land,<l eID="gen20179" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20180"/>or like a traveler who spreads out <transChange type="added">his tent</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> to spend the night? <l eID="gen20180" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8808"/><l level="1" sID="gen20181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8808"/>Why should you be like a confused man,<l eID="gen20181" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20182"/>like a warrior <transChange type="added">who</transChange> is not able to help?<l eID="gen20182" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20183"/>Yet you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in our midst, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen20183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20184"/>and your name is called upon us.<l eID="gen20184" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20185"/>You must not leave us! <l eID="gen20185" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen20154"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8809"/><div sID="gen20186" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8809"/>Thus says Yahweh concerning this people: <div eID="gen20186" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20187"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20188"/>“They have loved so much to wander,<l eID="gen20188" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20189"/>they have not spared their feet.<l eID="gen20189" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20190"/>Therefore Yahweh is not favorable to them,<l eID="gen20190" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20191"/>now he will remember their iniquity and punish their sins.” <l eID="gen20191" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20187"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8810"/><title type="x-s">Lying Prophets</title> <div sID="gen20192" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8810"/>So Yahweh said to me, “You must not pray for this people, for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> happiness.<note placement="foot">Or “good”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:12
verses.text: Although they fast, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> not listening to their cry of entreaty. And although they present burnt offering and grain offering, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> not favorable to them. But by the sword, and by the famine, and by the plague, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to destroy them.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:13
verses.text: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh, look, the prophets <transChange type="added">are</transChange> saying to them, ‘You will not see <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword, and famine will not be yours, but reliable peace I will give to you in this place.’ ”

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:14
verses.text: And Yahweh said to me, “The prophets <transChange type="added">are</transChange> prophesying lies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note> in my name. I have not sent them, and I have not commanded them, and I have not spoken to them. They are prophesying to you a lying vision, and a divination, worthless, and the deceitfulness of their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞minds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh concerning the prophets who prophecy in my name though I have not sent them, yet they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> saying, “Sword and famine will not be in this land.” “By the sword and by the famine those prophets will perish.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:16
verses.text: And the people <transChange type="added">to</transChange> whom they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> prophesying will be cast out into the streets of Jerusalem <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of”</note> the famine and the sword. And there will be no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> buries them, their wives, or their sons, or their daughters. And I will pour out on them their wickedness.  <div eID="gen20192" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8811"/><title type="x-s">The Nation Hopes in Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen20193" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8811"/>“And you shall say to them this word, <div eID="gen20193" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20194"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20195"/>‘Let my eyes melt <transChange type="added">with</transChange> tears night and day,<l eID="gen20195" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20196"/>and let them not cease,<l eID="gen20196" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20197"/>for <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a great wound the virgin daughter of my people is broken,<l eID="gen20197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20198"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> a very incurable wound. <l eID="gen20198" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8812"/><l level="1" sID="gen20199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8812"/>If I go out <transChange type="added">into</transChange> the field,<l eID="gen20199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20200"/>then look, those slain by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword.<l eID="gen20200" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20201"/>And if I enter the city,<l eID="gen20201" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20202"/>then look, the sickness of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> famine.<l eID="gen20202" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20203"/>For both prophet and priest wander around through the land,<l eID="gen20203" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20204"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they do not know what is going on⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “and not they know”</note> <l eID="gen20204" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8813"/><l level="1" sID="gen20205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8813"/>Have you completely rejected Judah?<l eID="gen20205" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20206"/>Or has your soul<note placement="foot">Or “inner self”</note> loathed Zion?<l eID="gen20206" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20207"/>Why have you struck us<l eID="gen20207" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20208"/>so that there is no healing for us?<l eID="gen20208" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20209"/>We hope for peace, but there is no good,<l eID="gen20209" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20210"/>and for a time of healing, but look, there is terror. <l eID="gen20210" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8814"/><l level="1" sID="gen20211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8814"/>We know, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, our wickedness,<l eID="gen20211" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20212"/>the iniquity of our ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note><l eID="gen20212" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20213"/>for we have sinned against you. <l eID="gen20213" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8815"/><l level="1" sID="gen20214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8815"/>You must not spurn <transChange type="added">us</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> for the sake of your name,<l eID="gen20214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20215"/>you must not dishonor <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your glorious throne⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the throne of your glory”</note><l eID="gen20215" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20216"/>Remember <transChange type="added">us</transChange>!<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note><l eID="gen20216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20217"/>You must not break your covenant with us. <l eID="gen20217" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8816"/><l level="1" sID="gen20218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8816"/>Are there <transChange type="added">any</transChange> among the idols of the nation <transChange type="added">who</transChange> cause rain to pour?<l eID="gen20218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20219"/>Or can the heavens give showers?<l eID="gen20219" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20220"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> it not you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh our God?<l eID="gen20220" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20221"/>Therefore, we hope in you, for you do all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>. <l eID="gen20221" level="2"/><lg eID="gen20194"/> <chapter eID="Jer.14"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8817"/><title type="x-s">Four Types of Calamity</title> <div sID="gen20222" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8817"/>Then Yahweh said to me, “<transChange type="added">Even</transChange> if Moses and Samuel stood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> my heart would not be to this people. Send them away from my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> and let them go out.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:2
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> if they say to you, ‘Where shall we go?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen20222" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20223"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20224"/>“<transChange type="added">Those</transChange> who <transChange type="added">are destined</transChange> for the plague, to the plague,<l eID="gen20224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20225"/>and <transChange type="added">those</transChange> who <transChange type="added">are destined</transChange> for the sword, to the sword,<l eID="gen20225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20226"/>and <transChange type="added">those</transChange> who <transChange type="added">are destined</transChange> for the famine, to the famine,<l eID="gen20226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20227"/>and <transChange type="added">those</transChange> who <transChange type="added">are destined</transChange> for the captivity, to the captivity.” ’ <l eID="gen20227" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen20223"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8818"/><div sID="gen20228" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8818"/>“And I will summon<note placement="foot">Or “appoint”</note> over them four types of calamity,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “the sword to kill, and the dogs to drag away, and the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the air and the wild animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wild animal”</note> of the earth to devour and to destroy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:4
verses.text: And I will make them a terror to all of the kingdoms of the earth because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, the king of Judah, because of what he did in Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen20228" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8819"/><lg sID="gen20229"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8819"/>“For who will have compassion on you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Jerusalem,<l eID="gen20230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20231"/>or who will show sympathy to you,<l eID="gen20231" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20232"/>or who will turn aside <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to ask about your welfare⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “to ask to the welfare of you”</note> <l eID="gen20232" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8820"/><l level="1" sID="gen20233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8820"/>You have forsaken me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen20233" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20234"/>“You go backward, so I have stretched my hand against you,<l eID="gen20234" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20235"/>and I have destroyed you.<l eID="gen20235" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20236"/>I am tired of becoming remorseful. <l eID="gen20236" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8821"/><l level="1" sID="gen20237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8821"/>And I have winnowed them with a winnowing fork in the gates of the land.<l eID="gen20237" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20238"/>I am bereaved.<l eID="gen20238" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20239"/>I have destroyed my people.<l eID="gen20239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20240"/>They did not turn back from their ways. <l eID="gen20240" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8822"/><l level="1" sID="gen20241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8822"/>Their widows<note placement="foot">Hebrew “widow”</note> will be more numerous before me than <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas.<l eID="gen20241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20242"/>I have brought to them, against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mothers<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mother”</note> of young men,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “man”</note><l eID="gen20242" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20243"/>a destroyer at noon.<l eID="gen20243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20244"/>I will suddenly drop on her anguish and horror.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “horrors”</note> <l eID="gen20244" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8823"/><l level="1" sID="gen20245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8823"/>She who gave birth to seven has withered away.<l eID="gen20245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20246"/>She gasps her breath.<l eID="gen20246" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20247"/>Her sun <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞set⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “came”</note> while still day.<l eID="gen20247" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20248"/>She has been put to shame and disgraced.<l eID="gen20248" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20249"/>And the remainder of them I will give to the sword<l eID="gen20249" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20250"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> their enemies,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen20250" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20229"/> <title type="x-s">Jeremiah’s Lament and Yahweh’s Response</title> <div sID="gen20251" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen20251" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8824"/><lg sID="gen20252"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8824"/>Woe to me, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> my mother, that you gave birth to me,<l eID="gen20253" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20254"/>a man of contention and quarreling <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the whole land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to all of the land”</note><l eID="gen20254" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20255"/>I have not lent out and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have not borrowed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not they have lent out for me”</note><l eID="gen20255" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20256"/>All of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> cursing me. <l eID="gen20256" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20252"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8825"/><div sID="gen20257" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8825"/>Yahweh said, <div eID="gen20257" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20258"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20259"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If not”</note> I will set you free <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to be good⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for good”</note> for you,<l eID="gen20259" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20260"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> I will cause the enemy to intercede with you<l eID="gen20260" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20261"/>in a time of trouble,<l eID="gen20261" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20262"/>and in a time of distress. <l eID="gen20262" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8826"/><l level="1" sID="gen20263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8826"/>Can anyone break iron,<l eID="gen20263" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20264"/>iron from the north, or bronze? <l eID="gen20264" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8827"/><l level="1" sID="gen20265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8827"/>I will give your wealth and your treasures<l eID="gen20265" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20266"/>as plunder without price,<l eID="gen20266" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20267"/>even because of all your sins,<l eID="gen20267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20268"/>and throughout all your territories. <l eID="gen20268" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8828"/><l level="1" sID="gen20269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8828"/>And I will make you serve your enemies<l eID="gen20269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20270"/>in a land <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you <transChange type="added">do</transChange> not know,<l eID="gen20270" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20271"/>for a fire will kindle in my anger.<l eID="gen20271" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20272"/>Upon you it will be kindled.” <l eID="gen20272" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8829"/><l level="1" sID="gen20273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8829"/>You who know, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, remember me, and attend to me,<l eID="gen20273" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20274"/>and take revenge for me against my persecutors <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in your forbearance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the length of your nose”</note><l eID="gen20274" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20275"/>You must take me away.<l eID="gen20275" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20276"/>Know <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> carrying disgrace because of you. <l eID="gen20276" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8830"/><l level="1" sID="gen20277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8830"/>Your words were found and I ate them,<l eID="gen20277" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20278"/>and your words became to me as jubilation,<l eID="gen20278" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20279"/>even as the joy of my heart,<l eID="gen20279" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20280"/>for your name is called on me, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh God of hosts. <l eID="gen20280" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8831"/><l level="1" sID="gen20281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8831"/>I sat not in the assembly of jokers,<l eID="gen20281" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20282"/><transChange type="added">nor did</transChange> I exult.<l eID="gen20282" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20283"/>Because of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> of your hand I sat alone,<l eID="gen20283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20284"/>for you filled me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> indignation. <l eID="gen20284" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8832"/><l level="1" sID="gen20285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8832"/>Why is my pain endless, and my wound incurable?<l eID="gen20285" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20286"/>It refuses to become healed.<l eID="gen20286" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20287"/>Truly you are to me like a deceitful <transChange type="added">brook</transChange>,<l eID="gen20287" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20288"/>waters <transChange type="added">that</transChange> are not trustworthy. <l eID="gen20288" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20258"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8833"/><div sID="gen20289" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8833"/>Therefore thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen20289" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20290"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20291"/>“If you turn back, then I will take you back.<l eID="gen20291" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20292"/>You will stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note><l eID="gen20292" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20293"/>And if you utter <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> precious and not <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> worthless,<l eID="gen20293" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20294"/>you will be as my mouth.<l eID="gen20294" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20295"/>They will turn back to you,<l eID="gen20295" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20296"/>and you will not turn back to them. <l eID="gen20296" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8834"/><l level="1" sID="gen20297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8834"/>And I will make you to this people<l eID="gen20297" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20298"/>a wall of fortified bronze,<l eID="gen20298" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20299"/>and they will fight against you,<l eID="gen20299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20300"/>but they will not prevail over you,<l eID="gen20300" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20301"/>for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> with you, to save you,<l eID="gen20301" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20302"/>and to deliver you,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen20302" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8835"/><l level="1" sID="gen20303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8835"/>“And I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked,<l eID="gen20303" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20304"/>and I will redeem you from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tyrant.” <l eID="gen20304" level="2"/><lg eID="gen20290"/> <chapter eID="Jer.15"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8836"/><title type="x-s">Jeremiah is Commanded Not to Marry</title> <div sID="gen20305" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8836"/>And the word of Yahweh came to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:2
verses.text: “You shall not take for yourself a wife, there shall not be for you sons and daughters in this place.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:3
verses.text: For thus says Yahweh concerning the sons and concerning the daughters born in this place, and concerning their mothers who gave birth to them, and concerning their fathers who fathered them in this land:

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:4
verses.text: “They will die by diseases, they will not be mourned, and they will not be buried. They will be as dung on the face of the earth. And they will perish by the sword and they will perish by the famine. And their dead bodies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dead body”</note> will become food for the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the air, and for the wild animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wild animal”</note> of the earth.”  <div eID="gen20305" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8837"/><div sID="gen20306" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8837"/>For thus says Yahweh, “You must not enter <transChange type="added">the</transChange> house of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> funeral meal, and you must not go to lament, and you must not show sympathy for them, for I have taken away my peace from this people,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “the loyal love and the compassion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:6
verses.text: Both the great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried, and they will not mourn for them, and no one will cut himself with a blade, and no one will shave himself for them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:7
verses.text: And they will not break bread for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mourning ceremony for them, to comfort him because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dead. And they will not give drink to them, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cup of desolation, for their fathers,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “father”</note> or for their mothers.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mother”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:8
verses.text: And you shall not enter <transChange type="added">the</transChange> house of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> banquet, to sit with them, to eat and drink.”  <div eID="gen20306" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8838"/><div sID="gen20307" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8838"/>For thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to cause to disappear from this place, before your eyes and in your days, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of jubilation, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of joy, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bridegroom, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bride.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:10
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> when you tell this people all these words and they ask you, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Why⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “On what”</note> has Yahweh pronounced against us all this great evil, and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our iniquity, and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our sin that we have sinned against Yahweh our God?’

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:11
verses.text: Then you shall say to them, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “On that”</note> your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> have forsaken me,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and they have gone after other gods, and they have served them, and they have bowed down in worship to them, and they have forsaken me, and they have not kept my laws.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:12
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you have behaved badly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you have done evil to do”</note> more than your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and look, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> going each one after the stubbornness of his evil heart, without listening to me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:13
verses.text: So I will throw you from this land to the land that you have not known, you or your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will not show you favor.  <div eID="gen20307" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8839"/><title type="x-s">The Nation’s Return to the Land</title> <div sID="gen20308" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8839"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> look, days are coming,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and it will no longer be said, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As Yahweh lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “The life of Yahweh”</note> who led up the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> from the land of Egypt,”

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but only⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “but if”</note> “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As Yahweh lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “The life of Yahweh”</note> who led up the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> from the land of the north, and from all the lands where he had driven them,” for I will bring them back to their ground that I gave to their ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:16
verses.text: Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> sending for many fishermen,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and they will fish them out, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞afterward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “after thus”</note> I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and from the clefts of the cliffs.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:17
verses.text: For my eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on all their ways, they are not hidden <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from to the face of me”</note> and their iniquity is not concealed from before my eyes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:18
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will first doubly repay⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will reward first second”</note> their iniquity and their sin because of their profaning my land with the dead bodies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dead body”</note> of their abhorrences, and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their abominations they have filled up my inheritance.’ ”  <div eID="gen20308" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8840"/><lg sID="gen20309"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8840"/><transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, my strength, and my stronghold,<l eID="gen20310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20311"/>and my refuge in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of distress,<l eID="gen20311" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20312"/>to you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations will come from the ends of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen20312" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20313"/>and they will say, “Our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> have inherited only lies,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note><l eID="gen20313" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20314"/>vanity, and there is no profit in them. <l eID="gen20314" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8841"/><l level="1" sID="gen20315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8841"/>Can a human make for himself gods?<l eID="gen20315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20316"/>Yet they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not gods!” <l eID="gen20316" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8842"/><l level="1" sID="gen20317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8842"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to let them know,<l eID="gen20317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20318"/>this time I am going to let them know<l eID="gen20318" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20319"/>my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> and my might,<l eID="gen20319" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20320"/>and they will know that my name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh.” <l eID="gen20320" level="2"/><lg eID="gen20309"/> <chapter eID="Jer.16"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8843"/><title type="x-s">The Sin of Judah</title> <div sID="gen20321" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen20321" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20322"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8843"/>“The sin of Judah <transChange type="added">is</transChange> written with an iron stylus,<l eID="gen20323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20324"/>with a point of diamond <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> engraved<l eID="gen20324" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20325"/>on the tablet of their heart,<l eID="gen20325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20326"/>and on the horns of their altars. <l eID="gen20326" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8844"/><l level="1" sID="gen20327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8844"/>As the remembering of their children,<l eID="gen20327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20328"/><transChange type="added">so is the remembering of</transChange> their altars<l eID="gen20328" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20329"/>and their poles of Asherah worship<l eID="gen20329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20330"/>beside <transChange type="added">the</transChange> leafy trees<note placement="foot">Hebrew “tree”</note> on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> high hills. <l eID="gen20330" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8845"/><l level="1" sID="gen20331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8845"/><transChange type="added">O</transChange> my mountain in the open country,<l eID="gen20331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20332"/>I will give your wealth, all your treasures, for spoil,<l eID="gen20332" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20333"/>your high places, because of <transChange type="added">your</transChange> sin,<l eID="gen20333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20334"/>throughout all your territories. <l eID="gen20334" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:4
