verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8846"/><l level="1" sID="gen20335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8846"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will let go your hand from your inheritance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you shall loose and in you from your inheritance”</note><l eID="gen20335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20336"/>that I gave to you,<l eID="gen20336" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20337"/>and I will make you serve your enemies<l eID="gen20337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20338"/>in the land that you do not know,<l eID="gen20338" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20339"/>for you kindled a fire in my anger,<l eID="gen20339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20340"/>until eternity it will be kindled.” <l eID="gen20340" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20322"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8847"/><title type="x-s">The One Who Trusts in Humankind Contrasted With the One Who Trusts in Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen20341" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8847"/>Thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen20341" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20342"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20343"/>“Cursed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the person who trusts in humankind<l eID="gen20343" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20344"/>and makes flesh his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞strength⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “arm”</note><l eID="gen20344" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20345"/>and turns aside his heart from Yahweh. <l eID="gen20345" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8848"/><l level="1" sID="gen20346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8848"/>And he will be like a juniper in the wilderness,<note placement="foot">Or “Arabah”</note><l eID="gen20346" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20347"/>and he will not see when good comes,<l eID="gen20347" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20348"/>and he will dwell <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> parched places in the desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note><l eID="gen20348" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20349"/><transChange type="added">in</transChange> a land of salt flats,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “salt flat”</note> where no one lives. <l eID="gen20349" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8849"/><l level="1" sID="gen20350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8849"/>Blessed be the person who trusts in Yahweh,<l eID="gen20350" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20351"/>and Yahweh is his trust. <l eID="gen20351" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8850"/><l level="1" sID="gen20352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8850"/>For he will be like a tree planted by water,<l eID="gen20352" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20353"/>and to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stream it sends its roots,<l eID="gen20353" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20354"/>and it will not fear when heat comes,<l eID="gen20354" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20355"/>and its leaves<note placement="foot">Hebrew “leaf”</note> will be luxuriant,<l eID="gen20355" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20356"/>and in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> year of drought it will not be anxious,<l eID="gen20356" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20357"/>and it will not cease from the bearing of fruit. <l eID="gen20357" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8851"/><l level="1" sID="gen20358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8851"/>The heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> deceitful more than anything else,<l eID="gen20358" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20359"/>and it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> disastrous. Who can understand it? <l eID="gen20359" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8852"/><l level="1" sID="gen20360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8852"/>I, Yahweh, examine <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note><l eID="gen20360" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20361"/><transChange type="added">I</transChange> test <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “kidneys”</note><l eID="gen20361" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20362"/>and give to each one according to his way,<l eID="gen20362" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20363"/>according to the fruit of his deeds. <l eID="gen20363" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8853"/><l level="1" sID="gen20364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8853"/><transChange type="added">Like</transChange> a partridge that hatches eggs it did not lay<l eID="gen20364" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20365"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> one who amasses wealth without justice.<l eID="gen20365" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20366"/>In the middle of his days it will leave him,<l eID="gen20366" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20367"/>and at his end he will <transChange type="added">prove to</transChange> be a fool.”<l eID="gen20367" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20342"/> <title type="x-s">The Fountain of Living Water</title> <div sID="gen20368" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen20368" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8854"/><lg sID="gen20369"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8854"/>A lofty throne of glory from the beginning<l eID="gen20370" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20371"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> the place of our sanctuary. <l eID="gen20371" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8855"/><l level="1" sID="gen20372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8855"/><transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, the hope of Israel,<l eID="gen20372" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20373"/>all <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> forsake you will be put to shame,<l eID="gen20373" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20374"/>and <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> turn aside from you in the earth will be recorded,<l eID="gen20374" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20375"/>for they have forsaken the fountain of living water, Yahweh. <l eID="gen20375" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8856"/><l level="1" sID="gen20376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8856"/>Heal me, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, and I will be healed,<l eID="gen20376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20377"/>save me, and I will be saved,<l eID="gen20377" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20378"/>for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my praise. <l eID="gen20378" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8857"/><l level="1" sID="gen20379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8857"/>Look, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> saying to me,<l eID="gen20379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20380"/>“Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the word of Yahweh?<l eID="gen20380" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20381"/>Please let it come.” <l eID="gen20381" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8858"/><l level="1" sID="gen20382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8858"/>But I, I have not run away from being a shepherd <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who follows you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “after you”</note><l eID="gen20382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20383"/>and I have not desired the disastrous day.<l eID="gen20383" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20384"/>You, you know the pronouncement of my lips,<l eID="gen20384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20385"/>it was before your face. <l eID="gen20385" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8859"/><l level="1" sID="gen20386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8859"/>You must not become to me a terror,<l eID="gen20386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20387"/>you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my refuge in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of disaster. <l eID="gen20387" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8860"/><l level="1" sID="gen20388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8860"/>Let my persecutors be put to shame,<l eID="gen20388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20389"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but as for me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I”</note> <transChange type="added">do</transChange> not let me be put to shame.<l eID="gen20389" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20390"/>Let them be dismayed,<l eID="gen20390" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20391"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but as for me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I”</note> <transChange type="added">do</transChange> not let me be dismayed.<l eID="gen20391" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20392"/>Bring on them the day of disaster,<l eID="gen20392" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20393"/>and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> double destruction, destroy them. <l eID="gen20393" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20369"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8861"/><title type="x-s">The Sabbath Day</title> <div sID="gen20394" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8861"/>Thus said Yahweh to me, “Go, and you must stand in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞People’s Gate⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gate of the sons/children of the people”</note> through which the kings of Judah enter, and through which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:20
verses.text: And you must say to them, ‘Hear the word of Yahweh, kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem who enter through these gates.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:21
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh, “Be on your guard for the sake of yourselves, that you must not carry a burden on the day of the Sabbath, and you must <transChange type="added">not</transChange> bring <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> through the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:22
verses.text: And you must not carry a burden from your houses on the day of the Sabbath, and you must not do any work. But you must declare holy the day of Sabbath, just as I commanded your ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:23
verses.text: Yet they did not listen, and they did not incline their ear, and they hardened their neck <transChange type="added">so as</transChange> to not hear, nor to receive discipline.  <div eID="gen20394" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8862"/><div sID="gen20395" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8862"/>“And it will happen, if you carefully listen to me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “to bring no burden through the gates of this city on the day of the Sabbath, but to declare holy the day of Sabbath, not to do on it any work,

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:25
verses.text: then kings and officials who sit on the throne of David will enter through the gates of this city riding in chariots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note> and on horses, they, and their officials, the people of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:26
verses.text: And they will come from the towns of Judah, and from all around Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the Shephelah, and from the hill country, and from the Negev, bringing burnt offerings,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “burnt offering”</note> and sacrifices,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sacrifice”</note> and grain offerings,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “grain offering”</note> and frankincense, and bringing thank offerings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thank offering”</note> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:27
verses.text: But if you do not listen to me, to declare holy the day of the Sabbath, and to not carry a burden and enter through the gates of Jerusalem on the day of the Sabbath, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it will not be quenched.” ’ ”  <chapter eID="Jer.17"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8863"/><title type="x-s">The Potter and the Clay</title> <div sID="gen20396" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8863"/>The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:2
verses.text: “Stand up and go down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of the potter, and there I will let you hear my words.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:3
verses.text: So I went down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of the potter and look, there he was doing work at the potter’s wheels.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:4
verses.text: And the vessel that he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> making with the clay was spoiled in the hand of the potter, so <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he made again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he turned back and he made it”</note> another vessel, as it was right in the eyes of the potter to make.  <div eID="gen20396" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8864"/><div sID="gen20397" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8864"/>And the word of Yahweh came to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:6
verses.text: “Like this potter, am I not able to do to you, O house of Israel?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. “Look, like the clay in the hand of the potter, so <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you in my hand, O house of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:7
verses.text: One moment I speak concerning a nation or concerning a kingdom, to uproot, and to tear down, and to destroy <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:8
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">if</transChange> that nation turns back from its evil that I have threatened against it, then I will relent concerning the disaster that I planned to do to it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:9
verses.text: And the <transChange type="added">next</transChange> moment I speak concerning a nation or concerning a kingdom, to build, and to plant <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:10
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">if</transChange> it does evil in my sight, to not listen to my voice, then I will relent concerning the good that I said I would do <transChange type="added">to</transChange> it.  <div eID="gen20397" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8865"/><div sID="gen20398" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8865"/>“So now then, say, please, to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “man”</note> of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Thus says Yahweh, “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> preparing evil against you, and <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> planning a plan against you. Please turn back, each one from his evil way, and walk rightly <transChange type="added">in</transChange> your ways and your deeds.” ’

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:12
verses.text: But they will say, ‘<transChange type="added">It is</transChange> hopeless, for we will go after our <transChange type="added">own</transChange> plans, and each one of us will act <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> the stubbornness of his evil heart.’  <div eID="gen20398" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8866"/><div sID="gen20399" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8866"/>“Therefore thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen20399" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20400"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20401"/>‘Please ask among the nations, “Who has heard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the like of this⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “like these”</note><l eID="gen20401" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20402"/>The virgin of Israel has done something very horrible. <l eID="gen20402" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8867"/><l level="1" sID="gen20403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8867"/>Does the snow of Lebanon leave from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> crags<note placement="foot">Hebrew “crag”</note> of Sirion?<l eID="gen20403" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20404"/>Or are <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cold waters flowing from distant mountains dried up? <l eID="gen20404" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8868"/><l level="1" sID="gen20405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8868"/>But my people have forgotten me.<l eID="gen20405" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20406"/>They make smoke offerings to the idols,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “idol”</note><l eID="gen20406" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20407"/>and they caused them to stumble in their ways, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ancient ways,<l eID="gen20407" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20408"/>to go <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bypaths⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “paths of way”</note> not <transChange type="added">one that</transChange> is built up. <l eID="gen20408" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8869"/><l level="1" sID="gen20409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8869"/>To make their land a horror,<l eID="gen20409" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20410"/><transChange type="added">an object of</transChange> whistling for eternity.<l eID="gen20410" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20411"/>All <transChange type="added">who</transChange> pass by it will be appalled,<l eID="gen20411" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20412"/>and he will shake his head. <l eID="gen20412" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8870"/><l level="1" sID="gen20413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8870"/>Like the wind from the east<l eID="gen20413" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20414"/>I will scatter them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy.<l eID="gen20414" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20415"/>I will show them <transChange type="added">my</transChange> back and not <transChange type="added">my</transChange> face<l eID="gen20415" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20416"/>in the day of their disaster.’ ” <l eID="gen20416" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20400"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8871"/><title type="x-s">Jeremiah’s Imprecatory Prayer</title> <div sID="gen20417" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8871"/>Then they said, “Come and let us plan plans against Jeremiah, for instruction will not be lost from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> priest, nor advice from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise man, nor <transChange type="added">the</transChange> word from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prophet. Come and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞let us bring charges against him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “let us strike him with the tongue”</note> and let us not listen attentively to any of his words.”  <div eID="gen20417" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8872"/><lg sID="gen20418"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8872"/>Listen attentively to me, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen20419" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20420"/>and listen to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of my opponents. <l eID="gen20420" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8873"/><l level="1" sID="gen20421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8873"/>Should good be repaid in place of evil?<l eID="gen20421" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20422"/>Yet they have dug a pit for me.<l eID="gen20422" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20423"/>Remember my standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> to speak good for them,<l eID="gen20423" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20424"/>to avert your wrath from them. <l eID="gen20424" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8874"/><l level="1" sID="gen20425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8874"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> give their children to the famine,<l eID="gen20425" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20426"/>and hand them over to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword,<l eID="gen20426" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20427"/>and let their wives be bereaved and widows,<l eID="gen20427" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20428"/>and let their men be killed by death,<l eID="gen20428" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20429"/>their young men struck dead<l eID="gen20429" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20430"/><transChange type="added">by the</transChange> sword in the battle. <l eID="gen20430" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8875"/><l level="1" sID="gen20431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8875"/>Let a cry for help be heard from their houses<l eID="gen20431" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20432"/>when you suddenly bring upon them <transChange type="added">the</transChange> raiding band,<l eID="gen20432" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20433"/>for they have dug a pit to catch me,<l eID="gen20433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20434"/>and they have fixed secretly a trap for my feet. <l eID="gen20434" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8876"/><l level="1" sID="gen20435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8876"/>But you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, you know<l eID="gen20435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20436"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all their plans of assassination against me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all of their plan against me to the death”</note><l eID="gen20436" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20437"/>You must not make atonement for their iniquity,<l eID="gen20437" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20438"/>and you must not cause their sin to be blotted out from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note><l eID="gen20438" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20439"/>But let them be overthrown <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note><l eID="gen20439" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20440"/>Deal with them in the time of your anger. <l eID="gen20440" level="2"/><lg eID="gen20418"/> <chapter eID="Jer.18"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8877"/><title type="x-s">The Valley of the Slaughter</title> <div sID="gen20441" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8877"/>Thus said Yahweh, “Go and buy a potter’s earthenware jar, and <transChange type="added">take</transChange> some of the elders of the people, and some of the leaders of the priests,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:2
verses.text: and go out to the Valley of Ben Hinnom, which <transChange type="added">is at</transChange> the entrance of the Gate of the Potsherd, and proclaim there the words that I speak to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:3
verses.text: And you shall say, ‘Hear the word of Yahweh, O kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel: “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to bring disaster upon this place so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone who hears it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all hears it”</note> his ears will ring.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:4
verses.text: Because they have forsaken me, and they have defaced this place, and they have made smoke offerings in it to other gods whom they have not known, they, nor their ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> nor the kings of Judah, and they have filled up this place <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> blood of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> innocent,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:5
verses.text: and they have built the high places of Baal, to burn their children in the fire, burnt offerings to Baal, which I commanded not, and I ordered not, and it did not come to my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note>  <div eID="gen20441" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8878"/><div sID="gen20442" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8878"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> look, days are about to come,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “when this place will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “surely if”</note> the Valley of the Slaughter.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:7
verses.text: And I will lay waste the plans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “plan”</note> of Judah and Jerusalem in this place, and I will bring them to ruin by the sword <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life, and I will give their dead bodies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dead body”</note> as food to the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of heaven and to the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:8
verses.text: And I will make this city a horror, and <transChange type="added">an object of</transChange> hissing, everyone <transChange type="added">who</transChange> passes by it will be appalled, and will hiss because of all its wounds.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:9
verses.text: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons, and the flesh of their daughters, and each one will eat the flesh of his neighbor in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> siege and in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> distress which their enemies and those who seek their life inflict on them.” ’  <div eID="gen20442" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8879"/><div sID="gen20443" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8879"/>“Then you shall break the jar before the eyes of the men who go with you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:11
verses.text: And you shall say to them, ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts: “So I will break this people and this city as one breaks the vessel of the potter, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> that it is not able to be repaired again. And in Topheth they will bury <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until there is no room to bury⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from there is no place to bury”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:12
verses.text: Thus will I do to this place,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and to its inhabitants, to make this city like Topheth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:13
verses.text: And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be unclean like the place of Topheth, all the houses where they made smoke offerings upon their roofs to all the host of heaven, and <transChange type="added">where</transChange> they poured out libations to other gods.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen20443" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8880"/><div sID="gen20444" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8880"/>Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where Yahweh had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the courtyard of the house of Yahweh and said to all the people,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:15
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, ‘Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to bring to this city and upon all its towns all the disaster that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their neck to not hear my words.’ ”  <chapter eID="Jer.19"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8881"/><title type="x-s">A Message for Pashhur</title> <div sID="gen20445" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8881"/>Now Pashhur, the son of Immer, the priest <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> officer in charge in the temple of Yahweh, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:2
verses.text: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the upper Gate of Benjamin, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> by the temple of Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:3
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it was”</note> on the next day, when Pashhur brought Jeremiah out from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, “Yahweh will not call your name Pashhur, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “but if”</note> Terror From All Around.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:4
verses.text: For thus says Yahweh, ‘Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> making you a terror to yourself and to all your friends, and they will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> seeing <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> And all Judah I will give into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will deport them <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon, and he will strike them with the sword.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:5
verses.text: And I will give all the wealth of this city, and all its acquisitions, and all its precious items, and all of the treasures of the kings of Judah I will give into the hand of their enemies, and they will plunder them, and they will seize them, and they will bring them <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:6
verses.text: And you, Pashhur, and all <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> live <transChange type="added">in</transChange> your house will go into captivity, and you will go <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends to whom you have prophesied <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the lie”</note>’ ” <div eID="gen20445" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">Jeremiah’s Lament</title> <div sID="gen20446" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen20446" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8882"/><lg sID="gen20447"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8882"/>You have persuaded me, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, and I was persuaded.<l eID="gen20448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20449"/>You have overpowered me, and you have prevailed.<l eID="gen20449" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20450"/>I have become a laughingstock all day <transChange type="added">long</transChange>.<l eID="gen20450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20451"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Everyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All of him”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mocking me. <l eID="gen20451" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8883"/><l level="1" sID="gen20452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8883"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as often as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from enough”</note> I speak,<l eID="gen20452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20453"/>I must cry out violence and destruction.<l eID="gen20453" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20454"/>I must shout, for the word of Yahweh has become for me<l eID="gen20454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20455"/>a disgrace and derision all day <transChange type="added">long</transChange>. <l eID="gen20455" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8884"/><l level="1" sID="gen20456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8884"/>But <transChange type="added">if</transChange> I say, “I will not mention him<l eID="gen20456" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20457"/>and I will no longer speak in his name,”<l eID="gen20457" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20458"/>then it becomes in my heart like a fire burning,<l eID="gen20458" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20459"/>locked up in my bones,<l eID="gen20459" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20460"/>and I struggle to contain <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note><l eID="gen20460" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20461"/>and I am not able. <l eID="gen20461" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8885"/><l level="1" sID="gen20462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8885"/>For I hear the rumor of many,<l eID="gen20462" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20463"/>“Terror <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from all around, denounce <transChange type="added">him</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note><l eID="gen20463" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20464"/>yes, let us denounce him!”<l eID="gen20464" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20465"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞All my close friends⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All the human being of my peace”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> watchers of my stumbling,<l eID="gen20465" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20466"/><transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, “perhaps he can be persuaded,<l eID="gen20466" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20467"/>and we can prevail over him,<l eID="gen20467" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20468"/>and we can take our revenge on him.” <l eID="gen20468" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8886"/><l level="1" sID="gen20469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8886"/>But Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with me like a powerful warrior.<l eID="gen20469" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20470"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail.<l eID="gen20470" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20471"/>They will be very ashamed, for they will not achieve success.<l eID="gen20471" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20472"/><transChange type="added">Their</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everlasting insult⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “insult of eternity”</note> will not be forgotten. <l eID="gen20472" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8887"/><l level="1" sID="gen20473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8887"/>Yet, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh of hosts, who tests <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous,<l eID="gen20473" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20474"/>who sees <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “kidneys”</note> and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note><l eID="gen20474" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20475"/>let me see your retribution upon them,<l eID="gen20475" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20476"/>for to you I have revealed my legal case. <l eID="gen20476" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8888"/><l level="1" sID="gen20477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8888"/>Sing to Yahweh, praise Yahweh,<l eID="gen20477" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20478"/>for he has delivered <transChange type="added">the</transChange> life of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of evildoers. <l eID="gen20478" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8889"/><l level="1" sID="gen20479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8889"/>Cursed be <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day <transChange type="added">on</transChange> which I was born,<l eID="gen20479" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20480"/>let not the day <transChange type="added">on</transChange> which my mother gave birth to me be blessed. <l eID="gen20480" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8890"/><l level="1" sID="gen20481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8890"/>Cursed be the man who brought the news <transChange type="added">to</transChange> my father,<l eID="gen20481" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20482"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “A child is born to you, a son!”<l eID="gen20482" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20483"/>and he made him very glad. <l eID="gen20483" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8891"/><l level="1" sID="gen20484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8891"/>And let that man be like the cities<l eID="gen20484" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20485"/>that Yahweh demolished without regret,<l eID="gen20485" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20486"/>and let him hear a cry for help in the morning,<l eID="gen20486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20487"/>and an alarm at the time of noon. <l eID="gen20487" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8892"/><l level="1" sID="gen20488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8892"/>Because he did not kill me in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb,<l eID="gen20488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20489"/>so that my mother would have been for me my grave,<l eID="gen20489" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20490"/>and <transChange type="added">her</transChange> womb <transChange type="added">would be</transChange> pregnant forever. <l eID="gen20490" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8893"/><l level="1" sID="gen20491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8893"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Why⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To what this”</note> did I come out from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb,<l eID="gen20491" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20492"/>to see toil, and sorrow, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞end my days in shame⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “my days will come to an end in shame”</note> <l eID="gen20492" level="2"/><lg eID="gen20447"/> <chapter eID="Jer.20"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8894"/><title type="x-s">A Message for Zedekiah</title> <div sID="gen20493" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8894"/>The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur, the son of Malchiah, and Zephaniah, the son of Maaseiah, the priest, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:2
verses.text: “Please inquire <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Yahweh on behalf of us, for Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon <transChange type="added">is</transChange> fighting against us. Perhaps Yahweh will do with us according to all his miraculous acts, so that he may go up from against us.”  <div eID="gen20493" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8895"/><div sID="gen20494" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8895"/>Then Jeremiah said to them, “Thus you shall say to Zedekiah:

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:4
verses.text: ‘Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to turn back the weapons of war that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in your hands,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “hand”</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> fighting against them, the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who are laying siege to you from outside the wall, and I will gather them into the center of this city.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:5
verses.text: And I myself will fight against you with outstretched hand, and with strong arm, and in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “nose”</note> and in fury, and in great wrath.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:6
verses.text: And I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both humankind and animal; by a great plague they will die.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:7
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞afterward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “after thus”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “I will give Zedekiah, the king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and those who remain in this city from the plague, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their lives, and he will strike them with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞edge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword. He will not take pity on them, and he will not have compassion, nor will he show compassion.” ’  <div eID="gen20494" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8896"/><title type="x-s">The Way of Life and the Way of Death</title> <div sID="gen20495" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8896"/>“And to this people you shall say, ‘Thus says Yahweh, “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> setting <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> the way of life and the way of death.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:9
verses.text: He who stays in this city will die by the sword, or by the famine, or by the plague. And he who goes out and goes over to the Chaldeans who are laying siege to you will live, and his life will be to him as booty.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:10
verses.text: For I have set my face against this city for evil and not for good,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.” ’  <div eID="gen20495" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8897"/><title type="x-s">A Series of Messages for the House of the King of Judah</title> <div sID="gen20496" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8897"/>“And to the house of the king of Judah, ‘Hear the word of Yahweh,

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:12
verses.text: O house of David, thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen20496" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20497"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20498"/>“Execute judgment in the morning, justice,<l eID="gen20498" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20499"/>and deliver <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who has been seized<l eID="gen20499" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20500"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppressor,<l eID="gen20500" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20501"/>lest my wrath goes forth like the fire and it burns,<l eID="gen20501" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20502"/>and there is no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> quenches <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note><l eID="gen20502" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20503"/>because of the evil of your deeds. <l eID="gen20503" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8898"/><l level="1" sID="gen20504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8898"/>Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against you,<l eID="gen20504" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20505"/>O inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of the valley,<l eID="gen20505" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20506"/>O rock of the plain,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh;<l eID="gen20506" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20507"/>“you who say, ‘Who can descend against us,<l eID="gen20507" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20508"/>or who can enter into our hiding place?’ <l eID="gen20508" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8899"/><l level="1" sID="gen20509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8899"/>And I will punish you<l eID="gen20509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20510"/>according to the fruit of your deeds,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen20510" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20511"/>“And I will kindle a fire in its forest,<l eID="gen20511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20512"/>and it will devour all its surroundings.” ’ ” <l eID="gen20512" level="2"/><lg eID="gen20497"/> <chapter eID="Jer.21"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:1
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: “Go down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of the king of Judah and you must speak this word there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:2
verses.text: And you must say, ‘Hear the word of Yahweh, O king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David, you, and your servants, and your people who enter through these gates.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:3
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh, “Act <transChange type="added">with</transChange> justice and righteousness, and deliver <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who has been seized from the hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oppressor. And you must not oppress <transChange type="added">the</transChange> immigrant, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow. And you must not shed innocent blood in this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:4
verses.text: And if you indeed obey this word, then kings who sit for David on his throne will enter through the gates of this house, riding in chariots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note> and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:5
verses.text: But if you do not obey these words, I swear by myself,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “that this house will become a site of ruins.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen20513" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8900"/><div sID="gen20514" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8900"/>For thus says Yahweh concerning the house of the king of Judah, <div eID="gen20514" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20515"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20516"/>“You <transChange type="added">are like</transChange> Gilead to me,<l eID="gen20516" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20517"/><transChange type="added">like</transChange> the head of the Lebanon.<l eID="gen20517" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20518"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If not”</note> I will make you a desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note><l eID="gen20518" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20519"/><transChange type="added">like</transChange> cities <transChange type="added">that</transChange> are not inhabited. <l eID="gen20519" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8901"/><l level="1" sID="gen20520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8901"/>And I will consecrate against you destroyers,<l eID="gen20520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20521"/>everyone with his weapons,<l eID="gen20521" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20522"/>and they will cut down <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your choicest cedars⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the choicest thing of your cedars”</note><l eID="gen20522" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20523"/>and cast <transChange type="added">them</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> on the fire. <l eID="gen20523" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20515"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8902"/><div sID="gen20524" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8902"/>And many nations will pass by this city and they will say each one to his neighbor, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Why⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Over what”</note> has Yahweh done in this manner to this great city?’

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:9
verses.text: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh their God, and bowed down in worship to other gods, and served them.’ ”  <div eID="gen20524" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8903"/><lg sID="gen20525"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8903"/>You must not weep for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dead person,<l eID="gen20526" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20527"/>and you must not show sympathy for him.<l eID="gen20527" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20528"/>Weep bitterly for the one who goes away,<l eID="gen20528" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20529"/>for he will not return, or see the land of his birth again. <l eID="gen20529" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20525"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8904"/><div sID="gen20530" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8904"/>For thus says Yahweh concerning Shallum, the son of Josiah, the king of Judah, who reigned as king in place of Josiah his father, who went out from this place: “He will not return here again.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:12
verses.text: But in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> place where they have deported him, there he will die, and he will not see this land again.  <div eID="gen20530" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8905"/><lg sID="gen20531"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8905"/>Woe <transChange type="added">to the one who</transChange> builds his house without righteousness,<l eID="gen20532" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20533"/>and his upper rooms without justice.<l eID="gen20533" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20534"/>His fellow countryman, he works for nothing,<l eID="gen20534" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20535"/>and he does not give to him his wages.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wage”</note> <l eID="gen20535" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8906"/><l level="1" sID="gen20536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8906"/>Who says ‘I will build for myself<l eID="gen20536" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20537"/>a spacious house with large upper rooms,’<l eID="gen20537" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20538"/>and he cuts windows for it,<l eID="gen20538" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20539"/>and <transChange type="added">it is</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the subject is supplied from context in the English translation</note> paneled with cedar,<l eID="gen20539" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20540"/>and he paints <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with vermilion. <l eID="gen20540" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8907"/><l level="1" sID="gen20541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8907"/>Do you reign as king because you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> competing in cedar?<l eID="gen20541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20542"/>Did not your father eat and drink,<l eID="gen20542" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20543"/>and he did justice and righteousness,<l eID="gen20543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20544"/>then it was well with him? <l eID="gen20544" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8908"/><l level="1" sID="gen20545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8908"/>He judged <transChange type="added">the</transChange> legal cause of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor,<l eID="gen20545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20546"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> then it was well.<l eID="gen20546" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20547"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Is that not what it means to know me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “Not that the knowledge me”</note>” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen20547" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8909"/><l level="1" sID="gen20548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8909"/>“But there is nothing <transChange type="added">in</transChange> your eyes and your heart<l eID="gen20548" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20549"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞except⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “but if”</note> your unlawful gain,<l eID="gen20549" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20550"/>and on shedding the blood of the innocent,<l eID="gen20550" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20551"/>and on committing oppression and extortion.” <l eID="gen20551" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20531"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8910"/><div sID="gen20552" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8910"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh concerning Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, the king of Judah: <div eID="gen20552" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20553"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20554"/>“They will not lament for him,<l eID="gen20554" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20555"/>‘Alas, my brother,’ or ‘Alas, sister.’<l eID="gen20555" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20556"/>They will not lament for him,<l eID="gen20556" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20557"/>‘Alas, lord,’ or ‘alas, his majesty.’ <l eID="gen20557" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8911"/><l level="1" sID="gen20558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8911"/>He will be buried <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the burial of a donkey.<l eID="gen20558" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20559"/><transChange type="added">He will be</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the subject is supplied from context in the English translation</note> dragged away and thrown <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from beyond”</note> the gates of Jerusalem. <l eID="gen20559" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8912"/><l level="1" sID="gen20560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8912"/>Go up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Lebanon and cry out,<l eID="gen20560" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20561"/>and in Bashan lift up your voice,<l eID="gen20561" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20562"/>and cry out from Abarim,<l eID="gen20562" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20563"/>for all your lovers are shattered. <l eID="gen20563" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8913"/><l level="1" sID="gen20564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8913"/>I spoke to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the times you were secure⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in your security”</note><l eID="gen20564" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20565"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> you said, ‘I will not listen!’<l eID="gen20565" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20566"/>This <transChange type="added">was</transChange> your way from your youth,<l eID="gen20566" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20567"/>for you have not obeyed my voice. <l eID="gen20567" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8914"/><l level="1" sID="gen20568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8914"/>All your shepherds will shepherd <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind,<l eID="gen20568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20569"/>and your lovers will go into captivity.<l eID="gen20569" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20570"/>Yes, then you will be ashamed and humiliated<l eID="gen20570" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20571"/>because of all your wickedness. <l eID="gen20571" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8915"/><l level="1" sID="gen20572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8915"/>Inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Inhabitant”</note> of Lebanon,<l eID="gen20572" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20573"/>nestled among the cedars,<l eID="gen20573" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20574"/>how you will groan when labor pains come to you,<l eID="gen20574" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20575"/>fear and pain as the <transChange type="added">woman who</transChange> gives birth. <l eID="gen20575" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20553"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8916"/><div sID="gen20576" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8916"/>“As I live,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “surely if Coniah, the son of Jehoiakim, the king of Judah, were <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seal on my right hand, surely from there I would wrench you off.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:25
verses.text: And I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of those from whom you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> frightened by their presence, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:26
verses.text: And I will throw you and your mother who gave birth to you to another country where you were not born, and there you will die.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:27
verses.text: As for the land to which they are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞longing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lifting their inner self”</note> to return, they will not return.  <div eID="gen20576" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8917"/><lg sID="gen20577"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8917"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> this man Coniah a despised, shattered vessel?<l eID="gen20578" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20579"/>Or a vessel <transChange type="added">in which</transChange> there is no delight?<l eID="gen20579" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20580"/>Why are he and his offspring thrown far,<l eID="gen20580" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20581"/>and cast away to the land that they do not know?” <l eID="gen20581" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20577"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8918"/><div sID="gen20582" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8918"/><transChange type="added">O</transChange> land, land, land, hear the word of Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:30
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen20582" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20583"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20584"/>“Record this man <transChange type="added">as</transChange> childless,<l eID="gen20584" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20585"/>a man <transChange type="added">who</transChange> will not succeed in his days,<l eID="gen20585" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20586"/>for no man from his offspring will succeed <transChange type="added">him</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note><l eID="gen20586" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20587"/>sitting on the throne of David and ruling again in Judah.” <l eID="gen20587" level="2"/><lg eID="gen20583"/> <chapter eID="Jer.22"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8919"/><title type="x-s">Woe to the Evil Shepherds</title> <div sID="gen20588" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8919"/>“Woe <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> shepherds who destroy and scatter the flock of my pasture,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:2
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel concerning the shepherds who shepherd my people, “You yourselves have scattered my flock, and you have driven them away, and you do not attend to them. Look, I will punish you for the evil of your deeds,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:3
verses.text: “Then I myself will gather together the remnant of my flock from all the lands where I have driven them, and I will bring them back to their grazing place, and they will be fruitful, and they will become numerous.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:4
verses.text: And I will raise up over them shepherds, and they will shepherd them, and they will no longer fear, and they will not be dismayed, and they will not be missing,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <div eID="gen20588" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">The Righteous Branch</title> <div sID="gen20589" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen20589" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8920"/><lg sID="gen20590"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8920"/>“Look, days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen20591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20592"/>“when I will raise up for David a righteous branch,<l eID="gen20592" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20593"/>and he will reign <transChange type="added">as</transChange> king, and he will achieve success,<l eID="gen20593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20594"/>and he will do justice and righteousness in the land. <l eID="gen20594" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8921"/><l level="1" sID="gen20595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8921"/>In his days Judah will be saved,<l eID="gen20595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20596"/>and Israel will dwell <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in safety⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence”</note><l eID="gen20596" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20597"/>and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name <transChange type="added">by</transChange> which he will be called:<l eID="gen20597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20598"/>‘Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our righteousness.’ <l eID="gen20598" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20590"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8922"/><div sID="gen20599" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8922"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> look, days are coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “when they will no longer say, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As Yahweh lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the life of Yahweh”</note> who led up the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> from the land of Egypt,’

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:8
verses.text: but ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As Yahweh lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the life of Yahweh”</note> who led up, and who brought the offspring of the house of Israel from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land <transChange type="added">of the</transChange> north and from all the lands where he had driven them.’ Then they will live in their land.”  <div eID="gen20599" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8923"/><title type="x-s">The Unfaithful Prophets</title> <div sID="gen20600" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8923"/>Concerning the prophets: <div eID="gen20600" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20601"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20602"/>My heart is broken in my midst.<l eID="gen20602" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20603"/>All my bones tremble.<l eID="gen20603" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20604"/>I have become like a drunken man,<l eID="gen20604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20605"/>even like a man over whom wine has passed,<l eID="gen20605" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20606"/>because of Yahweh,<l eID="gen20606" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20607"/>and because of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his holy words⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “words of his holiness”</note> <l eID="gen20607" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8924"/><l level="1" sID="gen20608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8924"/>For the land is full <transChange type="added">of</transChange> adulterers;<l eID="gen20608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20609"/>for the land mourns because of a curse.<l eID="gen20609" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20610"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> pastures of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note> are dry,<l eID="gen20610" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20611"/>and their evil has been their way of running,<l eID="gen20611" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20612"/>and their power <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not right. <l eID="gen20612" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8925"/><l level="1" sID="gen20613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8925"/>“For both prophet as well as priest are godless,<l eID="gen20613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20614"/>even in my temple I have found their wickedness,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen20614" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8926"/><l level="1" sID="gen20615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8926"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> their way will be to them like the slippery places,<l eID="gen20615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20616"/>they will be pushed in the darkness,<l eID="gen20616" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20617"/>and they will fall into it,<l eID="gen20617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20618"/>for I will bring disaster on them <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the year of their punishment,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen20618" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8927"/><l level="1" sID="gen20619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8927"/>“Now in the prophets of Samaria I saw a disgusting thing.<l eID="gen20619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20620"/>They prophesied by Baal and they caused my people Israel to err. <l eID="gen20620" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8928"/><l level="1" sID="gen20621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8928"/>And in the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen something horrible.<l eID="gen20621" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20622"/>They commit adultery, and they walk in lies,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the lie”</note><l eID="gen20622" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20623"/>and they make strong <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hands of evildoers,<l eID="gen20623" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20624"/><transChange type="added">so</transChange> that they have not turned back each from his wickedness.<l eID="gen20624" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20625"/>All of them have become to me like Sodom,<l eID="gen20625" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20626"/>and its inhabitants like Gomorrah.” <l eID="gen20626" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20601"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8929"/><div sID="gen20627" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8929"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh concerning the prophets, <div eID="gen20627" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20628"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20629"/>“Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to let them eat wormwood<l eID="gen20629" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20630"/>and I will give them water of poison to drink,<l eID="gen20630" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20631"/>for from the prophets of Jerusalem<l eID="gen20631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20632"/>went out ungodliness to all the land.” <l eID="gen20632" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20628"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8930"/><div sID="gen20633" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8930"/>Thus says Yahweh of hosts, <div eID="gen20633" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20634"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20635"/>“You must not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you.<l eID="gen20635" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20636"/>They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> deluding you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> visions of their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note><l eID="gen20636" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20637"/>They do not speak from the mouth of Yahweh. <l eID="gen20637" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8931"/><l level="1" sID="gen20638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8931"/><transChange type="added">They are</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the subject and verb are supplied from context in the English translation</note> continually saying to those who disregard the word of Yahweh,<l eID="gen20638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20639"/>‘Peace it will be to you,’<l eID="gen20639" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20640"/>and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all”</note> who walks in the stubbornness of his heart they say,<l eID="gen20640" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20641"/>‘Calamity will not come upon you.’ <l eID="gen20641" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:18
