verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8932"/><l level="1" sID="gen20642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8932"/>For who has stood in the council of Yahweh,<l eID="gen20642" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20643"/>that he has seen and heard his word?<l eID="gen20643" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20644"/>Who has listened attentively <transChange type="added">to</transChange> his word<l eID="gen20644" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20645"/>and heard <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> <l eID="gen20645" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8933"/><l level="1" sID="gen20646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8933"/>Look, the storm of Yahweh has gone forth <transChange type="added">in</transChange> wrath,<l eID="gen20646" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20647"/>even a whirling tempest.<l eID="gen20647" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20648"/>It will whirl upon <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked. <l eID="gen20648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8934"/><l level="1" sID="gen20649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8934"/>The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “nose”</note> of Yahweh will not turn back<l eID="gen20649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20650"/>until his doing and until his keeping the plans of his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note><l eID="gen20650" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20651"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In latter days⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In the last of the days”</note> you will look closely at it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> understanding. <l eID="gen20651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8935"/><l level="1" sID="gen20652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8935"/>I have not sent the prophets, yet they ran.<l eID="gen20652" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20653"/>I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied. <l eID="gen20653" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8936"/><l level="1" sID="gen20654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8936"/>But if they had stood in my council,<l eID="gen20654" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20655"/>then they would have proclaimed my words <transChange type="added">to</transChange> my people,<l eID="gen20655" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20656"/>and they would have caused them to turn from their evil way,<l eID="gen20656" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20657"/>and from the evil of their deeds. <l eID="gen20657" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8937"/><l level="1" sID="gen20658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8937"/><transChange type="added">Am</transChange> I a God from near,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen20658" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20659"/>“and not a God from far? <l eID="gen20659" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8938"/><l level="1" sID="gen20660"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8938"/>Or can a person hide himself in secret places<l eID="gen20660" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20661"/>and I cannot see him?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen20661" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20662"/>“<transChange type="added">Do</transChange> I not fill up the heaven and the earth?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen20662" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen20634"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8939"/><div sID="gen20663" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8939"/>“I have heard what the prophets who prophesy lies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note> have said in my name, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘I have dreamed! I have dreamed!’

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:26
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Until when”</note> will this be in the hearts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> of the prophets who prophesy lies,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the lie”</note> even the prophets of the deceitfulness of their hearts,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:27
verses.text: who plan to make my people forget my name by their dreams that they tell each one to his neighbor, just as their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> forgot my name through Baal?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:28
verses.text: The prophet who <transChange type="added">has</transChange> with him a dream, let him tell <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dream. But <transChange type="added">the prophet</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the subject is supplied from context in the English translation</note> who has my word with him, let him speak my word faithfully. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What is straw compared to wheat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “What to the straw in comparison with the wheat”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:29
verses.text: “<transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not my word like fire?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and like a blacksmith’s hammer <transChange type="added">that</transChange> breaks a rock into pieces?  <div eID="gen20663" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8940"/><div sID="gen20664" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8940"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> look, I am against the prophets,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “who steal my words each one from his neighbor.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:31
verses.text: Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against the prophets,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “who take their tongues<note placement="foot">Hebrew “tongue”</note> and declare as prophets, ‘Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:32
verses.text: Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against those who prophesy dreams of lies,”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and tell them, and they caused my people to err through their lies, and in their recklessness, when I myself have not sent them nor commanded them, so they profit not this people at all,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen20664" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8941"/><div sID="gen20665" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8941"/>“Now when this people, or a prophet, or a priest, ask you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘What is the burden<note placement="foot">Or “oracle”</note> of Yahweh?’ then you shall say to them, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You are the burden⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “What burden”</note> and I will forsake you,’ ” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:34
verses.text: “And the prophet, and the priest, and the people who say, ‘The burden<note placement="foot">Or “oracle”</note> of Yahweh,’ I will punish that man and his house.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:35
verses.text: Thus you shall say, each one to his neighbor and each one to his brother: ‘What has Yahweh answered?’ or, ‘What has Yahweh spoken?’

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:36
verses.text: But you shall not mention the burden<note placement="foot">Or “oracle”</note> of Yahweh, for the burden<note placement="foot">Or “oracle”</note> is to each one his word, and so you twist the words of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living God, Yahweh of hosts, our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:37
verses.text: Thus you shall say to that prophet, ‘What has Yahweh answered you?’ or, ‘What has Yahweh spoken?’

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:38
verses.text: But if you say, ‘The burden<note placement="foot">Or “oracle”</note> of Yahweh,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to thus”</note> thus says Yahweh, ‘because of your saying these words,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “word”</note> “The burden<note placement="foot">Or “oracle”</note> of Yahweh,” then I will send to you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “You shall not say, ‘The burden<note placement="foot">Or “oracle”</note> of Yahweh.’ ” ’

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:39
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> look, here I am, and I will surely lift you up and forsake you and the city that I gave to you and to your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my face”</note>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:40
verses.text: and I will bring upon you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting disgrace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a disgrace of eternity”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting shame⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a shame of eternity”</note> that will not be forgotten.”  <chapter eID="Jer.23"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8942"/><title type="x-s">Two Baskets of Figs</title> <div sID="gen20666" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8942"/>Yahweh showed me, and look, there were two baskets of figs placed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the temple of Yahweh—after Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had deported Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, the king of Judah, with the officials of Judah, and the craftsmen, and the smiths,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “smith”</note> from Jerusalem and had brought them <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:2
verses.text: The one basket <transChange type="added">had</transChange> very good figs, like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞early figs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the figs of the early ripened fruit”</note> and the other basket <transChange type="added">had</transChange> very bad figs that could not be eaten because of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> bad quality.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:3
verses.text: And Yahweh asked me, “What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you seeing, Jeremiah?” And I said, “Figs—the good figs, very good, and the bad <transChange type="added">figs</transChange>, very bad, that cannot be eaten because of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> bad quality.”  <div eID="gen20666" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8943"/><div sID="gen20667" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8943"/>Then the word of Yahweh came to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:5
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard as good the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> of Judah whom I have sent away from this place <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:6
verses.text: For I will set my eyes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “eye”</note> on them for good, and I will bring them back to this land. And I will build them and not annihilate <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, and I will plant them and not uproot <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:7
verses.text: And I will give to them a heart to know me, that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will be my people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they shall be for me as a people”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will be their God⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I will be for them as God”</note> for they will return to me with the whole of their heart.  <div eID="gen20667" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8944"/><div sID="gen20668" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8944"/>But like the bad figs that cannot be eaten because of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> bad quality—for thus says Yahweh—so I will treat Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his officials, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who live in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:9
verses.text: And I will make them as a terror, an evil to all the kingdoms of the earth, as a disgrace and a proverb, as a taunt and a curse, in all the places where I will drive them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:10
verses.text: And I will send among them the sword, the famine, and the plague, until they perish from the land that I gave to them and their ancestors.’ ”<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>  <chapter eID="Jer.24"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8945"/><title type="x-s">Seventy Years of Servitude</title> <div sID="gen20669" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8945"/>The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, the king of Judah, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the first year of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:2
verses.text: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:3
verses.text: “From <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thirteenth year of Josiah, the son of Amon, the king of Judah, even up to this day, these twenty-three years<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> the word of Yahweh has come to me, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have spoken to you over and over again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I have spoken to you doing early and speaking”</note> but you have not listened.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">though</transChange> Yahweh has sent all his servants the prophets to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞over and over again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do early and sending”</note> you have not listened, and you have not inclined your ear to hear,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:5
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Turn back please, each one from his evil way, and from the evil of your deeds, and live on the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> from a long time back and until forever,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:6
verses.text: and you must not go after other gods to serve them, and to bow in worship to them, and you must not provoke me to anger with the work of your hands, then I will not do something bad to you.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:7
verses.text: ‘Yet you have not listened to me,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘so that you<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they”</note> have provoked me to anger with the work of your hands for your own harm.’  <div eID="gen20669" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8946"/><div sID="gen20670" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8946"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh of hosts, ‘Because you have not obeyed my words,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:9
verses.text: look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to send and take all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clans<note placement="foot">Or “families”</note> of the north,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and I will send<note placement="foot">Here the subject and verb are supplied from context in the English translation</note> to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and I will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations all around, and I will destroy them, and I will make them a horror, and an object of hissing, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everlasting ruins⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sites of ruins of eternity”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:10
verses.text: And I will exterminate from them the sound of jubilation, and the sound of joy, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bridegroom, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bride, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> millstones, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> light of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lamp.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:11
verses.text: And all this land will become a site of ruins, a desolation, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note>  <div eID="gen20670" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8947"/><title type="x-s">The Cup of Wrath</title> <div sID="gen20671" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8947"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> when the seventy years<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> are fulfilled, I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and I will make it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting waste⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a waste of eternity”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:13
verses.text: And I will bring upon that land all my words that I have spoken against it, everything that is written in this scroll which Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:14
verses.text: For many nations and great kings will let them work, even them, and I will repay them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.’ ”

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:15
verses.text: For thus said Yahweh, the God of Israel, to me, “Take this cup of the wine <transChange type="added">of</transChange> wrath from my hand, and you must give it <transChange type="added">to</transChange> all the nations to whom I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> sending you to drink.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:16
verses.text: And they will drink, and they will stagger, and they will act like madmen because of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> of the sword that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> sending among them.”  <div eID="gen20671" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8948"/><div sID="gen20672" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8948"/>So I took the cup from the hand of Yahweh and I gave <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> all the nations to whom Yahweh sent me to drink:

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:18
verses.text: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and its kings, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> its officials, to make them a site of ruins, a horror, an <transChange type="added">object of</transChange> hissing, and a curse, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> this day;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:19
verses.text: Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and his servants, and his officials, and all his people;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:20
verses.text: and all the other<note placement="foot">Or “foreign”</note> people; and all the kings of the land of Uz; and all the kings of the land of the Philistines—<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Philistine”</note>Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:21
verses.text: Edom, and Moab, and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:22
verses.text: and all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastland that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> across the sea;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:23
verses.text: and Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all those who are trimmed to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:24
verses.text: and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the other<note placement="foot">Or “foreign”</note> people who dwell in the desert;<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:25
verses.text: and all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of Media;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:26
verses.text: and all the kings of the north, near and far, each one to his brother, and all the kingdoms of the world that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on the face of the earth; and the king of Sheshach, he will drink after them.  <div eID="gen20672" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8949"/><div sID="gen20673" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8949"/>“And you shall say to them, ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, “Drink and become drunk, and vomit, and fall, and you must not rise because of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> of the sword that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> sending among you.” ’

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:28
verses.text: And it will happen, if they refuse to take the cup from your hand to drink, then you shall say to them, ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts, “You must certainly drink!

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:29
verses.text: For look, on the city that is called <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on it”</note> my name I am beginning to inflict harm, and you indeed, will you go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am summoning a sword against all the inhabitants of the earth,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts.’  <div eID="gen20673" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8950"/><div sID="gen20674" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8950"/>And you yourself shall prophesy against them all these words, and you shall say to them: <div eID="gen20674" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20675"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20676"/>‘Yahweh will roar from <transChange type="added">on</transChange> high,<l eID="gen20676" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20677"/>and from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his holy dwelling place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the dwelling place of his holiness”</note> he will give his voice.<l eID="gen20677" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20678"/>He will roar mightily against his settlement,<l eID="gen20678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20679"/>a jubilant shout like those who tread <transChange type="added">grapes</transChange>,<l eID="gen20679" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20680"/>he will answer against all the inhabitants of the earth. <l eID="gen20680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8951"/><l level="1" sID="gen20681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8951"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> rage of battle will resound to the end of the earth,<l eID="gen20681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20682"/>for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> a lawsuit of Yahweh against the nations.<l eID="gen20682" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20683"/>He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> entering into judgment with all wicked flesh,<l eID="gen20683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20684"/>he will give them to the sword,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.” <l eID="gen20684" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20675"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8952"/><div sID="gen20685" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8952"/>Thus says Yahweh of hosts, <div eID="gen20685" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20686"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20687"/>“Look, disaster <transChange type="added">is</transChange> going out from nation to nation,<l eID="gen20687" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20688"/>and a great tempest is stirred up from the farthest parts of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen20688" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8953"/><l level="1" sID="gen20689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8953"/>And the slain <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> of Yahweh will be on that day<l eID="gen20689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20690"/>from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> end of the earth to the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> end of the earth,<l eID="gen20690" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20691"/>and they will not be mourned,<l eID="gen20691" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20692"/>and they will not be gathered,<l eID="gen20692" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20693"/>and they will not be buried.<l eID="gen20693" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20694"/>They will become like dung on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surface⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> of the ground. <l eID="gen20694" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8954"/><l level="1" sID="gen20695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8954"/>Wail, you shepherds, and cry out.<l eID="gen20695" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20696"/>And roll about in mourning <transChange type="added">in the dust</transChange>, O leaders<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> of the flock.<l eID="gen20696" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20697"/>For your days of slaughter and your dispersions have arrived,<l eID="gen20697" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20698"/>and you will fall like a vessel of desire. <l eID="gen20698" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8955"/><l level="1" sID="gen20699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8955"/>And flight will perish from the shepherds,<l eID="gen20699" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20700"/>and escape from the leaders<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> of the flock. <l eID="gen20700" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8956"/><l level="1" sID="gen20701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8956"/>A sound, the cry of distress of the shepherds<l eID="gen20701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20702"/>and the wailing of the leaders<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> of the flock,<l eID="gen20702" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20703"/>for Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> despoiling their pasture. <l eID="gen20703" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8957"/><l level="1" sID="gen20704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8957"/>And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞peaceful settlements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “settlements of the peace”</note> are devastated<l eID="gen20704" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20705"/>because of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the burning anger of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the blaze of the nose of Yahweh”</note> <l eID="gen20705" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8958"/><l level="1" sID="gen20706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8958"/>He has left his den like a lion,<l eID="gen20706" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20707"/>for their land has become a horror,<l eID="gen20707" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20708"/>because of the anger of the oppressors,<l eID="gen20708" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20709"/>and because of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his burning anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “the blaze of his nose”</note> <l eID="gen20709" level="2"/><lg eID="gen20686"/> <chapter eID="Jer.25"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8959"/><title type="x-s">Jeremiah Escapes Death</title> <div sID="gen20710" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8959"/>At the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, the king of Judah, this word came from Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:2
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh: ‘Stand in the courtyard of the house of Yahweh, and you must speak to all the cities of Judah that come to bow in worship <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the house of Yahweh all the words that I command you to speak to them. You must not omit a word.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:3
verses.text: Perhaps they will listen and turn back each from his evil way, and I will relent of the disaster that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> planning to do to them because of their evil deeds.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:4
verses.text: And you shall say to them, “Thus says Yahweh: ‘If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law that I have set<note placement="foot">Or “given”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:5
verses.text: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I have sent to you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞over and over again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and doing early and sending”</note> though you have not listened,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:6
verses.text: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and this city I will make a curse for all the nations of the earth.’ ” ’ ”  <div eID="gen20710" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8960"/><div sID="gen20711" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8960"/>And the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the temple of Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it happened”</note> as Jeremiah finished speaking all that Yahweh had commanded him to speak to all the people, then the priests and the prophets and all the people laid hold of him, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “You will die!

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:9
verses.text: Why have you prophesied in the name of Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be in ruins, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> inhabitant’?” And all the people gathered around Jeremiah in the temple of Yahweh.  <div eID="gen20711" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8961"/><div sID="gen20712" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8961"/>When the officials of Judah heard these things, they came up from the house of the king <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the temple of Yahweh, and they sat in the entrance of the New Gate of Yahweh’s <transChange type="added">temple</transChange>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:11
verses.text: Then the priests and the prophets said to the officials and to all the people, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞This man deserves the death sentence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “A sentence of death is to this man”</note> because he has prophesied against this city as that <transChange type="added">which</transChange> you have heard with your ears.”  <div eID="gen20712" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8962"/><div sID="gen20713" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8962"/>Then Jeremiah said to all the officials and to all the people, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Yahweh sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:13
verses.text: Now <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “so then”</note> amend your ways and your deeds, and obey the voice of Yahweh your God, and Yahweh will relent of the disaster that he has spoken over you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:14
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> me, look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> in your hand, do to me what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good and right in your eyes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:15
verses.text: Only you must certainly know that if you put me to death, you will bring on yourselves innocent blood, and on this city and on its inhabitants, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞truly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in truth”</note> Yahweh sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.”  <div eID="gen20713" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8963"/><div sID="gen20714" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8963"/>Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞This man does not deserve⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Not to this man”</note> a sentence of death, for in the name of Yahweh our God, he has spoken to us.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:17
verses.text: Then men from the elders of the land arose and said to all the assembly of the people, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:18
verses.text: “Micah the Morashtite was prophesying in the days of Hezekiah, the king of Judah, and he said to all the people of Judah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> <div eID="gen20714" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20715"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20716"/>‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen20716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20717"/>“Zion will be plowed,<l eID="gen20717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20718"/>and Jerusalem will become a heap of ruins,<l eID="gen20718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20719"/>and the mountain of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house”</note> as high places of wood.” ’ <l eID="gen20719" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen20715"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8964"/><div sID="gen20720" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8964"/><transChange type="added">Did</transChange> Hezekiah, the king of Judah, and all Judah actually put him to death? <transChange type="added">Was he</transChange> not in fear of Yahweh? And he entreated the face of Yahweh, and Yahweh relented of the disaster that he had spoken against them. But we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to do great disaster to ourselves.”  <div eID="gen20720" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8965"/><div sID="gen20721" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8965"/>Indeed, there also was a man prophesying in the name of Yahweh, Uriah, the son of Shemaiah, from Kiriath-Jearim, and he prophesied against this city and against this land like all the words of Jeremiah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:21
verses.text: And when King Jehoiakim, and all his warriors, and all the officials heard his words, then the king sought to put him to death. But Uriah heard, and he was afraid, and he fled and went <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:22
verses.text: Then King Jehoiakim sent men <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt. Elnathan, the son of Achbor, and men with him <transChange type="added">went</transChange> to Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:23
verses.text: And they brought out Uriah from Egypt and they brought him to King Jehoiakim, and he struck him down with the sword, and he threw his dead body into the burial sites of the sons of the people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:24
verses.text: However, the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that he was not given into the hand of the people to put him to death.  <chapter eID="Jer.26"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8966"/><title type="x-s">Jeremiah Uses Fetters and Yokes to Illustrate His Message of Submission</title> <div sID="gen20722" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8966"/>In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, the king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>—

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:2
verses.text: thus said Yahweh to me—“Make for yourself fetters and yokes and put them on your neck,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:3
verses.text: and send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> envoys who have come <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Jerusalem, to Zedekiah, the king of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:4
verses.text: And you must command them for their masters, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, this you shall say to your masters:

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:5
verses.text: “I have made the earth with humankind and animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on the face of the earth by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and I give it to whomever is right in my eyes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:6
verses.text: And now I myself have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and also the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the field I have given to him to serve him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:7
verses.text: And all the nations will serve him, and his son, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his grandson⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the son of his son”</note> until the coming of the time of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his own⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “also his”</note> land. Then many nations and great kings will let him work.  <div eID="gen20722" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8967"/><div sID="gen20723" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8967"/>“But it will be <transChange type="added">that</transChange> the nation or kingdom that will not serve him, Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put his neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, I will punish that nation with the sword, and with the famine, and with the plague,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “until I have destroyed it with my hand.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:9
verses.text: And you, you must not listen to your prophets, and to your diviners, and to your dreamers, and to your interpreters of signs, and to your sorcerers who are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:10
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> prophesying to you a lie, so that you <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> removed from your land, and I will drive you away, and you will perish.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:11
verses.text: But the nation that will bring its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and will serve him, yet will I leave it on its land,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and they will till it, and they will live in it.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen20723" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8968"/><div sID="gen20724" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8968"/>And I spoke words like these to Zedekiah, the king of Judah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:13
verses.text: Why should you die—you and your people—by the sword, by the famine, and by the plague, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:14
verses.text: And you must not listen to the words of the prophets who are speaking to you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘You must not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> prophesying a lie to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:15
verses.text: For I have not sent them,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “but they are prophesying in my name <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the lie”</note> so that I will drive them away. And you will perish—you and the prophets who are prophesying to you.”  <div eID="gen20724" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8969"/><title type="x-s">The Vessels of the Temple</title> <div sID="gen20725" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8969"/>Then I spoke to the priests and to all this people, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Thus says Yahweh, ‘You must not listen to the words of your prophets who are prophesying to you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Look, the vessels of the house of Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> about to be quickly brought back from Babylon”, for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> prophesying a lie to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:17
verses.text: And you must not listen to them; serve the king of Babylon and live. Why should this city become a site of ruins?

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:18
verses.text: But if they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> prophets, and if there is with them the word of Yahweh, let them please plead with Yahweh of hosts, that the vessels that are left over in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house”</note> of Yahweh, and the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem, must not go <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon.’  <div eID="gen20725" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8970"/><div sID="gen20726" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8970"/>For thus says Yahweh of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the stands, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:20
verses.text: which Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, did not take when he deported Jeconiah, the son of Jehoiakim, the king of Judah, from Jerusalem <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞along with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:21
verses.text: For thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that are left <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the house of Yahweh, and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the house of the king of Judah, and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Jerusalem:

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:22
verses.text: ‘They will be brought <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon, and there they will stay until the day of my attending to them,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. ‘Then I will bring them up and restore them to this place.’ ”  <chapter eID="Jer.27"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8971"/><title type="x-s">Hananiah, the False Prophet</title> <div sID="gen20727" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8971"/>And it was in that <transChange type="added">same</transChange> year, at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah, the king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah, the son of Azzur, the prophet who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> from Gibeon, said to me in the house of Yahweh before the eyes of the priests and all the people, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:2
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:3
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Within two years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In still two years days”</note> I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> bring back to this place all the vessels of the house of Yahweh which Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon took away from this place and brought <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:4
verses.text: And Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, the king of Judah, and all the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> from Judah who went to Babylon, I will bring back to this place,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘For I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’ ”  <div eID="gen20727" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8972"/><div sID="gen20728" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8972"/>Then Jeremiah the prophet said to Hananiah the prophet before the eyes of the priests and before the eyes of all the people who were standing in the house of Yahweh,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:6
verses.text: and Jeremiah the prophet said, “Amen! May Yahweh do so; may Yahweh fulfill your words that you have prophesied, to bring back the vessels of the house of Yahweh and all the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> from Babylon to this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:7
verses.text: Nevertheless listen please <transChange type="added">to</transChange> this word that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> speaking in your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “ears”</note> and in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “ears”</note> of all the people,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:8
verses.text: The prophets who were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> me and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> you from ancient <transChange type="added">times</transChange> prophesied against many countries and against great kingdoms of war, and of disaster, and of plague.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:9
verses.text: The prophet who prophesies peace, at the coming of the word of the prophet, will become known <transChange type="added">as</transChange> the prophet that Yahweh has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞truly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in truth”</note> sent.”  <div eID="gen20728" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8973"/><div sID="gen20729" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8973"/>Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:11
verses.text: Then Hananiah said before the eyes of all the people, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Thus says Yahweh, ‘This is how I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within two years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in still two years days”</note> from the neck of all the nations.’ ” And Jeremiah the prophet went on his way.  <div eID="gen20729" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8974"/><div sID="gen20730" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8974"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah after Hananiah the prophet broke the yoke from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:13
verses.text: “Go, and you must say to Hananiah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Thus says Yahweh, “You have broken yoke bars of wood, but you have made in place of them yoke bars of iron.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:14
verses.text: For thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, “I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, to serve Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, and they will serve him, and I have even given the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the open field to him.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen20730" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8975"/><div sID="gen20731" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8975"/>Then Jeremiah the prophet said to Hananiah the prophet, “Please listen, Hananiah, Yahweh has not sent you, and you have made this people trust in a lie.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:16
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh, ‘Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to send you from the face of the earth. This year you <transChange type="added">will</transChange> die because you have spoken rebellion against Yahweh.’ ”

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:17
verses.text: And Hananiah the prophet died in that <transChange type="added">same</transChange> year in the seventh month.  <chapter eID="Jer.28"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8976"/><title type="x-s">Jeremiah’s Letter to the Exiles in Babylon</title> <div sID="gen20732" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8976"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the remainder of the exiles,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had deported from Jerusalem <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:2
verses.text: after the going out of Jeconiah the king, and the queen mother, and the court officials, the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, and the artisans,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “artisan”</note> and the smiths<note placement="foot">Hebrew “smith”</note> from Jerusalem,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:3
verses.text: by the hand of Elasah, the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah, the son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah, the king of Judah, sent to Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:4
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, to all the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> whom I have deported from Jerusalem <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:5
verses.text: ‘Build houses and live <transChange type="added">in them</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> and plant gardens and eat their fruit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:6
verses.text: Take wives and father sons and daughters, and take for your sons wives, and give your daughters to men that they may bear sons and daughters, and multiply there, and you must not be few.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:7
verses.text: And seek the prosperity of the city where I have deported you, and pray on behalf of it to Yahweh, for in its prosperity you will have prosperity.’  <div eID="gen20732" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8977"/><div sID="gen20733" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8977"/>For thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, ‘Do not let your prophets who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in your midst, and your diviners, deceive you, and you must not listen to your dreams that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> causing <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to dream.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:9
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> prophesying <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in a lie”</note> to you in my name; I have not sent them,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:10
verses.text: For thus says Yahweh, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As soon as the time has passed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “When to the mouth of being full”</note> seventy years<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> for Babylon, I will attend to you, and I will fulfill my good word to you, to bring you back to this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:11
verses.text: For I know the plans that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> planning concerning you,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘plans for prosperity and not for harm, to give to you a future and a hope.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:12
verses.text: Then <transChange type="added">when</transChange> you call me, and you come and pray to me, then I will listen to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:13
verses.text: When you search for me, then you will find <transChange type="added">me</transChange>, if you seek me with all your heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:14
verses.text: And I will let myself be found by you,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and I will restore your fortunes,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> and I will gather you from all the nations and from all the places to which I have driven you,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and I will bring you back to the place from which I deported you.’  <div eID="gen20733" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8978"/><div sID="gen20734" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8978"/>Because you have said, ‘Yahweh has raised up prophets for us <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Babylon’—

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:16
verses.text: for thus says Yahweh concerning the king who sits on the throne of David and concerning all the people who live in this city, your fellow kinsmen who did not go with you into the exile—

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:17
verses.text: thus says Yahweh of hosts, ‘Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to send among them the sword, the famine, and the plague, and I will make them like rotten figs that cannot be eaten because of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> bad quality.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:18
verses.text: And I will pursue them with the sword, with the famine, and with the plague, and I will make them a terror to all the kingdoms of the earth, a curse, and a horror, and <transChange type="added">an object of</transChange> hissing, and a disgrace among all the nations to which I have driven them,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:19
verses.text: because they did not listen to my words,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘when I sent to them my servants the prophets, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sending over and over again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “doing early and sending”</note> and they would not listen,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen20734" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8979"/><div sID="gen20735" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8979"/>And you, hear the word of Yahweh, all <transChange type="added">you</transChange> exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> whom I sent away from Jerusalem <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:21
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab, the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah, the son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying to you in my name a lie, ‘Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to give them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and he will strike them before your eyes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:22
verses.text: And a curse will be taken <transChange type="added">up</transChange> because of them by all the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> of Judah who are in Babylon, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “May Yahweh make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire,”

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:23
verses.text: because they have done a disgraceful thing in Israel, and they have committed adultery with the wives of their neighbors, and they have spoken words<note placement="foot">Hebrew “word”</note> in my name, lies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note> that I have not commanded them, and I am he who knows, and I am a witness,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen20735" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8980"/><title type="x-s">Shemaiah’s Letter to Zephaniah the Priest</title> <div sID="gen20736" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8980"/>And to Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall say, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:25
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Because you yourself sent a letter<note placement="foot">Hebrew “letters”</note> in your name to all the people who are in Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah, the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:26
verses.text: “Yahweh made you priest instead of Jehoiada the priest, so that there are overseers <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the house of Yahweh over any mad man <transChange type="added">who</transChange> exhibits the behavior of a prophet, and you must put him into the stocks and into the neck iron,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:27
verses.text: and so then why have you not rebuked Jeremiah the Anathothite who exhibits the behavior of a prophet for you?

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:28
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Seeing that unto thus”</note> he has sent to us in Babylon, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘It will be a long time, build houses and live in them,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> and plant gardens and eat their fruit.’ ” ’ ”

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:29
verses.text: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “ears”</note> of Jeremiah the prophet.  <div eID="gen20736" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8981"/><title type="x-s">Jeremiah’s Response to Shemaiah’s Letter</title> <div sID="gen20737" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8981"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:31
verses.text: “Send to all the exiles,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Thus says Yahweh concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: “Because Shemaiah prophesied to you, though I have not sent him, and he has made you trust in a lie,”

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:32
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to thus”</note> thus says Yahweh, “Look, I am going to punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring. There will not be for him a man who lives in the midst of this people, and he will not see the good that I am going to do to my people,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “For he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh.” ’ ”  <chapter eID="Jer.29"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8982"/><title type="x-s">Israel and Judah Will Be Delivered from Their Distress</title> <div sID="gen20738" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8982"/>The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:2
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Write for yourself all the words that I have spoken to you in a scroll.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:3
verses.text: For look, days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘when I will restore the fortunes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> of my people Israel and Judah,’ says Yahweh, ‘and I will bring them back to the land that I gave to their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and they will take possession of it.’ ”  <div eID="gen20738" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8983"/><div sID="gen20739" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8983"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the words that Yahweh spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:5
verses.text: “For thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen20739" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20740"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20741"/>‘We have heard a sound of trembling,<l eID="gen20741" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20742"/>terror, and there is no peace. <l eID="gen20742" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8984"/><l level="1" sID="gen20743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8984"/>Ask please and see whether a male can bear a child.<l eID="gen20743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20744"/>Why <transChange type="added">do</transChange> I see every strong man<l eID="gen20744" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20745"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> his hands on his loins like a woman giving birth?<l eID="gen20745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20746"/>And <transChange type="added">why</transChange> are all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> faces changed to paleness? <l eID="gen20746" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8985"/><l level="1" sID="gen20747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8985"/>Alas! For that day <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great,<l eID="gen20747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20748"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there is none like it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from none like it”</note><l eID="gen20748" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20749"/>And it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a time of distress for Jacob,<l eID="gen20749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20750"/>yet from it he will be delivered. <l eID="gen20750" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8986"/><l level="1" sID="gen20751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8986"/>And it will happen on that day,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen20751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20752"/>‘I will break his yoke from your neck<l eID="gen20752" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20753"/>and your bonds I will tear to pieces.<l eID="gen20753" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20754"/>And strangers will no longer let him work as a slave. <l eID="gen20754" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8987"/><l level="1" sID="gen20755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8987"/>But they will serve Yahweh their God,<l eID="gen20755" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20756"/>and David their king, whom I will raise up for them. <l eID="gen20756" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8988"/><l level="1" sID="gen20757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8988"/>But you must not fear, my servant Jacob,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen20757" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20758"/>‘and you must not be dismayed, Israel,<l eID="gen20758" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20759"/>for look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to save you from far,<l eID="gen20759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20760"/>and your offspring from the land of their captivity.<l eID="gen20760" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20761"/>And Jacob will return,<l eID="gen20761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20762"/>and he will be at rest,<l eID="gen20762" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20763"/>and he will be at ease,<l eID="gen20763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20764"/>and there will be no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> makes <transChange type="added">him</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> afraid. <l eID="gen20764" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8989"/><l level="1" sID="gen20765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8989"/>For I am with you,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘to save you.<l eID="gen20765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20766"/>For I will make a complete destruction<l eID="gen20766" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20767"/>of all the nations to which I scattered you,<l eID="gen20767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20768"/>but you I will not make a complete destruction.<l eID="gen20768" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20769"/>And I will chastise you to the measure,<l eID="gen20769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20770"/>and I will not leave you entirely unpunished.’ <l eID="gen20770" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20740"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8990"/><div sID="gen20771" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8990"/>For thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen20771" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20772"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20773"/>‘Your injury <transChange type="added">is</transChange> incurable,<l eID="gen20773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20774"/>your wound <transChange type="added">is</transChange> overcome by sickness. <l eID="gen20774" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8991"/><l level="1" sID="gen20775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8991"/>There is no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> pleads your cause,<l eID="gen20775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20776"/>for <transChange type="added">your</transChange> boil there is no healing for you. <l eID="gen20776" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8992"/><l level="1" sID="gen20777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8992"/>All your lovers have forgotten you,<l eID="gen20777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20778"/>they do not care for you.<l eID="gen20778" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20779"/>I have struck you <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> blow of an enemy,<l eID="gen20779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20780"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> punishment of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cruel,<l eID="gen20780" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20781"/>because of the greatness of your guilt,<l eID="gen20781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20782"/>your sins are numerous. <l eID="gen20782" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8993"/><l level="1" sID="gen20783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8993"/>Why do you cry because of your wound?<l eID="gen20783" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20784"/>Your pain <transChange type="added">is</transChange> incurable.<l eID="gen20784" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20785"/>Because of the greatness of your guilt—your sins are vast—<l eID="gen20785" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20786"/>I have done these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to you. <l eID="gen20786" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8994"/><l level="1" sID="gen20787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8994"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> all <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> devour you will be devoured,<l eID="gen20787" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20788"/>and all your foes, all of them will go into captivity,<l eID="gen20788" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20789"/>and <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> plunder you will be as plunder,<l eID="gen20789" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20790"/>and all <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> plunder you I will make as plunder. <l eID="gen20790" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:17
