verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8995"/><l level="1" sID="gen20791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8995"/>For I will present healing to you,<l eID="gen20791" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20792"/>and I will heal you of your wounds,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen20792" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20793"/>‘Because they have called you an outcast, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,<l eID="gen20793" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20794"/>“It is Zion, there is no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> cares for her.” ’ <l eID="gen20794" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20772"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8996"/><div sID="gen20795" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8996"/>Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen20795" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20796"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20797"/>‘Look, I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> restore the fortunes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> of the tents of Jacob,<l eID="gen20797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20798"/>and I will have compassion on his dwellings,<l eID="gen20798" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20799"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city will be rebuilt upon its mound,<l eID="gen20799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20800"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> citadel fortress will stand on its rightful site. <l eID="gen20800" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8997"/><l level="1" sID="gen20801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8997"/>And thanksgiving and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of merrymakers<l eID="gen20801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20802"/>will come out from them,<l eID="gen20802" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20803"/>and I will make them numerous,<l eID="gen20803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20804"/>and they will not be few.<l eID="gen20804" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20805"/>And I will make them honored,<l eID="gen20805" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20806"/>and they will not be lowly. <l eID="gen20806" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8998"/><l level="1" sID="gen20807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8998"/>And their children will be as of old,<l eID="gen20807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20808"/>and their community will be established <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note><l eID="gen20808" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20809"/>And I will punish all their oppressors. <l eID="gen20809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8999"/><l level="2" sID="gen20810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8999"/>And their noble will be from them,<l eID="gen20810" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20811"/>and their ruler will come out from their midst.<l eID="gen20811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20812"/>And I will bring him near and he will approach me.<l eID="gen20812" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20813"/>For who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he that would pledge his heart to approach me?’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen20813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9000"/><l level="1" sID="gen20814"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9000"/>‘And you will be to me a people,<l eID="gen20814" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20815"/>and I will be to you God.’ ” <l eID="gen20815" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9001"/><l level="1" sID="gen20816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9001"/>Look, the storm of Yahweh!<l eID="gen20816" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20817"/>Wrath has gone forth,<l eID="gen20817" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20818"/>a whirling tempest.<l eID="gen20818" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20819"/>It will whirl upon <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked. <l eID="gen20819" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9002"/><l level="1" sID="gen20820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9002"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The burning anger of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The blaze of the nose of Yahweh”</note> will not turn back until his doing,<l eID="gen20820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20821"/>and until his accomplishing the plans of his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note><l eID="gen20821" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20822"/>In the last of the days you will understand it. <l eID="gen20822" level="1"/><lg eID="gen20796"/> <chapter eID="Jer.30"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:1
verses.text: “At that time,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, <div eID="gen20823" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20824"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20825"/>“I will be the God of all the clans<note placement="foot">Or “families”</note> of Israel,<l eID="gen20825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20826"/>and they will be to me a people.” <l eID="gen20826" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen20824"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9003"/><div sID="gen20827" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9003"/>Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen20827" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20828"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20829"/>“<transChange type="added">The</transChange> people of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> survivors of the sword found grace in the desert;<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note><l eID="gen20829" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20830"/>Israel going to find their rest.” <l eID="gen20830" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9004"/><l level="1" sID="gen20831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9004"/>From afar Yahweh appeared to me, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,<l eID="gen20831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20832"/>“I have loved you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> an everlasting love.<l eID="gen20832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20833"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> I have drawn you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> loyal love. <l eID="gen20833" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9005"/><l level="1" sID="gen20834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9005"/>I will again build you,<l eID="gen20834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20835"/>and you will be built, O virgin Israel.<l eID="gen20835" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20836"/>You will again adorn yourself <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your tambourines,<l eID="gen20836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20837"/>and you will go forth in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dancing in a ring of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> merrymakers. <l eID="gen20837" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9006"/><l level="1" sID="gen20838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9006"/>You will again plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria.<l eID="gen20838" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20839"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> planters will plant, and they will enjoy <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> <l eID="gen20839" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9007"/><l level="1" sID="gen20840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9007"/>For there will be a day <transChange type="added">when</transChange> watchmen will call in the hill country of Ephraim,<l eID="gen20840" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20841"/>‘Stand up, and let us go up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Zion, to Yahweh our God.’ ” <l eID="gen20841" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20828"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9008"/><div sID="gen20842" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9008"/>For thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen20842" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20843"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20844"/>“Sing for joy for Jacob <transChange type="added">with</transChange> gladness,<l eID="gen20844" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20845"/>and shout out for the head of the nations.<l eID="gen20845" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20846"/>Proclaim, praise, and say,<l eID="gen20846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20847"/>‘Save, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, your people, the remnant of Israel.’ <l eID="gen20847" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9009"/><l level="1" sID="gen20848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9009"/>Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to bring them from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,<l eID="gen20848" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20849"/>and I will gather them from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> remotest part of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth.<l eID="gen20849" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20850"/>Among them <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blind, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lame,<l eID="gen20850" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20851"/><transChange type="added">those who are</transChange> pregnant, and <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> give birth,<l eID="gen20851" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20852"/>together, a great assembly,<l eID="gen20852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20853"/>they will return here. <l eID="gen20853" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9010"/><l level="1" sID="gen20854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9010"/>With weeping they will come,<l eID="gen20854" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20855"/>and with pleas for mercy I will bring them;<l eID="gen20855" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20856"/>I will let them walk by streams of water in a straight path.<l eID="gen20856" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20857"/>They will not stumble in it,<l eID="gen20857" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20858"/>for I have become to Israel a father,<l eID="gen20858" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20859"/>and Ephraim, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my firstborn.” <l eID="gen20859" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9011"/><l level="1" sID="gen20860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9011"/>Hear the word of Yahweh, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> nations,<l eID="gen20860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20861"/>and declare in the coastlands from afar, and say,<l eID="gen20861" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20862"/>“The scatterer of Israel will gather him,<l eID="gen20862" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20863"/>and he will keep him as a shepherd his flock. <l eID="gen20863" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9012"/><l level="1" sID="gen20864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9012"/>For Yahweh has ransomed Jacob,<l eID="gen20864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20865"/>and he has redeemed him from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> person <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞stronger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “strong”</note> than he. <l eID="gen20865" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9013"/><l level="1" sID="gen20866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9013"/>And they will come,<l eID="gen20866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20867"/>and they will sing for joy on the height of Zion,<l eID="gen20867" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20868"/>and they will be radiant over the goodness of Yahweh,<l eID="gen20868" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20869"/>over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grain, and over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wine, and over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> olive oil,<l eID="gen20869" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20870"/>and over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young ones of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flock, and over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cattle.<l eID="gen20870" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20871"/>And their life will become like a well-watered garden,<l eID="gen20871" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20872"/>and they will never languish again.” <l eID="gen20872" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9014"/><l level="1" sID="gen20873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9014"/>“Then <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young woman will rejoice in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dancing in a ring,<l eID="gen20873" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20874"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young men and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> old men together.<l eID="gen20874" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20875"/>And I will turn their mourning to jubilation,<l eID="gen20875" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20876"/>and I will comfort them,<l eID="gen20876" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20877"/>and I will gladden them from their sorrow. <l eID="gen20877" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9015"/><l level="1" sID="gen20878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9015"/>And I will saturate the appetite of the priests <transChange type="added">with</transChange> fatness,<l eID="gen20878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20879"/>and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen20879" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9016"/><l level="1" sID="gen20880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9016"/>Thus says Yahweh,<l eID="gen20880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20881"/>“A voice <transChange type="added">is</transChange> heard in Ramah,<l eID="gen20881" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20882"/>lamentation, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> weeping of bitterness.<l eID="gen20882" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20883"/>Rachel <transChange type="added">is</transChange> weeping for her children;<l eID="gen20883" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20884"/>she refuses to be comforted because of her children,<l eID="gen20884" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20885"/>for they are no <transChange type="added">more</transChange>.” <l eID="gen20885" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20843"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9017"/><div sID="gen20886" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9017"/>Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen20886" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20887"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20888"/>“Restrain your voice from weeping,<l eID="gen20888" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20889"/>and your eyes from tears,<l eID="gen20889" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20890"/>for there is a reward for your work,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen20890" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20891"/>“and they will return from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy. <l eID="gen20891" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9018"/><l level="1" sID="gen20892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9018"/>And there is hope for your future,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen20892" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20893"/>“and <transChange type="added">your</transChange> children will return to their territory. <l eID="gen20893" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9019"/><l level="1" sID="gen20894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9019"/>Indeed I heard Ephraim pitying themselves,<l eID="gen20894" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20895"/>‘You disciplined me, and I was disciplined,<l eID="gen20895" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20896"/>like a calf that is not trained.<l eID="gen20896" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20897"/>Bring me back and let me return,<l eID="gen20897" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20898"/>for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> Yahweh my God. <l eID="gen20898" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9020"/><l level="1" sID="gen20899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9020"/>For after my turning back I repented,<l eID="gen20899" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20900"/>and after coming to understand I struck <transChange type="added">my</transChange> thigh.<l eID="gen20900" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20901"/>I was ashamed and also humiliated,<l eID="gen20901" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20902"/>because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’ <l eID="gen20902" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9021"/><l level="1" sID="gen20903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9021"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> Ephraim my dear son,<l eID="gen20903" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20904"/>or <transChange type="added">the</transChange> child of <transChange type="added">my</transChange> delight?<l eID="gen20904" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20905"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as often as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from enough”</note> I have earnestly spoken against him,<l eID="gen20905" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20906"/>I still remember him.<l eID="gen20906" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20907"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> my bowels are turbulent for him,<l eID="gen20907" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20908"/>surely I will have compassion on him,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen20908" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9022"/><l level="1" sID="gen20909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9022"/>“Set up for yourself road markers,<l eID="gen20909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20910"/>make for yourself signposts,<l eID="gen20910" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20911"/>set your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> to the main road,<l eID="gen20911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20912"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> road <transChange type="added">by which</transChange> you went.<l eID="gen20912" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20913"/>Return, O virgin of Israel,<l eID="gen20913" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20914"/>return to these your cities. <l eID="gen20914" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9023"/><l level="1" sID="gen20915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9023"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Until when”</note> will you waver, O unfaithful daughter?<l eID="gen20915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20916"/>For Yahweh has created a new <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> on the earth,<l eID="gen20916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20917"/>a woman, she shelters a man.” <l eID="gen20917" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20887"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9024"/><div sID="gen20918" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9024"/>Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, “They will again say these words<note placement="foot">Hebrew “word”</note> in the land of Judah and in its towns at my restoring their fortunes,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> <div eID="gen20918" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20919"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20920"/>‘Yahweh bless you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> settlement of righteousness,<l eID="gen20920" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20921"/>O hill of holiness.’ <l eID="gen20921" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9025"/><l level="1" sID="gen20922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9025"/>And Judah and all of its towns together will live in it,<l eID="gen20922" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20923"/>farmers and those who travel with the flocks.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “flock”</note> <l eID="gen20923" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9026"/><l level="1" sID="gen20924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9026"/>For I will saturate <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thirst of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> weary,<l eID="gen20924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20925"/>and every person <transChange type="added">who</transChange> languishes I will replenish.” <l eID="gen20925" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9027"/><l level="1" sID="gen20926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9027"/>At this I awoke and looked,<l eID="gen20926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20927"/>and my sleep was pleasant to me. <l eID="gen20927" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen20919"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9028"/><title type="x-s">The New Covenant</title> <div sID="gen20928" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9028"/>“Look, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of humankind, and with the seed of animals.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:28
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> as I have watched over them to pull up, and to tear down, and to annihilate, and to destroy, and to do evil, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:29
verses.text: “In those days they will say no longer, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Parents⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Fathers”</note> have eaten unripe fruit, and the teeth of the children <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are set on edge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “have become blunt”</note>.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:30
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞But⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “But if”</note> each will die because of his iniquity, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of the humankind”</note> who eats the unripe fruit, their teeth will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞be set on edge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “become blunt”</note>  <div eID="gen20928" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9029"/><div sID="gen20929" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9029"/>Look, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah,

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:32
verses.text: not like the covenant that I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> with their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> on the day of my grasping them<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> by their hand, bringing them out from the land of Egypt, my covenant that they themselves broke, though I myself was a master over them,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:33
verses.text: “But this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the covenant that I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> with the house of Israel after those days,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh: “I will put my law in their inward parts and on their hearts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> I will write it, and I will be to them God, and they themselves will be to me people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:34
verses.text: And they will no longer teach each one his neighbor, or each one his brother, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Know Yahweh,’ for all of them will know me, from their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞smallest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “small”</note> and up to their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞greatest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “great”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “for I will forgive their iniquity and their sin I will no longer remember.”  <div eID="gen20929" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9030"/><div sID="gen20930" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9030"/>Thus says Yahweh, who gives <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun for light by day, the regulations of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moon and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stars for light <transChange type="added">by</transChange> night, who stirs up the sea and its waves roar—Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:36
verses.text: “If these rules would cease from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “also the offspring of Israel would cease from being a nation <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “all the days”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:37
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh, “If <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens above can be measured, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> foundations of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth below can be explored, also I will reject all the offspring of Israel because of all that they have done,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:38
verses.text: “Look, days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “and the city will be rebuilt for Yahweh, from the Tower of Hananel <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the Corner Gate.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:39
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the measuring line⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the string of the measurement”</note> will still go out immediately in front <transChange type="added">of</transChange> it to the hill of Gareb, and it will turn <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Goah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:40
verses.text: And the whole of the valley <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the corpses, and the ashes, and all the cultivated fields up to the wadi of Kidron, up to the corner of the Gate of the Horses <transChange type="added">toward the</transChange> east <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> holy to Yahweh. It will not be uprooted, and it will not be overthrown again <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note>  <chapter eID="Jer.31"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9031"/><title type="x-s">Jeremiah Buys a Field</title> <div sID="gen20931" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9031"/>The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the tenth year of Zedekiah the king of Judah, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:2
verses.text: Now at that time the army of the king of Babylon <transChange type="added">was</transChange> laying siege to Jerusalem and Jeremiah the prophet was confined in the courtyard of the guard that <transChange type="added">was in</transChange> the palace of the king of Judah,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:3
verses.text: where Zedekiah, the king of Judah, had confined him, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Why are you prophesying, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Thus says Yahweh, “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:4
verses.text: and Zedekiah, the king of Judah, will not escape from the hand of the Chaldeans, but surely he will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will speak face to face with him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his mouth shall speak with his mouth”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will see him eye to eye⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his eyes shall see his eyes”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:5
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon he will bring Zedekiah, and there he will be until my attending to him,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. “If you fight against the Chaldeans, you will not be successful” ’?”  <div eID="gen20931" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9032"/><div sID="gen20932" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9032"/>And Jeremiah said, “The word of Yahweh came to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:7
verses.text: ‘Look, Hanamel, the son of Shallum, your uncle, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> going to come to you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Buy for yourself my field that is at Anathoth, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to you is”</note> the right of redemption to buy it.” ’<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:8
verses.text: Then Hanamel, the son of my uncle, came to me, to the courtyard of the guard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as”</note> the word of Yahweh, and he said to me, ‘Please buy my field that is at Anathoth, that is in the land of Benjamin, for to you is the claim of possession, and to you the redemption; buy it<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> for yourself.’ Then I knew that this <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the word of Yahweh.  <div eID="gen20932" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9033"/><div sID="gen20933" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9033"/>And I bought the field from Hanamel, the son of my uncle, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> at Anathoth. And I weighed out to him the money, seventeen silver shekels.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:10
verses.text: And I signed on the letter<note placement="foot">Or “scroll”</note> and sealed it,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> and I called witnesses as witness, and I weighed out the money on a set of scales.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:11
verses.text: Then I took the deed<note placement="foot">Or “scroll”</note> of the purchase, the sealed copy containing the commandments<note placement="foot">Hebrew “commandment”</note> and the rules, together with the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> that was open.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:12
verses.text: And I gave the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the presence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the eyes of”</note> Hanamel, the son of my uncle, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the presence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the eyes of”</note> the witnesses who signed the deed of the purchase, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the presence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the eyes of”</note> the Judeans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Judean”</note> who were sitting in the courtyard of the guard.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:13
verses.text: And I commanded Baruch <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in their presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “before their eyes”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:14
verses.text: ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, “Take these deeds,<note placement="foot">Or “scrolls”</note> this deed of the purchase, the sealed one, and this opened deed, and you must put them in an <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞earthenware jar⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “jar of earthenware”</note> so that they may be kept preserved many days.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:15
verses.text: For thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel: “Houses and fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land.” ’  <div eID="gen20933" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9034"/><div sID="gen20934" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9034"/>And I prayed to Yahweh—after giving my deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah—<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:17
verses.text: ‘Ah Lord Yahweh! Look, you made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Nothing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Not all a thing”</note> is too difficult for you,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:18
verses.text: showing loyal love to the thousands, and repaying the guilt of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞parents⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fathers”</note> into the laps<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lap”</note> of their children after them. Powerful, great, mighty, his name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh of hosts,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:19
verses.text: great in counsel and great <transChange type="added">in</transChange> deed, whose eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> opened to all the ways of the children of humankind, to give to each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:20
verses.text: who accomplished signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, up to this day, and in Israel, and among humankind, and you have made for yourself a name, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> this day.  <div eID="gen20934" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9035"/><div sID="gen20935" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9035"/>And you brought out your people Israel from the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with an arm stretched out, and with great terror.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:22
verses.text: And you gave to them this land, which you swore to their ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to give to them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:23
verses.text: And they entered and took possession of it, but they did not listen to your voice, and they did not follow your law. They did nothing of all that you commanded to them to do, and you caused to happen <transChange type="added">to</transChange> them all this disaster.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:24
verses.text: Look, the siege ramps have come up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the city to capture it, and the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it, because of the sword, the famine, and the plague, and what you spoke happened, and look, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> seeing <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:25
verses.text: Yet you have said to me, Lord Yahweh, “Buy for yourself the field with the money, and call witnesses as witness,” though the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’ ”  <div eID="gen20935" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9036"/><div sID="gen20936" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9036"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:27
verses.text: “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> God of all flesh; is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all thing”</note> too difficult for me?”

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:28
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh: “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:29
verses.text: And the Chaldeans, who are fighting against this city, will come and set this city on fire, and they will burn it, and the houses where they have made smoke offerings on their roofs to Baal, and <transChange type="added">where</transChange> they have devoted libations to other gods, in order to provoke me to anger.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:30
verses.text: For the people<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Israel and the people<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Judah were doing only evil in my eyes from their youth, for the people<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Israel were only provoking me to anger by the work of their hands,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen20936" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9037"/><div sID="gen20937" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9037"/>“For this city has been for me <transChange type="added">a cause</transChange> of my anger and of my wrath from the day that they built it even until this day, <transChange type="added">so I will</transChange> remove it from my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:32
verses.text: because of all the evil of the people<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Israel and the people<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Judah that they did to provoke me to anger—they, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets, and the men<note placement="foot">Hebrew “man”</note> of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:33
verses.text: And they have turned to me <transChange type="added">their</transChange> backs<note placement="foot">Hebrew “back”</note> and not their faces, though <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have taught them over and over again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I have taught them doing early and teaching”</note> but they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> not listening to accept discipline.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:34
verses.text: And they set up their abominations in the house that is called by my name, to defile it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:35
verses.text: And they built the high places of Baal that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to present as offerings their sons and their daughters to Molech, which I had not commanded them, and it had not come to my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> to do this detestable thing in order to cause Judah to sin.”  <div eID="gen20937" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9038"/><div sID="gen20938" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9038"/>“So now <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to thus”</note> thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, concerning this city, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> which you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> saying, ‘It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the plague’:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:37
verses.text: Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to gather them from all the lands <transChange type="added">to</transChange> which I driven them in my anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath, and I will bring them back to this place, and I will cause them to dwell <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in safety⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:38
verses.text: And they will be for me a people, and I will be for them God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:39
verses.text: And I will give to them one heart and one way, to revere me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all the days”</note> for good to them, and to their children after them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:40
verses.text: And I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> with them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a covenant of eternity”</note> that I will not turn away from them, my doing good to them, and my reverence I will put in their hearts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> so that <transChange type="added">they will</transChange> not turn aside from me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:41
verses.text: And I will rejoice over them to do good <transChange type="added">to</transChange> them, and I will plant them in this land in faithfulness with all my heart, and with all my inner self.”<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note>  <div eID="gen20938" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9039"/><div sID="gen20939" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9039"/>“For thus says Yahweh, ‘Just as I have brought to this people all this great disaster, so I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> bring upon them all the good that I promise to them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:43
verses.text: And the fields<note placement="foot">Hebrew “field”</note> will be bought in this land of which you are saying, “It is a desolation, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without humankind or animals⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not humankind and animal”</note> It has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:44
verses.text: They will buy fields with money, and they will sign the deeds,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “scroll”</note> and they will seal them,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> and they will call witnesses as witness in the land of Benjamin, and in the surroundings of Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the hill country, and in the cities of the Shephelah, and in the cities of the Negev, for I will restore their fortunes,’<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.”  <chapter eID="Jer.32"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9040"/><title type="x-s">The Fortunes of Judah and Israel Will Be Restored</title> <div sID="gen20940" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9040"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah <transChange type="added">a</transChange> second <transChange type="added">time</transChange> while he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> still held back in the courtyard of the guard, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:2
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh who made <transChange type="added">the earth</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> Yahweh who formed it to establish it, Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name:

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:3
verses.text: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and I will tell you great <transChange type="added">things</transChange> and inaccessible <transChange type="added">things that</transChange> you have not known.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:4
verses.text: For thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, that were torn down <transChange type="added">to make a defense</transChange> against the siege ramps and against the sword:

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:5
verses.text: ‘<transChange type="added">They are</transChange> coming to fight against the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the corpses of the people whom I will strike in my anger and in my wrath, for whom I have hidden my face from this city because of all their wickedness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:6
verses.text: Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to bring healing and health to it, and I will heal them, and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and reliability.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:7
verses.text: And I will restore the fortunes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> of Judah and the fortunes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> of Israel, and I will rebuild them as in the beginning.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:8
verses.text: And I will cleanse them from all their guilt that they sinned against me, and I will forgive all their iniquities that they sinned against me, and that they rebelled against me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:9
verses.text: And it will be to me a name of jubilation, a praise, and a glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear all the good that I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> do <transChange type="added">for</transChange> them, and they will fear,<note placement="foot">Or “tremble”</note> and they will tremble because of all the good, and because of all the prosperity that I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> provide for it.’  <div eID="gen20940" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9041"/><div sID="gen20941" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9041"/>“Thus says Yahweh: ‘Again will be heard in this place, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> which you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> saying, “It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a waste, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> people and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> animals,”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> people and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> animals,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of jubilation, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of joy, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bridegroom, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bride, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voices<note placement="foot">Hebrew “voice”</note> of those who say, “Praise Yahweh of hosts, for Yahweh is good, for his loyal love is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note> the voices of those who bring thank offerings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thank offering”</note> to the house of Yahweh, for I will restore the fortunes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> of the land as in the beginning,’ says Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:12
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘Again there will be in this waste place, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> people and animals,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> and in all its towns, pasture for shepherds allowing <transChange type="added">their</transChange> flock to lie down.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:13
verses.text: In the towns of the hill country, in the towns of the Shephelah, and in the towns of the Negev, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the surroundings <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Jerusalem, and in the towns of Judah, flocks will again pass under <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hands of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> counter,’ says Yahweh.  <div eID="gen20941" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9042"/><div sID="gen20942" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9042"/>‘Look, days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and I will fulfill the good promise<note placement="foot">Or “word”</note> that I promised to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:15
verses.text: In those days and in that time I will make a branch of righteousness sprout for David, and he will execute justice and righteousness in the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:16
verses.text: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞safely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence”</note> and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> what they shall call it: “Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our righteousness.” ’

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:17
verses.text: For thus says Yahweh: ‘A man who sits on the throne of the house of Israel will not be cut off for David.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:18
verses.text: And for the priests, a man from the Levites <transChange type="added">who</transChange> offers burnt offerings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “burnt offering”</note> and who burns grain offerings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “grain offering”</note> and who brings sacrifices<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sacrifice”</note> will not be cut off <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “all the days”</note>  <div eID="gen20942" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9043"/><div sID="gen20943" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9043"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:20
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh: ‘If you could break my covenant <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the day, and my covenant <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the night, so that day and night <transChange type="added">would</transChange> not come at their time,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:21
verses.text: then my covenant could be broken with David my servant, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞having⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “being for him”</note> a son who could rule on his throne, and with the Levites, the priests, my ministers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:22
verses.text: As the host of heaven cannot be counted, and the sand of the sea cannot be measured, so I will make numerous the offspring of David my servant and the Levites <transChange type="added">who</transChange> minister <transChange type="added">to</transChange> me.’ ”

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:23
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:24
verses.text: “Have you not seen how these people speak, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘The two clans<note placement="foot">Or “families”</note> whom Yahweh chose, he has also rejected them’? Thus they spurn my people from being a nation <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of them”</note> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:25
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: ‘If my covenant <transChange type="added">with</transChange> day and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> night, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> regulations of heaven and earth, I had not established,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:26
verses.text: then the offspring of Jacob and David my servant I would reject, from choosing rulers from his offspring over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; for I will restore their fortunes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> and I will have compassion on them.’ ”  <chapter eID="Jer.33"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9044"/><title type="x-s">A Message for Zedekiah</title> <div sID="gen20944" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9044"/>The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and all his army, with all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kingdoms of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth <transChange type="added">under</transChange> the dominion of his hand, and all the peoples <transChange type="added">were</transChange> fighting against Jerusalem and against all its cities, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:2
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: ‘Go and say to Zedekiah the king of Judah, now you must say to him, “Thus says Yahweh: ‘Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:3
verses.text: And you will not escape from his hand, but surely you will be captured, and into his hand you will be given, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will see the king of Babylon eye to eye⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “your eyes shall see with the eyes of the king of Babylon”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will speak face to face with him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “his mouth shall speak with your mouth”</note> and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon you will go.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:4
verses.text: However, hear the word of Yahweh, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Zedekiah, the king of Judah. Thus says Yahweh concerning you: ‘You will not die by the sword.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:5
verses.text: In peace you will die, and as <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> burning for your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> the former kings who were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> so they will burn for you, and they will lament for you, “Alas, lord!” For the word I have spoken,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.” ’ ”

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:6
verses.text: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Zedekiah the king of Judah all these words in Jerusalem

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:7
verses.text: when the army of the king of Babylon <transChange type="added">was</transChange> fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah that were left over—Lachish and Azekah, for these remained among the cities of Judah, the cities of fortification.  <div eID="gen20944" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9045"/><title type="x-s">Zedekiah’s Covenant Concerning Slaves</title> <div sID="gen20945" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9045"/>The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh after king Zedekiah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> a covenant with all the people who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in Jerusalem to proclaim release to them,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:9
verses.text: to let go each one his <transChange type="added">male</transChange> slave and each one his female slave, the Hebrew and the free Hebrew, <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> no one among the Judeans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Judean”</note> <transChange type="added">should</transChange> enslave his fellow countryman.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:10
verses.text: And all the officials and all the people obeyed, who had entered into the covenant to let go each one his <transChange type="added">male</transChange> slave and each one his female slave, not enslaving them again, and they obeyed and they let <transChange type="added">them</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> go.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:11
verses.text: But <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞afterward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “after thus”</note> they turned back and they brought back the <transChange type="added">male</transChange> slaves and the female slaves whom they had let go free, and they subdued them as <transChange type="added">male</transChange> slaves and female slaves.  <div eID="gen20945" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9046"/><div sID="gen20946" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9046"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:13
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: ‘I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> a covenant with your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> on the day of my bringing them out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:14
verses.text: “At <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end of seven years you must let go each one his fellow countryman, the Hebrew who has been sold to you and who has served you six years, and you must let him go free from you.” But your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> did not listen to me, and they did not incline their ears.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ear”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:15
verses.text: And you turned back <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞recently⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> and you did right in my eyes, to proclaim release each one to his neighbor, and you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> a covenant <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> in the house that is called <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on it”</note> my name.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:16
verses.text: But you turned back and you profaned my name when you brought back each one his <transChange type="added">male</transChange> slave and each one his female slave, whom you had let go free according to their desire, and you subdued them to be to you as <transChange type="added">male</transChange> slaves and as female slaves.’  <div eID="gen20946" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9047"/><div sID="gen20947" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9047"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh, ‘You have not listened to me to proclaim release each one to his fellow countryman and each one to his neighbor. Look, I am going to proclaim to you a release,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘to the sword, to the plague, and to the famine, and I will make you a terror to all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:18
verses.text: And I will make the men who transgressed my covenant, who have not kept the words of the covenant that they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> the calf which they cut in two and they passed between its parts—

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:19
verses.text: the officials of Judah, and the officials of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the parts of the calf—

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:20
verses.text: and I will give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of the seekers of their lives, and their dead bodies<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dead body”</note> will become as food for the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the heavens<note placement="foot">Or “sky”</note> and for the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:21
verses.text: And Zedekiah the king of Judah and his officials I will give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of the seekers of their lives, and into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, who retreated from you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:22
verses.text: Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to command,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and I will bring them back to this city, and they will fight against it, and they will capture it, and they will burn it with fire, and the towns of Judah I will make a desolation <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> an inhabitant.’ ”  <chapter eID="Jer.34"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9048"/><title type="x-s">The Faithfulness of the Rechabites</title> <div sID="gen20948" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9048"/>The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the days of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, the king of Judah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:2
verses.text: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak with them, and bring them <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of Yahweh into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:3
verses.text: So I took Jaazaniah, the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers, and all his sons, and the whole of the house of the Rechabites,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:4
verses.text: and I brought them <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of Yahweh, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> beside the chamber of the officials, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> above the chamber of Maaseiah, the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.  <div eID="gen20948" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9049"/><div sID="gen20949" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9049"/>Then I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞set⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gave”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine and cups, and I said to them, “Drink wine.”

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:6
verses.text: But they answered, “We will not drink wine, for Jonadab, the son of Rechab, our ancestor,<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> commanded us, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘You shall not drink wine, you or your children, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until eternity”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:7
verses.text: And you shall not build a house, and you shall not sow seed, and you shall not plant a vineyard, and it shall not be for you, but in tents you shall live all your days, so that you may live many days on the surface of the land where you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> dwelling as aliens.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:8
verses.text: And we obeyed the voice of Jonadab, the son of Rechab, our ancestor,<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> in all that he commanded us, not to drink wine all our days, ourselves, our wives, our sons, or our daughters,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:9
verses.text: and not to build houses <transChange type="added">for</transChange> our living, and there is not vineyard, or field, or seed for us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:10
verses.text: But we have lived in tents, and we have obeyed, and we have done all that Jehonadab, our ancestor,<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> commanded us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:11
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞But then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it was”</note> at the coming up against the land of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, then we said, ‘Come and let us go to Jerusalem <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">“from the face of”</note> the army of the Chaldeans, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">“from the face of”</note> the army of the Arameans.’<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Aramean”</note> That is why we are living in Jerusalem.”  <div eID="gen20949" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9050"/><div sID="gen20950" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9050"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:13
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘Go and say to the people of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Can you not learn a lesson to listen to my words?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:14
verses.text: “The words of Jonadab, the son of Rechab, that he commanded his descendants<note placement="foot">Or “children”</note> to not drink, have been carried out, and they have not drunk until this day, for they have obeyed the command of their ancestor.<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> But <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have spoken to you over and over again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I have spoken to you doing early and speaking”</note> and you have not listened to me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:15
verses.text: And I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have sent them over and over again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “doing early and sending”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Turn back please each one from his evil way, and amend your deeds, and you must not go after other gods to serve them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that you may live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and live”</note> on the land that I gave to you and to your ancestors.’<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> But you did not incline your ear and you did not listen to me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:16
verses.text: For the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “children”</note> of Jonadab, the son of Rechab, have carried out the command of their ancestor<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> that he commanded them, but this people did not listen to me.”  <div eID="gen20950" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9051"/><div sID="gen20951" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9051"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh, the God of hosts, the God of Israel, “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to bring to Judah and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem every disaster that I have spoken against them, because I have spoken to them and they have not listened, and I have called to them and they have not answered.” ’ ”

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:18
verses.text: But to the house of the Rechabites Jeremiah said, “Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, ‘Because you have listened to the command of Jonadab your ancestor,<note placement="foot">Or “father”</note> and you have kept all his commands, and you have done all that he commanded you,’

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to thus”</note> thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘A man will not be cut off for Jonadab, the son of Rechab, to stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞always⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “all the days”</note>  <chapter eID="Jer.35"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9052"/><title type="x-s">Jehoiakim Burns the Scroll of Jeremiah’s Prophecies</title> <div sID="gen20952" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9052"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it was”</note> in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, the king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:2
verses.text: “Take for yourself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a scroll⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a scroll of a scroll”</note> and you must write on it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah, and until this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:3
verses.text: Perhaps <transChange type="added">when</transChange> the house of Judah hears all the disasters<note placement="foot">Hebrew “disaster”</note> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> planning to do to them, then they may turn back each one from his evil way, and I will forgive their guilt and their sin.”  <div eID="gen20952" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:4
