verses.text: And Yahweh was no longer able to bear<note placement="foot">Or “endure”</note> it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of”</note> the evil of your deeds, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of”</note> the detestable things that you committed. Thus your land became as a site of ruins, and as a horror, and as a curse, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> inhabitants, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:23
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “From the face of”</note> the fact that you made smoke offerings, and that you sinned against Yahweh, and you did not listen to the voice of Yahweh, and you have not walked in his law, and in his statute, and in his legal provisions, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “unto thus”</note> this disaster has happened to you, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> this day.”  <div eID="gen21001" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9095"/><div sID="gen21002" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9095"/>Then Jeremiah said to all the people and to all the women, “Hear the word of Yahweh, all Judah who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:25
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘You and your wives have promised with your mouths<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mouth”</note> and with your hands<note placement="foot">Hebrew “hand”</note> you have fulfilled, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “We certainly will carry out our vows that we vowed, to make smoke offerings to the queen of the heavens,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heaven”</note> and to pour out to her libations.” You must certainly keep your vows and you must certainly carry out your vows.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:26
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> hear the word of Yahweh, all Judah, those who live in the land of Egypt: ‘Look, I hereby swear by my great name,’ says Yahweh, ‘surely my name will no longer be called in the mouth of any man of Judah, saying, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as the Lord Yahweh lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “the life of Lord Yahweh”</note> in all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:27
verses.text: Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to watch over them for harm and not for good, and all people<note placement="foot">Or “men”</note> of Judah who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the land of Egypt will perish by the sword and by the famine until their perishing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:28
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> survivors of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword will return from the land of Egypt <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the land of Judah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞few in number⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “males of number”</note> And all the remnant of Judah who have come to the land of Egypt to dwell as aliens there will know whose word will endure, from me or from them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:29
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> to you the sign,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to punish you in this place, so that you may know that surely my words will endure against you for evil.’

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:30
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: ‘Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to give Pharaoh Hophra, the king of Egypt, into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of those who seek his life, just as I gave Zedekiah the king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, his enemy and the one who sought his life.’ ”  <chapter eID="Jer.44"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9096"/><title type="x-s">A Message for Baruch</title> <div sID="gen21003" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9096"/>The word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch, the son of Neriah, at his writing these words on a scroll from the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, the king of Judah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:2
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, to you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Baruch:

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:3
verses.text: ‘You said, “Woe please to me, for Yahweh has added sorrow to my pain. I am weary in my groaning and I do not find rest.” ’

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:4
verses.text: Thus you will say to him: ‘Thus says Yahweh, “Look, what I have built I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to tear down, and what I have planted I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> about to pluck up, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> all the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:5
verses.text: And you, <transChange type="added">do</transChange> you seek great <transChange type="added">things</transChange> for yourself? <transChange type="added">Do</transChange> not seek <transChange type="added">great things</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> for look, I am about to bring disaster upon all flesh,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “but to you I will give your life as booty in all the places where you may go.” ’ ”  <chapter eID="Jer.45"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9097"/><title type="x-s">Messages Concerning Egypt</title> <div sID="gen21004" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9097"/>The word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:2
verses.text: Concerning Egypt: Concerning the army of Pharaoh Neco, the king of Egypt, which was by the Euphrates River at Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon defeated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, the king of Judah.  <div eID="gen21004" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9098"/><lg sID="gen21005"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9098"/>“Prepare small shield and shield,<l eID="gen21006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21007"/>and approach for the battle! <l eID="gen21007" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9099"/><l level="1" sID="gen21008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9099"/>Harness the horses and mount the steeds!<l eID="gen21008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21009"/>And take your stand with helmets!<l eID="gen21009" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21010"/>Polish the spears!<l eID="gen21010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21011"/>Put on the body armor! <l eID="gen21011" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9100"/><l level="1" sID="gen21012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9100"/>Why do I see them terrified?<l eID="gen21012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21013"/><transChange type="added">They are</transChange> turning back<l eID="gen21013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21014"/>and their warriors are beaten down.<l eID="gen21014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21015"/>And they have fled <transChange type="added">to</transChange> a place of refuge<l eID="gen21015" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21016"/>and they do not turn <transChange type="added">back</transChange>.<l eID="gen21016" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21017"/>Terror <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from all around,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21017" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9101"/><l level="1" sID="gen21018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9101"/>The swift cannot flee,<l eID="gen21018" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21019"/>and the warrior cannot escape.<l eID="gen21019" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21020"/>They have stumbled and they have fallen,<l eID="gen21020" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21021"/>by the bank of the Euphrates River. <l eID="gen21021" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9102"/><l level="1" sID="gen21022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9102"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this that rises like the Nile,<l eID="gen21022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21023"/>like the rivers whose waters surge? <l eID="gen21023" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9103"/><l level="1" sID="gen21024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9103"/>Egypt rises like the Nile,<l eID="gen21024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21025"/>even like the rivers <transChange type="added">whose</transChange> waters surge.<l eID="gen21025" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21026"/>And he says, “Let me rise,<l eID="gen21026" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21027"/>let me cover <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth,<l eID="gen21027" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21028"/>let me destroy cities,<l eID="gen21028" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21029"/>and the inhabitants in them.” <l eID="gen21029" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9104"/><l level="1" sID="gen21030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9104"/>Go up, O horses,<l eID="gen21030" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21031"/>and drive madly, O chariots,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note><l eID="gen21031" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21032"/>and let the warriors go forth;<l eID="gen21032" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21033"/>Cush and Put, who wield <transChange type="added">the</transChange> small shield,<l eID="gen21033" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21034"/>and Lud, who wield <transChange type="added">and</transChange> bend <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bow. <l eID="gen21034" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9105"/><l level="1" sID="gen21035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9105"/>For that day <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to the Lord Yahweh of hosts<l eID="gen21035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21036"/>a day of retribution,<l eID="gen21036" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21037"/>to take revenge on his foes.<l eID="gen21037" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21038"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword will devour and be satisfied,<l eID="gen21038" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21039"/>and it will drink its fill of their blood,<l eID="gen21039" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21040"/>for a sacrifice <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the Lord Yahweh of hosts<l eID="gen21040" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21041"/>in the land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north by the Euphrates River. <l eID="gen21041" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9106"/><l level="1" sID="gen21042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9106"/>Go up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Gilead and take balm,<l eID="gen21042" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21043"/>O virgin of the daughter of Egypt.<l eID="gen21043" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21044"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In vain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To the vanity”</note> you make use of many medicines;<l eID="gen21044" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21045"/>there is no healing for you. <l eID="gen21045" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9107"/><l level="1" sID="gen21046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9107"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> nations have heard your shame,<l eID="gen21046" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21047"/>and your cry of lament fills the earth.<l eID="gen21047" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21048"/>For warrior has stumbled against warrior,<l eID="gen21048" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21049"/>together they have fallen, the two of them. <l eID="gen21049" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21005"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9108"/><div sID="gen21050" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9108"/>The word that Yahweh spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon to attack the land of Egypt:  <div eID="gen21050" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9109"/><lg sID="gen21051"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9109"/>“Declare in Egypt, and proclaim in Migdol,<l eID="gen21052" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21053"/>and proclaim in Memphis and in Tahpanhes,<l eID="gen21053" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21054"/>say, ‘Take your stand and be prepared,<l eID="gen21054" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21055"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword will devour <transChange type="added">those</transChange> all around you.’ <l eID="gen21055" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9110"/><l level="1" sID="gen21056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9110"/>Why are your bulls defeated?<l eID="gen21056" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21057"/>He did not stand because Yahweh thrust him down. <l eID="gen21057" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9111"/><l level="1" sID="gen21058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9111"/>He multiplied <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ones<note placement="foot">Hebrew “one”</note> stumbling.<l eID="gen21058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21059"/>Furthermore, each one fell to his neighbor,<l eID="gen21059" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21060"/>and said, ‘Stand up, and let us return to our people<l eID="gen21060" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21061"/>and to the land of our birth,<l eID="gen21061" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21062"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> of the sword of the oppressor.’ <l eID="gen21062" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9112"/><l level="1" sID="gen21063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9112"/>They will call there,<l eID="gen21063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21064"/>‘Pharaoh, the king of Egypt <transChange type="added">is but</transChange> a roar,<l eID="gen21064" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21065"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he missed the opportunity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “he has allowed to pass over the appointed time”</note> <l eID="gen21065" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9113"/><l level="1" sID="gen21066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9113"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “Life I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> the king,<l eID="gen21066" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21067"/>Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name,<l eID="gen21067" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21068"/>“one will come like Tabor among the mountains<l eID="gen21068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21069"/>and like Carmel by the sea. <l eID="gen21069" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9114"/><l level="1" sID="gen21070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9114"/>Pack <transChange type="added">your</transChange> baggage for exile,<l eID="gen21070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21071"/>O inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of the daughter of Egypt,<l eID="gen21071" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21072"/>for Memphis will become as a horror,<l eID="gen21072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21073"/>and it will be destroyed, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> inhabitant. <l eID="gen21073" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9115"/><l level="1" sID="gen21074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9115"/>Egypt <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a beautiful heifer,<l eID="gen21074" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21075"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> a gadfly from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north <transChange type="added">will</transChange> come against her. <l eID="gen21075" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9116"/><l level="1" sID="gen21076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9116"/>Even her mercenaries in her midst <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like calves of fattening,<l eID="gen21076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21077"/>for they also have turned away,<l eID="gen21077" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21078"/>they have fled together.<l eID="gen21078" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21079"/>They stand not,<l eID="gen21079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21080"/>for the day of their calamity has come,<l eID="gen21080" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21081"/>the time of their punishment. <l eID="gen21081" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9117"/><l level="1" sID="gen21082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9117"/>Her sound <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a snake <transChange type="added">that</transChange> glides away,<l eID="gen21082" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21083"/>for they march in force.<l eID="gen21083" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21084"/>And with axes they come to her<l eID="gen21084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21085"/>like those who chop trees. <l eID="gen21085" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9118"/><l level="1" sID="gen21086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9118"/>They will cut down her forest,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21087"/>“for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is impenetrable⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it cannot be searched out”</note><l eID="gen21087" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21088"/>Yes, they are more numerous than locusts,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “locust”</note><l eID="gen21088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21089"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they are without number⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not to them a number”</note> <l eID="gen21089" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9119"/><l level="1" sID="gen21090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9119"/>The daughter of Egypt will be ashamed,<l eID="gen21090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21091"/>she will be given into the hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north.” <l eID="gen21091" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21051"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9120"/><div sID="gen21092" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9120"/>Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, said, “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to punish Amon of Thebes, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, and her gods, and her kings, even Pharaoh and those who trust in him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:26
verses.text: And I will give them into the hand of the seekers of their lives,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “life”</note> and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and into the hand of his troops. But <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞afterward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “after thus”</note> it will be inhabited, as in days of old,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen21092" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9121"/><lg sID="gen21093"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9121"/>“But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> you, my servant Jacob, you must not be afraid,<l eID="gen21094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21095"/>and Israel, you must not be dismayed,<l eID="gen21095" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21096"/>for look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to save you from far,<l eID="gen21096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21097"/>and your offspring from the land of their captivity.<l eID="gen21097" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21098"/>And Jacob will return,<l eID="gen21098" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21099"/>and he will be quiet,<l eID="gen21099" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21100"/>and he will be at ease,<l eID="gen21100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21101"/>and without <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> makes <transChange type="added">him</transChange> afraid. <l eID="gen21101" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9122"/><l level="1" sID="gen21102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9122"/>You must not be afraid, my servant Jacob,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21103"/>“for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> with you.<l eID="gen21103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21104"/>For I will make a complete destruction in all the nations where I scattered you,<l eID="gen21104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21105"/>but you I will not make a complete destruction,<l eID="gen21105" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21106"/>though I will chastise you to the measure,<l eID="gen21106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21107"/>and I will certainly not leave you unpunished.” <l eID="gen21107" level="2"/><lg eID="gen21093"/> <chapter eID="Jer.46"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9123"/><title type="x-s">A Message Concerning the Philistines</title> <div sID="gen21108" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9123"/>The word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Philistines <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at not yet”</note> Pharaoh attacked Gaza.

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:2
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen21108" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21109"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21110"/>“Look, waters <transChange type="added">are</transChange> rising from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,<l eID="gen21110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21111"/>and they will become as a raging torrent,<l eID="gen21111" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21112"/>and they will overflow <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen21112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21113"/>and that which fills it,<l eID="gen21113" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21114"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> city and those who live in it.<l eID="gen21114" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21115"/>And the people will cry out,<l eID="gen21115" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21116"/>and every inhabitant of the land will wail, <l eID="gen21116" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9124"/><l level="1" sID="gen21117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9124"/>from the sound of the stamping of the hoofs of his stallions,<l eID="gen21117" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21118"/>from the clattering of his chariots,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note><l eID="gen21118" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21119"/>the noise of their wheels.<l eID="gen21119" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21120"/>Fathers do not turn to <transChange type="added">their</transChange> children<l eID="gen21120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21121"/>because of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slackness of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> hands. <l eID="gen21121" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9125"/><l level="1" sID="gen21122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9125"/>Because of the day that is coming<l eID="gen21122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21123"/>to destroy all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Philistines,<l eID="gen21123" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21124"/>to cut off from Tyre and from Sidon<l eID="gen21124" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21125"/>every survivor <transChange type="added">who could</transChange> help,<l eID="gen21125" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21126"/>for Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> destroying <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Philistines,<l eID="gen21126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21127"/>the remnant of the coastland of Caphtor. <l eID="gen21127" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9126"/><l level="1" sID="gen21128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9126"/>Baldness has come upon Gaza,<l eID="gen21128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21129"/>Ashkelon is destroyed.<l eID="gen21129" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21130"/>O remnant of their valley,<l eID="gen21130" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21131"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until when”</note> will you cut yourself with a blade? <l eID="gen21131" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9127"/><l level="1" sID="gen21132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9127"/>Ah, sword of Yahweh,<l eID="gen21132" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21133"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until when”</note> will you not be quiet?<l eID="gen21133" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21134"/>Gather to your sheath,<l eID="gen21134" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21135"/>keep quiet and stand still. <l eID="gen21135" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9128"/><l level="1" sID="gen21136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9128"/>How can you be quiet<l eID="gen21136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21137"/>when Yahweh has given an order to it?<l eID="gen21137" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21138"/>Against Ashkelon and against the shore of the sea,<l eID="gen21138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21139"/>there he has appointed it.” <l eID="gen21139" level="2"/><lg eID="gen21109"/> <chapter eID="Jer.47"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9129"/><title type="x-s">A Message Concerning Moab</title> <div sID="gen21140" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9129"/>Concerning Moab, thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel: <div eID="gen21140" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21141"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21142"/>“Woe to Nebo,<l eID="gen21142" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21143"/>for it is devastated.<l eID="gen21143" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21144"/>It is ashamed,<l eID="gen21144" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21145"/>Kiriathaim is captured.<l eID="gen21145" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21146"/>Misgab is ashamed,<l eID="gen21146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21147"/>and it is filled with terror. <l eID="gen21147" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9130"/><l level="1" sID="gen21148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9130"/>The glory of Moab is no longer.<l eID="gen21148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21149"/>In Heshbon they planned evil against her.<l eID="gen21149" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21150"/>Come and let us cut her off from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> a nation.<l eID="gen21150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21151"/>Also, Madmen, you will be silent.<l eID="gen21151" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21152"/>After you will go <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword. <l eID="gen21152" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9131"/><l level="1" sID="gen21153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9131"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> sound of a cry of distress <transChange type="added">arises</transChange> from Horonaim,<l eID="gen21153" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21154"/>devastation and great destruction. <l eID="gen21154" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9132"/><l level="1" sID="gen21155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9132"/>Moab is broken,<l eID="gen21155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21156"/>her little ones <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make heard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause to hear”</note> a cry for help. <l eID="gen21156" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9133"/><l level="1" sID="gen21157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9133"/>For the ascent of Luhith,<l eID="gen21157" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21158"/>in weeping they go weeping,<l eID="gen21158" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21159"/>For on the slope of Horonaim they have heard<l eID="gen21159" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21160"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> distresses of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cry of distress of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> destruction. <l eID="gen21160" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9134"/><l level="1" sID="gen21161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9134"/>Flee! Save your life!<l eID="gen21161" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21162"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞For⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And”</note> you must not be like the juniper tree in the desert. <l eID="gen21162" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9135"/><l level="1" sID="gen21163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9135"/>For because of your trusting in your works and in your treasures,<l eID="gen21163" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21164"/>even you yourselves will be taken,<l eID="gen21164" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21165"/>and Chemosh will go out into the exile,<l eID="gen21165" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21166"/>his priests and his officials together. <l eID="gen21166" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9136"/><l level="1" sID="gen21167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9136"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> destroyer will come to every town,<l eID="gen21167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21168"/>and a town will not escape.<l eID="gen21168" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21169"/>And the valley will be destroyed,<l eID="gen21169" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21170"/>and the plain will be destroyed, as Yahweh has spoken. <l eID="gen21170" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9137"/><l level="1" sID="gen21171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9137"/>Give salt for Moab,<l eID="gen21171" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21172"/>for certainly she will go to ruin,<l eID="gen21172" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21173"/>and her towns will become as a desolation,<l eID="gen21173" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21174"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> an inhabitant in them. <l eID="gen21174" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9138"/><l level="1" sID="gen21175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9138"/><transChange type="added">The one who</transChange> does the work of Yahweh <transChange type="added">with</transChange> slackness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> cursed,<l eID="gen21175" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21176"/>and <transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> keeps away blood from his sword <transChange type="added">is</transChange> cursed. <l eID="gen21176" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9139"/><l level="1" sID="gen21177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9139"/>Moab has been at ease from his youth,<l eID="gen21177" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21178"/>and he has been quiet on his dregs,<l eID="gen21178" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21179"/>and he has not been poured out from vessel to vessel,<l eID="gen21179" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21180"/>and he has not gone into exile.<l eID="gen21180" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21181"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> his taste has remained unchanged,<l eID="gen21181" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21182"/>and his fragrance has not changed. <l eID="gen21182" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9140"/><l level="1" sID="gen21183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9140"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> look, days are coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21184"/>“and I will send to him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞decanters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “those who tilt”</note><l eID="gen21184" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21185"/>and they will decant him,<l eID="gen21185" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21186"/>and his vessels they will empty out,<l eID="gen21186" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21187"/>and their jars they will smash. <l eID="gen21187" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9141"/><l level="1" sID="gen21188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9141"/>Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh,<l eID="gen21188" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21189"/>just as the house of Israel were ashamed of Bethel, their trust. <l eID="gen21189" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9142"/><l level="1" sID="gen21190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9142"/>How can you say, ‘we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> warriors,<l eID="gen21190" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21191"/>and men of might for the battle.’ <l eID="gen21191" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9143"/><l level="1" sID="gen21192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9143"/>Moab is destroyed,<l eID="gen21192" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21193"/>and his towns have gone up,<l eID="gen21193" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21194"/>and the choice of his young men have gone down to the slaughtering,”<l eID="gen21194" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21195"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> the King, Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name. <l eID="gen21195" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9144"/><l level="1" sID="gen21196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9144"/>“The disaster of Moab <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near to come,<l eID="gen21196" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21197"/>and his disaster <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞approaches very quickly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “hastens greatly”</note> <l eID="gen21197" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9145"/><l level="1" sID="gen21198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9145"/>Mourn for him, all his surroundings,<l eID="gen21198" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21199"/>and all those who knew his name.<l eID="gen21199" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21200"/>Say, ‘How <transChange type="added">the</transChange> staff of might is broken,<l eID="gen21200" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21201"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> staff of glory.’ <l eID="gen21201" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9146"/><l level="1" sID="gen21202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9146"/>Come down from glory and sit on the parched ground,<l eID="gen21202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21203"/>O inhabitant, daughter of Dibon,<l eID="gen21203" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21204"/>for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you,<l eID="gen21204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21205"/>he has destroyed your fortifications. <l eID="gen21205" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9147"/><l level="1" sID="gen21206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9147"/>Stand by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> road and watch,<l eID="gen21206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21207"/>O inhabitant of Aroer.<l eID="gen21207" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21208"/>Ask <transChange type="added">the man who is</transChange> fleeing and <transChange type="added">the woman who is</transChange> escaping,<l eID="gen21208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21209"/>say, ‘What has happened?’ <l eID="gen21209" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9148"/><l level="1" sID="gen21210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9148"/>Moab is ashamed,<l eID="gen21210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21211"/>for it is filled with terror.<l eID="gen21211" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21212"/>Wail and cry out,<l eID="gen21212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21213"/>tell <transChange type="added">it</transChange> by Arnon that Moab is devastated. <l eID="gen21213" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21141"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9149"/><div sID="gen21214" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9149"/>Judgment has also come to the land of the plain, to Holon, and to Jahaz, and on Mephaath,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:22
verses.text: and on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on Beth-diblathaim,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:23
verses.text: and on Kiriathaim, and on Beth-gamul, and on Beth-meon,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:24
verses.text: and on Kerioth, and on Bozrah, and on all the towns of the land of Moab, the far and the near.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:25
verses.text: The horn of Moab is cut off and his arm is broken,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen21214" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9150"/><lg sID="gen21215"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9150"/>“Make him drunk,<l eID="gen21216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21217"/>because he magnified himself against Yahweh,<l eID="gen21217" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21218"/>and let Moab wallow in his vomit.<l eID="gen21218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21219"/>And he also will become a laughingstock. <l eID="gen21219" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9151"/><l level="1" sID="gen21220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9151"/>Now <transChange type="added">was</transChange> not Israel the laughingstock to you?<l eID="gen21220" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21221"/>Or was he found among thieves?<l eID="gen21221" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21222"/>For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as often as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from enough”</note> you spoke over him<l eID="gen21222" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21223"/>you shook <transChange type="added">your head</transChange>. <l eID="gen21223" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9152"/><l level="1" sID="gen21224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9152"/>Leave <transChange type="added">the</transChange> towns and dwell on the rock,<l eID="gen21224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21225"/>O inhabitants of Moab,<l eID="gen21225" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21226"/>and be like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dove,<l eID="gen21226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21227"/>it nests on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sides of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mouth of a ravine. <l eID="gen21227" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9153"/><l level="1" sID="gen21228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9153"/>We have heard <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the pride of Moab<l eID="gen21228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21229"/>—<transChange type="added">he is</transChange> very proud—<l eID="gen21229" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21230"/>his height, and his pride, and his arrogance,<l eID="gen21230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21231"/>and the haughtiness of his heart. <l eID="gen21231" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9154"/><l level="1" sID="gen21232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9154"/>I know his insolence,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21232" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21233"/>“and his boastings <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞false⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “not right”</note><l eID="gen21233" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21234"/>they act <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not right”</note> <l eID="gen21234" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9155"/><l level="1" sID="gen21235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9155"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> over Moab I wail,<l eID="gen21235" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21236"/>and for all of Moab I cry out,<l eID="gen21236" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21237"/>for the people<note placement="foot">Or “men”</note> of Kir-heres I moan. <l eID="gen21237" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9156"/><l level="1" sID="gen21238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9156"/>More than the weeping of Jazer<l eID="gen21238" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21239"/>I weep for you, O vine Sibmah.<l eID="gen21239" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21240"/>Your branches cross over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea,<l eID="gen21240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21241"/>up to the sea of Jazer they reach.<l eID="gen21241" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21242"/>Upon your summer fruit and upon your vintage<l eID="gen21242" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21243"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> destroyer has fallen. <l eID="gen21243" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9157"/><l level="1" sID="gen21244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9157"/>And joy and rejoicing have been taken away from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fruitful land,<l eID="gen21244" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21245"/>even from the land of Moab.<l eID="gen21245" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21246"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wine from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wine presses<l eID="gen21246" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21247"/>I have caused to disappear.<l eID="gen21247" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21248"/>He will not tread <transChange type="added">with</transChange> exuberant shouts.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exuberant shout”</note><l eID="gen21248" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21249"/>Exuberant shouts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Exuberant shout”</note> will not be exuberant shouts.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exuberant shout”</note> <l eID="gen21249" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9158"/><l level="1" sID="gen21250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9158"/>From the cry for help of Heshbon, up to Elealeh,<l eID="gen21250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21251"/>up to Jahaz, they give their voice,<l eID="gen21251" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21252"/>from Zoar up to Horonaim, <transChange type="added">up to</transChange> Eglath-shelishiyah,<l eID="gen21252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21253"/>for even the waters of Nimrim have become as a desolation. <l eID="gen21253" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9159"/><l level="1" sID="gen21254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9159"/>And I will cause to disappear for Moab,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21255"/>“<transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who presents a sacrifice <transChange type="added">at</transChange> a high place,<l eID="gen21255" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21256"/>and <transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> burns a smoke offering to his gods. <l eID="gen21256" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9160"/><l level="1" sID="gen21257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9160"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> my heart moans for Moab like the flute.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “flutes”</note><l eID="gen21257" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21258"/>It moans for the people<note placement="foot">Or “men”</note> of Kir-heres like the flute.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “flutes”</note><l eID="gen21258" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21259"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wealth they gained has perished. <l eID="gen21259" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9161"/><l level="1" sID="gen21260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9161"/>For <transChange type="added">on</transChange> every head <transChange type="added">is</transChange> baldness,<l eID="gen21260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21261"/>and every beard is trimmed.<l eID="gen21261" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21262"/>On all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hands, slashes,<l eID="gen21262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21263"/>and on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> loins, sackcloth. <l eID="gen21263" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9162"/><l level="1" sID="gen21264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9162"/>On all the roofs of Moab, and in its public squares,<l eID="gen21264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21265"/><transChange type="added">there is</transChange> wailing everywhere.<l eID="gen21265" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21266"/>For I have broken Moab like a vessel,<l eID="gen21266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21267"/>there is no delight in it,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21267" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9163"/><l level="1" sID="gen21268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9163"/>“How it is filled with terror! <transChange type="added">How</transChange> they wail!<l eID="gen21268" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21269"/>How Moab has turned <transChange type="added">his</transChange> back! He is disgraced!<l eID="gen21269" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21270"/>So Moab has become as a derision,<l eID="gen21270" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21271"/>and as a terror for all his surrounding <transChange type="added">peoples</transChange>.” <l eID="gen21271" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21215"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9164"/><div sID="gen21272" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9164"/>For thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen21272" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21273"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21274"/>“Look, like an eagle he will swoop down,<l eID="gen21274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21275"/>and he will spread out his wings against Moab. <l eID="gen21275" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9165"/><l level="1" sID="gen21276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9165"/>Kerioth will be taken,<l eID="gen21276" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21277"/>and the strongholds will be conquered,<l eID="gen21277" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21278"/>and the hearts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> of the warriors of Moab will be on that day<l eID="gen21278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21279"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of a woman <transChange type="added">who</transChange> is in labor. <l eID="gen21279" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9166"/><l level="1" sID="gen21280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9166"/>And Moab will be destroyed from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> a people,<l eID="gen21280" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21281"/>because against Yahweh he magnified himself. <l eID="gen21281" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9167"/><l level="1" sID="gen21282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9167"/>Dread, and pit, and a trapping net <transChange type="added">are</transChange> against you,<l eID="gen21282" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21283"/>O inhabitant of Moab,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21283" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9168"/><l level="1" sID="gen21284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9168"/>“He <transChange type="added">who</transChange> flees <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of”</note> the dread<l eID="gen21284" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21285"/>will fall into the pit,<l eID="gen21285" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21286"/>and the <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> climbs up from the pit<l eID="gen21286" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21287"/>will be caught in the trapping net,<l eID="gen21287" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21288"/>for I will bring on Moab<l eID="gen21288" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21289"/>the year of their punishment,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21289" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9169"/><l level="1" sID="gen21290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9169"/>“In the shadow of Heshbon<l eID="gen21290" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21291"/>fugitives stand without strength,<l eID="gen21291" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21292"/>for a fire has gone out from Heshbon,<l eID="gen21292" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21293"/>and a flame from Sihon.<l eID="gen21293" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21294"/>And it has eaten the forehead of Moab,<l eID="gen21294" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21295"/>and the skulls<note placement="foot">Hebrew “skull”</note> of the people<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of tumult. <l eID="gen21295" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9170"/><l level="1" sID="gen21296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9170"/>Woe to you, Moab!<l eID="gen21296" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21297"/>The people of Chemosh have perished.<l eID="gen21297" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21298"/>For your sons have been taken into captivity,<l eID="gen21298" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21299"/>and your daughters into captivity. <l eID="gen21299" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9171"/><l level="1" sID="gen21300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9171"/>Yet I will restore the fortunes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> of Moab<l eID="gen21300" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21301"/>in the last of the days,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen21301" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21273"/> <div sID="gen21302" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Thus far⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Up to here”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the judgment of Moab.  <chapter eID="Jer.48"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9172"/><title type="x-s">A Message Concerning Ammon</title> <div sID="gen21303" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9172"/>Concerning the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> Thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen21303" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21304"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21305"/>“Are there no sons for Israel?<l eID="gen21305" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21306"/>Or is there no heir for him?<l eID="gen21306" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21307"/>Why has Milcom taken possession of Gad,<l eID="gen21307" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21308"/>and his people dwelled in its towns? <l eID="gen21308" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9173"/><l level="1" sID="gen21309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9173"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> look, days are coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21310"/>“and I will sound against Rabbah, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note><l eID="gen21310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21311"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> alarm of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> war,<l eID="gen21311" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21312"/>and it will become as a mound of desolation,<l eID="gen21312" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21313"/>and its daughters will burn in the fire.<l eID="gen21313" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21314"/>Then Israel will dispossess his dispossessors,” says Yahweh. <l eID="gen21314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9174"/><l level="1" sID="gen21315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9174"/>“Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is devastated.<l eID="gen21315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21316"/>Cry out, O daughters of Rabbah, put on sackcloth.<l eID="gen21316" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21317"/>Lament and run back and forth among the walls.<l eID="gen21317" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21318"/>For Milcom will go into exile,<l eID="gen21318" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21319"/>his priests and his officials together. <l eID="gen21319" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9175"/><l level="1" sID="gen21320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9175"/>Why do you boast in <transChange type="added">your</transChange> valleys?<l eID="gen21320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21321"/>Your valleys<note placement="foot">Hebrew “valley”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> ebbing.<l eID="gen21321" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21322"/>O unfaithful daughter, who trusted in her treasures,<l eID="gen21322" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21323"/><transChange type="added">who said</transChange>, ‘Who will come against me?’ <l eID="gen21323" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9176"/><l level="1" sID="gen21324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9176"/>Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to bring dread on you,”<l eID="gen21324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21325"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Lord Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen21325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21326"/>“from all your surrounding <transChange type="added">neighbors</transChange>.<l eID="gen21326" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21327"/>And you will be scattered,<l eID="gen21327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21328"/>each one <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of it”</note><l eID="gen21328" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21329"/>and there is no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> gathers the fugitives.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fugitive”</note> <l eID="gen21329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9177"/><l level="1" sID="gen21330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9177"/>Yet <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞afterward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “after thus”</note> I will restore<l eID="gen21330" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21331"/>the fortunes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21331" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21304"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9178"/><title type="x-s">A Message Concerning Edom</title> <div sID="gen21332" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9178"/>Concerning Edom, thus says Yahweh of hosts: <div eID="gen21332" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21333"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21334"/>“Is there no longer wisdom in Teman?<l eID="gen21334" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21335"/>Has counsel become lost from <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> understand?<l eID="gen21335" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21336"/>Is their wisdom rotting? <l eID="gen21336" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9179"/><l level="1" sID="gen21337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9179"/>Flee! Turn back! <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Get down low⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “make deep to dwell”</note><l eID="gen21337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21338"/>O inhabitants of Dedan.<l eID="gen21338" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21339"/>For I will bring upon him the disaster of Esau<l eID="gen21339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21340"/><transChange type="added">at the</transChange> time <transChange type="added">when</transChange> I will punish him. <l eID="gen21340" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9180"/><l level="1" sID="gen21341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9180"/>If grape-gatherers come to you,<l eID="gen21341" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21342"/>would they not leave gleanings?<l eID="gen21342" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21343"/>If thieves in the night,<l eID="gen21343" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21344"/>they destroy <transChange type="added">only</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞enough for them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “their enough”</note> <l eID="gen21344" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9181"/><l level="1" sID="gen21345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9181"/>But I have stripped Esau bare.<l eID="gen21345" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21346"/>I have uncovered his hiding places,<l eID="gen21346" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21347"/>and he is not able to hide himself.<l eID="gen21347" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21348"/>His offspring are devastated, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞along with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> his brothers,<l eID="gen21348" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21349"/>and his neighbors, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he is no more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and not he”</note> <l eID="gen21349" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9182"/><l level="1" sID="gen21350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9182"/>Leave your orphans. I will let <transChange type="added">them</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> live.<l eID="gen21350" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21351"/>And your widows, let them trust in me.” <l eID="gen21351" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21333"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9183"/><div sID="gen21352" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9183"/>For thus says Yahweh, “Look, those <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who are not condemned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who there is not their justice”</note> to drink the cup must certainly drink it.<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> And are you the one who will go entirely unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for you must certainly drink it.<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:13
verses.text: For I have sworn by myself,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “that Bozrah will become as a horror, as a disgrace, as a waste, and as a curse. And all her towns will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everlasting sites of ruins⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “sites of ruins of eternity”</note>  <div eID="gen21352" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9184"/><lg sID="gen21353"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9184"/>I have heard a message from Yahweh,<l eID="gen21354" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21355"/>and a messenger has been sent among the nations.<l eID="gen21355" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21356"/>“Gather and come against her,<l eID="gen21356" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21357"/>and rise for the battle.” <l eID="gen21357" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9185"/><l level="1" sID="gen21358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9185"/>“For look, I will make you small among the nations,<l eID="gen21358" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21359"/>despised by the humankind. <l eID="gen21359" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9186"/><l level="1" sID="gen21360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9186"/>Your terror has deceived you,<l eID="gen21360" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21361"/>the pride of your heart,<l eID="gen21361" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21362"/><transChange type="added">O you who</transChange> dwell in the clefts of the rock,<l eID="gen21362" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21363"/><transChange type="added">you who</transChange> seize <transChange type="added">the</transChange> height of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hill.<l eID="gen21363" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21364"/>Though you make your nest high like the eagle,<l eID="gen21364" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21365"/>from there I will bring you down,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21365" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9187"/><l level="1" sID="gen21366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9187"/>“And Edom will become as a horror,<l eID="gen21366" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21367"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone who passes by it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all who passes by it”</note> will be appalled,<l eID="gen21367" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21368"/>and will hiss because of all its blows. <l eID="gen21368" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9188"/><l level="1" sID="gen21369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9188"/>As the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah<l eID="gen21369" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21370"/>and their neighbors,” says Yahweh,<l eID="gen21370" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21371"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not a man”</note> will live there,<l eID="gen21371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21372"/>and the son of humankind will not dwell as an alien in it. <l eID="gen21372" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9189"/><l level="1" sID="gen21373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9189"/>Look, like a lion he comes up from the thickets of the Jordan<l eID="gen21373" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21374"/>to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a pastureland by a constantly flowing stream⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a pasture of everflowing”</note><l eID="gen21374" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21375"/>So <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will chase him away hurriedly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will do in an instant I will chase him away”</note> from it.<l eID="gen21375" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21376"/>And whoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> chosen I will appoint over it.<l eID="gen21376" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21377"/>For who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like me, and who can summon me?<l eID="gen21377" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21378"/>And who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shepherd who can stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> <l eID="gen21378" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9190"/><l level="1" sID="gen21379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9190"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> hear the plan of Yahweh that he has planned against Edom,<l eID="gen21379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21380"/>and his plans that he has planned against the inhabitants of Teman.<l eID="gen21380" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21381"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If not”</note> they will drag them away,<l eID="gen21381" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21382"/>the little <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> of the flock.<l eID="gen21382" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21383"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If not”</note> he will cause to be desolated over them<l eID="gen21383" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21384"/>their grazing place. <l eID="gen21384" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9191"/><l level="1" sID="gen21385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9191"/>The earth will quake from the sound of their falling.<l eID="gen21385" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21386"/>A cry of distress! Their voice will be heard at <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Red Sea⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Sea of Reeds”</note> <l eID="gen21386" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9192"/><l level="1" sID="gen21387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9192"/>Look, like an eagle he will go up and he will swoop down,<l eID="gen21387" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21388"/>and he will spread out his wings against Bozrah.<l eID="gen21388" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21389"/>And the heart of the warriors of Edom will be in that day<l eID="gen21389" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21390"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of a woman <transChange type="added">who</transChange> is in labor. <l eID="gen21390" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21353"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9193"/><title type="x-s">A Message Concerning Damascus</title> <div sID="gen21391" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9193"/>Concerning Damascus: <div eID="gen21391" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21392"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21393"/>“Hamath and Arpad are ashamed,<l eID="gen21393" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21394"/>for they have heard bad news;<l eID="gen21394" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21395"/>they melt.<l eID="gen21395" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21396"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> concern in the sea.<l eID="gen21396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21397"/>It is not able to keep quiet. <l eID="gen21397" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9194"/><l level="1" sID="gen21398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9194"/>Damascus has grown slack.<l eID="gen21398" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21399"/>She has turned away to flee and panic.<l eID="gen21399" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21400"/>Anxiety has seized <transChange type="added">her</transChange>,<l eID="gen21400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21401"/>and labor pains have grasped her,<l eID="gen21401" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21402"/>like a woman in labor. <l eID="gen21402" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9195"/><l level="1" sID="gen21403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9195"/>How <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city of praise has not been abandoned!<l eID="gen21403" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21404"/>The city of my joy! <l eID="gen21404" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9196"/><l level="1" sID="gen21405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9196"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> her young men will fall in her public squares,<l eID="gen21405" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21406"/>and all <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the soldiers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the men of the battle”</note> will perish in that day,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts. <l eID="gen21406" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9197"/><l level="1" sID="gen21407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9197"/>“And I will kindle a fire at the wall of Damascus,<l eID="gen21407" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21408"/>and it will devour the citadel fortresses of Ben-hadad.” <l eID="gen21408" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21392"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9198"/><title type="x-s">A Message Concerning Kedar and the Kingdoms of Hazor</title> <div sID="gen21409" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9198"/>Concerning Kedar and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor that Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon defeated. Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen21409" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21410"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21411"/>“Rise up, go up against Kedar<l eID="gen21411" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21412"/>and destroy <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east. <l eID="gen21412" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9199"/><l level="1" sID="gen21413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9199"/>They will take their tents, and their flocks,<l eID="gen21413" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21414"/>their tent curtains, and all their equipment,<l eID="gen21414" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21415"/>and their camels they will carry away for themselves,<l eID="gen21415" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21416"/>and they will call to them, ‘Terror <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from all around.’ <l eID="gen21416" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:30
