verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9200"/><l level="1" sID="gen21417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9200"/>Flee! Wander far away! <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Get down low⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “Make deep to dwell”</note><l eID="gen21417" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21418"/>O inhabitants of Hazor,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen21418" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21419"/>“For Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, has planned a plan against you.<l eID="gen21419" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21420"/>And he has schemed<note placement="foot">Or “planned”</note> a scheme<note placement="foot">Or “plan”</note> against you. <l eID="gen21420" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9201"/><l level="1" sID="gen21421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9201"/>Rise up, go up against a nation <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> at ease,<l eID="gen21421" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21422"/>living <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞securely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen21422" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21423"/>“<transChange type="added">There are</transChange> no gates and <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> no bars<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bar”</note> for them,<l eID="gen21423" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21424"/>they dwell alone. <l eID="gen21424" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9202"/><l level="1" sID="gen21425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9202"/>And their camels will become as plunder,<l eID="gen21425" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21426"/>and the multitude of their livestock as spoil.<l eID="gen21426" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21427"/>And I will scatter to every wind <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> are trimmed to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side,<l eID="gen21427" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21428"/>and from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all his sides”</note> I will bring their disaster,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21428" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9203"/><l level="1" sID="gen21429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9203"/>“And Hazor will become as a lair of jackals,<l eID="gen21429" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21430"/>a waste forever;<l eID="gen21430" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21431"/>no one will live there,<l eID="gen21431" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21432"/>and no son of humankind will dwell as an alien in it.” <l eID="gen21432" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21410"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9204"/><title type="x-s">A Message Concerning Elam</title> <div sID="gen21433" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9204"/>The word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah the king of Judah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:35
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts: <div eID="gen21433" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21434"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21435"/>‘Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to break the bow of Elam,<l eID="gen21435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21436"/>the first and best of their might. <l eID="gen21436" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9205"/><l level="1" sID="gen21437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9205"/>And I will bring to Elam four winds,<l eID="gen21437" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21438"/>from the four corners of heaven,<l eID="gen21438" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21439"/>and I will scatter them to all these winds,<l eID="gen21439" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21440"/>and there will not be a nation<l eID="gen21440" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21441"/>where the scattered people of Elam will not go. <l eID="gen21441" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9206"/><l level="1" sID="gen21442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9206"/>So I will shatter Elam <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> their enemies,<l eID="gen21442" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21443"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the seekers of their life.<l eID="gen21443" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21444"/>And I will bring disaster upon them,<l eID="gen21444" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21445"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my burning anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the blaze of my nose”</note>’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.<l eID="gen21445" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21446"/>‘And I will send after them the sword<l eID="gen21446" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21447"/>until I have destroyed them. <l eID="gen21447" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9207"/><l level="1" sID="gen21448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9207"/>And I will set my throne in Elam<l eID="gen21448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21449"/>and I will destroy from there king and officials,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21449" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9208"/><l level="1" sID="gen21450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9208"/>‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> in the last of the days<l eID="gen21450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21451"/>I will restore the fortunes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fortune”</note> of Elam,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.” <l eID="gen21451" level="2"/><lg eID="gen21434"/> <chapter eID="Jer.49"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9209"/><title type="x-s">A Message Concerning Babylon</title> <div sID="gen21452" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9209"/>The word that Yahweh spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans, by the hand of Jeremiah the prophet:  <div eID="gen21452" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9210"/><lg sID="gen21453"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9210"/>“Declare among the nations and proclaim,<l eID="gen21454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21455"/>and lift up a banner.<l eID="gen21455" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21456"/>Proclaim, you must not conceal <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<l eID="gen21456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21457"/>Say, ‘Babylon is captured,<l eID="gen21457" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21458"/>Bel is ashamed,<l eID="gen21458" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21459"/>Merodach is filled with terror,<l eID="gen21459" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21460"/>her idols are ashamed,<l eID="gen21460" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21461"/>her idols are filled with terror. <l eID="gen21461" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9211"/><l level="1" sID="gen21462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9211"/>For a nation will come up against her from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north.<l eID="gen21462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21463"/>It will make her land as a horror,<l eID="gen21463" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21464"/>and an inhabitant will not be in her.<l eID="gen21464" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21465"/>From humans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note> to animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> they <transChange type="added">all</transChange> will wander <transChange type="added">off</transChange>.<l eID="gen21465" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21466"/>They will go <transChange type="added">away</transChange>. <l eID="gen21466" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9212"/><l level="1" sID="gen21467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9212"/>In those days and in that time,’ ” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21467" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21468"/>“the people<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Israel will come,<l eID="gen21468" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21469"/>they and the people<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Judah together.<l eID="gen21469" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21470"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Weeping as they go⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “They shall go and weeping”</note> they will go,<l eID="gen21470" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21471"/>and Yahweh their God they will seek. <l eID="gen21471" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9213"/><l level="1" sID="gen21472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9213"/>They will ask <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Zion,<l eID="gen21472" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21473"/><transChange type="added">turning</transChange> their faces there.<l eID="gen21473" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21474"/>They will come and join themselves to Yahweh<l eID="gen21474" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21475"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a covenant of eternity”</note> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> will not be forgotten. <l eID="gen21475" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9214"/><l level="1" sID="gen21476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9214"/>My people have become lost sheep,<l eID="gen21476" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21477"/>their shepherds have caused them to go astray.<l eID="gen21477" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21478"/>They led them away <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> mountains.<l eID="gen21478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21479"/>From mountain to hill they have gone,<l eID="gen21479" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21480"/>they have forgotten their resting place. <l eID="gen21480" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9215"/><l level="1" sID="gen21481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9215"/>All <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> found them have devoured them.<l eID="gen21481" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21482"/>And their foes have said, ‘We are not guilty,<l eID="gen21482" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21483"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “under that”</note> they have sinned against Yahweh, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞true pasture⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “settlement of righteousness”</note><l eID="gen21483" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21484"/>even Yahweh, the hope of their ancestors.’<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> <l eID="gen21484" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9216"/><l level="1" sID="gen21485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9216"/>Flee from the midst of Babylon,<l eID="gen21485" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21486"/>and from the land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans.<l eID="gen21486" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21487"/>Go out and be like he-goats<l eID="gen21487" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21488"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flock. <l eID="gen21488" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9217"/><l level="1" sID="gen21489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9217"/>For look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to stir up,<l eID="gen21489" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21490"/>and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to bring against Babylon<l eID="gen21490" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21491"/>a contingent of great nations<l eID="gen21491" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21492"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north.<l eID="gen21492" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21493"/>And they will draw up a battle formation against her,<l eID="gen21493" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21494"/>from there she will be captured.<l eID="gen21494" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21495"/>Their arrows <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like a warrior <transChange type="added">who has</transChange> achieved success,<l eID="gen21495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21496"/>he does not return without success. <l eID="gen21496" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9218"/><l level="1" sID="gen21497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9218"/>And Chaldea will be as booty,<l eID="gen21497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21498"/>all <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> plunder her will be satisfied,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21498" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9219"/><l level="1" sID="gen21499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9219"/>“Though you rejoice, though you exult,<l eID="gen21499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21500"/>O plunderers of my inheritance,<l eID="gen21500" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21501"/>though you frisk about like a heifer on the grass,<l eID="gen21501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21502"/>and you neigh like the powerful stallions, <l eID="gen21502" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9220"/><l level="1" sID="gen21503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9220"/>your mother will be very ashamed.<l eID="gen21503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21504"/><transChange type="added">She who</transChange> gave birth <transChange type="added">to</transChange> you will be humiliated.<note placement="foot">Or “ashamed”</note><l eID="gen21504" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21505"/>Look, <transChange type="added">she will be the</transChange> least of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations,<l eID="gen21505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21506"/>a desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note> dry land, and wilderness.<note placement="foot">Or “Arabah”</note> <l eID="gen21506" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9221"/><l level="1" sID="gen21507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9221"/>Because of the anger of Yahweh she will not be inhabited,<l eID="gen21507" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21508"/>but she will be a wasteland, all of her.<l eID="gen21508" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21509"/>Everyone <transChange type="added">who</transChange> passes by Babylon will be appalled<l eID="gen21509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21510"/>and will hiss because of all her wounds. <l eID="gen21510" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9222"/><l level="1" sID="gen21511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9222"/>Draw up a battle formation at Babylon all around,<l eID="gen21511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21512"/>all those who bend <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bow, shoot at her.<l eID="gen21512" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21513"/>You must not spare arrows,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “arrow”</note><l eID="gen21513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21514"/>for she has sinned against Yahweh. <l eID="gen21514" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9223"/><l level="1" sID="gen21515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9223"/>Raise a war cry against her on all sides.<l eID="gen21515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21516"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞She has surrendered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “She has given her hand”</note><l eID="gen21516" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21517"/>Her towers have fallen,<l eID="gen21517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21518"/>her walls are ruined.<l eID="gen21518" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21519"/>For this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the vengeance of Yahweh.<l eID="gen21519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21520"/>Take revenge on her.<l eID="gen21520" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21521"/>As she has done <transChange type="added">to others</transChange>,<l eID="gen21521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21522"/><transChange type="added">so</transChange> do to her. <l eID="gen21522" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9224"/><l level="1" sID="gen21523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9224"/>Cut off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sower from Babylon,<l eID="gen21523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21524"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who uses <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sickle in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of harvest.<l eID="gen21524" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21525"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “From the face of”</note> the sword of the oppressor<l eID="gen21525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21526"/>each one will turn to their people,<l eID="gen21526" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21527"/>and each one will flee to their land. <l eID="gen21527" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9225"/><l level="1" sID="gen21528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9225"/>Israel <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sheep scattered,<l eID="gen21528" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21529"/>lions drove <transChange type="added">them</transChange> away.<l eID="gen21529" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21530"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> first who devoured it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the king of Assyria,<l eID="gen21530" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21531"/>and now <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the end Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, gnawed its bones.” <l eID="gen21531" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21453"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9226"/><div sID="gen21532" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9226"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, <div eID="gen21532" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21533"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21534"/>“Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to punish the king of Babylon and his land<l eID="gen21534" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21535"/>just as I punished the king of Assyria. <l eID="gen21535" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9227"/><l level="1" sID="gen21536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9227"/>And I will restore Israel to its pasture,<l eID="gen21536" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21537"/>and it will feed <transChange type="added">on</transChange> Carmel, and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Bashan,<l eID="gen21537" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21538"/>and on the hills<note placement="foot">Hebrew “hill”</note> of Ephraim, and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Gilead<l eID="gen21538" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21539"/>its hunger will be satisfied. <l eID="gen21539" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9228"/><l level="1" sID="gen21540"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9228"/>In those days and at that time,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21540" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21541"/>“the guilt of Israel will be sought, but there <transChange type="added">is</transChange> none,<l eID="gen21541" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21542"/>and the sins of Judah, but they will not be found,<l eID="gen21542" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21543"/>for I will forgive those I left behind. <l eID="gen21543" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9229"/><l level="1" sID="gen21544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9229"/>To the land of Merathaim,<l eID="gen21544" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21545"/>go up against her,<l eID="gen21545" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21546"/>and against the inhabitants of Pekod,<l eID="gen21546" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21547"/>massacre and destroy them,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21547" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21548"/>“and do according to all that I have commanded you. <l eID="gen21548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9230"/><l level="1" sID="gen21549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9230"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> sound of battle <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the land,<l eID="gen21549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21550"/>and great destruction. <l eID="gen21550" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9231"/><l level="1" sID="gen21551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9231"/>How the blacksmith’s hammer of all the earth is cut down and broken!<l eID="gen21551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21552"/>How Babylon has become as a horror among the nations! <l eID="gen21552" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9232"/><l level="1" sID="gen21553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9232"/>I laid a bird snare for you, and you were caught, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Babylon.<l eID="gen21553" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21554"/>But you yourself <transChange type="added">did</transChange> not know.<l eID="gen21554" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21555"/>You were discovered and seized,<l eID="gen21555" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21556"/>because with Yahweh you measured yourself. <l eID="gen21556" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9233"/><l level="1" sID="gen21557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9233"/>Yahweh has opened his armory,<l eID="gen21557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21558"/>and he has brought out the weapons of his wrath,<l eID="gen21558" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21559"/>for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a word for my Lord Yahweh of hosts<l eID="gen21559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21560"/>in the land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans. <l eID="gen21560" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9234"/><l level="1" sID="gen21561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9234"/>Come against her from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end,<l eID="gen21561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21562"/>open her granaries.<l eID="gen21562" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21563"/>Pile her up like heaps and destroy her.<l eID="gen21563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21564"/>Let there be no remnant for her. <l eID="gen21564" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9235"/><l level="1" sID="gen21565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9235"/>Massacre all her bulls,<l eID="gen21565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21566"/>let them go down to the slaughtering.<l eID="gen21566" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21567"/>Woe to them, for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> day has come,<l eID="gen21567" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21568"/>the time of their punishment. <l eID="gen21568" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9236"/><l level="1" sID="gen21569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9236"/><transChange type="added">There is the</transChange> sound of fugitives and survivors<l eID="gen21569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21570"/>from the land of Babylon,<l eID="gen21570" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21571"/>to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahweh our God,<l eID="gen21571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21572"/>the vengeance for his temple. <l eID="gen21572" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9237"/><l level="1" sID="gen21573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9237"/>Summon archers against Babylon,<l eID="gen21573" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21574"/>all those who bend <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bow.<l eID="gen21574" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21575"/>Encamp all around her,<l eID="gen21575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21576"/>there must not be for her an escape.<l eID="gen21576" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21577"/>Take revenge on her according to her deeds.<l eID="gen21577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21578"/>According to all that she has done, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> do to her.<l eID="gen21578" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21579"/>For against Yahweh she has behaved insolently,<l eID="gen21579" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21580"/>against the Holy One of Israel. <l eID="gen21580" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9238"/><l level="1" sID="gen21581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9238"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> her young men will fall in her public squares,<l eID="gen21581" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21582"/>and all <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞her soldiers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “her the men of war”</note> will perish on that day,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21582" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9239"/><l level="1" sID="gen21583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9239"/>“Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> arrogant <transChange type="added">one</transChange>,”<l eID="gen21583" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21584"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Lord Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen21584" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21585"/>“for your day has come,<l eID="gen21585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21586"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> time <transChange type="added">when</transChange> I will punish you. <l eID="gen21586" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9240"/><l level="1" sID="gen21587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9240"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> arrogant <transChange type="added">one</transChange> will stumble and fall,<l eID="gen21587" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21588"/>and there is no <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> raises <transChange type="added">him</transChange> up.<l eID="gen21588" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21589"/>And I will kindle a fire in his cities,<l eID="gen21589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21590"/>and it will devour everything around him.” <l eID="gen21590" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21533"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9241"/><div sID="gen21591" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9241"/>Thus says Yahweh of hosts: <div eID="gen21591" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21592"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21593"/>“The people<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Israel <transChange type="added">are</transChange> oppressed,<l eID="gen21593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21594"/>and the people<note placement="foot">Or “sons/children”</note> of Judah likewise,<l eID="gen21594" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21595"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> all their captors have seized them,<l eID="gen21595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21596"/>they refuse to let them go free. <l eID="gen21596" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9242"/><l level="1" sID="gen21597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9242"/>Their redeemer <transChange type="added">is</transChange> strong,<l eID="gen21597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21598"/>his name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh of hosts.<l eID="gen21598" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21599"/>Surely he will plead their case,<l eID="gen21599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21600"/>in order to make peace <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the earth,<l eID="gen21600" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21601"/>but to cause unrest to the inhabitants of Babylon. <l eID="gen21601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9243"/><l level="1" sID="gen21602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9243"/>A sword against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21602" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21603"/>“and against the inhabitants of Babylon,<l eID="gen21603" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21604"/>and against her officials,<l eID="gen21604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21605"/>and against her wise men. <l eID="gen21605" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9244"/><l level="1" sID="gen21606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9244"/>A sword against the oracle priests,<l eID="gen21606" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21607"/>and they will become foolish.<l eID="gen21607" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21608"/>A sword against her warriors,<l eID="gen21608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21609"/>and they will be filled with terror. <l eID="gen21609" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9245"/><l level="1" sID="gen21610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9245"/>A sword against his horses,<l eID="gen21610" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21611"/>and against his chariots,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note><l eID="gen21611" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21612"/>and against all the foreign troops who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the midst of her,<l eID="gen21612" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21613"/>so that they may become as women.<l eID="gen21613" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21614"/>A sword against her treasures,<l eID="gen21614" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21615"/>so that they may be plundered. <l eID="gen21615" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9246"/><l level="1" sID="gen21616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9246"/>A drought <transChange type="added">will come</transChange> against her waters,<l eID="gen21616" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21617"/>and they will dry up,<l eID="gen21617" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21618"/>for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a land of images,<l eID="gen21618" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21619"/>and because of the frightful <transChange type="added">objects</transChange>, they act like madmen. <l eID="gen21619" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9247"/><l level="1" sID="gen21620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9247"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> desert creatures will live there<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with jackals,<l eID="gen21620" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21621"/>and daughters of ostriches<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ostrich”</note> will inhabit her.<l eID="gen21621" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21622"/>And she will not be inhabited again <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note><l eID="gen21622" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21623"/>and she will not be dwelt in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for all generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until generation and generation”</note> <l eID="gen21623" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9248"/><l level="1" sID="gen21624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9248"/>As <transChange type="added">when</transChange> God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah<l eID="gen21624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21625"/>and their neighbors,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21625" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21626"/>“no one will live there,<l eID="gen21626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21627"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> son of humankind will not dwell as an alien in her. <l eID="gen21627" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9249"/><l level="1" sID="gen21628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9249"/>Look, a people <transChange type="added">is</transChange> about to come<l eID="gen21628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21629"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,<l eID="gen21629" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21630"/>and a great nation and many kings are woken up<l eID="gen21630" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21631"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> remotest part of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen21631" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9250"/><l level="1" sID="gen21632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9250"/>They keep hold of bow and short sword.<l eID="gen21632" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21633"/>They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> cruel and they have no mercy.<l eID="gen21633" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21634"/>Their sound <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the sea, it roars,<l eID="gen21634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21635"/>and upon horses they ride.<l eID="gen21635" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21636"/>Drawn up for battle as a man for the battle,<l eID="gen21636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21637"/>against you, O daughter of Babylon. <l eID="gen21637" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9251"/><l level="1" sID="gen21638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9251"/>The king of Babylon heard their report<l eID="gen21638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21639"/>and his hands grew slack.<l eID="gen21639" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21640"/>Anxiety has seized him,<l eID="gen21640" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21641"/>fear and pain like the <transChange type="added">woman who</transChange> gives birth. <l eID="gen21641" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9252"/><l level="1" sID="gen21642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9252"/>Look, like a lion he comes up from the thickets<note placement="foot">Hebrew “thicket”</note> of the Jordan<l eID="gen21642" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21643"/>against <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a pastureland by a constantly flowing stream⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a pasture of ever-flowing”</note><l eID="gen21643" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21644"/>so <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will chase them away quickly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will do in an instant I will cause them to run”</note> from her,<l eID="gen21644" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21645"/>and I will appoint whoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> chosen over her.<l eID="gen21645" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21646"/>For who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like me, and who can summon me,<l eID="gen21646" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21647"/>and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this shepherd who can stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> <l eID="gen21647" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9253"/><l level="1" sID="gen21648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9253"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> hear the plan of Yahweh<l eID="gen21648" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21649"/>that he has planned against Babylon,<l eID="gen21649" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21650"/>and his plans<l eID="gen21650" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21651"/>that he has planned against the land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans.<l eID="gen21651" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21652"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If not”</note> they will drag them away,<l eID="gen21652" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21653"/>the little <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> of the flock.<l eID="gen21653" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21654"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If not”</note> he will cause <transChange type="added">their</transChange> grazing place<l eID="gen21654" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21655"/>to be desolate over them. <l eID="gen21655" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9254"/><l level="1" sID="gen21656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9254"/>At <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound, ‘Babylon has been captured,’<l eID="gen21656" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21657"/>the earth will quake,<l eID="gen21657" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21658"/>and a cry for help among the nations<l eID="gen21658" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21659"/>will be heard.” <l eID="gen21659" level="2"/><lg eID="gen21592"/> <chapter eID="Jer.50"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:1
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen21660" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21661"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21662"/>“Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to stir up against Babylon<l eID="gen21662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21663"/>and against the inhabitants of Leb-qamai a destructive wind. <l eID="gen21663" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9255"/><l level="1" sID="gen21664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9255"/>And I will send winnowers to Babylon,<l eID="gen21664" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21665"/>and they will winnow her,<l eID="gen21665" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21666"/>and they will lay waste her land,<l eID="gen21666" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21667"/>for they will be against her from all sides on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of disaster. <l eID="gen21667" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9256"/><l level="1" sID="gen21668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9256"/>Let not him who bends the bow shoot his bow,<l eID="gen21668" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21669"/>and let him not rise high in his body armor.<l eID="gen21669" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21670"/>And you must not spare her young men;<l eID="gen21670" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21671"/>destroy her whole army. <l eID="gen21671" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9257"/><l level="1" sID="gen21672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9257"/>And they will fall slain in the land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans,<l eID="gen21672" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21673"/>and pierced through in her streets. <l eID="gen21673" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9258"/><l level="1" sID="gen21674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9258"/>For neither Israel nor Judah <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a widower from their God,<l eID="gen21674" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21675"/>from Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen21675" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21676"/>though their land is full of guilt<l eID="gen21676" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21677"/>against the Holy One of Israel.” <l eID="gen21677" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9259"/><l level="1" sID="gen21678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9259"/>Flee from the midst of Babylon and save each one his life.<l eID="gen21678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21679"/>You must not perish because of her guilt.<l eID="gen21679" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21680"/>For this <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> time of vengeance for Yahweh,<l eID="gen21680" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21681"/>he <transChange type="added">will</transChange> repay her what is deserved. <l eID="gen21681" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9260"/><l level="1" sID="gen21682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9260"/>Babylon <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a cup of gold in the hand of Yahweh,<l eID="gen21682" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21683"/>making drunk all the earth.<l eID="gen21683" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21684"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> nations drank of her wine.<l eID="gen21684" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21685"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Unto thus”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations acted like madmen. <l eID="gen21685" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9261"/><l level="1" sID="gen21686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9261"/>Suddenly Babylon has fallen and she is shattered.<l eID="gen21686" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21687"/>Wail over her!<l eID="gen21687" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21688"/>Take balm for her wounds,<l eID="gen21688" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21689"/>perhaps she may be healed. <l eID="gen21689" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9262"/><l level="1" sID="gen21690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9262"/>We tried to heal Babylon, and she was not healed.<l eID="gen21690" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21691"/>Forsake her and let us go each one to his country,<l eID="gen21691" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21692"/>for her judgment has reached to the heavens,<l eID="gen21692" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21693"/>and it has been lifted up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> skies. <l eID="gen21693" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9263"/><l level="1" sID="gen21694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9263"/>Yahweh has brought forth our vindication.<l eID="gen21694" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21695"/>Come and let us make known in Zion the work of Yahweh our God. <l eID="gen21695" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9264"/><l level="1" sID="gen21696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9264"/>Sharpen the arrows, fill the quivers!<l eID="gen21696" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21697"/>Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes.<l eID="gen21697" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21698"/>Because his plan concerning Babylon <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to destroy it,<l eID="gen21698" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21699"/>for that is the vengeance of Yahweh,<l eID="gen21699" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21700"/>the vengeance for his temple. <l eID="gen21700" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9265"/><l level="1" sID="gen21701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9265"/>Against the walls of Babylon raise a banner;<l eID="gen21701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21702"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞post a strong watch⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “make strong the guard”</note> post watchmen, prepare the ambushes,<l eID="gen21702" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21703"/>for Yahweh has both planned as well as performed<l eID="gen21703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21704"/>what he has spoken concerning the inhabitants of Babylon. <l eID="gen21704" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9266"/><l level="1" sID="gen21705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9266"/><transChange type="added">O you who</transChange> live by mighty waters, rich in treasures,<l eID="gen21705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21706"/>your end has come, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the measure of your life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the cubit of your severing”</note> <l eID="gen21706" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9267"/><l level="1" sID="gen21707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9267"/>Yahweh of hosts has sworn by himself,<l eID="gen21707" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21708"/>“Surely I will fill you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> troops like the creeping locusts,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “locust”</note><l eID="gen21708" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21709"/>and they will sing over you a war cry.” <l eID="gen21709" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9268"/><l level="1" sID="gen21710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9268"/><transChange type="added">He is the one who</transChange> made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth by his power,<l eID="gen21710" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21711"/><transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> created <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world by his wisdom,<l eID="gen21711" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21712"/>and by his understanding he stretched out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens. <l eID="gen21712" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9269"/><l level="1" sID="gen21713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9269"/>At the giving of his voice<l eID="gen21713" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21714"/><transChange type="added">there is</transChange> a roar of waters in the heavens,<l eID="gen21714" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21715"/>and he causes <transChange type="added">the</transChange> patches of mist<l eID="gen21715" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21716"/>to go up from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth.<l eID="gen21716" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21717"/>He makes lightning for the rain,<l eID="gen21717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21718"/>and he brings out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind from his storehouses. <l eID="gen21718" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9270"/><l level="1" sID="gen21719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9270"/>All humankind turns out to be stupid,<l eID="gen21719" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21720"/>without knowledge.<l eID="gen21720" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21721"/>Every goldsmith is put to shame<l eID="gen21721" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21722"/>by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> divine image.<l eID="gen21722" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21723"/>For his cast image <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a lie,<l eID="gen21723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21724"/>and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no breath in them. <l eID="gen21724" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9271"/><l level="1" sID="gen21725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9271"/>They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> worthless,<l eID="gen21725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21726"/>a work of mockery.<l eID="gen21726" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21727"/>At the time of their punishment,<l eID="gen21727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21728"/>they will perish. <l eID="gen21728" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9272"/><l level="1" sID="gen21729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9272"/>The portion of Jacob <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not like these,<l eID="gen21729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21730"/>for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the creator of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the all”</note><l eID="gen21730" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21731"/>and the tribe of his inheritance.<l eID="gen21731" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21732"/>Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name. <l eID="gen21732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9273"/><l level="1" sID="gen21733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9273"/><transChange type="added">He says</transChange>, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a war club for me,<l eID="gen21733" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21734"/>a weapon of battle,<l eID="gen21734" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21735"/>and I smash nations with you,<l eID="gen21735" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21736"/>and I destroy kingdoms with you. <l eID="gen21736" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9274"/><l level="1" sID="gen21737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9274"/>And I smash <transChange type="added">the</transChange> horse with you,<l eID="gen21737" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21738"/>and its rider,<l eID="gen21738" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21739"/>and I smash <transChange type="added">the</transChange> chariot with you,<l eID="gen21739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21740"/>and its rider. <l eID="gen21740" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9275"/><l level="1" sID="gen21741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9275"/>And I smash man and woman with you,<l eID="gen21741" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21742"/>and I smash <transChange type="added">the</transChange> old man and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> boy with you,<l eID="gen21742" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21743"/>and I smash <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young man and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young woman with you. <l eID="gen21743" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9276"/><l level="1" sID="gen21744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9276"/>And I smash <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shepherd and his flock with you,<l eID="gen21744" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21745"/>and I smash <transChange type="added">the</transChange> farmer and his team with you,<l eID="gen21745" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21746"/>and I smash <transChange type="added">the</transChange> governors and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> officials with you. <l eID="gen21746" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9277"/><l level="1" sID="gen21747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9277"/>And I will repay Babylon,<l eID="gen21747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21748"/>and all the inhabitants of Chaldea,<l eID="gen21748" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21749"/>all their wickedness that they have done in Zion<l eID="gen21749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21750"/>before your eyes,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21750" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9278"/><l level="1" sID="gen21751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9278"/>“Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against you,<l eID="gen21751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21752"/>O mountain of the destruction,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21752" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21753"/>“the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> that destroys the whole earth.<l eID="gen21753" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21754"/>And I will stretch out my hand against you,<l eID="gen21754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21755"/>and I will roll you down from the cliffs,<l eID="gen21755" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21756"/>and I will make you as a mountain burned away. <l eID="gen21756" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9279"/><l level="1" sID="gen21757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9279"/>They will not take from you<l eID="gen21757" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21758"/>a stone for a corner,<l eID="gen21758" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21759"/>and a stone for a foundation,<l eID="gen21759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21760"/>for you will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting desolation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “a desolation of everlasting”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21760" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9280"/><l level="1" sID="gen21761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9280"/>Raise a banner in the land;<l eID="gen21761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21762"/>blow a horn among the nations;<l eID="gen21762" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21763"/>prepare for holy war against her;<l eID="gen21763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21764"/>summon <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations against her,<l eID="gen21764" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21765"/>the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz;<l eID="gen21765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21766"/>summon against her an official;<l eID="gen21766" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21767"/>bring up horses<note placement="foot">Hebrew “horse”</note> like bristling creeping locusts.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “locust”</note> <l eID="gen21767" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9281"/><l level="1" sID="gen21768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9281"/>Prepare <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations for holy war against her,<l eID="gen21768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21769"/>the kings of the Medes,<l eID="gen21769" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21770"/>with their governors and all their officials,<l eID="gen21770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21771"/>and every land of their dominion. <l eID="gen21771" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9282"/><l level="1" sID="gen21772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9282"/>And the land quakes and writhes,<l eID="gen21772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21773"/>for the plans of Yahweh against Babylon stand,<l eID="gen21773" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21774"/>to make the land of Babylon as a horror,<l eID="gen21774" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21775"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> inhabitant. <l eID="gen21775" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9283"/><l level="1" sID="gen21776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9283"/>The warriors of Babylon have ceased to fight,<l eID="gen21776" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21777"/>they remain in the strongholds,<l eID="gen21777" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21778"/>their power has dried up,<l eID="gen21778" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21779"/>they have become as women.<l eID="gen21779" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21780"/>Her dwelling places are set on fire,<l eID="gen21780" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21781"/>her bars are broken. <l eID="gen21781" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9284"/><l level="1" sID="gen21782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9284"/><transChange type="added">one</transChange> runner runs to meet <transChange type="added">another</transChange> runner,<l eID="gen21782" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21783"/>and <transChange type="added">one</transChange> messenger to meet <transChange type="added">another</transChange> messenger,<l eID="gen21783" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21784"/>to tell the king of Babylon that his city has been captured,<l eID="gen21784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21785"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from end to end⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from end”</note> <l eID="gen21785" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9285"/><l level="1" sID="gen21786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9285"/>And the fords have been seized,<l eID="gen21786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21787"/>and the reed marshes have been burned with fire,<l eID="gen21787" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21788"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the soldiers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the men of the war”</note> are horrified. <l eID="gen21788" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21661"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9286"/><div sID="gen21789" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9286"/>For thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, <div eID="gen21789" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21790"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21791"/>“The daughter of Babylon <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a threshing floor<l eID="gen21791" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21792"/><transChange type="added">at the</transChange> time it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> trodden down,<l eID="gen21792" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21793"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just a little while⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “still a little”</note><l eID="gen21793" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21794"/>and the time of the harvest will come for her.” <l eID="gen21794" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9287"/><l level="1" sID="gen21795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9287"/>Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon<l eID="gen21795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21796"/>has devoured me <transChange type="added">and</transChange> sucked me dry;<l eID="gen21796" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21797"/>he has made me an empty vessel;<l eID="gen21797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21798"/>he has swallowed me like the sea monster;<l eID="gen21798" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21799"/>he has filled his belly with my delicacies;<l eID="gen21799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21800"/>he has rinsed me. <l eID="gen21800" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9288"/><l level="1" sID="gen21801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9288"/>“<transChange type="added">May</transChange> the violence done to me and to my flesh <transChange type="added">be</transChange> on Babylon,”<l eID="gen21801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21802"/>the inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of Zion will say;<l eID="gen21802" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21803"/>and “My blood <transChange type="added">be</transChange> upon the inhabitants of Chaldea,”<l eID="gen21803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21804"/>Jerusalem will say. <l eID="gen21804" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen21790"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9289"/><div sID="gen21805" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9289"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> thus says Yahweh, <div eID="gen21805" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21806"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21807"/>“Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to contend your case,<l eID="gen21807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21808"/>and I will avenge your vengeance,<l eID="gen21808" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21809"/>and I will cause her sea to dry up,<l eID="gen21809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21810"/>and I will cause her fountain to dry up. <l eID="gen21810" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9290"/><l level="1" sID="gen21811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9290"/>And Babylon will become as a heap of stones,<l eID="gen21811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21812"/>a lair of jackals,<l eID="gen21812" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21813"/><transChange type="added">an object of</transChange> horror, and <transChange type="added">an object of</transChange> hissing,<l eID="gen21813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21814"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not”</note> inhabitants. <l eID="gen21814" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9291"/><l level="1" sID="gen21815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9291"/>They will roar together like the young lions,<l eID="gen21815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21816"/>they will growl like the cubs of lions. <l eID="gen21816" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9292"/><l level="1" sID="gen21817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9292"/>At their becoming hot I will set their banquets,<l eID="gen21817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21818"/>and I will make them drunk,<l eID="gen21818" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21819"/>so that they will fall into a swoon,<l eID="gen21819" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21820"/>and they will sleep <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting sleep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a sleep of eternity”</note><l eID="gen21820" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21821"/>and they will not wake up,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21821" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9293"/><l level="1" sID="gen21822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9293"/>“I will bring them down like young rams to slaughter,<l eID="gen21822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21823"/>like rams and goats. <l eID="gen21823" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9294"/><l level="1" sID="gen21824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9294"/>How Sheshach is captured,<l eID="gen21824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21825"/>and the glory of all the earth is seized!<l eID="gen21825" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21826"/>How Babylon has become as an <transChange type="added">object of</transChange> horror<l eID="gen21826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21827"/>among the nations! <l eID="gen21827" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9295"/><l level="1" sID="gen21828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9295"/>The sea has risen over Babylon,<l eID="gen21828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21829"/>she has been covered by the roar of its waves. <l eID="gen21829" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9296"/><l level="1" sID="gen21830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9296"/>Her cities have become as an <transChange type="added">object of</transChange> horror,<l eID="gen21830" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21831"/>a dry land and a wilderness,<note placement="foot">Or “Arabah”</note><l eID="gen21831" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21832"/>a land in which no person lives,<l eID="gen21832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21833"/>nor does a son of humankind pass through it. <l eID="gen21833" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9297"/><l level="1" sID="gen21834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9297"/>And I will punish Bel in Babylon,<l eID="gen21834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21835"/>and I will wrench out from his mouth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what he has swallowed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “what has been swallowed by him”</note><l eID="gen21835" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21836"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations will not stream towards him <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer<l eID="gen21836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21837"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what’s worse⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “also”</note> the wall of Babylon has fallen. <l eID="gen21837" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9298"/><l level="1" sID="gen21838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9298"/>Come out from her midst, my people,<l eID="gen21838" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21839"/>and save each one his life<l eID="gen21839" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21840"/>from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the burning anger of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the blazing of the nose of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21840" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9299"/><l level="1" sID="gen21841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9299"/>Now <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that you are not fainthearted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “so that your heart is not timid”</note><l eID="gen21841" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21842"/>and you are afraid at the rumors<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rumor”</note> that are heard in the land—<l eID="gen21842" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21843"/>and in the year the rumor comes,<l eID="gen21843" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21844"/>and in the year after it the rumor,<l eID="gen21844" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21845"/>and violence <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the land,<l eID="gen21845" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21846"/>with ruler against ruler— <l eID="gen21846" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9300"/><l level="1" sID="gen21847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9300"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to thus”</note> look, days <transChange type="added">are</transChange> coming,<l eID="gen21847" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21848"/>and I will punish the images of Babylon,<l eID="gen21848" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21849"/>and all her land will be put to shame,<l eID="gen21849" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21850"/>and all her slain ones will fall in the midst of her. <l eID="gen21850" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9301"/><l level="1" sID="gen21851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9301"/>Then <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heaven and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in them<l eID="gen21851" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21852"/>will shout for joy over Babylon,<l eID="gen21852" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21853"/>for from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north<l eID="gen21853" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21854"/>the destroyers will come to it,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21854" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9302"/><l level="1" sID="gen21855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9302"/>Babylon must fall not only <transChange type="added">because of</transChange> the slain ones of Israel,<l eID="gen21855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21856"/>but also because of Babylon the slain ones of all the earth have fallen. <l eID="gen21856" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9303"/><l level="1" sID="gen21857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9303"/>Survivors of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword, go!<l eID="gen21857" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21858"/>You must not linger!<l eID="gen21858" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21859"/>Remember Yahweh from far <transChange type="added">away</transChange>,<l eID="gen21859" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21860"/>and let Jerusalem come to your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> <l eID="gen21860" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9304"/><l level="1" sID="gen21861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9304"/>We are ashamed,<l eID="gen21861" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21862"/>for we have heard taunts,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “taunt”</note><l eID="gen21862" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21863"/>disgrace covers our faces,<l eID="gen21863" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21864"/>for strangers have come to the holy places of the house of Yahweh. <l eID="gen21864" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9305"/><l level="1" sID="gen21865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9305"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To thus”</note> look, days are coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen21865" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21866"/>“and I will punish her images,<l eID="gen21866" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21867"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fatally wounded will sigh through all her land. <l eID="gen21867" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9306"/><l level="1" sID="gen21868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9306"/>Though Babylon goes up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the heavens,<l eID="gen21868" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21869"/>and though she fortifies the high place of her strength,<l eID="gen21869" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21870"/>from me destroyers will come to her,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen21870" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9307"/><l level="1" sID="gen21871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9307"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> sound of a cry for help from Babylon,<l eID="gen21871" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21872"/>and a great collapse from the land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans. <l eID="gen21872" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9308"/><l level="1" sID="gen21873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9308"/>For Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> devastating Babylon,<l eID="gen21873" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21874"/>and he obliterates <transChange type="added">her</transChange> loud noise<note placement="foot">Or “voice”</note> from her.<l eID="gen21874" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21875"/>Their waves roar like mighty waters,<l eID="gen21875" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21876"/>the roar of their voices<note placement="foot">Hebrew “voice”</note> resounds. <l eID="gen21876" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9309"/><l level="1" sID="gen21877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9309"/>For a destroyer <transChange type="added">is</transChange> coming against her, against Babylon,<l eID="gen21877" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21878"/>and her warriors are captured.<l eID="gen21878" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21879"/>Their bows are broken;<l eID="gen21879" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21880"/>for Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a God of recompense,<l eID="gen21880" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21881"/>certainly he will repay. <l eID="gen21881" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:57
