verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9310"/><l level="1" sID="gen21882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9310"/>“And I will make drunk her officials, and her wise men,<l eID="gen21882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21883"/>her governors, and her officials, and her warriors,<l eID="gen21883" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21884"/>and they will sleep <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting sleep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a sleep of eternity”</note><l eID="gen21884" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21885"/>and they will not wake up,”<l eID="gen21885" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21886"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> the King, Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name. <l eID="gen21886" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen21806"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9311"/><div sID="gen21887" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9311"/>Thus says Yahweh of hosts: <div eID="gen21887" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21888"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21889"/>“The broad walls of Babylon will be utterly demolished,<l eID="gen21889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21890"/>and her high gates will burn with fire,<l eID="gen21890" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21891"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples will labor <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for nothing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for enough of empty”</note><l eID="gen21891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21892"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for fire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for enough of fire”</note><l eID="gen21892" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21893"/>and they will grow weary.” <l eID="gen21893" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen21888"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9312"/><title type="x-s">The Scroll Concerning Babylon is Thrown into the Euphrates</title> <div sID="gen21894" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9312"/>The word that Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah, the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, at his going with Zedekiah, the king of Judah, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah <transChange type="added">was the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞quartermaster⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “official of the resting place”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:60
verses.text: And Jeremiah wrote all the disasters<note placement="foot">Hebrew “disaster”</note> that would come on Babylon in one scroll, all these words that are written concerning Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:61
verses.text: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “At your coming <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon, then you must see <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you read aloud all these words.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:62
verses.text: And you must say, ‘Yahweh, you yourself spoke against this place, to destroy it, so that <transChange type="added">there will</transChange> not be in it <transChange type="added">anything</transChange> living, from humankind to animals,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> for it will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting desolation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “a desolation of eternity”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:63
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> when you finish reading aloud this scroll, you must tie a stone on it, and you must throw it into the middle of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Euphrates.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:64
verses.text: And you must say, ‘Babylon will sink, and she will not rise, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> the face of the disasters<note placement="foot">Hebrew “disaster”</note> that I am bringing on her, and they will grow weary.’ ” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Thus far⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Up to here”</note> the words of Jeremiah.  <chapter eID="Jer.51"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9313"/><title type="x-s">The Fall of Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen21895" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9313"/>Zedekiah <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twenty-one years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of twenty-one year”</note> at his beginning to reign, and he reigned eleven years<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note> in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:2
verses.text: And he did evil in the eyes of Yahweh like all that Jehoiakim had done.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:3
verses.text: For because of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “nose”</note> of Yahweh this happened in Jerusalem and Judah until his casting them from his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> And Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:4
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it was”</note> in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came against Jerusalem, he and all his army. And they laid siege to it, and built siege works<note placement="foot">Literally “siege work”</note> against it all around.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:5
verses.text: So the city came <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞under siege⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “into the siege”</note> until <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eleventh year of King Zedekiah.  <div eID="gen21895" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9314"/><div sID="gen21896" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9314"/>In the fourth month, on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ninth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the month, the famine in the city became severe and there was no food for the people of the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:7
verses.text: Then the city was breached, and all <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the soldiers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the men of the battle”</note> fled and went out from the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls that are at the garden of the king, though the Chaldeans were all around the city. And they went in the direction of the Jordan Valley.<note placement="foot">Or “Arabah”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:8
verses.text: But the army of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans pursued after the king and they overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho, and all his army was scattered from him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:9
verses.text: Then they captured the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon <transChange type="added">at</transChange> Riblah in the land of Hamath, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he passed sentence on him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he spoke to him judgments”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:10
verses.text: And the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and he also slaughtered all the officials of Judah at Riblah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:11
verses.text: Then he made blind the eyes of Zedekiah, and they tied him up with bronze fetters, and the king of Babylon brought him <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon. And he put him in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞prison⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the house of the watch”</note> until the day of his death.  <div eID="gen21896" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9315"/><div sID="gen21897" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9315"/>Now in the fifth month, on the tenth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the month, which <transChange type="added">was the</transChange> nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan <transChange type="added">the</transChange> captain of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guard,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “guards”</note> who stood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the king of Babylon, entered into Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:13
verses.text: And he burned the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house”</note> of Yahweh, and the palace<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> of the king, and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house he burned with fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:14
verses.text: And all the army of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> captain of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guard<note placement="foot">Hebrew “guards”</note> broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:15
verses.text: And Nebuzaradan <transChange type="added">the</transChange> captain of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guard<note placement="foot">Hebrew “guards”</note> deported <transChange type="added">some</transChange> of the poor of the people, and the rest of the people who were left in the city, and the deserters who deserted to the king of Babylon, along with the rest of the craftsmen.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:16
verses.text: But Nebuzaradan <transChange type="added">the</transChange> captain of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guard<note placement="foot">Hebrew “guards”</note> left <transChange type="added">some</transChange> of the poor of the land <transChange type="added">to serve</transChange> as vinedressers and farmers.  <div eID="gen21897" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9316"/><div sID="gen21898" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9316"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house”</note> of Yahweh, and the kettle stands and the sea of bronze that were in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house”</note> of Yahweh, and they carried all their bronze <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:18
verses.text: And they took with them the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the sprinkling bowls, and the pans, and all the vessels of bronze which <transChange type="added">were used in temple</transChange> service.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:19
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> captain of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guard<note placement="foot">Hebrew “guards”</note> took the bowls, and the firepans, and the sprinkling bowls, and the pots, and the lampstands, and the pans, and the libation bowls, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those made of solid gold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which gold gold”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those made of solid silver⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “which silver silver”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:20
verses.text: The two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze oxen that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> under the kettle stands which King Solomon had made for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house”</note> of Yahweh—there was not a weight for the bronze of all these vessels!

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:21
verses.text: Now the pillars, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> height of one pillar <transChange type="added">was</transChange> eighteen cubits,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cubit”</note> and a thread of twelve cubits<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cubit”</note> surrounded it, and its thickness <transChange type="added">was</transChange> four fingers, hollowed out.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:22
verses.text: And a capital upon it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> bronze and the height of the one capital <transChange type="added">was</transChange> five cubits, and latticework and pomegranates <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on the capital on all sides, all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> bronze. And like these <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the second pillar with pomegranates.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:23
verses.text: And there were ninety-six pomegranates <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the sides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “breath”</note> all the pomegranates on the latticework on all sides <transChange type="added">were</transChange> a hundred.  <div eID="gen21898" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9317"/><div sID="gen21899" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9317"/>Then <transChange type="added">the</transChange> captain of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guard<note placement="foot">Hebrew “guards”</note> took Seraiah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the chief priest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the priest of the head”</note> and Zephaniah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the second priest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the priest of the second”</note> and three keepers of the threshold.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:25
verses.text: And from the city he took one high official who was chief officer over <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the soldiers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the men of the battle”</note> and seven men of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the king’s advisors⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “those who see the face of the king”</note> who were found in the city, and the secretary of the commander of the army who levied for military service the people of the land, and sixty men<note placement="foot">Hebrew “man”</note> of the people of the land who were found in the midst of the city.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:26
verses.text: Then Nebuzaradan <transChange type="added">the</transChange> captain of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guard<note placement="foot">Hebrew “guards”</note> took them and brought them to the king of Babylon <transChange type="added">at</transChange> Riblah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:27
verses.text: And the king of Babylon struck them down and killed them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah left from its land.  <div eID="gen21899" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9318"/><div sID="gen21900" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9318"/>This <transChange type="added">is the number of</transChange> the people whom Nebuchadnezzar deported: in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Judeans;

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:29
verses.text: in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, eight hundred and thirty-two persons<note placement="foot">Hebrew “person”</note> from Jerusalem;

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:30
verses.text: in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> captain of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guard,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “guards”</note> deported seven hundred and forty-five Judean persons;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “person”</note> there were four thousand six hundred persons<note placement="foot">Hebrew “person”</note> in all.  <div eID="gen21900" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9319"/><title type="x-s">An Allowance for Jehoiachin</title> <div sID="gen21901" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9319"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it was”</note> in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin, the king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evil-merodach, the king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin, the king of Judah, and brought him out from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞prison⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of the imprisonment”</note>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:32
verses.text: Then he spoke with him kindly and gave his seat above the seats<note placement="foot">Hebrew “seat”</note> of the kings who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him in Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:33
verses.text: So he changed the garments of his imprisonment and he ate food <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of him”</note> continually all the days of his life.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:34
verses.text: And his allowance, a continual allowance was given to him by the king of Babylon <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on a daily basis⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a matter of a day in its day”</note> all the days of his life up to the day of his death.  <chapter eID="Jer.52"/> <div eID="gen21901" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen19174" osisID="Jer" type="book"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9320"/><title type="x-s">The Desolate City</title> <div sID="gen21903" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen21903" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21904"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9320"/>How desolate the city sits<l eID="gen21905" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21906"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> was full of people!<l eID="gen21906" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21907"/>She has become like a widow,<l eID="gen21907" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21908"/><transChange type="added">once</transChange> great among the nations!<l eID="gen21908" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21909"/>Like a woman of nobility in the provinces,<l eID="gen21909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21910"/>she has become a forced laborer. <l eID="gen21910" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9321"/><l level="1" sID="gen21911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9321"/>She weeps bitterly in the night,<l eID="gen21911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21912"/>her tears <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on her cheeks;<l eID="gen21912" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21913"/>she has no comforter<l eID="gen21913" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21914"/>among all her lovers.<l eID="gen21914" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21915"/>All her friends have been unfaithful to her;<l eID="gen21915" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21916"/>they have become her enemies. <l eID="gen21916" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9322"/><l level="1" sID="gen21917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9322"/>Judah has gone into exile with misery<l eID="gen21917" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21918"/>and under hard servitude;<l eID="gen21918" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21919"/>she lives among the nations,<l eID="gen21919" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21920"/>she has not found a resting place;<l eID="gen21920" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21921"/>all her pursuers have overtaken her<l eID="gen21921" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21922"/>amidst <transChange type="added">her</transChange> distress. <l eID="gen21922" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9323"/><l level="1" sID="gen21923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9323"/>The roads of Zion <transChange type="added">are</transChange> mourning<l eID="gen21923" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21924"/>because no one comes to the festival.<l eID="gen21924" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21925"/>All her gates <transChange type="added">are</transChange> desolate,<l eID="gen21925" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21926"/>her priests groan;<l eID="gen21926" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21927"/>her young women <transChange type="added">are</transChange> worried,<l eID="gen21927" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21928"/>and she herself suffers bitterly. <l eID="gen21928" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9324"/><l level="1" sID="gen21929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9324"/>Her foes have become <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞master⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note><l eID="gen21929" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21930"/>her enemies are at ease;<l eID="gen21930" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21931"/>Yahweh has made her suffer<l eID="gen21931" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21932"/>because of the greatness of her transgressions.<l eID="gen21932" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21933"/>Her children have gone away,<l eID="gen21933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21934"/>captive before the foe. <l eID="gen21934" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9325"/><l level="1" sID="gen21935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9325"/>All her majesty has gone away<l eID="gen21935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21936"/>from the daughter of Zion;<l eID="gen21936" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21937"/>her princes have become like young stags<l eID="gen21937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21938"/>that have not found pasture;<l eID="gen21938" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21939"/>they have gone away without strength,<l eID="gen21939" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21940"/>before the pursuer. <l eID="gen21940" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9326"/><l level="1" sID="gen21941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9326"/>Jerusalem remembers<l eID="gen21941" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21942"/>the days of her misery and wanderings,<l eID="gen21942" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21943"/>all her treasures<l eID="gen21943" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21944"/>that were from the days of long ago.<l eID="gen21944" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21945"/>When her people fell into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of the enemy,<l eID="gen21945" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21946"/>there was no one helping her;<l eID="gen21946" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21947"/>the enemies saw her, they mocked<l eID="gen21947" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21948"/>at her destruction. <l eID="gen21948" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9327"/><l level="1" sID="gen21949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9327"/>Jerusalem sinned grievously,<l eID="gen21949" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21950"/>thus she became an objection of derision;<l eID="gen21950" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21951"/>all those who honored her despise her<l eID="gen21951" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21952"/>because they have seen her nakedness.<l eID="gen21952" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21953"/>She herself groans<l eID="gen21953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21954"/>and turns away. <l eID="gen21954" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9328"/><l level="1" sID="gen21955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9328"/>Her uncleanness <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in her skirts;<l eID="gen21955" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21956"/>she did not remember her future,<l eID="gen21956" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21957"/>she has descended beyond understanding,<l eID="gen21957" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21958"/>there is no comforter for her.<l eID="gen21958" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21959"/>See, O Yahweh, my persecution!<l eID="gen21959" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21960"/><transChange type="added">My</transChange> enemy has been made great! <l eID="gen21960" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9329"/><l level="1" sID="gen21961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9329"/>The enemy has stretched out his hand<l eID="gen21961" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21962"/>over all her treasures;<l eID="gen21962" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21963"/>for she has seen the nations,<l eID="gen21963" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21964"/>they entered her sanctuary,<l eID="gen21964" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21965"/>those whom you commanded not to enter<l eID="gen21965" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21966"/>in your assembly. <l eID="gen21966" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9330"/><l level="1" sID="gen21967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9330"/>All her people groan,<l eID="gen21967" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21968"/>they are searching for bread.<l eID="gen21968" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21969"/>They give their treasures for food,<l eID="gen21969" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21970"/>to bring back life.<l eID="gen21970" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21971"/>See, O Yahweh, and look,<l eID="gen21971" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21972"/><transChange type="added">how</transChange> I am despised. <l eID="gen21972" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9331"/><l level="1" sID="gen21973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9331"/>Is it nothing to you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all who pass by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “all who cross a road”</note><l eID="gen21973" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21974"/>Look and see<l eID="gen21974" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21975"/>if there is sorrow like my sorrow,<note placement="foot">Or “pain like my pain”</note><l eID="gen21975" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21976"/>which was dealt to me,<l eID="gen21976" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21977"/>which Yahweh inflicted<l eID="gen21977" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21978"/>on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞day of his wrath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on the day of the blaze of his nose”</note> <l eID="gen21978" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9332"/><l level="1" sID="gen21979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9332"/>From heaven he sent fire,<l eID="gen21979" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21980"/>into my bones he let it descend.<l eID="gen21980" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21981"/>He spread out a net for my feet;<l eID="gen21981" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21982"/>he turned me back,<l eID="gen21982" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21983"/>he gave me devastation,<l eID="gen21983" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21984"/>fainting all day. <l eID="gen21984" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9333"/><l level="1" sID="gen21985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9333"/>My rebellion was bound <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a yoke,<l eID="gen21985" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21986"/>with his hand it was fastened together;<l eID="gen21986" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21987"/>it was put on my neck<l eID="gen21987" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21988"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> caused my strength to fail.<l eID="gen21988" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21989"/>The Lord gave me into the hands<l eID="gen21989" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21990"/><transChange type="added">of those whom</transChange> I cannot withstand. <l eID="gen21990" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9334"/><l level="1" sID="gen21991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9334"/>The Lord has rejected<l eID="gen21991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21992"/>all my mighty ones in my midst.<l eID="gen21992" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21993"/>He called an assembly against me,<l eID="gen21993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21994"/>to crush my young men;<l eID="gen21994" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21995"/><transChange type="added">like in</transChange> a wine press,<l eID="gen21995" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21996"/>the Lord has trodden <transChange type="added">on</transChange><l eID="gen21996" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21997"/>the virgin daughter of Judah. <l eID="gen21997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9335"/><l level="1" sID="gen21998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9335"/>For these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, I am weeping,<l eID="gen21998" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21999"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my eyes flow with tears⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “my eye my eye is going down with water”</note><l eID="gen21999" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22000"/>because a comforter is far from me,<l eID="gen22000" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22001"/>one to restore my life.<l eID="gen22001" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22002"/>My sons are desolate<l eID="gen22002" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22003"/>because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy has prevailed. <l eID="gen22003" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9336"/><l level="1" sID="gen22004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9336"/>Zion stretches out her hands;<l eID="gen22004" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22005"/>there is no one to comfort her.<l eID="gen22005" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22006"/>Yahweh has commanded against Jacob,<l eID="gen22006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22007"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> those surrounding him<note placement="foot">NRSV translates “his neighbors”</note> <transChange type="added">should be</transChange> his enemies;<l eID="gen22007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22008"/>Jerusalem has become<l eID="gen22008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22009"/>a defilement among them. <l eID="gen22009" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9337"/><l level="1" sID="gen22010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9337"/>Yahweh is righteous;<l eID="gen22010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22011"/>I have rebelled <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his word⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his mouth”</note><l eID="gen22011" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22012"/>Please hear, all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations,<l eID="gen22012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22013"/>And see my pain;<l eID="gen22013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22014"/>My young women<note placement="foot">Or “virgins”</note> and young men<l eID="gen22014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22015"/>went into captivity. <l eID="gen22015" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9338"/><l level="1" sID="gen22016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9338"/>I have called to my lovers,<l eID="gen22016" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22017"/>they themselves deceived me;<l eID="gen22017" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22018"/>my priests and elders perished in the city<l eID="gen22018" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22019"/>when they sought food for themselves<l eID="gen22019" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen22020"/>to revive their life.<note placement="foot">Or “their soul”</note> <l eID="gen22020" level="3"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9339"/><l level="1" sID="gen22021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9339"/>See, O Yahweh, that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am in distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “there is distress for me”</note><l eID="gen22021" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22022"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my stomach⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “inner parts”</note> is in torment,<l eID="gen22022" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22023"/>my heart has turned inside me<l eID="gen22023" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22024"/>because I have certainly rebelled.<l eID="gen22024" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22025"/>From outside a sword brings bereavement,<l eID="gen22025" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22026"/>inside the house <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> like death. <l eID="gen22026" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9340"/><l level="1" sID="gen22027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9340"/>They hear that I was groaning;<l eID="gen22027" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22028"/><transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no comforter for me.<l eID="gen22028" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22029"/>All my enemies have heard my misery,<l eID="gen22029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22030"/>they are pleased that you have done it.<l eID="gen22030" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22031"/>Bring <transChange type="added">that</transChange> day that you have proclaimed,<note placement="foot">Or “you have called”</note><l eID="gen22031" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22032"/>And let them be like me. <l eID="gen22032" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9341"/><l level="1" sID="gen22033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9341"/>Let all their evil come before you;<l eID="gen22033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22034"/>and deal with them<l eID="gen22034" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22035"/>just as you have dealt with me<l eID="gen22035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22036"/>because of all my crimes;<l eID="gen22036" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22037"/>for my groaning is much and my heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> faint. <l eID="gen22037" level="1"/><lg eID="gen21904"/> <chapter eID="Lam.1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9342"/><title type="x-s">The Lord is Angry</title> <div sID="gen22038" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen22038" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22039"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9342"/>How, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in his anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in his nose”</note><l eID="gen22040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22041"/>the Lord has covered the daughter of Zion in a cloud!<l eID="gen22041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22042"/>He has thrown down from heavens <transChange type="added">to</transChange> earth<l eID="gen22042" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22043"/>the splendor of Israel,<l eID="gen22043" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22044"/>and he has not remembered his footstool<l eID="gen22044" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22045"/>in the day of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his nose”</note> <l eID="gen22045" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9343"/><l level="1" sID="gen22046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9343"/>The Lord has devoured; he has not shown mercy<l eID="gen22046" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22047"/>to all the dwellings of Jacob;<l eID="gen22047" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22048"/>he has broken down in his wrath<l eID="gen22048" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22049"/>the fortifications of the daughter of Judah;<l eID="gen22049" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22050"/>he has leveled to the ground, he has dishonored<l eID="gen22050" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22051"/>the kingdom and its commanders.<note placement="foot">Or “her commanders”</note> <l eID="gen22051" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9344"/><l level="1" sID="gen22052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9344"/>He has cut down <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in fierce anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in a fierce nose”</note><l eID="gen22052" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22053"/>all the might of Israel;<l eID="gen22053" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22054"/>he has withdrawn his right hand<l eID="gen22054" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22055"/>from the faces of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy,<l eID="gen22055" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22056"/>and he has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire,<l eID="gen22056" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22057"/>it has consumed all around. <l eID="gen22057" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9345"/><l level="1" sID="gen22058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9345"/>He has bent his bow like an enemy;<l eID="gen22058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22059"/>he has set his right hand<l eID="gen22059" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22060"/>like a foe, and he has slain<l eID="gen22060" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22061"/>all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> treasures of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eye;<note placement="foot">NRSV translates “all in whom we took pride”</note><l eID="gen22061" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22062"/>in the tent of the daughter of Zion,<l eID="gen22062" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22063"/>he has poured out his anger like fire. <l eID="gen22063" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9346"/><l level="1" sID="gen22064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9346"/>The Lord has become like an enemy;<l eID="gen22064" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22065"/>he has destroyed Israel;<l eID="gen22065" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22066"/>he has destroyed all its citadel fortresses;<note placement="foot">Or “her citadel fortresses”</note><l eID="gen22066" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22067"/>he has ruined all its fortifications<l eID="gen22067" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22068"/>and multiplied lamentation and mourning<l eID="gen22068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22069"/>in the daughter of Judah. <l eID="gen22069" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9347"/><l level="1" sID="gen22070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9347"/>He has broken down <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his dwelling⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his booth”; or “his tabernacle”</note> place like the garden;<l eID="gen22070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22071"/>he has ruined his appointed feasts;<l eID="gen22071" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22072"/>Yahweh has made <transChange type="added">them</transChange> forget in Zion<l eID="gen22072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22073"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞festival⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “appointed time”</note> and Sabbath,<l eID="gen22073" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22074"/>and he has despised in his anger<l eID="gen22074" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22075"/>king and priest. <l eID="gen22075" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9348"/><l level="1" sID="gen22076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9348"/>The Lord has rejected his altar;<l eID="gen22076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22077"/>he has rejected his sanctuary;<l eID="gen22077" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22078"/>he has delivered into the hands of the enemy<l eID="gen22078" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22079"/>the walls of its citadel fortresses.<note placement="foot">Or “her citadel fortress”</note><l eID="gen22079" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22080"/>They have cried out in the house of Yahweh<l eID="gen22080" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22081"/>like a day of an appointed feast. <l eID="gen22081" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9349"/><l level="1" sID="gen22082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9349"/>Yahweh has planned to destroy<l eID="gen22082" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22083"/>the wall of the daughter of Zion.<l eID="gen22083" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22084"/>He measured <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a line; he has not restrained<l eID="gen22084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22085"/>his hand from destroying;<l eID="gen22085" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22086"/>he caused rampart and wall to mourn;<l eID="gen22086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22087"/>together they have languished away. <l eID="gen22087" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9350"/><l level="1" sID="gen22088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9350"/>Her gates have sunk into the earth;<l eID="gen22088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22089"/>he has ruined and broken her bars,<l eID="gen22089" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22090"/>her kings and its princes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> among the nations;<l eID="gen22090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22091"/>there is no more law.<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note><l eID="gen22091" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22092"/>Also, her prophets have not found<l eID="gen22092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22093"/>a revelation from Yahweh. <l eID="gen22093" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9351"/><l level="1" sID="gen22094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9351"/>They sit on the ground,<l eID="gen22094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22095"/>the elders of the daughter of Zion are silent.<l eID="gen22095" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22096"/>They cast dust on their head,<l eID="gen22096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22097"/>they have put on sackcloth;<l eID="gen22097" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22098"/>the young women of Jerusalem<l eID="gen22098" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22099"/>have bowed their head down to the ground. <l eID="gen22099" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9352"/><l level="1" sID="gen22100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9352"/>My eyes have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spent all their tears⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “finished with the weeping”</note><l eID="gen22100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22101"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my stomach⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my inward parts”</note> is in torment,<l eID="gen22101" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22102"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my liver”</note> is poured out on the earth<l eID="gen22102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22103"/>because of the destruction of the daughter of my people,<l eID="gen22103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22104"/>because child and babe faint<l eID="gen22104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22105"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> public squares of a city. <l eID="gen22105" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9353"/><l level="1" sID="gen22106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9353"/>To their mothers they say,<l eID="gen22106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22107"/>“Where is the bread and wine?”<l eID="gen22107" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22108"/>as they faint like the wounded<l eID="gen22108" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22109"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> public squares of a city,<l eID="gen22109" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22110"/>as their life is being poured out<l eID="gen22110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22111"/>onto the bosom of their mothers. <l eID="gen22111" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9354"/><l level="1" sID="gen22112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9354"/>What can I say for you? What can I compare to you,<l eID="gen22112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22113"/>O daughter of Jerusalem?<l eID="gen22113" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22114"/>To what can I liken you so that I can comfort you,<l eID="gen22114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22115"/>O virgin daughter of Zion?<l eID="gen22115" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22116"/>For your destruction <transChange type="added">is</transChange> as vast as the sea;<l eID="gen22116" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22117"/>who can heal you? <l eID="gen22117" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9355"/><l level="1" sID="gen22118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9355"/>Your prophets had a vision for you,<l eID="gen22118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22119"/>false and worthless;<l eID="gen22119" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22120"/>they have not exposed your sin,<l eID="gen22120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22121"/>to restore your fortune;<l eID="gen22121" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22122"/>they have seen oracles for you,<l eID="gen22122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22123"/>false and misleading. <l eID="gen22123" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9356"/><l level="1" sID="gen22124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9356"/>They clap hands over you,<l eID="gen22124" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22125"/>all who pass along the way;<l eID="gen22125" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22126"/>they hiss and they shake their head,<l eID="gen22126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22127"/>at the daughter of Jerusalem.<l eID="gen22127" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22128"/>Is this the city of which it is said,<l eID="gen22128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22129"/>“A perfection of beauty, a joy for all the earth?” <l eID="gen22129" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9357"/><l level="1" sID="gen22130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9357"/>They have opened their mouths against you,<l eID="gen22130" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22131"/>all your enemies.<l eID="gen22131" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22132"/>They hiss and gnash a tooth,<l eID="gen22132" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22133"/>and they say, “We have destroyed <transChange type="added">her</transChange>!<l eID="gen22133" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22134"/>Surely this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the day we have hoped for;<l eID="gen22134" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22135"/>we have found <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, we have seen <transChange type="added">it</transChange>!” <l eID="gen22135" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9358"/><l level="1" sID="gen22136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9358"/>Yahweh has done what he has planned;<l eID="gen22136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22137"/>he has fulfilled his promise<l eID="gen22137" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22138"/>that he ordained from the days of old;<l eID="gen22138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22139"/>he has demolished and not shown mercy;<l eID="gen22139" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22140"/>he has made an enemy rejoice over you,<l eID="gen22140" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22141"/>he has exalted the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞might⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “horn”</note> of your foes. <l eID="gen22141" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9359"/><l level="1" sID="gen22142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9359"/>Their heart cried to the Lord,<l eID="gen22142" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22143"/>“O wall of the daughter of Zion,<l eID="gen22143" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22144"/>let tears stream down like a river;<l eID="gen22144" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22145"/>day and night,<l eID="gen22145" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22146"/>do not give yourself relief,<l eID="gen22146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22147"/>do not give your eyes rest. <l eID="gen22147" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9360"/><l level="1" sID="gen22148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9360"/>“Arise, cry out in the night,<l eID="gen22148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22149"/>at the beginning of the night watches;<l eID="gen22149" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22150"/>pour out your heart like water,<l eID="gen22150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22151"/>before the face of the Lord.<l eID="gen22151" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22152"/>Lift to him your hands,<l eID="gen22152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22153"/>for the life of your children,<l eID="gen22153" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22154"/>who faint in starvation,<l eID="gen22154" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22155"/>at the head of all streets.” <l eID="gen22155" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9361"/><l level="1" sID="gen22156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9361"/>See, Yahweh, and take note!<l eID="gen22156" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22157"/>With whom have you dealt thus?<l eID="gen22157" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22158"/>Should women eat their young<l eID="gen22158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22159"/>children of tender care?<l eID="gen22159" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22160"/>Should priest and prophet be slain<l eID="gen22160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22161"/>in the sanctuary of the Lord? <l eID="gen22161" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9362"/><l level="1" sID="gen22162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9362"/>They lie in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> soil of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> streets,<l eID="gen22162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22163"/>young and old;<l eID="gen22163" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22164"/>my young women<note placement="foot">Or “my virgins”</note> and young men,<l eID="gen22164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22165"/>they have fallen by the sword;<l eID="gen22165" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22166"/>you have slain on the day of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “your nose”</note><l eID="gen22166" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22167"/>you have slaughtered and not shown mercy. <l eID="gen22167" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9363"/><l level="1" sID="gen22168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9363"/>You have summoned my horror from all around,<l eID="gen22168" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22169"/>as if for a feast day;<l eID="gen22169" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22170"/>no one on the day of Yahweh’s anger<l eID="gen22170" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22171"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> a fugitive and a survivor;<l eID="gen22171" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22172"/>whoever I have cared for and reared,<l eID="gen22172" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22173"/>my enemy has destroyed. <l eID="gen22173" level="2"/><lg eID="gen22039"/> <chapter eID="Lam.2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9364"/><title type="x-s">Israel’s Affliction</title> <div sID="gen22174" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen22174" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22175"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9364"/>I am a man who has seen misery,<l eID="gen22176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22177"/>under the rod of his wrath. <l eID="gen22177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9365"/><l level="1" sID="gen22178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9365"/>He has driven me along, he brought<l eID="gen22178" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22179"/>darkness and not light. <l eID="gen22179" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9366"/><l level="1" sID="gen22180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9366"/>Surely he has turned his hand against me,<l eID="gen22180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22181"/>all day long. <l eID="gen22181" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9367"/><l level="1" sID="gen22182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9367"/>He has worn out my flesh and skin,<l eID="gen22182" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22183"/>he has broken my bones. <l eID="gen22183" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9368"/><l level="1" sID="gen22184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9368"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He has besieged⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he has built against”</note> and engulfed me<l eID="gen22184" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22185"/>with bitterness and hardship. <l eID="gen22185" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9369"/><l level="1" sID="gen22186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9369"/>In darkness he has let me dwell<l eID="gen22186" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22187"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dead of long ago. <l eID="gen22187" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9370"/><l level="1" sID="gen22188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9370"/>He has built a wall around me, I cannot go out;<l eID="gen22188" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22189"/>he has made my bronze fetters heavy. <l eID="gen22189" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9371"/><l level="1" sID="gen22190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9371"/>Though I cry out for help,<l eID="gen22190" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22191"/>he shuts out my prayers. <l eID="gen22191" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9372"/><l level="1" sID="gen22192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9372"/>He has blocked my ways with dressed stones;<l eID="gen22192" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22193"/>he has made my paths crooked. <l eID="gen22193" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9373"/><l level="1" sID="gen22194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9373"/>To me he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a bear lying in wait,<l eID="gen22194" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22195"/>a lion in hiding. <l eID="gen22195" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9374"/><l level="1" sID="gen22196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9374"/>He has forsaken my way and torn me to pieces;<l eID="gen22196" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22197"/>he has caused me desolation. <l eID="gen22197" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9375"/><l level="1" sID="gen22198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9375"/>He has bent his bow and set me<l eID="gen22198" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22199"/>as the target for the arrow. <l eID="gen22199" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9376"/><l level="1" sID="gen22200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9376"/>He shot <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the arrows of his quiver⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the offspring of his arrow quiver”</note><l eID="gen22200" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22201"/>into my kidneys. <l eID="gen22201" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9377"/><l level="1" sID="gen22202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9377"/>I have become a laughingstock for all the people,<l eID="gen22202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22203"/>their mocking song all day long. <l eID="gen22203" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9378"/><l level="1" sID="gen22204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9378"/>He has filled me with bitterness,<l eID="gen22204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22205"/>he has drenched me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> wormwood. <l eID="gen22205" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9379"/><l level="1" sID="gen22206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9379"/>He has broken my teeth on grit,<l eID="gen22206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22207"/>he has trampled me down in ash. <l eID="gen22207" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9380"/><l level="1" sID="gen22208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9380"/>My life has been removed from peace,<l eID="gen22208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22209"/>I have forgotten goodness. <l eID="gen22209" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9381"/><l level="1" sID="gen22210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9381"/>And I have said, “My glory is ruined,<l eID="gen22210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22211"/>my expectation from Yahweh.” <l eID="gen22211" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9382"/><l level="1" sID="gen22212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9382"/>Remember my misery and bitterness,<l eID="gen22212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22213"/>the wormwood<note placement="foot">Or “the bitter substance”</note> and venom! <l eID="gen22213" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9383"/><l level="1" sID="gen22214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9383"/>Surely my soul remembers<l eID="gen22214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22215"/>and bows down within me. <l eID="gen22215" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9384"/><l level="1" sID="gen22216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9384"/>This <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have reminded myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I have brought back to my heart”</note><l eID="gen22216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22217"/>therefore I will hope. <l eID="gen22217" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9385"/><l level="1" sID="gen22218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9385"/>The loyal love of Yahweh does not cease;<l eID="gen22218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22219"/>his compassions do not come to an end. <l eID="gen22219" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9386"/><l level="1" sID="gen22220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9386"/><transChange type="added">They</transChange> are new in the morning,<l eID="gen22220" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22221"/>great is your faithfulness. <l eID="gen22221" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9387"/><l level="1" sID="gen22222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9387"/>“Yahweh is my portion,”<l eID="gen22222" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22223"/>says my soul,<l eID="gen22223" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen22224"/>“Thus I will hope on him.” <l eID="gen22224" level="3"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9388"/><l level="1" sID="gen22225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9388"/>Yahweh is good to those who wait on him,<l eID="gen22225" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22226"/>to the person that seeks him. <l eID="gen22226" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9389"/><l level="1" sID="gen22227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9389"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> good to wait in silence<l eID="gen22227" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22228"/>for the salvation of Yahweh. <l eID="gen22228" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9390"/><l level="1" sID="gen22229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9390"/><transChange type="added">It is</transChange> good for a man who carries<l eID="gen22229" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22230"/>the yoke of his childhood. <l eID="gen22230" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9391"/><l level="1" sID="gen22231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9391"/>Let him sit alone and be silent<l eID="gen22231" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22232"/>when he<note placement="foot">Yahweh</note> has laid it on him. <l eID="gen22232" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9392"/><l level="1" sID="gen22233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9392"/>Let <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞him put⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “him give”</note> his mouth in the dust;<l eID="gen22233" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22234"/>perhaps there is hope. <l eID="gen22234" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9393"/><l level="1" sID="gen22235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9393"/>Let him give a cheek to his smiter,<l eID="gen22235" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22236"/>let him be filled with disgrace. <l eID="gen22236" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9394"/><l level="1" sID="gen22237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9394"/>For the Lord will not reject<l eID="gen22237" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22238"/>forever. <l eID="gen22238" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9395"/><l level="1" sID="gen22239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9395"/>For even though he causes grief he has compassion<l eID="gen22239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22240"/>according to the greatness of his royal love. <l eID="gen22240" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9396"/><l level="1" sID="gen22241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9396"/>He does not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞afflict willingly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “afflict from the heart”</note><l eID="gen22241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22242"/>or grieve <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the sons of men”</note> <l eID="gen22242" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9397"/><l level="1" sID="gen22243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9397"/>To crush under his feet<l eID="gen22243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22244"/>all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prisoners of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth; <l eID="gen22244" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9398"/><l level="1" sID="gen22245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9398"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to deprive one of justice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to turn aside the judgment of a man”</note><l eID="gen22245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22246"/>before the face of the Most High; <l eID="gen22246" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9399"/><l level="1" sID="gen22247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9399"/>to subvert a person in a legal dispute<l eID="gen22247" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22248"/>—the Lord has not found delight <transChange type="added">in these things</transChange>. <l eID="gen22248" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9400"/><l level="1" sID="gen22249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9400"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Who can speak⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Who is this that speaks”</note> and it will happen<l eID="gen22249" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22250"/><transChange type="added">if</transChange> the Lord has not commanded <transChange type="added">it</transChange>? <l eID="gen22250" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9401"/><l level="1" sID="gen22251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9401"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> it not from the mouth of the Most High<l eID="gen22251" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22252"/><transChange type="added">that</transChange> disaster and good will come? <l eID="gen22252" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9402"/><l level="1" sID="gen22253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9402"/>Why should any living person complain<l eID="gen22253" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22254"/>about his sin? <l eID="gen22254" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9403"/><l level="1" sID="gen22255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9403"/>Let us test and examine our ways;<l eID="gen22255" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22256"/>let us return to Yahweh. <l eID="gen22256" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9404"/><l level="1" sID="gen22257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9404"/>Let us lift up our hearts with our hands<l eID="gen22257" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22258"/>to God in the heavens. <l eID="gen22258" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9405"/><l level="1" sID="gen22259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9405"/>We ourselves have transgressed and rebelled,<l eID="gen22259" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22260"/>you have not forgiven. <l eID="gen22260" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9406"/><l level="1" sID="gen22261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9406"/>You have covered <transChange type="added">yourself</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the nose”</note> and pursued us,<l eID="gen22261" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22262"/>you have slain and not shown mercy. <l eID="gen22262" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9407"/><l level="1" sID="gen22263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9407"/>You have covered yourself in a cloud<l eID="gen22263" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22264"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that prayer cannot pass through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from a passing prayer”</note> <l eID="gen22264" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9408"/><l level="1" sID="gen22265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9408"/>You have made us scum and refuse<l eID="gen22265" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22266"/>in the midst of the nations. <l eID="gen22266" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9409"/><l level="1" sID="gen22267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9409"/>All our enemies<l eID="gen22267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22268"/>have opened their mouth against us. <l eID="gen22268" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9410"/><l level="1" sID="gen22269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9410"/>Fear and a pit have come upon us,<l eID="gen22269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22270"/>desolation and destruction. <l eID="gen22270" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9411"/><l level="1" sID="gen22271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9411"/>Channels of water run down my eyes<l eID="gen22271" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22272"/>because of the destruction of the daughter of my people. <l eID="gen22272" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9412"/><l level="1" sID="gen22273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9412"/>My eyes have poured down unceasingly<l eID="gen22273" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22274"/>without respite, <l eID="gen22274" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9413"/><l level="1" sID="gen22275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9413"/>until Yahweh looks down<l eID="gen22275" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22276"/>and sees from heaven. <l eID="gen22276" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9414"/><l level="1" sID="gen22277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9414"/>My eyes inflict my soul<l eID="gen22277" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22278"/>because of all the daughters of my city. <l eID="gen22278" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9415"/><l level="1" sID="gen22279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9415"/>My enemies hunt me without cause,<l eID="gen22279" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22280"/>like a bird. <l eID="gen22280" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9416"/><l level="1" sID="gen22281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9416"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They have silenced me in a pit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they have put to silence my life in a pit”</note><l eID="gen22281" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22282"/>they have thrown a stone at me. <l eID="gen22282" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9417"/><l level="1" sID="gen22283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9417"/>Water has flown over my head,<l eID="gen22283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22284"/>I said, “I am cut off.” <l eID="gen22284" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9418"/><l level="1" sID="gen22285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9418"/>I have called your name, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen22285" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22286"/>from the depths of the pit. <l eID="gen22286" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9419"/><l level="1" sID="gen22287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9419"/>You have heard my cry, “Do not shut your ear<l eID="gen22287" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22288"/>to my cry for help, for my relief!” <l eID="gen22288" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9420"/><l level="1" sID="gen22289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9420"/>You came near on a day <transChange type="added">when</transChange> I called you,<l eID="gen22289" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22290"/>you said, “Do not fear!” <l eID="gen22290" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9421"/><l level="1" sID="gen22291"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9421"/>O Lord, you have pleaded for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my cause⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the legal disputes of my soul”</note><l eID="gen22291" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22292"/>you have redeemed my life. <l eID="gen22292" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9422"/><l level="1" sID="gen22293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9422"/>You have seen my injustice, O Yahweh;<l eID="gen22293" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22294"/>judge my case. <l eID="gen22294" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9423"/><l level="1" sID="gen22295"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9423"/>You have seen all their vengeance,<l eID="gen22295" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22296"/>all there plans against me. <l eID="gen22296" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9424"/><l level="1" sID="gen22297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9424"/>You have heard their disgrace, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen22297" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22298"/>all their plans against me. <l eID="gen22298" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9425"/><l level="1" sID="gen22299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9425"/>The lips and meditation of my assailants<l eID="gen22299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22300"/><transChange type="added">are</transChange> against me all day long. <l eID="gen22300" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9426"/><l level="1" sID="gen22301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9426"/>Look at their sitting and their standing,<l eID="gen22301" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22302"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> their mocking song. <l eID="gen22302" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:64
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9427"/><l level="1" sID="gen22303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9427"/>Return to them what is deserved, O Yahweh,<l eID="gen22303" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22304"/>according to the work of their hands. <l eID="gen22304" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9428"/><l level="1" sID="gen22305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9428"/>Give them a stubborn heart;<l eID="gen22305" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22306"/>curse them! <l eID="gen22306" level="2"/>
