verses.name: Lamentations 3:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9429"/><l level="1" sID="gen22307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9429"/>Pursue them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in nose”</note> and destroy them<l eID="gen22307" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22308"/>from under the heavens of Yahweh. <l eID="gen22308" level="2"/><lg eID="gen22175"/> <chapter eID="Lam.3"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9430"/><title type="x-s">Zion Is Punished</title> <div sID="gen22309" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen22309" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22310"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9430"/>How <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gold has grown dim,<l eID="gen22311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22312"/>the pure gold has changed.<l eID="gen22312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22313"/>The stones of holiness are scattered<l eID="gen22313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22314"/>at the head of every street. <l eID="gen22314" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9431"/><l level="1" sID="gen22315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9431"/>The precious sons of Zion<l eID="gen22315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22316"/>weighed against fine gold,<l eID="gen22316" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22317"/>how they are thought of as earthen vessels of clay,<l eID="gen22317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22318"/>the work of the potter’s hands. <l eID="gen22318" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9432"/><l level="1" sID="gen22319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9432"/>Even the jackal bears the beast<l eID="gen22319" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22320"/>and nurses their cubs;<l eID="gen22320" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22321"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> the daughter of my people has become ruthless,<l eID="gen22321" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22322"/>like ostriches in the wilderness. <l eID="gen22322" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9433"/><l level="1" sID="gen22323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9433"/>The tongue of the nursling cleaves<l eID="gen22323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22324"/>to its palate in thirst.<l eID="gen22324" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22325"/>Children beg <transChange type="added">for</transChange> food,<l eID="gen22325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22326"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no one lays it out before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “nothing spreads to them”</note> <l eID="gen22326" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9434"/><l level="1" sID="gen22327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9434"/>The ones who eat delicacies,<l eID="gen22327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22328"/>they are ruined in the streets;<l eID="gen22328" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22329"/>the ones nurtured in purple<l eID="gen22329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22330"/>lie <transChange type="added">on</transChange> piles of trash. <l eID="gen22330" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9435"/><l level="1" sID="gen22331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9435"/>The iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater<l eID="gen22331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22332"/>than the sin of Sodom;<l eID="gen22332" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22333"/>it was overthrown in a moment<l eID="gen22333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22334"/>and no hands were laid on her. <l eID="gen22334" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9436"/><l level="1" sID="gen22335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9436"/>Her princes were purer than snow,<l eID="gen22335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22336"/>they were whiter than milk;<l eID="gen22336" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22337"/><transChange type="added">their</transChange> bodies were more ruddy than rubies,<l eID="gen22337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22338"/>sapphire their appearance. <l eID="gen22338" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9437"/><l level="1" sID="gen22339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9437"/><transChange type="added">Now</transChange> their appearance is blacker than soot,<l eID="gen22339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22340"/>they are not recognized in the streets;<l eID="gen22340" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22341"/>their skin has shriveled on their bones,<l eID="gen22341" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22342"/>it has become dry like wood. <l eID="gen22342" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9438"/><l level="1" sID="gen22343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9438"/>Happier were <transChange type="added">the</transChange> victims of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword<l eID="gen22343" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22344"/>than the victims of famine;<l eID="gen22344" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22345"/>they have pined away, very hungry<l eID="gen22345" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22346"/>for the crops of my field. <l eID="gen22346" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9439"/><l level="1" sID="gen22347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9439"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> hands of compassionate women,<l eID="gen22347" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22348"/>have cooked their children;<l eID="gen22348" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22349"/>they became as something to eat<l eID="gen22349" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22350"/>in the destruction of the daughter of my people. <l eID="gen22350" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9440"/><l level="1" sID="gen22351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9440"/>Yahweh has completed his anger,<l eID="gen22351" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22352"/>he has poured out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his fierce anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the fierce anger of his nose”</note><l eID="gen22352" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22353"/>he has kindled a fire in Zion,<l eID="gen22353" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22354"/>it consumed her<note placement="foot">Or “its”</note> foundations. <l eID="gen22354" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9441"/><l level="1" sID="gen22355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9441"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> kings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth did not believe,<l eID="gen22355" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22356"/>and all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world,<l eID="gen22356" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22357"/>that a foe and an enemy could enter<l eID="gen22357" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22358"/>into the gates of Jerusalem. <l eID="gen22358" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9442"/><l level="1" sID="gen22359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9442"/>Because of the sins of her prophets,<l eID="gen22359" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22360"/>the guilt of her priests,<l eID="gen22360" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22361"/>who shed blood in her midst,<l eID="gen22361" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22362"/>of righteous people. <l eID="gen22362" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9443"/><l level="1" sID="gen22363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9443"/>They wander blindly in the streets;<l eID="gen22363" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22364"/>they were defiled with the blood,<l eID="gen22364" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22365"/>their clothes<l eID="gen22365" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22366"/>could not be touched. <l eID="gen22366" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9444"/><l level="1" sID="gen22367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9444"/>“Go away! Defiled!” they shout to them.<l eID="gen22367" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22368"/>“Go away! Go away! Do not touch!”<l eID="gen22368" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22369"/>so they left, they left; it was said among the nations,<l eID="gen22369" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22370"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They will no longer dwell with us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “They will no longer be here as aliens”</note> <l eID="gen22370" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9445"/><l level="1" sID="gen22371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9445"/>The presence of Yahweh has scattered them,<l eID="gen22371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22372"/>he will no longer watch over them;<l eID="gen22372" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22373"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they did not honor the priests⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they did not lift up the faces of the priests”</note><l eID="gen22373" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22374"/>they did not show mercy <transChange type="added">to</transChange> elders. <l eID="gen22374" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9446"/><l level="1" sID="gen22375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9446"/>Still our eyes failed,<l eID="gen22375" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22376"/><transChange type="added">looking for</transChange> our help in vain;<l eID="gen22376" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22377"/>in our watchtower, we kept watch<l eID="gen22377" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22378"/>for a nation that could not save. <l eID="gen22378" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9447"/><l level="1" sID="gen22379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9447"/>They hunted our steps,<l eID="gen22379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22380"/>from walking in our streets;<l eID="gen22380" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22381"/>our end has come near, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞our days are finished⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “our days are filled”</note><l eID="gen22381" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22382"/>our end has come. <l eID="gen22382" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9448"/><l level="1" sID="gen22383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9448"/>Our pursuers were swifter<l eID="gen22383" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22384"/>than <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eagles of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens;<l eID="gen22384" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22385"/>they chased us on the mountains,<l eID="gen22385" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22386"/>they have set an ambush for us in the desert. <l eID="gen22386" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9449"/><l level="1" sID="gen22387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9449"/>The breath of our nostrils, the anointed one of Yahweh,<l eID="gen22387" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22388"/>was captured in their pits;<l eID="gen22388" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22389"/>of whom we said, “In his shadow<l eID="gen22389" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22390"/>we will live among the nations.” <l eID="gen22390" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9450"/><l level="1" sID="gen22391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9450"/>Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom,<l eID="gen22391" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22392"/>you who dwell in the land of Uz;<l eID="gen22392" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22393"/>but to you also the cup will pass,<l eID="gen22393" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22394"/>you will become drunk and strip yourself bare. <l eID="gen22394" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9451"/><l level="1" sID="gen22395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9451"/>The <transChange type="added">punishment</transChange> of your iniquity is completed, O daughter of Zion,<l eID="gen22395" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22396"/>your exile will not continue;<l eID="gen22396" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22397"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> he will punish your iniquity, O daughter of Edom,<l eID="gen22397" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22398"/>he will reveal your sins. <l eID="gen22398" level="2"/><lg eID="gen22310"/> <chapter eID="Lam.4"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9452"/><title type="x-s">A Request for Mercy</title> <div sID="gen22399" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen22399" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22400"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22401"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9452"/>Remember, O Yahweh, what has become of us;<l eID="gen22401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22402"/>take note, and see our disgrace! <l eID="gen22402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9453"/><l level="1" sID="gen22403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9453"/>Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers,<l eID="gen22403" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22404"/>our houses, to foreigners. <l eID="gen22404" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9454"/><l level="1" sID="gen22405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9454"/>We have become orphans, fatherless,<l eID="gen22405" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22406"/>our mothers are like widows. <l eID="gen22406" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9455"/><l level="1" sID="gen22407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9455"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞We pay for water with money⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “we drink our water by money”</note><l eID="gen22407" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22408"/>our wood comes <transChange type="added">to us</transChange> at a price. <l eID="gen22408" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9456"/><l level="1" sID="gen22409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9456"/>We are driven on our necks;<l eID="gen22409" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22410"/>we are weary, there is no rest for us. <l eID="gen22410" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9457"/><l level="1" sID="gen22411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9457"/>We have made a deal with Egypt <transChange type="added">and</transChange> Assyria<l eID="gen22411" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22412"/>to be satisfied <transChange type="added">with</transChange> food. <l eID="gen22412" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9458"/><l level="1" sID="gen22413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9458"/>Our fathers have sinned, they are no more;<l eID="gen22413" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22414"/>we bear their iniquity. <l eID="gen22414" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9459"/><l level="1" sID="gen22415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9459"/>Slaves rule over us;<l eID="gen22415" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22416"/>there is no one to deliver us from their hand. <l eID="gen22416" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9460"/><l level="1" sID="gen22417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9460"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞We risk our life for food⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “We take our food at our life”</note><l eID="gen22417" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22418"/>because of the sword of the desert. <l eID="gen22418" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9461"/><l level="1" sID="gen22419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9461"/>Our skin is hot like an oven<l eID="gen22419" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22420"/>because of the scorching famine. <l eID="gen22420" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9462"/><l level="1" sID="gen22421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9462"/>They raped women in Zion,<l eID="gen22421" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22422"/>young women<note placement="foot">Or “virgins”</note> in the cities of Judah. <l eID="gen22422" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9463"/><l level="1" sID="gen22423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9463"/>They hang princes by their hand;<l eID="gen22423" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22424"/>they do not show respect before elders. <l eID="gen22424" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9464"/><l level="1" sID="gen22425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9464"/>Young men must carry a hand-mill<l eID="gen22425" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22426"/>and boys stumble under the wood. <l eID="gen22426" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9465"/><l level="1" sID="gen22427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9465"/>Elders are no longer at the gate,<l eID="gen22427" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22428"/>young men no longer play stringed instruments. <l eID="gen22428" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9466"/><l level="1" sID="gen22429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9466"/>The joy of our hearts has stopped;<l eID="gen22429" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22430"/>our circle-dancing has changed to a mourning ceremony. <l eID="gen22430" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9467"/><l level="1" sID="gen22431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9467"/>The crown has fallen from our head;<l eID="gen22431" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22432"/>woe to us, for we have sinned! <l eID="gen22432" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9468"/><l level="1" sID="gen22433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9468"/>Because of this, our heart has become faint,<l eID="gen22433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22434"/>because of these, our eyes have become dim. <l eID="gen22434" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9469"/><l level="1" sID="gen22435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9469"/>Because of Mount Zion, which lies desolate,<l eID="gen22435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22436"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foxes tread on it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “foxes go on it”</note> <l eID="gen22436" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9470"/><l level="1" sID="gen22437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9470"/>You, O Yahweh, will sit forever<l eID="gen22437" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22438"/><transChange type="added">on</transChange> your throne for generation to generation. <l eID="gen22438" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9471"/><l level="1" sID="gen22439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9471"/>Why have you forgotten us forever?<l eID="gen22439" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22440"/>Why have you forsaken us <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for so long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “for long days”</note> <l eID="gen22440" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9472"/><l level="1" sID="gen22441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9472"/>Restore us to you, O Yahweh, that we will be restored;<l eID="gen22441" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22442"/>renew our days as of old. <l eID="gen22442" level="2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9473"/><l level="1" sID="gen22443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9473"/>Unless you have utterly rejected us,<l eID="gen22443" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22444"/>unless you are angry with us beyond measure. <l eID="gen22444" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22400"/> <chapter eID="Lam.5"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen21902" osisID="Lam" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9474"/><title type="x-s">Date of Vision of Living Creatures and Glory of the Throne of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen22446" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9474"/>And it was in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> thirtieth year, in the fourth <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, on the fifth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the month, and I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in the midst of<note placement="foot">Or “among”</note> the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> by the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Kebar River⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “river of Kebar”</note> The heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:2
verses.text: On the fifth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of the king Jehoiachin—

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:3
verses.text: the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> clearly<note placement="foot">Or “certainly”</note> to Ezekiel the son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans at the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Kebar River⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “river of Kebar”</note> and the hand of Yahweh was on him there.  <div eID="gen22446" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9475"/><div sID="gen22447" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9475"/>And I looked,<note placement="foot">Or “saw”</note> and look! A storm wind was coming from the north, a great cloud, and fire flashing back and forth, and brightness around and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for it”</note> and from its midst<note placement="foot">Or “middle”</note> it was like the outward appearance of amber stone from the midst<note placement="foot">Or “middle”</note> of the fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:5
verses.text: And from its midst<note placement="foot">Or “middle”</note> was the likeness of four living creatures, and this was their appearance: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a human form⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “this their appearance the likeness of a human to them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:6
verses.text: and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each had four faces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and four faces to each”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each of them had four wings⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and four wings to each for them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:7
verses.text: And their legs <transChange type="added">were</transChange> straight legs, and the sole of their feet <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like the sole of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> foot of a calf, and <transChange type="added">they</transChange> were sparkling like the outward appearance of polished bronze.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:8
verses.text: And under their wings <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞human hands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand his a man”</note> on their four sides. And their faces and their wings for the four of them <transChange type="added">were as follows</transChange>:

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their wings were touching one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “their wings were touching each her sister”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each of them went straight forward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they did not turn at their going”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without turning right or left⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “each toward the side of his face they went”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:10
verses.text: The likeness of their faces <transChange type="added">was the</transChange> face of a human <transChange type="added">in front</transChange>, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> face of a lion on the right <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of each of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “of the four of them”</note> and the face of an ox on the left <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of each of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “of the four of them”</note> and the face of an eagle <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for each of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “of the four of them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:11
verses.text: So <transChange type="added">were</transChange> their faces; their wings <transChange type="added">were</transChange> spread out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “from to above”</note> each <transChange type="added">had</transChange> two touching one another and two covering their bodies.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:12
verses.text: And each <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞went straight forward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “toward the side of his face they went”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wherever the spirit went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “towards which it was there the spirit”</note> they went, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they did not turn as they went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they did not turn at their going”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:13
verses.text: As for<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. It<note placement="foot">That is, the fire</note> was moving to and fro between the living creatures, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the fire was very bright⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “brightness was for the fire”</note> and lightning <transChange type="added">was</transChange> going out from the fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:14
verses.text: And the living creatures <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were speeding to and fro⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sped forth and returned”</note> like the appearance of lightning.  <div eID="gen22447" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9476"/><div sID="gen22448" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9476"/>And I saw the living creatures, and look! A wheel was on the earth<note placement="foot">Or “ground”</note> beside <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each of the living creatures that had four faces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the living creatures for the four of his/its faces.” The LXX has “for the four of them.”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:16
verses.text: The appearance of the wheels and their construction <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appearance of beryl,<note placement="foot">Or “chrysolite,” or “topaz”; this stone is difficult to identify exactly</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they all looked alike⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “likeness was one for the four of them”</note> and their appearance and their construction was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞like a wheel within a wheel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as that it was a wheel in the midst of a wheel”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:17
verses.text: When they moved, they went toward their four sides; they did not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞veer at all as they went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “turn away when they went”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:18
verses.text: And their rims <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were high and awesome⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “height was for them and awesomeness was for them”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all four of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of the four of them”</note> their rims <transChange type="added">were</transChange> full of eyes <transChange type="added">all</transChange> around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:19
verses.text: And at the going of the living creatures, the wheels next to them <transChange type="added">also</transChange> went, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the creatures were lifted from the ground⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and at the lifting up of the creatures from the earth”</note> the wheels <transChange type="added">also</transChange> rose.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:20
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Wherever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Toward which”</note> the spirit went they would go there, and the wheels rose, for the spirit of the living creatures<note placement="foot">Hebrew “creature”</note> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in the wheels.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:21
verses.text: At their<note placement="foot">That is, the living creatures</note> going, they<note placement="foot">That is, the wheels</note> go, and at their standing, they stood, and at their being lifted up from on the earth,<note placement="foot">Or “ground”</note> the wheels rose,<note placement="foot">Or “were lifted up”</note> for the spirit of the living creatures<note placement="foot">Hebrew “creature”</note> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in the wheels.  <div eID="gen22448" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9477"/><div sID="gen22449" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9477"/>Now<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the likeness above the heads of the living creatures was an expanse like the outward appearance of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞awesome⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “terrible”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “frozen water”</note> spread out above their heads <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from to upward”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:23
verses.text: And under the expanse their wings <transChange type="added">were stretched out</transChange> straight <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one toward the other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “each towards its sister”</note> each had two <transChange type="added">wings</transChange> covering them, and each had two <transChange type="added">wings</transChange> covering their bodies.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:24
verses.text: And I heard the sound of their wings like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of many waters, like the voice of Shaddai,<note placement="foot">Often translated “Almighty”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they moved⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at their going”</note> there was a sound of tumult like the sound of an army; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they stood still⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at their standing”</note> they lowered their wings.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:25
verses.text: And there was<note placement="foot">Or “it was”</note> a sound from above the expanse that was above their heads, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and when they stood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at their standing”</note> they lowered their wings.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:26
verses.text: And from above the expanse that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> above their heads <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> the likeness of a throne, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞looking like a sapphire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the appearance of a stone of sapphire”</note> and above the likeness of the throne was a likeness similar to<note placement="foot">Or “like”</note> the appearance of a human on it, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞above it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from to above”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:27
verses.text: And I saw <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> outward appearance of amber, <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appearance of fire, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a covering around <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, from the likeness of his loins and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to above”</note> And from the likeness of his loins and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞downward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to down”</note> I saw something like the appearance of fire, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it was radiant all around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “brightness was for it around”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:28
verses.text: Like the appearance<note placement="foot">Or “likeness”</note> of a bow that is in the cloud on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a rainy day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day of the rain”</note> such was the radiance<note placement="foot">Or “brightness”</note> around it; <transChange type="added">thus was</transChange> the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Yahweh. And I saw, and I fell on my face, and I heard a voice speaking.  <chapter eID="Ezek.1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9478"/><title type="x-s">The Call of Ezekiel to Speak God’s Words</title> <div sID="gen22450" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9478"/>And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> stand on your feet, so that I can speak with you.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:2
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Spirit<note placement="foot">Or “a spirit”</note> came into me as he was speaking to me, and it set me on my feet, and I heard the one speaking to me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:3
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> I am sending you to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> to nations<note placement="foot">Or “a people”</note> who are rebelling, who rebelled against me, they and their ancestors,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fathers”</note> they transgressed against me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until this very day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until the day the this”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:4
verses.text: And the children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞impudent⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hard of face”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞stubborn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “strong of heart”</note> <transChange type="added">and so</transChange> I am sending you to them, and you must say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh!’

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:5
verses.text: And they, whether they listen or whether they fail <transChange type="added">to listen</transChange>, for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a rebellious house, they will know that a prophet was in their midst.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:6
verses.text: And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> you must not be afraid of them, and you must not be afraid of their words, because<note placement="foot">Or “although”</note> briers and thorns are with you, and you are sitting among scorpions. You must not be afraid of their words, and you must not be dismayed because of their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞looks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “faces”</note> for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a rebellious house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:7
verses.text: And you must speak my words to them whether they listen or whether they fail <transChange type="added">to listen</transChange>, for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> rebellious.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:8
verses.text: And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> hear what I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> speaking to you: you must not be rebellious like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> house of rebellion. Open your mouth and eat what I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> giving to you.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:9
verses.text: And I looked,<note placement="foot">Or “saw”</note> and look! There was a hand stretched out to me, and look! In it was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a scroll with writing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a scroll of a book”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:10
verses.text: And he rolled it out<note placement="foot">Or “he spread it out”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> and it was written on the front and back, and there were written on it laments and mourning and wailing.<note placement="foot">Or “woe”</note>  <chapter eID="Ezek.2"/> <div eID="gen22450" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:1
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> what you find, eat! Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:2
verses.text: And I opened my mouth, and he gave me this scroll to eat,

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:3
verses.text: and he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> you must give your stomach this to eat, and you must fill your belly with this scroll that I am giving to you.” And I ate, and it became <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞like sweet honey⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “like honey for sweetness”</note> in my mouth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:4
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> come! Go to the house of Israel, and you must speak to them with my words.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:5
verses.text: For you are sent to the house of Israel, not to a people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of obscure speech⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “obscure of lip”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of a difficult language⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heavy/thick of tongue”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> not to many nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of obscure speech⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “obscure of tongue”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a difficult language⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heavy/thick of tongue”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose words⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “their words”</note> you do not understand, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> if I had sent you to them they would have listened to you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:7
verses.text: And the house of Israel, they are not willing to listen to you, for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not willing to listen to me, for all of the house of Israel is hard of forehead, and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> hard of heart.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> look, I have made<note placement="foot">Or “set”</note> your face hard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to correspond to”</note> their faces and your forehead hard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to correspond to”</note> their forehead.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:9
verses.text: Like a diamond <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞harder than flint⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hard more than flint”</note> I have made your forehead; you must not fear them, and you must not be dismayed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on account of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of them”</note> for they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are a rebellious house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “are a house of rebellion”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:10
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> all of my words that I shall speak to you, receive into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> your heart and hear with your ears.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:11
verses.text: And come, go to the exiles,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> to the children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of your people, and you must speak to them, and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh!’ whether they listen or whether they fail <transChange type="added">to listen</transChange>.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:12
verses.text: And the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the sound of a great earthquake when the glory of Yahweh rose from its place.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:13
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> the sound of the wings of the living creatures touching lightly<note placement="foot">Or “brushing against”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one against the other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “each against each its sister</note> and the sound of the wheels beside them and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of a great earthquake.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:14
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Spirit lifted me and took me, and I went <transChange type="added">in</transChange> bitterness in the heat of my spirit, and the hand of Yahweh <transChange type="added">was</transChange> strong on me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:15
verses.text: And I went to the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> at Tel Abib, who were dwelling near the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Kebar River⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “river of Kebar”</note> and I sat <transChange type="added">where</transChange> they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> dwelling. I sat there seven days in the midst of them, stunned.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:16
verses.text: And then it happened<note placement="foot">Or “was”</note> at the end of seven days, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the word of Yahweh came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it was the word of Yahweh to me to say saying”</note> to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:17
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> I have appointed you <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a watchman for the house of Israel. When you hear a word from my mouth, then you must warn them from me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:18
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When I say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at/in my saying”</note> to the wicked, ‘Surely you will die,’ and you do not warn him and you do not speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that he may live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “so that you let him live”</note> that wicked <transChange type="added">person</transChange> will die because of his guilt, and from your hand I will seek his blood.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:19
verses.text: And you, if you do warn <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked and he does not turn from his wickedness and from his wicked way, on account of his guilt he will die, and you yourself will have saved your life.<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “self”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:20
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the righteous turns from his righteousness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and at the to turn of the righteous from his righteousness”</note> and does injustice, and I place<note placement="foot">Or “give”</note> a stumbling block <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of him”</note> he will die, for you did not warn him. Because of his sin he will die, and his righteousness<note placement="foot">Or “righteous deeds”</note> that he did will not be remembered, and his blood I shall seek from your hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:21
verses.text: And if you warn him, the righteous, not to sin, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous does not sin, surely he will live, for he heeded a warning. And you will have saved your life.”<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “self”</note>  <div eID="gen22451" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9479"/><div sID="gen22452" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9479"/>And the hand of Yahweh was on me there, and he said to me, “Rise up, go out to the valley, and there I will speak with you.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:23
verses.text: And I rose up, and I went to the valley, and, look, there the glory of Yahweh <transChange type="added">was</transChange> standing, like the glory that I saw near the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Kebar River⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “river of Kebar”</note> and I fell on my face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:24
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Spirit<note placement="foot">Or “a spirit”</note> came into me, and it made me stand on my feet, and he spoke with me and said to me, “Come, shut yourself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞inside your house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the midst of your house”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:25
verses.text: and you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> look, they will place<note placement="foot">Or “give”</note> cords on you, and they will tie you up with them. Then you will not go out into the midst of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:26
verses.text: And I will make your tongue cling to the roof of your mouth, and you will be silenced, and you will not be a reproving man for them, for they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are a rebellious house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a house of rebellion”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:27
verses.text: And when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you must say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “The <transChange type="added">one</transChange> hearing him, let him hear, and the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> failing <transChange type="added">to hear</transChange>, let him fail,” ’ for they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are a rebellious house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a house of rebellion”</note>  <chapter eID="Ezek.3"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9480"/><title type="x-s">Siege of Jerusalem Illustrated on a Brick</title> <div sID="gen22453" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9480"/>“Now,<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> take for yourself a brick, and you must put it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> and you must portray on it a city, Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:2
verses.text: And you must build against it siege works, and you must build against it <transChange type="added">a</transChange> bulwark, and you must heap against it a siege ramp, and you must set up against it camps and put against it a battering ram all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:3
verses.text: And take for yourself a plate of iron, and you must place it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a wall of iron between you and the city, and you must set your face against it, and it must be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞under siege⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the siege”</note> and you must lay the siege against it; it is a sign for the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:4
verses.text: And you, lie down on your left side, and you must put<note placement="foot">Or “you will put”</note> the guilt of the house of Israel on it. You will carry their guilt the number of days that you will lie on it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:5
verses.text: And I will give to you the years of their guilt according to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> number of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> days, three hundred and ninety days, and you must bear the guilt<note placement="foot">Or “punishment”</note> of the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:6
verses.text: When you have completed these, then you must lie a second <transChange type="added">time</transChange> on your right side; and you must bear the guilt<note placement="foot">Or “punishment”</note> of the house of Judah forty days, a day for each year, a day for each year I give it to you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:7
verses.text: And toward the siege of Jerusalem you must set your face and your bared arm; then you must prophesy against it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:8
verses.text: Now<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> look! I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> put on you cords, and you may not turn yourself from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> side to your <transChange type="added">other</transChange> side until you complete the days of your siege.  <div eID="gen22453" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9481"/><title type="x-s">Ezekiel’s Strange Defiled Meal</title> <div sID="gen22454" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9481"/>“And you, take for yourself<note placement="foot">Hebrew “you”</note> wheat and barley and beans and lentils and millet<note placement="foot">Or “sorghum”</note> and spelt, and you must put them in one vessel, and you must make them for yourself<note placement="foot">Hebrew “you”</note> into a food <transChange type="added">during</transChange> the number of days that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> lying on your side; three hundred and ninety days you shall eat it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:10
verses.text: And your food that you will eat<note placement="foot">Hebrew “will eat it”</note> will be according to weight; twenty shekels for each day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at fixed times⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from time to time”</note> you shall eat it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:11
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an amount of water⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “water by amount”</note> you shall drink, a sixth of a hin; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at fixed times⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from time to time”</note> you shall drink <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:12
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as a</transChange> bread-cake of barley you shall eat it, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with human excrement⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with human dung of the excrement of the human”</note> you shall bake it before their eyes.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:13
verses.text: And Yahweh said, “Thus shall the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> eat their unclean food among the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where I will scatter them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “which I will scatter them there”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:14
verses.text: And I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Look! I have not been defiling myself, and a dead body and mangled carcass I have not eaten from my childhood until now, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞unclean meat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “flesh of unclean meat”</note> has not come into my mouth!”

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:15
verses.text: And he said to me, “See I will give you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cattle manure⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the manure of cattle”</note> in the place of the feces of a human, and you may prepare your food on it.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:16
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> look, I am going to break the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞supply⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “staff”</note> of bread in Jerusalem, and they will eat bread by weight, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anxiously⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and with worry”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rationed water⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and water by amount”</note> and they will drink with horror,

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:17
verses.text: so that they will lack food and water, and they will be appalled <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a man and his brother”</note> and they will waste away because of their guilt.<note placement="foot">Or “punishment”</note>  <chapter eID="Ezek.4"/> <div eID="gen22454" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:1
verses.text: “And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> take for yourself<note placement="foot">Hebrew “you”</note> a sword, sharp as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a barber’s razor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the razor of the barbers”</note> Take it for yourself, and you must cause it to pass over your head and over your beard, and you must take for yourself a set of scales for weighing, and you must divide them.<note placement="foot">That is, the hairs</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:2
verses.text: A third you must burn with fire in the midst<note placement="foot">Or “middle”</note> of the city at <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the completion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the completing”</note> of the days of the siege, and you must take a third, and you must strike <transChange type="added">it</transChange> with the sword around it, and a third you must scatter to the wind, and I will draw a sword behind them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:3
verses.text: And you must take from these a few in number, and you must tuck them in your hem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:4
verses.text: And from them again you shall take <transChange type="added">some</transChange>, and you must throw them in the middle of the fire, and you must burn them with fire; from it a fire will go out to all of the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:5
verses.text: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Jerusalem in the midst of the nations <transChange type="added">where</transChange> I have put her, and countries <transChange type="added">are</transChange> around her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:6
verses.text: But she has rebelled against my regulations to the point of wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> around her; for they rejected my regulations, and <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> my statutes, they did not walk in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:7
verses.text: Therefore, thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because of your commotion more than the nations that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> around you—you did not walk in my statutes, and you did not do my regulations, and according to the regulations of the nations that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> around you, you did not do.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:8
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Look! I, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞even I⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “surely I”</note> am against you, and I will execute judgment in the midst of you before the eyes of the nations,

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:9
verses.text: and I will do with you <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which I have not done, and which I will not do again, because of all of your detestable things.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:10
verses.text: Therefore<note placement="foot">Literally “to thus”</note> parents<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> will eat children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> in the midst of you, and children<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> will eat their parents,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and I will execute judgment in you, and I will scatter your entire remnant to every wind.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:11
verses.text: Therefore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as surely as I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “alive I am”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “If not”</note> because you have defiled my sanctuary with all of your vile idols and with all of your detestable things, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞now indeed I⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and also I”</note> will reduce, and my eye will not take pity, and surely I will show no compassion.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:12
verses.text: A third of you will die because of the plague, and because of the famine they will perish in the midst of you, and a third will fall through the sword around you, and a third I will scatter to every direction of the wind, and I will draw <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword behind them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:13
verses.text: And my anger will come to an end, and I will place my rage on them, and I will relent, and they will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my passion <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when I fully vent my rage against them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “at my finishing my anger against them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:14
verses.text: And I will make you into a desolate place and into a disgrace among the nations that surround you before the eyes of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every one who passes by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “every one of passing by”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:15
verses.text: And it will be<note placement="foot">Or “and you will be”</note> an object of taunting<note placement="foot">Hebrew “taunt”</note> and <transChange type="added">an</transChange> object of mockery, a warning and a horror to the nations that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> around you whenever I execute judgments against you in anger and in wrath and in furious punishments! I, Yahweh, have spoken!

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:16
verses.text: When I send my arrows of deadly famine against them, which will be as destruction that I will send <transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to destroy you, I will increase famine against you, and I will break <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the supply of food⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “staff of bread”</note> for you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:17
verses.text: And I will send against you famine and fierce animals,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> and they will make you childless; and plague and blood will pass through you, and I will bring <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword upon you. I, Yahweh, I have spoken!”  <chapter eID="Ezek.5"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9482"/><title type="x-s">Idolatrous Worship and Idolatrous Objects Denounced</title> <div sID="gen22456" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9482"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> set your face to the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:3
verses.text: and you must say, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh, thus says the Lord Yahweh to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys: “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> bringing upon you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword, and I will destroy your high places,

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:4
verses.text: and your altars will be desolate, and your incense altars will be broken, and I will throw down your slain ones <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> your idols,

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:5
verses.text: and I will place<note placement="foot">Or “give”</note> the corpses of the children of Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:6
verses.text: In all of your dwellings, the cities will be desolate and the high places will be ruined, so that your altars will be desolate and will suffer punishment. Your idols will be broken and will come to an end, and your incense altars will be cut down, and your works will be destroyed,

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:7
verses.text: and the slain one will fall in the midst of you, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:8
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> I will spare some, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so there will be⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at their being”</note> for you fugitives from the sword among the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you are scattered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at you to be scattered”</note> in the countries.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:9
verses.text: And your fugitives will remember me among the nations <transChange type="added">to</transChange> which they were taken captive, that I was shattered by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their adulterous heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart their which was prostituting itself”</note> which departed from me, and by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their adulterous eyes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “eyes their which were prostituting”</note> which went after their idols, and they will feel loathing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for their face”</note> for the evil that they did, for all of their detestable things.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:10
verses.text: And they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh; not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in vain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to nothing”</note> I spoke to bring to them this evil.” ’

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:11
verses.text: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Clap your hand and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas, for all of the detestable things of the evil of the house of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of which⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which”</note> they will fall with the sword, with the famine, and with the plague.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:12
verses.text: The one who is far <transChange type="added">away</transChange> will die by the plague, and the one who is near will fall by the sword, and the one who is being left behind and being spared will die by the famine, and I will complete my rage on<note placement="foot">Or “toward”</note> them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:13
verses.text: And you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when their slain ones are in the midst of their idols⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the being of their slain ones in the midst of their idols”</note> around their altars at every high hill, on the tops of all the mountains and under every green tree and under every leafy oak—the place <transChange type="added">at</transChange> which they gave <transChange type="added">a</transChange> pleasing scent for all of their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:14
verses.text: And I will stretch out my hand against them, and I will make the land a desolation and a wasteland from the desert to Riblah in all of their dwellings, and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.” ’ ”  <chapter eID="Ezek.6"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9483"/><title type="x-s">Punishment for Abominations Throughout the Land</title> <div sID="gen22457" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9483"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:2
verses.text: “And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> thus says the Lord Yahweh to the land of Israel: ‘<transChange type="added">The</transChange> end comes, the end on the four corners of the land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:3
verses.text: Now the end <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on you, and I will send my anger on you, and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will bring on you all your detestable things.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:4
verses.text: And my eye will not take pity on you, and I will not show compassion for your ways; on you I will bring your detestable things; they will be in the midst of you, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:5
verses.text: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Look! Disaster after disaster <transChange type="added">is</transChange> coming!

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> end comes, comes the end! It has awakened against you! Look! <transChange type="added">It</transChange> comes!

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:7
verses.text: Doom is coming against you, the dweller<note placement="foot">Or “inhabitant”</note> of the land; the time comes, the day <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near, panic and not joy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the mountains.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Soon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “now from near”</note> I will pour out my rage on you, and I will fully vent my anger on you, and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will bring on you all of your detestable things.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:9
verses.text: And my eye will not take pity, and I will not show compassion. According to your ways I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deal with you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “on you I will bring”</note> and your detestable things will be in the midst of you, and you will know that I am Yahweh who strikes.<note placement="foot">Or “smites”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:10
verses.text: Look! The day is coming; doom goes out, the staff blossoms, pride sprouts.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:11
verses.text: Violence has grown to <transChange type="added">become</transChange> a staff of wickedness; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞none⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not any”</note> from them will remain, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞none⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not any”</note> from their abundance nor from their wealth;<note placement="foot">Or “noise,” or “multitude”; the same word appears in each of the next three verses</note> and prominence <transChange type="added">will</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> among them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:12
verses.text: The time has come, the day has arrived; let not the buyer rejoice, and let the seller not mourn, for anger <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on all their multitude.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:13
verses.text: For the seller will not return to the merchandise <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞while they are still alive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “while still is in the life, their life”</note> for the vision <transChange type="added">is</transChange> about all of its multitude; it will not change, and a man because of his guilt will not be able to hold onto his life.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:14
verses.text: They shall blow on the trumpet and prepare <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the all”</note> but <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no <transChange type="added">one</transChange> going to the battle, for my anger <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on all of their multitude.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:15
verses.text: The sword <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is outside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “is in the outside place”</note> and the plague and the famine <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are inside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “are from the house</note> <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the field will die by the sword, and <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the city, famine and plague will devour him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:16
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">if</transChange> their survivors will escape, they will be on the mountains, like the doves of the valley, all of them groaning, each because of his guilt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:17
verses.text: All of the hands will hang limp, and all of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the knees will be wet with urine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the knees will flow with water”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:18
verses.text: And they will wear sackcloth, and horror will cover them, and on all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> faces <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> shame, and baldness on all of their heads.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:19
verses.text: Their silver they will discard on the streets, and filth will be their gold; their silver and their gold will not be able to rescue them on the day of the wrath of Yahweh. They will not satisfy their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hunger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “selves,” or “desire”</note> and their stomachs they will not fill, for their guilt will be their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> stumbling block.  <div eID="gen22457" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9484"/><title type="x-s">Judgment for the Profanation of the Temple and Sanctuary</title> <div sID="gen22458" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9484"/>“ ‘And the beauty of its<note placement="foot">Or “their”</note> ornament <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he made into a prideful thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to a prideful thing he made it”</note> and made with it their detestable things and their vile idols; therefore I will make it into an impure thing for them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:21
verses.text: And I will give it into the hand of strangers as plunder and to the wicked people of the earth as spoil, and they will defile it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:22
verses.text: And I will turn my face from them, and they will defile my treasured <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, and violent ones will enter and defile it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:23
verses.text: Make a chain for the land; it is full of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bloody crimes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the judgment of blood”</note> and the city is full of violence.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:24
verses.text: And I will bring <transChange type="added">the</transChange> worst of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations, and they will take possession of their houses, and I will put to an end <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pride of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mighty ones, and their sanctuaries will be defiled.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:25
verses.text: Anguish comes, and they will seek peace, and <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> none.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:26
verses.text: Calamity upon calamity will come, and rumor will be upon rumor. And they will seek a vision from a prophet, but instruction will perish from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> priest and counsel from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> elders.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:27
verses.text: The king will mourn, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prince will be dressed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. According to their way I will do to<note placement="foot">Or “deal with”</note> them, and according to their judgments I will judge them, and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.’ ”  <chapter eID="Ezek.7"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9485"/><title type="x-s">Abominations in the Temple and in Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen22459" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9485"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it happened”</note> in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> And the hand of the Lord Yahweh fell on me there,

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:2
verses.text: and I saw,<note placement="foot">Or “looked”</note> and look! A figure like the appearance of a man;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fire”; but reading the BHS note 2b, “a man.”</note> from the appearance of his waist and below was fire, and from his waist and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to above”</note> was like the appearance of brightness,<note placement="foot">Or “shining metal”</note> like the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞outward appearance of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “eye”</note> amber.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:3
