verses.text: And he sent out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> form of a hand, and he took me by a lock of hair of my head, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Spirit lifted me between earth and heaven, and it brought me to Jerusalem in visions of God to the doorway of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inner gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that faced north⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the one facing north”</note> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> which there <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the seat of the image of jealousy, which was making jealous.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:4
verses.text: And look! There <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the glory of the God of Israel like the vision that I saw in the valley.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:5
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> lift up now<note placement="foot">Particle of entreaty, “please/ please now”</note> your eyes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞toward the north⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “to the way of the north”</note> And I lifted up my eyes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞toward the north⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the way of the north”</note> and, look, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> to the north of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy at the entrance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:6
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Do you see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Are you seeing?”</note> what they are doing—great detestable things that the house of Israel is committing<note placement="foot">Or “doing”</note> here so as to drive me from<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from upon”</note> my sanctuary, and yet <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will see again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you will return you will see”</note> greater<note placement="foot">Or “worse”</note> detestable things.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:7
verses.text: And he brought me to the doorway of the courtyard, and I saw, and look! A hole in the wall.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:8
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> dig now<note placement="foot">Or “please”</note> through the wall.” And I dug through the wall, and look! There was a doorway.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:9
verses.text: And he said to me, “Come and see the detestable things, the evil that they are doing<note placement="foot">Or “making”</note> here.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:10
verses.text: And I came, and I saw, and look, all kinds of creatures<note placement="foot">Hebrew “creature”</note> and detestable beasts;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “beast”</note> and all of the idols of the house of Israel were carved on the wall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “around around”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:11
verses.text: And seventy men from the elders of the house of Israel, and Jaazaniah, the son of Shaphan, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> standing in the midst of them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of them”</note> Each <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> his censer in his hand, and the fragrance of the cloud of the incense <transChange type="added">was</transChange> going up.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:12
verses.text: And he said to me, “Have you seen, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> what the elders of the house of Israel <transChange type="added">are</transChange> doing in the dark, each in the inner rooms of his idol, for <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> saying, ‘Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not seeing us; Yahweh has abandoned the land.’ ”

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:13
verses.text: And he said to me, “Still <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will see again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you will return, you will see”</note> greater detestable things that they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> doing.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:14
verses.text: And he brought me to the doorway of the gate of the house of Yahweh that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> toward the north, and look! There <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the women sitting weeping for Tammuz.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:15
verses.text: And he said to me, “Have you seen, son of man?<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> Still <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will see again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you will return, you will see”</note> greater detestable things than these.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:16
verses.text: And he brought me to the inner courtyard of the house of Yahweh, and look, <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the doorway of the temple of Yahweh, between the portico and the altar, <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> about twenty-five men <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their backs to the temple of Yahweh and their faces toward the east, and they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> bowing down toward the east before the sun.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:17
verses.text: And he said to me, “Have you seen, son of man?<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Was it too small a thing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was it too little”</note> for the house of Judah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to do⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from doing”</note> the detestable things that they did here? For they filled up the land with violence, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they provoked me to anger again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they returned to provoke me to anger”</note> and look! They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> putting the branch to their nose.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:18
verses.text: And so I will act in rage, and my eye will not take pity, and I will not have compassion, and they will cry in my ear <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a loud voice, and I will not hear them.”  <chapter eID="Ezek.8"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9486"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Avenging Messenger Destroys the Wicked in the City</title> <div sID="gen22460" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9486"/>And he called in my ears <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a loud voice, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “They have come near,<note placement="foot">Or “Come near” (imperative)</note> the punishers of the city, and each <transChange type="added">with</transChange> his weapon of destruction in his hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:2
verses.text: And look! Six men coming from the way of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the upper gate⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the gate of the upper”</note> that faced <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞northward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “faced north + directive”</note> and each with his weapon for<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> shattering in his hand; and one man was in the midst of them, dressed in linen, and the<note placement="foot">Or “his”</note> writing case of the scribe <transChange type="added">was</transChange> at his side. And they came and stood beside the bronze altar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:3
verses.text: And the glory of the God of Israel lifted itself up from upon the cherub that he was on<note placement="foot">Hebrew “which he was on it”</note> and went to the threshold of the house,<note placement="foot">That is, the temple</note> and he called to the man who was clothed in linen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with a scribal writing case at his side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “whom a writing case of a scribe was at his side”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:4
verses.text: And Yahweh said to him, “Go through in the midst of the city, in the midst of Jerusalem, and you must place a mark on the foreheads of the men <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who are groaning and lamenting⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the men the groaning and the lamenting”</note> about all of the detestable things <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that are being done⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the being done”</note> in the midst of her.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:5
verses.text: And to the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city behind him and kill! Your eyes shall not take pity, and you shall not have compassion.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:6
verses.text: You must kill <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞totally⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to destruction”</note> old man, young man and young woman, and little children and women, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concerning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “upon”</note> every man <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with the mark on him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which is on him the mark”</note> you must not approach; and from my sanctuary you must begin.” And they began with the old men who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “were to the face of”</note> the house.<note placement="foot">That is, the temple</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:7
verses.text: And he said to them, “Defile the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> and fill the courtyards <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the dead; go out! And they went out, and they killed in the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it was”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as they were striking⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in their striking”</note> and I was left behind, I fell on my face, and I cried out, and I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! “Will you be destroying all of the remnant of Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞while you pour out your rage⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “when pouring out your rage”</note> on Jerusalem?”

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:9
verses.text: And he said to me, “The guilt of the house of Israel and Judah <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞exceedingly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with very very”</note> great, and the land is filled with bloodguilt, and the city is full of injustice. For they say Yahweh abandoned the land, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Yahweh does not see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not Yahweh is seeing</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:10
verses.text: And I, my eye will not take pity, and I will not have compassion; their way I will bring on their head.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:11
verses.text: And look! The man clothed in linen <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with a writing case at his side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which/whom the writing-case was at his side”</note> was bringing back a word, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “I have done all that you commanded me.”  <chapter eID="Ezek.9"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9487"/><title type="x-s">God’s Presence Leaves the Temple</title> <div sID="gen22461" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9487"/>And I looked, and look! On the expanse that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> above the head of the cherubim <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like a stone of sapphire,<note placement="foot">Or “lapis lazuli”</note> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appearance of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shape of a throne it appeared above them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:2
verses.text: And he spoke<note placement="foot">Or “said”</note> to the man clothed in linen and said, “Go <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in among the wheel area under the cherubim⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to between to the wheel to under the cherub”</note> and fill the hollow of your hands <transChange type="added">with</transChange> coals of fire from among the cherubim, and toss <transChange type="added">them</transChange> on the city.” And he went <transChange type="added">right</transChange> before my eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:3
verses.text: Now<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the cherubim were standing on the south of the temple <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the man went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at his coming the man”</note> and the cloud filled the inner courtyard.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:4
verses.text: And the glory of Yahweh rose up from on the cherub toward<note placement="foot">Or “onto”</note> the threshold of the house,<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> and the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> was filled with the cloud, and the courtyard was filled with the brightness of the glory of Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:5
verses.text: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as far as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “up to”</note> the outer courtyard; it was like the voice of God Shaddai<note placement="foot">Often translated “Almighty”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he speaks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in his speaking”</note>  <div eID="gen22461" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9488"/><div sID="gen22462" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9488"/>And then at his command<note placement="foot">Or “when he commanded”</note> to the man clothed in linen, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Take fire from among the wheel area from among the cherubim,” he went and stood beside the wheel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:7
verses.text: Then the cherub stretched out his hand from among<note placement="foot">Or “between”</note> the cherubim toward the fire that was among<note placement="foot">Or “between”</note> the cherubim, and he lifted up and gave<note placement="foot">Or “placed”</note> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> into the hollow of the hand of <transChange type="added">the man</transChange> clothed with linen, and he took <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and he went out.  <div eID="gen22462" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9489"/><div sID="gen22463" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9489"/>And <transChange type="added">there</transChange> appeared for<note placement="foot">Literally “to”</note> the cherubim the form of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a human hand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a hand of a man”</note> under their wings.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:9
verses.text: And I saw, and look, four wheels beside the cherubim, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one wheel beside each cherub⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “wheel one beside the cherub one, and wheel one beside the cherub one”</note> and the appearance of the wheels was like the outward appearance of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞turquoise stone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “stone of turquoise”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:10
verses.text: Their appearance<note placement="foot">That is, of the wheels</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was the same for each of the four of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “likeness one was for the four of them”</note> as if the wheel was in the midst of a wheel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:11
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When they went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In their going”</note> to the four of their directions that they went, they did not change direction <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “At their going”</note> for the place to which the head<note placement="foot">Or “first” or “lead wheel”</note> turned, they went behind him; they did not change direction at their going.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:12
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their whole body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the whole of their body”</note> and their rims, and their spokes, and their wings, and the wheels were full of eyes all around—<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the wheels for the four of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for the four of them their wheels”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:13
verses.text: Concerning the wheels, he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> calling them “the wheelwork” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in my hearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in my ears”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:14
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each one had four faces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “four faces were to each”</note> the face of the one <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the face of a cherub, and the face of the second <transChange type="added">was the</transChange> face of a human, and the face of the third <transChange type="added">was the</transChange> face of a lion, and the fourth <transChange type="added">was the</transChange> face of an eagle.  <div eID="gen22463" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9490"/><div sID="gen22464" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9490"/>And the cherubim rose; that is, the living creatures<note placement="foot">Hebrew “creature”</note> that I saw at the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Kebar River⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “river of Kebar”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:16
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the cherubim went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at the going of the cherubim”</note> the wheels beside them went; and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the cherubim lifted their wings to rise up from the earth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and at the lifting of the cherubim wings their to rise from on the earth”</note> the wheels also did not turn aside from beside them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:17
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When they stood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at their standing”</note> they stood, and at their rising, they rose with them, for the spirit of the living creatures <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:18
verses.text: And the glory of Yahweh went out from<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from on”</note> the threshold of the temple, and it stood above the cherubim.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:19
verses.text: And the cherubim lifted up their wings, and they rose from the earth before my eyes. At their going out, the wheels <transChange type="added">were</transChange><note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> beside them. And he stood at the doorway of the eastern gate of the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> of Yahweh, and the glory of the God of Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was over them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on them from to above”</note>  <div eID="gen22464" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9491"/><div sID="gen22465" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9491"/>This <transChange type="added">was</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “these were”</note> the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel at the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Kebar River⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “river of Kebar”</note> and I knew that they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> cherubim.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:21
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Each one had four faces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “four faces were for one/each”</note> and there were four wings for each, and the likeness of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞human hands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hands of a man”</note> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> under their wings.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:22
verses.text: And the likeness of their faces, they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the faces that I saw at the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Kebar River⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Litearlly “river of Kebar”</note> thus was their appearance, and they each went <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞straight ahead⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the opposite of face his”</note>  <chapter eID="Ezek.10"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9492"/><title type="x-s">Judgment On Evil Rulers</title> <div sID="gen22466" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9492"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Spirit lifted me up, and it brought me to the eastern gate, the one facing east, of the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> of Yahweh. And look, there were twenty-five men in the doorway of the gate, and I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azzur in the midst of them, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, the commanders of the people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:2
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> these are the men <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who devise mischief⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones devising mischief”</note> and <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> offering bad counsel in this city,

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:3
verses.text: who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> saying, “The building of houses <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not near; <transChange type="added">the city</transChange> is the pot, and we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the flesh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:4
verses.text: Therefore prophesy against them! Prophesy, son of man!”<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note>  <div eID="gen22466" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9493"/><div sID="gen22467" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9493"/>And the Spirit of Yahweh fell on me, and he said to me, “Say, ‘thus says Yahweh: “This is what you think, house of Israel, and I myself know them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> the thoughts of your spirit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:6
verses.text: You made your slain ones numerous in this city, and you have filled its streets <transChange type="added">with</transChange> slain ones.” ’<note placement="foot">Hebrew “slain one”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:7
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Your slain ones whom you put in its midst, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the flesh, and it is <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pot, and I<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> will bring you out from its midst.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> sword you have feared, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword I will bring against you!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:9
verses.text: “And I will bring you out from its midst, and I will give you into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of strangers, and I will execute judgments against you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:10
verses.text: By the sword you will fall at the border of Israel; I will judge you, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:11
verses.text: It will not be as a pot to you, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you would be<note placement="foot">Or “will be”</note> in the midst of it as flesh, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> at the border of Israel I will judge you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:12
verses.text: And you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, whose<note placement="foot">Hebrew “which”</note> rules you did not follow, and whose<note placement="foot">Hebrew “my”</note> regulations you did not do, but according to the regulations of the nations that are around you, you acted.” ’<note placement="foot">Or “did”</note>  <div eID="gen22467" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9494"/><div sID="gen22468" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9494"/>And it happened <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as I was prophesying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at my prophesying”</note> Pelatiahu the son of Benaiahu died! And I fell on my face, and I cried <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a loud voice, and I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh, you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> making <transChange type="added">a</transChange> complete destruction <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the remnant of Israel!”

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:14
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:15
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> your brothers, your brothers, the men of your redemption, and all of the house of Israel, all of it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who said concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “which they said concerning them the inhabitants of Jerusalem”</note> ‘They are far from Yahweh, <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> to us this land was given as a possession.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:16
verses.text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Though I have removed them <transChange type="added">far away</transChange> among the nations and though I have scattered them among the countries, yet I was a sanctuary to them <transChange type="added">for a</transChange> little while in the countries <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to which they have gone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “which they came there”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:17
verses.text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “And I will assemble you from the peoples, and I will gather you from the countries <transChange type="added">to</transChange> which you were scattered among them, and I will give the land of Israel to you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:18
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> they come there, then they will remove all of its vile idols and all of its detestable things from it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:19
verses.text: And I will give to them one heart, and a new spirit I will give<note placement="foot">Or “put”</note> in their inner parts. And I will remove their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> heart of stone from their body, and I will give to them a heart of flesh,

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:20
verses.text: so that they may walk in my statutes, and they will keep my regulations, and they will do them, and they will be to me a people, and I myself will be to them as God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:21
verses.text: But to<note placement="foot">Or “and to”</note> the heart of their abominations and the detestable things their heart is going. I will bring their way on their head,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.’ ”  <div eID="gen22468" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9495"/><div sID="gen22469" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9495"/>Then<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> the cherubim lifted up their wings, and their<note placement="foot">Or “the”</note> wheels were beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was over them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from to above”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:23
verses.text: And the glory of Yahweh went up from the midst of the city, and it stood <transChange type="added">still</transChange> on the mountain that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to the east of the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:24
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Spirit lifted me up, and it brought me to Chaldea, to the exiles,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> in the vision by the spirit of God; and the vision that I had seen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞left me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “went up from being upon me”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:25
verses.text: And I spoke to the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> all of the words of Yahweh that he had shown me.  <chapter eID="Ezek.11"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9496"/><title type="x-s">The Announcement of the Imminent Coming of the Exile</title> <div sID="gen22470" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9496"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> you are dwelling in the midst of the house of rebellion <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who has eyes to see and they do not see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “which eyes are for them to see and not they see”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they have ears to hear⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “ears are for them to hear”</note> and they do not hear, for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a house of rebellion.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:3
verses.text: And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> prepare for yourself<note placement="foot">Hebrew “you”</note> the baggage of an exile, and go into exile by day before their eyes. And you must go into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> exile from your place to another place before their eyes; perhaps they will see that they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a house of rebellion.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:4
verses.text: And you must bring out your baggage like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> baggage of an exile by day before their eyes, and you must go out in the evening before their eyes like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who go into exile⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “like the goers out of an exile”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:5
verses.text: Before their eyes dig through for yourself,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “you”</note> through the wall, and you must bring <transChange type="added">the baggage</transChange> out through it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:6
verses.text: Before their eyes, on your<note placement="foot">Literally “the”</note> shoulder, you must lift up <transChange type="added">the baggage</transChange> in the dusk, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> your face you must cover, so that you may not see the land, for I make you <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a sign to the house of Israel.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:7
verses.text: And I did <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “so as that”</note> I was commanded; my baggage, like the baggage of an exile, I brought out by day, and in the evening I dug through for myself<note placement="foot">Hebrew “me”</note> into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> the wall with my hand in the dusk; I brought <transChange type="added">the baggage</transChange> on <transChange type="added">my</transChange> shoulder; I carried <transChange type="added">it</transChange> before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:8
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me in the morning, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:9
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> did not they, the house of Israel, the house of rebellion, say to you, ‘What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you doing?’

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:10
verses.text: Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “This oracle <transChange type="added">is about</transChange> the prince in Jerusalem and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the entire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of”</note> house of Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who are among them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.” ’<note placement="foot">Literally “which they are in the midst of them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:11
verses.text: Say, ‘I am your sign, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> I did, so will it be done to them in the exile; into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> captivity they will go.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:12
verses.text: And the prince who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the midst of them, on <transChange type="added">his</transChange> shoulder he will carry <transChange type="added">the baggage</transChange> in the dusk, and<note placement="foot">Or “in the dusk he will go out”</note> he will go out; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the wall will be dug through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “through the wall they will dig”</note> to bring him through it; and he will cover his face so that he will<note placement="foot">Or “may”</note> not see the land with his<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> eye.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:13
verses.text: And I will spread out my net on him, and he will be captured in my hunting snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans, but he will not see it, and there he will die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:14
verses.text: And all who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> around him, his help<note placement="foot">Or “support”</note> and all of his troops I will scatter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in every direction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to every direction of the wind”</note> and I will draw<note placement="foot">Or “unsheathe”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword behind them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:15
verses.text: And they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when I scatter them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at my scattering them”</note> among the nations and I scatter them in the countries.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:16
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> I will spare from them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a few men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “men of number”</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> famine and from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> plague, so that they may tell of all their abominations among the nations <transChange type="added">to</transChange> which they will go, and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen22470" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9497"/><div sID="gen22471" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9497"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:18
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> you must eat your food with trembling, and your water with shuddering, and with anxiety you must drink.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:19
verses.text: And you must say to the people of the land, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh to the inhabitants of Jerusalem about the land of Israel: “They will eat their food with anxiety and their water they will drink with horror, because their land will be desolate from<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> its fullness because of all the violence of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who are dwelling in it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones dwelling in it”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:20
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the inhabited cites will be desolate⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the being inhabited cities they will be desolate”</note> and the land will be a desolation, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen22471" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9498"/><div sID="gen22472" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9498"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:22
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> what is this proverb <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you people have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to you”</note> about the land of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to you”</note> ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The days are prolonged⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they are long the days”</note> and every vision has come to nothing.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:23
verses.text: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “I will put an end <transChange type="added">to</transChange> this proverb, and they will not quote it as a proverb again in Israel.” ’ But<note placement="foot">Hebrew “But if”</note> say to them, ‘The days are near, and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> the word of every vision.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:24
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there</transChange> will not be any longer <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any false vision⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “every vision of falseness”</note> or flattering divination in the midst of the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:25
verses.text: For I, Yahweh, I will speak what I will speak <transChange type="added">as a</transChange> word, and it will be done. It will not prolong <transChange type="added">itself</transChange> any longer, for in your days, house of rebellion, I will speak a word and I will fulfill it!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:26
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:27
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> look! The house of Israel <transChange type="added">is</transChange> saying, ‘The vision that he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> seeing <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for many days <transChange type="added">from now</transChange>, and for distant times he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> prophesying.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:28
verses.text: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “None of my words will <transChange type="added">be</transChange> prolonged any longer that I speak <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a word, and it will be fulfilled!” ’ ” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.12"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9499"/><title type="x-s">Condemnation of False Prophets</title> <div sID="gen22473" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9499"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> prophesy to<note placement="foot">Or “against”</note> the prophets of Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who are prophesying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones prophesying”</note> and you must say to those who are prophets out of their own <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞imagination⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> ‘Hear the word of Yahweh!’

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:3
verses.text: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Alas, for the foolish prophets who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> going after their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> spirit, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and they did not see anything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “and not they saw”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:4
verses.text: Your prophets have been like foxes<note placement="foot">Or “jackals”</note> among ruins.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:5
verses.text: You did not go up into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> the breaches and repair a wall for the house of Israel to stand <transChange type="added">firm</transChange> in the battle on the day of Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:6
verses.text: They saw falseness and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a lying divination⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a divination of a lie”</note> the ones saying, ‘Declaration of Yahweh!’ and Yahweh did not send them, and they wait <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the confirmation of their word⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to confirm a word”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:7
verses.text: Have you not seen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a false vision⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “vision of falseness”</note> and spoken a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞lying divination⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “divination of a lie”</note> and you said, ‘Declaration of Yahweh!’ but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself did not speak⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “I not I spoke”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:8
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because of your speaking falseness and <transChange type="added">because</transChange> you envisioned a lie, therefore, look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against you!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:9
verses.text: “And it will be my hand against the prophets who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> seeing falseness and who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> practicing lying divination. They will not be in the council of my people, and they will not be written <transChange type="added">down</transChange> in the record <transChange type="added">book</transChange> of the house of Israel, and into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> the land of Israel they will not come, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:10
verses.text: Because, yes, because they led my people astray, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Peace!’ And there is not peace. And when anyone<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> builds a flimsy wall, look, they coat it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> whitewash.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:11
verses.text: Say to <transChange type="added">those</transChange> covering <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> whitewash that it will fall; there will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a torrent of rain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “rain flooding”</note> and I will give stones of hail; they will fall!<note placement="foot">Or “and I will give great hailstones. They will fall”</note> And a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞windstorm⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wind of a storm”; or “with respect/concerning you stones of hail, they will fall”</note> will burst forth!

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:12
verses.text: And look! <transChange type="added">When</transChange> the wall falls, will it not be said to you, ‘Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the whitewash <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which you covered <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?’

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:13
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I will let burst forth a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞windstorm⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a wind of storm”</note> in my rage, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there will be a torrent of rain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “rain flooding there will be”</note> in my anger, and hailstones in my rage <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for complete destruction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to complete destruction”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:14
verses.text: And I will break down the wall that you covered <transChange type="added">with</transChange> whitewash, and I will knock it to the ground, and its foundation will be revealed, and it will fall, and you will come to an end in the midst of it, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh!

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:15
verses.text: And I will fully vent my rage against the wall and against those covering it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> whitewash, and I will say to you, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The wall is no more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “not is the wall”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the people covering it are no more⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “not are the people whitewashing him”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, the prophets of Israel, the ones prophesying concerning Jerusalem and the ones seeing visions of peace, and there is not peace!’ ” ” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22473" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9500"/><div sID="gen22474" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9500"/>“And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> place your face toward the daughters of your people who prophesy from their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞imagination⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> and prophesy against them!

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:18
verses.text: And you must say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Woe to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who sew⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the sewers of”</note> magic charm bands on all the wrists<note placement="foot">Or “joints”</note> of the hands of my people and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who make the veils⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the makers of the veils”</note> that are on the head of people of every height, to ensnare people’s lives!<note placement="foot">Or “souls”</note> Will you ensnare the lives<note placement="foot">Or “souls”</note> of my people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and keep yourselves alive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “and lives/souls for you, you keep alive”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:19
verses.text: And you defiled me among my people for a handful of barley and for morsels of bread to kill persons who should not die and to keep alive persons who should not live by <transChange type="added">means of</transChange> your lies to my people <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> listening to <transChange type="added">your</transChange> lies.” ’<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:20
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Look! I am against your magic charm bands <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with which you are ensnaring persons⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which you are ensnaring with them the souls/individuals”</note> as birds; I will tear them from your arms, and I will release the persons that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> ensnaring, <transChange type="added">treating</transChange> persons as birds.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:21
verses.text: And I will tear off your veils, and I will deliver my people from your hand, and they will not any longer be in your hand as prey, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:22
verses.text: Because <transChange type="added">you</transChange> disheartened <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous <transChange type="added">by</transChange> deception, and I have not<note placement="foot">Or “did not”</note> caused him pain, and strengthened the hands of the wicked so that he did not turn<note placement="foot">Or “not to turn”</note> from his wicked way to save his life.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:23
verses.text: Therefore falseness<note placement="foot">Or “vanity” or “vain/false visions”</note> you will not see,<note placement="foot">Or “observe”</note> and divination you will not practice<note placement="foot">Or “you will indeed not practice divination”</note> any longer, and I will rescue my people from your hand, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh!’ ”  <chapter eID="Ezek.13"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9501"/><title type="x-s">Condemnation of Israel’s Idolatrous Elders</title> <div sID="gen22475" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9501"/>And men from the elders of Israel came to me, and they sat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:2
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:3
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> these men took up their idols into their heart and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they placed before themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they gave before their faces”</note> a stumbling block of their guilt.<note placement="foot">Or “iniquity”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Should I really let myself be consulted by them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “Surely I will let me be consulted by them?”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:4
verses.text: Therefore speak with them, and you must say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Every person from the house of Israel who brings up his idols into his heart and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞places before himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they gave before their faces”</note> a stumbling block of his guilt<note placement="foot">Or “iniquity”</note> and yet he comes to the prophet, I Yahweh, I will respond to him through this act<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> with respect to the multitude<note placement="foot">According to the <hi type="italic">Kethib</hi>; the <hi type="italic">Qere</hi> reads “I will respond to him, he who comes with the multitude of his idols”</note> of his idols,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:5
verses.text: so that <transChange type="added">I may</transChange> take hold of the house of Israel by their heart, <transChange type="added">those</transChange> who are estranged from me, all of them, through their idols.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:6
verses.text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Return,<note placement="foot">Or “Repent”</note> and turn away from your idols and from all of your detestable things! Turn away your faces!” ’

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:7
verses.text: For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man, a man” or “each one, each one”</note> from the house of Israel, and from the alien who dwells as an alien in Israel, who separates himself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from following me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from behind me”</note> and brings up his idols into his heart and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞places before himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he puts beside his face”</note> a stumbling block of his guilt<note placement="foot">Or “iniquity”</note>, and yet he comes to the prophet to consult him concerning me, I Yahweh will answer<note placement="foot">Or “am answering”</note> him myself.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:8
verses.text: And I will set my face against that person, and I will make him to<note placement="foot">Or “as”</note> be a sign and make him into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> <transChange type="added">the subject of</transChange> proverbs; and I will cut him off from the midst of my people, and you will know I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:9
verses.text: And the prophet, if he is deceived and he speaks a word, I Yahweh, I have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand against him, and I will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:10
verses.text: And they will bear their guilt, like<note placement="foot">Or “as”</note> the guilt of the inquirer so<note placement="foot">Or “like”</note> the guilt of the prophet will be,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:11
verses.text: so that the house of Israel will not go astray again <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from behind me”</note> and they will not make themselves unclean again with all of their transgressions, and they will be for me a people, and I will be for them as God,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22475" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9502"/><title type="x-s">Jerusalem will not be Spared</title> <div sID="gen22476" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9502"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:13
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> when a land sins against me by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞acting very unfaithfully⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “acting unfaithfully doing infidelity”</note> then I will stretch out my hand against it, and I will break for it the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞supply of food⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “staff of bread”</note> and I will send against it famine, and I will cut it off, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> human and animal.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:14
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">even</transChange> the three of these men were in the midst of it—Noah, Daniel, and Job—they, through their righteousness, would save <transChange type="added">only</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!”<note placement="foot">Literally “their souls”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:15
verses.text: “If a fierce animal I <transChange type="added">should</transChange> let cross through the land, and it <transChange type="added">should</transChange> make it childless and it will be <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation, so that <transChange type="added">there will</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> one crossing over <transChange type="added">the land</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞due to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of”</note> the presence of the animal,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">even if</transChange> these three men <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the midst of it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as surely as I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “surely they will not save sons and daughters; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they themselves alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they to alone them”</note> they will be saved, but the land will be <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:17
verses.text: Or, if I bring a sword over that land, and I say, ‘Sword, let it cross over into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> the land!’ And I will cut off from it <transChange type="added">both</transChange> human and animal.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:18
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">if</transChange> these three men <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the midst of it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as surely as I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “they will not save sons and daughters, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they to alone them”</note> will be saved.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:19
verses.text: And if I <transChange type="added">were to</transChange> send a plague to that land, and I pour out my rage on it with blood to cut it off, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> human and animal,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:20
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> Noah, Daniel, and Job <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the midst of her, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as surely as I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “surely not a son, surely not a daughter will they save by their righteousness; they would save <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “their souls”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:21
verses.text: For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “How much more when I send my four punishments—the evil sword, and famine, and <transChange type="added">a</transChange> fierce animal, and a plague—to Jerusalem to cut it off, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> human and animal!

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:22
verses.text: But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> look! A remnant will be left over in it, sons and daughters <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who will be brought out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones being brought out”</note> Look! They are coming out to you, and you will see their way, and with their deeds you will be consoled with respect to<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for”</note> the evil that I brought over Jerusalem, all of it that I brought over<note placement="foot">Or “upon”</note> it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:23
verses.text: And they will console you when you see their way and their deeds, and you will know that not for nothing I did all that I did in it,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.14"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9503"/><title type="x-s">Jerusalem a Useless Vine</title> <div sID="gen22477" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9503"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:2
verses.text: “Son of man, how will the wood of the vine be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞better than⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “more than”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any of the wood of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of the wood of”</note> the branch which is among the trees of the forest?<note placement="foot">Or “wood”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:3
verses.text: Can wood be taken from it to make anything, or can they take a tent peg from it to hang on it any object?<note placement="foot">Or “vessel”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:4
verses.text: Look! It is given to the fire as fuel. The fire will consume two of its ends, and its middle will be charred. Is it useful for anything?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:5
verses.text: Look! <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When it is in perfect condition⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “In being it perfect”</note> it will not be used for anything, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how much less⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “indeed”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the fire has consumed it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for if fire has consumed it”</note> and it is charred; and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> can it be used again for anything?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:6
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Just like⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “As that”</note> the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest<note placement="foot">Or “wood”</note> which I gave to the fire for fuel, so I have given the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:7
verses.text: And I will set my face against them. From the fire they <transChange type="added">may</transChange><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞escape⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “go out”</note> but the fire will yet consume them, and they will know that I am Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when I set my face against them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in to set me my face against them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:8
verses.text: And I will make the land <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they acted very unfaithfully⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!”<note placement="foot">Literally “they displayed infidelity”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.15"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9504"/><title type="x-s">God’s Covenant Grace to Unfaithful and Rebellious Israel</title> <div sID="gen22478" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9504"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> make known to Jerusalem its detestable things,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:3
verses.text: and you must say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh to Jerusalem: Your origin and your birth <transChange type="added">were</transChange> from the land of the Canaanites,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Canaanite”</note> your father <transChange type="added">was</transChange> an Amorite, and your mother <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a Hittite.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> your birth, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the day you were born⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the day of being born you”</note> your umbilical cord was not cut, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you were not thoroughly washed clean with water⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with water not you were cleansed for cleansing”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you were not thoroughly rubbed with salt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “being rubbed with salt you were not rubbed with salt”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you were not carefully wrapped in strips of cloth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “being wrapped in strips of cloth not you were wrapped in strips of cloth”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:5
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞No eye took pity on you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not took pity on you an eye”</note> to do to you one of these things to show compassion for you, and you were thrown <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞into the open field⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of the field”</note> in their despising of you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the day you were born⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on the day of being born you”</note>  <div eID="gen22478" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9505"/><div sID="gen22479" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9505"/>“ ‘And I passed by you, and I saw you kicking about in your blood, and I said to you in your blood, “Live!

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:7
verses.text: Grow up;<note placement="foot">Or “A myriad I have made you”</note> I will make you like a plant of the field.” And you grew up, and you became tall and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞reached full womanhood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “ornament of ornaments”</note> <transChange type="added">Your</transChange> breasts were formed, and your hair had grown, but you <transChange type="added">were</transChange> naked and bare.  <div eID="gen22479" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9506"/><div sID="gen22480" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9506"/>“ ‘And I passed by you, and I saw you, and look, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your time of lovemaking had come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “your time was the time of lovemaking”</note> and so I spread out my hem over you, and I covered your nakedness, and I swore to you, and I entered into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> a covenant with you,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, ‘and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you became mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and you were to me”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:9
verses.text: And I washed you with water, and I rinsed off your blood from on you, and I anointed you with oil.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:10
verses.text: And I clothed you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> beautiful finished cloth, and I put sandals <transChange type="added">on</transChange> you <transChange type="added">of</transChange> fine leather, and I bound you in fine linen, and I covered you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> costly fabric.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:11
verses.text: And I adorned you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> ornaments,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ornament”</note> and I put a bracelet on your arms and a necklace on your neck.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:12
verses.text: And I put an ornamental ring on your nose and earrings on your ears and a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beautiful crown⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a crown of splendor”</note> on your head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:13
verses.text: And you adorned yourself with gold and silver, and your clothing <transChange type="added">was</transChange> fine linen and costly fabric and beautiful finished cloth; you ate finely milled flour and honey and olive oil, and you became exceedingly beautiful; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you were fit to be a queen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you could succeed to queenship”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:14
verses.text: And a name went out for you among the nations because of your beauty, for it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> perfect because of my majesty that I bestowed on you,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:15
verses.text: ‘And you trusted in your beauty, and you prostituted on account of your name, and you poured out your fornication on every <transChange type="added">one</transChange> passing by, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, “Let it be his.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:16
verses.text: And you took from your clothes and you made for yourself colorful<note placement="foot">Or “gaudy”</note> shrines, and you prostituted on them; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this had not happened before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Not were happening”</note> and it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will not continue to happen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and not it will be”; Hebrew text unclear</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:17
verses.text: And you took <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your beautiful jewelry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the jewelry of splendor”</note> made from my gold and from my silver that I had given to you, and you made for yourself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞male images⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “images of a male”</note> and you prostituted with them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:18
verses.text: And you took the clothes of your beautiful finished cloth, and you covered them and my oil and my incense you set <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:19
verses.text: And my bread that I gave to you, finely milled flour and oil and honey <transChange type="added">with which</transChange> I fed you, then you set it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of them”</note> as a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pleasing odor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a scent of an incense”</note> and so it was,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:20
verses.text: ‘And you took your sons and your daughters whom you had borne for me, and you sacrificed them to them to be eaten,<note placement="foot">Or “consumed”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as if your whorings were not enough⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it was too little from your whorings”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:21
verses.text: And you slaughtered my children, and you gave them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to be sacrificed to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to cause them to cross over to them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:22
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">in</transChange> all of your detestable things and your fornication you did not remember the days of your childhood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you were naked and bare⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at your being naked and bare”</note> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> you were kicking about in your blood.  <div eID="gen22480" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9507"/><div sID="gen22481" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9507"/>“ ‘And then after all of your evil! Woe, woe, to you!’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:24
verses.text: ‘And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> you built for yourself a mound, and you made for yourself a high place in every public square.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:25
verses.text: At <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head of every street you built your high place and you disgraced your beauty and you spread your feet for every passerby, and you increased your whoring.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:26
verses.text: And you prostituted with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Egyptians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Egypt”</note> your neighbors <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who were sexually aroused⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “those being great of flesh”</note> and you increased your fornication to provoke me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:27
verses.text: And look!
