I stretched out my hand against you, and I reduced your portion, and I gave you into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> the desire of your haters, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed because of your lewd <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞conduct⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “your way of life”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:28
verses.text: And you prostituted with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Assyrians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Assyria”</note> on account of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your insatiable lust⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “of no your satisfaction”</note> and you prostituted <transChange type="added">with</transChange> them, and still you were not satisfied.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:29
verses.text: And you increased your fornication to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of traders,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “trader”</note> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Chaldea, and even with this you were not satisfied.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:30
verses.text: How hot with fever <transChange type="added">was</transChange> your heart!’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh. ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When you did⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at/in you to do”</note> all of these actions <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of a headstrong female prostitute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “deeds of a woman prostituting domineering”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:31
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you built⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at/in building your”</note> your mound at the head of every street and your high place you made on every street, yet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> you were<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> not like a prostitute, <transChange type="added">as you were</transChange> scorning <transChange type="added">your</transChange> harlot’s wages.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:32
verses.text: O, adulterous woman! In the place of her husband she received strangers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:33
verses.text: To all prostitutes they give a fee, but you, you gave your gifts to all of your lovers, and you bribed them to come to you from all around in your whorings!

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:34
verses.text: And it was the opposite with you from the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> women in your whorings; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no one solicited you as a prostitute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and after you not he solicited a prostitute”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You gave⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And at your giving”</note> a harlot’s wages, and <transChange type="added">a</transChange> harlot’s wages <transChange type="added">were</transChange> not given to you, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> it was <transChange type="added">just</transChange> the opposite.  <div eID="gen22481" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9508"/><div sID="gen22482" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9508"/>“ ‘Therefore, prostitute, hear the word of Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:36
verses.text: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because of the pouring out of your shame and <transChange type="added">because</transChange> your nakedness was revealed in your whoring with your lovers, and on account of all of the idols of your detestable things, and according to the blood of your children whom you gave to them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:37
verses.text: therefore, look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> gathering all of your lovers <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whom you were pleased about⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “whom you were pleased about them”</note> and all of whom you loved in addition to all of whom you hated, and I will gather them against you from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everywhere⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all around”</note> and I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> uncover your nakedness to them, and they will see all of your nakedness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:38
verses.text: And I will judge you <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> judgment of <transChange type="added">women</transChange> committing adultery and shedding blood, and I will give you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blood of rage and jealousy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:39
verses.text: And I will give you into their hand, and they will demolish your mound, and they will break down your high places, and they will strip you of your clothes, and they will take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your beautiful jewelry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the objects of your splendor”</note> and they will leave you naked and bare.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:40
verses.text: And they will bring up against you a crowd, and they will stone you with stones,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “stone”</note> and they will cut you to pieces with their swords.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:41
verses.text: And they will burn your houses with fire, and they will execute against you judgments <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the eyes of”</note> many women, and I will stop you from prostitution, and also a harlot’s wages you will not give<note placement="foot">Or “pay”</note> again.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:42
verses.text: And I will satisfy my rage on you, and my jealousy will turn away from you, and I will be calm, and I will not be angry <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:43
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because that”</note> you did not remember<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>) with BHS</note> the days of your childhood and you made me angry with all of these. And in turn I, look, I will return your way upon your head,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, ‘and did<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>); cf. BHS</note> you not do wickedness<note placement="foot">Literally “the wickedness”</note> in addition to all of your detestable things?

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:44
verses.text: Look! Everyone quoting a proverb<note placement="foot">Literally “proverbing a proverb”</note> against you, he will quote, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Like her mother <transChange type="added">is</transChange> her daughter!’

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:45
verses.text: You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a daughter of your mother <transChange type="added">who</transChange> abhorred her husband and her children, and you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a sister of your sisters who abhorred their husbands and their children. Your mother <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a Hittite, and your father <transChange type="added">was</transChange> an Amorite.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:46
verses.text: And your elder sister, she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Samaria, and her daughters, <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> dwelling on your north, and your younger sister <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the one dwelling on your south; <transChange type="added">she</transChange> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Sodom and her daughters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:47
verses.text: And you have not <transChange type="added">only</transChange> gone in their ways, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you also did according to their detestable things. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞In such a short time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as few little and”</note> you behaved <transChange type="added">more</transChange> corruptly than they in all of your ways.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:48
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As surely as I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,’<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely your sister Sodom and her daughters did not do as<note placement="foot">Hebrew “as that”</note> you and your daughters did.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:49
verses.text: Look! This was the iniquity of Sodom, your sister: Pride, abundance of food, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞prosperous ease⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and ease of granting relief”</note> was to her and to her daughters, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she did not sustain the needy and the poor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “And the hand of the needy and the poor not she did take hold of”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:50
verses.text: And they were proud, and they did a detestable thing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> and I removed them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> I saw <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:51
verses.text: And Samaria did not sin <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to even half of your sins⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “about/as/like the half of sins your not did she sin”</note> and you caused your detestable things to increase more than they, and you made your sister righteous in comparison with all of your detestable things that you did.<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>); cf. BHS</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:52
verses.text: Also,<note placement="foot">Or “indeed”</note> you bear your disgrace, by which you furnished justification to your sisters<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sister”</note> through your sins by which you acted more abominably than they; they were more righteous than you, and also,<note placement="foot">Or “indeed”</note> you be ashamed and bear your disgrace through your making your sister righteous.  <div eID="gen22482" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9509"/><div sID="gen22483" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9509"/>And I will restore their fortune, the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters, and the fortunes of Samaria and her daughters, and <transChange type="added">even</transChange> the fortunes of your captivity in the midst of them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:54
verses.text: in order that you may bear your disgrace and you may be put to shame because of all that you did at your consoling them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:55
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, they will return to their former state, and Samaria and her daughters, they will return to their former state, and you and your daughters will return to your former state.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:56
verses.text: And was not Sodom, your sister, a byword in your mouth in the day of your pride

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:57
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at not yet”</note> your evil was uncovered? <transChange type="added">It was</transChange> like the time of the scorn of the daughters of Aram and all <transChange type="added">those</transChange> around her, and of the daughters of the Philistines, those all around who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> despising you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:58
verses.text: Your wickedness and your detestable things, you, you must bear them,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:59
verses.text: ‘For thus says the Lord Yahweh: And I will do it<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to what you have done⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as that you have done”</note> who despised <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oath to break covenant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:60
verses.text: And I, I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish with you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a covenant of eternity”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:61
verses.text: And you will remember your ways, and you will be ashamed when you take your sisters, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞both the older and the younger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the older from you to the younger from you”</note> and I give them to you as daughters, but not on account of your covenant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:62
verses.text: And I, I will establish my covenant with you, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:63
verses.text: in order that you will remember, and you will be ashamed, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not open your mouth again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not it will be again an opening of mouth”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of”</note> your disgrace when I forgive you for all that you have done!’ ” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.16"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9510"/><title type="x-s">Parable of Two Eagles and a Vine</title> <div sID="gen22484" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9510"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> tell a riddle and quote a proverb to the house of Israel,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:3
verses.text: and you must say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The great eagle with great wings and long feathers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the eagle the great great of the wings long of the feather”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞full of variegated plumage⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “full of the plumage which is for him the variegated”</note> came to Lebanon and he took the treetop of the cedar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:4
verses.text: He plucked the top of its new plant shoot, and he brought it to the land of Canaan <transChange type="added">and</transChange> put it in a city of merchants,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:5
verses.text: and he took from the seed of the land and placed it in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fertile soil⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a field of seed”</note> on<note placement="foot">Or “by”</note> many waters; <transChange type="added">like</transChange> a willow he planted it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:6
verses.text: And it sprouted, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it became a vine spreading out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he was to vine spreading out”</note> low of height, turning its branches to him, and its roots were under it, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it became a vine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and it was to a vine”</note> and it made<note placement="foot">Or “sprouted”</note> branches, and it sent out foliage.  <div eID="gen22484" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9511"/><div sID="gen22485" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9511"/>“ ‘ “And there was another great eagle, great of wings and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> abundant plumage, and look! This vine stretched out its roots toward him and extended its branches to him to water it from the garden bed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where it was planted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from the garden bed of its planting”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:8
verses.text: It was planted in<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> a good field by<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> many waters<note placement="foot">Hebrew “water”</note> to produce branches<note placement="foot">Hebrew “branch”</note> and to bear fruit to become<note placement="foot">Hebrew “be”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a beautiful vine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.” ’<note placement="foot">Literally “to a vine of splendor”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:9
verses.text: Say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Will it prosper? Will he not tear out its roots, and will he not make its fruit scaly, and it will wither, and all of the freshness of its vegetation will dry up? And to lift it from its roots <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will not require great strength or many people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not with strong arm and with many people”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:10
verses.text: And look! <transChange type="added">Though</transChange> it is planted, will it prosper? <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When the east wind strikes it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at striking her/it the wind of the east”</note> will it not dry up completely? On the garden bed of its vegetation it will dry up!” ’ ”  <div eID="gen22485" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9512"/><div sID="gen22486" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9512"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:12
verses.text: “Say now to the rebellious house of Israel, ‘Do you not know what these <transChange type="added">are</transChange>?’<note placement="foot">Or “mean”</note> Say, ‘Look! The king of Babylon will come to Jerusalem, and he will take its king and its officials, and he will bring<note placement="foot">Or “take”</note> them to himself,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:13
verses.text: And he took from the seed of the kingship, and he made with him a covenant, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he brought him under oath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and he brought him into oath”</note> and he took the rulers of the land,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:14
verses.text: so that <transChange type="added">they would</transChange> be a humble kingdom and not lift itself up to keep his covenant <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in order for it to stand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to standing her”; or “to let her stand”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:15
verses.text: But he rebelled against him by sending his messengers <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt to give to him horses and a large army. Will he succeed? Will he escape doing these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, and can he break <transChange type="added">the</transChange> covenant and escape?

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:16
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,’<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> in the place of the king <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who he was making”</note> him king, who despised his oath and who broke his covenant with him—in the midst of Babylon he will die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:17
verses.text: And not with a great army and with a great crowd will Pharaoh work<note placement="foot">Or “help/aid”</note> with him in the war, at the pouring out of a siege ramp and the building of siege works to destroy many lives.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:18
verses.text: And he despised <transChange type="added">the</transChange> oath to break covenant. And, look, he gave his hand <transChange type="added">in pledge</transChange>, and <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> he did all of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>. He will not escape.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:19
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> my oath that he despised and my covenant that he broke I will return upon his head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:20
verses.text: And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in my hunting net, and I will bring him <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Babylon, and I will enter into judgment with him there <transChange type="added">about</transChange> his infidelity that he displayed against me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:21
verses.text: And all of his choice troops, among all of his troops, they will fall by the sword, and <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> remaining,<note placement="foot">Or “left over”</note> they will be scattered to all <transChange type="added">the directions of the</transChange> wind, and you will know that I, Yahweh, I have spoken.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:22
verses.text: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘And I will take, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> I, from the treetop of the high cedar, and I will plant <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, from the head of its new plant shoot I will pluck a tender one, and I will plant <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> I, on a high and lofty mountain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:23
verses.text: On the height of the mountain of Israel I will plant <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and it will carry<note placement="foot">Or “bear”</note> branches,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “branch”</note> and it will bear fruit, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it will become a noble cedar⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he will be to a cedar noble”</note> and all of the birds of all wings<note placement="foot">Or “kinds”</note> will dwell under it in the shade of its branches.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:24
verses.text: And all of the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, I will bring low a high tree, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> I will exalt a low, fresh tree, and I will make a dry tree flourish. I, Yahweh, I have spoken, and I will do <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.’ ”  <chapter eID="Ezek.17"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9513"/><title type="x-s">God’s Just Treatment of Individuals, Both Righteous and Wicked</title> <div sID="gen22487" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9513"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:2
verses.text: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What do you mean by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “What is to you”</note> quoting this proverb about the land of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘The fathers, they ate unripe fruit, and the teeth of the child became blunt.’<note placement="foot">Or “dull,” set on edge”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:3
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “life I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, it will surely not any longer be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞appropriate for you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to you”</note> to quote this proverb in Israel!

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:4
verses.text: Look! <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞All lives are mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all of the lives are for me they”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The lives of father and son alike are mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Like the life of the father and like the life of the son is to me look”</note> The person<note placement="foot">Or “life,” or “soul”</note> sinning will die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:5
verses.text: And if a man is righteous and does justice and righteousness,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:6
verses.text: and on the mountains he <transChange type="added">does</transChange> not eat and he <transChange type="added">does</transChange> not lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, and the wife of his neighbor he <transChange type="added">does</transChange> not defile and he <transChange type="added">does</transChange> not approach a woman of<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> menstruation,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:7
verses.text: and he oppresses <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a person not”</note> and he returns a pledge for his loan <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and he commits no robbery⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “robbed things not he seized”</note> and he gives<note placement="foot">Or “shares”</note> his bread to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hungry and he covers a naked person <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a garment,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he does not charge interest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with the interest not he gives”</note> and he takes no usury, and he holds back<note placement="foot">Or “brings back”</note> his hand from injustice and he executes a judgment of fairness between <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞persons⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “man and man”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> in my statutes he goes about and my regulations he keeps,<note placement="foot">Or “watches”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞performing faithfully⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to do with with faithfulness”</note> —then he is righteous, and certainly he will live,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22487" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9514"/><div sID="gen22488" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9514"/>“And <transChange type="added">now</transChange> he has a son, a violent one, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who sheds blood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shedding of blood”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and does any of these things⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and he does like from one from these”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:11
verses.text: (though<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> he<note placement="foot">That is, the father</note> did not do all of these things), for the son also<note placement="foot">Or “even”</note> eats on the mountains and he defiles the wife of his neighbor.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:12
verses.text: He oppresses <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he commits robbery⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “robbed things he seized”</note> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> he <transChange type="added">does</transChange> not return <transChange type="added">a</transChange> pledge for a loan, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> he lifts his eyes to the idols <transChange type="added">so</transChange> he does a detestable thing.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:13
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He charges interest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with the interest he gives”</note> and takes usury. Then, shall he live? He shall not live, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> he did all of these detestable things. Surely he will die! His blood will be on him.  <div eID="gen22488" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9515"/><div sID="gen22489" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9515"/>“And look! He has a son, and he sees all of the sin of his father that he did, and he sees <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, but he does not <transChange type="added">do</transChange> it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:15
verses.text: On the mountains he does not eat, and he does not lift <transChange type="added">up</transChange> his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the wife of his neighbor he does not defile.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:16
verses.text: And he oppresses no one; he requires no pledge for a loan, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he does not commit robbery⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “robbed things not does he seize”</note> he gives his bread to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hungry, and he covers the naked person <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a garment.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:17
verses.text: He brings back<note placement="foot">Or “holds back”</note> his hand from iniquity;<note placement="foot">Cf. verse <reference osisRef="Ezek.18.8">8</reference></note> he does not take interest and usury; he does my regulations; he goes<note placement="foot">Or “walks”</note> in my statutes. He will not die because of the guilt of his father; he will surely live!

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:18
verses.text: Because his father <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞oppressed severely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “he oppressed oppression”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he stole from his brother⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “he seized robbed things of a brother”</note> that which is not good he did in the midst of his people, and look! He will die through<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> his guilt.  <div eID="gen22489" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9516"/><div sID="gen22490" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9516"/>“Yet<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you say, ‘Why <transChange type="added">does</transChange> the son not bear the guilt of the father?’ And <transChange type="added">since</transChange> the son does justice and righteousness and he keeps all of my statutes and does them, he shall surely live!

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:20
verses.text: The person,<note placement="foot">Or “soul,” or “life”</note> the one sinning, will die. A son shall not bear the guilt of the father, and a father shall not bear the guilt of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him; the wickedness of the wicked<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> shall be on him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:21
verses.text: But if the wicked returns from all of his sins<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> that he has done and he keeps all of my statutes and he does justice and righteousness, he shall surely live; he shall not die!

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:22
verses.text: All of his transgressions that he committed will not be remembered against<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> him. Through<note placement="foot">Or “By means of”</note> his righteousness that he has done he shall live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:23
verses.text: Have I delight by any means<note placement="foot">Or “in any way”</note> in the death of the wicked, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, and not at his turning from his way, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> he lives?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:24
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the righteous turns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at turning of the righteous”</note> from his righteousness, so that<note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> he does injustice, and does all of the detestable things that the wicked do, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> will he live because of all of his righteousness<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> that he did? Those things will not be remembered because of his infidelity that he displayed, and because of his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sin that he committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sin that he sinned”</note> Through<note placement="foot">Or “in/by”</note> them he shall die.  <div eID="gen22490" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9517"/><div sID="gen22491" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9517"/>“Yet<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair!’ Listen, now, house of Israel, is my way not fair? <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not your ways <transChange type="added">that</transChange> are not fair?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:26
verses.text: When the righteous turns from his righteousness, and he does injustice, then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he will die because of them; because of his injustice that he did he will die!

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:27
verses.text: And when the wicked turns from his wickedness that he did and he does justice and righteousness, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will preserve his life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his soul/life he will keep alive”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:28
verses.text: And if he sees and he returns from all of his transgressions that he did, surely he will live; he will not die!

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:29
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> they, the house of Israel, say, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair!’ <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> not my ways fair, house of Israel? <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Are not your ways unfair?⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not ways your not are right”</note>  <div eID="gen22491" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9518"/><div sID="gen22492" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9518"/>“Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, each one<note placement="foot">Hebrew “man”</note> according to his ways,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh. “Repent<note placement="foot">Or “Turn/Return”</note> and turn around from all of your transgression, and it will not be as a stumbling block of iniquity to you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:31
verses.text: Throw <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞away from yourselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from on you”</note> all of your transgressions that you committed,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “committed with them”</note> and make <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for yourselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to you”</note> a new heart and new spirit, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> why will you die, house of Israel?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:32
verses.text: For I have no pleasure in the death of the dying,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh. “And so repent<note placement="foot">Or “turn/return”</note> and live!”  <chapter eID="Ezek.18"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9519"/><title type="x-s">Lament for the Leaders of Israel</title> <div sID="gen22493" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9519"/>“And you, raise a lament about<note placement="foot">Or “over”</note> the leaders of Israel,

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:2
verses.text: and you must say, <div eID="gen22493" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22494"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22495"/>‘What a lioness <transChange type="added">was</transChange> your mother<l eID="gen22495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22496"/>among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lions.<l eID="gen22496" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22497"/>She lay down in the midst of young lions,<l eID="gen22497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22498"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> she reared her lion cubs. <l eID="gen22498" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9520"/><l level="1" sID="gen22499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9520"/>And she raised up one from her cubs;<l eID="gen22499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22500"/>he became a fierce lion,<l eID="gen22500" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22501"/>and he learned to tear prey;<l eID="gen22501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22502"/>he ate<note placement="foot">Or “devoured”</note> humans.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note> <l eID="gen22502" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9521"/><l level="1" sID="gen22503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9521"/>And nations heard about him;<l eID="gen22503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22504"/>in their pit he was caught,<l eID="gen22504" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22505"/>and they brought him with hooks<l eID="gen22505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22506"/>to the land of Egypt. <l eID="gen22506" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9522"/><l level="1" sID="gen22507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9522"/>And she saw<note placement="foot">Or “realized”</note> that she was waiting <transChange type="added">in vain</transChange>;<l eID="gen22507" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22508"/>her hope was destroyed,<l eID="gen22508" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22509"/>and she took one from her cubs,<l eID="gen22509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22510"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> she made him a fierce lion. <l eID="gen22510" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9523"/><l level="1" sID="gen22511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9523"/>And he walked about in the midst of lions;<l eID="gen22511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22512"/>he became a fierce lion,<l eID="gen22512" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22513"/>and he learned to tear prey;<l eID="gen22513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22514"/>he ate<note placement="foot">Or “devoured”</note> humans.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note> <l eID="gen22514" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9524"/><l level="1" sID="gen22515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9524"/>And he knew their widows,<note placement="foot">Or “ravished/raped”; or “he ravaged their strongholds”</note><l eID="gen22515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22516"/>and he devastated their cities,<l eID="gen22516" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22517"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land was appalled, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone in it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “its fullness”</note><l eID="gen22517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22518"/>at the sound of his roar. <l eID="gen22518" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9525"/><l level="1" sID="gen22519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9525"/>And nations set out against him<l eID="gen22519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22520"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from the surrounding provinces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all around from the provinces”</note><l eID="gen22520" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22521"/>and they spread their net over him,<l eID="gen22521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22522"/>and he was caught in their pit. <l eID="gen22522" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9526"/><l level="1" sID="gen22523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9526"/>And they put him in a collar with hooks,<l eID="gen22523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22524"/>and they brought him to the king of Babylon;<l eID="gen22524" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22525"/>they brought him into<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> a prison,<l eID="gen22525" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22526"/>so that his voice <transChange type="added">would</transChange> not be heard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any longer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “longer”</note><l eID="gen22526" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22527"/>on the mountains of Israel. <l eID="gen22527" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9527"/><l level="1" sID="gen22528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9527"/>Your mother <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like the vine in your vineyard;<note placement="foot">Or “in the vineyard”</note><l eID="gen22528" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22529"/>planted <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fruitfully⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fruitful”</note> beside water,<l eID="gen22529" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22530"/>and it was full of branches<l eID="gen22530" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22531"/>from many waters.<note placement="foot">Or “from waters abundant/many”</note> <l eID="gen22531" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9528"/><l level="1" sID="gen22532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9528"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she produced branches of strength⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they became to her branches/rods of strength”</note><l eID="gen22532" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22533"/>to<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> scepters of rulers;<l eID="gen22533" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22534"/>its height became tall<l eID="gen22534" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22535"/>between<note placement="foot">Or “among”</note> thick foliage,<l eID="gen22535" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22536"/>and it was seen<note placement="foot">Or “visible”</note> because of its tallness<l eID="gen22536" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22537"/>among the abundance of its branches. <l eID="gen22537" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9529"/><l level="1" sID="gen22538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9529"/>But it was uprooted in rage;<l eID="gen22538" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22539"/>it was thrown to the earth,<l eID="gen22539" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22540"/>and the east wind dried up its fruit;<l eID="gen22540" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22541"/>they were stripped off,<l eID="gen22541" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22542"/>and its strong branch dried up;<l eID="gen22542" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22543"/>fire consumed it. <l eID="gen22543" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9530"/><l level="1" sID="gen22544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9530"/>And now <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> planted in the desert,<l eID="gen22544" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22545"/>in a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞dry and thirsty land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a land of dryness and thirst”</note> <l eID="gen22545" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9531"/><l level="1" sID="gen22546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9531"/>And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> fire has gone out from the stem of its branches;<l eID="gen22546" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22547"/>its fruit it has consumed,<l eID="gen22547" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22548"/>and <transChange type="added">there</transChange> was not in it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a strong branch⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a branch of strength”</note><l eID="gen22548" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22549"/>a scepter for ruling.’ ”<l eID="gen22549" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22494"/> <div sID="gen22550" type="x-p"/> This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a lament, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it will be used as a lament⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “she is for a lament”</note>  <chapter eID="Ezek.19"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9532"/><title type="x-s">God’s Dealings with Israel for His Name’s Sake</title> <div sID="gen22551" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9532"/>And then in the seventh year, in the fifth <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, on the tenth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the month, men from the elders of Israel came to consult Yahweh, and they sat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:2
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:3
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> speak with the elders of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Are you coming to consult me? <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> I will surely not allow myself<note placement="foot">Or “me”</note> to be consulted by you!” ’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:4
verses.text: Will you judge them? Will you judge <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, son of man?<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> Make known to them the detestable things of their ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:5
verses.text: And you must say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “On the day of my choosing Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I swore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and I raised my hand”</note> to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and I made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I swore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and I raised my hand”</note> to them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:6
verses.text: On that day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I swore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I raised my hand”</note> to them to bring them out from the land of Egypt to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey—it <transChange type="added">is the most</transChange> beautiful of all of the lands.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:7
verses.text: Then I said to them, ‘<transChange type="added">Let</transChange> each <transChange type="added">one</transChange> throw away the detestable things of his eyes, and you must not make yourselves unclean with the idols of Egypt! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:8
verses.text: But they rebelled against me, and they were not willing to listen to me; each <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞did not throw away⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not they threw away”</note> the detestable things of their eyes; and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they did not abandon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not they abandoned”</note> the idols of Egypt, and I decided to pour out my rage on them, to fully vent my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.  <div eID="gen22551" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9533"/><div sID="gen22552" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9533"/>“But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> I acted for the sake of my name <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to keep it from being profaned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not to be profaned before the eyes of”</note> before the eyes of the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among whom they lived⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “which they were in their midst”</note> where I made known to them before their eyes, to bring them out from the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:10
verses.text: And I brought them out from the land of Egypt, and I brought them to the desert,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:11
verses.text: and I gave my statutes to them, and my regulations I made known to them, which, if a person does them, then he will live by them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:12
verses.text: And also my Sabbaths I gave to them to be a sign between me and between them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so they would know⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “know”</note> that I, Yahweh, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> sanctifying them.  <div eID="gen22552" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9534"/><div sID="gen22553" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9534"/>“But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> in the desert the house of Israel rebelled against me; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they did not walk in my statutes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in my statutes not they went”</note> and they rejected my regulations, which, if a person does them, he will live by them, and they greatly profaned my Sabbaths, and I decided to pour out my rage on them in the desert to destroy them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:14
verses.text: and I acted for the sake of my name, <transChange type="added">that it</transChange> not be profaned before the eyes of the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before whom I brought them out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “which I brought out them before their eyes”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:15
verses.text: And also <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself swore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I, I raised my hand”</note> to them in the desert not to bring them into the land that I had given <transChange type="added">to them</transChange>, flowing with milk and honey—it <transChange type="added">is the most</transChange> beautiful of all of the lands—

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:16
verses.text: because they despised my judgments, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they did not walk in my statutes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and my statutes not they went in them”</note> and my Sabbaths they profaned, for their heart was going after their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:17
verses.text: But my eye took pity on them by not destroying them, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I did not completely destroy them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not I make them complete destruction”</note> in the desert.  <div eID="gen22553" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9535"/><div sID="gen22554" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9535"/>“And I said to their children in the desert, ‘You must not go in the statutes of your parents;<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> you must not keep their regulations, and you must not make yourself unclean with their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:19
verses.text: I, Yahweh, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> your God, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> go in my statutes and keep my regulations and do them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:20
verses.text: And treat my Sabbaths as holy, and they will be a sign between me and between you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that you may know⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “know”</note> that I, Yahweh, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> your God.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:21
verses.text: But the children rebelled against me; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they did not walk in my statutes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in statutes my not they went”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they did not observe my regulations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “my regulations not they kept to do them”</note> which <transChange type="added">if</transChange> a person does them, then he will live by them. My Sabbaths they desecrated, and I decided to pour out my rage on them, to finish my anger against them in the desert.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:22
verses.text: But I withheld my hand, and I acted for the sake of my name not to be profaned before the eyes of the nations <transChange type="added">before</transChange> whom I <transChange type="added">had</transChange> brought them out before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:23
verses.text: What is more, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I swore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will raise my hand”</note> to them in the desert to scatter them among the nations and to disperse them in the lands,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:24
verses.text: because they did not <transChange type="added">do</transChange> my regulations, and my statutes they despised, and my Sabbaths they profaned, and their eyes were after the idols of their ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:25
verses.text: And in turn I gave to them rules <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> not good and regulations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by which they will not live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “regulations not they will live by them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:26
verses.text: And I defiled them through their gifts in sacrificing all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first offspring of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> womb, in order that<note placement="foot">Or “so that”</note> I will cause them to be stunned, so that they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22554" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9536"/><div sID="gen22555" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9536"/>“Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> and you must say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Again in this your ancestors blasphemed me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at<note placement="foot">Or “by”</note> their display of infidelity toward me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.” ’<note placement="foot">Literally “at/in acting unfaithfully they against me in/by unfaithfulness”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:28
verses.text: And I brought them to the land that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I swore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I raised my hand”</note> to give<note placement="foot">Hebrew “give it”</note> to them, and they saw every high hill and every leafy tree, and they offered their sacrifices, and they presented there the provocation of their offering, and they gave there their fragrant incense offering, and they poured out their libations there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:29
verses.text: And I said to them, ‘What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the high place<note placement="foot">Hebrew Bamah, which became its name</note> to which you are going?’ And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is called⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it is called name its”</note> Bamah until this day.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:30
verses.text: Therefore thus say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “In the way of your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> <transChange type="added">will</transChange> you defile yourself, and after their vile idols <transChange type="added">will</transChange> you prostitute <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:31
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you lift up your gifts, sacrificing your children⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at to lift up your gifts at causing to pass over your children”</note> through the fire, you are defiling yourself through all of your idols until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞today⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> and will I let myself<note placement="foot">Hebrew “me”</note> be consulted by you, house of Israel?” ’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “Live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “I will not let myself<note placement="foot">Hebrew “me”</note> be consulted by you!

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:32
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what you are planning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “what is going up on your spirit”</note> surely it will not be—that you are saying, ‘Let us be like the nations, like the clans<note placement="foot">Or “tribes”</note> of the lands, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞serving wood and stone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!’<note placement="foot">Literally “to serve wood and stone”</note>  <div eID="gen22555" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9537"/><div sID="gen22556" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9537"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rage pouring forth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “rage poured out”</note> I will reign as king over you!

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:34
verses.text: And I will bring you from the peoples, and I will gather you from the countries <transChange type="added">to</transChange> which you were scattered with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with rage poured out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:35
verses.text: Then I will bring you to the desert of the peoples, and I will execute justice on you there face to face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:36
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Like what”</note> I executed justice on your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> in the desert of the land of Egypt, likewise I will execute justice on you!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:37
verses.text: “And I will make you pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:38
verses.text: And I will purge the rebels from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> you and the <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> transgressing against me; I will bring them out from the land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where they are living as aliens⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the land of living as an alien there”</note> but into the land of Israel they will not come, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22556" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9538"/><div sID="gen22557" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9538"/>And you, house of Israel, thus says the Lord Yahweh: “<transChange type="added">Let</transChange> each one go serve his idols <transChange type="added">now</transChange> and after, if you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not listening to me, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the name of my holiness”</note> you will not profane <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer with your gifts and with your idols.  <div eID="gen22557" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9539"/><div sID="gen22558" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9539"/>“For on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of my holiness”</note> on the mountain of the height of Israel,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “there all of the house of Israel will serve me, all of them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it/him”</note> in the land. I will take pleasure in them, and there I will accept your contributions and the best of your portions with all of your holy objects.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:41
verses.text: I will accept you as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a fragrant incense offering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a fragrance of an incense offering”</note> when I bring you out from the peoples and I gather you from the lands <transChange type="added">to</transChange> which you were scattered, and I will show myself holy among you before the eyes of the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:42
verses.text: And you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when I bring you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/> to the land of Israel, to the land that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I swore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I raised my hand”</note> to give to your ancestors.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:43
verses.text: And you will remember there your ways, and all of your deeds <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by which you were made unclean⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “which you were made unclean by them”</note> and you will feel a loathing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for your face”</note> for all of your evils that you have done.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:44
verses.text: And you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when I deal with you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at/in doing my with you”</note> for the sake of my name and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞not according to your evil ways⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not like your ways the evil”</note> or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “like”</note> your corrupted deeds, house of Israel,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22558" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9540"/><div sID="gen22559" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9540"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Ezek.20.45-Ezek.21.32">Ezekiel 20:45–21:32 </reference>in the English Bible is 21:1–37 in the Hebrew Bible</note> And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:46
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> set your face toward the way of the south,<note placement="foot">Or “Teman”</note> and preach to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south, and prophesy against the forest of the territory of the Negev.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:47
verses.text: And you must say to the forest of the Negev, ‘Hear the word of Yahweh, thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I am kindling against you a fire, and it will devour in you every fresh tree and every dry tree; <transChange type="added">the</transChange> blaze of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flame will not be quenched, and all the surfaces from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north will be scorched by it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:48
verses.text: And all creatures will see that I, Yahweh, I kindled it—it will not be quenched!” ’ ”

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:49
verses.text: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh, they are saying about me, ‘<transChange type="added">Is</transChange> he not posing a parable?’ ”  <chapter eID="Ezek.20"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9541"/><title type="x-s">A Vision of the Avenging Sword of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen22560" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9541"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sanctuaries, and prophesy to the land of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:3
verses.text: And you must say to the land of Israel, ‘Thus says Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against you, and I will draw out my sword from its sheath, and I will cut <transChange type="added">off</transChange> from you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:4
verses.text: Because<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Because that”</note> I will cut off from you both righteous and wicked, therefore my sword will go out from its sheath to<note placement="foot">Or “against”</note> all creatures<note placement="foot">Hebrew “creature”</note> from south <transChange type="added">to</transChange> north.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:5
verses.text: And they will know, all creatures, that I, Yahweh, I will bring out my sword from its sheath; it will not return again!” ’

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:6
verses.text: And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> groan <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with shaking hips⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with destruction of loins”</note> and you must groan with bitterness before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:7
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it will be”</note> when they say to you, ‘On account of what are you groaning?’ then you must say, ‘On account of the report, for it is coming, and every heart will be weak and all hands will hang limp and every spirit will be disheartened, and all knees will go like water.’ Look! It is coming, and it will happen!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22560" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9542"/><div sID="gen22561" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9542"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:9
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> prophesy, and you must say, ‘Thus says the Lord,’ say, ‘A sword, a sword <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sharpened and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> also polished.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:10
verses.text: It is sharpened to slaughter a slaughter, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞polished to flash like lightning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “so that there be for her lightning”</note> Or will we rejoice?<note placement="foot">Or “be pleased”</note> A rod, my son, is despising every tree.<note placement="foot">Or “stick” of correction; Hebrew is uncertain in meaning here</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:11
verses.text: And he gives it to be polished, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to be seized by the hand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to take hold of in the palm of the hand”</note> It is sharpened—a sword—and it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> polished to give it into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> killer.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:12
verses.text: Cry and wail, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> for it is against my people; it is against all of the princes of Israel. They are thrown to the sword with my people; therefore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞strike your thigh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “strike on the thigh”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:13
verses.text: For <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞examine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “it was tested”</note> And what if also the rod will not be despising?’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:14
verses.text: And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> prophesy <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and clap your hands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “strike hand to hand”</note> And the sword will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞strike twice⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “be doubled”</note> let it happen a third time. It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sword of the dead, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword of the great dead that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> surrounding them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:15
verses.text: so that a heart melts, and the fallen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞multiply⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “be made many”</note> at all of their gates. I gave a sword for slaughter, and alas! It is made for flashing, it is grasped<note placement="foot">Or “polished”</note> for slaughtering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:16
verses.text: Gather together, strike to the right; cause <transChange type="added">to</transChange> go to the left, where your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞edge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “face”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> directed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:17
verses.text: And also <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I, I”</note> will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞clap my hands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “strike my hand to my hand”</note> and I will satisfy my rage! I, Yahweh, I have spoken.”  <div eID="gen22561" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9543"/><div sID="gen22562" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9543"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:19
verses.text: “And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> mark out for yourself<note placement="foot">Hebrew “you”</note> two roads for the coming of the sword of the king of Babylon; they must <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞both⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the two of them”</note> go out from the same land. And hew out a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞signpost⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> hew <transChange type="added">it</transChange> at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> road of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:20
verses.text: You must mark a road for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> coming of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Rabbah of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Judah, in Jerusalem <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fortified.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:21
verses.text: For the king of Babylon stands at the fork of the road at the head of the two roads to practice divination. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He shakes the arrows⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he casts the lot with the arrows” (cf. NASB, NRSV)</note> he inquires with the teraphim, he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞examines⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sees with”</note> the liver.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:22
