verses.text: In his right hand is the divination for Jerusalem, to put <transChange type="added">up</transChange> battering rams, to open <transChange type="added">a</transChange> mouth for slaughter,<note placement="foot">Or “open the mouth of Sheol”; or “give the command to slaughter” (cf. NRSV, NASB)</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to raise the battle cry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to raise a voice in shouting”</note> to put up battering rams against gates, to build a siege ramp, to build siege works.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “siege work”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:23
verses.text: And it will be to them like practicing divination falsely<note placement="foot">Or “in vain”</note> in their eyes; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they have sworn oaths for themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “swearers of oaths will be for them”</note> But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> he <transChange type="added">will</transChange> bring <transChange type="added">their</transChange> guilt to remembrance <transChange type="added">so as</transChange> to seize them.  <div eID="gen22562" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9544"/><div sID="gen22563" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9544"/>“Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because you have brought to remembrance your guilt by the uncovering of your transgressions, so that your sins in all of your deeds appear—because of your being remembered, you will be captured in the hand.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:25
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> you, profane one, wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> punishment of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:26
verses.text: thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Remove the turban and lift off the crown; things <transChange type="added">are</transChange> no longer the same. Exalt the low and bring low the high.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:27
verses.text: A ruin, a ruin, a ruin I will make it! Also<note placement="foot">Or “indeed”</note> this has not ever happened;<note placement="foot">Or “will not happen until” (cf. NASB and NRSV)</note> <transChange type="added">it will remain</transChange> until the coming of <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> whom the judgment belongs and I have given it <transChange type="added">to him</transChange>.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:28
verses.text: And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> prophesy, and you must say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> and concerning their disgrace,’ and you must say, ‘A sword, a sword is drawn for slaughtering; it is polished for holding, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for flashing like lightning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for the sake of lightening”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:29
verses.text: when seeing a false vision for you in vain, when practicing divination for you falsely, to give<note placement="foot">Or “place”</note> you on the neck of the profane ones of the wicked, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose day has come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “who has come their day”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the time of final punishment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the time of the punishment of the end”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:30
verses.text: Return it to its sheath in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> place where you were created. In the land of your origin I will judge you!

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:31
verses.text: And I will pour out my anger on you; I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and I will give you into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of brutal men, skilled craftsmen of destruction.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:32
verses.text: You will be as fuel for the fire; your blood will be in the midst of the earth. You will not be remembered, for I, Yahweh, I have spoken.’ ”  <chapter eID="Ezek.21"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9545"/><title type="x-s">Highlighting the Sins and the Judgments of Israel</title> <div sID="gen22564" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9545"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:2
verses.text: “And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> will you judge? Will you judge the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞bloody city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “city of blood”</note> Then you must make known <transChange type="added">to</transChange> her all of her detestable things!

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:3
verses.text: And you must say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “A city pouring out blood in the midst of her; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its time has come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to come time her its”</note> and it made idols for itself, becoming unclean.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:4
verses.text: By your blood that you poured out you have become guilty, and by your idols that you made you have become unclean, and you have brought your days near, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and your appointed years have come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and it came to years your”</note> Therefore I have made you a disgrace for the nations and a laughingstock to all of the countries.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:5
verses.text: The <transChange type="added">people</transChange> near and the <transChange type="added">people</transChange> far from you will make fun of you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the unclean and the terrified⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the unclean of the name the great of the panic”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:6
verses.text: Look! The princes of Israel, each <transChange type="added">one</transChange> according to his strength,<note placement="foot">Or “influence”</note> they are in you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the shedding of blood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to shedding of blood”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:7
verses.text: They have treated father and mother with contempt in you; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they violated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they did with extortion”</note> the alien with<note placement="foot">Or “by”</note> extortion; in the midst of you they mistreated <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan and widow.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:8
verses.text: You despised my holy objects; my Sabbaths you profaned.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:9
verses.text: Slanderous men are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in you”</note> to shed blood, and they, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in you”</note> eat upon the mountains; they do wickedness in the midst of you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:10
verses.text: They uncover <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nakedness of <transChange type="added">a</transChange> father among<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> you; they violate a woman unclean of menstruation among<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:11
verses.text: And a man does a detestable thing <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the wife of his neighbor, and a man defiles his daughter-in-law in wickedness, and a man sexually violates among<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> you his sister, the daughter of his father.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:12
verses.text: They take a bribe among<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> you in order to shed blood; and you take usury, and you make gain from your neighbors by extortion, and so you have forgotten me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:13
verses.text: And look! I strike my hand for your ill-gotten gain that you <transChange type="added">have</transChange> made and at your blood that was in the midst of you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:14
verses.text: Can your heart endure,<note placement="foot">Or “hold up”</note> or can your hands be strong at the days <transChange type="added">in</transChange> which I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> dealing with you? I, Yahweh, I have spoken, and I will act!

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:15
verses.text: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will disperse you through the countries, and I will purge your uncleanness from you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:16
verses.text: And I will be profaned by you before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen22564" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9546"/><div sID="gen22565" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9546"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:18
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> the house of Israel has become as silver dross to me; all of them <transChange type="added">are as</transChange> bronze and tin and iron and lead in the midst of a furnace, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> silver dross, silver <transChange type="added">dross</transChange> they became!

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:19
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because all of you have become <transChange type="added">as</transChange> silver dross, therefore look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> gathering you to the midst of Jerusalem,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:20
verses.text: like the gathering of silver and bronze and iron and lead and tin to the middle of a furnace to blow fire on it for melting. Thus I will gather in my anger and in my rage, and I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deposit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will put/place”</note> you, and I will melt you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:21
verses.text: And I will gather you, and I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I will melt <transChange type="added">you</transChange> in the midst of her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:22
verses.text: Thus you will be melted like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> melting of silver in the midst of a furnace, and you will know that I, Yahweh, I have poured out my rage on you.’ ”

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:23
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:24
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> say to her, ‘You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a land not cleansed; it is not rained upon <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of indignation.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:25
verses.text: The conspiracy of its prophets in the midst of her <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a roaring lion <transChange type="added">that</transChange> is tearing prey. They devour people, and they take wealth and treasure; they make its widows numerous in the midst of her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:26
verses.text: Its priests treat my law violently, and they profane my holy objects; they do not distinguish between <transChange type="added">a</transChange> holy object and what is unholy, or between the clean and the unclean. They do not teach the difference, and they hide their eyes from my Sabbaths, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I am profaned in the midst of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:27
verses.text: Its officials <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like wolves tearing prey in its midst, to pour out blood, to destroy people, to make dishonest gain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:28
verses.text: And for them its prophets plaster whitewash; <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> seeing falseness and <transChange type="added">are</transChange> practicing divination for them <transChange type="added">by</transChange> lying, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh,’ and Yahweh has not spoken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:29
verses.text: They severely oppress the people of the land, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they committed robbery⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and they seized a robbed things”</note> and they mistreated the needy and the poor, and they oppressed the alien <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with not”</note> justice.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:30
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I sought for them somebody, one repairing <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wall and standing in the breach <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> on behalf of the land not to destroy it, but I did not find <transChange type="added">anyone</transChange>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:31
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I poured out my indignation on them. With the fire of my wrath I destroyed them; I returned their way upon their head,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.22"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9547"/><title type="x-s">Oholah and Oholibah as Symbols of God’s Corrupt People</title> <div sID="gen22566" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9547"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> there were two women, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> daughters of one mother,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:3
verses.text: and they prostituted <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> in Egypt in their childhood; they were prostituting <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> there, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> their breasts were fondled, and there they caressed the bosoms of their virginity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:4
verses.text: Now <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> their names, the older <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Oholah, and Oholibah <transChange type="added">was</transChange> her sister. And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they became mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they were for me”</note> and they bore sons and daughters, and their names<note placement="foot">Hebrew “name”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> Samaria <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Oholah, and Jerusalem <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Oholibah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:5
verses.text: And Oholah prostituted <transChange type="added">herself</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞while she was still mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “under me”</note> and she lusted for her lovers, for Assyria <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> nearby,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:6
verses.text: clothed in blue cloth, governors and prefects, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞handsome young men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “young men of handsomeness/beauty”</note> and all of them horsemen, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞experts on horseback⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “riders of horsemen”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:7
verses.text: And she bestowed her fornication on them, <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the choice <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Assyrians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Assyria”</note> all of them, and with every one <transChange type="added">after</transChange> which she lusted; with all of their idols she defiled herself.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:8
verses.text: And her whorings from <transChange type="added">the time of</transChange> Egypt she <transChange type="added">did</transChange> not abandon, for they slept with her in her childhood, and they caressed the bosoms of her virginity, and they poured out their fornication on her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:9
verses.text: Therefore I gave her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Assyrians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Assyria”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞after whom she lusted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “which she lusted for them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:10
verses.text: They uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. And she became a name for the women, and they executed judgments against her.  <div eID="gen22566" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9548"/><div sID="gen22567" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9548"/>“And though Oholibah her sister saw, yet in her lust <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she behaved more corruptly than her⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “she behaved corruptly in lust from her”</note> and her whoring <transChange type="added">was</transChange> more than the prostitution of her sister.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:12
verses.text: She lusted after the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Assyrians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Assyria”</note> governors and prefects, warriors<note placement="foot">Hebrew uncertain</note> clothed in<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> perfection,<note placement="foot">Or “in full armor” or “wonderfully dressed”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞expert horsemen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “horsemen, riders of horses”</note> all of them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞handsome young men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “young men of handsomeness”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:13
verses.text: And I saw that she was defiled; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they had both taken the same path⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “way one was for the two of them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:14
verses.text: And she increased her whorings, and she saw men carved<note placement="foot">Or “portrayed”</note> on the wall, images of Chaldeans<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> carved in red,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:15
verses.text: belted with a belt at<note placement="foot">Or “around”</note> their waist with turbans on their heads, all of them giving the appearance of adjutants,<note placement="foot">Or “officers”</note> the image<note placement="foot">Or “likeness”</note> of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Babylonians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Babylon”</note> Chaldea <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the land of their birth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:16
verses.text: And she lusted for them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when her eyes saw them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at the sight of her eyes”</note> and she sent messengers to them <transChange type="added">at</transChange> Chaldea.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:17
verses.text: And so the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Babylonians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Babylon”</note> came to her <transChange type="added">for the</transChange> bed of lovemaking; and they defiled her with their fornication, and she was defiled by them, and she turned from them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:18
verses.text: And she revealed her whorings, and she revealed her nakedness, and so I turned from her <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> I turned from her sister.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:19
verses.text: Yet<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> she increased her whorings, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞recalling⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “remembering”</note> the days of her childhood when she was prostituted<note placement="foot">Or “prostituted herself”</note> in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:20
verses.text: And she lusted after her male lovers whose genitalia <transChange type="added">were the</transChange> genitalia of male donkeys and <transChange type="added">their</transChange> seminal emission <transChange type="added">was the</transChange> seminal emission of horses.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:21
verses.text: And you longed <transChange type="added">after</transChange> the obscene conduct of your youth when your bosom was caressed by Egypt, fondling your young breasts.  <div eID="gen22567" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9549"/><div sID="gen22568" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9549"/>“Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> stirring up your lovers against you <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> whom you turned away, and I will bring them against you from all around:

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:23
verses.text: the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Babylonians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Babylon”</note> and all of the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Assyrians⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Assyria”</note> along with them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞handsome young men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “young men of beauty/handsomeness”</note> governors and prefects, all of them adjutants<note placement="foot">Or “officers”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and excellent horsemen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “ones called riders of horses”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:24
verses.text: And they will come against you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> an army chariot and wagon and with a crowd<note placement="foot">Or “horde” or “host of”</note> of peoples; they will set themselves against you from all around with large shield and small shield and helmet. And I will give <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of them”</note> judgment, and they will judge you with their judgments.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:25
verses.text: And I will direct my zeal against you, and they will deal with you in anger; your nose and your ears they will remove, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who are left⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and remainder your”</note> they will fall by the sword, and they will take your sons and your daughters, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your remnant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and remainder your”</note> will be consumed by fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:26
verses.text: And they will strip you <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your clothes, and they will take <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your splendid jewelry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the jewelry of splendor your”; or “your beautiful jewelry”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:27
verses.text: And I will put an end to your obscene conduct <transChange type="added">coming</transChange> from you and your fornication from the land of Egypt, and you will not lift your eyes to them; and you will not remember Egypt again.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:28
verses.text: For thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> giving you into the hand of those you hated, into the hand of those from whom<note placement="foot">Literally “them”</note> you turned away.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:29
verses.text: And they will deal with you in hatred, and they will take all of your acquisitions, and they will leave you naked and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> bareness; and the nakedness of your fornication and your obscene conduct and your whorings will be exposed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:30
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> accomplished<note placement="foot">Or “done”</note> against<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> you since you prostituted yourself after the nations, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> on account of that, you defiled yourself by their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:31
verses.text: You went in the <transChange type="added">same</transChange> way of your sister, and I will give her cup into your hand.” ’  <div eID="gen22568" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9550"/><div sID="gen22569" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9550"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “You will drink the deep and wide<note placement="foot">Or place “drink deep and wide the cup”</note> cup of your sister; you will be as laughter and as scorn; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the cup holds so much⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “a large among to hold”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:33
verses.text: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, for a cup of horror and desolation <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the cup of your sister, Samaria.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:34
verses.text: And you will drink it, and you will drain <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and its potsherds you will gnaw, and you will tear out your breasts, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I, I”</note> spoke,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:35
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because you have forgotten me, and you threw me behind your back, now in turn<note placement="foot">Or “also”</note> you bear your obscene conduct and your whorings.”  <div eID="gen22569" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9551"/><div sID="gen22570" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9551"/>And Yahweh said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> will you judge Oholah and Oholibah and declare their abominable deeds to<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> them?

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:37
verses.text: For they committed adultery, and blood <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on their hands, and they committed adultery with their idols, and even their children that they had borne for me—they sacrificed them as food!

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:38
verses.text: Also they did this to me: they defiled my sanctuary on that day, and they profaned my Sabbaths,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:39
verses.text: and when they slaughtered their children for their idols, they came to my sanctuary on that day to profane it. And look, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this is what they did in my house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “thus they did in the midst of house my”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:40
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What is worse⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and also for/indeed”</note> they sent for men <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “coming”</note> from a distant place, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> whom a messenger <transChange type="added">was</transChange> sent to them, and look! They came! <transChange type="added">Men</transChange> for whom you bathed and painted your eyes, and you adorned yourself <transChange type="added">with</transChange> an ornament.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:41
verses.text: And you sat on a magnificent couch and a table prepared <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before her⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of her”</note> and my incense and my olive oil you put on her.<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:42
verses.text: And a sound of a carefree crowd <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with it,<note placement="foot">Or “her”</note> and in addition to these men, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a crowd of drunken men<note placement="foot">A problematic verse; reading according to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> was brought in⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from an abundance of men being brought in drunken”</note> from the desert,<note placement="foot">Or “wilderness”</note> and they put bracelets on their arms and a crown of splendor on their heads.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:43
verses.text: And I said to<note placement="foot">Or “about”</note> the one worn out with adulteries, ‘Now they will prostitute her concerning her fornication, even her.’<note placement="foot">Or “that she did”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:44
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> they went to her like going to a female<note placement="foot">Or “a woman”</note> prostitute; and thus they went to Oholah and to Oholibah, the women of obscene conduct.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:45
verses.text: But righteous men, they will judge them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> judgment of committing adultery, and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> judgment of shedding blood; for they were committing adultery, and blood <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on their hands.”  <div eID="gen22570" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9552"/><div sID="gen22571" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9552"/>For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Bring up against them an assembly, and make them as a thing of horror and as plunder.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:47
verses.text: And an assembly must stone them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> stones,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “stone”</note> and they must cut them down. With their swords they shall kill their sons and their daughters, and with fire they shall burn their houses.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:48
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will cause obscene conduct to cease from the land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “I will put an end to obscene conduct from the land”</note> and all of the women will be warned, and they will not do according to your wickedness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:49
verses.text: And they will repay your obscene conduct upon you, and the guilt of your idols you will bear, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.23"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9553"/><title type="x-s">The Boiling Pot and the Death of Ezekiel’s Wife</title> <div sID="gen22572" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9553"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> write for yourself the name of the day, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this very day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “exactly the day the this”</note> The king of Babylon laid siege to Jerusalem on exactly this day!

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:3
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞deliver a proverb⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “quote a proverb”; “proverb a proverb”</note> to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the rebellious house⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the house of rebellion”</note> and you must say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Place the pot! Place <transChange type="added">it</transChange> and also pour water into it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:4
verses.text: Gather its pieces to it, every good piece, thigh and shoulder, fill it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> choice bones;

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:5
verses.text: take the choicest of the flock, and also pile the bones<note placement="foot">Or possibly “logs”; the difference is one letter in Hebrew</note> under it; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞boil it vigorously⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “boil its boiling”</note> indeed,<note placement="foot">Or “also”</note> its bones boiled in the midst of it.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen22572" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9554"/><div sID="gen22573" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9554"/>Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Woe <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the city of bloodguilt! A pot that <transChange type="added">has</transChange> its rust in it; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its rust did not go out from it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “rust her not went forth from her”</note> Bring it out <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞piece by piece⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “according to its pieces”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one is as good as another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “no lot has fallen on it”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:7
verses.text: For her blood was in the midst of her; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she put it on a bare rock⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “on barrenness of a rock she put it”</note> she did not pour it on the ground to cover it with dust.<note placement="foot">Or “earth” or “dirt”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:8
verses.text: To stir up rage, to avenge myself <transChange type="added">through</transChange> vengeance, I placed its blood on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> barrenness of a rock, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that it may not be covered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “so as not to be covered”</note>  <div eID="gen22573" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9555"/><div sID="gen22574" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9555"/>Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Woe <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the city of bloodguilt! I, even I, will make the pile of wood great!

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:10
verses.text: Pile up the logs; kindle the fire; finish <transChange type="added">cooking</transChange> the meat, and mix <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the spices, and let the bones be burned.<note placement="foot">Or “charred”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:11
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make it stand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause it to stand”</note> empty upon its burning coals so that it may become hot, and its copper may become molten and be melted in the midst of it,<note placement="foot">Literally “her”</note> <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> its uncleanness and its rust be consumed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Through</transChange> effort she has caused weariness; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its thick rust⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the abundance of its rust”</note> went not <transChange type="added">out of</transChange> it. Its rust! Into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fire <transChange type="added">with</transChange> its rust!

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:13
verses.text: In your uncleanness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> obscene conduct, because I cleansed you, but you were not clean from your uncleanness; you will not be clean again until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I fully vent my rage⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until causing rest I to my rage”</note> on you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:14
verses.text: I, Yahweh, I have spoken. <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> coming, and I did <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; I will not disregard, and I will not take pity, and I will not reconsider. According to your ways and according to your deeds they will judge you!”<note placement="foot">Or “I will judge”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22574" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9556"/><div sID="gen22575" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9556"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:16
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> look! I am taking from you what is pleasing to your eyes with a plague,<note placement="foot">Or “blow”</note> but you shall not mourn, and you shall not weep, and your tears shall not run down.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:17
verses.text: Sigh in silence <transChange type="added">for the</transChange> dead; you shall not make a mourning ceremony. Bind your turban on you, and you must put your sandals on your feet. You must not cover your <transChange type="added">upper</transChange> lip,<note placement="foot">Or “your mustache” (NASB)</note> and the bread of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mourners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “men”</note> you shall not eat.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:18
verses.text: And I spoke to the people in the morning, and my wife died in the evening, and I did in the morning <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> I was commanded.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:19
verses.text: And the people said to me, “Will you not make known to us what these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> that you are doing <transChange type="added">mean</transChange> for us?”

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:20
verses.text: And I said to them that the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:21
verses.text: “Say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> profaning my sanctuary, the pride of your strength <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the delight of your eyes and the object of your own<note placement="foot">Or “souls’,” or “selves’ ”</note> affection; and your sons and your daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:22
verses.text: and you shall do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> I did: You shall not cover your upper lip,<note placement="foot">Or “mustache”</note> and you shall not eat the bread of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mourners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “men”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:23
verses.text: And your turban <transChange type="added">must be</transChange> on your heads, and your sandals <transChange type="added">must be</transChange> on your feet. You shall not mourn, and you shall not weep, but you shall waste away because of your iniquities, and you shall groan <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a man to his brother”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:24
verses.text: And Ezekiel will be to you as a sign; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everything that he did⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “like all that he did”</note> you shall do; and when it comes you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22575" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9557"/><div sID="gen22576" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9557"/>“And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> will it not be that on the day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when I take from them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the day of to take me from them”</note> their stronghold, the joy of their glory, the delight of their eyes, and the longing of their inner self,<note placement="foot">Or “soul”</note> their sons and daughters—

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:26
verses.text: on that day a survivor will come to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with the news⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with a message for ears”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:27
verses.text: On that day your mouth shall be opened <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the arrival of the fugitive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with the fugitive”; or “to the one who has escaped” (NRSV; cf. NASB)</note> and you shall speak, and you shall not be silent <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer, and you shall be to them as a sign, and they will know that I am Yahweh.”  <chapter eID="Ezek.24"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9558"/><title type="x-s">Judgment upon Various Gentile Nations</title> <div sID="gen22577" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9558"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> set your face toward the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> and prophesy against them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:3
verses.text: and you must say to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> ‘Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because of your saying, ‘Ah!’ to my sanctuary when it was profaned, and to the land of Israel when it was<note placement="foot">Or “became”</note> desolate, and to the house of Judah when they went into the exile,

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:4
verses.text: therefore look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> giving you to the people<note placement="foot">Or “children”</note> of the East as a possession, and they will set up their encampments in you, and they will make in you their dwelling places; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they, they”</note> will eat your fruit and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they, they”</note> will drink your milk.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:5
verses.text: And I will make Rabbah as a pasture of camels and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> as a haunt of flocks, and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.” ’ ”

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:6
verses.text: For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because of clapping your hand and stamping with your foot, and <transChange type="added">because</transChange> you rejoiced in<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> yourself with all of your malice over the land of Israel,

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:7
verses.text: therefore look! I stretched out my hand against you, and I will give you as plunder<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> to the nations, and I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will destroy you from the countries, and I will wipe you out, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen22577" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9559"/><div sID="gen22578" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9559"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because of Moab and Seir saying, ‘The house of Judah <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like all of the nations,’

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:9
verses.text: therefore, look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> opening the side of<note placement="foot">Or “the flank”</note> Moab from the cities on its frontier, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> glory of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land: Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:10
verses.text: I will give it to the people<note placement="foot">Or “children”</note> of the East in addition to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> as a possession, so that the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of Ammon”</note> will not be remembered among the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:11
verses.text: And on Moab I will execute punishments, and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen22578" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9560"/><div sID="gen22579" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9560"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because of the doings of Edom in avenging himself <transChange type="added">with</transChange> vengeance for<note placement="foot">Or “toward”</note> the house of Judah, and so they became very guilty and<note placement="foot">Or “since”</note> they avenged themselves on them,”

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:13
verses.text: therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “so<note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> I will stretch out my hand against Edom and I will cut off from it <transChange type="added">both</transChange> human and animal, and I will make it a ruin from Teman and Dedan; they will fall by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:14
verses.text: And I will exact my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my rage, and they will know my vengeance,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22579" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9561"/><div sID="gen22580" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9561"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞acting⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “doing”</note> of the Philistines in vengeance, so that they avenged themselves relentlessly with malice in themselves for destruction <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with everlasting hostility⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with hostility of ongoing ages/eternity”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:16
verses.text: therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> stretching out my hand against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Philistines, and I will cut off the Kerethites, and I will destroy the remainder of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the seacoast⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the coast of the sea”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:17
verses.text: And I will execute on them great vengeance with punishments of rage, and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh when I exact my vengeance on them!”  <chapter eID="Ezek.25"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9562"/><title type="x-s">Ezekiel Prophesies Against Tyre</title> <div sID="gen22581" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9562"/>And it was in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞eleventh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one ten”</note> year, on the first day of the month, the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> because<note placement="foot">Hebrew “because that”</note> Tyre said concerning Jerusalem, ‘Ah! The gates of the peoples are broken; it has swung <transChange type="added">open</transChange> to me; I shall be filled, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> it lies in ruins!’

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:3
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against you, Tyre, and I will bring up against you many nations like the stirring up of the sea <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞stirring up its waves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with respect to its waves”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:4
verses.text: And I will destroy the walls of Tyre, and they will demolish its towers, and I will scrape away its earthen dirt from it, and I will make it into <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a bare rock⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to barrenness of rock”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:5
verses.text: It will become a place for spreading out dragnets in the midst of the sea; for I have spoken,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh. ‘And it will become as plunder for the nations,

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:6
verses.text: and its daughters who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the field with the sword, they will be killed; and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.’ ”  <div eID="gen22581" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9563"/><div sID="gen22582" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9563"/>For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> bringing to Tyre Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king of kings, with horse and with chariot and with horsemen and <transChange type="added">his</transChange> assembly and many people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:8
verses.text: Your daughters he will kill in the field with the sword, and he will place<note placement="foot">Hebrew “give”</note> against you siege works, and he will build against you a siege ramp, and he will raise against you a shield,

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:9
verses.text: and the thrust of his battering ram he will direct against your walls, and your towers he will break down with his weapons.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:10
verses.text: From the abundance of his horses he will cover you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> their fine dust; at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of horseman and wheel and chariot your walls will shake, at his coming into your gates like the entrance of a city <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> being broken through.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:11
verses.text: With the hooves of his horses he will trample all of your streets. He will kill your people with the sword, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your strong stone pillars⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the stone pillars of strength your”</note> will tumble down to the earth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:12
verses.text: And they will plunder your wealth, and they will loot your merchandise, and they will break down your walls, and the houses of your delight they will break down, and your stones and your timbers and your earthen dirt they will cast into the midst of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> water.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:13
verses.text: And, I will put an end to the noise of your songs, and the sound of your lyres will not be heard any longer.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:14
verses.text: And I will make you into <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a bare rock⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to barrenness of rock”</note> a place for the spreading out of dragnets. You will not be built again, for I, Yahweh, I have spoken,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22582" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9564"/><div sID="gen22583" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9564"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh to Tyre, “Will not the coastlands shake from the sound of your downfall, at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> groaning of the wounded, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at people being killed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at being killed a killing”</note> in the midst of you?

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:16
verses.text: And all the princes of the sea will go down from their thrones, and they will remove their robes, and their <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beautiful garments⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the garments of beautiful finished cloth”</note> of finished cloth they will take off. With terror they will be clothed, and on the ground they will sit, and they will tremble <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continually⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for moments”</note> and they will be appalled over you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:17
verses.text: And they will raise a lament over you, and they will say to you, <div eID="gen22583" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22584"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22585"/>‘How you have been lost <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> inhabited from<note placement="foot">Or “on”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas;<l eID="gen22585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22586"/>the city that was praised, that was strong.<l eID="gen22586" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22587"/>It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <transChange type="added">located</transChange> on the sea,<l eID="gen22587" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22588"/>and its inhabitants imposed their terror <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on all of its inhabitants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to all of its inhabitants”</note> <l eID="gen22588" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9565"/><l level="1" sID="gen22589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9565"/>Now the coastlands will tremble<l eID="gen22589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22590"/><transChange type="added">at</transChange> the day of your downfall,<l eID="gen22590" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22591"/>and the islands that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the sea<l eID="gen22591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22592"/>will be horrified because of your departure.’ ” <l eID="gen22592" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22584"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9566"/><div sID="gen22593" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9566"/>For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when bringing up over you the deep, the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞great surging waters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the waters the many”</note> will cover you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:20
verses.text: And I will bring you down with <transChange type="added">those who are</transChange> going down to the grave,<note placement="foot">Or “pit”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an ancient people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a people of eternity/endless ages”</note> and I will cause you to dwell in the world<note placement="foot">Or “land”</note> of the depths, in the ruins from of old with those who are going down to the grave,<note placement="foot">Or “pit”</note> so that you will not be inhabited and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have a place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “and I will give beauty in the land of the living”</note> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:21
verses.text: Sudden terrors I will bring <transChange type="added">on</transChange> you, and you shall no <transChange type="added">longer exist</transChange>; and you will be sought, and you will not be found again <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity/endless ages”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.26"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9567"/><title type="x-s">A Lament for Doomed Tyre</title> <div sID="gen22594" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9567"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:2
verses.text: “And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> raise a lament against Tyre.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:3
verses.text: And you must say to Tyre, the one who sits at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> entrance of the sea <transChange type="added">as</transChange> the merchant of the peoples to the many coastlands, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22594" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22595"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22596"/>Tyre, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you yourself said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you you said”</note><l eID="gen22596" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22597"/>“I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> perfect <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in beauty⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!”<note placement="foot">Literally “of beauty”</note> <l eID="gen22597" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9568"/><l level="1" sID="gen22598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9568"/>In <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your boundaries;<l eID="gen22598" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22599"/>your builders perfected your beauty. <l eID="gen22599" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9569"/><l level="1" sID="gen22600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9569"/>They built <transChange type="added">with</transChange> pine trees from Senir<l eID="gen22600" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22601"/>all of your boards for you;<l eID="gen22601" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22602"/>they took cedars from Lebanon<l eID="gen22602" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22603"/>to make a sailing mast <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on you”</note> <l eID="gen22603" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9570"/><l level="1" sID="gen22604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9570"/>They made your oars<l eID="gen22604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22605"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> oaks from Bashan;<l eID="gen22605" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22606"/>your deck they made <transChange type="added">with</transChange> inlaid ivory,<l eID="gen22606" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22607"/>with cypress trees from the coastlands of Cyprus.<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> <l eID="gen22607" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9571"/><l level="1" sID="gen22608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9571"/>Your sail was fine linen with colorful weaving from Egypt<l eID="gen22608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22609"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to serve as a banner for you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to be for you as a banner”</note><l eID="gen22609" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22610"/>blue and purple cloth from the coastlands of Cyprus<note placement="foot">Or “Elishah”</note><l eID="gen22610" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22611"/>was your awning. <l eID="gen22611" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9572"/><l level="1" sID="gen22612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9572"/>The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvan<l eID="gen22612" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22613"/>were your rowers;<l eID="gen22613" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22614"/>your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞skilled men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “wise men”</note> O Tyre, were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from your own people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in you”</note><l eID="gen22614" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22615"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> your seamen. <l eID="gen22615" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9573"/><l level="1" sID="gen22616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9573"/>The elders of Gebal and its <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞skilled men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wise men”</note> were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in you”</note><l eID="gen22616" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22617"/><transChange type="added">as</transChange> the repairers of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seam of your boat;<l eID="gen22617" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22618"/>all of the ships of the sea and their mariners were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in you”</note><l eID="gen22618" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22619"/>to barter your wares. <l eID="gen22619" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9574"/><l level="1" sID="gen22620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9574"/>Persia and Lud and Put<l eID="gen22620" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22621"/>were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among your soldiers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “in your army as the men of war your”</note><l eID="gen22621" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22622"/>small shield and helmet hung <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in you”</note><l eID="gen22622" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22623"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> gave <transChange type="added">to you</transChange> your adornment. <l eID="gen22623" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9575"/><l level="1" sID="gen22624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9575"/>The people<note placement="foot">Or “children,” or “sons”</note> of Arvan and Helech<l eID="gen22624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22625"/><transChange type="added">were</transChange> on your walls all around,<l eID="gen22625" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22626"/>and Gammadites<l eID="gen22626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22627"/>were in your towers.<l eID="gen22627" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22628"/>They hung their quivers<note placement="foot">Or “shields” (cf. NJPS; NIV)</note> on your walls all around;<l eID="gen22628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22629"/>they perfected your beauty. <l eID="gen22629" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22595"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9576"/><div sID="gen22630" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9576"/>“ ‘Tarshish <transChange type="added">was</transChange> your trader; from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> abundance of all of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> wealth, with silver, iron, tin, and lead they exchanged for your merchandise.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:13
verses.text: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in exchange for people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “for a human person/soul”</note> and an object of bronze they gave <transChange type="added">you</transChange> your wares.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:14
verses.text: From Beth Togarmah they exchanged horses and war horses and mules for your wares.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:15
verses.text: The people<note placement="foot">Or “children”</note> of Dedan were trading with you, many coastlands composed the region of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞influence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> they brought back horns of ivory and ebony <transChange type="added">as</transChange> your payment.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:16
verses.text: Edom<note placement="foot">Reading Edom for Aram</note> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> trading <transChange type="added">with</transChange> you because of the abundance of your products, <transChange type="added">trading</transChange> with malachite, purple wool yarn and colorful weaving, and fine white fabric and black corals and rubies; <transChange type="added">all these</transChange> they exchange for your merchandise.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:17
verses.text: Judah and the land of Israel <transChange type="added">were</transChange> trading <transChange type="added">with</transChange> you with wheat from Minnith and millet and honey and olive oil and balm; <transChange type="added">all these</transChange> they gave <transChange type="added">for</transChange> your wares.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:18
verses.text: Damascus <transChange type="added">was</transChange> trading <transChange type="added">with</transChange> you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for”</note> the abundance of your products, because of the abundance of all of <transChange type="added">your</transChange> wealth, <transChange type="added">trading</transChange> with the wine of Helbon and white wool.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:19
verses.text: Vedan and Javan from Uzal, they exchanged wrought iron, cinnamon,<note placement="foot">Or “cassia”</note> and reed spice for your merchandise; <transChange type="added">all this</transChange> was for your wares.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:20
verses.text: Dedan <transChange type="added">was</transChange> trading <transChange type="added">with</transChange> you, with garments of woven material for riding.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:21
verses.text: Arabia and all of the leaders of Kedar <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your customers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “traders of your hand”</note> with young rams and <transChange type="added">adult</transChange> rams and goats <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> trading with them with you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:22
verses.text: The traders of Sheba and Raamah <transChange type="added">were</transChange> trading <transChange type="added">with</transChange> you, with the finest of every spice and with every precious stone and gold; they exchanged <transChange type="added">all these</transChange> for your merchandise.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:23
verses.text: Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traders of Sheba, Assyria, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> Kilmad <transChange type="added">were</transChange> trading <transChange type="added">with</transChange> you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:24
verses.text: They <transChange type="added">were</transChange> trading <transChange type="added">with</transChange> you in finery, in mantles of blue cloth and colorful embroidered work and with rugs of variegated cloth in twisted cords and knotted tightly; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞these were among your merchandise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in your trading/marketplace” (cf. NET)</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:25
verses.text: The ships of Tarshish <transChange type="added">were</transChange> carrying <transChange type="added">for</transChange> you your wares, and you were filled, and you became very heavy in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas.  <div eID="gen22630" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9577"/><lg sID="gen22631"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9577"/>“ ‘Into many waters<l eID="gen22632" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22633"/>the rowers brought you;<l eID="gen22633" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22634"/><transChange type="added">but</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the east wind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the wind of the east”</note> wrecked you<l eID="gen22634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22635"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas. <l eID="gen22635" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9578"/><l level="1" sID="gen22636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9578"/>Your wealth and your merchandise, your wares,<l eID="gen22636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22637"/>your mariners, and your seamen,<l eID="gen22637" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22638"/>your shipwrights<note placement="foot">Literally “the repairers/strengtheners of your seams”</note> and the barterers of your wares<l eID="gen22638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22639"/>and all of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your soldiers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the men of your war”</note> who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in you,<l eID="gen22639" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22640"/>along<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> with all of your crew who are in the midst of you,<l eID="gen22640" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22641"/>they will fall in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas on the day of your downfall. <l eID="gen22641" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9579"/><l level="1" sID="gen22642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9579"/>At the sound of the shout<note placement="foot">Or “cry”</note> of your seamen,<l eID="gen22642" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22643"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> pasturelands will shake. <l eID="gen22643" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9580"/><l level="1" sID="gen22644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9580"/>And they will go down from their ships,<l eID="gen22644" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22645"/>all of <transChange type="added">those</transChange> holding an oar,<l eID="gen22645" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22646"/>mariners, all of the seamen of the sea<l eID="gen22646" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22647"/>will stand on the land, <l eID="gen22647" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9581"/><l level="1" sID="gen22648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9581"/>and they will lament<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lamented”</note> over you with their voice,<l eID="gen22648" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22649"/>and they will cry out<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cried out”</note> bitterly,<l eID="gen22649" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22650"/>and they will throw<note placement="foot">Hebrew “threw”</note> dust on their heads,<l eID="gen22650" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22651"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> they will roll<note placement="foot">Hebrew “rolled”</note> in the dust. <l eID="gen22651" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9582"/><l level="1" sID="gen22652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9582"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They will shave themselves bald for your sake⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “And they made bald for you with baldness”</note><l eID="gen22652" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22653"/>and they will dress<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dressed”</note> themselves <transChange type="added">in</transChange> sackcloth,<l eID="gen22653" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22654"/>and they will weep<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wept”</note> over you with a bitterness of soul<note placement="foot">Or “of their inner self”</note><l eID="gen22654" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22655"/><transChange type="added">and</transChange> with bitter wailing. <l eID="gen22655" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9583"/><l level="1" sID="gen22656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9583"/>And they will raise<note placement="foot">Hebrew “raised”</note> over you with their wailing a lament,<l eID="gen22656" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22657"/>and they will chant<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chanted”</note> a lament over you:<l eID="gen22657" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22658"/>‘Who is like Tyre,<l eID="gen22658" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22659"/>like <transChange type="added">this</transChange> destruction in the midst of the sea?’ <l eID="gen22659" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:33
