verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9584"/><l level="1" sID="gen22660"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9584"/>When your merchandise went out from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas,<l eID="gen22660" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22661"/>you satisfied many peoples with the abundance of your wealth,<l eID="gen22661" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22662"/>and <transChange type="added">by</transChange> your wares<l eID="gen22662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22663"/>you made rich <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kings of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> world. <l eID="gen22663" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9585"/><l level="1" sID="gen22664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9585"/>Now you are broken by seas<l eID="gen22664" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22665"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths of waters;<l eID="gen22665" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22666"/>your wares and all of your crew<l eID="gen22666" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22667"/>in the midst of you have sunk. <l eID="gen22667" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9586"/><l level="1" sID="gen22668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9586"/>All of the inhabitants of the coastlands<l eID="gen22668" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22669"/>are appalled over you,<l eID="gen22669" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22670"/>and their kings <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shudder⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they have bristling hair”</note> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> horror;<l eID="gen22670" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22671"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they distort their faces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “they are distorted as to faces”</note> <l eID="gen22671" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9587"/><l level="1" sID="gen22672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9587"/>The traders among the peoples hiss over you;<l eID="gen22672" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22673"/>you have become <transChange type="added">a</transChange> horror,<l eID="gen22673" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22674"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall be no more forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not you until eternity/endless ages” (cf. NRSV)</note> <l eID="gen22674" level="2"/><lg eID="gen22631"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.27"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9588"/><title type="x-s">A Prophecy Aimed at the King of Tyre</title> <div sID="gen22675" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9588"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> say to the leader of Tyre, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22675" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22676"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22677"/>“Because your heart was haughty,<l eID="gen22677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22678"/>and you said, ‘I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a god;<l eID="gen22678" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22679"/>I sit <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> seat of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gods,<l eID="gen22679" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22680"/>I sit in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas!’<l eID="gen22680" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22681"/>But<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you are a human, not a god,<l eID="gen22681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22682"/>and you gave your heart to be like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of a god. <l eID="gen22682" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9589"/><l level="1" sID="gen22683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9589"/>Look, are you wiser than Daniel,<l eID="gen22683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22684"/><transChange type="added">so that</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no secret⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of hidden/secret”</note> is hidden <transChange type="added">from</transChange> you? <l eID="gen22684" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9590"/><l level="1" sID="gen22685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9590"/>By your wisdom and by your understanding<l eID="gen22685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22686"/>you have gained for yourself wealth,<l eID="gen22686" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22687"/>and you have amassed gold and silver<l eID="gen22687" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22688"/>in your treasuries. <l eID="gen22688" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9591"/><l level="1" sID="gen22689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9591"/>By the abundance of your wisdom in your trading<l eID="gen22689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22690"/>you <transChange type="added">have</transChange> increased your wealth<l eID="gen22690" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22691"/>and your heart was proud in<note placement="foot">Or “by/through”</note> your wealth.” ’ ” <l eID="gen22691" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22676"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9592"/><div sID="gen22692" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9592"/>Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22692" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22693"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22694"/>“Because of your regarding your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note><l eID="gen22694" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22695"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> of a god, <l eID="gen22695" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9593"/><l level="1" sID="gen22696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9593"/>therefore look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> bringing strangers over you,<l eID="gen22696" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22697"/><transChange type="added">the most</transChange> ruthless of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples,<l eID="gen22697" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22698"/>and they will draw their swords against the beauty<note placement="foot">Or “splendor”</note> of your wisdom,<l eID="gen22698" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22699"/>and they will defile your splendor. <l eID="gen22699" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9594"/><l level="1" sID="gen22700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9594"/>They will thrust you down to the pit,<l eID="gen22700" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22701"/>and you will die <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a violent death⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a death of a slain”</note><l eID="gen22701" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22702"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heart of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas. <l eID="gen22702" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9595"/><l level="1" sID="gen22703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9595"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Will you indeed still say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Will you say, will you say”</note> “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a god!”<l eID="gen22703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22704"/>before the face of your killers?<note placement="foot">Or “slayers”</note><l eID="gen22704" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22705"/>And <transChange type="added">in fact</transChange> you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a human<note placement="foot">Or “man”</note> and not a god<l eID="gen22705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22706"/>in the hand of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who pierce you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “piercers/slayers of you”</note> <l eID="gen22706" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9596"/><l level="1" sID="gen22707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9596"/>You will die <transChange type="added">the</transChange> death of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> uncircumcised<l eID="gen22707" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22708"/>by the hand of strangers,<l eID="gen22708" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22693"/> <div sID="gen22709" type="x-p"/> for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “I, I”</note> have spoken!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22709" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9597"/><div sID="gen22710" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9597"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:12
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> raise a lament over the king of Tyre, and you must say to him, ‘thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22710" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22711"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22712"/>“You were a perfect model of<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> an example,<l eID="gen22712" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22713"/>full of wisdom and perfect of beauty. <l eID="gen22713" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9598"/><l level="1" sID="gen22714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9598"/>You were in Eden, the garden of God,<l eID="gen22714" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22715"/>and every precious stone <transChange type="added">was</transChange> your adornment:<l eID="gen22715" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22716"/>carnelian, topaz and moonstone,<note placement="foot">Meaning of Hebrew uncertain</note><l eID="gen22716" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22717"/>turquoise, onyx and jasper,<l eID="gen22717" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22718"/>sapphire,<note placement="foot">Or “lapis lazuli”</note> malachite and emerald.<l eID="gen22718" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22719"/>And gold <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the craftsmanship of your settings<l eID="gen22719" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22720"/>and your mountings in you;<l eID="gen22720" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22721"/>on the day when you were created they were prepared. <l eID="gen22721" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9599"/><l level="1" sID="gen22722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9599"/>You were <transChange type="added">an</transChange> anointed guardian cherub,<l eID="gen22722" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22723"/>and I placed you on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞God’s holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “on the mountain of the holiness of God”</note><l eID="gen22723" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22724"/>you walked in the midst of stones of fire. <l eID="gen22724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9600"/><l level="2" sID="gen22725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9600"/>You <transChange type="added">were</transChange> blameless in your ways<l eID="gen22725" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22726"/>from the day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you were created⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “being created you”</note><l eID="gen22726" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22727"/>until wickedness was found in you. <l eID="gen22727" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9601"/><l level="1" sID="gen22728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9601"/>In the abundance of your trading,<l eID="gen22728" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22729"/>they filled the midst of you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> violence, and you sinned;<l eID="gen22729" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22730"/>and I cast you as a profane thing from the mountain of God,<l eID="gen22730" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22731"/>and I expelled you, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> guardian<note placement="foot">Or “guarding”</note> cherub,<l eID="gen22731" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22732"/>from the midst of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stones of fire. <l eID="gen22732" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9602"/><l level="1" sID="gen22733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9602"/>Your heart was proud because of your beauty;<l eID="gen22733" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22734"/>you ruined your wisdom because of your splendor.<l eID="gen22734" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22735"/>I threw you on the ground <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the face of”</note> kings;<l eID="gen22735" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22736"/>I have exposed you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for viewing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to look at you”</note> <l eID="gen22736" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9603"/><l level="1" sID="gen22737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9603"/>From the abundance of your iniquities<l eID="gen22737" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22738"/>in the dishonesty of your trading,<l eID="gen22738" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22739"/>I profaned your sanctuaries<l eID="gen22739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22740"/>and I brought fire from your midst;<l eID="gen22740" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22741"/>it consumed you, and I have turned you to ashes on the earth<l eID="gen22741" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22742"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before the eyes of everyone who sees you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “before the eyes of all seeing you”</note> <l eID="gen22742" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9604"/><l level="1" sID="gen22743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9604"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞All who know you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of the knowers of you”</note> among the peoples<l eID="gen22743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22744"/>are appalled over you;<l eID="gen22744" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22745"/>you have become <transChange type="added">as</transChange> horrors,<l eID="gen22745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22746"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you shall cease to exist forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.” ’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not you until eternity”</note> <l eID="gen22746" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22711"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9605"/><div sID="gen22747" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9605"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:21
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against it,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:22
verses.text: and you must say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22747" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22748"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22749"/>“Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against you, Sidon,<l eID="gen22749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22750"/>and I display my glory in the midst of you,<l eID="gen22750" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22751"/>and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh<l eID="gen22751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22752"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when I execute my judgments⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in/at doing in her judgments”</note><l eID="gen22752" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22753"/>and I will show myself holy within it. <l eID="gen22753" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9606"/><l level="1" sID="gen22754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9606"/>And I will send into it a plague,<l eID="gen22754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22755"/>and blood will <transChange type="added">be</transChange> in its streets.<l eID="gen22755" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22756"/>And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dead will fall in the midst of her<l eID="gen22756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22757"/>by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> against it from all around;<l eID="gen22757" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22758"/>and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh. <l eID="gen22758" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen22748"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9607"/><div sID="gen22759" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9607"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there will not be any longer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not it will be again”</note> a painful thorn and a sharp thornbush for<note placement="foot">Or “against”</note> the house of Israel from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anywhere around them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from all of all around them”</note> from those <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who are despising them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones despising them”</note> and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> the Lord Yahweh.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen22759" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9608"/><div sID="gen22760" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9608"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples to which they were scattered <transChange type="added">about</transChange> in them, and I show myself holy in<note placement="foot">Or “among”</note> them before the eyes of the nations, then they will live on their soil, which I gave to my servant Jacob.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:26
verses.text: And they will live on it in safety, and they will build houses, and they will plant vineyards, and they will live in safety when I execute my judgments on all <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who despise them from all around them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones despising them”</note> and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh their God.”  <chapter eID="Ezek.28"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9609"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Judgment upon Egypt</title> <div sID="gen22761" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9609"/>In the tenth year, in the tenth <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twelfth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “two ten”</note> day of the month, the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> set your face against Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against Egypt, all of it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:3
verses.text: Speak, and you must say, ‘thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22761" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22762"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22763"/>“Look! I am against you,<l eID="gen22763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22764"/>Pharaoh, king of Egypt,<l eID="gen22764" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22765"/>the great sea monster,<l eID="gen22765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22766"/>the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> lying down<l eID="gen22766" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22767"/>in the midst of his Nile streams,<l eID="gen22767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22768"/>who says to me, “<transChange type="added">It is</transChange> my Nile, and I made <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> myself.”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “me”</note> <l eID="gen22768" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9610"/><l level="1" sID="gen22769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9610"/>And so I will put hooks in your jawbones,<l eID="gen22769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22770"/>and I will make the fish of your Nile streams stick to your scales,<l eID="gen22770" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22771"/>and I will bring you up from the midst of your Nile streams,<l eID="gen22771" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22772"/>and all of the fish of your Nile streams <transChange type="added">which</transChange> cling to your scales. <l eID="gen22772" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9611"/><l level="1" sID="gen22773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9611"/>And I will fling you <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the desert,<l eID="gen22773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22774"/>you and all the fish of your Nile streams.<l eID="gen22774" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22775"/>On the surface of the field you will fall;<l eID="gen22775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22776"/>you will not be gathered,<l eID="gen22776" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22777"/>and you will not be assembled.<l eID="gen22777" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22778"/>To the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the field<l eID="gen22778" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22779"/>and to the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the heavens<l eID="gen22779" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22780"/>I will give you as food. <l eID="gen22780" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9612"/><l level="1" sID="gen22781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9612"/>And all of the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen22781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22782"/>because of their<note placement="foot">LXX, Syriac, and Vulgate: “you”</note> being a staff of reed for the house of Israel. <l eID="gen22782" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9613"/><l level="1" sID="gen22783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9613"/>When they took hold of you with the hand, you snapped,<l eID="gen22783" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22784"/>and you split their every shoulder.<l eID="gen22784" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22785"/>And when they leaned on you, you broke,<l eID="gen22785" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22786"/>and you caused all of their loins to wobble.” <l eID="gen22786" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22762"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9614"/><div sID="gen22787" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9614"/>Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> bringing on you <transChange type="added">a</transChange> sword, and I will cut off from you human and animal.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:9
verses.text: And the land of Egypt will become<note placement="foot">Hebrew “be”</note> a desolation and ruins, and they will know that I am Yahweh because he<note placement="foot">That is, Pharaoh</note> said, ‘The Nile is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “to me”</note> And I, I made <transChange type="added">it</transChange>!’

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:10
verses.text: Therefore look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against you and against your Nile streams, and I will make the land of Egypt into ruins, <transChange type="added">a</transChange> pile of rubble, <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation from Migdol <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Syene and up to the boundary of Cush.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:11
verses.text: A foot of a human will not pass over it, and a foot of an animal will not pass over it, and so it will not be inhabited <transChange type="added">for</transChange> forty years.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:12
verses.text: And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of desolated countries, and its cities <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> in the midst of ruined cities. They will be <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation <transChange type="added">for</transChange> forty years, and I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and I will disperse them among the countries.”  <div eID="gen22787" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9615"/><div sID="gen22788" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9615"/>For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “At the end of forty years I will gather Egypt from the peoples <transChange type="added">among</transChange> whom they were scattered.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:14
verses.text: And I will restore the fortunes of Egypt, and I will bring them back <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin, and they will be a lowly kingdom there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:15
verses.text: Of <transChange type="added">all</transChange> the kingdoms it will be <transChange type="added">the most</transChange> lowly, and it will not exalt itself again over the nations, and I will make them small <transChange type="added">so as</transChange> not to rule over the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:16
verses.text: And it will not be again for the house of Israel an object of trust, bringing to remembrance <transChange type="added">their</transChange> guilt <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they turned back to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at their turning”</note> and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> the Lord Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen22788" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9616"/><div sID="gen22789" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9616"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it happened”</note> in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the twenty-seventh year⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “twenty and seven year”</note> in the first month, on the first day of the month, the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:18
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, he made his army labor hard against Tyre. Every head was rubbed bare, and every shoulder was rubbed raw, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> a wage was not <transChange type="added">paid</transChange> for him and for his army from Tyre for the labor that he did against it.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:19
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> giving to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon the land of Egypt, and he will carry its wealth <transChange type="added">away</transChange>, and he will plunder its plunder, and he will loot its loot, and it will be <transChange type="added">a</transChange> wage for his army.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> his wages that he worked for, I will give to him the land of Egypt, because they worked for me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22789" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9617"/><div sID="gen22790" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9617"/>“On that day I will cause <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a horn”</note> to grow <transChange type="added">up</transChange> for the house of Israel, and for you I will give an opening of <transChange type="added">your</transChange> mouth in the midst of them, and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.”  <chapter eID="Ezek.29"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9618"/><title type="x-s">A Lament over the Nation and Land of Egypt</title> <div sID="gen22791" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9618"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> prophesy, and you must say, ‘thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22791" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22792"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22793"/>“Wail, alas! For the day! <l eID="gen22793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9619"/><l level="2" sID="gen22794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9619"/>For a day <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near;<l eID="gen22794" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22795"/>indeed, a day <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near for Yahweh.<l eID="gen22795" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22796"/>A day of cloud,<l eID="gen22796" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22797"/>a time of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations it will be. <l eID="gen22797" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9620"/><l level="1" sID="gen22798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9620"/>And a sword will come in Egypt,<l eID="gen22798" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22799"/>and anguish will be in Cush,<l eID="gen22799" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22800"/>at the falling of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slain in Egypt.<l eID="gen22800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22801"/>And they will take its wealth,<l eID="gen22801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22802"/>and its foundation will be demolished. <l eID="gen22802" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22792"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9621"/><div sID="gen22803" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9621"/>Cush and Put and Lud and all of Arabia and Kub and the people<note placement="foot">Or “children”</note> of the land of the treaty<note placement="foot">Or “covenant”</note> with them—by the sword they will fall.”  <div eID="gen22803" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9622"/><div sID="gen22804" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9622"/>Thus says Yahweh: <div eID="gen22804" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22805"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22806"/>“And the supporters of Egypt will fall,<l eID="gen22806" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22807"/>and the majesty of its strength will go down<l eID="gen22807" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22808"/>from Migdol <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Syene;<l eID="gen22808" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22809"/>by the sword they will fall in it,”<l eID="gen22809" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22810"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh. <l eID="gen22810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9623"/><l level="1" sID="gen22811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9623"/>“And they will be desolate in the midst of desolate countries,<l eID="gen22811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22812"/>and its cities will be in the midst of ruined cities. <l eID="gen22812" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9624"/><l level="1" sID="gen22813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9624"/>And they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh<l eID="gen22813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22814"/>when I put my fire in Egypt,<l eID="gen22814" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22815"/>and all of its helpers are broken. <l eID="gen22815" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22805"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9625"/><div sID="gen22816" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9625"/>On that day messengers will go down from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> in the ships to terrify unsuspecting Cush, and anguish will be in them on the day of Egypt; for look, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> coming!”  <div eID="gen22816" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9626"/><div sID="gen22817" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9626"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22817" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22818"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22819"/>“And I will put an end to the crowds<note placement="foot">Or “hordes”</note> of Egypt<l eID="gen22819" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22820"/>by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon. <l eID="gen22820" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9627"/><l level="1" sID="gen22821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9627"/>He and his people with him, <transChange type="added">the most</transChange> ruthless of nations,<l eID="gen22821" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22822"/><transChange type="added">will</transChange> be brought to destroy the land.<l eID="gen22822" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22823"/>And they will draw their swords against Egypt,<l eID="gen22823" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22824"/>and they will fill the land <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slain, <l eID="gen22824" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9628"/><l level="1" sID="gen22825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9628"/>and I will make the Nile streams dry land,<l eID="gen22825" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22826"/>and I will sell the land into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of bad <transChange type="added">people</transChange>,<l eID="gen22826" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22827"/>and I will lay waste <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land and its fullness<l eID="gen22827" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22828"/>by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of strangers.<l eID="gen22828" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22818"/> <div sID="gen22829" type="x-p"/> I, Yahweh, I have spoken.”  <div eID="gen22829" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9629"/><div sID="gen22830" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9629"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22830" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22831"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22832"/>“And I will destroy <transChange type="added">the</transChange> idols,<l eID="gen22832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22833"/>and I will put an end to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> worthless idols from Memphis.<l eID="gen22833" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22834"/>And there will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no longer be⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not be any longer”</note> a prince from the land of Egypt,<l eID="gen22834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22835"/>and I will put fear in the land of Egypt. <l eID="gen22835" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9630"/><l level="1" sID="gen22836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9630"/>And I will lay waste Pathros,<l eID="gen22836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22837"/>and I will set fire in Zoan,<l eID="gen22837" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22838"/>and I will execute judgments in No.<note placement="foot">That is, Thebes</note> <l eID="gen22838" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9631"/><l level="1" sID="gen22839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9631"/>I will pour out my rage over Sin,<l eID="gen22839" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22840"/>the stronghold of Egypt,<l eID="gen22840" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22841"/>and I will cut off the crowd<note placement="foot">Or “horde”</note> of No.<note placement="foot">That is, Thebes</note> <l eID="gen22841" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9632"/><l level="1" sID="gen22842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9632"/>And I will set fire in Egypt,<l eID="gen22842" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22843"/>certainly Sin will writhe,<l eID="gen22843" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22844"/>and No<note placement="foot">That is, Thebes</note> will be breached,<l eID="gen22844" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22845"/>and Memphis <transChange type="added">will</transChange> face enemies <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞daily⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “of by day”</note> <l eID="gen22845" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9633"/><l level="1" sID="gen22846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9633"/>The young men of On and Pi Beseth will fall by the sword,<l eID="gen22846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22847"/>and they will go into captivity. <l eID="gen22847" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9634"/><l level="1" sID="gen22848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9634"/>And at Tahpanhes the day will become dark<l eID="gen22848" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22849"/>when I break the yoke of Egypt,<l eID="gen22849" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22850"/>and in it the majesty of its strength<l eID="gen22850" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22851"/>will come to an end.<l eID="gen22851" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22852"/>A cloud will cover it,<l eID="gen22852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22853"/>and its daughters will go into captivity. <l eID="gen22853" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9635"/><l level="1" sID="gen22854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9635"/>And I will execute judgments in Egypt,<l eID="gen22854" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22855"/>and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.” <l eID="gen22855" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22831"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9636"/><div sID="gen22856" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9636"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it was”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the eleventh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on one ten”</note> year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:21
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> the arm of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, I have broken. And look, it has not been bound up for giving of a remedy, or for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> placing of a splint to bind it <transChange type="added">up</transChange> to make it strong to take hold of the sword.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:22
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and I will break his strong arm and the broken <transChange type="added">arm</transChange>, and I will let the sword fall from his hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:23
verses.text: And I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and I will disperse them among the countries.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:24
verses.text: And I will strengthen the arm of the king of Babylon, and I will give my sword into his hand, and I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> groaning of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mortally wounded <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the face of him”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:25
verses.text: And I will strengthen the arm of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh will fall. And they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh when I give my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will stretch it out to the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:26
verses.text: And I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and I will disperse them into the countries, and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.”  <chapter eID="Ezek.30"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9637"/><title type="x-s">Pharaoh Is Warned Through Assyria’s Destruction</title> <div sID="gen22857" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9637"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it happened/it was”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the eleventh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on one ten”</note> year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> say to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and to his crowd,<note placement="foot">Or “hordes”</note> <div eID="gen22857" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22858"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22859"/>‘To whom are you like in your greatness? <l eID="gen22859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9638"/><l level="1" sID="gen22860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9638"/>Look! Assyria <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a cedar in Lebanon,<l eID="gen22860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22861"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> beautiful branches<note placement="foot">Hebrew “branch”</note> and a forest giving shade,<l eID="gen22861" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22862"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞very high⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “high of height”</note><l eID="gen22862" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22863"/>and its treetop <transChange type="added">was</transChange> between <transChange type="added">the</transChange> clouds. <l eID="gen22863" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9639"/><l level="1" sID="gen22864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9639"/>Waters made it great,<l eID="gen22864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22865"/>the deep made it grow high;<l eID="gen22865" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22866"/>its rivers <transChange type="added">were</transChange> going all around <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its planting area⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “base of its tree”; NRSV, “in the place where it was planted”</note><l eID="gen22866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22867"/>and its channels it sent <transChange type="added">out</transChange><l eID="gen22867" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22868"/>to all of the trees of the field. <l eID="gen22868" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9640"/><l level="1" sID="gen22869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9640"/>Therefore it became tall,<l eID="gen22869" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22870"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> its height more than all of the trees of the field,<l eID="gen22870" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22871"/>and its branches became numerous,<l eID="gen22871" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22872"/>and its branches became long<l eID="gen22872" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22873"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from its sending its shoots from abundant water⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from water much at sending shoots its”</note> <l eID="gen22873" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9641"/><l level="1" sID="gen22874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9641"/>In its branches all the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the heaven<note placement="foot">Or “sky”</note> made their nest,<l eID="gen22874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22875"/>and under its branches all the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the field gave birth,<l eID="gen22875" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22876"/>and in its shadow all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> many nations lived. <l eID="gen22876" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9642"/><l level="1" sID="gen22877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9642"/>And it was beautiful in its greatness,<l eID="gen22877" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22878"/>in the length of its branches,<l eID="gen22878" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22879"/>for its root <transChange type="added">was</transChange> toward much water. <l eID="gen22879" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9643"/><l level="1" sID="gen22880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9643"/>Cedars in the garden of God<l eID="gen22880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22881"/>could not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> equal to it;<l eID="gen22881" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22882"/>fir trees<note placement="foot">Or possibly, juniper</note> could not resemble its branches,<l eID="gen22882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22883"/>and plane trees were not <transChange type="added">even</transChange> like its branches;<l eID="gen22883" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22884"/>any tree <transChange type="added">even</transChange> in the garden of God<l eID="gen22884" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22885"/>could not resemble it in its beauty. <l eID="gen22885" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9644"/><l level="1" sID="gen22886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9644"/>I made it beautiful with the abundance of its branches,<l eID="gen22886" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22887"/>and all of the trees of Eden that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the garden of God envied it.’ ” <l eID="gen22887" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22858"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9645"/><div sID="gen22888" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9645"/>Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because that”</note> it was tall in height and it set its treetop between<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to between”</note> thick clouds, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he took pride in his tallness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and his heart he raised in his tallness”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:11
verses.text: then<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> I gave it into the hand of the leader of nations; he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞dealt thoroughly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “doing he did”</note> with it according to its wickedness. I drove it <transChange type="added">out</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:12
verses.text: And strangers cut it off, <transChange type="added">the most</transChange> ruthless of nations, and they abandoned it. On the mountains and in all <transChange type="added">of the</transChange> valleys its branches fell, and its branches were broken in all the river channels of the land, and all the peoples of the world went out from its shadow, and they abandoned it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:13
verses.text: On its fallen trunk all the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the heaven<note placement="foot">Or “sky”</note> <transChange type="added">now</transChange> dwell, and all the animals of the field were on its branches.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This occurred</transChange> so that all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> trees <transChange type="added">with abundant</transChange> water will not become tall, and they will not set their treetop between<note placement="foot">Or “among”</note> their thick foliage,<note placement="foot">Or “clouds”</note> and so that<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all of the trees that are abundantly watered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of the drinkers of water”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will not stand up to them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will not stand to them”</note> in their tallness, for all of them, they have been given over to death, to the world below in the midst of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mortals⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons of men,” or “children of humankind”</note> to the people going down to the grave.”<note placement="foot">Or “pit”</note>  <div eID="gen22888" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9646"/><div sID="gen22889" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9646"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “On the day of its going down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Sheol, I caused mourning; I covered over it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the deep, and I withheld its rivers, and many waters were restrained, and I brought gloom over it; Lebanon and all of the trees of the field, they <transChange type="added">had</transChange> fainted because of it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:16
verses.text: From the sound of its downfall I caused nations to shake when I made it go down to Sheol, with <transChange type="added">the people</transChange> going down to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grave,<note placement="foot">Or “the pit”</note> and so in the world below all of the trees of Eden, the choice and the best of Lebanon, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the well-watered trees⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all ofthe drinkers of water”</note> were comforted!

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:17
verses.text: They also went down with it to Sheol to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who died by the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the slain of the sword”</note> and its army <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> lived in its shadow in the midst of nations.  <div eID="gen22889" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9647"/><div sID="gen22890" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9647"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞To whom could you be compared, whether in glory or in majesty⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To who you are like as in glory and in majesty”</note> among the trees of Eden? And yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the world below; in the midst of the uncircumcised you will lie with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who died by the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the slain of the sword”</note> That is Pharaoh and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his entire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all his hordes/crowd”</note> crowd!”<note placement="foot">Or “hordes”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.31"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9648"/><title type="x-s">A Lament for Pharaoh, King of Egypt</title> <div sID="gen22891" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9648"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it was/happened”</note> in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the twelfth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “two of ten”</note> year, in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twelfth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in two ten month”</note> month, on the first day of the month, the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> raise a lament over Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and you must say to him, <div eID="gen22891" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22892"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22893"/>‘<transChange type="added">With</transChange> a fierce, strong lion among nations you compared yourself,<l eID="gen22893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22894"/>and you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like the sea monster in the seas,<l eID="gen22894" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22895"/>and you thrash about in your rivers,<l eID="gen22895" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22896"/>and you make water turbid with your feet,<l eID="gen22896" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22897"/>and you make your rivers muddy. <l eID="gen22897" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22892"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9649"/><div sID="gen22898" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9649"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22898" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22899"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22900"/>Now I will spread my net over you<l eID="gen22900" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22901"/>in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> assembly of many peoples,<l eID="gen22901" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22902"/>and I will bring you up in my dragnet. <l eID="gen22902" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9650"/><l level="1" sID="gen22903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9650"/>And I will throw you on the ground;<l eID="gen22903" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22904"/>on the surface of the open field I will hurl you,<l eID="gen22904" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22905"/>and I will cause every bird of the heaven to dwell on you,<l eID="gen22905" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22906"/>and I will satisfy the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of all of the world from you. <l eID="gen22906" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9651"/><l level="1" sID="gen22907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9651"/>And I will put your flesh on the mountains,<l eID="gen22907" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22908"/>and I will fill the valleys <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your carcass. <l eID="gen22908" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9652"/><l level="1" sID="gen22909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9652"/>And I will water <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your discharge from your blood<l eID="gen22909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22910"/>on the mountains,<l eID="gen22910" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22911"/>and valleys will be filled from<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> you. <l eID="gen22911" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9653"/><l level="1" sID="gen22912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9653"/>And I will cover <transChange type="added">you</transChange> at<note placement="foot">Or “by”</note> extinguishing your heavens,<l eID="gen22912" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22913"/>and I will make dark their stars,<l eID="gen22913" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22914"/>and I will cover <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun with the cloud,<l eID="gen22914" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22915"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moon will not give its light. <l eID="gen22915" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9654"/><l level="1" sID="gen22916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9654"/>All<note placement="foot">Or “every”</note> sources of light in the heavens,<l eID="gen22916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22917"/>I will make them dark over you,<l eID="gen22917" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22918"/>and I will put<note placement="foot">Or “give”</note> darkness on your land,’ ”<l eID="gen22918" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22899"/> <div sID="gen22919" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22919" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9655"/><lg sID="gen22920"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9655"/>“And I will disturb <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hearts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> of many peoples<l eID="gen22921" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22922"/>at my bringing <transChange type="added">about</transChange> your captivity among the nations,<l eID="gen22922" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22923"/>to countries that you do not know. <l eID="gen22923" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9656"/><l level="1" sID="gen22924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9656"/>And I will cause many peoples to be awestruck over you,<l eID="gen22924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22925"/>and their kings will shudder over you <transChange type="added">in</transChange> horror,<l eID="gen22925" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22926"/>at<note placement="foot">Or “when”</note> my brandishing my sword before their faces,<l eID="gen22926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22927"/>and they will tremble <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continually⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for moments/seconds”</note><l eID="gen22927" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22928"/>each <transChange type="added">person</transChange> for his life,<l eID="gen22928" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22929"/>on the day of your downfall.” <l eID="gen22929" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22920"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9657"/><div sID="gen22930" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9657"/>For thus says the Lord Yahweh: <div eID="gen22930" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22931"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22932"/>“The sword of the king of Babylon,<l eID="gen22932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22933"/>it will come to you. <l eID="gen22933" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9658"/><l level="1" sID="gen22934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9658"/>By the swords of warriors I will cause to fall your hordes<l eID="gen22934" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22935"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange> <transChange type="added">the most</transChange> ruthless of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations, all of them,<l eID="gen22935" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22936"/>and they will devastate the majesty of Egypt,<l eID="gen22936" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22937"/>and all of its hordes will be destroyed. <l eID="gen22937" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9659"/><l level="1" sID="gen22938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9659"/>And I will destroy all her domestic livestock<l eID="gen22938" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22939"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from on”</note> many waters.<l eID="gen22939" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22940"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> feet of humans<note placement="foot">Hebrew “human”</note> will not make them turbid again,<l eID="gen22940" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22941"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hooves of domestic livestock will not make them turbid. <l eID="gen22941" level="2"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9660"/><l level="1" sID="gen22942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9660"/>Then I will make their waters settle,<l eID="gen22942" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22943"/>and their rivers as the olive oil I will let flow,”<l eID="gen22943" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22931"/> <div sID="gen22944" type="x-p"/> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22944" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9661"/><lg sID="gen22945"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9661"/>“Then I make the land of Egypt <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation,<l eID="gen22946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22947"/>so that the land will be stripped from its fullness<l eID="gen22947" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22948"/>when I strike all of <transChange type="added">those</transChange> dwelling in it,<l eID="gen22948" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22949"/>and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh. <l eID="gen22949" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen22945"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9662"/><div sID="gen22950" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9662"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞This is⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “she is”</note> a lament, and they will chant it as a lament; the daughters of the nations will chant it as a lament over Egypt, and over all of its hordes they will chant it as a lament,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22950" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9663"/><div sID="gen22951" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9663"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it happened/was”</note> in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twelfth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “two of ten”</note> year, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the fifteenth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the five ten of”</note> day of the month, the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:18
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> mourn over the hordes of Egypt, and make her go down, and with her the daughters of mighty nations, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞down to the deep underworld⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the world/earth deeps/depth”</note> with the people going down to the grave.<note placement="foot">Or “pit” or “netherworld”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You are more lovely than whom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “from whom are you lovely”</note> Go down and be laid in rest with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> uncircumcised.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:20
verses.text: In the midst of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people slain by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword it<note placement="foot">Or “she”; that is, Egypt</note> is given they will fall to a sword; they carried her<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> off and all of her<note placement="foot">Or “its”</note> hordes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> chiefs of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> warriors will speak to him from the middle of Sheol; with his helpers they have gone down; the uncircumcised lie <transChange type="added">still</transChange>, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those slain by the sword⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the slain of the sword”</note>  <div eID="gen22951" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9664"/><div sID="gen22952" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9664"/>Assyria <transChange type="added">is</transChange> there and all of its assembly; all around it <transChange type="added">are</transChange> its graves, all of them killed, those fallen by the sword,

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:23
verses.text: who<note placement="foot">That is, Assyria</note> will be given its graves in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> remote areas of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit, and its assembly will be all around its grave, all of them killed, fallen by the sword, <transChange type="added">those</transChange> who spread terror in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living.  <div eID="gen22952" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9665"/><div sID="gen22953" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9665"/>Elam <transChange type="added">is</transChange> there and all of its hordes, all around its grave, all of them dead who fell by the sword, <transChange type="added">those</transChange> who went down uncircumcised to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> underworld,<note placement="foot">Literally “land/earth/world”</note> those who spread their terror to the land of the living, and now they bear their disgrace with the people going down to the grave.<note placement="foot">Or “pit” or “sheol”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:25
verses.text: In the midst of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slain they made a bed for her with all of her hordes all around its graves, all of them uncircumcised, slain by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword, for their terror was spread in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living, and they <transChange type="added">now</transChange> bear their disgrace with <transChange type="added">the people</transChange> going down to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grave;<note placement="foot">Or “pit”</note> in the midst of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slain it was placed.  <div eID="gen22953" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9666"/><div sID="gen22954" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9666"/>Meshech <transChange type="added">and</transChange> Tubal <transChange type="added">are</transChange> there and all of its hordes, all around him its graves, all of them uncircumcised <transChange type="added">and</transChange> killed by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword, for they gave their terror in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:27
verses.text: And they do not lie with warriors fallen from long ago, who went down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Sheol with their weapons of war,<note placement="foot">Literally “with the weapons of war their”</note> and they placed their sword under their heads, and their shields<note placement="foot">Reading “their shields” for “their guilt”</note> were on their bones, for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> terror of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> warriors <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of the living.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:28
verses.text: And you<note placement="foot">Evidently refers to Egypt</note> <transChange type="added">too</transChange> in the midst of uncircumcised <transChange type="added">people</transChange> will be broken, and you will lie with <transChange type="added">those</transChange> slain by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword.  <div eID="gen22954" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9667"/><div sID="gen22955" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9667"/>There <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Edom, its kings and all of its leaders who are laid <transChange type="added">along</transChange> with their might with <transChange type="added">those</transChange> killed by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword; they will lie with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> uncircumcised and with <transChange type="added">the people</transChange> going down to the grave.<note placement="foot">Or “pit”</note>  <div eID="gen22955" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9668"/><div sID="gen22956" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9668"/>There are <transChange type="added">also</transChange> the princes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north, all of them, all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Sidonians who have gone down, being ashamed <transChange type="added">to lie</transChange> with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> slain because<note placement="foot">Or “in spite of” (cf. NJPS, NIV)</note> of their terror that they caused from their might, and they lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword, and they bear their disgrace along with the people going down to the grave.<note placement="foot">Or “pit”</note>  <div eID="gen22956" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9669"/><div sID="gen22957" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9669"/>Pharaoh will see them, and he will be comforted over all of his hordes killed by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword, Pharaoh and all of his army,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:32
verses.text: “For<note placement="foot">Or “although”</note> he spread<note placement="foot">Hebrew “I gave”</note> my terror in the land of the living, and so he will be laid down in the midst of the uncircumcised with those killed by the sword: Pharaoh and all of his hordes,”<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.32"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9670"/><title type="x-s">Ezekiel Appointed as a Watchman and His Responsibility</title> <div sID="gen22958" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9670"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> speak to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the children of your people”</note> and you must say to them, ‘A land, if I bring over it a sword and the people of the land take a man, one from their number, and they appoint him for them as a watchman,

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:3
verses.text: and he sees the sword coming against the land, and he blows on the horn and he warns the people,

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:4
verses.text: and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone who listens⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the listening”</note> hears the sound of the horn and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he does not take warning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not he takes warning”</note> and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword comes and it takes him, his blood will be on his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">For</transChange> he heard the sound of the horn and he did not take warning; his blood will be on him. But <transChange type="added">if</transChange> he took warning, he saved his life.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> the watchman, if he sees the sword coming and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he does not blow⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not he blows on”</note> the horn, and the people are not warned, and the sword comes and it takes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “it takes from them a life”</note> he will be taken through his guilt, but his blood from the hand of the watchman I will seek.’  <div eID="gen22958" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:7
