verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9671"/><div sID="gen22959" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9671"/>“And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; if you hear a word from my mouth, then you must warn them from me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When I say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At my saying”</note> to the wicked, ‘Wicked one, you will certainly die,’ and you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞did not speak⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not you spoke”</note> to warn <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked from his way, he, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked, will die by his guilt, but his blood I will seek from your hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:9
verses.text: But, you, if you warn <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked from his way, to turn from it, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he does not turn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not he turns”</note> from his way, he will die by his guilt, and you will have saved your life.  <div eID="gen22959" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9672"/><div sID="gen22960" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9672"/>“And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> say to the house of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘So you said, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “Indeed, our transgressions and our sins <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on us, and because of them we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> rotting, and how can we live?” ’

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:11
verses.text: Say to them, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,’<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely I have no delight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if”</note> in the death of the wicked, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞except⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for it”</note> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked returning from his way, and he lives. Turn back! Turn back from your ways, O evil <transChange type="added">ones</transChange>, for why should you die, house of Israel?’  <div eID="gen22960" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9673"/><div sID="gen22961" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9673"/>“So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> say to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the children of your people”</note> that the righteousness of the righteous shall not save him in the day of his transgression, and the wickedness of the wicked <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will not cause him to stumble⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not he will stumbled by it”</note> on the day of his returning from his wickedness; and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous will not be able to live by it on the day when he returns to his sin.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:13
verses.text: When I say to the righteous, ‘Certainly he will live,’ and he trusted in<note placement="foot">Or “on”</note> his righteousness, and he turns and he does injustice, all of his righteousness<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> will not be remembered, and because of his injustice that he did, because of it he will die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:14
verses.text: And when I say to the wicked, ‘Certainly you will die,’ but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> he returns from his sin and he does justice and righteousness—

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">for example</transChange>, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked returns a pledge for a loan, he restores <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞stolen property⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “robbed/stolen items”</note> he goes in the statutes of life <transChange type="added">so as</transChange> not to do injustice—certainly he will live; he will not die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:16
verses.text: All of his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sins that he committed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sins that he sinned”</note> they will not be remembered against<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> him, and he did justice and righteousness; certainly he will live.  <div eID="gen22961" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9674"/><div sID="gen22962" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9674"/>“Yet<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the children of your people”</note> say, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair!’ <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> their way is not fair.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:18
verses.text: When <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous turns from his righteousness and does injustice, then he will die <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “by/in them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:19
verses.text: And when the wicked turns from his wickedness, and he does justice and righteousness, because of it<note placement="foot">Hebrew “them”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will certainly live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “he, he will live”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:20
verses.text: Yet you said, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair!’ I will judge you, house of Israel, each <transChange type="added">person</transChange> according to his ways.”  <div eID="gen22962" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9675"/><div sID="gen22963" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9675"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it happened”</note> it was in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the twelfth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “two of ten”</note> year, in the tenth month, on the fifth day of the month of our exile, a survivor from Jerusalem came to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> “The city was destroyed!”

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:22
verses.text: And the hand of Yahweh was on me on the evening <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the coming of the survivor, and he opened my mouth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before the survivor came to me in the morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until coming to me in the morning”</note> and my mouth was opened, and I was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no longer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not I was dumb still”</note> dumb.<note placement="foot">Or “silent” or “speechless”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:23
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:24
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> the inhabitants of these ruins on the soil of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was one man, and he took possession of the land, and we are many; the land has been given for<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> us as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> possession.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:25
verses.text: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “You eat blood <transChange type="added">in your meat</transChange>, and you raise your eyes to your idols and you pour out blood, and <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> you want to take possession of the land?<note placement="foot">Or “you would take possession of”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:26
verses.text: You rely on your sword, you do a detestable thing, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each man defiles⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man the wife of neighbor you defile”</note> the wife of his neighbor, and yet you want to take possession of the land?” ’<note placement="foot">Or “you would take possession of the land”</note>  <div eID="gen22963" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9676"/><div sID="gen22964" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9676"/>“Thus you must say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I live”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> whoever is in the ruins, by the sword they will fall, and whoever is on the surface of the open field, I will give him to the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> to eat him, and whoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the stronghold and in the cave, they will die by the plague.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:28
verses.text: And I will make the land <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation and <transChange type="added">a</transChange> wasteland, and the pride of its strength will come to an end, and the mountains of Israel will be desolate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with no one traveling through them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.” ’<note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not someone going over”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:29
verses.text: And they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh when I make my land <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation and <transChange type="added">a</transChange> wasteland, because of all of their detestable things that they have done.  <div eID="gen22964" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9677"/><div sID="gen22965" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9677"/>“And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the children of your people”</note> the ones talking together concerning you beside the walls and in the doorways of the houses, each one with his brother <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Please come and hear what is the word <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that is going out from Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “the going out from with Yahweh”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:31
verses.text: And they come to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as people do⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “like the coming of a people”</note> and they sit <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> and my people hear your words, and they do not do them, for they are showing<note placement="foot">Or “expressing”</note> passion in their mouth, but their heart <transChange type="added">is</transChange> going after ill-gotten gain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:32
verses.text: Now, look! You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> to them like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a sensual song⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “like a song of lust”</note> beautiful of voice and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞played well on an instrument⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “doing good to play a music instrument”</note> and they hear your words, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but they are not doing them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and/but doing there is not they them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:33
verses.text: So<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when it comes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in/at her coming”</note> look! It is coming! And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> they will know that a prophet was in the midst of them.”  <chapter eID="Ezek.33"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9678"/><title type="x-s">Prophecy Concerning Israel’s Shepherds and Sheep</title> <div sID="gen22966" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9678"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and you must say to them, to the shepherds, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Woe <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the shepherds of Israel who were feeding themselves! Must not the shepherds feed the flock?

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:3
verses.text: The fat you eat, and you clothe <transChange type="added">yourself</transChange> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the wool; the well-nourished <transChange type="added">animals</transChange> you slaughter, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> you do not feed the flock.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:4
verses.text: The weak you <transChange type="added">have</transChange> not strengthened, and the sick you <transChange type="added">have</transChange> not healed, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with respect to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for”</note> the hurt<note placement="foot">Or “wounded”</note> you have not bound them up, and you have not brought back the scattered, and you have not sought the lost, but rather you ruled over them with force<note placement="foot">Or “violence”</note> and with ruthlessness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:5
verses.text: And they were scattered <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from not”</note> a shepherd, and they were<note placement="foot">Or “became”</note> as food for all the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the field <transChange type="added">when</transChange> they were scattered.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:6
verses.text: My flock went astray upon all of the mountains and on every high hill, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> upon all the surface of the world<note placement="foot">Or “earth”</note> my flock were scattered, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there was no one seeking them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “there was not someone seeking them”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there was no one searching for them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “there was not someone searching for them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:7
verses.text: Therefore, hear, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> shepherds, the word of Yahweh:

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:8
verses.text: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Surely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> because my flock have become as plunder, and my flock became as food to<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> all the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the field, since there was not a shepherd, <transChange type="added">since</transChange> my shepherds <transChange type="added">have</transChange> not sought my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and they fed not my flock,’ ”

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:9
verses.text: therefore, O shepherds, hear the word of Yahweh,

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:10
verses.text: ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against the shepherds, and I will seek my flock from their hand, and I will put an end to them from shepherding flocks, and the shepherds will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no longer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not any longer”</note> feed themselves, and I will deliver my flocks from their mouth, so that they will not be as food for them.”  <div eID="gen22966" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9679"/><div sID="gen22967" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9679"/>“ ‘For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I, even I, will seek my flock, and I will look after them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">just</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> caring of a shepherd <transChange type="added">for</transChange> his herd on<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> the day when he is in the midst of his scattered flock. Thus I will look after my flock, and I will deliver them from all the places <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to which they were scattered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which they were scattered there”</note> on the day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of storm and stress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “on the day of cloud and deep gloom”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:13
verses.text: And I will bring them out from the peoples, and I will gather them from the countries, and I will bring them to their soil, and I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, in the valleys, and in all of the settlements of the land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:14
verses.text: I will feed them in good pasture, and their pasture will be on the mountains of the heights of Israel; there they will lie down in good pasture, and <transChange type="added">on</transChange> lush pasture they will feed on the mountains of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I, I”</note> will feed my flock and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I, I”</note> will allow them to lie down,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:16
verses.text: “I will seek the lost, and I will bring back the scattered, and I will bind <transChange type="added">up</transChange> the one hurt, and I will strengthen the sick; and the fat and the strong I will destroy. I will feed her with justice.”  <div eID="gen22967" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9680"/><div sID="gen22968" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9680"/>“ ‘And you, my flock, thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> judging between <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one sheep and another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “small sheep and small sheep”</note> between the rams and between the he-goats.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:18
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Is it not enough for you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “is it too little from you”</note> that you feed on the good pasture? And still you must trample the remainder of your pasture with your feet, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞clear water⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and settling of water”</note> you drink, and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞leftover water⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “water being left”</note> you must make muddy with your feet.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:19
verses.text: And my flock must graze the <transChange type="added">pasture</transChange> treaded upon by<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> your feet, and must drink the mud puddle stirred up by<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> your feet.”  <div eID="gen22968" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9681"/><div sID="gen22969" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9681"/>“ ‘Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh to them: “Look! I, even I will judge between fat sheep and between lean sheep,

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:21
verses.text: because with <transChange type="added">your</transChange> flank and with <transChange type="added">your</transChange> shoulder you shoved, and with your horns you pushed all of the sick <transChange type="added">animals</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until that”</note> you scattered it<note placement="foot">Or “them”</note> to the outside.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:22
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I will save my flock, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will no longer be⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not they will be longer for plunder”</note> for plunder, and I will judge between <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one sheep and another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sheep and sheep”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:23
verses.text: And I will set up over them one shepherd, and he will feed them; <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be for them as<note placement="foot">Or “like”</note> a shepherd.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:24
verses.text: And I, Yahweh, I will be for them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as God⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to a God”</note> and my servant David <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> a leader in the midst of them. I, Yahweh, I have spoken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:25
verses.text: And I will make them a covenant of peace, and I will put an end to wild animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> from the land, and they will dwell in the desert <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞safely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence/trust”</note> and they will sleep in the forest.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:26
verses.text: And I will make them and <transChange type="added">the area</transChange> all around my hill a blessing, and I will let the rain go down <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at its appointed time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “in time his”</note> they will be rains of blessing.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:27
verses.text: And the tree<note placement="foot">Or “trees”</note> of the field will give its fruit, and the land will give its produce, and they will be on their land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞safely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with/in conficence”</note> and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh when I break their yoke, and I will deliver them from the hand of the ones enslaving them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:28
verses.text: And they will not be <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer plunder to the nations, and the animals of the land will not eat them, and they will dwell <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in safety⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence”</note> and <transChange type="added">there will</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be anyone</transChange> frightening <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:29
verses.text: And I will raise for them a garden plot<note placement="foot">Or “planting”</note> of renown, and they will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no longer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not any longer”</note> be victims of famine in the land, and they will not bear any more the insult of the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:30
verses.text: And they will know that I, Yahweh their God, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> with them and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my people, the house of Israel,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh,

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:31
verses.text: “and you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my flock, the flock of my pasture. You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “humanity, Mankind, human, mankind”</note> I am your God,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.’ ”  <chapter eID="Ezek.34"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9682"/><title type="x-s">Prophecy Directed at Edom</title> <div sID="gen22970" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9682"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> set your face against the mountain of Seir and prophesy against it,

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:3
verses.text: and you must say to it, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I am against you, mountain of Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you, and I will make you <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation and <transChange type="added">a</transChange> wasteland.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:4
verses.text: Your cities I will make ruins, and you will be <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh,

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:5
verses.text: because there <transChange type="added">has been</transChange> to you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an ancient hostility⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “enmity of eternity”</note> and you handed over the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> to the power of the sword at the time of their disaster, at the time of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their final punishment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the time of punishment of end”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:6
verses.text: Therefore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “Certainly to blood guilt I will prepare you and blood<note placement="foot">Or “blood vengeance”</note> will pursue; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞since⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you did not hate blood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “not blood you hated”</note> it will pursue you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:7
verses.text: And I will make the mountain of Seir into <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation and ruin, and I will cut off from it <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <transChange type="added">he who is</transChange> crossing over and <transChange type="added">he who is</transChange> returning.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:8
verses.text: And I will fill its mountains <transChange type="added">with</transChange> its slain; your hills and your valleys and all of your watercourses, the slain by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword will fall in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞An everlasting desolation⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of eternity/endless ages”</note> I will make you, and your cities will not return, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">I do this</transChange> because of your saying,<note placement="foot">Or “thinking”</note> ‘The two nations and the two lands, they will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to me”</note> and we will take possession of it,’ and <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> Yahweh was there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:11
verses.text: Therefore, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as I live⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “live I”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “so I will deal with you according to your anger and according to your jealousy that you did,<note placement="foot">Or “showed” or “acted on”</note> because of your hatred against them, and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:12
verses.text: And you will know that I, Yahweh, I have heard all of your contemptible words that you said<note placement="foot">Or “spoke”</note> against the mountains of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘They will be desolate; they are given to us as food.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:13
verses.text: And you magnified yourself against me with your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞insolent speech⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with your mouth”</note> and you spoke voluminously against me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your words—I heard!

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:14
verses.text: Thus the Lord Yahweh says, ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As the whole world rejoices⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as/like the rejoicing of all of the world”</note> I will make you <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Like your rejoicing over the inheritance of the house of Israel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as/like rejoicing your for the inheritance of the house of Israel”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because that”</note> it was desolate, I will do to you; you will be <transChange type="added">a</transChange> desolation, mountain of Seir and all of Edom, indeed all of it; and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.’ ” ’  <chapter eID="Ezek.35"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9683"/><title type="x-s">Prophecy to the Mountains of Israel and of Israel’s Restoration</title> <div sID="gen22971" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9683"/>“And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> prophesy to the mountains of Israel; and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you must say, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear the word of Yahweh;

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:2
verses.text: thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because the enemy said concerning you, ‘Ah, and<note placement="foot">Or “now”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ancient high places will be to us as a possession!’ ” ’

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:3
verses.text: Therefore prophesy, and you must say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Because indeed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with because”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you were desolate⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “you being desolate”</note> then they crushed you from all around, so that you became a possession to the remainder<note placement="foot">Or “the rest of”</note> of the nations, and you became <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a byword and object of slander for the people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “on lips of the tongue and slander of the people”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:4
verses.text: Therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh; thus says the Lord Yahweh to the mountains and to the hills, to the river channels and to the valleys and to the ruins that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> desolate and to the cities that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> abandoned <transChange type="added">and</transChange> that have become as plunder and as scorn for the remainder<note placement="foot">Or “the rest of”</note> of the nations that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> from all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:5
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Certainly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> in the fire of my passion I spoke against the rest of the nations and against all<note placement="foot">Literally “against Edom all of it”</note> Edom, who made my land as a possession, because of<note placement="foot">Or “in order to plunder its pastureland”</note> its pastureland for plunder, for themselves in all of the joy of their whole heart and in their inner disdain.”<note placement="foot">Or “malice/disrespect”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:6
verses.text: Therefore prophesy against the land of Israel, and you must say to the mountains and to the hills, to the river channels and to the valleys, thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I spoke in my passion and in my anger <transChange type="added">the</transChange> insult of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples you have endured.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:7
verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I swear⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I, raise my hand”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞certainly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> that the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that are all around you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “that are to you from all around”</note> they indeed will endure their disgrace.  <div eID="gen22971" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9684"/><div sID="gen22972" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9684"/>“ ‘ “But you, mountains of Israel, your branch you will shoot, and your fruit you will carry<note placement="foot">Or “bear”</note> for my people Israel, for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> soon to come.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:9
verses.text: For look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> for you, and I will turn you, and you will be tilled, and you will be planted.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:10
verses.text: And I will cause <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your population⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “humans/humankind”</note> to increase for you, all of the house of Israel, all of it, and the towns will be inhabited, and the ruins will be built.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:11
verses.text: And I will cause <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your population⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “humans/humankind”</note> to increase for you, and domestic animals, even they will be numerous, and they will be fruitful, and I will cause you to be inhabited like your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ancient times⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “past days/times/ancient times”</note> and I will do good <transChange type="added">things</transChange> more than <transChange type="added">in</transChange> your former times, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:12
verses.text: And I will send over you my people Israel, and they will take possession of you, and you will be for them as an inheritance, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will no longer bereave them of their children⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “not you will again longer to bring bereavement for them”</note>  <div eID="gen22972" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9685"/><div sID="gen22973" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9685"/>“ ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh, because <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> saying to you, “You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <transChange type="added">an</transChange> eater of humans,<note placement="foot">Or “peoples”</note> and you are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one who makes childless⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “maker of childless”</note> your people.”<note placement="foot">That is, Israel and Judah; Cf. <reference osisRef="Ezek.37.15-Ezek.37.22">Ezek 37:15–22</reference></note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:14
verses.text: Therefore humans<note placement="foot">Or “peoples”</note> you will not eat any longer, and your nation you will not make childless<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> any longer,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:15
verses.text: “And I will not let you hear <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer the insult of the nations, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> disgrace of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples you will not bear <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer; you <transChange type="added">yourself</transChange> will not cause your nation to stumble,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.’ ”  <div eID="gen22973" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9686"/><div sID="gen22974" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9686"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:17
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> the house of Israel, they were dwelling on their soil, and they defiled it with their way and with their deeds; like the uncleanness of menstruation was their way <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:18
verses.text: And I poured out my rage on them for the blood that they poured on the land and for their idols <transChange type="added">with which</transChange> they defiled it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:19
verses.text: And I scattered them among the nations, and I dispersed <transChange type="added">them</transChange> in the countries according to their way, and according to their deeds I judged them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:20
verses.text: And they came<note placement="foot">Or “went”</note> into the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to which they went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “who/which they went there”</note> and they profaned <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the name of my holiness”</note> when they said to them, ‘These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the people of Yahweh, and from his land they went out.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:21
verses.text: And I was concerned for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the name of my holiness”</note> which, the house of Israel defiled among the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to which they went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “which they went there”</note>  <div eID="gen22974" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9687"/><div sID="gen22975" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9687"/>“Therefore thus say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Not for your sake⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not for the sake of/on behalf of you”</note> am I about to act, house of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for it”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for my holy name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for the name of holiness my”</note> which you defiled among the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to which you went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “which you went there”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:23
verses.text: And I will consecrate my great name, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> profaned among the nations <transChange type="added">and</transChange> which you have profaned in the midst of them, and the nations will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh!” ’ <transChange type="added">a</transChange> declaration of the Lord Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when I show myself holy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at/in showing/to show self holy my”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to their eyes”</note> their eyes.  <div eID="gen22975" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9688"/><div sID="gen22976" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9688"/>“ ‘And I will take you from the nations, and I will gather you from all of the lands, and I will bring you to your land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:25
verses.text: And I will sprinkle on you pure water, and you will be clean from all of your uncleanness, and I will cleanse you from all of your idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:26
verses.text: And I will give a new heart to you, and a new spirit I will give<note placement="foot">Or “put/place”</note> into your inner parts, and I will remove the<note placement="foot">Or “your”</note> heart of stone from your flesh, and I will give to you a heart of flesh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:27
verses.text: And I will give<note placement="foot">Or “place/put”</note> my spirit into your inner parts, and I will make it so that you will go<note placement="foot">Or “walk”</note> in my rules, and my regulations you will remember, and you will do <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:28
verses.text: And you will dwell in the land that I gave to your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and you will be to me as a people, and I will be to you as<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:29
verses.text: And I will save you from all of your uncleanness, and I will call to the grain, and I will cause it to increase, and I will not bring famine upon you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:30
verses.text: And I will cause the fruit of the tree and the crop of the field to increase, so that you will not suffer again <transChange type="added">the</transChange> disgrace of famine among the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:31
verses.text: And you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> not good, and you will loathe <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for face your”</note> over<note placement="foot">Or “because of”</note> your iniquities and over your detestable things.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:32
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> not for your sake <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I acting,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh. “Let it be known to you, be ashamed, and be put to shame because of your ways, house of Israel.  <div eID="gen22976" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9689"/><div sID="gen22977" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9689"/>“Thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘On the day when I cleanse you from all of your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:34
verses.text: And the land that was desolate will be cultivated in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the very place that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the place that/which/where”</note> it was desolate before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of all of <transChange type="added">the persons</transChange> crossing over.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:35
verses.text: And they will say, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞This desolate land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the land this the being desolate”</note> has become like the garden of Eden, and the wasted and desolate and destroyed cities, <transChange type="added">now</transChange> being refortified, are inhabited.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:36
verses.text: And the nations who are left all around, you will know that I, Yahweh, I built <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that which was destroyed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the destroyed”</note> I planted the desolate <transChange type="added">land</transChange>; I, Yahweh, I have spoken, and I will act.’  <div eID="gen22977" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9690"/><div sID="gen22978" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9690"/>“Thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Again this <transChange type="added">time</transChange> I will let <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞myself be inquired of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will be/let me be searched”</note> by the house of Israel, to do something for them; I will cause them to increase <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their population like a flock⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “them as the flock humankind”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:38
verses.text: Like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flock of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sanctuary, like the flock of Jerusalem at its festival, so the desolate cities will be filled with flocks<note placement="foot">Hebrew “flock”</note> of people; and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.’ ”  <chapter eID="Ezek.36"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9691"/><title type="x-s">A Valley of Dried Bones; A Renewed Nation of Israel</title> <div sID="gen22979" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9691"/>The hand of Yahweh was upon me, and he brought me by the Spirit of Yahweh, and he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞let me rest⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “placed me”; literally “set me”</note> in the midst of the valley, and it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> full of bones.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:2
verses.text: And he led me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> over them, and look, very many on the surface of the valley, and look, very dry.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:3
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> can these bones live?” And I said, “Lord Yahweh, you know.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:4
verses.text: And he said to me, “Prophesy to these bones, and you must say to them, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the dry bones, ‘Hear the word of Yahweh!

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:5
verses.text: Thus says the Lord Yahweh to these bones: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> bringing into you breath, and you will live!

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:6
verses.text: And I will lay on you sinews, and I will let flesh come upon you, and I will cover you over <transChange type="added">with</transChange> skin, and I will put breath into you, and you will live, and you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen22979" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9692"/><div sID="gen22980" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9692"/>And I prophesied <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> I had been commanded, and <transChange type="added">there</transChange> was a sound at my prophesying, and look! A rattling, and they came together—<transChange type="added">the</transChange> bones! Bone to its bone!

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:8
verses.text: And I looked, and indeed, sinews <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on them, and flesh went up,<note placement="foot">Or “appeared”</note> and skin covered over<note placement="foot">Or “on”</note> them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from to above”</note> but breath <transChange type="added">was</transChange> not in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:9
verses.text: And he said to me, “Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> and you must say to the breath, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from the four winds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from four winds”</note> “Come, O spirit and breath, on these dead ones, so that they may live!” ’ ”

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:10
verses.text: And I prophesied <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “like what”</note> he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they became alive, and they stood on their feet, a very, very large group.  <div eID="gen22980" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9693"/><div sID="gen22981" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9693"/>And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> these bones are all of the house of Israel; look! they are saying, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is destroyed; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞we are cut off as far as we are concerned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “we are cut in two for us”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:12
verses.text: Therefore prophesy, and you must say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> opening your graves, and I will bring you up from your graves, my people, and I will bring you to the land of Israel!

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:13
verses.text: And you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh when I open your graves when I bring you up from your graves, my people!

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:14
verses.text: And I will put my breath into you so that you may live, and I will cause you to rest on your soil, and you will know that I, Yahweh, I have spoken, and I will act!” ’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.”  <div eID="gen22981" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9694"/><div sID="gen22982" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9694"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:16
verses.text: “And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> take for yourself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a piece of wood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a piece of wood one”</note> and write on it, ‘For Judah and for the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> his associates,’ and take another piece of wood, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the piece of wood of<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> Ephraim and all of the house of Israel his associates.’

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:17
verses.text: And join them one to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> other with respect to you <transChange type="added">as</transChange> one <transChange type="added">piece of</transChange> wood, so that they may become one in your hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:18
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the children of your people”</note> say to you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note> ‘Will you not inform us <transChange type="added">as to</transChange> what these <transChange type="added">actions</transChange> mean for you?’

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> speak to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> taking <transChange type="added">the piece of</transChange> wood for Joseph that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the hand of Ephraim and the tribes of Israel its associates, and I will put them on it, <transChange type="added">the piece of</transChange> wood of Judah, and I will make them into one <transChange type="added">piece of</transChange> wood, so that they be one in my hand.’ ”

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:20
verses.text: And the <transChange type="added">pieces of</transChange> wood <transChange type="added">on</transChange> which you wrote will be in your hand before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:21
verses.text: And speak to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> taking the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> from among <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the nations to which they went⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “which they went there”</note> and I will gather them from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everywhere⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all around”</note> and I will bring them to their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> soil.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:22
verses.text: And I will make them into one nation in the land on the mountains of Israel, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will all have one king as their king⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and king one he will be for all of them to king”</note> and they<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> will not again be two nations and will not again divide into two kingdoms again.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:23
verses.text: And they will not defile themselves again with their idols and with vile idols and with all of their transgressions, and I will save them from all of their apostasy <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by which they sinned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “which they sinned by them”</note> and I will cleanse them and they will be for me as a people and I, I will be for them as God.  <div eID="gen22982" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9695"/><div sID="gen22983" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9695"/>“ ‘ “And my servant David <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> king over them, and one shepherd will be for all of them, and in my regulations they will go, and my statutes they will observe, and they will do them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:25
verses.text: And they will dwell on the land that I gave to my servant, to Jacob, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in which your ancestors dwelled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “which they dwelt in it your fathers”</note> and they will dwell on it, they and their children and the children of their children <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until eternity” or “until unlimited time”</note> and my servant David will be a leader for them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity” or “to endless ages”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:26
verses.text: And I will make with them a covenant of peace; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a covenant of eternity”</note> it will be with them. And I will establish them, and I will cause them to increase, and I will put my sanctuary in the midst of them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity” or “to unlimited ages”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:27
verses.text: And my tabernacle will be with them, and I will be for them as God, and they will be to me as a nation.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:28
verses.text: And the nations will know that I, Yahweh, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> consecrating Israel when my sanctuary <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the midst of them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.” ’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity” or “to unlimited ages”</note>  <chapter eID="Ezek.37"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9696"/><title type="x-s">God’s Message to Gog</title> <div sID="gen22984" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9696"/>And the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞saying⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to say”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:2
verses.text: “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> set your face toward Gog of the land of Magog, the head<note placement="foot">Or “chief”</note> leader of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:3
verses.text: And you must say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> against you, Gog, the head<note placement="foot">Or “chief”</note> leader of Meshach and Tubal,

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:4
verses.text: and I will turn you around, and I will place<note placement="foot">Or “give”</note> hooks in your cheeks, and I will bring you out and all of your horses and horsemen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fully armed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “clothed of fullness”</note> all of them, a great crowd, holding a shield,<note placement="foot">Or “buckler”</note> and small shield, and holding<note placement="foot">Or “wielding”</note> swords, all of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:5
verses.text: Persia, Cush, and Put <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with them, all of them, with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> small shield and helmet.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:6
verses.text: Gomer and all of its troops, Beth Togarmah, the remote areas of the north, and with all of its troops and many peoples with them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:7
verses.text: Be ready, and prepare <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yourselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for you”</note> you and all of your assembly,<note placement="foot">Or “battalions” or “hoards”</note> the assembling<note placement="foot">Or “assemblies”</note> around you, and you must be<note placement="foot">Or “serve”</note> for them as a guard.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:8
verses.text: After many days you will be mustered; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the last years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “final years”; literally “in the last of the years”</note> you will come to a restored land from the sword, gathered from many peoples on the mountains of Israel which were as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞permanent ruins⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “ruins continually/permanently”</note> but from peoples it was brought out, and they will dwell <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in safety⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence/assurance/trust”</note> all of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:9
verses.text: And you will advance like a storm; you will come, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> you will be like a cloud <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞covering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to cover”</note> the land, and all of your troops and many nations <transChange type="added">along</transChange> with you.”  <div eID="gen22984" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9697"/><div sID="gen22985" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9697"/>“ ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it will be”</note> on that day, things<note placement="foot">Or “thoughts”</note> will come up on<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> your mind, and you will devise evil plans.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:11
verses.text: And you will say, ‘I will go up against a land of open country; I will come<note placement="foot">Or “go”</note> to the people being at rest <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in safety⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence”</note> all of them dwelling without a wall<note placement="foot">Or “walls”</note> and crossbars<note placement="foot">Hebrew “crossbar”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without doors⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and doors there are not for them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:12
verses.text: to<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> loot loot,<note placement="foot">Or “war-booty”; this word is chosen because of the alliteration in Hebrew</note> and to plunder<note placement="foot">Or “seize”; this word is chosen because of the alliteration in Hebrew</note> plunder, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to assail⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to bring back your hand against”; NJPS, “to turn your hand against”</note> inhabited ruins and <transChange type="added">a</transChange> people gathered together from <transChange type="added">various</transChange> peoples <transChange type="added">and who are</transChange> acquiring livestock and goods <transChange type="added">and</transChange> dwelling at the center of the world.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:13
verses.text: Sheba and Dedan and traders of Tarshish and all its strong lions,<note placement="foot">Or “all of its violent leaders”</note> they will ask you, ‘To<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> loot loot<note placement="foot">Or “war-booty” this word is chosen because of the alliteration in Hebrew</note> are you coming? To plunder<note placement="foot">Or “seize”; this word is chosen because of the alliteration in Hebrew</note> plunder have you summoned your assembly, to take away silver and gold, to take livestock and goods, to loot great amounts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “amount”</note> of loot?” ’  <div eID="gen22985" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9698"/><div sID="gen22986" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9698"/>“Therefore prophesy, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> and you must say to Gog, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Will you not realize<note placement="foot">LXX reads, “stir up/rouse yourself”</note> on that day when my people Israel are dwelling <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in safety⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence/trust”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:15
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you will come from your place, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> remote areas of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north, you and many people with you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞horsemen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “riders of horsemen”</note> all of them, a great crowd and a vast army,

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:16
verses.text: and you will advance against my people Israel like a cloud <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞covering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to cover”</note> the land; it will be<note placement="foot">Or “occur”</note> in the last days, and I will bring you against my land, so that the nations know me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when I show myself holy through you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/> before their eyes, O Gog!” ’  <div eID="gen22986" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9699"/><div sID="gen22987" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9699"/>“Thus says the Lord Yahweh, ‘<transChange type="added">Are</transChange> you he of whom I spoke in former days by the hand of my servants the prophets of Israel <transChange type="added">who</transChange> were prophesying in those days for years <transChange type="added">that I would</transChange> bring you against them?

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:18
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> then in that day, on the day of the coming of God against the land of Israel,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, ‘my rage will come up in my anger.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:19
verses.text: And in my passion, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the fire of my wrath, I spoke<note placement="foot">Or “I asserted”</note> that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞certainly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if not”</note> on that day <transChange type="added">a</transChange> great earthquake will be on the land of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:20
verses.text: And the fish of the sea and the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the heaven<note placement="foot">Or “sky”</note> and the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the field and all of the creeping things that creep on the earth and all of the humans<note placement="foot">Or “every human being”</note> who are on the surface of the earth will shake <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at my presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of me”</note> and the mountains will be demolished, and the steep mountain sides will fall, and every wall on<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> the earth will fall.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:21
verses.text: And I will call against him<note placement="foot">Or “summon against him” (cf. NJPS)</note> in all of my mountains a sword,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, ‘<transChange type="added">And</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword of each <transChange type="added">person</transChange> will be against his brother.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:22
verses.text: And I will execute justice with<note placement="foot">Or “with respect to him”</note> him with a plague and with blood and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞torrents of rain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “rain flooding/pouring down”</note> and hailstones; fire and sulfur I will cause to fall on him and on his troops and on many peoples who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:23
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I will exalt myself, and I will show myself holy, and I will make myself known before <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eyes of many nations, and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.’ ”  <chapter eID="Ezek.38"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9700"/><title type="x-s">God’s Destruction of Gog and His Hordes</title> <div sID="gen22988" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9700"/>“And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> prophesy against Gog, and you must say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Look! I am against you Gog, the head<note placement="foot">Or “chief”</note> leader of Meshech and Tubal,

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:2
verses.text: and I will turn you around, and I will drag you along, and I will bring you up from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> remote areas of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north, and I will bring you against the mountains of Israel,

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:3
verses.text: and I will strike your bow from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your left hand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the hand of left your”</note> and your arrows from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your right hand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the hand of right your”</note> I will cause to fall.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:4
verses.text: On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all of your troops, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> peoples who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with you, to birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of prey, birds of every wing,<note placement="foot">Or “kind”</note> and animals of the field I will give you as food.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:5
verses.text: On the surface of the field you will fall, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I, I”</note> have spoken,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:6
verses.text: “And I will send fire against Magog and among <transChange type="added">the people</transChange> inhabiting the coastlands <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in safety⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence/trust”</note> and they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:7
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the name of my holiness”</note> I will make known in the midst of my people Israel, and I will not let the name of my holiness be profaned anymore, and the nations will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy <transChange type="added">one</transChange> in Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:8
verses.text: Look! <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> coming, and it will happen,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh. “It is the day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞about which I have spoken⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “which I have spoken of”</note>  <div eID="gen22988" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9701"/><div sID="gen22989" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9701"/>“ʻ“And the inhabitants of the towns<note placement="foot">Or “cities”</note> of Israel will go out, and they will set ablaze, and they will kindle a fire with a weapon<note placement="foot">Or “weapons”</note> and a small shield and a shield,<note placement="foot">Or “shields and bucklers”; cf. NJPS</note> with a bow and with arrows, and with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hand clubs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with club of hand”</note> and with spears,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “spear”</note> and so they will light a fire with them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a fire lasting seven years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a fire of seven years”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:10
verses.text: And they will not carry trees from the field, and they will not chop wood from the forests, for with the weapons<note placement="foot">Hebrew “weapon”</note> they will light a fire; and they will plunder those plundering them, and they will plunder those plundering them,” ’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen22989" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9702"/><div sID="gen22990" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9702"/>“ ‘ “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it will happen”</note> on that day I will give to Gog <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a grave there⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a place there of a grave”</note> in Israel, The Valley of the Travelers, east of the sea,<note placement="foot">That is, the Dead Sea</note> and it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will block⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “blocking”</note> the travelers and Gog and all of his hordes<note placement="foot">Hebrew “horde”</note> they will bury there, and they will call it the Valley of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Hamon-Gog⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Gog’s Multitude”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:12
verses.text: And the house of Israel will bury them for seven months to cleanse the land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:13
verses.text: All of the people of the land will bury them, and it will be an honor for them <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the day when I appear,” ’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:14
verses.text: ʻ“And they will set apart <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞men to continually⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “men of continuity/men who regularly”</note> go through the land burying the travelers,<note placement="foot">In a negative sense = “invaders”</note> the ones left over on the surface of the land to cleanse it; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the whole of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the end of”</note> seven months they will explore <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:15
