verses.text: And the ones going through, they will go through within the land, and if <transChange type="added">anyone</transChange> sees <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bones of <transChange type="added">a</transChange> person, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> he will build beside it a sign <transChange type="added">to remain</transChange> until the buriers have buried him in the Valley of Hamon-Gog.<note placement="foot">Or “Gog’s multitude”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:16
verses.text: And furthermore <transChange type="added">the</transChange> name of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city <transChange type="added">there</transChange> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Hamonah,<note placement="foot">That is, “Multitude”</note> and <transChange type="added">thus</transChange> they will cleanse the land.” ’  <div eID="gen22990" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9703"/><div sID="gen22991" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9703"/>“And you, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Say to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all kinds of birds and animals of the field⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to bird of every wind and to every animal of the field”</note> “Be gathered, come be gathered <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from everywhere⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all around”</note> to my sacrifice that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> sacrificing for you, a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, and you will eat flesh, and you will drink blood.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:18
verses.text: Flesh of warriors you will eat, and the blood of leaders of the land you will drink; rams, young rams and goats, bulls, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the fattened animals of Bashan—all of them!

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:19
verses.text: And you will eat fat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until you are satiated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “satiation/gluttony”</note> and you will drink blood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until you are drunk⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to drunkenness”</note> from my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you,

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:20
verses.text: and you will be satisfied at my table <transChange type="added">with</transChange> horse and horsemen and warriors and every man of war,” ’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:21
verses.text: “And I will display my glory among the nations, and all of the nations will see my judgment that I have executed and my hand that I have laid upon them.  <div eID="gen22991" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9704"/><div sID="gen22992" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9704"/>“And the house of Israel will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh their God from that day and beyond,

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:23
verses.text: and the nations will know that because of their guilt the house of Israel went into exile, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because that”</note> they acted unfaithfully against me, and I hid my face from them, and I gave them into the hand of their foes, and they fell by the sword, all of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:24
verses.text: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgression I dealt with them, and I hid my face from them.  <div eID="gen22992" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9705"/><div sID="gen22993" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9705"/>Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob, and I will have compassion on all of the house of Israel, and I will be jealous<note placement="foot">Or “zealous”</note> for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for the name of holiness my”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:26
verses.text: And they will forget their disgrace and all of their infidelity that they displayed against me when they dwelt on their soil <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in safety⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with confidence”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with nobody making them afraid⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and not was somebody making afraid”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:27
verses.text: When I restore them from the nations and I gather them from the countries of their enemies, then I will show myself holy through them before the eyes of many nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:28
verses.text: And they will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh their God, <transChange type="added">because of</transChange> when I deported them into the nations, and I reassembled them to their soil, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will not let any of them remain there any longer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not I will leave over/let remain again/still from them there”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:29
verses.text: And I will not hide my face again from them when I pour out my Spirit over<note placement="foot">Or “upon”</note> the house of Israel,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.39"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9706"/><title type="x-s">A Vision of the New Temple</title> <div sID="gen22994" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9706"/>In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was destroyed, in this day exactly, the hand of Yahweh was on me, and he brought me there

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:2
verses.text: in visions from God. He brought me to the land of Israel and put me on a very high mountain, and on it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like a structure of a city to the south.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:3
verses.text: And he brought me there, and look, there was a man whose<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> appearance <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appearance of bronze, and a cord of linen <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in his hand and a reed for measurement; <transChange type="added">he</transChange> was standing in the gate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:4
verses.text: And the man spoke to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> look with your eyes and listen with your ears and apply<note placement="foot">Or “set/put”</note> your heart to all that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> showing you, for you were brought here in order to show you <transChange type="added">this</transChange>; tell all that you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> seeing to the house of Israel.”  <div eID="gen22994" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9707"/><title type="x-s">The Eastern Gate</title> <div sID="gen22995" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9707"/>And there was a wall on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> outside of the temple <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> and in the hand of the man the reed<note placement="foot">Or “rod”</note> for measurement was six long cubits, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with/in”</note> the cubit<note placement="foot">That is, about 18 inches</note> and a handbreadth,<note placement="foot">A handbreadth wasabout 3 inches; the reed/rod was 10.5 feet long</note> and he measured the width of the outer wall as one reed,<note placement="foot">That is, 10.5 feet</note> and the height as one reed.<note placement="foot">That is, about 10.5 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> he went toward<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> the gate whose face was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the way toward the east”</note> And he went up by<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> its steps, and he measured the threshold of the gate, one reed<note placement="foot">That is, about 10.5 feet</note> wide.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:7
verses.text: And the alcove<note placement="foot">Or “niches” in the temple tower</note> was one reed<note placement="foot">That is, about 10.5 feet</note> long and one reed<note placement="foot">That is, about 10.5 feet</note> wide,<note placement="foot">That is, 10.5 x 10.5 feet</note> and between the alcoves was five cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, about 8.75 feet</note> and the threshold of the gate along the side of the portico of the gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the inside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the house”</note> was one reed.<note placement="foot">That is, about 10.5 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:8
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> he measured the portico of the gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the inside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the house”</note> as one reed.<note placement="foot">That is, about 10.5 feet.</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:9
verses.text: And he measured the portico of the gate <transChange type="added">as</transChange> eight cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, about 14 feet</note> and its pilaster was two cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 feet</note> thick, and he measured the portico of the gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the inside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from the house”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:10
verses.text: And the alcoves<note placement="foot">Hebrew “alcove”</note> of the gate toward the way<note placement="foot">Or “direction”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞eastward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of the east”</note> were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞three on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “was three from here and three from here”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the same measurements applied to all three of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “measurement one was to the three of them”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the same measurement applied to the pilaster⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “measurement one was to the pilaster”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from here and from there”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:11
verses.text: And he measured the width of the doorway of the gate <transChange type="added">as</transChange> ten cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 17.5 feet</note> and the length of the gateway<note placement="foot">Hebrew “gate”</note> was thirteen cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 22.75 feet; or the inside width of the gateway was 22.75 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:12
verses.text: And a wall<note placement="foot">Or “guard wall”; others prefer “curb” (NLT)</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was to the face of”</note> the alcoves; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one cubit<note placement="foot">That is, about 18 inches</note> on either side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cubit one and cubit one”; or 21 inches</note> was the wall from here.<note placement="foot">Or “from the front”</note> And the alcove <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was six cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 10.5 feet</note> on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “was six cubits from here and six cubits from here”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:13
verses.text: And he measured the gate from the top slab of the alcove to its <transChange type="added">opposite</transChange> top slab <transChange type="added">as</transChange> twenty-five cubits <transChange type="added">in</transChange> width, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from one entrance to the other one opposite it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “doorway opposite doorway”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:14
verses.text: And he made <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pilasters sixty cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 105 feet (problematic in this context)</note> and to the pilaster of the courtyard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around the gate⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the gate all around, all around”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And from the front of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and at the face of”</note> the gate at the entrance to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the front of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the face of”</note> the portico of the inner gate was fifty cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 87.5 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:16
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> narrow windows for the alcoves and for their pilasters to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inside of the gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> it. And likewise with respect to the porticos and windows were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> to the inside, and on a pilaster there were images of palm trees.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “tree”</note>  <div eID="gen22995" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9708"/><title type="x-s">The Outer Courtyard</title> <div sID="gen22996" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9708"/>And he brought me to the outer courtyard, and there were chambers and a pavement made for the courtyard all around <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> thirty chambers <transChange type="added">were facing</transChange> to the pavement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:18
verses.text: And the pavement <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞flanked⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was to the side of”</note> the side of the gates <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and all along the gates⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to along side the length of the gates”</note> this <transChange type="added">describes</transChange> the lower pavement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:19
verses.text: And he measured <transChange type="added">the width</transChange> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the front of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the lower gate to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the front of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the outside of the inner courtyard as a hundred cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note> to the east and to the north.  <div eID="gen22996" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9709"/><title type="x-s">Measurement of the North Gate</title> <div sID="gen22997" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9709"/>And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> the gate that <transChange type="added">had</transChange> its face <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞toward the north⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the way of the north”</note> of the outer courtyard, he measured its length and its width.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:21
verses.text: And its alcoves <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞three on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “three from here and three from here”</note> and its pilasters and its porticos <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had the same measurement⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it was like the measurement of”</note> as the first gate: its length was fifty cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 87.5 feet</note> and its width was twenty-five <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cubits⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in/by the cubit”; 43.5 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:22
verses.text: And its windows and its porticos and its palm tree images <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like the measurement of the gate that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞facing toward the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “its face to the way of the east”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it had⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and with steps”</note> seven steps that go up it, and there were porticos <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of them”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:23
verses.text: And a gate <transChange type="added">led</transChange> to the inner courtyard, opposite the gate to the north and to the east, and he measured from gate to gate <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a hundred cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note>  <div eID="gen22997" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9710"/><title type="x-s">The Gate to the South</title> <div sID="gen22998" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9710"/>And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> he took me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞toward the south⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the way of the south”</note> and look, a gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞toward the south⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the way of the south”</note> and he measured its pilasters and its porticos; they had measurements just <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞like the others⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “like the measurements the these”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:25
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> for it windows and for its porticos <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> like these windows; fifty cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 87.5 feet</note> long and twenty-five cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 43.75 feet</note> wide.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:26
verses.text: And seven steps <transChange type="added">were</transChange> going up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> it and its porticos <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of them”</note> And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it had palm tree images⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and palm tree images were for it”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all along⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from here and one from here to”</note> its pilasters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:27
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the way of the south<note placement="foot">That is, “to the south”</note> a gate for the inner courtyard, and he measured from gate to the gate on the way of the south, a hundred cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note>  <div eID="gen22998" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9711"/><title type="x-s">Gates to the Inner Courtyard</title> <div sID="gen22999" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9711"/>And he brought me to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inner courtyard through<note placement="foot">Or “at”</note> the gate of the south, and he measured the south gate, and it had measurements like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the others⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the measurements the these”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:29
verses.text: And its alcoves and its pilasters and its porticos <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <transChange type="added">just</transChange> like these measurements. And <transChange type="added">it had</transChange> windows for it and for its porticos<note placement="foot">Hebrew “portico”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> fifty cubits<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cubit”</note> along<note placement="foot">Literally “long”</note> its length, and twenty-five cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 43.75 feet</note> <transChange type="added">wide</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:30
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> porticos <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> its length, twenty-five cubits;<note placement="foot">That is, 43.75 feet</note> and its width was five cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 8.75 feet, which differs from 40:9; the LXX and some Greek versions lack this verse altogether</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:31
verses.text: And its porticos <transChange type="added">were</transChange> to the outer courtyard, and palm tree images <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on its pilasters, and eight steps <transChange type="added">were for</transChange> its stairs.  <div eID="gen22999" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9712"/><div sID="gen23000" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9712"/>And he brought me to the inner courtyard <transChange type="added">by way of</transChange> the east <transChange type="added">gate</transChange>, and he measured the gate <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <transChange type="added">just</transChange> like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the other measurements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the measurements the these”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:33
verses.text: And its alcoves and its pilasters and its porticos <transChange type="added">were also</transChange> like these measurements, and windows <transChange type="added">were</transChange> for it and for its porticos all around;<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> its length was fifty cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 87.5 feet</note> and it was twenty-five cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 43.75 feet</note> wide.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:34
verses.text: And its porticos <transChange type="added">were</transChange> toward the outer courtyard, and palm tree images <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on its pilasters <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from here and from here”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞eight steps served as it stairs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and eight steps its stairs”</note>  <div eID="gen23000" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9713"/><div sID="gen23001" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9713"/>And he brought me to the gate of the north, and he measured <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; and he measured <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the same measurements as these others⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “like the measurements the these”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:36
verses.text: its alcoves, its pilasters and porticos, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and its windows⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “its windows were for it”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> and a length of fifty cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 87.5 feet</note> and twenty-five cubits wide.<note placement="foot">That is, 43.75 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:37
verses.text: And its pilasters <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞faced the outer courtyard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “were to the courtyard the outer”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it had palm tree images on its pilasters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and palm tree images were for its pilaster”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “from here and from here”</note> and eight steps <transChange type="added">served as</transChange> its stairs.  <div eID="gen23001" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9714"/><title type="x-s">Rooms for Sacrificial Preparations</title> <div sID="gen23002" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9714"/>And a chamber with its doorway <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in<note placement="foot">Or “set among”</note> the pilasters at the gates,<note placement="foot">Or “gate”</note> and there they rinsed off<note placement="foot">Or “washed”</note> the burnt offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:39
verses.text: And in the portico of the gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were two tables on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “were two tables from here and two tables from here”</note> to slaughter the burnt offering on them and the sin offering and the guilt offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:40
verses.text: And on the outer side as <transChange type="added">one</transChange> goes up to the doorway of the gate <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the north <transChange type="added">were</transChange> two tables, and on the other side, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> toward the portico of the gate, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> two tables.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:41
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞On each side of the gate were four tables⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “four tables from here and four tables from here”</note> eight tables <transChange type="added">in all</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> on them they slaughtered <transChange type="added">sacrifices</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:42
verses.text: And four tables <transChange type="added">were</transChange> for the burnt offering, <transChange type="added">and made of</transChange> dressed stones, one cubit and a half<note placement="foot">That is, 31.5 inches</note> long and one cubit and a half wide and one cubit<note placement="foot">That is, 21 inches</note> high <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was their measurements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “wasto them</note> and they placed the objects<note placement="foot">Or “instruments/utensils”</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which they slaughtered the burnt offering on them and the sacrifice.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:43
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> double-pronged hooks, one handbreadth <transChange type="added">in width</transChange>, put in place in the house<note placement="foot">Or “inside”</note> all around, and on the tables <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the flesh of the offering.  <div eID="gen23002" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9715"/><title type="x-s">Rooms for Priests and Other Worship Leaders</title> <div sID="gen23003" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9715"/>And on the outside of the inner gate, <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> chambers for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> singers in the inner courtyard, which was to the side of the north gate, and their faces<note placement="foot">That is, of the chambers</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were to the south⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “were to the way of the south”</note> <transChange type="added">with respect to one</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> on the side of the east gate <transChange type="added">one</transChange> facing to the north.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:45
verses.text: And he said to me, “This chamber <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with its face toward the south⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which its face is to the way of the south”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the priests <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> taking care of the responsibility of the temple.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:46
verses.text: And the chamber <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with its face to the north⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with its face is to the way of the north”</note> is for the priests who are taking care of the responsibility of the altar. They are the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zadok, the ones who approach from among the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Levi to Yahweh to serve him.”  <div eID="gen23003" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9716"/><title type="x-s">Inner Courtyard and Temple Measurements</title> <div sID="gen23004" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9716"/>And he measured the courtyard <transChange type="added">as to its</transChange> length, a hundred cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note> and a hundred cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note> wide, squared, and the altar <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is in front of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before face of”</note> the temple.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:48
verses.text: And he brought me to the portico of the temple, and he measured <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pilaster of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> portico, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞five cubits on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">That is, 8.75 feet; literally “five cubits from here and five cubits from here”</note> and the width of the gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was three cubits on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “was three cubits from here and three cubits from here”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:49
verses.text: The length of the portico <transChange type="added">was</transChange> twenty cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 35 feet</note> and its width eleven cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 19.25 feet; LXX reads 12 cubits or 21 feet</note> and with ten steps they went up to it, and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pilasters had pillars⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and pillars were to the pilasters”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “one from here and one from here”</note>  <chapter eID="Ezek.40"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9717"/><title type="x-s">Sanctuary and Temple</title> <div sID="gen23005" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9717"/>And he brought me to the temple <transChange type="added">sanctuary</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Or “main room” (of the temple of Jerusalem); “great hall” (JPS); “outer sanctuary” (NIV); word can refer to surrounding courts and halls; HALOT 245.</note> and he measured the pilasters, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞six cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 10.5 feet</note> wide on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “six cubits wide from here and six cubits wide from here”</note> this was the width of the tent.<note placement="foot">Or “of the jambs”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:2
verses.text: And the width of the doorway <transChange type="added">was</transChange> ten cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 17.5 feet</note> and the sidewall of the doorway <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was five cubits on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “was five cubits from here and five cubits from here”; five cubits = 8.75 feet</note> and he measured its<note placement="foot">That is, the outer sanctuary</note> length as forty cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 70 feet</note> and its width was twenty cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 35 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:3
verses.text: And he went into <transChange type="added">the</transChange> inner <transChange type="added">room</transChange>, and he measured the pilaster of the doorway <transChange type="added">as</transChange> two cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 feet</note> and the doorway as six cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 10.5 feet</note> and the width of the doorway seven cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 12.25 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:4
verses.text: And he measured its length <transChange type="added">as</transChange> twenty cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 35 feet</note> and its width as twenty cubits to the front of the temple, and he said to me, “This is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the most holy place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the holy of the holies”</note>  <div eID="gen23005" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9718"/><div sID="gen23006" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9718"/>And he measured the wall of the temple <transChange type="added">as</transChange> six cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 10.5 feet</note> and the width of the side room as four cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 7 feet</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all along the outside wall for the temple all around the wall⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around for the temple all around”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:6
verses.text: And the side rooms <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞side by side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “were side room to side room”</note> in three stories and a total of thirty <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞rooms⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “times”</note> and there were offsets<note placement="foot">Meaning of word is uncertain</note> in the wall, which was for the temple for the side rooms, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> to be supports, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> they were not supports <transChange type="added">extending</transChange> into the wall of the temple.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:7
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">each level</transChange> widened, and it went around<note placement="foot">Or “was surrounded”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to above, to above”</note> to the side rooms for the structure that surrounds<note placement="foot">Or “goes around”</note> the temple <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to above, to above”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> therefore the width increased to the temple <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to above”</note> and thus the lower <transChange type="added">level</transChange> goes up to the upper <transChange type="added">level</transChange> by <transChange type="added">means of</transChange> the middle story.  <div eID="gen23006" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9719"/><div sID="gen23007" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9719"/>And I saw for the temple a platform <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> the foundations of the side rooms; it was the length of a full reed, six cubits long.<note placement="foot">That is, 10.5 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:9
verses.text: The width of the <transChange type="added">outside</transChange> wall, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> for the side room to the outside, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> five cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 8.75 feet</note> and <transChange type="added">a space</transChange> that was set between <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side rooms, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> for the temple

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:10
verses.text: and between the chambers <transChange type="added">was the</transChange> width of twenty cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 35 feet</note> all around the temple, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:11
verses.text: And the doorway of the side room <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞faced⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was to”</note> the open area; one doorway <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞faced⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was to”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the north⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the way of the north”</note> and one doorway was to the south, and the width of the place of the open area was five cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 8.75 feet</note> all around.<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:12
verses.text: And the building that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞faced⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was to the front of”</note> the courtyard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was toward the west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “wasto the side of the way of the sea/west”</note> and its width was seventy cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 122.5 feet</note> and the wall of the building was five cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 8.25 feet</note> wide <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> and its length was ninety cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 157.5 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:13
verses.text: And he measured the temple, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> its length <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <transChange type="added">a</transChange> hundred cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note> and the courtyard and the building and its walls, their length was a hundred cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:14
verses.text: And the width of the front of the temple and the courtyard to the east <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <transChange type="added">a</transChange> hundred cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:15
verses.text: And he measured the length of the building <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞facing the courtyard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the front of the courtyard”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the rear⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which was on behind her/it”</note> and its galleries, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a hundred cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note> on each side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from here and from here”</note> and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> the temple, the court, and the porticos of the courtyard,

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:16
verses.text: the thresholds and the framed windows and the galleries around the three of them. Before the threshold <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a covering of wood all around,<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> the ground up to the windows, and <transChange type="added">all around</transChange> the windows, <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> covered.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:17
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Above⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “On from on”</note> the doorway and up to the inner temple<note placement="foot">Or “sanctuary”</note> and on the outside, and on all of the wall <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> in the inner and in the outer areas were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞patterns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “measurements”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:18
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> made of cherubim and palm tree images; a palm tree image between cherub and cherub, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the cherub had two faces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “two faces were for the cherub”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:19
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> face of a human <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was toward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was to”</note> the palm tree image <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the one side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from here”</note> and the face of a fierce strong lion <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞faced⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was to”</note> the palm tree image <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the other side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “from here”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this work was executed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “being made”</note> for the entire temple <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:20
verses.text: From the ground up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞above⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “up to form on”</note> the doorway,<note placement="foot">Or “entrance”</note> the cherubim and the palm tree images were made,<note placement="foot">Or “being made”</note> and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> the <transChange type="added">outer</transChange> wall of the temple.  <div eID="gen23007" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9720"/><div sID="gen23008" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9720"/><transChange type="added">As far as</transChange> the temple <transChange type="added">is concerned</transChange> <transChange type="added">its</transChange> doorframe <transChange type="added">was</transChange> squared, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the front of”</note> the sanctuary <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the appearance as <transChange type="added">it were</transChange> the appearance of

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:22
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a wooden altar⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the altar made of wood”</note> that was three cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 5.25 feet</note> high, and its length was two cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 feet</note> and its corners<note placement="foot">Hebrew “corner”</note> for it and its length and its walls were of wood. And he spoke to me, “This is the table that is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh.”

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:23
verses.text: And the two doors <transChange type="added">were</transChange> for the temple and for the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:24
verses.text: And two leaves<note placement="foot">That is, two swinging leaves for each door</note> of a door <transChange type="added">were</transChange> for <transChange type="added">each of</transChange> the doors, two hinged leaves of a door: two <transChange type="added">were</transChange> for the first door, and two leaves of a door <transChange type="added">were</transChange> for the other door.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:25
verses.text: And cherubim <transChange type="added">were</transChange> made<note placement="foot">Or “carved”</note> on them, that is, on the doors of the temple and palm tree images like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the ones prepared for the walls⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “like which they were made for the walls”</note> and <transChange type="added">an</transChange> overhang <transChange type="added">of</transChange> wood <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on the surface of the porticos on the outside.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:26
verses.text: And narrow windows and palm tree images <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were on either side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “were from here and from here”</note> and on the side walls of the portico, and the side rooms of the temple and their<note placement="foot">Literally “the”</note> overhang.  <chapter eID="Ezek.41"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9721"/><title type="x-s">Description of Rooms for the Priests</title> <div sID="gen23009" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9721"/>And he brought me out to the outer courtyard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the north⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the way of the north”</note> and he brought me to the chamber which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> opposite the courtyard and which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> opposite the building to the north.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> to<note placement="foot">Or “along the face of”</note> the face of the length of the building with the doorway to the north, it was a hundred cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note> and its<note placement="foot">Or “the”</note> width was fifty cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 87.5 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:3
verses.text: Opposite the twenty <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of the inner courtyard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “which were to the courtyard the inner”</note> and opposite the pavement that was to the outer courtyard was a gallery <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞facing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “toward in the face/front of”</note> a gallery in the three <transChange type="added">stories</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:4
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in front of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the chambers was a passageway ten cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 17.5 feet</note> in width toward the inside, a walkway of one cubit,<note placement="foot">One cubit of 18–21 inches is problematic; LXX and Syriac read 100 cubits (175 feet) running the length of the building</note> and their doorways <transChange type="added">were</transChange> to the north.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:5
verses.text: And the upper chambers narrowed, for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> galleries took away <transChange type="added">space</transChange> from them more than <transChange type="added">they took</transChange> from the lower <transChange type="added">levels</transChange> and more than <transChange type="added">they took</transChange> from the middle <transChange type="added">level</transChange> <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> building.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:6
verses.text: For they<note placement="foot">Or “there”</note> were three stories and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they had no pillars⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there were not for them pillars”</note> like<note placement="foot">Or “as”</note> the pillars of<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> the courtyards; therefore they were smaller than the lower <transChange type="added">stories</transChange> and than the middle <transChange type="added">stories</transChange> from the ground <transChange type="added">up</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:7
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> a wall that was to the outside <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alongside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the outside to corresponding”</note> the chambers on the walkway to<note placement="foot">Or “of”</note> the outer courtyard<note placement="foot">That is, “to the north”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in front of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to in face of”</note> the chambers; its length was fifty<note placement="foot">That is, 87.5 feet</note> cubits.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cubit”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:8
verses.text: For<note placement="foot">Or “while”</note> the length of the chambers which were to the outer courtyard was fifty<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cubit”</note> cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 87.5 feet</note> and look!<note placement="foot">Or “yet!”</note> The chambers on the front of the temple were a hundred<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cubit”</note> cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 175 feet</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:9
verses.text: And from under these chambers <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the entrance<note placement="foot">Reading the Ketiv</note> from the east for them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when one enters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at/in his/its coming”</note> from the outer courtyard.  <div eID="gen23009" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9722"/><div sID="gen23010" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9722"/>All along the width of the wall of the courtyard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞eastward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on the way of the east”</note> in front of the courtyard to the front of the building <transChange type="added">were</transChange> chambers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:11
verses.text: And a walkway <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was to the face of them”</note> like the appearance of the chambers which were on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the north⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “were on the way of the north”</note> <transChange type="added">just</transChange> like <transChange type="added">them in</transChange> their length, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> so <transChange type="added">was</transChange> their width and all their exits, and <transChange type="added">they were built</transChange> like their arrangements and like their doorways,

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:12
verses.text: and like the doorways of the chambers which <transChange type="added">were on</transChange> the way of the south <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <transChange type="added">a</transChange> doorway at the head of the way<note placement="foot">Dropping one “way”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/> the stone wall, projecting<note placement="foot">Or “protecting wall”</note> on<note placement="foot">Or “toward”</note> the way of the east at their coming.<note placement="foot">That is, when people entered the complex</note>  <div eID="gen23010" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9723"/><div sID="gen23011" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9723"/>And he said to me, “The chambers of the north <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the chambers of the south which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the front of”</note> the courtyard, they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are the holy chambers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “are the chambers of the holiness”</note> in which the priests, who are near to Yahweh, will eat the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞most holy objects⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “holy objects of the holy objects”</note> There they shall put the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞most holy objects⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “holy objects of the holy objects”</note> and the grain offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering, for the place <transChange type="added">is</transChange> holy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:14
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When the priests enter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at coming their”</note> then they shall not go out from the sanctuary to the outer courtyard; and there they must put<note placement="foot">Or “deposit/leave/remove”</note> their garments in which they serve because they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> holy. They must put on other garments and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> they may approach <transChange type="added">the area</transChange> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the people.  <div eID="gen23011" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9724"/><div sID="gen23012" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9724"/>And he completed the measurements of the inner temple, and he brought me <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the walkway of the gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that faces toward the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which its face is to the way of the east”</note> and he measured it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:16
verses.text: He measured the east side with the reed<note placement="foot">Or “rod”</note> for<note placement="foot">Literally “of measuring”</note> measuring, five hundred cubits,<note placement="foot">Hebrew has “reeds” here (= 5,250 feet), which is not correct; 500 cubits = 875 feet.</note> with <transChange type="added">respect to</transChange> reeds with the reed for measurement, <transChange type="added">he measured it</transChange> all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:17
verses.text: He measured the north side <transChange type="added">as</transChange> five hundred <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>, <transChange type="added">with respect to</transChange> reeds with the reed for measurement all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> he measured the south side <transChange type="added">as</transChange> five hundred <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>, <transChange type="added">with respect to</transChange> reeds with the reed for measurement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:19
verses.text: He went around the west side<note placement="foot">Or “side toward/to the sea”</note> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> he measured five hundred <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>, <transChange type="added">with respect to</transChange> reeds with the reed for measurement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:20
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Toward the four sides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “toward the four winds”</note> he measured it; there was a wall for it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> Its length was five hundred cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 875 feet</note> and <transChange type="added">its</transChange> width <transChange type="added">was</transChange> five hundred <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>, in order to make <transChange type="added">a</transChange> separation between what is holy and what is common.  <chapter eID="Ezek.42"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9725"/><title type="x-s">Return of the Lord’s Glory and Description of Sacrifices and Worship</title> <div sID="gen23013" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9725"/>And he brought me to the gate which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞facing east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “which was facing to the way of the east”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:2
verses.text: And, look! The glory of the God of Israel, it came from the way of the east, and its sound <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of many waters<note placement="foot">Hebrew “water”</note> and the land radiated due to his glory!

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:3
verses.text: And<note placement="foot">Or “and as”; as is not needed in translation</note> the appearance of the vision which I saw was as<note placement="foot">Or “like”</note> the vision which I saw at his<note placement="foot">Or “my coming”</note> coming to destroy the city, and these visions were also as<note placement="foot">Or “like”</note> the vision which I saw by the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Kebar River⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “river of Kebar”</note> and I fell on my face.  <div eID="gen23013" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9726"/><div sID="gen23014" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9726"/>And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> the glory of Yahweh came to the temple <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by the way of the gate facing east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “by the way of the gate which its face was to the way of the east”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:5
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Spirit lifted me and it brought me to the inner courtyard and, look! The glory of Yahweh filled the temple!

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:6
verses.text: And I heard <transChange type="added">someone</transChange> speaking to me from the house,<note placement="foot">Or “from inside”</note> and a man was standing beside me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:7
verses.text: And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> this is the place of my throne and the place for the soles of my feet <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where I will dwell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which I will dwell there”</note> in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> to eternity, and they, the house of Israel, they and their kings, will not again defile <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the name of my holiness”</note> with their fornication and with their offerings for the dead<note placement="foot">Or “corpses”</note> of their kings <transChange type="added">on</transChange> their high places.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When they placed their threshold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in/at their placing their threshold”</note> with<note placement="foot">Or “beside/next to”</note> my threshold, their doorframe beside my doorframe and the<note placement="foot">Or “their”</note> wall was between me and between them, then they defiled <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the name of my holiness”</note> with their detestable things that they did, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I consumed them in my anger.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:9
verses.text: Now let them send their fornication far away and the offerings for the dead<note placement="foot">Or “corpses”</note> of their kings away from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note>  <div eID="gen23014" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9727"/><div sID="gen23015" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9727"/>You, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> describe <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of Israel the temple and let them be ashamed of their iniquities and let them measure the pattern.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:11
verses.text: And if they are ashamed of all that they did, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> the plan of the temple and its arrangement and its exits and its entrances and all of its plans<note placement="foot">Or “its entire pattern”</note> and all of its statutes. And all of its plans<note placement="foot">Or “purposes”</note> and all of its laws<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>); cf. BHS</note> make known <transChange type="added">to</transChange> them and write <transChange type="added">them</transChange> before their eyes, so that they may remember all of its plans and all of its statutes, so that they do them!

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:12
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the law<note placement="foot">Literally “torah” or “instruction”</note> of the temple: On the top of the mountain, all of its territory, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the way around it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all around, all around”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will be most holy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “will be a holiness of holinesses”</note> Look, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the law of the temple.  <div eID="gen23015" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9728"/><div sID="gen23016" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9728"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the measurements of the altar in the cubits<note placement="foot">Or “in long cubits”</note> (a cubit is a cubit and a handbreadth):<note placement="foot">That is, about 18 inches (regular cubit) + 3 inches = 21 inches (long cubit)</note> now its gutter<note placement="foot">Or “trench” (NJPS)</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is a cubit<note placement="foot">That is, 21 inches</note> in depth by a cubit<note placement="foot">That is, 21 inches</note> in width⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the cubit and cubit its width”</note> and its rim along its edge all around is one span,<note placement="foot">That is, 9 inches</note> and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <transChange type="added">also</transChange> the height of the altar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:14
verses.text: And from the gutter<note placement="foot">Or “trench”</note> at the ground up to the lower ledge is two cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 3 feet 6 inches</note> and its width is one cubit,<note placement="foot">That is, 21 inches</note> and from the small ledge up to the large ledge is four cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 7 feet</note> and <transChange type="added">its</transChange> width <transChange type="added">is</transChange> one cubit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:15
verses.text: And the altar hearth <transChange type="added">was</transChange> four cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 7 feet</note> and from the altar hearth and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞upwards⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and to above”</note> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> the four horns <transChange type="added">of the altar</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:16
verses.text: And the altar hearth <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twelve⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “two ten”</note> cubits in length and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞twelve⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “two ten”</note> cubits in width<note placement="foot">That is, 21 feet square</note>; it was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞squared on its four sides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “squared to the four of its sides”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:17
verses.text: And the ledge <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fourteen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “four ten”</note> cubits in length with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fourteen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “four ten”</note> cubits its width<note placement="foot">That is, 24.5 feet on all four sides, a square</note> to all four of its sides, and a rim was all around it of one-half cubit.<note placement="foot">That is, 10.5 inches</note> And the gutter<note placement="foot">Or “trench”</note> for it was a cubit<note placement="foot">That is, 21 inches</note> all around, and its steps <transChange type="added">were</transChange> facing east.”  <div eID="gen23016" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9729"/><div sID="gen23017" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9729"/>And he said to me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘These are the statutes of the altar on the day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when it is made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to be made it”</note> to sacrifice a burnt offering on it and to sprinkle blood on it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:19
verses.text: And you must give to the Levitical priests who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> from the offspring of Zadok, the <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> <transChange type="added">coming</transChange> near me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “to serve me, a bull, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a calf⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “son of cattle,” or “son of the herd”</note> as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> sin offering.  <div eID="gen23017" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9730"/><div sID="gen23018" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9730"/>You must take some of its blood and put <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the four horns of the altar⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “on its four horns”</note> and the four corners of the ledge, and on the rim all around; thus you must purify it and make atonement for it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:21
verses.text: And you must take the bull, the sin offering, and you must burn it in the designated place of the temple outside of the holy place.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:22
verses.text: And on the second day you must offer a he-goat without defect as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> sin offering, and they must purify the altar <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞like⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> they purified with the bull.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:23
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When you are finished⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at your finishing”</note> from purifying, you must offer a bull, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a calf⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “son of cattle,” or “son of the herd”</note> without defect, and a ram from the flock without defect.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:24
verses.text: And you must bring them near <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh, and the priests must throw salt on them, and they must offer them <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a burnt offering to Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:25
verses.text: <transChange type="added">For</transChange> seven days you must provide a goat of sin offering for the day and a bull, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a calf⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “son of cattle,” or “son of the herd”</note> and a ram from the flock without defect; you must provide <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:26
verses.text: Seven days they must purify the altar and they must cleanse it and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will consecrate it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they must fill its hand”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:27
verses.text: And they will finish the days, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it will happen”</note> on the eighth day and beyond that the priests will offer on the altar your burnt offerings and your fellowship offerings, and then I will be pleased with you,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.43"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9731"/><title type="x-s">The Prince, the Levites, and the Priests Described</title> <div sID="gen23019" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9731"/>And he brought me back <transChange type="added">by</transChange> the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> facing east, and it was shut.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:2
verses.text: And Yahweh said to me, “This gate will be shut. It shall not be opened, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and a man not”</note> will go through it, for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has entered it, and it will be shut.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:3
verses.text: The prince, he may sit in it to eat food <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh; he will come from the way<note placement="foot">Or “direction”</note> of the portico of the gate and by means of its way he will <transChange type="added">also</transChange> go out.”  <div eID="gen23019" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9732"/><div sID="gen23020" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9732"/>Then he brought me <transChange type="added">by</transChange> the way of the gate of the north to the front of the temple,<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> and I looked,<note placement="foot">Or “saw”</note> and look! The glory of Yahweh filled the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> of Yahweh, and I fell on my face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:5
verses.text: And Yahweh said, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> set your heart<note placement="foot">Or “pay close attention” or “listen closely”</note> and look with your eyes and with your ears hear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of which/what”</note> I am saying to you concerning all the statutes of the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> of Yahweh and concerning all its laws,<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>); cf. BHS</note> and you must listen with your heart concerning the entrance of the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> with all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> exits of the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:6
verses.text: And you must say to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rebellious, to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Enough for you, house of Israel, of<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> all of your detestable things!

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:7
verses.text: At<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> your bringing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foreigners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “children/people of a foreign land”</note> who are uncircumcised of heart and uncircumcised of flesh to be in my sanctuary to profane it, my temple,<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as you offered my food, fat, and blood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in/at your offering my food and fat and blood”</note> so<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you broke my covenant by all of your detestable things.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:8
verses.text: And you did not observe the responsibility of my sanctuary, but<note placement="foot">Or “and”</note> you appointed them<note placement="foot">That is, foreigners</note> as the keepers of my responsibility in my sanctuary for you.”  <div eID="gen23020" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9733"/><div sID="gen23021" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9733"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Every <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foreigner⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “child of a foreign land”</note> uncircumcised of heart and uncircumcised of flesh shall not come into my sanctuary—not any of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞foreigners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “child of a foreign land”</note> who are in the midst of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:10
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞But⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “For if”</note> the Levites who removed themselves from me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the going astray of Israel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “when Israel went astray”</note> who went astray from me <transChange type="added">and went</transChange> after their idols, as a result they will bear their guilt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:11
verses.text: Then they will be<note placement="foot">Or “may be”</note> in my sanctuary, those serving in my sanctuary, as sentries<note placement="foot">Or “guards”</note> at the gates of the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> and as those serving the temple;<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> they will slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they will stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of them”</note> to serve them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:12
