verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because that”</note> they used to serve them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> their idols and they were for the house of Israel like a stumbling block of iniquity. Therefore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I swore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I raised my hand”</note> concerning them,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh, “<transChange type="added">that</transChange> they will bear their iniquity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:13
verses.text: And they shall not approach me to serve as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> priest for me and to come near to all of<note placement="foot">Or “any of”</note> my holy objects, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the most holy objects⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the holy objects of the holy objects”</note> and they will bear their disgrace and <transChange type="added">the results of</transChange> their detestable things they have done.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:14
verses.text: And I will appoint them <transChange type="added">as</transChange> the keepers of the responsibility of<note placement="foot">Or “toward”</note> the temple, for all of its work<note placement="foot">Or “tasks”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all”</note>which will be done in it.  <div eID="gen23021" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9734"/><div sID="gen23022" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9734"/>But the Levitical priests, the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zadok, who cared for the responsibility of my sanctuary <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the Israelites went astray⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at going astray the children of Israel”</note> from me, they will approach me to serve me, and they will stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of me”</note> to offer to me fat and blood,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:16
verses.text: “They shall come to my sanctuary, and they shall approach my table to serve me, and they will observe my requirement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:17
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and it will happen”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at their coming”</note> to the gates of the inner courtyards, they shall put on their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> inner linen garments and not wear wool garments <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they serve⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at their serving”</note> in the gates of the inner courtyard and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞inside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and toward”</note> the temple.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:18
verses.text: Linen turbans shall be on their head and linen undergarments shall be on their waists; they shall not gird themselves with <transChange type="added">material causing</transChange> perspiration.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:19
verses.text: When they go out to the outer courtyard to the people, they must take off their garment in which they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> serving, and they must place them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the holy chambers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the chambers of the holiness”</note> and they must put on other <transChange type="added">garments</transChange>, so that they will not make the people holy with their garments.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:20
verses.text: And their head they shall not shave, or long hair they shall not let grow; short they shall clip their heads.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:21
verses.text: And no priest shall drink wine when they come into the inner courtyard.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:22
verses.text: And a widow or divorced <transChange type="added">woman</transChange> they shall not take for themselves as wives, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but only⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “but if”</note> a virgin from the offspring of the house of Israel, or the widow who is a widow for a priest they may take.  <div eID="gen23022" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9735"/><div sID="gen23023" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9735"/>And they will teach my people <transChange type="added">the difference</transChange> between what is holy and what is unholy, and <transChange type="added">the difference</transChange> between unclean and clean they must show them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:24
verses.text: And at a legal dispute they themselves shall stand to judge; employing<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> my judgments they shall judge it, and <transChange type="added">with respect to</transChange> my laws and my statutes. All my festivals they shall keep and my Sabbaths they shall consecrate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:25
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞near a dead person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and to a dead person of a man”</note> he<note placement="foot">That is, the priest</note> shall not come to be defiled, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞but only⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “but if”</note> for a father and for a mother and for a son and for a daughter, for a brother and for a sister <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who was not married⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who not she was for a man”</note> may they defile themselves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:26
verses.text: And, after his<note placement="foot">That is, the priest</note> cleansing, they shall count for him seven days,

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:27
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> on the day of his coming into the sanctuary to the inner courtyard to serve in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen23023" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9736"/><div sID="gen23024" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9736"/>And <transChange type="added">thus</transChange> it will be to them as <transChange type="added">regards</transChange> inheritance, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> their inheritance, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you shall not give to them property in Israel; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> their property.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:29
verses.text: The grain offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering, they themselves may eat them, and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> consecrated possessions<note placement="foot">Hebrew “possession”</note> in Israel will be theirs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:30
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">also</transChange> what is first of all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> firstfruits of everything, and of all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> contribution of everything from all of your contributions, to the priest <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it belongs⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “it shall be”</note> and what is first of your dough you shall give to the priest, so that a blessing may rest on your house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:31
verses.text: Any dead body or mangled carcass from the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> or from the animals,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> the priests shall not eat.”  <chapter eID="Ezek.44"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9737"/><title type="x-s">Instructions about Divisions of the Renewed Land</title> <div sID="gen23025" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9737"/>And when you allocate the land as an inheritance, you shall provide a contribution for Yahweh <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a holy portion from the land, <transChange type="added">its</transChange> length <transChange type="added">being</transChange> twenty-five thousand <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange><note placement="foot">Or 8.33 miles</note> and its width ten thousand cubits;<note placement="foot">Hebrew 3.5 miles; LXX reads 6.67 miles in width, or 20,000 cubits (cf. 45:3, 5; 48:9)</note> it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> holy in all its territory, all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:2
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there</transChange> shall be from this <transChange type="added">area</transChange> five hundred <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange><note placement="foot">That is, “875 feet by 875 feet”</note> by five hundred cubits, squared all around, for the sanctuary; and fifty cubits<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cubit”</note><note placement="foot">That is, “87.5 feet”</note> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> open space <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> for it all around <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:3
verses.text: And from this measured area you shall measure a length of twenty-five<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> thousand cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 miles; cf. 45:5</note> and a width of ten thousand cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 miles; cf. 45:5</note> and in it will be the sanctuary, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the most holy place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the holiness of holinesses”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:4
verses.text: It<note placement="foot">Or “this area”</note> is a holy portion from the land; it will be for the priests, the servants of the sanctuary <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who approach⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones who approach”</note> to serve Yahweh, and it will be for them a place for houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:5
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">an area</transChange> twenty-five thousand <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> length and ten thousand <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> width will be for the Levites, the servants of the temple. <transChange type="added">It will serve</transChange> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> property for them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as cities to dwell in⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “twenty chambers”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as</transChange> property of the city, you must set apart alongside the contribution of the sanctuary <transChange type="added">a portion</transChange> five thousand <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange><note placement="foot">That is, 1.67 miles</note> in width and twenty-five thousand cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 miles</note> in length, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> it shall be for the entire house of Israel.  <div eID="gen23025" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9738"/><div sID="gen23026" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9738"/>And <transChange type="added">a portion will be</transChange> for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> the prince <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on both sides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from this and from this”</note> of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the holy district⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the contribution of the holiness”</note> and both sides of the property of the city, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alongside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the front of”</note> the property of the city <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from/on the side of the sea”</note> and alongside the property <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from/on the side of east”</note> And also its length<note placement="foot">Or “portion”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞corresponds to one of the tribal portions to the west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “corresponding to one of the portions from the boundary of the sea”</note> running <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the eastern border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the boundary of the east”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This</transChange> shall be to him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with respect to the land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the land”</note> as property in Israel; <transChange type="added">and so</transChange> my princes shall not again oppress my people, but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.”  <div eID="gen23026" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9739"/><div sID="gen23027" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9739"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Enough <transChange type="added">of this</transChange> for you, the princes of Israel; put away violence and destruction and do justice and righteousness; revoke your <transChange type="added">acts of</transChange> dispossession from upon<note placement="foot">Or “against”</note> my people!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There</transChange> shall be for you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an honest set of scales⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a set of scales of justice/honesty”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an honest ephah⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “an ephah of honesty”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an honest bath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a bath of honesty”; a bath is a liquid measure</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:11
verses.text: The ephah and the bath shall be one unit of measurement;<note placement="foot">Or “shall be the same size”</note> the tenth part of the homer is the bath, and the tenth of the homer is the ephah; so the homer shall be its<note placement="foot">Or “the”</note> unit of measurement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:12
verses.text: And the shekel <transChange type="added">shall weigh</transChange> twenty gerahs, twenty shekels<note placement="foot">Hebrew “shekel”</note> and five and twenty shekels<note placement="foot">Hebrew “shekel”</note> and ten and five shekels,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “shekel”</note> that shall make the mina for you.<note placement="foot">Meaning of Hebrew uncertain</note>  <div eID="gen23027" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9740"/><div sID="gen23028" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9740"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the contribution <transChange type="added">offering</transChange> which you shall present: a sixth of the ephah from a<note placement="foot">Or “each”; literally “the”</note> homer of wheat, and a<note placement="foot">Literally “the”</note> sixth of the ephah from a<note placement="foot">Literally “the”</note> homer of barley.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:14
verses.text: And the quota of the olive oil, the bath <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the olive oil, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the tenth part of a bath from a kor, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> ten baths, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> a homer—for ten baths <transChange type="added">are equal to</transChange> a homer.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:15
verses.text: And one<note placement="foot">Or “a”</note> sheep from the flock from among two hundred from the pastures of Israel will be taken as a grain offering and as a burnt offering and as a fellowship offering to make atonement for them,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:16
verses.text: “All of the people of the land shall join <transChange type="added">in</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “participate/ take part in”</note> to this contribution with<note placement="foot">Or possibly “for/to”</note> the prince in Israel.  <div eID="gen23028" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9741"/><div sID="gen23029" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9741"/>“But on the prince shall be <transChange type="added">the responsibility for</transChange> the burnt offerings, and the grain offering, and the libation at the feasts, and at the New Moon festivals, and at<note placement="foot">Or “on”</note> the Sabbaths at all of the assemblies of the house of Israel; he shall provide the sin offering, and the grain offering, and the burnt offering, and the fellowship offering to make atonement for the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:18
verses.text: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘On the first <transChange type="added">month</transChange> on the first <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the month, you shall take a bull, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a calf⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “son of cattle,” or “son of the herd”</note> without defect, and you shall purify the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:19
verses.text: And the priest shall take from the blood of the sin offering, and he shall put <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on the doorframe of the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar and on the doorframe of the gate of the inner courtyard.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:20
verses.text: And so you shall do on the seventh <transChange type="added">day</transChange> in the month for anyone doing wrong inadvertently or due to ignorance, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> you must make atonement for the temple.<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note>  <div eID="gen23029" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9742"/><div sID="gen23030" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9742"/>In the first <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fourteenth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “four ten”</note> day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast lasting for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞seven days⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a week of days”</note> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> you shall eat unleavened breads.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:22
verses.text: And the prince shall provide on that day for himself<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> and for all of the people of the land a bull <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <transChange type="added">a</transChange> sin offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:23
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">during</transChange> the seven days of the religious feast he shall provide <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a burnt offering to Yahweh seven bulls and seven rams without defect for each of the seven days, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a sin offering a he-goat for each day.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:24
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as a</transChange> grain offering, an ephah for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> the bull and an ephah for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> the ram he must provide, and a hin of olive oil for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the”</note> ephah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:25
verses.text: In the seventh <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fifteenth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “five ten”</note> day of the month, during the feast, he shall provide just as <transChange type="added">he has for</transChange> these seven days, as <transChange type="added">he did for</transChange> the sin offering, <transChange type="added">as he did for</transChange> the burnt offering, and <transChange type="added">as he did</transChange> for the grain offering, and <transChange type="added">as he did</transChange> for the olive oil.’ ”  <chapter eID="Ezek.45"/> <div eID="gen23030" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:1
verses.text: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “The gate of the inner courtyard facing east must be shut <transChange type="added">on</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “during”</note> the six of the days for work, but on the day of the Sabbath it must be opened and on the day of the new moon it must be opened.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:2
verses.text: And the prince shall come <transChange type="added">by</transChange> way of the portico of the gate from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> outside, and he shall stand at the doorframe of the gate and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his fellowship offerings, and he shall bow down at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be closed until the evening.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:3
verses.text: And the people of the land will bow down <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the doorway of that gate on the Sabbaths and on the new moons <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen23031" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9743"/><div sID="gen23032" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9743"/>And the burnt offering which the prince will offer to Yahweh on the Sabbath day <transChange type="added">must be</transChange> six male lambs without defect and a ram without defect.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:5
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grain offering <transChange type="added">he will give</transChange> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> an ephah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for each ram⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the ram”</note> and for the male lambs the grain offering shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as much as he wants to give⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the gift of his hand”</note> and a hin of olive oil <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for each ephah⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the ephah”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:6
verses.text: And on the day of the new moon <transChange type="added">he will offer</transChange> a bull, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a calf⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “son of cattle,” or “son of the herd”</note> without defect and six male lambs and a ram; they must be without defect.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:7
verses.text: And an ephah for each bull and an ephah for the ram he must provide <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a grain offering, and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> for the male lambs <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as much as he can afford⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that it stretches out his hand”</note> and a hin <transChange type="added">of</transChange> olive oil for each ephah.  <div eID="gen23032" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9744"/><div sID="gen23033" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9744"/>And when the prince comes, on<note placement="foot">Or “by”</note> the way of the portico of the gate he shall come and by this<note placement="foot">Or “his”</note> way he shall go out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:9
verses.text: And when the people of the land come <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh at the festivals, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one coming <transChange type="added">by</transChange> way of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gate of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north to bow down<note placement="foot">Or “to worship”</note> must go out <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way of the gate of the south, and the one coming by way of the gate of the south must go out by the way of the gate of the north, so he must not return by the way of the gate by which he came,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “came by it”</note> but before it he<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>)</note> shall go out opposite it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:10
verses.text: And the prince <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> in the midst of them; he will come in when they come in, and when they go out he will go out.  <div eID="gen23033" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9745"/><div sID="gen23034" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9745"/>And at the festivals and at the appointed times, the grain offering will be an ephah with a bull and an ephah with the ram and with the male lambs, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as much as he wants to give⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the gift of his hand”</note> and a hin of olive oil <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for each ephah⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the ephah”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:12
verses.text: And when the prince makes a freewill offering, a burnt offering, or a fellowship offering <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a freewill offering to Yahweh, the gate facing east will be open for him. And he must offer his burnt offering and his fellowship offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> he does on the day of the Sabbath, and then he must go out and the gate will shut <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞after he goes out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “after his going out”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:13
verses.text: And a male lamb, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a yearling⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a son of his year”</note> without defect, he must provide as a burnt offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞daily⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the day”</note> for Yahweh; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the morning in the morning”</note> he must provide it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:14
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">a</transChange> grain offering he must provide in addition to it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the morning in the morning”</note> a<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> sixth of an<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the”</note> ephah and a third of a hin of olive oil to moisten the finely milled flour as a grain offering to Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as a perpetual statute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “regulations of everlasting continually”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">So</transChange> they must provide the male lamb and the grain offering and the olive oil <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the morning in the morning”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as a regular burnt offering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “as burnt offering of regularity/continuity”</note>  <div eID="gen23034" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9746"/><div sID="gen23035" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9746"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “If the prince gives a gift to any <transChange type="added">one</transChange> from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> his sons, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his inheritance <transChange type="added">and</transChange> it will belong<note placement="foot">Hebrew “be”</note> to his sons; it is their possession as an inheritance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:17
verses.text: And if he give a gift from his inheritance to one from <transChange type="added">among</transChange> his servants, then it will belong<note placement="foot">Hebrew “be”</note> to him until the year of release,<note placement="foot">That is, the Year of Jubilee</note> and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> it will return to the prince. His inheritance <transChange type="added">with respect to</transChange> his sons will be only for them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:18
verses.text: But the prince shall not take from the inheritance of the people to rob<note placement="foot">Or “oppress”</note> them, <transChange type="added">separating them</transChange> from their property; from his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> property he shall bestow an inheritance on his sons, so that my people will not be driven away, any one, from his property.”  <div eID="gen23035" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9747"/><div sID="gen23036" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9747"/>Then he brought me through the entrance which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on the side of the gate <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the holy chambers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the chamber of the holiness”</note> to the priests; <transChange type="added">the chambers</transChange> were facing northwards and, look, there <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a place at the extreme end westwards.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:20
verses.text: And he said to me, “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the place where the priests will boil the guilt offering and the sin offering, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> where they shall bake the grain offering <transChange type="added">in order</transChange> not to bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> out to the outer courtyard to make the people holy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:21
verses.text: And he brought me to the outer courtyard and led me past the four corners of the courtyard; and look, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there was a courtyard in each corner of the courtyard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a courtyard in the corner of the courtyard, a courtyard in the corner of the courtyard”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:22
verses.text: In the four corners of the courtyard <transChange type="added">were</transChange> small<note placement="foot">Hebrew uncertain</note> courtyards forty cubits in length and thirty cubits in width, each with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the same measurements⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “measurement one”</note> for the four of them with corners.<note placement="foot">Or “being cornered”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:23
verses.text: And a row <transChange type="added">was</transChange> all around inside<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> them, and cooking-places were made under the rows of stones<note placement="foot">Possibly some kind of stone ledge</note> all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:24
verses.text: And he said to me, “These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the houses for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “of”</note> cooking, where <transChange type="added">the ones</transChange> serving the temple shall cook the sacrifices of the people.”  <chapter eID="Ezek.46"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9748"/><title type="x-s">River of the Temple, Division of the Land and Its Boundaries</title> <div sID="gen23037" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9748"/>And he brought me back to the doorway of the temple and, look! There was water coming out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, because the face of the temple <transChange type="added">was</transChange> eastwards; and the water was coming down from under the south side of the temple, from south of the altar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:2
verses.text: And he brought me out <transChange type="added">by the way</transChange> of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north gate and he led me around <transChange type="added">by the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞way leading to the outside of the outer gate⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “way of the outside to the gate of the outside”</note> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> way of the <transChange type="added">gate</transChange> facing east, and look, there was water trickling from the south side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:3
verses.text: As the man went eastward a measuring line <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in his hand, and he measured a thousand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞cubits⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the cubit”; about 1,750 feet</note> And he led me through on into the water; it was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ankle deep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “water of ankles”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:4
verses.text: And he measured a thousand <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>,<note placement="foot">About 1,750 feet</note> and he brought me over into the waters and it was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞knee deep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “water of knees”</note> And he measured a thousand cubits,<note placement="foot">About 1,750 feet</note> and he brought me over into the waters and it was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞waist deep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “water of waist”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:5
verses.text: And he measured a thousand <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>,<note placement="foot">About 1,750 feet</note> and it became a stream that I was not able to cross, because the water rose, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞waters a person could swim in⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “water of swimming”</note> <transChange type="added">and became</transChange> a stream that could not be crossed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:6
verses.text: And he asked me, “Son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> did you see <transChange type="added">this</transChange>?” And he made me go, and he brought me back <transChange type="added">along</transChange> the bank of the stream.  <div eID="gen23037" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9749"/><div sID="gen23038" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9749"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When I returned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “At my returning”</note> then look! On the bank of the river were many trees <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on both sides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from this and from this”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:8
verses.text: And he said to me, “These waters <transChange type="added">are</transChange> going out to the eastern region, and they go down to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Jordan Valley⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Arabah”</note> and they come to the sea<note placement="foot">Clearly refers to the Dead Sea</note> and flow into the sea where <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they issue out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “being brought out/are issued out”</note> and the waters in the sea will be healed.<note placement="foot">Or “made fresh”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:9
verses.text: And then every living creature <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which it teems,<note placement="foot">Or “swarms”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to every place the waters come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to all of which they come there the water”</note> it will live; and very many fish will live because these waters came there, and so the water will be healed<note placement="foot">Or “fresh”</note> and everything will be alive <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everywhere that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all that”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the stream will come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “that it will come there the stream”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:10
verses.text: And then fishers<note placement="foot">Or “fishermen”</note> from En Gedi and on up to En Eglaim will stand beside it, a sea-girt drying yard for nets; their fish for the dragnets will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of every kind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the”</note> like the fish of the great sea,<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean</note> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> very many.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:11
verses.text: But its marshes and its swamps will not be cured, for they were given for salt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:12
verses.text: And along the stream will go up on its banks <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from both sides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from this and from this”</note> every tree <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞producing food⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “of food”</note> its leaf will not wither and it will not cease producing its fruit. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Every month⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for its months”</note> it will bear early fruit, for its waters <transChange type="added">are</transChange> going out from the sanctuary, and its fruit will be as food, and its leaf for healing.”  <div eID="gen23038" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9750"/><div sID="gen23039" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9750"/>Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the boundary <transChange type="added">by</transChange> which you shall distribute the land for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the twelve⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “two ten”</note> tribes of Israel: Two shares <transChange type="added">shall be for</transChange> Joseph.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:14
verses.text: And you must take possession of it, each <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <transChange type="added">a share</transChange> like his brother, <transChange type="added">of this land</transChange> which <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I swore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I raised my hand”</note> to give it to your fathers, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> this land shall fall to you as an inheritance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:15
verses.text: And<note placement="foot">Or “Bow”</note> this is the boundary of the land: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞On the north side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the side of the north”</note> from the great sea by the way of Hethlon <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until you come to Zedad⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the arriving at Zedad”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:16
verses.text: Hamath<note placement="foot">Or “Lebo-Hamath to Zeded” (cf. NRSV, NJPS)</note> to Berothath to Sibraim, which is<note placement="foot">Or “are”</note> between the boundary of Damascus and the boundary of Hamath, <transChange type="added">on to</transChange> Hazer Hatticon, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on the boundary of Hauran.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:17
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> boundary will be from the sea<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean</note> to Hazar Enan <transChange type="added">at</transChange> the boundary of Damascus northwards and the boundary of Hamath <transChange type="added">to the north</transChange>, and this <transChange type="added">is the boundary on the</transChange> side of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:18
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And the eastern boundary⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and the side of the east”</note> will be between Hauran and Damascus, and from between Gilead and the land of Israel along the Jordan River from<note placement="foot">Or “to”</note> the boundary on the eastern sea to Tamar. And<note placement="foot">Or “Now”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this is the border on the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and this is the side of the east”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:19
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And on the south side the border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and the side of the south to south”</note> will run from Tamar up to the waters of Meribot Kadesh and along the wadi<note placement="foot">That is, the Wadi of Egypt</note> to the Great Sea.<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean</note> And this is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the boundary to the south⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and this is the side of south to the south”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:20
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And on the west side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and the side of the west”</note> the Great Sea<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean</note> shall be the boundary up to opposite Lebo-Hamath. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞This is the western boundary⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “this is the side of the west”</note>  <div eID="gen23039" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9751"/><div sID="gen23040" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9751"/>You shall divide this land for yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:22
verses.text: And then you shall allocate it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the aliens dwelling as aliens in the midst of you who have children in the midst of you, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> they shall be to you <transChange type="added">just</transChange> like full citizens among the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Israel”</note> With you they shall be allotted with an inheritance in the midst of the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:23
verses.text: And then in the tribe <transChange type="added">in</transChange> which an alien who is with you dwells, there you shall give his inheritance,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Ezek.47"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9752"/><title type="x-s">The Allotment of the Land and the Gates of the City</title> <div sID="gen23041" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9752"/>And<note placement="foot">Or “Now”</note> these are the names of the tribes: At the end of the north, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞along the way to Hethlon⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the side of the way of Hethlon”</note> from Lebo-hamath to Hazar Enan on the boundary of Damascus <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beside Hamath northward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “northward to the side of Hamat,”</note> there will be one portion for Dan from the eastern border to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞west⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sea”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:2
verses.text: And next to the territory of Dan, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the eastern border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the east</note> up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the western border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the sea/west”</note> one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Asher.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:3
verses.text: And next to the territory of Asher, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the eastern border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the east”</note> and up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the western border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the west/sea”</note> one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Naphtali.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:4
verses.text: And next to the territory of Naphtali, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the eastern border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the east”</note> up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the western border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the sea/west”</note> one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Manasseh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:5
verses.text: And next to the territory of Manasseh, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the eastern border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the east”</note> up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the western border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the sea/west”</note> one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Ephraim.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:6
verses.text: And next to the territory of Ephraim, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the eastern border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the east”</note> and up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the western border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the sea/west</note> one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Reuben.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:7
verses.text: And next to the territory of Reuben, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the eastern border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the east</note> up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the western border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the sea/west</note> one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> Judah.  <div eID="gen23041" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9753"/><div sID="gen23042" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9753"/>And next to the territory of Judah, from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the eastern border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the east</note> up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the western border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the sea/west</note> shall be located the contribution that you set apart, twenty-five thousand cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 miles</note> in width, and its length just like one of the portions from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the eastern border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the east</note> up to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the western border⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the sea/west</note> and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:9
verses.text: The contribution that you shall set apart for Yahweh, its length <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> twenty-five thousand <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>,<note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 miles</note> and its width ten thousand cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 miles; cf. 48:13 and 45:1</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:10
verses.text: And to these shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the holy district⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “the contribution of the holiness”</note> to the priests northwards twenty-five thousand cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 miles</note> and westwards its width ten thousand cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 miles</note> and eastwards its width ten thousand cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 miles</note> and southwards its length twenty-five thousand cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 miles</note> and the sanctuary of Yahweh shall be in the midst of it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:11
verses.text: To the priests, the <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> being consecrated from the descendants<note placement="foot">Or “sons”</note> of Zadok, who took care of my service and who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞did not go astray⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who not they went astray”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when the Israelites went astray⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at going astray the children of Israel”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> the Levites went astray.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:12
verses.text: And it will be for them a special gift from the contribution of the land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as a most holy object⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as a holiness of holinesses”</note> next to the territory of the Levites.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:13
verses.text: And the Levites <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alongside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to corresponding”</note> the territory of the priests shall have twenty-five thousand cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 miles</note> in length and in width ten thousand cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 miles</note> its <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞full length⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all/every of its length ….”</note> twenty-five thousand cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 miles</note> and its full width, ten thousand cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 miles</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:14
verses.text: And they shall not sell <transChange type="added">any part</transChange> from it, and shall not exchange, and shall not transfer the best of the land, for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> holy to Yahweh.  <div eID="gen23042" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9754"/><div sID="gen23043" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9754"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the remaining part⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the being a part left over”</note> of five thousand cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 1.75 miles</note> in the width <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in front of”</note> twenty-five thousand cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 miles</note> is unholy;<note placement="foot">Or “common”</note> it is for the city as dwelling and as pastureland; and the city will be located <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the middle of it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “will be the city in its middle”</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:16
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> its measurements: <transChange type="added">on</transChange> its side to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north, four thousand five hundred <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>;<note placement="foot">That is, 1.5 miles</note> and on its side to the south, four thousand five hundred cubits;<note placement="foot">That is, 1.5 miles</note> and on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the eastern side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the side of the east”</note> four thousand five hundred cubits;<note placement="foot">That is, 1.5 miles</note> and on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the western side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and the side of the sea/west + directive”</note> four thousand five hundred cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 1.5 miles</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:17
verses.text: And a pastureland shall be for the city northwards, two hundred and fifty <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>,<note placement="foot">That is, 150 yards</note> southwards two hundred and fifty cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 150 yards</note> and eastwards two hundred and fifty cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 150 yards</note> and westwards two hundred and fifty cubits.<note placement="foot">That is, 150 yards</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:18
verses.text: And the rest in <transChange type="added">its</transChange> length <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alongside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to corresponding”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the holy district⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the contribution of the holiness”</note> ten thousand cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 miles</note> eastwards and ten thousand<note placement="foot">That is, 3.5 miles</note> westwards; and it shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alongside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to corresponding”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the holy district⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the contribution of the holiness”</note> and its yield<note placement="foot">According to the reading tradition (<hi type="italic">Qere</hi>); cf. BHS</note> shall be as food for the workers of the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:19
verses.text: And the workers of the city from all the tribes of Israel shall cultivate it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:20
verses.text: All of the contribution, twenty-five thousand by twenty five thousand <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange><note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 square miles</note> square, you shall set apart as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the holy district⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the contribution of the holiness”</note> <transChange type="added">along</transChange> with the property of the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:21
verses.text: And the rest <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> to<note placement="foot">Or “for”</note> the prince, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on both sides⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from this and from this”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of the holy district⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of the contribution of the holiness”</note> and of the property of the city <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞extending from⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to in front of”</note> twenty-five thousand cubits of the contribution up to the boundary of the east, and westwards <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞extending⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to in front of”</note> twenty-five thousand cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 8.33 miles</note> to the boundary of the sea <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alongside⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to corresponding”</note> the tribal portions. They shall be for the prince, and it shall be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the holy district⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the contribution of the holiness”</note> and the sanctuary of the temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> will be in its middle.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:22
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">also</transChange> the property of the Levites and the property of the city will be in the midst of <transChange type="added">the property</transChange> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the prince; between the territory of Judah and <transChange type="added">between</transChange> the territory of Benjamin <transChange type="added">the land</transChange> will be for the prince.  <div eID="gen23043" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9755"/><div sID="gen23044" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9755"/>And <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the remainder of the tribes: From <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side <transChange type="added">on</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side <transChange type="added">on</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> west, Benjamin one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:24
verses.text: and next to the territory of Benjamin, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side <transChange type="added">on</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea, Simeon one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:25
verses.text: and next to the territory of Simeon, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea, Issachar one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:26
verses.text: and next to the territory of Issachar, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea, Zebulun one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:27
verses.text: and next to the territory of Zebulun, from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east up to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea, Gad one <transChange type="added">portion</transChange>;

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:28
verses.text: and next to the territory of Gad, to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> side of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞southward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “south”</note> and the territory will be from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, toward the wadi,<note placement="foot">That is, the Wadi of Egypt</note> on to the Great Sea.<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean</note>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:29
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the land that you shall allot as <transChange type="added">an</transChange> inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> their portions,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen23044" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9756"/><div sID="gen23045" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9756"/>And these <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> the exits of the city: From<note placement="foot">Or “on” or “along”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the north side⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the side of the north”</note> four thousand and five hundred cubits<note placement="foot">That is, 1.5 miles</note> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> measurement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:31
verses.text: And the gates of the city <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> according to the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> north, the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:32
verses.text: And on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east side, four thousand five hundred <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>,<note placement="foot">That is, 1.5 miles</note> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> three gates, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:33
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">on</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south side, four thousand five hundred <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange><note placement="foot">That is, 1.5 miles</note> by measurement, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> three gates, the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:34
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> on the west<note placement="foot">Or “sea”</note> side, four thousand five hundred cubits,<note placement="foot">That is, 1.5 miles</note> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> their gates three, the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:35
verses.text: All around <transChange type="added">the city</transChange> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> eighteen thousand <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>,<note placement="foot">That is, 6 miles</note> and the name of the city from <transChange type="added">that</transChange> day <transChange type="added">is</transChange> “Yahweh <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> There”!  <chapter eID="Ezek.48"/> <div eID="gen23045" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen22445" osisID="Ezek" type="book"/>

verses.name: Daniel 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9757"/><title type="x-s">Daniel’s Development in the King’s Court</title> <div sID="gen23047" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9757"/>In <transChange type="added">the</transChange> third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.

verses.name: Daniel 1:2
verses.text: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim the king of Judah into his hand and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the end/extremity/limits”</note> of the utensils of the temple of God,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the God”</note> and he brought them to the land of Shinar to the temple of his gods, and he brought the utensils to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the treasury⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the house of the treasury”</note> of his gods.  <div eID="gen23047" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9758"/><div sID="gen23048" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9758"/>And the king <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ordered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “said to”</note> Ashpenaz, the commander of his court officials, to bring <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of the Israelites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the sons/children of Israel”</note> from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the royal family⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the seed of the kingship”</note> and from the lords,<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 1:4
verses.text: youths who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have no physical defect⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not in them any physical defect”</note> and who are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞handsome⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “good/pleasing of appearance”</note> and who are prudent<note placement="foot">Or “insightful”</note> in all wisdom and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞endowed with knowledge⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “who have knowledge of knowledge”</note> and who understand insight, and who have the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ability⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “strength”</note> in them to serve in the palace of the king. <transChange type="added">And the king ordered him</transChange> to teach them the literature and the language of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans.

verses.name: Daniel 1:5
verses.text: And the king assigned to them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his daily portion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the portion of the day on its day”</note> from the fine food of the king, and from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the wine that he drank⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the wine of his drink”</note> and instructed that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they were to be educated for three years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and to be educated them years three”</note> And at the end of their training, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they were to be stationed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they would stand”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the king.

verses.name: Daniel 1:6
verses.text: Now there was among them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from the Judeans⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the children of Judah”</note> Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.

verses.name: Daniel 1:7
verses.text: And the commander of the court officials gave them names, and he called Daniel, Belteshazzar; and Hananiah, Shadrach; and Mishael, Meshach; and Azariah, Abednego.  <div eID="gen23048" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9759"/><title type="x-s">Daniel’s Resolve</title> <div sID="gen23049" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9759"/>Now <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Daniel resolved⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Daniel placed upon his heart”</note> that he would not defile himself with the fine food of the king, and with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the wine that he drank⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the wine of his drink”</note> and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> he requested from the commander of the court officials <transChange type="added">permission so</transChange> that he would not defile himself.

verses.name: Daniel 1:9
verses.text: And God<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the God”</note> gave Daniel favor and compassion <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the commander of the court officials,

verses.name: Daniel 1:10
verses.text: and the commander of the court officials said to Daniel, “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> afraid <transChange type="added">of</transChange> my lord, the king, who has determined your food and your drink, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞why should⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to what would”</note> he see your face having a worse appearance than the young men who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are your age⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “like your age”; “your” is plural</note> Then you will endanger my head with the king.”

verses.name: Daniel 1:11
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> Daniel asked the guard<note placement="foot">Or “overseer”</note> whom the commander of the court officials <transChange type="added">had</transChange> appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

verses.name: Daniel 1:12
verses.text: “Please test your servants <transChange type="added">for</transChange> ten days, and let them give us <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some of the vegetables⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the vegetables”</note> and let us eat and let us drink water.

verses.name: Daniel 1:13
verses.text: Then<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> let our appearances and the appearance of the young men who are eating the fine food of the king be compared <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in your presence”</note> and then deal with your servants <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to what you see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “and according to/that you see”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 1:14
verses.text: So he agreed to this proposal with them, and he tested them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> ten days.

verses.name: Daniel 1:15
verses.text: And at the end of ten days their appearances appeared better and <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> healthier of body than all the young men who were eating the fine food of the king.

verses.name: Daniel 1:16
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞So⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it happened”</note> the guard <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continued to withhold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he was … withdrawing”</note> their fine food and the wine of their drink, and he gave them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to them”</note> vegetables.  <div eID="gen23049" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9760"/><div sID="gen23050" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9760"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And as for these four young men⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “And these young men, four of them”</note> God<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the God”</note> gave to them knowledge and insight into all literature and wisdom, and Daniel had insight into all visions<note placement="foot">Hebrew “vision”</note> and dreams.

verses.name: Daniel 1:18
verses.text: And at the end of the time the king had set to bring them, the commander of the court officials brought them in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.name: Daniel 1:19
verses.text: And the king spoke with them, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and among all of them no one was found like⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and he was not found from all of them like”</note> Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah; then they stood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the king.

verses.name: Daniel 1:20
verses.text: And in every matter of wisdom <transChange type="added">and</transChange> understanding <transChange type="added">about</transChange> which the king inquired from them, he found them ten times better <transChange type="added">than</transChange> all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the magicians<note placement="foot">Or “soothsayer-priests”</note> and conjurers<note placement="foot">Or “enchanters”</note> that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were in his entire kingdom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the whole of his kingdom”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 1:21
verses.text: And Daniel was <transChange type="added">there</transChange> until the first year of Cyrus the king.  <chapter eID="Dan.1"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9761"/><title type="x-s">The King’s Troubling Dream</title> <div sID="gen23051" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9761"/>Now<note placement="foot">Hebrew “And”</note> in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled and his sleep left him.

verses.name: Daniel 2:2
verses.text: So the king said to call the magicians<note placement="foot">Or “soothsayer-priests”</note> and the conjurers<note placement="foot">Or “enchanters”</note> and the sorcerers and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞astrologers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldeans”</note> to tell to the king his dreams. And they came in and they stood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:3
verses.text: And the king said to them, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I have had a dream⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “A dream I have dreamed”</note> and my spirit is anxious to know the dream.”  <div eID="gen23051" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9762"/><div sID="gen23052" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9762"/>And the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞astrologers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldeans”</note> said to the king in Aramaic,<note placement="foot">The text of Daniel is in Aramaic from this point on through Daniel chapter 7. Then the text resumes in Hebrew to the end of the book</note> “O king, live forever! Tell the dream to your servants and we will reveal the explanation.”

verses.name: Daniel 2:5
verses.text: The king answered and said to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞astrologers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldeans”</note> “The command from me is firm: if you do not make known to me the dream and its explanation,<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note> <transChange type="added">then</transChange> you will be broken into pieces and your houses will be laid in ruins.

verses.name: Daniel 2:6
verses.text: But if you tell me the dream and its explanation, you will receive gifts and rewards<note placement="foot">Aramaic “reward”</note> and great honor from me. Therefore, tell me the dream and its explanation.”<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:7
verses.text: They answered once more and said, “Let the king tell the dream to his servants and we will make the explanation known.”

verses.name: Daniel 2:8
verses.text: The king answered and said, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Certainly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “From a certainty”</note> I know that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you are trying to gain time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the time you are gaining”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all because of that”</note> you have seen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that this matter is firmly decreed by me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “that firm from me is the decree”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:9
