verses.text: for if you <transChange type="added">do</transChange> not make the dream known to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your verdict is fixed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “one is your verdict”</note> and you have conspired to say a lying and deceitful word to me until the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “time”</note> will change. Therefore, tell me the dream, and I will know that you can tell me its explanation.”

verses.name: Daniel 2:10
verses.text: The <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞astrologers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldeans”</note> answered the king and said, “There is not a man on earth that is able to reveal the word of the king; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in fact⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all because that”</note> no great and powerful king has ever asked a thing like this of any magician<note placement="foot">Or “soothsayer-priest”</note> or conjurer<note placement="foot">Or “enchanter”</note> or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞astrologer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldean”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:11
verses.text: And the thing that the king is asking <transChange type="added">is too</transChange> difficult and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there is no one who⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there is not another”</note> can reveal it to the king except the gods <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose dwelling is not with mortals⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “concerning their dwelling is not with flesh”</note>  <div eID="gen23052" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9763"/><div sID="gen23053" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9763"/>Because of this the king became angry, and he became very much enraged, and he said <transChange type="added">that</transChange> all the wise men of Babylon <transChange type="added">are</transChange> to be destroyed.

verses.name: Daniel 2:13
verses.text: And the decree was issued, and the wise men <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were on the verge of being executed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “were in the process of being killed”</note> and they searched for Daniel and his companions to be executed.

verses.name: Daniel 2:14
verses.text: Then Daniel responded prudently and discretely to Arioch, the commander of the imperial guard of the king, who had gone out to execute the wise men of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 2:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He asked⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he answered”</note> and said to Arioch, the royal official of the king, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Why⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Over what”</note> is the decree from the king so severe?” Then Arioch explained the matter<note placement="foot">Or “situation”</note> to Daniel.

verses.name: Daniel 2:16
verses.text: And Daniel went in and requested from the king that he would give him time, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he would tell the king⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to tell/reveal to the king”</note> the explanation.<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note>  <div eID="gen23053" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9764"/><div sID="gen23054" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9764"/>Then Daniel went to his home, and he made the matter known to Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah, his companions,

verses.name: Daniel 2:18
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">told them</transChange> to seek mercy <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from the God of heaven⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from before the God of the heaven”</note> concerning this mystery, so that Daniel and his companions, along with the remainder of the wise men of Babylon, would not be killed.  <div eID="gen23054" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9765"/><div sID="gen23055" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9765"/>Then in a vision of the night the mystery was revealed to Daniel; then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.  <div eID="gen23055" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9766"/><div sID="gen23056" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9766"/>Daniel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “answered and he said”</note> <div eID="gen23056" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23057"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23058"/>“Let his name, <transChange type="added">the name</transChange> of God,<note placement="foot">Aramaic “the God”</note> be blessed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout the ages⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the age unto the age”</note><l eID="gen23058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23059"/>for the wisdom and the power <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞are his⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “of to him it is”</note> <l eID="gen23059" level="2"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9767"/><l level="1" sID="gen23060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9767"/>And he changes the times and the seasons,<l eID="gen23060" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23061"/>and he deposes kings and he sets up kings;<l eID="gen23061" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23062"/>he gives wisdom<note placement="foot">Aramaic “the wisdom”</note> to wise men<l eID="gen23062" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23063"/>and knowledge to <transChange type="added">men who</transChange> know understanding. <l eID="gen23063" level="2"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9768"/><l level="1" sID="gen23064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9768"/>He reveals the deep and the hidden things;<l eID="gen23064" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23065"/>he knows what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the darkness,<l eID="gen23065" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23066"/>and the light dwells with him. <l eID="gen23066" level="2"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9769"/><l level="1" sID="gen23067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9769"/>To you, O God of my ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note><l eID="gen23067" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23068"/>I give thanks and I give praises,<l eID="gen23068" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23069"/>for the wisdom and the power you gave to me,<l eID="gen23069" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23070"/>and now you have made known to me<l eID="gen23070" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23071"/>what we have asked from you,<l eID="gen23071" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23072"/>for you have made known to us the matter of the king.” <l eID="gen23072" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen23057"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9770"/><title type="x-s">Daniel Praises God and Interprets the King’s Dream</title> <div sID="gen23073" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9770"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Now because this”</note> Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed<note placement="foot">Aramaic “has appointed”</note> to destroy the wise men of Babylon; he went and thus he said to him: “You must not destroy the wise men of Babylon; take me in before the king and I will give the explanation<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note> to the king.”  <div eID="gen23073" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9771"/><div sID="gen23074" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9771"/>Then Arioch <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞quickly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in haste”</note> brought Daniel in before the king and thus he said to him: “I have found a man among <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the exiles⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the children of exiles”</note> of Judah<note placement="foot">Aramaic “Jehud”</note> who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞can relate⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he will make known”</note> the explanation<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note> to the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:26
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The king then asked⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The king answered”</note> and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, “Are you able to make known to me the dream that I have seen and its explanation?”<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:27
verses.text: Daniel answered the king and said, “The mystery that the king asks, no wise men, conjurers,<note placement="foot">Or “enchanters”</note> magicians,<note placement="foot">Or “soothsayer-priests”</note> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> diviners are able to make known to the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:28
verses.text: But there is a God in heaven <transChange type="added">who</transChange> reveals mysteries, and he has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> that will be at the end of days. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your dream and the visions of your head on your bed.  <div eID="gen23074" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9772"/><div sID="gen23075" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9772"/>“<transChange type="added">As for you</transChange>, king,<note placement="foot">Aramaic “the king”</note> your thoughts on your bed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞turned to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they went up”</note> what it was that would be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the future⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “after this”</note> and the revealer of mysteries has made known to you what that would be.

verses.name: Daniel 2:30
verses.text: And as for me, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not because of wisdom that is in me more than <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any other living person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of living beings”</note> that this mystery is revealed to me, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in order that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “concerning the matter of”</note> the explanation<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note> may be made known to the king and you will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞understand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “know”</note> the thoughts of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note>  <div eID="gen23075" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9773"/><div sID="gen23076" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9773"/>“You, O king, were looking and, look, there was one great statue. This statue <transChange type="added">was</transChange> huge and its brilliance extraordinary, standing <transChange type="added">there</transChange> before you, and its appearance <transChange type="added">was</transChange> frightening.<note placement="foot">Or “dreadful”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:32
verses.text: The head of this statue <transChange type="added">was</transChange> of fine gold, its chest and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,

verses.name: Daniel 2:33
verses.text: its legs of iron, its feet, part of them of iron and part of them of clay.

verses.name: Daniel 2:34
verses.text: You were looking on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until that”</note> a stone was chiseled out<note placement="foot">Or “became loose”</note>—that not by hands—and it struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay, and it broke them in pieces.

verses.name: Daniel 2:35
verses.text: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver and the gold <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all at once⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “like one”</note> broke into pieces<note placement="foot">Or “were crushed”</note> and they became like chaff from the summer threshing floor, and the wind carried them away and any trace of them could not be found. But the stone that struck the statue became a great mountain and it filled the whole earth.  <div eID="gen23076" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9774"/><div sID="gen23077" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9774"/>“This <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the dream, and <transChange type="added">now</transChange> we will tell its interpretation to the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:37
verses.text: You, O king, the king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power and the might and the glory,

verses.name: Daniel 2:38
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞human beings wherever they dwell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and into all that dwell sons of humankind”</note> the animals of the field and the birds<note placement="foot">Aramaic “bird”</note> of heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note>—he has given into your hand and made you ruler over all of them—you are the head of gold.

verses.name: Daniel 2:39
verses.text: And after you another kingdom inferior to yours will arise, and another third <transChange type="added">kingdom</transChange> of bronze that will rule over the whole earth.

verses.name: Daniel 2:40
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">a</transChange> fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of because”</note> iron crushes and smashes <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everything⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the whole thing”</note> and as iron shatters all of these <transChange type="added">other metals</transChange>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> it will crush and it will shatter <transChange type="added">these nations</transChange>.

verses.name: Daniel 2:41
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And that”</note> you saw the feet and the toes, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞partly potter’s clay⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from them clay of the potter”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞partly iron⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from them iron”</note> it will be a divided kingdom; and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞some hardness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the hardness”</note> of the iron will be in it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of because that”</note> you have seen the iron mixed with the wet clay.

verses.name: Daniel 2:42
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as</transChange> the toes of the feet <transChange type="added">were</transChange> partly iron and partly clay, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> part of the kingdom will be strong <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and partly brittle⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and from it, it will be brittle”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:43
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">in</transChange> that you saw the iron was mixed with wet clay, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will mix in marriage⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mixing they will in the seed of man”</note> and they will not cling <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “this one with that one”</note> just as iron <transChange type="added">does</transChange> not mix with clay.

verses.name: Daniel 2:44
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the day of those kings⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in their days of those kings”</note> the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞never⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to forever not”</note> be destroyed, and the kingdom will not be left for another nation,<note placement="foot">Or “people”</note> and it will bring an end to all these kingdoms, but it will stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 2:45
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Inasmuch as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All of because that”</note> you saw that a stone from the mountain was chiseled out<note placement="foot">Or “became loose”</note> but not by hands, and that it crushed the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver and the gold, thereby the great God made known to the king what will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the future⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “after this”</note> and the dream is certain and its explanation trustworthy.”  <div eID="gen23077" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9775"/><title type="x-s">The King’s Response to Daniel and His God</title> <div sID="gen23078" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9775"/>Then the king, Nebuchadnezzar, fell on his face and he paid homage to Daniel; and he commanded <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to offer <transChange type="added">a</transChange> grain offering and incense offering to him.

verses.name: Daniel 2:47
verses.text: The king answered Daniel and said, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Truly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “From truth that”</note> your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the God of gods and the Lord of kings, and he reveals mysteries, for you are able to reveal this mystery.”

verses.name: Daniel 2:48
verses.text: Then the king promoted Daniel and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon and the chief prefect over all the wise men of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 2:49
verses.text: And Daniel made a request from the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon, while Daniel <transChange type="added">remained</transChange> in the court of the king.  <chapter eID="Dan.2"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9776"/><title type="x-s">The Faithfulness of Three Young Israelites and God’s Deliverance</title> <div sID="gen23079" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9776"/>Nebuchadnezzar the king made a statue of gold. Its height <transChange type="added">was</transChange> sixty cubits <transChange type="added">and</transChange> its width <transChange type="added">was</transChange> six cubits; he set it up in the valley of Dura in the province of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 3:2
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent <transChange type="added">directions</transChange> to assemble the satraps, the prefects, and the governors, the counselors, the treasurers, the judges, the magistrates and all of the officials of the provinces to come to the dedication of the statue that Nebuchadnezzar the king <transChange type="added">had</transChange> set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:3
verses.text: Then the satraps, the prefects, the governors, the counselors, the treasurers, the judges, the magistrates, and all the officials of the province <transChange type="added">were</transChange> assembled for the dedication of the statue that Nebuchadnezzar the king <transChange type="added">had</transChange> set up, and <transChange type="added">were</transChange> standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the front”</note> the statue that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:4
verses.text: Then the herald proclaimed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞aloud⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with power”</note> “To you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it is commanded⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they are saying”</note> O peoples, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞nations and people of all languages⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the nations and the languages”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> at the time that you hear the sound of the horn, the flute, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lyre, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> trigon, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> harp, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> drum and all kinds of music, you must fall down and you must worship the statue of gold<note placement="foot">Aramaic “the gold”</note> that Nebuchadnezzar the king <transChange type="added">has</transChange> set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:6
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whoever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who that”</note> does not fall down and worship will be thrown <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞immediately⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the time”</note> into the midst of the furnace of blazing fire.”

verses.name: Daniel 3:7
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “All of because this”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at that time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at the time”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as soon as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, the flute, the lyre, the trigon, the harp and all kinds of music, all the peoples, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the nations and people of all languages⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the nations and the languages”</note> were falling down and were worshiping the statue of gold<note placement="foot">Aramaic “the gold”</note> that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.  <div eID="gen23079" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9777"/><div sID="gen23080" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9777"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All because of this”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at this time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at it the time”</note> some <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞astrologers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldean men”</note> came forward and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they denounced the Jews⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they ate their pieces of the Jews”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They responded and said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they answered and were saying”</note> to Nebuchadnezzar the king, “O king, may you live <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:10
verses.text: You, O king, have made a decree that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of humanity”</note> who hears the sound of the horn, the flute, the lyre, the trigon, the harp and the drum and all kinds of music, he shall fall down and shall worship the statue of gold.<note placement="foot">Aramaic “the gold”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:11
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And whoever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And who that”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞does not fall down⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not he falls down”</note> and worship shall be thrown into the midst of the furnace of blazing fire.

verses.name: Daniel 3:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">However</transChange> there are Judean men whom you have appointed<note placement="foot">Aramaic “whom you have appointed them”</note> over the affairs of the province of Babylon—Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego—these men, O king, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pay you no heed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not they pay heed to you”</note> and were not serving your god, and the statue of gold<note placement="foot">Aramaic “the gold”</note> that you set up they are not worshiping.”  <div eID="gen23080" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9778"/><div sID="gen23081" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9778"/>Then Nebuchadnezzar said in rage and anger to bring in Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego; then they brought in these men before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 3:14
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar answered and said to them, “<transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> true, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you are not serving my god, and <transChange type="added">you are</transChange> not worshiping the statue of gold<note placement="foot">Aramaic “the gold”</note> that I have set up?

verses.name: Daniel 3:15
verses.text: Now if you are ready so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at that time”</note> you hear the sound of the horn, the flute, the lyre, the trigon, the harp and the drum and all kinds of music, you fall down and you worship the statue that I have made, that will be good. But if you do not worship it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞immediately⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at that very time”</note> you will be thrown into the midst of the furnace of blazing fire, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who is the god⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who he god”</note> who<note placement="foot">Or “that”</note> will rescue you from my hands?”  <div eID="gen23081" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9779"/><div sID="gen23082" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9779"/>Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego answered and said to the king, Nebuchadnezzar, “We have no need on this matter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to present a defense to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to return to you”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 3:17
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞If it is so⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “If there is”</note> our God, whom we serve, is able to rescue us from the furnace of blazing fire. And from your hand, O king, let him rescue us.

verses.name: Daniel 3:18
verses.text: And if not, let it be known to you, O king, that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞we will not serve your gods⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “your gods not there is us serving”</note> and the statue of gold<note placement="foot">Aramaic “the gold”</note> that you have set up we will not worship.”  <div eID="gen23082" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9780"/><title type="x-s">The Wrath of the King and His Fiery Furnace of Death</title> <div sID="gen23083" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9780"/>Then Nebuchadnezzar was filled with anger and the image of his face was changed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞toward⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “against”</note> Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, so he <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ordered and said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answering and saying”</note> to heat up the one furnace seven times what was usual to heat <transChange type="added">it</transChange> up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:20
verses.text: And he commanded <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the strongest men of the guards⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the strong men, men of strength”</note> who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego and to throw <transChange type="added">them</transChange> into the furnace of blazing fire.

verses.name: Daniel 3:21
verses.text: Then these men were bound with their garments, their trousers and their turbans and their <transChange type="added">other</transChange> clothing, and they were thrown into the midst of the furnace of blazing fire.

verses.name: Daniel 3:22
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because of this”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from that”</note> the word of the king was severe and the furnace was exceedingly hot, the flame of the fire killed these men who lifted up Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego.

verses.name: Daniel 3:23
verses.text: But these men, the three of them, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, fell down into the midst of the furnace of blazing fire, <transChange type="added">and they</transChange> were bound.  <div eID="gen23083" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9781"/><div sID="gen23084" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9781"/>Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished, and he rose up in haste <transChange type="added">and</transChange> he asked, saying to his advisers, “<transChange type="added">Did</transChange> we not throw three men, bound, into the midst of the fire? They answered, saying to the king, “Certainly, O king!”

verses.name: Daniel 3:25
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He answered⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “was answering”</note> saying, “Look, I see four men unbound walking in the midst of the fire and there is no damage to them, and the<note placement="foot">Aramaic “its”</note> appearance of the fourth <transChange type="added">man</transChange> resembles the son of a god.”

verses.name: Daniel 3:26
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar approached the door of the furnace of blazing fire, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> he called out, saying, “Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞servants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his servant”</note> of the Most High God, come out<note placement="foot">Or “Go out”</note> and come here!”

verses.name: Daniel 3:27
verses.text: And the satraps, the prefects, the governors and the advisors of the king <transChange type="added">were</transChange> assembling, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> they saw these men, that the fire had no power over their bodies, and the hair of their heads was<note placement="foot">Aramaic plural</note> not singed, and their garments were not harmed, and the smell of fire did not come from them.  <div eID="gen23084" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9782"/><title type="x-s">The King’s Praise for the Great Deliverance of the Three Young Israelites</title> <div sID="gen23085" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9782"/>Nebuchadnezzar <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞responded⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “answering”</note> saying, “Blessed be their God, the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, who sent his angel<note placement="foot">Or “messenger”</note> and rescued his servants who trusted in him, and the command of the king they disobeyed, and they gave their bodies so that they <transChange type="added">did</transChange> not serve and <transChange type="added">did</transChange> not worship any god except their God.

verses.name: Daniel 3:29
verses.text: And from me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is set forth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “setting out”</note> a decree that any people, nation, or language that may utter criticism against their God—the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego—will be broken into pieces and their<note placement="foot">Aramaic “his”</note> house will be made like ruins. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞For⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “All of because”</note> there is not another God who is able to rescue like this <transChange type="added">God</transChange>.”

verses.name: Daniel 3:30
verses.text: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the province of Babylon.  <chapter eID="Dan.3"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9783"/><title type="x-s">Nebuchadnezzar Declares What the Most High God Has Done for Him</title> <div sID="gen23086" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9783"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Dan.4.1-Dan.4.37">Daniel 4:1–4:37 </reference>in the English Bible is 3:31–4:34 in the Hebrew Bible</note> Nebuchadnezzar the king to all of the nations, the peoples and languages that live in the whole earth: “May your prosperity increase!

verses.name: Daniel 4:2
verses.text: It is pleasing to me to recount the signs and wonders that the Most High God worked for me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:3
verses.text: How great <transChange type="added">are</transChange> his signs and wonders, how strong <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his kingdom, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an everlasting kingdom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “a kingdom of eternity”</note> and his sovereignty is from generation to generation.  <div eID="gen23086" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9784"/><title type="x-s">The Dream and the King’s Search for an Interpreter</title> <div sID="gen23087" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9784"/>“I, Nebuchadnezzar, was content in my house and prospering in my palace.

verses.name: Daniel 4:5
verses.text: And I saw a dream and a revelation on my bed and it frightened me, and the visions of my head terrified me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:6
verses.text: And a decree was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sent out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “put/placed”</note> <transChange type="added">ordering that</transChange> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise men of Babylon <transChange type="added">were</transChange> to be brought in before me <transChange type="added">so</transChange> that they may make known to me <transChange type="added">the</transChange> explanation of the dream.

verses.name: Daniel 4:7
verses.text: Then the magicians,<note placement="foot">Or “soothsayer-priests”</note> the conjurers,<note placement="foot">Or “enchanters”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞astrologers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldeans”</note> and the diviners came in and I told them the dream, but they could not make known to me its explanation.<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 4:8
verses.text: Then <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at last⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until another”</note> Daniel came before me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose name was⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who name his”</note> Belteshazzar, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “like”</note> the name of my god, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in whom was the spirit of the holy gods⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and who the spirit of gods holy in him”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and I related the dream to him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and the dream before him I told”</note>  <div eID="gen23087" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9785"/><div sID="gen23088" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9785"/>“ ‘<transChange type="added">O</transChange> Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians,<note placement="foot">Or “soothsayer-priests”</note> I myself know that the spirit<note placement="foot">Or “a spirit”</note> of the holy gods is in you, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no mystery is too difficult⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “every mystery is not difficult”</note> for you. Now tell me the visions of my dream that I saw, and its explanation.<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 4:10
verses.text: Now <transChange type="added">these were</transChange> the visions of my head <transChange type="added">as I was lying</transChange> on my bed: I was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞gazing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “seeing”</note> and, look, a tree <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in the midst of the earth, and its height <transChange type="added">was</transChange> exalted.  <div eID="gen23088" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9786"/><lg sID="gen23089"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9786"/>The tree grew and it became strong,<l eID="gen23090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23091"/>and its height reached to heaven,<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note><l eID="gen23091" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23092"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it was visible to the end of the whole earth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and its appearance was to the end of the whole earth”</note> <l eID="gen23092" level="2"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9787"/><l level="1" sID="gen23093"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9787"/>Its foliage <transChange type="added">was</transChange> beautiful,<l eID="gen23093" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23094"/>and its fruit abundant,<l eID="gen23094" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23095"/>and in it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> provision for all.<l eID="gen23095" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23096"/>Under it the animals<note placement="foot">Aramaic “animal”</note> of the field sought shade,<l eID="gen23096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23097"/>and in its branches the birds of heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> nested,<l eID="gen23097" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23098"/>and from it all the living beings were fed. <l eID="gen23098" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen23089"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9788"/><div sID="gen23099" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9788"/>“ ‘I was looking in the vision of my head <transChange type="added">as I lay</transChange> on my bed, and look, a watcher,<note placement="foot">Or “angelic being”</note> and <transChange type="added">a</transChange> holy <transChange type="added">one</transChange>, came down from heaven.  <div eID="gen23099" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9789"/><div sID="gen23100" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9789"/>He cried <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞aloud⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in strength”</note> and so he said: <div eID="gen23100" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23101"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23102"/>“Cut down the tree and chop off its branches;<l eID="gen23102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23103"/>shake off its foliage and scatter its fruit.<l eID="gen23103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23104"/>Let the animals flee from under it,<l eID="gen23104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23105"/>and the birds from its branches. <l eID="gen23105" level="2"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9790"/><l level="1" sID="gen23106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9790"/>But the stump of its roots<l eID="gen23106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23107"/>leave in the earth,<l eID="gen23107" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23108"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞along with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and with”</note> a band of iron and bronze;<l eID="gen23108" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23109"/><transChange type="added">leave it</transChange> in the grass of the field.<l eID="gen23109" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23110"/>And in<note placement="foot">Or “with”</note> the dew of heaven<l eID="gen23110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23111"/>let it<note placement="foot">Or “him,” that is, the king</note> be watered,<l eID="gen23111" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23112"/>and with the animals<note placement="foot">Aramaic “animal”</note><l eID="gen23112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23113"/>let his lot <transChange type="added">be</transChange> in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grass of the earth. <l eID="gen23113" level="2"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9791"/><l level="1" sID="gen23114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9791"/>Let his mind be changed from <transChange type="added">that of a</transChange> human,<note placement="foot">Or “the human”</note><l eID="gen23114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23115"/>and let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mind of an animal be given to him,<l eID="gen23115" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23116"/>and let seven times pass over him. <l eID="gen23116" level="2"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9792"/><l level="1" sID="gen23117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9792"/>The sentence <transChange type="added">is</transChange> by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> decree of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> watchers,<l eID="gen23117" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23118"/>and the decision <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> command of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy <transChange type="added">ones</transChange>,<l eID="gen23118" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23119"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in order that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until matter that”</note> the living will know<l eID="gen23119" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23120"/>that the Most High <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sovereign over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kingdom of humankind,<l eID="gen23120" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23121"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to whomever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to whom that”</note> he wills he gives it,<l eID="gen23121" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23122"/>and he <transChange type="added">even</transChange> sets <transChange type="added">the</transChange> humblest of men over it.” <l eID="gen23122" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen23101"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9793"/><div sID="gen23123" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9793"/>“ ‘This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the dream <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I, Nebuchadnezzar the king, saw. Now<note placement="foot">Or “And”</note> you, Belteshazzar, declare its explanation, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of because that”</note> all of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise men of my kingdom were not able to make the explanation known to me, but you are able because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spirit of holy gods <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in you.’  <div eID="gen23123" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9794"/><title type="x-s">Daniel Relates and Interprets the Dream</title> <div sID="gen23124" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9794"/>“Then Daniel, whose name <transChange type="added">was</transChange> Belteshazzar, was distressed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for some time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for one hour”</note> and his thoughts disturbed him. The king answered and he said, ‘Belteshazzar, let the dream and its explanation not disturb you.’ Belteshazzar answered and said, ‘My lord, <transChange type="added">may</transChange> the dream and its explanation <transChange type="added">be</transChange> for <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> hate you and for your enemies.

verses.name: Daniel 4:20
verses.text: The tree that you saw, which grew and became strong and its height reached to heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it was visible to the end of the whole earth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “its appearance to the all the earth”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 4:21
verses.text: and its foliage <transChange type="added">was</transChange> beautiful and its fruit abundant, and <transChange type="added">so there was</transChange> provision for all in it, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the animals<note placement="foot">Aramaic “animal”</note> of the field lived under it and in its branches nest the birds of heaven,<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 4:22
verses.text: —it is you, O king, who have grown <transChange type="added">great</transChange> and you have grown strong, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> your greatness has increased and it has reached to heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> and your sovereignty to the end of the earth.

verses.name: Daniel 4:23
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">inasmuch</transChange> that the king saw <transChange type="added">the</transChange> watcher, a holy <transChange type="added">one</transChange> coming down from heaven<note placement="foot">Or “the sky”</note> and he said, “Cut down the tree and destroy it, but the stump of its root in the earth leave with a band of iron and bronze in the grass of the field, and let it be watered with the dew of heaven and let his lot be with the animals of the field <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until seven times have passed over him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “until that seven times they pass over him”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 4:24
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the explanation, O king, and it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a decree of the Most High that has come upon my lord the king:

verses.name: Daniel 4:25
verses.text: you will be driven away <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from human society⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the humankind”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will dwell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your dwelling will be”</note> with the animals<note placement="foot">Aramaic “animal”</note> of the field, and you will be caused to graze grass like the oxen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞yourself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with respect to you”</note> and you will be watered with the dew of heaven, and seven periods of time will pass over you until that you have acknowledged that the Most High is sovereign over the kingdom of humankind, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to whom he wills⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that he wills”</note> he gives it.

verses.name: Daniel 4:26
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And in that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And for”</note> they said to leave alone the stump of the tree’s root, so your kingdom will be restored for you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from that”</note> you acknowledge that heaven <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sovereign.

verses.name: Daniel 4:27
verses.text: Therefore, O king, let my advice be acceptable <transChange type="added">to you</transChange> and your sin remove<note placement="foot">Or “replace”</note> with righteousness and your iniquity with having mercy on the oppressed, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in case there might be a prolongation of your prosperity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “if will be prolongation for your prosperity”</note>  <div eID="gen23124" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9795"/><title type="x-s">God Judges the King for His Hubris</title> <div sID="gen23125" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9795"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞All this happened⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “It came upon”</note> to Nebuchadnezzar the king.

verses.name: Daniel 4:29
verses.text: At the end of twelve months he was walking on the <transChange type="added">roof of</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the royal palace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the place of the kingdom”</note> of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 4:30
verses.text: And the king answered and said, “Is this not the great Babylon which I have built as a royal palace by the strength of my own power, and for the glory of my own majesty?”

verses.name: Daniel 4:31
verses.text: <transChange type="added">While</transChange> the words <transChange type="added">were</transChange> still in the mouth of the king, a voice from heaven came, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, ‘To you, King Nebuchadnezzar, <transChange type="added">it</transChange> is declared that the kingdom has departed from you,

verses.name: Daniel 4:32
verses.text: and you will be driven away from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞human society⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the humankind”</note> and your dwelling will be with the animals<note placement="foot">Aramaic “animal”</note> of the field and they will cause you to graze <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grass like oxen, and seven times will pass over you, until you acknowledge that the Most High <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sovereign over the kingdom of humankind and that he gives it to whom he wills.’

verses.name: Daniel 4:33
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Immediately⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In that hour”</note> the word was fulfilled <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concerning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “over”</note> Nebuchadnezzar, and he was expelled from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞human society⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the humankind”</note> and he ate grass like oxen, and his body was bathed with the dew of heaven until his hair <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the hair of</transChange> an eagle and his nails grew like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> bird’s <transChange type="added">claws</transChange>.  <div eID="gen23125" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9796"/><title type="x-s">The King Praises and Extols the Most High God</title> <div sID="gen23126" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9796"/>“But at the end of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that period⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day”</note> I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and then my reason returned to me; and I blessed the Most High and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the one who lives forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the one living forever”</note> I praised and I honored. <div eID="gen23126" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23127"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23128"/>“For his sovereignty <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <transChange type="added">an</transChange> everlasting sovereignty,<l eID="gen23128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23129"/>and his kingdom <transChange type="added">continues</transChange> from generation to generation. <l eID="gen23129" level="2"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9797"/><l level="1" sID="gen23130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9797"/>And all the dwellers of the earth<l eID="gen23130" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23131"/>are regarded as nothing,<l eID="gen23131" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23132"/>and he does <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as”</note> his desire<l eID="gen23132" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23133"/>in the host of heaven and <transChange type="added">among</transChange> the dwellers of earth,<l eID="gen23133" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23134"/>and there is not <transChange type="added">one</transChange> who can hold back his hand,<l eID="gen23134" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23135"/>or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ask him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “or asks to him”</note> ‘What are you doing?’ <l eID="gen23135" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen23127"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9798"/><div sID="gen23136" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9798"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞At that time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In it the time”</note> my reason returned to me, and also the glory of my kingdom and my majesty and splendor returned to me, and my advisers and my lords<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> searched <transChange type="added">me</transChange> out, and I was established over my kingdom and abundant greatness was added to me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:37
verses.text: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and exalt and honor the king of heaven, for all his works <transChange type="added">are</transChange> truth,<note placement="foot">Or “true”</note> and his ways <transChange type="added">are</transChange> justice and that he is able to humble those who walk in pride.”  <chapter eID="Dan.4"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9799"/><title type="x-s">The Mysterious Writing on the Wall</title> <div sID="gen23137" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9799"/>Belshazzar the king made a great festival for <transChange type="added">a</transChange> thousand <transChange type="added">of</transChange> his lords,<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the presence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to over against”</note> the thousand lords he was drinking wine.<note placement="foot">Or “the wine”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:2
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞When he tasted the wine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “At the taste of the wine”</note> Belshazzar commanded that they bring the vessels of gold and silver that Nebuchadnezzar his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞predecessor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “father”</note> had taken from the temple that was in Jerusalem, so that the king and his lords,<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> his wives and his concubines may drink from them.

verses.name: Daniel 5:3
verses.text: Then they brought in the vessels of gold that they took from the temple, the house of God that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in Jerusalem, and the king and his lords,<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> his wives and his concubines drank from them.

verses.name: Daniel 5:4
verses.text: They drank the wine and praised the gods of gold and silver, bronze, iron, wood and stone.<note placement="foot">All these metals have the definite article that does not have to be translated into English to retain the meaning</note>  <div eID="gen23137" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9800"/><div sID="gen23138" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9800"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Immediately⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In its the hour”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞human fingers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “fingers of the hand of a man”</note> appeared and they wrote <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞opposite⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to over against”</note> the lampstand on the plaster of the wall of the palace of the king, and the king was watching<note placement="foot">Or “gazing at”</note> the palm of the hand that was writing.

verses.name: Daniel 5:6
verses.text: Then his face changed and his thoughts terrified him, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his hip joints gave way⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the limbs of his hip became loose”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his knees knocked together⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his knees this to this they knocked together”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:7
verses.text: The king cried <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞aloud⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with strength”</note> to bring in the conjurers,<note placement="foot">Or “enchanters”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞astrologers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldeans”</note> and the diviners; the king <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answered”</note> and said to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wise men of Babylon, “Any man that can read this writing and can tell me its explanation will be clothed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> purple and <transChange type="added">will have</transChange> <transChange type="added">a</transChange> necklace of gold <transChange type="added">hung</transChange> around his neck and he will rule <transChange type="added">as</transChange> third <transChange type="added">in authority</transChange> in the kingdom.”

verses.name: Daniel 5:8
verses.text: Then all the wise men of the king came in, but they were not able to read the writing or to make known its explanation.<note placement="foot">Aramaic “the explanation/ interpretation”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:9
verses.text: Then the king, Belshazzar, became greatly terrified, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his facial features⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “shining of his face”</note> changed upon him, and his lords<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> were perplexed.  <div eID="gen23138" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9801"/><div sID="gen23139" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9801"/>Because of the words of the king and his lords,<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> the queen came into <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the banqueting hall⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the house of the drinking”</note> and the queen <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spoke up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answered”</note> and said, “O king, live <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note> and let not your thoughts terrify you and do not let your facial expressions <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞grow pale⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “change”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:11
verses.text: There is a man in your kingdom <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who has the spirit of the holy gods in him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “who the spirit of holy gods is in him”</note> And in the days of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞predecessor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “father”</note> enlightenment and insight and wisdom like the wisdom of the gods was found in him; and, O king, Nebuchadnezzar your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞predecessor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “father”</note> appointed him as chief of the magicians,<note placement="foot">Or “soothsayer-priests”</note> the conjurers,<note placement="foot">Or “enchanters”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞astrologers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “Chaldeans”</note> and the diviners. Your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞predecessor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “father”</note> the king <transChange type="added">did this</transChange>

verses.name: Daniel 5:12
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of because that”</note> there was found in him an excellent spirit and understanding and insight for interpreting dreams and explaining riddles and solving riddles; that is, in Daniel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whom the king named⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “whom the king gave his name”</note> Belteshazzar. Now, let Daniel be called and he will tell the explanation.”<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note>  <div eID="gen23139" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9802"/><title type="x-s">Daniel Deciphers and Interprets the Writing</title> <div sID="gen23140" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9802"/>Then Daniel was brought in before the king, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the king <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answered”</note> and said to Daniel, “You are Daniel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who are one of the exiles⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who from sons of the exile”</note> of Judah<note placement="foot">Aramaic “Jehud”</note> whom my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞predecessor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “father”</note> the king, brought from Judah.<note placement="foot">Aramaic “Jehud”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:14
verses.text: And I have heard that a spirit of the gods <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in you and enlightenment and insight and excellent wisdom was found in you.

verses.name: Daniel 5:15
verses.text: And now the wise men <transChange type="added">and</transChange> the conjurers<note placement="foot">Or “enchanters”</note> were brought in before me so that they could read this writing in order to make its explanation<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note> known to me, but they were not able to disclose the explanation<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note> of the matter.

verses.name: Daniel 5:16
verses.text: But I have heard concerning you that you are able <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to produce interpretations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to interpret interpretations”</note> and to solve riddles; now if you are able to read the writing and to make known its explanation<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note> to me, you will be clothed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> purple and <transChange type="added">a</transChange> necklace of gold <transChange type="added">will be placed</transChange> around your neck and you will rule <transChange type="added">as</transChange> third <transChange type="added">in command</transChange> in the kingdom.”  <div eID="gen23140" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9803"/><div sID="gen23141" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9803"/>Then Daniel answered and said before the king, “Let your gifts be for yourself or your rewards give to another; nevertheless, I will read the writing to the king and I will make known to him the explanation.<note placement="foot">Or “interpretation”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:18
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞O king⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “You, O king”</note> the Most High God gave the kingdom and the greatness and the glory and the majesty to Nebuchadnezzar your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞predecessor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “father”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:19
verses.text: And because of the greatness that he gave to him, all the peoples, the nations and languages trembled and feared before him; whomever he wanted he killed, and whomever he wanted he let live, and whomever he wanted he honored, and whomever he wanted he humbled.

verses.name: Daniel 5:20
verses.text: But <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> his heart became arrogant and his spirit became hard so as to act proudly, he was deposed from the throne of his kingdom and the<note placement="foot">Or “his”</note> glory <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was taken away from him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they took away”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 5:21
verses.text: And he was driven away <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from human society⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the sons of the humankind”</note> and his mind was made like the animals<note placement="foot">Aramaic “with the animals”</note> and his dwelling was with the wild asses; and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he was given⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they gave him”</note> grass like oxen to eat, and with<note placement="foot">Aramaic “from”</note> the dew of heaven his body was bathed, until he acknowledged that the Most High God is sovereign over the kingdom of humankind, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whoever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to from that”</note> he wants he sets over it.  <div eID="gen23141" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9804"/><div sID="gen23142" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9804"/>“But you his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞successor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “son”</note> Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞even though⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of because that”</note> you knew all this.

verses.name: Daniel 5:23
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">now</transChange> you have exalted yourself against the Lord of heaven, and the vessels of his temple you have brought in before you, and you and your lords,<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> your wives and your concubines, have been drinking wine from<note placement="foot">Aramaic “with”</note> them, and you have praised the gods of silver, gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone<note placement="foot">All the materials in this list have the definite article that does not have to be translated into English</note> that do not see and do not hear and do not know, but the God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who holds your life in his hand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who your breath is in his hand”</note> and all of your ways <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞come from him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “belong to him”</note> you have not honored.

verses.name: Daniel 5:24
verses.text: So then the palm of the hand was sent out from his presence and this writing was inscribed.  <div eID="gen23142" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9805"/><div sID="gen23143" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9805"/>“Now this was the writing that was inscribed: ‘Mene, Mene, Tekel and Parsin.’  <div eID="gen23143" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9806"/><div sID="gen23144" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9806"/>“This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the explanation of the matter:<note placement="foot">Or “word, message”</note> ‘Mene’—God has numbered your kingdom and brought an end <transChange type="added">to</transChange> it.  <div eID="gen23144" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9807"/><div sID="gen23145" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9807"/>“ ‘Tekel’—you have been weighed on scales and you have been found wanting.<note placement="foot">Or “deficient”</note>  <div eID="gen23145" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9808"/><div sID="gen23146" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9808"/>“ ‘Peres’—your kingdom has been divided and given to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Medes and Persians.’ ”  <div eID="gen23146" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9809"/><div sID="gen23147" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9809"/>Then Belshazzar commanded, and they clothed Daniel <transChange type="added">with</transChange> purple and <transChange type="added">placed</transChange> a necklace of gold around his neck, and they made a proclamation concerning him that he would be <transChange type="added">the</transChange> third ruler <transChange type="added">in authority</transChange> in the kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 5:30
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞That same night⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In it, in the night”</note> Belshazzar, the Chaldean king, was killed.

verses.name: Daniel 5:31
verses.text: <note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Dan.5.31-Dan.6.28">Daniel 5:31–6:28 </reference>in the English Bible is 6:1–29 in the Hebrew Bible</note> And Darius the Mede received the kingdom <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he was about sixty-two years old⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “when a son of sixty and two years”</note>  <chapter eID="Dan.5"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9810"/><title type="x-s">Daniel’s Integrity and His Entrapment by His Enemies</title> <div sID="gen23148" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9810"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞It pleased Darius⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “It was pleasant before Darius”</note> and he set up one hundred and twenty satraps over the kingdom, that they were <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout the whole kingdom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in all the kingdom”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:2
verses.text: and over them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> three administrators, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> whom Daniel <transChange type="added">was</transChange> one, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> that these satraps were giving account to them, and the king would not be suffering loss.

verses.name: Daniel 6:3
verses.text: Then Daniel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞began distinguishing himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was distinguishing himself”</note> above the administrators and the satraps <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of because that”</note> an exceptional spirit <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in him, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> the king planned to appoint him over the whole kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 6:4
verses.text: Then the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> administrators and satraps <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞began to seek⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “were seeking”</note> to find a pretext against Daniel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in connection with the kingdom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the side of the kingdom”</note> but they were not able to find any pretext and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞corruption⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “being corrupt”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all because that”</note> he was trustworthy, and no<note placement="foot">Aramaic “any”</note> negligence or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞corruption⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “being corrupt”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞could be found in him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not could be found”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:5
verses.text: Then these men <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “were saying”</note> “We will not find any pretext<note placement="foot">Or “basis for accusation”</note> against this Daniel unless we find it in connection with the law of his God.”  <div eID="gen23148" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9811"/><div sID="gen23149" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9811"/>So the administrators and the satraps conspired <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with respect to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on/upon”</note> the king and so they said to him, “Darius, O king, live <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:7
verses.text: All of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> administrators of the kingdom, and the prefects, the satraps, the counselors and the governors took counsel <transChange type="added">and have</transChange> agreed to establish an edict of the king and to enforce a decree that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whoever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all that”</note> will seek a prayer from any god or human except from you for up to thirty days will be thrown into <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the lion pit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “pit of lions”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:8
verses.text: Now, O king, establish the edict and you must sign the document <transChange type="added">so</transChange> that <transChange type="added">it</transChange> cannot be changed, according to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> law of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Medes and Persians which cannot be revoked.”  <div eID="gen23149" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9812"/><div sID="gen23150" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9812"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞So⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Like to before this”</note> the king, Darius, signed the writing and the interdict.<note placement="foot">Or “the writing that is the interdict”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:10
