verses.text: Now <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as that”</note> Daniel realized that the document was signed, he went to his house (<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞now he had windows in his upper room that were open⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and windows were open to him in his upper room”</note> toward Jerusalem), and three times <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞daily⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the day”</note> he knelt on his knees and prayed and gave praise before his God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all because that”</note> he had been doing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞previously⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from before this”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:11
verses.text: Then these men came as a group and they found Daniel praying and pleading for mercy before his God.

verses.name: Daniel 6:12
verses.text: Then they approached <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and spoke with the king⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and saying before the king”</note> concerning the edict of the king, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Did you not sign an edict⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Not an edict you signed?”</note> that any person who would seek anything from any God or human within thirty days except from you, O king, would be thrown into <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the lion pit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “pit of lions”</note> The king answered and said, “The matter <transChange type="added">as you have just stated</transChange> is certain according to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> law of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Medes and Persians which cannot be revoked.”  <div eID="gen23150" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9813"/><title type="x-s">God’s Miraculous Deliverance of Daniel Again</title> <div sID="gen23151" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9813"/>Then <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they responded⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they answered”</note> and said before the king, “Daniel, who is from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the exiles⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the sons of the exile”</note> of Judah,<note placement="foot">Aramaic “Jehud”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is not paying any attention⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not he sets his mind”</note> to you, O king, or to the decree that you have signed, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and three times daily⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and three times on the day”</note> he says his prayer.”

verses.name: Daniel 6:14
verses.text: Then the king, when<note placement="foot">Aramaic “as ”</note> he heard that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞report⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “word”</note> he was extremely distressed over it; and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞concerning Daniel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “upon Daniel”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he was determined⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he set his heart”</note> to rescue him. And until the setting of the sun he was making every effort to deliver him.

verses.name: Daniel 6:15
verses.text: Then these men came as <transChange type="added">a</transChange> group to the king and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “saying”</note> “Recall, O king, that with respect to the law of<note placement="foot">Aramaic “to”</note> the Medes and Persians that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞any⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all/every”</note> decree or edict that the king establishes cannot be changed.”  <div eID="gen23151" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9814"/><div sID="gen23152" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9814"/>Then the king gave the command, and Daniel was brought in and they threw <transChange type="added">him</transChange> into <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the lion pit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “pit of lions”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The king said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “The king answered and saying”</note> to Daniel, “Your God, whom you serve <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞faithfully⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the loyalty”</note> may he rescue you!”

verses.name: Daniel 6:17
verses.text: And a<note placement="foot">Aramaic “one”</note> stone was brought and it was put on the entrance of the pit, and the king sealed it with his signet ring and with the signet rings of his lords,<note placement="foot">Or “nobles”</note> so that nothing would be changed concerning Daniel.

verses.name: Daniel 6:18
verses.text: Then the king went to his palace and spent the night in fasting, and no food was brought in before him and his sleep fled from him.  <div eID="gen23152" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9815"/><div sID="gen23153" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9815"/>Then the king got up at daybreak, at first light, and he went <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in haste⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to hasten”</note> to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the lion pit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “pit of lions”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:20
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he came near⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as coming near him”</note> to the pit, he cried out to Daniel with a distressed voice, and the king <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answered”</note> and said to Daniel, “O Daniel, servant of the living God, your God whom you serve faithfully, was he able to rescue you from the lions?”

verses.name: Daniel 6:21
verses.text: Then Daniel spoke to<note placement="foot">Aramaic “with”</note> the king, “O king, live <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “unto endless ages”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:22
verses.text: My God sent his angel and he shut the mouth of the lions and they did not<note placement="foot">Aramaic “would not”</note> hurt me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of because that”</note> before him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I was found⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it was found for me”</note> blameless, and also before you, O king, I have not done <transChange type="added">any</transChange> wrong.”  <div eID="gen23153" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9816"/><div sID="gen23154" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9816"/>Then the king was exceedingly glad over it<note placement="foot">That is, the situation</note> and commanded <transChange type="added">that</transChange> Daniel be lifted up from the pit; and <transChange type="added">there</transChange> was not any wound found on him, because he had trusted in his God.

verses.name: Daniel 6:24
verses.text: The king then commanded, and these men were brought <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who had accused Daniel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they ate his pieces of Daniel”</note> and they threw them and their children and their wives into <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the lion pit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “pit of lions”</note> and they had not reached the floor of the pit <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until that”</note> the lions had overpowered them and they had crushed all of their bones.  <div eID="gen23154" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9817"/><title type="x-s">The King Praises the God of Daniel and Daniel Prospers</title> <div sID="gen23155" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9817"/>Then Darius the king wrote to all the people, the nations, and the languages living in the whole earth, “May your prosperity become great!

verses.name: Daniel 6:26
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I make a decree⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “From before me is put forth a decree”</note> that in all the dominion of my kingdom people will be trembling and fearing before the God of Daniel, for he is the living God and endures <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity/endless ages”</note> and his<note placement="foot">Literally “and whose”</note> kingdom is one that will not be destroyed and his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞dominion has no end⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “dominion his to the end”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 6:27
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> rescuing, delivering, and working signs and wonders in the heavens and on earth, for he <transChange type="added">has</transChange> rescued Daniel from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “hand”</note> of the lions.”

verses.name: Daniel 6:28
verses.text: So this Daniel prospered during the kingdom of Darius and during the kingdom of Cyrus the Persian.  <chapter eID="Dan.6"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9818"/><title type="x-s">Daniel’s Vision of Four Beasts and the Son of Man</title> <div sID="gen23156" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9818"/>In the first year of Belshazzar the king of Babylon, Daniel saw a dream and visions<note placement="foot">Or “the visions”</note> of his head as he lay on his bed; then he wrote down the dream and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞summary⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “head”</note> of the words <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as follows⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “saying”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:2
verses.text: Daniel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞explained⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answered”</note> and said, “I was looking in my vision in the night, and look, the four winds of heaven were stirring <transChange type="added">up</transChange> the great sea.

verses.name: Daniel 7:3
verses.text: And four great beasts <transChange type="added">were</transChange> coming up from the sea, differing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “this from this”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:4
verses.text: The first <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> lion and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for him/it”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wings of an eagle. I was watching until its wings were plucked off, and it was lifted up from the earth and it was raised on <transChange type="added">its</transChange> feet like a human, and a human heart was given to it.

verses.name: Daniel 7:5
verses.text: And look, another beast, a second one, looking like a bear. And it was raised up on one side and three tusks<note placement="foot">Or “ribs”</note> were in its mouth between its teeth, and so <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it was told⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they were saying”</note> “Arise, eat much flesh!”

verses.name: Daniel 7:6
verses.text: After this I was watching and look, another <transChange type="added">beast</transChange> like a leopard; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it had four wings⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and there were to it four wings”</note> of a bird on its back, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the beast had⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the beast”</note> four heads, and dominion was given to it.

verses.name: Daniel 7:7
verses.text: After this in the visions of the night I was looking and there was a fourth beast, terrifying and frightful and exceedingly strong, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it had⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “were to it”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞great iron teeth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “teeth of iron for it great”</note> and it was devouring and crushing, and it stamped the remainder<note placement="foot">Or “residue”</note> with its feet; and it was different from all the other beasts <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that preceded it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that preceding her/it”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and it had ten horns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and ten horns for her/it”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:8
verses.text: I was considering the horns, and look, another little horn came up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞among⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “between”</note> them, and three of the earlier horns <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were rooted out⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “dehorned”</note> from before it, and there were eyes like the eyes of a human<note placement="foot">Or “humankind”</note> in this horn and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> a mouth <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> speaking boastfully.  <div eID="gen23156" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9819"/><div sID="gen23157" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9819"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I continued watching⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I was watching”</note> until thrones were placed and an Ancient of Days sat; his clothing was like white snow and the hair of his head was like pure wool and his throne was a flame<note placement="foot">Or “ablaze with”</note> of fire and its wheels<note placement="foot">Aramaic “wheel”</note> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> burning fire.

verses.name: Daniel 7:10
verses.text: A stream of fire issued forth and flowed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from his presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “from before him”</note> thousands <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> thousands served him and ten thousand <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> ten thousand stood before him. The judge sat, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> books were opened.  <div eID="gen23157" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9820"/><div sID="gen23158" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9820"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I continued watching⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I was watching”</note> then<note placement="foot">Aramaic “in then”</note> because of the noise of the boastful words of the horn who was speaking; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I continued watching⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I was watching”</note> until the beast was slain and its body was destroyed, and it was given <transChange type="added">over</transChange> to burning with fire.

verses.name: Daniel 7:12
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> the remainder of the beasts, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their dominion was taken away⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “they took away their dominion”</note> but a prolongation <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of their life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in life”</note> was given to them for a season and a time.  <div eID="gen23158" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9821"/><div sID="gen23159" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9821"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I continued watching⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I was watching”</note> in the visions of the night, and look, with the clouds of heaven one like a son of man<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> was coming, and he came to the Ancient of Days, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was presented⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they presented him”</note> before him.

verses.name: Daniel 7:14
verses.text: And to him was given dominion and glory and kingship that<note placement="foot">Aramaic “and”</note> all the peoples, the nations, and languages would serve him; his dominion is a dominion <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without end⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of eternity”</note> that will not cease, and his kingdom <transChange type="added">is one</transChange> that will not be destroyed.  <div eID="gen23159" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9822"/><title type="x-s">Daniel Explains and Interprets the Vision</title> <div sID="gen23160" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9822"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As for me, Daniel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I Daniel”</note> my spirit was troubled <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞within me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the midst of sheath”</note> and the visions of my head terrified me.

verses.name: Daniel 7:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">So</transChange> I approached one of the attendants and I asked him<note placement="foot">Aramaic “from him”</note> about the truth concerning all this; and he told me<note placement="foot">Aramaic “to me”</note> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> he would make known to me the explanation of the matter.

verses.name: Daniel 7:17
verses.text: ‘These great beasts which are four <transChange type="added">in number</transChange> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> four kings <transChange type="added">who</transChange> will arise from the earth.

verses.name: Daniel 7:18
verses.text: But the holy ones<note placement="foot">Or “saints”</note> of the Most High will receive the kingdom, and they will take possession of the kingdom forever, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “forever and to forever”</note>  <div eID="gen23160" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9823"/><div sID="gen23161" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9823"/>“Then I desired to make certain concerning the fourth beast that was different from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the others⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of them”</note>—exceedingly terrifying, with its iron teeth and its claws of bronze; it devoured and crushed <transChange type="added">and</transChange> stamped the remainder with its feet—

verses.name: Daniel 7:20
verses.text: and concerning the horns that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> on its head, and <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> other <transChange type="added">horn</transChange> that came up and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before which three horns fell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and fell from before it three”</note> and this horn <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had eyes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and eyes to it”</note> and a mouth speaking <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞boastfully⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “abundantly”</note> and its appearance <transChange type="added">was</transChange> larger than its companions.

verses.name: Daniel 7:21
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I continued watching⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I was watching”</note> and this horn made war with the holy ones<note placement="foot">Or “saints”</note> and it prevailed over them,

verses.name: Daniel 7:22
verses.text: until the Ancient of Days came and gave judgment to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy ones<note placement="foot">Or “saints”</note> of the Most High; and the time arrived and the holy ones<note placement="foot">Or “saints”</note> took possession of the kingdom.  <div eID="gen23161" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9824"/><div sID="gen23162" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9824"/>“And he said, ‘The fourth beast <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the fourth kingdom <transChange type="added">that</transChange> will be on the earth that will be different from all the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> kingdoms, and it will devour the whole earth and it will trample it and it will crush it.

verses.name: Daniel 7:24
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> the ten horns <transChange type="added">coming</transChange> from it, <transChange type="added">from</transChange> this kingdom<note placement="foot">Or “the kingdom”</note> ten kings will arise, and another will arise after them. And he will be different from the earlier <transChange type="added">ones</transChange>, and he will subdue three kings.

verses.name: Daniel 7:25
verses.text: And he will speak words against the Most High, and he will wear out <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy ones<note placement="foot">Or “saints”</note> of the Most High, and he will attempt to change times and law, and they will be given into his hand for a time and two times and half a time.

verses.name: Daniel 7:26
verses.text: Then the court will sit, and his dominion will be removed,<note placement="foot">Or “taken away”</note> to be eradicated and to be destroyed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞totally⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until the end”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 7:27
verses.text: And the kingdom and the dominion and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole heaven will be given to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nation of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy ones<note placement="foot">Or “saints”</note> of the Most High; his kingdom <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is an everlasting kingdom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “is a kingdom of eternity”</note> and all the dominions will serve and obey him.’  <div eID="gen23162" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9825"/><div sID="gen23163" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9825"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞This is the end of the account⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Up to here is the end of the account”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As for me, Daniel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I Daniel”</note>—my thoughts terrified me greatly and my face changed over me, but I kept the matter in my heart.”<note placement="foot">Or “to myself”</note>  <chapter eID="Dan.7"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9826"/><title type="x-s">The Vision of a Small Horn that Oppresses Israel and Threatens the Temple</title> <div sID="gen23164" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9826"/>In the third year <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the kingdom of Belshazzar the king, a vision appeared <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to me, Daniel⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I Daniel”</note> after the one that appeared to me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞previously⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the beginning”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:2
verses.text: And I saw in the vision, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and when I saw⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and it was at my seeing”</note> I was in Susa, the citadel that was in the province of Elam. And I saw in the vision, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I myself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I, I was”</note> was at the stream of Ulai.<note placement="foot">Or “Ulai Canal” (NASB); “stream of the Ulai” (NEB)</note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:3
verses.text: And I lifted up my eyes and I saw, and look! A ram<note placement="foot">Hebrew “One ram”</note> standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the stream, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it had⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for it”</note> two horns, and the horns were long, but the one was longer than the second, and the longer one came up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞after the other one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in the behind of the other”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:4
verses.text: I saw the ram charging westward and northward and southward, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞none of the beasts stood before it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all the beasts not they withstood to the face of him”</note> and there was no rescuing from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “its hand”</note> and it did <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what it wanted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “according to its will”</note> and it became strong.<note placement="foot">Or “it/he magnified itself/himself”</note>  <div eID="gen23164" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9827"/><div sID="gen23165" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9827"/>And I was considering <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, and look, a he-goat coming from the west across the face of the whole earth, and <transChange type="added">it</transChange> was not touching the ground;<note placement="foot">Or “earth,” or “land”</note> and the he-goat had <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a conspicuous horn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a horn of vision”</note> between its eyes.

verses.name: Daniel 8:6
verses.text: Then it came toward the ram <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that had the two horns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the owner of the two horns”</note> that I saw standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the stream, and it ran at it with<note placement="foot">Or “in”</note> the rage of its power.

verses.name: Daniel 8:7
verses.text: And I saw it approaching the ram and it was furious at it, and it struck the ram, and it broke its two horns, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there was not strength in the ram to stand before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and not was strength in the ram to withstand to the face of him”</note> and he threw it down to the ground and trampled it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and there was no one who could rescue the ram⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and not he/it was one rescuing”</note> from its power.

verses.name: Daniel 8:8
verses.text: And the he-goat grew <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞exceedingly great⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “until much”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the height of its power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and at his being powerful”</note> the great horn was broken, and four conspicuous horns<note placement="foot">LXX reads “others” here for “conspicuous.” The words in Hebrew can be confused for each other</note> came up in place of it toward the four winds of heaven.  <div eID="gen23165" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9828"/><div sID="gen23166" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9828"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And from one of them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And from the one from them”</note> came forth a horn, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a little one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “one from little”</note> and it grew exceedingly<note placement="foot">Or “pre-eminently”</note> toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the beautiful land.

verses.name: Daniel 8:10
verses.text: And it grew up to the host of heaven, and it threw down to the ground some of the host and some of the stars and trampled them.

verses.name: Daniel 8:11
verses.text: Even against the prince of the hosts it acted arrogantly and took away from him the regular burnt offering, and the place of his sanctuary was overthrown.

verses.name: Daniel 8:12
verses.text: And on account of transgression, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> host was given over <transChange type="added">to the horn</transChange> in addition to the regular burnt offering. And it cast down truth to the ground, and it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞acted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “did”</note> and it had success.  <div eID="gen23166" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9829"/><div sID="gen23167" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9829"/>And I heard a certain holy one speaking, and a certain other holy one said to the specific one <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who was speaking⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the one speaking”</note> “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞For how long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Until when”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the vision <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> the regular burnt offering, and the transgression <transChange type="added">that</transChange> makes desolate, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> giving over <transChange type="added">of the</transChange> sanctuary and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> host to trampling?”

verses.name: Daniel 8:14
verses.text: And he said to me, “For two thousand three hundred evenings and mornings, then <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sanctuary will be restored.”  <div eID="gen23167" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9830"/><title type="x-s">Gabriel Gives Angelic Help and Interprets the Vision</title> <div sID="gen23168" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9830"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it happened”</note> when I, Daniel, saw the vision, and I was seeking understanding, there was <transChange type="added">one</transChange> standing before me with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appearance of a man.

verses.name: Daniel 8:16
verses.text: And I heard <transChange type="added">the</transChange> voice of a human at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Ulai, and he called and said, “Gabriel, <transChange type="added">make</transChange> this <transChange type="added">man</transChange> understand the vision.”

verses.name: Daniel 8:17
verses.text: And he came beside <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞where I was standing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “my standing”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he came⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at his coming”</note> I became terrified and I fell prostrate on my face. And he said to me, “Understand, son of man,<note placement="foot">Or “mortal,” or “son of humankind”</note> that the vision <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end.”  <div eID="gen23168" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9831"/><div sID="gen23169" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9831"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he spoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at his speaking”</note> with me I fell into a trance with my face to the ground, and he touched me and made me stand on by feet.

verses.name: Daniel 8:19
verses.text: And he said, “Look, I am making known to you what will happen in the period of wrath,<note placement="foot">Or “the wrath”</note> for <transChange type="added">it refers</transChange> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appointed time of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end.  <div eID="gen23169" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9832"/><div sID="gen23170" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9832"/>“The ram that you saw <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who had two horns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the owner of the two horns”</note> <transChange type="added">represents</transChange> the kings of Media and Persia.  <div eID="gen23170" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9833"/><div sID="gen23171" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9833"/>“And the hairy he-goat <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞kingdom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “king”</note> of Greece, and the great horn that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> between his eyes—he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the first king.

verses.name: Daniel 8:22
verses.text: And the <transChange type="added">horn</transChange> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> was broken, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> there arose four <transChange type="added">horns</transChange> in place of it—<transChange type="added">these are</transChange> four kingdoms <transChange type="added">that</transChange> will arise from <transChange type="added">his</transChange> nation, but not with his power.

verses.name: Daniel 8:23
verses.text: And at the end of their kingdom, when the transgressions are completed, a king will arise, fierce in countenance and skilled in riddles.

verses.name: Daniel 8:24
verses.text: And his power will grow, but not by his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> power, and he will cause fearful destruction, and he will succeed and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will act⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he will do”</note> and he will destroy the mighty and the people of the holy ones.<note placement="foot">Or “saints”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 8:25
verses.text: And by his planning<note placement="foot">Or “cunning”</note> he will make a success of deceit by<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in”</note> his hand, and in his <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mind⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “heart”</note> he will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞boast⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “magnify himself”</note> and in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> ease he will destroy many, and <transChange type="added">even</transChange> against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prince of princes he will rise up, and he will be broken, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> not by human hands.

verses.name: Daniel 8:26
verses.text: And the vision of the evening and the morning that has been <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞described⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “told”</note> it is true; and you, seal up the vision, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it refers to many days to come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “for to days many”</note>  <div eID="gen23171" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9834"/><div sID="gen23172" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9834"/>And I, Daniel, was overcome, and I became ill for <transChange type="added">some</transChange> days, and I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞performed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “did”</note> the business of the king, and I was dismayed over the vision and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I did not understand it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “there was not understanding”</note>  <chapter eID="Dan.8"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9835"/><title type="x-s">Daniel’s Prayer for His People</title> <div sID="gen23173" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9835"/>In <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first year <transChange type="added">of</transChange> Darius, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> son of Ahasuerus,<note placement="foot">That is, Xerxes</note> from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> offspring of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Medes, who became king over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kingdom of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Chaldeans—

verses.name: Daniel 9:2
verses.text: in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first year <transChange type="added">of</transChange> his kingship I, Daniel, observed in the scrolls the number of the years that it was <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> to be fulfilled <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> word of Yahweh to Jeremiah the prophet for the devastation of Jerusalem—seventy years.  <div eID="gen23173" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9836"/><div sID="gen23174" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9836"/>Then I turned my face to the Lord God to seek <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> prayer and pleas for mercy,<note placement="foot">Or “supplications”</note> in fasting and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> sackcloth and ashes.

verses.name: Daniel 9:4
verses.text: And I prayed to Yahweh my God, and I made confession and I said, “O Lord, the great and awesome God, keeping the covenant and loyal love with <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> love him and with <transChange type="added">those who</transChange> keep his commandments,

verses.name: Daniel 9:5
verses.text: we have sinned and we have done wrong and we acted wickedly and we rebelled and <transChange type="added">have been</transChange> turning aside from your commandments and from your ordinances.

verses.name: Daniel 9:6
verses.text: We have not listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes and our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> and to all the people of the land.  <div eID="gen23174" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9837"/><div sID="gen23175" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9837"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Righteousness belongs to you, O Lord⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for you Lord the righteousness”</note> and on us is open shame, just as it is this day to the people of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to all Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who are near and those who are far off⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “those near and those far”</note> in all the lands to which you have driven them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to which you have driven them there”</note> because of their infidelity which they displayed against you.

verses.name: Daniel 9:8
verses.text: Yahweh, on us <transChange type="added">is</transChange> open shame, on our kings, on our princes, and on our ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> because we have sinned against you.

verses.name: Daniel 9:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Compassion and forgiveness belong to the Lord, our God⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the Lord our God the compassion and the forgiveness”</note> for we have rebelled against him,

verses.name: Daniel 9:10
verses.text: and we have not listened to the voice of Yahweh our God, by following his law <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞which he placed before us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which he gave to the face of us”</note> by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand of his servants the prophets.  <div eID="gen23175" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9838"/><div sID="gen23176" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9838"/>“And all Israel transgressed your law and turned aside <transChange type="added">so as</transChange> not to listen to your voice, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> the curse and the oath which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> written in the law of Moses, the servant of God, has been poured out upon us, because we have sinned against him.

verses.name: Daniel 9:12
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> he <transChange type="added">has</transChange> carried out his words which he spoke against us and against our rulers who ruled us, to bring upon us <transChange type="added">a</transChange> great calamity which was not done under all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> heaven as it was done in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Daniel 9:13
verses.text: Just as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> written in the law of Moses, all of this calamity has come upon us, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞we have not implored⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “we not implored”</note> the face of Yahweh our God so as to turn from our iniquities and to attend closely to your faithfulness.<note placement="foot">Or “truth”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:14
verses.text: So Yahweh <transChange type="added">has</transChange> kept watch over the<note placement="foot">Or “his”</note> calamity, and now he has brought it upon us. Indeed, Yahweh our God is righteous concerning all his works<note placement="foot">Or “acts”</note> that he has done, but we have not listened to his voice.  <div eID="gen23176" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9839"/><div sID="gen23177" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9839"/>“And now, Lord our God, who have brought your people out from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of Egypt with a strong hand, and you <transChange type="added">have</transChange> made for yourself a name <transChange type="added">until</transChange> this day—we have sinned, we have acted wickedly.

verses.name: Daniel 9:16
verses.text: Lord, according to all your righteousness, please let your anger and your rage turn away from your city Jerusalem, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of your holiness”</note> because through our sins and through the iniquities of our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> Jerusalem and your people have become an object of mockery among all of our neighbors.  <div eID="gen23177" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9840"/><div sID="gen23178" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9840"/>“And now, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his pleas for mercy. Shine<note placement="foot">Or “let shine” or “cause to shine”</note> your face upon your desolate sanctuary <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for your sake, O Lord⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for the sake of the Lord”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:18
verses.text: Incline your ear, my God, and listen; open your eyes and look at our desolation and the city that is called <transChange type="added">by</transChange> your name, for we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not presenting our pleas for mercy <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of you”</note> because of our righteousness, but <transChange type="added">rather</transChange> because of your great compassion.

verses.name: Daniel 9:19
verses.text: Lord, listen! Lord, forgive! Lord, pay heed and act! You must not delay <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for your sake⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for the sake of you”</note> my God; because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your city and your people are called by your name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “your name is called over your city and over your people”</note>  <div eID="gen23178" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9841"/><title type="x-s">Gabriel’s Announcement and Presentation of the Seventy Sets of Seven</title> <div sID="gen23179" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9841"/>Now I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> still speaking and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my plea <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> Yahweh my God, on behalf <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of the holy mountain of my God⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of the holiness of my God”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:21
verses.text: And I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> still speaking in prayer, and the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞previously⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in the beginning”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in my weariness touched me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my being wearied, touching me”</note> at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> evening offering.

verses.name: Daniel 9:22
verses.text: And he instructed <transChange type="added">me</transChange> and he spoke with me and he said, “Daniel I have now come out<note placement="foot">Or “forth”</note> to teach you understanding.

verses.name: Daniel 9:23
verses.text: At the beginning of your pleas for mercy, a word went out, and <transChange type="added">now</transChange> I have come to declare<note placement="foot">Or “deliver”</note> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> highly esteemed, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> consider the word and understand the vision.  <div eID="gen23179" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9842"/><title type="x-s">The Seventy Sets of Seven Detailed</title> <div sID="gen23180" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9842"/>“Seventy weeks is decreed for your people and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for your holy city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for the city of your holiness”</note> to put an end to the transgression and to seal up sin<note placement="foot">Or “to make an end to sin”</note> and to make atonement for guilt and to bring in everlasting righteousness and to seal vision and prophet and to anoint <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the most holy place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the holy place of holy places”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 9:25
verses.text: And you must know and you must understand<note placement="foot">Or “so you are to know and discern” (NASB), or “know then and understand” (e.g. NEB)</note> that from the time of the going out of the word to restore and build Jerusalem until an anointed<note placement="foot">Or “messiah”</note> one—a leader—will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞seven weeks and sixty-two weeks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “weeks seven and weeks sixty and two”</note> it will be restored and will be built with streets and a moat, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in a time of oppression⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in distress/oppression of the times/time”</note>  <div eID="gen23180" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9843"/><div sID="gen23181" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9843"/>“And after the sixty and two weeks an anointed one<note placement="foot">Or “messiah”</note> shall be cut off, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he shall have nothing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “there is not for him”</note> and the people of the coming leader will destroy the city and the sanctuary,<note placement="foot">Or “holy place”</note> and its end <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> with the flood and <transChange type="added">on</transChange> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> war; <transChange type="added">these</transChange> desolations are determined.

verses.name: Daniel 9:27
verses.text: And he will make a strong covenant with the many <transChange type="added">for</transChange> one week, but <transChange type="added">in</transChange> half of the week he will let cease sacrifice and offering <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and in its place⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and on a wing of”</note> a desolating abomination comes even until <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the determined complete destruction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a complete destruction and being determined”</note> is poured out on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desolator.”  <chapter eID="Dan.9"/>

verses.name: Daniel 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9844"/><title type="x-s">Daniel’s Vision of a Dazzling Heavenly Messenger</title> <div sID="gen23182" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9844"/>In the third year of Cyrus <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Persians, a word<note placement="foot">Or “matter,” or “message”</note> was revealed to Daniel, who was called by his name Belteshazzar, and the word<note placement="foot">Or “matter,” or “message”</note> was reliable and it concerned a great tribulation,<note placement="foot">Or “conflict”</note> and he understood the word<note placement="foot">Or “matter,” or “message”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he received understanding⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and understanding to him”</note>  <div eID="gen23182" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9845"/><div sID="gen23183" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9845"/>In those days, I, Daniel, I <transChange type="added">myself</transChange><note placement="foot">This is an emphatic use of the first person personal pronoun</note> was in mourning <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for three whole weeks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “three weeks of days”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:3
verses.text: I had not eaten <transChange type="added">any</transChange> choice food, and meat and wine did not enter my mouth, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I did not use any ointment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I have not anointed at all”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until the end of three whole weeks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until being full/complete three weeks of days”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 10:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twenty-fourth day of the first month, I <transChange type="added">myself</transChange><note placement="foot">This is an emphatic use of the first person personal pronoun</note> was on the bank of the great river; that is, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Tigris.

verses.name: Daniel 10:5
verses.text: And I lifted up my eyes and I saw,<note placement="foot">Or “looked”</note> and there was a man, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> he was dressed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> linen, and his waist was girded with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gold of Uphaz.

verses.name: Daniel 10:6
verses.text: Now his body <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like turquoise,<note placement="foot">Or “yellow jasper” or other gold-colored stones; the exact identity of ancient precious stones is difficult</note> and his face <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appearance of lightning, and his eyes <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like torches of fire, and his arms and his legs <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> gleam of polished bronze, and the sound of his words <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of a multitude.

verses.name: Daniel 10:7
verses.text: And I saw, I, Daniel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to alone me”</note> the vision; and the people who were with me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞did not see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not they saw”</note> the vision; nevertheless, a great trembling fell upon them and they fled <transChange type="added">in order</transChange> to hide themselves.

verses.name: Daniel 10:8
verses.text: And I myself, Daniel, alone saw this great vision, and <transChange type="added">as a result</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no strength was left in me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “not was left in me strength”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my complexion grew deathly pale⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and complexion my changed over me to destruction”</note> and I did not retain any strength.

verses.name: Daniel 10:9
verses.text: And I heard the sound of his words, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when I heard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at my hearing”</note> the sound of his words I myself began falling into a trance on my face, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with my face to the ground⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and my face toward the ground”</note>  <div eID="gen23183" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9846"/><div sID="gen23184" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9846"/>And look, a hand touched me and it roused me to my knees<note placement="foot">Hebrew “on my knees”</note> and the palms<note placement="foot">Hebrew “palm”</note> of my hands.

verses.name: Daniel 10:11
verses.text: And he said to me, “Daniel, <transChange type="added">a</transChange> man beloved, pay attention to the words that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> speaking to you and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞stand upright where you are⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “stand on your position”</note> for I have now been sent to you.” And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞while he was speaking⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at his speaking”</note> with me this word,<note placement="foot">Or “matter,” or “message”</note> I stood up trembling.

verses.name: Daniel 10:12
verses.text: And he said to me, “You must not fear, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your heart to understand and to humble yourself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> your God, your words were heard, and I myself<note placement="foot">This is an emphatic use of the first person personal pronoun</note> have come because of your words.

verses.name: Daniel 10:13
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prince of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kingdom of Persia stood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to front of me”</note> for twenty-one days. And look,<note placement="foot">Or “finally”</note> Michael, one of the chief princes, came to assist me, and I left <transChange type="added">him</transChange> there beside <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Persians.

verses.name: Daniel 10:14
verses.text: And I have come<note placement="foot">Hebrew “I came”</note> to instruct you about what<note placement="foot">Hebrew “that”</note> will happen to your people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the future⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at the end of the days”</note> for there is a further vision here <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for the future⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for the days”</note>  <div eID="gen23184" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9847"/><div sID="gen23185" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9847"/>And while he was speaking with me according to these words, I turned my face toward the ground and I was speechless.

verses.name: Daniel 10:16
verses.text: Then look, there was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one in the form of a human⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “as the likeness of a son of man”</note> he touched my lips and I opened my mouth and I spoke and I said to the one standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to opposite me”</note> “My lord, because of the vision my anxieties fell upon me and I <transChange type="added">have</transChange> not retained <transChange type="added">my</transChange> strength.

verses.name: Daniel 10:17
verses.text: So <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how am I, a servant of my lord⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “how is he able a servant of my lord this”</note> to speak with <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you, my lord⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with my lord this”</note> and I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞just now⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from now”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have no strength in me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “not it remains in me strength”</note>  <div eID="gen23185" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9848"/><div sID="gen23186" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9848"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he again touched⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he added to and touched”</note> me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the one in the form of a human⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “like vision of a man”</note> and he strengthened me.

verses.name: Daniel 10:19
verses.text: And he said, “You must not fear, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> beloved man. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Peace be to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “Peace to/for you”</note> be strong and be courageous!” And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he spoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at his speaking”</note> with me, I was strengthened and I said, “Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me.”

verses.name: Daniel 10:20
verses.text: Then he asked, “Do you know why I have come to you? And now I return to fight against the prince of Persia and I <transChange type="added">myself</transChange><note placement="foot">This is an emphatic use of the first person personal pronoun</note> am going, and look,<note placement="foot">Or “listen”</note> the prince of Javan<note placement="foot">That is, Greece</note> will come.

verses.name: Daniel 10:21
verses.text: However, I will tell you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what is inscribed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the being inscribed”</note> in the book of truth, and there is not one who contends with me against these beings <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞except⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “but if”</note> Michael, your prince.”  <chapter eID="Dan.10"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9849"/><title type="x-s">A Survey of the Kings of the North and South</title> <div sID="gen23187" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9849"/>“And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I stood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my standing”</note> as a support and as a protection for him.  <div eID="gen23187" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9850"/><div sID="gen23188" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9850"/>And now I will reveal <transChange type="added">the</transChange> truth to you. Look! Still three kings will arise in Persia, and the fourth will get abundance <transChange type="added">and</transChange> great wealth, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> more than all <transChange type="added">of them</transChange>, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he becomes strong⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at his strength”</note> through his wealth, then he will stir up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the all”</note> against the kingdom of Javan.<note placement="foot">That is, Greece</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:3
verses.text: And a mighty king will arise, and he will rule <transChange type="added">with</transChange> great dominion, and he will do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as he pleases⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as his pleasure”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:4
verses.text: But <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as he rises in power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as his rising/to rise”</note> his kingdom will be divided toward the four winds of heaven, but not to his posterity, and not according to his dominion by which he ruled, for his kingdom will be uprooted and be given <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to others besides them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to others from to alone these”</note>  <div eID="gen23188" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9851"/><div sID="gen23189" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9851"/>“Then the king of the south will grow strong and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one of his officials⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from among his officials”</note> and he will grow stronger <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞than him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “over him”</note> and he will rule <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a dominion greater than his dominion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a dominion great dominion his”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:6
verses.text: And at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end of <transChange type="added">some</transChange> years they will make an alliance, and the daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to make a peace treaty, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞she will not retain her position of power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “she will not retain the power of her arm”</note> and his offspring<note placement="foot">Or “power”</note> will not endure, and she will be given up, she and her attendants and her child supporting her, in those times.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “in the times”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:7
verses.text: And a branch from her roots<note placement="foot">That is, a member of her family</note> will rise up <transChange type="added">in</transChange> his place, and he will come against the army and he will enter the stronghold of the king of the north and he will take action against them and he will prevail.

verses.name: Daniel 11:8
verses.text: And also their gods with their idols <transChange type="added">and</transChange> with the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞precious vessels⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “vessels of their desire”</note> silver and gold he will take to Egypt into captivity, and for years <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will leave the king of the north alone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “he will stand back from the king of the north”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:9
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> he<note placement="foot">That is, the king of the north</note> will come into the kingdom of the king of the south, but he will return to his land.  <div eID="gen23189" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9852"/><div sID="gen23190" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9852"/>“But his sons will wage war and they will gather a multitude of great forces and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will advance with great force⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “he will come, to come”</note> and he will overflow <transChange type="added">like a flood</transChange> and he will pass through and he will return, and they will wage war up to his fortress.

verses.name: Daniel 11:11
verses.text: And the king of the south will become furious, and he will go and he will battle against him, against the king of the north; and he will muster a great multitude, and the multitude will be given into his hand.

verses.name: Daniel 11:12
verses.text: When the multitude is carried off, his heart will be exalted and he will overthrow <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞tens of thousands⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “myriads”</note> but he will not prevail.

verses.name: Daniel 11:13
verses.text: And the king of the north will again raise a multitude, greater than the former, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the end of some years⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the end of the times years”</note> he will surely come with a great army and with great supplies.<note placement="foot">Or “resources”</note>  <div eID="gen23190" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9853"/><div sID="gen23191" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9853"/>“And in these times many will rise <transChange type="added">up</transChange> against the king of the south, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the violent ones of your people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the sons of the lawless ones of your people”</note> will lift themselves <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to fulfill⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to cause to stand”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> vision, but they will fall.

verses.name: Daniel 11:15
verses.text: And the king of the north will come, and he will throw up siege ramps<note placement="foot">Hebrew “ramp”</note> and capture a city of fortifications and the military forces of the south and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his choice troops⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the army of his chosen troops”</note> will not stand, for<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> there is no strength <transChange type="added">left</transChange> to resist.

verses.name: Daniel 11:16
verses.text: And the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> coming to him will act <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as”</note> his pleasure, and there is no one who <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will stand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “standing”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of him”</note> and he will stand in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the beautiful land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the land of the beauty”</note> and complete destruction <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> in his power.

verses.name: Daniel 11:17
verses.text: And he will set his face to come with the authority of his whole kingdom and will form an agreement;<note placement="foot">Or “treaty,” or “peace proposal”; the Hebrew is difficult</note> and he will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞act⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “do, perform”</note> and the daughter of women he will give to him to destroy it,<note placement="foot">Or “her”</note> but the ploy will not succeed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and she will not support him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and not for him will she be”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:18
verses.text: And he will turn his face to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> coastlands, and he will capture many, but<note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> a commander will end his insults to him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that instead his insults will turn back upon him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “so that not his insults he will return against him”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:19
verses.text: And he will turn back his face toward<note placement="foot">Hebrew “to”</note> the strongholds of his land, but he will stumble and he will fall and will not be found.  <div eID="gen23191" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9854"/><div sID="gen23192" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9854"/>“Then in his place will arise <transChange type="added">one</transChange> sending an official <transChange type="added">throughout</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> glory<note placement="foot">Or “splendor”</note> of his kingdom, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in a few days⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in some days”</note> he will be broken, but not in anger and not in battle.

verses.name: Daniel 11:21
verses.text: And in his place a despicable person will arise on whom<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> they have not conferred the majesty of the kingdom, and he will come in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without warning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in ease”</note> and he will seize <transChange type="added">the</transChange> kingdom by deceit.

verses.name: Daniel 11:22
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of him”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mighty military forces⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “military forces of the flood”</note> will be utterly swept away, and they will be broken, and also <transChange type="added">the</transChange> leader of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> covenant.

verses.name: Daniel 11:23
verses.text: And after an alliance <transChange type="added">is made</transChange> with him, he will act deceitfully, and he will rise and he will become powerful with few people <transChange type="added">backing him</transChange>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:24
verses.text: In <transChange type="added">a time of</transChange> ease and in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rich parts of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> province, he will come and he will do what <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his predecessors⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his fathers and the father of his fathers”</note> did not do; he will distribute plunder and spoil and possessions to them, and he will devise his plans against fortifications, but only <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for a time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until time”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:25
verses.text: And he will stir up his power and his heart against the king of the south and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with a much greater and stronger army⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “with an army great and numerous exceedingly”</note> but he will not succeed, for they will devise plans against him.

verses.name: Daniel 11:26
verses.text: And those who eat of his royal rations will break him and his army will be overwhelmed, and many will fall, slain.

verses.name: Daniel 11:27
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And two of the kings⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And two of them, the kings”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will bend their hearts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “their heart”</note> to evil. And at the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞same table⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one table”</note> they will speak lies, but <transChange type="added">what is discussed</transChange> will not succeed, for still an end <transChange type="added">is coming</transChange> at the appointed time.

verses.name: Daniel 11:28
verses.text: Then he will return to his land with many possessions, but his heart <transChange type="added">will be set</transChange> against <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the holy covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “covenant of holiness”</note> and he will take action and he will return to his land.  <div eID="gen23192" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9855"/><div sID="gen23193" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9855"/>“At the appointed time he will return and he will come into the south, but it will not be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as it was before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as the former and as the last”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:30
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ships of Kittim will come against him, and he will lose heart, and he will turn back, and he will be enraged <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against the holy covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “against the covenant of holiness”</note> and he will take action, and he will turn back, and he will pay attention to those who forsake <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the holy covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the covenant of holiness”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:31
verses.text: And military forces from him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will occupy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will stand forth”</note> and will profane<note placement="foot">Or “desecrate”</note> the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sanctuary stronghold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the sanctuary, the stronghold”</note> and they will abolish the regular burnt offering, and they will set up the abomination that causes desolation.  <div eID="gen23193" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:32
