verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9856"/><div sID="gen23194" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9856"/>“And those who violate <transChange type="added">the</transChange> covenant he will seduce with flattery, but the persons who know their God<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the ones who know his God”</note> will stand firm and will take action.

verses.name: Daniel 11:33
verses.text: And those who have insight <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will instruct⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “make understand”</note> the many, but they will fall by sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for some time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “during days”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:34
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they fall⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in/at their falling”</note> they will receive little help, and many will join with them <transChange type="added">in</transChange> hypocrisy.

verses.name: Daniel 11:35
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">even</transChange> some of those <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who have insight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones who produce insight”</note> will fall<note placement="foot">Or “stumble”</note> <transChange type="added">in order for</transChange> them to be refined by it, and to be purified and cleansed until the time of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end, for the appointed time <transChange type="added">is</transChange> still to come.  <div eID="gen23194" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9857"/><div sID="gen23195" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9857"/>“Then the king will do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as he pleases⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as his pleasure”</note> and he will exalt himself and will consider himself above any god, and he will speak horrendous things <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “over”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> God of gods, yet he will succeed until <transChange type="added">the period</transChange> of anger is finished, for <transChange type="added">what</transChange> is determined will be done.

verses.name: Daniel 11:37
verses.text: He will not pay respect to the gods of his ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> or to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> darling of women, and not to any god will he pay respect, for he will consider himself great over all <transChange type="added">gods</transChange>.

verses.name: Daniel 11:38
verses.text: But <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞instead⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in his place”</note> he will honor the god of fortresses, a god whom his ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> did not know. He will honor him with gold, and with silver, and with precious stones<note placement="foot">Hebrew “precious stone”</note> and with costly gifts.

verses.name: Daniel 11:39
verses.text: And he will deal with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fortified strongholds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the fortifications of strongholds”</note> with the help of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a foreign god⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “the god of a foreign land”</note> and he will increase wealth for whoever will acknowledge him, and he will cause them to rule<note placement="foot">Or “appoint”</note> over the many, and he will distribute land for a price.  <div eID="gen23195" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9858"/><div sID="gen23196" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9858"/>“And at <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end the king of the south will attack him, and the king of the north will storm against him with chariots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note> and with horsemen and with many ships, and he will advance against the countries and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he will sweep through like a flood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and he will overflow them and he will pass through”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:41
verses.text: And he will come <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞into the beautiful land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “into the land of the beauty”</note> and many will fall victim, but these will escape from his power: Edom and Moab and the best part<note placement="foot">A difficult word to translate in this context: possibly it means “the foremost” (NASB), or it may mean “the remnant” (NEB)</note> of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Ammon”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:42
verses.text: And he will stretch out his hand against countries and the land of Egypt <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will not escape⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “not it will be to escape”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 11:43
verses.text: And he will rule over the treasures of gold and the silver and over all the precious things of Egypt; and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Libyans and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Cushites <transChange type="added">will follow</transChange> in his footsteps.

verses.name: Daniel 11:44
verses.text: But reports will terrify him from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east and from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north, and he will go out with great fury to destroy and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> exterminate many.

verses.name: Daniel 11:45
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> he will pitch the tents of his palace between <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the beautiful holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of the beauty holiness”</note> and he will come to his end, and there is no one<note placement="foot">Or “not one”</note> helping him.”  <chapter eID="Dan.11"/>

verses.name: Daniel 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9859"/><title type="x-s">The Time of the Judgment and the Resurrection of Two Groups</title> <div sID="gen23197" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9859"/>“Now at that time, Michael, the great prince, will arise, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the protector⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the one who stands with”</note> over the sons of your people, and it will be a time of distress that has not been since your people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have been⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to be” or “being”</note> a nation until that time. And at that time your people will escape, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone who is found⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all of the being found”</note> written in the scroll.<note placement="foot">Or “book”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 12:2
verses.text: And many from <transChange type="added">those</transChange> sleeping <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the dusty ground⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of the ground of dust”</note> will awake, some to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everlasting life⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “life of eternity”</note> and some to disgrace and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everlasting contempt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “contempt of eternity”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 12:3
verses.text: But the <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> having insight will shine like the brightness of the expanse, and <transChange type="added">the ones</transChange> providing justice <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the many<note placement="foot">Or “leading the many in righteousness”</note> will be like the stars <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to eternity and ever”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 12:4
verses.text: But you, Daniel, keep the words secret and seal the scroll<note placement="foot">Or “book”</note> until <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end; many will run back and forth and knowledge will increase.”  <div eID="gen23197" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9860"/><div sID="gen23198" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9860"/>Then I looked, I myself, Daniel, and look, there were two others standing: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one on this bank of the stream and one on the other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “one here on the bank of the stream and one there on the bank of the stream”</note>

verses.name: Daniel 12:6
verses.text: Then he said to the man <transChange type="added">who</transChange> was clothed in linen who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> above<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from above”</note> the water of the stream,<note placement="foot">Or “river”</note> “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long until⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Until when”</note> the end of the wonders?”

verses.name: Daniel 12:7
verses.text: And I heard the man <transChange type="added">who</transChange> was clothed in linen who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> above<note placement="foot">Hebrew “from above”</note> the water of the stream,<note placement="foot">Or “river”</note> and he raised his right hand and his left hand to heaven and he swore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞by the one who lives forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by the life of the eternity”</note> that an appointed time, appointed times, and half an appointed time would pass when the shattering of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the power of the holy people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the power of the people of holiness”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞would be completed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “to come to an end”</note> <transChange type="added">then</transChange> all these things will be accomplished.  <div eID="gen23198" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Daniel 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9861"/><title type="x-s">Daniel Seeks Additional Insights</title> <div sID="gen23199" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9861"/>Now I myself heard, but I <transChange type="added">did</transChange> not understand, and I said, “My lord, what <transChange type="added">will be the</transChange> outcome <transChange type="added">of</transChange> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>?”

verses.name: Daniel 12:9
verses.text: And he said, “Go, Daniel, for the words <transChange type="added">are</transChange> secret and <transChange type="added">are</transChange> sealed <transChange type="added">up</transChange> until <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> end.

verses.name: Daniel 12:10
verses.text: Many will be purified and will be cleansed and will be refined, but <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked will act wickedly <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and none of the wicked will understand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and not will understand all the wicked”</note> but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who have insight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the ones having insight”</note> will understand.

verses.name: Daniel 12:11
verses.text: And from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> time the regular burnt offering is removed and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> abomination that causes desolation <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is set up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to be set up” or “to put in place”</note> <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> one thousand two hundred and ninety days.

verses.name: Daniel 12:12
verses.text: Happy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the <transChange type="added">one who is</transChange> persevering, and attains <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one thousand three hundred and thirty-five days.

verses.name: Daniel 12:13
verses.text: But you, go <transChange type="added">on</transChange> to the end and rest, and you will arise for your allotted inheritance at the end of the days.”  <chapter eID="Dan.12"/> <div eID="gen23199" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen23046" osisID="Dan" type="book"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9862"/><title type="x-s">God Commands Hosea to Start a Family</title> <div sID="gen23201" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9862"/>The word of Yahweh that came to Hosea son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, the kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.  <div eID="gen23201" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9863"/><lg sID="gen23202"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9863"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞At the beginning when Yahweh spoke⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “At the beginning of the talking of Yahweh”</note> through Hosea,<l eID="gen23203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23204"/>Yahweh said to Hosea,<l eID="gen23204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23205"/>“Go, take for yourself a wife and children of whoredom,<l eID="gen23205" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23206"/>because the land commits great whoredom<l eID="gen23206" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23207"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forsaking Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “from behind Yahweh”</note> <l eID="gen23207" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9864"/><l level="1" sID="gen23208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9864"/>So he went and took Gomer daughter of Diblaim,<l eID="gen23208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23209"/>and she conceived and bore him a son. <l eID="gen23209" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9865"/><l level="1" sID="gen23210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9865"/>And Yahweh said to him,<l eID="gen23210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23211"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Name him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Call his name”</note> Jezreel;<note placement="foot">Jezreel means “God sows”</note><l eID="gen23211" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23212"/>because in a little while <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will punish⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will visit sin upon”</note> the house of Jehu<note placement="foot">Or “the dynasty of Jehu”</note><l eID="gen23212" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23213"/>for the blood<note placement="foot">Or “bloodshed”</note> of Jezreel,<note placement="foot">Jezreel means “God sows”</note><l eID="gen23213" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23214"/>and I will put an end to the kingdom of the house of Israel.<note placement="foot">Or “the dynasty of Israel”</note> <l eID="gen23214" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9866"/><l level="1" sID="gen23215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9866"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞On that day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen on that day”</note><l eID="gen23215" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23216"/>I will break the bow of Israel<l eID="gen23216" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23217"/>in the Valley of Jezreel.” <l eID="gen23217" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen23202"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9867"/><div sID="gen23218" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9867"/>And she conceived again and bore a daughter, and he<note placement="foot">Yahweh</note> said to him, <div eID="gen23218" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23219"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23220"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Name her⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Call her name”</note> Lo-ruhamah,<note placement="foot">Lo-ruhamah means “Not pitied”</note><l eID="gen23220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23221"/>for I will no longer have pity<l eID="gen23221" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23222"/>on the house of Israel<l eID="gen23222" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23223"/>or <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forgive them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “raise them up”</note> <l eID="gen23223" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9868"/><l level="1" sID="gen23224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9868"/>But I will have pity <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the house of Judah<l eID="gen23224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23225"/>and I will save them by Yahweh their God,<l eID="gen23225" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23226"/>and will not deliver them<l eID="gen23226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23227"/>by bow, sword, war,<l eID="gen23227" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23228"/>horses, or horsemen. <l eID="gen23228" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9869"/><l level="1" sID="gen23229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9869"/>And when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah,<note placement="foot">Lo-ruhamah means “Not pitied”</note> she conceived and bore a son. <l eID="gen23229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9870"/><l level="1" sID="gen23230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9870"/>And he<note placement="foot">Yahweh</note> said, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Name him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Call his name”</note> Lo-ammi,<note placement="foot">Lo-ammi means “not my people”</note><l eID="gen23230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23231"/>for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not my people<l eID="gen23231" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23232"/>and I am not your <transChange type="added">God</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “not yours”</note> <l eID="gen23232" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9871"/><l level="1" sID="gen23233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9871"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Hos.1.10-Hos.2.23">Hosea 1:10–2:23 </reference>in the English Bible is 2:1–25 in the Hebrew Bible</note> The number of the children of Israel<l eID="gen23233" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23234"/>will be like the sand of the sea<l eID="gen23234" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23235"/>that cannot be measured or counted;<l eID="gen23235" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23236"/>and in the place where it is said to them,<l eID="gen23236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23237"/>“You are not my people,”<l eID="gen23237" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23238"/>it will be said to them,<l eID="gen23238" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23239"/>“Children of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living God.” <l eID="gen23239" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9872"/><l level="1" sID="gen23240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9872"/>Then the children of Judah<l eID="gen23240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23241"/>and Israel will be gathered together,<l eID="gen23241" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23242"/>and they will appoint for themselves<l eID="gen23242" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23243"/>one head;<l eID="gen23243" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23244"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will take possession of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they will go up from”</note> the land,<l eID="gen23244" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23245"/>for great <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the day of Jezreel.<note placement="foot">Jezreel means “God sows”</note> <l eID="gen23245" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23219"/> <chapter eID="Hos.1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9873"/><title type="x-s">The Unfaithful Wife</title> <div sID="gen23246" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23246" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23247"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9873"/>Say to your brother,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “brothers”</note> “Ammi,”<note placement="foot">Ammi means “My people”</note><l eID="gen23248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23249"/>and to your sister,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sisters”</note> “Ruhamah.”<note placement="foot">Ruhamah means “Pitied”</note> <l eID="gen23249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9874"/><l level="1" sID="gen23250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9874"/>Plead with your mother, plead—<l eID="gen23250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23251"/>because she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not my wife,<l eID="gen23251" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23252"/>and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> not her husband.<l eID="gen23252" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23253"/>Let her put away her whoring <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from before her⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from her face”</note><l eID="gen23253" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23254"/>and her adultery from between her breasts. <l eID="gen23254" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9875"/><l level="1" sID="gen23255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9875"/>Lest I strip her naked<l eID="gen23255" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23256"/>and expose her like the day when she was born;<l eID="gen23256" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23257"/>I will make her like the desert<l eID="gen23257" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23258"/>and turn her into parched land;<l eID="gen23258" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23259"/>I will kill her with thirst. <l eID="gen23259" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9876"/><l level="1" sID="gen23260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9876"/>And I will not have pity on her children,<l eID="gen23260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23261"/>because <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> children of whoredom. <l eID="gen23261" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9877"/><l level="3" sID="gen23262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9877"/>Because their mother was unfaithful;<note placement="foot">Or “their mother played the whore”</note><l eID="gen23262" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23263"/>she who conceived them has acted shamefully,<l eID="gen23263" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23264"/>for she said:<l eID="gen23264" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23265"/>“I will go after my lovers,<l eID="gen23265" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23266"/>the ones who give <transChange type="added">me</transChange> my bread, my water,<l eID="gen23266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23267"/>my wool, and my flax,<l eID="gen23267" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23268"/>my oil, and my drink.” <l eID="gen23268" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9878"/><l level="1" sID="gen23269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9878"/>Therefore, Look!<l eID="gen23269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23270"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to hedge her path<note placement="foot">Hebrew “your path”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with thorns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with the thorns”</note><l eID="gen23270" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23271"/>and I will build a stone wall, a stone wall <transChange type="added">against</transChange> her,<l eID="gen23271" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23272"/>and she will not find her paths. <l eID="gen23272" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9879"/><l level="1" sID="gen23273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9879"/>Then she will pursue <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞her lovers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the ones who love her”</note><l eID="gen23273" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23274"/>but she will not overtake them;<l eID="gen23274" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23275"/>she will seek them and not find <transChange type="added">them</transChange>;<l eID="gen23275" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23276"/>and she will say, “I will go<l eID="gen23276" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23277"/>and return to my first husband<l eID="gen23277" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23278"/>because <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> better for me then than now.” <l eID="gen23278" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9880"/><l level="1" sID="gen23279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9880"/>But she did not know<l eID="gen23279" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23280"/>that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> I who gave her<l eID="gen23280" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23281"/>grain, new wine, and oil,<l eID="gen23281" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23282"/>and who gave her silver in abundance,<l eID="gen23282" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23283"/>and gold which they made into a Baal. <l eID="gen23283" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9881"/><l level="1" sID="gen23284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9881"/>Therefore I will take again<l eID="gen23284" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23285"/>my grain in its time,<l eID="gen23285" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23286"/>and my wine in its season;<l eID="gen23286" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23287"/>and I will take away my wool and my flax,<l eID="gen23287" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23288"/><transChange type="added">which were</transChange> to cover her nakedness. <l eID="gen23288" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9882"/><l level="1" sID="gen23289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9882"/>And now I will uncover her nakedness<l eID="gen23289" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23290"/>before the eyes of her lovers,<l eID="gen23290" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23291"/>and no one will rescue her from my hand. <l eID="gen23291" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9883"/><l level="1" sID="gen23292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9883"/>And I will put an end to all her mirth,<l eID="gen23292" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23293"/>her festivals,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “festival”</note> her new moons,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “new moon”</note> and her Sabbaths,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Sabbath”</note><l eID="gen23293" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23294"/>and all her appointed festivals;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “festival”</note> <l eID="gen23294" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9884"/><l level="1" sID="gen23295"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9884"/>and I will lay waste to her vines<note placement="foot">Hebrew “vine”</note> and her fig trees,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “fig tree”</note><l eID="gen23295" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23296"/>of which she said,<l eID="gen23296" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23297"/>“They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> my payment for prostitution,<l eID="gen23297" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23298"/>which my lovers gave to me.”<l eID="gen23298" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23299"/>I will make them a forest,<l eID="gen23299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23300"/>and the wild animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the field will devour them. <l eID="gen23300" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9885"/><l level="1" sID="gen23301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9885"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will punish her⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To visit sins upon her;” see 1:4</note> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the days of the Baals,<l eID="gen23301" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23302"/>to whom she burns incense,<l eID="gen23302" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23303"/>and she decked herself <transChange type="added">with</transChange> her ornamental ring and jewelry,<l eID="gen23303" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23304"/>and she went after her lovers, and forgot me<l eID="gen23304" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23305"/>—a declaration of Yahweh. <l eID="gen23305" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9886"/><l level="1" sID="gen23306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9886"/>Therefore, Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to allure her<l eID="gen23306" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23307"/>and bring her <transChange type="added">into</transChange> the desert,<l eID="gen23307" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23308"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will speak tenderly to her⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “I will speak to her heart”</note> <l eID="gen23308" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9887"/><l level="1" sID="gen23309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9887"/>From there I will give her<l eID="gen23309" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23310"/>her vineyards,<l eID="gen23310" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23311"/>and the Valley of Achor as a doorway of hope.<l eID="gen23311" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23312"/>And there she will respond,<l eID="gen23312" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23313"/>as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the days of her youth,<l eID="gen23313" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23314"/>just as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the day of her coming out of<l eID="gen23314" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23315"/>the land of Egypt. <l eID="gen23315" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9888"/><l level="1" sID="gen23316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9888"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And on that day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>—<note placement="foot">Literally, “And it will happen on that day”</note><l eID="gen23316" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23317"/>a declaration of Yahweh—<l eID="gen23317" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23318"/>you will call me, “My husband;”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Ishi”</note><l eID="gen23318" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23319"/>you will no longer call me, “My Baal.”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Baali”</note> <l eID="gen23319" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9889"/><l level="1" sID="gen23320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9889"/>I will remove the names<l eID="gen23320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23321"/>of the Baals from her mouth,<l eID="gen23321" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23322"/>and they will no longer be mentioned by their name. <l eID="gen23322" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9890"/><l level="1" sID="gen23323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9890"/>I will make a covenant for them on that day,<l eID="gen23323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23324"/>with the animals<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> of the field,<l eID="gen23324" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23325"/>with the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the heaven, and<l eID="gen23325" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23326"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> the creeping things<note placement="foot">Hebrew “creeping thing”</note> of the ground;<l eID="gen23326" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23327"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> bow, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> war I will abolish from the land, and I will let them lie down in safety. <l eID="gen23327" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9891"/><l level="1" sID="gen23328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9891"/>And I will take you as my wife forever;<l eID="gen23328" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23329"/>I will take you as a wife for myself in righteousness and in justice,<l eID="gen23329" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23330"/>in steadfast love and in mercy. <l eID="gen23330" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9892"/><l level="1" sID="gen23331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9892"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will take you as my wife⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will take you as a wife to me”</note> in faithfulness,<l eID="gen23331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23332"/>and you will know Yahweh. <l eID="gen23332" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9893"/><l level="1" sID="gen23333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9893"/>On that day I will answer, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of Yahweh</note><l eID="gen23333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23334"/>I will answer the heavens,<l eID="gen23334" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23335"/>and they will answer the earth. <l eID="gen23335" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9894"/><l level="1" sID="gen23336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9894"/>And the earth will answer<l eID="gen23336" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23337"/>the grain, the wine, and the oil,<l eID="gen23337" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23338"/>and they will answer Jezreel.<note placement="foot">Jezreel means “God sows”</note> <l eID="gen23338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9895"/><l level="2" sID="gen23339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9895"/>I will sow her for myself in the land;<l eID="gen23339" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23340"/>I will have pity on Lo-ruhama;<note placement="foot">Lo-ruhama means “Not pitied”</note><l eID="gen23340" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23341"/>I will say to Lo-ammi,<note placement="foot">Lo-ammi means “Not my people”</note><l eID="gen23341" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23342"/>“You are my people,”<l eID="gen23342" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23343"/>and he himself will say, “<transChange type="added">you are</transChange> my God.” <l eID="gen23343" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23247"/> <chapter eID="Hos.2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9896"/><title type="x-s">Another Symbolic Marriage</title> <div sID="gen23344" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23344" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23345"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9896"/>And Yahweh said to me again,<l eID="gen23346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23347"/>“Go, love a woman<l eID="gen23347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23348"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who has a lover⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who is beloved of a friend”</note> and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> committing adultery,<l eID="gen23348" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23349"/>just like the love of Yahweh <transChange type="added">for</transChange> the children of Israel,<l eID="gen23349" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23350"/>but they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> turning to other gods<l eID="gen23350" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23351"/>and love raisin cakes.” <l eID="gen23351" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9897"/><l level="1" sID="gen23352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9897"/>So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver<l eID="gen23352" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23353"/>and a homer of barely and a measure of wine.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “a measure of barley”; the LXX has “a nebel of wine,” although some modern translations, e.g. NASB, have “a homer and a half of barley”</note> <l eID="gen23353" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9898"/><l level="1" sID="gen23354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9898"/>And I said to her,<l eID="gen23354" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23355"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You must remain as mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “You must sit at home for me”</note> for many days,<l eID="gen23355" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23356"/>and you will not play the whore;<l eID="gen23356" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23357"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you will not belong⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you will not be”</note> to a man,<l eID="gen23357" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23358"/>and I <transChange type="added">will</transChange> belong to you.” <l eID="gen23358" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9899"/><l level="1" sID="gen23359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9899"/>The children of Israel will remain for many days<l eID="gen23359" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23360"/>without a king and prince,<l eID="gen23360" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23361"/>without sacrifice and stone pillar, ephod and teraphim. <l eID="gen23361" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9900"/><l level="1" sID="gen23362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9900"/>Afterward the children of Israel will return<l eID="gen23362" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23363"/>and seek Yahweh their God and David their king.<l eID="gen23363" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23364"/>They will come in fear to Yahweh<l eID="gen23364" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23365"/>and to his goodness at the end of days. <l eID="gen23365" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23345"/> <chapter eID="Hos.3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9901"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Has an Indictment</title> <div sID="gen23366" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23366" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23367"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9901"/>Hear the word of Yahweh, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> children of Israel,<l eID="gen23368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23369"/>for Yahweh has an indictment against the inhabitants of the land.<l eID="gen23369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23370"/>There is no faithfulness or loyalty,<l eID="gen23370" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23371"/>there is no knowledge of God in the land. <l eID="gen23371" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9902"/><l level="1" sID="gen23372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9902"/>Swearing and lying,<l eID="gen23372" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23373"/>murdering and stealing,<l eID="gen23373" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23374"/>and adultery break out,<note placement="foot">The LXX adds “and adultery breaks out in the land”</note><l eID="gen23374" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23375"/>and bloodshed follows bloodshed. <l eID="gen23375" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9903"/><l level="1" sID="gen23376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9903"/>Therefore the land mourns,<l eID="gen23376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23377"/>and all <transChange type="added">those</transChange> living in it languish<l eID="gen23377" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23378"/>with the animals of the field,<l eID="gen23378" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23379"/>and the birds of the heaven,<l eID="gen23379" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23380"/>and even the fish of the sea<l eID="gen23380" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23381"/>are being swept away. <l eID="gen23381" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9904"/><l level="1" sID="gen23382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9904"/>Yet, let no one contend,<l eID="gen23382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23383"/>and let no one accuse,<l eID="gen23383" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23384"/>for with you, O priest, <transChange type="added">is my</transChange> contention.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is unclear; the NASB translates “For your people are like those who contend with the priest”</note> <l eID="gen23384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9905"/><l level="1" sID="gen23385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9905"/>You will stumble <transChange type="added">by</transChange> day,<l eID="gen23385" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23386"/>and the priest also will stumble<l eID="gen23386" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23387"/>with you at night.<l eID="gen23387" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23388"/>And I will destroy your mother; <l eID="gen23388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9906"/><l level="2" sID="gen23389"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9906"/>My people are destroyed<l eID="gen23389" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23390"/>for lack of knowledge;<l eID="gen23390" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23391"/>because you have rejected knowledge,<l eID="gen23391" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23392"/>I reject you from acting as a priest for me.<note placement="foot">Or “to me”</note><l eID="gen23392" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23393"/>And since you have forgotten the law of your God,<l eID="gen23393" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23394"/>I will also forget your children.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sons”</note> <l eID="gen23394" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9907"/><l level="1" sID="gen23395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9907"/>When they became many, their sin increased against me;<l eID="gen23395" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23396"/>they changed<note placement="foot">Hebrew uncertain; MT “I will exchange”</note> their glory into shame. <l eID="gen23396" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9908"/><l level="1" sID="gen23397"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9908"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They feed on the sin of my people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “They eat the sins of my people”</note><l eID="gen23397" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23398"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they are greedy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they lift up their throat”</note> for their iniquity. <l eID="gen23398" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9909"/><l level="1" sID="gen23399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9909"/>And it will be like people, like priest;<l eID="gen23399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23400"/>I will punish them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> for their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> ways,<l eID="gen23400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23401"/>and I will requite them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> for their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> deeds. <l eID="gen23401" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9910"/><l level="1" sID="gen23402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9910"/>They will eat and not be satisfied;<l eID="gen23402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23403"/>they will play the whore and not multiply,<l eID="gen23403" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23404"/>because they have forsaken Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to devote themselves to <milestone type="x-idiom-end"/> <l eID="gen23404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9911"/><l level="2" sID="gen23405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9911"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>whoredom⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to watch over whoredom”</note><l eID="gen23405" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23406"/>Wine and new wine <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞take away the understanding⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “take away heart”</note> <l eID="gen23406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9912"/><l level="2" sID="gen23407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9912"/>My people,<l eID="gen23407" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23408"/>consult <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their wooden idols⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “their wood”</note><l eID="gen23408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23409"/>and their divining rod gives them oracles;<l eID="gen23409" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23410"/>because a spirit of whoredom led <transChange type="added">them</transChange> astray,<l eID="gen23410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23411"/>and they played the whore from under their God.<note placement="foot">That is, “they played the whore forsaking their God”; See <reference osisRef="Ezek.23.5">Ezek 23:5</reference></note> <l eID="gen23411" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9913"/><l level="1" sID="gen23412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9913"/>On the tops of the mountains they sacrifice,<l eID="gen23412" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23413"/>and on the hills they make offerings,<l eID="gen23413" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23414"/>under oak, poplar, and terebinth,<l eID="gen23414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23415"/>because their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “its”</note> shade is good.<l eID="gen23415" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23416"/>Therefore your daughters play the whore,<l eID="gen23416" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23417"/>and all your daughters-in-law<note placement="foot">Or “brides”</note> commit adultery. <l eID="gen23417" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9914"/><l level="1" sID="gen23418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9914"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will not punish your daughters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will not visit sins upon your daughters”</note> when they play the whore,<l eID="gen23418" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23419"/>or your daughters-in-law<note placement="foot">Or “brides”</note> when they commit adultery;<l eID="gen23419" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23420"/>because they go aside with whores,<l eID="gen23420" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23421"/>and they sacrifice with temple prostitutes,<l eID="gen23421" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23422"/>a people that does not understand comes to ruin. <l eID="gen23422" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9915"/><l level="1" sID="gen23423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9915"/>Even though you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Israel, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> playing the whore,<l eID="gen23423" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23424"/>do not let Judah become guilty;<l eID="gen23424" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23425"/>do not enter Gilgal,<l eID="gen23425" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23426"/>or go up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Beth-aven;<l eID="gen23426" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23427"/>and do not swear,<l eID="gen23427" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23428"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As Yahweh lives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!”<note placement="foot">Literally “the life of Yahweh”</note> <l eID="gen23428" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9916"/><l level="1" sID="gen23429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9916"/>Indeed, like a stubborn heifer,<l eID="gen23429" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23430"/>Israel is stubborn;<l eID="gen23430" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23431"/>Now Yahweh will feed them,<l eID="gen23431" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23432"/>like a lamb in broad pasture.<note placement="foot">Or “Can Yahweh feed them, like a lamb in broad pasture?”</note> <l eID="gen23432" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9917"/><l level="1" sID="gen23433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9917"/>Ephraim is joined to idols;<l eID="gen23433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23434"/>let him alone. <l eID="gen23434" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9918"/><l level="1" sID="gen23435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9918"/>When their drinking has ended,<l eID="gen23435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23436"/>they surely indulge in sexual orgies.<l eID="gen23436" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23437"/>They love lewdness more than their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “her”</note> glory. <l eID="gen23437" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9919"/><l level="1" sID="gen23438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9919"/>A wind has wrapped them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “her”</note> in its wings,<l eID="gen23438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23439"/>and they will be ashamed because of their altars. <l eID="gen23439" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23367"/> <chapter eID="Hos.4"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9920"/><title type="x-s">The Priests Are a Snare</title> <div sID="gen23440" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23440" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23441"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9920"/>Hear this, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> priests!<l eID="gen23442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23443"/>Give heed, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> house of Israel!<l eID="gen23443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23444"/>Listen, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> house of the king!<l eID="gen23444" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23445"/>Because the judgment <transChange type="added">applies</transChange> to you;<l eID="gen23445" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23446"/>because you have been a snare for Mizpah,<l eID="gen23446" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23447"/>and a net spread out on Tabor; <l eID="gen23447" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9921"/><l level="1" sID="gen23448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9921"/>they dug a deep pit<note placement="foot">Hebrew uncertain</note> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Shittim,<l eID="gen23448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23449"/>but I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a punishment for all of them. <l eID="gen23449" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9922"/><l level="1" sID="gen23450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9922"/>I myself know Ephraim,<l eID="gen23450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23451"/>and Israel is not hidden from me;<l eID="gen23451" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23452"/>because now you have played the whore, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Ephraim—<l eID="gen23452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23453"/>Israel is defiled. <l eID="gen23453" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9923"/><l level="1" sID="gen23454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9923"/>Their deeds do not permit them<l eID="gen23454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23455"/>to return them to God.<l eID="gen23455" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23456"/>Because a spirit of whoredom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in their midst,<l eID="gen23456" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23457"/>they do not know Yahweh. <l eID="gen23457" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9924"/><l level="1" sID="gen23458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9924"/>The pride of Israel testifies <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “against his face;” see 7:10</note><l eID="gen23458" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23459"/>and Israel and Ephraim stumble in their guilt,<l eID="gen23459" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23460"/>and Judah stumbles with them. <l eID="gen23460" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9925"/><l level="1" sID="gen23461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9925"/>With their flocks<note placement="foot">Hebrew “flock”</note> and herds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “herd”</note> they will go<l eID="gen23461" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23462"/>to seek Yahweh, but they will not find him;<l eID="gen23462" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23463"/>he has withdrawn from them. <l eID="gen23463" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9926"/><l level="1" sID="gen23464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9926"/>They have dealt faithlessly with Yahweh<l eID="gen23464" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23465"/>because they have borne illegitimate children.<l eID="gen23465" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23466"/>Now <transChange type="added">the</transChange> new moon will devour them with their fields. <l eID="gen23466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9927"/><l level="1" sID="gen23467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9927"/>Blow the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞horn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “shofar”</note> in Gibeah,<l eID="gen23467" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23468"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> trumpet in Ramah.<l eID="gen23468" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23469"/>Sound the alarm <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Beth-aven;<l eID="gen23469" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23470"/><transChange type="added">look</transChange> behind you, Benjamin. <l eID="gen23470" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9928"/><l level="1" sID="gen23471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9928"/>Ephraim will be a desolation<l eID="gen23471" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23472"/>in the day of punishment;<l eID="gen23472" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23473"/>among the tribes of Israel<l eID="gen23473" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23474"/>I will reveal what is true. <l eID="gen23474" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9929"/><l level="1" sID="gen23475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9929"/>The princes of Judah have become<l eID="gen23475" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23476"/>like those who remove a landmark;<l eID="gen23476" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23477"/>on them I will pour out<l eID="gen23477" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23478"/>my wrath like water. <l eID="gen23478" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9930"/><l level="1" sID="gen23479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9930"/>Ephraim is oppressed,<l eID="gen23479" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23480"/>crushed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> judgment,<l eID="gen23480" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23481"/>because he was determined<l eID="gen23481" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23482"/>to go after filth.<note placement="foot">Hebrew uncertain; another possible translation is “that he follows human commands”</note> <l eID="gen23482" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9931"/><l level="1" sID="gen23483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9931"/>But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> like a maggot to Ephraim<l eID="gen23483" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23484"/>and like rottenness to the house of Judah. <l eID="gen23484" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9932"/><l level="1" sID="gen23485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9932"/>And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> Ephraim saw his illness,<l eID="gen23485" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23486"/>and Judah his wound,<l eID="gen23486" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23487"/>Ephraim went to Assyria,<l eID="gen23487" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23488"/>he sent to the great king.<note placement="foot">Some translate literally “King Jareb” (see the NASB, NKJV)</note><l eID="gen23488" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23489"/>But he was unable to cure you<l eID="gen23489" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23490"/>and heal your wound. <l eID="gen23490" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9933"/><l level="1" sID="gen23491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9933"/>Because I <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> like a lion to Ephraim<l eID="gen23491" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23492"/>and like a fierce strong lion to the house of Judah.<l eID="gen23492" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23493"/>I myself will tear and I will go;<l eID="gen23493" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23494"/>I will carry off, and there is no one who delivers. <l eID="gen23494" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9934"/><l level="1" sID="gen23495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9934"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will return again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will go, I will return”</note> to my place<l eID="gen23495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23496"/>until they acknowledge <transChange type="added">their</transChange> guilt<l eID="gen23496" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23497"/>and seek my face;<l eID="gen23497" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23498"/>in their distress they will search<note placement="foot">Or “they will beg favor of”</note> me. <l eID="gen23498" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23441"/> <chapter eID="Hos.5"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9935"/><title type="x-s">A Call to Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen23499" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23499" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23500"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9935"/>Come, let us return to Yahweh;<l eID="gen23501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23502"/>because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> he who has torn, and he will heal us;<l eID="gen23502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23503"/>he has struck us down and will bind us up. <l eID="gen23503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9936"/><l level="2" sID="gen23504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9936"/>He will revive us after two days;<l eID="gen23504" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23505"/>on the third day he will raise us up,<l eID="gen23505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23506"/>that we may live in his presence.<note placement="foot">Or “before his face”</note> <l eID="gen23506" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9937"/><l level="1" sID="gen23507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9937"/>Let us know, let us press on to know Yahweh;<l eID="gen23507" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23508"/>his rising <transChange type="added">is</transChange> sure like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dawn.<l eID="gen23508" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23509"/>He will come like the showers to us,<l eID="gen23509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23510"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spring rain that waters <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen23510" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9938"/><l level="1" sID="gen23511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9938"/>What will I do with you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Ephraim?<l eID="gen23511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23512"/>What will I do with you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Judah?<l eID="gen23512" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23513"/>Your love <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a morning cloud,<l eID="gen23513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23514"/>like the dew that goes away early in the morning. <l eID="gen23514" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9939"/><l level="1" sID="gen23515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9939"/>Therefore, I have hewn <transChange type="added">them</transChange> by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prophets;<l eID="gen23515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23516"/>I have killed them by the words of my mouth,<l eID="gen23516" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23517"/>and my judgment<note placement="foot">Hebrew “your judgments”</note> goes forth like the light. <l eID="gen23517" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9940"/><l level="1" sID="gen23518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9940"/>Because I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice,<l eID="gen23518" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23519"/>and knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings. <l eID="gen23519" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9941"/><l level="1" sID="gen23520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9941"/>But like Adam, they transgressed <transChange type="added">the</transChange> covenant;<l eID="gen23520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23521"/>there they dealt faithlessly with me. <l eID="gen23521" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9942"/><l level="1" sID="gen23522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9942"/>Gilead <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a city of evil,<l eID="gen23522" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23523"/>a cunning <transChange type="added">city</transChange> because of blood.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is difficult; NRSV translates “tracked with blood”</note> <l eID="gen23523" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9943"/><l level="1" sID="gen23524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9943"/>Like bandits lying in wait,<l eID="gen23524" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23525"/><transChange type="added">so is</transChange> a band of priests;<l eID="gen23525" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23526"/>they murder <transChange type="added">on the</transChange> road to Shechem;<l eID="gen23526" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23527"/>indeed, they commit a monstrous crime. <l eID="gen23527" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9944"/><l level="1" sID="gen23528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9944"/>In the house of Israel I have seen something horrible;<l eID="gen23528" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23529"/>Ephraim’s unfaithfulness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> there.<l eID="gen23529" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23530"/>Israel is defiled.<l eID="gen23530" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen23500"/> <title type="x-s">Ephraim’s Guilt</title> <div sID="gen23531" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen23531" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9945"/><lg sID="gen23532"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9945"/>For you also, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Judah, a harvest is appointed,<l eID="gen23533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23534"/>when I restore the fortunes of my people, <l eID="gen23534" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23532"/> <chapter eID="Hos.6"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:1
verses.text: when I would heal Israel,<l eID="gen23537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23538"/>and the corruption of Ephraim is revealed,<l eID="gen23538" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23539"/>and the wicked deeds of Samaria;<l eID="gen23539" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23540"/>because they deal <transChange type="added">in</transChange> falsehood,<l eID="gen23540" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23541"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> thief breaks in,<note placement="foot">Or “comes in”</note><l eID="gen23541" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23542"/><transChange type="added">and the</transChange> bandit raids the outside. <l eID="gen23542" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9946"/><l level="1" sID="gen23543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9946"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞But they did not consider⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “But they did not say to their heart”</note><l eID="gen23543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23544"/>that I remember all their wickedness.<l eID="gen23544" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23545"/>Now their deeds surround them;<l eID="gen23545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23546"/>they are before my face. <l eID="gen23546" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9947"/><l level="1" sID="gen23547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9947"/>By their wickedness they make <transChange type="added">the</transChange> king glad,<l eID="gen23547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23548"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> officials by their treacheries. <l eID="gen23548" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9948"/><l level="1" sID="gen23549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9948"/>All of them commit adultery,<l eID="gen23549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23550"/>like a burning oven<l eID="gen23550" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23551"/>whose baker has stopped from stirring the fire,<l eID="gen23551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23552"/>and from kneading <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dough until it is leavened. <l eID="gen23552" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9949"/><l level="1" sID="gen23553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9949"/><transChange type="added">On</transChange> the day of our king, the princes<l eID="gen23553" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23554"/>became sick <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the heat of wine;<note placement="foot">This phrase refers to the effects of wine on the body</note><l eID="gen23554" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23555"/>he stretched out his hand with mockers. <l eID="gen23555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9950"/><l level="2" sID="gen23556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9950"/>Because they are kindled<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they drew near;” other ancient translations read “they are kindled”</note> like an oven,<l eID="gen23556" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23557"/>their heart burns within them;<l eID="gen23557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23558"/>all night their anger <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞smolders⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sleeps”</note><l eID="gen23558" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23559"/><transChange type="added">in the</transChange> morning it blazes like a flaming fire. <l eID="gen23559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9951"/><l level="1" sID="gen23560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9951"/>All of them are hot as an oven,<l eID="gen23560" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23561"/>and they devour<note placement="foot">Or “they eat”</note> their rulers.<l eID="gen23561" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23562"/>All their kings have fallen;<l eID="gen23562" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23563"/>there is none who calls to me amongst them. <l eID="gen23563" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9952"/><l level="1" sID="gen23564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9952"/>Ephraim mixes himself<l eID="gen23564" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23565"/>with the nations;<l eID="gen23565" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23566"/>Ephraim is a bread cake<l eID="gen23566" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23567"/>not turned over. <l eID="gen23567" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9953"/><l level="1" sID="gen23568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9953"/>Foreigners devour<note placement="foot">Or “Foreigners eat”</note> his strength,<l eID="gen23568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23569"/>and he does not know <transChange type="added">it</transChange>;<l eID="gen23569" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23570"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞mold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “grey hair,” but in this case the word refers to the “hairs of mold” on food</note> is also sprinkled upon him,<l eID="gen23570" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23571"/>and he does not know <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <l eID="gen23571" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9954"/><l level="1" sID="gen23572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9954"/>The pride of Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞testifies against him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “answers against his face”</note>—<l eID="gen23572" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23573"/>they do not return to Yahweh their God;<l eID="gen23573" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23574"/>they do not seek him for all of this.<note placement="foot">Or “in all of this”</note> <l eID="gen23574" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9955"/><l level="1" sID="gen23575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9955"/>Ephraim was like a dove,<l eID="gen23575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23576"/>silly, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞without sense⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “without heart”</note><l eID="gen23576" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23577"/>they call <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt,<l eID="gen23577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23578"/>they go <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Assyria. <l eID="gen23578" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9956"/><l level="1" sID="gen23579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9956"/>Just as they go, I will cast my net<l eID="gen23579" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23580"/>over them;<l eID="gen23580" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23581"/>I will bring them down<l eID="gen23581" level="1"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23582"/>like the birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> of the heavens;<note placement="foot">Or “sky”</note><l eID="gen23582" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23583"/>I will discipline them<l eID="gen23583" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23584"/>according to a report to their assembly.<note placement="foot">Hebrew uncertain</note> <l eID="gen23584" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9957"/><l level="1" sID="gen23585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9957"/>Woe to them, because they have strayed from me!<l eID="gen23585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23586"/>Destruction to them, because they have rebelled against me!<l eID="gen23586" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23587"/>I myself would redeem them,<l eID="gen23587" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23588"/>but they speak lies against me. <l eID="gen23588" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9958"/><l level="1" sID="gen23589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9958"/>They do not cry out to me from their heart,<l eID="gen23589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23590"/>but they wail on their beds;<l eID="gen23590" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23591"/>because of grain and new wine they lacerate<note placement="foot">Or “gash”</note> themselves;<l eID="gen23591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23592"/>they depart from me. <l eID="gen23592" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9959"/><l level="1" sID="gen23593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9959"/>And I myself trained<l eID="gen23593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23594"/>and strengthened their arms;<l eID="gen23594" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23595"/>but they plan evil against me. <l eID="gen23595" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9960"/><l level="1" sID="gen23596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9960"/>They turn, not to the Most High,<note placement="foot">Hebrew uncertain; the NRSV translates “to that which does not profit”; the NASB translates “but not upward”</note><l eID="gen23596" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23597"/>like a slack bow;<l eID="gen23597" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23598"/>their officials will fall by the sword<l eID="gen23598" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23599"/>because of the anger of their tongue.<l eID="gen23599" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23600"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their scorn<note placement="foot">The NRSV translates “So much for their babbling”</note><l eID="gen23600" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23601"/>in the land of Egypt. <l eID="gen23601" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23536"/> <chapter eID="Hos.7"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9961"/><title type="x-s">Israel Rejects the Good</title> <div sID="gen23602" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23602" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23603"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9961"/><transChange type="added">Put</transChange> to your lips <transChange type="added">the</transChange> trumpet<l eID="gen23604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23605"/>like a vulture over the house of Yahweh,<l eID="gen23605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23606"/>because they have <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞broken my covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “transgressed my covenant”</note><l eID="gen23606" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23607"/>and rebelled against my law. <l eID="gen23607" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9962"/><l level="1" sID="gen23608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9962"/>They cry out to me,<l eID="gen23608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23609"/>“My God! We, Israel, know you!” <l eID="gen23609" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:3
