verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9963"/><l level="1" sID="gen23610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9963"/>Israel has spurned <transChange type="added">the</transChange> good;<l eID="gen23610" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23611"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy will pursue him. <l eID="gen23611" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9964"/><l level="1" sID="gen23612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9964"/>They appointed kings, but not through me;<l eID="gen23612" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23613"/>they made officials, but without my knowledge.<l eID="gen23613" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23614"/><transChange type="added">With</transChange> their silver and gold<l eID="gen23614" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23615"/>they made idols for themselves<l eID="gen23615" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23616"/>for their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> own <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞destruction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “cut off”</note> <l eID="gen23616" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9965"/><l level="1" sID="gen23617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9965"/>Your calf is rejected,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he rejects” or “has rejected you”</note> <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Samaria;<l eID="gen23617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23618"/>my anger burns against them.<l eID="gen23618" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23619"/>How long<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Until when”</note> will they be incapable of innocence? <l eID="gen23619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9966"/><l level="2" sID="gen23620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9966"/>Because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> from Israel,<l eID="gen23620" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23621"/>an artisan made it,<l eID="gen23621" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23622"/>it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not a god;<l eID="gen23622" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23623"/>for the calf of Samaria<l eID="gen23623" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23624"/>will be broken <transChange type="added">to</transChange> pieces. <l eID="gen23624" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9967"/><l level="1" sID="gen23625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9967"/>Because they sow the wind,<l eID="gen23625" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23626"/>they will reap the whirlwind.<l eID="gen23626" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23627"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> standing grain does not have heads;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “head”</note><l eID="gen23627" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23628"/>it will not yield flour.<l eID="gen23628" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23629"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> if it would yield,<l eID="gen23629" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23630"/>strangers would devour it. <l eID="gen23630" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9968"/><l level="1" sID="gen23631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9968"/>Israel is swallowed up;<l eID="gen23631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23632"/>now they are among the nations,<l eID="gen23632" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23633"/>like an object that no one desires. <l eID="gen23633" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9969"/><l level="1" sID="gen23634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9969"/>For they have gone up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Assyria,<l eID="gen23634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23635"/>a wild donkey alone to itself;<l eID="gen23635" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23636"/>Ephraim has sold itself <transChange type="added">for</transChange> lovers. <l eID="gen23636" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9970"/><l level="1" sID="gen23637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9970"/>Even though they have sold themselves to the nations,<l eID="gen23637" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23638"/>now I will gather them.<l eID="gen23638" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23639"/>They will soon writhe<l eID="gen23639" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23640"/>from the burden of kings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “king”</note> and princes. <l eID="gen23640" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9971"/><l level="1" sID="gen23641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9971"/>When Ephraim multiplied altars<l eID="gen23641" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23642"/>to expiate sins,<l eID="gen23642" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23643"/>they became to him altars to sin <transChange type="added">on</transChange>. <l eID="gen23643" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9972"/><l level="1" sID="gen23644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9972"/>I write for him myriads of my instruction;<note placement="foot">Or “my law”</note><l eID="gen23644" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23645"/>they are regarded as a strange thing. <l eID="gen23645" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9973"/><l level="1" sID="gen23646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9973"/>They offer sacrifices of my choice<note placement="foot">Hebrew uncertain; or “loved ones”</note><l eID="gen23646" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23647"/>and they eat flesh;<l eID="gen23647" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23648"/>Yahweh does not accept them.<l eID="gen23648" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23649"/>Now he will remember their iniquity<l eID="gen23649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23650"/>and punish their sins;<l eID="gen23650" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23651"/>they will return <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt. <l eID="gen23651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9974"/><l level="2" sID="gen23652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9974"/>Israel has forgotten his maker and built palaces,<l eID="gen23652" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23653"/>and Judah has multiplied fortified cities;<l eID="gen23653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23654"/>but I will send fire on his cities<l eID="gen23654" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23655"/>and it will devour her strongholds. <l eID="gen23655" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23603"/> <chapter eID="Hos.8"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9975"/><title type="x-s">Ephraim Faces Punishment</title> <div sID="gen23656" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23656" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23657"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9975"/>Do not rejoice, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Israel,<l eID="gen23658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23659"/>do not exult like the nations!<l eID="gen23659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23660"/>For you played the whore, departing from your God;<l eID="gen23660" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23661"/>you loved a harlot’s wage<l eID="gen23661" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23662"/>on all the threshing floors of grain. <l eID="gen23662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9976"/><l level="2" sID="gen23663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9976"/>Threshing floor and wine vat will not feed them,<l eID="gen23663" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23664"/>and new wine will fail her.<note placement="foot">That is, Israel</note> <l eID="gen23664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9977"/><l level="2" sID="gen23665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9977"/>They will not remain<l eID="gen23665" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23666"/>in the land of Yahweh.<l eID="gen23666" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23667"/>But Ephraim will return <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Egypt,<l eID="gen23667" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23668"/>and in Assyria they will eat unclean food. <l eID="gen23668" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9978"/><l level="1" sID="gen23669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9978"/>They will not pour <transChange type="added">drink offerings of</transChange> wine to Yahweh,<l eID="gen23669" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23670"/>and their sacrifices will not please him.<l eID="gen23670" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23671"/><transChange type="added">They are</transChange> like mourners’ bread for them;<l eID="gen23671" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23672"/>all those who eat it will be defiled.<l eID="gen23672" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23673"/>For their bread will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for their hunger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “for their soul”</note><l eID="gen23673" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23674"/>it will not come <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the house of Yahweh. <l eID="gen23674" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9979"/><l level="1" sID="gen23675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9979"/>What will you do on the day of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appointed time,<l eID="gen23675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23676"/>and on the day of the festival of Yahweh? <l eID="gen23676" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9980"/><l level="1" sID="gen23677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9980"/>For look! <transChange type="added">If</transChange> they flee from the destruction,<l eID="gen23677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23678"/>Egypt will gather them;<l eID="gen23678" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23679"/>Memphis<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Noph”</note> will bury them.<l eID="gen23679" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23680"/>Nettles will possess<l eID="gen23680" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23681"/>their precious things of silver;<l eID="gen23681" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23682"/>thorns <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> in their tents. <l eID="gen23682" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9981"/><l level="1" sID="gen23683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9981"/>The days of punishment have come;<l eID="gen23683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23684"/>the days of retribution have come;<l eID="gen23684" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23685"/>Israel knows!<l eID="gen23685" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23686"/>The prophet <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a fool,<l eID="gen23686" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23687"/>the man of the spirit <transChange type="added">is</transChange> acting like a madman.<l eID="gen23687" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23688"/>Because of the greatness of your sin,<l eID="gen23688" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23689"/><transChange type="added">your</transChange> hostility <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great. <l eID="gen23689" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9982"/><l level="1" sID="gen23690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9982"/>The prophet keeps watch <transChange type="added">over</transChange> Ephraim for my God;<l eID="gen23690" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23691"/>the snare of a fowler <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on all his ways,<l eID="gen23691" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23692"/>and hostility in the house of his God. <l eID="gen23692" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9983"/><l level="1" sID="gen23693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9983"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They deeply corrupted themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “They made deep, they corrupted themselves”</note><l eID="gen23693" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23694"/>as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the days of Gibeah;<l eID="gen23694" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23695"/>he will remember their sin,<l eID="gen23695" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23696"/>he will punish their sins. <l eID="gen23696" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9984"/><l level="1" sID="gen23697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9984"/>Like the grapes in the wilderness,<l eID="gen23697" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23698"/>I found Israel.<l eID="gen23698" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23699"/>Like early ripened fruit on the fig tree in the first season,<note placement="foot">Or “in the beginning”</note><l eID="gen23699" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23700"/>I saw your ancestors.<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note><l eID="gen23700" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23701"/>They themselves came <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Baal Peor,<l eID="gen23701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23702"/>and they consecrated themselves to shame.<l eID="gen23702" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23703"/>And they became detestable things,<l eID="gen23703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23704"/>like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the thing they love⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “like loving things”</note> <l eID="gen23704" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9985"/><l level="1" sID="gen23705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9985"/>Ephraim’s glory <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a bird;<l eID="gen23705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23706"/>it will fly away—<l eID="gen23706" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23707"/>no birth, no pregnancy, and no conception. <l eID="gen23707" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9986"/><l level="1" sID="gen23708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9986"/>Even though they bring up their children,<l eID="gen23708" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23709"/>I will bereave them before maturity.<note placement="foot">Or “until no one is left”</note><l eID="gen23709" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23710"/>Woe to them indeed,<l eID="gen23710" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23711"/>when I depart from them! <l eID="gen23711" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9987"/><l level="1" sID="gen23712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9987"/>Ephraim, as I see <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,<l eID="gen23712" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23713"/><transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a palm in a meadow;<l eID="gen23713" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23714"/>but Ephraim must bring out<l eID="gen23714" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23715"/>his children to the slayer. <l eID="gen23715" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9988"/><l level="1" sID="gen23716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9988"/>Give them, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh—<l eID="gen23716" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23717"/>what will you give <transChange type="added">them</transChange>?<l eID="gen23717" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23718"/>Give them a miscarrying womb<l eID="gen23718" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23719"/>and dry breasts. <l eID="gen23719" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9989"/><l level="1" sID="gen23720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9989"/>Every evil of theirs <transChange type="added">began</transChange> at Gilgal,<l eID="gen23720" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23721"/>so I <transChange type="added">began</transChange> to hate them there;<l eID="gen23721" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23722"/>because of the evil of their deeds<l eID="gen23722" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23723"/>I will drive them out from my house.<l eID="gen23723" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23724"/>I will love them no more;<l eID="gen23724" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23725"/>all their officials <transChange type="added">are</transChange> rebels. <l eID="gen23725" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9990"/><l level="1" sID="gen23726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9990"/>Ephraim is stricken,<l eID="gen23726" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23727"/>their root is dried up,<l eID="gen23727" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23728"/>they shall not bear fruit.<l eID="gen23728" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23729"/>Even if they give birth,<l eID="gen23729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23730"/>I will kill the cherished offspring of their womb. <l eID="gen23730" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9991"/><l level="1" sID="gen23731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9991"/>My God will reject them<l eID="gen23731" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23732"/>because they did not listen to him,<l eID="gen23732" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23733"/>and they will be wanderers among the nations. <l eID="gen23733" level="3"/><lg eID="gen23657"/> <chapter eID="Hos.9"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9992"/><title type="x-s">Israel Is Punished</title> <div sID="gen23734" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23734" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23735"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9992"/>Israel <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a luxuriant vine;<note placement="foot">Or “ravaged vine”</note><l eID="gen23736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23737"/>he yields fruit for himself.<l eID="gen23737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23738"/>The more his fruit increased,<l eID="gen23738" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23739"/><transChange type="added">the more</transChange> he made numerous altars.<l eID="gen23739" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23740"/>The more his land prospered,<l eID="gen23740" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23741"/><transChange type="added">the more</transChange> he<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they”</note> improved<note placement="foot">Or “made beautiful”</note> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> stone pillars. <l eID="gen23741" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9993"/><l level="1" sID="gen23742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9993"/>Their heart is false;<l eID="gen23742" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23743"/>now they must bear <transChange type="added">their</transChange> guilt.<l eID="gen23743" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23744"/>He himself<note placement="foot">That is, “Yahweh himself”</note> will break down their altars;<l eID="gen23744" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23745"/>he will destroy their stone pillars. <l eID="gen23745" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9994"/><l level="1" sID="gen23746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9994"/>For now they will say,<l eID="gen23746" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23747"/>“We have no king;<l eID="gen23747" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23748"/>indeed, we did not fear Yahweh,<l eID="gen23748" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23749"/>and what can a king do for us?” <l eID="gen23749" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9995"/><l level="1" sID="gen23750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9995"/>They utter words of vain oaths<l eID="gen23750" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23751"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞making covenants⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “cutting covenant”</note><l eID="gen23751" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23752"/>and judgment blossoms like a poisonous plant<l eID="gen23752" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23753"/>on the furrows of the field. <l eID="gen23753" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9996"/><l level="1" sID="gen23754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9996"/>The inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of Samaria tremble<l eID="gen23754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23755"/>for the calf<note placement="foot">Hebrew “calves”</note> of Beth-aven.<l eID="gen23755" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23756"/>Indeed, his people will mourn for it,<l eID="gen23756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23757"/>and his idolatrous priests will wail<note placement="foot">Or “rejoice”</note> over it—<l eID="gen23757" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23758"/>over its glory because it has departed from it. <l eID="gen23758" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9997"/><l level="1" sID="gen23759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9997"/>It will also be brought to Assyria,<l eID="gen23759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23760"/><transChange type="added">as</transChange> tribute to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> great king.<note placement="foot">See 5:13; some translate literally “King Jareb”</note><l eID="gen23760" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23761"/>Ephraim will obtain disgrace<l eID="gen23761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23762"/>and Israel will be ashamed from his advice.<note placement="foot">Or “counsel”</note> <l eID="gen23762" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9998"/><l level="1" sID="gen23763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9998"/>Samaria will be destroyed;<l eID="gen23763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23764"/>her king <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a chip on the surface of the water. <l eID="gen23764" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9999"/><l level="1" sID="gen23765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9999"/>The high places of Aven,<l eID="gen23765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23766"/>the sin of Israel, will be destroyed.<l eID="gen23766" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23767"/>Thorn and thistle will grow<l eID="gen23767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23768"/>on their altars.<l eID="gen23768" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23769"/>They will say to the mountains, “Cover us,”<l eID="gen23769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23770"/>and to the hills, “Fall on us.” <l eID="gen23770" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10000"/><l level="1" sID="gen23771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10000"/>From the days of Gibeah you have sinned, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Israel;<l eID="gen23771" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23772"/>there <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they have remained⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “they stood”</note><l eID="gen23772" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23773"/>Will not war in Gibeah overtake them<l eID="gen23773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23774"/>against the children of evil? <l eID="gen23774" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10001"/><l level="2" sID="gen23775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10001"/>In my desire<note placement="foot">The LXX translates “I will come”</note> I will punish them;<l eID="gen23775" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23776"/>nations will be gathered against them<l eID="gen23776" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23777"/>when they are punished for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their double iniquities⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">So <hi type="italic">Qere</hi>; Masoretic Hebrew text (<hi type="italic">Kethib</hi>) “their two eyes”</note> <l eID="gen23777" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10002"/><l level="1" sID="gen23778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10002"/>Ephraim <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a trained heifer,<l eID="gen23778" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23779"/>that loved to thresh <transChange type="added">grain</transChange>,<l eID="gen23779" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23780"/>and I myself <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞spared⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “passed over”</note><l eID="gen23780" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23781"/>the fairness of her neck;<l eID="gen23781" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23782"/>I will make Ephraim break the ground,<l eID="gen23782" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23783"/>Judah will plow,<l eID="gen23783" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23784"/>Jacob must till for himself. <l eID="gen23784" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10003"/><l level="1" sID="gen23785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10003"/>Sow for yourselves righteousness;<l eID="gen23785" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23786"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞reap loyal love⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “reap according to loyal love”</note><l eID="gen23786" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23787"/>Break up for yourself fallow ground;<l eID="gen23787" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23788"/><transChange type="added">it is</transChange> time to seek Yahweh<l eID="gen23788" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23789"/>so he will come and rain<l eID="gen23789" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23790"/>righteousness upon you. <l eID="gen23790" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10004"/><l level="1" sID="gen23791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10004"/>You have plowed wickedness,<l eID="gen23791" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23792"/>you have reaped injustice,<l eID="gen23792" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23793"/>you have eaten the fruit of lies,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note><l eID="gen23793" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23794"/>because you have trusted in your strength,<l eID="gen23794" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23795"/>in the multitude of your warriors. <l eID="gen23795" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10005"/><l level="1" sID="gen23796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10005"/>The tumult of war will rise up against your people,<l eID="gen23796" level="1"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23797"/>and all your fortresses will be destroyed,<l eID="gen23797" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23798"/>as Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel;<l eID="gen23798" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23799"/>on the day of war<l eID="gen23799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23800"/>mothers were dashed to pieces with <transChange type="added">their</transChange> children.<note placement="foot">Or “upon their children”</note> <l eID="gen23800" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10006"/><l level="1" sID="gen23801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10006"/>So it will be done to you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Bethel,<l eID="gen23801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23802"/>because of the evil of your wickedness;<l eID="gen23802" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23803"/>at dawn, the king of Israel<l eID="gen23803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23804"/>will be utterly destroyed. <l eID="gen23804" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23735"/> <chapter eID="Hos.10"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10007"/><title type="x-s">God Will Have Compassion</title> <div sID="gen23805" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23805" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23806"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10007"/>When Israel was a child, I loved him,<l eID="gen23807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23808"/>and out of Egypt I called my son. <l eID="gen23808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10008"/><l level="1" sID="gen23809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10008"/>When I called<note placement="foot">Hebrew “When they called”; the LXX and modern translations read “When I called”</note> them, they went from my face.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “their face”</note><l eID="gen23809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23810"/>They sacrificed to the Baals, and they sacrificed to idols. <l eID="gen23810" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10009"/><l level="1" sID="gen23811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10009"/>And I myself taught Ephraim to walk;<l eID="gen23811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23812"/>I took them<note placement="foot">Hebrew uncertain</note> in my<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> arms,<l eID="gen23812" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23813"/>but they did not know that I healed them. <l eID="gen23813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10010"/><l level="1" sID="gen23814"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10010"/>I drew them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with human ties⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “ropes of a human”</note><l eID="gen23814" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23815"/>with the bands of love.<l eID="gen23815" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23816"/>I was to them like one who lifted up<note placement="foot">Or “like one who imposed”</note> a yoke on their jaws,<note placement="foot">Or “infants to their cheeks”</note><l eID="gen23816" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23817"/><transChange type="added">though</transChange> I bent down to them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> and let them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> eat. <l eID="gen23817" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10011"/><l level="1" sID="gen23818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10011"/>He will return<note placement="foot">Or “They will not return”</note> to the land of Egypt,<l eID="gen23818" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23819"/>and Assyria will be his king,<note placement="foot">That is “Israel’s king”</note><l eID="gen23819" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23820"/>because they refused to return. <l eID="gen23820" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10012"/><l level="1" sID="gen23821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10012"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> sword rages in his cities;<l eID="gen23821" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23822"/>it consumes his false prophets<l eID="gen23822" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23823"/>and devours because of their plans. <l eID="gen23823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10013"/><l level="2" sID="gen23824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10013"/>My people are bent on backsliding from me.<l eID="gen23824" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23825"/>To the Most High they call,<l eID="gen23825" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23826"/>he does not raise them at all. <l eID="gen23826" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10014"/><l level="1" sID="gen23827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10014"/>How can I give you up, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Ephraim?<l eID="gen23827" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23828"/><transChange type="added">How</transChange> can I hand you over, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Israel?<l eID="gen23828" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23829"/>How can I make you like Admah?<l eID="gen23829" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23830"/><transChange type="added">How</transChange> can I treat you like Zeboiim?<l eID="gen23830" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23831"/>My heart is disturbed<note placement="foot">Or “My heart is overturned”</note> within me;<l eID="gen23831" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23832"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “together”</note> my compassions are aroused. <l eID="gen23832" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10015"/><l level="1" sID="gen23833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10015"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will not execute⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will not do”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my fierce anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the anger of my nose”</note><l eID="gen23833" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23834"/>I will not again destroy Ephraim;<l eID="gen23834" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23835"/>because I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> God<l eID="gen23835" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23836"/>and not a mortal,<note placement="foot">Or “human”</note><l eID="gen23836" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23837"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> Holy <transChange type="added">One</transChange> in your midst;<l eID="gen23837" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23838"/>and I will not come in wrath. <l eID="gen23838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10016"/><l level="2" sID="gen23839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10016"/>They will go after Yahweh;<l eID="gen23839" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23840"/>he roars like a lion.<l eID="gen23840" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23841"/>When he roars,<l eID="gen23841" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23842"/>his children will come trembling<l eID="gen23842" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23843"/>from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea.<note placement="foot">That is, “the West”</note> <l eID="gen23843" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10017"/><l level="1" sID="gen23844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10017"/>They will tremble like birds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “bird”</note> from Egypt,<l eID="gen23844" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23845"/>and like doves<note placement="foot">Hebrew “dove”</note> from the land of Assyria;<l eID="gen23845" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23846"/>and I will let them return<note placement="foot">Hebrew “I will cause them to live”</note> to their homes—<l eID="gen23846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23847"/>a declaration of Yahweh.<l eID="gen23847" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen23806"/> <title type="x-s">Israel’s History</title> <div sID="gen23848" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen23848" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10018"/><lg sID="gen23849"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10018"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Hos.11.12-Hos.12.14">Hosea 11:12–12:14 </reference>in the English Bible is 12:1–15 in the Hebrew Bible</note> Ephraim has surrounded me with lies,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lie”</note><l eID="gen23850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23851"/>and the house of Israel with deceit;<l eID="gen23851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23852"/>and Judah is still wandering with God<l eID="gen23852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23853"/>and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> faithful to the Holy One. <l eID="gen23853" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23849"/> <chapter eID="Hos.11"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:1
verses.text: Ephraim herds <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wind<note placement="foot">Or “Ephraim befriends the wind”</note><l eID="gen23856" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23857"/>and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> pursuing <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east wind all day long;<l eID="gen23857" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23858"/>he multiplies deception and violence<l eID="gen23858" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23859"/>and he<note placement="foot">Hebrew “they”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞makes a treaty with Assyria⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “cuts a covenant with Assyria”</note><l eID="gen23859" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23860"/>and oil is brought to Egypt. <l eID="gen23860" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10019"/><l level="1" sID="gen23861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10019"/>Yahweh has a quarrel<note placement="foot">This word in Hebrew conveys a legal setting</note> with Judah<l eID="gen23861" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23862"/>and will punish Jacob according to his ways<l eID="gen23862" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23863"/>and repay him according to his deeds. <l eID="gen23863" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10020"/><l level="1" sID="gen23864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10020"/>In the womb he deceived his brother,<l eID="gen23864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23865"/>and in his manhood he struggled with God. <l eID="gen23865" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10021"/><l level="1" sID="gen23866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10021"/>He struggled with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> angel and prevailed;<l eID="gen23866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23867"/>he pleaded for his mercy.<l eID="gen23867" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23868"/>He met him at Bethel,<l eID="gen23868" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23869"/>and there he spoke with him.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “us”</note> <l eID="gen23869" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10022"/><l level="1" sID="gen23870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10022"/>Yahweh the God of hosts,<l eID="gen23870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23871"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his renowned name! <l eID="gen23871" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10023"/><l level="1" sID="gen23872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10023"/>But you, you must return to your God;<l eID="gen23872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23873"/>keep love and justice,<l eID="gen23873" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23874"/>and wait continually for your God. <l eID="gen23874" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10024"/><l level="1" sID="gen23875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10024"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> trader, in his hand <transChange type="added">are</transChange> scales of deceit;<note placement="foot">Or “false balances”</note><l eID="gen23875" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23876"/>he loves to oppress. <l eID="gen23876" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10025"/><l level="1" sID="gen23877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10025"/>And Ephraim said, “Surely, I am rich,<l eID="gen23877" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23878"/>I gained<note placement="foot">Or “I found”</note> wealth for myself;<l eID="gen23878" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23879"/>in all my toil they have not found guilt in me<l eID="gen23879" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23880"/>that is <transChange type="added">sin</transChange>. <l eID="gen23880" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10026"/><l level="1" sID="gen23881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10026"/>But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God<l eID="gen23881" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23882"/>since<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> the land of Egypt;<l eID="gen23882" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23883"/>I will make you live in tents again,<l eID="gen23883" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23884"/>like the days of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appointed festival. <l eID="gen23884" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10027"/><l level="1" sID="gen23885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10027"/>I spoke to the prophets;<l eID="gen23885" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23886"/>I myself multiplied revelations<note placement="foot">Hebrew “revelation”</note><l eID="gen23886" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23887"/>and through the hand of the prophets I will destroy. <l eID="gen23887" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10028"/><l level="1" sID="gen23888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10028"/>If <transChange type="added">in</transChange> Gilead <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> evil,<l eID="gen23888" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23889"/>surely they will come to nothing.<l eID="gen23889" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23890"/>In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls,<l eID="gen23890" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23891"/>also their altars will be like stone heaps<l eID="gen23891" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23892"/>on furrows of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> field. <l eID="gen23892" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10029"/><l level="1" sID="gen23893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10029"/>Jacob fled <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the open field of Aram,<note placement="foot">Or “the land of Aram”</note><l eID="gen23893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23894"/>and Israel served for a wife,<l eID="gen23894" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23895"/>and for a wife he watched over <transChange type="added">sheep</transChange>. <l eID="gen23895" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10030"/><l level="1" sID="gen23896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10030"/>And by a prophet Yahweh brought<l eID="gen23896" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23897"/>Israel up from Egypt,<l eID="gen23897" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23898"/>and by a prophet<l eID="gen23898" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23899"/>he<note placement="foot">Israel</note> was watched over. <l eID="gen23899" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10031"/><l level="1" sID="gen23900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10031"/>Ephraim has caused bitter provocation,<l eID="gen23900" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23901"/>and his Lord will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞hold him responsible for his crimes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will bring down on him his blood”</note><l eID="gen23901" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23902"/>and pay back to him his insults. <l eID="gen23902" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23855"/> <chapter eID="Hos.12"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10032"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Judgment on Idolatrous Israel</title> <div sID="gen23903" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23903" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23904"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10032"/>When Ephraim spoke,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “speaks”</note> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> terror;<l eID="gen23905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23906"/>he was exalted in Israel,<l eID="gen23906" level="1"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23907"/>but he incurred guilt through Baal and died. <l eID="gen23907" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10033"/><l level="1" sID="gen23908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10033"/>And now they sin again,<l eID="gen23908" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23909"/>and they make for themselves a molten idol,<l eID="gen23909" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23910"/>idols from their silver metal according to their understanding,<l eID="gen23910" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23911"/>all of them the work of skilled craftsmen.<l eID="gen23911" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23912"/>To these they say, “Sacrifice!”<l eID="gen23912" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23913"/>People are kissing bull calves. <l eID="gen23913" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10034"/><l level="1" sID="gen23914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10034"/>Therefore, they will be like the morning cloud,<l eID="gen23914" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23915"/>and like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dew of early morning going <transChange type="added">away</transChange>,<l eID="gen23915" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23916"/>like chaff swirling from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> threshing floor,<l eID="gen23916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23917"/>or like smoke from a window. <l eID="gen23917" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10035"/><l level="1" sID="gen23918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10035"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh your God<l eID="gen23918" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23919"/>since<note placement="foot">Or “from”</note> the land of Egypt;<l eID="gen23919" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23920"/>you know no god except me,<l eID="gen23920" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23921"/>and no one saves besides me. <l eID="gen23921" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10036"/><l level="1" sID="gen23922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10036"/>I fed you<note placement="foot">So LXX; Hebrew “I knew you”</note> in the desert,<l eID="gen23922" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23923"/>in the land of drought. <l eID="gen23923" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10037"/><l level="1" sID="gen23924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10037"/>When I fed them,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “According to their pasture”</note> they were satisfied;<l eID="gen23924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23925"/>they were satisfied and their heart was lifted up;<l eID="gen23925" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23926"/>therefore they forgot me. <l eID="gen23926" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10038"/><l level="1" sID="gen23927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10038"/>And I will be like a lion to them;<l eID="gen23927" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23928"/>I lie in wait beside <transChange type="added">the</transChange> way, like a leopard. <l eID="gen23928" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10039"/><l level="1" sID="gen23929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10039"/>I will attack them like a bear robbed of her offspring,<l eID="gen23929" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23930"/>and I will tear open the covering of their heart;<l eID="gen23930" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23931"/>there I will devour them like a lion,<l eID="gen23931" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23932"/>like an animal of the field would mutilate them. <l eID="gen23932" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10040"/><l level="1" sID="gen23933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10040"/>I will destroy you,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “He destroys you”</note> <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Israel;<l eID="gen23933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23934"/>who will help you?<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for in me, in your help”</note> <l eID="gen23934" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10041"/><l level="1" sID="gen23935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10041"/>Where now <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your king that he may save you?<l eID="gen23935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23936"/><transChange type="added">Where</transChange> in all your cities <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your judges,<l eID="gen23936" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23937"/>of whom you said, “Give to<l eID="gen23937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23938"/>me a king and rulers?” <l eID="gen23938" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10042"/><l level="1" sID="gen23939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10042"/>I gave you a king in my anger,<l eID="gen23939" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23940"/>and I took <transChange type="added">him</transChange> in my wrath. <l eID="gen23940" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10043"/><l level="1" sID="gen23941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10043"/>The sin of Ephraim <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wrapped up;<l eID="gen23941" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23942"/>his sin <transChange type="added">is</transChange> concealed. <l eID="gen23942" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10044"/><l level="1" sID="gen23943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10044"/>The labor pains of childbirth come for him;<l eID="gen23943" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23944"/>he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an unwise son<l eID="gen23944" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23945"/>because <transChange type="added">at the</transChange> proper time, he does not present himself<l eID="gen23945" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23946"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at the mouth of the womb⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the place where the sons burst forth”</note> <l eID="gen23946" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10045"/><l level="1" sID="gen23947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10045"/>Should I redeem them from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the power⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the hand”</note> of Sheol?<note placement="foot">“Sheol” is a Hebrew term for the place where the dead reside, i.e., the underworld</note><l eID="gen23947" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23948"/>Should I deliver them from death?<l eID="gen23948" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23949"/>Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your plagues, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Death?<l eID="gen23949" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23950"/>Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your destruction, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Sheol?<note placement="foot">“Sheol” is a Hebrew term for the place where the dead reside, i.e., the underworld</note><l eID="gen23950" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23951"/>Compassion is hidden from my eyes. <l eID="gen23951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10046"/><l level="2" sID="gen23952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10046"/>Although he may flourish among reeds,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “brothers”</note><l eID="gen23952" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23953"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> east wind will come, a wind of Yahweh<l eID="gen23953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23954"/>rising from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert;<l eID="gen23954" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23955"/>his fountain will dry up,<l eID="gen23955" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23956"/>his spring will be parched.<l eID="gen23956" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23957"/>It will plunder his treasury,<note placement="foot">Or “its treasury”</note><l eID="gen23957" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23958"/>every object of desire. <l eID="gen23958" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10047"/><l level="1" sID="gen23959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10047"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Hos.13.16-Hos.14.9">Hosea 13:16–14:9 </reference>in the English Bible is 14:1–10 in the Hebrew Bible</note> Samaria will be guilty,<l eID="gen23959" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23960"/>because she has rebelled against her God;<l eID="gen23960" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23961"/>they will fall by <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sword,<l eID="gen23961" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23962"/>their children will be dashed to pieces,<l eID="gen23962" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23963"/>and their pregnant women will be ripped open. <l eID="gen23963" level="2"/><lg eID="gen23904"/> <chapter eID="Hos.13"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10048"/><title type="x-s">Return to Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen23964" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen23964" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23965"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10048"/>Return to Yahweh your God, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Israel,<l eID="gen23966" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23967"/>for you have stumbled because of your sin. <l eID="gen23967" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10049"/><l level="1" sID="gen23968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10049"/>Take words with you,<l eID="gen23968" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23969"/>and return to Yahweh.<l eID="gen23969" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23970"/>Say to him,<l eID="gen23970" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23971"/>“Take away all guilt;<l eID="gen23971" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23972"/>accept good, and we will offer<l eID="gen23972" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23973"/>the fruit<note placement="foot">Hebrew uncertain</note> of our lips. <l eID="gen23973" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10050"/><l level="1" sID="gen23974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10050"/>Assyria will not save us;<l eID="gen23974" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23975"/>we will not ride on horses,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “horse”</note><l eID="gen23975" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23976"/>and we will say no more, “Our God,”<l eID="gen23976" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23977"/>to the work of our hands<l eID="gen23977" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23978"/>because in you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fatherless child finds mercy. <l eID="gen23978" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10051"/><l level="1" sID="gen23979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10051"/>I will heal their disloyalty;<note placement="foot">Or “backsliding”</note><l eID="gen23979" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23980"/>I will love them freely<l eID="gen23980" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23981"/>because my anger has turned back<l eID="gen23981" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen23982"/>from them.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> <l eID="gen23982" level="3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10052"/><l level="1" sID="gen23983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10052"/>I will be like the dew to Israel;<l eID="gen23983" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23984"/>he will blossom like the lily plant,<l eID="gen23984" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23985"/>and he will strike his roots like the <transChange type="added">trees of</transChange> Lebanon. <l eID="gen23985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10053"/><l level="2" sID="gen23986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10053"/>His new plant shoots will spread out;<l eID="gen23986" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23987"/>his splendor will be like the olive tree,<l eID="gen23987" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23988"/>and his scent like the <transChange type="added">trees of</transChange> Lebanon. <l eID="gen23988" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10054"/><l level="1" sID="gen23989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10054"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They will again dwell⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “They shall return, they shall dwell”</note> in my<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> shadow;<l eID="gen23989" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23990"/>they will grow grain<l eID="gen23990" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23991"/>and they will blossom like the plant vine;<l eID="gen23991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23992"/>his fame <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> like the wine of Lebanon. <l eID="gen23992" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10055"/><l level="1" sID="gen23993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10055"/><transChange type="added">O</transChange> Ephraim, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what have I to do⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “what for me”</note> with idols?<l eID="gen23993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23994"/>I myself have answered and looked after you.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note><l eID="gen23994" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23995"/>I am like a luxuriant cypress;<l eID="gen23995" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23996"/>your fruit<note placement="foot">Or “your faithfulness”</note> comes from me. <l eID="gen23996" level="2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10056"/><l level="1" sID="gen23997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10056"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> wise that he can understand these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>?<l eID="gen23997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen23998"/>Who is discerning that he knows them?<l eID="gen23998" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23999"/>The ways of Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> right,<l eID="gen23999" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24000"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous walk in them;<l eID="gen24000" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24001"/>but transgressors stumble in them. <l eID="gen24001" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen23965"/> <chapter eID="Hos.14"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen23200" osisID="Hos" type="book"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:1
verses.text: The word of Yahweh that came to Joel son of Pethuel. <div eID="gen24003" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">A Lament Over the Land</title> <div sID="gen24004" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24004" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10057"/><lg sID="gen24005"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10057"/>Hear this, O elders,<l eID="gen24006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24007"/>and give ear, all the inhabitants of the land.<l eID="gen24007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24008"/>Has this happened in your days?<l eID="gen24008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24009"/>Or the days of your ancestors? <l eID="gen24009" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10058"/><l level="1" sID="gen24010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10058"/>Tell it to your children,<l eID="gen24010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24011"/>and your children to their children,<l eID="gen24011" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24012"/>and their children to the following generation. <l eID="gen24012" level="3"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10059"/><l level="1" sID="gen24013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10059"/>What the cutting locust left,<l eID="gen24013" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24014"/>the swarming locust has eaten.<l eID="gen24014" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24015"/>What the swarming locust left,<l eID="gen24015" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24016"/>the hopping locust has eaten.<l eID="gen24016" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24017"/>And what the hopping locust left,<l eID="gen24017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24018"/>the destroying locust has eaten. <l eID="gen24018" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10060"/><l level="1" sID="gen24019"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10060"/>Wake up, drunkards, and weep!<l eID="gen24019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24020"/>Wail, all drinkers of wine, over the new wine,<l eID="gen24020" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24021"/>for it is cut off from your mouth. <l eID="gen24021" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10061"/><l level="1" sID="gen24022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10061"/>Because a nation has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞invaded⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “come up against”</note> my land,<l eID="gen24022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24023"/>strong <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and beyond counting⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “without number”</note><l eID="gen24023" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24024"/>Its teeth <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the teeth of a lion,<l eID="gen24024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24025"/>and its fangs <transChange type="added">are those</transChange> of a lioness. <l eID="gen24025" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10062"/><l level="1" sID="gen24026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10062"/>It has made my vine a desolation,<l eID="gen24026" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24027"/>and my fig tree a completely splintered stump.<l eID="gen24027" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24028"/>It has stripped them bare and thrown <transChange type="added">them</transChange> down;<l eID="gen24028" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24029"/>their branches have turned white. <l eID="gen24029" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10063"/><l level="1" sID="gen24030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10063"/>Lament like a virgin girded in sackcloth<l eID="gen24030" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24031"/>for the husband of her youth. <l eID="gen24031" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10064"/><l level="1" sID="gen24032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10064"/>The offering and libation are withheld<l eID="gen24032" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24033"/>from the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh.<l eID="gen24033" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24034"/>The priests mourn,<l eID="gen24034" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24035"/>the ministers of Yahweh. <l eID="gen24035" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10065"/><l level="1" sID="gen24036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10065"/>The field is destroyed;<l eID="gen24036" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24037"/>the earth mourns<l eID="gen24037" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24038"/>because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> grain is destroyed,<l eID="gen24038" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24039"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> new wine dries up,<l eID="gen24039" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24040"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> olive oil languishes. <l eID="gen24040" level="3"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10066"/><l level="1" sID="gen24041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10066"/>Be ashamed, farmers;<l eID="gen24041" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24042"/>Wail, vinedressers,<l eID="gen24042" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24043"/>over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wheat and over <transChange type="added">the</transChange> barley,<l eID="gen24043" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24044"/>because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> harvest of the field is ruined. <l eID="gen24044" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10067"/><l level="1" sID="gen24045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10067"/>The vine withers<l eID="gen24045" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24046"/>and the fig tree droops.<l eID="gen24046" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24047"/>The pomegranate tree, and also the palm tree, the apple tree<l eID="gen24047" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24048"/>—all the trees of the field—are dried up.<l eID="gen24048" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24049"/>Indeed, joy is dried up<l eID="gen24049" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24050"/>among the sons of men. <l eID="gen24050" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10068"/><l level="1" sID="gen24051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10068"/>Gird yourselves and lament, O priests!<l eID="gen24051" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24052"/>Wail, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> ministers of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> altar!<l eID="gen24052" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24053"/>Come spend the night in sackcloth,<l eID="gen24053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24054"/><transChange type="added">O</transChange> ministers of my God,<l eID="gen24054" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24055"/>because offering and libation<l eID="gen24055" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24056"/>are withheld from the house of your God. <l eID="gen24056" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10069"/><l level="1" sID="gen24057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10069"/>Solemnize a fast!<l eID="gen24057" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24058"/>Call an assembly!<l eID="gen24058" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24059"/>Gather <transChange type="added">the</transChange> elders,<l eID="gen24059" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24060"/>all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the inhabitants of the land<l eID="gen24060" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24061"/><transChange type="added">in</transChange> the house of Yahweh your God,<l eID="gen24061" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24062"/>and cry out to Yahweh. <l eID="gen24062" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10070"/><l level="1" sID="gen24063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10070"/>Ah! For the day!<l eID="gen24063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24064"/>For the day of Yahweh is near.<l eID="gen24064" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24065"/>It will come like destruction from Shaddai.<note placement="foot">Often translated “the Almighty”</note> <l eID="gen24065" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10071"/><l level="1" sID="gen24066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10071"/><transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not food cut <transChange type="added">off</transChange><l eID="gen24066" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24067"/>before our eyes,<l eID="gen24067" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24068"/>from the house of our God,<l eID="gen24068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24069"/>joy and gladness? <l eID="gen24069" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10072"/><l level="1" sID="gen24070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10072"/>The seeds shrivel under their clods;<l eID="gen24070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24071"/>the storehouses are desolate.<l eID="gen24071" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24072"/>The grain storage places are destroyed<l eID="gen24072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24073"/>because grain has dried out. <l eID="gen24073" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10073"/><l level="1" sID="gen24074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10073"/>How <transChange type="added">the</transChange> beasts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “beast”</note> groan;<l eID="gen24074" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24075"/>the herds of cattle wander around<l eID="gen24075" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24076"/>because there is no pasture for them;<l eID="gen24076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24077"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> flocks of sheep are in distress. <l eID="gen24077" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10074"/><l level="1" sID="gen24078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10074"/>To you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Yahweh, I cry out,<l eID="gen24078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24079"/>because fire has devoured<l eID="gen24079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24080"/>the pastures of the desert,<l eID="gen24080" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24081"/>and flames<note placement="foot">Hebrew “flame”</note> burned<l eID="gen24081" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24082"/>all the trees of the field. <l eID="gen24082" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10075"/><l level="1" sID="gen24083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10075"/>Also, the beasts of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> field<l eID="gen24083" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24084"/>long for you,<l eID="gen24084" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24085"/>because the courses of water<l eID="gen24085" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24086"/>are dried up,<l eID="gen24086" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24087"/>and fire has devoured<l eID="gen24087" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24088"/>the pastures of the desert. <l eID="gen24088" level="2"/><lg eID="gen24005"/> <chapter eID="Joel.1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10076"/><title type="x-s">The Day of Yahweh is Near</title> <div sID="gen24089" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24089" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24090"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24091"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10076"/>Blow <transChange type="added">the</transChange> trumpet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “shofar”</note> in Zion,<l eID="gen24091" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24092"/>and sound the alarm on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “mountain of my holiness”</note><l eID="gen24092" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24093"/>Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble,<l eID="gen24093" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24094"/>for the day of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> coming<l eID="gen24094" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24095"/>—<transChange type="added">it is</transChange> indeed near. <l eID="gen24095" level="3"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10077"/><l level="1" sID="gen24096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10077"/>A day of darkness and gloom,<l eID="gen24096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24097"/>a day of cloud and thick darkness,<l eID="gen24097" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24098"/>like the dawn spreads on the mountains,<l eID="gen24098" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24099"/>a great and strong army!<l eID="gen24099" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24100"/>There has been nothing like it from old,<l eID="gen24100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24101"/>and after it nothing will be again <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for generations to come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “until years of generations”</note> <l eID="gen24101" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10078"/><l level="1" sID="gen24102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10078"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before the presence of it”</note> a fire devours,<l eID="gen24102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24103"/>and behind them a flame burns.<l eID="gen24103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24104"/>Like the garden of Eden is the land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “before the presence of it”</note><l eID="gen24104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24105"/>and after them <transChange type="added">it is like</transChange> a desolate desert,<l eID="gen24105" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24106"/>and nothing can escape them. <l eID="gen24106" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10079"/><l level="1" sID="gen24107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10079"/>Like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> appearance of horses is their appearance,<l eID="gen24107" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24108"/>and like horsemen they run; <l eID="gen24108" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10080"/><l level="1" sID="gen24109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10080"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap about;<l eID="gen24109" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24110"/>like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sound of a flame of fire<l eID="gen24110" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24111"/>devouring stubble;<l eID="gen24111" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24112"/>like a strong army arranged<l eID="gen24112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24113"/>in rows <transChange type="added">for</transChange> battle. <l eID="gen24113" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10081"/><l level="1" sID="gen24114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10081"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞From before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “From in front of it,” or “From the presence of it”</note> nations writhe,<l eID="gen24114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24115"/>all faces <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞turn pale⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “gather paleness”</note> <l eID="gen24115" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10082"/><l level="1" sID="gen24116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10082"/>They run like mighty warriors,<note placement="foot">That is, the “great and strong army” (see 2:2)</note><l eID="gen24116" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24117"/>they scale the wall like men of war;<l eID="gen24117" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24118"/>each goes on its own way,<l eID="gen24118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24119"/>and they do not swerve <transChange type="added">from</transChange> their paths. <l eID="gen24119" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10083"/><l level="1" sID="gen24120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10083"/>They do not jostle <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “each man his brother”</note><l eID="gen24120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24121"/>each goes on its own trail;<l eID="gen24121" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24122"/>and through the falling weapons,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “weapon”</note><l eID="gen24122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24123"/>they are not halted. <l eID="gen24123" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10084"/><l level="1" sID="gen24124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10084"/>In the city they rush forth;<l eID="gen24124" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24125"/>on the walls<note placement="foot">Hebrew “wall”</note> they run.<l eID="gen24125" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24126"/>Into the houses they climb up;<l eID="gen24126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24127"/>through the windows<l eID="gen24127" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24128"/>they enter like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> thief. <l eID="gen24128" level="3"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:10
