verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10085"/><l level="1" sID="gen24129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10085"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Before the presence of it”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth quakes;<l eID="gen24129" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24130"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens tremble;<l eID="gen24130" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24131"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> sun and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moon grow dark,<l eID="gen24131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24132"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stars <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have withheld⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gathered”</note> their splendor <l eID="gen24132" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10086"/><l level="1" sID="gen24133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10086"/>And Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞utters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gives”</note> his voice before his army,<l eID="gen24133" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24134"/>because his encampment <transChange type="added">is</transChange> very large;<l eID="gen24134" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24135"/>strong <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> one who carries out his decree,<l eID="gen24135" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24136"/>for great <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the day of Yahweh<l eID="gen24136" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24137"/>and exceedingly fearful.<l eID="gen24137" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24138"/>Who can endure it?<l eID="gen24138" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24090"/> <title type="x-s">A Call to Repentance</title> <div sID="gen24139" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24139" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10087"/><lg sID="gen24140"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10087"/>“And even now,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen24141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24142"/>“return to me with all your heart,<l eID="gen24142" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24143"/>with fasting, and weeping, and wailing.” <l eID="gen24143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10088"/><l level="2" sID="gen24144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10088"/>Rend your hearts<note placement="foot">Hebrew “heart”</note> and not your garments,<l eID="gen24144" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24145"/>and return to Yahweh your God,<l eID="gen24145" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24146"/>because he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> gracious and compassionate,<l eID="gen24146" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24147"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞slow to anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “patient”; literally “long of anger”</note> and great in loyal love,<l eID="gen24147" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24148"/>and relenting from harm. <l eID="gen24148" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10089"/><l level="1" sID="gen24149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10089"/>Who knows <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> he will turn and relent,<l eID="gen24149" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24150"/>and leave a blessing behind him,<l eID="gen24150" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24151"/>an offering and a libation,<l eID="gen24151" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24152"/>for Yahweh your God? <l eID="gen24152" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10090"/><l level="1" sID="gen24153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10090"/>Blow <transChange type="added">the</transChange> trumpet<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Shofar”</note> in Zion,<l eID="gen24153" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24154"/>sanctify a fast, call an assembly; <l eID="gen24154" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10091"/><l level="1" sID="gen24155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10091"/>gather <transChange type="added">the</transChange> people, consecrate <transChange type="added">the</transChange> assembly;<l eID="gen24155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24156"/>assemble <transChange type="added">the</transChange> elders, gather <transChange type="added">the</transChange> children,<l eID="gen24156" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24157"/>even those <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> breast-feeding;<l eID="gen24157" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24158"/>let <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bridegroom come out from his private room,<l eID="gen24158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24159"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bride from her canopy. <l eID="gen24159" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10092"/><l level="1" sID="gen24160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10092"/>Between the colonnade and the altar,<l eID="gen24160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24161"/>let the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, weep.<l eID="gen24161" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24162"/>And let them say, “Take pity, Yahweh, on your people.<l eID="gen24162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24163"/>Do not make your inheritance a reproach,<l eID="gen24163" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24164"/>a byword among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> nations.<l eID="gen24164" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24165"/>Why should they say among the nations,<l eID="gen24165" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24166"/>‘Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their God?’ ”<l eID="gen24166" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24140"/> <title type="x-s">The Response and Promise of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen24167" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24167" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10093"/><lg sID="gen24168"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10093"/>Then Yahweh became jealous for his land<l eID="gen24169" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24170"/>and took pity on his people. <l eID="gen24170" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10094"/><l level="1" sID="gen24171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10094"/>And Yahweh answered and said to his people,<l eID="gen24171" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24172"/>“Look at me, <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> sending to you<l eID="gen24172" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24173"/>grain, new wine, and olive oil,<l eID="gen24173" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24174"/>and you will be satisfied by it.<l eID="gen24174" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24175"/>I will not give you <transChange type="added">over</transChange> any more<l eID="gen24175" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24176"/>as a disgrace among the nations. <l eID="gen24176" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10095"/><l level="1" sID="gen24177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10095"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The northerners⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “The northern army”</note><l eID="gen24177" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24178"/>I will remove from you;<l eID="gen24178" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24179"/>I will drive them to a desert<l eID="gen24179" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24180"/>and desolate land,<l eID="gen24180" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24181"/>its<note placement="foot">That is, the northern army</note> front to the eastern sea,<l eID="gen24181" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24182"/>and its rear into the western sea;<l eID="gen24182" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24183"/>its stench and odor will rise up<l eID="gen24183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24184"/>because he<note placement="foot">That is, Yahweh (see v. <reference osisRef="Joel.2.21">21</reference>)</note> has done great things. <l eID="gen24184" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10096"/><l level="1" sID="gen24185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10096"/>Do not fear, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> land,<l eID="gen24185" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24186"/>rejoice and be glad,<l eID="gen24186" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24187"/>because Yahweh has done great things. <l eID="gen24187" level="3"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10097"/><l level="1" sID="gen24188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10097"/>Do not fear, wild animals of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> field,<l eID="gen24188" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24189"/>because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pastures of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert have put forth new green shoots,<l eID="gen24189" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24190"/>because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tree has produced its fruit,<l eID="gen24190" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24191"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> fig tree and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> vine<l eID="gen24191" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24192"/>have yielded their produce. <l eID="gen24192" level="3"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10098"/><l level="1" sID="gen24193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10098"/>Be glad, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> children of Zion,<l eID="gen24193" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24194"/>be glad and rejoice in Yahweh your God,<l eID="gen24194" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24195"/>because he has given for you<l eID="gen24195" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24196"/>the autumn rains for <transChange type="added">your</transChange> righteousness,<note placement="foot">Or “vindication”</note><l eID="gen24196" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24197"/>and he has <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞poured down⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “brought down”</note> for you rainwater,<l eID="gen24197" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24198"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> autumn and spring rains, as before. <l eID="gen24198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10099"/><l level="1" sID="gen24199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10099"/>The threshing floors will be full <transChange type="added">with</transChange> grain,<l eID="gen24199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24200"/>and the vats will overflow<l eID="gen24200" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24201"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> new wine and olive oil. <l eID="gen24201" level="3"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10100"/><l level="1" sID="gen24202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10100"/>I will repay you the years<l eID="gen24202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24203"/>that the locust has eaten,<l eID="gen24203" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24204"/>the hopper, the destroyer, and the cutter,<l eID="gen24204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24205"/>my mighty troops that I sent against you. <l eID="gen24205" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10101"/><l level="1" sID="gen24206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10101"/>And you will eat abundantly and be satisfied,<l eID="gen24206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24207"/>and praise the name of Yahweh your God,<l eID="gen24207" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24208"/>who has dealt with you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞wondrously⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to do a wonder”</note><l eID="gen24208" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24209"/>My people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will never be ashamed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “will forever not be ashamed”</note> <l eID="gen24209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10102"/><l level="1" sID="gen24210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10102"/>And you will know that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> in the midst of Israel,<l eID="gen24210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24211"/>and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh,<l eID="gen24211" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24212"/>your God, and there is no <transChange type="added">other</transChange>.<l eID="gen24212" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24213"/>My people <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will never be ashamed again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “will forever no longer be ashamed”</note><l eID="gen24213" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen24168"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Spirit Poured Out</title> <div sID="gen24214" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24214" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10103"/><lg sID="gen24215"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10103"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Joel.2.28-Joel.2.32">Joel 2:28–32 </reference>in the English Bible is 3:1–5 in the Hebrew Bible</note> And it will happen afterward thus:<l eID="gen24216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24217"/>I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh,<l eID="gen24217" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24218"/>and your sons and your daughters will prophesy,<l eID="gen24218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24219"/>and your elders will dream dreams;<l eID="gen24219" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24220"/>your young men shall see visions. <l eID="gen24220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10104"/><l level="1" sID="gen24221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10104"/>And also on the male slaves and on the female slaves,<l eID="gen24221" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24222"/>I will pour out my Spirit in those days. <l eID="gen24222" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24215"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10105"/><div sID="gen24223" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10105"/>And I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞set⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “give”</note> wonders in the heavens, and on earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke.

verses.name: Joel 2:31
verses.text: The sun will be changed to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the coming of the great and awesome day of Yahweh.

verses.name: Joel 2:32
verses.text: And it will happen—everyone who calls on the name of Yahweh will be rescued, because on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who escape⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally, “an escape”</note> as Yahweh said, and among the survivors whom Yahweh is calling.  <chapter eID="Joel.2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10106"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Judgment on the Nations</title> <div sID="gen24224" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10106"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Joel.3.1-Joel.3.21">Joel 3:1–21 </reference>in the English Bible is 4:1–21 in the Hebrew Bible</note> For look! In those days, and in that time, when I will return<note placement="foot">Or “restore”</note> the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

verses.name: Joel 3:2
verses.text: I will gather all the nations, and I will bring them down to the valley of Jehoshaphat, and I will argue <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a case against them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a matter with them”</note> there concerning my people and my inheritance Israel whom they have scattered among the nations, and my land <transChange type="added">that</transChange> they have divided.

verses.name: Joel 3:3
verses.text: For my people they cast lots,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “lot”</note> and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they traded⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gave”</note> the male child for the prostitute, and the female child they sold for wine and they drank <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.  <div eID="gen24224" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10107"/><div sID="gen24225" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10107"/>What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you to me, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Tyre and <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Sidon, and all of the regions of Philistia? Are you repaying to me what is deserved? If you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> recompensing me, I will return swiftly <transChange type="added">and</transChange> quickly what you deserve on your head!

verses.name: Joel 3:5
verses.text: For you have taken my silver and my gold, and my beautiful treasures you have carried into your temples.

verses.name: Joel 3:6
verses.text: And the sons of Judah and Jerusalem you sold to the sons of the Greeks, in order to remove them from their border.

verses.name: Joel 3:7
verses.text: Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> rousing them from the place where you have sold them, and I will return what you deserve on your head!

verses.name: Joel 3:8
verses.text: I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they will sell them to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Sabeans and to a nation far <transChange type="added">away</transChange>, for Yahweh has spoken. <div eID="gen24225" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Judgment in the Valley of Jehoshaphat</title> <div sID="gen24226" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24226" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10108"/><lg sID="gen24227"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10108"/>Proclaim this among the nations:<l eID="gen24228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24229"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Prepare for war⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “Sanctify a battle”</note><l eID="gen24229" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24230"/>Stir up the mighty warriors;<l eID="gen24230" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24231"/>let them approach and come up;<l eID="gen24231" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24232"/><transChange type="added">let</transChange> all the men of war approach. <l eID="gen24232" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10109"/><l level="1" sID="gen24233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10109"/>Beat your cutting tools of iron into swords<l eID="gen24233" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24234"/>and your pruning hooks into spears;<l eID="gen24234" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24235"/>let the weakling say, ‘I am a mighty warrior!’ <l eID="gen24235" level="3"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10110"/><l level="1" sID="gen24236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10110"/>Hurry and come,<l eID="gen24236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24237"/>all the nations, from all around,<l eID="gen24237" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24238"/>and gather <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange> there.<l eID="gen24238" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24239"/>Bring down your mighty warriors, O Yahweh! <l eID="gen24239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10111"/><l level="1" sID="gen24240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10111"/>Let the nations be roused and let them come up<l eID="gen24240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24241"/>to the valley of Jehoshaphat,<l eID="gen24241" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24242"/>for there I will sit to judge<l eID="gen24242" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24243"/>all the nations from all around. <l eID="gen24243" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10112"/><l level="1" sID="gen24244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10112"/>Send forth <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sickle,<l eID="gen24244" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24245"/>for the harvest is ripe!<l eID="gen24245" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24246"/>Go tread,<l eID="gen24246" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24247"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> winepress is full!<l eID="gen24247" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24248"/>The vats overflow,<l eID="gen24248" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24249"/>because their evil <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great! <l eID="gen24249" level="3"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10113"/><l level="1" sID="gen24250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10113"/>Commotion, commotion<l eID="gen24250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24251"/>in the valley of decision!<l eID="gen24251" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24252"/>For the day of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near<l eID="gen24252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24253"/>in the valley of decision! <l eID="gen24253" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10114"/><l level="1" sID="gen24254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10114"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> sun and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> moon grow dark,<l eID="gen24254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24255"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stars <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have withheld⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gathered”</note> their splendor. <l eID="gen24255" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10115"/><l level="1" sID="gen24256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10115"/>And Yahweh roars from Zion;<l eID="gen24256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24257"/>from Jerusalem he utters his voice,<l eID="gen24257" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24258"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth shake.<l eID="gen24258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24259"/>But Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a refuge for his people,<l eID="gen24259" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24260"/>and a protection for the children of Israel. <l eID="gen24260" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10116"/><l level="1" sID="gen24261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10116"/>And you will know that I, Yahweh your God,<l eID="gen24261" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24262"/><transChange type="added">am</transChange> dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain.<l eID="gen24262" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24263"/>And Jerusalem will be <transChange type="added">a place of</transChange> holiness,<l eID="gen24263" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24264"/>and strangers will pass through <transChange type="added">it</transChange> no longer. <l eID="gen24264" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10117"/><l level="1" sID="gen24265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10117"/>And it will happen on that day;<l eID="gen24265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24266"/>the mountains will drip new wine,<l eID="gen24266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24267"/>and the hills will flow with milk,<l eID="gen24267" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24268"/>and all the channels of Judah will flow with water.<l eID="gen24268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24269"/>A spring from the house of Yahweh will come forth,<l eID="gen24269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24270"/>and it will water the valley of Acacia Trees.<note placement="foot">Or “the wadi Shittim”</note> <l eID="gen24270" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10118"/><l level="1" sID="gen24271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10118"/>Egypt will become a desolation,<l eID="gen24271" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24272"/>and Edom will become a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞desolate desert⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “desert of desolation”</note><l eID="gen24272" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24273"/>because of the violence <transChange type="added">they did</transChange> against the children of Judah,<l eID="gen24273" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24274"/>in whose land they have shed innocent blood. <l eID="gen24274" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10119"/><l level="1" sID="gen24275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10119"/>But Judah will be inhabited forever,<l eID="gen24275" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24276"/>and Jerusalem <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for all generations⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Or “for each generation”</note> <l eID="gen24276" level="2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10120"/><l level="1" sID="gen24277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10120"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will cleanse their bloodguilt⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will not leave unpunished their blood”</note> that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I did not cleanse⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Or “I did not consider innocent”</note><l eID="gen24277" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24278"/>for Yahweh is dwelling in Zion. <l eID="gen24278" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24227"/> <chapter eID="Joel.3"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen24002" osisID="Joel" type="book"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10121"/><title type="x-s">Introduction</title> <div sID="gen24280" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10121"/>The words of Amos, who was among the shepherds from Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah the king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Jehoash, two years <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the earthquake.  <div eID="gen24280" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10122"/><title type="x-s">Judgment on Israel’s Neighbors</title> <div sID="gen24281" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10122"/>And he said, “Yahweh roars from Zion and he utters his voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds wither and the top of Carmel dries up.”

verses.name: Amos 1:3
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh, “For three transgressions of Damascus and for four I will not revoke <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> because they threshed Gilead with threshing sledges of iron!

verses.name: Amos 1:4
verses.text: So I will send fire against Hazael’s house and it will consume the citadel fortresses of Ben-Hadad.

verses.name: Amos 1:5
verses.text: I will break the gate bars of Damascus and I will cut off the inhabitants from the Valley of Aven and the one who takes hold of the scepter of Beth Eden, and the people of Aram will go into exile to Kir,” says Yahweh.  <div eID="gen24281" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10123"/><div sID="gen24282" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10123"/>Thus says Yahweh: “For three transgressions of Gaza and for four I will not revoke <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> because they exiled a whole community, handing them over to Edom!

verses.name: Amos 1:7
verses.text: So I will send a fire against the wall of Gaza and it will devour its citadel fortresses.

verses.name: Amos 1:8
verses.text: And I will cut off the inhabitants from Ashdod and the one who takes hold of the scepter of Ashkelon. I will also turn my hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord Yahweh.  <div eID="gen24282" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10124"/><div sID="gen24283" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10124"/>Thus says Yahweh: “For three transgressions of Tyre and for four I will not revoke <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> because they delivered up a whole community to Edom and they did not remember the covenant of brotherhood!

verses.name: Amos 1:10
verses.text: So I will send a fire against the wall of Tyre and it will devour its citadel fortresses.”  <div eID="gen24283" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10125"/><div sID="gen24284" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10125"/>Thus says Yahweh: “For three transgressions of Edom and for four I will not revoke <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> because he pursued his brother with the sword! He stifled his compassion and his anger tore them apart <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continually⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “forever”</note> and he kept his rage forever.

verses.name: Amos 1:12
verses.text: So I will send a fire against Teman and it will devour the citadel fortresses of Bozrah.”  <div eID="gen24284" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10126"/><div sID="gen24285" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10126"/>Thus says Yahweh: “For three transgressions of Ammon and for four I will not revoke <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to enlarge their territory!

verses.name: Amos 1:14
verses.text: So I will kindle a fire against the wall of Rabbah and it will devour its citadel fortresses with a war cry on the day of battle, with a storm on the day of the violent tempest.

verses.name: Amos 1:15
verses.text: And their king will go into exile, he and his commanders together,” says Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Amos.1"/> <div eID="gen24285" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:1
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: “For three transgressions of Moab and for four I will not revoke <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> because he burned to lime the bones of the king of Edom.

verses.name: Amos 2:2
verses.text: So I will send a fire against Moab and it will devour the citadel fortresses of Kerioth, and Moab will die amid uproar, amid war cries <transChange type="added">and</transChange> amid the sound of a horn.

verses.name: Amos 2:3
verses.text: And I will cut off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ruler from its midst and I will kill all of its officials with him,” says Yahweh.  <div eID="gen24286" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10127"/><title type="x-s">Judgment on Judah</title> <div sID="gen24287" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10127"/>Thus says Yahweh: “For three transgressions of Judah and for four I will not revoke <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> because they have rejected the law of Yahweh and have not kept his rules, and their lies have led them astray, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞after which their ancestors walked⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “which their ancestors walked after them”</note>

verses.name: Amos 2:5
verses.text: So I will send a fire against Judah and it will devour the citadel fortresses of Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen24287" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10128"/><title type="x-s">Judgment on Israel</title> <div sID="gen24288" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10128"/>Thus says Yahweh: “For three transgressions of Israel and for four I will not revoke <transChange type="added">the punishment</transChange>,<note placement="foot">Or “it”</note> because they sell the righteous for money and the poor for a pair of sandals!

verses.name: Amos 2:7
verses.text: Those who trample the heads of the powerless into the dust of the ground and turn aside the way of the destitute, a man and his father <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have sexual relations with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “go to”</note> the same girl, so that <transChange type="added">they</transChange> profane my holy name.

verses.name: Amos 2:8
verses.text: They stretch themselves out beside every altar on clothing taken in pledge and they drink wine, bought with fines imposed,<note placement="foot">Literally “imposing a fine”</note> in the house of their God.

verses.name: Amos 2:9
verses.text: Yet I destroyed the Amorite <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of them”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who was as tall as⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “whose height was as the height of”</note> cedars and was as strong as the oaks. I destroyed his fruit above and his roots beneath.

verses.name: Amos 2:10
verses.text: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and I led you in the wilderness forty years to take possession of the land of the Amorite.

verses.name: Amos 2:11
verses.text: And I raised up some <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your sons to <transChange type="added">be</transChange> prophets and some <transChange type="added">of</transChange> your young men to <transChange type="added">be</transChange> Nazirites. Is it not so, O <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “children”</note> of Israel? <transChange type="added">This is</transChange> the declaration of Yahweh!

verses.name: Amos 2:12
verses.text: But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy.’

verses.name: Amos 2:13
verses.text: Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to press <transChange type="added">you</transChange> down in your place just as a utility cart full of mature stalks of grain <transChange type="added">is pressed down</transChange>.

verses.name: Amos 2:14
verses.text: Flight will perish from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> swift and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> strong person will not muster his strength and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> warrior will not save his life.

verses.name: Amos 2:15
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who takes hold of the bow will not stand and <transChange type="added">the one who is</transChange> swift on his feet will not save himself, nor will <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who rides the horse save his life.

verses.name: Amos 2:16
verses.text: Even those who are strong of heart among the mighty will flee away naked from the city on that day. <transChange type="added">This is</transChange> the declaration of Yahweh!”  <chapter eID="Amos.2"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10129"/><title type="x-s">Israel’s Guilt and Punishment</title> <div sID="gen24289" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10129"/>Hear this word that Yahweh has spoken against you, O people of Israel, against the whole clan that I brought up from the land of Egypt:<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Egypt, saying”</note>

verses.name: Amos 3:2
verses.text: “You only have I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞chosen⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “known”</note> of all the clans of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.

verses.name: Amos 3:3
verses.text: Do two walk together unless they have met?

verses.name: Amos 3:4
verses.text: Does a lion roar in the forest <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he has no prey⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “and there is no prey to him”</note> Does a fierce, young lion cry out from his den unless he has caught <transChange type="added">something</transChange>?

verses.name: Amos 3:5
verses.text: Does a bird fall into a trapping net on the earth when there is no snare for it? Does a trapping net spring up from the ground unless it has certainly caught something?

verses.name: Amos 3:6
verses.text: Or is a horn blown in a city and people are not afraid? Or does a disaster occur in the city and Yahweh has not done <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?

verses.name: Amos 3:7
verses.text: Surely my Lord does not do anything unless he has revealed his secret to his servants the prophets.

verses.name: Amos 3:8
verses.text: A lion has roared! Who is not afraid? My Lord Yahweh has spoken, who will not prophesy?

verses.name: Amos 3:9
verses.text: Proclaim to the citadel fortresses in Ashdod and the citadel fortresses in the land of Egypt and say: “Gather on the mountains of Samaria and see the great panic in her midst and the oppression in her midst!”

verses.name: Amos 3:10
verses.text: “They do not know <transChange type="added">how</transChange> to do right,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the declaration of Yahweh”</note> “those who store up violence and destruction in their citadel fortresses.”

verses.name: Amos 3:11
verses.text: Therefore, thus says my Lord Yahweh, “A foe shall surround the land and bring down your strongholds, and your citadel fortresses shall be plundered.”

verses.name: Amos 3:12
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh, “Just as the shepherd rescues two legs or a piece of an ear from the mouth of the lion, so shall the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “children”</note> of Israel who dwell in Samaria, with the corner of a couch and the damask of a bed.”

verses.name: Amos 3:13
verses.text: “Listen and testify against the house of Jacob,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> my Lord Yahweh, the God of hosts.

verses.name: Amos 3:14
verses.text: “For on the day I punish Israel for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its transgression⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the transgression of Israel upon it”</note> I will also punish the altars of Bethel and the horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.

verses.name: Amos 3:15
verses.text: I will ruin the winter house as well as the summer house, and the houses of ivory will perish and the great houses shall come to an end,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Amos.3"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10130"/><title type="x-s">Social and Spiritual Corruption</title> <div sID="gen24290" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10130"/>Hear this word, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> cows of Bashan who <transChange type="added">live</transChange> on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the powerless, who crush the poor, who say to their husbands, “Bring <transChange type="added">something</transChange> so that we may drink!”

verses.name: Amos 4:2
verses.text: My Lord Yahweh has sworn by his holiness that, “Behold, the days are coming upon you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when they⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and he”</note> will take you away with hooks, even the last of you with fishing hooks.

verses.name: Amos 4:3
verses.text: And you shall leave through breaches <transChange type="added">in the wall</transChange>, each one in front of her. You will be dragged off toward Harmon,”<note placement="foot">The meaning of this Hebrew word is uncertain</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 4:4
verses.text: “Come <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Bethel and transgress; <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Gilgal and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞multiply transgression⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “increase to transgress”</note> Bring your sacrifices in the morning and your tithes on the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞third day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for three of days”</note>

verses.name: Amos 4:5
verses.text: And bring a thank offering of unleavened bread, and proclaim freewill offerings, pronounce them, for so you love <transChange type="added">to do</transChange>, O <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “children”</note> of Israel,” <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the declaration of my Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 4:6
verses.text: “And I<note placement="foot">Emphatic use of personal pronoun</note> in turn gave you cleanness of teeth in all your cities and lack of bread in all your places. Yet you did not return to me,” <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the declaration of Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 4:7
verses.text: “And I also withheld the rain from you when <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> still three months to the harvest. And I would send rain on one city and send no rain on another city. One tract of land will be rained on, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tract of land <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on which it does not rain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which does not rain down on it”</note> will dry up.

verses.name: Amos 4:8
verses.text: So two <transChange type="added">or</transChange> three cities wandered to one city to drink water and they were not satisfied, yet you did not return to me,” <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the declaration of Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 4:9
verses.text: “I struck you with blight and with mildew. Frequently the cutting locust devoured your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees, yet you did not return to me,” <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the declaration of Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 4:10
verses.text: “I sent among you a plague in the manner of Egypt; I killed your young men with the sword, along with the captivity of your horses. And I made the stench of your camps go up into your nostrils, yet you did not return to me,” <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the declaration of Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 4:11
verses.text: “I overthrew some of you as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were as a stick snatched from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fire, and yet you did not return to me,” <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the declaration of Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 4:12
verses.text: “Therefore, thus I will do to you, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Israel. Because I will do this to you, O Israel, prepare to meet your God!

verses.name: Amos 4:13
verses.text: Yes, here is the one who forms <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains, and the one who creates the wind, and the one who reveals to humans what his thoughts <transChange type="added">are</transChange>, and the one who treads on the heights of the earth; Yahweh, the God of hosts, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name!”  <chapter eID="Amos.4"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10131"/><title type="x-s">A Lament and Call to Repentance</title> <div sID="gen24291" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10131"/>Hear this word that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to intone over you <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a lament, O house of Israel!

verses.name: Amos 5:2
verses.text: Virgin Israel has fallen and will not rise again. She is deserted on her land; there is no one to raise her up.

verses.name: Amos 5:3
verses.text: For thus says my Lord Yahweh, “The city that marches out <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a thousand will <transChange type="added">only</transChange> have a hundred left. And the one that marches out <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a hundred will <transChange type="added">only</transChange> have ten left for the house of Israel.”

verses.name: Amos 5:4
verses.text: For thus says Yahweh to the house of Israel, “Seek me so that you may live.”

verses.name: Amos 5:5
verses.text: But do not seek Bethel or go <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Gilgal or cross over to Beersheba, for Gilgal will certainly go into exile and Bethel will come to disaster.”

verses.name: Amos 5:6
verses.text: Seek Yahweh so that you may live, so that he will not break out like a fire <transChange type="added">against</transChange> the house of Joseph! And it will devour, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with none to quench⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and there is not one to quench”</note> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> for Bethel.

verses.name: Amos 5:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Ah,</transChange> you who turn justice into wormwood and hurl righteousness to the ground!

verses.name: Amos 5:8
verses.text: The one who made the Pleiades and Orion and who turns deep darkness into the morning and darkens day <transChange type="added">into</transChange> night, the one who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out on the surface of the earth, Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name!

verses.name: Amos 5:9
verses.text: The one who makes destruction flash upon <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fierce, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> destruction comes upon <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fortification.

verses.name: Amos 5:10
verses.text: They hate the one who reproves in the gate and they abhor the one who speaks honestly.

verses.name: Amos 5:11
verses.text: Therefore, because you trample on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor and you take a grain tax from them, you built houses of dressed stone, but you will not live in them. You built vineyards of delightfulness, but you will not drink their wine.

verses.name: Amos 5:12
verses.text: For I know your transgressions <transChange type="added">are</transChange> many and your sins <transChange type="added">are</transChange> numerous, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> foes of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous, those who take a bribe, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞those who⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “they”</note> push aside <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> in the gate!

verses.name: Amos 5:13
verses.text: Therefore, whoever has insight will keep silent in that time, for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a time of evil.

verses.name: Amos 5:14
verses.text: Seek good and not bad in order that you may live, and so Yahweh, the God of hosts, will be with you, as you have said.

verses.name: Amos 5:15
verses.text: Hate evil and love good and establish justice in the gate; perhaps Yahweh, the God of hosts, will be gracious <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the remnant of Joseph.

verses.name: Amos 5:16
verses.text: Therefore, thus says Yahweh, the God of hosts, my Lord, “In all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the public squares <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> wailing, and in all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> the streets <transChange type="added">they will say</transChange>, ‘Alas, alas, alas!’ They shall call <transChange type="added">the</transChange> farmers to mourning and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> wailing, to those who are skilled <transChange type="added">in</transChange> lamentation.

verses.name: Amos 5:17
verses.text: And in all <transChange type="added">of the</transChange> vineyards <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> wailing, because I will pass in your midst,” says Yahweh.  <div eID="gen24291" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10132"/><title type="x-s">The Day of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen24292" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10132"/>Alas, those who desire the day of Yahweh, why <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this for you the day of Yahweh? It <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> darkness and not light!

verses.name: Amos 5:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It will be</transChange> as <transChange type="added">if</transChange> a man fled from a lion and a bear met him; or he went <transChange type="added">into</transChange> the house and leaned his hand against the wall and a snake bit him.

verses.name: Amos 5:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not the day of Yahweh darkness and not light, and pitch dark with no brightness in it?

verses.name: Amos 5:21
verses.text: “I hate, I despise your festivals, and I take no delight in your assemblies.

verses.name: Amos 5:22
verses.text: Yes, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> if you offer me your burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, and I will not look at the fellowship offerings of your fattened animals.

verses.name: Amos 5:23
verses.text: Remove from me the noise of your songs, and I do not want to hear the melody of your harps!

verses.name: Amos 5:24
verses.text: But let justice roll on like the water, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.

verses.name: Amos 5:25
verses.text: Did you bring to me sacrifices and offering<transChange type="added">s</transChange> those forty years in the desert, O house of Israel?

verses.name: Amos 5:26
verses.text: And you will take up Sikkuth, your king, and Kaiwan, your images, the star of your gods which you made for yourselves.

verses.name: Amos 5:27
verses.text: And I will deport you beyond Damascus,” says Yahweh—the God of hosts <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his name.  <chapter eID="Amos.5"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10133"/><title type="x-s">Woe to the Complacent</title> <div sID="gen24293" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10133"/>Alas <transChange type="added">for</transChange> those being at ease in Zion, and those who feel secure on Mount Samaria, the notables of the best of the nations! The house of Israel resorts to them.

verses.name: Amos 6:2
verses.text: Cross over <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Calneh and see, and go from there <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Hamath Rabbah and go down <transChange type="added">to</transChange> Gath of the Philistines. <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> you better than these kingdoms, or is their territory greater than your territory?

verses.name: Amos 6:3
verses.text: You that put off the day of disaster and bring near a reign of violence!

verses.name: Amos 6:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Alas for</transChange> those who lie on beds of ivory and lounge on their couches, and those eating young rams from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sheep and goats, and bull-calves from the middle of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> animal stall.

verses.name: Amos 6:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Alas for those</transChange> who sing to the tune of the harp; like David they improvise on instruments of music.

verses.name: Amos 6:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Alas for those</transChange> who drink from sprinkling bowls of wine and anoint themselves with the best of olive oils and are not grieved over the ruin of Joseph.

verses.name: Amos 6:7
verses.text: Therefore, they shall now go into exile at the head of the exiles and the feast of lounging shall pass away.  <div eID="gen24293" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10134"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Abhors Israel’s Pride</title> <div sID="gen24294" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10134"/>My Lord Yahweh has sworn by himself, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, the God of hosts: “I abhor the pride of Jacob and I hate his citadel fortresses and I will deliver <transChange type="added">the</transChange> city and its fullness!”

verses.name: Amos 6:9
verses.text: And then if ten people remain in one house, they too will die.

verses.name: Amos 6:10
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">if</transChange> one’s relative, who burns <transChange type="added">the body</transChange>, lifts it up and brings the body out of the house and he will say to someone in the innermost part of the house, “<transChange type="added">Are there</transChange> any more with you?” and he will say, “None,” then he will say, “Silence,” because <transChange type="added">we</transChange> must not invoke the name of Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 6:11
verses.text: Look, Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> going to command and the great house will be destroyed <transChange type="added">to</transChange> bits and the little house <transChange type="added">to</transChange> pieces.

verses.name: Amos 6:12
verses.text: Do horses run on rocks, or does one plow the sea with oxen?<note placement="foot">Or “does one plow them with oxen”</note> But you have turned justice into poison and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fruit of righteousness into wormwood!

verses.name: Amos 6:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">You</transChange> who rejoice over Lo-Debar, who say, “Have we not taken Karnaim for ourselves by our strength?”

verses.name: Amos 6:14
verses.text: Indeed, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, the God of hosts. And they shall oppress you from Lebo-hamath up to the wadi of the Arabah.  <chapter eID="Amos.6"/>

verses.name: Amos 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10135"/><title type="x-s">Warning Visions</title> <div sID="gen24295" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10135"/>This is what my Lord Yahweh showed me, and look, <transChange type="added">he</transChange> is going to form locusts at the beginning of the sprouting of the second crop, and look, after the mowings of the king.

verses.name: Amos 7:2
verses.text: And then when they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he/it”</note> finished eating the vegetation of the land, I said, “O Lord Yahweh, please forgive! How can Jacob stand, because he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> small?”

verses.name: Amos 7:3
verses.text: Yahweh relented concerning this. “It will not be,” said Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 7:4
verses.text: This is what my Lord Yahweh showed me, and look, my Lord Yahweh was going to call for a legal case with fire, and it devoured the great deep and it ate up the plots of ground.

verses.name: Amos 7:5
verses.text: Then I said, “<transChange type="added">O</transChange> Lord Yahweh, please stop! How can Jacob stand, because he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> small?”

verses.name: Amos 7:6
verses.text: Yahweh also relented concerning this. “This also will not be,” said my Lord Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 7:7
verses.text: This is what he showed me: Behold, my Lord <transChange type="added">was</transChange> standing beside a wall <transChange type="added">built with</transChange> a plummet, and a plummet <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in his hand.

verses.name: Amos 7:8
verses.text: And Yahweh said to me, “What do you see?” And I said, “A plummet.” And my Lord said, “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to set a plummet in the midst of my people, Israel. I will not pass them by again.

verses.name: Amos 7:9
verses.text: The high places of Isaac shall become desolate and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste. And I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”  <div eID="gen24295" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10136"/><title type="x-s">Amaziah’s Opposition</title> <div sID="gen24296" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10136"/>Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam the king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel. The land is not able to endure all of his words.

verses.name: Amos 7:11
verses.text: For this Amos has said, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword and Israel will certainly go into exile <transChange type="added">away</transChange> from his land.’ ”

verses.name: Amos 7:12
verses.text: And Amaziah said to Amos, “<transChange type="added">O</transChange> seer, go, flee to the land of Judah and earn food there and prophesy there!”

verses.name: Amos 7:13
verses.text: But do not prophesy again at Bethel, because this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a sanctuary of a king and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a temple of a kingdom.”

verses.name: Amos 7:14
verses.text: And Amos answered and said to Amaziah, “I am not a prophet and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> not a son of a prophet, but I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a herdsman and I am one taking care of sycamore trees.

verses.name: Amos 7:15
verses.text: And Yahweh took me from <transChange type="added">following</transChange> behind the sheep and goats and Yahweh said to me, “Go, prophesy to my people Israel!

verses.name: Amos 7:16
verses.text: And so then, hear the word of Yahweh! You are saying, ‘You must not prophesy against Israel and you must not preach against the house of Isaac!’

verses.name: Amos 7:17
verses.text: Therefore, thus says Yahweh, ‘Your wife will become a prostitute in the city and your sons and your daughters will fall by the sword and your land will be divided with a line, and you<note placement="foot">Emphatic second person pronoun</note> will die in an unclean land and Israel will surely go into exile from this land.’ ”  <chapter eID="Amos.7"/>

verses.name: Amos 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10137"/><title type="x-s">A Basket of Ripe Fruit</title> <div sID="gen24297" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10137"/>My Lord Yahweh showed me this, and there was a basket of summer fruit.

verses.name: Amos 8:2
verses.text: And he said, “What do you see, Amos?” And I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” And Yahweh said to me, “The end has come upon my people Israel. I will not pass by them again!”

verses.name: Amos 8:3
verses.text: “And the songs of the temple shall become wailings in that day,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> my Lord Yahweh. “The corpses are numerous; he throws them in every place. Be quiet!”

verses.name: Amos 8:4
verses.text: Hear this, those who trample on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor and who annihilate the afflicted of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land,

verses.name: Amos 8:5
verses.text: saying, “When will the new moon be over, so that we can sell grain? And the Sabbath, so that we can open the grain bins, that we can make <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ephah small and make <transChange type="added">the</transChange> shekel large, and can practice deceit <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a set of scales of deceit?

verses.name: Amos 8:6
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞That we can⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to buy”</note> buy <transChange type="added">the</transChange> powerless with silver and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> poor for the sake of a pair of sandals, and we can sell the waste of the grain?”

verses.name: Amos 8:7
verses.text: Yahweh has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Surely I will never forget any of their deeds!

verses.name: Amos 8:8
verses.text: On account of this, will not the land tremble and will not every living <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> in it mourn? And all of it will rise like the Nile and it will be tossed about and subside like the Nile of Egypt.

verses.name: Amos 8:9
verses.text: And then in that day,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> my Lord Yahweh, “I<note placement="foot">Literally “and I”</note> will make the sun go down at noon and I will darken the land on a day of light.

verses.name: Amos 8:10
verses.text: And I will turn your feasts into mourning and all of your songs into lament, and I will put sackcloth on all loins and baldness on every head. And I will make it like the mourning for an only child, and its end like a bitter day.

verses.name: Amos 8:11
verses.text: Look, the days are coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> my Lord Yahweh, “when I will send a famine in the land, not a famine for bread and not a thirst for water, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of hearing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “but if to hear”</note> the words of Yahweh!

verses.name: Amos 8:12
verses.text: And they will wander from sea to sea and from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north and to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> east. They will roam about to seek the word of Yahweh, but they will not find <transChange type="added">it</transChange>!

verses.name: Amos 8:13
verses.text: In that day the beautiful young women and the young men will faint because of thirst.

verses.name: Amos 8:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">These are</transChange> those who swear by the guilt of Samaria and say, ‘By the life of your gods, O Dan,’ and ‘By the life of the way of Beersheba,’ they will fall and they will not rise again.”  <chapter eID="Amos.8"/>

verses.name: Amos 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10138"/><title type="x-s">Destruction of Israel</title> <div sID="gen24298" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10138"/>I saw my Lord standing by the altar and he said, “Strike the capitals so that the thresholds will shake, and shatter them on the head of all of them, and I will kill the rest of them with the sword. A fugitive belonging to them will not run away, and a survivor belonging to them will not escape.

verses.name: Amos 9:2
verses.text: If they dig into Sheol, from there my hand will take them, and <transChange type="added">even</transChange> if they climb up <transChange type="added">to</transChange> heaven, from there I will bring them down.

verses.name: Amos 9:3
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">even</transChange> if they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, from there I will search and will take them, and <transChange type="added">even</transChange> if they hide from before my eyes at the bottom of the sea, from there I will command the sea serpent and it will bite them.

verses.name: Amos 9:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">even</transChange> if they go into captivity before their enemies, from there I will command the sword and it will kill them, and I will fix my eyes on them for harm and not for good.”

verses.name: Amos 9:5
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">thus will do</transChange> the Lord Yahweh of hosts, who touches the earth and it melts, and all of those living in it mourn, and all of it rises like the Nile and it sinks down like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Nile of Egypt,

verses.name: Amos 9:6
verses.text: who builds his upper chambers in the heavens and lays the foundation of his vault on the earth, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them on the surface of the earth—Yahweh is his name.

verses.name: Amos 9:7
verses.text: “Are you not like the Cushites to me, O people of Israel?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. “Did I not bring up Israel from the land of Egypt and the Philistines from Caphtor and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Arameans⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Aram”</note> from Kir?

verses.name: Amos 9:8
verses.text: Look, the eyes of my Lord Yahweh <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on the kingdom of sin, and I will destroy it from the surface of the earth. However, I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Amos 9:9
verses.text: “Yes, look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to command and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations like one who shakes with a sieve, but not a pebble will fall <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> ground.

verses.name: Amos 9:10
verses.text: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, ‘Evil will not overtake or confront us.’  <div eID="gen24298" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10139"/><title type="x-s">Restoration of Israel</title> <div sID="gen24299" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10139"/>On that day I will raise up the booth of David that is fallen, and I will repair its breaches and will raise up its ruins and will build it like the days of old.

verses.name: Amos 9:12
verses.text: Thus they may take possession of the remnant of Edom and all the nations <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who are called by my name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “who my name is called over them”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> does this.

verses.name: Amos 9:13
verses.text: “Look, days are coming,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “when <transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> plows will overtake <transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> reaps, the one who treads grapes <transChange type="added">will catch up</transChange> with the one who sows the seed. And the mountains will drip sweet wine and all of the hills will flow <transChange type="added">with it</transChange>.

verses.name: Amos 9:14
verses.text: And I will restore the fortunes of my people Israel, and they will rebuild <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desolated cities and will inhabit <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. And they will plant vineyards and will drink their wine, and they will make gardens and will eat their fruit.

verses.name: Amos 9:15
verses.text: And I will plant them on their land and they will not be uprooted again from their land that I have given to them,” says Yahweh your God.  <chapter eID="Amos.9"/> <div eID="gen24299" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen24279" osisID="Amos" type="book"/>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:1
verses.text: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says my Lord Yahweh concerning Edom: <div eID="gen24302" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">Edom’s Approaching Destruction</title> <div sID="gen24303" type="x-p"/> We have heard a report from Yahweh, and a messenger has been sent among the nations: “Rise up and let us rise against it<note placement="foot">That is, Edom</note> for battle.”

verses.name: Obadiah 1:2
verses.text: “Look, I will<note placement="foot">The NET Bible note for this verse points out: “The Hebrew perfect verb form used here usually describes past events. However, here and several times in the following verses it is best understood as portraying certain fulfillment of events that at the time of writing were still future. It is the perfect of certitude”</note> make you insignificant among the nations. You <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> utterly despised!

verses.name: Obadiah 1:3
verses.text: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who live in the clefts of a rock, the heights of its dwelling, <transChange type="added">you who</transChange> say in your heart: ‘Who can bring me down <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> ground?’

verses.name: Obadiah 1:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> if you soar like the eagle, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> if your nest is set among <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stars, from there I will bring you down!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh:

verses.name: Obadiah 1:5
verses.text: “If thieves came to you, if plunderers of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> night—How you have been destroyed!—would they not steal <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what they wanted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “their sufficiency”</note> If grape gatherers came, would they not leave gleanings?

verses.name: Obadiah 1:6
verses.text: How Esau has been pillaged; his treasures have been ransacked!

verses.name: Obadiah 1:7
verses.text: All of your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞allies⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “men of your covenant”</note> have driven you up to the boundary; your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞confederates⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “men of your peace”</note> have deceived you and have prevailed against you. Those who eat your bread have set an ambush for you, there is no<note placement="foot">The preposition בּ plus אֵין indicates the absence of a thing within a location</note> understanding of it.<note placement="foot">Or “in him”</note>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:8
verses.text: On that day,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “will I not destroy the wise men from Edom, and understanding from the mountain of Esau?

verses.name: Obadiah 1:9
verses.text: And your warriors will be shattered, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Teman, so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “each”</note> from the mountain of Esau will be cut off because of the slaughter!  <div eID="gen24303" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10140"/><title type="x-s">Edom’s Treachery against Judah</title> <div sID="gen24304" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10140"/>“Because of the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you and you will be cut off forever.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:11
verses.text: On <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the day you stood nearby⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the day of your standing nearby”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the day strangers took⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day of the taking captive by strangers”</note> his wealth, and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you were also like one of them.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:12
verses.text: But you should not have gloated<note placement="foot">The Hebrew expression “to look upon” often has the sense of “to feast the eyes upon” or “to gloat over”</note> over your brother’s day, on the day of his misfortune, and you should not have rejoiced over the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “son”</note> of Judah on the day of their perishing, and you should not have opened your mouth wide on the day of distress.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:13
verses.text: You should not have entered the gate of my people on the day of their disaster. You also should not have gloated over his misery on the day of his disaster, and you should not have stretched out <transChange type="added">your hands</transChange> on the day of his disaster.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:14
verses.text: And you should not have stood at the crossroad<transChange type="added">s</transChange> to cut off his fugitives and you should not have handed over his survivors on the day of distress.  <div eID="gen24304" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10141"/><title type="x-s">Future Judgment of the Nations</title> <div sID="gen24305" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10141"/>“For the day of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near against all the nations! Just as you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return on your <transChange type="added">own</transChange> head.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:16
verses.text: For just as you have drunk on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of my holiness”</note> all the nations will drink continually. They will drink and they will slurp, and they will be as <transChange type="added">if</transChange> they had never been.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:17
verses.text: But on Mount Zion there will be an escape, and it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will take possession <transChange type="added">of</transChange> their dispossessors.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:18
verses.text: And the house of Jacob will be a fire and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau stubble; and they will set them on fire and will consume them. And there will not be a survivor for the house of Esau,” for Yahweh has spoken.  <div eID="gen24305" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Obadiah 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10142"/><title type="x-s">Future Blessing for Israel</title> <div sID="gen24306" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10142"/>Those of the Negev will take possession of the mountain of Esau, and those of the Shephelah <transChange type="added">will possess the land of</transChange> the Philistines, and they shall take possession of the territory of Ephraim and the territory of Samaria, and Benjamin <transChange type="added">will take possession of</transChange> Gilead.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:20
verses.text: And the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> of this army of the people of Israel will possess Canaan up to Zarephath, and the exiles<note placement="foot">Hebrew “exile”</note> of Jerusalem who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in Sepharad will take possession of the cities of the Negev.

verses.name: Obadiah 1:21
verses.text: And those who have been saved will go up on Mount Zion to rule the mountain of Esau. And the kingdom <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will belong to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will be for”</note> Yahweh.  <chapter eID="Obad.1"/> <div eID="gen24306" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen24300" osisID="Obad" type="book"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10143"/><title type="x-s">Jonah Disobeys Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen24308" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10143"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

verses.name: Jonah 1:2
verses.text: “Get up! Go to the great city Nineveh and cry out against her, because their evil has come up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “to my face”</note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:3
verses.text: But Jonah set out to flee toward Tarshish from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the presence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from to face of”</note> Yahweh. And he went down to Joppa and found a merchant ship going to Tarshish, and paid her fare, and went on board her to go with them toward Tarshish from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the presence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from to face of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen24308" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:4
