verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10144"/><div sID="gen24309" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10144"/>And Yahweh hurled a great wind upon the sea, and it was a great storm on the sea, and the merchant ship <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was in danger of breaking up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “threatened to be broken up”</note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:5
verses.text: And the mariners were afraid, and each cried out to his god. And they threw the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞contents⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “objects”</note> that were in the merchant ship into the sea to lighten it for them. And <transChange type="added">meanwhile</transChange> Jonah went down into the hold of the vessel and lay down and fell asleep.

verses.name: Jonah 1:6
verses.text: And the captain<note placement="foot">Or “commander”</note> of the ship approached him and said to him, “Why are you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sound asleep⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “in a deep sleep”</note> Get up! Call on your god! Perhaps your god<note placement="foot">Literally “the god,” with the article indicating previous reference</note> will take notice of us and we won’t perish!”

verses.name: Jonah 1:7
verses.text: And they said <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “each to his friend/companion”</note> “Come, let us cast lots so that we may know on whose account this disaster <transChange type="added">has come</transChange> on us!” And they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

verses.name: Jonah 1:8
verses.text: So they said to him, “Please tell us whoever <transChange type="added">is responsible that</transChange> this disaster <transChange type="added">has come</transChange> upon us! What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your occupation? And from where do you come? What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your country? And from which people <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you?”

verses.name: Jonah 1:9
verses.text: And he said to them, “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a Hebrew, and I fear Yahweh, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”

verses.name: Jonah 1:10
verses.text: Then the men <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞were greatly afraid⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “were afraid with a great fear”</note> and they said to him, “What is this you have done?” because they<note placement="foot">Literally “the men” but this is redundant in English</note> knew that he was fleeing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from the presence of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from before the face of”</note> Yahweh (because he had told them).

verses.name: Jonah 1:11
verses.text: So they said to him, “What shall we do to you so that the sea may quiet down for us?” because the sea <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was growing more and more tempestuous⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “going/growing and storming”</note>

verses.name: Jonah 1:12
verses.text: And he said to them, “Pick me up and hurl me into the sea so that the sea may quiet down for you, because I know that on account of me this great storm <transChange type="added">has come</transChange> upon you all.”

verses.name: Jonah 1:13
verses.text: But the men rowed <transChange type="added">hard</transChange> to bring <transChange type="added">the ship</transChange><note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context</note> back to the dry land, and they could not do so because the sea <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was growing more and more tempestuous⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “going/growing and storming”</note> against them.

verses.name: Jonah 1:14
verses.text: So they cried out to Yahweh, and they said, “O Yahweh! Please do not let us perish because of this man’s life, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞do not make us guilty of innocent blood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “do not give innocent blood on us”</note> because you, O Yahweh, did what you wanted.”

verses.name: Jonah 1:15
verses.text: And they picked Jonah up and hurled him into the sea, and the sea ceased from its raging.

verses.name: Jonah 1:16
verses.text: So the men feared Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞greatly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “with a great fear”</note> and they offered a sacrifice to Yahweh and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “vowed”</note> vows.  <div eID="gen24309" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10145"/><title type="x-s">Jonah Is Swallowed by a Fish and Prays to Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen24310" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10145"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Jonah.1.17-Jonah.2.10">Jonah 1:17–2:10 </reference>in the English Bible is 2:1–11 in the Hebrew Bible</note> And Yahweh provided a large fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.  <chapter eID="Jonah.1"/> <div eID="gen24310" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:1
verses.text: And Jonah prayed to Yahweh his God from the belly of the fish

verses.name: Jonah 2:2
verses.text: and said, <div eID="gen24311" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24312"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24313"/>“I called <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from my distress⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from distress for me”</note> to Yahweh,<l eID="gen24313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24314"/>and he answered me;<l eID="gen24314" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24315"/>from the belly of Sheol<note placement="foot">“Sheol” is a Hebrew term for the place where the dead reside (i.e. the Underworld)</note> I cried for help—<l eID="gen24315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24316"/>you heard my voice. <l eID="gen24316" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10146"/><l level="1" sID="gen24317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10146"/>And you threw me <transChange type="added">into the</transChange> deep,<l eID="gen24317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24318"/>into the heart of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seas,<l eID="gen24318" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24319"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> sea currents surrounded me;<l eID="gen24319" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24320"/>all your breakers and your surging waves<l eID="gen24320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24321"/>passed over me. <l eID="gen24321" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10147"/><l level="1" sID="gen24322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10147"/>And I said, ‘I am banished<note placement="foot">Or “expelled,” or “driven away”</note><l eID="gen24322" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24323"/>from your sight;<l eID="gen24323" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24324"/>how<note placement="foot">Or “however, I will continue to look on your holy temple”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will I continue to look⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will I do again to look,” meaning “will I continue to look”</note><l eID="gen24324" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24325"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on your holy temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?’<note placement="foot">Literally “on the temple of your holiness”</note> <l eID="gen24325" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10148"/><l level="1" sID="gen24326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10148"/><transChange type="added">The</transChange> waters encompassed me up to <transChange type="added">my</transChange> neck;<l eID="gen24326" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24327"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> deep surrounded me;<l eID="gen24327" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24328"/>seaweed was wrapped around my head. <l eID="gen24328" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10149"/><l level="1" sID="gen24329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10149"/>I went down to the foundations of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains;<l eID="gen24329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24330"/>the Underworld—its bars <transChange type="added">were</transChange> around me forever.<l eID="gen24330" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24331"/>But you brought up my life from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> pit,<l eID="gen24331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24332"/>Yahweh my God. <l eID="gen24332" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10150"/><l level="1" sID="gen24333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10150"/>When my life was ebbing away from me,<l eID="gen24333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24334"/>I remembered Yahweh,<l eID="gen24334" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24335"/>and my prayer came to you,<l eID="gen24335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24336"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to your holy temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the temple of your holiness”</note> <l eID="gen24336" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10151"/><l level="1" sID="gen24337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10151"/>Those who worship vain idols<l eID="gen24337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24338"/>forsake their loyal love.<note placement="foot">This could mean (1) they forsake the loyal love they should show to God or (2) they forfeit forsake the loyal love that God would have shown to them</note> <l eID="gen24338" level="2"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10152"/><l level="1" sID="gen24339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10152"/>But I, with a voice of thanksgiving,<l eID="gen24339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24340"/>will sacrifice to you;<l eID="gen24340" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24341"/>I will fulfill what I have vowed.<l eID="gen24341" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24342"/>Deliverance<note placement="foot">Or “salvation”</note> <transChange type="added">belongs</transChange> to Yahweh!” <l eID="gen24342" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24312"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10153"/><div sID="gen24343" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10153"/>And Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah out on the dry land.  <chapter eID="Jonah.2"/>

verses.name: Jonah 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10154"/><title type="x-s">The People of Nineveh Repent at Jonah’s Proclamation</title> <div sID="gen24344" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10154"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Jonah a second <transChange type="added">time</transChange>, saying,

verses.name: Jonah 3:2
verses.text: “Get up! Go to Nineveh, the great city, and proclaim to it the message that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> telling you.”

verses.name: Jonah 3:3
verses.text: So Jonah got up<note placement="foot">Or “set out”</note> and went to Nineveh according to the word of Yahweh. Now Nineveh was <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an extraordinarily great city⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a great city to God” or “a great city to the gods,” a disputed phrase which may refer to God’s estimate or ownership of Nineveh, to the presence of many idols, or an idiom referring to the size of Nineveh (this translation takes the last view)</note>—a journey of three days across.<note placement="foot">This phrase may also refer to a journey on which business was done, so that “three days” is the total elapsed time</note>

verses.name: Jonah 3:4
verses.text: And Jonah began to go into the city a journey of one day, and he cried out and said, “Forty more days and Nineveh will be demolished!”<note placement="foot">Or “overthrown”</note>

verses.name: Jonah 3:5
verses.text: And the people of Nineveh believed in God, and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth—from the greatest of them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the least important⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the smallest of them”</note>  <div eID="gen24344" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jonah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10155"/><title type="x-s">The King’s Proclamation</title> <div sID="gen24345" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10155"/>And the news reached the king of Nineveh, and he rose from his throne and removed his royal robe, put on sackcloth, and sat in the ashes.

verses.name: Jonah 3:7
verses.text: And he had a proclamation made, and said, <div eID="gen24345" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen24346" type="x-p"/> “In Nineveh, by a decree of the king and his nobles: <div eID="gen24346" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen24347" type="x-p"/> “No human being or animal, no herd or flock, shall taste anything! They must not eat, and they must not drink water!

verses.name: Jonah 3:8
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> human beings and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> animals must be covered <transChange type="added">with</transChange> sackcloth! And they must call forcefully to God, and each must turn from his evil way and from the violence that is in his<note placement="foot">Hebrew “their”</note> hands.

verses.name: Jonah 3:9
verses.text: Who knows? God may relent and change his mind and turn <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from his blazing anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the heat of his anger”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “and”</note> we will not perish.”  <div eID="gen24347" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jonah 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10156"/><div sID="gen24348" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10156"/>And God saw their deeds—that they turned from their evil ways—and God changed his mind about the evil that he had said <transChange type="added">he would</transChange> bring upon them, and he did not do <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note placement="foot">Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note>  <chapter eID="Jonah.3"/>

verses.name: Jonah 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10157"/><title type="x-s">Jonah Is Angry at Yahweh’s Compassion</title> <div sID="gen24349" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10157"/>And this<note placement="foot">Hebrew “it”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was greatly displeasing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was displeasing with great displeasure”</note> to Jonah, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he became furious⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it was hot for him”</note>

verses.name: Jonah 4:2
verses.text: And he prayed to Yahweh and said, “O Yahweh, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> this not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what I said⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my word”</note> while I was in my homeland? Therefore <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I originally fled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I did the first time to flee”</note> to Tarshish, because I knew that you are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and having great steadfast love⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and great of steadfast love”</note> and one who relents concerning calamity.<note placement="foot">That is, calamity sent by God as judgment</note>

verses.name: Jonah 4:3
verses.text: And so then, Yahweh, please take my life from me, because <transChange type="added">for</transChange> me death <transChange type="added">is</transChange> better than life!”

verses.name: Jonah 4:4
verses.text: And Yahweh said, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Is it right for you to be angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “Rightfully is it hot for you”; some take this to mean “Are you so very angry?” (<hi type="italic">Targum</hi> <reference osisRef="Jonah.4.4">Jonah 4:4; </reference>see also JPS, NEB, NET)</note>  <div eID="gen24349" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jonah 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10158"/><div sID="gen24350" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10158"/>And Jonah went out from the city and sat <transChange type="added">down</transChange> east of the city, and he made for himself a shelter there. And he sat under it in the shade, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞waiting to see⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until he would see”</note> what would happen with the city.

verses.name: Jonah 4:6
verses.text: And Yahweh God appointed a plant,<note placement="foot">Probably a castor oil plant, though some have suggested some type of gourd plant</note> and he made it grow up over Jonah to be a shade over his head, to save him from his discomfort. And Jonah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was very glad⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “was glad with great joy”</note> about the plant.

verses.name: Jonah 4:7
verses.text: So God appointed a worm <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞at daybreak⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “at the coming up of the dawn”</note> the next day, and it attacked the plant, and it withered.

verses.name: Jonah 4:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And when the sun rose⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and it happened at the rising of the sun”</note> God appointed a scorching east wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah’s head and he grew faint. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And he asked that he could die⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and he asked his soul to die”</note> and said, “My death <transChange type="added">is</transChange> better than my life!”

verses.name: Jonah 4:9
verses.text: So God said to Jonah, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Is it right for you to be angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “rightfully is it hot for you”; some take this to mean “Are you so very angry?” (<hi type="italic">Targum</hi> <reference osisRef="Jonah.4.4">Jonah 4:4; </reference>see also JPS, NEB, NET)</note> about the plant?” And he said, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞It is right for me to be angry enough to die⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!”<note placement="foot">Literally “Rightfully it is hot for me until death”</note>  <div eID="gen24350" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jonah 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10159"/><div sID="gen24351" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10159"/>But Yahweh said, “You are troubled about the plant, for which you did not labor nor cause it to grow. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞It grew up in a night and it perished in a night⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “Which was a son of a night and as a son of a night it perished”</note>

verses.name: Jonah 4:11
verses.text: And should I not be concerned about Nineveh, the great city, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in which there are⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “which there are in it”</note> more <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞than one hundred and twenty thousand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “than two ten myriad” (12 x 10,000)</note> people who do not know right from left,<note placement="foot">“hand” is often supplied, but it is not clear just what deficiency is meant by this expression, which occurs only here in biblical Hebrew</note> plus many animals?”  <chapter eID="Jonah.4"/> <div eID="gen24351" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen24307" osisID="Jonah" type="book"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10160"/><title type="x-s">The Impending Doom of Samaria and Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen24353" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10160"/>The word of Yahweh that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, the kings of Judah, that he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem:  <div eID="gen24353" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10161"/><lg sID="gen24354"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10161"/>Hear, all you peoples;<l eID="gen24355" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24356"/>give heed, O earth and its fullness.<l eID="gen24356" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24357"/>And let the Lord Yahweh be against you as a witness,<l eID="gen24357" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24358"/>the Lord from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his holy temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the temple of his holiness”</note> <l eID="gen24358" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10162"/><l level="1" sID="gen24359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10162"/>For behold, Yahweh is coming out from his place,<l eID="gen24359" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24360"/>and he will come down and tread upon the high places of the earth. <l eID="gen24360" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10163"/><l level="1" sID="gen24361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10163"/>The mountains will melt under him<l eID="gen24361" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24362"/>and the valleys will burst open,<l eID="gen24362" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24363"/>like wax before the fire,<l eID="gen24363" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24364"/>like water rushing down a slope. <l eID="gen24364" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10164"/><l level="1" sID="gen24365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10164"/>All this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for the rebellion of Jacob,<l eID="gen24365" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24366"/>and for the sins of the house of Israel.<l eID="gen24366" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24367"/>What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the rebellion of Jacob?<l eID="gen24367" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24368"/><transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not Samaria?<l eID="gen24368" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24369"/>And what <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the high places of Judah?<l eID="gen24369" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24370"/><transChange type="added">Are they</transChange> not Jerusalem? <l eID="gen24370" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10165"/><l level="1" sID="gen24371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10165"/>So I will make Samaria as a heap of rubble in the field,<l eID="gen24371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24372"/>a place for planting a vineyard.<l eID="gen24372" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24373"/>And I will pour down her stones into the valley<l eID="gen24373" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24374"/>and uncover her foundations. <l eID="gen24374" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10166"/><l level="1" sID="gen24375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10166"/>Then all her idols will be broken in pieces,<l eID="gen24375" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24376"/>and all her prostitution wages will be burned in the fire,<l eID="gen24376" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24377"/>and all her idols I will make a desolation,<l eID="gen24377" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24378"/>For from the wage of a prostitute she gathered <transChange type="added">them</transChange>,<l eID="gen24378" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24379"/>and to the wage of a prostitute they will return. <l eID="gen24379" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10167"/><l level="1" sID="gen24380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10167"/>On account of this I will lament and wail.<l eID="gen24380" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24381"/>I will go about barefoot and naked.<l eID="gen24381" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24382"/>I will make a lamentation like the jackals,<l eID="gen24382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24383"/>and a mourning ceremony like the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞ostriches⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “daughters of an ostrich”</note> <l eID="gen24383" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10168"/><l level="1" sID="gen24384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10168"/>For her wounds <transChange type="added">are</transChange> incurable,<l eID="gen24384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24385"/>because it has come to Judah.<l eID="gen24385" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24386"/>It has reached to the gate of my people, to Jerusalem. <l eID="gen24386" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10169"/><l level="1" sID="gen24387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10169"/>Do not tell <transChange type="added">it</transChange> in Gath;<l eID="gen24387" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24388"/>you must not weep at all.<l eID="gen24388" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24389"/>In Beth-le-Aphrah<l eID="gen24389" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24390"/>roll yourself <transChange type="added">in</transChange> dust. <l eID="gen24390" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10170"/><l level="1" sID="gen24391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10170"/>Pass on, you inhabitants of Shaphir,<l eID="gen24391" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24392"/>in naked shame.<l eID="gen24392" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24393"/>The inhabitants of Zaanan do not come forth;<l eID="gen24393" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24394"/>the wailing of Beth-ha-Ezel will take its protection from you. <l eID="gen24394" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10171"/><l level="1" sID="gen24395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10171"/>For the inhabitants of Maroth<l eID="gen24395" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24396"/>writhed for good,<l eID="gen24396" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24397"/>because disaster has come down from Yahweh<l eID="gen24397" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24398"/>to the gate of Jerusalem. <l eID="gen24398" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10172"/><l level="1" sID="gen24399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10172"/>Harness the chariot to the team of horses,<l eID="gen24399" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24400"/>O inhabitants of Lachish;<l eID="gen24400" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24401"/>it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the beginning of sin<l eID="gen24401" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24402"/>for the daughter of Zion,<l eID="gen24402" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24403"/>for the transgressions of Israel<l eID="gen24403" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24404"/>were found in you. <l eID="gen24404" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10173"/><l level="1" sID="gen24405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10173"/>Therefore you will give parting gifts<l eID="gen24405" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24406"/>to Moresheth-Gath;<l eID="gen24406" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24407"/>the houses of Achzib <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> a deception<l eID="gen24407" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24408"/>to the kings of Israel. <l eID="gen24408" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10174"/><l level="1" sID="gen24409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10174"/>I will again bring the conqueror upon you,<l eID="gen24409" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24410"/>O inhabitants of Mareshah;<l eID="gen24410" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24411"/>the glory of Israel<l eID="gen24411" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24412"/>will come to Adullam. <l eID="gen24412" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10175"/><l level="1" sID="gen24413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10175"/>Make yourselves bald<l eID="gen24413" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24414"/>and cut off your hair<l eID="gen24414" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24415"/>for the children of your pleasure.<l eID="gen24415" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24416"/>Expand your baldness as the eagle,<l eID="gen24416" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24417"/>for they will go into exile away from you. <l eID="gen24417" level="2"/><lg eID="gen24354"/> <chapter eID="Mic.1"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10176"/><title type="x-s">Woe to the Oppressors of God’s People</title> <div sID="gen24418" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24418" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24419"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10176"/>Woe <transChange type="added">to</transChange> those who plan wickedness<l eID="gen24420" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24421"/>and evil deeds upon their beds!<l eID="gen24421" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24422"/>In the light of the morning they did it,<l eID="gen24422" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24423"/>because they have power in their hands. <l eID="gen24423" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10177"/><l level="1" sID="gen24424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10177"/>They covet fields and seize <transChange type="added">them</transChange>,<l eID="gen24424" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24425"/>and houses, and they take <transChange type="added">them</transChange> away.<l eID="gen24425" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24426"/>They oppress a man and his house;<l eID="gen24426" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24427"/>a man and his inheritance. <l eID="gen24427" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24419"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10178"/><div sID="gen24428" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10178"/>Therefore, thus says Yahweh: Look! I am planning disaster against this family from which you will not be able to remove your necks. You will not walk proudly, for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a time of disaster.  <div eID="gen24428" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10179"/><lg sID="gen24429"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24430"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10179"/>In that day they will raise a proverb against you,<l eID="gen24430" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24431"/>and will wail a bitter wailing, saying,<l eID="gen24431" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24432"/>“We are utterly ruined;<l eID="gen24432" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24433"/>he exchanges <transChange type="added">the</transChange> portion of my people.<l eID="gen24433" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24434"/>How he removes <transChange type="added">it</transChange> from me;<l eID="gen24434" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24435"/>he apportions our field to an apostate.” <l eID="gen24435" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10180"/><l level="1" sID="gen24436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10180"/>Therefore you will have no one casting a line by lot<l eID="gen24436" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24437"/>in the assembly of Yahweh. <l eID="gen24437" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10181"/><l level="1" sID="gen24438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10181"/>“Do not preach!” they are preaching.<l eID="gen24438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24439"/>They should not preach to these;<l eID="gen24439" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24440"/>disgrace will not overtake us. <l eID="gen24440" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10182"/><l level="1" sID="gen24441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10182"/>Should <transChange type="added">this</transChange> be said, O house of Jacob?<l eID="gen24441" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24442"/>Is the patience<note placement="foot">Or “spirit”</note> of Yahweh shortened?<l eID="gen24442" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24443"/><transChange type="added">Are</transChange> these his deeds?<l eID="gen24443" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24444"/>Are my words not pleasing<l eID="gen24444" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24445"/>to him who walks upright? <l eID="gen24445" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10183"/><l level="1" sID="gen24446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10183"/>But <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞recently⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “yesterday”</note> my people have risen up as an enemy;<l eID="gen24446" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24447"/>from before the cloak you strip off the robe<l eID="gen24447" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24448"/>from those passing by <transChange type="added">in</transChange> confidence,<l eID="gen24448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24449"/>returning <transChange type="added">from</transChange> war. <l eID="gen24449" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10184"/><l level="1" sID="gen24450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10184"/>You have driven out the women of my people<l eID="gen24450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24451"/>from the houses of their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “her”</note> pleasure.<l eID="gen24451" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24452"/>From their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “her”</note> children you have taken away<l eID="gen24452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24453"/>my glory forever. <l eID="gen24453" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10185"/><l level="1" sID="gen24454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10185"/>Arise and go,<l eID="gen24454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24455"/>for this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> no resting place,<l eID="gen24455" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24456"/>on account of uncleanness <transChange type="added">that</transChange> destroys<l eID="gen24456" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24457"/>with painful destruction. <l eID="gen24457" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10186"/><l level="1" sID="gen24458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10186"/>If a man walks about in a spirit of deception and lies,<l eID="gen24458" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24459"/><transChange type="added">saying</transChange> “I will preach to you of wine and strong drink,”<l eID="gen24459" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24460"/>then he would be a preacher <transChange type="added">for</transChange> this people! <l eID="gen24460" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10187"/><l level="1" sID="gen24461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10187"/>I will surely gather all of you, O Jacob;<l eID="gen24461" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24462"/>I will surely gather together the remainder of Israel.<l eID="gen24462" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24463"/>I will set them like sheep of Bozrah.<l eID="gen24463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24464"/>Like a herd in the midst of their pasture<l eID="gen24464" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24465"/>they will be in tumult from people. <l eID="gen24465" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10188"/><l level="1" sID="gen24466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10188"/>The one who breaks out before them goes up;<l eID="gen24466" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24467"/>they break through and pass the gate,<l eID="gen24467" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24468"/>going out through it.<l eID="gen24468" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24469"/>Their king passes before them,<l eID="gen24469" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24470"/>Yahweh at their head. <l eID="gen24470" level="2"/><lg eID="gen24429"/> <chapter eID="Mic.2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10189"/><title type="x-s">Israel’s Leaders Denounced</title> <div sID="gen24471" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24471" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24472"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10189"/>And I said,<l eID="gen24473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24474"/>“Listen, O heads of Jacob<l eID="gen24474" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24475"/>and leaders of the house of Israel!<l eID="gen24475" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24476"/><transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not for you to know justice? <l eID="gen24476" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10190"/><l level="1" sID="gen24477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10190"/><transChange type="added">Those of you who are</transChange> haters of good<l eID="gen24477" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24478"/>and lovers of evil,<l eID="gen24478" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24479"/><transChange type="added">who</transChange> tear their skin from them<l eID="gen24479" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24480"/>and their flesh from their bones, <l eID="gen24480" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10191"/><l level="1" sID="gen24481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10191"/>and who eat the flesh of my people,<l eID="gen24481" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24482"/>and strip their skin from them,<l eID="gen24482" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24483"/>and break their bones,<l eID="gen24483" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24484"/>and chop <transChange type="added">them</transChange> like meat in the pot,<l eID="gen24484" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24485"/>and like flesh in the midst of a cooking pot.” <l eID="gen24485" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10192"/><l level="1" sID="gen24486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10192"/>Then they will cry to Yahweh,<l eID="gen24486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24487"/>but he will not answer them.<l eID="gen24487" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24488"/>He will hide his face from them at that time,<l eID="gen24488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24489"/>when they have made their deeds evil. <l eID="gen24489" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10193"/><l level="1" sID="gen24490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10193"/>Thus says Yahweh concerning the prophets<l eID="gen24490" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24491"/>who are leading my people astray,<l eID="gen24491" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24492"/>who are biting with their teeth<l eID="gen24492" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24493"/>and proclaim, “Peace,”<l eID="gen24493" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24494"/>but whoever puts nothing into their mouths<l eID="gen24494" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24495"/>they declare war against. <l eID="gen24495" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10194"/><l level="1" sID="gen24496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10194"/>Therefore <transChange type="added">it will be as</transChange> night to you, without vision,<l eID="gen24496" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24497"/>and darkness to you, without divination.<l eID="gen24497" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24498"/>And the sun will set on the prophets,<l eID="gen24498" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24499"/>and the day will grow dark over them. <l eID="gen24499" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10195"/><l level="1" sID="gen24500"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10195"/>Then the seers will be disgraced,<l eID="gen24500" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24501"/>and those practicing divination will be put to shame.<l eID="gen24501" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24502"/>All of them will cover their lips,<l eID="gen24502" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24503"/>for there is no reply from God. <l eID="gen24503" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10196"/><l level="1" sID="gen24504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10196"/>But I, I am filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> power,<l eID="gen24504" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24505"/>with the Spirit of Yahweh,<l eID="gen24505" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24506"/>and with justice and might,<l eID="gen24506" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24507"/>to declare to Jacob his rebellion,<l eID="gen24507" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24508"/>and to Israel his sin. <l eID="gen24508" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10197"/><l level="1" sID="gen24509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10197"/>Hear this, O rulers of the house of Jacob<l eID="gen24509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24510"/>and leaders of the house of Israel,<l eID="gen24510" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24511"/>those detesting justice<l eID="gen24511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24512"/>and perverting all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> right, <l eID="gen24512" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10198"/><l level="1" sID="gen24513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10198"/>he who builds Zion with blood<l eID="gen24513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24514"/>and Jerusalem with wickedness. <l eID="gen24514" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10199"/><l level="1" sID="gen24515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10199"/>Its rulers judge for a bribe;<l eID="gen24515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24516"/>its priests teach for a price;<l eID="gen24516" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24517"/>its prophets practice divination for money.<l eID="gen24517" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24518"/>But they lean on Yahweh, saying,<l eID="gen24518" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24519"/>“<transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not Yahweh in our midst?<l eID="gen24519" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24520"/>Disaster will not come upon us.” <l eID="gen24520" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10200"/><l level="1" sID="gen24521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10200"/>Therefore on account of you<l eID="gen24521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24522"/>Zion will be plowed <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a field,<l eID="gen24522" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24523"/>and Jerusalem will be a heap of rubble,<l eID="gen24523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24524"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the temple mount⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of the house”</note> as a high place <transChange type="added">in</transChange> a forest. <l eID="gen24524" level="2"/><lg eID="gen24472"/> <chapter eID="Mic.3"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10201"/><title type="x-s">The Mountain of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen24525" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24525" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24526"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10201"/>And it will be <transChange type="added">that</transChange> at the end of those days,<l eID="gen24527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24528"/>the mountain of Yahweh<l eID="gen24528" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24529"/>will be established as the highest of the mountains,<l eID="gen24529" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24530"/>and it will be lifted up above the hills,<l eID="gen24530" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24531"/>and people will stream to it. <l eID="gen24531" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10202"/><l level="1" sID="gen24532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10202"/>And many nations will come and say,<l eID="gen24532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24533"/>“Come! Let us go up to the mountain of Yahweh,<l eID="gen24533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24534"/>and to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house”</note> of the God of Jacob,<l eID="gen24534" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24535"/>that he may teach us his ways,<l eID="gen24535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24536"/>and that we may walk in his paths,”<l eID="gen24536" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24537"/>for the law will go out from Zion,<l eID="gen24537" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24538"/>and the word of Yahweh from Jerusalem. <l eID="gen24538" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10203"/><l level="1" sID="gen24539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10203"/>And he will judge between many peoples<l eID="gen24539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24540"/>and will arbitrate for strong nations far away;<l eID="gen24540" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24541"/>and they will beat their swords into plowshares<l eID="gen24541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24542"/>and their spears into pruning hooks;<l eID="gen24542" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24543"/>nation will not lift up a sword against a nation,<l eID="gen24543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24544"/>and they will no longer learn war. <l eID="gen24544" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10204"/><l level="1" sID="gen24545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10204"/>But they will sit, each under his vine<l eID="gen24545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24546"/>and under his fig tree,<l eID="gen24546" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24547"/>and no one will make them afraid,<l eID="gen24547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24548"/>for the mouth of Yahweh of hosts has spoken. <l eID="gen24548" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10205"/><l level="1" sID="gen24549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10205"/>For all the nations walk,<l eID="gen24549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24550"/>each in the name of its god,<l eID="gen24550" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24551"/>but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God,<l eID="gen24551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24552"/>forever and ever.<l eID="gen24552" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24526"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh Will Deliver Zion</title> <div sID="gen24553" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24553" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10206"/><lg sID="gen24554"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10206"/>“In that day,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares Yahweh,⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of Yahweh”</note><l eID="gen24555" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24556"/>“I will assemble the one who limps,<l eID="gen24556" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24557"/>and I will gather the one who has been scattered,<l eID="gen24557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24558"/>and <transChange type="added">those</transChange> whom I have mistreated. <l eID="gen24558" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10207"/><l level="1" sID="gen24559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10207"/>And I will make the one who limps a remnant,<l eID="gen24559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24560"/>and the one driven far away a strong nation,<l eID="gen24560" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24561"/>and Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion<l eID="gen24561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24562"/>from now to forever. <l eID="gen24562" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10208"/><l level="1" sID="gen24563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10208"/>And you, O Migdal-Eder,<note placement="foot">Or “tower of the flock”</note><l eID="gen24563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24564"/>hill of the daughter of Zion,<l eID="gen24564" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24565"/>to you it will come,<l eID="gen24565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24566"/>and the former dominion will come,<l eID="gen24566" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24567"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> reign of the daughter of Jerusalem. <l eID="gen24567" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10209"/><l level="1" sID="gen24568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10209"/>So then, why do you shout a loud shout?<l eID="gen24568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24569"/>Is there no king in you?<l eID="gen24569" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24570"/>Has your counselor perished<l eID="gen24570" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24571"/>that pangs like a woman in labor have seized you? <l eID="gen24571" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10210"/><l level="1" sID="gen24572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10210"/>Writhe and groan, O daughter of Zion,<l eID="gen24572" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24573"/>like a woman in labor.<l eID="gen24573" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24574"/>For now you will go forth from the city,<l eID="gen24574" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24575"/>and you will camp in the field;<l eID="gen24575" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24576"/>you will go to Babylon.<l eID="gen24576" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24577"/>There you will be rescued;<l eID="gen24577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24578"/>there Yahweh will redeem you<l eID="gen24578" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24579"/>from the hand of your enemies. <l eID="gen24579" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10211"/><l level="1" sID="gen24580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10211"/>And now, many nations are gathered against you<l eID="gen24580" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24581"/>who are saying, ‘Let her be defiled,<l eID="gen24581" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24582"/>and let our eyes gaze upon Zion.’ <l eID="gen24582" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10212"/><l level="1" sID="gen24583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10212"/>But they do not know the thoughts of Yahweh,<l eID="gen24583" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24584"/>and they do not understand his plan,<l eID="gen24584" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24585"/>that he has gathered them as sheaves<l eID="gen24585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24586"/>to his threshing floor. <l eID="gen24586" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10213"/><l level="1" sID="gen24587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10213"/>Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion,<l eID="gen24587" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24588"/>for your horn I will make <transChange type="added">as</transChange> iron<l eID="gen24588" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24589"/>and your hooves <transChange type="added">as</transChange> bronze.<l eID="gen24589" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24590"/>And you will break many peoples in pieces,<l eID="gen24590" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24591"/>and their gain you will devote to destruction to Yahweh,<l eID="gen24591" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24592"/>and their wealth to the Lord of the whole earth.” <l eID="gen24592" level="2"/><lg eID="gen24554"/> <chapter eID="Mic.4"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10214"/><title type="x-s">A Ruler from Bethlehem</title> <div sID="gen24593" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24593" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24594"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10214"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Mic.5.1-Mic.5.15">Micah 5:1–15 </reference>in the English Bible is 4:14–5:14 in the Hebrew Bible</note> Now muster troops, O daughter of troops;<l eID="gen24595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24596"/>a siege he puts against us.<l eID="gen24596" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24597"/>They strike the ruler of Israel<l eID="gen24597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24598"/>with a rod on the cheek. <l eID="gen24598" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10215"/><l level="1" sID="gen24599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10215"/>But you, O Bethlehem Ephrathah,<l eID="gen24599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24600"/><transChange type="added">too</transChange> small to be among the clans of Judah,<l eID="gen24600" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24601"/>from you one will go out for me,<l eID="gen24601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24602"/>to be ruler in Israel;<l eID="gen24602" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24603"/>and his origins <transChange type="added">are</transChange> from of old,<l eID="gen24603" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24604"/>from ancient days. <l eID="gen24604" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10216"/><l level="1" sID="gen24605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10216"/>Therefore he will give them up<l eID="gen24605" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24606"/>until the time of she who is with child has given birth.<l eID="gen24606" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24607"/>And the rest of his brothers will return<l eID="gen24607" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24608"/>to the children of Israel. <l eID="gen24608" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10217"/><l level="1" sID="gen24609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10217"/>And he will stand and shepherd <transChange type="added">his flock</transChange><l eID="gen24609" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24610"/>in the strength of Yahweh,<l eID="gen24610" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24611"/>in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God.<l eID="gen24611" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24612"/>And they will live,<l eID="gen24612" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24613"/>for now he will be great unto the ends of the earth. <l eID="gen24613" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10218"/><l level="1" sID="gen24614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10218"/>And this one will be peace.<l eID="gen24614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24615"/><transChange type="added">As for</transChange> the Assyrian,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Assyria”</note> when he comes into our land<l eID="gen24615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24616"/>and when he treads on our fortresses,<l eID="gen24616" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24617"/>then we will raise up against him seven shepherds<l eID="gen24617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24618"/>and eight leaders of men. <l eID="gen24618" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10219"/><l level="1" sID="gen24619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10219"/>And they will shepherd the land of Assyria with the sword,<l eID="gen24619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24620"/>and the land of Nimrod at its entrances.<l eID="gen24620" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24621"/>And he will rescue <transChange type="added">us</transChange> from the Assyrian<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Assyria”</note><l eID="gen24621" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24622"/>when he comes into our land,<l eID="gen24622" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24623"/>and when they tread upon our border.<l eID="gen24623" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24594"/> <title type="x-s">A Remnant Delivered</title> <div sID="gen24624" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24624" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10220"/><lg sID="gen24625"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10220"/>And the remnant of Jacob will be<l eID="gen24626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24627"/>in the midst of many nations,<l eID="gen24627" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24628"/>like dew from Yahweh,<l eID="gen24628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24629"/>like showers upon the grass<l eID="gen24629" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24630"/>which does not wait for a man,<l eID="gen24630" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24631"/>nor delays for the children of humankind. <l eID="gen24631" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10221"/><l level="1" sID="gen24632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10221"/>And the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations,<l eID="gen24632" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24633"/>in the midst of many peoples,<l eID="gen24633" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24634"/>like a lion among the wild animals of the forest,<l eID="gen24634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24635"/>like a young lion among the herds of sheep<l eID="gen24635" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24636"/>which, when it passes through and treads <transChange type="added">down</transChange><l eID="gen24636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24637"/>and tears in pieces, there is none who <transChange type="added">can</transChange> deliver. <l eID="gen24637" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10222"/><l level="1" sID="gen24638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10222"/>Your hand will be lifted high over your enemies,<l eID="gen24638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24639"/>and all your foes will be cut off. <l eID="gen24639" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10223"/><l level="1" sID="gen24640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10223"/>“And it will happen <transChange type="added">that</transChange> in that day,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen24640" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24641"/>“then I will cut off your horses from among you,<l eID="gen24641" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24642"/>and I will destroy your chariots. <l eID="gen24642" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10224"/><l level="1" sID="gen24643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10224"/>And I will cut off the cities of your land,<l eID="gen24643" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24644"/>and I will demolish all your fortifications. <l eID="gen24644" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10225"/><l level="1" sID="gen24645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10225"/>And I will cut off sorceries from your hand,<l eID="gen24645" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24646"/>and you will not have soothsayers. <l eID="gen24646" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10226"/><l level="1" sID="gen24647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10226"/>And I will cut off your idols<l eID="gen24647" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24648"/>and your stone pillars from among you,<l eID="gen24648" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24649"/>and you will no longer bow down<l eID="gen24649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24650"/>to the work of your hands. <l eID="gen24650" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10227"/><l level="1" sID="gen24651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10227"/>And I will uproot your Asherahs from among you,<l eID="gen24651" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24652"/>and I will destroy your cities. <l eID="gen24652" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10228"/><l level="1" sID="gen24653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10228"/>And in anger and in wrath I will execute vengeance<l eID="gen24653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24654"/>on the nations who did not obey.” <l eID="gen24654" level="2"/><lg eID="gen24625"/> <chapter eID="Mic.5"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10229"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Brings a Charge against Israel</title> <div sID="gen24655" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24655" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24656"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10229"/>Hear now what Yahweh says:<l eID="gen24657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24658"/>“Arise! Plead <transChange type="added">your case</transChange> with the mountains,<l eID="gen24658" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24659"/>and let the hills hear your voice.” <l eID="gen24659" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10230"/><l level="1" sID="gen24660"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10230"/>Hear, O mountains, the indictment of Yahweh,<l eID="gen24660" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24661"/>and you eternal foundations of the earth,<l eID="gen24661" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24662"/>for Yahweh has an indictment against his people,<l eID="gen24662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24663"/>and against Israel he contends. <l eID="gen24663" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10231"/><l level="1" sID="gen24664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10231"/>“O my people, what have I done to you,<l eID="gen24664" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24665"/>and how have I wearied you? Answer me! <l eID="gen24665" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10232"/><l level="1" sID="gen24666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10232"/>For I brought you up from the land of Egypt,<l eID="gen24666" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24667"/>and from the house of slavery I redeemed you.<l eID="gen24667" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24668"/>And I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam before you. <l eID="gen24668" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10233"/><l level="1" sID="gen24669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10233"/>O my people, remember what Balak the king of Moab devised,<l eID="gen24669" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24670"/>and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him,<l eID="gen24670" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24671"/>and <transChange type="added">what happened from</transChange> Shittim to Gilgal,<l eID="gen24671" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24672"/>so that you might know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”<l eID="gen24672" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24656"/> <title type="x-s">What Does Yahweh Require?</title> <div sID="gen24673" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24673" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10234"/><lg sID="gen24674"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10234"/>With what shall I approach Yahweh,<l eID="gen24675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24676"/>and bow down to God on high?<l eID="gen24676" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24677"/>Shall I approach him with burnt offerings,<l eID="gen24677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24678"/>with bull calves a year old? <l eID="gen24678" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10235"/><l level="1" sID="gen24679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10235"/>Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams,<l eID="gen24679" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24680"/>with myriads of rivers of oil?<l eID="gen24680" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24681"/>Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression,<l eID="gen24681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24682"/>the fruit of my body <transChange type="added">for the</transChange> sin of my soul? <l eID="gen24682" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10236"/><l level="1" sID="gen24683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10236"/>He has told you, O mortal, what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good,<l eID="gen24683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24684"/>and what does Yahweh ask from you<l eID="gen24684" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24685"/>but to do justice, and to love kindness,<l eID="gen24685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24686"/>and to walk humbly with your God?<l eID="gen24686" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24674"/> <title type="x-s">The Destruction of the Wicked</title> <div sID="gen24687" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24687" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10237"/><lg sID="gen24688"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10237"/>The voice of Yahweh calls to the city<l eID="gen24689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24690"/>(<transChange type="added">it is</transChange> sound judgment to fear your name):<l eID="gen24690" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24691"/>“Hear, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> staff!<note placement="foot">Or “tribe”</note> Now who has appointed it? <l eID="gen24691" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10238"/><l level="1" sID="gen24692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10238"/>Is there any longer a man <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the house of the wicked<l eID="gen24692" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24693"/>treasures of wickedness,<l eID="gen24693" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24694"/>and the ephah of scarcity <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> accursed?<note placement="foot">The meaning of the Hebrew text is uncertain</note> <l eID="gen24694" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10239"/><l level="1" sID="gen24695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10239"/>Shall I regard as pure <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> with scales of wickedness,<l eID="gen24695" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24696"/>and with a bag of deceitful weights? <l eID="gen24696" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10240"/><l level="1" sID="gen24697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10240"/>Because her rich are full of violence,<l eID="gen24697" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24698"/>and her inhabitants speak lies,<l eID="gen24698" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24699"/>and their tongue <transChange type="added">is</transChange> deceitful in their mouth. <l eID="gen24699" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10241"/><l level="1" sID="gen24700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10241"/>And I also <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞have made you sick by striking you down⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I have made sick to strike you down”</note><l eID="gen24700" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24701"/>making <transChange type="added">you</transChange> desolate because of your sins. <l eID="gen24701" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10242"/><l level="1" sID="gen24702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10242"/>You yourself will eat but not be satisfied;<l eID="gen24702" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24703"/>your hunger <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> in your midst,<l eID="gen24703" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24704"/>and you will put away, but you will not save,<l eID="gen24704" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24705"/>and what you save I will hand over to the sword. <l eID="gen24705" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10243"/><l level="1" sID="gen24706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10243"/>You yourself will sow, but you will not reap;<l eID="gen24706" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24707"/>you will tread olives, but you will not anoint yourself with oil;<l eID="gen24707" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24708"/><transChange type="added">you will tread</transChange> grapes, but you will not drink wine. <l eID="gen24708" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10244"/><l level="1" sID="gen24709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10244"/>For you have observed the regulations of Omri<l eID="gen24709" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24710"/>and all the works of the house of Ahab.<l eID="gen24710" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24711"/>And you have walked in their counsels,<l eID="gen24711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24712"/>so that I am making you a desolation<l eID="gen24712" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24713"/>and your inhabitants an object of scorn.<l eID="gen24713" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24714"/>So you will bear the scorn of my people. <l eID="gen24714" level="2"/><lg eID="gen24688"/> <chapter eID="Mic.6"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10245"/><title type="x-s">Wait Upon Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen24715" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24715" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24716"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10245"/>Woe is me! For I have become<l eID="gen24717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24718"/>like the gatherings of summer,<l eID="gen24718" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24719"/>like the gleanings of the grape harvest,<l eID="gen24719" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24720"/><transChange type="added">when</transChange> there is no cluster of grapes to eat<l eID="gen24720" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24721"/><transChange type="added">or</transChange> early ripened fruit <transChange type="added">that</transChange> my soul desires. <l eID="gen24721" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10246"/><l level="1" sID="gen24722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10246"/>The faithful <transChange type="added">person</transChange> has perished from the land,<l eID="gen24722" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24723"/>and there is none who is upright among humankind.<l eID="gen24723" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24724"/>All of them lie in wait;<l eID="gen24724" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24725"/>each hunts his brother <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a net. <l eID="gen24725" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10247"/><l level="1" sID="gen24726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10247"/>Their hands <transChange type="added">are</transChange> upon evil, to do <transChange type="added">it</transChange> well;<l eID="gen24726" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24727"/>the official and the judge ask for the bribe,<l eID="gen24727" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24728"/>and the great <transChange type="added">man</transChange> utters the evil desire of his soul;<l eID="gen24728" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24729"/>and they weave <transChange type="added">it</transChange> together. <l eID="gen24729" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10248"/><l level="1" sID="gen24730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10248"/>The best of them <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a brier;<l eID="gen24730" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24731"/><transChange type="added">the most</transChange> upright <transChange type="added">worse</transChange> than a thorn hedge.<l eID="gen24731" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24732"/>The day of your watchman, your punishment, has come;<l eID="gen24732" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24733"/>now their confusion will come. <l eID="gen24733" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10249"/><l level="1" sID="gen24734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10249"/>Do not put faith in a friend;<l eID="gen24734" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24735"/>put no trust in a close friend.<l eID="gen24735" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24736"/>Guard the doorways of your mouth<l eID="gen24736" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24737"/>from the one who lies in your lap. <l eID="gen24737" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10250"/><l level="1" sID="gen24738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10250"/>For a son treats a father with contempt;<l eID="gen24738" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24739"/>a daughter rises up against her mother,<l eID="gen24739" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24740"/>a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law;<l eID="gen24740" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24741"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemies of a man <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the men of his own house. <l eID="gen24741" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10251"/><l level="1" sID="gen24742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10251"/>But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> me, I will look to Yahweh;<l eID="gen24742" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24743"/>I will wait for the God of my salvation.<l eID="gen24743" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24744"/>My God will hear me. <l eID="gen24744" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10252"/><l level="1" sID="gen24745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10252"/>You should not rejoice over me, O my enemy!<l eID="gen24745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24746"/>When I fall I will stand up;<l eID="gen24746" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24747"/>when I sit in darkness<l eID="gen24747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24748"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> a light for me. <l eID="gen24748" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10253"/><l level="1" sID="gen24749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10253"/>I will bear the rage of Yahweh,<l eID="gen24749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24750"/>for I have sinned against him,<l eID="gen24750" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24751"/>until he pleads my cause<l eID="gen24751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24752"/>and executes my justice.<l eID="gen24752" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24753"/>He will bring me out to the light;<l eID="gen24753" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24754"/>I will see his righteousness. <l eID="gen24754" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10254"/><l level="1" sID="gen24755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10254"/>Then my enemy will see,<l eID="gen24755" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24756"/>and shame will cover her who said to me,<l eID="gen24756" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24757"/>“Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Yahweh your God?”<l eID="gen24757" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24758"/>My eyes will look upon her;<l eID="gen24758" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24759"/>now she will become a trampling place,<l eID="gen24759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24760"/>like mud in the streets. <l eID="gen24760" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10255"/><l level="1" sID="gen24761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10255"/>A day for building your walls;<l eID="gen24761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24762"/><transChange type="added">on</transChange> that day he will extend <transChange type="added">your</transChange> boundary. <l eID="gen24762" level="2"/>
