verses.name: Micah 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10256"/><l level="1" sID="gen24763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10256"/><transChange type="added">On</transChange> that day he will come to you<l eID="gen24763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24764"/>from Assyria and the cities of Egypt,<l eID="gen24764" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24765"/>and from Egypt to the River,<l eID="gen24765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24766"/>and from sea to sea<l eID="gen24766" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24767"/>and mountain to mountain. <l eID="gen24767" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10257"/><l level="1" sID="gen24768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10257"/>But the earth will be a desolation<l eID="gen24768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24769"/>because of its inhabitants,<l eID="gen24769" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24770"/>for the fruit of their deeds. <l eID="gen24770" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10258"/><l level="1" sID="gen24771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10258"/>Shepherd your people with your staff,<l eID="gen24771" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24772"/>the flock of your inheritance,<l eID="gen24772" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24773"/>those dwelling alone <transChange type="added">in</transChange> a forest<l eID="gen24773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24774"/>in the midst of Carmel.<l eID="gen24774" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24775"/>Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead,<l eID="gen24775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24776"/>as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the days of old. <l eID="gen24776" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10259"/><l level="1" sID="gen24777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10259"/>As <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the days when you came out<l eID="gen24777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24778"/>from the land of Egypt<l eID="gen24778" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24779"/>I will show him wondrous things. <l eID="gen24779" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10260"/><l level="1" sID="gen24780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10260"/>The nations will see and be ashamed<l eID="gen24780" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24781"/>because of all their might.<l eID="gen24781" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24782"/>They will lay <transChange type="added">the</transChange> hand on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mouth;<l eID="gen24782" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24783"/>their ears will be deaf. <l eID="gen24783" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10261"/><l level="1" sID="gen24784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10261"/>They will lick the dust like the serpent,<l eID="gen24784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24785"/>like the crawling things of the earth.<l eID="gen24785" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24786"/>They will come trembling from their strongholds<l eID="gen24786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24787"/>to Yahweh our God.<l eID="gen24787" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24788"/>Let them fear and be afraid of you. <l eID="gen24788" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10262"/><l level="1" sID="gen24789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10262"/>Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a God like you, forgiving sin<l eID="gen24789" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24790"/>and passing over rebellion for the remnant of his inheritance?<l eID="gen24790" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24791"/>He does not retain his anger forever,<l eID="gen24791" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24792"/>for he delights in loyal love. <l eID="gen24792" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10263"/><l level="1" sID="gen24793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10263"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He will again have compassion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “He will return, he will have compassion”</note> on us;<l eID="gen24793" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24794"/>he will trample our iniquities.<l eID="gen24794" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24795"/>And you will hurl all their sins<l eID="gen24795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24796"/>in the depths of the sea. <l eID="gen24796" level="2"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10264"/><l level="1" sID="gen24797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10264"/>You will show faithfulness to Jacob,<l eID="gen24797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24798"/>and loyal love to Abraham,<l eID="gen24798" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24799"/>as you have sworn to our ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note><l eID="gen24799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24800"/>from the days of old. <l eID="gen24800" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24716"/> <chapter eID="Mic.7"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen24352" osisID="Mic" type="book"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10265"/><title type="x-s">Superscription</title> <div sID="gen24802" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24802" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24803"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10265"/>The oracle concerning Nineveh—<l eID="gen24804" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24805"/>the scroll of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite:<l eID="gen24805" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24803"/> <title type="x-s">Half-Acrostic: Yahweh Takes Vengeance against His Enemies</title> <div sID="gen24806" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24806" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10266"/><lg sID="gen24807"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10266"/>Yahweh is a jealous God and avenging;<l eID="gen24808" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24809"/>Yahweh is avenging and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞full of wrath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a lord of wrath”</note><l eID="gen24809" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24810"/>Yahweh takes vengeance against his enemies;<l eID="gen24810" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24811"/>he rages against his adversaries. <l eID="gen24811" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10267"/><l level="1" sID="gen24812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10267"/>Yahweh is slow to anger but great <transChange type="added">in</transChange> power;<l eID="gen24812" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24813"/>he will certainly not allow <transChange type="added">the guilty</transChange> to go unpunished.<l eID="gen24813" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24814"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He marches⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “His path”</note> in storm wind and in gale;<l eID="gen24814" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24815"/>storm clouds <transChange type="added">are the</transChange> dust of his feet. <l eID="gen24815" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10268"/><l level="1" sID="gen24816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10268"/>He rebukes the sea and he dries up the rivers;<l eID="gen24816" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24817"/>he makes all the rivers run dry.<l eID="gen24817" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24818"/>Bashan and Carmel wither;<note placement="foot">MT reads “languishes,” but the versions reflect “withers,” which also restores the acrostic</note><l eID="gen24818" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24819"/>the blossom of Lebanon languishes. <l eID="gen24819" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10269"/><l level="1" sID="gen24820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10269"/>Mountains quake before him;<l eID="gen24820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24821"/>the hills shake apart.<note placement="foot">Or “melt”</note><l eID="gen24821" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24822"/>The earth heaves before him—<l eID="gen24822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24823"/>the world and all her inhabitants. <l eID="gen24823" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10270"/><l level="1" sID="gen24824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10270"/>His indignation—who can stand before it?<l eID="gen24824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24825"/>Who can endure <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his fierce anger⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “the heat of his anger”</note><l eID="gen24825" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24826"/>His wrath is poured out like fire;<l eID="gen24826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24827"/>rocks are shattered before<note placement="foot">Or “by”</note> him. <l eID="gen24827" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10271"/><l level="1" sID="gen24828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10271"/>Yahweh is good—a refuge in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> day of distress;<l eID="gen24828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24829"/><transChange type="added">he knows</transChange> those who take refuge in him. <l eID="gen24829" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10272"/><l level="1" sID="gen24830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10272"/>But with a rushing torrent he will bring <transChange type="added">Nineveh</transChange> to an end;<l eID="gen24830" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24831"/>he will chase his enemies into darkness.<l eID="gen24831" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24807"/> <title type="x-s">Yahweh Will Destroy Nineveh</title> <div sID="gen24832" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24832" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10273"/><lg sID="gen24833"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10273"/>What<note placement="foot">Or “Why …?”</note> do you plot against Yahweh?<l eID="gen24834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24835"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞He will completely destroy it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “he will make a complete destruction”</note><l eID="gen24835" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24836"/>trouble will not rise up a second time! <l eID="gen24836" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10274"/><l level="1" sID="gen24837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10274"/>For like entangled thorns,<l eID="gen24837" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24838"/>and like their drink which is drunk,<l eID="gen24838" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24839"/>they will be consumed like fully dry chaff. <l eID="gen24839" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10275"/><l level="1" sID="gen24840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10275"/>From you goes out one who plots evil against Yahweh,<l eID="gen24840" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24841"/>one who plans wickedness. <l eID="gen24841" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24833"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10276"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Will Deliver Judah and Destroy Nineveh</title> <div sID="gen24842" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10276"/>Yahweh says this: <div eID="gen24842" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24843"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24844"/>“Even though <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> powerful and likewise many,<l eID="gen24844" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24845"/>even so they will be cut off and pass away.<l eID="gen24845" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24846"/>Though I have afflicted you,<note placement="foot">That is, Judah</note><l eID="gen24846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24847"/>I will afflict you<note placement="foot">That is, Judah</note> no longer. <l eID="gen24847" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10277"/><l level="1" sID="gen24848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10277"/>And now, I will break his yoke from upon you;<l eID="gen24848" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24849"/>I will snap your bonds.” <l eID="gen24849" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24843"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10278"/><div sID="gen24850" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10278"/>Yahweh has commanded concerning you: <div eID="gen24850" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24851"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24852"/>“Your name will no longer be sown.<l eID="gen24852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24853"/>I will cut off <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the idols and images⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the idols and the molten idols”</note> from the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞temple⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “house”</note> of your gods;<l eID="gen24853" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24854"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will send you to the grave⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will make your grave”</note> because you are worthless.” <l eID="gen24854" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10279"/><l level="1" sID="gen24855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10279"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Nah.1.15-Nah.2.13">Nahum 1:15–2:13 </reference>in the English Bible is 2:1–14 in the Hebrew Bible</note> Look! On the mountains!<l eID="gen24855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24856"/>The feet of the one who brings good tidings,<l eID="gen24856" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24857"/>the one who proclaims peace!<l eID="gen24857" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24858"/>“Celebrate <transChange type="added">a festival</transChange>, O Judah,<l eID="gen24858" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24859"/>Fulfill your vows!<l eID="gen24859" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24860"/>For he will not invade you again;<l eID="gen24860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24861"/>the wicked one is cut off completely!” <l eID="gen24861" level="2"/><lg eID="gen24851"/> <chapter eID="Nah.1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10280"/><title type="x-s">The Divine Warrior Will Attack Nineveh</title> <div sID="gen24862" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24862" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24863"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10280"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞One who shatters⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a shatterer”</note> has come up against you!<l eID="gen24864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24865"/>Guard <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fortification!<l eID="gen24865" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24866"/>Watch <transChange type="added">the</transChange> road!<note placement="foot">Or “way”</note><l eID="gen24866" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24867"/>Gird <transChange type="added">your</transChange> loins!<l eID="gen24867" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24868"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Muster⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “Collect”</note> all <transChange type="added">your</transChange> strength! <l eID="gen24868" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10281"/><l level="1" sID="gen24869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10281"/>For Yahweh will restore the majesty of Jacob<l eID="gen24869" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24870"/>like the majesty of Israel;<l eID="gen24870" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24871"/>for ravagers have ravaged them<l eID="gen24871" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24872"/>and ruined <transChange type="added">their</transChange> branches.<l eID="gen24872" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24863"/> <title type="x-s">The Enemy Army Conquers the City of Nineveh</title> <div sID="gen24873" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24873" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10282"/><lg sID="gen24874"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10282"/>The shields of his warriors <transChange type="added">are</transChange> dyed red;<l eID="gen24875" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24876"/>The powerful men <transChange type="added">are</transChange> dressed in scarlet.<l eID="gen24876" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24877"/>The metal of the chariots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note> shines like fire <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on the day of battle⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “on the day of his preparation”</note><l eID="gen24877" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24878"/>and <transChange type="added">their</transChange> spears quiver. <l eID="gen24878" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10283"/><l level="1" sID="gen24879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10283"/>The chariots<note placement="foot">Hebrew “chariot”</note> race madly through the streets;<l eID="gen24879" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24880"/>they rush back and forth in the public squares.<l eID="gen24880" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24881"/>Their appearance like lightning bolts,<l eID="gen24881" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24882"/>they dart about like flashes of lightning. <l eID="gen24882" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10284"/><l level="1" sID="gen24883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10284"/>He calls his officers;<l eID="gen24883" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24884"/>they stumble as they march;<l eID="gen24884" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24885"/>they rush to her wall;<l eID="gen24885" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24886"/>they set the covering<note placement="foot">The Hebrew word describes a small portable roof to protect siege warriors from arrows and debris hurled at them from the fortified city wall</note> in place. <l eID="gen24886" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10285"/><l level="1" sID="gen24887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10285"/>The gates of the river are opened;<l eID="gen24887" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24888"/>the palace trembles. <l eID="gen24888" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10286"/><l level="1" sID="gen24889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10286"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Her goddess is taken out and taken into exile⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “It is decreed that she be exiled and led away.” MT reads the very enigmatic “And he is placed, she is sent into exile, she is taken up.” The BHS editors suggest the conjectural emendation “And her goddess = the idol of the patron deity of Nineveh is taken and taken into exile.” This is adopted in the translation on the basis of internal evidence</note><l eID="gen24889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24890"/>her maidservants moan like doves;<l eID="gen24890" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24891"/>they beat on their breasts. <l eID="gen24891" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10287"/><l level="1" sID="gen24892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10287"/>Nineveh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a pool of water without its water.<note placement="foot">MT reads “from her days.” Greek LXX and Syriac Peshitta reflect “from her waters”</note><l eID="gen24892" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24893"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞As they flee⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “And they flee away”</note> <transChange type="added">she cries,</transChange> “Stop! Stop!”<l eID="gen24893" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24894"/>But there is no one who turns back. <l eID="gen24894" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10288"/><l level="1" sID="gen24895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10288"/>Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold!<l eID="gen24895" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24896"/>There is no end to the spoils,<note placement="foot">Literally “the supply”</note><l eID="gen24896" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24897"/>an abundance of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everything one could want⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “every kind of desirable object”</note> <l eID="gen24897" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10289"/><l level="1" sID="gen24898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10289"/>Emptiness and plundering and devastation!<l eID="gen24898" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24899"/>Their hearts faint and their knees tremble,<note placement="foot">Or “totter”</note><l eID="gen24899" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24900"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞All their loins shake⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And shaking of all loins”</note> and all their faces <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞turn⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “gather”</note> pale.<l eID="gen24900" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen24874"/> <title type="x-s">The Divine Warrior Will Hunt down the Mighty Lions</title> <div sID="gen24901" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24901" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10290"/><lg sID="gen24902"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10290"/>Where <transChange type="added">now</transChange> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the den of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> lions<l eID="gen24903" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24904"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cave of the fierce lions?<l eID="gen24904" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24905"/>There the lioness, the cub, and the lion once <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞prowled⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “went”</note><l eID="gen24905" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24906"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and no one disturbed them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “there is no one making them afraid”</note> <l eID="gen24906" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10291"/><l level="1" sID="gen24907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10291"/>The lion tore apart enough <transChange type="added">prey</transChange> for his cubs,<l eID="gen24907" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24908"/>he strangled <transChange type="added">prey</transChange> for his lioness;<l eID="gen24908" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24909"/>he filled <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his lair⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his holes”</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> prey<l eID="gen24909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24910"/>and his den <transChange type="added">with</transChange> mangled carcass. <l eID="gen24910" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10292"/><l level="1" sID="gen24911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10292"/>“Look! I am against you!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts.<l eID="gen24911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24912"/>“I will burn her chariots <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with fire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “with smoke”</note><l eID="gen24912" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24913"/>the sword will devour fierce lions.<l eID="gen24913" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24914"/>I will cut off your prey from the earth;<l eID="gen24914" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24915"/>the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.” <l eID="gen24915" level="3"/><lg eID="gen24902"/> <chapter eID="Nah.2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10293"/><title type="x-s">The Doom of the Wicked City is Certain</title> <div sID="gen24916" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24916" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24917"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10293"/>Woe to the city <transChange type="added">that has shed</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞much blood⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “bloods”</note><l eID="gen24918" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24919"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞She is a deceiver⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “All of her is deception”</note><l eID="gen24919" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24920"/>She is filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> plunder,<l eID="gen24920" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24921"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞She has hoarded her spoils of war⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “Prey does not depart”</note> <l eID="gen24921" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10294"/><l level="1" sID="gen24922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10294"/>The crack of the whip!<l eID="gen24922" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24923"/>The rumbling of the <transChange type="added">chariot</transChange> wheel!<l eID="gen24923" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24924"/>The galloping of the horse!<l eID="gen24924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24925"/>The racing of the chariot! <l eID="gen24925" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10295"/><l level="1" sID="gen24926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10295"/>Chariots charge!<l eID="gen24926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24927"/>Swords flash!<l eID="gen24927" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24928"/>Spears glitter!<l eID="gen24928" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24929"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Many corpses are piled high⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “Many dead, piles of corpses”</note><l eID="gen24929" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24930"/>There is no end to the slain!<l eID="gen24930" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24931"/>They stumble over their dead!<l eID="gen24931" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen24917"/> <title type="x-s">Harlot Nineveh Will Get What She Deserves</title> <div sID="gen24932" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24932" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10296"/><lg sID="gen24933"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10296"/>“Because of the many idolatries of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> prostitute,<l eID="gen24934" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24935"/>the beautiful charm <transChange type="added">of</transChange> a mistress of witchcraft,<l eID="gen24935" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24936"/>she who enslaves nations by her harlotries,<l eID="gen24936" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24937"/>and peoples by her sorceries, <l eID="gen24937" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10297"/><l level="1" sID="gen24938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10297"/>“Look! I am against you!” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note>Yahweh.<l eID="gen24938" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24939"/>“I will strip up your skirts over your face;<l eID="gen24939" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24940"/>I will let nations look <transChange type="added">at</transChange> your nakedness and your shame. <l eID="gen24940" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10298"/><l level="1" sID="gen24941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10298"/>“I will throw filth upon you,<l eID="gen24941" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24942"/>I will treat you with contempt,<l eID="gen24942" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24943"/>I will make you a spectacle. <l eID="gen24943" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10299"/><l level="1" sID="gen24944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10299"/>“And it will be that everyone who sees you will flee from you,<l eID="gen24944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24945"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> will say, ‘Nineveh is destroyed!’<l eID="gen24945" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24946"/>Who will mourn for her?<l eID="gen24946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24947"/>From whence shall I seek comforters for you?”<l eID="gen24947" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24933"/> <title type="x-s">Nineveh Will Suffer the Same Fate She Inflicted on Thebes</title> <div sID="gen24948" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24948" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10300"/><lg sID="gen24949"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10300"/>Are you better than Thebes?<note placement="foot">Hebrew “No-Amon”</note><l eID="gen24950" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24951"/>She who sits at the Nile, surrounded by her waters,<l eID="gen24951" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24952"/>her rampart <transChange type="added">was the</transChange> sea and water <transChange type="added">was</transChange> her wall. <l eID="gen24952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10301"/><l level="1" sID="gen24953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10301"/>Cush <transChange type="added">was</transChange> her strength, Egypt without end;<l eID="gen24953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24954"/>Put and Libya were among <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your allies⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “your helpers”</note> <l eID="gen24954" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10302"/><l level="1" sID="gen24955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10302"/>Yet she went into captivity as an exile;<l eID="gen24955" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24956"/>her children were dashed to pieces at the head of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> streets;<l eID="gen24956" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24957"/>they cast lots for all of her nobles;<l eID="gen24957" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24958"/>all of her dignitaries were bound with chains. <l eID="gen24958" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10303"/><l level="1" sID="gen24959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10303"/>You also will behave like a drunkard;<l eID="gen24959" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24960"/>You also will hide yourself;<l eID="gen24960" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24961"/>You also will seek refuge from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> enemy.<l eID="gen24961" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen24949"/> <title type="x-s">Nineveh’s Defenses Will Fail</title> <div sID="gen24962" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24962" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10304"/><lg sID="gen24963"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10304"/>All of your fortifications <transChange type="added">are like</transChange> fig trees with <transChange type="added">ripe</transChange> firstfruits—<l eID="gen24964" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24965"/>if they are shaken, they will fall into the mouth of the eater. <l eID="gen24965" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10305"/><l level="1" sID="gen24966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10305"/>Look! Your troops <transChange type="added">are like</transChange> women in your midst.<l eID="gen24966" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24967"/>The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies;<l eID="gen24967" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24968"/>fire will consume the bars <transChange type="added">of your gates</transChange>. <l eID="gen24968" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10306"/><l level="1" sID="gen24969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10306"/>Draw water for a siege!<l eID="gen24969" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24970"/>Strengthen your fortifications!<l eID="gen24970" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24971"/>Go to the mud <transChange type="added">pit</transChange>!<l eID="gen24971" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24972"/>Trample the clay!<l eID="gen24972" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24973"/>Grasp the brick mold! <l eID="gen24973" level="3"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10307"/><l level="1" sID="gen24974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10307"/>There fire will consume you;<l eID="gen24974" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24975"/>the sword will cut you off.<l eID="gen24975" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24976"/>It will consume you like the locust.<l eID="gen24976" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen24963"/> <title type="x-s">Nineveh’s Defenders Will Flee</title> <div sID="gen24977" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24977" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24978"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24979"/>Multiply yourself like the locust!<l eID="gen24979" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24980"/>Multiply yourself like the grasshopper! <l eID="gen24980" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10308"/><l level="1" sID="gen24981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10308"/>You have increased your merchants more than the stars of heaven;<l eID="gen24981" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24982"/><transChange type="added">like</transChange> the locust they will shed <transChange type="added">their skin</transChange> and fly away. <l eID="gen24982" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10309"/><l level="1" sID="gen24983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10309"/>Your officials <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like locusts;<l eID="gen24983" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24984"/>your commanders <transChange type="added">are</transChange> like a swarm of locusts.<l eID="gen24984" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24985"/>They encamp on the walls on a cold day;<l eID="gen24985" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24986"/>when the sun rises, they fly away—<l eID="gen24986" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen24987"/>no one knows where they have gone.<l eID="gen24987" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen24978"/> <title type="x-s">Nineveh Will Come to an End</title> <div sID="gen24988" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen24988" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10310"/><lg sID="gen24989"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10310"/>Your shepherds are sleeping, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> king of Assyria!<l eID="gen24990" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24991"/>Your nobles slumber.<l eID="gen24991" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24992"/>Your people are scattered on the mountains;<l eID="gen24992" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24993"/>no one can gather them. <l eID="gen24993" level="2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10311"/><l level="1" sID="gen24994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10311"/>There is no healing for your wound;<l eID="gen24994" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24995"/>your injury is fatal.<l eID="gen24995" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24996"/>All who hear the report of you will clap <transChange type="added">their</transChange> hands <transChange type="added">for joy</transChange> concerning you,<l eID="gen24996" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen24997"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞For who has not suffered at the hands of your endless cruelty⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “For over whom has your endless cruelty not passed?”</note> <l eID="gen24997" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24989"/> <chapter eID="Nah.3"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen24801" osisID="Nah" type="book"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10312"/><title type="x-s">Habakkuk’s Complaint</title> <div sID="gen24999" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen24999" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25000"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10312"/>The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet saw. <l eID="gen25001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10313"/><l level="1" sID="gen25002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10313"/>O Yahweh, how long shall I cry for help<l eID="gen25002" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25003"/>and you will not listen?<l eID="gen25003" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25004"/><transChange type="added">How long</transChange> will I cry out to you, “Violence!”<l eID="gen25004" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25005"/>and you will not save? <l eID="gen25005" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10314"/><l level="1" sID="gen25006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10314"/>Why do you cause me to see evil<l eID="gen25006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25007"/><transChange type="added">while</transChange> you look at trouble?<l eID="gen25007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25008"/>Destruction and violence happen before me;<l eID="gen25008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25009"/>contention and strife arise. <l eID="gen25009" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10315"/><l level="1" sID="gen25010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10315"/>Therefore the law is paralyzed,<l eID="gen25010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25011"/>and justice does not go forth perpetually.<note placement="foot">Or “forever”</note><l eID="gen25011" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25012"/>For the wicked surround the righteous;<l eID="gen25012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25013"/>therefore justice goes forth perverted.<l eID="gen25013" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen25000"/> <title type="x-s">God’s Answer to Habakkuk</title> <div sID="gen25014" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen25014" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10316"/><lg sID="gen25015"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10316"/>“Look among the nations and see;<l eID="gen25016" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25017"/>be astonished and astounded.<l eID="gen25017" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25018"/>For a work <transChange type="added">is about to</transChange> be done in your days<l eID="gen25018" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25019"/>that you will not believe if it is told. <l eID="gen25019" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10317"/><l level="1" sID="gen25020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10317"/>For look! I am raising up the Chaldeans,<l eID="gen25020" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25021"/>the bitter and impetuous nation,<l eID="gen25021" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25022"/>the one who walks through the spacious places of earth<l eID="gen25022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25023"/>to take possession of dwellings not belonging to it.<note placement="foot">Or “him”</note> <l eID="gen25023" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10318"/><l level="1" sID="gen25024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10318"/>They<note placement="foot">Hebrew “He”</note> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> dreadful and awesome;<l eID="gen25024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25025"/>their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> justice and their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> dignity proceed from themselves.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> <l eID="gen25025" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10319"/><l level="1" sID="gen25026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10319"/>Their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “His”</note> horses <transChange type="added">are</transChange> more swift than leopards;<l eID="gen25026" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25027"/>they are more menacing than wolves <transChange type="added">at</transChange> dusk.<l eID="gen25027" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25028"/>Their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “His”</note> horsemen gallop; their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> horsemen come from afar;<l eID="gen25028" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25029"/>they fly like an eagle <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> swift to devour. <l eID="gen25029" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10320"/><l level="1" sID="gen25030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10320"/>All of them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> come for violence,<l eID="gen25030" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25031"/>their faces pressing forward.<l eID="gen25031" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25032"/>They gather captives like the sand. <l eID="gen25032" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10321"/><l level="1" sID="gen25033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10321"/>And they themselves scoff at kings<l eID="gen25033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25034"/>and rulers <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a joke to them.<l eID="gen25034" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25035"/>They laugh at every fortification,<l eID="gen25035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25036"/>and they heap up earth and take it. <l eID="gen25036" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10322"/><l level="1" sID="gen25037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10322"/>Then they sweep <transChange type="added">like the</transChange> wind and pass on;<l eID="gen25037" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25038"/>they become guilty, whose might <transChange type="added">is</transChange> their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> god!”<l eID="gen25038" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen25015"/> <title type="x-s">Habakkuk’s Second Complaint</title> <div sID="gen25039" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen25039" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10323"/><lg sID="gen25040"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10323"/>Are you not from of old,<l eID="gen25041" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25042"/>O Yahweh my God, my Holy One?<l eID="gen25042" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25043"/>You<note placement="foot">Hebrew “we shall not die,” considered a deliberate scribal change of the text to avoid offensive language toward Yahweh</note> shall not die.<l eID="gen25043" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25044"/>O Yahweh, you have marked them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> for judgment;<l eID="gen25044" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25045"/>O Rock, you have established them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note> for reproof. <l eID="gen25045" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10324"/><l level="1" sID="gen25046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10324"/>Your eyes <transChange type="added">are</transChange> too pure to see evil,<l eID="gen25046" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25047"/>and you are not able to look at wrongdoing.<note placement="foot">Or “trouble”</note><l eID="gen25047" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25048"/>Why do you look at the treacherous?<l eID="gen25048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25049"/><transChange type="added">Why</transChange> are you silent when the wicked swallows up<l eID="gen25049" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25050"/><transChange type="added">someone</transChange> more righteous than him? <l eID="gen25050" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10325"/><l level="1" sID="gen25051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10325"/>You make humankind like fish of the sea,<l eID="gen25051" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25052"/>like crawling creatures that have no ruler among them. <l eID="gen25052" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10326"/><l level="1" sID="gen25053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10326"/>He brings up all of them with a fishhook;<l eID="gen25053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25054"/>he drags them up with a fishnet;<l eID="gen25054" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25055"/>he gathers them in his dragnet.<l eID="gen25055" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25056"/>Therefore, he rejoices and exults. <l eID="gen25056" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10327"/><l level="1" sID="gen25057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10327"/>Therefore he sacrifices to his fishnet<l eID="gen25057" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25058"/>and makes offerings to his dragnet,<l eID="gen25058" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25059"/>for by them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he makes a good living⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his portion is fat”</note><l eID="gen25059" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25060"/>and his food <transChange type="added">is</transChange> rich. <l eID="gen25060" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10328"/><l level="1" sID="gen25061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10328"/>Will he therefore empty his fishnet<l eID="gen25061" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25062"/>and continually kill nations without showing mercy? <l eID="gen25062" level="2"/><lg eID="gen25040"/> <chapter eID="Hab.1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10329"/><title type="x-s">The Righteous Will Live by Faith</title> <div sID="gen25063" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen25063" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25064"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10329"/>I will stand at my post,<l eID="gen25065" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25066"/>and station myself on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> rampart.<l eID="gen25066" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25067"/>And I will keep watch to see what he will say to me,<l eID="gen25067" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25068"/>and what he will answer concerning my complaint. <l eID="gen25068" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10330"/><l level="1" sID="gen25069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10330"/>Then Yahweh answered me and said,<l eID="gen25069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25070"/>“Write <transChange type="added">the</transChange> vision and make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> plain on the tablet<l eID="gen25070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25071"/>so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it might be read quickly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “it might run reading upon it”</note> <l eID="gen25071" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10331"/><l level="1" sID="gen25072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10331"/>For <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> yet a vision for the appointed time;<l eID="gen25072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25073"/>it will give witness to the end, and it will not lie.<l eID="gen25073" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25074"/>If it tarries, wait for it,<l eID="gen25074" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25075"/>for it will surely come and not delay. <l eID="gen25075" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10332"/><l level="1" sID="gen25076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10332"/>Look! His spirit within him is puffed up;<l eID="gen25076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25077"/>it is not upright.<l eID="gen25077" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25078"/>But the righteous shall live by his faithfulness. <l eID="gen25078" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10333"/><l level="1" sID="gen25079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10333"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How much less⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And moreover because”</note> the defiant;<note placement="foot">“Defiant” follows the Dead Sea Scrolls (1QpHab)</note><l eID="gen25079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25080"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> arrogant, treacherous man?<l eID="gen25080" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25081"/>He who broadens his throat like Sheol,<l eID="gen25081" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25082"/>and who, like death, is not satisfied,<l eID="gen25082" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25083"/>and who gathers to himself all the nations,<l eID="gen25083" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25084"/>and harvested for himself all the peoples,<l eID="gen25084" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25085"/>will not succeed. <l eID="gen25085" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10334"/><l level="1" sID="gen25086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10334"/>Shall not all of these take up a taunt against him,<l eID="gen25086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25087"/>with ridicule and riddles against him, saying,<l eID="gen25087" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25088"/>‘Woe to him who heaps up what is not his’?<l eID="gen25088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25089"/><transChange type="added">For</transChange> how long?<l eID="gen25089" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25090"/>And, ‘<transChange type="added">Woe to him</transChange> who makes himself heavy with pledges’? <l eID="gen25090" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10335"/><l level="1" sID="gen25091"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10335"/>Will not your creditors suddenly rise up<l eID="gen25091" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25092"/>and awaken those who make you tremble?<l eID="gen25092" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25093"/>Then you shall be as plunder for them. <l eID="gen25093" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10336"/><l level="1" sID="gen25094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10336"/>Because you plundered many nations,<l eID="gen25094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25095"/>all the remaining nations will plunder you<l eID="gen25095" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25096"/>on account of the blood of humanity<l eID="gen25096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25097"/>and violence <transChange type="added">against the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen25097" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25098"/><transChange type="added">and against</transChange> cities and all who live in them. <l eID="gen25098" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10337"/><l level="1" sID="gen25099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10337"/>Woe to <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> obtains profit <transChange type="added">from</transChange> evil gain for his house,<l eID="gen25099" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25100"/>to set his nest on high,<l eID="gen25100" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25101"/>to be saved from the hand of misfortune! <l eID="gen25101" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10338"/><l level="1" sID="gen25102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10338"/>You have plotted shame for your house,<l eID="gen25102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25103"/>cutting off many peoples<l eID="gen25103" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25104"/>and sinning against your life. <l eID="gen25104" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10339"/><l level="1" sID="gen25105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10339"/>For the stone will cry out from the wall,<l eID="gen25105" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25106"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> plaster from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wood will answer it. <l eID="gen25106" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10340"/><l level="1" sID="gen25107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10340"/>Woe to <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> builds a city by bloodguilt,<l eID="gen25107" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25108"/>and <transChange type="added">who</transChange> founds a city by wickedness! <l eID="gen25108" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10341"/><l level="1" sID="gen25109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10341"/>Look! <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not from Yahweh of hosts<l eID="gen25109" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25110"/>that people labor for mere fire,<l eID="gen25110" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25111"/>and nations exhaust themselves for mere vanity? <l eID="gen25111" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10342"/><l level="1" sID="gen25112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10342"/>For the earth will be filled<l eID="gen25112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25113"/>with the knowledge of the glory of Yahweh,<l eID="gen25113" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25114"/>like the waters covering the sea. <l eID="gen25114" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10343"/><l level="1" sID="gen25115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10343"/>Woe to <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> gives a drink to his neighbors,<l eID="gen25115" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25116"/>pouring out your wrath and also making <transChange type="added">them</transChange> drunk<l eID="gen25116" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25117"/>in order to see their nakedness! <l eID="gen25117" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10344"/><l level="1" sID="gen25118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10344"/>You will be sated with shame rather than glory.<l eID="gen25118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25119"/>Drink also yourself, and expose yourself!<l eID="gen25119" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25120"/>The cup of the right hand of Yahweh<l eID="gen25120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25121"/>will come around upon you<l eID="gen25121" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25122"/>and disgrace upon your glory. <l eID="gen25122" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10345"/><l level="1" sID="gen25123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10345"/>For <transChange type="added">the</transChange> violence of Lebanon will cover you,<l eID="gen25123" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25124"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> destruction of wild animals will shatter them<l eID="gen25124" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25125"/>on account of the blood of humanity,<l eID="gen25125" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25126"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> violence <transChange type="added">against the</transChange> land,<l eID="gen25126" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25127"/><transChange type="added">against</transChange> a city and all the inhabitants in it. <l eID="gen25127" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10346"/><l level="1" sID="gen25128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10346"/>What value <transChange type="added">is</transChange> an idol<l eID="gen25128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25129"/>when its carver has fashioned it,<l eID="gen25129" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25130"/>a molten idol, a teacher of lies?<l eID="gen25130" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25131"/>For <transChange type="added">he who</transChange> fashioned his creation trusts in it,<l eID="gen25131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25132"/><transChange type="added">though</transChange> making mute idols! <l eID="gen25132" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10347"/><l level="1" sID="gen25133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10347"/>Woe to <transChange type="added">him who</transChange> says to the wood, ‘Wake up!’<l eID="gen25133" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25134"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> to a lifeless stone, ‘Arise!’<l eID="gen25134" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25135"/>Can he teach?<l eID="gen25135" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25136"/>Look, it is covered <transChange type="added">with</transChange> gold and silver,<l eID="gen25136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25137"/>and there is no breath within it. <l eID="gen25137" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10348"/><l level="1" sID="gen25138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10348"/>But Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in his holy temple.<l eID="gen25138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25139"/>Let all the earth be silent before him.” <l eID="gen25139" level="2"/><lg eID="gen25064"/> <chapter eID="Hab.2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10349"/><title type="x-s">The Prayer of Habakkuk</title> <div sID="gen25140" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen25140" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25141"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10349"/>A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth. <l eID="gen25142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10350"/><l level="1" sID="gen25143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10350"/>O Yahweh, I have heard the report of you;<l eID="gen25143" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25144"/>O Yahweh, I stand in awe of your works.<l eID="gen25144" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25145"/>In the midst of the years, revive it!<l eID="gen25145" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25146"/>In the midst of the years, make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> known!<l eID="gen25146" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25147"/>In wrath, may you remember to show compassion. <l eID="gen25147" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10351"/><l level="1" sID="gen25148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10351"/>God came from Teman;<l eID="gen25148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25149"/>the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah<l eID="gen25149" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25150"/>His splendor covers the heavens,<l eID="gen25150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25151"/>and his praise fills the earth. <l eID="gen25151" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10352"/><l level="1" sID="gen25152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10352"/>And his brightness was like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> light;<l eID="gen25152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25153"/>flashing rays <transChange type="added">came</transChange> from his hand for him;<l eID="gen25153" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25154"/>And there <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the covering of his strength. <l eID="gen25154" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10353"/><l level="1" sID="gen25155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10353"/>Before him went Disease,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term is also the name of a Canaanite deity</note><l eID="gen25155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25156"/>and Pestilence<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term is also the name of a Canaanite deity</note> went out at his feet. <l eID="gen25156" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10354"/><l level="1" sID="gen25157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10354"/>He stood and measured the earth;<l eID="gen25157" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25158"/>he looked and made the nations tremble.<l eID="gen25158" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25159"/>Then the mountains of old were shattered;<l eID="gen25159" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25160"/>the hills of old collapsed.<l eID="gen25160" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25161"/>The ways of old belong to him. <l eID="gen25161" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10355"/><l level="1" sID="gen25162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10355"/>Under affliction I saw the tents of Cushan;<l eID="gen25162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25163"/>the tent curtains of the land of Midian trembled. <l eID="gen25163" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10356"/><l level="1" sID="gen25164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10356"/>Was the anger of Yahweh against the rivers?<l eID="gen25164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25165"/>Was your wrath against the rivers,<l eID="gen25165" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25166"/>or your fury against the sea,<l eID="gen25166" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25167"/>when you mounted upon your horses,<l eID="gen25167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25168"/>upon your victory chariot? <l eID="gen25168" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10357"/><l level="1" sID="gen25169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10357"/>You laid bare the nakedness of your bow,<l eID="gen25169" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25170"/>swearing oaths <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> arrows of <transChange type="added">your</transChange> word.<l eID="gen25170" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25171"/>You split the earth <transChange type="added">with</transChange> rivers. <l eID="gen25171" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10358"/><l level="1" sID="gen25172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10358"/><transChange type="added">When the</transChange> mountains saw you they writhed;<l eID="gen25172" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25173"/>a torrent of waters swept by;<l eID="gen25173" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25174"/>the deep gave its voice;<l eID="gen25174" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25175"/>it raised its hands on high. <l eID="gen25175" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10359"/><l level="1" sID="gen25176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10359"/>Sun <transChange type="added">and</transChange> moon stood still in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> place;<l eID="gen25176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25177"/>at the light of your arrows they moved about;<l eID="gen25177" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25178"/>at the gleam of the flashing of your spear. <l eID="gen25178" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10360"/><l level="1" sID="gen25179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10360"/>In fury you marched through <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth;<l eID="gen25179" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25180"/>in anger you trampled the nations. <l eID="gen25180" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10361"/><l level="1" sID="gen25181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10361"/>You went forth for the salvation of your people,<l eID="gen25181" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25182"/>for the salvation of your anointed.<l eID="gen25182" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25183"/>You crushed the head of the house of wickedness,<l eID="gen25183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25184"/>laying bare <transChange type="added">from the</transChange> foundation to the top.<note placement="foot">Or “to the neck”</note> <l eID="gen25184" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10362"/><l level="1" sID="gen25185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10362"/>You pierced the head of his warriors with his own arrows;<l eID="gen25185" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25186"/>they came like a whirlwind to scatter me,<l eID="gen25186" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25187"/>their exultation like <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> devours the afflicted in ambush. <l eID="gen25187" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10363"/><l level="1" sID="gen25188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10363"/>You trampled upon the sea <transChange type="added">with</transChange> your horses,<l eID="gen25188" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25189"/>the churning of many waters. <l eID="gen25189" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10364"/><l level="1" sID="gen25190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10364"/>I hear and my stomach shakes;<l eID="gen25190" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25191"/>my lips quiver at the sound;<l eID="gen25191" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25192"/>infection enters my bones;<l eID="gen25192" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25193"/>that which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> beneath me trembles;<l eID="gen25193" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25194"/>I wait quietly for the day of trouble<l eID="gen25194" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25195"/>to come upon the people attacking us. <l eID="gen25195" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10365"/><l level="1" sID="gen25196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10365"/>Though the fig tree <transChange type="added">does</transChange> not blossom,<l eID="gen25196" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25197"/>nor there be fruit on the vines;<l eID="gen25197" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25198"/>the yield of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> olive tree fails,<l eID="gen25198" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25199"/>and the cultivated fields do not yield food;<l eID="gen25199" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25200"/><transChange type="added">the</transChange> flock is cut off from the animal pen,<l eID="gen25200" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25201"/>and there is no cattle in the stalls, <l eID="gen25201" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10366"/><l level="1" sID="gen25202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10366"/>Yet I will rejoice in Yahweh;<l eID="gen25202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25203"/>I will exult in the God of my salvation. <l eID="gen25203" level="2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10367"/><l level="1" sID="gen25204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10367"/>Yahweh, my Lord, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my strength;<l eID="gen25204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25205"/>he makes my feet like the deer;<l eID="gen25205" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25206"/>he causes me to walk on my high places.<l eID="gen25206" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25207"/>To the choirmaster with stringed instruments. <l eID="gen25207" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen25141"/> <chapter eID="Hab.3"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen24998" osisID="Hab" type="book"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10368"/><title type="x-s">Judah’s Impending Judgment</title> <div sID="gen25209" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10368"/>The word of Yahweh that came to Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.  <div eID="gen25209" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10369"/><lg sID="gen25210"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10369"/>“I will surely destroy everything<l eID="gen25211" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25212"/>from the face of the earth”—a declaration of Yahweh. <l eID="gen25212" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10370"/><l level="1" sID="gen25213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10370"/>“I will destroy humanity and beast;<l eID="gen25213" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25214"/>I will destroy the birds of the sky<l eID="gen25214" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25215"/>and the fish of the sea,<l eID="gen25215" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25216"/>and the stumbling blocks<note placement="foot">A reference to idols</note> with the wicked.<l eID="gen25216" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25217"/>And I will cut off humankind<l eID="gen25217" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25218"/>from the face of the earth”—a declaration of Yahweh. <l eID="gen25218" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10371"/><l level="1" sID="gen25219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10371"/>“And I will stretch out my hand against Judah<l eID="gen25219" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25220"/>and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem.<l eID="gen25220" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25221"/>And I will cut off from this place<l eID="gen25221" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25222"/>the remnant of Baal,<l eID="gen25222" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25223"/>and the name of idolatrous priests with the priests,<note placement="foot">The last phrase, “with the priests,” may be a later explanatory gloss</note> <l eID="gen25223" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10372"/><l level="1" sID="gen25224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10372"/>and those who bow down on the rooftops<l eID="gen25224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25225"/>to the host of heaven,<l eID="gen25225" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25226"/>and those who bow down, swearing to Yahweh<l eID="gen25226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25227"/>but <transChange type="added">also</transChange> swearing by Milkom,<note placement="foot">Or “their king”</note> <l eID="gen25227" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10373"/><l level="1" sID="gen25228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10373"/>and those who turned back from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞following⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “after”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen25228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25229"/>and who did not seek Yahweh,<l eID="gen25229" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25230"/>and did not inquire of him.” <l eID="gen25230" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10374"/><l level="1" sID="gen25231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10374"/>Be silent before the Lord Yahweh,<l eID="gen25231" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25232"/>for the day of Yahweh draws near,<l eID="gen25232" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25233"/>for Yahweh has provided a sacrifice<l eID="gen25233" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25234"/>and has consecrated his guests. <l eID="gen25234" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10375"/><l level="1" sID="gen25235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10375"/>And it shall be <transChange type="added">that</transChange> on the day of the sacrifice of Yahweh,<l eID="gen25235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25236"/>I will punish the officials<l eID="gen25236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25237"/>and the sons of the king<l eID="gen25237" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25238"/>and those who dress in foreign clothing. <l eID="gen25238" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10376"/><l level="1" sID="gen25239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10376"/>And on that day I will punish<l eID="gen25239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25240"/>all who leap over the threshold,<l eID="gen25240" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25241"/>who fill up the house of their master<l eID="gen25241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25242"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> violence and deceit. <l eID="gen25242" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10377"/><l level="1" sID="gen25243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10377"/>“And there shall be on that day”—a declaration of Yahweh—<l eID="gen25243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25244"/>“a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞loud outcry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “voice of a cry of distress”</note> from the Fish Gate,<l eID="gen25244" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25245"/>and a wailing from the Second District,<l eID="gen25245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25246"/>and a loud<note placement="foot">Or “great”</note> crashing from the hills. <l eID="gen25246" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10378"/><l level="1" sID="gen25247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10378"/>The inhabitants of the Mortar shall wail,<l eID="gen25247" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25248"/>for all the traders have perished;<l eID="gen25248" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25249"/>all who trade with silver have been cut off. <l eID="gen25249" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10379"/><l level="1" sID="gen25250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10379"/>And it shall be <transChange type="added">that</transChange> at that time<l eID="gen25250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25251"/>I will search Jerusalem with lamps,<l eID="gen25251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25252"/>and I will punish the men<l eID="gen25252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25253"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose senses are dulled from drinking⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “who are thickened with their dregs”</note><l eID="gen25253" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25254"/>who say in their hearts,<l eID="gen25254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25255"/>‘Yahweh will not do good, nor will he do evil.’ <l eID="gen25255" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10380"/><l level="1" sID="gen25256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10380"/>Then their wealth shall be as plunder,<l eID="gen25256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25257"/>and their homes as desolation.<l eID="gen25257" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25258"/>And they shall build their houses and not inhabit them,<l eID="gen25258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25259"/>and they shall plant vineyards and not drink their wine.” <l eID="gen25259" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:14
