verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10381"/><l level="1" sID="gen25260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10381"/>The great day of Yahweh draws near;<l eID="gen25260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25261"/><transChange type="added">it is</transChange> near and <transChange type="added">coming</transChange> very swiftly.<l eID="gen25261" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25262"/>The sound of the day of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> bitterness;<l eID="gen25262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25263"/>there, a warrior cries out! <l eID="gen25263" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10382"/><l level="1" sID="gen25264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10382"/>That day <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> a day of wrath,<l eID="gen25264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25265"/>a day of trouble and distress,<l eID="gen25265" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25266"/>a day of disaster and ruination,<l eID="gen25266" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25267"/>a day of darkness and deep gloom,<l eID="gen25267" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25268"/>a day of clouds<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cloud”</note> and thick clouds,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “cloud”</note> <l eID="gen25268" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10383"/><l level="1" sID="gen25269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10383"/>a day of trumpet and <transChange type="added">trumpet</transChange> blast<l eID="gen25269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25270"/>against the fortified cities<l eID="gen25270" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25271"/>and against the high corner towers. <l eID="gen25271" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10384"/><l level="1" sID="gen25272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10384"/>And I will bring distress to all humankind,<l eID="gen25272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25273"/>and they shall walk about like the blind,<l eID="gen25273" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25274"/>for they sinned against Yahweh;<l eID="gen25274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25275"/>their blood shall be poured out like dust<l eID="gen25275" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25276"/>and their entrails like dung. <l eID="gen25276" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10385"/><l level="1" sID="gen25277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10385"/>Moreover, their silver and their gold<l eID="gen25277" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25278"/>will not be able to save them<l eID="gen25278" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25279"/>on the day of the wrath of Yahweh.<l eID="gen25279" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25280"/>And in the fire of his zeal,<l eID="gen25280" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25281"/>the whole land shall be consumed,<l eID="gen25281" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25282"/>for a terrifying end he shall make<l eID="gen25282" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25283"/><transChange type="added">for</transChange> all the inhabitants of the land. <l eID="gen25283" level="2"/><lg eID="gen25210"/> <chapter eID="Zeph.1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10386"/><title type="x-s">Judgment of Judah’s Enemies</title> <div sID="gen25284" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen25284" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25285"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10386"/>Gather yourselves together! Now gather together,<l eID="gen25286" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25287"/>O nation having no shame! <l eID="gen25287" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10387"/><l level="1" sID="gen25288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10387"/>Before the birth of the decree,<l eID="gen25288" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25289"/>the day flies away like chaff;<l eID="gen25289" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25290"/>before the fierce anger of Yahweh overtakes you;<l eID="gen25290" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25291"/>before the day of the anger of Yahweh overtakes you. <l eID="gen25291" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10388"/><l level="1" sID="gen25292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10388"/>Seek Yahweh, all you afflicted of the land<l eID="gen25292" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25293"/>who have fulfilled his law;<l eID="gen25293" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25294"/>seek righteousness;<l eID="gen25294" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25295"/>seek humility.<l eID="gen25295" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25296"/>Perhaps you will be concealed<l eID="gen25296" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25297"/>on the day of the anger of Yahweh. <l eID="gen25297" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10389"/><l level="1" sID="gen25298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10389"/>For Gaza will be abandoned,<l eID="gen25298" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25299"/>and Ashkelon as a desolation.<l eID="gen25299" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25300"/><transChange type="added">As for</transChange> Ashdod, at noon they will drive her away,<l eID="gen25300" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25301"/>and Ekron shall be uprooted. <l eID="gen25301" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10390"/><l level="1" sID="gen25302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10390"/>Woe <transChange type="added">to you</transChange>, inhabitants of the region of the sea,<l eID="gen25302" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25303"/>people of the Kerethites!<l eID="gen25303" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25304"/>The word of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> against you,<l eID="gen25304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25305"/>O Canaan, land of the Philistines.<l eID="gen25305" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25306"/>I will destroy you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞until there is no inhabitant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “from there is not an inhabitant”</note> <l eID="gen25306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10391"/><l level="1" sID="gen25307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10391"/>And you, O region of the sea, shall become<l eID="gen25307" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25308"/>pastures <transChange type="added">and</transChange> meadows <transChange type="added">for</transChange> shepherds<l eID="gen25308" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25309"/>and sheep pens <transChange type="added">for the</transChange> flocks. <l eID="gen25309" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10392"/><l level="1" sID="gen25310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10392"/>And it shall become a region<l eID="gen25310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25311"/>for the remnant of the house of Judah;<l eID="gen25311" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25312"/>upon them they shall graze,<l eID="gen25312" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25313"/>and in the houses of Ashkelon<l eID="gen25313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25314"/>they shall lie down in the evening.<l eID="gen25314" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25315"/>For Yahweh their God shall be mindful of them,<l eID="gen25315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25316"/>and he will restore their fortunes. <l eID="gen25316" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10393"/><l level="1" sID="gen25317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10393"/>I have heard the reproaches of Moab<l eID="gen25317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25318"/>and the scorning of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Ammon”</note><l eID="gen25318" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25319"/><transChange type="added">with</transChange> which they have taunted my nation<l eID="gen25319" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25320"/>and made boasts against their territory. <l eID="gen25320" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10394"/><l level="1" sID="gen25321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10394"/>“Therefore, as I live”—a declaration of Yahweh of hosts,<l eID="gen25321" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25322"/>the God of Israel—<l eID="gen25322" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25323"/>“Moab shall be as Sodom,<l eID="gen25323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25324"/>and the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Ammonites⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons/children of Ammon”</note> like Gomorrah,<l eID="gen25324" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25325"/>a place of weeds and salt pits<l eID="gen25325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25326"/>and a desolation forever.<l eID="gen25326" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25327"/>The remnant of my people shall plunder them,<l eID="gen25327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25328"/>and the remainder of my nation shall possess them.” <l eID="gen25328" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10395"/><l level="1" sID="gen25329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10395"/>This <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> for them in place of their pride<l eID="gen25329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25330"/>because they mocked and boasted<l eID="gen25330" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25331"/>against the people of Yahweh of hosts. <l eID="gen25331" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10396"/><l level="1" sID="gen25332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10396"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> awesome against them,<l eID="gen25332" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25333"/>for he will destroy all the gods of the earth<l eID="gen25333" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25334"/>and all the lands<note placement="foot">Or “islands”</note> of the nations;<l eID="gen25334" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25335"/>each in its place will bow down to him. <l eID="gen25335" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10397"/><l level="1" sID="gen25336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10397"/>You also, O Cushites,<l eID="gen25336" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25337"/>they shall be killed by my sword. <l eID="gen25337" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10398"/><l level="1" sID="gen25338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10398"/>And he will stretch out his hand against the north,<l eID="gen25338" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25339"/>and he will destroy Assyria<l eID="gen25339" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25340"/>and will make Nineveh a desolation,<l eID="gen25340" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25341"/>a dry wasteland like the desert. <l eID="gen25341" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10399"/><l level="1" sID="gen25342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10399"/>Herds shall lie down in her midst,<l eID="gen25342" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25343"/>every wild animal of a nation;<l eID="gen25343" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25344"/>even the desert owl and the screech owl<l eID="gen25344" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25345"/>shall lodge on her capitals.<l eID="gen25345" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25346"/>A voice shall hoot in the window;<l eID="gen25346" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25347"/>rubble<note placement="foot">The traditional Hebrew text has “waste,” while LXX has “a raven,” reflecting a different word with one consonant changed</note> on the threshold;<l eID="gen25347" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25348"/>for the cedar <transChange type="added">is</transChange> laid bare. <l eID="gen25348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10400"/><l level="1" sID="gen25349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10400"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the city of rejoicing<l eID="gen25349" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25350"/>that lived securely;<l eID="gen25350" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25351"/>the one saying in her heart,<l eID="gen25351" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25352"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am, and there is none besides me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “I am and none me”</note><l eID="gen25352" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25353"/>How she has become a desolation,<l eID="gen25353" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25354"/>a lair for wild animals!<l eID="gen25354" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25355"/>Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist. <l eID="gen25355" level="1"/><lg eID="gen25285"/> <chapter eID="Zeph.2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10401"/><title type="x-s">Judgment of Jerusalem and the Nations</title> <div sID="gen25356" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen25356" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25357"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10401"/>Woe <transChange type="added">to you</transChange>, O rebellious and defiled one!<l eID="gen25358" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25359"/>The oppressing city! <l eID="gen25359" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10402"/><l level="1" sID="gen25360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10402"/>She listens to no voice;<l eID="gen25360" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25361"/>she does not accept correction.<l eID="gen25361" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25362"/>In Yahweh she does not trust;<l eID="gen25362" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25363"/>to her God she does not draw near. <l eID="gen25363" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10403"/><l level="1" sID="gen25364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10403"/>Her officials in her midst <transChange type="added">are</transChange> roaring lions;<l eID="gen25364" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25365"/>her judges <transChange type="added">are</transChange> evening wolves;<l eID="gen25365" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen25366"/>they leave nothing until the morning. <l eID="gen25366" level="3"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10404"/><l level="1" sID="gen25367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10404"/>Her prophets <transChange type="added">are</transChange> arrogant men of treachery;<l eID="gen25367" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25368"/>her priests have defiled <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> holy;<l eID="gen25368" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen25369"/>they do violence to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> law. <l eID="gen25369" level="3"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10405"/><l level="1" sID="gen25370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10405"/>Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> righteous in her midst;<l eID="gen25370" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25371"/>he does not do wickedness.<l eID="gen25371" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25372"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Morning by morning⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “In the morning, in the morning”</note> he renders his judgment;<l eID="gen25372" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25373"/>at dawn he does not fail,<l eID="gen25373" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25374"/>but an evil one knows no shame. <l eID="gen25374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10406"/><l level="1" sID="gen25375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10406"/>“I have cut off nations;<l eID="gen25375" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25376"/>their strongholds are deserted.<l eID="gen25376" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25377"/>I have laid waste their streets,<l eID="gen25377" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25378"/>so that none pass through.<l eID="gen25378" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25379"/>Their cities have been destroyed<l eID="gen25379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25380"/><transChange type="added">and are</transChange> without a man, without an inhabitant. <l eID="gen25380" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10407"/><l level="1" sID="gen25381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10407"/>I have said, ‘Surely she will fear me;<l eID="gen25381" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25382"/>she will accept discipline.<l eID="gen25382" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25383"/>Then her dwelling place will not be cut down,<l eID="gen25383" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25384"/><transChange type="added">nor</transChange> all that I have brought upon her.’<l eID="gen25384" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25385"/>Surely they rise early;<l eID="gen25385" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25386"/>they make all their deeds corrupt. <l eID="gen25386" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10408"/><l level="1" sID="gen25387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10408"/>“Therefore, wait for me”—a declaration of Yahweh—<l eID="gen25387" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25388"/>“for the day of my rising as a witness.<l eID="gen25388" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25389"/>For my decision <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to gather nations,<l eID="gen25389" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25390"/>to assemble<note placement="foot">The traditional Hebrew has “assemble me”; this translation follows LXX</note> kingdoms,<l eID="gen25390" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25391"/>to pour out my wrath upon them, all my burning anger.<l eID="gen25391" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25392"/>For by the fire of my anger all the land shall be consumed. <l eID="gen25392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10409"/><l level="1" sID="gen25393"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10409"/>Because then I will <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞make the speech of the nations pure⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “I will turn to the nations a purged lip”</note><l eID="gen25393" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25394"/>that all of them might call on the name of Yahweh,<l eID="gen25394" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25395"/>to serve him <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in unison⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “with one shoulder”</note> <l eID="gen25395" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10410"/><l level="1" sID="gen25396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10410"/>From beyond the rivers of Cush<l eID="gen25396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25397"/>my worshipers and the daughter of my scattered ones<l eID="gen25397" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25398"/>shall bring my offering. <l eID="gen25398" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10411"/><l level="1" sID="gen25399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10411"/>On that day you shall not be humiliated<l eID="gen25399" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25400"/>on account of all your deeds<l eID="gen25400" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25401"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange> which you have rebelled against me.<l eID="gen25401" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25402"/>For then I shall remove from your midst<l eID="gen25402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25403"/>those exulting in your pride,<l eID="gen25403" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25404"/>and you shall no longer be haughty<l eID="gen25404" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25405"/>in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my holy mountain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of my holiness”</note> <l eID="gen25405" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10412"/><l level="1" sID="gen25406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10412"/>And I will leave in your midst<l eID="gen25406" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25407"/>a people afflicted and poor,<l eID="gen25407" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25408"/>and they shall take refuge<l eID="gen25408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25409"/>in the name of Yahweh. <l eID="gen25409" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10413"/><l level="1" sID="gen25410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10413"/>The remnant of Israel<l eID="gen25410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25411"/>shall not do wickedness;<l eID="gen25411" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25412"/>they shall not speak deception,<l eID="gen25412" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25413"/>nor shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth.<l eID="gen25413" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25414"/>For they shall graze and lie down,<l eID="gen25414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25415"/>and none shall frighten <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.” <l eID="gen25415" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10414"/><l level="1" sID="gen25416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10414"/>Shout for joy, O daughter of Zion!<l eID="gen25416" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25417"/>Cry aloud, O Israel!<l eID="gen25417" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25418"/>Rejoice and be jubilant with all your heart,<l eID="gen25418" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25419"/>O daughter of Jerusalem! <l eID="gen25419" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10415"/><l level="1" sID="gen25420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10415"/>Yahweh has annulled your judgments;<l eID="gen25420" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25421"/>he has turned away your enemies.<l eID="gen25421" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25422"/>The king of Israel, Yahweh, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your midst;<l eID="gen25422" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25423"/>you shall no longer fear misfortune. <l eID="gen25423" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10416"/><l level="1" sID="gen25424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10416"/>On that day it shall be said to Jerusalem,<l eID="gen25424" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25425"/>“Fear not, O Zion;<l eID="gen25425" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25426"/>your hands shall not hang limp. <l eID="gen25426" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10417"/><l level="1" sID="gen25427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10417"/>Yahweh your God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in your midst;<l eID="gen25427" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25428"/>a mighty warrior who saves.<l eID="gen25428" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25429"/>He shall rejoice over you with joy;<l eID="gen25429" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25430"/>he renews<note placement="foot">The translation follows the LXX text; the traditional Hebrew text reads “he will silence you in his love”</note> you in his love;<l eID="gen25430" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25431"/>he will exult over you with singing. <l eID="gen25431" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10418"/><l level="1" sID="gen25432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10418"/>I will gather those of you grieving on account of the feast;<l eID="gen25432" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25433"/>they were raising against her a reproach. <l eID="gen25433" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10419"/><l level="1" sID="gen25434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10419"/>Behold, at that time I will deal with all your oppressors;<l eID="gen25434" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25435"/>I will save the lame and gather the outcast.<l eID="gen25435" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25436"/>I will change<note placement="foot">Or “make”</note> them from shame<l eID="gen25436" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25437"/>to glory and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞renown⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a name”</note> throughout the whole world. <l eID="gen25437" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10420"/><l level="1" sID="gen25438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10420"/>At that time I will bring you <transChange type="added">in</transChange>;<l eID="gen25438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25439"/>at the time of my gathering you <transChange type="added">together</transChange>.<l eID="gen25439" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25440"/>For I will make you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞renowned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a name”</note> and praised<l eID="gen25440" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25441"/>among all the nations of the earth<l eID="gen25441" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25442"/>when I restore your fortunes before your eyes,”<l eID="gen25442" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25443"/>says Yahweh. <l eID="gen25443" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen25357"/> <chapter eID="Zeph.3"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen25208" osisID="Zeph" type="book"/>

verses.name: Haggai 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10421"/><title type="x-s">The Temple Lies in Ruins</title> <div sID="gen25445" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10421"/>In the second year of King Darius, in the sixth month, on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> first day, the word of Yahweh came <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “through the hand of”</note> Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 1:2
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘This people says, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The time has not come to rebuild the temple of Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “The time is not coming, the time for the house of Yahweh to be built”</note>

verses.name: Haggai 1:3
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh came <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “through the hand of”</note> Haggai the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 1:4
verses.text: “<transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> a time for you yourselves to dwell in your houses that have been paneled <transChange type="added">while</transChange> this house<note placement="foot">That is, the temple</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> desolate?”

verses.name: Haggai 1:5
verses.text: And so then, thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Consider your ways⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “Set your heart on your ways”</note>

verses.name: Haggai 1:6
verses.text: You have sown much but have harvested little. You have eaten without <transChange type="added">being</transChange> satisfied; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you have drunk without being satiated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “You have drunk, without becoming drunk”</note> you have worn clothes without being warm; the one who earns wages puts it in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a pouch with holes⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “a pierced pouch”</note>

verses.name: Haggai 1:7
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Consider your ways⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “Set your heart on your ways”</note>

verses.name: Haggai 1:8
verses.text: Go up the mountain and bring wood and build the house<note placement="foot">That is, the temple</note> so that I may be pleased with it and honored,’ says Yahweh.

verses.name: Haggai 1:9
verses.text: ‘You have looked for much, and look! <transChange type="added">It came</transChange> to little; and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> you brought <transChange type="added">it</transChange> home, I blew it <transChange type="added">away</transChange>. Why?’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of ”</note> Yahweh of hosts. ‘Because my house <transChange type="added">is</transChange> desolate and you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> running each to your own house!

verses.name: Haggai 1:10
verses.text: Therefore, because of you <transChange type="added">the</transChange> heavens have withheld <transChange type="added">the</transChange> dew and the earth has withheld its produce.

verses.name: Haggai 1:11
verses.text: I have called for a drought on the land and the hills,<note placement="foot">Or mountains</note> on the grain, the new wine, the olive oil, on what the soil produces, on human beings and wild animals,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “animal”</note> and on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all their labor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’ ”<note placement="foot">Literally “all the labor of the hands”</note>  <div eID="gen25445" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Haggai 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10422"/><div sID="gen25446" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10422"/>Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people gave heed to the voice of Yahweh their God and to the words of Haggai the prophet, as Yahweh their God had sent him, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞and the people feared Yahweh⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “and the people feared from before Yahweh”</note>

verses.name: Haggai 1:13
verses.text: And Haggai the messenger of Yahweh spoke to the people with the message of Yahweh, saying, “ ‘I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> with you’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.”

verses.name: Haggai 1:14
verses.text: And Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people. And they came and did <transChange type="added">the</transChange> work on the house of Yahweh of hosts, their God,

verses.name: Haggai 1:15
verses.text: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of King Darius.  <chapter eID="Hag.1"/>

verses.name: Haggai 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10423"/><title type="x-s">A Promise to Rebuild</title> <div sID="gen25447" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10423"/>In the seventh <transChange type="added">month</transChange> on the twenty-first day, the word of Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞came through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “came through the hand of”</note> Haggai the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 2:2
verses.text: “Speak now to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 2:3
verses.text: ‘Who among you <transChange type="added">is</transChange> left that saw this house in its former glory? And how do you see it now? Does it seem like nothing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “in your eyes”</note>

verses.name: Haggai 2:4
verses.text: ‘But now take courage,<note placement="foot">Or “be strong”</note> Zerubbabel,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. ‘Take courage,<note placement="foot">Or “Be strong”</note> Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and take courage,<note placement="foot">Or “be strong”</note> all the people of the land,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh. ‘Do the work, because I am with you,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts,

verses.name: Haggai 2:5
verses.text: ‘according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the promise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the word”</note> that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I covenanted⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I cut”</note> with you when you came out of Egypt. My spirit <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is with you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “is standing in your midst”</note> do not be afraid.’

verses.name: Haggai 2:6
verses.text: For thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘Once again, in a little while, I will shake the heavens and the earth and the sea and dry land.

verses.name: Haggai 2:7
verses.text: I will shake all the nations so that the treasure of all the nations will come, and I will fill this house<note placement="foot">That is, the temple</note> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> glory,’ says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Haggai 2:8
verses.text: ‘The silver <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine and the gold <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Haggai 2:9
verses.text: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of hosts, ‘and in this place I will give peace’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts.’ ”  <div eID="gen25447" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Haggai 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10424"/><div sID="gen25448" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10424"/>On <transChange type="added">the</transChange> twenty-fourth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the ninth <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, in the second year of Darius, the word of Yahweh came to the prophet Haggai, saying,

verses.name: Haggai 2:11
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘Ask now the priests <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a ruling:<note placement="foot">Or “a torah,” or “a law”</note>

verses.name: Haggai 2:12
verses.text: If a man carries<note placement="foot">Literally “lifts”</note> consecrated meat in the hem of his garment, and his hem touches bread, or stew, or wine, or olive oil, or any kind of food, will it become holy?’ ” The priests answered, “No.”

verses.name: Haggai 2:13
verses.text: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean from contact with a corpse touches any of these, will it become unclean?” The priests answered, “Yes, it will be become unclean.”

verses.name: Haggai 2:14
verses.text: And Haggai answered and said, “ ‘So <transChange type="added">it is with</transChange> this people, and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> this nation before me,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and so <transChange type="added">it is with</transChange> every kind of work of their hands; and what they offer there <transChange type="added">is</transChange> unclean.

verses.name: Haggai 2:15
verses.text: But now, please <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞consider⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “set your heart”</note> from this day forward, before one stone was placed on another in the temple of Yahweh,

verses.name: Haggai 2:16
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from that time when⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “from their being,” or “from the time they were then”</note> one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten, and when one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty measures,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “measure”</note> there were <transChange type="added">only</transChange> twenty.

verses.name: Haggai 2:17
verses.text: I struck you with blight, and with plant mildew, and hail, all the work of your hands. But <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you did not come back to me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,’<note placement="foot">Literally “there were none of you to me”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Haggai 2:18
verses.text: ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Please consider⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Please set your heart”</note> from this day forward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, from the day that the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was laid,<note placement="foot">Or “placed,” or “set”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞consider⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “set your heart”</note>

verses.name: Haggai 2:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> still seed in the store chamber? Do the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree still produce nothing? From this day <transChange type="added">forward</transChange> I will bless <transChange type="added">you</transChange>.’ ”  <div eID="gen25448" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Haggai 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10425"/><title type="x-s">The Coming Kingdom</title> <div sID="gen25449" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10425"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Haggai a second time on the twenty-fourth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the month saying,

verses.name: Haggai 2:21
verses.text: “Say to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to shake the heavens and the earth,

verses.name: Haggai 2:22
verses.text: and I will overthrow the thrones of kingdoms and destroy the military strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow chariots and their drivers; horses and their riders will fall, every one by the sword of another!

verses.name: Haggai 2:23
verses.text: ‘On that day,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts, ‘I will take you, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, my servant,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and I will make you a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts.”  <chapter eID="Hag.2"/> <div eID="gen25449" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen25444" osisID="Hag" type="book"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 1:1
verses.text: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of Yahweh came<note placement="foot">Literally “was”</note> to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, son of Iddo, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 1:2
verses.text: “Yahweh <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was very angry with your ancestors⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “was angry against your ancestors with anger”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 1:3
verses.text: You must say to them: ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts: “Return to me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts, “and I will return to you,” says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:4
verses.text: “Do not be like your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying, ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts: “Return from your evil ways and your evil deeds!” ’ But they did not hear<note placement="foot">Or “listen”</note> and they did not pay attention<note placement="foot">Or “give heed”</note> to me,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:5
verses.text: “Your ancestors,<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?

verses.name: Zechariah 1:6
verses.text: However, did not my words and my regulations which I commanded my servants the prophets overtake your ancestors?<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> And they repented and said, ‘Yahweh of hosts planned to do with us according to our ways, and according to our deeds so he has dealt with us.’ ” ’ ”  <div eID="gen25451" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10426"/><title type="x-s">Zechariah’s First Vision</title> <div sID="gen25452" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10426"/>On the twenty-fourth day of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of Yahweh came to Zechariah the prophet, son of Berekiah, son of Iddo, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 1:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I had a vision in the night⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I saw the night,” which means “I had a vision”</note> and look, a man riding on a red horse. And he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> standing between the myrtle shrubs that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> in the ravine, and behind him <transChange type="added">were</transChange> red, reddish-brown, and white horses.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:9
verses.text: And I asked, “What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these, my lord?” And the angel <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> talking with me said, “I will show you what these are.”

verses.name: Zechariah 1:10
verses.text: And the man standing between the myrtle shrubs answered and said, “These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> those whom Yahweh has sent to patrol<note placement="foot">Or “to go about,” or “to walk through”</note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth.”

verses.name: Zechariah 1:11
verses.text: And they answered the angel of Yahweh who was standing between the myrtle shrubs, and they said, “We have patrolled<note placement="foot">Or “have gone about,” or “have walked through”</note> the earth, and look, all the earth <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞is dwelling in peace⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “is dwelling and is at rest”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 1:12
verses.text: The angel of Yahweh answered and said, “O Yahweh of hosts, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞how long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until when”</note> will you have no compassion on Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, with which you showed fury these seventy years?”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “year”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 1:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">With</transChange> gracious<note placement="foot">Or “kind”; literally “good”</note> and comforting words Yahweh answered the angel who was talking with me.

verses.name: Zechariah 1:14
verses.text: And the angel who was talking with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts: “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am very jealous⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I am jealous with a great jealousy”</note> for Jerusalem and for Zion!

verses.name: Zechariah 1:15
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am extremely angry⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “With a great anger I am angry”</note> with the nations that are at ease, for while I was a little angry, they <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞furthered disaster⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “helped disaster”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 1:16
verses.text: Therefore, thus says Yahweh: “I have returned to Jerusalem with compassion. My temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> will be built in it,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts, “and a measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.” ’

verses.name: Zechariah 1:17
verses.text: Proclaim again, saying, ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts: “My cities shall again overflow from prosperity, and Yahweh will comfort Zion again, and he will choose Jerusalem again.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen25452" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10427"/><title type="x-s">Zechariah’s Second Vision</title> <div sID="gen25453" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10427"/><note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Zech.1.18">Zechariah 1:18–2:17 </reference>in the English Bible is 2:1–13 in the Hebrew Bible</note> And I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞looked up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lifted up my eyes”</note> and I saw, and look, <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> four horns!

verses.name: Zechariah 1:19
verses.text: And I said to the angel <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> talking with me, “What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these?” And he said to me, “These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”

verses.name: Zechariah 1:20
verses.text: Then Yahweh showed me four skilled craftsmen,

verses.name: Zechariah 1:21
verses.text: and I asked, “What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these coming to do?” And he answered, saying, “These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the horns that scattered Judah, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so that no man⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “according to the mouth of a man”</note> lifted up his head; but these have come to frighten them, to strike down the horns of the nations that lifted a horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”  <chapter eID="Zech.1"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10428"/><title type="x-s">Zechariah’s Third Vision</title> <div sID="gen25454" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10428"/>And I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞looked up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lifted up my eyes”</note> and I saw, and look, a man, and in his hand <transChange type="added">was</transChange> a measuring rope!

verses.name: Zechariah 2:2
verses.text: And I asked, “Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you going?” And he answered me, “To measure Jerusalem to see what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> its width and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> its length.”

verses.name: Zechariah 2:3
verses.text: And look, the angel who was talking to me <transChange type="added">was</transChange> coming forward, and another angel <transChange type="added">was</transChange> coming forward to meet him.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:4
verses.text: And he said to him, “Run, say to that young man, ‘Jerusalem shall be inhabited <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞like villages without walls⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “like open regions”</note> because of the multitude of people and animals in its midst.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:5
verses.text: And I will be for it a wall of fire all around,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘and I will be <transChange type="added">the</transChange> glory in its midst.’ ”  <div eID="gen25454" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10429"/><div sID="gen25455" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10429"/>“Woe! Woe! Flee from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> land of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh, “for I have scattered you like the four winds of the heavens,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:7
verses.text: “Woe, Zion! Escape, you inhabitants of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> daughter of Babylon!”

verses.name: Zechariah 2:8
verses.text: For thus said Yahweh of hosts, after glory<note placement="foot">The phrase “after glory” is difficult to interpret</note> he sent me against the nations plundering you: Truly, the one touching you is touching the apple<note placement="foot">Hebrew “pupil,” but the expression “apple of his eye” has become well-established in English</note> of his eye.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:9
verses.text: “Yes, look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to wave my hand against them, and they will become plunder for their servants, and you will know that Yahweh of hosts has sent me.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:10
verses.text: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion, for look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> coming and I will dwell in your midst,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a declaration of”</note> Yahweh.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:11
verses.text: “Many nations will join themselves to Yahweh on that day, and they will be my people, and I will dwell in your midst. And you will know that Yahweh of hosts has sent me to you.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:12
verses.text: And Yahweh will inherit Judah <transChange type="added">as</transChange> his portion <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in the holy land⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “upon the land of the holiness”</note> and he will again choose Jerusalem.

verses.name: Zechariah 2:13
verses.text: Be silent, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “all flesh”</note> before Yahweh, for he is roused from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his holy dwelling⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “the dwelling place of his holiness”</note>  <chapter eID="Zech.2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10430"/><title type="x-s">Zechariah’s Fourth Vision</title> <div sID="gen25456" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10430"/>And he showed me Joshua the high priest standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the angel of Yahweh; and Satan<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the accuser,” or “the adversary”</note> was standing on his right to accuse him.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:2
verses.text: But Yahweh said to Satan,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the accuser,” or “the adversary”</note> “Yahweh rebukes you, O Satan!<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the accuser,” or “the adversary”</note> Yahweh who has chosen Jerusalem rebukes you! <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> this not a stick snatched from the fire?”

verses.name: Zechariah 3:3
verses.text: And Joshua was clothed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> filthy garments and was standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> the angel.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:4
verses.text: And he answered and said to the ones standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> him, saying, “Remove the filthy garments from him.” And he said to him, “See, I have taken away your guilt<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers to guilt caused by sin (HALOT 800 s.v. <reference osisRef="Zech.3.2">2</reference>)</note> from you, and will clothe you <transChange type="added">with</transChange> rich garments.”

verses.name: Zechariah 3:5
verses.text: And I said, “Let them put a clean headband<note placement="foot">Or “turban”</note> on his head.” And they put a clean headband on his head, and they clothed him <transChange type="added">with</transChange> garments. And the angel of Yahweh <transChange type="added">was</transChange> standing <transChange type="added">by</transChange>.  <div eID="gen25456" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10431"/><div sID="gen25457" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10431"/>And the angel of Yahweh assured Joshua, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 3:7
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will keep my requirements, then you will judge<note placement="foot">Or “govern”</note> my house, and you will also guard my courtyards, and I will give to you passageways<note placement="foot">Or “right of access”</note> among these that are standing here.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:8
verses.text: Listen, please, O Joshua the high priest, you and your companions<note placement="foot">Possibly his fellow priests</note> that are sitting <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of”</note> you. For the men are a sign that,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “for”</note> look, I am going to bring my servant the Branch.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Sprout” or “Shoot” (“Branch” is a traditional rendering in English)</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 3:9
verses.text: For consider, the stone that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I set before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I gave to the face of, ”or “I gave in the presence of”</note> Joshua, on one stone are seven eyes.<note placement="foot">Or “facets”</note> Look, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am going to engrave an inscription on it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,’<note placement="foot">Literally “I am going to engrave its engraving”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts, ‘and I will remove the guilt of that land in a single day.

verses.name: Zechariah 3:10
verses.text: On that day,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts, ‘you will invite <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a man to his friend”</note> under <transChange type="added">the</transChange> vine and under <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fig tree.’ ”  <chapter eID="Zech.3"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10432"/><title type="x-s">Zechariah’s Fifth Vision</title> <div sID="gen25458" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10432"/>And the angel <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> talking with me returned, and he wakened me as one who is wakened from his sleep.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:2
verses.text: And he said to me, “What do you see?” And I said, “I see, and look, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a lampstand all of gold⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “a lampstand of gold in its totality”</note> and a bowl <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on its top, and its seven lamps on it, and seven lips on <transChange type="added">each of</transChange> the lamps that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> on its top.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:3
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> two olive trees by it, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left.”

verses.name: Zechariah 4:4
verses.text: And I answered and said to the angel <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> talking to me, “What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these, my lord?”

verses.name: Zechariah 4:5
verses.text: And the angel <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> talking with me answered and said to me, “Do you not know what these <transChange type="added">are</transChange>?” And I said, “No, my lord.”

verses.name: Zechariah 4:6
verses.text: And he answered and said to me, “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the word of Yahweh to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by strength and not by power, but <transChange type="added">only</transChange> by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:7
verses.text: ‘Who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you O great mountain? <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “To the face of”</note> Zerubbabel <transChange type="added">you will become</transChange> level ground, and he will bring out the top stone amid the shouts of “Grace, grace to it!” ’ ”

verses.name: Zechariah 4:8
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 4:9
verses.text: “The hands of Zerubbabel have founded this house, and his hands will finish it. And you will know that Yahweh of hosts has sent me to you.

verses.name: Zechariah 4:10
verses.text: For whoever has despised the day of small <transChange type="added">things</transChange> will rejoice and will see the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞plumb line⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the tin stone”; this could refer to a plumb line or a plummet</note> in the hand of Zerubbabel.” <div eID="gen25458" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen25459" type="x-p"/> These seven <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the eyes of Yahweh which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> ranging <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞throughout the whole earth⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “in all the earth”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 4:11
verses.text: And I answered and said to him, “What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these two olive trees on the right of the lampstand and on its left?”

verses.name: Zechariah 4:12
verses.text: And I replied a second <transChange type="added">time</transChange> and asked him, “What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these two twigs of olive trees<note placement="foot">Or “two clusters of olive branches”; literally “two ears of grain,” perhaps based on similarity of shape</note> on the right of the lampstand and on its left?”

verses.name: Zechariah 4:13
verses.text: And he replied to me, “Do you not know what these <transChange type="added">are</transChange>?” And I said, “No, my lord.”

verses.name: Zechariah 4:14
verses.text: And he said, “These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the two <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anointed ones⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “sons of the olive oil”</note> standing by the Lord of the whole earth.”  <chapter eID="Zech.4"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10433"/><title type="x-s">Zechariah’s Sixth Vision</title> <div sID="gen25460" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10433"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I looked up again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I did again, I lifted up my eyes”</note> and I saw, and look!—a flying scroll!

verses.name: Zechariah 5:2
verses.text: And he asked me, “What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> you seeing?” And I said, “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> seeing a flying scroll twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.”<note placement="foot">That is, thirty feet by fifteen feet</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 5:3
verses.text: And he said to me, “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the curse going out over the surface of the whole earth. For everyone who steals has gone unpunished<note placement="foot">Many translations render this verb as “will be cut off”</note> according to it, and <transChange type="added">likewise</transChange> everyone who swears <transChange type="added">falsely</transChange> has gone unpunished according to it.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:4
verses.text: ‘I have sent it out,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts, ‘and it will go into the house of the thief and into the house of the one swearing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely by my name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “by my name to lie”</note> and it will spend the night in that<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> house and will destroy it, with its timber and its stone.’ ”  <div eID="gen25460" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10434"/><title type="x-s">Zechariah’s Seventh Vision</title> <div sID="gen25461" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10434"/>And the angel who was speaking to me went out, and he said to me, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Please look up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “Lift, please, your eyes!”</note> See what this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> going out.”

verses.name: Zechariah 5:6
verses.text: And I asked, “What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> it?” And he said, “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a basket<note placement="foot">Or “an ephah,” a measure of grain</note> going out. And he said, “This is their iniquity<note placement="foot">Hebrew “eye”; other ancient versions (LXX, Syriac) read “iniquity”</note> throughout all the earth.

verses.name: Zechariah 5:7
verses.text: And look, the lead cover was lifted and a woman <transChange type="added">was</transChange> sitting inside the basket.<note placement="foot">Or “ephah,” a measure of grain</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 5:8
verses.text: And he said, “This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Wickedness!” And he thrust her <transChange type="added">back down</transChange> into the basket,<note placement="foot">Or “ephah,” a measure of grain</note> and threw the lead cover on top of it.<note placement="foot">That is, on top of the “basket” or “ephah”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 5:9
verses.text: And I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞looked up⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “lifted up my eyes”</note> and saw, and look!—two women coming forward, and the wind was in their wings, and they had wings like those of a stork, and they lifted up the basket<note placement="foot">Or “ephah,” a measure of grain</note> between the earth and the sky.<note placement="foot">Or “heaven”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 5:10
verses.text: And I asked the angel who was talking to me, “Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> they taking the basket?”<note placement="foot">Or “ephah,” a measure of grain</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 5:11
verses.text: And he said to me, “To build for it a house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> in the land of Shinar,<note placement="foot">That is, Babylon (<reference osisRef="Gen.11.2">Gen 11:2</reference>)</note> and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> it is put in place, it will be placed there on its site.”  <chapter eID="Zech.5"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10435"/><title type="x-s">Zechariah’s Eighth Vision</title> <div sID="gen25462" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10435"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I looked up again⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I did again, I lifted up my eyes”</note> and I saw, and look!—four chariots coming out from between two mountains, and the mountains <transChange type="added">were</transChange> mountains of bronze.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:2
verses.text: With the first chariot <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> red horses, and with the second chariot <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> black horses.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:3
verses.text: And with the third chariot <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> white horses, and with the fourth chariot <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> strong<note placement="foot">Other ancient versions read “grey” here</note> dappled horses.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:4
verses.text: And I answered and said to the angel <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> talking to me, “What <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these, my lord?”

verses.name: Zechariah 6:5
verses.text: And the angel answered and said to me, “These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the four winds<note placement="foot">Or “spirits” (The same Hebrew word can be translated “wind” or “spirit” depending on the context)</note> of the heavens going out after presenting themselves before the Lord of all the earth.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:6
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞The one with⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Her with which”</note> the black horses is going out to the north country, and the white horses go after them,<note placement="foot">Some interpret the word “after” to indicate a westward direction</note> while the dappled <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> go to the south country.”

verses.name: Zechariah 6:7
verses.text: When the strong <transChange type="added">horses</transChange> went out, they were anxious to go to patrol the earth. And he<note placement="foot">That is, “Lord of all the earth”</note> said, “Go, patrol the earth.” And they patrolled the earth.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:8
verses.text: And he cried out to me and said to me, “See those going out to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> north country have set my spirit at rest in the north country.”  <div eID="gen25462" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10436"/><title type="x-s">The Branch is Crowned</title> <div sID="gen25463" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10436"/>And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 6:10
verses.text: “Collect<note placement="foot">The imperative “Collect” has no object; many translations supply “silver and gold” or “an offering”</note> from the exiles—from Heldai, Tobijah, and from Jedaiah, <transChange type="added">all of</transChange> whom came from Babylon—and go on that day, go <transChange type="added">to the</transChange> house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:11
verses.text: Take <transChange type="added">the</transChange> silver and gold and make a crown, and set <transChange type="added">it</transChange> on the head of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:12
verses.text: And say to him, ‘Thus says Yahweh of hosts: “Look, <transChange type="added">here is</transChange> a man whose name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Branch,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “Sprout” or “Shoot” (“Branch” is a traditional rendering in English)</note> and from his place he will sprout, and he will build the temple of Yahweh.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:13
verses.text: And he will build the temple of Yahweh, and he will bear majesty and will sit and rule on his throne. And he shall be a priest on his throne, and the counsel of peace will be between the two of them.” ’<note placement="foot">That is, between king and priest</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 6:14
verses.text: And the crown will be for Helem,<note placement="foot">“Helem” is probably another name for Heldai (v. <reference osisRef="Zech.6.10">10</reference>)</note> for Tobijah, for Jedaiah, and for Hen<note placement="foot">“Hen” is frequently understood as a reference to Josiah (v. <reference osisRef="Zech.6.10">10</reference>)</note> son of Zephaniah, as a memorial in the temple of Yahweh.

verses.name: Zechariah 6:15
verses.text: And those who are far off will come and build the temple of Yahweh, and you will know that Yahweh of hosts has sent me to you. And it will happen if you will listen diligently to the voice of Yahweh your God.”  <chapter eID="Zech.6"/> <div eID="gen25463" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:1
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and it happened”</note> in the fourth year of King Darius, the word of Yahweh came to Zechariah on <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fourth <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the ninth month, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> Kislev.

verses.name: Zechariah 7:2
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the people of</transChange> Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem-Melech, and their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> men, to entreat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the favor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the face”</note> of Yahweh,

verses.name: Zechariah 7:3
verses.text: saying to the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞priests of the house of Yahweh of hosts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “priests who are for the house of Yahweh of hosts”</note> and to the prophets, “Should I mourn in the fifth month and keep myself separate<note placement="foot">Or “abstain”; some interpret this as a reference to fasting</note> as I have done for these many years?”

verses.name: Zechariah 7:4
verses.text: And the word of Yahweh of hosts came to me, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 7:5
verses.text: “Say to all the people of the land and to the priests: ‘When you fasted and lamented in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years, did you really fast for me?

verses.name: Zechariah 7:6
verses.text: And when you eat and drink, are you not eating and drinking <transChange type="added">for yourselves</transChange>?

verses.name: Zechariah 7:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> not <transChange type="added">these</transChange> the words that Yahweh proclaimed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by the hand of”</note> the former prophets, when Jerusalem and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞its surrounding towns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “her towns around her”</note> were inhabited and at ease, and the Negev<note placement="foot">The Negev is an arid region south of the Judean hills</note> and the Shephelah<note placement="foot">The Shephelah is a geographical area on the western edge of the Judean hills</note> were inhabited?’ ”  <div eID="gen25464" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10437"/><div sID="gen25465" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10437"/>And the word of Yahweh came to Zechariah, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 7:9
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘Judge <transChange type="added">with</transChange> trustworthy justice, and show<note placement="foot">Literally “do”</note> steadfast love and compassion <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “a man his brother”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:10
verses.text: You must not oppress <transChange type="added">the</transChange> widow, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> orphan, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> foreigner, and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> needy. You must not devise evil in your heart <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞against one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.’<note placement="foot">Literally “a man his brother”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:11
verses.text: But they refused to listen, and turned<note placement="foot">Hebrew “gave”</note> a stubborn shoulder and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞stopped their ears from listening⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “their ears were heavy from hearing”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 7:12
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞They made their hearts adamant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “They set their hearts like hard stone”</note> in order not to hear the law<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> and the words that Yahweh of hosts had sent by his spirit through<note placement="foot">Literally “by the hand of”</note> the former prophets; <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> great wrath came from Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 7:13
verses.text: ‘Thus, just as I<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he called” (but still referring to Yahweh)</note> called and they would not hear, so they will call and I will not hear,’ says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 7:14
verses.text: ‘And I scattered them with a wind among all the nations that they had not known; the land was made desolate behind them— no one crossing through <transChange type="added">it</transChange> or returning—and they made the desirable land<note placement="foot">Hebrew “land of desire,” but this could be understood as a land characterized by desire rather than a desirable land</note> a desolation.’ ”  <chapter eID="Zech.7"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10438"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Promise to Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen25466" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10438"/>And the word of Yahweh of hosts came, saying,

verses.name: Zechariah 8:2
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am exceedingly jealous for Zion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy”</note> I am jealous for it <transChange type="added">with</transChange> great wrath.’

verses.name: Zechariah 8:3
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh: ‘I have returned to Zion, and I will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; and Jerusalem will be called the faithful city,<note placement="foot">Or “the city of truth”</note> and the mountain of Yahweh of hosts <transChange type="added">will be called</transChange> the holy mountain.’

verses.name: Zechariah 8:4
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘Old men and old women shall again sit in the public squares of Jerusalem, each with staff in hand<note placement="foot">Hebrew “a man his staff in his hand”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞because of great age⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “because of the multitude of days”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:5
verses.text: And the public squares of the city will be filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> boys and girls playing in its public squares.’

verses.name: Zechariah 8:6
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘<transChange type="added">Even</transChange> if it seems impossible<note placement="foot">Or “wonderful”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to the remnant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the eyes of the remnant”</note> of this people in those days, should it also seem impossible<note placement="foot">Or “wonderful”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?’<note placement="foot">Literally “in my eyes”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:7
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to save my people from the land of the east, and from the land of the west,

verses.name: Zechariah 8:8
verses.text: and I will bring them and they will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem. They will be my people and I will be their God in faithfulness<note placement="foot">Or “truth”</note> and in righteousness.’  <div eID="gen25466" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10439"/><div sID="gen25467" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10439"/>“Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘Let your hands be strong, you<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the ones”</note> who are hearing in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were present on the day <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the foundation was laid for the rebuilding of the temple, the house of Yahweh of hosts⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the temple, the house of Yahweh of hosts, was founded to be built”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:10
