verses.text: For before those days there was no wage for people or for animals, and there was no safety from the enemy for those who went out or those who came in, and I sent each person against <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his neighbor”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:11
verses.text: But now <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will not deal with the remnant of this people as in the former days⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,’<note placement="foot">Literally “not like the former days I will be to the remnant”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:12
verses.text: ‘For <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> a sowing of peace; the vine will give its fruit, and the soil will give its produce, and the heavens will give their dew. And I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:13
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and it will happen”</note> just as you were a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so will I save you, and you will be a blessing. You must not be afraid; let your hands be strong!’ ”  <div eID="gen25467" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10440"/><div sID="gen25468" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10440"/>For thus says Yahweh of hosts: “Just as I planned to bring disaster<note placement="foot">Hebrew “evil”</note> on you when your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> provoked me to anger,” says Yahweh of hosts, “and I did not regret <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,

verses.name: Zechariah 8:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞so again I have planned⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “<reference osisRef="Song.1.1">So I </reference>did again, I planned”</note> in these days to do good to Jerusalem and the house of Judah. Do not be afraid!

verses.name: Zechariah 8:16
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the things that you must do: speak truth, each <transChange type="added">of you</transChange>, with his neighbor; practice trustworthy judgment and peace in your gates.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:17
verses.text: Do not devise evil in your hearts <transChange type="added">against</transChange> your neighbor, and do not love <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a false oath⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “an oath of deception”</note> because all these are things I hate,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh.  <div eID="gen25468" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10441"/><div sID="gen25469" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10441"/>And the word of Yahweh of hosts came to me, saying

verses.name: Zechariah 8:19
verses.text: “Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘The fast of the fourth <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, the fifth <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, the seventh <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, and the tenth <transChange type="added">month</transChange> will be for the house of Judah jubilation and joy and merry festivals; therefore love truth and peace.’

verses.name: Zechariah 8:20
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘<transChange type="added">It will happen</transChange> again that nations and the inhabitants of many cities will come.

verses.name: Zechariah 8:21
verses.text: And the inhabitants of one city will go to another <transChange type="added">city</transChange>, saying, “Let us go immediately to entreat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the favor of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the face of”</note> Yahweh, to seek Yahweh of hosts—I also will go!”

verses.name: Zechariah 8:22
verses.text: And many peoples and powerful<note placement="foot">Or “mighty”</note> nations will come to seek Yahweh of hosts in Jerusalem, and to entreat <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the favor of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the face of”</note> Yahweh.’

verses.name: Zechariah 8:23
verses.text: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: ‘In those days ten men from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞all the nations of every language⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all the languages of the nations”</note> will take hold of the hem of a Judean man,<note placement="foot">Many versions translate “a Jew,” but “Judean” highlights Zechariah’s focus on provincial geography</note> saying, “Let us go with you, for we have heard <transChange type="added">that</transChange> God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with you!” ’ ”  <chapter eID="Zech.8"/> <div eID="gen25469" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:1
verses.text: An oracle. The word of Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> against the land of Hadrach, <div eID="gen25470" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25471"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25472"/>and Damascus <transChange type="added">is</transChange> its resting place.<l eID="gen25472" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25473"/>For to Yahweh belongs the eye of humankind,<note placement="foot">“Eye of humankind” is difficult to understand in this context; some scholars emend the phrase to “cities of Aram” or “capital of Aram”</note><l eID="gen25473" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen25474"/>and all the tribes of Israel, <l eID="gen25474" level="3"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10442"/><l level="1" sID="gen25475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10442"/>and also Hamath, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> borders on it;<l eID="gen25475" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25476"/>Tyre and Sidon—yes, they are very wise!<note placement="foot">That is, wise in their own eyes (ironic)</note> <l eID="gen25476" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10443"/><l level="1" sID="gen25477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10443"/>Tyre has built a fortification for itself,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “her”</note><l eID="gen25477" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25478"/>and it heaped up silver like dust,<l eID="gen25478" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25479"/>and gold like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mud of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> streets. <l eID="gen25479" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10444"/><l level="1" sID="gen25480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10444"/>Look! The Lord will drive it<note placement="foot">Hebrew “her”</note> out<l eID="gen25480" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25481"/>and will hurl its<note placement="foot">Hebrew “her”</note> outer ramparts into the sea,<l eID="gen25481" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen25482"/>and it<note placement="foot">Hebrew “she”</note> will be consumed by fire. <l eID="gen25482" level="3"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10445"/><l level="1" sID="gen25483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10445"/>Ashkelon will see and will be afraid,<l eID="gen25483" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25484"/>and Gaza will writhe exceedingly,<l eID="gen25484" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25485"/>and Ekron <transChange type="added">also</transChange>, because its hope is ruined.<note placement="foot">Traditionally “ashamed”; some presuppose a different Hebrew form and translate “withered”</note><l eID="gen25485" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25486"/>And the king from Gaza will perish,<l eID="gen25486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25487"/>and Ashkelon will not be inhabited. <l eID="gen25487" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10446"/><l level="1" sID="gen25488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10446"/>A mongrel people<note placement="foot">That is, a people of mixed marriage; “half-breeds”</note> will dwell in Ashdod,<l eID="gen25488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25489"/>and I will cut down the pride of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Philistines. <l eID="gen25489" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10447"/><l level="1" sID="gen25490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10447"/>I will remove its<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> blood from its<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> mouth,<l eID="gen25490" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25491"/>and its<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> abominations from between its<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> teeth.<l eID="gen25491" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25492"/>And it<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> too will be a remnant for our God;<l eID="gen25492" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25493"/>and it<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> will be like a tribal chief<note placement="foot">This word is sometimes interpreted as “clan”</note> in Judah,<l eID="gen25493" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25494"/>and Ekron <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> like <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Jebusite. <l eID="gen25494" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10448"/><l level="1" sID="gen25495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10448"/>But I will encamp at my temple<note placement="foot">Or “house”</note> <transChange type="added">like a</transChange> guard,<l eID="gen25495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25496"/>against those crossing through and returning;<l eID="gen25496" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25497"/>no oppressor will cross through them again,<l eID="gen25497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25498"/>for now I have seen with my <transChange type="added">own</transChange> eyes. <l eID="gen25498" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10449"/><l level="1" sID="gen25499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10449"/>Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion!<l eID="gen25499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25500"/>Shout aloud, O daughter of Jerusalem!<l eID="gen25500" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25501"/>Look! Your king comes to you;<l eID="gen25501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25502"/>he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> righteous and victorious,<l eID="gen25502" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25503"/>humble and riding on a donkey,<l eID="gen25503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25504"/>and on a male donkey, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the foal of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the son of ”</note> a female donkey! <l eID="gen25504" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10450"/><l level="1" sID="gen25505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10450"/>And I will cut off <transChange type="added">the</transChange> chariot from Ephraim,<l eID="gen25505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25506"/>and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> horse from Jerusalem;<l eID="gen25506" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25507"/>the battle bow will be cut down,<l eID="gen25507" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25508"/>and he will announce peace to the nations.<l eID="gen25508" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25509"/>His dominion <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> from sea to sea,<l eID="gen25509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25510"/>and from <transChange type="added">the</transChange> River<note placement="foot">That is, the Euphrates</note> to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ends of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> earth. <l eID="gen25510" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10451"/><l level="1" sID="gen25511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10451"/><transChange type="added">As for</transChange> you also, because of the blood of your covenant,<l eID="gen25511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25512"/>I will release your prisoners from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the waterless pit⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the cistern there is not water in him”</note> <l eID="gen25512" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10452"/><l level="1" sID="gen25513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10452"/>Return to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> fortress,<l eID="gen25513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25514"/>O prisoners of hope;<l eID="gen25514" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25515"/>today <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> declaring <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I will repay you double. <l eID="gen25515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10453"/><l level="1" sID="gen25516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10453"/>For I have bent Judah <transChange type="added">as</transChange> my bow;<l eID="gen25516" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25517"/>I have set Ephraim <transChange type="added">as an arrow</transChange>.<l eID="gen25517" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25518"/>I will set in motion your sons, O Zion,<l eID="gen25518" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25519"/>against your sons, O Javan.<note placement="foot">That is, Greece</note><l eID="gen25519" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25520"/>I will wield you like the sword of a warrior. <l eID="gen25520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10454"/><l level="1" sID="gen25521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10454"/>Then Yahweh will appear over them,<l eID="gen25521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25522"/>and his arrow will go forth like lightning;<l eID="gen25522" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25523"/>and my Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet,<l eID="gen25523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25524"/>and he shall go out in the storm winds of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> south. <l eID="gen25524" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10455"/><l level="1" sID="gen25525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10455"/>Yahweh of hosts will defend them,<l eID="gen25525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25526"/>and they will devour and subdue the slingstones;<note placement="foot">Perhaps metonymy for the slingers of stones</note><l eID="gen25526" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25527"/>they will drink, they will make noise<note placement="foot">LXX reads “they will drink blood like wine”</note> like wine,<l eID="gen25527" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25528"/>and they will be full like the sacrificial basin,<note placement="foot">That is, the ceremonial bowl used by the priest for sprinkling blood</note><l eID="gen25528" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25529"/><transChange type="added">drenched</transChange> like the corners of an altar. <l eID="gen25529" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10456"/><l level="1" sID="gen25530"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10456"/>And Yahweh their God will save them on that day,<l eID="gen25530" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25531"/>as the flock of his people;<l eID="gen25531" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25532"/>for <transChange type="added">they are like</transChange> the stones of a diadem,<l eID="gen25532" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25533"/>glittering on his land. <l eID="gen25533" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10457"/><l level="1" sID="gen25534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10457"/>For how <transChange type="added">great is</transChange> his goodness, and how <transChange type="added">great is</transChange> his beauty!<l eID="gen25534" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25535"/>Grain will make the young men thrive,<l eID="gen25535" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25536"/>and new wine <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young women. <l eID="gen25536" level="1"/><lg eID="gen25471"/> <chapter eID="Zech.9"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10458"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Gives Rain</title> <div sID="gen25537" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10458"/>Ask rain from Yahweh in the season of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> spring rain— <div eID="gen25537" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25538"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25539"/>Yahweh, who makes storm clouds,<l eID="gen25539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25540"/>and he gives showers of rain to them,<l eID="gen25540" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25541"/>to everyone vegetation in the field. <l eID="gen25541" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10459"/><l level="1" sID="gen25542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10459"/>Because the household gods<note placement="foot">Hebrew <hi type="italic">teraphim</hi></note> speak deceit,<l eID="gen25542" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25543"/>and those who practice divination see a lie,<l eID="gen25543" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25544"/>and the dreamers of vanity speak in vain.<l eID="gen25544" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25545"/>Therefore <transChange type="added">the people</transChange> wander like sheep;<note placement="foot">Or “flocks”; the Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note><l eID="gen25545" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25546"/>they are afflicted because there is no shepherd. <l eID="gen25546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10460"/><l level="1" sID="gen25547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10460"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞My anger burns⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “My nose becomes hot”</note> against the shepherds,<l eID="gen25547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25548"/>and I will punish the leaders,<note placement="foot">Or “male goats”</note><l eID="gen25548" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25549"/>because Yahweh of hosts watches over his flock,<note placement="foot">Or “herd”</note><l eID="gen25549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25550"/>the house of Judah;<l eID="gen25550" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen25551"/>and he will make them like his majestic horse in war. <l eID="gen25551" level="3"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10461"/><l level="1" sID="gen25552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10461"/>From them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him” (or “it”), referring to the flock in v. <reference osisRef="Zech.10.3">3</reference></note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cornerstone will go out,<l eID="gen25552" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25553"/>from them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him” (or “it”), referring to the flock in v. <reference osisRef="Zech.10.3">3</reference></note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> tent peg,<l eID="gen25553" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25554"/>from them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him” (or “it”), referring to the flock in v. <reference osisRef="Zech.10.3">3</reference></note> <transChange type="added">the</transChange> battle bow,<l eID="gen25554" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25555"/>from them<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him” (or “it”), referring to the flock in v. <reference osisRef="Zech.10.3">3</reference></note> every ruler,<l eID="gen25555" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen25556"/><transChange type="added">all</transChange> together. <l eID="gen25556" level="3"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10462"/><l level="1" sID="gen25557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10462"/>And they will be like warriors,<l eID="gen25557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25558"/>trampling in the mud of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> streets in the battle.<l eID="gen25558" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25559"/>They will fight, because Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with them,<l eID="gen25559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25560"/>and they will put to shame <transChange type="added">the</transChange> riders on horses. <l eID="gen25560" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10463"/><l level="1" sID="gen25561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10463"/>And I will strengthen the house of Judah,<l eID="gen25561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25562"/>and the house of Joseph I will save.<l eID="gen25562" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25563"/>And I will bring them back, because I have compassion on them,<l eID="gen25563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25564"/>and they will be as if I had not rejected them,<l eID="gen25564" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25565"/>for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> Yahweh their God, and I will answer them. <l eID="gen25565" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10464"/><l level="1" sID="gen25566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10464"/>And <transChange type="added">the people of</transChange> Ephraim will be like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> warrior,<l eID="gen25566" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25567"/>and their heart will be glad as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> wine.<l eID="gen25567" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25568"/>And their children will see and rejoice;<l eID="gen25568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25569"/>their heart will shout in exultation in Yahweh. <l eID="gen25569" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10465"/><l level="1" sID="gen25570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10465"/>I will whistle to them and gather them,<l eID="gen25570" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25571"/>for I have redeemed them,<l eID="gen25571" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25572"/>and they will become numerous as they have been numerous <transChange type="added">before</transChange>. <l eID="gen25572" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10466"/><l level="1" sID="gen25573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10466"/>Though I sow<note placement="foot">Or “scatter”</note> them among the nations,<l eID="gen25573" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25574"/>in the distant places they will remember me,<l eID="gen25574" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25575"/>and they will stay alive with their children, and they will return. <l eID="gen25575" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10467"/><l level="1" sID="gen25576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10467"/>And I will bring them back from the land of Egypt,<l eID="gen25576" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25577"/>and from Assyria I will gather them.<l eID="gen25577" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25578"/>To the land of Gilead and Lebanon I will bring them,<l eID="gen25578" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25579"/>until no <transChange type="added">room</transChange> will be found for them <transChange type="added">there</transChange>. <l eID="gen25579" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10468"/><l level="1" sID="gen25580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10468"/>And he<note placement="foot">LXX reads “they,” referring to the Israelites (so NIV, NRSV, NASB)</note> will pass through the sea of distress,<l eID="gen25580" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25581"/>and he will strike the waves of the sea,<l eID="gen25581" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25582"/>and all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> depths of the Nile will dry up.<l eID="gen25582" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25583"/>The pride of Assyria will be brought low,<l eID="gen25583" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25584"/>and the scepter of Egypt will depart. <l eID="gen25584" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10469"/><l level="1" sID="gen25585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10469"/>I will make them strong in Yahweh,<l eID="gen25585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25586"/>and in his name they will walk,<l eID="gen25586" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen25587"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh. <l eID="gen25587" level="3"/><lg eID="gen25538"/> <chapter eID="Zech.10"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:1
verses.text: Open your doors, <transChange type="added">O</transChange> Lebanon, <div eID="gen25588" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25589"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25590"/>so that fire will devour your cedars! <l eID="gen25590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10470"/><l level="1" sID="gen25591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10470"/>Wail, O juniper,<note placement="foot">Or “cypress”</note> for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> cedar has fallen,<l eID="gen25591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25592"/>for <transChange type="added">the</transChange> magnificent <transChange type="added">trees</transChange> are ruined!<l eID="gen25592" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25593"/>Wail, oaks of Bashan,<l eID="gen25593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25594"/>for the impenetrable forest has come down! <l eID="gen25594" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10471"/><l level="1" sID="gen25595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10471"/><transChange type="added">Listen to</transChange> the wailing of the shepherds,<l eID="gen25595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25596"/>for their splendor is ruined!<l eID="gen25596" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25597"/><transChange type="added">Listen to</transChange> the roar of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> young lions,<l eID="gen25597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25598"/>for the thickets of the Jordan are ruined! <l eID="gen25598" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen25589"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10472"/><title type="x-s">The Two Shepherds</title> <div sID="gen25599" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10472"/>Thus says Yahweh my God: “Shepherd the flock<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> <transChange type="added">doomed</transChange> to slaughter.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:5
verses.text: The ones buying them kill them and go unpunished, and the ones selling them say, ‘Blessed <transChange type="added">be</transChange> Yahweh, for I have become rich.’ Their own shepherds have no compassion for them.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:6
verses.text: For I will no longer have compassion on the inhabitants of the land,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh. “Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to cause humankind to fall, each into the hand of his neighbor, and into the hand of his king; and they will devastate the land, and I will not deliver <transChange type="added">anyone</transChange> from their hand.”  <div eID="gen25599" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10473"/><div sID="gen25600" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10473"/>And I shepherded the flock<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> doomed to slaughter, even<note placement="foot">Hebrew “therefore”</note> the afflicted<note placement="foot">LXX reads “merchants of the flock” which is reflected in some English translations</note> of the flock.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> I took two staffs, one I called Kindness, and the other I called Unity, and I shepherded the flock.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:8
verses.text: And I got rid of three shepherds in one month, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I grew impatient⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “my soul became short”</note> with them, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they also became tired of me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “also their soul detested me”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:9
verses.text: So I said, “I will not shepherd you! The <transChange type="added">one</transChange> dying will die, and the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> to be destroyed will be destroyed. And the <transChange type="added">ones</transChange> remaining, let them devour <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the flesh of each other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “each the flesh of her neighbor”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:10
verses.text: And I took my staff Kindness and broke it, to break my covenant that I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞had made⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “had cut”</note> with all the peoples.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:11
verses.text: And it was broken on that day. Then the afflicted<note placement="foot">LXX reads “merchants (of the flock)” which is reflected in some English translations</note> of the flock,<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> the <transChange type="added">ones who were</transChange> watching me, knew that it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the word of Yahweh.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:12
verses.text: And I said to them, “If <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it seems right to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “it is good in your eyes”</note> give me my wages, but if not, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞keep them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “refrain”</note> And they weighed out my wages, thirty silver <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange>.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:13
verses.text: And Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter,”<note placement="foot">Syriac reads “treasury,” followed by NAB, NRSV, TEV</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this noble price⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the price of honor”</note> at which I was valued by them!” So I took the thirty silver shekels and I threw them to the potter<note placement="foot">Syriac reads “treasury,” followed by NAB, NRSV, TEV</note> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the house of Yahweh.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:14
verses.text: Then I broke my second staff Unity to break the family ties between Judah and Israel.  <div eID="gen25600" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10474"/><div sID="gen25601" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10474"/>And Yahweh said to me, “Take again the implements<note placement="foot">Hebrew “implement”</note> of a foolish shepherd.

verses.name: Zechariah 11:16
verses.text: For look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> raising up a shepherd in the land who will not attend to the <transChange type="added">ones that are</transChange> perishing; he will not seek the young man,<note placement="foot">Syriac and other ancient versions read “the wandering” or “the scattered,” as do several English translations</note> he will not heal the ones that are crushed and he will not sustain the healthy ones; he will devour the flesh of the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fattened ones⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the stall-fed”</note> and tear apart <transChange type="added">even</transChange> their hoofs.  <div eID="gen25601" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10475"/><lg sID="gen25602"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10475"/>“Woe, my worthless shepherd<l eID="gen25603" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25604"/>who deserts the flock!<note placement="foot">The Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note><l eID="gen25604" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25605"/><transChange type="added">May</transChange> a sword <transChange type="added">fall</transChange> on his arm<l eID="gen25605" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25606"/>and on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his right eye⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>!<note placement="foot">Literally “the eye of his right”</note><l eID="gen25606" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25607"/>May his arm wither completely<l eID="gen25607" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25608"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his right eye⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the eye of his right”</note> be utterly blinded!” <l eID="gen25608" level="2"/><lg eID="gen25602"/> <chapter eID="Zech.11"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10476"/><title type="x-s">The Day of Yahweh</title> <div sID="gen25609" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10476"/>An oracle. The word of Yahweh concerning Israel. “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Thus declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Declaration of”</note> Yahweh, who stretches out the heavens, founds the earth, and forms the spirit of humankind in its midst:<note placement="foot">Or “forms the spirit of a man within him”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:2
verses.text: ‘Look, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to make Jerusalem a cup of reeling for all the surrounding nations; it will also be against Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:3
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> on that day I will make Jerusalem a stone weight<note placement="foot">Or “a heavy stone”</note> for all the peoples. All those lifting it up will grievously hurt themselves, and all the nations of the earth will assemble against it.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:4
verses.text: On that day,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh, ‘I will strike every horse with confusion, and the one riding it with madness; but over the house of Judah <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will keep my eyes open⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “I will open my eyes,” that is, “I will be responsive” or “I will pay attention”</note> and I will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:5
verses.text: And the clans of Judah will say <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “in their heart”</note> “The inhabitants of Jerusalem are a strength to us,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “me”</note> through Yahweh of hosts, their God.”  <div eID="gen25609" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10477"/><div sID="gen25610" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10477"/>“ ‘On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a pan of fire among <transChange type="added">sticks of</transChange> wood, and like a torch of fire among stalks<note placement="foot">Hebrew “stalk”</note> of grain, and they will devour to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> right and to <transChange type="added">the</transChange> left all the surrounding peoples, and Jerusalem will be inhabited again <transChange type="added">in</transChange> its place, in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:7
verses.text: And Yahweh will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of Jerusalem may not be exalted over Judah.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:8
verses.text: On that day Yahweh will put a shield around the inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of Jerusalem, and the one who stumbles among them on that day will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of Yahweh, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of them”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:9
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> on that day I will seek to destroy all the nations coming against Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen25610" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10478"/><div sID="gen25611" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10478"/>“ ‘I will pour on the house of David and on the inhabitants<note placement="foot">Hebrew “inhabitant”</note> of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and supplication, and they will look to me whom they pierced, and they shall mourn over him, as one wails over an only child, and they will grieve bitterly over him as <transChange type="added">one</transChange> grieves bitterly over a firstborn.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:11
verses.text: On that day the wailing will be great in Jerusalem, like the wailing for Hadad Rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.

verses.name: Zechariah 12:12
verses.text: And the land shall mourn, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each clan by itself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>;<note placement="foot">Literally “clans, clans alone”</note> the clan of the house of David by itself, and their wives by themselves; the clan of the house of Nathan by itself, and their wives by themselves;

verses.name: Zechariah 12:13
verses.text: the clan of the house of Levi by itself, and their wives by themselves; the clan of the Shimeites by itself, and their wives by themselves;

verses.name: Zechariah 12:14
verses.text: and all those clans remaining, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each clan by itself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “clans, clans alone”</note> and their wives by themselves.’ ”  <chapter eID="Zech.12"/> <div eID="gen25611" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 13:1
verses.text: “ ‘On that day a well will be opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to cleanse them from sin and from impurity⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “for sin and for impurity”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 13:2
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> on that day,’ <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts, ‘I will cut off the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered; and also the prophets and the spirit of uncleanness I will banish from the land.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:3
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> if anyone prophesies again, his father and his mother who bore him will say to him, “You shall not live, because you have spoken a lie in the name of Yahweh!” And his father and his mother who bore him will pierce him through when he prophesies.

verses.name: Zechariah 13:4
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> on that day, each of the prophets will be ashamed because of his vision when he was prophesying, and they will not put on a cloak of hair in order to deceive,

verses.name: Zechariah 13:5
verses.text: but he will say, “I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> not a prophet; I am a tiller of the soil, for a man has acquired me since my youth.”<note placement="foot">Other translations read “for the land has been my possession since my youth”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 13:6
verses.text: And someone<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> shall say to him, “What are these wounds <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞between your arms⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “between your hands”; that is, on the chest or on the back</note> and he will say, “Those I have received<note placement="foot">Hebrew “have been struck”</note> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the house of <transChange type="added">the ones who</transChange> love me.” ’ ” <div eID="gen25612" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">The Sword Shall Strike the Shepherd</title> <div sID="gen25613" type="x-p"/>  <div eID="gen25613" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10479"/><lg sID="gen25614"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10479"/>“O sword, awake against my shepherd,<l eID="gen25615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25616"/>against <transChange type="added">the</transChange> man <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> my associate,”<l eID="gen25616" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen25617"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh of hosts.<l eID="gen25617" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25618"/>“Strike the shepherd,<l eID="gen25618" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25619"/>so that the sheep<note placement="foot">Or “flock”; the Hebrew term refers collectively to both sheep and goats (small livestock animals)</note> may be scattered,<l eID="gen25619" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25620"/>and I will turn my hand against the small <transChange type="added">ones</transChange>. <l eID="gen25620" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10480"/><l level="1" sID="gen25621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10480"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> in all the land,” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh,<l eID="gen25621" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25622"/>“<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞two thirds⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a mouth of two”</note> will be cut off and perish,<l eID="gen25622" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25623"/>and one third will be left alive<note placement="foot">Hebrew “left over”</note> in it. <l eID="gen25623" level="2"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10481"/><l level="1" sID="gen25624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10481"/>And I will bring the <transChange type="added">remaining</transChange> third into the fire,<l eID="gen25624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25625"/>and I will refine them like <transChange type="added">one</transChange> refines silver,<l eID="gen25625" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25626"/>and I will test them like <transChange type="added">one</transChange> tests gold.<l eID="gen25626" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25627"/>They<note placement="foot">Hebrew “He”</note> will call my name,<l eID="gen25627" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25628"/>and I will answer them.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “him”</note><l eID="gen25628" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25629"/>I will say, ‘They<note placement="foot">Hebrew “He”</note> are my people,’<l eID="gen25629" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen25630"/>and they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> will say, ‘Yahweh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my God.’ ” <l eID="gen25630" level="2"/><lg eID="gen25614"/> <chapter eID="Zech.13"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10482"/><title type="x-s">Zechariah’s Apocalyptic Vision</title> <div sID="gen25631" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10482"/>Look! A day <transChange type="added">is</transChange> coming for Yahweh, when your plunder will be divided in your midst.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:2
verses.text: I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem to battle, and the city will be captured, and they will loot the houses, and the women will be raped; half of the city will go into exile, but the remainder of the people will not be cut off from the city.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:3
verses.text: Then Yahweh will go forth and fight against those nations, like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he fights⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the day of his fighting”</note> on a day of battle.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:4
verses.text: On that day his feet will stand on <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Mount of Olives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of the olive trees”</note> which faces Jerusalem on the east; and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Mount of Olives⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the mountain of the olive trees”</note> will be split <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in half⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “from its half”</note> from east to west, <transChange type="added">by</transChange> a very great valley; and half of the mountain will withdraw toward the north, and the other half toward the south.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:5
verses.text: And you will flee <transChange type="added">by</transChange> the valley of my mountains, because the valley of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> mountains will reach to Azal, and you will flee like you fled from the earthquake in the days of King Uzziah of Judah. And Yahweh my God will come, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> holy ones with him.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “you”; LXX has “him”</note>  <div eID="gen25631" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10483"/><div sID="gen25632" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10483"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> on that day there will not be light,<note placement="foot">Some suggest reading “flame” (= “heat”) here</note> the precious things will congeal.<note placement="foot">Or “the noble ones will congeal”; the Hebrew is difficult here</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:7
verses.text: There shall be continuous day—it is known to Yahweh—not day and not night; and at evening time there will be light.  <div eID="gen25632" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10484"/><div sID="gen25633" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10484"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> on that day, living waters will flow out from Jerusalem, half of them to the eastern sea,<note placement="foot">That is, the Dead Sea</note> and the other half to the western sea;<note placement="foot">That is, the Mediterranean Sea</note> it will happen <transChange type="added">both</transChange> in the summer and in the winter.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:9
verses.text: And Yahweh will be king over all the earth; on that day Yahweh will be one and his name one.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:10
verses.text: All the land will be transformed into a desert plateau<note placement="foot">Or “will be changed like the Arabah”</note> from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem. But it<note placement="foot">That is, Jerusalem</note> will rise up high and it will stay<note placement="foot">Or “remain”</note> in its place from the Gate of Benjamin to the place of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> former gate, up to the Corner Gate and from the Tower of Hananel to the king’s winepresses.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:11
verses.text: And they<note placement="foot">That is, the people</note> will dwell in it, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞there will be no more ban imposed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and there will not be a thing devoted to destruction” (that is, put under the ban of utter destruction)</note> and Jerusalem will dwell in security.  <div eID="gen25633" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10485"/><div sID="gen25634" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10485"/>And this will be the plague <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which Yahweh will strike all the peoples that fight against Jerusalem: their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> flesh will rot while they<note placement="foot">Hebrew “he”</note> are standing on their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> feet; their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> eyes will rot in their sockets, and their<note placement="foot">Hebrew “his”</note> tongues<note placement="foot">Hebrew “tongue”</note> will rot in their mouths.<note placement="foot">Hebrew “mouth”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:13
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> on that day a great panic from Yahweh will fall<note placement="foot">Hebrew “will be”</note> on them, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞they will seize one another’s hand⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “and a man will seize the hand of his neighbor”</note> and the hand of the one will be raised against the hand of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “his neighbor”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:14
verses.text: And Judah also will fight at<note placement="foot">Or “against” (so NAB, CEV)</note> Jerusalem. And the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected—gold and silver, and garments <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in great abundance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “as far as the very multitude”</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Like this plague⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And so”</note> will be the plague on the horse, the mule, the camel, and the donkey, and every kind of animal in those camps.  <div eID="gen25634" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10486"/><div sID="gen25635" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10486"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> every survivor from all those nations coming against Jerusalem will go up year after year<note placement="foot">Or “from year to year”; or “yearly”</note> to worship the king, Yahweh of hosts, and celebrate the Feast of Booths.<note placement="foot">That is, Succoth (or Tabernacles)</note>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:17
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞And then⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “And it will happen”</note> whoever of the clans of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to worship the king, Yahweh of hosts, it will not rain on them.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:18
verses.text: And if the clan of Egypt will not go up and come in, on them will be that plague Yahweh inflicts on the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Booths.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:19
verses.text: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Booths.  <div eID="gen25635" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zechariah 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10487"/><div sID="gen25636" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10487"/>On that day there will be <transChange type="added">inscribed</transChange> on the bells of the horses, “Holy to Yahweh.” And the cooking pots in the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh will be holy like the sacrificial basins<note placement="foot">That is, the ceremonial bowls used by the priests for sprinkling blood</note> before the altar.

verses.name: Zechariah 14:21
verses.text: And every cooking pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to Yahweh of hosts, and all those who sacrifice will come and will take from them, and will cook in them, and there will be no longer a <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞trader⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Canaanite” (Canaanites, especially Phoenicians, were merchants and traders)</note> in the house<note placement="foot">Or “temple”</note> of Yahweh of hosts on that day.  <chapter eID="Zech.14"/> <div eID="gen25636" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen25450" osisID="Zech" type="book"/>

verses.name: Malachi 1:1
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞An oracle⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “A burden”</note> The word of Yahweh to Israel <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞through⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by the hand of”</note> Malachi.<note placement="foot">The name “Malachi” means “my messenger” in Hebrew</note>  <div eID="gen25638" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10488"/><title type="x-s">An Oracle Against Edom</title> <div sID="gen25639" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10488"/>“I have loved you,” says Yahweh, but you say, “How have you loved us?” “<transChange type="added">Is</transChange> Esau not Jacob’s brother?” <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞declares⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “declaration of”</note> Yahweh. “I have loved Jacob,

verses.name: Malachi 1:3
verses.text: but Esau I have hated. I have made his<note placement="foot">That is, “Esau’s”</note> mountain ranges a desolation, and <transChange type="added">given</transChange> his inheritance to the jackals of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> desert.”

verses.name: Malachi 1:4
verses.text: If Edom says, “We are shattered, but we will return and rebuild <transChange type="added">the</transChange> ruins,” Yahweh of hosts says this: “They may build, but I will tear down; and they will be called a territory of wickedness, and the people <transChange type="added">with</transChange> whom Yahweh is angry forever.”

verses.name: Malachi 1:5
verses.text: Your eyes will see <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, and you will say, “Yahweh is great beyond the borders<note placement="foot">Hebrew “boundary”</note> of Israel.”  <div eID="gen25639" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10489"/><title type="x-s">An Oracle Against the Temple Priesthood</title> <div sID="gen25640" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10489"/>“A son honors <transChange type="added">his</transChange> father, and a slave his master;<note placement="foot">Hebrew “masters”</note> but if I am a father, where is my honor, and if I am a master,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “masters”</note> where is my reverence?” says Yahweh of hosts to you, O priests, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who despise⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “despisers of”</note> my name. “But you say, ‘How have we despised your name?’

verses.name: Malachi 1:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">You are</transChange> presenting defiled food on my altar! But you ask, ‘How have we defiled you?’ By saying <transChange type="added">that</transChange> the table of Yahweh is despised!

verses.name: Malachi 1:8
verses.text: When you offer a blind <transChange type="added">animal</transChange> for sacrifice, is that not wrong?<note placement="foot">Or “is there no wrong?”</note> And when you offer the lame and the one who is ill, is that not wrong?<note placement="foot">Or “is there no wrong?”</note> Present it, please, to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Will he show you favor⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “Will he lift your face?”</note> says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 1:9
verses.text: So then, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞implore the favor of God⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “appease, please, the face of God”</note> so that he will be gracious to us. “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞This is what you have done⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “From your hand was this”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Will he show favor to any of you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “will he lift up from you a face”</note> says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 1:10
verses.text: “Who also among you will shut <transChange type="added">the temple</transChange> doors <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> you will not kindle fire in vain <transChange type="added">on</transChange> my altar? I take no pleasure in you,” says Yahweh of hosts, “and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I will not accept⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I will not take pleasure in”</note> an offering from your hand.

verses.name: Malachi 1:11
verses.text: From the rising of the sun to its setting, my name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great among the nations, and in every place incense <transChange type="added">is</transChange> being presented to my name, and a pure offering. For my name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> great among the nations,” says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 1:12
verses.text: “But you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> profaning it by saying the table of the Lord <transChange type="added">is</transChange> defiled, and its fruit—its food<note placement="foot">The Hebrew here is difficult; “its food” may function to explain “its fruit”</note>—is despised!

verses.name: Malachi 1:13
verses.text: And you say, ‘Look! <transChange type="added">This is</transChange> a weariness,’ and you sniff <transChange type="added">with disdain</transChange> at it,” says Yahweh of hosts. “And you bring <transChange type="added">the</transChange> stolen, the lame, and the one that is sick—<transChange type="added">this</transChange> you bring as the offering! Should I <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞accept it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “take pleasure in it”</note> from your hand?” says Yahweh.

verses.name: Malachi 1:14
verses.text: “Cursed is the one who cheats, who has in his flock a male and vows <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, but <transChange type="added">instead</transChange> sacrifices a blemished one to the Lord! For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> a great king,” says Yahweh of hosts, “and my name <transChange type="added">is</transChange> awesome among the nations.”  <chapter eID="Mal.1"/> <div eID="gen25640" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 2:1
verses.text: “And so then, O priests, this command <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for you:

verses.name: Malachi 2:2
verses.text: If you will not listen, and if you will not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞take it to heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally, “place it on your heart”</note> to give glory to my name,” says Yahweh of hosts, “then I will send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings; moreover I have already cursed them because <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you are not taking it to heart⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “you are not placing it on your heart”</note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:3
verses.text: Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to rebuke <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your offspring⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “for you the offspring”</note> and I will scatter offal on your faces, the offal of your religious feasts, and you will be carried to it.<note placement="foot">The Hebrew is difficult. The subject is indefinite, and “it” likely refers to a refuse or waste pile</note>  <div eID="gen25641" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10490"/><div sID="gen25642" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10490"/>“Then you will know that I have sent to you this command, that my covenant with Levi <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞continues⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “be”</note> says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 2:5
verses.text: “My covenant with him was <transChange type="added">one of</transChange> life and peace, and I gave them to him. <transChange type="added">This required</transChange> reverence, and he revered<note placement="foot">Or “feared”</note> me and stood in awe <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of”</note> my name.

verses.name: Malachi 2:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The</transChange> instruction of truth<note placement="foot">Or “law of truth”</note> was in his mouth, and wickedness was not found on his lips. In peace and in uprightness<note placement="foot">Or “rectitude,” or “fairness”</note> he walked with me, and he brought back many from sin.<note placement="foot">Or “iniquity”</note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:7
verses.text: For the lips of <transChange type="added">the</transChange> priest should guard knowledge, and they should seek instruction<note placement="foot">Or “law”</note> from his mouth, for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the messenger of Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 2:8
verses.text: But you, you have turned from the way; you have caused many to stumble by <transChange type="added">your</transChange> instruction;<note placement="foot">Or “the law”</note> you have ruined the covenant of Levi,” says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 2:9
verses.text: “And in turn I have made you despised and humbled before all the people, inasmuch as you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not keeping<note placement="foot">Or “observing”</note> my way, but are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞favoring your own instruction⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.”<note placement="foot">Literally “lifting faces in the instruction/law”</note>  <div eID="gen25642" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10491"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh Hates Faithlessness</title> <div sID="gen25643" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10491"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Do we not all have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Is for all of us not”</note> one father? Has not one God created us? Why then are we unfaithful <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “each man to his brother”</note> profaning the covenant of our ancestors?<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:11
verses.text: Judah has been faithless, and a detestable thing has been done in Israel and in Jerusalem. Judah has profaned the sanctuary of Yahweh which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign<note placement="foot">Or “pagan”</note> god.

verses.name: Malachi 2:12
verses.text: May Yahweh cut off from the tents of Jacob the man who does this, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> one who is awake and <transChange type="added">who</transChange> answers, and <transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> brings an offering to Yahweh of hosts!  <div eID="gen25643" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10492"/><div sID="gen25644" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10492"/>And this you do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as well⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>:<note placement="foot">Literally “a second time”</note> you cover the altar of Yahweh with tears, with weeping and with groaning, because he<note placement="foot">Yahweh</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no longer regards the offering⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “there is no longer turning to the offering”</note> or accepts <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> favor from your hand.

verses.name: Malachi 2:14
verses.text: But you ask, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞For what reason⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?”<note placement="foot">Literally “Because of what?”</note> Because Yahweh stands as a witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have been unfaithful, even though she is your marriage partner and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your wife by covenant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “the wife of your covenant”</note>

verses.name: Malachi 2:15
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Did not one God make them?⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Not one did he make”</note> But a remnant of the spirit is his.<note placement="foot">The meaning of this sentence is difficult; literally “And a remnant of the spirit to him”</note> And what does the one God desire? An offspring of God.<note placement="foot">Or “a godly offspring”</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You must be attentive to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “You must keep watch on”</note> your spirit, and you must not be unfaithful to the wife of your youth.

verses.name: Malachi 2:16
verses.text: “For <transChange type="added">I</transChange> hate divorce,”<note placement="foot">Hebrew “sending away”</note> says Yahweh, the God of Israel, “and he who covers his clothing with violence,” says Yahweh of hosts. “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞You must be attentive to⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “You must keep watch on”</note> your spirit and you must not be unfaithful.”  <div eID="gen25644" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10493"/><div sID="gen25645" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10493"/>You have wearied Yahweh with your words, but you ask, “With what have we wearied <transChange type="added">him</transChange>?” <transChange type="added">You have done so</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when you say⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “at your saying”</note> “Everyone who does evil is good in the <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “eyes”</note> of Yahweh, and in them he delights,” or “Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the God of justice?”  <chapter eID="Mal.2"/>

verses.name: Malachi 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10494"/><title type="x-s">Yahweh’s Messenger is Coming</title> <div sID="gen25646" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10494"/>“Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to send my messenger,<note placement="foot">Or “my angel”</note> and he will prepare<note placement="foot">Or “clear”</note> the way <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “before my face”</note> And the Lord whom you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> seeking will come suddenly to his temple, and the messenger of the covenant, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> whom you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> taking pleasure—look!—<transChange type="added">he is</transChange> about to come,” says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 3:2
verses.text: And who <transChange type="added">can</transChange> endure the day of his coming? And who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the one who can stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞when he appears⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>?<note placement="foot">Literally “at his appearing”</note> For he is like a refiner’s fire, like launderers’ alkali.<note placement="foot">Or “lye,” or “soap”</note>

verses.name: Malachi 3:3
verses.text: He will sit <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a refiner and purifier of silver; he will purify the children of Levi, and he will refine them like gold and like silver, and they will present to Yahweh offerings<note placement="foot">Hebrew “offering”</note> in righteousness.

verses.name: Malachi 3:4
verses.text: And the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to Yahweh, like <transChange type="added">in the</transChange> days of old and like <transChange type="added">in</transChange> former years.  <div eID="gen25646" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10495"/><div sID="gen25647" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10495"/>“Then I will approach you for judgment, and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers and against the adulterers, and against those who swear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞falsely⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “as far as the falseness”</note> and against the oppressors of the hired worker with his wages, the widow and the orphan, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the abusers of⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “those pushing aside”</note> the alien,<note placement="foot">Or “sojourner”</note> and <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> do not fear me,” says Yahweh of hosts.  <div eID="gen25647" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10496"/><title type="x-s">An Overflowing Blessing</title> <div sID="gen25648" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10496"/>“For I, Yahweh, have not changed,<note placement="foot">Or “I do not change”</note> and you, O children of Jacob, have not perished.<note placement="foot">Or “are not destroyed”</note>

verses.name: Malachi 3:7
verses.text: From the days of your ancestors<note placement="foot">Or “fathers”</note> you have turned aside from my rules, and have not kept<note placement="foot">Or “observed”</note> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>! Return to me and I will return to you,” says Yahweh of hosts, “but you say, ‘How shall we return?’  <div eID="gen25648" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10497"/><div sID="gen25649" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10497"/>Will a human <transChange type="added">dare to</transChange> rob God? Yet you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> robbing me! And you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In the tithes and the contributions!

verses.name: Malachi 3:9
verses.text: You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> being cursed with <transChange type="added">a</transChange> curse, for you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> robbing me, the whole nation <transChange type="added">of you</transChange>!

verses.name: Malachi 3:10
verses.text: Bring the whole tithe to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the storehouse⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Hebrew “the house of the treasure”</note> so that there will be food in my house, and test me please in this,” says Yahweh of hosts, “if I will not open for you the windows of heaven, and pour forth for you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞an overflowing blessing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally, “a blessing up to not enough”</note>

verses.name: Malachi 3:11
verses.text: I will rebuke the devourer<note placement="foot">NRSV, JPS interpret this word as “locust”</note> for you; it will not destroy the fruit of your soil; your vine in the field will not be unfruitful,” says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 3:12
verses.text: “And all the nations will call you blessed, because you will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a land in which one takes joy⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,”<note placement="foot">Literally “a land of desire”</note> says Yahweh of hosts.

verses.name: Malachi 3:13
verses.text: “Your words have been harsh<note placement="foot">Hebrew “strong”</note> against me,” says Yahweh. “But you say, ‘How have we spoken together against you?’

verses.name: Malachi 3:14
verses.text: You have said, ‘<transChange type="added">It is</transChange> useless<note placement="foot">Or “vain”</note> to serve God! What is the gain if we keep<note placement="foot">Or “observe”</note> his requirements, and if we walk as mourners <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the face of”</note> Yahweh of hosts?

verses.name: Malachi 3:15
verses.text: And now we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> calling <transChange type="added">the</transChange> arrogant blessed! Not only do those who do wickedness prosper; they also test God and they escape!’ ”  <div eID="gen25649" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10498"/><title type="x-s">A Book of Remembrance is Written</title> <div sID="gen25650" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10498"/>Then those who revered<note placement="foot">Or “fear”</note> Yahweh spoke <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞with one another⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “each with his friend/companion”</note> And Yahweh listened attentively<note placement="foot">Or “gave heed”</note> and heard, and a scroll of remembrance was written <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before him⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the face of him”</note> of those who revere<note placement="foot">Or “fear”</note> Yahweh and ponder his name.

verses.name: Malachi 3:17
verses.text: “They will be mine,” says Yahweh of hosts, “on the day that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> acting, <transChange type="added">my</transChange> treasured possession. I will have compassion on them as a man has compassion on his son who serves him.

verses.name: Malachi 3:18
verses.text: You will return and see <transChange type="added">the difference</transChange> between <transChange type="added">the</transChange> righteous and <transChange type="added">the</transChange> wicked, between <transChange type="added">the one who</transChange> serves God and the one who does not serve him.  <chapter eID="Mal.3"/> <div eID="gen25650" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 4:1
verses.text: <note placement="foot"><reference osisRef="Mal.4.1-Mal.4.6">Malachi 4:1–6 </reference>in the English Bible is 3:19–24 in the Hebrew Bible</note> “For look! The day is about to come, burning like an oven, and all the arrogant and every <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞evildoer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “doer of wickedness”</note> will be stubble. The coming day will consume<note placement="foot">Or “devour”</note> them,” says Yahweh of hosts. “It will not leave behind for them root or branch.

verses.name: Malachi 4:2
verses.text: But for you who revere<note placement="foot">Or “fear”</note> my name, the sun of righteousness will rise, with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fattened calves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>.<note placement="foot">Literally “bull-calves of the animal stall” (on the idiom see HALOT 631 s.v.)</note>

verses.name: Malachi 4:3
verses.text: You will trample down the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to act,” says Yahweh of hosts.  <div eID="gen25651" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Malachi 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10499"/><div sID="gen25652" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10499"/>“Remember the instruction<note placement="foot">Or “law”; Hebrew <hi type="italic">torah</hi></note> of my servant Moses, which I commanded him at Horeb to all Israel, the rules and regulations.

verses.name: Malachi 4:5
verses.text: Look! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> going to send to you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome day of Yahweh!

verses.name: Malachi 4:6
