verses.name: II Corinthians 10:3
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">although we</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“are living”) which is understood as concessive</note> are living in the flesh, we do not wage war according to the flesh,

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:4
verses.text: for the weapons of our warfare <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not merely human, but powerful to God for the tearing down of fortresses, tearing down arguments

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:5
verses.text: and all pride that is raised up against the knowledge of God, and taking every thought captive to the obedience of Christ.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:6
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞we are ready⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “having with ready”</note> to punish all disobedience, whenever your obedience is completed.  <div eID="gen27363" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11713"/><div sID="gen27364" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11713"/>You are looking at things according to appearance. If anyone is convinced he himself is Christ’s, he should consider this concerning himself again: that just as Christ himself <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, so also <transChange type="added">are</transChange> we.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:8
verses.text: For even if I boast somewhat more about our authority that the Lord gave <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for building you up and not for tearing you down⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for building up and not for tearing down of you”</note>, I will not be put to shame,

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:9
verses.text: so that I do not want to appear as if I were terrifying you by my letters,

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:10
verses.text: because it is said, “His letters <transChange type="added">are</transChange> severe and powerful, but his bodily presence <transChange type="added">is</transChange> weak and his speech is of no account.”

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:11
verses.text: Let such a person consider this: that what we are in word by letters <transChange type="added">when we</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“are absent”) which is understood as temporal</note> are absent, we will also be in <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞actions⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “deed”</note> when we<note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“are present”) which is understood as temporal</note> are present.  <div eID="gen27364" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11714"/><div sID="gen27365" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11714"/>For we do not dare to classify or to compare ourselves with some who commend themselves, but <transChange type="added">they</transChange> themselves, <transChange type="added">when they</transChange> measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, do not understand.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:13
verses.text: But we will not boast <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beyond limits⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the things immeasurable”</note>, but according to the measure of the assignment that God has assigned to us as a measure to reach even as far as you.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:14
verses.text: For we are not overextending ourselves, as <transChange type="added">if we</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “if” is supplied as a component of the participle (“reached”) which is understood as conditional</note> had not reached you, because we have reached even as far as you with the gospel of Christ,

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:15
verses.text: not boasting <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞beyond limits⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the things immeasurable”</note> in the labors of others, but having hope <transChange type="added">that as</transChange> your faith is growing to be enlarged greatly by you according to our assignment,

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:16
verses.text: so that we may proclaim the gospel in the regions that lie beyond you, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> not boast in the things accomplished in the <transChange type="added">area</transChange> assigned to someone else.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:17
verses.text: But “the one who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Jer.9.24">Jer 9:24</reference></note>

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:18
verses.text: For it is not the one commending himself who is approved, but <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> whom the Lord commends.  <chapter eID="2Cor.10"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11715"/><title type="x-s">Paul Defends His Apostleship</title> <div sID="gen27366" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11715"/>I wish that you would put up with me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in something a little foolish⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a little something of foolishness”</note>—but indeed you are putting up with me.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:2
verses.text: For I am jealous <transChange type="added">for</transChange> you with a godly jealousy, because I promised you <transChange type="added">in marriage</transChange> to one husband, to present <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a pure virgin to Christ.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:3
verses.text: But I am afraid lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craftiness, your minds may be led astray from the sincerity and the purity of <transChange type="added">devotion</transChange> to Christ.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:4
verses.text: For if the one who comes proclaims another Jesus whom we have not proclaimed, or you receive a different spirit which you did not receive, or a different gospel which you did not accept, you put up with <transChange type="added">it</transChange> well <transChange type="added">enough</transChange>!

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:5
verses.text: For I consider myself in no way to be inferior to the preeminent apostles.<note placement="foot">Some interpreters take this to refer to the original apostles in Jerusalem; others take Paul to be referring sarcastically to his opponents in Corinth.</note>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:6
verses.text: But even if <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> unskilled in speech, yet <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> not in knowledge; certainly in everything <transChange type="added">we</transChange> have made this clear to you in every <transChange type="added">way</transChange>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:7
verses.text: Or did I commit a sin <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“humbling”) which is understood as means</note> humbling myself in order that you may be exalted, because I proclaimed the gospel of God to you without payment?

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:8
verses.text: I robbed other churches <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“accepting”) which is understood as means</note> accepting support <transChange type="added">from them</transChange> for the ministry to you.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:9
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">when I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“was present”) which is understood as temporal</note> was present with you and was in need, I did not burden anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my need, and in everything I kept myself from being a burden to you, and will keep <transChange type="added">myself from being a burden</transChange>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As the</transChange> truth of Christ is in me, this boasting <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of mine⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to me”</note> will not be stopped in the regions of Achaia.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:11
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Why⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because of what”</note>? Because I do not love you? God knows <transChange type="added">I do</transChange>!

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:12
verses.text: But what I am doing, I will also do, in order that I may remove the opportunity of those who want an opportunity, that they may be found just as also we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in what they are boasting about.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:13
verses.text: For such people <transChange type="added">are</transChange> false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:14
verses.text: And no wonder, for Satan himself disguises himself as an angel of light.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:15
verses.text: Therefore <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not a great thing if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their deeds.  <div eID="gen27366" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11716"/><title type="x-s">Paul Boasts in His Sufferings</title> <div sID="gen27367" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11716"/>Again I say, do not let anyone think I am foolish. But indeed, if <transChange type="added">you do</transChange>, accept me even as foolish, in order that I also may boast a little.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:17
verses.text: What I am saying in this project of boasting, I am not saying as the Lord <transChange type="added">would say</transChange>, but as in foolishness.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:18
verses.text: Since many are boasting according to human standards, I also will boast.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:19
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">because you</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“are”) which is understood as causal</note> are wise, you put up with foolish people gladly!

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:20
verses.text: For you put up with <transChange type="added">it</transChange> if someone enslaves you, if someone devours <transChange type="added">you</transChange>, if someone takes advantage of <transChange type="added">you</transChange>, if someone is presumptious <transChange type="added">toward you</transChange>, if someone strikes you in the face.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:21
verses.text: I say <transChange type="added">this</transChange> to <transChange type="added">my</transChange> shame, namely, that we have been weak. <div eID="gen27367" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen27368" type="x-p"/> But in whatever anyone dares to <transChange type="added">boast</transChange>—I am speaking in foolishness—I also dare to <transChange type="added">boast</transChange>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:22
verses.text: Are they Hebrews? I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> also! Are they Israelites? I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> also! Are they descendants of Abraham? I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> also!

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:23
verses.text: Are they servants of Christ?—I am speaking as though I were beside myself—I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> more so, with far greater labors, with far more imprisonments, with beatings to a much greater degree, in <transChange type="added">danger of</transChange> death many times.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:24
verses.text: Five times I received at the hands of the Jews forty <transChange type="added">lashes</transChange> less one.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:25
verses.text: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I received a stoning. Three times I was shipwrecked. A day and a night I have spent in the deep water.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:26
verses.text: <transChange type="added">I have been</transChange> on journeys many times, in dangers from rivers, in dangers from robbers, in dangers from <transChange type="added">my own</transChange> people, in dangers from the Gentiles, in dangers in the city, in dangers in the wilderness, in dangers at sea, in dangers because of false brothers,

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:27
verses.text: with toil and hardship, often in sleepless nights, with hunger and thirst, often going hungry, in cold and poorly clothed.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:28
verses.text: Apart from these external things, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> the pressure on me every day of the anxiety about all the churches.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:29
verses.text: Who is weak, and <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> not weak? Who is caused to sin, and I do not burn <transChange type="added">with indignation</transChange>?

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:30
verses.text: If it is necessary to boast, I will boast <transChange type="added">about</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the things related to my weakness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things of my weakness”</note>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:31
verses.text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is blessed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the ages”</note>, knows that I am not lying.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:32
verses.text: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas was guarding the city of the Damascenes in order to take me into custody,

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:33
verses.text: and I was lowered through a window through the wall in a rope-basket, and I escaped his hands.  <chapter eID="2Cor.11"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11717"/><title type="x-s">A Vision of Paradise</title> <div sID="gen27369" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11717"/>It is necessary to boast; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not profitable, but I will proceed to visions and revelations of the Lord.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:2
verses.text: I know a man in Christ fourteen years ago—whether in the body I do not know, or outside the body I do not know, God knows—such a man was caught up to the third heaven,

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:3
verses.text: and I know this man—whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, God knows—

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:4
verses.text: that he was caught up to paradise and heard words not to be spoken, which <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not permitted for a person to speak.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:5
verses.text: On behalf of such a person I will boast, but on behalf of myself I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:6
verses.text: For if I want to boast, I will not be foolish, because I will be telling the truth, but I am refraining, so that no one can credit to me more than what he sees <transChange type="added">in</transChange> me or hears anything from me,

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:7
verses.text: even because of the extraordinary degree of the revelations. Therefore, so that I would not exalt myself, a thorn in the flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satan, in order that it would torment me so that I would not exalt myself.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:8
verses.text: Three times I appealed to the Lord about this, that it would depart from me.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:9
verses.text: And he said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, because the<note placement="foot">A majority of later manuscripts read “my”</note> power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore rather I will boast most gladly in my weaknesses, in order that the power of Christ may reside in me.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:10
verses.text: Therefore I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in calamities, in persecutions and difficulties for the sake of Christ, for whenever I am weak, then I am strong.  <div eID="gen27369" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11718"/><title type="x-s">Paul’s Concern for the Christians at Corinth</title> <div sID="gen27370" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11718"/>I have become a fool! You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> in no way inferior to the preeminent apostles,<note placement="foot">Some interpreters take this to refer to the original apostles in Jerusalem; others take Paul to be referring sarcastically to his opponents in Corinth.</note> even if I am nothing.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:12
verses.text: Indeed, the signs of an apostle have been done among you with all patient endurance, both signs and wonders and deeds of power.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:13
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞For in what respect are you made worse off⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for what is it with respect to which you are made worse off”</note> more than the rest of the churches, except that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:14
verses.text: Behold, this third <transChange type="added">time</transChange> I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden <transChange type="added">to you</transChange>. For I am not seeking your possessions, but you. For children are not obligated to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:15
verses.text: But I will spend and be expended most gladly for your lives. If I love you much more, am I to be loved less?

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:16
verses.text: But let <transChange type="added">it</transChange> be. I have not been a burden to you, but <transChange type="added">because I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“was”) which is understood as causal</note> was crafty, I took you by cunning.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:17
verses.text: I have not taken advantage of you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞through anyone whom I sent to you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “anyone whom I sent to you, through him”</note>, have I?<note placement="foot">*The negative construction in Greek anticipates a negative answer here</note>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:18
verses.text: I urged Titus <transChange type="added">to go</transChange>, and I sent the brother <transChange type="added">with him</transChange>. Titus did not take advantage of you, <transChange type="added">did he</transChange>?<note placement="foot">*The negative construction in Greek anticipates a negative answer here</note> Did we not conduct ourselves in the same spirit?<note placement="foot">*The negative construction in Greek anticipates a positive answer here</note> Did we not walk in the same footsteps?<note placement="foot">*The negative construction in Greek anticipates a positive answer here</note>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:19
verses.text: Have you been thinking all this time that we are defending ourselves to you? We are speaking in Christ before God, and all <transChange type="added">these things</transChange>, dear friends, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> for your edification.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:20
verses.text: For I am afraid lest somehow <transChange type="added">when I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“arrive”) which is understood as temporal</note> arrive, I will not find you as I want, and I may be found by you as you do not want. I am afraid<note placement="foot">*The words “I am afraid” are not in the Greek text, but are an understood repetition from the previous clause</note> lest somehow <transChange type="added">there will be</transChange> strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambition, slander, gossip, pride, disorder.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">I am afraid</transChange> lest <transChange type="added">when I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“come”) which is understood as temporal</note> come again my God will humiliate me <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in your presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with you”</note>, and I will grieve over many of those who sinned previously and have not repented because of their impurity and sexual immorality and licentiousness that they have practiced.  <chapter eID="2Cor.12"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11719"/><title type="x-s">Final Warnings to the Church at Corinth</title> <div sID="gen27371" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11719"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the third <transChange type="added">time</transChange> I am coming to you. <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞By the testimony⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the mouth”</note> of two or three witnesses every word<note placement="foot">Or “matter”</note> will be established.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:2
verses.text: I have already said when <transChange type="added">I</transChange> was present the second time, and <transChange type="added">although I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“am absent”) which is understood as concessive</note> am absent now <transChange type="added">I</transChange> also say in advance to those who sinned previously and to all the rest, that if I come again I will not spare <transChange type="added">anyone</transChange>,

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:3
verses.text: since you are demanding proof that Christ, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not weak toward you, but is powerful among you, is speaking in me.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:4
verses.text: For indeed, he was crucified because of weakness, but he lives because of the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live together with him because of the power of God toward you.  <div eID="gen27371" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11720"/><div sID="gen27372" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11720"/>Test yourselves <transChange type="added">to see</transChange> if you are in the faith. Examine yourselves! Or do you not recognize regarding yourselves that Jesus Christ <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in you, unless you are unqualified?

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:6
verses.text: And I hope that you will recognize that we are not unqualified!

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:7
verses.text: Now we pray to God that you not do wrong in any way, not that we are seen as approved, but that you do what is good, even <transChange type="added">though</transChange> we are <transChange type="added">seen</transChange> as though unqualified.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:8
verses.text: For we are not able <transChange type="added">to do</transChange> anything against the truth, but rather <transChange type="added">only</transChange> for the truth.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:9
verses.text: For we rejoice whenever we are weak, but you are strong, and we pray for this: your maturity.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:10
verses.text: Because of this, I am writing these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <transChange type="added">although I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“am absent”) which is understood as concessive</note> am absent, in order that when I<note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“am present”) which is understood as temporal</note> am present I may not have to act severely according to the authority that the Lord has given me for building up and not for tearing down.  <div eID="gen27372" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11721"/><title type="x-s">Final Greetings and Benediction</title> <div sID="gen27373" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11721"/>Finally, brothers, rejoice, be restored, be encouraged, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞be in agreement⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “think the same thing”</note>, be at peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:12
verses.text: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the saints greet you.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:13
verses.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with all of you.  <chapter eID="2Cor.13"/> <div eID="gen27373" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27315" osisID="2Cor" type="book"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11722"/><title type="x-s">Greeting</title> <div sID="gen27375" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11722"/>Paul, an apostle not from men nor by men but through Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised him from the dead,

verses.name: Galatians 1:2
verses.text: and all the brothers with me, to the churches of Galatia.

verses.name: Galatians 1:3
verses.text: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ”</note>

verses.name: Galatians 1:4
verses.text: who gave himself for our sins in order to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,

verses.name: Galatians 1:5
verses.text: to whom <transChange type="added">be</transChange> the glory forever and ever. Amen.  <div eID="gen27375" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11723"/><title type="x-s">A Different Gospel</title> <div sID="gen27376" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11723"/>I am astonished that you are turning away so quickly from the one who called you by the grace of Christ to a different gospel,

verses.name: Galatians 1:7
verses.text: not that <transChange type="added">there</transChange> is a different <transChange type="added">gospel</transChange>, except there are some who are disturbing you and wanting to distort the gospel of Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 1:8
verses.text: But even if we or an angel from heaven should proclaim a gospel to you contrary to what we proclaimed to you, let him be accursed!

verses.name: Galatians 1:9
verses.text: As we said before, and now I say again, if anyone is proclaiming a gospel <transChange type="added">to</transChange> you contrary to what you have received, let him be accursed!

verses.name: Galatians 1:10
verses.text: For am I now making an appeal to people or <transChange type="added">to</transChange> God? Or am I seeking to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a slave of Christ.  <div eID="gen27376" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11724"/><title type="x-s">Paul’s Defense of His Apostleship</title> <div sID="gen27377" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11724"/>For I make known to you, brothers, the gospel that has been proclaimed by me, that it is not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞of human origin⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “according to man”</note>.

verses.name: Galatians 1:12
verses.text: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, but <transChange type="added">I received it</transChange> through a revelation of Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 1:13
verses.text: For you have heard about my former way of life in Judaism, that to an extraordinary degree I was persecuting the church of God, and trying to destroy it,

verses.name: Galatians 1:14
verses.text: and was progressing in Judaism beyond many contemporaries in my nation, <transChange type="added">because</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“was”) which is understood as causal</note> I was a far more zealous adherent of the traditions handed down by my forefathers.  <div eID="gen27377" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11725"/><div sID="gen27378" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11725"/>But when the one who set me apart<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “when God who set me apart”</note> from my mother’s womb and called <transChange type="added">me</transChange> by his grace was pleased

verses.name: Galatians 1:16
verses.text: to reveal his Son in me in order that I would proclaim the gospel <transChange type="added">about</transChange> him among the Gentiles, immediately I did not consult with flesh and blood,

verses.name: Galatians 1:17
verses.text: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> apostles before me, but I went away to Arabia and I returned again to Damascus.

verses.name: Galatians 1:18
verses.text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to become acquainted with Cephas, and I stayed with him fifteen days,

verses.name: Galatians 1:19
verses.text: but I did not see <transChange type="added">any</transChange> others of the apostles except James, the brother of the Lord.

verses.name: Galatians 1:20
verses.text: (Now <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which I am writing to you, behold, <transChange type="added">I assure you</transChange> before God that I am not lying.)

verses.name: Galatians 1:21
verses.text: Then I came to the regions of Syria and of Cilicia,

verses.name: Galatians 1:22
verses.text: but I was unknown <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by face”</note> to the churches of Judea <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> in Christ,

verses.name: Galatians 1:23
verses.text: and they were only hearing, “The one formerly persecuting us is now proclaiming the faith that formerly he was attempting to destroy,”

verses.name: Galatians 1:24
verses.text: and they were glorifying God because of me.  <chapter eID="Gal.1"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11726"/><title type="x-s">Paul’s Ministry Recognized by the Jerusalem Apostles</title> <div sID="gen27379" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11726"/>Then after fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking along Titus also.

verses.name: Galatians 2:2
verses.text: Now I went up <transChange type="added">there</transChange> because of a revelation and laid out to them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles, but in private to the influential people, lest somehow I was running, or had run, in vain.

verses.name: Galatians 2:3
verses.text: But not even Titus <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> with me, <transChange type="added">although</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“was”) which is understood as concessive</note> he was a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

verses.name: Galatians 2:4
verses.text: Now <transChange type="added">this was</transChange> because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who slipped in to spy out our freedom that we have in Christ Jesus, in order that they might enslave us,

verses.name: Galatians 2:5
verses.text: to whom not even for an hour did we yield in subjection, in order that the truth of the gospel might remain continually with you.

verses.name: Galatians 2:6
verses.text: But from those <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who were influential⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who were thought to be something”</note> (whatever they were, it makes no difference to me, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞God does not show partiality⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “God does not receive the face of man”</note>)—for those who were influential added nothing to me.

verses.name: Galatians 2:7
verses.text: But these, <transChange type="added">when they</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“saw”) which is understood as temporal</note> saw that I had been entrusted <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the gospel to the uncircumcision, just as Peter to the circumcision

verses.name: Galatians 2:8
verses.text: (for the one who was at work through Peter for <transChange type="added">his</transChange> apostleship to the circumcision was at work also through me for the Gentiles),

verses.name: Galatians 2:9
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> James and Cephas and John—those thought to be pillars—acknowledged the grace given to me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right <transChange type="added">hand</transChange> of fellowship, in order that we <transChange type="added">should go</transChange> to the Gentiles and they to the circumcision.

verses.name: Galatians 2:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">They asked</transChange> only that we should remember the poor, the very thing I was also eager to do.  <div eID="gen27379" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11727"/><title type="x-s">Paul Confronts Peter at Antioch</title> <div sID="gen27380" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11727"/>But when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed <transChange type="added">him</transChange> to his face, because he was condemned.

verses.name: Galatians 2:12
verses.text: For before certain people came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles, but when they came, he withdrew and separated himself, <transChange type="added">because he</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“was afraid of”) which is understood as causal</note> was afraid of those <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> of the circumcision,

verses.name: Galatians 2:13
verses.text: and the rest of the Jews also joined in <transChange type="added">this</transChange> hypocrisy with him, so that even Barnabas was carried away with them in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> hypocrisy.

verses.name: Galatians 2:14
verses.text: But when I saw that they were not being straightforward with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in the presence of <transChange type="added">them</transChange> all, “If you, <transChange type="added">although you</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“are”) which is understood as concessive</note> are a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you try to compel the Gentiles to live like Jews?”  <div eID="gen27380" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11728"/><title type="x-s">Justified by Faith in Christ</title> <div sID="gen27381" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11728"/>We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> Jews by nature and not sinners from among the Gentiles,

verses.name: Galatians 2:16
verses.text: but knowing that a person is not justified by the works of the law, if not by faith in Jesus Christ,<note placement="foot">Or “by the faithfulness of Jesus Christ”</note> and we have believed in Christ Jesus so that we may be justified by faith in Christ<note placement="foot">Or “by the faithfulness of Christ”</note> and not by the works of the law, because by the works of the law <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞no human being will be justified⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “all flesh will not be justified”</note>.

verses.name: Galatians 2:17
verses.text: But if <transChange type="added">while</transChange> seeking to be justified by Christ, <transChange type="added">we</transChange> ourselves also have been found <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> sinners, then <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Christ an agent of sin? May it never be!

verses.name: Galatians 2:18
verses.text: For if I build up again these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> which I destroyed, I show myself <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> a transgressor.

verses.name: Galatians 2:19
verses.text: For through the law I died to the law, in order that I might live to God. I have been crucified with Christ,

verses.name: Galatians 2:20
verses.text: and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me, and that <transChange type="added">life</transChange> I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

verses.name: Galatians 2:21
verses.text: I do not declare invalid the grace of God, for if righteousness <transChange type="added">is</transChange> through the law, then Christ died to no purpose.  <chapter eID="Gal.2"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11729"/><title type="x-s">Justified by the Law, or Justified by Faith?</title> <div sID="gen27382" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11729"/>O foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was publicly portrayed <transChange type="added">as</transChange> having been crucified?

verses.name: Galatians 3:2
verses.text: I want only to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

verses.name: Galatians 3:3
verses.text: Are you so foolish? Having begun by the Spirit, are you now trying to be made complete by the flesh?

verses.name: Galatians 3:4
verses.text: Have you suffered so many <transChange type="added">things</transChange> for nothing—if indeed also <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> for nothing?

verses.name: Galatians 3:5
verses.text: Therefore does the one who gives you the Spirit and who works miracles among you <transChange type="added">do so</transChange> by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?  <div eID="gen27382" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11730"/><div sID="gen27383" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11730"/>Just as Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him for righteousness,

verses.name: Galatians 3:7
verses.text: then understand that the ones <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who have faith⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of faith”</note>, these are sons of Abraham.

verses.name: Galatians 3:8
verses.text: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, proclaimed the good news in advance to Abraham: “In you all the nations<note placement="foot">Or “Gentiles”; the same Greek word can be translated “nations” or “Gentiles” depending on the context</note> will be blessed.”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Gen.12.3">Gen 12:3</reference>; <reference osisRef="Gen.18.18">18:18</reference></note>

verses.name: Galatians 3:9
verses.text: So then, the ones <transChange type="added">who have</transChange> faith are blessed together with Abraham who believed.

verses.name: Galatians 3:10
verses.text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse, for it is written, “Cursed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> everyone who does not abide by all <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> that are written in the book of the law to do them.”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Deut.27.26">Deut 27:26</reference></note>

verses.name: Galatians 3:11
verses.text: Now <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> clear that no one is justified in the sight of God by the law, because “the one who is righteous will live by faith.”<note placement="foot">Or “the one who is righteous by faith will live,” a quotation from <reference osisRef="Hab.2.4">Hab 2:4</reference></note>

verses.name: Galatians 3:12
verses.text: But the law is not from faith, but “the one who does these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> will live by them.”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Lev.18.5">Lev 18:5</reference></note>  <div eID="gen27383" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11731"/><div sID="gen27384" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11731"/>Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“becoming”) which is understood as means</note> becoming a curse for us, because it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Deut.21.23">Deut 21:23</reference></note>

verses.name: Galatians 3:14
verses.text: in order that the blessing of Abraham might come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, so that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.  <div eID="gen27384" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11732"/><title type="x-s">The Promise to Abraham and His Descendant</title> <div sID="gen27385" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11732"/>Brothers, I am speaking according to a human perspective. Nevertheless, <transChange type="added">when</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“has been ratified”) which is understood as temporal</note> the covenant of a man has been ratified, no one declares <transChange type="added">it</transChange> invalid or adds additional provisions <transChange type="added">to it</transChange>.

verses.name: Galatians 3:16
verses.text: Now to Abraham and to his descendant the promises were spoken. It does not say, “and to descendants,” as concerning many, but as concerning one, “and to your descendant,”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Gen.12.7">Gen 12:7</reference>; <reference osisRef="Gen.13.15">13:15</reference>; <reference osisRef="Gen.17.7">17:7</reference>; <reference osisRef="Gen.24.7">24:7</reference></note> who is Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 3:17
verses.text: Now I am saying this: the law, that came after four hundred and thirty years, does not revoke a covenant previously ratified by God, in order to nullify the promise.

verses.name: Galatians 3:18
verses.text: For if the inheritance <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from the law, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> no longer from the promise, but God graciously gave <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to Abraham through the promise.  <div eID="gen27385" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11733"/><title type="x-s">The Addition of the Law</title> <div sID="gen27386" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11733"/>Why then the law? It was added on account of transgressions, until the descendant should come to whom it had been promised, having been ordered through angels by the hand of a mediator.

verses.name: Galatians 3:20
verses.text: Now the mediator is not for one, but God is one.  <div eID="gen27386" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11734"/><div sID="gen27387" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11734"/>Therefore <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the law opposed to the promises of God? May it never be! For if a law had been given that was able to give life, certainly righteousness would have been from the law.

verses.name: Galatians 3:22
verses.text: But the scripture imprisoned all under sin, in order that the promise could be given by faith<note placement="foot">Or “through the faithfulness of Jesus Christ”</note> in Jesus Christ to those who believe.  <div eID="gen27387" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11735"/><div sID="gen27388" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11735"/>But before faith came, we were detained under the law, imprisoned until the coming faith was revealed.

verses.name: Galatians 3:24
verses.text: So then, the law became our guardian until Christ, in order that we could be justified by faith.

verses.name: Galatians 3:25
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">after</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “after” is supplied as a component of the participle (“has come”) which is understood as temporal</note> faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.

verses.name: Galatians 3:26
verses.text: For you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus,<note placement="foot">Or “For in Christ Jesus you are all sons of God through faith”</note>

verses.name: Galatians 3:27
verses.text: for as many <transChange type="added">of you</transChange> as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 3:28
verses.text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is neither male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Galatians 3:29
verses.text: And if you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> Christ’s, then you are descendants of Abraham, heirs according to the promise.  <chapter eID="Gal.3"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11736"/><title type="x-s">No Longer Slaves But Sons and Heirs</title> <div sID="gen27389" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11736"/>Now I say, for as long a time <transChange type="added">as</transChange> the heir is a child, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> no different from a slave, <transChange type="added">although he</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“is”) which is understood as concessive</note> is master of everything,

verses.name: Galatians 4:2
verses.text: but he is under guardians and managers until the time set by <transChange type="added">his</transChange> father.

verses.name: Galatians 4:3
verses.text: So also we, when we were children, we were enslaved under the elemental spirits of the world.

verses.name: Galatians 4:4
verses.text: But when the fullness of time came, God sent out his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,

verses.name: Galatians 4:5
verses.text: in order that he might redeem those under the law, in order that we might receive the adoption.

verses.name: Galatians 4:6
verses.text: And because you are sons, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba!<note placement="foot">“Abba” is Aramaic for “father”</note> (Father!),”

verses.name: Galatians 4:7
verses.text: so that you are no longer a slave but a son, and if a son, also an heir through God.  <div eID="gen27389" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11737"/><title type="x-s">Do Not Be Enslaved Again</title> <div sID="gen27390" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11737"/>But at that time <transChange type="added">when you</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“know”) which is understood as temporal</note> did not know God, you were enslaved to the things which by nature are not gods.

verses.name: Galatians 4:9
verses.text: But now, <transChange type="added">because you</transChange> have come to know God, or rather have come to be known by God, how can you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental spirits? Do you want to be enslaved to them<note placement="foot">Literally “to whom”</note> all over again?

verses.name: Galatians 4:10
verses.text: You carefully observe days and months and seasons and years.

verses.name: Galatians 4:11
verses.text: I am afraid <transChange type="added">for</transChange> you, lest perhaps I have labored for you in vain!

verses.name: Galatians 4:12
verses.text: I ask you, brothers, become like me, because I also <transChange type="added">have become</transChange> like you. You have done me no <transChange type="added">wrong</transChange>!  <div eID="gen27390" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11738"/><title type="x-s">Paul’s Personal Appeal</title> <div sID="gen27391" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11738"/>But you know that because of an illness of the flesh I proclaimed the gospel to you the first time.

verses.name: Galatians 4:14
verses.text: And you did not despise or disdain <transChange type="added">what was</transChange> a trial for you in my flesh, but you welcomed me like an angel of God, like Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Galatians 4:15
verses.text: So where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> your blessing? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have torn out your eyes <transChange type="added">and</transChange> given <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to me!

verses.name: Galatians 4:16
verses.text: So then, have I become your enemy <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“being truthful”) which is understood as means</note> being truthful to you?

verses.name: Galatians 4:17
verses.text: They zealously seek you, not commendably, but they want to exclude you, in order that you may seek them <transChange type="added">zealously</transChange>.

verses.name: Galatians 4:18
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> good to be sought zealously in good at all times, and not only when I am present with you.

verses.name: Galatians 4:19
verses.text: My children, for whom I am having birth pains again, until Christ is formed in you!

verses.name: Galatians 4:20
verses.text: But I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone because I am perplexed about you.  <div eID="gen27391" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11739"/><title type="x-s">Hagar and Sarah Represent Two Covenants</title> <div sID="gen27392" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11739"/>Tell me, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> who are wanting to be under the law, do you not understand<note placement="foot">Literally “hear”</note> the law?

verses.name: Galatians 4:22
verses.text: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the female slave and one by the free woman.

verses.name: Galatians 4:23
verses.text: But the one by the female slave was born according to human descent, and the one by the free woman through the promise,

verses.name: Galatians 4:24
verses.text: which <transChange type="added">things</transChange> are spoken allegorically, for these <transChange type="added">women</transChange> are two covenants, one from Mount Sinai, bearing <transChange type="added">children</transChange> for slavery, who is Hagar.

verses.name: Galatians 4:25
verses.text: Now Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and corresponds to the present Jerusalem, for she is a slave with her children.

verses.name: Galatians 4:26
verses.text: But the Jerusalem above is free, which is our mother.

verses.name: Galatians 4:27
verses.text: For it is written, <div eID="gen27392" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27393"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27394"/>“Rejoice, O barren woman, who does not give birth to <transChange type="added">children</transChange>;<l eID="gen27394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27395"/>burst out and shout, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> who do not have birth pains,<l eID="gen27395" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27396"/>because many <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the children of the desolate <transChange type="added">woman</transChange>,<l eID="gen27396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27397"/>even more than <transChange type="added">those of</transChange> the one who has a husband.”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Isa.54.1">Isa 54:1</reference></note> <l eID="gen27397" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen27393"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11740"/><div sID="gen27398" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11740"/>But you, brothers, are children of the promise, just as Isaac.

verses.name: Galatians 4:29
verses.text: But just as at that time the <transChange type="added">child</transChange> born according to human descent persecuted the <transChange type="added">child born</transChange> according to the Spirit, so also now.

verses.name: Galatians 4:30
verses.text: But what does the scripture say? “Drive out the female slave and her son, for the son of the female slave will never inherit with the son”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Gen.21.10">Gen 21:10, </reference>which does not include the words “of the free woman”</note> of the free woman.

verses.name: Galatians 4:31
verses.text: Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the female slave but of the free woman.  <chapter eID="Gal.4"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11741"/><title type="x-s">Live in Freedom and Love One Another</title> <div sID="gen27399" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11741"/>For freedom Christ has set us free. Stand firm, therefore, and do not be subject again to a yoke of slavery.

verses.name: Galatians 5:2
verses.text: Look! I, Paul, tell you that if you become circumcised, Christ will profit you nothing!

verses.name: Galatians 5:3
verses.text: And again I testify to every man who becomes circumcised, that he is under obligation to keep the whole law.

verses.name: Galatians 5:4
verses.text: You are estranged from Christ, <transChange type="added">you</transChange> who are attempting to be justified<note placement="foot">*The present tense has been translated as conative here (“are attempting”)</note> by the law; you have fallen from grace.

verses.name: Galatians 5:5
verses.text: For through the Spirit by faith we eagerly await the hope of righteousness.

verses.name: Galatians 5:6
verses.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision counts for anything nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.  <div eID="gen27399" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11742"/><div sID="gen27400" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11742"/>You were running well. Who hindered you from obeying the truth?

verses.name: Galatians 5:8
verses.text: This persuasion <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not from the one who calls you!

verses.name: Galatians 5:9
verses.text: A little leaven leavens the whole batch of dough.

verses.name: Galatians 5:10
verses.text: I have confidence in you in the Lord that you will think nothing different, but the one who is confusing you <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will pay the penalty⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will bear the = his condemnation”</note>, whoever he may be.

verses.name: Galatians 5:11
verses.text: Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the stumbling block of the cross has been abolished.

verses.name: Galatians 5:12
verses.text: I wish that the ones who are disturbing you would also <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞castrate themselves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cut themselves off”</note>!  <div eID="gen27400" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11743"/><div sID="gen27401" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11743"/>For you were called to freedom, brothers. Only do not let your freedom <transChange type="added">become</transChange> an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another.

verses.name: Galatians 5:14
verses.text: For the whole law is fulfilled in one statement, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Lev.19.18">Lev 19:18</reference></note>

verses.name: Galatians 5:15
verses.text: But if you bite and devour one another, watch out <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you are not consumed by one another.  <div eID="gen27401" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11744"/><title type="x-s">Live by the Spirit and Reject the Deeds of the Flesh</title> <div sID="gen27402" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11744"/>But I say, live by the Spirit, and you will never carry out the desire of the flesh.

verses.name: Galatians 5:17
verses.text: For the flesh desires against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh, for these are in opposition to one another, so that whatever you want, you may not do these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.

verses.name: Galatians 5:18
verses.text: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.  <div eID="gen27402" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11745"/><div sID="gen27403" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11745"/>Now the deeds of the flesh are evident, which are sexual immorality, impurity, licentiousness,

verses.name: Galatians 5:20
verses.text: idolatry, sorcery, enmity, strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambition, dissension, factions,

verses.name: Galatians 5:21
verses.text: envy, drunkenness, carousing, and things like these, <transChange type="added">things</transChange> which I am telling you <transChange type="added">in advance</transChange>, just as I said before, that the ones who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Galatians 5:22
verses.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

verses.name: Galatians 5:23
verses.text: gentleness, self control. Against such things <transChange type="added">there</transChange> is no law.

verses.name: Galatians 5:24
verses.text: Now those <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who belong to Christ⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of Christ”</note><note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “Christ Jesus”</note> have crucified the flesh together with its feelings and its desires.  <div eID="gen27403" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11746"/><div sID="gen27404" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11746"/>If we live by the Spirit, we must also follow the Spirit.

verses.name: Galatians 5:26
verses.text: We must not become conceited, provoking one another, envying one another.  <chapter eID="Gal.5"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11747"/><title type="x-s">Carry One Another’s Burdens</title> <div sID="gen27405" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11747"/>Brothers, even if a person is caught in some trespass, you <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> spiritual restore such a person in a spirit of humility, looking out for yourself, lest you also be tempted.

verses.name: Galatians 6:2
verses.text: Carry the burdens of one another, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 6:3
verses.text: For if anyone thinks he is something <transChange type="added">although he</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“is”) which is understood as concessive</note> is nothing, he is deceiving himself.

verses.name: Galatians 6:4
verses.text: But let each one examine his own work, and then he will have a reason for boasting in himself alone, and not in someone else.

verses.name: Galatians 6:5
verses.text: For each one will carry his own burden.  <div eID="gen27405" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11748"/><title type="x-s">Do Good to All People</title> <div sID="gen27406" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11748"/>Now the one who is taught the word must share in all good <transChange type="added">things</transChange> with the one who teaches.

verses.name: Galatians 6:7
verses.text: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked, for whatever a person sows, this he will also reap,

verses.name: Galatians 6:8
verses.text: because the one who sows to his own flesh will reap corruption from the flesh, but the one who sows to the Spirit will reap eternal life from the Spirit.

verses.name: Galatians 6:9
verses.text: And let us not grow weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap, <transChange type="added">if we</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “if” is supplied as a component of the participle (“give up”) which is understood as conditional</note> do not give up.

verses.name: Galatians 6:10
verses.text: So then, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all <transChange type="added">people</transChange>, and especially to those who belong to the household of faith.  <div eID="gen27406" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11749"/><title type="x-s">A Final Warning</title> <div sID="gen27407" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11749"/>See with what large letters I am writing to you with my <transChange type="added">own</transChange> hand.

verses.name: Galatians 6:12
verses.text: As many as are wanting to make a good showing in the flesh, these are attempting to compel<note placement="foot">*The present tense has been translated as conative here (“are attempting”)</note> you to be circumcised, only so that they will not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 6:13
verses.text: For not even those who are circumcised observe the law themselves, but they want you to be circumcised in order that they may boast in your flesh.

verses.name: Galatians 6:14
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as</transChange> for me, may it never be <transChange type="added">that I</transChange> boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

verses.name: Galatians 6:15
verses.text: For neither is circumcision anything nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

verses.name: Galatians 6:16
verses.text: And all those who follow this rule, peace and mercy <transChange type="added">be</transChange> on them and on the Israel of God.  <div eID="gen27407" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11750"/><title type="x-s">Conclusion and Benediction</title> <div sID="gen27408" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11750"/>Finally, let no one cause me trouble, for I carry on my body the marks of Jesus.

verses.name: Galatians 6:18
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with your spirit, brothers. Amen.  <chapter eID="Gal.6"/> <div eID="gen27408" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27374" osisID="Gal" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11751"/><title type="x-s">Greeting</title> <div sID="gen27410" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11751"/>Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, to the saints who are in Ephesus<note placement="foot">A number of the earliest and most important manuscripts omit “in Ephesus,” though it is hard to make sense of the line without this phrase (cf. <sc>rsv</sc>, “to the saints who are also faithful”)</note> and faithful in Christ Jesus:

verses.name: Ephesians 1:2
verses.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.  <div eID="gen27410" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11752"/><title type="x-s">Praise to God for Spiritual Blessings</title> <div sID="gen27411" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11752"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange><note placement="foot">Or “blessed be”</note> the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly <transChange type="added">places</transChange> in Christ,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:4
verses.text: just as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> we should be holy and blameless before him in love,<note placement="foot">Or “before him, having predestined us in love” (the phrase “in love” could go either with v. <reference osisRef="Eph.1.4">4</reference> or v. <reference osisRef="Eph.1.5">5</reference>)</note>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:5
verses.text: having predestined us to adoption through Jesus Christ to himself according to the good pleasure of his will,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:6
verses.text: to the praise of the glory of his grace that he bestowed on us in the beloved,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:7
verses.text: in whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:8
verses.text: that he caused to abound to us in all wisdom and insight,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:9
verses.text: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure that he purposed in him,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:10
verses.text: for the administration of the fullness of times, to bring together all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him

verses.name: Ephesians 1:11
verses.text: in whom also we were chosen, having been predestined according to the purpose of the One who works all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> according to the counsel of his will,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> we who hoped beforehand in Christ should be for the praise of his glory,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:13
verses.text: in whom also you, when you heard<note placement="foot">*This participle (“hearing”) and the following one (“believing”) are understood as temporal</note> the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation, in whom also when you believed you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:14
verses.text: who is the down payment of our inheritance, until the redemption of the possession, to the praise of his glory.  <div eID="gen27411" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11753"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for Spiritual Wisdom</title> <div sID="gen27412" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11753"/>Because of this I also, hearing of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your faith⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the according to you faith”</note> in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:16
verses.text: do not cease giving thanks for you, making mention in my prayers,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:17
verses.text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the glorious Father⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the Father of glory”</note>,<note placement="foot">*Here “glorious” is an attributive genitive</note> may give you a spirit of wisdom<note placement="foot">*Or “spiritual wisdom” (with “wisdom” is an attributive genitive)</note> and revelation in the knowledge of him

verses.name: Ephesians 1:18
verses.text: (the eyes of your hearts having been enlightened), so that you may know what is the hope of his calling, what <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the riches of the glory of his inheritance among the saints,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:19
verses.text: and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the surpassing greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to the working of his mighty strength

verses.name: Ephesians 1:20
verses.text: which he has worked<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “he worked”</note> in Christ, raising<note placement="foot">*These participles are either means (“by raising … and seating”) or temporal (“when he raised … and seated”)</note> him from the dead and seating him<note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> at his right hand in the heavenly <transChange type="added">places</transChange>,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:21
verses.text: above all rule and authority and power and lordship and every name named, not only in this age but also in the coming one,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:22
verses.text: and he subjected all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> under his feet<note placement="foot">An allusion to <reference osisRef="Ps.8.6">Ps 8:6</reference></note> and gave him <transChange type="added">as</transChange> head over all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to the church,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:23
verses.text: which is his body, the fullness of the one who fills all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> in every <transChange type="added">way</transChange>.  <chapter eID="Eph.1"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11754"/><title type="x-s">Made Alive in Christ</title> <div sID="gen27413" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11754"/>And you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞although you were dead⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and you being dead”</note><note placement="foot">*Here the participle (“being”) is understood as concessive</note> in your trespasses and sins,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:2
verses.text: in which you formerly walked according to the course of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, the spirit now working in the sons of disobedience,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:3
verses.text: among whom also we all formerly lived in the desires of our flesh, doing the will<note placement="foot">Or “desires”</note> of the flesh and of the mind, and we were children of wrath<note placement="foot">This phrase is a Semitic idiom which can mean either (1) “children characterized by wrath” or (2) “children destined for wrath”</note> by nature, as also the rest of <transChange type="added">them</transChange> were.  <div eID="gen27413" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11755"/><div sID="gen27414" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11755"/>But God, being rich in mercy, because of his great love <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which he loved us,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:5
verses.text: and we being dead in trespasses, he made <transChange type="added">us</transChange> alive together with Christ (by grace you are saved),

verses.name: Ephesians 2:6
verses.text: and raised <transChange type="added">us</transChange> together and seated <transChange type="added">us</transChange> together in the heavenly <transChange type="added">places</transChange> in Christ Jesus,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:7
verses.text: in order that he might show in the coming ages the surpassing riches of his grace in kindness upon us in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:8
verses.text: For by grace you are saved through faith, and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not from yourselves, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> the gift of God;

verses.name: Ephesians 2:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not from works, so that no one can boast.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:10
verses.text: For we are his creation, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, so that we may walk in them.  <div eID="gen27414" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11756"/><title type="x-s">Jewish and Gentile Believers United in Christ</title> <div sID="gen27415" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11756"/>Therefore remember that formerly you, the Gentiles in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flesh, the so-called uncircumcision by the so-called circumcision in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flesh, made by hands,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:12
verses.text: that you were at that time apart from Christ, alienated from the citizenship of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of promise, not having hope, and without God in the world.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:13
verses.text: But now in Christ Jesus you, the ones who once were far away, have become near by the blood of Christ.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:14
verses.text: For he himself is our peace, who made both one and broke down the dividing wall of the partition, the enmity, in his flesh,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:15
verses.text: invalidating the law of commandments in ordinances, in order that he might create the two in himself into one new man, <transChange type="added">thus</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “thus” is supplied as a component of the participle (“making”) which is understood as result</note> making peace,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:16
verses.text: and might reconcile both in one body to God through the cross, killing the enmity in himself.<note placement="foot">Or “by it” (referring to the cross)</note>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:17
verses.text: And coming, he proclaimed the good news of peace to you who were far away and peace to the ones who were near,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:18
verses.text: because through him <transChange type="added">we</transChange> both have access in one Spirit to the Father.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:19
verses.text: Consequently, therefore, you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens of the saints and members of the household of God,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:20
verses.text: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the cornerstone,<note placement="foot">Or perhaps “capstone”</note>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:21
verses.text: in whom the whole building, joined together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:22
verses.text: in whom you also are built up together into a dwelling place of God in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> Spirit.<note placement="foot">Or “are built up together in spirit = spiritually into a dwelling place of God” (cf. <sc>nrsv</sc>)</note>  <chapter eID="Eph.2"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11757"/><title type="x-s">The Mystery of Christ Revealed</title> <div sID="gen27416" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11757"/>On account of this I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles

verses.name: Ephesians 3:2
verses.text: —if indeed you have heard <transChange type="added">about</transChange> the stewardship of God’s grace given to me for you.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:3
verses.text: According to<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “given to me for you, that according to”</note> revelation the mystery was made known to me, just as I wrote beforehand in brief,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:4
verses.text: so that you may be able when you read<note placement="foot">Or “by reading”</note> to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ

verses.name: Ephesians 3:5
verses.text: (which in other generations was not made known to the sons of men as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit):

verses.name: Ephesians 3:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> the Gentiles are fellow heirs, and fellow members of the body, and fellow sharers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:7
verses.text: of which I became a servant, according to the gift of God’s grace given to me, according to the working of his power.  <div eID="gen27416" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11758"/><div sID="gen27417" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11758"/>To me, the least of all the saints, was given this grace: to proclaim the good news of the fathomless riches of Christ to the Gentiles,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:9
verses.text: and to enlighten everyone <transChange type="added">as to</transChange> what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the administration of the mystery hidden from the ages by God, who created all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:10
verses.text: in order that the many-sided wisdom of God might be made known now to the rulers and the authorities in the heavenly <transChange type="added">places</transChange> through the church,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:11
verses.text: according to the purpose of the ages which he carried out in Christ Jesus our Lord,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:12
verses.text: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through faith in him.<note placement="foot">Or “through his i.e., Christ’s faithfulness”</note>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:13
verses.text: Therefore I ask <transChange type="added">you</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> not to be discouraged at my afflictions on behalf of you, which are your glory.  <div eID="gen27417" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:14
