verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11759"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for Spiritual Strength</title> <div sID="gen27418" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11759"/>On account of this, I bend my knees before the Father,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:15
verses.text: from whom every<note placement="foot">Or “the whole”</note> family in heaven and on earth is named,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:16
verses.text: that he may grant you according to the riches of his glory to be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith (you having been firmly rooted and established in love),

verses.name: Ephesians 3:18
verses.text: in order that you may be strong enough to grasp together with all the saints what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the breadth, and length, and height, and depth,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:19
verses.text: and to know the love of Christ that surpasses knowledge, in order that you may be filled up to all the fullness of God.  <div eID="gen27418" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11760"/><div sID="gen27419" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11760"/>Now to the one who is able to do beyond all measure more than all that we ask or think, according to the power that is at work in us,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:21
verses.text: to him <transChange type="added">be</transChange> the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.  <chapter eID="Eph.3"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11761"/><title type="x-s">Christians Should Live in Unity</title> <div sID="gen27420" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11761"/>Therefore I, the prisoner in the Lord, exhort you to live in a manner worthy of the calling with which you were called:

verses.name: Ephesians 4:2
verses.text: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, putting up with one another in love,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:3
verses.text: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace;

verses.name: Ephesians 4:4
verses.text: one body and one Spirit (just as also you were called with one hope of your calling),

verses.name: Ephesians 4:5
verses.text: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:6
verses.text: one God and Father of all, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> over all, and through all, and in all.  <div eID="gen27420" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11762"/><title type="x-s">Gifted Leaders Bring the Church to Maturity</title> <div sID="gen27421" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11762"/>Now to each one of us was given this grace, according to the measure of Christ’s gift.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:8
verses.text: Therefore it says, <div eID="gen27421" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27422"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27423"/>“Ascending on high he led captivity captive;<l eID="gen27423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27424"/>he gave gifts to men.”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Ps.68.18">Ps 68:18</reference></note> <l eID="gen27424" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen27422"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11763"/><div sID="gen27425" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11763"/>Now “he ascended,” what is <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, except that he also descended<note placement="foot">Some secondary manuscripts add “first”</note> to the lower regions of the earth?

verses.name: Ephesians 4:10
verses.text: The one who descended himself is also the one who ascended above all the heavens, in order that he might fill all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.  <div eID="gen27425" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11764"/><div sID="gen27426" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11764"/>And he himself gave some <transChange type="added">as</transChange> apostles and some <transChange type="added">as</transChange> prophets and some <transChange type="added">as</transChange> evangelists and some <transChange type="added">as</transChange> pastors and teachers

verses.name: Ephesians 4:12
verses.text: for the equipping of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for building up the body of Christ,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:13
verses.text: until we all reach the unity of the faith and the knowledge of the Son of God, to a mature man, to a measure of the maturity of the fullness of Christ,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:14
verses.text: so that we may no longer be infants, tossed about by waves and carried about by every wind of teaching, by the trickery of people, by craftiness with reference to the scheming of deceit.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:15
verses.text: But speaking the truth in love, we are to grow into him <transChange type="added">with reference to</transChange> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, who is the head, Christ,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:16
verses.text: from whom the whole body, joined together and held together by every supporting ligament, according to the working by measure of each single part, the growth of the body makes for the building up of itself in love.  <div eID="gen27426" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11765"/><title type="x-s">Appeal for New Behavior</title> <div sID="gen27427" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11765"/>This therefore I say and testify in the Lord, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you no longer walk as the Gentiles walk: in the futility of their mind,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:18
verses.text: being darkened in understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance <transChange type="added">that</transChange> is in them, because of the hardness of their heart,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:19
verses.text: who, becoming callous, gave themselves over to licentiousness, for the pursuit of all uncleanness in greediness.  <div eID="gen27427" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11766"/><div sID="gen27428" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11766"/>But you did not learn Christ in this way,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:21
verses.text: if indeed you have heard <transChange type="added">about</transChange> him, and you were taught by him (just as truth is in Jesus),

verses.name: Ephesians 4:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you take off, according to your former way of life, the old man, who is being destroyed according to deceitful desires,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:23
verses.text: be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:24
verses.text: and put on the new man (in accordance with God), who is created in righteousness and holiness from the truth.  <div eID="gen27428" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11767"/><title type="x-s">Old Behavior, New Behavior, and Motivation</title> <div sID="gen27429" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11767"/>Therefore, putting aside the lie, speak truth each one of you with his neighbor,<note placement="foot">An allusion to <reference osisRef="Zech.8.16">Zech 8:16</reference></note> because we are members of one another.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:26
verses.text: Be angry and do not sin;<note placement="foot">An allusion to <reference osisRef="Ps.4.4">Ps 4:4</reference></note> do not let the sun set on your anger,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:27
verses.text: nor give place to the devil.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:28
verses.text: The one who steals must steal no longer, but instead must labor, working with his own hands <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> good, so that he may have <transChange type="added">something</transChange> to share with the one who has need.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:29
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞No rotten word must proceed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “Every rotten word must not proceed”</note> from your mouth, but only something good for the building up of the need, in order that it may give grace to those who hear,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:30
verses.text: and do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:31
verses.text: All bitterness, and rage, and wrath, and clamor, and abusive speech, must be removed from you, together with all wickedness.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:32
verses.text: Become<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “But become”</note> kind toward one another, compassionate, forgiving one another, just as also God in Christ has forgiven you.  <chapter eID="Eph.4"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11768"/><title type="x-s">Imitators of God</title> <div sID="gen27430" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11768"/>Therefore become imitators of God, as beloved children,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:2
verses.text: and live in love, just as also Christ loved us, and gave himself for us an offering and sacrifice to God for a fragrant smell.<note placement="foot">Or “a fragrant offering”</note>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:3
verses.text: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or greediness, must not even be named among you (as is fitting for saints),

verses.name: Ephesians 5:4
verses.text: and obscenity, and foolish talk, or coarse jesting (which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not proper), but rather thanksgiving.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:5
verses.text: For this you know <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for certain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for this you know, knowing”</note>, that every sexually immoral <transChange type="added">person</transChange>, or unclean <transChange type="added">person</transChange>, or greedy <transChange type="added">person</transChange> (who is an idolater), does not have an inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:6
verses.text: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.  <div eID="gen27430" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11769"/><title type="x-s">Walk Like Children of Light</title> <div sID="gen27431" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11769"/>Therefore do not be sharers<note placement="foot">Or “partners”</note> with them,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:8
verses.text: for you were formerly darkness, but now <transChange type="added">you are</transChange> light in the Lord. Live like children of light

verses.name: Ephesians 5:9
verses.text: (for the fruit of the light <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in all goodness and righteousness and truth),

verses.name: Ephesians 5:10
verses.text: trying to learn what is well-pleasing to the Lord.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:11
verses.text: And do not participate in the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even expose <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:12
verses.text: For it is shameful even to speak <transChange type="added">about</transChange> the things being <transChange type="added">done</transChange> by them in secret,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:13
verses.text: but all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> exposed by the light are made visible,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:14
verses.text: for everything made visible is light. Therefore it says, <div eID="gen27431" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27432"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27433"/>Wake up, sleeper,<l eID="gen27433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27434"/>and rise from the dead,<l eID="gen27434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27435"/>and Christ will shine on you.<note placement="foot">A quotation of unknown origin with possible allusions to <reference osisRef="Isa.26.19">Isa 26:19</reference>, <reference osisRef="Isa.51.17">51:17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Isa.52.1">52:1</reference>, <reference osisRef="Isa.60.1">60:1</reference></note> <l eID="gen27435" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen27432"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11770"/><div sID="gen27436" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11770"/>Therefore, consider carefully how you live, not as unwise but as wise,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:16
verses.text: making the most of the time because the days are evil.  <div eID="gen27436" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11771"/><title type="x-s">Being Filled by the Spirit</title> <div sID="gen27437" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11771"/>Because of this do not become foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord <transChange type="added">is</transChange>.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:18
verses.text: And do not be drunk with wine (in which is dissipation), but be filled by the Spirit,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:19
verses.text: speaking to one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and singing praise in your heart to the Lord,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:20
verses.text: giving thanks always for all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to the God and Father,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:21
verses.text: being subject to one another <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞out of reverence for⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the fear of”</note> Christ

verses.name: Ephesians 5:22
verses.text: —wives to their own husbands as to the Lord,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:23
verses.text: because <transChange type="added">the</transChange> husband is <transChange type="added">the</transChange> head of the wife, as also Christ <transChange type="added">is the</transChange> head of the church (he himself <transChange type="added">being the</transChange> Savior of the body).

verses.name: Ephesians 5:24
verses.text: But as the church is subject to Christ, thus also wives <transChange type="added">should be subject</transChange><note placement="foot">*The words “should be subject” are not in the Greek text, but are an understood repetition from the previous clause</note> to their husbands in everything.  <div eID="gen27437" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11772"/><title type="x-s">Husbands and Wives</title> <div sID="gen27438" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11772"/>Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for her;

verses.name: Ephesians 5:26
verses.text: in order that he might sanctify her by cleansing <transChange type="added">her</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> with the washing of water by the word;

verses.name: Ephesians 5:27
verses.text: in order that he might present to himself the church glorious, not having a spot or wrinkle or any such <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, but that she may be holy and blameless.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:28
verses.text: Thus also husbands ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. The one who loves his own wife loves himself.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:29
verses.text: For no one ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, just as also Christ <transChange type="added">does</transChange> the church,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:30
verses.text: because we are members of his body.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:31
verses.text: “For this <transChange type="added">reason</transChange> a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Gen.2.24">Gen 2:24</reference></note>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:32
verses.text: (This mystery is great, but I am speaking with reference to Christ and the church.)

verses.name: Ephesians 5:33
verses.text: Only you also, each one <transChange type="added">of you</transChange>, must thus love his own wife as himself, and the wife <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞must respect⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that she fear”</note> her husband.  <chapter eID="Eph.5"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11773"/><title type="x-s">Children and Parents</title> <div sID="gen27439" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11773"/>Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:2
verses.text: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first<note placement="foot">Or “is a very important”</note> commandment with a promise),

verses.name: Ephesians 6:3
verses.text: “in order that it may be well with you, and you may <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞live a long time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “be long-lived”</note> on the earth.”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Exod.20.12">Exod 20:12 </reference>and/or <reference osisRef="Deut.5.16">Deut 5:16</reference></note>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:4
verses.text: And fathers, do not make your children angry, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.  <div eID="gen27439" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11774"/><title type="x-s">Slaves and Masters</title> <div sID="gen27440" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11774"/>Slaves, obey your earthly masters with fear and trembling, in the sincerity of your heart, as to Christ,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:6
verses.text: not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞while being watched⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with eye service”</note>, as people pleasers, but as slaves of Christ doing the will of God from the heart,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:7
verses.text: serving with goodwill as to the Lord and not to people,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">because you</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“know”) which is understood as causal</note> know that each one of you, whatever good he should do,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “if he should do anything good”</note> this he will receive back from the Lord, whether slave or free.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:9
verses.text: And masters, do the same <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to them, giving up threats, knowing that both their Lord and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.  <div eID="gen27440" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11775"/><title type="x-s">Spiritual Warfare</title> <div sID="gen27441" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11775"/>Finally, become strong in the Lord and in the might of his strength.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:11
verses.text: Put on the full armor of God, so that you may be able to stand against the stratagems of the devil,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:12
verses.text: because our struggle is not against blood and flesh, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the world rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual <transChange type="added">forces</transChange> of wickedness in the heavenly <transChange type="added">places</transChange>.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:13
verses.text: Because of this, take up the full armor of God, in order that you may be able to resist in the evil day, and having done everything, to stand.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:14
verses.text: Stand therefore, girding your waist with truth, and putting on the breastplate of righteousness,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:15
verses.text: and binding <transChange type="added">shoes</transChange> under your feet with the preparation of the good news of peace,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:16
verses.text: in everything taking up the shield of faith, with which you are able to quench all the flaming arrows of the evil one,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:17
verses.text: and receive the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:18
verses.text: with all prayer and supplication praying at all times in the Spirit, and to this <transChange type="added">end</transChange> being alert with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:19
verses.text: and for me, that a word may be given to me at the opening of my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the gospel,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:20
verses.text: for the sake of which I am an ambassador in chains, that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in them⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in it” since “chain” is singular in the Greek text</note> I may speak freely, as it is necessary for me to speak.  <div eID="gen27441" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11776"/><title type="x-s">Conclusion and Benediction</title> <div sID="gen27442" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11776"/>Now, so that you also may know <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things with me”</note>, what I am doing, Tychicus, my dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:22
verses.text: whom I have sent<note placement="foot">Or “whom I am sending”</note> to you for this very reason, that you may know <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞our circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things concerning us”</note>, and he may encourage your hearts.  <div eID="gen27442" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11777"/><div sID="gen27443" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11777"/>Peace to the brothers and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:24
verses.text: Grace <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ in incorruptibility.<note placement="foot">Or “with undying love”</note>  <chapter eID="Eph.6"/> <div eID="gen27443" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27409" osisID="Eph" type="book"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11778"/><title type="x-s">Greeting</title> <div sID="gen27445" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11778"/>Paul and Timothy, slaves of Christ Jesus, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons.

verses.name: Philippians 1:2
verses.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.  <div eID="gen27445" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11779"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving</title> <div sID="gen27446" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11779"/>I give thanks to my God upon my every remembrance of you,<note placement="foot">Or “upon your every remembrance of me”</note>

verses.name: Philippians 1:4
verses.text: always in my every prayer for all of you, making the prayer with joy,

verses.name: Philippians 1:5
verses.text: because of your participation in the gospel from the first day until now,

verses.name: Philippians 1:6
verses.text: convinced of this same <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, that the one who began a good work in you will finish <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> until the day of Christ Jesus,

verses.name: Philippians 1:7
verses.text: just as it is right for me to think this about all of you, because I have you in my heart, <transChange type="added">since</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “since” is supplied as a component of the participle (“are”) which is understood as causal</note> both in my imprisonment and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel all of you are sharers of grace with me.

verses.name: Philippians 1:8
verses.text: For God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> my witness, that I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.  <div eID="gen27446" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11780"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for Spiritual Maturity</title> <div sID="gen27447" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11780"/>And this I pray: that your love may abound still more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

verses.name: Philippians 1:10
verses.text: so that you may approve what is superior, in order that you may be sincere and blameless in<note placement="foot">Or “for,” or “until”</note> the day of Christ,

verses.name: Philippians 1:11
verses.text: having been filled <transChange type="added">with the</transChange> fruit of righteousness which <transChange type="added">comes</transChange> through Jesus Christ to the glory and praise of God.  <div eID="gen27447" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11781"/><title type="x-s">The Progress of the Gospel</title> <div sID="gen27448" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11781"/>Now I want you to know, brothers, that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things with me”</note> have happened instead for the progress of the gospel,

verses.name: Philippians 1:13
verses.text: so that my imprisonment in Christ has become known in the whole praetorium<note placement="foot">Or “praetorian guard,” or “imperial guard”</note> and to all the rest,

verses.name: Philippians 1:14
verses.text: and most of the brothers, trusting in the Lord because of my imprisonment, dare <transChange type="added">even</transChange> more to speak the word without fear.

verses.name: Philippians 1:15
verses.text: Some even because of envy and strife preach Christ, but some also because of good will.

verses.name: Philippians 1:16
verses.text: The latter <transChange type="added">do so</transChange> from love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.

verses.name: Philippians 1:17
verses.text: The former proclaim Christ from selfish ambition, not sincerely, thinking to raise up affliction in my imprisonment.

verses.name: Philippians 1:18
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞What is the result?⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for what”</note> Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed, and in this I rejoice. But also I will rejoice,

verses.name: Philippians 1:19
verses.text: for I know that this will turn out to me for deliverance through your prayer and the support of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

verses.name: Philippians 1:20
verses.text: according to my eager expectation and hope, that I will be put to shame in nothing, but with all boldness, even now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether through life or through death.

verses.name: Philippians 1:21
verses.text: For to me to live <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Christ and to die <transChange type="added">is</transChange> gain.

verses.name: Philippians 1:22
verses.text: But if <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> to live in the flesh, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> fruitful work for me, and which I will prefer <transChange type="added">I do</transChange> not know.

verses.name: Philippians 1:23
verses.text: But I am hard pressed <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞between the two options⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “by the two”</note>, having the desire to depart and to be with Christ, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for this is very much better⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for this is more better by much”</note>.

verses.name: Philippians 1:24
verses.text: But to stay on in the flesh <transChange type="added">is</transChange> more necessary for your sake.

verses.name: Philippians 1:25
verses.text: And because I am<note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“convinced”) which is understood as causal</note> convinced of this, I know that I will remain and continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,

verses.name: Philippians 1:26
verses.text: so that <transChange type="added">what</transChange> you can be proud of may increase in Christ Jesus because of me through my return again to you.  <div eID="gen27448" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11782"/><title type="x-s">Stand Firm for the Gospel</title> <div sID="gen27449" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11782"/>Only lead your lives in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or am absent I hear <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things concerning you”</note>, that you are standing firm in one spirit, with one soul contending side by side for the faith of the gospel,

verses.name: Philippians 1:28
verses.text: and not letting yourselves be intimidated in anything by your opponents, which is a sign of destruction to them, but of your salvation, and this from God,

verses.name: Philippians 1:29
verses.text: because to you has been graciously granted on behalf of Christ not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on behalf of him,

verses.name: Philippians 1:30
verses.text: having the same struggle which you saw in me and now hear about in me.  <chapter eID="Phil.1"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11783"/><title type="x-s">Humility and Unity</title> <div sID="gen27450" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11783"/>Therefore, if <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> any encouragement in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,

verses.name: Philippians 2:2
verses.text: complete my joy, so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you are in agreement⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you think the same thing</note>, having the same love, united in spirit, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞having one purpose⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “thinking the one thing”</note>.

verses.name: Philippians 2:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Do</transChange> nothing according to selfish ambition or according to empty conceit, but in humility considering one another better than yourselves,

verses.name: Philippians 2:4
verses.text: each of you<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “each one of you”</note> not looking out for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your own interests⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things of yourselves”</note>, but also each of you for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the interests⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things”</note> of others.  <div eID="gen27450" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11784"/><title type="x-s">Christ’s Humiliation and Exaltation</title> <div sID="gen27451" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11784"/>Think this in<note placement="foot">Or “among”</note> yourselves which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> also in Christ Jesus,  <div eID="gen27451" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11785"/><lg sID="gen27452"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11785"/>who, existing in the form of God,<l eID="gen27453" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27454"/>did not consider being equal with God something to be grasped, <l eID="gen27454" level="2"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11786"/><l level="1" sID="gen27455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11786"/>but emptied himself<l eID="gen27455" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27456"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“taking”) which is understood as means</note> taking the form of a slave,<l eID="gen27456" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27457"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“becoming”) which is understood as means</note> becoming in the likeness of people.<l eID="gen27457" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27458"/>And being found in appearance like a man, <l eID="gen27458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11787"/><l level="1" sID="gen27459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11787"/>he humbled himself<l eID="gen27459" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27460"/><transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“becoming”) which is understood as means</note> becoming obedient to the point of death,<l eID="gen27460" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen27461"/>that is, death on a cross. <l eID="gen27461" level="3"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11788"/><l level="1" sID="gen27462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11788"/>Therefore also God exalted him<l eID="gen27462" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27463"/>and graciously granted him the name above every name, <l eID="gen27463" level="2"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11789"/><l level="1" sID="gen27464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11789"/>so that at the name of Jesus<l eID="gen27464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27465"/>every knee should bow,<l eID="gen27465" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27466"/>of <transChange type="added">those</transChange> in heaven and of <transChange type="added">those</transChange> on earth and of <transChange type="added">those</transChange> under the earth, <l eID="gen27466" level="2"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11790"/><l level="1" sID="gen27467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11790"/>and every tongue confess<l eID="gen27467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27468"/>that Jesus Christ <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Lord,<l eID="gen27468" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27469"/>to the glory of God the Father. <l eID="gen27469" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen27452"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11791"/><title type="x-s">Holding Fast to the Word of Life</title> <div sID="gen27470" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11791"/>Therefore my dear friends, just as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

verses.name: Philippians 2:13
verses.text: For the one at work in you, both to will and to work for his good pleasure, is God.

verses.name: Philippians 2:14
verses.text: Do all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> without grumbling and disputing,

verses.name: Philippians 2:15
verses.text: in order that you may become blameless and innocent, children of God without fault<note placement="foot">Or “blameless”</note> in the midst of a crooked and perverted generation, among whom you shine as stars in the world,<note placement="foot">Or possibly “in the universe”</note>

verses.name: Philippians 2:16
verses.text: holding fast to the word of life, for a source of pride<note placement="foot">Or “for a cause of boasting”</note> to me in the day of Christ, that I did not run in vain or labor in vain.

verses.name: Philippians 2:17
verses.text: But even if I am being poured out as a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice and rejoice with all of you.

verses.name: Philippians 2:18
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the same <transChange type="added">way</transChange> also you rejoice and rejoice with me.  <div eID="gen27470" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11792"/><title type="x-s">Timothy’s Proven Character</title> <div sID="gen27471" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11792"/>But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, so that I also may be encouraged <transChange type="added">when I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“know”) which is understood as temporal</note> know <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things concerning you”</note>.

verses.name: Philippians 2:20
verses.text: For I have no one like-minded who <transChange type="added">will</transChange> sincerely be concerned about <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things concerning you”</note>.

verses.name: Philippians 2:21
verses.text: For they all seek <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞their own interests⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things of themselves”</note>, not those of Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Philippians 2:22
verses.text: But you know his proven character, that like a child with a father he served with me for the gospel.

verses.name: Philippians 2:23
verses.text: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things concerning me”</note>.

verses.name: Philippians 2:24
verses.text: And I am convinced in the Lord that I myself will arrive shortly also.  <div eID="gen27471" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11793"/><title type="x-s">Epaphroditus’ Mission</title> <div sID="gen27472" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11793"/>But I considered <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow worker and fellow soldier, but your messenger and servant of my need,

verses.name: Philippians 2:26
verses.text: because he was longing for all of you and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick.

verses.name: Philippians 2:27
verses.text: For indeed he was sick, coming near to death, but God had mercy on him and not <transChange type="added">on</transChange> him only, but also <transChange type="added">on</transChange> me, so that I would not have grief upon grief.

verses.name: Philippians 2:28
verses.text: Therefore I am sending him with special urgency, in order that <transChange type="added">when</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“see”) which is understood as temporal</note> you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.

verses.name: Philippians 2:29
verses.text: Therefore welcome him in the Lord with all joy, and consider such <transChange type="added">people</transChange> highly honored,

verses.name: Philippians 2:30
verses.text: because on account of the work of Christ he came near to the point of death, risking his life in order that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he might make up for your inability to serve me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he might fill up your lack of service to me”</note>.  <chapter eID="Phil.2"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11794"/><title type="x-s">Warning Against Evil Workers</title> <div sID="gen27473" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11794"/>Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to you <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not troublesome to me, but <transChange type="added">is</transChange> a safeguard for you.

verses.name: Philippians 3:2
verses.text: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the mutilation.<note placement="foot">This term is a wordplay on the Greek word “circumcision”</note>

verses.name: Philippians 3:3
verses.text: For we are the circumcision, the ones who worship<note placement="foot">Or “who serve”</note> by the Spirit<note placement="foot">Or “in the Spirit”</note> of God and boast in Christ Jesus and do not <transChange type="added">put</transChange> confidence in the flesh,

verses.name: Philippians 3:4
verses.text: although I <transChange type="added">could</transChange> have confidence even in the flesh. <div eID="gen27473" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">Righteousness Through Christ</title> <div sID="gen27474" type="x-p"/> If anyone else thinks to put confidence in the flesh, I <transChange type="added">can do so</transChange> more:

verses.name: Philippians 3:5
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞circumcised on the eighth day⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with respect to circumcision it was on the eighth day”</note>, from the nation of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew <transChange type="added">born</transChange> from Hebrews, according to the law a Pharisee,

verses.name: Philippians 3:6
verses.text: according to zeal persecuting the church, according to the righteousness in the law being blameless.

verses.name: Philippians 3:7
verses.text: But whatever <transChange type="added">things</transChange> were gain to me, these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> I have considered loss because of Christ.

verses.name: Philippians 3:8
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞More than that⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “but on the contrary”</note>, I even consider all things to be loss because of the surpassing greatness of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, for the sake of whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and consider them<note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> dung, in order that I may gain Christ

verses.name: Philippians 3:9
verses.text: and may be found in him, not having my righteousness <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> from the law, but <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> through faith in Christ,<note placement="foot">Or “through Christ’s faithfulness”</note> the righteousness from God on the basis of faith,<note placement="foot">Or “on the basis of his faithfulness”</note>

verses.name: Philippians 3:10
verses.text: so that I may know him and the power of his resurrection and the fellowship of his sufferings, being conformed to his death,

verses.name: Philippians 3:11
verses.text: if somehow I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

verses.name: Philippians 3:12
verses.text: Not that I have already received <transChange type="added">this</transChange>,<note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> or have already been made perfect, but I press on if indeed I may lay hold of that for which also I was laid hold of by Christ.<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “Christ Jesus”</note>

verses.name: Philippians 3:13
verses.text: Brothers, I do not consider myself to have laid hold of <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> But <transChange type="added">I do</transChange> one <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, forgetting the things behind and straining toward the things ahead,

verses.name: Philippians 3:14
verses.text: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.  <div eID="gen27474" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11795"/><title type="x-s">Imitate Paul</title> <div sID="gen27475" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11795"/>Therefore as many as <transChange type="added">are</transChange> perfect, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞let us hold this opinion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “let us think this”</note>, and if you think anything differently, God will reveal this also to you.

verses.name: Philippians 3:16
verses.text: Only to what we have attained, to the same hold on.

verses.name: Philippians 3:17
verses.text: Become fellow imitators of me, brothers, and observe those who walk in this way, just as you have us <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an example.

verses.name: Philippians 3:18
verses.text: For many live, of whom I spoke about to you many times, but now speak about even weeping, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> the enemies of the cross of Christ,

verses.name: Philippians 3:19
verses.text: whose end <transChange type="added">is</transChange> destruction, whose God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the stomach, and <transChange type="added">whose</transChange> glory <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in their shame, the ones who think on earthly things.

verses.name: Philippians 3:20
verses.text: For our commonwealth exists in heaven, from which also we eagerly await a savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.name: Philippians 3:21
verses.text: who will transform our humble body <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> conformed to his glorious body, in accordance with the power that enables him even to subject all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to himself.  <chapter eID="Phil.3"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11796"/><title type="x-s">Appeal for Unity</title> <div sID="gen27476" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11796"/>So then, my beloved and greatly desired brothers, my joy and crown, thus stand firm in the Lord, dear friends.

verses.name: Philippians 4:2
verses.text: I appeal to Euodia and I appeal to Syntyche <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to be in agreement⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to think the same thing”</note> in the Lord.

verses.name: Philippians 4:3
verses.text: Yes, I ask also you, true yokefellow, help them, who struggled along with me in the gospel with both Clement and the rest of my fellow workers whose names <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in the book of life.  <div eID="gen27476" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11797"/><title type="x-s">Be Anxious for Nothing</title> <div sID="gen27477" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11797"/>Rejoice in the Lord always; again I say, rejoice.

verses.name: Philippians 4:5
verses.text: Let your gentleness be made known to all people. The Lord <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near.

verses.name: Philippians 4:6
verses.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.

verses.name: Philippians 4:7
verses.text: And the peace of God that surpasses all understanding will guard your hearts and your minds<note placement="foot">Or “thoughts”</note> in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Philippians 4:8
verses.text: Finally, brothers, whatever <transChange type="added">things</transChange> are true, whatever <transChange type="added">things are</transChange> honorable, whatever <transChange type="added">things are</transChange> right, whatever <transChange type="added">things are</transChange> pure, whatever <transChange type="added">things are</transChange> pleasing, whatever <transChange type="added">things are</transChange> commendable, if <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> any excellence of character and if anything praiseworthy, think about these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.

verses.name: Philippians 4:9
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which you have learned and received and heard about and seen in me, practice these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, and the God of peace will be with you.  <div eID="gen27477" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11798"/><title type="x-s">Support for Paul’s Ministry</title> <div sID="gen27478" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11798"/>But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly that now at last <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you have renewed your concern for me⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “you have revived to think on behalf of me”</note>, for whom also you were thinking, but you had no opportunity <transChange type="added">to express it</transChange>.

verses.name: Philippians 4:11
verses.text: Not that I speak from need, for I have learned to be content in whatever <transChange type="added">circumstances</transChange> I am.

verses.name: Philippians 4:12
verses.text: I know <transChange type="added">how</transChange> both <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to make do with little⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to be humbled”</note> and I know how <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to have an abundance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to abound”</note>. In everything and in all things I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to have an abundance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to abound”</note> and to go without.

verses.name: Philippians 4:13
verses.text: I am able <transChange type="added">to do</transChange> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> by the one who strengthens me.

verses.name: Philippians 4:14
verses.text: Nevertheless you have done well by sharing<note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“sharing”) which is understood as means</note> with me in my affliction.

verses.name: Philippians 4:15
verses.text: Now you also know, Philippians, that at the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving except you alone,

verses.name: Philippians 4:16
verses.text: because even in Thessalonica <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on more than one occasion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “both once and twice”</note> you sent for my need.

verses.name: Philippians 4:17
verses.text: Not that I seek the gift, but I seek for the profit that increases to your account.

verses.name: Philippians 4:18
verses.text: But I have received everything <transChange type="added">in full</transChange> and have an abundance; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am well supplied⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I have been made full”</note> because<note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“received”) which is understood as causal</note> I received from Epaphroditus <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what you had sent⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things from you”</note>, a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.

verses.name: Philippians 4:19
verses.text: And my God will fulfill your every need according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Philippians 4:20
verses.text: Now to our God and Father <transChange type="added">be</transChange> the glory <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the ages of the ages”</note>. Amen.  <div eID="gen27478" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11799"/><title type="x-s">Final Greetings and Benediction</title> <div sID="gen27479" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11799"/>Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers with me greet you.

verses.name: Philippians 4:22
verses.text: All the saints greet you, and especially those of Caesar’s household.

verses.name: Philippians 4:23
verses.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with your spirit.  <chapter eID="Phil.4"/> <div eID="gen27479" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27444" osisID="Phil" type="book"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11800"/><title type="x-s">Greeting</title> <div sID="gen27481" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11800"/>Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

verses.name: Colossians 1:2
verses.text: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ in Colossae. Grace to you and peace from God our Father.  <div eID="gen27481" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11801"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for the Colossian Believers</title> <div sID="gen27482" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11801"/>We give thanks always to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ <transChange type="added">when we</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“pray”) which is understood as temporal</note> pray for you,

verses.name: Colossians 1:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">since we</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “since” is supplied as a component of the participle (“heard about”) which is understood as causal</note> heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and the love that you have for all the saints,

verses.name: Colossians 1:5
verses.text: because of the hope reserved for you in heaven, which you have heard about beforehand in the word of truth, the gospel,

verses.name: Colossians 1:6
verses.text: that has come to you, just as also in all the world it is bearing fruit and increasing, just as also among you from the day you heard about and understood the grace of God in truth,

verses.name: Colossians 1:7
verses.text: just as you learned <transChange type="added">it</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> from Epaphras, our dear fellow slave who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “on your behalf”</note>

verses.name: Colossians 1:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">who</transChange> also made clear to us your love in the Spirit.  <div eID="gen27482" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11802"/><title type="x-s">Prayer for Maturity Based on Christ’s Preeminence</title> <div sID="gen27483" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11802"/>Because of this also we, from the day we heard about <transChange type="added">it</transChange>,<note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> did not cease praying for you, and asking that you may be filled <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual insight,

verses.name: Colossians 1:10
verses.text: so that you may live in a manner worthy of the Lord, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to please <transChange type="added">him</transChange> in all respects⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to all pleasing”</note>, bearing fruit in every good deed and increasing in the knowledge of God,

verses.name: Colossians 1:11
verses.text: enabled with all power, according to his glorious might, for all steadfastness and patience with joy,

verses.name: Colossians 1:12
verses.text: giving thanks to the Father who has qualified you for a share of the inheritance of the saints in light,

verses.name: Colossians 1:13
verses.text: who has rescued us from the domain of darkness and transferred <transChange type="added">us</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> to the kingdom of the Son <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he loves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of his love”</note>,

verses.name: Colossians 1:14
verses.text: in whom we have the redemption, the forgiveness of sins,

verses.name: Colossians 1:15
verses.text: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all<note placement="foot">*Translated as a genitive of subordination (Wallace, <hi type="italic">GGBB</hi>, 104)</note> creation,

verses.name: Colossians 1:16
verses.text: because all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> in the heavens and on the earth were created by him, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or powers, all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> were created through him and for him,

verses.name: Colossians 1:17
verses.text: and he himself is before all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, and in him all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> are held together,

verses.name: Colossians 1:18
verses.text: and he himself is the head of the body, the church, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, so that he himself may become first in everything,

verses.name: Colossians 1:19
verses.text: because he was well pleased <transChange type="added">for</transChange> all the fullness to dwell in him,

verses.name: Colossians 1:20
verses.text: and through him to reconcile all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to himself, <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“making peace”) which is understood as means</note> making peace through the blood of his cross, through him, whether things on earth or things in heaven.  <div eID="gen27483" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11803"/><div sID="gen27484" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11803"/>And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞although you were formerly alienated⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and you formerly being alienated”</note><note placement="foot">*Here the participle (“being”) is understood as concessive</note> and enemies in attitude, because of your evil deeds,

verses.name: Colossians 1:22
verses.text: but now you have been reconciled<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “he has reconciled you”</note> by <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his physical body⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the body of his flesh”</note> through death, to present you holy and blameless and above reproach before him,

verses.name: Colossians 1:23
verses.text: if indeed you remain in the faith, established and steadfast and not shifted away from the hope of the gospel that you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, became a minister.  <div eID="gen27484" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11804"/><title type="x-s">Paul’s Suffering and Stewardship</title> <div sID="gen27485" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11804"/>Now I rejoice in my sufferings on behalf of you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking of the afflictions of Christ, on behalf of his body which is the church,

verses.name: Colossians 1:25
verses.text: of which I became a minister, according to God’s stewardship which was given to me for you, to complete the word of God,

verses.name: Colossians 1:26
verses.text: the mystery <transChange type="added">which</transChange> has been hidden from the ages and from the generations, but has now been revealed to his saints,

verses.name: Colossians 1:27
verses.text: to whom God wanted to make known what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the glorious wealth of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory,

verses.name: Colossians 1:28
verses.text: whom we proclaim, <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“admonishing”) which is understood as means</note> admonishing every person<note placement="foot">Literally “man,” used here in a generic sense to refer to persons of either gender</note> and teaching every person<note placement="foot">Literally “man,” used here in a generic sense to refer to persons of either gender</note> with all wisdom, in order that we may present every person<note placement="foot">Literally “man,” used here in a generic sense to refer to persons of either gender</note> mature in Christ,

verses.name: Colossians 1:29
verses.text: for which <transChange type="added">purpose</transChange> also I labor, striving according to his working which is at work powerfully in me.  <chapter eID="Col.1"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11805"/><title type="x-s">Christ, the Mystery of God</title> <div sID="gen27486" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11805"/>For I want you to know how great a struggle I have on behalf of you, and those in Laodicea, and all those who have not seen my face <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in person⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the flesh”</note>,

verses.name: Colossians 2:2
verses.text: so that their hearts may be encouraged, united in love and into all the wealth of the full assurance of insight into the knowledge of the mystery of God, Christ,

verses.name: Colossians 2:3
verses.text: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

verses.name: Colossians 2:4
verses.text: I say this in order that no one will deceive you with persuasive speech,

verses.name: Colossians 2:5
verses.text: for even if I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in spirit, rejoicing and seeing your good order and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.  <div eID="gen27486" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11806"/><title type="x-s">Made Alive in Christ</title> <div sID="gen27487" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11806"/>Therefore as you have received Christ Jesus the Lord, live in him,

verses.name: Colossians 2:7
verses.text: firmly rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, just as you were taught, abounding with thankfulness.

verses.name: Colossians 2:8
verses.text: Beware lest <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞anyone take you captive⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “anyone be the one who takes captive you”</note> through philosophy and empty deceit, according to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞human tradition⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the tradition of men”</note>, according to the elemental spirits of the world and not according to Christ,

verses.name: Colossians 2:9
verses.text: because in him all the fullness of deity dwells bodily,

verses.name: Colossians 2:10
verses.text: and you are filled in him, who is the head over every ruler and authority,

verses.name: Colossians 2:11
verses.text: in whom also you were circumcised with a circumcision not made by hands, by the removal of the body of the flesh, by the circumcision of Christ,

verses.name: Colossians 2:12
verses.text: having been buried with him in baptism, in which also you were raised together with <transChange type="added">him</transChange> through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

verses.name: Colossians 2:13
verses.text: And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞although you were dead⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and you being dead”</note><note placement="foot">*Here the participle (“being”) is understood as concessive</note> in the trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh, he made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

verses.name: Colossians 2:14
verses.text: having destroyed the certificate of indebtedness in ordinances against us, which was hostile to us, and removed it out of the way <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“nailing”) which is understood as means</note> nailing it to the cross.

verses.name: Colossians 2:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">When he</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“had disarmed”) which is understood as temporal</note> had disarmed the rulers and the authorities, he made a display of them in public, triumphing over them by it.<note placement="foot">Or “in him”</note>  <div eID="gen27487" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11807"/><title type="x-s">Do Not Be Judged by Human Religious Rules</title> <div sID="gen27488" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11807"/>Therefore do not let anyone judge you with reference to eating or<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “and”</note> drinking or participation in a feast or a new moon or a Sabbath,

verses.name: Colossians 2:17
verses.text: which are a shadow of what is to come, but the reality <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Christ.

verses.name: Colossians 2:18
verses.text: Let no one condemn you, taking pleasure in humility and the worship of angels, going into detail <transChange type="added">about</transChange> <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which he has seen, inflated without cause by his fleshly mind,

verses.name: Colossians 2:19
verses.text: and not holding fast to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and held together by the ligaments and sinews, grows with the growth of God.  <div eID="gen27488" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11808"/><div sID="gen27489" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11808"/>If you have died with Christ to the elemental spirits of the world, why do you submit <transChange type="added">to them</transChange> as <transChange type="added">if</transChange> living in the world?

verses.name: Colossians 2:21
verses.text: “Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch,”

verses.name: Colossians 2:22
verses.text: which <transChange type="added">things</transChange> are all <transChange type="added">meant</transChange> for destruction by consuming according to human commandments and teachings,

verses.name: Colossians 2:23
verses.text: which <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞although they have⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “having”</note>,<note placement="foot">*Here the participle (“having”) is understood as concessive</note> to be sure, an appearance of wisdom in self-made religion and humility and unsparing treatment of the body, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞do not have any value⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “are not with any value”</note> against the indulgence of the flesh.  <chapter eID="Col.2"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11809"/><title type="x-s">Seek the Things Above</title> <div sID="gen27490" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11809"/>Therefore, if you have been raised together with Christ, seek the things above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.

verses.name: Colossians 3:2
verses.text: Set your mind on the things above, not <transChange type="added">on</transChange> the things on earth.

verses.name: Colossians 3:3
verses.text: For you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

verses.name: Colossians 3:4
verses.text: When Christ, <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> your life, is revealed, then you also will be revealed with him in glory.  <div eID="gen27490" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11810"/><title type="x-s">Put Off the Old Behavior</title> <div sID="gen27491" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11810"/>Therefore put to death <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞what is earthly in you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the members on the earth”</note>: sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustful passion, evil desire, and greediness, which is idolatry,

verses.name: Colossians 3:6
verses.text: because of which the wrath of God is coming upon the sons of disobedience,

verses.name: Colossians 3:7
verses.text: in which also you once lived, when you used to live in them.<note placement="foot">Or “among them” (the pronoun may refer either to people or to sins)</note>

verses.name: Colossians 3:8
verses.text: But now you also lay aside all <transChange type="added">these</transChange> things: anger, rage, wickedness, slander, abusive language from your mouth.

verses.name: Colossians 3:9
verses.text: Do not lie to one another, <transChange type="added">because you</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“have taken off”) which is understood as causal</note> have taken off the old man together with his deeds,

verses.name: Colossians 3:10
verses.text: and have put on the new <transChange type="added">man</transChange> that is being renewed in knowledge according to the image of the one who created him,

verses.name: Colossians 3:11
verses.text: where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, slave, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> free, but Christ <transChange type="added">is</transChange> all, and in all.  <div eID="gen27491" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11811"/><title type="x-s">Appeal for New Behavior</title> <div sID="gen27492" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11811"/>Therefore, as <transChange type="added">the</transChange> chosen of God, holy and <transChange type="added">dearly</transChange> loved, put on affection, compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, patience,

verses.name: Colossians 3:13
verses.text: putting up with one another and forgiving one another. If anyone should have a complaint against anyone, just as also the Lord forgave you, thus also you <transChange type="added">do the same</transChange>.

verses.name: Colossians 3:14
verses.text: And to all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <transChange type="added">add</transChange> love, which is <transChange type="added">the</transChange> bond of perfection.

verses.name: Colossians 3:15
verses.text: And the peace of Christ must rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

verses.name: Colossians 3:16
verses.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, teaching and admonishing one another with all wisdom, with psalms, hymns, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> spiritual songs, singing with thankfulness in your hearts to God,

verses.name: Colossians 3:17
verses.text: and everything <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whatever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if anything that”</note> you do in word or in deed, giving thanks <transChange type="added">for</transChange> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> in the name of the Lord Jesus to God the Father through him.  <div eID="gen27492" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11812"/><title type="x-s">Mutual Responsibilities in Christian Relationships</title> <div sID="gen27493" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11812"/>Wives, be subject to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

verses.name: Colossians 3:19
verses.text: Husbands, love your wives and do not be embittered against them.

verses.name: Colossians 3:20
verses.text: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing in the Lord.

verses.name: Colossians 3:21
verses.text: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so that they will not become discouraged.

verses.name: Colossians 3:22
verses.text: Slaves, obey your <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞human⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “according to the flesh”</note> masters in everything, not <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞while being watched⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “with eye-service”</note>, as people pleasers, but with sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.

verses.name: Colossians 3:23
verses.text: Whatever you do, accomplish <transChange type="added">it</transChange> from the soul, as to the Lord, and not to people,

verses.name: Colossians 3:24
verses.text: <transChange type="added">because you</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“know”) which is understood as causal</note> know that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance. Serve<note placement="foot">Or “You serve”; the same Greek verb form can be understood as either imperative (“serve”) or indicative (“you serve”), so that commentators and Bible translations differ</note> the Lord Christ.

verses.name: Colossians 3:25
verses.text: For the one who does wrong will receive back whatever wrong he has done, and there is no partiality.  <chapter eID="Col.3"/> <div eID="gen27493" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:1
verses.text: Masters, grant your slaves justice and fairness, knowing that you also have a master in heaven.  <div eID="gen27494" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11813"/><title type="x-s">Further Advice for the Christian Life</title> <div sID="gen27495" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11813"/>Be devoted to prayer, keeping alert in it with thanksgiving,

verses.name: Colossians 4:3
verses.text: praying at the same time for us also, that God may open for us a door of the message, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which also <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am a prisoner⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I have been bound”</note>,

verses.name: Colossians 4:4
verses.text: so that I may reveal<note placement="foot">Or “may make it clear”</note> it, as it is necessary for me to speak.

verses.name: Colossians 4:5
verses.text: Live with wisdom toward those outside, making the most of the time.

verses.name: Colossians 4:6
verses.text: Let your speech always <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with grace, seasoned with salt, so that <transChange type="added">you</transChange> may know how it is necessary for you to answer each one.  <div eID="gen27495" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11814"/><title type="x-s">Exhortations Regarding Fellow Workers</title> <div sID="gen27496" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11814"/>Tychicus, my dear brother and faithful servant and fellow slave in the Lord, will make known to you all <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things according to me”</note>,

verses.name: Colossians 4:8
verses.text: whom I have sent to you for this very <transChange type="added">reason</transChange>, in order that you may know <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞our circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things concerning us”</note> and he may encourage your hearts,

verses.name: Colossians 4:9
verses.text: together with Onesimus, my faithful and dear brother, who is <transChange type="added">one</transChange> of you. They will make known to you all <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the circumstances⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the things”</note> here.  <div eID="gen27496" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11815"/><div sID="gen27497" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11815"/>Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (about whom you received instructions—if he should come to you, welcome him),

verses.name: Colossians 4:11
verses.text: and Jesus who is called Justus. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the only ones who are fellow workers for the kingdom of God from the circumcision, who have been a comfort to me.

verses.name: Colossians 4:12
verses.text: Epaphras, who is <transChange type="added">one</transChange> of you, greets you, a slave of Christ<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “of Christ Jesus”</note> always struggling on behalf of you in his prayers, that you may stand mature and fully assured<note placement="foot">Or “and filled”</note> in all the will of God.
