verses.name: Colossians 4:13
verses.text: For I testify to him that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he is working hard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he has much labor”</note> on behalf of you and those in Laodicea and those in Hierapolis.

verses.name: Colossians 4:14
verses.text: Luke the physician, our dear friend, greets you, <transChange type="added">as does</transChange> Demas.

verses.name: Colossians 4:15
verses.text: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, and Nympha and the church in her<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts, including the majority of Byzantine minuscules, read the masculine form of the pronoun here (“his”), understanding the form of the name “Nympha” earlier in the verse to be masculine</note> house.

verses.name: Colossians 4:16
verses.text: And whenever this letter is read among you, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞see to it⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “cause”</note> that it is read also among the Laodicean church, and that you also read the <transChange type="added">letter</transChange> from Laodicea.

verses.name: Colossians 4:17
verses.text: And tell Archippus, “Direct your attention to the ministry that you received in the Lord, in order that you may complete it.”  <div eID="gen27497" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11816"/><title type="x-s">Final Greeting and Benediction</title> <div sID="gen27498" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11816"/>The greeting <transChange type="added">is</transChange> by my hand, Paul’s. Remember my <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞imprisonment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “bonds”</note>. Grace <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with you.  <chapter eID="Col.4"/> <div eID="gen27498" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27480" osisID="Col" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11817"/><title type="x-s">Greeting</title> <div sID="gen27500" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11817"/>Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Grace to you and peace.  <div eID="gen27500" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11818"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for the Thessalonian Believers</title> <div sID="gen27501" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11818"/>We give thanks to God always concerning all of you, making mention constantly in our prayers,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">because we</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“remember”) which is understood as causal</note> remember your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ in the presence of our God and Father,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:4
verses.text: knowing, brothers <transChange type="added">dearly</transChange> loved by God, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that he has chosen you⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the choice of you”</note>,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:5
verses.text: because our gospel did not come to you with word only, but also with power and with the Holy Spirit and with much certainty, just as you know what sort of <transChange type="added">people</transChange> we became among you for your sake.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:6
verses.text: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, receiving the word in much affliction, with the joy of the Holy Spirit,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:7
verses.text: so that you became an example to all those who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:8
verses.text: for from you the word of the Lord has sounded forth, not only in Macedonia and Achaia,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “and in Achaia”</note> but in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we have no need to say anything.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:9
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">they</transChange> themselves report about us, what sort of welcome we had with you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living and true God,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:10
verses.text: and to await his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, Jesus, the one who delivers us from the coming wrath.  <chapter eID="1Thess.1"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11819"/><title type="x-s">Paul’s Approach to Ministry in Thessalonica</title> <div sID="gen27502" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11819"/>For <transChange type="added">you</transChange> yourselves know, brothers, our reception with you, that it was not in vain,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:2
verses.text: but <transChange type="added">after we</transChange> had already suffered and been mistreated in Philippi, just as you know, we had the courage in our God to speak to you the gospel of God amid much opposition.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:3
verses.text: For our exhortation <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not from error or from impurity or with deceit,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:4
verses.text: but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, thus we speak, not as pleasing people but God, who examines our hearts.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:5
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞For never⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for neither ever”</note> did we come with a word of flattery, just as you know, nor with a pretext of greediness (God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> witness),

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:6
verses.text: nor seeking glory from people, neither from you nor from others.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:7
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Although we could have insisted on our own importance⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “being able to be with a claim of importance”</note><note placement="foot">*Here the participle (“being able”) is understood as concessive</note> as apostles of Christ, yet we became infants in your midst, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:8
verses.text: Longing for you in this way, we determined to share with you not only the gospel of God but also our own souls, because you had become dear to us.  <div eID="gen27502" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11820"/><div sID="gen27503" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11820"/>For you remember, brothers, our labor and hardship: working by night and day in order not to be a burden to any of you, we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:10
verses.text: You <transChange type="added">are</transChange> witnesses, and <transChange type="added">so is</transChange> God, how devoutly and righteously and blamelessly we became to you who believe,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:11
verses.text: just as you know how <transChange type="added">we treated</transChange> each one of you, like a father his own children,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:12
verses.text: exhorting and consoling you and insisting that you live in a manner worthy of God, who calls you to his own kingdom and glory.  <div eID="gen27503" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11821"/><title type="x-s">The Thessalonians’ Response to Paul’s Message</title> <div sID="gen27504" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11821"/>And because of this we also give thanks to God constantly, that <transChange type="added">when you</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“received”) which is understood as temporal</note> received God’s word <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞that you heard⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of hearing”</note> from us, you accepted <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not <transChange type="added">as the</transChange> word of men, but as <transChange type="added">it</transChange> truly is, <transChange type="added">the</transChange> word of God, which also is at work in you who believe.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:14
verses.text: For you became imitators, brothers, of the churches of God <transChange type="added">which</transChange> are in Judea in Christ Jesus, because you also suffered the same <transChange type="added">things</transChange> at the hands of your own people, just as <transChange type="added">they</transChange> themselves <transChange type="added">did</transChange> also at the hands of the Jews,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:15
verses.text: who killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and who persecuted us, and <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> not pleasing to God and <transChange type="added">are</transChange> opposed to all people,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:16
verses.text: hindering us from speaking to the Gentiles in order that they may be saved, so that <transChange type="added">they</transChange> always fill up their sins. But wrath has come upon them to the end.<note placement="foot">Or “has come upon them at last”</note>  <div eID="gen27504" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11822"/><title type="x-s">Paul’s Desire to Revisit the Thessalonians</title> <div sID="gen27505" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11822"/>But <transChange type="added">when</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“were made orphans by separation”) which is understood as temporal</note> we were made orphans by separation from you, brothers, for <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a short time⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the time of an hour”</note> (in face, not in heart), <transChange type="added">we were</transChange> even more eager with great desire to see your face,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:18
verses.text: because we wanted to come to you—I, Paul, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on more than one occasion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “both once and twice”</note>—and Satan hindered us.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:19
verses.text: For who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> our hope or joy or crown of boasting? <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not even you, in the presence of our Lord Jesus at his coming?

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:20
verses.text: For you are our glory and joy.  <chapter eID="1Thess.2"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11823"/><title type="x-s">Paul Sends Timothy to Thessalonica</title> <div sID="gen27506" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11823"/>Therefore <transChange type="added">when we</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“could bear”) which is understood as temporal</note> could bear <transChange type="added">it</transChange> no longer, we determined to be left behind in Athens alone,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:2
verses.text: and we sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, in order to strengthen and to encourage you about your faith,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> no one would be shaken by these afflictions. For <transChange type="added">you</transChange> yourselves know that we are appointed for this,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:4
verses.text: for indeed when we were with you we told you beforehand that we were about to be afflicted, just as indeed it happened, and you know.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:5
verses.text: Because of this, I also, <transChange type="added">when I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“could endure”) which is understood as temporal</note> could endure <transChange type="added">it</transChange> no longer, sent in order to know your faith, lest somehow the tempter tempted you and our labor should be in vain.  <div eID="gen27506" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11824"/><title type="x-s">Timothy’s Positive Report</title> <div sID="gen27507" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11824"/>But now, <transChange type="added">because</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“has come”) which is understood as causal</note> Timothy has come to us from you and has brought good news to us of your faith and love, and that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞you always think kindly of us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that you have kindly remembrance of us always”</note>, desiring to see us just as also we <transChange type="added">desire to see</transChange> you,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:7
verses.text: because of this, brothers, we have been comforted because of you in all our distress and affliction through your faith,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:8
verses.text: because now we live, if you stand firm in the Lord.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:9
verses.text: For what thanks can we repay to God concerning you, because of all the joy <transChange type="added">with</transChange> which we rejoice because of you before our God,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:10
verses.text: night and day praying beyond all measure that <transChange type="added">we</transChange> may see your face and complete what is lacking in your faith?  <div eID="gen27507" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11825"/><div sID="gen27508" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11825"/>Now <transChange type="added">may</transChange> our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus direct our way to you,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:12
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">may</transChange> the Lord <transChange type="added">cause</transChange> you to increase and to abound in love for one another and for all, just as also we <transChange type="added">do</transChange> for you,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:13
verses.text: so that your hearts may be established blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “his saints. Amen.”</note>  <chapter eID="1Thess.3"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11826"/><title type="x-s">Appeal for Continuing Sanctification</title> <div sID="gen27509" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11826"/>Finally therefore, brothers, we ask you and appeal to <transChange type="added">you</transChange> in the Lord Jesus that, just as you have received from us how it is necessary for you to live and to please God, just as indeed you are living, that you progress even more.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:2
verses.text: For you know what commands we gave to you through the Lord Jesus.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:3
verses.text: For this is the will of God, your sanctification: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you abstain from sexual immorality;

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> each of you know how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:5
verses.text: not in lustful passion, just as also the Gentiles who do not know God;

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:6
verses.text: not to transgress and to exploit his brother in the matter, because the Lord <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the one who avenges concerning all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, just as also we told you beforehand and testified solemnly.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:7
verses.text: For God did not call us to impurity, but in holiness.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:8
verses.text: Therefore the one who rejects <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not rejecting man, but God, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> also gives his Holy Spirit to you.  <div eID="gen27509" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11827"/><title type="x-s">Affirmation of Continuing Love</title> <div sID="gen27510" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11827"/>But concerning brotherly love, I do not have need to write to you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:10
verses.text: for indeed you are practicing it toward all the brothers in all of Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to progress even more,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:11
verses.text: and to aspire to live a quiet life, and to attend to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞your own business⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/>,<note placement="foot">Literally “your own things”</note> and to work with your hands,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “your own hands”</note> just as we commanded you,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:12
verses.text: so that you may live decently toward those outside, and may have need of nothing.  <div eID="gen27510" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11828"/><title type="x-s">The Comfort of the Lord’s Return</title> <div sID="gen27511" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11828"/>Now we do not want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you will not grieve as also the rest, who have no hope.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:14
verses.text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose <transChange type="added">again</transChange>, thus also God will bring those who have fallen asleep through Jesus together with him.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:15
verses.text: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who remain until the Lord’s coming, will not possibly precede those who have fallen asleep.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:16
verses.text: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout of command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:17
verses.text: Then we who are alive, who remain, will be snatched away at the same time together with them in the clouds for a meeting with the Lord in the air, and thus we will be together with the Lord always.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:18
verses.text: Therefore comfort one another with these words.  <chapter eID="1Thess.4"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11829"/><title type="x-s">The Sudden Arrival of the Day of the Lord</title> <div sID="gen27512" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11829"/>Now concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need <transChange type="added">of anything</transChange> to be written to you,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:2
verses.text: for <transChange type="added">you</transChange> yourselves well know that the day of the Lord is coming in the <transChange type="added">same</transChange> way as a thief in the night.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:3
verses.text: Whenever they say “Peace and security,” then sudden destruction will overtake them like the birth pains of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a pregnant woman⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one who has in the belly”</note>, and they will not possibly escape.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:4
verses.text: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness, so that the day should catch you like a thief,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:5
verses.text: for you are all sons of light and sons of day. We are not of the night nor of darkness.  <div eID="gen27512" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11830"/><div sID="gen27513" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11830"/>So then, we must not sleep like the rest, but must be on the alert and be self-controlled.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:7
verses.text: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, are drunk at night.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:8
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">because</transChange><note placement="foot">Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“are”) which is understood as causal</note> we are of the day, we must be sober, by<note placement="foot">Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“putting on”) which is understood as means</note> putting on the breastplate of faith and love and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> a helmet the hope of salvation,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:9
verses.text: because God did not appoint us for wrath, but for the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:10
verses.text: who died for us, so that whether we are awake or asleep, we will live at the same time with him.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:11
verses.text: Therefore encourage one another and build up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each other⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one the one,” i.e., “one the other”</note>, just as indeed you are doing.  <div eID="gen27513" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11831"/><title type="x-s">Final Exhortations and Benediction</title> <div sID="gen27514" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11831"/>Now we ask you, brothers, to respect those who labor among you and rule over you in the Lord and admonish you,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:13
verses.text: and to esteem them beyond all measure in love, because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.  <div eID="gen27514" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11832"/><div sID="gen27515" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11832"/>And we urge you, brothers, admonish the disorderly, console the discouraged, help the sick, be patient toward all <transChange type="added">people</transChange>.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:15
verses.text: See to it that no one pays back evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue good toward<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “both toward”</note> one another and toward all <transChange type="added">people</transChange>.  <div eID="gen27515" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11833"/><div sID="gen27516" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11833"/>Rejoice always,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:17
verses.text: pray constantly,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:18
verses.text: give thanks in everything; for this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the will of God for you in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:19
verses.text: Do not quench the Spirit.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:20
verses.text: Do not despise prophecies,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:21
verses.text: but examine all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>; hold fast to <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> good.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:22
verses.text: Abstain from every form of evil.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:23
verses.text: Now may the God of peace himself sanctify you completely, and may your spirit and soul and body be kept complete, blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:24
verses.text: The one who calls you <transChange type="added">is</transChange> faithful, who also will do <transChange type="added">this</transChange>.  <div eID="gen27516" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11834"/><div sID="gen27517" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11834"/>Brothers, pray for us.<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “pray for us also”</note>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:26
verses.text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:27
verses.text: I adjure you by the Lord, have this letter read aloud to all the brothers.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:28
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with you.  <chapter eID="1Thess.5"/> <div eID="gen27517" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27499" osisID="1Thess" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11835"/><title type="x-s">Greeting</title> <div sID="gen27519" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11835"/>Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:2
verses.text: Grace to you and peace from God the Father<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “God our Father”</note> and the Lord Jesus Christ.  <div eID="gen27519" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11836"/><title type="x-s">Thanksgiving for the Thessalonian Believers</title> <div sID="gen27520" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11836"/>We ought to give thanks to God always concerning you, brothers, just as it is fitting, because your faith is flourishing and the love of each one of you all toward one another is increasing

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:4
verses.text: so that we ourselves boast in you in the churches of God about your patient endurance and faith in all your persecutions and the afflictions that you are enduring,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:5
verses.text: a proof of the righteous judgment of God, so that you may be considered worthy of the kingdom of God, on behalf of which also you are suffering,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:6
verses.text: since <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> righteous in the sight of God to pay back those who are afflicting you with affliction,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:7
verses.text: and to you who are being afflicted, rest with us at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with his powerful angels,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:8
verses.text: with burning flame<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “with flaming fire”</note> giving punishment to those who do not know God and who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:9
verses.text: who will pay the penalty <transChange type="added">of</transChange> eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his strength,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:10
verses.text: whenever he should come to be glorified on that day by his saints and to be marveled at by all who believe, because our testimony was believed among you,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:11
verses.text: for which <transChange type="added">purpose</transChange> we also pray always for you, that you may be considered worthy of the calling of our God, and he might fulfill every desire for goodness and work of faith with power,<note placement="foot">Or “by his power”</note>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:12
verses.text: in order that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.  <chapter eID="2Thess.1"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11837"/><title type="x-s">The Man of Lawlessness Will Be Revealed</title> <div sID="gen27521" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11837"/>Now we ask you, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our assembling to him,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:2
verses.text: that you not be easily shaken from your composure, nor be troubled either by a spirit or by a message or by a letter <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞alleged to be from us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “as if by us”</note>, to the effect that the day of the Lord has arrived.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:3
verses.text: Do not let anyone deceive you in any way, for <transChange type="added">that day will not come</transChange> unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:4
verses.text: who opposes and who exalts himself over every so-called god or object of worship, so that he sits down in the temple of God, proclaiming that he himself is God.  <div eID="gen27521" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11838"/><div sID="gen27522" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11838"/>Do you not remember that <transChange type="added">while</transChange><note placement="foot">Here “while” is supplied as a component of the participle (“were”) which is understood as temporal</note> we were still with you, we were saying these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to you?

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:6
verses.text: And you know that which restrains <transChange type="added">him</transChange> now, so that he will be revealed in his own time.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:7
verses.text: For the mystery of lawlessness is at work already; only the one who now restrains<note placement="foot">Or “restrains it” (referring to the “mystery of lawlessness”; or “restrains him” (referring to the “man of lawlessness” in v. <reference osisRef="2Thess.2.3">3</reference>)</note> will do so until he is out of the way,<note placement="foot">Literally “out of the midst”</note>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:8
verses.text: and then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of his mouth, and wipe out by the appearance of his coming,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:9
verses.text: whose coming is in accordance with the working of Satan, with all power and signs and lying wonders,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:10
verses.text: and with every unrighteous deception against those who are perishing, in place of which they did not accept the love of the truth, so that they would be saved.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:11
verses.text: And because of this, God sends them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a powerful delusion⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a working of deceit”</note> so that they will believe the lie,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:12
verses.text: in order that all may be condemned who did not believe the truth, but delighted in unrighteousness.  <div eID="gen27522" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11839"/><title type="x-s">Stand Firm and Hold Fast</title> <div sID="gen27523" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11839"/>But we ought to give thanks to God always concerning you, brothers <transChange type="added">dearly</transChange> loved by the Lord, because God has chosen you <transChange type="added">as</transChange> first fruits for salvation by the sanctification of the Spirit and faith in the truth,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:14
verses.text: for which <transChange type="added">purpose</transChange> he called<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “he also called”</note> you through our gospel for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:15
verses.text: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold fast to the traditions which you were taught, whether by <transChange type="added">spoken</transChange> word or by letter from us.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:16
verses.text: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who has loved us and given <transChange type="added">us</transChange> eternal encouragement and good hope by grace,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:17
verses.text: encourage your hearts and strengthen <transChange type="added">you</transChange> in every good work and word.  <chapter eID="2Thess.2"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11840"/><title type="x-s">Paul’s Prayer Request</title> <div sID="gen27524" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11840"/>Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may progress and be honored, just as also <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> with you,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:2
verses.text: and that we may be delivered from evil and wicked people, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for not all have the faith⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for not of all is the faith”</note>.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:3
verses.text: But the Lord is faithful, who will strengthen you and guard <transChange type="added">you</transChange> from the evil one.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:4
verses.text: And we have confidence in the Lord about you, that you are both doing and you will do <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> that we are commanding.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:5
verses.text: Now may the Lord direct your hearts toward the love of God and toward the patient endurance of Christ.  <div eID="gen27524" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11841"/><title type="x-s">Warning Against Lazy, Irresponsible Behavior</title> <div sID="gen27525" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11841"/>But we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you keep away from every brother who lives irresponsibly and not according to the tradition that they received from us.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:7
verses.text: For you yourselves know how it is necessary to imitate us, that we did not behave irresponsibly among you,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:8
verses.text: nor did we eat bread from anyone without paying, but with toil and labor, <transChange type="added">we were</transChange> working night and day in order not to be a burden to any of you,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:9
verses.text: not that we do not have the right, but so that we may give ourselves <transChange type="added">as</transChange> an example to you, so that <transChange type="added">you</transChange> may imitate us.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:10
verses.text: For even when we were with you, we used to command this to you: that if anyone does not want to work, neither should he eat.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:11
verses.text: For we hear <transChange type="added">that</transChange> some among you are living irresponsibly, working <transChange type="added">at</transChange> nothing, but being busybodies.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:12
verses.text: Now we command and we exhort such people in the Lord Jesus Christ that, working with quietness, they eat their own bread.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:13
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> you, brothers, do not be discouraged <transChange type="added">while</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “while” is supplied as a component of the participle (“doing what is right”) which is understood as temporal</note> doing what is right.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:14
verses.text: But if anyone does not obey our message through this letter, take note not to associate with him, in order that he may be put to shame.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:15
verses.text: And do not consider <transChange type="added">him</transChange> as an enemy, but admonish <transChange type="added">him</transChange> as a brother.  <div eID="gen27525" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11842"/><title type="x-s">Final Greeting and Benediction</title> <div sID="gen27526" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11842"/>Now may the Lord of peace himself grant you peace through everything in every way. <transChange type="added">May</transChange> the Lord <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with all of you.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:17
verses.text: The greeting <transChange type="added">is</transChange> by my hand, Paul’s, which is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a sign of genuineness⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “a sign”</note> in every letter: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞this is how I write⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in this way I write”</note>.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:18
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with all of you.  <chapter eID="2Thess.3"/> <div eID="gen27526" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27518" osisID="2Thess" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11843"/><title type="x-s">Greeting</title> <div sID="gen27528" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11843"/>Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:2
verses.text: to Timothy, <transChange type="added">my</transChange> true child in the faith. Grace, mercy, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.  <div eID="gen27528" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11844"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Timothy in Ephesus</title> <div sID="gen27529" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11844"/>Just as I urged you <transChange type="added">when I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“traveled”) which is understood as temporal</note> traveled to Macedonia, remain in Ephesus, so that you may instruct certain people not to teach other doctrine,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:4
verses.text: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause useless speculations rather than God’s plan <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> by faith.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:5
verses.text: But the goal of our instruction is love from a pure heart and a good conscience and a faith without hypocrisy,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:6
verses.text: from which some have deviated, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> have turned away into fruitless discussion,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:7
verses.text: wanting to be teachers of the law, <transChange type="added">although they</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“understand”) which is understood as concessive</note> do not understand either <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which they are saying or <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> concerning which they are speaking confidently.  <div eID="gen27529" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11845"/><div sID="gen27530" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11845"/>But we know that the law <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good, if anyone makes use of it lawfully,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:9
verses.text: knowing this, that the law <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not given for a righteous <transChange type="added">person</transChange> but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and totally worldly, for the one who kills his father and the one who kills his mother, for murderers,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:10
verses.text: sexually immoral people, homosexuals, kidnappers, liars, perjurers, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whatever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “if anything”</note> else is opposed to sound teaching,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:11
verses.text: according to the glorious gospel of the blessed God that I was entrusted with.  <div eID="gen27530" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11846"/><title type="x-s">Paul’s Thankfulness for the Mercy Shown to Him</title> <div sID="gen27531" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11846"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I give thanks⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I have thankfulness”</note> to the one who strengthens me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he considered me faithful, placing me into ministry,<note placement="foot">Or “service”</note>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">although I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“was”) which is understood as concessive</note> was formerly a blasphemer and a persecutor and a violent man, but I was shown mercy because I acted ignorantly in unbelief,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:14
verses.text: and the grace of our Lord abounded with the faith and love <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:15
verses.text: The saying <transChange type="added">is</transChange> trustworthy and worthy of all acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the foremost.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:16
verses.text: But because of this I was shown mercy, in order that in me foremost, Christ Jesus might demonstrate his total patience, for an example for those who are going to believe in him for eternal life.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:17
verses.text: Now to the King of the ages, immortal, invisible, to the only God, <transChange type="added">be</transChange> honor and glory <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to the ages of the ages”</note>. Amen.  <div eID="gen27531" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11847"/><title type="x-s">Paul’s Charge to Timothy</title> <div sID="gen27532" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11847"/>I am setting before you this instruction, Timothy <transChange type="added">my</transChange> child, in accordance with the prophecies spoken long ago about you, in order that by them you may fight the good fight,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:19
verses.text: having faith and a good conscience, which some, <transChange type="added">because they</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“have rejected”) which is understood as causal</note> have rejected <transChange type="added">these</transChange>, have suffered shipwreck concerning their faith,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:20
verses.text: among whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan, in order that they may be taught not to blaspheme.  <chapter eID="1Tim.1"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11848"/><title type="x-s">Instructions to Pray for All People</title> <div sID="gen27533" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11848"/>Therefore, I urge first of all <transChange type="added">that</transChange> petitions, prayers, requests, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> thanksgiving be made on behalf of all people,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:2
verses.text: on behalf of kings and all those who are in authority, in order that we may live a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:3
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good and acceptable before God our Savior,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:4
verses.text: who wants all people to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:5
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> one God and one mediator between God and human beings, the man Christ Jesus,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:6
verses.text: who gave himself a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:7
verses.text: for which I was appointed a herald and an apostle—I am speaking the truth, <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:8
verses.text: Therefore I want the men in every place to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and dispute.  <div eID="gen27533" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11849"/><title type="x-s">Instructions for Women</title> <div sID="gen27534" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11849"/>Likewise also the women should adorn themselves in appropriate clothing, with modesty and self-control, not with braided hair and gold jewelry or pearls or expensive clothing,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:10
verses.text: but with good deeds which are fitting for women who profess godliness.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:11
verses.text: A woman must learn in quietness with all submission.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:12
verses.text: But I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man, but <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞to remain quiet⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to be in quietness”</note>.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:13
verses.text: For Adam was formed first, then Eve,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:14
verses.text: and Adam was not deceived, but the woman, <transChange type="added">because she</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“was deceived”) which is understood as causal</note> was deceived, came into transgression.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:15
verses.text: But she will be saved through the bearing of children, if she continues in faith and love and holiness with self-control.  <chapter eID="1Tim.2"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11850"/><title type="x-s">Qualifications for Overseers</title> <div sID="gen27535" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11850"/>The saying <transChange type="added">is</transChange> trustworthy: if anyone aspires to supervision, he desires a good work.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:2
verses.text: Therefore the overseer must be irreproachable, the husband of one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, skillful in teaching,

verses.name: I Timothy 3:3
verses.text: not addicted to wine, not a violent person, but gentle, peaceable, not loving money,

verses.name: I Timothy 3:4
verses.text: managing his own household well, having children in submission with all dignity

verses.name: I Timothy 3:5
verses.text: (but if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how will he take care of the church of God?),

verses.name: I Timothy 3:6
verses.text: not newly converted, lest he become conceited <transChange type="added">and</transChange> fall into the condemnation of the devil.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:7
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">he</transChange> must also have a good testimony from those outside, in order that he may not fall into disgrace and the trap of the devil.  <div eID="gen27535" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11851"/><title type="x-s">Qualifications for Deacons</title> <div sID="gen27536" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11851"/>Deacons likewise <transChange type="added">must be</transChange> dignified, not insincere, not devoted to much wine, not fond of dishonest gain,

verses.name: I Timothy 3:9
verses.text: holding the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience,

verses.name: I Timothy 3:10
verses.text: and these also must be tested first; then let them serve <transChange type="added">if they</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “if” is supplied as a component of the participle (“are”) which is understood as conditional</note> are above reproach.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:11
verses.text: The wives<note placement="foot">Or “The women”</note> likewise <transChange type="added">must be</transChange> dignified, not slanderous, temperate, faithful in all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:12
verses.text: Deacons must be husbands of one wife, managing <transChange type="added">their</transChange> children and their own households well.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:13
verses.text: For those who have served well acquire a good standing for themselves, and great boldness in the faith <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> in Christ Jesus.  <div eID="gen27536" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11852"/><title type="x-s">The Mystery of Godliness Described</title> <div sID="gen27537" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11852"/>I am writing these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to you, hoping to come to you in a short time.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:15
verses.text: But if I am delayed, <transChange type="added">I am writing</transChange><note placement="foot">*The words “I am writing” are not in the Greek text, but are an understood repetition from the previous clause</note> in order that you may know how one must conduct oneself in the household of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and mainstay<note placement="foot">Or “basis”; or “support”</note> of the truth.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:16
verses.text: And most certainly, great is the mystery of godliness: <div eID="gen27537" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27538"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27539"/>Who was revealed in the flesh,<l eID="gen27539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27540"/>was vindicated by<note placement="foot">Or perhaps “in”</note> the Spirit,<l eID="gen27540" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27541"/>was seen by angels,<l eID="gen27541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27542"/>was proclaimed among the Gentiles<note placement="foot">Or “nations”; the same Greek word can be translated “nations” or “Gentiles” depending on the context</note>,<l eID="gen27542" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27543"/>was believed on in the world,<l eID="gen27543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27544"/>was taken up in glory. <l eID="gen27544" level="2"/><lg eID="gen27538"/> <chapter eID="1Tim.3"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11853"/><title type="x-s">The Coming Apostasy</title> <div sID="gen27545" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11853"/>Now the Spirit explicitly says that in the last times some will depart from the faith, paying attention to deceitful spirits and teachings of demons,

verses.name: I Timothy 4:2
verses.text: by the hypocrisy of liars, who are seared in their own conscience,

verses.name: I Timothy 4:3
verses.text: who forbid marrying <transChange type="added">and insist on</transChange> abstaining from foods that God created for sharing in with thankfulness by those who believe and who know the truth,

verses.name: I Timothy 4:4
verses.text: because everything created by God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> good and nothing <transChange type="added">is to be</transChange> rejected <transChange type="added">if it is</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “if” is supplied as a component of the participle (“received”) which is understood as conditional</note> received with thankfulness,

verses.name: I Timothy 4:5
verses.text: for it is made holy by the word of God and prayer.  <div eID="gen27545" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11854"/><title type="x-s">The Good Servant of Christ</title> <div sID="gen27546" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11854"/><transChange type="added">By</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“teaching”) which is understood as means</note> teaching these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, trained in the words of the faith and of the good teaching that you have followed faithfully.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:7
verses.text: But reject those <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞worthless myths told by elderly women⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “worthless and characteristic of an elderly woman myths”</note>, and train yourself for godliness.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:8
verses.text: For the training of the body is <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞somewhat⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for a little”</note> profitable, but godliness is profitable for everything, because it<note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“holds”) which is understood as causal</note> holds promise for the present life and for the <transChange type="added">life</transChange> to come.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:9
verses.text: The statement <transChange type="added">is</transChange> trustworthy and deserving of complete acceptance.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:10
verses.text: For to this <transChange type="added">end</transChange> we labor and suffer reproach,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “and strive”</note> because we have put our hope in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> living God, who is the Savior of all people, especially of believers.  <div eID="gen27546" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11855"/><div sID="gen27547" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11855"/>Command these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> and teach <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:12
verses.text: Let no one look down on your youth, but be an example for the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:13
verses.text: Until I come, pay attention to the <transChange type="added">public</transChange> reading,<note placement="foot">Many English translations supply “of scripture” here to clarify what is to be read aloud</note> to exhortation, to teaching.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:14
verses.text: Do not neglect the gift <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> in you, that was granted to you through prophecy with the laying on of hands by the council of elders.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:15
verses.text: Practice these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>. Be <transChange type="added">diligent</transChange><note placement="foot">Literally “be in these things,” though most English versions supply a predicate here</note> in these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, in order that your progress may be evident to everyone.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:16
verses.text: Fix <transChange type="added">your</transChange> attention on yourself and on your teaching. Continue in them, for <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“doing”) which is understood as means</note> doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.  <chapter eID="1Tim.4"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11856"/><title type="x-s">Instructions About Widows</title> <div sID="gen27548" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11856"/>Do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to <transChange type="added">him</transChange> as a father, younger men as brothers,

verses.name: I Timothy 5:2
verses.text: older women as mothers, younger women as sisters, with all purity.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:3
verses.text: Honor widows <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> truly widows.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:4
verses.text: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, they must learn to show profound respect for their own household first, and to pay back recompense to their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:5
verses.text: But the widow <transChange type="added">who is one</transChange> truly, and is left alone, has put her hope in God and continues in her petitions and prayers night and day.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:6
verses.text: But the one who lives for sensual pleasure is dead <transChange type="added">even though she</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “even though” is supplied as a component of the participle (“lives”) which is understood as concessive</note> lives.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:7
verses.text: And command these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, in order that they may be irreproachable.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:8
verses.text: But if someone does not provide for his own <transChange type="added">relatives</transChange>, and especially the members of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.  <div eID="gen27548" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11857"/><div sID="gen27549" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11857"/>Let a widow be put on the list <transChange type="added">if she</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “if” is supplied as a component of the participle (“is”) which is understood as conditional</note> is not less than sixty years <transChange type="added">old</transChange>, the wife of one husband,

verses.name: I Timothy 5:10
verses.text: being well-attested by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has shown hospitality, if she has washed the feet of the saints, if she has helped those who are oppressed, if she has devoted herself to every good work.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:11
verses.text: But refuse younger widows, for whenever their physical desires lead them away from Christ, they want to marry,

verses.name: I Timothy 5:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">thus</transChange> incurring condemnation because they have broken their former pledge.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:13
verses.text: And at the same time also, going around from house to house, they learn <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> idle, and not only idle, but also gossipy and busybodies, saying the things <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> not necessary.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:14
verses.text: Therefore I want younger <transChange type="added">widows</transChange> to marry, to bear children, to manage a household, to give the adversary no opportunity for reproach.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:15
verses.text: For already some have turned away <transChange type="added">and followed</transChange> after Satan.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:16
verses.text: If any believing woman has widows, she must help them, and the church must not be burdened, in order that it may help those <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> truly widows.  <div eID="gen27549" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11858"/><title type="x-s">Honoring Worthy Elders and Dealing With Sinners</title> <div sID="gen27550" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11858"/>The elders who lead well must be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who labor by speaking and teaching.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:18
verses.text: For the scripture says, “You must not muzzle an ox <transChange type="added">while it</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “while” is supplied as a component of the participle (“threshing”) which is understood as temporal</note> is threshing,”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Deut.25.4">Deut 25:4</reference></note> and “The worker is worthy of his wages.”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Luke.10.7">Luke 10:7</reference></note>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:19
verses.text: Do not accept an accusation against an elder except on the evidence of two or three witnesses.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:20
verses.text: Reprove those who sin in the presence of all, in order that the rest also may experience fear.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:21
verses.text: I testify solemnly before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels that you observe these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> without prejudice, doing nothing according to partiality.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:22
verses.text: Lay hands on no one hastily, and do not participate in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:23
verses.text: (No longer drink only water, but use a little wine for your stomach and your frequent illnesses.)

verses.name: I Timothy 5:24
verses.text: The sins of some people are evident, preceding <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to judgment, but for some also they follow after <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:25
verses.text: Likewise also good works <transChange type="added">are</transChange> evident, and those considered otherwise are not able to be hidden.  <chapter eID="1Tim.5"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11859"/><title type="x-s">Slaves and Masters</title> <div sID="gen27551" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11859"/>All those who are under the yoke as slaves must regard their own masters as worthy of all honor, lest the name of God and the teaching be slandered.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:2
verses.text: And those who have believing masters must not look down on <transChange type="added">them</transChange> because they are brothers, but rather they must serve, because those who benefit by their service are believers and dearly loved. <div eID="gen27551" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">False Teachers and the Love of Money</title> <div sID="gen27552" type="x-p"/> Teach and encourage these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:3
verses.text: If anyone teaches other doctrine and does not devote himself to the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> in accordance with godliness,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:4
verses.text: he is conceited, understanding nothing, but having a morbid interest concerning controversies and disputes about words, from which come envy, strife, slanders, evil suspicions,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:5
verses.text: constant wrangling by people of depraved mind and deprived of the truth, who consider godliness to be a means of gain.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:6
verses.text: But godliness with contentment is a great means of gain.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:7
verses.text: For we have brought nothing into the world, so that neither can we bring anything out.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:8
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">if we</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “if” is supplied as a component of the participle (“having”) which is understood as conditional</note> have food and clothing, with these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> we will be content.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:9
verses.text: But those who want to be rich fall into temptation and a trap and many foolish and harmful desires, which plunge those people into ruin and destruction.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:10
verses.text: For the love of money is a root of all evil, by which some, <transChange type="added">because they</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“desire”) which is understood as causal</note> desire <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, have gone astray from the faith and have pierced themselves with many pains.  <div eID="gen27552" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11860"/><title type="x-s">Renewed Charge to Timothy</title> <div sID="gen27553" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11860"/>But you, O man of God, flee from these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patient endurance, gentleness.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:12
verses.text: Fight the good fight of the faith; take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and confessed the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:13
verses.text: I command you, in the sight of God who gives life to all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> and Christ Jesus who testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> you observe the commandment without fault, irreproachable until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:15
verses.text: which he will make known in his own time, the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of those who reign as kings and Lord of those who rule as lords,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:16
verses.text: the <transChange type="added">one who</transChange> alone possesses immortality, who lives <transChange type="added">in</transChange> unapproachable light, whom no human being has seen nor is able to see, to whom <transChange type="added">be</transChange> honor and eternal power. Amen.  <div eID="gen27553" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11861"/><title type="x-s">Instructions to the Rich</title> <div sID="gen27554" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11861"/>Command those <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> rich in this present age not to be proud and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of riches, but in God, who provides us all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> richly for enjoyment,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:18
verses.text: to do good, to be rich in good works, to be generous, sharing freely,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:19
verses.text: storing up for themselves a good foundation for the future, in order that they may take hold of <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> truly life.  <div eID="gen27554" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11862"/><title type="x-s">Final Charge and Benediction</title> <div sID="gen27555" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11862"/>O Timothy, guard what has been entrusted <transChange type="added">to you</transChange>. Turn away from pointless empty talk and contradictions of <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> falsely called knowledge,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:21
verses.text: which some, <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“professing”) which is understood as means</note> professing <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, have deviated concerning the faith. Grace <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with you <transChange type="added">all</transChange>.  <chapter eID="1Tim.6"/> <div eID="gen27555" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27527" osisID="1Tim" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11863"/><title type="x-s">Greeting</title> <div sID="gen27557" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11863"/>Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, according to the promise of life which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in Christ Jesus,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:2
verses.text: to Timothy, <transChange type="added">my</transChange> dear child. Grace, mercy, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.  <div eID="gen27557" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11864"/><title type="x-s">Timothy’s Spiritual Heritage</title> <div sID="gen27558" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11864"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I am thankful⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I have thankfulness”</note> to God, whom I have served with a clear conscience <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞as my ancestors did⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from ancestors”</note>, when <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I remember you constantly⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I have remembrance concerning you constantly”</note> in my prayers night and day,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:4
verses.text: longing to see you <transChange type="added">as I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “as” is supplied as a component of the participle (“remember”) which is understood as temporal</note> remember your tears, so that I may be filled with joy,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:5
verses.text: <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞remembering the⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “receiving a remembrance of the”</note> sincere faith in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in you also,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:6
verses.text: for which reason I remind you to rekindle the gift of God that is in you through the laying on of my hands.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:7
verses.text: For God has not given us a spirit of cowardice, but of power and love and self-discipline.  <div eID="gen27558" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11865"/><title type="x-s">Exhortation to Share Paul’s Suffering</title> <div sID="gen27559" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11865"/>Therefore, do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord, nor me his prisoner, but suffer along with <transChange type="added">me</transChange> for the gospel, according to the power of God,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:9
verses.text: who saved us and called <transChange type="added">us</transChange> with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to his own purpose and grace that was given to us in Christ Jesus <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞before time began⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “before times eternal”</note>,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:10
verses.text: but has now been disclosed by the appearing of our Savior Jesus Christ,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “our Savior Christ Jesus”</note> who has abolished death and brought to light life and immortality through the gospel,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:11
verses.text: for which I was appointed a proclaimer and an apostle and a teacher,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:12
verses.text: for which reason also I suffer these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>. But <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> not ashamed, because I know in whom I have believed, and I am convinced that he is able to guard <transChange type="added">what</transChange> I have entrusted until that day.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:13
verses.text: Hold fast to the pattern of sound words which you heard from me, in the faith and love <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:14
verses.text: Guard the good deposit through the Holy Spirit who lives in us.  <div eID="gen27559" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11866"/><div sID="gen27560" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11866"/>You know this, that all those in Asia turned away from me, among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:16
verses.text: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he refreshed me many times, and was not ashamed of my imprisonment,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:17
verses.text: but <transChange type="added">when he</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“was”) which is understood as temporal</note> was in Rome, he diligently sought me and found <transChange type="added">me</transChange>.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:18
verses.text: May the Lord grant him to find mercy from the Lord in that day! And how much he served <transChange type="added">me</transChange> in Ephesus you know very well.  <chapter eID="2Tim.1"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11867"/><title type="x-s">Exhortation to Be Strong in Grace</title> <div sID="gen27561" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11867"/>You, therefore, my child, be strong in the grace <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> in Christ Jesus,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:2
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses, entrust these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to faithful people who will be competent to teach others also.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:3
verses.text: Suffer together with <transChange type="added">me</transChange> as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:4
verses.text: No one who serves as a soldier is entangled in the activities of <transChange type="added">everyday</transChange> life, so that he may please the one who enlisted <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:5
verses.text: And also if anyone competes he is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:6
verses.text: The farmer who works hard must <transChange type="added">be</transChange> the first to receive a share of the crops.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:7
verses.text: Consider what I am saying, for the Lord will grant you understanding in all <transChange type="added">these things</transChange>.  <div eID="gen27561" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11868"/><title type="x-s">A Trustworthy Saying</title> <div sID="gen27562" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11868"/>Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, a descendant of David according to my gospel,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:9
verses.text: in connection with which I suffer misfortune to the point of <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞imprisonment⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “bonds”</note> as a criminal, but the word of God is not bound.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:10
verses.text: Because of this, I endure all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> for the sake of the chosen, in order that they also may obtain salvation <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:11
verses.text: The saying <transChange type="added">is</transChange> trustworthy: <div eID="gen27562" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27563"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27564"/>For if we died with <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, we will also live with <transChange type="added">him</transChange>; <l eID="gen27564" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11869"/><l level="1" sID="gen27565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11869"/>if we endure, we will also reign with <transChange type="added">him</transChange>;<l eID="gen27565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27566"/>if we deny <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, he also will deny us; <l eID="gen27566" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11870"/><l level="1" sID="gen27567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11870"/>if we are unfaithful, he remains faithful—<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he cannot deny himself⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he is not able to deny himself”</note>.<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “because he is not able to deny himself”</note> <l eID="gen27567" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen27563"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11871"/><title type="x-s">A Worker Approved to God and Not Ashamed</title> <div sID="gen27568" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11871"/>Remind <transChange type="added">people</transChange> of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, solemnly urging <transChange type="added">them</transChange> before the Lord<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “before God”</note> not to dispute about words. <transChange type="added">This is</transChange> in no way beneficial <transChange type="added">and leads to</transChange> the ruin of the hearers.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:15
verses.text: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, a worker having no need to be ashamed, guiding the word of truth along a straight path.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:16
verses.text: But avoid pointless chatter, for it will progress to greater ungodliness,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:17
verses.text: and their message <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will spread⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will experience spreading”</note> like gangrene, among whom are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:18
verses.text: who have deviated concerning the truth <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“saying”) which is understood as means</note> saying the resurrection has already taken place, and they are upsetting the faith of some.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:19
