verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12055"/><div sID="gen27914" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12055"/>And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you do not have need that anyone teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, and is true and is not a lie, and just as it has taught you, you reside<note placement="foot">*By form the verb could also be imperative: “just as it has taught you, reside in him”</note> in him.  <div eID="gen27914" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 2:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12056"/><title type="x-s">God’s Children</title> <div sID="gen27915" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12056"/>And now, little children, remain in him, so that whenever he is revealed we may have confidence and not be put to shame before him at his coming.

verses.name: I John 2:29
verses.text: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “everyone also”</note> who practices righteousness has been fathered by him.  <chapter eID="1John.2"/> <div eID="gen27915" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 3:1
verses.text: See what sort of love the Father has given to us: that we should be called children of God, and we are! Because of this the world does not know us: because it did not know him.

verses.name: I John 3:2
verses.text: Dear friends, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that whenever he is revealed we will be like him, because we will see him just as he is.

verses.name: I John 3:3
verses.text: And everyone who has this hope in him purifies himself, just as that one is pure.  <div eID="gen27916" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12057"/><div sID="gen27917" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12057"/>Everyone who practices sin also practices lawlessness, and sin is lawlessness.

verses.name: I John 3:5
verses.text: And you know that that one was revealed in order that he might take away sins, and in him <transChange type="added">there</transChange> is no sin.

verses.name: I John 3:6
verses.text: Everyone who resides in him does not sin. Everyone who sins has neither seen him nor known him.

verses.name: I John 3:7
verses.text: Little children, let no one deceive you: the one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as that one is righteous.

verses.name: I John 3:8
verses.text: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. For this <transChange type="added">reason</transChange> the Son of God was revealed: in order to destroy the works of the devil.

verses.name: I John 3:9
verses.text: Everyone who is fathered by God does not practice sin, because his seed resides in him, and <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> not able to sin, because he has been fathered by God.

verses.name: I John 3:10
verses.text: By this the children of God and the children of the devil are evident: everyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, namely, the one who does not love his brother.  <div eID="gen27917" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12058"/><title type="x-s">God is Love, so Love One Another</title> <div sID="gen27918" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12058"/>For this is the message that you have heard from the beginning: that we should love one another,

verses.name: I John 3:12
verses.text: not as Cain, who was of the evil one and violently murdered his brother. And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞for what reason⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “on account of what”</note> did he violently murder him? Because his deeds were evil and the <transChange type="added">deeds</transChange> of his brother <transChange type="added">were</transChange> righteous.  <div eID="gen27918" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12059"/><div sID="gen27919" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12059"/>Do not marvel,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “And do not marvel”</note> brothers, if the world hates you.

verses.name: I John 3:14
verses.text: We know that we have passed over from death to life because we love the brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.

verses.name: I John 3:15
verses.text: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that every murderer does not have eternal life residing in him.

verses.name: I John 3:16
verses.text: We have come to know love by this: that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that one” (referring to Jesus Christ)</note> laid down his life on behalf of us, and we ought to lay down our lives on behalf of the brothers.

verses.name: I John 3:17
verses.text: But whoever has the world’s material possessions and observes his brother <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in need⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “having need”</note> and shuts his heart against him, how does the love of God reside in him?  <div eID="gen27919" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12060"/><div sID="gen27920" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12060"/>Little children, let us not love with word or with tongue, but in deed and truth.

verses.name: I John 3:19
verses.text: By this<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “And by this”</note> we know that we are of the truth and will convince our heart before him,

verses.name: I John 3:20
verses.text: that<note placement="foot">Or “because”</note> if our heart condemns us, that God is greater than our heart and knows all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.

verses.name: I John 3:21
verses.text: Dear friends, if our heart does not condemn <transChange type="added">us</transChange>, we have confidence before God,

verses.name: I John 3:22
verses.text: and whatever we ask we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> pleasing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in his sight⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in the sight of him”</note>.

verses.name: I John 3:23
verses.text: And this is his commandment: that we believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ and love one another, just as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞he commanded us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “he gave us commandment”</note>.

verses.name: I John 3:24
verses.text: And the one who keeps his commandments resides in him, and he in him. And by this we know that he resides in us: by the Spirit whom he has given to us.  <chapter eID="1John.3"/>

verses.name: I John 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12061"/><title type="x-s">How to Recognize the Spirit of God</title> <div sID="gen27921" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12061"/>Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits <transChange type="added">to determine</transChange> if they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

verses.name: I John 4:2
verses.text: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ<note placement="foot">Or “confesses Jesus as Christ who has come in the flesh” (see also <reference osisRef="2John.1.7">2 John 7</reference>)</note> has come in the flesh is from God,

verses.name: I John 4:3
verses.text: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God, and this is the <transChange type="added">spirit</transChange> of the antichrist, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> which you have heard that it is coming, and now it is already in the world.  <div eID="gen27921" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12062"/><div sID="gen27922" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12062"/>You are from God, little children, and have conquered them, because the one <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> in you is greater than the one <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> in the world.

verses.name: I John 4:5
verses.text: They are from the world; <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞therefore⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “because of this”</note> they speak from the world and the world listens to them.

verses.name: I John 4:6
verses.text: We are from God. The one who knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. By this we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deceit.  <div eID="gen27922" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12063"/><title type="x-s">God’s Love Revealed</title> <div sID="gen27923" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12063"/>Dear friends, let us love one another, because love is from God, and everyone who loves has been fathered by God and knows God.

verses.name: I John 4:8
verses.text: The one who does not love does not know God, because God is love.

verses.name: I John 4:9
verses.text: By this the love of God is revealed in us: that God sent his one and only Son into the world in order that we may live through him.

verses.name: I John 4:10
verses.text: In this is love: not that we have loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son <transChange type="added">to be the</transChange> propitiation<note placement="foot">Or “expiation”; or “atoning sacrifice”</note> for our sins.  <div eID="gen27923" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12064"/><div sID="gen27924" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12064"/>Dear friends, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

verses.name: I John 4:12
verses.text: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God resides in us and his love is perfected in us.

verses.name: I John 4:13
verses.text: By this we know that we reside in him and he in us: that<note placement="foot">Or “because”</note> he has given us of his Spirit.

verses.name: I John 4:14
verses.text: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son <transChange type="added">to be the</transChange> Savior of the world.  <div eID="gen27924" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12065"/><div sID="gen27925" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12065"/>Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God resides in him and he in God.

verses.name: I John 4:16
verses.text: And we have come to know and have believed the love that God has in us. God is love, and the one who resides in love resides in God, and God resides in him.

verses.name: I John 4:17
verses.text: By this love is perfected with us, so that we may have confidence in the day of judgment, because just as that one is, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> also are we in this world.

verses.name: I John 4:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There</transChange> is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear includes punishment, and the one who is afraid has not been perfected in love.

verses.name: I John 4:19
verses.text: We love, because he first loved us.  <div eID="gen27925" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12066"/><div sID="gen27926" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12066"/>If anyone says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar, for the one who does not love his brother whom he has seen is not able to love God whom he has not seen.

verses.name: I John 4:21
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the commandment we have from him: that the one who loves God should love his brother also.  <chapter eID="1John.4"/> <div eID="gen27926" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 5:1
verses.text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been fathered by God, and everyone who loves <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the father⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the one who fathers”</note> also loves the <transChange type="added">child</transChange> fathered by him.

verses.name: I John 5:2
verses.text: By this we know that we love the children of God: whenever we love God and keep his commandments.

verses.name: I John 5:3
verses.text: For this is the love of God: that we keep his commandments. And his commandments are not burdensome,

verses.name: I John 5:4
verses.text: because everyone who is fathered by God conquers the world. <div eID="gen27927" type="x-p"/> <title type="x-s">God Has Given Us Eternal Life in the Son</title> <div sID="gen27928" type="x-p"/> And this is the victory which has conquered the world: our faith.

verses.name: I John 5:5
verses.text: Now who is the one who conquers the world except the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

verses.name: I John 5:6
verses.text: This is the one who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ, not with the water only, but with the water and with the blood. And the Spirit is the one who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

verses.name: I John 5:7
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there</transChange> are three that testify,<note placement="foot">Later Latin manuscripts add the following words to v. <reference osisRef="1John.5.7">7</reference> and v. <reference osisRef="1John.5.8">8</reference>: “in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit, and these three are one.

verses.name: I John 5:8
verses.text: And there are three that testify on earth”</note>  the Spirit and the water and the blood, and the three are <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in agreement⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the one”</note>.  <div eID="gen27928" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12067"/><div sID="gen27929" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12067"/>If we receive the testimony of people, the testimony of God is greater, because this is the testimony of God that he has testified concerning his Son.

verses.name: I John 5:10
verses.text: (The one who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. The one who does not believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has testified concerning his Son.)

verses.name: I John 5:11
verses.text: And this is the testimony: that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

verses.name: I John 5:12
verses.text: The one who has the Son has the life; the one who does not have the Son of God does not have the life.  <div eID="gen27929" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12068"/><title type="x-s">Our Assurance of Eternal Life</title> <div sID="gen27930" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12068"/>These <transChange type="added">things</transChange> I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, in order that you may know that you have eternal life.  <div eID="gen27930" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12069"/><div sID="gen27931" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12069"/>And this is the confidence that we have before him: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.

verses.name: I John 5:15
verses.text: And if we know that he hears us <transChange type="added">in</transChange> whatever we ask, we know that we have the requests that we have asked from him.

verses.name: I John 5:16
verses.text: If anyone should see his brother sinning a sin not <transChange type="added">leading</transChange> to death, he should ask, and he will grant life to him, to those who sin not <transChange type="added">leading</transChange> to death. (<transChange type="added">There</transChange> is a sin <transChange type="added">leading</transChange> to death; I do not say that he should ask about that.

verses.name: I John 5:17
verses.text: All unrighteousness is sin, and <transChange type="added">there</transChange> is a sin not <transChange type="added">leading</transChange> to death.)  <div eID="gen27931" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I John 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12070"/><div sID="gen27932" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12070"/>We know that everyone who is fathered by God does not sin, but the one fathered by God, he protects him, and the evil one does not touch him.

verses.name: I John 5:19
verses.text: We know that we are from God, and the whole world lies in <transChange type="added">the power of</transChange> the evil one.

verses.name: I John 5:20
verses.text: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, in order that we may know the one who is true, and we are in the one who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This one is the true God and eternal life.

verses.name: I John 5:21
verses.text: Little children, guard yourselves from idols.  <chapter eID="1John.5"/> <div eID="gen27932" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27904" osisID="1John" type="book"/>

verses.name: II John 1:1
verses.text: The elder, to the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth—and not I alone, but also all those who know the truth—

verses.name: II John 1:2
verses.text: because of the truth that resides in us and will be with us <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Or “in perpetuity”; literally “for the age”</note>.

verses.name: II John 1:3
verses.text: Grace, mercy, peace will be with us from God the Father and from Jesus Christ the Son of the Father in truth and love.  <div eID="gen27935" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II John 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12071"/><div sID="gen27936" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12071"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I was very glad⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I rejoiced exceedingly”</note> because I found some of your children walking in the truth, just as <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the Father commanded us⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “we received commandment from the Father”</note>.  <div eID="gen27936" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II John 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12072"/><title type="x-s">Watch Out for False Teachers</title> <div sID="gen27937" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12072"/>And now I ask you, lady (not as <transChange type="added">if I were</transChange> writing a new commandment to you, but <transChange type="added">one</transChange> that we have had from the beginning), that we should love one another.

verses.name: II John 1:6
verses.text: And this is love: that we walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, just as you have heard from the beginning, so that you should walk in it.

verses.name: II John 1:7
verses.text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not confess Jesus Christ<note placement="foot">Or “confess Jesus as Christ coming in the flesh” (see <reference osisRef="1John.4.2">1 John 4:2</reference>)</note> coming in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> flesh. This person is the deceiver and the antichrist!

verses.name: II John 1:8
verses.text: Watch yourselves that you do not lose what we have worked for, but receive a full reward.  <div eID="gen27937" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II John 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12073"/><div sID="gen27938" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12073"/>Everyone who goes too far and does not remain in the teaching of Christ does not have God. The one who remains in the teaching—this person has both the Father and the Son.

verses.name: II John 1:10
verses.text: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into <transChange type="added">your</transChange> house and do not speak a greeting to him,

verses.name: II John 1:11
verses.text: because the one who speaks a greeting to him shares in his evil deeds.  <div eID="gen27938" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II John 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12074"/><title type="x-s">Conclusion and Final Greeting</title> <div sID="gen27939" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12074"/><transChange type="added">Although</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“have”) which is understood as concessive</note> I have many things to write to you, I do not want to do so by means of paper and ink, but I hope to be with you and to speak <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞face to face⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth to mouth”</note>, so that your<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “our”</note> joy may be complete.

verses.name: II John 1:13
verses.text: The children of your elect sister greet you.  <chapter eID="2John.1"/> <div eID="gen27939" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27933" osisID="2John" type="book"/>

verses.name: III John 1:1
verses.text: The elder, to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> truth.

verses.name: III John 1:2
verses.text: Dear friend, I pray you may prosper concerning everything and be healthy, just as your soul prospers.

verses.name: III John 1:3
verses.text: For I rejoiced exceedingly <transChange type="added">when the</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“came”) which is understood as temporal</note> brothers came and testified <transChange type="added">to</transChange> your truth, just as you are walking in <transChange type="added">the</transChange> truth.

verses.name: III John 1:4
verses.text: I have no greater joy than this: that I hear my children are walking in the truth.  <div eID="gen27942" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: III John 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12075"/><title type="x-s">Instructions to Gaius</title> <div sID="gen27943" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12075"/>Dear friend, you act faithfully<note placement="foot">Or “you act loyally”</note> in whatever you do for the brothers, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞even though they are strangers⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and this strangers”</note>.

verses.name: III John 1:6
verses.text: They have testified <transChange type="added">to</transChange> your love before the church; you will do well to send them<note placement="foot">Literally “whom”</note> on their way in a manner worthy of God.

verses.name: III John 1:7
verses.text: For they have gone out on behalf of the name, accepting nothing from the pagans.<note placement="foot">That is, Gentile unbelievers (as opposed to Gentile Christians)</note>

verses.name: III John 1:8
verses.text: Therefore we ought to support such <transChange type="added">people</transChange>, so that we become fellow workers with <transChange type="added">the</transChange> truth.  <div eID="gen27943" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: III John 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12076"/><title type="x-s">Diotrephes Causes Trouble</title> <div sID="gen27944" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12076"/>I wrote something to the church, but Diotrephes, who wants to be first <transChange type="added">among</transChange> them, does not acknowledge us.

verses.name: III John 1:10
verses.text: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the deeds he is doing⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “his deeds which he is doing”</note>, disparaging us with evil words. And not being content with these, he does not receive the brothers himself, and he hinders those wanting <transChange type="added">to do so</transChange> and throws <transChange type="added">them</transChange> out of the church.

verses.name: III John 1:11
verses.text: Dear friend, do not imitate <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> evil, but <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.  <div eID="gen27944" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: III John 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12077"/><title type="x-s">Demetrius Commended</title> <div sID="gen27945" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12077"/>Demetrius has been testified to by all, even by the truth itself. And we also testify <transChange type="added">to him</transChange>, and you know that our testimony is true.  <div eID="gen27945" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: III John 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12078"/><title type="x-s">Conclusion and Final Greeting</title> <div sID="gen27946" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12078"/>I have many things to write to you, but I do not want to write to you by means of ink and pen.

verses.name: III John 1:14
verses.text: But I hope to see you right away, and to speak <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞face to face⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “mouth to mouth”</note>. Peace <transChange type="added">be</transChange> to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.  <chapter eID="3John.1"/> <div eID="gen27946" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27940" osisID="3John" type="book"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:1
verses.text: Jude,<note placement="foot">“Jude” is the traditional form of the name introducing the letter, but the Greek form is the same as “Judas”</note> a slave of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to those who are called, loved in God the Father and kept for<note placement="foot">Or perhaps “by”</note> Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Jude 1:2
verses.text: May mercy and peace and love be multiplied to you.  <div eID="gen27949" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12079"/><title type="x-s">Contend for the Faith</title> <div sID="gen27950" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12079"/>Dear friends, <transChange type="added">although I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “although” is supplied as a component of the participle (“was making”) which is understood as concessive</note> was making every effort to write to you concerning our common salvation, I considered <transChange type="added">it</transChange> a necessity to write to you to encourage <transChange type="added">you</transChange> to contend for the faith delivered once and for all to the saints.

verses.name: Jude 1:4
verses.text: For certain men<note placement="foot">Or “people,” since the Greek term can be used in a generic sense, but if this statement is related to <reference osisRef="2Pet.2.12">2 Peter 2:12, </reference>it is more likely men are in view</note> have slipped in stealthily, who were designated long ago for this condemnation, ungodly ones, who change the grace of our God into licentiousness and who deny our only Master and Lord Jesus Christ.  <div eID="gen27950" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12080"/><title type="x-s">Condemnation of the Ungodly False Teachers</title> <div sID="gen27951" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12080"/>Now I want to remind you, <transChange type="added">although</transChange> you know everything once and for all,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts place this word in the following clause</note> that Jesus,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “the Lord”</note> having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, the second time destroyed those who did not believe.

verses.name: Jude 1:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the</transChange> angels who did not keep to their own domain but deserted their proper dwelling place, he has kept in eternal bonds under deep gloom for the judgment of the great day,

verses.name: Jude 1:7
verses.text: as Sodom and Gomorrah and the towns around them indulged in sexual immorality and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pursued unnatural desire⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “went after other flesh”</note> in the same way as these, are exhibited as an example by<note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“undergoing”) which is understood as means</note> undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.  <div eID="gen27951" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12081"/><div sID="gen27952" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12081"/>Despite that, in the same way also these <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <transChange type="added">because of their</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“dreams”) which is understood as causal</note> dreams, defile the flesh and reject authority and blaspheme majestic beings.

verses.name: Jude 1:9
verses.text: But Michael the archangel, when he argued with the devil, disputing concerning the body of Moses, did not dare to pronounce a blasphemous judgment, but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”

verses.name: Jude 1:10
verses.text: But these persons blaspheme all that they do not understand, and all that they understand by instinct like the irrational animals, by these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> they are being destroyed.

verses.name: Jude 1:11
verses.text: Woe to them! For they have traveled in the way of Cain, and have given themselves up to the error of Balaam for gain, and have perished<note placement="foot">Or possibly “will perish”</note> in the rebellion of Korah.

verses.name: Jude 1:12
verses.text: These are the ones feasting together without reverence, hidden reefs at your love feasts, caring for themselves, waterless clouds carried away by winds, late autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, uprooted,

verses.name: Jude 1:13
verses.text: wild waves of the sea foaming up their own shameful deeds, wandering stars, for whom the deep gloom of darkness has been reserved for eternity.  <div eID="gen27952" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12082"/><div sID="gen27953" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12082"/>And Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about<note placement="foot">Or “against”</note> these <transChange type="added">people</transChange>, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with tens of thousands of his holy ones

verses.name: Jude 1:15
verses.text: to execute judgment against all, and to convict all the ungodly<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “to convict every soul”</note> concerning all their ungodly deeds that they have committed in an ungodly way, and concerning all the harsh things that ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

verses.name: Jude 1:16
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">people</transChange> are grumblers, discontented, proceeding according to their<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “their own”</note> desires, and their mouths speaking pompous words, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞showing partiality to gain an advantage⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “respecting faces for the sake of advantage”</note>.  <div eID="gen27953" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12083"/><title type="x-s">Persevere in the Love of God</title> <div sID="gen27954" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12083"/>But you, dear friends, remember the words proclaimed beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.name: Jude 1:18
verses.text: for they said to you,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “to you that”</note> “In the end time there will be scoffers following according to their own ungodly desires.”

verses.name: Jude 1:19
verses.text: These are the ones who cause divisions, worldly, not having the Spirit.

verses.name: Jude 1:20
verses.text: But you, dear friends, <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“building up”) which is understood as means</note> building yourselves up in your most holy faith, by<note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“praying”) which is understood as means</note> praying in the Holy Spirit,

verses.name: Jude 1:21
verses.text: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking forward to the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

verses.name: Jude 1:22
verses.text: And have mercy on those who doubt,

verses.name: Jude 1:23
verses.text: and save others <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“snatching”) which is understood as means</note> snatching <transChange type="added">them</transChange> from the fire, and have mercy on others with fear, hating even the tunic stained by the flesh.  <div eID="gen27954" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12084"/><title type="x-s">Benediction</title> <div sID="gen27955" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12084"/>Now to the one who is able to protect you from stumbling and make <transChange type="added">you</transChange> to stand before his glory blameless<note placement="foot">Or “without blemish”</note> with exultation,

verses.name: Jude 1:25
verses.text: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, <transChange type="added">be</transChange> glory, majesty, power, and authority before all time and now and for all eternity. Amen.  <chapter eID="Jude.1"/> <div eID="gen27955" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27947" osisID="Jude" type="book"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12085"/><title type="x-s">Prologue</title> <div sID="gen27957" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12085"/>The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his slaves <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which must take place in a short time, and communicated <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <transChange type="added">by</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “by” is supplied as a component of the participle (“sending”) which is understood as means</note> sending <transChange type="added">it</transChange> through his angel to his slave John,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:2
verses.text: who testified about the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ, all that he saw.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:3
verses.text: Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the one who reads aloud and <transChange type="added">blessed are</transChange><note placement="foot">*The phrase “blessed are” is an understood repetition from the beginning of the verse</note> those who hear the words of the prophecy and observe the things written in it, because the time <transChange type="added">is</transChange> near!  <div eID="gen27957" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12086"/><title type="x-s">Greetings to the Churches</title> <div sID="gen27958" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12086"/>John, to the seven churches in Asia:<note placement="foot">A reference to the Roman province of Asia (modern Asia Minor)</note> grace to you and peace from the one who is and the one who was and the one who is coming, and from the seven spirits who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> before his throne,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:5
verses.text: and from Jesus Christ the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead and the ruler of the kings of the earth. <div eID="gen27958" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen27959" type="x-p"/> To the one who loves us and released us from our sins by his blood

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:6
verses.text: and made us a kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him <transChange type="added">be</transChange> the glory and the power <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>. Amen.  <div eID="gen27959" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12087"/><lg sID="gen27960"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12087"/>Behold, he is coming with the clouds,<l eID="gen27961" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27962"/>and every eye will see him,<l eID="gen27962" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27963"/>even every one who pierced him,<l eID="gen27963" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27964"/>and all the tribes of the earth will mourn over him.<l eID="gen27964" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen27960"/> <div sID="gen27965" type="x-p"/> Yes, amen.  <div eID="gen27965" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12088"/><div sID="gen27966" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12088"/>I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God, the one who is and the one who was and the one who is coming, the All-Powerful.  <div eID="gen27966" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12089"/><title type="x-s">John’s Vision of the Son of Man</title> <div sID="gen27967" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12089"/>I, John, your brother and co-sharer in the affliction and kingdom and steadfastness in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony about Jesus.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:10
verses.text: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a great sound like a trumpet

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:11
verses.text: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to the seven churches: to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamum and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.”  <div eID="gen27967" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12090"/><div sID="gen27968" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12090"/>And I turned to see the voice which was speaking with me, and <transChange type="added">when I</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“turned”) which is understood as temporal</note> turned, I saw seven gold lampstands,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:13
verses.text: and in the midst of the lampstands <transChange type="added">one</transChange> like a son of man, dressed in <transChange type="added">a robe</transChange> reaching to the feet and girded around his<note placement="foot">*Literally “the”; the Greek article is used here as a possessive pronoun</note> chest <transChange type="added">with</transChange> a golden belt,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:14
verses.text: and his head and hair <transChange type="added">were</transChange> white like wool, white as snow, and his eyes <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like a fiery flame,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:15
verses.text: and his feet <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like fine bronze when it has been fired in a furnace, and his voice <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like the sound of many waters,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:16
verses.text: and <transChange type="added">he</transChange> had in his right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword coming out of his mouth, and his face <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like the sun shining in its strength.  <div eID="gen27968" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12091"/><div sID="gen27969" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12091"/>And when I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person, and he placed his right hand on me, saying, “Do not be afraid! I am the first and the last,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:18
verses.text: and the one who lives, and I was dead, and behold, I am living <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>, and I hold the keys of death and of Hades.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:19
verses.text: Therefore, write <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which you saw, and <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which are, and <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which are about to take place after these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> the mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand and the seven gold lampstands—the seven stars are <transChange type="added">the</transChange> angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are <transChange type="added">the</transChange> seven churches.  <chapter eID="Rev.1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12092"/><title type="x-s">The Letter to the Church in Ephesus</title> <div sID="gen27970" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12092"/>“To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: <div eID="gen27970" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen27971" type="x-p"/> “This is what the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand says, the one who walks in the midst of the seven gold lampstands:

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:2
verses.text: ‘I know your works, and your labor and patient endurance, and that you are not able to tolerate evil, and you put to the test those who call themselves apostles and are not, and you found them <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> false.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:3
verses.text: And you have patient endurance, and have endured <transChange type="added">many things</transChange> because of my name, and have not become weary.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:4
verses.text: But I have <transChange type="added">this</transChange> against you: that you have left your first love.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:5
verses.text: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the works you did at first⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the first works”</note>. But if you do not, I am coming to you, and I will remove your lampstand from its place, unless you repent.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:6
verses.text: But you do have this: that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, <transChange type="added">things</transChange> which I also hate.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:7
verses.text: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers, I will grant to him to eat from the tree of life which is in the paradise of God.’  <div eID="gen27971" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12093"/><title type="x-s">The Letter to the Church in Smyrna</title> <div sID="gen27972" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12093"/>“And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: <div eID="gen27972" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen27973" type="x-p"/> “This is what the first and the last says, who was dead and came to life:

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:9
verses.text: ‘I know your affliction and poverty (but you are rich), and the slander of those <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who call themselves Jews⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who say themselves to be Jews”</note> and are not, but <transChange type="added">are</transChange> a synagogue of Satan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:10
verses.text: Do not be afraid of <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw <transChange type="added">some</transChange> of you into prison so that you may be tested, and you will experience affliction ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:11
verses.text: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who conquers will never be harmed by the second death.’  <div eID="gen27973" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12094"/><title type="x-s">The Letter to the Church in Pergamum</title> <div sID="gen27974" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12094"/>“And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: <div eID="gen27974" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen27975" type="x-p"/> “This is what the one who has the sharp double-edged sword says:

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:13
verses.text: ‘I know where you live, where the throne of Satan <transChange type="added">is</transChange>. And you hold fast to my name and did not deny your<note placement="foot">*Literally “the”; the Greek article is used here as a possessive pronoun</note> faith in me, even in the days of Antipas my faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan lives.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:14
verses.text: But I have a few <transChange type="added">things</transChange> against you: that you have there those who hold fast to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat food sacrificed to idols and to commit sexual immorality.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:15
verses.text: So likewise you also have those who hold fast to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:16
verses.text: Therefore repent! But if you do not, I am coming to you quickly, and I will make war with them with the sword from my mouth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:17
verses.text: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers, I will give to him <transChange type="added">some</transChange> of the hidden manna, and I will give to him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, that no one knows except the one who receives <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.’  <div eID="gen27975" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12095"/><title type="x-s">The Letter to the Church in Thyatira</title> <div sID="gen27976" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12095"/>“And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: <div eID="gen27976" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen27977" type="x-p"/> “This is what the Son of God says, the one who has his eyes like a fiery flame and his feet like fine bronze:

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:19
verses.text: ‘I know your works, and your love, and faith, and service, and patient endurance—and your last works <transChange type="added">are</transChange> greater than the first.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:20
verses.text: But I have against you that you tolerate the woman Jezebel, the one who calls herself a prophetess, and teaches and deceives my slaves to commit sexual immorality and to eat food sacrificed to idols.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:21
verses.text: And I have given her time in order to repent, and she did not want to repent from her sexual immorality.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:22
verses.text: Behold, I am throwing her into a sickbed and those who committed adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent from her deeds.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:23
verses.text: And I will kill her children with deadly disease, and all the churches will know that I am the one who searches minds and hearts, and I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:24
verses.text: But I say to you, to the rest <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> in Thyatira, all those who do not hold this teaching, who have not known the deep <transChange type="added">things</transChange> of Satan, as they say, I do not put upon you any other burden.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:25
verses.text: Nevertheless, hold fast to what you have until I come.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:26
verses.text: And the one who conquers and who keeps my works until the end, I will give him authority over the nations,

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:27
verses.text: and “he will shepherd them with an iron rod; he will break <transChange type="added">them</transChange> in pieces like jars made of clay,”<note placement="foot">A quotation from <reference osisRef="Ps.2.9">Ps 2:9</reference></note>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:28
verses.text: as I also have received from my Father, and I will give him the morning star.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:29
verses.text: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’  <chapter eID="Rev.2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12096"/><title type="x-s">The Letter to the Church in Sardis</title> <div sID="gen27978" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12096"/>“And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: <div eID="gen27978" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen27979" type="x-p"/> “This is what the one who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars says: ‘I know your works, that you have a name that you are alive, and you are dead.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:2
verses.text: Be on the alert and strengthen the remaining <transChange type="added">things</transChange> that are about to die, for I have not found your works completed before my God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:3
verses.text: Therefore remember how you have received and heard, and observe <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, and repent. If therefore you are not on the alert, I will come like a thief, and you will never know <transChange type="added">at</transChange> what hour I will come against you.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:4
verses.text: But you have a few <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “names”</note> in Sardis who have not defiled their clothing, and they will walk with me in white, because they are worthy.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:5
verses.text: The one who conquers in this way will be dressed in white clothing, and I will never erase his name from the book of life, and I will declare his name before my Father and before his angels.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:6
verses.text: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’  <div eID="gen27979" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12097"/><title type="x-s">The Letter to the Church in Philadelphia</title> <div sID="gen27980" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12097"/>“And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: <div eID="gen27980" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen27981" type="x-p"/> “This is what the holy one, the true one, the one who has the key of David, the one who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one can open, says:

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:8
verses.text: ‘I know your works (behold, I have put before you an opened door that no one is able to shut<note placement="foot">*Literally “to shut it,” but the direct object is not translated here in keeping with English style</note>) that you have a little strength, and have kept my word, and did not deny my name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:9
verses.text: Behold, I am causing <transChange type="added">those</transChange> of the synagogue of Satan, the ones who call themselves Jews and are not, but are lying—behold, I will make them <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞come⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “that they will come”</note> and kneel down before your feet and acknowledge that I have loved you.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:10
verses.text: Because you have kept the word of my patient endurance, I also will keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole inhabited world, to put to the test those who live on the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:11
verses.text: I am coming quickly! Hold fast to what you have, so that no one may take away your crown.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:12
verses.text: The one who conquers, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will never go outside again, and I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem that comes down from heaven from my God, and my new name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:13
verses.text: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’  <div eID="gen27981" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12098"/><title type="x-s">The Letter to the Church in Laodicea</title> <div sID="gen27982" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12098"/>“And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: <div eID="gen27982" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen27983" type="x-p"/> “This is what the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the originator<note placement="foot">Or “the ruler”; or “the beginning”; or “the source”</note> of God’s creation, says:

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:15
verses.text: ‘I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. Would that you were cold or hot!

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:16
verses.text: Thus, because you are lukewarm and neither hot nor cold, I am about to vomit you out of my mouth!

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:17
verses.text: Because you are saying, “I am rich, and have become rich, and I have need of nothing,” and you do not know that you are wretched and pitiable and poor and blind and naked,

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:18
verses.text: I advise you to buy from me gold refined by fire, in order that you may become rich, and white clothing, in order that you may be clothed and the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed, and eye salve to smear on your eyes, in order that you may see.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:19
verses.text: As many as I love, I reprove and discipline. Be zealous, therefore, and repent!

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:20
verses.text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock! If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, indeed I will come in to him and dine with him, and he with me.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:21
verses.text: The one who conquers, I will grant to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also have conquered and have sat down with my Father on his throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:22
verses.text: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’ ”  <chapter eID="Rev.3"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12099"/><title type="x-s">The Heavenly Throne</title> <div sID="gen27984" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12099"/>After these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> I looked, and behold, an open door in heaven, and the former voice that I had heard like a trumpet speaking with me was saying, “Come up here and I will show you <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which must take place after these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:2
verses.text: Immediately I was in the Spirit, and behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one was seated on the throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:3
verses.text: And the one seated <transChange type="added">was</transChange> similar in appearance to jasper and carnelian stone, and a rainbow <transChange type="added">was</transChange> around the throne similar in appearance to emerald.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:4
verses.text: And around the throne <transChange type="added">were</transChange> twenty-four thrones, and seated on the thrones <transChange type="added">were</transChange> twenty-four elders dressed in white clothing, and on their heads <transChange type="added">were</transChange> gold crowns.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:5
verses.text: And from the throne came out lightnings and sounds and thunders, and seven torches of fire <transChange type="added">were</transChange> burning before the throne, which are the seven spirits of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:6
verses.text: And before the throne <transChange type="added">was something</transChange> like a sea of glass, like crystal, and in the midst of the throne and around the throne <transChange type="added">were</transChange> four living creatures full of eyes in front and in back.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:7
verses.text: And the first living creature <transChange type="added">was</transChange> similar to a lion, and the second living creature <transChange type="added">was</transChange> similar to an ox, and the third living creature had a face like a man’s, and the fourth living creature <transChange type="added">was</transChange> similar to an eagle flying.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:8
verses.text: And the four living creatures, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞each one⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “one by one”</note> of them, had six wings apiece, full of eyes around and inside, and they do not have rest day and night, saying, <div eID="gen27984" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27985"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27986"/>“Holy, holy, holy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the Lord God All-Powerful,<note placement="foot">A quotation from (or an allusion to) <reference osisRef="Isa.6.3">Isa 6:3</reference></note><l eID="gen27986" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27987"/>the one who was and the one who is and the one who is coming!” <l eID="gen27987" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen27985"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12100"/><div sID="gen27988" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12100"/>And whenever the living creatures give glory and honor and thanks to the one who is seated on the throne, the one who lives <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>,

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:10
verses.text: the twenty-four elders fall down before the one who is seated on the throne and worship the one who lives <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>, and put down their crowns before the throne, saying,  <div eID="gen27988" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12101"/><lg sID="gen27989"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12101"/>“You are worthy, our Lord and God,<l eID="gen27990" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27991"/>to receive glory and honor and power,<l eID="gen27991" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27992"/>because you have created all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>,<l eID="gen27992" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27993"/>and because of your will they existed and were created.” <l eID="gen27993" level="2"/><lg eID="gen27989"/> <chapter eID="Rev.4"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12102"/><title type="x-s">The Scroll with Seven Seals and the Lamb</title> <div sID="gen27994" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12102"/>And I saw in the right hand of the one who is seated on the throne a scroll, written inside and on the back, sealed up with seven seals.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:2
verses.text: And I saw a powerful angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> worthy to open the scroll and to break its seals?”

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:3
verses.text: And no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or to look into it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:4
verses.text: And I began to weep loudly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to look into it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:5
verses.text: And one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! Behold, the lion of the tribe of Judah, the root of David, has conquered, so that he can open the scroll and its seven seals.  <div eID="gen27994" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12103"/><div sID="gen27995" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12103"/>And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders a Lamb standing as though slaughtered, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent into all the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:7
verses.text: And he came and took <transChange type="added">the scroll</transChange><note placement="foot">A very few less important manuscripts supply the words “the scroll” here; in Greek the direct object (“the scroll”) is frequently understood anyway and must be supplied in the English translation</note> from the right hand of the one who was seated on the throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:8
verses.text: And when he took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one of whom had a harp and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:9
verses.text: And they were singing a new song, saying, <div eID="gen27995" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27996"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27997"/>“You are worthy to take the scroll<l eID="gen27997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen27998"/>and to open its seals,<l eID="gen27998" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27999"/>because you were slaughtered,<l eID="gen27999" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28000"/>and bought <transChange type="added">people</transChange> for God by your blood<l eID="gen28000" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28001"/>from every tribe and language and people and nation, <l eID="gen28001" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12104"/><l level="1" sID="gen28002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12104"/>and made them a kingdom and priests to our God,<l eID="gen28002" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28003"/>and they will reign on the earth.” <l eID="gen28003" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen27996"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12105"/><div sID="gen28004" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12105"/>And I looked, and I heard the voice of many angels around the throne and of the living creatures and of the elders, and their number was ten thousand times ten thousand and thousands times thousands,

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:12
verses.text: saying with a loud voice, <div eID="gen28004" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28005"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28006"/>“Worthy is the Lamb who was slaughtered<l eID="gen28006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28007"/>to receive power and riches<l eID="gen28007" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28008"/>and wisdom and strength<l eID="gen28008" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28009"/>and honor and glory and praise!” <l eID="gen28009" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen28005"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12106"/><div sID="gen28010" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12106"/>And I heard every creature that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea and everything in them saying, <div eID="gen28010" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28011"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28012"/>“To the one who is seated on the throne and to the Lamb<l eID="gen28012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28013"/><transChange type="added">be</transChange> praise and honor and glory and power<note placement="foot">Or “sovereignty”</note><l eID="gen28013" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28014"/><milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>.” <l eID="gen28014" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen28011"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12107"/><div sID="gen28015" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12107"/>And the four living creatures were saying, “Amen!” and the elders fell down and worshiped.  <chapter eID="Rev.5"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12108"/><title type="x-s">The Opening of the First Six Seals</title> <div sID="gen28016" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12108"/>And I watched when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying like the sound of thunder, “Come!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:2
verses.text: And I looked, and behold, a white horse, and the one seated on it had a bow, and a crown was given to him, and he went out conquering and in order that he might conquer.  <div eID="gen28016" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12109"/><div sID="gen28017" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12109"/>And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:4
verses.text: And another horse came out, fiery red, and it was granted to the one seated on it to take peace from the earth, and that they would slaughter one another, and a large sword was given to him.  <div eID="gen28017" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12110"/><div sID="gen28018" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12110"/>And when he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come!” And I looked, and behold, a black horse, and the one seated on it had a balance scale in his hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:6
verses.text: And I heard <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, “A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not damage the olive oil and the wine!”  <div eID="gen28018" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12111"/><div sID="gen28019" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12111"/>And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard a voice from the fourth living creature saying, “Come!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:8
verses.text: And I looked, and behold, a pale green horse, and the one seated on it <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞was named⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “name to him”</note> Death, and Hades followed after him. And authority was granted to them over a fourth of the earth, to kill by the sword and by famine and by pestilence and by the wild beasts of the earth.  <div eID="gen28019" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12112"/><div sID="gen28020" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12112"/>And when he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slaughtered because of the word of God and because of the testimony which they had,

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:10
verses.text: and they cried out with a loud voice, saying, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞How long⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “until when”</note>, holy and true Lord, will you not judge and avenge our blood from those who live on the earth?”

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:11
verses.text: And to each one of them a white robe was given, and it was said to them that they should rest yet a short time, until <transChange type="added">the number of</transChange> their fellow slaves and their brothers who were about to be killed as they <transChange type="added">had been</transChange> were completed also.  <div eID="gen28020" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12113"/><div sID="gen28021" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12113"/>And I watched when he opened the sixth seal, and a great earthquake took place, and the sun became black like sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became like blood,

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:13
verses.text: and the stars of heaven<note placement="foot">Or “of the sky”</note> fell to the earth like a fig tree throws down its unripe figs when<note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“shaken”) which is understood as temporal</note> shaken by a great wind.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:14
verses.text: And the sky was split apart like a scroll that is rolled up, and every mountain and island were moved from their place.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:15
verses.text: And the kings of the earth, and the most important people, and the military leaders, and the rich, and the powerful, and every slave and free person hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains,

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:16
verses.text: And they said to the mountains and to the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of the one who is seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:17
verses.text: because the great day of their wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”  <chapter eID="Rev.6"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12114"/><title type="x-s">The Sealing of the 144,000</title> <div sID="gen28022" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12114"/>After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth, so that no wind could blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:2
verses.text: And I saw another angel ascending <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the rising of the sun”</note>, holding the seal of the living God, and he cried out with a loud voice to the four angels <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who were given permission⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to whom was granted to them”</note> to damage the earth and the sea,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:3
verses.text: saying, “Do not damage the earth or the sea or the trees until we have sealed the slaves of our God on their foreheads.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:4
verses.text: And I heard the number of the ones who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel:  <div eID="gen28022" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12115"/><div sID="gen28023" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12115"/>from the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand sealed, <div eID="gen28023" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen28024" type="x-p"/> from the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand, <div eID="gen28024" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen28025" type="x-p"/> from the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand,  <div eID="gen28025" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12116"/><div sID="gen28026" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12116"/>from the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand, <div eID="gen28026" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen28027" type="x-p"/> from the tribe of Naphtali, twelve thousand, <div eID="gen28027" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen28028" type="x-p"/> from the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand,  <div eID="gen28028" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12117"/><div sID="gen28029" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12117"/>from the tribe of Simeon,<note placement="foot">Or “Symeon,” an alternate spelling of the Greek form of the name</note> twelve thousand, <div eID="gen28029" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen28030" type="x-p"/> from the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand, <div eID="gen28030" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen28031" type="x-p"/> from the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand,  <div eID="gen28031" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12118"/><div sID="gen28032" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12118"/>from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand, <div eID="gen28032" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen28033" type="x-p"/> from the tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand, <div eID="gen28033" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen28034" type="x-p"/> from the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand were sealed.  <div eID="gen28034" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12119"/><title type="x-s">The Great Crowd before the Throne</title> <div sID="gen28035" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12119"/>After these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> I looked, and behold, a great crowd that no one was able to number, from every nation and tribe and people and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> white robes and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> palm branches in their hands.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:10
verses.text: And they were crying out with a loud voice, saying, <div eID="gen28035" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28036"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28037"/>“Salvation to our God<l eID="gen28037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28038"/>who is seated on the throne,<l eID="gen28038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28039"/>and to the Lamb!” <l eID="gen28039" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28036"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12120"/><div sID="gen28040" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12120"/>And all the angels stood around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and they fell down on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:12
verses.text: saying, <div eID="gen28040" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28041"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28042"/>“Amen! Praise and glory,<l eID="gen28042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28043"/>and wisdom and thanksgiving,<l eID="gen28043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28044"/>and honor and power and strength<l eID="gen28044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28045"/><transChange type="added">be</transChange> to our God <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>. Amen!” <l eID="gen28045" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28041"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12121"/><div sID="gen28046" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12121"/>And one of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are dressed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> the white robes—who are <transChange type="added">they</transChange>, and from where have they come?”

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:14
verses.text: And I said to him, “My lord, you know.” And he said to me, <div eID="gen28046" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28047"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28048"/>“These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation,<l eID="gen28048" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28049"/>and have washed their robes<l eID="gen28049" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28050"/>and made them white in the blood of the Lamb. <l eID="gen28050" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12122"/><l level="1" sID="gen28051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12122"/>Because of this, they are before the throne of God,<l eID="gen28051" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28052"/>and they serve<note placement="foot">Or “worship”</note> him day and night in his temple,<l eID="gen28052" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28053"/>and the one who is seated on the throne <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞will shelter⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “will take up residence over”</note> them. <l eID="gen28053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:16
