verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12123"/><l level="1" sID="gen28054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12123"/>They will not be hungry <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer or be thirsty <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer,<l eID="gen28054" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28055"/>nor will the sun ever beat down on them, nor any heat,<note placement="foot">An allusion to <reference osisRef="Isa.49.10">Isa 49:10</reference></note> <l eID="gen28055" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12124"/><l level="1" sID="gen28056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12124"/>because the Lamb <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> in the midst of the throne will shepherd them<l eID="gen28056" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28057"/>and will lead them to springs of living waters,<l eID="gen28057" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28058"/>and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”<note placement="foot">An allusion to <reference osisRef="Isa.25.8">Isa 25:8</reference></note> <l eID="gen28058" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28047"/> <chapter eID="Rev.7"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12125"/><title type="x-s">The Opening of the Seventh Seal</title> <div sID="gen28059" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12125"/>And when he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven <transChange type="added">for</transChange> about half an hour.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:2
verses.text: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:3
verses.text: And another angel who had a golden censer came and stood at the altar, and a large amount of incense was given to him, in order that he could offer the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> before the throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:4
verses.text: And the smoke of the incense went up before God with the prayers of the saints from the hand of the angel.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:5
verses.text: And the angel took the censer and filled it with the fire from the altar and threw <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to the earth, and there were thunders and sounds and lightnings and an earthquake.  <div eID="gen28059" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12126"/><title type="x-s">The Blowing of the Trumpets</title> <div sID="gen28060" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12126"/>And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves in order to blow them.  <div eID="gen28060" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12127"/><div sID="gen28061" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12127"/>And the first blew the trumpet, and there was hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was thrown to the earth, and a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.  <div eID="gen28061" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12128"/><div sID="gen28062" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12128"/>And the second angel blew the trumpet, and <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood,

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:9
verses.text: and a third of the creatures in the sea—the ones which had life—died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.  <div eID="gen28062" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12129"/><div sID="gen28063" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12129"/>And the third angel blew the trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:11
verses.text: And the name of the star was called Wormwood, and a third of the waters became wormwood, and many people died from the waters because they were made bitter.  <div eID="gen28063" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12130"/><div sID="gen28064" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12130"/>And the fourth angel blew the trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, and a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them were darkened, and the day did not shine <transChange type="added">with respect to</transChange> a third of it, and the night likewise.  <div eID="gen28064" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12131"/><div sID="gen28065" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12131"/>And I looked, and I heard one eagle flying <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞directly overhead⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “in midheaven,” i.e., “at the zenith”</note>, saying with a loud voice, “Woe, woe, woe to those who live on the earth, from the remaining sounds of the trumpets of the three angels who are about to blow the trumpet!”  <chapter eID="Rev.8"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12132"/><title type="x-s">Tormenting Locusts from the Abyss</title> <div sID="gen28066" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12132"/>And the fifth angel blew the trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to the earth, and the key of the shaft of the abyss was given to him.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:2
verses.text: And he opened the shaft of the abyss, and smoke went up from the shaft like smoke from a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke from the shaft.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:3
verses.text: And out of the smoke locusts came to the earth, and power was given to them like the scorpions of the earth have power.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:4
verses.text: And it was told to them that they should not damage the grass of the earth or any green <transChange type="added">plant</transChange> or any tree, except those people who do not have the seal of God on their<note placement="foot">*Literally “the”; the Greek article is used here as a possessive pronoun</note> foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:5
verses.text: And it was granted to them that they should not kill them, but that they would be tormented five months, and their torment <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the torment of a scorpion when it stings a person.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:6
verses.text: And in those days people will seek death and will never find it, and they will long to die, and death will flee from them.  <div eID="gen28066" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12133"/><div sID="gen28067" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12133"/>And the appearance of the locusts <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like horses prepared for battle, and on their heads <transChange type="added">were something</transChange> like crowns similar in appearance to gold, and their faces <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like men’s faces,

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:8
verses.text: and they had hair like the hair of women, and their teeth were like <transChange type="added">the teeth</transChange> of lions,

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:9
verses.text: and they had breastplates like iron breastplates, and the sound of their wings <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like the sound of many <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞horse-drawn chariots⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “chariots of horses”</note> running into battle.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:10
verses.text: And they have tails similar in appearance to scorpions, and stings, and their power to injure people <transChange type="added">for</transChange> five months <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in their tails.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:11
verses.text: They have <transChange type="added">as</transChange> king over them the angel of the abyss, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose name⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the name to him”</note> in Hebrew <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Abaddon, and in Greek he has the name Apollyon.  <div eID="gen28067" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12134"/><div sID="gen28068" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12134"/>The first woe has passed. Behold, two woes are still coming after these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>.  <div eID="gen28068" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12135"/><title type="x-s">A Third of Humanity Killed by Plagues</title> <div sID="gen28069" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12135"/>And the sixth angel blew the trumpet, and I heard one voice from the horns<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “four horns”</note> of the golden altar <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> before God

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:14
verses.text: saying to the sixth angel, the one who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who have been bound at the great river Euphrates!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:15
verses.text: And the four angels who had been prepared for the hour and day and month and year were released, in order that they should kill a third of humanity.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:16
verses.text: And the number of the troops of the cavalry <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞two hundred million⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “twenty thousands of ten thousands”</note>; I heard the number of them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:17
verses.text: And in this way I saw the horses in the vision, and those seated on them, who had fiery <transChange type="added">red</transChange> and hyacinth-colored and sulphurous <transChange type="added">yellow</transChange> breastplates, and the heads of the horses <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths came fire and smoke and sulphur.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:18
verses.text: By these three plagues a third of humanity was killed—by the fire and the smoke and the sulphur that came out of their mouths.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:19
verses.text: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails, for their tails <transChange type="added">are</transChange> similar in appearance to snakes, having heads, and with them they cause injury.<note placement="foot">Literally “they injure”</note>  <div eID="gen28069" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12136"/><div sID="gen28070" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12136"/>And the rest of humanity who were not killed by these plagues did not repent of the works of their hands, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞in order not to worship⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “so that they did not worship”</note> the demons and the gold and silver and bronze and stone and wooden idols, which are able neither to see nor to hear nor to walk,

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:21
verses.text: and they did not repent of their murders or of their magic spells or of their sexual immorality or of their thefts.  <chapter eID="Rev.9"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12137"/><title type="x-s">The Angel and the Little Scroll</title> <div sID="gen28071" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12137"/>And I saw another powerful angel descending from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, and a rainbow over his head, and his face <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like the sun, and his feet <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like pillars of fire,<note placement="foot">Or “like fiery pillars”</note>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:2
verses.text: and holding in his hand a little scroll that was opened. And he put his right foot on the sea and his<note placement="foot">*Literally “the”; the Greek article is used here as a possessive pronoun</note> left on the land.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:3
verses.text: And he cried out with a loud voice like a lion roars, and when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded<note placement="foot">Or “spoke”</note> their own voices.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:4
verses.text: And when the seven thunders spoke,<note placement="foot">Or “sounded”</note> I was about to write, and I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which the seven thunders spoke, and do not write them!”  <div eID="gen28071" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12138"/><div sID="gen28072" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12138"/>And the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:6
verses.text: and swore by the one who lives <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>, who created heaven and the <transChange type="added">things</transChange> in it, and the earth and the <transChange type="added">things</transChange> in it, and the sea and the <transChange type="added">things</transChange> in it, “There will be no more delay!

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:7
verses.text: But in the days of the sound of the seventh angel, whenever he is about to blow the trumpet, then<note placement="foot">Literally “and”</note> the mystery of God is completed, as he announced to his own slaves the prophets.”  <div eID="gen28072" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12139"/><div sID="gen28073" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12139"/>And the voice that I had heard from heaven <transChange type="added">was</transChange> speaking with me again and saying, “Go, take the opened scroll in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:9
verses.text: And I went to the angel and told him to give me the little scroll, and he said to me, “Take and eat it up, and it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:10
verses.text: And I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it up, and it was sweet as honey in my mouth, and when I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:11
verses.text: And they said to me, “It is necessary for you to prophesy again about many peoples and nations and languages and kings.”  <chapter eID="Rev.10"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12140"/><title type="x-s">The Two Witnesses</title> <div sID="gen28074" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12140"/>And a measuring rod similar in appearance to a staff was given to me, saying, “Get up and measure the temple of God and the altar and those who worship in it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:2
verses.text: And leave out the courtyard outside of the temple, and do not measure it, because it has been given to the Gentiles, and they will trample the holy city <transChange type="added">for</transChange> forty two months.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:3
verses.text: And I will grant <transChange type="added">authority</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy <transChange type="added">for one</transChange> thousand two hundred sixty days, dressed in sackcloth.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:4
verses.text: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:5
verses.text: And if anyone wants to harm them, fire comes out of their mouth and consumes their enemies. And if anyone wants to harm them, in this way he must be killed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:6
verses.text: These have the authority to shut the sky, so that <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞it does not rain⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “it does not rain rain”; the redundancy is removed in the translation</note> during the days of their prophecy. And they have authority over the waters, to turn them to blood, and to strike the earth with every plague as often as they wish.  <div eID="gen28074" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12141"/><div sID="gen28075" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12141"/>And when they have completed their testimony, the beast that comes up from the abyss will make war with them and will conquer them and will kill them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:8
verses.text: And their dead bodies <transChange type="added">will lie</transChange> in the street of the great city which is called symbolically Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:9
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">those</transChange> from peoples and tribes and languages and nations will see their dead bodies three and a half days, and they will not allow their dead bodies to be placed in a tomb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:10
verses.text: And those who live on the earth will rejoice over them, and will celebrate and will send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who live on the earth.  <div eID="gen28075" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12142"/><div sID="gen28076" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12142"/>And after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell on those who saw them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:12
verses.text: And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here,” and they went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies watched them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:13
verses.text: And at that hour a great earthquake took place, and a tenth of the city collapsed, and seven thousand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞people⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “names of men”</note> were killed by the earthquake, and the rest became terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:14
verses.text: The second woe has passed. Behold, the third woe is coming quickly!  <div eID="gen28076" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12143"/><title type="x-s">The Blowing of the Seventh Trumpet</title> <div sID="gen28077" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12143"/>And the seventh angel blew the trumpet, and there was a loud voice in heaven saying, <div eID="gen28077" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28078"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28079"/>“The kingdom of the world has become <transChange type="added">the kingdom</transChange> of our Lord<l eID="gen28079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28080"/>and of his Christ,<l eID="gen28080" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28081"/>and he will reign <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>.” <l eID="gen28081" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28078"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12144"/><div sID="gen28082" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12144"/>And the twenty-four elders <transChange type="added">who are</transChange> seated on their thrones before God fell down on their faces and worshiped God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:17
verses.text: saying, <div eID="gen28082" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28083"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28084"/>“We give thanks to you, Lord God All-Powerful,<l eID="gen28084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28085"/>the one who is and the one who was,<l eID="gen28085" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28086"/>because you have taken your great power<l eID="gen28086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28087"/>and have begun to reign. <l eID="gen28087" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12145"/><l level="1" sID="gen28088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12145"/>And the nations were angry,<l eID="gen28088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28089"/>and your wrath has come,<l eID="gen28089" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28090"/>and the time for the dead to be judged,<l eID="gen28090" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28091"/>and to give their<note placement="foot">*Literally “the”; the Greek article is used here as a possessive pronoun</note> reward to your slaves the prophets<l eID="gen28091" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28092"/>and to the saints and to the ones who fear your name,<l eID="gen28092" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28093"/>the small and the great,<l eID="gen28093" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28094"/>and to destroy those who destroy the earth.” <l eID="gen28094" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28083"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12146"/><div sID="gen28095" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12146"/>And the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant appeared in his temple, and there were lightnings and sounds and thunders and an earthquake and large hail.<note placement="foot">Or “a great hailstorm”</note>  <chapter eID="Rev.11"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12147"/><title type="x-s">The Woman and Her Son Versus the Dragon</title> <div sID="gen28096" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12147"/>And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun and <transChange type="added">with</transChange> the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars,

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:2
verses.text: and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞who was pregnant⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “who was having in the belly”</note> and was crying out because she<note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“was having birth pains”) which is understood as causal</note> was having birth pains, and was in torment to give birth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:3
verses.text: And another sign appeared in heaven, and behold, a great fiery red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads <transChange type="added">were</transChange> seven royal headbands.<note placement="foot">Or “diadem crowns”</note>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:4
verses.text: And his tail swept away a third of the stars from heaven and threw them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, in order that whenever she gave birth to her child he could devour <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:5
verses.text: And she gave birth to a son, a male <transChange type="added">child</transChange>, who is going to shepherd all the nations with an iron rod,<note placement="foot">An allusion to <reference osisRef="Ps.2.9">Ps 2:9</reference></note> and her child was snatched away to God and to his throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:6
verses.text: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she had a place prepared there by God, so that they could feed her there <transChange type="added">for one</transChange> thousand two hundred sixty days.  <div eID="gen28096" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12148"/><title type="x-s">Satan Thrown Down from Heaven to Earth</title> <div sID="gen28097" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12148"/>And there was war in heaven; Michael and his angels <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fought against⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “made war with”</note> the dragon, and the dragon and his angels <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fought back⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “made war”</note>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:8
verses.text: And they did not prevail, nor was a place found for them <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer in heaven.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:9
verses.text: And the great dragon was thrown down, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.  <div eID="gen28097" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12149"/><div sID="gen28098" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12149"/>And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying, <div eID="gen28098" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28099"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28100"/>“Now the salvation and the power<l eID="gen28100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28101"/>and the kingdom of our God<l eID="gen28101" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28102"/>and the authority of his Christ have come,<l eID="gen28102" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28103"/>because the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down,<l eID="gen28103" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28104"/>the one who accuses them before our God day and night. <l eID="gen28104" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12150"/><l level="1" sID="gen28105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12150"/>And they conquered him by the blood of the Lamb<l eID="gen28105" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28106"/>and by the word of their testimony,<l eID="gen28106" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28107"/>and they did not love their lives until death. <l eID="gen28107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12151"/><l level="1" sID="gen28108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12151"/>Because of this, rejoice, you heavens,<l eID="gen28108" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28109"/>and those who live in them!<l eID="gen28109" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28110"/>Woe <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the earth and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> the sea,<l eID="gen28110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28111"/>because the devil has come down to you,<l eID="gen28111" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28112"/>having great anger,<l eID="gen28112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28113"/><transChange type="added">because he</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “because” is supplied as a component of the participle (“knows”) which is understood as causal</note> knows that he has little time!” <l eID="gen28113" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen28099"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12152"/><div sID="gen28114" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12152"/>And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown down to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male <transChange type="added">child</transChange>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:14
verses.text: And the two wings of a great eagle were given to the woman, in order that she could fly into the wilderness, to her place where she is fed there <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a time, and times, and half a time, from the presence of the serpent.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:15
verses.text: And from his mouth the serpent spouted water like a river after the woman, in order that he could make her swept away by a river.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:16
verses.text: And the earth came to the aid of the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river that the dragon had spouted out of his mouth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:17
verses.text: And the dragon was angry at the woman, and went away to <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fight against⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to make war with”</note> the rest of her children, those who keep the commandments of God and who hold to the testimony about Jesus. And he stood on the sand of the sea.  <chapter eID="Rev.12"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12153"/><title type="x-s">The First Beast from the Sea</title> <div sID="gen28115" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12153"/>And I saw coming up out of the sea a beast that had ten horns and seven heads, and on its horns ten royal headbands,<note placement="foot">Or “ten diadem crowns”</note> and on its heads a blasphemous name.<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts read “blasphemous names”</note>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:2
verses.text: And the beast that I saw was similar to a leopard, and its feet <transChange type="added">were</transChange> like a bear’s, and its mouth <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like the mouth of a lion, and the dragon gave it his power and his throne and great authority.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:3
verses.text: And one of its heads <transChange type="added">appeared</transChange> as though slaughtered to death, and its <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞fatal wound⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “wound of death”</note> had been healed. And the whole earth was astonished <transChange type="added">and followed</transChange> after the beast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:4
verses.text: And they worshiped the dragon because he had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the beast, and who is able to make war with him?  <div eID="gen28115" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12154"/><div sID="gen28116" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12154"/>And a mouth was given to him speaking great <transChange type="added">things</transChange> and blasphemies, and authority to act was given to him <transChange type="added">for</transChange> forty-two months.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:6
verses.text: And he opened his mouth for blasphemies toward God, to blaspheme his name and his dwelling, those who live in heaven.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:7
verses.text: And it was given to him to make war with the saints and to conquer them. And authority was given to him over every tribe and people and language and nation.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:8
verses.text: And all those who live on the earth will worship him, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞everyone whose name is not written⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of whom his name is not written”</note> from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who was slaughtered.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:9
verses.text: If anyone has an ear, let him hear!  <div eID="gen28116" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12155"/><lg sID="gen28117"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12155"/>If anyone <transChange type="added">is going</transChange> into captivity, into captivity he goes.<l eID="gen28118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28119"/>If anyone <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to be killed by the sword, by the sword he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> to be killed.<l eID="gen28119" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28117"/> <div sID="gen28120" type="x-p"/> Here is the patient endurance and the faith of the saints.  <div eID="gen28120" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12156"/><title type="x-s">The Second Beast from the Earth</title> <div sID="gen28121" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12156"/>And I saw another beast coming up from the earth, and he had two horns like a lamb, and he was speaking like a dragon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:12
verses.text: And he exercises all the authority of the first beast on behalf of him, and he causes the earth and those who live in it to worship the first beast <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose fatal wound had been healed⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of whom the wound of his death had been healed”</note>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:13
verses.text: And he performs great signs, so that he even causes fire from heaven to come down to the earth before people.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:14
verses.text: And he deceives those who live on the earth because of the signs that it has been granted to him to perform on behalf of the beast, telling those who live on the earth to make an image to the beast who has the wound of the sword and <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> lived.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:15
verses.text: And it was given to him to put breath into the image of the beast, in order that the image of the beast both spoke and caused that all those, unless they worshiped the image of the beast, should be killed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:16
verses.text: And he causes all <transChange type="added">people</transChange>, the small and the great, and the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, that they give them a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:17
verses.text: and that no one was able to buy or to sell except the one who had the mark—the name of the beast or the number of his name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:18
verses.text: Here is wisdom: the one who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is man’s number,<note placement="foot">Or “it is the number of a man”</note> and his number is six hundred sixty-six.<note placement="foot">A few significant manuscripts read “six hundred sixteen”</note>  <chapter eID="Rev.13"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12157"/><title type="x-s">The Lamb and the 144,000 on Mount Zion</title> <div sID="gen28122" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12157"/>And I looked, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him one hundred forty-four thousand who had his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:2
verses.text: And I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of loud thunder, and the sound that I heard <transChange type="added">was</transChange> like harpists playing on their harps.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:3
verses.text: And they were singing <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders, and no one was able to learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand who had been bought from the earth.  <div eID="gen28122" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12158"/><div sID="gen28123" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12158"/>These are those who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the ones who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were bought from humanity <transChange type="added">as</transChange> first fruits to God and to the Lamb,

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:5
verses.text: and in their mouth a lie was not found; they are blameless.  <div eID="gen28123" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12159"/><title type="x-s">The Three Angels and Their Messages</title> <div sID="gen28124" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12159"/>And I saw another angel flying <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞directly overhead⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally, “in midheaven”</note>, having an eternal gospel to proclaim to those who reside on the earth, and to every nation and tribe and language and people,

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:7
verses.text: saying with a loud voice, “Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come, and worship the one who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and the springs of water!”  <div eID="gen28124" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12160"/><div sID="gen28125" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12160"/>And another second angel followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Babylon the great, who caused all the nations to drink from the wine of the passion of her sexual immorality.”  <div eID="gen28125" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12161"/><div sID="gen28126" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12161"/>And another third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:10
verses.text: he himself also will drink of the wine of the anger of God that has been mixed full strength in the cup of his wrath, and will be tortured with fire and sulphur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:11
verses.text: And the smoke of their torture went up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>, and those who worshiped the beast and his image did not have rest day and night, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞along with anyone who received⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “and if anyone received”</note> the mark of his name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:12
verses.text: Here is the patient endurance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith in Jesus.  <div eID="gen28126" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12162"/><div sID="gen28127" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12162"/>And I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write: <div eID="gen28127" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28128"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28129"/>‘Blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the dead who die in the Lord from now on!’ ”<l eID="gen28129" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28128"/> <div sID="gen28130" type="x-p"/> “Yes,” says the Spirit, “in order that they may rest from their labors, for their deeds follow after them.”  <div eID="gen28130" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12163"/><title type="x-s">The Earth is Harvested</title> <div sID="gen28131" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12163"/>And I looked, and behold, a white cloud, and on the cloud was seated <transChange type="added">one</transChange> like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:15
verses.text: And another angel came out of the temple, crying out with a loud voice to the one seated on the cloud, “Send out your sickle and reap, because the hour to reap has come, because the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:16
verses.text: And the one seated on the cloud swung his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.  <div eID="gen28131" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12164"/><div sID="gen28132" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12164"/>And another angel came out of the temple <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> in heaven; he also had a sharp sickle.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:18
verses.text: And another angel who had authority over the fire <transChange type="added">went out</transChange> from the altar, and he called out with a loud voice to the one who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send out your sharp sickle and harvest the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth, because its grapes are at their prime!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:19
verses.text: And the angel swung his sickle into the earth and harvested the vine of the earth, and threw <transChange type="added">the grapes</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here the direct object is supplied from context in the English translation</note> into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:20
verses.text: And the winepress was stomped outside the city, and blood went out from the winepress up to the bridles of the horses, about one thousand six hundred stadia.<note placement="foot">That is, about 300 km (200 mi); a <hi type="italic">stade</hi> (plural <hi type="italic">stadia</hi>) was a measure of distance about 192 m (607 ft)</note>  <chapter eID="Rev.14"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12165"/><title type="x-s">Seven Angels with Seven Last Plagues</title> <div sID="gen28133" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12165"/>And I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels having seven plagues <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> the last <transChange type="added">ones</transChange>, because with them the wrath of God is completed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:2
verses.text: And I saw <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who had conquered the beast and his image and the number of his name were standing by<note placement="foot">Or “on”; or “at”; or “near”</note> the glassy sea, holding harps from God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:3
verses.text: And they were singing the song of Moses, the slave of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying: <div eID="gen28133" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28134"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28135"/>“Great and marvelous <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your works,<l eID="gen28135" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28136"/>Lord God All-Powerful;<l eID="gen28136" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28137"/>righteous and true <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your ways,<l eID="gen28137" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28138"/>King of the ages!<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “nations”</note> <l eID="gen28138" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12166"/><l level="1" sID="gen28139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12166"/>Who would never fear, Lord,<l eID="gen28139" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28140"/>and glorify your name?<l eID="gen28140" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28141"/>For only you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> holy,<l eID="gen28141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28142"/>because all the nations<note placement="foot">Or “Gentiles”; the same Greek word can be translated “nations” or “Gentiles” depending on the context</note> will come<l eID="gen28142" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28143"/>and worship before you,<l eID="gen28143" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28144"/>because your righteous deeds have been revealed.” <l eID="gen28144" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28134"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12167"/><div sID="gen28145" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12167"/>And after these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> I looked, and the temple, the tent of the testimony in heaven, was opened,

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:6
verses.text: and the seven angels who had the seven plagues came out from the temple, dressed <transChange type="added">in</transChange> clean, bright linen garments, and girded with golden belts around their<note placement="foot">*Literally “the”; the Greek article is used here as a possessive pronoun</note> chests.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:7
verses.text: And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>,

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:8
verses.text: and the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.  <chapter eID="Rev.15"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12168"/><title type="x-s">The Seven Bowls of the Wrath of God</title> <div sID="gen28146" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12168"/>And I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out on the earth the seven bowls of the wrath of God.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:2
verses.text: And the first went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and there was an evil and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped his image.  <div eID="gen28146" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12169"/><div sID="gen28147" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12169"/>And the second poured out his bowl on the sea, and it became blood, like <transChange type="added">that</transChange> of a dead person, and every living thing <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> in the sea died.  <div eID="gen28147" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12170"/><div sID="gen28148" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12170"/>And the third poured out his bowl on the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:5
verses.text: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, <div eID="gen28148" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28149"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28150"/>“You are righteous, the one who is and the one who was, the Holy One,<l eID="gen28150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28151"/>because you have judged these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <l eID="gen28151" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12171"/><l level="1" sID="gen28152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12171"/>because they have poured out the blood of the saints and prophets,<l eID="gen28152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28153"/>and you have given them blood to drink;<l eID="gen28153" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28154"/>they are deserving!” <l eID="gen28154" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28149"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12172"/><div sID="gen28155" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12172"/>And I heard the altar saying, <div eID="gen28155" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28156"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28157"/>“Yes, Lord God All-Powerful,<l eID="gen28157" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28158"/>true and righteous <transChange type="added">are</transChange> your judgments.” <l eID="gen28158" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen28156"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12173"/><div sID="gen28159" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12173"/>And the fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was granted to it to burn up people with fire.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:9
verses.text: And people were burned up <transChange type="added">by the</transChange> great heat, and they blasphemed the name of God who has the authority over these plagues, and they did not repent to give him glory.  <div eID="gen28159" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12174"/><div sID="gen28160" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12174"/>And the fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom became darkened, and they began chewing their tongues because of the pain.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:11
verses.text: And they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pain and because of their sores, and they did not repent of their deeds.  <div eID="gen28160" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12175"/><div sID="gen28161" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12175"/>And the sixth poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, in order that the way would be prepared for the kings from <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the east⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “the rising of the sun”</note>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:13
verses.text: And I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon and out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet three unclean spirits like frogs.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:14
verses.text: For they are the spirits of demons performing signs that go out to the kings of the whole inhabited world, to gather them for the battle of the great day of God the All-Powerful.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:15
verses.text: (Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the one who is on the alert and who keeps his clothing, so that he does not walk around naked and they see his shamefulness!)

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:16
verses.text: And he gathered them to the place called in Hebrew Armageddon.  <div eID="gen28161" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12176"/><div sID="gen28162" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12176"/>And the seventh poured out his bowl on the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:18
verses.text: And there were lightnings and sounds and thunders, and there was a great earthquake, as has not happened from the <transChange type="added">time</transChange> humanity has been on the earth—so great in this way <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the earthquake.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:19
verses.text: And the great city was <transChange type="added">split</transChange> into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. And Babylon the great was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of his furious wrath.<note placement="foot">Literally “of the anger of the wrath of him”</note>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:20
verses.text: And every island fled, and mountains were not found.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:21
verses.text: And large hailstones, weighing about a hundred pounds,<note placement="foot">Literally “weighing a talent”; a talent was 125 Roman pounds (of 12 ounces each), so this is just under 100 lbs or 43 kg</note> came down from the sky upon people, and the people blasphemed God because of the plague of hail, because the plague of it was very great.  <chapter eID="Rev.16"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12177"/><title type="x-s">The Judgment of the Great Prostitute Babylon</title> <div sID="gen28163" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12177"/>And one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come, I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who is seated on many waters,

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:2
verses.text: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and those who live on the earth became drunk with the wine of her sexual immorality.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:3
verses.text: And he carried me away into the wilderness in the Spirit,<note placement="foot">Or “in the spirit,” referring to the human spirit</note> and I saw a woman seated on a scarlet beast that was full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:4
verses.text: And the woman was dressed in purple and scarlet and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls, holding a golden cup in her hand full of detestable things and the unclean things of her sexual immorality.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:5
verses.text: And on her forehead a name <transChange type="added">was</transChange> written, a mystery: “Babylon the great, the mother of prostitutes and of the detestable things of the earth.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:6
verses.text: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the witnesses to Jesus. <div eID="gen28163" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen28164" type="x-p"/> And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞I was greatly astonished when I saw her⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “I marveled a great marvel seeing her”</note>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:7
verses.text: And the angel said to me, “Why are you astonished? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that has the seven heads and the ten horns that carries her.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:8
verses.text: The beast that you saw was, and is not, and is going to come up from the abyss, and he is going to destruction. And those who live on the earth, whose names are not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, will be astonished <transChange type="added">when they</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“see”) which is understood as temporal</note> see the beast that was, and is not, and will be present.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:9
verses.text: Here <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the mind that has wisdom: the seven heads are seven mountains <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on which the woman sits⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “where the woman is seated on them”</note> and they are seven kings.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:10
verses.text: Five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come, and whenever he comes it is necessary <transChange type="added">for</transChange> him to remain a short time.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:11
verses.text: And the beast that was, and is not, is also himself an eighth, and is of the seven, and he is going to destruction.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:12
verses.text: And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings, who have not yet received a kingdom, but they will receive authority as kings <transChange type="added">for</transChange> one hour with the beast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:13
verses.text: These have one opinion, and they will give their power and authority to the beast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:14
verses.text: These will make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will conquer them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings, and those with him <transChange type="added">are</transChange> called and chosen and faithful.”  <div eID="gen28164" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12178"/><div sID="gen28165" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12178"/>And he said to me, “The waters that you saw, where the prostitute is seated, are peoples and crowds and nations and languages.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:16
verses.text: And the ten horns that you saw and the beast, these will hate the prostitute and will make her desolate and naked, and they will eat her flesh and will burn her up with fire.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:17
verses.text: For God put into their hearts to carry out his purpose and to make <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞a unanimous decision⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to make one decision”</note> and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:18
verses.text: And the woman that you saw is the great city that has sovereignty over the kings of the earth.  <chapter eID="Rev.17"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12179"/><title type="x-s">Lament Over Babylon the Great</title> <div sID="gen28166" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12179"/>After these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> I saw another angel descending from heaven, who had great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his splendor.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:2
verses.text: And he cried out with a powerful voice, saying, <div eID="gen28166" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28167"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28168"/>“Fallen, fallen <transChange type="added">is</transChange> Babylon the great,<l eID="gen28168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28169"/>and it has become a dwelling place of demons<l eID="gen28169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28170"/>and a haunt of every unclean spirit<l eID="gen28170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28171"/>and a haunt of every unclean bird<l eID="gen28171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28172"/>and a haunt of every unclean and detested animal. <l eID="gen28172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12180"/><l level="1" sID="gen28173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12180"/>For all the nations have drunk<note placement="foot">Some of the best manuscripts read “have fallen”</note><l eID="gen28173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28174"/>from the wine of the passion of her sexual immorality,<l eID="gen28174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28175"/>and the kings of the earth have committed sexual immorality with her,<l eID="gen28175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28176"/>and the merchants of the earth have become rich<l eID="gen28176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28177"/>from the power of her sensuality.” <l eID="gen28177" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28167"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12181"/><div sID="gen28178" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12181"/>And I heard another voice from heaven saying, <div eID="gen28178" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28179"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28180"/>“Come out from her, my people,<l eID="gen28180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28181"/>so that you will not participate in her sins,<l eID="gen28181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28182"/>and so that you will not receive her plagues, <l eID="gen28182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12182"/><l level="1" sID="gen28183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12182"/>because her sins have reached up to heaven,<l eID="gen28183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28184"/>and God has remembered her crimes. <l eID="gen28184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12183"/><l level="1" sID="gen28185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12183"/>Pay back to her as she herself also paid out,<l eID="gen28185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28186"/>and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞pay back double⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “double twofold”</note> according to her deeds;<l eID="gen28186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28187"/>in the cup that she mixed, mix double for her. <l eID="gen28187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12184"/><l level="1" sID="gen28188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12184"/>As much as she glorified herself and lived in luxury,<l eID="gen28188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28189"/>give to her so much torment and mourning,<l eID="gen28189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28190"/>because in her heart she said,<l eID="gen28190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28191"/>‘I sit as a queen, and am not a widow,<l eID="gen28191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28192"/>and I will never see mourning!’ <l eID="gen28192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12185"/><l level="1" sID="gen28193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12185"/>Because of this her plagues will come in one day—<l eID="gen28193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28194"/>death and mourning and famine—<l eID="gen28194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28195"/>and she will be burned up with fire,<l eID="gen28195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28196"/>because the Lord God who passes judgment on her <transChange type="added">is</transChange> powerful!” <l eID="gen28196" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28179"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12186"/><div sID="gen28197" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12186"/>And the kings of the earth will weep and mourn over her, those who committed sexual immorality and lived sensually with her, when they see the smoke of her burning,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:10
verses.text: standing <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞far off⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from afar”</note> because of the fear of her torment, saying, <div eID="gen28197" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28198"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28199"/>“Woe, woe, the great city,<l eID="gen28199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28200"/>Babylon the powerful city,<l eID="gen28200" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28201"/>because in one hour your judgment has come!” <l eID="gen28201" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28198"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12187"/><div sID="gen28202" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12187"/>And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, because no one buys their cargo any more—

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:12
verses.text: cargo of gold and silver and precious stones and pearls and fine linen and purple cloth and silk and scarlet cloth and all kinds of scented wood and all kinds of ivory goods and all kinds of goods of precious wood and bronze and iron and marble

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:13
verses.text: and cinnamon and amomum<note placement="foot">Or “spice”; the term can refer to “spice” in general, or specifically to <hi type="italic">amomum</hi>, a spice from India</note> and incense and ointment and frankincense and wine and olive oil and fine wheat flour and wheat and domesticated animals and sheep and horses and carriages and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞slaves⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “bodies”</note> and human lives.  <div eID="gen28202" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12188"/><lg sID="gen28203"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12188"/>“And <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞the fruit your soul desires⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “your fruit of desire”</note> has departed from you,<l eID="gen28204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28205"/>and all the luxury and the splendor has perished from you,<l eID="gen28205" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28206"/>and they will never find them any more.” <l eID="gen28206" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen28203"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12189"/><div sID="gen28207" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12189"/>The merchants of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, who became rich from them, will stand <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞far off⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from afar”</note>, weeping and mourning because of the fear of her torment,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:16
verses.text: saying, <div eID="gen28207" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28208"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28209"/>“Woe, woe, the great city,<l eID="gen28209" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28210"/>dressed in fine linen and purple cloth and scarlet cloth,<l eID="gen28210" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28211"/>and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls, <l eID="gen28211" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12190"/><l level="1" sID="gen28212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12190"/>because in one hour such great wealth has been laid waste!”<l eID="gen28212" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28208"/> <div sID="gen28213" type="x-p"/> And every shipmaster and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞every seafarer⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “everyone who sails to a place”</note> and sailors and all those who labor on the sea stood <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞far off⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from afar”</note>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:18
verses.text: and began to cry out <transChange type="added">when they</transChange><note placement="foot">*Here “when” is supplied as a component of the participle (“saw”) which is understood as temporal</note> saw the smoke of her burning, saying, “Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the great city?”

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:19
verses.text: And they threw dust on their heads and were crying out, weeping and mourning, saying, <div eID="gen28213" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28214"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28215"/>“Woe, woe, the great city,<l eID="gen28215" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28216"/>in which all those who had ships on the sea<l eID="gen28216" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen28217"/>became rich from her prosperity,<l eID="gen28217" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28218"/>because in one hour she has been laid waste!” <l eID="gen28218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12191"/><l level="1" sID="gen28219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12191"/>Rejoice over her, heaven<l eID="gen28219" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28220"/>and the saints and the apostles and the prophets,<l eID="gen28220" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28221"/>because God has pronounced your judgment on her!” <l eID="gen28221" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28214"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12192"/><div sID="gen28222" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12192"/>And one powerful angel picked up a stone like a great millstone and threw <transChange type="added">it</transChange> into the sea, saying, <div eID="gen28222" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28223"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28224"/>“In this way Babylon the great city will be thrown down with violence,<l eID="gen28224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28225"/>and will never be found again! <l eID="gen28225" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12193"/><l level="1" sID="gen28226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12193"/>And the sound of harpists and musicians and flute players and trumpeters<l eID="gen28226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28227"/>will never be heard in you again!<l eID="gen28227" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28228"/>And every craftsman of every trade<l eID="gen28228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28229"/>will never be found in you again!<l eID="gen28229" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28230"/>And the sound of a mill<l eID="gen28230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28231"/>will never be heard in you again! <l eID="gen28231" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12194"/><l level="1" sID="gen28232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12194"/>And the light of a lamp<l eID="gen28232" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28233"/>will never shine in you again!<l eID="gen28233" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28234"/>And the sound of a bridegroom and bride<l eID="gen28234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28235"/>will never be heard in you again!<l eID="gen28235" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28236"/>For your merchants were the most important people of the earth,<l eID="gen28236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28237"/>because with your sorcery they deceived all the nations. <l eID="gen28237" level="2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12195"/><l level="1" sID="gen28238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12195"/>And in her was found the blood of prophets and saints<l eID="gen28238" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28239"/>and all those who had been slaughtered on the earth. <l eID="gen28239" level="2"/><lg eID="gen28223"/> <chapter eID="Rev.18"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12196"/><title type="x-s">Rejoicing in Heaven</title> <div sID="gen28240" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12196"/>After these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> I heard <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like the loud sound of a great crowd in heaven saying, <div eID="gen28240" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28241"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28242"/>“Hallelujah!<l eID="gen28242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28243"/>Salvation and glory and power belong to our God, <l eID="gen28243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12197"/><l level="2" sID="gen28244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12197"/>because his judgments <transChange type="added">are</transChange> true and righteous,<l eID="gen28244" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28245"/>because he has passed judgment on the great prostitute<l eID="gen28245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28246"/>who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality,<l eID="gen28246" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28247"/>and has avenged the blood of his slaves <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞shed by⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from”</note> her hand!” <l eID="gen28247" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28241"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12198"/><div sID="gen28248" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12198"/>And a second time they said, <div eID="gen28248" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28249"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28250"/>“Hallelujah!”<l eID="gen28250" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28249"/> <div sID="gen28251" type="x-p"/> And her smoke goes up <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:4
verses.text: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who is seated on the throne, saying, <div eID="gen28251" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28252"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28253"/>“Amen! Hallelujah!” <l eID="gen28253" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28252"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12199"/><div sID="gen28254" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12199"/>And a voice came out from the throne, saying, <div eID="gen28254" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28255"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28256"/>“Praise our God<l eID="gen28256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28257"/>all his slaves,<l eID="gen28257" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28258"/>and those who fear him,<l eID="gen28258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28259"/>the small and the great!” <l eID="gen28259" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen28255"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12200"/><title type="x-s">The Wedding Celebration of the Lamb</title> <div sID="gen28260" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12200"/>And I heard <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like the sound of a great crowd and <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like the sound of many waters and <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like the sound of powerful thunder, saying, <div eID="gen28260" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28261"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28262"/>“Hallelujah!<l eID="gen28262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28263"/>For the Lord God,<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “the Lord our God, the All-Powerful”</note> the All-Powerful, reigns! <l eID="gen28263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12201"/><l level="1" sID="gen28264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12201"/>Let us rejoice and be glad<l eID="gen28264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28265"/>and give him the glory,<l eID="gen28265" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28266"/>because the wedding celebration of the Lamb has come,<l eID="gen28266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28267"/>and his bride has prepared herself. <l eID="gen28267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12202"/><l level="1" sID="gen28268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12202"/>And it has been granted to her that she be dressed in bright, clean fine linen (for the fine linen is the righteous deeds of the saints). <l eID="gen28268" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28261"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12203"/><div sID="gen28269" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12203"/>And he said to me, “Write: Blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> those who are invited to the banquet of the wedding celebration of the Lamb!” And he said to me, “These are the true words of God.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:10
verses.text: And I fell down before his feet to worship him, and he said to me, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Do not do that!⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do not see to it”</note> I am a fellow slave of you and of your brothers who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”  <div eID="gen28269" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12204"/><title type="x-s">The Warrior on the White Horse</title> <div sID="gen28270" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12204"/>And I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and the one seated on it was called “Faithful” and “True,” and with justice<note placement="foot">Or “in righteousness”</note> he judges and makes war.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:12
verses.text: Now his eyes <transChange type="added">were</transChange> a flame of fire, and on his head <transChange type="added">were</transChange> many royal headbands having a name written that no one except he himself knows.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:13
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">he was</transChange> dressed in an outer garment dipped in blood, and his name is called the Word of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:14
verses.text: And the armies <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> in heaven, dressed in clean, white fine linen, were following him on white horses.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:15
verses.text: And out of his mouth came a sharp sword, so that with it he could strike the nations. And he will shepherd them with an iron rod,<note placement="foot">An allusion to <reference osisRef="Ps.2.9">Ps 2:9</reference></note> and he stomps the winepress of the wine of the furious wrath of God, the All-Powerful.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:16
verses.text: And he has a name written on his outer garment and on his thigh: “King of kings and Lord of lords.”  <div eID="gen28270" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:17
