verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12205"/><div sID="gen28271" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12205"/>And I saw one angel standing in the sun, and he cried out with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞directly overhead⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally, “in midheaven”</note>, <div eID="gen28271" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28272"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28273"/>“Come! Assemble for the great banquet of God, <l eID="gen28273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12206"/><l level="1" sID="gen28274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12206"/>in order that you may eat the flesh of kings,<l eID="gen28274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28275"/>and the flesh of military tribunes,<l eID="gen28275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28276"/>and the flesh of the powerful,<l eID="gen28276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28277"/>and the flesh of horses and those seated on them,<l eID="gen28277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28278"/>and the flesh of all <transChange type="added">people</transChange>,<l eID="gen28278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28279"/>both free and slave,<l eID="gen28279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28280"/>and small and great!” <l eID="gen28280" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28272"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12207"/><div sID="gen28281" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12207"/>And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies assembled to make war with the one who is seated on the horse and with his army.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:20
verses.text: And the beast was seized, and with him the false prophet who performed the signs before him, by which he deceived those who received the mark of the beast and those who had worshiped his image. The two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulphur.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:21
verses.text: And the rest were killed by the sword of the one who is seated on the horse—the <transChange type="added">sword</transChange> that comes out of his mouth—and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.  <chapter eID="Rev.19"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12208"/><title type="x-s">Satan Bound for a Thousand Years</title> <div sID="gen28282" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12208"/>And I saw an angel descending from heaven, holding the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:2
verses.text: And he seized the dragon—the ancient serpent, who is the devil and Satan—and bound him <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a thousand years,

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:3
verses.text: and threw him into the abyss, and shut <transChange type="added">it</transChange> and sealed <transChange type="added">it</transChange> above him, in order that he could not deceive the nations again until the thousand years are completed. After these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> it is necessary <transChange type="added">for</transChange> him to be released <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a short time.  <div eID="gen28282" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12209"/><div sID="gen28283" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12209"/>And I saw thrones, and they sat down on them, and authority to judge was granted to them. And <transChange type="added">I saw</transChange> the souls of those who had been beheaded because of the testimony about Jesus and because of the word of God, and who had not worshiped the beast or his image, and did not receive the mark on their<note placement="foot">*Literally “the”; the Greek article is used here as a possessive pronoun</note> forehead and on their hand, and they came to life and reigned with Christ <transChange type="added">for</transChange> a thousand years.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:5
verses.text: (The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed.) This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the first resurrection.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:6
verses.text: Blessed and holy <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the one who has a part in the first resurrection. Over this person the second death has no authority, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and they will reign with him a thousand<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “for the thousand”</note> years.  <div eID="gen28283" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12210"/><title type="x-s">Satan’s Release and Defeat</title> <div sID="gen28284" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12210"/>And when the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his prison

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:8
verses.text: and he will go out to deceive the nations <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to assemble them for battle, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞whose number⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of whom the number of them”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like the sand of the sea.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:9
verses.text: And they went up on the broad plain of the earth and surrounded the fortified camp of the saints and the beloved city, and fire came down from heaven and consumed them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:10
verses.text: And the devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulphur, where the beast and the false prophet also <transChange type="added">are</transChange>, and they will be tormented day and night <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>.  <div eID="gen28284" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12211"/><title type="x-s">The Judgment at the Great White Throne</title> <div sID="gen28285" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12211"/>And I saw a great white throne and the one who was seated on it, <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞from whose presence⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “from the presence of whom”</note> earth and heaven fled, and a place was not found for them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:12
verses.text: And I saw the dead—the great and the small—standing before the throne, and books were opened. And another book was opened, which is the <transChange type="added">book</transChange> of life, and the dead were judged by what was written in the books, according to their deeds.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:13
verses.text: And the sea gave up the dead <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> in it, and Death and Hades gave up the dead <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> in them, and each one was judged according to their deeds.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:14
verses.text: And Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death—the lake of fire.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:15
verses.text: And if anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.  <chapter eID="Rev.20"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12212"/><title type="x-s">The New Heaven, New Earth, and New Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen28286" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12212"/>And I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea did not exist <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:2
verses.text: And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:3
verses.text: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, <div eID="gen28286" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28287"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28288"/>“Behold, the dwelling of God <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with humanity,<l eID="gen28288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28289"/>and he will take up residence with them,<l eID="gen28289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28290"/>and they will be his people<l eID="gen28290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28291"/>and God himself will be with them.<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “with them as their God”</note> <l eID="gen28291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12213"/><l level="1" sID="gen28292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12213"/>And he will wipe away every tear from their eyes,<l eID="gen28292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28293"/>and death will not exist <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer,<l eID="gen28293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28294"/>and<note placement="foot">Literally “or”</note> mourning or wailing or pain will not exist <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer.<l eID="gen28294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28295"/>The former <transChange type="added">things</transChange><note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “any longer, because the former things”</note> have passed away.” <l eID="gen28295" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28287"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12214"/><div sID="gen28296" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12214"/>And the one seated on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> new!” And he said, “Write, because these words are faithful and true.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:6
verses.text: And he said to me, “It is done! I <transChange type="added">am</transChange><note placement="foot">Some manuscripts explicitly state “am”</note> the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the one who is thirsty I will give water from the spring of the water of life freely.<note placement="foot">Or “without charge”</note>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:7
verses.text: The one who conquers will inherit these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, and I will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞his God⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to him God”</note> and he will be <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞my son⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “to me a son”</note>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:8
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as</transChange> for the cowards and unbelievers and detestable persons and murderers and sexually immoral people and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their share <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in the lake that burns with fire and sulphur, which is the second death.  <div eID="gen28296" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12215"/><title type="x-s">A Description of the New Jerusalem</title> <div sID="gen28297" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12215"/>And one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and spoke with me, saying, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:10
verses.text: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great and lofty mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:11
verses.text: that has the glory of God. Its radiance <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like a precious stone, <transChange type="added">something</transChange> like a jasper stone, shining like crystal.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:12
verses.text: It has<note placement="foot">Literally “having,” referring back to the city mentioned in v. <reference osisRef="Rev.21.11">11</reference></note> a great and high wall that has twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on the gates which are<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “which are the names”</note> of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel—

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:13
verses.text: on the east, three gates, and on the north, three gates, and on the south, three gates, and on the west, three gates.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:14
verses.text: And the wall of the city has twelve foundations, and on them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.  <div eID="gen28297" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12216"/><div sID="gen28298" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12216"/>And the one who spoke with me was holding a golden measuring rod in order that he could measure the city and its gates and its wall.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:16
verses.text: And the city is laid out as a square, and its length is the same as <transChange type="added">its</transChange> width. And he measured the city with the measuring rod at twelve thousand stadia;<note placement="foot">Or “two thousand two hundred kilometers”; or “fourteen hundred miles” (a <hi type="italic">stade</hi> was a unit of length about 185 meters or 607 feet)</note> the length and the width and the height of it are equal.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:17
verses.text: And he measured its wall, one hundred forty-four cubits<note placement="foot">This number in cubits amounts to 12 times 12; it would be about 65 meters (216 feet)</note> <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞according to human measure⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “according to the measure of a man”</note>, which is the angel’s.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:18
verses.text: And the material of its wall <transChange type="added">is</transChange> jasper, and the city <transChange type="added">is</transChange> pure gold, similar in appearance to pure glass.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:19
verses.text: The foundations of the wall of the city are adorned with every kind of precious stone: the first foundation jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:20
verses.text: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:21
verses.text: And the twelve gates <transChange type="added">are</transChange> twelve pearls, each one of the gates was from a single pearl. And the street of the city <transChange type="added">is</transChange> pure gold, like transparent glass.  <div eID="gen28298" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12217"/><div sID="gen28299" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12217"/>And I did not see a temple in it, for the Lord God All-Powerful is its temple, and the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:23
verses.text: And the city has no need of the sun or of the moon, that they shine on it, for the glory of God illuminates it, and its lamp <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:24
verses.text: And the nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:25
verses.text: And its gates will never be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:26
verses.text: and they will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:27
verses.text: And every unclean thing and one who practices<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “and the one who practices”</note> detestable things and falsehood will never enter into it, except those who are written in the book of life of the Lamb.  <chapter eID="Rev.21"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12218"/><title type="x-s">Paradise Restored</title> <div sID="gen28300" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12218"/>And he showed me the river of the water of life, clear as crystal, coming out from the throne of God and of the Lamb

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:2
verses.text: in the middle of its street, and <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞on both sides of the river⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “of the river from here and from there”</note> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the tree of life, producing twelve fruits—yielding its fruit according to every month—and the leaves of the tree <transChange type="added">are</transChange> for the healing of the nations.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:3
verses.text: And there will not be any curse <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer, and the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his slaves will serve<note placement="foot">Or “will worship”</note> him,

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:4
verses.text: and they will see his face, and his name <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> on their foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:5
verses.text: And night will not exist <transChange type="added">any</transChange> longer, and they will not have need of the light of a lamp and the light<note placement="foot">Some manuscripts have “of the light”</note> of the sun, because the Lord God will give light to them, and they will reign <milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞forever and ever⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “for the ages of the ages”</note>.  <div eID="gen28300" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12219"/><title type="x-s">The Time of Fulfillment is Near</title> <div sID="gen28301" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12219"/>And he said to me, “These words <transChange type="added">are</transChange> faithful and true, and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his slaves <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> which must take place in a short time.”  <div eID="gen28301" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12220"/><div sID="gen28302" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12220"/>“And behold, I am coming quickly! Blessed <transChange type="added">is</transChange> the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”  <div eID="gen28302" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12221"/><div sID="gen28303" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12221"/>And I, John, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> the one who heard and who saw these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>. And when I heard and saw <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who showed these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> to me.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:9
verses.text: And he said to me, “<milestone type="x-idiom-start"/>⌞Do not do that!⌟<milestone type="x-idiom-end"/><note placement="foot">Literally “do not see to it”</note> I am your fellow slave, and of your brothers the prophets, and of those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:10
verses.text: And he said to me, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near!

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:11
verses.text: The one who does evil, let him do evil still, and the defiled, let him be defiled still, and the righteous, let him practice righteousness still, and the holy, let him be holy still.”  <div eID="gen28303" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12222"/><div sID="gen28304" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12222"/>“Behold, I am coming quickly, and my reward <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with me, to repay each one according to <transChange type="added">what</transChange> his deeds are!

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:13
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.”  <div eID="gen28304" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12223"/><div sID="gen28305" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12223"/>Blessed <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the ones who wash their robes, so that their authority will be over the tree of life and they may enter into the city through the gates.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:15
verses.text: Outside <transChange type="added">are</transChange> the dogs and the sorcerers and the sexually immoral people and the murderers and the idolaters and everyone who loves and who practices falsehood.  <div eID="gen28305" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12224"/><div sID="gen28306" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12224"/>“I, Jesus, sent my angel to testify to you about these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David, the bright morning star.”  <div eID="gen28306" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12225"/><title type="x-s">An Invitation to Respond</title> <div sID="gen28307" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12225"/>And the Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” And the one who hears, let him say, “Come!” And the one who is thirsty, let him come. The one who wants, let him take the water of life freely.<note placement="foot">Or “without cost”</note>  <div eID="gen28307" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12226"/><title type="x-s">A Final Warning</title> <div sID="gen28308" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12226"/>I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues written in this book.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:19
verses.text: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share of the tree of life and from the holy city that are written in this book.  <div eID="gen28308" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12227"/><div sID="gen28309" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12227"/>The one who testifies about these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> says, “Yes, I am coming quickly!” Amen! Come, Lord Jesus!  <div eID="gen28309" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12228"/><div sID="gen28310" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12228"/>The grace of the Lord Jesus <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with all.<note placement="foot">Many manuscripts add “Amen”; some manuscripts add “the saints. Amen”</note> </leb>  <chapter eID="Rev.22"/> <div eID="gen28310" type="x-p"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen27956" osisID="Rev" type="book"/>
